ātmā buddhyā samarthyārthān mano yuṅkte vivakṣayā |
manaḥ kāyāgnimāhanti sa prerayati mārutam ||
ityevamādi |
tathāparaḥ paṭhati--"vāyuḥ koṣṭhasthānamanupradānamāpadyate | sa kaṇṭhagataḥ śvāsatāṃ nādatāṃ vā" ityādi |
athāpara āha--"mano'bhihataḥ kāyāgniḥ prāṇamudīrayati | sa nābherudyan mūrdhanyabhihato'nyena punarudyatā marutābhihanyamāno dhvaniḥ sampadyate, ka iti vā kha iti vā" ityevamādi pratiśākhaṃ śikṣāsu bhinnamāgamadarśanaṃ dṛśyamānaṃ sarvaṃ prapañcena samarthayitavyam || 112 - 115 ||
ajastravṛttiryaḥ śabda sūkṣmatvānnopalabhyate |
vyañjanād vāyuriva sa svanimittāt pratīyate || 116 ||
athāpara āgamo'nugamyate--sūkṣmo vāyusaṃnicaya ivāntarbahiśca sarvamūrttonāṃ dhvaniravasthitaḥ | sa caikeṣāmākāśa iti pratipadyate | sa yathaiva tu sarvatra paramāṇusaṃbhave saṃhatatvād vyajanābhighātena vāyurāśrayasthānāt pravibhajyamānaḥ kriyābhirāviśyate, tathaiva dhvaniḥ svanimittairabhivyaktapracitavikriyārūpaḥ śrotrapradeśaṃ prāpta upalabhyate saṃskaroti ca || 116 ||
tasya prāṇe ca yā śaktiryā ca buddhau vyavasthitā |
vivartamānā sthāneṣu saiṣā bhedaṃ prapadyate || 117 ||
pakṣabhedā evaite | nāyamanantaraḥ pracayadharmādhvaniriha śloke nirdiśyate | śabdastu pūrvaprakṛtaḥ pravādabhedairanvākhyāyate | śabdaḥ khalu prāṇādhiṣṭhāno buddhyadhiṣṭhānaśca |
sa tu dvābhyāṃ prāṇabuddhimātrāśaktibhyāṃ pratilabdhābhivyaktirarthaṃ pratyāyayati |
tatra prāṇo buddhitattvenāntarāviṣṭaḥ | sa cordhvamabhipravṛtto jvālāvad varṇasthāneṣvākṣepakaprayatnānuvidhāyī prativighātavivartena nityaśabdopagrāhiṇā vivartate |
sa ca saṃsṛṣṭaprāptaśaktivivartaḥ pṛthivīkalalanyagrodhadhānādivad bhepamupagṛhṇāti, bhedānurāgamātraṃ ca parasminnabhede śabdātmani saṃniveśayati || 117 ||
śabdeṣvevāśritā śaktirviśvasyāsya nibandhanī |
yannetraḥ pratibhātmāyaṃ bhedarūpaḥ pratīyate || 118 ||
tatra keṣāñcidākṛtayaḥ sūkṣmaśabdādhiṣṭhānanibandhanāḥ | tāḥ khalvātmābhivyaktimadhiṣṭhānapariṇāmena pratilabhamānā vācyavācakabhāvena vyavatiṣṭhante | yathāpareṣāmindriyeṣu viṣayamātraśaktayaḥ pratilayaṃ gacchanti, tathendriyamātrāśaktayo buddhiṣu, buddhimātrāśaktayaḥ pratisaṃhratakrame vāgātmani |
sā ceyaṃ svapnaprabodhapravṛttiḥ pravibhaktapuruṣānukārā mahatyapi vāktattve kāraṇe nityamavasthitā |
tathā'pare'pyāhuḥ--
vāgevārthaṃ paśyati vāg bravīti vāgevārthaṃ nihitaṃ santanoti |
vācyeva viśvaṃ bahurūpaṃ nibaddhaṃ tadetadekaṃ pravibhajyopabhuṅ‌kte || 118 ||
ṣaḍ‌jādibhedaḥ śabdena vyākhyāto rūpyate yataḥ |
tasmādarthavidhāḥ sarvāḥ śabdamātrāsu niśritāḥ || 119 ||
saṃvijñānapadanibandhano hi sarvo'rthaḥ smṛtinirūpaṇayā'bhijalpanirūpaṇayākāranirūpaṇayā ca nirūpyamāṇo vyavahāramavatarati |
ṣaḍ‌jaṛṣabhagāndhāradhaivatiniṣādapañjamamadhyamānāṃ cānavasthitaprasiddhasaṃvijñānapadānāṃviśeṣo'vadhāraṇanibandhanapadapratyayamantareṇa nāvadhāryate | gopālāvipālādayo hi nibandhanapaḍhāni prakalpya gavādiṣu viśeṣaviṣayaṃ vyavahāramārabhante |
tasmāt samākhyeyeṣvasamākhyeyeṣu ca sāmānyaviśeṣaśabdeṣvadhyārūḍho bhedavānarthaḥ śabdaśaktisaṃsṛṣṭyā śabdānuviddhayā śabdātmikayā buddhyā prakāśyata upagṛhyate svīkriyate || 119 ||
śabdasya pariṇāmo'yamityāmnāyavido viduḥ |
chandobhya eva prathamametad viśvaṃ vyavartata || 120 ||
yathaivānye kāryakāraṇabhāvamācakṣāṇāḥ kāryeṣu kāraṇadharmasamanvayaṃ dṛṣṭ‌vā vyāvṛttabhedaṃ sūkṣmamasaṃvedyaṃ sarvavikāraśaktyanugataṃ pratyastamitavyaktirūpamaṇugrāmaṃ pradhānaśaktisamūhamavidyākāraṇaṃ janmapariṇāmāsaṃsargaṃ vivartaṃ vyavasthāpayanti, tathaivāmnāye saṃhratabhogyabhoktṛśaktervāgātmano bahudhā kāraṇatvamāmnātam--"sa u evaiṣa ṛṅ‌mayo yajurmayaḥ sāmamayo vairājaḥ puruṣaḥ | puruṣo vai lokaḥ | puruṣo yajñaḥ | tasyaitā lokampṛṇāstistra āhutayastā eva tryālikhitā vai trayo lokāḥ" iti |
tathā--"eṣa vai chandasyaḥ sāmamayaḥ prathamo'kṣan vairājaḥ puruṣo yo'nnamasṛjata tasmāt paśavo'nvajāyanta | paśubhyo vanaspatayaḥ , vanaspatibhyo'gniḥ | tasmādāhurna dārupātreṇa duhyādagnirvā eṣa dārupātram | tasmānna dārupātreṇa duhyate" (iti) |
ṛgvarṇaḥ khalvapi--
indrācchandaḥ prathamaṃ prāsyadannaṃ tasmādime nāmarūpe viṣūcī |
nāma prāṇācchandasorūpamutpannamekaṃ chando buhudhā cākaśīti ||
tathā punarāha--
vāgeva śiśvā bhuvanāni jajñe vāca itsarvamamṛtaṃ yacca martyaṃm |
athedvāg bubhuje vāguvāca purutrā vāco na padaṃ yacca nāha ||
purākalpo'pyāha--
vibhajya bahudhātmānaṃ sa cchandasyaḥ prajāpatiḥ |
chandomayībhirmātrābhirbahudhaiva viveśa tam ||
sādhvī vāg‌bhūyasī yeṣu puruṣeṣu vyavasthitā |
adhikaṃ vartate teṣu puṇyaṃ rūpaṃ prajāpate| ||
prājāpatyaṃ mahattejastatpātrairiva saṃvṛtam |
śarīrabhede viduṣāṃ svāṃ yonimupadhāvati ||
yadetanmaṇḍalaṃ bhāsvad dhāma citrasya rādhasaḥ |
tadbhāvamabhisaṃbhūya vidyāyāṃ pravilīyate || 120 ||
itikarttavyatā loke sarvā śabdavyapāśrayā |
yāṃ pūrvāhitasaṃskāro bālo'pi pratipadyate || 121 ||
sadapi vāg‌vyavahāreṇānupagṛhītamarthaṃrūpamasatā tulyam | atyantāsacca prasiddhaṃ loke śaśaviṣāṇādi, prāptāvirbhāvatirobhāvaṃ ca gantharvanagarādi vācā samutthāpyamānaṃ mukhyasattāyuktamiva teṣu kāryeṣu pratyavabhāsate |
samāviṣṭavācāṃ ca svajātiṣu bālānāmapi pūrvaśabdāveśabhāvanāsaṃskārādhānāt tāsu tāsvarthakriyāsvanākhyeyaśabdanibandhanā pratipattirutpadyate || 121 ||
ādyaḥ karaṇavinyāsaḥ prāṇasyordhvaṃ samīraṇam |
sthānānāmabhighātaśca na vinā śabdabhāvanām || 122 ||
anādiścaiṣā śabdabhāvanā pratipuruṣamavasthitajñānabījaparigrahā | na hayetasyāḥ kathañcit pauruṣeyatvaṃ saṃbhavati |
tathā hyanupadeśasādhyāḥ pratibhāgamyā eva karaṇavinyāsādayaḥ | ko hyetān puruṣadharmānanyatra śabdātmikatāyā kartuṃ pratipādayituṃ vā samartha iti || 122 ||
na so'sti pratyayo loke yaḥ śabdānugamādṛte |
anuviddhamiva jñānaṃ sarvaṃ śabdena bhāsate || 123 ||
yathāsya saṃhratarūpā śabdabhāvanā tathā jñeyeṣvartheṣutpannenāpyavikalpakena kāryaṃ na kriyate |
tadyathā tvaritaṃ gacchatastṛṇaloṣṭādisaṃsparśāt satyapi jñāne kācideva sā jñānāvasthā, yasyāmabhimukhībhūtaśabdabhāvanābījāyāmāvirbhūtāsvarthopagrāhiṇāmākhyeyarūpāṇāmanākhyeyarūpāṇāṃ ca śabdānāṃ pratyarthaniyatāsu śaktiṣu śabdānuviddhena śaktyanupātinā jñānenākriyamāṇa upagṛhyamāṇo vastvātmā jñānānugato vyaktarūpapratyavabhāso jñāyata ityabhidhīyate | sa ca nimittāntarādāvirbhavātsu śrutibījeṣu smṛtiheturbhavati |
tathaikeṣāmācāryāṇāṃ suptasyāpi jāgrad‌vṛttyā sadṛśo jñānavṛttiprabandhaḥ | kevalaṃ tu śabdabhāvanābījāni tadā sūkṣmāṃ vṛttiṃ pratilabhante | tasmāt tāmasīṃ ceti tāmavasthāmāhuḥ | tadetat saṃjñānaṃ śabdaprakṛtivikārabhāvenāvirbhāvatirobhāvāvajastṃṣa pratyanubhavati || 123 ||
vāgrūpatā cedutkrāmedavabodhasya śāśvatī |
na prakāśaḥ prakāśeta sā hi pratyavamarśinī || 124 ||
yathā prakāśakatvamagneḥ svarūpaṃ caitanyaṃ vāntaryāmiṇaḥ, tathā jñānamapi sarvaṃ vāgrūpamātrānugatam | yāpyasañcetitāvasthā tasyāmapi sūkṣmo vāgdharmānugamo'bhyāvartate |
yo'pi prathamopanipātī bāhyeṣvartheṣu prakāśaḥ sa nimittānāmaparigraheṇa vastusvarūpamātramidaṃ tadityavyapadeśyayā vṛttyā pratyavabhāsayati |
smṛtikāle'pi ca tādṛśānāmupalabdhibījānāmābhimukhye smartavyeṣu ślokādiṣu prakāśānugamamātrarūpamiva buddhau viparivartate | ko'pyasāvanuvākaḥ śloko vā yo'yaṃ mayā śrutimātreṇa prakānta iti |
vāgrūpatāyāṃ cāsatyāmutpanno'pi prakāśaḥ pararūpamanaṅgīkurvan prakāśanakriyāsadhanarūpatāyāṃ na vyavatiṣṭhate | bhinnarūpāṇāṃ cānupakāriṇātmāntarātmanāmitaretarasya vastumātrājñāne pratyavabhāsamāne yaduttarakālamanusaṃdhānaṃ pratyavamarśa ekārthakāritvavibhāgena śaktisaṃsargayogopagrahaḥ, tad‌ vāgrūpatāyāṃ baddham |
sā hyanusandadhānā pratyavamṛśantī ca sarvaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭe'pyarthakriyākāriṇi pratyaye śaktyapoddhārakalpanayā bhedasaṃsargamātrāṃ na vijahāti || 124 ||
sā sarvavidyāśilpānāṃ kalānāṃ copabandhanī |
tadvaśādabhiniṣpannaṃ sarvaṃ vastu vibhajyate || 125 ||
vidyāśilpakalādibhirlaukikeṣu vaidikeṣu cārtheṣu manuṣyāṇāṃ prāyeṇa vyavahāraḥ pratibaddhaḥ |
manuṣyādhīnāścetarasya bhūtagrāmasya sthāvarajaṅgamasya pratṛttayaḥ | vidyādayaśca vāgrūpāyāṃ buddhau nibaddhāḥ |
ghaṭādīnāṃ cābhiniṣpādane prayojyaprayojakānāmupadeśasamīhādi sarvaṃ vāgrūpatānusāreṇa prakalpate || 125 ||
saiṣā saṃsāriṇāṃ saṃjñā bahirantaśca vartate |
tanmātrāmapyatikrāntaṃ caitanyaṃ sarvajātiṣu || 126 ||
yo'yaṃ caitanye vāgrūpatānugamastena loke sasaṃjño visaṃjña iti vyapadeśaḥ kriyate | evaṃ hyāha--
arthakriyāsu vāk‌ sarvān samīhayati dehinaḥ |
tadutkrāntau visaṃjño'yaṃ dṛśyate kāṣṭhakuḍyavat || iti |
antaḥ saṃjñānāmapi sukhaduḥ khasaṃvinmātrā yāvad vāgrūpatānuvṛttistāvadeva bhavati | bahiḥ saṃjñeṣu | tannibaṃdhano lokavyavahārastadabhāvānniyatamutsīdet |
nahī sā cetanyenāviṣṭā jātirasti, yasyāṃ svaparasambodho yo vācā nānugamyate | tasmāccitikriyārūpamalabdhavākśāktiparigrahaṃ na vidyate |
vāktattvarūpameva citikriyārūpamityanye | tathāha---
bhedod‌grāhavivartena labdhākāraparigrahā |
āmnātā sarvavidyāsu vāgeva prakṛtiḥ parā ||
ekatvamanatikrāntā vāṅ‌netrā vāṅ‌nibaṃdhanāḥ |
pṛthak pratyavabhāsante vāgvibāga gavādayaḥ ||
ṣaḍ‌dvārāṃ ṣaḍadhiṣṭhānāṃ ṣaṭ‌prabodhāṃ ṣaḍavyayām |
te mṛtyumativartante ye vai vācamupāsate || 126 ||
pravibhāge yathā kartā tayā kārye pravartate |
avibhāge tathā saiva kāryatvenāvatiṣṭhate || 127 ||
pravibhaktasādhyasādhanarūpo hi śabdabrahmaṇo vivartaḥ | prāptajanmādivikriyā vāgvibhāgagranthayo jāgaraṇavṛttikāle vāgrūpatāmanugacchantyo nivṛttivikriyāprāptibhiḥ kāryeṣu yatante | svapnādyavibhāge tu saiva vāgaviṣayā bāhyavastusvarūpā satī nirvṛttivikriyāprāptiṣu karmabhāvaṃ pratipadyate | āha ca ---
pravibhajyātmanātmānaṃ sṛṣṭ‌vā bhāvān pṛthagvidhān |
sarveśvaraḥ sarvamayaḥ svapne bhoktā pravata te || 127 ||
svamātrā paramātrā vā śrutyā prakramyate yathā |
tathaiva rūḍhatāmeti tayā hyartho vidhīyate || 128 ||
sarvo hi vikāra ātmamātreti keṣāñcid darśanam | sa tu pratipuruṣamantaḥ saṃniviṣṭo bāhya iva pratyavabhāsate | rūḍhatvācca vyavahāramātramidamantarbahiriti | na hyetadekatve'mūrtatve vā saṃbhavati |
apareṣāṃ sarvaprabodharūpaḥ sarvaprabhedarūpaścaikasya citikriyātattvasyāyaṃ pariṇāma ityādi svamātrāvādināṃ darśanam |
caitanyaṃ bhūtayonistilakṣodarasavat pravibhajyata ityeke |
anye tvāhuḥ-- tadyathā mahato'gnervisphulaṅgāḥ sūkṣmād vāyorabhraghanāścandrakāntād vibhāginyastoyadhārāḥ pṛthivyā vā sālādayo nyagrodhadhānādibhyo vā sāvarohaprasavā nyagrodhā ityevamādi paramātrāvadināṃ darśanam | svaparamātrāvādināṃ darśanaṃ vidyābhāṣyebhyaḥ pratipattavyam |
śrutyā prakramyate | śabdenāntaḥ saṃniveśinā sukhaduḥ khādibhāvena nānāprāṇiṣu bahudhā prakramyate,, loṣṭakṣepapātādiṣu ca lokabhāvanāsamayena prasiddhyā vyavatiṣṭhate | tayā hyartho vidhīyata iti | saiva hi śrutirarthaṃ kalpayati saṃskaroti || 128 ||
atyantamatathābhūte nimitte śrutyupāśrayāt |
dṛśyate'lātacakrādau vastvākāranirūpaṇā || 129 ||
śrutireva hi sarvaṃ śabdarthaṃ svarūpapadātmani saṃniviṣṭaṃ darśayati | sā tamarthaṃ janayatīva | sa hi tasyāṃ pratyāyyātmanā nityamavasthitaḥ | na ca bāhyavastugataṃ sadasattvaṃ śrutirapekṣate, nāpi viparyayāviparyayau |
tathā hyalātacakre'pi sarvapradeśavyāpirūpā ca kriyādiśabdarūpabhāvanānugatā śrutiravatiṣṭhamānā'lātacakrādiśabdānāṃ vyāvahārikāṇāmarthavattāṃ prakalpayati | tacchrutibījābhimukhye tathābhūtanimittayā śrutyā prakalpito vatsvākāraḥ satyapyanumānabalīyastve rūḍhībhavati |
atyantāsatsu ca nirjñāteṣu śaśaviṣāṇādiṣu śrutirevārthaṃ janayati prakalpayati svātmanyavaruṇaddhi | tathainānyān pratyakṣānarthān |
nityasaṃniviṣṭo hi sanibandhanaścānibandhanaśca śabdeṣvabhidheyatvenārthātmā, pratipuruṣaṃ tu bhāvanānuvidhāyinī satyasati vārthe svapratyayānukāreṇa bhinnarūpā śabdebhyaḥ pratipattirupapadyate || 129 ||
api prayokturātmānaṃ śabdamantaravasthitam |
prāhurmahāntamṛṣabhaṃ yena sāyujyamiṣyate || 130 ||
iha dvau śabdātmānau--nityaḥ kāryaśca | tatra kāryo vyavahārikaḥ puruṣasya vāgātmanaḥ pratibimbopagrāhī |
nityastu sarvavyavahārayoniḥ saṃhṛtakramaḥ sarvoṣāmantaḥ saṃniveśī prabhavo vikāraṇāmāśrayaḥ karmaṇāmadhiṣṭhānaṃ sukhaduḥ khayoḥ, sarvatrāpratihatakāryaśaktirghaṭādirniruddhaivaṃ prakāśaḥ parigṛhītabhogakṣetrāvadhiḥ, sarvamūrtonāmaparimāṇā prakṛtiḥ, sarvaprabodharūpatayā sarvaprabhedarūpatayā ca nityapravṛttapratyavabhāsasvapnaprabodhānukārī pravṛttinivṛttipadābhyāṃ parjaṃnyavad davāgnivacca prasavocchedaśaktiyuktaḥ sarveśvaraḥ sarvaśaktirmahān śabdavṛṣabhaḥ, tasmina, khalu vāgyogavido vicchidyahaṅkāragranthīnatyantavinirbhāgeṇa saṃsṛjyante |
āha ca--
catvāri śrṛṅgā trayo asya pādā dve śīrṣe sapta hastāso asya |
tridhā baddho vṛṣabho roravīti maho devo martyāṃ āviveśa || 130 ||
tasmād yaḥ śabdasaṃskāraḥ sā siddhiḥ paramātmanaḥ |
tasya pravṛttitattvajñastad bahmāmṛtamaśnute || 131 ||
vyavasthitasādhubhāvena hi rūpeṇa saṃskriyamāṇe śabdatattve'pabhraṃśopaghātāpagamādāvirbhūte dharmaviśeṣe niyato'bhyudayaḥ | tadabhyāsācca śabdapūrvakaṃ yogamadhigamya pratibhāṃtattvaprabhavāṃ bhāvavikāraprakṛtiṃ sattāṃ sādhyasādhanaśaktiyuktāṃ samyagavabuddhya niyatā kṣemaprāptiriti |
āha ca--
prāṇavṛttimatikrānte vācastattve vyavasthitaḥ |
kramasaṃhārayogena saṃhṛtyātmānamātmani ||
vācaḥ saṃskāramādhāya vācaṃ jñāne niveśya ca |
vibhajya bandhanānyasyāḥ kṛtvā tāṃ chinnabandhanām ||
jyotirāntaramāsādya cchinnagranthiparigrahaḥ |
pareṇa jyotiṣekatvaṃ chitvā granthīn prapadyate || 131 ||
na jātvakartṛkaṃ kaścidāgamaṃ pratipadyate |
bojaṃ sarvāgamāpāye trayyevāto vyavasthitā || 132 ||
sarvapravādeṣvāgamavākyānāṃ praṇetṛparigraheṇa pauruṣeyatvamabhyupagamyate | vedavākyāni tu caitanyavadapauruṣeyāṇi | tānyāgamāntarāṇāṃ praṇetṛṣu vicchinneṣvāgamāntarānusandhāne bījavadavatiṣṭhante || 132 ||
astaṃ yāteṣu vādeṣu kartṛṣvanyaṣvasatsvapi |
śrutismṛtyuditaṃ dharmaṃ loko na vyativartate || 133 ||
iha praṇetṛvadāgamānāmapi pravādeṣu vicchedo (nā) bhyupagamyate | teṣu pratyastamiteṣu yāvadanye praṇetāro notpadyante, āgamantarāṇi ca na pratāyante, tatrāpyantarāle śrutivihitāni karmāṇi smṛtinibandhanāṃśca bhakṣyābhakṣyādīn niyamānnātikrāmanti śiṣṭāḥ || 133 ||
jñāne svābhāvike nārthaḥ śāstraiḥ kaścana vidyate |
dharmo jñānasya hetuścet tasyāmnāyo nibandhanam || 134 ||
anupadeśaṃ hi kasyacijjñānamabhyupagacchatāmahitapratiṣedhārthānāṃ hitapratipādanārthānāṃ copadeśaśāstrāṇāṃ vaiyarthyaṃ prasajyate |
yadi hi dharmaviśeṣāt kasyacideva puruṣasyopadeśamantareṇa jñānamutpadyate, kecit tu puruṣāḥ śāstreṇa pratipādayitavyāḥ, tadā tasya puruṣaviśeṣahetordharmasya vyavasthitena nibandhanena bhavitavyam | vicchidyante cānyāni nibandhanāni | tasmādamtāyanibandhanaṃ dharmamāsevamānāḥ pṛthakpravādānāṃ praṇetārastāṃ tāṃ bahuvikalpāṃ siddhiṃ labhante || 134 ||
vedaśāstrāvirodhī ca tarkaścakṣurapaśyatām |
rūpamātrāddhi vākyārthaḥ kevalānnāvatiṣṭhate || 135 ||
āgamavākyānāmeva hi śabdārthapravibhāgavyavasthā tarkeṇa kriyate | sa cāyamarvāgdarśanānāmanugrahe vartata iti pūrvairnyāyavidyāsvitthambhūtastarka āśritaḥ |
tatra yāvānanugamyamānastarkaḥ svaśāstraṃ na bādhate, tāvānanugantavyaḥ | tarkātītamapi bahu śraddhānugamyaṃ sarveṣu śāstreṣu dṛśyate |
atha tarkānanugamena yaḥ kevalamāgamaṃ pramāṇaṃ karoti, tasya kiṃ prayojanam ? āgamavākyānāṃ samyak pratipattiḥ prayojanam | vākyānāṃ hi tulyarūpatve'pi sati nimittāntarācchaktirbhidyate |
tatra yo rūpādeva kevalād vākyārthaṃ pratipadyate, prakaraṇasāmarthyādi nāpekṣate, sa vivakṣitāvivakṣitayoḥ saṃmohamāpadyate || 135 ||
sato'vivakṣā pārārthyaṃ vyaktirarthasya laiṅgikī |
iti nyāyo bahuvidhastarkeṇa pravibhajyate || 136 ||
karturīpsitatamaṃ karma, tasyāpatyam, grahaṃ saṃmārṣṭi, karmaṇā yamabhipraiti sasaṃpradānam |
"striyaṃ ye cepajīvanti prāptāste mṛtalakṣaṇam" iti liṅgasaṃkhyākālānāmavivakṣā kvacicca vivakṣeti lakṣaṇavyavasthāpanaṃ tarkādhīnam |
tathā ca--"nakṣatraṃ dṛṣṭ‌vā vācaṃ visṛjeta" iti kālopalakṣaṇārtha nakṣatradarśanaṃ tat pradhānasyānyathāsiddhau parārthatvād dṛśyamāneṣu jyotiḥ ṣu kālaviśeṣaparicchede sati tat kriyate |
`kākebhyo dadhi rakṣyatām' ityupaghātapratiṣedhasya cikīrṣitatvāt kākeṣvasatsvapi śvādibhyo rakṣyate | `pātrāṇi saṃmṛjyantām' iti bhujikriyāṅgopasaṃhāraparatvāt pātrābhāve'pyaṅgāntarāṇyupasaṃhriyante |
laiṅgikī khalvapi vyaktiḥ | "aktāḥ śarkarā upadadhāti" iti sarvāñjanadravyaprasaṅge "tejo vai ghṛtam" iti liṅgādviśeṣapratipattirityevaṃprakāro nyāyastarkeṇa pravibhajya lakṣaṇaṃ vyavasthāpyate || 136 ||
śabdānāmeva sā śaktistarko yaḥ puruṣāśrayaḥ |
śabdānanugato nyāyo'nāgameṣvanibandhanaḥ || 137 ||
śabda evopadeṣṭā, tatsāmarthyamevānugacchanto vaktāro yogyaśabdanibandhanayaiva vivakṣayā pravartante |
niyatāṃ tu śabdaśaktimarthaprakaraṇaliṅgavākyādibhiranugacchati puruṣe śabdāśritameva sāmarthyaṃ puruṣāśrayo'yaṃ tarka iti manyante, śabdaśaktirūpāparigṛhītastu sādharmyavaidharmyamātrānusārī sarvāgamopaghātahetutvādanibandhanaḥ śuṣkastarka ityucyate |
tadyathā--
yadudumbaravarṇānāṃ ghaṭīnāṃ maṇḍalaṃ mahat |
pītaṃ na gamayet svargaṃ kiṃ tat kratugataṃ nayet ||
śabdena vācmamityukte drāmilakena bhavati vaktavyamiti || 137 ||
rūpādayo yathā dṛṣṭāḥ pratyarthaṃ yataśaktayaḥ |
śabdāstathaiva dṛśyante viṣāpaharaṇādiṣu || 138 ||
jñāne śāstrapūrvake vā prayoge'bhyudaya ityāgamāt pratipannānāmupapattimātramāgamasyaivopod‌balakamityucyate | ihaiṣāṃ rūparasagandhasparśānāṃ pratyekaṃ samuditānāṃ ca dṛṣṭādṛṣṭaphalāḥ pratyartha yatāḥ śaktayaḥ parigṛhyante | dṛṣṭaphalāstāvad viṣauṣadhyayaskāntavanaspatiprabhṛtīnām |
adṛṣṭaphalā madyatīrthodakādīnām | śabdānāmapi keṣāñciduccāraṇe viṣāpaharaṇādidṛṣṭaṃ phalamupalabhyate | tathā sūktādīnāmabhyāsādabhyupagamyate viśiṣṭamadṛṣṭaṃ phalam ||138
yathaiṣāṃ tatra sāmarthyaṃ dharme'pyevaṃ pratīyatām |
sādhūnāṃ sādhubhistasmād vācyamabhyudayārthinām || 139 ||
santi ceha dṛṣṭaphalāḥ kāścit pratiśabdaṃ śaktaya ityāgamādevāvasīyate | satyāgame sādhūnāmapi tathaivāvasīyatāṃ dharmasādhanatvamityato'bhyudayārthibhiranatiśaṅkanīyāṃ smṛtimavicchinnaśiṣṭasamācārāṃ parigṛhya vyavahāre sādhava eva śabdāḥ prayoktavyāḥ || 139 ||
sarvo|dṛṣṭaphalānarthānāgamāt pratipadyate |
viparītaṃ ca sarvatra śakyate vaktumāgame || 140 ||
tatra kecidāhuḥ--yathaiṣāṃ viṣāpaharaṇādiṣu sāmarthyamadharme'pyevaṃ kasmānna pratīyate ? etasmādeva dṛṣṭāntādastu śaktiviparyayapratipattiriti | etasmin paryanuyoge pratividhīyate---sarveṣvāgameṣu dṛṣṭādṛṣṭaphalāsu pratipattiṣu viparītaphalaprāptiḥśakyate prasaṅ‌ktum | tasmādāgamaṃ kañcit pramāṇīkṛtya vyavasthite tasmin yā kācidupapattirucyamānā pratipattāvupodvalakatvaṃ labhate || 140 ||
sādhutvajñānaviṣayā saiṣā vyākaraṇasmṛtiḥ |
avicchedena śiṣṭānāmidaṃ smṛtinibandhanam || 141 ||
yathaiva bhakṣyābhakṣyagamyāgamyavācyāvācyādiviṣayā vyavasthitāḥ smṛtayaḥ, yāsunibaddhaṃ samācāraṃ śiṣṭā na vyatikrāmanti, tatheyamapi vācyāvācyaviśeṣaviṣayā vyākaraṇākhyā smṛtiḥ | smṛto hyarthaḥ pāramparyādavicchedena punaḥ punarnibadhyate, prasiddhasamācārāyāṃ smṛtāvanibandhanaśabdāyāṃ śiṣṭasamācārāvicchedenaiva smaryate || 141 ||
vaikharyā madhyamāyāśca paśyantyāścaitadad‌bhutam |
anekatīrthabhedāyāstrayyā vācaḥ paraṃ padam || 142 ||
paraiḥ saṃvedyaṃ yasyāḥ śrotraviṣayatvena pratiniyataṃ śrutirūpaṃ sā vaikharī | śliṣṭā vyaktavarṇasamuccāraṇā prasiddhasādhubhāvā bhraṣṭasaṃskārā ca | tathā yā'kṣe yā dundubhau yā veṇau (yā) vīṇāyāmityaparimāṇabhedā |
madhyamā tvantaḥ saṃniveśinī parigṛhītakrameva buddhimātropādānā | sā tu sūkṣmaprāṇavṛttyanugatā kramasaṃhārabhāve'pi vyaktakramaparigrahaiva keṣāñcit |
pratisaṃhṛtakramā satyapyabhede samāviṣṭakramaśaktiḥ paśyantī | sā calācalā pratilabdhasamādhānā cāvṛtā viśuddhā ca, sanniviṣṭajñeyākārā pratilīnākārā nirākārā ca, parichinnārthaṃpratyavabhāsā saṃsṛṣṭārthapratyavabhāsā praśāntasarvārthapratyavabhāsā cetyaparimāṇabhedā |
tatra vyāvahārikīṣu sarvāsu vāgavasthāsu vyavasthitaḥ sādhvasādhupravibhāgaḥ puruṣasaṃskāraheturekeṣām | parantu paśyantīrūpamanapabhraṃśamasaṃkīrṇaṃ lokavyavahārātītam | tasyā eva vāco vyākaraṇena sādhutvajñānalabhyena vā śabdapūrveṇa yogenādhigamyata ityekeṣāmāgamaḥ |
tathetihāseṣu nidarśanānyupalabhyante--
gauriva prakṣaratyekā rasamuttamaśālinī |
divyādivyena rūpeṇa bhāratī gauḥ śucismitā ||
etayorantaraṃ paśya sūkṣyamayoḥ spandamānayoḥ |
prāṇāpānāntare nityamekā sarvasya tiṣṭhati ||
anyā tva (tu) preryamāṇaiva vinā prāṇena vartate |
jāyate hi tataḥ prāṇo vācyamāpyāyayan punaḥ ||
prāṇenāpyāyitā seyaṃ vyavahāranibandhanā |
sarvasyocch‌vāsamāsādya na vāg‌ vadati karhicit |
ghoṣiṇī jātanirghoṣā aghoṣā ca pravartate ||
tayorapi ca ghoṣiṇyornirghoṣaiva garīyasī ||
punaścāha--
sthāneṣu vidhṛte vāyau kṛtavarṇaparigrahā |
vaikharī vāk prayoktṝṇāṃ prāṇavṛttinibandhanā ||
kevalaṃ buddhyupādānā kramarūpānupātinī |
prāṇavṛttimatikramya madhyamā vāk‌ pravartate ||
avibhāga tu paśyantī sarvataḥ saṃhṛtakramā |
svarūpajyotirevāntaḥ sūkṣmā vāganapāyinī ||
seyamākīryamāṇāpi nityamāgantukairmalaiḥ |
antyā kaleva somasya nātyantamabhibhūyate ||
tasyāṃ dṛṣṭasvarūpāyāmadhikāro nivartate |
puruṣe ṣoḍaśakale tāmāhuramṛtāṃ kalām ||
prāptoparāgarūpā sā viplavairanuṣaṅgibhiḥ |
vaikharī sattvamātreva guṇairna vyavakīryate ||
saiṣā trayī vāk caitanyagranthivivartavadanākhyeyaparimāṇā turīyeṇa manuṣyeṣu pratyavabhāsate | tatrāpi cāsyāḥ kiñcideva vyāvahārikam, anyattu sāmānyavyavahārātītam |
āha ca--
catvāri vākparimitā padāni tāni vidurbrāhmaṇā ye manīṣiṇaḥ |
guhā trīṇi nihitā neṅgayanti turīyaṃ vāco manuṣyā vadanti || iti |
tasyāścāsaṃkīrṇaṃ vāco rūpaṃ kārtsnyena sāmānyaviśeṣavatyasmiṃllakṣaṇe vyākaraṇākhye nibaddham |
arvāgdarśanānāṃ tu puruṣāṇāṃ prāyeṇa sātiśayāḥ pratighātinyaḥ sāparādhāḥ śaktayaḥ | niraparādhastu lakṣaṇaprapañcavānanekamārgo'yaṃ śabdānāṃ pratipatyupāyo darśitaḥ || 142 ||
tadvibhāgāvibhāgabhyāṃ kriyamāṇamavasthitam |
svabhāvajñaiśca bhāvānāṃ dṛśyante śabdaśaktayaḥ || 143 ||
vibhāgo nāma parapratipādanāya kalpitaḥ prakṛtipratyayādibhedaḥ | tadyathā--dhātostavyadādaya iti |
tathā coktam--`yattāvadayaṃ sāmānyena śaknotyupadeṣṭu tattāvadupadiśati' iti | avibhāgastu yatra svarūpeṇoccāraṇam | tadyathā--`dādharttidardhartidāśvānsāhvān'iti |
kānicid vyākaraṇāni bahvavibhāgāni bahūn pratyakṣapakṣeṇa śabdān pratipādayanti | kānicit tu vibhajyānumānapakṣeṇa bahūnāṃ samudāyānāṃ pratipādanaṃ kurvanti | saiṣā smṛtiryathākālaṃ puruṣāśaktyapekṣayā tathā tathā vyavasthāpyate | santi tu sādhuprayogānumeyā eva śiṣṭāḥ | sarvajñeyeṣvapratibaddhāntaḥ prakāśāste viśiṣṭākalāvadhipravibhāgāṃ yathākālaṃ dharmā dharmasādhanabhāvena samanvitāṃ śabdaśaktimavyabhicāreṇa paśyanti || 143 ||
anādimavyavacchinnāṃ śrutimāhurartṛkām |
śiṣṭairnibadhyamānā tu na vyavacchidyate smṛtiḥ || 144 ||
ye śabdapramāṇakā eva kevalaṃ sarvameva śāstrapratyayamadṛṣṭaphaleṣvartheṣvabhiśaṅkanīyatvādapramāṇaṃ puruṣasya darśanamiti manyante, teṣāṃ śrutismṛtyoravicchedāviśeṣe tulye cobhayorarthasya nityatve śrutiravyabhicaritasvaravarṇānupūrvyadeśakālaniyamā na kenacitkartrā prakārāntareṇāvasthāpitapūrvā sarvakālaṃ sarvapradeśeṣu praticaraṇaṃ vibhāgena vyavasthāpitā | smṛtistu nityamavicchidyamānārthā gadyaślokavākyādibhedena pratikālamanyathā śiṣṭaireva nibadhyate |
tatra kecidācāryā manyante--na prakṛtyā kiñcit karma dṛṣṭamadṛṣṭaṃ vā (dṛṣṭārthamadṛṣṭārthaṃ vā) | śāstrānuṣṭhānāt tu kevalād dharmābhivyaktiḥ | śāstrātikramācca pratyavāyayogaḥ | yeṣāmeva hi brāhmaṇavadhādīnāṃ viṣayāntare pātakatvam, teṣāmeva viṣayāntare prakṛṣṭābhyudayahetutvaṃ śāstreṇa vidhīyata iti |
anye tu manyante--bhāvaśaktimeva pratiniyataviṣayāṃ śāstramanuvadati | ko hi śāstrasya krīḍata iva kāraṇasya puruṣānugrahopaghātābhyāmarthaḥ | śāstrasvabhāvābhyupagamād dravyasvabhāvābhyupagama eva yuktataro dṛśyate |
tathā hi dṛṣṭārthāsu cikitsādiṣu smṛtiṣu viṣauṣadhādīnāmivārthakriyāsu sāmarthyamupalabhyate,. na smṛtiśāstrāṇām | tasmācchāstrasvabhāva iva pakṣāntare dravyadisvabhāvo'yaṃ śāstreṇānudyate |
yathaivopaghātanimittānyanugrahanimittāni ca loke vyavasthitāni, tathaiva tatpratipattyupāyānāmapyavicchedena vyavasthā vidyate || 144 ||
avibhāgād vivṛttānāmabhikhyā svapnavacchrutau |
bhāvatattvaṃ tu vijñāya liṅgebhyo vihitā smṛtiḥ || 145 ||
yeṣāṃ tāvadiyaṃ nityaiva lokasya vibhāgena pravṛttirnaiva kācid yugamanvantaravyavasthā, nāpi brahmaṇo'sādhāraṇaḥ kaścidahorātravibhāgo vidyata iti darśanam, teṣāmuktaḥ śrutismṛtipravṛttidarmaḥ purastādanantare śloke |
yeṣāṃ tu svapnaprabodhavṛttyā nityaṃ vibhaktapuruṣānukāritayā kāraṇaṃ pravartate, teṣā. mṛṣayaḥ kecit pratibhātmani vivartante, sattālakṣaṇaṃ mahāntamātmānamavidyāyoniṃ paśyantaḥ pratibodhenābhisaṃbhavanti |
kecit tu vidyāyāṃ vivartante | te manogranthimātmānamākāśādiṣu bhūteṣu pratyekaṃ samuditeṣu vā viśuddhamanibaddhaparikalpaṃ tathaivābhisaṃbhavanti | teṣāṃ cāganturavidyāvyavahāraḥ sarva evauparārikaḥ, vidyātmakatvaṃ tu nityamanāntukaṃ mukhyam | te ca svapna ivāśrotragamyaṃ śabdaṃ prajñayaiva sarvamāmnāyaṃ sarvabhedaśaktiyuktamabhinnaśaktiyuktaṃ ca paśyanti |
kecit tu puruṣānugrahopaghātaviṣayaṃ teṣāmarthānāṃ svabhāvamupalabhyāmnāyeṣu kvacit tadviṣayāṇi liṅgāni dṛṣṭvā dṛṣṭādṛṣṭārthāṃ ca smṛtimupanibadhnanti | śrutiṃ tu yathādarśanamavyabhicaritaśabdāmeva prathamamavibhaktāṃ punaḥ saṃgṛhītacaraṇavibhāgāṃ samāmanantītyāgamaḥ || 145 ||
kāyavāgbuddhiviṣayā ye malāḥ samavasthitāḥ |
cikitsālakṣaṇādhyātmaśāstraisteṣāṃ viśuddhayaḥ ||146 ||
yathaiva hi śarīre doṣaśaktiṃ ratnauṣadhādiṣu ca doṣapratīkārasāmarthyaṃ dṛṣṭvā cikitsāśāstramāऱbdham | rāgādīṃśca buddherupaplavānavagamya tadupaghātehetujñānopāyabhūtānyadhyātmaśāstrāṇi upanibaddhāni | tathaidamapi sādhūnāṃ vācaḥ saṃskārāṇāṃ jñāpanārthamapabhraṃśānā copaghātānāṃ tyāgārthaṃ lakṣaṇamārabdham || 146 ||
śabdaḥ saṃskārahīno yo gauriti prayuyukṣite |
tamapabhraṃśamicchanti viśiṣṭārthaniveśinam || 147 ||
kathaṃbhūtāḥ punarapabhraṃśāḥ--
śabdaprakṛtirapabhraṃśa iti saṃgrahakāraḥ | nāprakṛtirapabhraṃśaḥ svatantraḥ kaścidvidyate | sarvasyaiva hi sādhurevāpabhraṃśasya prakṛtiḥ | prasiddhestu rūḍhitāmāpadyamānāḥ svātantryameva kecidapabhraṃśā labhante |
tatra gauriti prayoktavye'śaktyā pramādādibhirvā gāvyādayastatprakṛtayo'bhraṃśāḥ prayujyante | te ca sāsnādimatyeva labdhasvarūpāḥ sādhutvaṃ vijahati | arthāntare tu prayujyamānāḥ sādhava eva vijñāyante | na hyeteṣāṃ rūpamātrapratibaddhamasādhutvam || 147 ||
asvagoṇyādayaḥ śabdāḥ sādhavo viṣayāntare |
nimittabhedāt sarvatra sādhutvaṃ ca vyavasthitam || 148 ||
āvapane goṇīti svaviprayogābhidhāne cāsva ityetayoravasthitaṃ sādhutvam | tathā sāsnādimati hreṣitādiliṅge ca nimittāntarāt pravṛttāvetayoranyatra viṣaye labdhasaṃskārayoḥ sādhutvameva vijñāyate | goṇīveyaṃ gaurgoṇīti bahukṣīradhāraṇādiviṣayādāvapanatvasāmānyādabhidhīyate | tathā'vidyamānaṃ svamasya so'yamasva iti |
tasmād vastvaparigṛhītakāraṇaṃ na kiñcinniyatamasti, yatra sādhutvamasādhutvaṃ vā vyavatiṣṭheta || 148 ||
te sādhuṣvanumānena pratyayotpattihetavaḥ |
tādātmyamupagamyeva śabdārthasya prakāśakāḥ || 149 ||
apabhraṃśā hi sādhūnāṃ śabdānāṃ viṣaye prayujyamānā yathaivākṣinikocādayaḥ paricayādupagṛhītasvarūpā prasiddhāḥ, tathā sādhupranāḍikayārthaṃ pratyāyanti | tatra sākṣādabhidhānaṃ neti ślokāntaropanyāsaḥ || 149 ||
na śiṣṭairanugamyante paryāyā iva sādhavaḥ |
te yataḥ smṛtiśastreṇa tasmāt sākṣādavācakāḥ || 150 ||
atha kasmādete gośabdasya gāvyādayaḥ paryāyā na vijñāyante ? nahi śiṣṭasamācāraprasiddheranyadevaṃprakāreṣu smṛtinibandhaneṣvartheṣu nimittamabhidhīyate | gāvyādayaścet paryāyāḥ syurete'pi śiṣṭairlaṃkṣaṇairanugamyeran prayujyeraṃśca | yaśca pratyakṣapakṣeṇa prayojakeṣvabhidheyeṣu pravartate, sa sādhuḥ | sākṣāt prayojakaṃ vācyamartharūpaṃ sādhubhiḥ pratyāyyate |
ityayamuktārthaḥ ślokaḥ || 150 ||
ambāmbeti yathā bālaḥ śikṣamāṇaḥ prabhāsate |
avyaktaṃ tadvidāṃ tena vyakte bhavati niścayaḥ || 151 ||
bālo hi karaṇamātraśaktivaikalyād yatnavānapi sādhuprayuyukṣāyāmavyaktāṃ śrutiṃ prayuṅ‌kte, tadā pratipattārastatprakṛtiṃ vyaktaṃ śabdamavadhārayanti | tamevārthasaṃbandhinaṃ manyante, tasmādāha--na bālaprapayuktamapabhraṃśam || 151 ||
evaṃ sādhau prayoktavye yo'pabhraṃśaḥ prayujyate |
tena sādhuvyavahitaḥ kaścidartho'bhidhīyate || 152 ||
saṅkīrṇāyāṃ vāci sādhuviṣaye'paśabdāḥ prayujyante | taiḥ śiṣṭā lakṣaṇavidaḥsādhūn pratipadyante | taireva sādhūbhistadarthamamidhīyamānaṃ paśyanti | anumānastu dhūma ivāgneḥ, asādhuritareṣām || 152 ||
pāramparyādapabhraṃśā viguṇeṣvabhidhātṛṣu |
prasiddhimāgatā yeṣu teṣāṃ sādhuravācakaḥ || 153 ||
ihābhyāsāt strīśūdracāṇḍālādibhirapabhraṃśāḥ prayujyamānāstathā pramādyatsu vaktṛṣu rūḍhimupāgatāḥ, yena taireva prasiddhataro vyavahāraḥ | sati ca sādhuprayogāt saṃśaye yastasyāpabhraṃśastena sampati nirṇayaḥ kriyate | tameva cāsādhuṃ vācakaṃ pratyakṣapakṣe manyante | sādhuṃ cānumānapakṣe vyavasthāpayanti || 153 ||
daivī vāg vyatikīrṇeyamaśaktairabhidhāt‌bhiḥ |
anityadarśināṃ tvasmin vāde buddhiviparyayaḥ || 154 ||
śruyate purākalpe khaśarīrajyotiṣāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ yathaivānṛtādibhirasaṅkīrṇā vāgāsīt, tathā sarvairapabhraṃśaiḥ | sā tu śaṅkīryamāṇā pūrvadoṣābhyāsabhāvanānuṣaṅgāt kālenaprakṛtireva teṣāṃ prayoktṝṇāṃ rūḍhimupāgatā | anityavādinastu ye sādhūnāṃ dharmahetutvaṃ na pratipadyante, mallasamayādisadṛśīṃ sādhuvyavasthāṃ manyante, te prakṛtau bhavaṃ prākṛtaṃ sādhūnāṃ śabdānāṃ samūhamācakṣate | vikārastu paścād vyavasthāpitiḥ, yaḥ sabhinnabuddhibhiḥ puruṣaiḥ, svarasaṃskārādibhirnirṇoyata iti || 154 ||
ubhayeṣāmavicchedād anyaśabdavivakṣayā |
yo'nyaḥ prayujyate śabdo na so'rthasyābhidhāyakaḥ || 155 ||
yeṣāmapi ca naiva purākalpaḥ, na ca daivī vāgasaṅkīrṇā kadācidāsīt, teṣāmapi gamyāgamyādivyavasthāvadiyaṃ sādhvasādhuvyavasthā nityamavicchedena śiṣṭaiḥ smaryate | tatrānyaśabdavivakṣayā bālapralāpavadartheṣu prayujyamāno yaḥ śabdo rūḍhaḥ, yaśca na rūḍhaḥ, tāvubhāvapyarthaṃsya na vācakau bhavataḥ | tatra tu sādhuvyavahitā vā bhavatyarthapratipattirabhyāsād‌vā pramattānāmakṣinikocādivat sampratyayamātraṃ jāyate || 155 ||
|| iti śriharivṛṣabhamahāvaiyākaraṇaviracite vākyapadīye
āgamasamuccayo nāma brahmakāṇḍaṃ samāptam ||
<2>
atha dvitīyakāṇḍam
evaṃ śabdasya prayojanasahitaṃ svarūpādikaṃ leśato nirṇotam | tasya ca sādhāraṇyena vācakatvaṃ vyavasthāpitam | idānīṃ matabhedena keṣāñcitpadaṃ vācakamanyeṣāṃ vākyamiti vācakātmano vākyasvarūpasya tāvadvitatya svarūpapratipādanāya dvitīyakāṇḍaprārambhaḥ |
tatrācāryamatabhedāśrayeṇa tāvadvākyoddeśārthamāha---
ākhyātaśabdaḥ saṅghāto jātiḥ saṅghātavartinī |
eko'navayavaḥ śabdaḥ kramo buddhyanusaṃhṛtiḥ || 1 ||
padamādyaṃ pṛthak‌ sarvaṃ padaṃ sākāṅkṣamityapi |
vākyaṃ prati matirbhinnā bahudhā nyāyavādinām || 2 ||
ete'ṣṭau vākyavikalpā ācāryaṇām | tatrākhaṇḍapakṣe jātiḥ saṅghātavarttinī, eko'navayavaḥ śabdaḥ, buddhyanusaṃhṛtiriti trīṇi lakṣaṇāni | khaṇḍapakṣe tu-- ākhyātaśabdaḥ, kramaḥ, saṅghātaḥ, padamādyam, pṛthaksarvaṃ padaṃ sākāṅkṣamiti pañca lakṣaṇāni | atrāpi saṅghātaḥ krama ityabhihitānvayapakṣe lakṣaṇadvayam | ākhyātaśabdaḥ, padamādyam, pṛthakyarva padaṃ sākāṅkṣamityanvitābhidhānapakṣe lakṣaṇatrayamiti vibhāgaḥ |
iha ca "padaprakṛtiḥ saṃhitā" iti prātiśākhyam | tatra padānāṃ prakṛtiḥ kāraṇaṃ padaprakṛtiḥ saṃhitetyakhaṇḍapakṣaḥ padāni prakṛtiryasyāḥ seti khaṇḍapakṣaḥ prādurbhavati|
tatrākhyātaśabdo vākyamiti parastācchabdārthanirṇaya iti prakaraṇe darśayiṣyata|yathā---
ākhyātaśabde niyataṃ sādhanaṃ yatra gamyate |
tadapyekaṃ samāptārthaṃ vākyamityabhidhīyate || iti 
"kevalena padenārthaḥ" ityādinā |
ślokāṣṭakena saṅghāto vākyamiti darśayiṣyati | "yathaika eva sarvārthaḥ" ityādinā "devadattādayo vākye tathaiva syuranarthakāḥ" ityantena granthena, tathā "avyaktaḥ kramavān" ityādinā "vyāvṛttabhedo yenārthaḥ" ityantena cākhaṇḍa eva sphoṭalakṣaṇaḥ śabdo vākyamati darśitam | uktañca---"yenoccāritena sāsnālāṅ‌gūlakhurakakudaviṣāṇyartharūpaṃ pratipādyate sa śabdaḥ", tathā---"sphoṭaḥ śabdo dhvaniḥ śabdaguṇaḥ" iti |
sphoṭaśca dvividhaḥ--bāhya ābhyantaraśceti | bāhyo'pi jātivyatiktibhedena dvividhaḥ | tatra jātilakṣaṇasya jātiḥ saṅghātavartinīti, vyaktilakṣaṇasyaiko'navayavaḥ śabda iti | ābhyantarasya tu buddhyanusaṃhṛtirityanenoddeśaḥ | tatra jātivyaktilakṣaṇasya bāhyasya `yathaika eve' tyādinā punaḥ `avyaktaḥ kramavāni' tyādinā granthena svarūpamuktam‌ | `yadantaḥ śabdatattvami' tyādinā ślokacatuṣṭayena āntarasya svarūpamuktam, `saṃpratyaye' tyādiślokacatuṣṭayena kramo vākyamiti darśayiṣyati | `niyataṃ sādhane sādhyami' tyanena ca ślokadvayena padamādyaṃ pṛthaksarvaṃ padaṃ sākāṅkṣamiti lakṣaṇadvayaṃ vyākhyasyati | anyadapi vārttikakārīyaṃ pāribhāṣikaṃ śāstre vākyalakṣaṇamasti |
"ākhyātaṃ sāvyayakārakaviśeṣaṇaṃ vākyamekatiṅiti" ca|
jaranmīmāṃsakoktaṃ laukikamapyasti--"arthaikatvādekaṃ vākyaṃ sākāṅkṣaṃ cedvibhāge syāt" iti | anayoḥ saṅghātapakṣe'ntarbhāvaḥ |
ete'pi prathamameva `nighātādivyavasthārthaṃmi' tyādinā vicārayiṣyante | itthamaṣṭāveva vākyavikalpā matabhedena sampadyanta iti voddhavyam |
yatpunaranena vṛttāvuktam---udāharaṇamātrametat, anyānyapi vākyalakṣaṇāni darśayiṣyatīti | tadvārttikakārīyavākyalakṣaṇāderantarbhāvamanapekṣyeti mantavyam | uddiṣṭānāṃ ca vākyalakṣaṇānāṃ yathānyāsamagre kārikābhireva darśitakrameṇa svarūpamunmīlayiṣyatīti nārtha iha tatpradarśanena |
vākyalakṣaṇaprasaṅgena ca tathā vākyārthasya sambandhasya ca matabhedaṃ darśayiṣyati | tatrākhaṇḍapakṣe triṣvapi lakṣaṇeṣu pratibhā vākyārthaḥ | yathā darśayiṣyati--
"vicchedagrahaṇe'rthānāṃ pratibhānyaiva jāyate |
vākyārtha iti tāmāhuḥ" iti  |
avaśiṣṭeṣu pañcasu lakṣaṇeṣu madhyādākhyātaśabdo vākyamityasmin pakṣe kriyā vākyārthaḥ | yathā vakṣyati---"kriyā kriyāntarādbhinnā"  ityādi |
yathā ca--
pratibhā yatprabhūtārthā yāmanuṣṭhānamāśritam |
phalaṃ prasūyeta yataḥ sā kriyā vākyagocaraḥ || iti |
saṅghātapakṣe ca saṃsargo vākyārthaḥ | sa ca ---
sambandhe sati yattvanyadādhikyamupajāyate |
vākyārthametaṃ samprāhuranekapadasaṃśrayam ||
ityādinā darśayiṣyate | tathā saṅghātapakṣa eva "sarvabhedānuguṇyam" ityādinā prakārāntareṇābhihitānvayapakṣe pratipādyamāne "kāryānumeyaḥ sambandho rūpaṃ tasya na vidyate" ityanena ślokena viśeṣaviśrāntaḥ padānāmevārtho vākyārtha iti lakṣyate |
padamādyam, pṛthaksarvaṃ padaṃ sākāṅkṣamityasmin tu pakṣadvaye saṃsṛṣṭa eva prathamataraṃ prakamyate vākyārthaḥ | yathā nirūpayiṣyati --
"teṣāṃ tu kṛtsno vākyārthaḥ pratibhedaṃ samāpyate" (iti),
tathā---
pūrvairarthairanugato yathārthātmā paraḥ paraḥ |
saṃsarga eva prakrāntastathādyeṣvarthavastuṣu || iti |
"abhidheyaḥ padasyārtho vākyāsyārthaḥ prayojanam | "
ityanena prayojanaṃ vākyārthatvena pradarśitam |
tatkeṣāñcinmate sarvalakṣaṇasādhāraṇamiti na prayojanavākyārtho vākyalakṣameṣu pṛthag vibhajyate |
tadevaṃ pratibhā, saṃsargaḥ, saṃsargavaśānnirākāṅkṣo viśeṣāvasthitaḥ padārtha eva,saṃsṛṣṭa evārthaḥ kriyā, prayojanaṃ ceti ṣaḍ vākyārthā ihopadarśitāḥ |
saṃsarge, saṃsargavaśādviśeṣāvasthite padārthe ca vākyārthe'bhihitānvayaḥ | saṃsṛṣṭe kriyāyāṃ cānvitābhidhānam | pratibhāyāṃ tvekarasaiva pratipattiriti na tatra kācidabhihitānvayānvitāvidhānacarcā | prayojane tvabhihitānvaya eva |
vidhiniyogabhāvanāsaṃjñāstu vākyārthā na nirūpitāḥ, yasmādbhāvanākriyayoḥ paryāyatā prayaśo lakṣyate | kevalaṃ prakṛtyarthapratyayārthatāyāmatra vaiyākaraṇamīmāṃsakayorvivādaḥ |
kiñci, bhāvanā sakarmikevākarmikāpi kriyeti satyapi bhede sādhyatvāviśeṣādabheda evānayoḥ | yathā dhātvarthabhūtā kriyā sādhyarūpaiva, tathā bhāvanā'pīti kathamavāntarabhedādbhedo'nayorbhavet ? vidhiniyogau tu liṅloṭ‌kṛtyānteṣveva vākyeṣvarthāvityasarvaviṣayatvādanādṛtāviheti na tatpradarśanaṃ kṛtam |
tattadanādivākyārthavikalpāhitavāsanāprabodhajanmā kramavadbhirivākramairbahīrūpatayā'dhyastaiḥ padārthaiścitrīkṛta iva vikalpaviśeṣollikhyamāna ākāro bahīrūpatayā'dhyasto nirvibhāga eva śākyānāṃ vākyārtha iti prayaśaḥ pratibhāsodara evāsau mantavyaḥ
vākyamapi tattadanādivākyavikalpāhitavāsanāprabodhajanma kramabadbhirivākramaiḥ padaiścitrīkṛta iva bahīrūpatayā'dhyasyamāno viśiṣṭavikalpollikhyamāna ākāraviśeṣa eva bahīrūpatayādhyasta iti prayaśo buddhyanusaṃhṛtirityasya sodarameveti na tanmatānusāreṇa vākyavākyārthayorihāsaṃgraho veditavyaḥ |
naiyāyikādīnāṃ tu pūrvapūrvavarṇasmṛtisacivo'ntyo varṇo naśyadavasthānubhavaviṣayīkriyamāṇaḥ padaṃ yathā, tathaiva pūrvapūrvapadasmṛtisacivamantyameva padaṃnaśyadavasthānubhavaviṣayīkriyamāṇaṃ vākyamiti prāyaśaḥ saṃsargapakṣa evantarbhavati | tathā pūrvapūrvapadārthasmaraṇasacivenāntyena padenopajanyamānā pratītirvākyārtha iti prāyaśaḥ saṃsargapakṣa evāsyāntarbhāva iti na tadasaṃgraheṇāvyāptiratra vaktavyā |
athātrā'navayava evaikasmin sphoṭātmake vākye pratibhā lakṣaṇe ca vākyārthe vākyavākyārthayoradhyāsarūpaḥ sambandhaḥ | yadvakṣyati `vākyavṛttasya vākyārthe vṛttiḥ" ityādi |
avaśiṣṭeṣu pakṣeṣu vācyavācakabhāvalakṣaṇo yogyatākhya eva śabdarthayoḥ sambandho mīmāṃsakadṛṣṭyā | śākyadarśanānusāreṇa tu vijñānavādanayena bauddhe śabdārthe sarvatra kāryakāraṇabhāva eva | vākyārthavāde tu tatra saṃketalakṣaṇo'sau boddhavyaḥ |
naiyāyikādyanusāreṇa ca saṃketalakṣaṇa evāsāvityevamatra vākyavākyārthasambandhānāṃ saṃkṣepataḥ svarūpaṃ boddhavyam | sambandheṣu madhyādatrādhyāsameva darśayiṣyati | padakāṇḍe tu sarvānabhidhāsyati |
tatra vaiyākaraṇasyākhaṇḍa evaiko'navayavaḥ śabdaḥ sphoṭalakṣaṇo vākyam, pratibhaiva vākyārthaḥ, adhyāsaśca sambandha iti padavādipakṣadūṣaṇaparaḥ paraṃ ṭīkākāro vyavasthāpayatītyasya kāṇḍasya saṃkṣepaḥ || 1 - 2 ||
atha vārttikakāramīmāṃsakoktayorvākyalakṣaṇayoḥ kiṃ samāveśa uta bhinnaviṣayateti vicārārthamāha--
nighātādivyavasthārthaṃ śāstre yat paribhāṣitam |
sākāṅkṣāvayavaṃ tena na sarvaṃ tulyalakṣaṇam || 3 ||
iha padavidhiḥ sāmathyaṃ sati paribhāṣitaḥ | tatra satyapi padānāṃ sāmarthye nighātādayaḥ kkacinneṣyante | yathā--ayaṃ daṇḍo harānena | odanaṃ paca mama bhaviṣyati | odanaṃ paca tava bhaviṣyatīti | atrāneneti sarvanāmnā daṇḍasya parāmarśāddharatinā saha tasya sāmarthyam | tathā yuṣmadarthasyaudanena sambandhāt pacatyarthasya tena saha sāmarthyam | evaṃ ca sati sāmarthye tiṅtiṅ iti nighātaḥ prāpnoti | temayāvekavacanasyeti cādeśau | na ceṣyante, vākyabhedāt | sāmarthyābhāve'pīṣyante | yathā -- nadyāstiṣṭhati kūle, śālīnāṃ te odanaṃ dāsyāmīti |
atra nadyāstiṣṭhatītyasya ca sambandhānupapatteḥ sāmarthyaṃ nāsti | iṣyate ca nighātaḥ | tathā śālīnāṃ yuṣmadaśca sāmarthyābhāvaḥ | iṣyate ca temayāvekavacanasyeti yuṣmādādeśa ityālocya vārttikakṛtā nighātādivyavasthārthamārabdham--`samānavākye nighātayuṣmadasmadādeśā vaktavyāḥ' iti |
evaṃ cāyaṃ daṇḍa ityatra satyapi sāmarthye nāsti nighātasya prasaṅgo'vadhyadhimatobhinnavākyatayāvasthānāt | astītyadhyāhāreṇa hyayaṃ daṇḍa ityekaṃ vākyam | harāneneti ca dvitīyaṃ vākyam | nadyāstiṣṭhatītyādau tvavadhyavadhimatoḥ padayoḥ sāmarthyābhāve'pyekavākyavyasthitau pravartanta eva nighātādaya iti nāstyeṣāmavyavasthā | samānavākye nighātādayo vaktavyā ityuktam | tatra vākye vijñāte samānavākyatvaṃ jñāyata iti prasaṅgātttra vārttikakāreṇādāveva vākyalakṣaṇamuktam-- `ākhyataṃ sāvyayakārakaviśeṣaṇaṃ vākyamekatiṅiti ca' iti |
evaṃ ca mīmāsakoktenāsya sarvatra samāveśo'sti, na veti vicāryate | śāstre vākyakāreṇa nighātādivyavasthārthaṃ yadvākyalakṣaṇaṃ paribhāṣitaṃ tena mīmāṃsakoktaṃ vākyalakṣaṇaṃ sakalaṃ na tulyalakṣaṇam | sākāṅkṣāvayavamityanena mīmāṃsakoktaṃ vākyalakṣaṇaṃ sūcitam | tatra kacidete samāviśataḥ | yathā nidyāstiṣṭhati kūle, śālīnāṃ ta odanaṃ dāsyāmīti | ayaṃ daṇḍo harānena odanaṃ paca tava bhaviṣyatītyādāvasamāveśaḥ mīmāṃsakavākyalakṣaṇasamāśraṇenātra prāpnuvanti nighātādayaḥ, ekaprayojanatvāt | na ceṣyante | tasmādvārttikakārīyameva vākyalakṣaṇaṃ jyāyaḥ || 3 ||
athaātra prasaṅgānmīmāṃsakavākyalakṣaṇamarthadvāreṇa pradarśayitumāha--
sākāṅkṣāvayavaṃ bhede pārānākāṅkṣaśabdakam |
karmapradhānaṃ guṇavadekārthaṃ vākyamiṣyate || 4 ||
bhede vibhāge viśeṣajijñāsāyāṃ yatsākāṅkṣāvayavam, avibhāge tu parānākāṅkṣāḥ śabdāḥ padāni yasmin tatparānākāṅkṣaśabdakam | karmapradhānaṃ kriyāpadapradhānamityarthaḥ | tasyaiva pradhānābhidheyaprayuktatvādityabhiprāyaḥ | guṇavadviśeṣaṇapadayuktam | ekārthamekaprayojanam || 4 ||
idānīṃ vārttikakārīyasya vākyalakṣaṇasyāvyāptimāśaṅkyāha--
sambodhanapadaṃ yacca tat kriyāyā viśeṣakam |
vrajāni devadatteti nighāto'tra tathā sati || 5 ||
vrajāni devadattetyatra devadattetyetatpadaṃ nāvyayam, na ca kārakam, nāpi tadviśeṣaṇamiti vākyalakṣaṇenāsaṃgṛhītatvādāṣṭamika āmantritasya ceti nighāto na prāpnotīti codyam | ākhyātaṃ sāvyayaṃ sakārakaṃ saviśeṣaṇamiti sāmānyenābhidhānāt sakriyāviśeṣaṇasyāpyākhyātasya vākyatetyadoṣaḥ |
tathā hi--atra saṃbodhyamānadevadattaviṣayā vrajatikriyā, asaṃbodhyamānadevadattaviṣayāyāḥ saṃbodhyamānayajñadattaviṣayāyā vā pṛthageveti viśiṣṭaivātra vrajatikriyā |
kriyāyāśca viśeṣaṇaṃ kadācit sāmānādhikaraṇyena bhavati | yathā--suṣṭhu karoti śobhanaṃ karotīti | atra karotyarthasya suṣṭhivatyādiviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭasyaiva pratīteḥ suṣṭhivatyādīnāṃ karotyādikriyayā sāmānādhikareṇyam |
evaṃ cāsattvabhūtāyāḥ kriyāyā viśeṣaṇamityasattvapradhānatvālliṅgasarvanāmnā napuṃsakena yogaḥ kriyāyāścet nirvartyatvāt karmatvamiti nyāyasiddhameva `karmatvaṃ napuṃsakatā ceti `kriyāviśeṣaṇānāṃ karmatvaṃ napuṃsakaliṅgatā ca' iti nārambhaṇīyaṃ vacanam | vaiyadhikaraṇyenāpi viśeṣaṇaṃ bhavati, yathā--vrajāni devadatteti |
atra hi devadatta vrajānīti devadattasya vrajanakriyāyāśca sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ nāsti| kevalamāmantrya devadattaṃ vrajatyasāviti devadattāmantraṇiśeṣitā kevalā yā vilakṣaṇā vrajanakriyetyākhyātaṃ saviśeṣaṇameveti vākyalakṣaṇasadbhāvāt pravartata eva nighātaḥ | devadatta vrajānītyevamudāharaṇaṃ na pradarśitam | āmantritaṃ pūrvamavidyamānavaditi na nighātaḥ syāditi || 5 ||
punarapyavyāptiṃ vārttikakāralakṣaṇasyāśaṅkya parihartumāha--
yathānekamapi ktvāntaṃ tiṅantasya viśeṣakam |
tathā tiṅntaṃ tatrāhustiṅantasya viśeṣakam || 6 ||
iha pūrvaṃ snāti pacati tato vrajati tata ityatra tata ityetasmāduttarasya vrajatītyasya nighāto na prāpnoti, vākyabhedāt | iṣyate ca | atra tiṅantāduttarasya tu tiṅantasyātiṅiti pratiṣedhānnighātanivṛttiḥ siddheti nātra snātītyasmāduttarasya pacatiśabdasya nighātaḥ prāpnotīti codyamudbhāvanīyam | iṣṭasya nighātasyāprāptirevātrodbhāvanīyā |
atrocyate--nāstyatra vākyabhedaḥ | vrajatītyetatprādhānyenaikaṃ kriyāpadamatra sthitam | anyāni kriyāntarāṇi tadviśeṣaṇānyeva | yathā snānabhojanapānaiḥ kṛdantairviśiṣyate vrajatikriyā tathātra tiṅantaiḥ snātiprabhṛtibhiḥ pradhānaṃ vrajatikriyaiva viśiṣyata ityekaivātra saviśeṣaṇā vrajatikriyā | kevalāyāstvasyāḥ pṛthagevetyetatsaviśeṣaṇamekameva vākyamiti vākyabhedābhāvānnāsti nighātāsiddhidoṣaḥ | ekavākyatve ca tiṅantāduttarasya tiṅantasyātiṅiti pratiṣedhānnighātābhāvaḥ | yathā vakṣyati --
bahuṣvapi tiṅanteṣu sākāṅkṣeṣvekavākyatā |
tiṅāṃ tiṅbhyo nighātasya paryudāsastathārthavān || iti |
evaṃ cātiṅ‌grahaṇe saprayojane sthite vārttikakāreṇa yaduktam--atiṅ‌grahaṇamanarthakaṃ samānavākyādhikārāditi tatrābhiprāyo vācyaḥ | evaṃ vādinastasya vākyabhedo'trābhimata ityabhiprāya ākhyātaṃ sāvyayakārakaviśeṣaṇamityatraikavacanasya vivakṣitatvāditi | tathā ca ṭīkākāraḥ pradarśayiṣyati --
ekatiṅ yasya tu śāstre niyatalakṣaṇam |
tasyātiṅ‌grahaṇenārtho vākyabhedānna vidyate || iti |
sūtrakārasya tvatiṅ‌grahaṇādekamevākhaṇḍaṃ vākyamarthaikatvādakhyātabhede'pyabhipretamiti gamyate | tadabhiprāyānusāreṇaiva nirūpayiṣyati--
anekākhyātayoge'pi vākyaṃ nyāyapathānugaiḥ |
ekameveṣyate kaiścidbhinnarūpamiva sthitam ||
 iti | 6 ||
ṭīkākāraścāmumeva pakṣaṃ sūtrakārābhiprāyasamāśrayaṇena yuktiyuktaṃ manyamāno bahīrūpa āntaro vā nirvibhāgaḥ śabdārthamayo bodhasvabhāvaḥ śabdaḥ sphoṭalakṣaṇa eva vākyamitikrameṇa vyājihīrṣuścitrajñānacitrarūpadṛṣṭāntapradarśanapūrvamupakramate | tatra citrabuddhidṛṣṭāntapradarśanārthamāha---
yathaika eva sarvārthapratyayaḥ pravibhajyate |
dṛśyabhedānukāreṇa vākyārthānugamastathā || 7 ||
citrajñānaṃ sarvākāramekameva | pravibhāgastvasya dṛśyabhedasamāśrayeṇa kriyate | nīlapītādyanekākārameva vijñānamupajātamiti | vastusthityā tatra jñāna ākārabhedo nāsti | tathā vākyavākyārthayoḥ svarūpaṃ boddhavyam |
vākyārthānugamastathetyanena hi vākyavākyārthayorakhaṇḍatvaṃ pānakarasamayūrāṇḍarasacitrarūpanarasiṃhagavayacitrajñānavat samānamevetyucyate | yathā vākyaṃ nirvibhāgaṃ sphoṭalakṣaṇaṃ vācakam, tathā vākyārtho'pi tathāvidha evetyanayorekayogakṣematvamuktam || 7 ||
evamāntaraṃ dṛṣṭāntamupadarśya bāhyamapyupadarśayitumāha--
citrasyaikasvarūpasya yathā bhedanidarśanaiḥ |
nīlādibhiḥ samākhyānaṃ kriyate bhinnalakṣaṇaiḥ || 8 ||
citraṃ hi rūpamavayavigatamanaṃśamekameva | tasyaivākyavagatairyathā nīlādibhirbhedena nidarśanaṃ pradarśanaṃ yeṣāṃ taiḥ pṛthagrūpaireva samākhyānaṃ kriyate || 8 ||
tathā prakṛte kimityāha--
tathaivaikasya vākyasya nirākāṅkṣasya sarvataḥ |
śabdāntaraiḥ samākhyānaṃ sākāṅkṣairanugamyate || 9 ||
ekasya nirvibhāgasya vākyasya sarvataḥ paripūrṇasya vākyāntaragataiḥ padāntarairanvākhyānaṃ tathāva kriyata iti || 9 ||
na vā padasyārthe prayogādityasmina darśane yathākhaṇḍameva padaṃ prakṛtipratyayādibhiḥ kalpitaireva vibhajyate tathā vākye'pyasatyabhūtānāmevābudhabodhanāya padānāṃ vibhāgo draṣṭavya iti pradarśayitumāha--
yathā pade vibhajyante prakṛtipratyayādayaḥ |
apoddhārastathā vākye padānāmupavarṇyate || 10 ||
pade hi yathā prakṛtipratyayavibhāgo'satya eva bālavyutpādanāya kriyate, tathā vākye vākyārthapratipādanāyāpoddhāraḥ padānāmuparṇyata iti boddhavyam || 10 ||
tatra vākyādapod‌dhṛtānāṃ padānāṃ kevalamitarapadasārūpyamātraṃ dṛśyata iti pratipādayitumāha--
varṇāntarasarūpaṃ ca varṇabhāgeṣu dṛśyate |
padāntarasarūpāśca padabhāgā avasthitāḥ || 11 ||
yathā saṃdhyakṣareṣu bhāgā varṇāntarasarūpā dṛśyante, paramārthastvavyapavṛktatvānnirvibhāgā eva | evaṃ vākye dāntarasarūpāḥ padarūpā bhāgāḥ padabhāgāḥ | pade vā niraṃśe ye bhāgāḥ prakṛtipratyayarūpāste'vasthitā iti || 11 ||
etadeva vyaktīkurvannāha--
bhāgairanarthakairyuktā vṛṣabhodakayāvakāḥ |
anvayavyatirekau tu vyavahāranibandhanam || 12 ||
nahī vṛṣabhe ṛṣabhasyodakayāvakayorvodayāvaśabdayorarthānugamaḥ kaścidasti, api tu śāstre padasya prakṛtipratyayoranvayavyatirekābhyāṃ vinā kathamajño vyutpādyeta ? evañca niraṃśameva vākyaṃ vācakamityeva yuktam || 12 ||
śabdasya na vibhāgo'sti kuto'rthasya bhaviṣyati |
vibhāgaiḥ prakriyābhedamavidvān pratipadyate || 13 ||
(svopajñavṛttirūpaṃ vivaraṇam)--yastāvannimittarūpaphalabhedādaprasiddhabhedakramavadbhirayugapad‌bhāvairavayavairyukta ityevaṃ pratītaḥ śabdastasyaivaṃ nityatvapakṣe yo'yaṃ parikalpito vyavahāraviṣayo dravyaśaktinimittānupātī śabdeṣu pratyastarūpo vibhāgaḥ sa nāsti | kuto buddhiṣvalabdhayaugapadyāsu buddhyantarasya buddhyantare
atha vākyārthasyāpi tathaiva nirvibhāgatvaṃ pratipādayitumāha--śabdasyeti | śabdasya sphoṭalakṣaṇasya vibhāgo nāsti, tadvācyasya pratibhārūpasyārthasya kuto bhaviṣyati, yathā nidarśayiṣyati--
"vicchedagrahaṇe'rthānāṃ pratibhā'nyaiva jāyate |
vākyartha iti tāmāhuḥ" iti |
satatasannidhānenānugrahaṃ kurvati vyavahāraṃ pratyekabuddhipratyavamṛṣṭarūpeṣu mūrttibhedakramayukteṣu vyartharūpeṣu vibhāgarūpeṇāvibhāgamāpāditeṣvātmāntaratvādanavayavāyāmatathābhyupagatabhedarūpabuddhāvupasaṃsṛṣṭabuddhimātrārūpanirbhāseṣu satyapyātmabhede sarvārtheṣu vibhāgo bhaviṣyati | tasmāt samīhitapaurvāparyo'rthātmā svarūpādapracyuto'pi sarvo vibhāgātītatattva eva |
vibhāgaiḥ prakriyābhedamiti bhedagrahaṇaṃ hi tasyārthātmanaḥ śabdātmanaścābhinnasya pratipattidvāram | padapratipattipūrvikā hi sāmānyaviśeṣāvagrahaṇopāyā laghuprakramā vibhāgenāvibhaktasya pratipattiḥ, prakṛtipratyayādipratipattivat | guruprakramā tvatra saṃsṛṣṭarūpasya pratipattiravibhāgena pratipadaṃ pāṭhavat | kuśalastu pratipattā sarvameva bhedamabhedānatikrameṇa paśyati | prakriyābhedāstu śāstre vibhāganibandhanam |
tathā hi--haridrurmitadrurdurdaśo dustara ityatra mitadruravagṛhyo haridruranavagṛhyaḥ | tatra vibhāge prakriyā bhidyate | haridrurharitaravo haridrava iti | tathā dustara ityapi taratestṛṇātervā | ataśca vibhāge bhidyamānāyāṃ prakriyāyāmanavagrahaḥ | tathā--indrāṇī varuṇānī pūtakratāyī | indrādīnāmānuka, pūtakratorai ceti sāmānyaviśeṣavatā lakṣaṇena bhedenānvākhyāne śāstraprakriyābhedenāvidvāṃsaḥ pratipadyante || 13 ||
tasya padānurodhena padārthasyāpi prakṛtipratyayānurodhena bhāgakalpanā | mūḍhastu vibhāgena prakriyābhedaṃ prakriyābhede cārthabhedamasatyamapi pratipadyata iti kiṃ kurmaḥ | kathaṃ punaḥ śruyamāṇarūpā eva devadattādayaḥ pratīyamānābhidheyā anarthakāḥ syurityetad vicārayiṣyāmaḥ | api tu ---
brāhmaṇārtho yathā nāsti kaścid brāhmaṇākambale |
devadattādayo vākye tathāva syuranarthakāḥ || 14 ||
yathā hi vicchedenoccāryamāṇe brāhmaṇakambala iti brāhmaṇaśabda upalabhyamānasvarūpo'pi vicchedagrāhibhiḥ samāptimanapekṣamāṇaiḥ pratipattṛbhiḥ, pratīyamānārtho'pyanarthaka eveti prasiddhaḥ | evaṃ satyapi rūpavicchedagrahaṇe sampratyaye cānarthakā eva vākyarūpānnā devadatādisarūpā atyantamasantaḥ parikalpitātmāno vibhāgābhimatāḥ || 14 ||
yuktaṃ caitat yadvākye padārthabhedo nāstīti dṛṣṭantapradarśanapūrvakamāha--brāhmaṇārtha iti | yathā brāhmaṇakambalaśabde brāhmaṇaśabdasya na kaścidartho vidyate, tathaiva devadatta gāmabhyājetyādauvākye devadattādīnāṃ pṛthagartho nāstītyanarthakānyeva padāni | ataśca sthitametad yadakhaṇḍaṃ nirākāṅkṣamekaṃ padavyatiriktaṃ vākyaṃ padārthavyatirikto vākyārthaśca tathaiveti || 14 ||
devadattādīnāṃ ca bhāgābhimatānāmarthayogābhyupagame sāmānye'vasthitānāṃ padānāṃ viśeṣe'vasthānamityetasmin satyekāntena parigṛhyamāṇe--
sāmānyārthastirobhūto na viśeṣe'vatiṣṭhate |
upāttasya kutastyāgo nivṛttaḥ kkāvatiṣṭhatām || 15 ||
iha sāmānyavṛttiruccarito devadattaśabdaḥ sāmānyārthasambaddha eva tirobhavati | tatra yena śabdenāvirbhāvakāla eva viśiṣṭo'rtho na pratilabdhaḥ sa śabdaḥ viśeṣe'vasthātu na punarutsahate | na ca sāmānyaviśeṣayorvivakṣā yugapat saṃbhavati | viśeṣavivakṣāyāṃ hi sarvasyāniyamena sāmānyādavacchedo vijñāyate | tatropāttasya nitye śabdarthasambandhe kutastyāgaḥ, yuktinirūpaṇeṣu cārthātmasvabhidhānakriyāyogābhāve vinivṛtto'navadhāryamāṇātmā śabdaḥ śabdopakramasyārthasyābhāvādaviṣayaḥ kvāvasthāpyatām |
yat punarmomāṃsakairucyate yathā padasaṃghāta evākāṅkṣāyogyatāsannidhānavaśāt parasparasamanvito vākyaṃ saṃsargaśca vākyārtha iti tad dūṣayitumāha--sāmānyārtha iti | iha devadatta gāmabhyāja śulkāṃ daṇḍeneti devadattādīnyeva padāni vākyām | tatra devadattapadaṃ tāvad yadi sāmānyamātre prathamaṃ vartate tattasya gavādipadakāle vācaḥ kramavartitvāttirodhānādasattvameveti kutaḥ padāntaraśravaṇakāle tadarthapratītiḥ | asattvādeva ca na padāntarasaṃnidhāne tasya viśeṣe'vasthānam |
abhyupagamyāpi smaryamāṇatayā padāntarasaṃnidhāne vidyamānatvaṃ padasya na viśeṣe'vasthānaṃ yujyata ityāha--upāttasyeti | sāmānya-sāmānyārthastirobhūto lakṣaṇasya sakalapadārthasādhāraṇasyārthasya pūrvamupāttasya vācyatvena parigṛhītasyedānīṃ padāntarasaṃnidhāne tyāgaḥ kuto yujyate śabdārthasambandhasyānityatāprāpteḥ |
na ca tathā mīmāṃsakasyābhyupagama iti | tadapyabhyupagamyocyate---nivṛtta iti | svārthānnivṛtto'sau padāntarasannidhāne śabdaḥ kvedānīmavatiṣṭhatām | śabdāntarabhodhye'rthe tasya vācakabhāvavirahāt sthitiḥ kathaṃ yujyate || 15 ||
eva tarhyaśabdo vākyārthaḥ | śabdaṣvātmarūpamātrāpratipattihetuṣu tirobhūteṣvapadeśyasaṃskāraviśeṣāyāṃ buddhāvupajātāyāṃ padeṣu padārthamātraṃ pratyāyya nivṛtteṣvaśabdavācyo'sattvabhūtaḥ sambandhaḥ saṃjñārthānāṃ sāmānyarūpāṇāṃ bhedaheturupaplavamānaḥ śokaharṣādivaduttareṣu buddhyantareṣvanusandhīyate | etasmin darśana ucyate---
aśabdo yadi vākyārthaḥ padārtho'pi tathā bhavet |
evaṃ ca sati sambandhaḥ śabdasyārthena hīyate || 16 ||
kathaṃ varṇaṣvapyanarthakeṣu svarūpamātraṃ buddhau saṃniveśya nivṛtteṣvabhyāsānniyatanimittamānakhyepāyamartharūpaṃ duddhyantareṣvanusandhīyate | tathā ca śabdārthayoḥ sambandho hīyate | tathaiva tu dravyaguṇakarmāṇi viniviṣṭanimittarūpāṇi prabojakairnimittaiḥ sambaddhānyākhyāyante | jñānaṃ ca viniviṣṭajñeyarūpam | apareṇa sambandhakalpena jñeyairarthaiḥ sambandha ityākhyāyate | jñānāccopagṛhītabuddhirūpo buddhyā sambandha ucyate | tathā śabdo'puyapareṇa yogyatākhyena sambandhakalpenopagṛhītārtharūpo viniveśitābhidhayatattvaḥ śabdārthayorbhede tena tenārthena sambandha ityucyate | arthabhāvapariṇatipakṣe tu sarvato nedīyān sambandha iti || 16 ||
athocyate---arthapratipattirdṛṣṭā devadattetyādikāt samudāyāt sā kathamapahnūyate | tatrāha---aśabda iti |
uktanītyā śabdāna yujyante vācakāḥ | tadabhāvāccāśabdo vākyārtho yadyabhyupagamyate tadayamaparaste doṣaḥ | padārtho'pi padapratipādyo na kaścid anekavarṇavarttitvād vāca uccaritapraghvaṃsitvācca, varṇānāmitipadamapyekaṃ nāsti | tadabhāvāt kaḥ padārthaḥ syāt | itthamaśabdo'vācako vākyārtha iti vācyavācakabhāvalakṣaṇaḥ sambandhaḥ śabdārthayostyaktaḥ syānmīsāṃsakenetyāha---evaṃ ceti || 16 ||
viśeṣaśabdāḥ keṣāñcit sāmānyapratirūpākāḥ |
śabdāntarābhisambandhād vyajyante pratipattṛṣu || 17 ||
keṣāñcitu prakriyāntaravādināmakṣādivadaśnotyādikriyāyogaviśeṣe viśeṣāntarayuktā devadattādayo vākyaviṣayā nityaṃ paritaḥ paricchinnārthavṛttayo viśeṣaśabdavācakasya viśeṣasya pratipattṛbhiḥ sāmānyāpahṛtabuddhibhiḥ parokṣaviśeṣairaparicchedāt sāmānyaśabdapratirūpakāḥ śabdāntarābhisambandhādāgantunā kenacidapyarthenāyujyamānā nityasiddhaniyatatvānniyamaṃ viśeṣāntarādhyāroparūpaṃ cātikrāntāḥ kevalamanuvādamātreṇa śabdāntarāṇāṃ yathāyathamarthābhidhānasiddhaye vyajyante pratipattṛṣu prayoktṛbhirnirdhāritaviśeṣā ityabhiprāyaḥ || 17 ||
evaṃ tāvadabhihitānvayavādī nirastaḥ | idānīmanvitābhidhānasamāśrayaṇena padamādyaṃ pṛthak sarvapadaṃ sākāṅkṣamityuddiṣṭe vākyalakṣaṇe pradarśayitukāma āha---viśeṣaśabdā iti | iha devadatta gāmabhyājetyatra devadattapadaṃ gāṃ badhānetyasmād viśiṣṭameva vaktrā samudīritaṃ bhramāttu sakalasādhāraṇaṃ pratibhāti | uttarakālaṃ gāvādipadasambandhād viśṣṭā pratipattirabhivyajyata iti tadeva vākyam | sakalaviśeṣaṇakhacitaśca prathamataramevopakrāntaḥ saṃsṛṣṭa evārtho vākyārtha iti | yathā vakṣyati---
pūrvairarthairanugato yathārthātmā paraḥ paraḥ |
saṃsarga eva prakrāntastathādyeṣvarthavastuṣu || iti || 17 | 
nirbhāgaikaśabdābhidheyaṃ tvekaṃ vākyārthaṃ pratipannāḥ svamatamupapādayanto nidarśayanti---
teṣāṃ tu kṛtsno vākyārthaḥ pratibhedaṃ samāpyate |
vyaktopavyañjanā siddhirarthasya pratipattṛṣu || 18 ||
teṣāmevamupagṛhītasarvaviśeṣa ekasminnarthe bahuśabdānabhyupagacchatāmavikalpaḥ kṛtsno vākyārthaḥ pratipadaṃ prativarṇaṃ vā samāpyate | tadetat pakṣāntaraiḥ saha darśanaṃ vicārayiṣyate | evaṃ vyakteṣu hyupavyañjaneṣvarthaḥ pratipattṛṣu prasiddhiṃ labhate | na tu sannidhānamātrād anabhivyaktopavyañjana iti || 18 ||
etadeva sphuṭīkartumāha---eṣāṃ tviti | upakrama eva vivakṣitārthapratyāyanāya viśiṣṭapadodīraṇamārabhata ityādya eva pade pratyekaṃ vā sakalasya vākyārthasya samāptiravagantavyā | yadyekasmādeva padāt sakalavākyārthapratītistarhotarapadavaiyarthyamityāśaṅkyāha---vyakteti | pratipattṛṣu vākyārthasya siddhiravagatirvyaktopavyañjanā | vyaktā udīritā upavyañjanā abhivyañjakāḥ padaviśeṣā yasyāḥ sā tathoktā | abhivyaktābhivyañjakā vākyārthāvagatiriti padāntarāṇāṃ vākye nāstyeva vaiyarthyamityanvitābhidhānapradarśanama | dūṣaṇamasyāgre tatra tatrābhidhāsyati | yathā --- niyamārthā śratirbhavedityādi| tathāhi---yadyekena padena sakalavākyārthasyāśeṣaviśeṣaṇakhacitasyāvagatistadottareṣāṃ padānāṃ niyamāyānuvādāya voccāraṇaṃ syāt | na caitadyuktamiti vakṣyāmaḥ | ekasmādeva padāt samastaviśeṣaṇakhacitasya vākyārthasya pratītirucareṣāmānarthakyaṃ syādeva | na ca tasmādeva vākyārthapratītirdṛśyate |
vyaktopavyañjanetyasamādhānameva | yataḥ kimekasmād vākyārthāvasāyo'nyeṣāmupavyañjakatvama | atha samastebhya eva tebhyaḥ | sarvathottarāṇi padāni vākyārthapratītaya upādīyanta evetyanvitābhidhānamasamañjasameva | ekasya vā paradoccāraṇakāle tirodhānādabhihitānvayasyāpyasambhava ityarthabhāge dūṣaṇam | śabdabhāgasamāśrayaṇena dvayorapi pakṣayordūṣaṇaṃ padāni vākye tānyevetyādiślokadvayenābhidhāsyati || 18 ||
avyaktaḥ kramavātrśabdaḥ upāṃśvayamadhīyate |
akramastu vitatyeva buddhiryatrāvatiṣṭhate || 19 ||
upādhimato hyekasya śabdasya vibhāgā ivāvasthitāḥ saṃhitāsaṃhitayordrutamadhyamavilambitāsu vṛttiṣu śanairuccairupāṃśu paramopāṃśu saṃhṛtakramaṃ ceti | tatra prāṇavṛttyanugrahe satyeva yatra śabdarūpaṃ parairasaṃvedyaṃ bhavati tadupāṃśu | antareṇa tu prāṇavṛttyanugrahaṃ yatra kevalameva buddhau samāviṣṭarūpo bṛd‌dhyupādāna eva śabdātmā tat paramopāṃśu |
yatra tu pratisaṃhṛtakramaśaktiyogayā buddhyā nimittāntaropasaṃprāptamavyakte śabde'dhyāropitaṃ hi śabdānāṃ kramarūpamiva sākṣātkriyate tat pratisaṃhṛtakramam| śabdānāṃ kramarūpopasaṃhāraviṣayāyāṃ buddhāvasamprakhyātatattvamiva pratipadyamānāyāmārabhyate śabdātīto vyavahāraḥ |
saṃsṛṣṭaśaktayaśca kramasaṃhāreṇa samāviṣṭavācāṃ prayoktṝṇāṃ śabdau prayatnena prāṇe karaṇeṣu ca kramavṛttitāmanubhūya pratipatṛṣvapi kramapratyastamayenaiva samāveśaṃ pratipadyante |
tatropalabdhyupāyānupātī kramavṛttilakṣito bhedo vyāvahārikamapi śabdatattvaṃ nānupatati | kramasaṃhārānāśrayaṇe hi vyavahāra eva vicchidyate |
tasmācca nabhogādivat prāptadeśavibhāgaivaikā yatra buddhiḥ sa evādyantayoreko vākyākhyaḥ śabda iti || 19 ||
samprati pratibhābhedavyācikhyāsayā'khaṇḍapakṣamevānubadhnannāha--avyakta iti | iha niraṃśa evābhinno vyaktisphoṭo jātisphoṭo vā bahīrūpa āntaraḥ śabdārthamayo vā buddhyanusaṃhāro vākyamiti sa eva vācaka upapannaḥ | yastu bhedapratibhāsaḥ so'sāvupādhikṛta evetyarthaḥ | tathopāṃśu paramopāṃśu vyakto vyaktataraśca vilambito vilambitataraśca druto drutataraścetyādikāḥ pratibhāsā abhivyañjakadhvanikṛtā na punaḥ satyā iti boddhavyam| tasmādyaḥ śabdo vyakta upāṃśu kṛtvādhīyate so'bhivyañjakadhvanikṛtāt kramāt kramavānnānāvidhāvasthāyuktaḥ pratīyate |
paramārthatastvasāvakrama eva sphoṭātmā pratibhāsaḥ upādhivaśāttu tatra buddhirvitatevānugamyata iti boddhavyam | anenaiko'navayavaḥ śabda ityuddiṣṭasya vyaktisphoṭasya svarūpamuktamiti boddhavyam || 19 ||
etasmiṃścaikatvapakṣe niravayavā śabdavyaktirevaikā syāt | yā vā śabdavyaktiḥ śabdākṛtireva vākyamiti pratīyeta | tatra niravayavasyaikasyārthasya kuto bhedasādṛśye? bhedasiddhiviśeṣo hyātmāntaraṃ sādṛśyaṃ ca | nahyātmābhedaḥ sādṛśyaṃ vā | api tu vināpi sāmānyaviśeṣābhyāṃ sāmānyaviśeṣāntaravat prasiddhiḥ | tadyathā'prasiddharūpasyāpi niravayavasyotkṣepaṇatvādeḥ | (tatrāha)--
yathākṣepaviśeṣe'pi karmabhedo na gṛhyate |
āvṛttau vyajyate jātiḥ karmabhirbhramaṇādibhiḥ || 20 ||
varṇavākyapadeṣvevaṃ tulyopavyañjanā śrutiḥ |
atyantabhede tacvasya sarūpeva pratīyate || 21 ||
ākṣepaviśeṣāddhi svajātiprayukte bhinnātmani pratibhedaṃ viniviṣṭasvajātiviśeṣe bhramaṇādau karmaṇi kampanarecanotkṣepaṇādibhyo yo bhedaḥ sa na gṛhyate | āvṛttau tu digviśeṣāvadhisaṃyogavibhāgopādhikāyāmupalabdhāyāmanupalabdhapūrvā'vyaktopalabdhā vā bhramaṇarecanākhyā jātirupalabdhṝṇāṃ svanimittapratyayahetuḥ sampadyate | tathaiva yāvat sadṛśāni jātyupavyañjanāni tāvadatyantabhinnī'pyarthaḥ sarva eva sārūpyeṇa gṛhyate |
aparaḥ kalpaḥ | śabdajātereva vākyatve bhramaṇatvādayo dṛṣṭāntatvenopanyastāḥ| varṇatvapadatvavākyatvāni hi tulyātulyopavyañjanāni, yāvattulyopavyañjanasannipātastāvad buddhibhedaṃ kurvanti | katham ? apacitadhvanivyaṅgyastāvadeko varṇastasyābhivyaktinimittaiḥ sadṛśairanyaiśca śrutibhinnairekaṃ niravayavaṃ ca padaṃ vyajyate | tatheva tulyātulyaiḥ pacitatamairvākyamiti || 20 - 21 |
atha jātiḥ saṅghātavartinītyuddiṣṭasya jātisphoṭasyāpi dṛṣṭāntapradarśanadvāreṇa sphujīkaraṇāyāha--yathākṣepeti |
iha bhramaṇalakṣaṇā karmajātiryathā viśṣṭaprayatnajatitenākṣepaviśeṣeṇābhivyaktā, pratyekaparisamāptatvāt | na ca pārśvasthena sā vijñāyate | bhramaṇānāmāvṛttau tu bhraṇamaṃ bhramaṇaṃ prati pratipattrā sā gṛhyate | evaṃ varṇapadavākyeṣu śrutirabhivyañjako dhvaniratyantabhede tattvasya varṇapadavākyasphoṭalakṣaṇasya sābhivyañjakā sarūpeva pratīyate paramārthato bhinnā'pi satī kīdṛśī ? tulyopavyañjaneti | tulyaḥ sadṛśa upavyañjanaḥsthānakaraṇābhighātalakṣaṇo yasyāḥ sā tatheti | tena bhinnaprayatnodīritadhvanyabhivyakto'yaṃ jātisphoṭo vilakṣaṇa eveti boddhavyama | yuktaṃ caitat || 20 - 21 ||
vyakyekatvapakṣe tu vākyasyaikasya paurvāparyavyavasthāṃ pratyucyate---
nityeṣu tu kutaḥ pūrvaṃ paraṃ vā paramārthataḥ |
ekasyaiva tu sā śaktiryadevamavabhāsate || 22 ||
kālākhyā hi kartṛ śaktiḥ kāryeṣveva pratibandhābhyanujñābhyāṃ paurvāparyaṃ prakalpayati | na hyaṇūnāmaviśṣṭe satāṃ yoge paurvāparyamastīti |
nanu ca nityatvagrahaṇe na tasya paurvāparyaṃ syāt | ekasmiṃstu vākyākhye niravayave ekagrahaṇaviṣaye varṇapadaviṣayaṃ paurvāparyaṃ na saṃbhavatīti | ata hadamucyate--`ekasyaiva tu sā śaktiḥ' iti | yadevamiti | kramapratyavabhāsatvamekatvānatikrameṇākrame buddhilakṣaṇe kṣaṇikavādinaḥ sarvasya viruddharūpamivāviruddhaṃ bhavati |
trayyantavidāṃ tu--viśvātmanyekatvānatikrameṇa kramapratyavabhāsatvaṃ bhavati | tathā śabde'pi syāditi nāsti virodhaḥ | svaśaktiyogāddhi pratyavabhāsamātrabhedānnātropāyāpāyau kvacidapi pakṣe vidyete || 22 ||
yathā niraṃśasyāsya sphoṭasya pūrvāparabhāva upādhikṛto na svato nityatvāditi vaitatyena nityatvasamarthanārthamāha--nityeṣviti |
nityeṣu hi paramārthataḥ pūrvāparabhāvo'saṃbhavyupādhikṛto dṛśyata eva | nanu sadaikarūpatayā kiṃ nāvabhāsate ? nahi tatra svabhāvabhedasya sambhava ityāśaṅkyoktam--ekasyetyādi | ekasvabhāvo'pi tathāvidhaśaktiyukta eva vastusvābhāvyāt | yadevaṃ vaitatyena pūrvāparabhāvasvarūpatayā upādhibhedānuvartanenāvabhāsata iti | || 22 ||
kathaṃ punarvākyapadahṇasvadīrghaplutavyañjanādiṣu nityeṣvaviśiṣṭeṣu kālabheda upapadyate---
ciraṃ kṣipramiti jñāne kālabhedādṛte yathā
bhinnakāle prakāśete sa dharmo hlasvadīrghayoḥ || 23 ||
tadyathā ciramiti jñānasya yadātmakatvaṃ kṣipramityetasmiṃśca jñāne'pi | na ca tayorātmanoḥ kaścidapi sthitikālabhedo'sti | labdhātmakaṃ hi sarvajñānamaviśiṣṭakālaṃ jñānāntareṇa |
atha ca ciramityekaṃ jñānaṃ jñānāntareṇātikrāntapratyavarśarūpeṇa tadbhāvanā viśeṣāvadhānācca bhāvināpi pratyavarśarūpeṇa prakṛṣṭatāmiva kālādhvanaḥ pradarśayati | kṣipramityetasmiṃstu laghupravṛttirūpeṇa pratyapakṛṣyata iva kālādhvā || 23 |
punarapyupādhibhedenaiva śabdasya bhedapratibhāso na svataḥ, nityatvāditi dṛṣṭāntapradarśanapūrvakamāha--ciramiti |
ciramiti jñānaṃ kṣipramiti ca yathā jñānatvāviśeṣādekakālamapi jñeyasamāśrayaṇena bhinnakālamiva prathate | cirajñānaṃ vitatapratibhāsamivābhāti | kṣiprajñānametadviparītam | tadvad hrasvadīrghayordharmaḥ svabhāvo'vagantavyaḥ | na tu hrasvādirūpatā kācit sphoṭa iti nāsti sphoṭasya svato bhedaḥ || 23 |
kathaṃ dīrghaplutādiṣu kālādhvaparimāṇabhedadarśanamaviruddham‌ ?
na nityaḥ paramātrābhiḥ kālo bhedamihārhati |
vyāvarttinīnāṃ mātrāgṇamabhāve kīdṛśaḥ kramaḥ || 24 ||
nityapakṣe'nityapakṣe vā kālasya mātrāṇāṃ vā āśrīyamāṇe na kālātmanaḥ satyataḥ kaucit prakarṣāpakarṣau vidyete | yadi nityaḥ kālaḥ, nāsyādityagatibhirbahvībhirātmaparimāṇamutkṛṣyate, nāpyalpābhirapakṛṣyate | krośayojanādiparimāṇamiva bhidyamānābhirgantṛkriyābhiḥ | kālasyaiva copādhiviśiṣṭasya parimāṇatvāt kuto'syāparaṃ parimāṇamityetatkālasamuddeśe vyākhyāsyate |
atha gatirapi nityā sarvamevāvyatipāti ca pratijñāyate | athaitā vyāvartinya eva viśvasya mātrāḥ, tatra na pūrvamapareṇānusandhīyate, sarvaṃ samīhitamasaṃsṛṣṭameva vyatipatati, nirupākhyayośca pūrvāparayoḥ koṭyormadhyamanavabaddhaṃ paścāt purastāccānālambanamanupākhyaṃ pūrvabhāgāparabhāgapratyavamarśinevāhaṅkāreṇānusyūtamapakarṣaparyantagatamabhedyamapyasataḥ pararūpasyopagraheṇa cātyantamanupagrāhi parimāṇābhede'pi mithyāsādaviduṣo dīrghamiva prakāśate |
tadetasmin pakṣe ekadharmāvibaddheṣvekadharmapratiṣṭhiteṣvabhinnakāleṣu sarvavyavahāreṣu kīdṛśaḥ satāmatyantāsatāṃ ca mātrābhedānāṃ kramaḥ ?
nahi śaśaviṣāṇasyoṣṭraviṣāṇena himavatā vā kaścidapi kramo vidyate |
yadyapyekasyārthasya saṃmukhībhāve sadbhiḥ samānakālairbhinnakālaiśca vyāpāraiḥ saha kramo na saṃbhavati, tathāpyetasmin darśane nānyathā kramaḥ saṃbhavatītyevambhūtava kramavyavasthā, satyamevambhūtā kramavyavasthā, na tu kasyacinmūrtiparimāṇabhedātikrameṇa parikalpitaparimāṇabhedo vidyate | sahotpādā hi sarve bhāvāḥ kālāntarāvasthāparikalpite kālādhvani manvantarākhye kṣaṇākhye vā nātmatattvamatikramānto'naikāntikenāgantunāpyanāgantukena bhedena saṃspṛśyante |
nahi tebhyo vyatiriktaḥ kṣaṇākhyaḥ kālādhvā manvantarākhyo vā kaścidanyo vidyate, yasminnadhikaraṇabhūte prāptaviśeṣabhāvāḥ kālāntarāvasthāyino nityāḥ kṣaṇikā iti vā pratijñābhedaviṣayatāmāpadyeran || 24 |
athocyate--na nityamupādhivaśādbhinnaṃ vaktuṃ yuktam, svabhāvabhedaprasaṅgādityāśaṅkyāha--na nitya iti | iha kālo'pi nitya evābhyuvagato nityamekamityādilakṣaṇakathanāt | tasyedānīṃ kṣaṇalavanimeṣetyādivyavahāraḥ kathamupapadyate ? atha paramātrābhistasya bheda upacaryate | yathā paramāṇoḥ svāvaruddhanabhodeśatyāgopalakṣitaḥ kālaḥ kṣaṇaḥ, kṣaṇadvayaṃ ca lava ityādi | tathā niraṃśe vākya aupādhikabhedaparikalpanāyāṃ kaḥ pradveṣaḥ ?
atha brūṣe na vayaṃ nityamekamityādilakṣaṇalakṣitaṃ kālaṃ vyatiriktaṃ jānīmaḥ, pūrvāparībhūtāḥ padārthamātrā eva svabhāvabhinnāḥ kālaḥ, tatsamāśrayaṇena cāyaṃ kramayaugapadyavyavahāraḥ, na punastadvyatiriktanityasvabhāvakālakṛta iti | tatrāpyāhavyāvartinīnāmiti| tāḥ pūrvāparībhūtāḥ padārthamātrā udayavyayayoginya eveti viśarārūṇāṃ tāsāṃ kīdṛśaḥ kramaḥ, kathaṃ ca tatsamāśrayaṇena kālavyavahāra iti yatkiñcidetat || 24 |
evaṃ tarhi kramavatībhyo mātrābhya utpannā buddhiḥ pracitamātrā vā'pracitamātrā vā parimāṇabhedavyavahārāya kalpiṣyate, sarvathā sādhvanupāttamātrārūpaiva---
tābhyo yā jāyate buddhirekā sā bhāgavartinī |
sā hi svaśaktyā bhinneva kramapratyavamarśinī || 25 |
ekatvāddhi buddhāvātmabhūtāni saṃsargiṇīnāṃ virodhinīnāṃ vā mātrāṇāṃ bhinnāni tattvāni na saṃbhavanti | sā tvekā bhāgavarjitā buddhiḥ prakāśasvarūpatvānmātrāṇāṃ kramasaṃkīrṇapaurvāparyyāṇāṃ tad‌rūpāparityāgenāsaṃhāryamapi saṃhṛtyaiva pratyavamṛśati | evambhūta eva buddhipratyavamarśaḥ || 25 |
atha tathāvidhapadārthasamāśrayaṇena buddhirupajāyamānā kālavyavahāraṃ nirvartayiṣyatītyāśaṅkyāha---tābhya iti |
tābhyaḥ padārthamātrābhyo yā jāyate buddhiḥ sā'pi na śaknoti kālavyavahāraṃ nirvartayitum | yata ekāsau buddhirnirvibhāgeti kathaṃ pūrvāparavyavahāraṃ nirvartayet | tatrāha--sā hīti | buddhirhi bhinneva svaśaktyā kramapratyavamarśinī bhaviṣyati | yataḥ kramollekhānuṣaṅgeṇaivāsāvanubhavavāsanāvaśādupajāyata iti kālavyavahāranirvartanacaturaiva sā|| 25 |
kramollekhānuṣaṅgeṇa tasyāṃ yad bījamāhitam |
tattvanānātvayostasya niruktirnāvatiṣṭhate || 26 |
iha yad vyavahitānāṃ mātrāṇāmanupākhyānāṃ pūrvāsu buddhiṣūpayuktasāmarthyānāṃ sāmāpaśinī (sāmisparśinī) na rūpopagrahollekhyā.......bījānāmiva vyapadeśātītaṃ tattvam |
kutaḥ statra viruddhaphalānāṃ mātropahitānāmātma śaktibījānāmekasyāṃ buddhau laukikamekatvaṃ laukikaṃ vā nānātvaṃ nirvaktuṃ na śakyate ? kathaṃ hi viruddhātmakamanavayavamekaṃ vastu syādaneko vā viruddha ātmā kathamekasya prakalpakaḥ || 26 ||
etad dūṣayitumāha--tasyāmiti | tasyāṃ buddhau yadāhitaṃ padārthamātrābhiranubhavavaśād bījaṃ vāsanārūpaṃ saṃskārasvabhāvaṃ tat kiṃ vyatiriktaṃ tasyā utāvyatiriktamiti dvayī gatiḥ | vyatireke tasyāstena na kiñciditi kathaṃ tadvaśāt kramādiko vyavahāraḥ ? avyatireke punarapi saivaikā nirvibhāgeti padārthamātrāvat kālavyavahāraṃ kathaṃ nirvāhayediti tattvanānātvābhyāṃ nirvacanaṃ buddheḥ kartuṃ na pāryata iti yatkiñcidetat || 26|
bhāvanāsamaye tvetat kramasāmarthyamakramam |
vyāvṛttabhedo yenārtho bhedavānapalabhyate || 27 |
bhedabhāvanānugatabuddhīnāmekatvena vyavaharatāmanādinā mithyābhyāsena vihitasamavāyānāmekasyāṃ buddhāvavyatiriktāsvanapāyopāyinīṣu sarvamātrāsu kramākhyāyāḥ śakteḥ sāmarthyamavidyamānaṃ prakalpyate kramaprasiddhaye | tad‌vyāvṛttabhedo'pi sarvā prā (sarvo vākyarūpaḥ) śabdākhyo'rtho viruddhadharmakramarūpopagraheṇāsatāmapi bhedena prayuktaivopalabhyate |
tathāhi--ūrdhvamadhastiryagityekatve'pi diśā yathāyathaṃ viniviṣṭabhāvanāviśeṣāḥ sarvaprāṇinaḥ | gurutvāhiyuktā loṣṭādayo'pi nātmavat prāṇināṃ bhāvanāsamayamanuvartante | ekaṃ tu vākyaṃ pratipadyamānasyāsadapi nityatvādatyantanānātvaṃ vyavahāreṇa || 27 |
punaścātakāṇḍakalalavadavibhakta eva yukta iti pratipādayitumāha--bhāvaneti | brahmakāṇḍe sarvaśaṅkānivāraṇapūrvakaṃ sphoṭasvarūpaṃ nirūpitameva | tasmādetad‌vākyamakramaṃ sphoṭasvabhāvamekaṃ vācakam | svapadārthabhāvanāvasare tūpādhivaśāt kramasāmarthyaṃ krame sāmarthyaṃ śaktiryasya tat kramasāmarthyamavagatam | yenārtho vācyasvarūpo vyāvṛttabhedo'khaṇḍa eva padārthopādhivaśādbhedavānivopalabhyate, na paramārthataḥ || 27 |
padāni vākye tānyeva varṇāste ca pade yadi |
varṇeṣu varṇabhāgānāṃ bhedaḥ syāt paramāṇuvat || 28 |
yasya punastāni padānyevopalabhyamānāni vastu santi vākye'bhimatāni, na tadvyatiriktamekamanaṃśamastyakhaṇḍasvabhāvaṃ vākyam, tasya padānyapi na varṇavyatirekeṇa vidyante | varṇā api bhāgavanta iti prakarṣaprāpto bheda eva sarvatra syāditi padavādinaṃ dūṣayitumāha--padānīti |
yathāvayavavyatirekeṇāvayavina ekasyānaṅgīkaraṇe'vayavānāmapi bhāgavattvād bhāgaparikalpanāyā atiprasaṅgāt paramāṇūnāmavaśeṣaḥ | teṣāmapi keṣāñcinmate ṣaṭ‌kena yugapadyogāt saṃśatāyāmaṇīyaso'pyavayavasyānupapattiḥ | ataśca vyapadeśyapadārthavirahitaṃ nirīhameva jagadāpatitam || 28 |
bhāgānāmanupaśleṣānna varṇau na padaṃ bhavet |
teṣāmavyapadeśyatvāt kimanyadapadiśyatām || 29 |
yadi vākye tānyeva padāni yāni pṛthagupalabdhāni varṇāśca ye pṛthagupalabdhāsta eva samuditā yadi padeṣvāśrīyante, na ca varṇebhyo vākyapadayorātmā vyatirikta iti pratijñāyate | tathā sati varṇeṣvapi yāvadapakarṣaparyantagatistāvadvarṇabhāgānāṃ paramāṇukalpo bhedaḥ prasajyate | tathā ca kramavatāmalabdhayaugapadyānāṃ bhāgānāmanyonyāsaṃsparśānna varṇo nāma kaścidekaḥ padaṃ vā vidyate | avyapadeśyatvāddhi teṣu pratibhāgaṃ vyavahārābhāvāt kiṃ tadekamasti śabdarūpaṃ yadidaṃ tadityupākhyāyeta | evaṃ tarhi nānirdeśyabhāgabhedarūpeṇa bahiranupasaṃhāreṇa śabdatattvena vyavahāro'stīti || 29 |
tathaiva varṇabhāgānāmanupaśleṣānna varṇa ekaḥ kaścit syāt | tadabhāve padamapi na bhavediti pratipādayitumāha--bhāgānāmiti |
ataścoktarītyā bhāgānāmasattvād vyapadeśavirahāt kimatra vācakametadvyatiriktamanyadapadiśyatām | akhaṇḍasyānaṅgīkaraṇāt padānāmuktena nyāyenānupapatteriti na kaścid vācakaḥ syāt | asti ca vākyārthasya pratītiḥ | sā sanimittā bhavitumarhaṃtītyeka eva nityaḥ padābhivyaṅgayo'khaṇḍo vyaktisphoṭo jātisphoṭo vā vācako'ṅgīkārya iti siddhāntaḥ || 29 |
yadantaḥ śabdatattvaṃ tu nādairekaṃ prakāśitam |
tadāhurapare śabdaṃ tasya vākye tathaikatā || 30 |
bāhyāsyākṣaracihnādivacchabdavyapadeśamātrāyuktasya yadudayastamayanibandhanaṃ vācastattvamakṣaracihnādivadevātathābhūteḥ kramavadbhirbhāgairakramaṃ prakāśyate, tadeva mukhyaṃ śabdasyātmarūpamityapare manyante |
sa ceṣa buddhyanusaṃhāralakṣaṇa āntaraḥ śabdātmā tatra samāmnātaḥ | tasya cetthambhāve vicchinnapadarūpapravibhāgadarśana eka evāyaṃ vākyākhyaḥ śabdo yathaiva varṇapadākhya iti prasiddha eṣa samāmnāye mārgaḥ || 30 |
evaṃ tāvad bahīrūpaṃ vyaktisphoṭaṃ jātisphoṭaṃ vā vācakamāśritya vākyaṃ vyākhyātam | idānīmantarevānavayavaṃ bodhasvabhāvaṃ śabdārthamayaṃ nirvibhāgaṃ śabdatattvamiti yad gītaṃ tadeva nādairbahiḥ prakāśitaṃ vākyamāhurācāryā ityāntaraṃ buddhyanusaṃhṛtirityuddiṣṭaṃ vyākhyātumāha--yadantariti |
vākyavicāre prastute tasyāntarasyaikatā niraṃśataiva pratipādyata iti tadeva satyatvādvākyamastu kiṃ tadvyatiriktenāsatyena vākyenetyarthaḥ || 30 |
arthabhāgaistathā teṣāmāntaro'rthaḥ prakāśyate |
ekasyaivātmano bhedau śabdārthāvapṛthakasthitau || 31 |
yathaivāvyapadeśyaśabdabhāgopāyamantarniveśi vāktattvamabhinnaṃ mukhyaḥ śabdātmeti prasiddhaṃ tathā vyatipātinīṣu vyāvahārikīṣu bāhyāsvarthamātrāsvavyapadeśyopacīyamānaviśeṣaṃ krameṇa pratyarthaniyatamutpadyamānaṃ buddhitattvaṃ bāhyavastutattvenaiva pratyupabhujyate |
nityapakṣe vā kramaśaktirūpanirbhāsamātrayā nivartate | nahi pratilabdhārtharūpaviparyāsāṃ buddhimantareṇa bāhyaṃ vastu vyāvahārikīṣvarthakriyāsu samarthaṃ bhavati | tasmādantarniviṣṭarūpeṇārthena sarvo vyavahāraḥ kriyate |
anye tu saṃkrāntaviṣayarūpāyā buddherātmani samavāyād buddhirūpaniveśena tad‌rūpatāmivāpanne bodhātmake puruṣe puruṣārthasya prasiddhiṃ manyante |
prakāśasvabhāvayā buddhyā citisvarūpasyārtharūpasya ca pratibimbakayogenopagrahe sambhavati prāptaviṣayarūpaviparyāsāyāmupagṛhītapuruṣarūpāyāṃ buddhau bhogyabhoktṛśaktyoratyantavibhaktayoratyantasaṃkīrṇayoravibhāgaprāptāviva satyāṃ vibhāgaḥ prakalpate |
apariṇāminī hi bhoktṛśaktirapratisaṃkramā ca pariṇāminyarthe pratisaṃkrānteva tad‌vṛttimanupatati |
tasyāśca prāptacaitanyopagraharūpāyā buddhivṛtte (buddheḥ) ranukāramātrayā buddhivṛttyā viśiṣṭajñānasya pravṛttirākhyāyate |
sarveṣu ca pakṣaṣvantarniveśina iva (eva) prāptānusaṃhārāt śabdādantarniviṣṭarūpeṣviva (ṣveva) pratisaṃhṛteṣvavibhakteṣu vibhāgarūpānatikrameṇārtheṣu gṛhyamāṇeṣveka evāyaṃ parisamāptiprāptānusaṃhāro buddhyātmā pratipādakapratipattavyaśaktyoravibhāgena pṛthagātmanorbhedaśaktirūpāparityāgamātrayā vyavatiṣṭhate | nityavādināṃ tvānāgantukamanatikrāntamanupacayāpacayam || 31 |
na kevalaṃ vākyaṃ tathā yāvadvākyārtho'pyakhaṇḍaḥ pratibhātmakaḥ padārthabhāgairabhivyajyata iti prasaṅgādāha--arthabhāgairiti |
teṣāmāntaravākyavādināmācāryāṇāṃ mate āntara evātrāpi vākyārtha iti boddhavyam | tau ca śabdārthāvabhinnāvekasyāntarasya tattvasya sambandhinau vastuto bahiḥ sthitau bhedāviva pratibhāsete iti bodhyamityāha--ekasyaiveti || 31 |
prakāśakaprakāśyatvaṃ kāryakāraṇarūpatā |
antarmātrātmanastasya śabdatattvasya sarvadā || 32 |
ayamantarmātrāśabdo'napāyinyapāyinībhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ śabdaśaktibhyāmanugataḥ | tasyaitasminnātmanyavibhaktamapi prakāśakatvena prakāśyatvaṃ vibhaktamiva pratyavabhāsate|anyonyānuvidhāyirūpatayā ca kāryakāraṇarūpatā, tasyādeśasyāntarmātretyevamākhyāyamānasya śabdātmanaḥ sarvadā |
sarvadeti nāsyānyaḥ kālādhvā vidyate | bhāvābhāvavibhāgābhāvapratipattyarthaṃ tu vyavahārapradarśanāya sarvaṃdetyucyate | bhāvābhāvavibhāgābhāvādantarmātrāniveśiśabdārthakatvam |
sarvadaivānapāyinirbhāsopa(ga) mo'pi cāsyāvyatirekānatikrameṇa tathaiva vyavasthitaḥ, sarvavyatirekānatikramāt (vyatirekātikramāta) tatra kiṃ kṛtaṃ kadācit saṃpratyayahetutvam |
sarvādā kadācidityetadavyatiriktasyādhārādheyabhāvavikalpanā, avasthiterarthasya mithyābhyāsabhāvanānugamāt parikalpitabhedamātmatattvameva tatrāviśeṣo viśeṣa iva vyāmohaṃ janayati || 32 |
nanu śabdarthau vācyavācakāviti prasiddham | ataḥ kathaṃ tayorabheda ityāśaṅkyāha--prakāśaketi | tasya hi śabdatattvasyāntarasya jyotīrūpasya śaktibhedādayaṃ bhedapratibhāso na viruddhaḥ | etaccādāvenoktamāgamakāṇḍe `ekasya sarvabījasya' ityādinā||32|
tasyaivāstitvanāstitvasāmarthye samavasthite |
akrame kramanirbhāse vyavahāranibandhane || 33 |
ekasyātmano hyantarmātrāniveśinaḥ śabdārthatattvasyātmabhūte nitye anāgamāgapame ekatvamanatikrānte dve sāmarthye bhāvābhāvākhye ekabuddhigatamiva kramarūpamakrame saṃvedyete yathaiva (tathaiva) bhāvābhāvāvityekā prakhyā | atra granthapātaḥ
idamapi tasya śaktibhedādavabhāsata iti prasaṅgādāha--tasyaiveti
tasya tadevaikaṃ nirvibhāgaṃ paraṃ tattvamāśrityāyaṃ sakalalokasaṃvyavahāraḥ śaktibhedāt pratīyate, kiṃ punarayaṃ vācyavācakavibhāgamātrarūpa ityakhaṇḍapakṣa eva yuktaḥ||33|
saṃpratyayapramāṇatvāt padārthāstitvakalpane |
padārthābhyuccaye tyāgādānarthakyaṃ prasajyate || 34 |
idānīṃ padavādīmatamāśaṅkya punarapi dūṣayitumāha---
yadi padārthasaṃpratyayaḥ pramāṇaṃ padapadārthasattāyāmucyate, tadā devadatta gāmabhyāja śuklāṃ daṇḍenetyasmin vākye pūrvapūrvapadārthānāmuttarottarapadārthābhyuccaye svārthatyāgāt tattatpadopādānasyānarthakyaṃ prasajyate | tataścānarthakasyoccāraṇavaiphalyāduccāritādvā tasmācchabdamātrāt padārthapratyayasyānupapatteḥ kiṃ nibandhanā vākyārthapratītiḥ syāditi yatkiñcidetat || 34 |
rājaśabdena rājārtho bhinnarūpeṇa gamyate |
tathā ca padānāmavyavasthiteḥ padavādo'nupapanna eva lakṣyate ityabhidhātumāha--
rājā rājānaṃ rājñā rājñe rājño rājñi rājanītyevamaniyatasvarūpeṇa rājapadena rājārthapratītirdṛśyate | yadi padasya satyatā syāt , tadā niyataṃ tat paridṛśyeta | sarvatra na ca dṛśyate, ato manyāmahe mithyaiva padānīti |
vṛttāvākhyātasaddaśaṃ padamanyatra yujyate || 35 |
ito'pi nāsti padamityāha---
rājapuruṣa ityasyāṃ vṛttau rājaśabda ākyātasadṛśaḥ | tataśca he rājapuruṣetyatra rāja bhrājasva puruṣetyarthapratītiḥ syāt | na caitadiṣṭam | tasmāt pāramārthikāni padāni na santyeva || 35 |
yadi ca na kevalo rājaśabdo'nyatra dṛṣṭaprayogaḥ , sa rājapuruṣādiṣu bhidyate; kiṃ kṛtā puruṣe rājapuruṣo brāhmaṇapuruṣa iti viśiṣṭārthasyāvagatiḥ (ata āha)---
yathāśvakarṇa ityukte vinaivāśvena gamyate |
kaścideva viśṣṭo'rthaḥ sarveṣu pratyayastathā || 36 |
tadyathā--ajakarṇo'śvakarṇa ityukte nāśvārthasya karṇārthasya vā svalpo'pi samanvayo vidyate | bhedaviṣayeṇa tvatyantamatadarthena vākyenārthapradarśikā kriyate, bahuvrīhitatpuruṣasaṃjñādibhiḥ samudāyāntareṣu śabdasaṃskāraḥ |
aśvādīnāṃ padārthanāmatyantāsamanvaye'pi gamyate vyāvṛttānuvṛttasvalakṣaṇaḥ kaścideva niyato'rthaḥ | tathaiva sarvāsu vṛttiṣvarthāntarāsamanvaye gaṃsyata eva viśiṣṭo'rthaḥ || 36 |
nakevalaṃ kevalānāṃ niyatarūpāsaṃbhavasteṣāṃ yāvadvṛttāvapi sthitānāmityāha---yathāśvakarṇa iti |
aśvakarṇa ityatrāśvapadārthena vinaiva jātyantaraviśiṣṭaḥ kaścidartho gamyate |tasmāt sarveṣvapi padeṣu parāmṛṣṭavibhāgeṣu vākyābhivyañjakeṣu satsvakhaṇḍavākyāvagatipūrvako vākyārthapratyaya ityeva yuktam || 36 ||
yadi tarhi rājapuruṣādīnāmaśvakarṇādibhistulyaḥ pūrvapadottarapadārtha (rthā)- samanvayaḥ , tatkuto rūḍhyarūḍhivibhāgaḥ (ata āha) --
vākyeṣvarthāntaragateḥ sādṛśyaṃ parikalpyate |
keṣāñcid rūḍhiśabdatvaṃ śāstra evānugamyate || 37 |
iha svabhāvasiddhe vṛttivākyayoratyantamarthasyābhede vṛttyā vākyena prakramyamāṇe'sya yatra pradhānasyāviśiṣṭaḥ kriyādisambandhastatra vākyasya vicchedavṛttimātrakṛtabhedamiva sādṛśyaṃ kalpyate, satsvapyupasarjanaviśeṣaṇādiṣu bhedeṣu | ataśca sādṛśyakalpanayā te'rūḍhiśabdā ityavagamyate |
yeṣāṃ tu vākyaprakramo'nya evārthaḥ kriyāsambandhī vṛttiprakramo'nya eva, teṣāṃ rūḍhiśabdatvam | teṣu ca `śilpini cākṛñaḥ' , `saṃjñāyāmanācitādīnām' , ṅyāpoḥ saṃjñāchandasorbahulam' , `bahulaṃ taṇi'--ityevamādīni kāryyāṇi śāstra evopavyākhyāyante || 37 |
nanvevaṃ sati yo'yaṃ rūḍhyarūḍhivibhāgaḥ śabdānāmucyate sa vṛthetyāśaṅkyāha--vākya iti |
vṛttivākyayoḥ sādṛśyaparikalpane keṣāñcicchabdānāṃ vākye vigraharūpe'rthāntarapratīte rūḍhiśabdatvamucyate | yathā---tailapāyiketi | atra tailaṃ pibatīti vākyavelāyāmarthaprādurbhāvaḥ | vṛtyavasthāyāṃ tailapāyiketi jātyantarayuktārthasya kasyacit pratītiḥ | na ca tasya tailapānakriyā lakṣyata iti rūḍhirūpatāsyocyate | keṣāñcittu vṛttivākyayorarthasya sādṛśyād yaugikatvam | yathā -- rājapuruṣa iti | parikalpana ityanena sarvametadavayavavibhāgādikaṃ śāstrasamaya eva kalpanāmātram , paramārthatastu vyavahārakāle nirvibhāgamevopalabhyata iti pratipādyate | etadeva śāstra evānugamyata ityanena vyaktīkṛtam || 37 |
upādāyāpi ye heyāstānupāyān pracakṣate |
upāyānāṃ ca niyamo nāvaśyamavatiṣṭhate || 38 |
iha śabdasaṃskāre kvacidarthasyāpi samadhigamamātrāyāṃ buddhau padāni vākyasyopakārāyopādīyante | carcādipadāni saṃhitāyām, vākyapadāni samāsataddhitasubdhātvekaśeṣavṛttiṣu | teṣāṃ ca yadarthamupādānaṃ tatsannidhāne niyata eṣāṃ tyāgaḥ, upāyabhāvāt |
śāstre hyāmantritasya padāt parasya tiṅṅatiṅa iti nighātādayaḥ śabdasaṃskārāḥ | tathā `ekādeśa udāttenodāttaḥ'  , `svarito vā anudātte padādau' , `udāttasvaritayoryaṇa'  iti | tathā tatpuruṣe tulyārthatṛtīyā , `saptamīhāriṇau'  ityevamādayo'rthapratipattimātrā api dṛśyante |
yathā me māt tathā me pitā, susnātaṃ bhoḥ, namo bharanta emasi, saubhāgyamasyai dattvāyāthāstaṃ viparetaneti |
taḥ paro yasmāt so'yaṃ taparaḥ, tādapi parastapara iti, viyātasya bhāvo vaiyātyam  iti | ta ete puruṣasambodhanopāyāḥ |
yadi tvanyathāpi puruṣāḥ pratipādayituṃ śakyante tadarthānyupāyāntarāṇyapi prakramyante || 38 |
kathametaducyata ityāha--upādāyāpīti | śāstramupāyaḥ śabdaparijñāne | jñāteṣu teṣu prayojanasampatteranupayoga iti tasya parityāgaḥ | upāyāśca na niyatā ityāha--upāyānāṃ ceti || 38 |
arthaṃ kathañcit puruṣaḥ kaścit saṃpratipadyate |
saṃsṛṣṭā vā vibhaktā vā bhedā vākyanibandhanāḥ || 39 |
vicitrā hi bahudhā pratipattṝṇāṃ pratipattiḥ | śrotriyaṃśchando'dhīta iti  vākyārthe padavacanam, chandaso vā śrotrabhāvaḥ gham̐śca pratyayaḥ, śrotrābhyāṃ kṛtaṃ karmeti vā| tathā `iko vaktavyaḥ' ākhanikaḥ, `ikavako vaktavyaḥ' ākhanikavakaḥ | pātresamitādiṣu  vā''khanikavaka iti paṭhyate |
tathā---uṣṭragoyugāśvaṣaḍ‌gavādiṣu pratyayatvenānyathānyathā cānvākhyānaṃ kriyate | te yadi vibhaktāḥ kadācidapyanibaddhā vākye vidyante, saṃsṛṣṭā rājapuruṣaḥ plakṣanyagrodhau | vibhaktā rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ, plakṣaśca nyagrodhaśceti |
apara āha---saṃsṛṣṭāḥ devadatta gāmabhyāja śuklāmiti | vibhaktāḥ yatra padāntaraiḥ, saha padasyāprayogaḥ | sarvathā yānyavicchinnarūpagrahaṇāni nidarśanāya sāmānyarūpāvasthitāni padānyupādīyante, tānyapyantataḥ sattāyāmunibaddhāni na kasyāñcidapyavasthāyāṃ nidarśanāyālam |
tasmādyadi saṃsṛṣṭā yadi vibhaktāḥ, nānibaddhā vākye bhedā vidyante | bhedasaṃsargo tvadhyāropaniyamānuvādaiḥ puruṣapratipattyupāyāveveti || 39 |
kaścidācāryaḥ pāṇiniviracitena lakṣaṇaśāstreṇa śabdānadhigacchati, kaścidanyeneti na niyamaḥ | etadeva spaṣṭīkṛtam---arthaṃ kathañcidityādinā | tasmāt saṃsṛṣṭasya vibhaktasya vārthaviśeṣasya vākyamekamanaṃśameva pratītinibandhanamiti padapadārthapravibhāgakalpanamasamañjasameveti pratipādayitumāha---saṃsṛṣṭā vā iti || 39 |
so'yamityabhisambandho bud‌dhyā prakamyate yadā |
vākyārthasya tadaiko'pi varṇaḥ pratyāyakaḥ kvacit || 40 |
nāvaśyaṃ vicchinnapadarūpavigraha eva śabdaḥ paurvāparyayuktamanugatavibhāgamevārthaṃ pratyāyayati | yadā hi vākyārthasyaivegyaṇaḥ sthāne bhavatītyevamāderbuddhiviṣayaḥ samprasāraṇamiti vā, `bha bhi' iti vā so'yamityabhisambandhaḥ kriyate, atho yathaivegyaṇa ityanena paurvāparyānupātinī pratipattirbhavati, evamapaurvāparyayā `bha bhi' ityekavarṇayā tasyārthasya saṃjñayā pratyastamitapaurvāparyaḥ sa evārthātmā pratīyate | na cāvaśyaṃ śabdavyavahitaiva tatra pratipattirbhavati | kṛtābhyāsānāṃ hi śabdāntareṇārthapratipattirna vyavadhīyate |
