yadi ca laghūpāyaṃ sāmānyaviśeṣayuktaṃ śāstraṃ sadṛśasaṃvyavahāramalasa itīva mithyābhyā (dhyā) saviparyayastad‌darśino loke nānupatet tadā pratipattārastamevākramaṃ pratipadyaren | bhedarūpeṇa cai (nai) katvaṃ saṃkīrṇam | tena sāparādhaiva prakarṣaviniveśinyāḥ prakrāntakramarūpopaplavāyā voco vṛttiḥ | sā hi sāparādheṣu puruṣeṣvanyathaivātmānaṃ darśayati | ataśca tāmeke paśyanto'pi na paśyanti, śrṛṇvanto'pi na śrṛṇvanti | tāṃ tu vaiyākaraṇā vāgyogavidaḥ śabdātmānamabhisaṃbhūtā bhedadarśanamatītya svena svarūpatattvenopalabhante |
sā ca tebhya evātmānaṃ vivṛṇoti | uktamidam---`arthaṃ kathañcit puruṣaḥ kaścit saṃpratipadyate' iti | śrataḥ puruṣapratipattibhedānāṃ parimāṇavikalpānāṃ nidarśanamātraṃ kriyate || 40 |
ataścaniraṃśaevāyaṃ padārthaśūnyo vākyārtho'dhyāsamātrasambandhagarbhaekasmādapi varṇāt pratīyata evatyabhidātumāha---so'yamiti |
so'yamityabhisambandho'dhyāsarūpo vākyārthasya vākyena saha yadā vaktrā prakamyate, tadaiko'pi varṇo vākyārthasya vācako bhavatyeva, kiṃ punaranekamaśoṣaviśeṣābhidhānavivakṣayodīritaṃ padamiti | evamadhyāsavaśād vākyavākyārthayorabhinnasvarūpatvād vākyārthābhivyaktau vākyamapi sphoṭātmakarmābhavyaktamevekyuktam---vākyārthasya tadaiko'pītyādi || 40 ||
kevalena padenārtho yāvānevābhidhīyate |
vākyasthaṃ tāvato'rthasya tadāhurabhidhāyakam || 41 |
iha yāvantaṃ kevalo vṛkṣaśabdo jātimātraṃ bhinnamarthaṃ bravīti tāvantameva vṛkṣo'sti vṛkṣo nāsti vṛkṣaśchinna ityevamādiṣvapi vākyeṣu prāptayogaṃ (gaḥ) pratyāyayati | bhāvābhāvacchedādiyogo (na) bhinnajātiyuktātmakatāṃ pradarśayati | nāpi jātiyogyo bhāvābhāvacchedādisambandhaḥ | nahi mābhāntaranibandhanasya mātrāntarapratyāyane sāmarthyamasti || 41 |
idānīmābhihitānvayapakṣasamāśrayaṇena saṃghātapakṣasya pradarśanāyāha---kevaleneti | kevalaṃ padaṃ yasyaivārthasya vācakam , vākyasthamapi tamevābhidadhāti |
sambandhe sati yattvanyadādhikyamupajāyate |
vākyārthameva taṃ prāhuranekapadasaṃśrayam || 42 |
yattu padāntareṇa sambandhe vīraḥ puruṣa iti viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyatvāt sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ jātiguṇaviśeṣayorekārthasamavāyapratipattipūrvakamartheṣvādhikyaṃ dṛśyate vākyārtha evāsau | nahi tasyāntaḥ padaṃ śabdasaṃskāre nimittatvena vyāpāra āśrīyate |
yastvekapadaviṣayo vyatirekaḥ karmādivad bāhyanimittopajanito rājñaḥ puruṣa iti so'ntaḥ padaṃ prātipadikānyeva vibhaktiyogaviśeṣayoge niyamayati | sa cāyaṃ vākyapadayorādhikyayorbhedo bhāṣya evopavyākhyātaḥ |
ataśca tatrabhavānāha---`yathaikapadagataḥ prātipadike'ntaḥ padaṃ saṃskāraheturartho vacanaṃ prati bhavati tathaikapadagataḥ padasaṃskārahetureva vibhaktiyogaṃ pratyaheturbhavati | grāmo grāmo ramaṇīya iti | anekapadasaṃśrayastu vākyārthaḥ pratinighātādivyavasthārthaṃheturākhyāyata iti || 42 ||
tataḥ samudāye padānāṃ parasparānvaye padārthavaśādyadādhikyaṃ saṃsargaḥ sa vākyārthaḥ | uktaṃ ca-`yadatrādhikyaṃ vākyārthaḥ sa' iti | anekapadasaṃśrayamityanena saṃghāto vākyamiti darśitam || 41 - 42 |
athāpyanekapadasaṃśrayatve'pyaparo darśanabhedaḥ--
sa tvanekapadasthopi pratibhedaṃ samāpyate |
jātivatsamudāye'pi saṃkhyāvatkalpyate paraiḥ || 43 |
yadyathā jātivat sattāvāne (yā ane) kādhikaraṇayoge'pi pratyadhikaraṇamanyūnakāryā (yā), tathāyamekeṣāṃ vākyārtha āvṛ(kṛ) tinyūnatāsamatikrameṇa pratipadamevāvikalaḥ samāpyate | athāparaḥ kalpaḥ---yathaikasyā viṃśatyādikāyāḥ saṃkhyāyāḥ prattyadhikaraṇaṃ tannimittapratyayahetutvaṃ tathā vākyārthasya pratipadaṃ pratyāyyatvenāvasthānamiti || 43 |
vākyārthasya cāsya jātivat pratyekaparisamāptiḥ, keṣāñcinmate saṃkhyāvat samudāyaparisamāptiriti pakṣadvayaṃ darśayitumāha--sa tvaneketi || 43 |
sarvabhedānuguṇyaṃ tu sāmānyamapare viduḥ |
tadarthāntarasaṃsargād bhajate bhedarūpatām || 44 |
bhedānākāṅ‌kṣatastasya yā pariplavamānatā |
avacchinatti saṃbandhastāṃ viśeṣe niveśayan || 45 |
apare tu manyante--svārthamātropādāyinaḥ sarvabhedān prati yā yogyatā tadevānuguṇyamātraṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyamātram | nahi tathānyathā sarvathā ceti sāmānyāvasthārūpaṃ kiñcidasti | sarva ete viśeṣā eva | tasyāntu sāmānyāvasthāyāṃ bhedasya kasyacidanirūpaṇādānuguṇyācca yā sarvabhedopagrahayogyatā pariplavamānakalpanārthasya tāṃ sambandho viṣayāntarādavacchidya viśiṣṭe viṣaye niyamayati | tasmiṃśca yogyatāvacchedamātre'rthasya kriyamāṇe nādhyāropaniyamaḥ, nānupādānayogyatā kiñcidartharūpaṃ (prati) nāpyartharūpādanyā || 44 - 45 |
athātra saṃghātapakṣa eva prakārāntareṇānvitābhidhānapradarśanāt padārtha eva vākyārtha iti prakramitumāha---sarvabhedeti | sarveṣāṃ bhedānāmānuguṇyaṃ yasmin tattathāvidhaṃ sāmānyaṃ saṃsargalakṣaṇamākāṅ‌kṣāyogyatāsannidhānavaśena padāntarasaṃsargānniyatasvarūpaṃ vākyārthaḥ || 44 |
tatra cākāṅ‌kṣāvasare yeyamasphuṭarūpatā vākyārthasya tāmitarapadārthasannidhirnivārayatītyāha--bhedāniti | pūrvatra padānāṃ vākye tāvānevārtho yāvāneva kevalānām, saṃsargastu saṃghātavācyaḥ | iha tu tathābhūta eva sāmānyarūpaḥ padasyārtho yastattadviśeṣasannidhau tattadviśeṣaviśrānta iti || 45 |
yastarhi yogyatāvacchedahetuḥ sambandhaḥ, sa ca nārthebhyo vākyasyābhidheya iti prāptaṃ so'pi sarvābhidheyadharmānatikrāntaḥ sambandhaḥ | yadi sarvābhidheyadharmānatikrāntaḥ kathaṃ tarhi so'stītyavasīyate--
kāryānumeyaḥ saṃbandho rūpaṃ tasya na dṛśyate |
asattvabhūtamatyantamatastaṃ pratijānate || 46 |
nahi tasya sambandhasya svarūpamavadhārayituṃ śakyam | sa eva yogyatāvacchedakāryaprasavānumeya eva nityam, prāptasaṃvijñānapadaviśeṣanibandhanaḥ sākṣātsambandhe'sambandhe vā sarvapratyayātmasu (a) viśiṣṭasvarūpaḥ | ataścedantaditi sākṣātparyāyaśabdena vā vyapadeṣṭumaśakyatvādatyantāsattvabhūtamanekasambandhiviṣayaṃ sambandhamācakṣate||46|
saṃghātapakṣe saṃsargo vākyārtha ityuktam | sa ca pūrvatra jātivat saṃkhyāvadvā padārthavyatirekeṇa vākyārthatvena kalpitaḥ | idānī padārthavyatirekeṇāsannaivaikāntānumeyo na samudāyavācyaḥ, kiṃ tarhi sarvabhedānuguṇasāmānyarūpo viśeṣāntarasannidhānādviśeṣaviśrāntaḥ padārtha eva vākyārtha iti darśayitumāha--kāryānumeya iti | kāryeṇa padārthānāṃ viśeṣaviśrāntilakṣaṇenānumīyata iti kāryānumeyaḥ | idaṃ taditi tu rūpaṃ tasya na dṛśyate | ata evāsattvabhūtaṃ padārthavyatirekeṇa sattvaṃ nāsti, yasya tamevaṃ bhūtamācāryāḥ pratijānate || 46 ||
niyataṃ sādhane sādhyaṃ kriyā niyatasādhanā |
sa sannidhānamātreṇa niyamaḥ san prakāśate || 47 |
niyatasādhanaḥ sādhyo'rthaḥ | niyatakriyāṇi ca sādhanānyavibhaktarūpopakārāṇyapi yutavyavasthāni pratipadamabhidheyatvenāvasthitāni | nityaniyatatvācca niyamo'pyatra vidheyaḥ | saṃstu niyamaḥ prayoge sannidhimātreṇa padāntarāṇāṃ puruṣaṃ prati prakāśate nānugṛhyate || 47 |
etadeva vyaktīkartumāha--niyatamiti |
sādhyaṃ sādhanaṃ ca parasparaṃ niyatameva | kevalamākāṅ‌kṣāvaśāditarapadārthasannidhāne sati niyamaḥ sanneva prakāśata ityākṣiptapadāntarāṇi padānyeva vākyam, padārthasca vākyārtha ityavyatiriktaḥ saṃghātapakṣo'yam || 47 |
yadi tarhi niyatasaṃsarga eva nityāvibhakto'yamartha evaṃ sati kiṃ kṛtā guṇapradhānabhāvapratyavasthā---
guṇabhāvena sākāṅ‌kṣaṃ tatra nāma pravartate |
sādhyatvena nimittāni kriyāpadamapekṣate || 48 |
iha sādhyenānupakārakeṇāṅginā mukhyenārthena prayuktāni sarvataḥ siddhāni parārthānyupakāraṃ prati śeṣabhāvenautsukyavantīvāṅgānyupādīyante | sādhyatvenaiva tu nimittāni kriyāpadamapekṣate |
etaduktaṃ bhavati---artheṣu satīmasatīṃ vā śabdavṛttyanukāreṇa puruṣo vyapekṣāṃ samīhate | tāṃ śabda eva prakāśayati | sā hi nityaniviṣṭarūpeva śabdātmani||48||
athātra parasparāpekṣāyāṃ samānāyāṃ viśeṣamabhidhātumāha---guṇabhāveneti |
nāma kārakapadaṃ kriyāyāṃ guṇabhūtaṃ sat padāntaramākāṅ‌kṣati | kriyāpadaṃ tu pradhānabhāvenāvasthitaṃ kārakapadānyapekṣata iti || 48 |
apara āha---
santa eva viśeṣā ye padārtheṣu vyavasthitāḥ |
te kramādanugamyante na vākyamabhidhāyakam || 49 |
arthatvamāpadyamāneṣu yāvanto viśeṣāḥ sannihitā niyataprasiddhivyavasthāste śabdāntaraviṣayeṇa kālavṛttyanugraheṇa pratibandhābhyanujñākhyena pratipattṛbhiranugamyante, nāparaṃ vākyaṃ nāma kiñcicchabdarūpamabhidhāyakaṃ vidyate || 49 |
kamo vākyamityuddiṣṭaṃ kramapakṣaṃ vyākhyātumāha--santa iti | padārtheṣu devadattādipadavācyeṣu gokarmikāyāmabhyājakriyāyāṃ devadattapadārthasya kartṛtvaṃ gopadārthasya devadattakartṛkāyāṃ karmatvamityādayo viśeṣāḥ santa eva padebhyaḥ krameṇa pratītebhyo'vagamyanta iti krama eva vākyam | na vākyamabhidhāyakamityanena kramavyatirekeṇa śabdātmakaṃ na vākyamabhidhāyakamastītyucyate || 49 |
śabdānāṃ kramamātre ca nānyaḥ śabdo'sti vācakaḥ |
kramo hi dharmaḥ kālasya tena vākyaṃ na vidyate || 50 |
nahi padeṣu pratibandhābhyanujñābhyāṃ kālenānugṛhyamāṇeṣvaparaḥ śabdaḥ kaścidupajāyate yenārthāntaraṃ pratyāyyeta | kramo hi śabdeṣu kālaśaktirūpaviśeṣasya niveśa iva | sa kālātmano na vyatiricyate | tena vākyamityavastukamevedamabhilāpamātram, padamevārthavaditi || 50 |
etadeva sphuṭīkurvannāha--śabdānāmiti | anapekṣitaviśiṣṭānupūrvokaḥ kramaḥ kramāmātram | tasmin satyarthapratīternnānyastadvyatiriktaḥ kaścit sphoṭādiḥ śabdo vācako'bhyupagantuṃ yuktaḥ | api tu krama evopalabhyamāno vācakaḥ | atha krama iti kimucyata ityāha--kramo hīti | kramavat padapadārthopādhivaśenāpi kālasya sa dharma ucyate || 50 |
kimarthaṃ tarhi kramavatāṃ kālaśaktirūpaniveśānugrahādvarṇānāmevārthavattā nābhyupagamyata ityāha--
ye ca saṃbhavino bhedāḥ padārtheṣvavibhāvitāḥ |
te sannidhāne vyajyante na tu varṇeṣvayaṃ kramaḥ || 51 ||
yathā hyu ccarite pade saṃbhavināṃ bhedānāṃ.......(atra granthapātaḥ).....
yuktaṃ caitat, yatkrama eva vākyamityāha---ye ceti |
padārtheṣu ye bhedāḥ pūrvoktāḥ santi te kevaleṣvavibhāvitāḥ santaḥ kramavatpadārthāntarasaṃnidhāne'bhivyajyanta iti darśanāt krama eva vākyamiti padakramo vākyamuktam | varṇakramastu na tathetyuktam, na tu varṇeṣvayaṃ krama iti || 51 ||
varṇānāṃ ca padānāṃ ca kramamātraniveśinī |
padākhyā vākyasaṃjñā ca śabdatvaṃ neṣyate tayoḥ || 52 ||
etadevopasaṃhāreṇa sphuṭa yitumāha---
varṇakramaḥ padamucyatāṃ nāma | vākyasaṃjñā padakrama eva yuktā, tathārthapratītidarśanāt | krama eva śabdo na varṇapade ityuktamupasaṃhartumāha śabdatvamiti | tayorvarṇapadayoḥ śabdatvaṃ śrotrendriyagrahyatve'pi vācakatvalakṣaṇaṃ neṣyate, api tu kramasyaiva || 52 ||
padakramasya śabdatvaṃ vākyārthenārthavattāyām | vākyārthabhāgaistu padānāmarthavattvam | evaṃ varṇakramasyāpi śabdatvaṃ padārthenārthavataḥ, tadarthavatāṃ varṇānāṃ kiṃ nāṅgīkriyata ityāha--
samāne'pi tu śabdatve dṛṣṭaḥ saṃpratyayaḥ padāt |
prativarṇaṃ tvasau nāsti padasyārthamato viduḥ || 53 |
varṇapadalakṣaṇasyobhayarūpasyāsya śabdatve samāne padānāṃ kramādvākyārthasyāvagamo dṛśyate na varṇādityataḥ padānyevārthavanti | tatkramaścaiva vākyam | saṃsargo vākyārtha iti || 53 |
idānīṃ saṃghātaḥ kramastathaiko'navayavaśca śabdaḥ sphoṭātmeti vyākhyātāni trīṇi vākyalakṣaṇāni ślokatrayeṇopasaṃharati | tatra saṃghātapakṣamupasaṃhartutāvadāha--
yathā'syāvayavā varṇā vinā vācyena kenacit |
arthavantaḥ samuditā vākyamapyevamiṣyate || 54 |
varṇānāṃ samudāyārthavattve kevalānāmanarthakatvaṃ yathā tathā padānāṃ kevalānāmarthāsaṃbhavāttatsamudāya eva vākyamiti || 54 |
anarthakānyupāyatvāt padārthenārthavanti vā |
krameṇoccaritānyāhurvākyārthaṃ bhinnalakṣaṇam || 55 |
kramapakṣamapyupasaṃhartumāha---
padāni kevalānyanarthakāni, keṣāñcinmate svārthenārthavanti, krameṇoccāritāni vākyam | tathāvidhādvākyādvākyārthaṃ bhinnalakṣaṇaṃ vyatiriktasvarūpaṃ saṃsargātmakaṃ viśiṣṭameva vā saṃsargavaśānnirākāṅ‌kṣaviśeṣāvasthitapadārthasvarūpameva vyatiriktamavagamyata iti || 55 |
nityatve samudāyānāṃ jātervā parikalpane |
ekasyaikārthatāmāhurvākyasyāvyabhicāriṇīm || 56 |
sphoṭapakṣamapyupasaṃhartumāha---
iha devadattagāmabhyāja suklāṃ daṇḍenetyādikāni bhinnavaktrudīritāni padasamudāyātmakāni śabdarūpādbhinnānyeva |
ayamarthaḥ- tatra tatra vaktari bhinnā api dhvanaya ekameva sphoṭaṃ vyaktisphoṭātmakaṃ nityamabhivyañjanti | devadatta gāmabhyājetyādiṣu bhinnavaktrudīriteṣu vā sphoṭajātirnityā devadattādipadasamudāyābhivyaṅgyā vākyārthasyaikasya pratibhātmakasya pratipādiketi matabhedājjātivyaktisphoṭopasaṃhāraḥ || 56 |
tadevaṃ saṃghātādīni trīṇi vākyalakṣaṇāni vyākhyātāni | ākhyātaṃ vākyamiti vyākhyāsyati | eṣāṃ ca madhyādakhaṇḍapakṣa evobhayorapīti sūtrakārābhiprāyamanusṛtyākhaṇḍapakṣa eva vākyavākyārthayorabhyupagamyata iti pradarśitam | idānīṃ bhāṣyakārābhiprāyeṇāpi sa evābhyupagantavya ityupakramyate |
abhedapūrvakā bhedāḥ kalpitā vākyavādibhiḥ |
bhedapūrvānabhedāṃstu manyante padadarśinaḥ || 57 |
tathā ca bhāṣyam--`na lakṣaṇena padakārā anuvartyāḥ padakārairnāma lakṣaṇamanuvartyam'| tathā--`yathālakṣaṇamaprayukte'iti | atra yadi padānāṃ satyatā syāt tadā teṣāṃ svata eva siddhatvāt padāni kurvantīti padakārā ityetadasaṃgataṃ syāt | lakṣaṇena ca tadananuvartanam, vastusattvātteṣām | padakārairnāma lakṣaṇamanuvartyamityapyasaṃgatam | tathā'prayuktapadaviṣaye padānāmasatyatvāt tatpravibhāgo'yaṃ na siddha iti yathālakṣaṇaṃ lakṣaṇānusāreṇa padakaraṇamaprayukta ityetadanupapannameva | āha caivaṃ bhāṣyakāraḥ | tasmānmanyāmahe padānyasatyāni, ekamabhinnasvabhāvakaṃ vākyam | tadabudhabodhanāya padavibhāgaḥ kalpita iti | tevābhidhātumāha---
yata evaṃ sūtrakārasya bhāṣyakārasya cākhaṇḍapakṣo'bhirucitaḥ | tasmādvākyavādibhiḥ sphoṭavādibhirabhedakalpanamāśritam | kālpanikaḥ padavādo'bhyupagata ityarthaḥ |
padavādimatamapi prasaṅgādupadarśayati--bhedapūrvāniti | bhedapratibhāsapūrvakānabhedān svābhimatān padadarśinaḥ, padameva satyaṃ ye na manyante te hyekamakhaṇḍaṃ vākyaṃ nāma kālpanikramāhuḥ || 57 |
padaprakṛtibhāvaśca vṛttibhedena varṇyate |
padānāṃ saṃhitā yoniḥ saṃhitā vā padāśrayā || 58 |
..ti tatpuruṣavṛttyāśabdasaṃskāramācakṣāṇa vivabhitamarthaṃ pratipādayanti | teṣāṃ (yeṣāṃ) tu caturṇāmeva padajātānāṃ saṃsargamātreṇa padeṣveva prasiddhaḥ sambandhaḥ kaścidarthātmā prakāśyate | tai bahuvrīhivṛttyā śabdasaṃskāramācakṣāṇāstathaiva vivakṣitamarthaṃ pratipādayanti |
tatra keṣāṃcitpauruṣeyāṇyāmnāyapadāni śabdeṣu smṛtipakṣasya vā |
keṣāṃcittu padarūpa evāmnāyaḥ saṃhitā pauruṣeyī smṛtipakṣasya vā |
keṣāñcittu nityāvubhāpyetau samāmnāyau | padasamāmnāyastu pratipādakatvena nityaḥ, itarastu pratipādyatvena nityaḥ |
keṣāñcinnityasyaikasyāmnāyasya dva ete vibhāgāvibhāgaśaktī pratipādakapratipattavyarūpeṇa vartete || 58 |
atha yadi naivaṃ sthitiḥ tatkathaṃ `padaprakṛtiḥ saṃhiteti' prātiśākhyam | atra hi padāni prakṛttiryasyāḥ saṃhitāyā ityartho vyākhyāyate | padānāṃ cāsatyatvāt tatkāraṇikā saṃhitā'pyayuktā syādityālocyākhaṇḍapakṣeṇāpyetatsaṃvādayitumāha--- padaprakṛtīti | vṛttibhedameva pradarśayitumāha--padānāmiti | akhaṇḍapakṣe padaprakṛtiḥ saṃhiteti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsena vyākhyāyata ityarthaḥ || 58 |
padāmnāyaśca yadyanyaḥ saṃhitāyā nidarśakaḥ |
nityastatra kathaṃ kāryaṃ padaṃ lakṣaṇadarśanāt || 59 |
yadyanya eva padāmnāyo nityaḥ puruṣaprayatnavyatirekeṇa siddhastatrāyaṃ bhāṣyagranthaḥ samarthayitavyaḥ | na lakṣaṇena padakārā anuvartyāḥ padakārairnāma lakṣaṇamanuvartam, yathālakṣaṇaṃ padaṃ kartavyam iti |
loke'pyarthena prayukteṣu śabdeṣu śāstreṇa dharmaniyamamātrameva kriyate | ataḥ śāstreṇa nityasya lakṣsyānuvidhānaṃ kartavyaṃ na tu nityena lakṣyeṇa śāstramanuvidheyam |
api ca bahuśakteḥ samāmnāyasya kaiścit padakāraiḥ kācidvibhāgaśaktiranugamyate | vakṣassurukmeti vakṣastu rukma iti |
tadevaṃ vibhāgaśaktyantaradarśanena pravṛttervibhāgaśaktyantarasyāpasāritatvād na śaktyantaradarśanaprakramo (me) yathālakṣaṇaṃ padānāṃ karaṇaṃ saṃbhavati || 59 | idānīṃ yenābhiprayeṇa bhāṣyena lakṣaṇenetyādikamuktaṃ tamabhivyaṅ‌ktumāha-- padāmnāyaśceti | yadi hi padāmnāyaḥ saṃhitāpradarśako nityaḥ satyabhūto'bhyupagatastadā kathaṃ lakṣaṇadarśanāt padaṃ kāryamiti na lakṣaṇena padakārā ityādinā bhāṣyakāro darśayet | yataśca padānyasatyāni tasya pratibhāsante tata evamabhihitamiti bhāṣyakārasyapyakhaṇḍapakṣo'bhipreta iti darśitam || 59 |
apare tu manyante--vākyārtha ekaḥ, tena cātyantamanarthakānyeva padāni yathaiva ca padārthena varṇāḥ--
prativarṇamasaṃvedyaḥ padārthapratyayo yathā |
padeṣvevamasaṃvedyaṃ vākyārthasya nirūpaṇam || 60 |
yathaiva varṇe varṇe padāthapratyayo notpadyata ityartho na vibhajyate, tathaiva pade pade vākyārthasyāsaṃnidhānāt pratipadaṃ tadviṣayo'pi pratyayo na nirūpayituṃ śakyate | arthanirbhāsā hi prakāśasvarūpatvādātmanirūpaṇa eva | ataśca vāḍhamarthānāmapi saṃvedyatvaṃ na vyatikrāmanti || 60 |
idānīṃ padavādinaṃ prati dūṣaṇamāha--prativarṇamiti |
devadattādau pade yathā na dakārādi varṇaṃ varṇaṃ prati devadattapratyayo jāyate, tathaiva devadatta gāmabhyājetyādivākyārthasya devadattādi padaṃ padaṃ prati nāsti pratyayo'ta ucyate--etānyanarthakānyeva vākyādevārthapratītidarśanād vākyamevārthavaditi || 60 |
yasya tu vākyātha padāni pratibhedamarthavanti tasya padārthena varṇāḥ pratibhedamarthavantaḥ prapnuvanti |
vākyārthaḥ saṃniviśate padeṣu sahavṛttiṣu |
yathā tathaiva varṇeṣu padārthaḥ sahavṛttiṣu || 61 |
yadi padeṣu sahavṛttiṣvapi sanniviṣṭo vākyārthaḥ pratipadaṃ niviṣṭa iti kalpyate tathaiva sahavṛttiṣu varṇeṣu kāmaṃ saṃniviṣṭaḥ padārthaḥ kalpayitavyaḥ || 61 |
etāvat pratividhātuṃ padavādyāha--vākyārtha iti |
iha pade varṇā arthavanto vākye padānyapīti draṣṭavyam | kevalaṃ yathā samuditeṣu padeṣu satsu vākyārthaḥ saṃniviśate svarūpaṃ pratilabhate, tathaiva varṇeṣvapi buddhau sahavṛttiṣveva padārtha upajāyata iti naitāvatā varṇadṛṣṭāntena padānāmanarthakatvam||61|
yadi tarhi padārthaḥ prativarṇaṃ niviṣṭaḥ kasmāt padasyeva prayoge varṇasyāpi prayoge kaścidartho na pratīyate---
sūkṣmaṃ grāhyaṃ yathā'nyena saṃsṛṣṭaṃ saha gṛhyate |
varṇo'pyanyena varṇena saṃbaddho vācakastathā || 62 |
yathā hi sūkṣmaṃ grāhyaṃ dūrāt keśamakṣikādyantike ca vātāyanarajaḥ kevalaṃ nopalabhyate | saṃsṛṣṭaṃ tvasaṃyuktamapyupalabhyate | varṇo'pyevamevāsatyapi śabdāntaraprādurbhāve'nyena sambaddhaḥ satyapvarthayoge pūrvamagṛhītasyārthasya pratyāyako bhaviṣyati || 62 |
etadeva dṛṣṭāntena darśayitumāha--sūkṣmamiti |
(a) grāhyamapi sūkṣmaṃ vastu rajaḥ prabhṛti yathā'nyena kenacitsajātīyena vilakṣaṇena vā saṃsṛṣṭaṃ sad gṛhyate, evamarthavānapi varṇa ekaikaṃ na saṃpratyāyako'nyena saṃsṛṣṭastu vācaka eva |
etaduktaṃ bhavati--arthavanta eva varṇāḥ pratipattrā tu pāṭavavirahādekaikaṃna tathā gṛhyanta iti nātra teṣāmaparādhaḥ || 62 |
padasyoccāraṇādartho yathā kaścinnirūpyate |
varṇānāmapi sānnidhyāttathā so'rthaḥ pratīyate | 63 |
pade kiloccārite yo'rtho nirūpyate tenārthena taduccaritaṃ padaṃ tadarthavaditi vā pratijñāyate | varṇeṣvapyuccariteṣu padavat sa evārthastathaiva pratīyate | tasmādyenaiva hetunā padārthavādī padasyārthavattāṃ pratijānīte tanaiva hetunā kevalavarṇārthavādyapi varṇasyārthavattāṃ pratijānīta iti || 63 |
na cānarthakameva padamiti vaktuṃ yuktaṃ pratyakṣavirodhādityāha---padasyeti |
nahī kiñcit padaṃ kenacidarthenānirūpitamiti yujyate vaktumanubhavavirodhāt | yathā caivaṃ padoccāraṇakāle'sti kācidarthapratītirevaṃ tenaivārthena saṃhatā apyarthavanta iti pratipādayitumāha---varṇānāmiti |
kevalaṃ sānnidhyāt sahoccāraṇādasāvarthasteṣāṃ pratīyate | tasmādyathā samuditāḥ parasparaśaktyāveśādvarṇā vācakāḥ, evaṃ padānyapi tathaiveti varṇapadavyatirekeṇa vākyaṃ nāma nāstīti | tadvaktam---
"yāvanto yādṛśā ye ca yadarthapratipādane |
varṇāḥ prajñātasāmarthyāste tathaivāvabodhakāḥ" || iti || 63 |
yeṣāmatyanta (ma) saṃsṛṣṭasyāśrayaviśeṣavadbhiḥ sādhanaiḥ kriyāviśeṣasyārthabhedeṣvalabdhapadavibhāgamekabhinnasyārthasya vācakaṃ vākyaṃ teṣāmaṅgabhreṣe yatra pratinidhirupādīyate tatra kriyāyāḥ pratinidhiḥ prāpnoti | apratinidheyā ca kriyā, tasmāt prasaktānuprasaktaṃ pratinidhisambandhenedamucyete--
prāptasya yasya sāmarthyānniyamārthā yataḥ śrutiḥ |
tenātyantaṃ viśeṣaṇa sāmānyaṃ yadi bādhyate || 64 |
iha yajetetyāha, dravyadevatāssāmarthyaprāptāḥ | nahi dravyaṃ devatāṃ sādhanaṃ cāntarema yajatiśabdaprayogalakṣaṇārthasyābhidhāvyaktirasti tatra dravyaṃ yajatikriyārūpaikadeśabhāvādaṅgatvena śrutiprāptasannidhānam | vrīhitvādayastu sāmānyaviśeṣā viruddhaikārthasamavāyā apyaviruddhekārthasamavāyena dravyatvenādṛṣṭasāhacaryavyabhicārāḥ sāmānyamātrā (tra) prāptasannidhānāḥ | teṣāṃ niyate'pi sannidhāne śabdarūpeṇānupādānād dravyatvavadaṅgabhāvo na pratīyate | yasya tu sāmarthyamātreṇāpi prāptā vrīhitvādayaḥ punaḥ śrutyā niyamyamānānāṃ yavatvādīnāṃ sāmānyaviśeṣāntarāṇāṃ nivartakā iti darśanaṃ tasya vrīhitvena yavatvādisahacāriṇo dravyasyātyantaṃ (ma) śrutilabhaṇamapasāraṇaṃ prāpnoti || 64 |
yadi ca padārthanibandhano vākyārthāvabhāso nāṅgīkriyate tadā pratinidhikalpanaṃ pikādiniyatapadapraśnaḥ śrutivākyayorvirodhe śrutirbalīyasītyavāntaravākyānāmarthavattvaṃ ca na syāllakṣaṇānupapattiśceti pañca codyānyāpatanti | tāni krameṇa pradarśayitumāha--prāptasyeti |
iha yajetetyākhyātapadapratipādyo yajanavidhirupadiśyate | tatra kriyāpradhānamākhyātabhityatra yajatikriyā sādhananirvartyetyasau kārakamātrasyākṣepikā, kadācidviśiṣṭasyaiveti dvayī gatiḥ | tatra yasāya vrīhitvasya yajatikriyāsāmarthyāt prāptasya vrīhibhiryajeteti punarvrohiśratiruccarantī niyamamavagamayati vrīhibhireva na yavairiti, tataśca tena dravyaviśeṣeṇātyantaṃ dravyasāmānyamātraṃ yadi bādhyate || 64 |
yajeteti yadā dravyaṃ prāptaṃ sāmarthyalakṣaṇm |
vrīhiśrutyā nivartteta na syātpratinidhistadā || 65 |
yadi sāmānyalakṣaṇaprāptaṃ yavādidravyaṃ vrīhiśrutyā śāstreṇa pratiṣidhyate tacchāstrāntarābhāvādyathaivānyāni dravyāṇyayajñiyāni tathā vrīhīṇāmasannidhāne maiva pratinidheyaṃ syāt | satyapyarthitve dṛṣṭe'pi sāmarthye śāstraṇāparyudastasyādhikāro yuktaḥ | tasmānmā bhūt prasiddhasyāsahacaritasya pratinidhirabhāvāditi || 65 |
ataḥ kimityāha--yajetetīti |
yajetetyetayā kriyayā niḥ sādhanā kriyā na bhavatīti yāmarthyādyadākṣiptaṃ dravyamātraṃ tat vrīhibhiryajeteti punarvrohiśrutyā bādhitaṃ sannivarteta tadabhāve pratinidhirna syāt | kriyayā dravyamātrākṣepe vrīhilakṣaṇasya dravyasyābhāve tatsadṛśaṃ dravyāntarameva nīvārādikaṃ samānīya tannirvartanaṃ kriyate | viśiṣṭadravyakṣepe tu tayā kṛte tadupādānaṃ niyamāya paryavasyatīti kathaṃ vrīhikaraṇakaṃ yajanamanyo nirvartayediti pratinidhyabhāvaḥ | tasmād dravyamātrākṣepe pratinidhyupapattiḥ || 65|
idamanyaddarśanamāśrīyate | śabdenānaṅgīkṛtaṃ vrīhitvamaṅgabhāvenādhikaṃ vrīhiśabdaḥ prakalpayatīti nigamayati--
tasmād vrīhitvamadhikaṃ vrīhiśabdaḥ prakalpayan |
dravyatvamaviruddhatvāt prāptyarthaḥ sanna bādhate || 66 ||
vrīhiśabdo hyadhikārthādhyāvāpāyopādīyamāno dravyatvavirūddhaikārthasamavāyaṃ prāptyarthaḥ sanna bādhate | nahi yavatvādīnāṃ vivṛttau tasya vyāpāro'sti, nāpyanujñāyām || 66 ||
tadetadeva darśayitumāha--tasmāditi |
tasmād dravyamātrākṣepe vrīhiśabdo'tra praptyartho vrīhitvamātrapāpaṇaprayojane vrīhitvamevādhikaṃ kṛtvā'bhyupakalpayan prakaṭīkurvan dravyatvaṃ na bādhate, aviruddhatvāt sāmānyasya viśeṣaṇa sahāvirodhāt || 66 ||
idaṃ ca dravyatvasya bādhanaṃ yassāmānyaviśeṣāntaraiścra sāhacāryādavacchedaḥ |
tena cāpi vyavacchinne dravyatve sahacāriṇi |
asambhavād viśeṣāṇāṃ tatrānyeṣāmadarśanam || 67 |
na ca sāmānyavatsarve kriyāśabdena lakṣitaḥ |
viśeṣā nahi sarveṣāṃ satāṃ śabdo'bhidhāyakaḥ || 68 |
yadi tarhi vrīhiśrutirna niyamārthā tarhi vikalpitatvaṃ yavādīnāṃ kasmānna vijñāyate | tatrāhuḥ--asaṃbhavo nāmāniyamaśabdavyāpāro niyamasadṛśaphalaḥ kvacidviṣaye'nya eva dharmo'yamasaṃbhaviyama iti niyamavibhāge nyāyavidaḥ
kecidācakṣate--yatra vrīhitvamadhikaṃ śabdenāṅgabhāvaṃ pratipadyate tatra viruddhaikārthasamavāyatvādapratiṣiddhānyapi śrutyā yavatvādīni na saṃbhavanti | yadi ca saṃbhaveyuḥ kāmamavirodhasāmathyaprāptasannidhānāni vinā śabdavyāpāreṇa samuccīyeran | na tveṣa vikalpasya viṣayaḥ | na ca sāmānyavat kriyāśabdena lakṣitā viśeṣāḥ | nahi sarveṣāṃ satāṃ śabdo'bhidhāyakaḥ || 67 - 68 ||
ataśca kimityāha--teneti |
tena ca vrīhiśabdena vyavacchinne kṛtābhyuccaye dattopacaye dravyatve sati | kīdṛśe sahacāriṇi aviruddhaikārthasamavete | dravyaviśeṣāṇāṃ tatrānyeṣāṃ samastānāmasaṃbhavādadarśanamanākṣepa eva || 67 |
evadevonmīlayitumāha--na ceti |
yajatinā hi kriyāśabdenātra dravyatvasāmānyavatsarve viśeṣāstadantargatā na lakṣitā ākṣiptā api tu dravyatvameva | tadeva cābhyuccayīkṛtaṃ vrīhiśabdena |
sāmānyamātrākṣepaḥ kimiti nāṅgīkriyata ityāśaṅkyāha---nahītyādi | nahī sakalasaṃnihitaviśeṣābhidhāyakaḥ śabdaḥ paridṛṣṭaḥ, tathā'pratīteḥ || 68 |
śuklādayo guṇāḥ santo yathā tatrāvivakṣitāḥ |
tathā'vivakṣā bhedānāṃ dravyatvasahacāriṇām || 69 ||
tatraitat syāt | yathā dravyatva (tvaṃ) niyatasannidhānaṃ (na) kriyāsannidhānaṃ kriyāpadārthaikadeśabhūtamiva sannidhānāt kriyāśabdena lakṣyate, tathā sarvaviśeṣāṇāṃ dravyatvasahacāriṇāṃ kriyāpadārthaikadeśabhūtānāmiva kasmācchabdenopādānaṃ na vijñāyate | ata āha--nahi sarveṣāṃ vastutvena satāmarthatvena śabdo'bhidhāyako bhavati |
vivakṣānibandhanaṃ hi vastu satāmapyarthānāmarthatvenāsattvam | vivakṣā hi śabde rūpasāmarthyanibandhanā | tatra yathaiva dravyatvasahacāriṇo niyatasannidhānā api śuklādayo guṇāḥ satyapi sannidhānād dravyatvavadupayoge śabdaśaktyanurodhādabhinnatvena kriyāśabdarūpeṇāṅgatvena pratyāyayitumaśakyatvādavivakṣitāḥ, tatheva śabdasāmarthyapratibandhā vrīhitvādīnāṃ dravya (tva) sahacāriṇāmupayogavatāṃ bhedānāmaṅgatvenāvivakṣa||69|
etadeva dṛṣṭāntena sphuṭīkartumāha---śuklādaya iti |
vrīhibhirityatra yathā śuklakṛṣṇādiguṇayogo na vivakṣitaḥ, tathā'tra vrīhibhiryajeteti bhedānāṃ dravyaviśeṣāṇāṃ sāmānya (nyā) virodhināmavivakṣaiveti | tataśca sthitametad yadatra yajakriyākṣiptadravyamātrābhyuccayābhidhāyako vrīhiśabdo na dravyaviśeṣavacana iti | tataśca na kriyā pratinidhaīyate, dravyaṃ tu pratinidhīyata iti mukhyābhāve tatsadṛśanīvārādidravyāntaropādānena yāganirvṛttiriti pratinidhisamāśrayaṇena vidhyarthānuṣṭhānaṃ siddhyatīti na tadavasādaḥ || 69 ||
tatraivaṃ śāstreṇāparyudaste viśeṣāntarasahacāriṇi dravyatve---
asaṃnnidhau pratinidhirmā bhūnnityasya karmaṇaḥ |
kāmyasva vā pravṛttasya lopa itpapadiśyate || 70 ||
nityaṃ yatkarma tasyākaraṇe pratyavāyaḥ | tasya pradhānasyāṅgamātrāsannidhāne mā bhūdāvṛttiḥ (bhūdanāpatti), kāmyasya vā sannihiteṣvaṅgeṣu prakāntasya mā bhūdaṅgabhreṣe vicched iti śāstreṇāparyudastaḥ pratinidhiḥ prathamakalpāsambhave upādīyata ityaviruddhaṃ bhavati || 70 |
tadetadeva pratinidhiprayojanamāha--asannidhāviti |
mukhyasyāsannidhāne'bhāve mā bhūnnityasya karmaṇo lopa pratinidhirupapadyate | kāmyasya vā pravṛttasya tathaiva lopo mā bhūditi | pravṛttasya kāmyasyetyanenaitadāha yanmukhyābhāve kāmye'pravṛttireva na jyāyasī | pravṛttau vā kenacidvaiguṇyenāsaṃpattau samudāyasya (syā) pratītestatrāpi pratinidhyupādānena tannirvartanaṃ vidheyam | anyathā śiṣṭavigarhaṇalakṣaṇaḥ pratyavāyaḥ || 70 ||
viśiṣṭaiva kriyā yena vākyārthaḥ parikalpyate |
dravyābhāve pratinidhau tasya tatsyāt kriyāntaram || 71 ||
yasya tu pūrvoktena dharmeṇa kriyāviśeṣaḥ śaktidravyasaṃsargabhinna eko vākyārthastasyāvibhaktiśabdārthatvādviśeṣāntarāvagame tasminnarthātmanyavikalpena vṛtte viśeṣantaropādāne putrīyati prakriyāntaraṃ muṇḍayati vā pratipādyamānoddeśa (śya) vibhāgaṃ tatpratinihitaṃ syāt, aniṣṭaśca kriyāyāḥ pratinidhiriti vibhāgapakṣa eva nyāyyaḥ |
apara āha---kriyāyāḥ kriyā nivartikā bhavati, dravyaṃ dravyasya | tasmāt kriyāntaropādāne kriyāntaraparityāgāt kriyāsu pratinidhirbhavati | kriyātyarthagṛhīteṣu yogyatāprāpiteṣu sādhaneṣu viśiṣṭadravyaviṣaye niyame kṛte tasya dravyasyābhāve samarthadravyāntaraṃ pūrvameva kriyāyāmaṅgīkṛtamupādīyate (datte) | tatra niyamamātraṃ bādhyata ityetasminnapi pratinidhidarśane yastu jātyuddeśe pratinidhiṃ pratyaparo darśanabhedaḥṣa tatra vā (') vibhāgapakṣābhyupagame kriyaivāpratinidheyā pratinidhīyata ityaniṣṭaprasaṅgaḥ || 71 |
evaṃ dravyamātrākṣepapakṣe pratinidhimupapādyedānīṃ padapadārthānāmanaṅgīkaraṇe'khaṇḍavādino dūṣaṇamāha--viśiṣṭaiveti |
yenākhaṇḍavākyavādinā vrīhikaraṇikā yajatikriyā nirastāvayavārthā vrīhibhiryajetetyatra vākyārtha ityucyate | tena dravyasya vrīhilakṣaṇasyābhāve yadā pratinidhisamāśrayaṇena tannirvartanaṃ kāryaṃ tadā vrīhibhiryajeteti vrīhikaraṇakayāgalakṣaṇasya vākyārthasyatyāgāt pratinidhainā tannivartane nīvārakaraṇikāyajatikriyā'nyaivānuṣṭhitā bhavatīti na kriyā pratinidhīyate, dravyaṃ tu pratinidhīyata iti nyāyasyopekṣaṇāt coditasyākaraṇameva syāt |
atha tvayā pratinidhirnāśrīyata ityucyate, tannaṃ, mā bhūnnityasyetyādinā tadāśrayaṇasya saprayojanatvādavaśyāśrayaṇīyaḥ pratinidhiriti padapadārthānāmabhāve vākyasyākhaṇḍarūpasyābhyupagame pratinidhyabhāva iti codyam || 71 |
vijñātārthaṃ padaṃ yacca tadarthe pratipādite |
pikādi yadavijñātaṃ tatkimityanuyujyate || 72 ||
itaśca vibhāgadarśanameva yuktam | iha vanāt pika ānīyatāṃ va (vā)- rāṅgījarjarā vṛṣalāya dīyatāmiti bahūnāṃ padānāmartheṣvāhitapratyayāḥ pratipattāro yadeva pikādyavijñātārtharūpaṃ padaṃ tanmātrameva jijñāsamānā vicchedena pṛcchanti---ko'yaṃ piko nāma, yo vanādāneyaḥ ? kā ca va (vā) rāṅgī nāma, yā vṛṣalāya dātavyeti | na ca vṛkṣavṛṣabhakāṇḍīrādiṣu prasiddhabhedeṣu ṛkṣaṛṣabhabhāṇḍīrādyarthe nirjñāte varṇamātraviṣayo vakārārthe kakārārthe vā praśno dṛśyate | tasmādavibhāgadharmāt pracyutena vibhāge vākyārthena vyavasthitena bhāvitavyam || 72 ||
pikādiniyatapadapraśno nopapadyata ityapyabhidhātumāha--vijñātārthamiti |
vanāt pika ānīyatāmityukte vanādānīyatāmiti padadvayaṃ vijñātārtham | tadarthe cāvagate kaḥ pika iti kasyacinnagarikasya praśno nopapadyate kila | vanādityādyakhaṇḍameva nirastapadapravibhāgaṃ vākyamanaṃśameva vācakaṃ vaiyākaraṇasya matam |
ataḥ kiṃ pikapadārthaḥ pṛthagavijñātaḥ kaścidasti | tadavijñātapikapadārthānuyogo nopapadyeta | asti ca tadarthe kasyacitsaṃdeha iti pṛthagevārthavanti padāni vijñātāni vākyamityeva vaktaṃ yuktamiti || 72 |
sāmarthyaprāpitaṃ yacca vyaktyarthamanuṣajyate |
śrutirevānuṣaṅge sā bādhikā liṅgavākyayoḥ || 73 ||
aprāpto yastu śuklādiḥ sannidhānena gamyate |
sa yatnaprāpito vākye śrutidharmavilakṣaṇaḥ || 74 ||
itaścāvibhāgapakṣo na yuktaḥ, śrutivākyasamavāye śrutitvāviśeṣeṇa pāradaurbalyāsaṃbhavāt | iha śrutirnāmaikaśabdaviṣayaikapadanibandhanārthā | tatra sāmarthyaprāpitaṃ yāvadekaśabdopādanāmartharūpaṃ śabdāntareṇa vyaktyarthamanūdyamānamanuṣajyate, tadapyanādheyasambandhatvāt śrutirvākyameva | tadyathā---pacyatāmavahanyatāṃ piṣyatāmityekatra sambaddhānāṃ ceṣṭāviśeṣāṇāṃ prakrāntatvāt pākyapeṣyāvaghṛte(tye)ṣu śabdarūpasāmarthyādaṅgīkṛteṣu yad vrīhyādidravyamātraṃ vrīhitvādiprāpaṇāya vrīhitvādibhivyaktamātmānaṃ pradarśayat kriyārūpādākṣiptasambandhaṃ sambaddhameva sannipatati, tadvastūpanibandhanāḥ sarve śrutiśabdāstadvastūpanibandhanatvena pratijñāyante, na tvadhikārthaprāpaṇena | yathā vā `divā sūrya udeti devo varṣati'iti vyaktyartho'nuṣaṅgaḥ sādhanasya sādhanāśrayasya ceti | sarvasya cānuṣaṅgamātre tathābhūtā śrutirvākyākhyasya śrutyantarasya bādhikā vijñāyate |
yastu śabdarūpasāmarthyāt sannihito'pi śabdavyāpāreṇāprāptasannidhānaḥ śuklādirguṇaḥ śuklādīnāṃ śabdānāmupadānamantareṇa vastutaḥ sannapi śabdārthatvenāpratītaḥ śuklādiśabdasannidhānena vyāpāravān pratīyate | sa yatnaprāpitasambandhaḥ śrutyarthavilakṣaṇo vākyārtha eva | tatra payasā bhukte devadattaḥ struteneti vākyaprāpitasya prayogaviṣayasya stravaṇasyāsambhave strutiprāpitamupasecanaṃ nivartate | stravaṇānugrahāya vopasecanatvena yadapi prasiddhaṃ loke tena strutena stravaṇasyānugrahaḥ kathaṃ syāditi na bhujyate | śrutivākyasavikalpasambhavena (vākyayorvikalpāsambhavena) śrutyartha eva kriyate na vākyārthaḥ || 73 - 74 |
idānīṃ śrutivākyayovirodhe śrutireva balīyasīti nyāyo na syāditi pradarśayitumāha--sāmarthyeti |
iha śrutiliṅgavākyaprakaraṇasthānasamākhyālakṣaṇāḥ saṃdigdhavākyārthavicāre vārkyāvadāṃ prasiddhāḥ | teṣāṃ ca parasparavirodhe pūrvaḥ pūrvo balīyāniti vyavasthāpyate | tatra śvetaṃ chāgamālabhetetyatrālambhanakriyayā yo dravyasya sambandhaḥ, sa dvitīyāśrutyā sākṣāt pratipāditaḥ | guṇasya tu tatsāmānādhikaraṇyādvākyīyaḥ | nirguṇasya hi dravyasyābhāvād guṇasya ca niradhikaraṇasyāsambhavādvākyīya āśrayāśrayiṇoḥ sambandhaḥ | taducyate `āśrayāśrayiṇorvākyānniyamastvavatiṣṭhate'3 iti | yadā tu dravyaguṇayordvayorapyālambhanakriyayā sākṣāt sambandhaḥ | yadvakṣyati` kriyayā yo'bhisambandhaḥ sa śrutiprāpitastayoḥ' iti | tataśca śvetābhāve'nyaguṇasya chāgasyālambhanamanuṣṭhīyate | chāgābhāve ca śvetaguṇayuktasya meṣasyāpyālambhanamiti pratinidhisamāśrayaṇena na śrutibādhaḥ | vakṣyati ca ---
tatra dravyaguṇābhāve pratyekaṃ syādvikalpanam |
śrutiprāpto hi sambandho balavān vākyalakṣaṇāt || iti ||

yadi ca vākyīyaḥ sambandho balavān syātadā'nyatarābhāve nālambhanamanuṣṭhīyeteti | vidhyarthaḥ śratiḥ | ataḥ śrautasyaiva sambandhasya vākyād balīyastvādanyatarābhāve'pi śrutiprāpitamālambhanamanuṣṭhitamiti na kaścicchratibādhaḥ | tadetatpratipādayitumuktam--sāmarthyaprāpitamityādi | nirguṇasya dravyasyābhāvācch‌vetaguṇayuktasyālambhanaṃ kriyāsāmarthyaprāpitaṃ śrautameva | vyaktārthaṃ sphuṭīkaraṇāya śvetamāla bheteti śvetādi tat (yat) saṃbadhyate, tataḥ kimityāha--śrutirityādi | tataśca sākṣāt dravyaguṇayoḥ śrutāvanuṣaṅgo'bhisambandhaḥ śrutireva tatra liṅgavākyayorbādhiketi na vākyīyasambandhastatra bhavati || 73 |
śrautavākyīyayorbhadamupadarśayitumāha---aprāpta iti | chagamālabhetetyatra dravyasyaiva sākṣāt sambandhaḥ, śuklādiguṇasya tu sannidhānavaśādvākyīyo yatnapratipādyaḥ | sa vākye yatnādavagataḥ śrutidharmavilakṣaṇaḥ sākṣāt sambandhavilakṣaṇa iti vyaktam || 74 ||
abhinnameva vākyaṃ tu yadyabhinnārthamiṣyate |
tatsarvaṃ śrutibhūtatvānna śrutyaiva virotsyate || 75 ||
yasyābhinnamavibhaktoddeśamekārthamekaṃ vākyaṃ muṇḍikuṭṭisūtrivadavikalaṃ śrunibhūtaṃ tasya kathaṃ śrutyarthāvyatirekeṇātmabhūtairyatnaprāpitasannidhānābhimatairasati virodhe bādhavyavasthā prakalpate | tatra śrutilaṅgavākyaprakaraṇasthānasamākhyānāṃ samavāye pāradaurbalyamarthaviprakarṣādityetadasamarthitaṃ syāt | vākyanibandhane caikasminnarthe paratantraṇāṃ śabdānāmabhāvamānarthakyaṃ cābhyupagacchato vākyāsyāpyānarthakyaṃ prāpnoti | tatra---"ekasyaivārthatā (syaikārthatā) māhurvākyasyāvyabhicāriṇīm" ityetat pratijñātaṃ hīyeta || 75 ||
idānīṃ prakṛte yojayitumāha---abhinnameveti |
yadi punarabhinnakhaṇḍameva nirastapadavibhāgaṃ vākyamabhinnartha śvetaguṇaviśiṣṭacchāgālambhanarūpa eva nānā artho yasya tattathābhūtamabhyupagamyate, tadā kutrāyaṃ pravibhāgo'yaṃ śrauto'yaṃ vākyīya iti | tataśca sarvasya śrautatvāt krena kasya bādha iti na śvetaguṇābhāve chāgālambhana (naṃ) chāgābhāve ca śvetaguṇayuktasyānyasya syāditi śvetaṃ chāgamālabhetatyatrānyatarābhāve ālambhanānupapattervidhyarthasya saṃkoca iti || 75 ||
vākyānāṃ samudāyaśca ya ekārthaprasiddhaye |
sākāṅ‌kṣāvayavastatra vākyārthā'pi na vidyate || 76 ||
iha gaurduhyatām, upādhyāyaḥ payasā bhuktvā māmadhyāpayiṣyatīti sādhanadravyakriyāntarāvadhiviśiṣṭāyāṃ kriyāyāṃ yadekaṃ vākyāntarāvayavaṃ vākyaṃ vartate tadavayavānāṃ sākāṅ‌kṣāṇāṃ padavadekārthenāsambandhe sati vākyānyapyanarthakāni saṃpadyante | na ca vākyarūpāvadhiparigrahe niyamo'sti | kadāvid gāmabhyājeti vākyaṃ bhavati, kadāciddevadatta gāmabhyājeti | kadāciddevadatta gāmabhyāja śuklāmiti | tatra tadevārthavattadevānarthakamiti viruddho'bhyupagamaḥ sampadyate | sarvanyāyalakṣaṇavyavasthāviruddhaścāyamavibhāgapakṣaḥ | tatra dvādaśa ṣaṭ caturviśatirvā lakṣaṇānīti lakṣaṇasamuddaśe sāpadeśaṃ savirodhaṃ vistareṇa vyākhyāsyate || 76 ||
avāntaravākyārthānupapattimapyatropadarśayitumāha--vākyānāmiti | ekasyamukhyārthasya prasiddhaye pratītaye yo'yamavāntaravākyānāṃ samudāyaḥ sākāṅ‌kṣāvayavaḥ, sākāṅ‌kṣā avayavā yasmin samudāye sa tathābhūto'bhijānāsi devadatta kaśmīreṣu vatsyāma ityādyātmako'trāvayavārtho'vāntaravākyārthātmako na vidyate kaścit | yugapatsakalaśāstrasya grahaṇaṃ pratipādanaṃ vā na saṃbhavatīti sakalavyavahārocchedaḥ || 76 ||
iha tu pradarśanārthamudāharaṇamātraṃ prasaktānuprasaktaṃ ca kiñciducyate ---
prāsāṅgikamidaṃ kāryamidaṃ tantreṇa labhyate |
idamāvṛttibhedābhyāmatra bādhasamuccayau || 77 ||
kiṃcāmī padārthopanibandhanā vākyeṣu nyāyāḥ sakalaśāstrīyalaukikavyavahāranibandhanabhūtāḥ padapadārthānaṅgīkaraṇe na prakalpanta ityāha--prāsaṅgikamiti |
etaiśca nirjñātairvākyagocaro'rthātmā yathāvallakṣyate niścīyata ityetāni mīmāṃsakairlakṣaṇānītyucyante | tatra ṣaṅ‌dvādaśa caturviśatirvaitāni lakṣaṇāni tāvadiha pradarśyante | eteṣāṃ ca vitatya sopapatikaṃ sanidarśanaṃ svarūpaṃ padakāṇḍe lakṣaṇasamuddeśe vinirdiṣṭamiti granthakṛtaiva svavṛttau pratipāditam | āgamabhraṃśāllekhakapramādādinā vā lakṣaṇasamud‌deśaśca padakāṇḍamadhye na prasiddhaḥ | tatra tāvad dvādaśalakṣaṇāni dvāādaśasvadhyāyeṣu saprapañcaṃ prāsaṅgikavicārasahitāni nirṇotāni |
tathā ca tatra `athāto dharmajijñāsā  ityupakramya ko dharmaḥ kiṃ lakṣaṇaścetyādyāśaṅkānirāsārthaṃ codanālakṣaṇa ityuktvā prathamenādhyāyena) codanālakṣaṇe nirṇote codanaiva pramāṇamityuktam | matabhedenāpi vidhiniyogetyādikā apyatrāsyāḥ saṃjñā upavaṇitāḥ | tatraiva ca svataḥ prāmāṇyaṃ vyavasthāpitam | tadanurodhena ca pratyākṣādīnāmapi svata eva prāmāṇyamupapāditam | codanā ca śabdādivaicitryād‌bhinnarūpeti bhedapratipādanāyāsyā eva dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ | bhinnasya ca śeṣaśeṣibhāvena viniyogapratipādanāya tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ | viniyuktasya prayojakāprayojakabhāvapratipādanāya caturthaḥ | krameṇa viniyoga iti tadarthaṃ pañcamaḥ | etatsamagraṃ yadarthamasāvartho śāstreṇāparyudasto'dhikārīti tatpratipādanāya ṣaṣṭha iti |
evaṃ vidhibhedaśeṣibhāvaprayuktikramādhikāriṇāṃ pratipādanāyādhyāyāḥ ṣaḍiti ṣaḍlakṣaṇāni | tatra prakṛtiṣaṭ‌kamupadeśaṣaṭ‌kamiti cocyate | tadanantaramanuktetikartavyatākamapi karmānyato vidhyantamāpnoti sāmānyātideśāditi pratipādanāya saptamaḥ | kvacitsāmarthyādviśeṣā evātidiśyanta iti nirūpaṇāyāṣṭamaḥ | atideśaprāpte mantre prakṛtidevatā vikṛtiyāgadevatātvena vipariṇamayitavyetyādisamarthanāya navamaḥ | sāmānyasya viśeṣeṇe bādhābhidānāya daśamaḥ | yena sakṛdanuṣṭhānādubhayasiddhastattantraṃ tadarthamekādaśaḥ | yadanyadartha (nyārtha) mārabdhamanyadapyekenaiva prayatnena saṃbhavalāghavābhyāṃ niṣpādayati tatprāsaṅgikam | taduktaye dvādaśo'dhyāya ityanenātideśaṣaṭkena saha dvādaśalakṣaṇāni | etatpratipakṣabhūtānyanyāni dvādaśa yathāyogameteṣvevādhyāyeṣu darśitāni |
tatra pramāṇasya pratipakṣo'saṃbhavaḥ | nahyapramāṇaṃ pramāṇamthāne niyujyābhimatasaṃpattirbhavati | bhedasya tu śāstrādi (śabdādi) bhedabhinnasya tadabhedādabhedaḥ pratipakṣaḥ |
tatra bhedasya svarūpaṃ nirdiṣṭam--"śaktivyāpārabhedo'snim phalamatra tu bhidyate | saṃbandhājjātabhedo'yam"  iti | bhedastatrāvivakṣita iti tatpratipakṣaḥ | tathā śeṣaśeṣibhāvasya guṇapradhānabhāvāvivakṣā pratipakṣaḥ | sā pratīyamānatvādatra noktā | tatra śeṣaśeṣibhāvasya idaṃ pradhānaṃ śeṣo'yamiti'  svarūpakathanam, `viniyogakramastvayam' `sākṣādasyopakārīdamidamārādviśeṣakam'  ityasyaivetikartavyatāyāḥ prabhedasya ca nirdeśaḥ | prayukteraprayojakaḥ pratipakṣaḥ | tatra `idaṃ parāṅgaiḥ saṃbandhamaṅgānāmaprayojakam' ityanenaikaphalatayā prayojakāprayojakapradarśanaṃ kṛtam | `prayojakamidaṃ teṣāmatredaṃ nāntarīyakam'  ityanena phalabhedena prayojakāprayojakopanyasaḥ |
tadevaṃ prayukterdvibhedāyāḥ sāpavādāyāḥ svarūpaṃ nirdiṣṭamanena ślokeneti vijñeyam | kramasyāvivakṣā pratipakṣaḥ | asya `iyaṃ śrutyā kramaprāptiriyamuccāraṇādibhaḥ'  iti svarūpam | `kramo'yamatra balavān asmistu na vivakṣitaḥ'  iti pratipakṣaḥ | adhikāriṇaḥ svarūpāpavādau `śāstrāt prāptādhikāro'yaṃ vyudāso'sya kriyāntare' iti kṛtau |
sāmānyātideśaviśeṣātideśayostvapavādavirahitaṃ svarūpaṃ nirdiṣṭam---`sāmānyasyātideśo'yaṃ viśeṣo'trātidiśyate' iti | ūhasya saṃbandhābādho'pavādaḥ | asya `ūho'smin viṣaye nyāyyaḥ' iti svarūpam | `saṃbandho'sya na bādhyate' ityapavādaḥ | tulvabalānāmavirodhāt samuccayo bādhasyāpavādaḥ |
tulyabalānāmacaritārthānāṃ virodhādvikalpo'pi bādhasyāpavādatvena darśitaḥ | `atra bādhasamuccayau' iti bādhasya svarūpamapavādaścoktaḥ |
tantrasyāpyāvṛttipratipakṣaḥ | tasya `idaṃ tantreṇa labhyate' iti svarūpam | `idamāvṛttibhedābhyām'  ityanena tantrasyāvṛttiḥ pratipakṣa uktaḥ | ekaprayatna nirvartyamapīcchāvaśādbhenecchatīti prāsāṅgikasyāpavādo bhedaḥ | tatra `prāsaṅgikamidaṃ kāryam' iti prāsaṅgikasvarūpanirdeśaḥ | `āvṛttibhedābhyāmi'tyasmādbhedaḥ prāsaṅgikasyāpavādo yojanīyaḥ | ?
yadyapi pareṣāṃ codanaiva pramāṇaṃ prasiddham, tathāpīha ṭīkākāro nyāyamātrasya pramāṇatvamaṅgīkaroti | ataḥ prakṛtaśāstravyākhyopayogitattatsthāne nyāyajātaṃ `prasajya pratiṣedho'yam' ityādinā pradarśayati |
ata eva codanāyāmeva pramāṇatvasyābhāvāt prathamameva lakṣaṇanidarśanaṃ na kṛtam | sāmānyena vākyadharmāṇāṃ prasaṅgikādīnāṃ sāpavādānāmatra nirdeśaḥ kṛta ityabhiprāyaḥ |
etaduktaṃbhavati---padapadārthavyavasthāpanāprastāveyoyaḥ kaścittad‌vyavasthāpane nyāyaḥ prabhavati sa sa kīrtanīyaḥ | tadatra codanāyāḥ kīdṛśaṃ prāthamyaṃ prādhānyaṃ vā tantraprasaṅgau tu sūtre kṛtāviti tatpuraḥ saratvenaiva padapadārthāvadhānamiti | samuccayo vikalpa āvṛttiścetyevamādibhiḥ saha dvāviṃśatirlakṣaṇāni bhavanti |
dve lakṣaṇe lakṣaṇasamuddeśādūhye | athavā sāmānyatideśasya tadabhāva evāpavādaḥ | viśeṣātideśasya sāmānyātideśa eva viśeṣāntarātideśo vetyanayoḥ sapratipakṣatvamāśritya caturviśatiḥ saṃpadyanta ityevamanena krameṇaitāni lakṣaṇāni | etadeva manasikṛtya ṣaḍ‌dvādaśa caturviṃśatirvā lakṣaṇānītyuktam |
athaiṣāṃ nidarśanārthaṃ leśataḥ svarūpasahitānyudāharaṇāni ṭīkākāreṇa pradarśitāni | tatra dvayorarthinoḥ kāryeṇa saṃbhavinā prayojakatvena nirjñātasāmarthyayoryatrānyataraprayuktenāparo'bhisaṃbadhyamānaḥ kṛtārthatvāt pṛthakprayojakatvaṃ nopaiti sa prasaṅgaḥ | tatprayojanakaṃ prāsaṅgikam | tadyathā saghātādhyayanam | tatra hi kañcideva śiṣyamuddiśya pravṛtte'dhyāpane bhedenādhyāpanāntarasya prayojane samarthatarā adhyetāraḥ satyapyarthitve pṛthagadhyāpanaṃ saṃbhavāllāghavācca na pravartayantiḥ apitvekenaiva yatnena tadanutiṣṭhanti |
vede yathā--agrīṣomīyasya vapayā pracaryāgrīṣomīyaṃ paśupuroḍāśamekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapanti | atrāgnīṣomīyapaśvarthaḥ prayājānuyajavidhyantaḥ prasaṅgādagrīṣomīyaṃ paśupuroḍāśamapyupakaroti |
śabdānuśāsane'pi yathā--sarvādīni sarvanāmānītyatra ṇatvābhāvaṃ prāsaṅgikamudāharanti | tatra hi saṃjñāsaṃjñisaṃbandhavidhānapare vākye rūpaviśeṣamātrādakṛtaṇatvādubhayasādhanatvaṃ vijñāyate | śakyo hyasya svarūpanirdeśāt pṛthag ṇatvapratiṣedho vaktumityekenaiva prayatnenobhayamatra vartata iti |
atha tantram | yatrārthinaḥ sarve prayojakā (ka) bhedenāvṛttyā vā yo'rthaḥ pratipattavyastamarthamekameva saṃbhavāllāghavācca prayojayanti tattantram| tadyathā--śālāyāmekaṃ pradīpaṃ vyākaraṇādhyāyinaḥ prayojayanti |
vede yathā--pradhānabhūtā ye ṣaḍ‌yāgā āgneyādayastadarthaṃ ye prayājādayaste pūrvaṃ paścādvā kṛtāḥ sarveṣāṃ tantreṇa sādhāraṇyenopakārakā bhavantītyucyate |
śāstre yathā--bhinnārthayostaparaśabdayostaparastatkālasyeti tantriṇoḥ sūtra upādānaṃ kriyata iti | evaṃ ca tatra tatra lakṣaṇeṣvapi tantralakṣaṇaṃ prabhavatyeveti vijñeyam | tadyathā--saṃkhyāsaṃjñāyāṃ rūpaviśeṣānurodhāttatatpradeśeṣu tantreṇaiva yugapadubhayapratipattiriti | athāvṛttibhedayostantraprasaṅgapratiyoginornidarśanamucyate | āvṛttau tāvattantrapratipakṣabhūtāyāṃ nidarśanam | yathā ekaṃ vastramābharaṇaṃ vā raṇabhūmiṣu bhaṭānāmupayegāya kalpata iti |
vede yathā---saptadaśa sāmidhenyo bhavantīti | atraikaśabdadarśane sāmidhenīṣu saptadaśatvamāvṛttisaṃkhyāmāt prakalpyate | yaducyate--"triḥ prathamāmanvāha, triruttamāmanvāha" iti |
vyākaraṇe yathā---saṃprasāraṇasaṃjñāyāṃ jñāpakapakṣānāśrayaṇena varṇavākyaviṣayayā āvṛttyā kṛtsnasya bhinnapratīyamānopaskārā pravṛttirākhyāyate | yathā caikaśabdadarśane "ekājanekāj‌grahaṇeṣu cāvṛttisakhyānāt" iti parihāra ucyate | bhedasya tantrapratiyogino nidarśanam | yathā bhinnāni pātrāṇyasaha(ṇisaha) bhujāṃ bhujikriyāyāṃ bhedenādhikaraṇabhāvaṃ pratipadyante |
vaidike'pi viṣaye yathā---grahaṃ saṃmārṣṭi" ityatra yaḥ saṃmārgo grahaviṣaye coditaḥ, sa bhedenaiva vyavatiṣṭhana iti | śāstre yathā--`na veti vibhāṣā" ityetasmin yoge pratyākhyānamubhayatra vibhāṣāṇāṃ kkacidvidhimukhena kkacit pratiṣedhamukhena vibhaktānāṃ vibhakta (pra) vṛttirāśrīyata iti |
atha bādhānidarśanaṃ kriyate | arthitvāt sāmānyopadeśādvā sati pravṛttisaṃbhave dṛṣṭādṛṣṭārthamaprāptyanumānamātraṃ yatra sā bādhā | yathārthitvāt pravṛtte sāmānyena bhakṣaṇe `abhakṣyo grāmyakukuṭaḥ'iti grāmyakukuṭabhakṣaṇaṃ kṣutpratighātārthamarthitvāt prāptamanena bādhyata iti vaidikamudāharaṇam |
laukikaṃ yathā--`brāhmaṇebhyo dadhi dīyatāṃ takraṃ kauṇḍinyāya' ityatra dadhidānamautsargikaṃ takradānena viśiṣṭe viṣaye bādhyata iti | śāstre yathā--- `karmaṇyaṇ‌' ityasya `āto'nupasarge kaḥ' iti kapratyayena bādheti | eṣā ca ṭīkākṛtā svavṛttau sā ca tulyabaleṣvasaṃbhavādityādinā bahuprakārā darśitā | na ceyattā prakārāṇāmasyāstenāpi tatra darśitā | yasmāduktam--"seyamaparimāṇavikalpā bādhā vistareṇa bādhāsamuddeśe samarthayiṣyate" iti |
atha samuccayaḥ | tulyabalānāmavirodhināṃ samuccayaḥ | tadyathā---`devadattaṃ bhojaya lavaṇena sarpiṣā śākena ca' iti | vede'pi -- `brāhmaṇebhyaḥ pādyamācamanaṃ ca dīyatām' iti śāstre'pyavirodhāt phalabhedācca pratyayakṛt‌kṛtyasaṃjñāḥ pratyayataddhitatadrājasaṃjñāścaikatra samuccīyanta iti |
vikalpo'pi bādhāpratiyogī | sa ca tulyapramāṇaviśiṣṭānāṃ viruddhānāṃ bhavati | vede yathā--`vrīhibhiryajeta', `yavairyajeta' iti | loke dadhitakre kauṇḍinyāya dīyetāmityekaphaladadhitakradānacodane |
śāstre'pi ṇvulatṛcāvityādi vidhipratiṣedhayorapi tulyabalatve virodhādvikalpo bhavatyeva | yathā -- vede "ṣoḍaśinaṃ gṛhṇāti na gṛhaṇāti" iti | loke'pi kiṃcidasya dīyatāṃ na dīyatāmiti | śāstre'pi---"vāgrahaṇānarthakyaṃ vidhiniṣedhasāmarthyādubhayoḥ siddhatvāt" iti | yathā pradarśitaṃ svavṛttau ṭīkākāreṇa |
vidhipratiṣedhayoḥ khalvapi tulyabalatve verodhādvipratiṣedhamāha---nāsikādibhyo vibhāṣāyāḥ `sahanañ‌vidyamānapūrvebhyaḥ pratiṣedho vipratiṣedhena |' ayaṃ vidhiḥ sa pratiṣedho vidhipratiṣedhayoścāyukto vipratiṣedhaḥ | ayamapi vidhirna mṛdvanāmiva kārpāsānāṃ kṛtaḥ pratiṣedhaviṣaya evārabhyate | sa yathaiva bahvaj‌lakṣaṇaṃ saṃyogopadhalakṣaṇaṃ ca bādhate | evaṃ vidyamānapūrvalakṣaṇamapi | tatra purastānmadhye'pavādā iti bādhakatve pratiṣiddhe vipratiṣethādvādhāvyavasthāpyata iti || 77 |
ūho'smin viṣaye nyāyyaḥ sambandho'sya na bādhyate |
sāmānyasyātideśo'yaṃ viśeṣo'trātidiśyate || 78 |
ūhaḥ khalvapi prakṛtau samarthānāṃ vikāre sāmarthyābhāvāt prakṛtirūpaliṅgavacanāntaropādānena kriyate | tadyathā--prakṛtāvagnaya ityagniśabdaḥ samartho'ṅgarārtho dṛṣṭaḥ | tatra vikāre sūryāyetyūha ityevamādinā nimittabhedena bahubhedo bhavatyūha iti vaidikamudāharaṇam |
loke'pi yathā--devadattasyoccāni gṛhāṇi āḍhyo vaidhaveya ityatra ṣaṇṭhyantamapohya nimittavaśāt prathamānta ūhyate | vyākaraṇe'pyūhaviṣayatvamāpannāḥ sarve vibhaktivipariṇāmāḥ | teṣu hi yogāntare yathā vibhaktyā sambaddho yaḥ śabda upalabdhastatsaṃbandhatyāgenaiva vibhaktyantarayogaṃ sa pratipadyate | tadyathā -- `upadeśe'janunāsika it, ito lopaḥ, bhūvādayo dhātavaḥ, dhātoranudātteto ṅita ātmanepadami'ti |
athohapratipakṣabhūtaṃ sambandhābādhanamapi nidarśyate | yathā devadattasyoccāni gṛhāṇi yuktaṃ tānyabhijātasyeti | atra yadvibhaktyantasyaiva śrutiḥ, tathā vākyāntare'pyabhisambandha iti | tathā badarī sūkṣmakaṇṭakā madhurā vṛkṣaḥ, pañcālā janapada ityevamādiṣu sambandhābādhanaṃ bhavatītyāhuḥ |
vede'pi yathā---yajamānaṃ daṇdena dīkṣayati, adbhirdokṣayati, mekhalayā dīkṣayatītyatra yajamānamityabādhitameva sambadhyate | śāstre'pi -- bahugaṇavatuḍatisaṃkhye  ti yoge vidhīyamānasambandhasya svarūpapadārthakasya saṃkhyāśabdasya śrutasya yogāntare saṃjñiveśeṣaṇatvaṃ vijñāyate | ṣṇāntā saṃkhyā ṣaṭ‌saṃjñā bhavatīti |
athātideśanirdeśaḥ kriyate | anyatrānyadharmapariprāpaṇamatideśaḥ | tasya ca dvau prakārau sāmānyatideśo viśeṣātideśaśceti | sāmānyātideśo yathā---anyatra rūḍhasambandhā dharmā nirjñātabhedeṣvartheṣu prasiddheranumeyabhedasambhavaiḥ sambandhibhirvyapadiśyante | tadyathā--brāhmaṇavadasmin kṣatriye vartitavyamityatra yāvānartho brāhmaṇaśabdaṃ na vyabhicarati tāvatyarthe yāna sambaddhāni kāryāṇi tānyatyantamalabdhabrāhmaṇavyapadeśe kṣatriye'tidiśyante | tathā guruvad guruputre vartitavyamiti | vede yathā--darśapūrṇamāsavadanyeṣvapi yāgeṣu pracaritavyamiti | śāstre'pi -- `sthānivadādeśo'nalvidhau' iti |
athaviśeṣātideśaḥ | nirjñātasāmānyakāryaṣu brāhmaṇādiṣu punaratideśasamarthyādviśiṣṭaprakṛtigatakāryātideśaḥ | yathā brāhmaṇavadasmin brāhmaṇe vartitavyamiti | atra ye brāhmaṇe brāhmaṇavadeva vartante tān pratyayamevaṃbhūto'tideśo vijñāyate | yeṣāṃ tu saṃbhedāt prasaṅgādvā vyatikarasteṣu niyama eva kriyate | uktaṃ ca --
sāmānyamātraṃ śabdārtho viśeṣā vyabhicāriṇaḥ |
sāmarthyamantareṇāto viśeṣo nātidiśyate || iti |
tatra vede yathā--`āgneyavat saurye' ityatraikadevatākasyaikadevatākasaṃbandhyeva vidhyanta iti | vidhyanta itikartavyatocyate |
śāstre rūpātideśādibhiḥ ṣaḍ‌bhiḥ prakārairviśeṣātideśaḥ paridṛśyate | tatra rūpātideśo yathā---`dvirvacane'ci' ityatra hi dhāturūpamevādeśasyātidiśyate | tataśca `yā' kṛ ityādīnāmeva dvirvacanaṃ bhavati | yathā---yayatuścakraturiti |
nimittātideśo yathā--pūrvavatsana iti | atra pūrvasya yannimittamātmanepade ṅakārādi tadeva sannantasyātiśyati iti |
tādātmyātideśo yathā---`subāmantrite parāṅgavat svare' iti | subantamāmantritasya mṛtpāsūdakavat tādātmyamāpadya tatsvaraṃ labhata iti |
śāstrātideśaḥ kāryātideśo vā yathā---karmavatkarmaṇātulyakriya iti | atra hi śāstrātideśe yakaḥ śapā bādhanaṃ syāditi yagvidhau karmakartaryumasaṃkhyānamārabhyate | vipratiṣedhāddhi śapo balīyastvamiti | kāryātideśe tu karmavatkarmaṇetyanenaiva yagvidhīyat iti yaka eva paratvānnāstyasya śapā bādheti nopasaṃkhyānārambhaḥ |
vyapadeśātideśastu--vyākaraṇe naiva sambhavati, saṃjñāpakṣādaviśeṣād vatkaraṇavaiphalyaprasaṅgacceti || 78 |
arthitvamatra sāmarthyamasminnartho na bhidyate |
śāstrāt prāptādhikāro'yaṃ vyudāso'sya kriyāntare || 79 |
athādhikārasya nidarśanam | arthitvaṃ sāmarthyaṃ śāstrāparyudāsayogitvamadhikāraḥ sa vidyate yasyāsāvadhikārī | arthitvamadhikārakāraṇam | paraṃ hi puruṣārthamatrāpavargamācakṣate | asmādapyartho pramādyati kaściditi satyevārthitve sāmathyamadhikārakāraṇam | utpannāyāmapi hyabhinayadidṛkṣāyāmandho darśane nādhikriyate | arthinaḥ khalvapi sāmarthyābhāvaḥ keṣucitkarmasu śāstreṇa paryudāsāt | yathā śūdāstrayyāṃ nādhikriyante | adṛṣṭārthaviśeṣe hi sāmarthyāsāmarthye śāstrādeva samadhigamyete | tasmāt pradhānamadhikārakāraṇaṃ śāstropadeśamācakṣate | tatra loke yathā---adyaprabhṛti tvamatra grāme nagare vā'dhikṛta iti rājā niyuṅ‌kte |
vede yathā---`agrihotraṃ juhuyāt svargakāmo brāhmaṇaḥ' ityatra brāhmaṇasyārthitvādibhiradhikāra iti | śāstrasya tu śabdārthapuruṣadharmeṣvadhikāraḥ |
tatra ṣoḍhā śabdaḥ--sādhurasādhuśca | sādhurapi śāstrīyaḥ prayogikaśca | śāstrīyo'pi tredhā--pratipādyaḥ, pratipādakaḥṣa ubhayarūpaśca | tatra pratipādyo yathā---dādhartyādirnipātyamānaḥ | pratipādako yathā---prakṛtipratyayādiḥ | tena hi kumbhakārādiḥ prayogasthaḥ pratipādyate | ubhayarūpo yathā---itavyaśabdaḥ | sa hi tavyaśabdena pratipādyate | prayogasthaṃ ca sa itavyaśabdaṃ pratipādayati |
prāyogikaśca laukikavaidikabhedena dvidhā---ityevasādhunā saha ṣoḍhā śabdaḥ | teṣu madhye pratipādyeṣu vyākaraṇaśāstrasyādhikāraḥ, na prakṛtyādiṣu | nahi te vyākaraṇena vyutpādyanta iti |
artho'ṣṭādaśadhā | tatra vastumātramabhidheyaśca | abhidheyo'pi dvidhāśāstrīyo laukikaśca | punarapi viśiṣṭāvagrahasaṃpratyayahetustadviparītaśca, mukhyaḥ parikalpitarūpaviparyāsaśca, vyapadeśyo'vyapadeśyaśca, sattvabhāvamāpanno'sattvabhūtaśca, sthiralakṣaṇo vivakṣāprāpitasaṃnidhānaśca, abhidhīyasānaḥ pratipādyamānaśca, abhisaṃhito nāntarīyakaśceti | tatra vastumātraṃ bāhyārtho yo vaktuṃ pratipādayituṃ na samīhitaḥ | yastu samīhito'sāvabhidheyaḥ | tatraiva ca śabdasyādhaikāraḥ |
sa ca dvidhā śāstrīyalaukikabhedena | tatra śāstriya āvāpoddhārikaḥ | laukikastvakhaṇḍaḥ | laukike cārthe śabdasyādhikāro na śāstrīye | śāstrīyo hi pauruṣeyaḥ parikalpitaḥ |
evamatathābhūto'pi śabdasādhutvasya nimittabhāvena pratipādako vijñāyate | ataśca tasya vyabhicāre'pyavyabhicāra eva smartṝṇām | sa cāniyatāvadhirbahudhā pravibhajyata vyākhyātṛbhiḥ |
viśiṣṭāvagrahasaṃpratyayaheturyathā--kaṃsaṃ ghātayati, baliṃ bandhayatīti | atra hyartho na tathābhūto'pi tu viśiṣṭākāreṇaiva sampratyayena gocarīkṛto vyavahāraviṣayatāmanupatati | tadviparīto yo bahireva tathā byavasthitaḥ | yathā gauḥ śukla ityādi | mukhyo yathā sāsnādimān gauriti | parikalpito nimittavaśena rūpaviparyāso yasyāsau parikalpitanimittarūpaviparyāso gauṇo'rtha ucyate | yathā gaurvāhīka iti | vyapadeśya āvāpoddhārika (apoddhārikaḥ) eva jātirvā dravyaṃ vetyevamukta iti | avyapadeśyastvakhaṇḍa eva vākyārthalakṣaṇa iti |
sattvabhāvamāpanno vyapadeśya evāvāpoddhārikasaṃjñakaḥ | asattvabhūto vākyārthalakṣaṇa eva | uktibhedādevātra prayaśo bhedakathanam | sthiralakṣaṇo yathā---rājaruruṣa ityatra rājasaṃbandhitvaṃ puruṣasya, taddhi na vyabhicarati |
vivakṣāprāpitasannidhāno yathā--rājñaḥ, puruṣasyeti | atra hi saṃbandhitvaṃ vyabhicarati, viśeṣaṇāviśeṣyayoryatheṣṭatvāt | abhidhīyamāno yathā---rājasakha ityatra rājñaḥ sakhā'yamityartho'bhidhīyate | tasmiṃstvabhidhīyamāne rājā sakhā'syetyayamarthaḥ pratīyamāna eva |
abhisaṃhito yathā---gośabde jātirdravyaṃ veti | nāntarīyako yathā tatraiva varṇasaṃsthānādiḥ- ityevamabhidheyabhedā upadarśanīyāḥ |
puruṣadharmā vaktṛtvapratipattṛtvaprabhṛtayaḥ | tatra vaktṛdharmā ābādhaḥ, asūyā'sammatikopakutsanabhartsanādayaśceti | pratipattṛdharmāstu kutsyamānatvaprabhṛtaya eva | tatra śāstrasya plutadvirvacanādividhāyakatvenādhikāra iti |
atra ca ya eva dharmāḥ śabdānāṃ śāstrasya vā'nadhikāraviṣayatvenoktāstānevāpekṣyocyate---vyudāso'sya kriyāntara iti || 79 |
iyaṃ śrutyā kramaprāptiriyamuccāraṇādibhiḥ |
kramo'yamatra balavānasmiṃstu na vivakṣitaḥ || 80 |
atha kramasya nidarśanam | `iyaṃ śrutyā kramaprāptiriyamuccāraṇādibhiḥ' iti śrutyādibhedenāyaṃ kramo naikaprakāraḥ | tathā ca śrutikramaḥ, arthakramaḥ, pāṭhakramaḥ, kāṇḍakramaḥ pravṛttikramaḥ, prayogakramaḥ, buddhikramaśceti | tatra śrutikramo yathā---snātvā vrajatīti | atra ktvāpratyayenaiva śrutyā krama uktaḥ | vede yathā--"hṛdayasyāgre'vadyatyatha jihvāyāḥ" ityatra śrutyaivāgre'thaśabdābhyāṃ kramaḥ uktaḥ | śāstre'pi ca `parasmaipadānāṃ ṇalatus' ityādau yathāsaṃkhyamanudeśaḥ samānāmiti śrutyaiva kramaḥ | arthaḥ sāmarthyaṃ tannimittaḥ kramo'rthakramo yathā---bhuktvā snātvā vrajatītyatra snānādīnāmanyathāśabdopāttānāmapyarthasvarūpaparyālocanayā snānādikramo lakṣyate | vede yathā---agrihotraṃ juhoti yavāgūṃ śrapayatītyatra śrapaṇaṃ paścādvinirdiṣṭamapi pūrvamanuṣṭhīyate, tato'grihotramityarthakramaḥ |
śāstre'pi `guṇakarmaṇi lādividhiḥ' ityuktam | tathā hi--gāṃ dogdhi paya ityatra gāvā kameṇā pūrvaṃ duheryogastataḥ payasaḥ | nahyanupādāya gāṃ kaścit paya ādātumarhati | tasmādatra gopayasorduhinā yaḥ krameṇa sambandhaḥ, so'rthasāmarthyādupajāyate | tasmāt satyapi pradhāne payasi duhergavaiva pūrvaṃ sambandha iti tatraiva lādayo'ntaraṅgatvādutpadyante gaurdugdhā sudohā gauriti | uccāraṇakrama evapāṭhakramo yathā---
indusvarṇaiṇamātaṅgapuṃskokilakalāpinaḥ |
vaktrakāntīkṣaṇagatisvarakeśaistvayā jitāḥ ||
ityatra yathāpaṭhitānāṃ yathāpaṭhitaireva sambandha iti | vede yathā---samidho yajati, tanūnapātaṃ yajati, iḍo yajati barhiryajati, svāhākāraṃ yajatītvevamātmakeṣu prayājeṣu yathāpāṭhameva krameṇānuṣṭhānam | śāstre yathā--vipratiṣedhe paraṃ kāryam, pūrvatrāsiddham iti ca | atra hi śāstrapāṭhamevāpekṣyedaṃ pūrvamidaṃ paramiti vyavasthāpyate | kāṇkrmo yathā yenaiva krameṇa brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviśāṃ varṇasamācārapratipādakāni prakaraṇānyuddiṣṭāni tenaivābhidhīyanta iti |
vede tu kutracid yājñe karmaṇi yenaiva kaṇḍikākrameṇa karmāṇi codyante, tenaiva krameṇa pravartante | yathā yājyānuvākyānāmagneyādīnāṃ ca | atra yenaiva krameṇa yājyānuvākyānāṃ sanniveśaḥ, tenaiva krameṇāgneyādīnāṃ sanniveśāt kāṇḍakrameṇa sambandhaḥ | śāstre yathā--dvirvacanakāṇḍāt samprasāraṇakāṇḍamiti | tadeva vipratiṣedhe sati pūrvaṃ bhavatīti |
pravṛtikramo yathā---yenaiva krameṇa brāhmaṇāḥ samānāḥ praviśanti tenaiva krameṇa yathāsvaṃ coditaṃ kāryaṃ pratilabhanta iti | vede yathā---"saptadaśa prājāpatyān paśūnālabheta" ityatra saptadaśānāmajānāṃ prokṣaṇaviśasanaparyagnikaraṇāni krameṇa coditāni | anuṣṭhātuḥ punaricchāvaśātteṣu pravartamānasya yata evārabhya paśostenānuṣṭhātrā teṣāmādyasyānuṣṭhānamārabdhaṃ tenaiva pravṛttikrameṇa punaraparayorapyanuṣṭhānaṃ vidhatta iti so'yaṃ pratipattaricchāvaśāt pravṛttaḥ kramaḥ pravṛttikrama ityucyate |
śāstre yathā--bhāṣya uktaṃ yayaivānupūrvyā'rthānāṃ prādurbhāvaḥ, tayaiva śabdānāmapi | yathāpaṭ‌vyā mṛd‌vyetyatra prathamaṃ liṅgasaṃbandhāt strīpratyaya utpadyate, tadanu karmasaṃkhyādisaṃbandhādekavacanamutpadyate | tathaiva ca yaṇādeśādikāryaṃ tenaiva krameṇa pravartata iti |
prapatipattikramo yathā--luṅalaṅ‌lṛṅ‌kṣvaḍudātta ityatra yadyapi prayoge pūrvamaḍāgama uccāryate, tathāpi vayaṃ vidhivākyārthaṃ ptipadyamānā luṅādīn pratipadyāmahe, paścādaḍāgamamiti śāstrīyamudāharaṇam |
loke yathā puruṣo rājña ityukte'pyuccāraṇakramamatikramya pājārthavyavacchedenaiva puruṣasya pratipattiḥ| vede yathā--pradhānayāgāḥ pūrvamuktā apyavāntarayāganivartanānusāreṇaiva pratipattimupārohanti | yathā--dīkṣaṇīyādīnāṃ somasya ca | atra hi somayāgasya pradhānasya pūrvaṃ buddhyupārohe'pi dīkṣaṇīyādiyāganirvatanapūrvakameva somapratipattiḥ |
prayogakramastu yathā--ḍukṛñityādau yathā''nupūrvyā anubandhāḥ prayuktāstayaivetsaṃjñāṃ labhanta iti śāstrīyamudāharaṇam |
vede yathā--darśapūrṇamāsābhyāmiṣṭvā'nyena yajete ityatra darśapūrṇamāsayāgapūrvakamanyānuṣṭhānaṃ vijñeyam | buddhikramo yathā--śāstre varṇānāmiko yaṇacītyādau buddhyā paurvāparyaṃ kalpyate | tathā ca paurvāpayamakālavyapetaṃ saṃhitā cet pūrvaparābhāvādasaṃhitam | ekavarṇavartitvādvāca uccaritapradhvaṃsitvācca varṇānāmityāśaṅkyoktaṃ bhāṣyakāreṇa |
"buddhau kṛtvā sarvāśceṣṭāḥ kartā dhīrastanvannītiḥ |
śabdenārthān vācyān dṛṣṭvā buddhau kuryāt paurvāparyam || "
iti śāstre buddhikramaḥ | loke'pi vidyataḥ krameṇa pravṛtā buddhau saṃkalayati | vede prayājādīnāmutpannapradhavaṃsināṃ buddhyaiva saṃkalanamiti bauddhaḥ kramaḥ | sarva eva vā bauddhaḥ kramo na vastusamuttha iti | yadāhuḥ--"pratipattikramo na vastusamutthaḥ" iti |
atha eṣāṃ kramāṇāṃ balābalacintāṃ karoti--kramo'yamatra balavāniti | yathā vede--prathamaṃ bhojayitavyastato'bhyañjanamiti |
atha kramapratiyoginaṃ darśayitumāha---asmiṃstu na vivakṣita iti | krama iti prakṛtam | avivakṣā kramasya pratipakṣaḥ | tadyathā vede'nuṣṭhātṝṇāṃ kramavivakṣā nimittavaśād dṛśyate | loke pratipattṝṇāmapi dṛśyate | śāstre yathoktaṃ vārttikakṛtā---atiprasaṅgo guṇavṛddhipratiṣedhe kṅiti ityādi || 80 |
atha prayojakāprayojake nidarśyete--
idaṃ parāṅgaiḥ saṃbaddhamaṅgānāmaprayojakam |
prayojakamidaṃ teṣāmatredaṃ nāntarīyakam || 81 |
tatra rājā chatracchāyāyāḥ prayojakaḥ, istyādayastadādhārā aprayojakā api chatracchāyayā saṃbadhyamānāḥ prayojakā ucyanta ityekaphalatayā prayojakabhāvaḥ | phalabhede'pyūhyamudāharaṇamiti loke | vedaśāstrayorapyūhyam || 81 |
idaṃ pradhānaṃ śeṣo'yaṃ viniyogakramastvayam |
sākṣādasyopakārīdamidamārād viśeṣakam || 82 |
athaṃ śeṣiśeṣau darśayitumāha--idaṃ pradhānaṃ śeṣo'yamiti |
vede yathā--vrīhīnavahantīti vrīhayaḥ śeṣiṇaḥ, avaghātaḥ śeṣastadarthatvāt | lokaśāstrayoruhyamudāharaṇam |
asyaiva śeṣiśeṣabhāvasyetikartavyatāṃ pradarśayitumāha--viniyogakramastvayamiti | tadevaṃ guṇapradhānabhāvasya parikarabandhasahitasyopadarśanaṃ kṛtvā tatraivāvāntarabhedamāha--sākṣādasyopakārīdamidamārādviśeṣakamiti |
tatra loke sākṣādupakārakaṃ yathā svātmanyalaṅkārādi | ārāt tadeva putradārādiṣu | śāstre'pi sākṣādupakārakaṃ pratyayasya prakṛtyādi |
yattu prakṛtyāderviśeṣaṇaṃ tadārādupakārakam | yathā erajityādāvivarṇāntatvādi dhātorviśeṣaṇam | kartṛviśeṣaṇaṃ ca paśvādīti | vede'pyavaghātādi darśapūṇamāsayoḥ sākṣādaṅgam, prayājādikaṃ tvārādupakārakam || 82 |
śaktivyāpārabhedo'smin phalamatra tu bhidyate |
saṃbandhājjātabhedo'yaṃ bhedastatrāvivakṣitaḥ || 83 |
ityevaṃ saprabhedaṃ saparikarabandhaṃ śeṣaśeṣibhāvamupadarśyedānīṃ bhedaṃ pradarśayitumāha--śaktivyāpārabhedo'sminniti |
śaktivyāpārabhedāśrayaṇena bahuvidho bhedo lakṣyate | tatra loke balāhakād vidyotate, balāhake vidyotate, balāhako vidyotata ityatra balāṅakasyāpādānādhikaraṇakartṛśaktīnāṃ bhedaḥ śāstre cātraiva vivakṣāvaśād vyāpārabhedaścetyevaṃ śaktivyāpārabhedaḥ |
(kkacittu) śaktibhedamātram, na tu vyāpārabhedaḥ | yathā--dhanuṣā vidhyatīti | atra hi garbhokṛtāpādānaśaktiḥ karaṇaśaktirvidhyatyarthābhedena vyāpriyate | na hyanyathānāśritāpādānaśaktidhanuṣaḥ karaṇatbaṃ saṃbhavati | ata evātra saṃjñayorvipratiṣedho varṇyate | vyāpārabhedastu śuddho na saṃbhavati, śaktibhedamantareṇa vyāpārabhedasyāsaṃbhavāt |
atha phalabhedena bhedamāha--phalamatra tu bhidyata iti | yathaikasya dānasyāyurārogyaiśvaryāṇi bhinnāni phalāni | anye tvāyuṣyaprabhṛtiṣu satsu prītiviśeṣamevaikaṃ phalamāhuḥ | tathā bahvīnāṃ kriyāṇāmekaṃ phalam, yathā vyavahāradarśane prajānāmeko nirṇayaḥ | yathā vakṣyati--
bhinnavyāpārarūpāṇāṃ vyavahārādidarśane |
kartṝṇāṃ darśanaṃ bhinnaṃ saṃbhūyārthasya sādhakam || iti  |
prakārāntareṇāpi bhedaṃ darśayitumāha--saṃbandhājjātabhedo'yamiti | yathā''khyāteṣu dhātūpāttāyāḥ kriyāyāḥ pratyayavācyakartṛbhede sati saṃbandhāt kriyāyā api bhedaḥ pratīyate, pacataḥ pacantīti | yathoktam--"sādhanabhedāt tiṅ‌kṣu phalābhāvāt phalaṃ bhavatyevāvabodhaścet sādhanebhyaḥ prasiddho'sau" iti |
idānīmasyaiva pratipakṣabhūtabhedaṃ darśayitumāha--bhedastvatrāvivakṣitaḥ iti | atra śaktyabhedo yathā--samānakartṛkayorityatra paktvaudanaṃ bhuṅ‌kta iti kartṛkarmaṇoḥ kriyābhedena prāptaḥ śaktibhedo vaktrā na vivakṣitaḥ | tathā ca satyatra samānakartṛkatvamupapannaṃ bhavati | vyāpārābhedaḥ prāgeva darśito dhanuṣā vidhyatītyatra phalābhedo'pi pūrvamukta eva | yathā dānasyaikā prītiḥ phalamiti keciditi |
saṃbandhājjātabhedatvasya pratipakṣo yatra na sambandhabhedājjātabhedatvam | yathā''syate devadattenetyatra bhāve lakāra utpannaḥ sādhanabhedānupādānāt kriyābhedamapi gamayituṃ na śakaoti |
devadattenetyasmāttatpratītiriti cedekapadāpekṣayaitaduktamasmābhirityadoṣaḥ| tadevaṃ śaktyādibhedena bahuvidho'yaṃ bheda iti lakṣyaiḥ svayamevotprekṣyaḥ | tathā tatpratipakṣabhūtastadvadabhedo'pi bahuvidhi eva vijñeyaḥ | anayośca bhedobhedayoḥ kkacidvāstavatvam kkacidvivakṣāmātraśaraṇatvam | vivakṣāpi kkacillaukikī, kkacit prayoktrītyetadapyatrānusartavyamiti |
vede'pi bhedavyavahāro dṛśyate | yajate, dadāti, juhotītyādau yāgadānahomarūpādanubandhabedādapūrvasya bhedaḥ | abhedo'pi yathā---ṣaṇṇāmapyāgneyādiyāgānāmekasminnevāpūrve sādhye aikyamiṣyati iti | evaṃ ṣaḍ‌dvādaśa caturviṃśatiśca lakṣaṇāni prākṛtāni vaikṛtāni ca sapratipakṣāṇi darśitāni || 83 |
idānīṃ ṣaḍ‌dvādaśacaturviṃśativyatirikta apyamī bahuprakārā nyāyāḥ padārthaniścayahetavaḥ santīti prauḍhavāditayā ṭīkākāraḥ pradarśayitumāha---
prasajyapratiṣedho'yaṃ paryudāso'yamatra tu |
idaṃ gauṇamidaṃ mukhyaṃ vyāpīdaṃ guru ladhvidam || 84 |
tatra prasajyapratiṣedho'yamiti | yatra kriyāpadena nañaḥ saṃbandho vākyabhedaśca |
śāstre yathā--"akartari ca kārake" iti |
vede yathā---"brahmaṇo na hantavyaḥ | nānṛtaṃ vadet" ityādi |
loke yathā--"asūryaṃpaśyā rājadārā" iti | "paryudāso'yamatra tu" iti | payudāsaḥ khalu prasajyapratiṣedhaviparītastatra hyākhyātenaiva nañaḥ saṃbandha ekavākyatā ca |
uktaṃ ca---"nāmadhātvarthayogī tu naiva nañ pratiṣedhakaḥ" iti |
tatra śāstre yathā---"āto'nupasarge kaḥ" iti | vede yathā---"abrāhmaṇaḥ somavikrayī" ityatra jātimātrānugamena brāhmaṇasadṛśasya kasyacideva pratipattiḥ | yathā ca "nodyantamādityamīkṣeta" ityevamādi smārtamudāharaṇadūraviprakarṣādatra vaidikameva |
loke yathā---"abrāhmaṇamānaya" iti | "idaṃ gauṇam " iti | śāstre yathā---"tatpuruṣaḥ samānādhikaraṇacha" iti | atrāvayavānāṃ samānādhikaraṇatvāt tatpuruṣasyāpi samānādhikaraṇatvam |
vede yathā---"ādityo yūpaḥ, yajamānaḥ prastaraḥ" iti | atra guṇāccākacaikyāderyūpādirapyādityādirityucyate |
loke ca---"siṃho māṇavakaḥ, gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣaḥ" ityādi |
idaṃ mukhyamiti | atra śāstre yathā---"dhātocha", "pratipadikāt" ityādāvabhidheyasya mukhyatvam |
vede yathā---"yajamāno'dhvaryumanvālabhate" ityatrādhvaryuyajamānau mukyāveva |
loke yathā---"śūro māṇavakaḥ" iti |
"vyāpīdam" iti | śāstre yathā---"ekaśruti dūrātsaṃbuddhau" iti | tatra hi laukikyāḥ saṃbuddhargrahaṇaṃ vyāpitvāt | tad‌grahaṇe hi śāstrīyāpi saṃbuddhiḥ parigṛhītā bhavati | vakṣyati ca---
viṣayaṃ kṛtrimasyāpi laukikaḥ kkaciduccaran |
vyāpnoti dūrāt saṃbuddhau tathā ca grahaṇaṃ dvayoḥ || iti |
yāvatsu cobhayānugrahastattatra sarvamanugantavyaṃ vyāpitveneti |
vede'pi---"sarve pradhānayāgaviṣayā jyotiṣṭomena" ityādyadhikāravidhayaḥ |
loke'pi yathā---kayāciditikartavyatayā sannihatyāmamarasindhusnānam |
yaducyate---
upoṣya rajanīmekāṃ sannihatyāṃ narottamaḥ |
saurye tamasi gaṅgāyāṃ cāndre cāpi vimucyate || iti |
atra sakṛdeva snānāt trailokyābhyantaragatasarvatīrthasnānamiti vyāpyudāharaṇaṃ prasaṅgāduktam |
guru ladhvidamiti | tatra śāstre yathā---`pṛṣodarādīni yathopadiṣṭami'ti śiṣṭaprasiddhasādhuśabdaughapratipādane laghurupāyaḥ | sa eva tu prātipadikādanabhihitakarmādigataikatvādau svādaya ityādinā gururupāyaḥ |
loke'pi--lohitaśālimānayaṃ grāma ityādivacanavyaktiṣu karmadhārayamatvarthoyayorekatra kriyamāṇayoḥ guruprakrama upajāyate, ughutvaṃ tu prakamasya bahuvrīhestetreti |
vede tu gurulāghavavyavahāratantraprasaṅgāvṛttiṣu | tatrāvṛttau guruḥ prakramo yathā---triḥ prathamāmanvāha triruttamāmiti | tantraprasaṅgayostu lāghavavyavahāro yathā nidarśitaṃ prāgiti || 84 ||
bhedenāṅgāṅgibhāvo'sya bahudhedaṃ vikalpyate |
idaṃ niyamyate'syātra yogyatvamupajāyate || 85 ||
bhedenāṅgāṅigabhāvo'syeti | yathā śāstre---saṃyuktavidhāneṣu tasyāpatyaṃ kartari kṛdityādi |
vede yathā---ekasyaivāvayavaḥ saṃbadhyamāno vyavahitairapi vākyāntaraiḥ saṃbandhamupayāti | yathā---acchidreṇetyādiścitpatyādibhiriti | pūrvamekaikasyaivāṅgāṅgibhāvaḥ idānīṃ bahūnāmaṅgināṃ yathā pradarśitamekamaṅgamiti punarasyopādānam |
loke'pi---
maṇiḥ śāṇollīḍhaḥ śaradi saritaḥ śyānapulināḥ
kalāśeṣaścandraḥ suratamṛditā bālalalanāḥ |
madakṣīṇo nāgaḥ samaravijayī hetinihata
stanimnā śobhante galitavibhavāścārthiṣu narāḥ || 
ityādidīpakālaṅgāreṣvekasyā eva kriyāyā bahubhirvākyaiḥ sambandha iti |
bahubhedaṃ vikalpyata iti | tatra śāstre yathā---kkacitprāptivikalpaḥ, kkacidaprāptavikalpaḥ, kkacidubhayavikalpaḥ |
vede yathā---"yatkiñcit prāgagnīṣomīyāttatsarvamupāṃśu kartavyam" ityatropāṃśusvare prāpte dīkṣaṇīyāyāṃ yatheṣṭamuccaiḥ svaravidhānamityādi |
loke yathā--`kiṃ tāruṇyataroriyami' tyādau mahākavibhirutprekṣitā vikalpāḥ | idaṃ niyamyata iti | śāstre yathā--`patiḥ samāsa eva", "te prāgdhātocha" ityādi|
vede yathā---"nakṣatradṛṣṭ‌vā vācaṃ visṛjet" iti | atra niyata eva kāle vāgvisargo niyamitaḥ |
loke'pi yathā--pārtha eva dhanurdhara ityatra dhānuṣkatvaṃ pārthe niyamyate |
asyātra yogyatvamupajāyata iti | yathā śāstre---"uḥ sthāne'ṇaḥ prasajyamānasyaiva raparatvaṃ prati yogyatvamupajāyate" iti | yathā vā--"pada ekasminnudātte svarite vā kriyamāṇe varjyamānaśeṣasya nidyāte yogyatvamupajāyate" iti |
vede yathā---"jyotiṣṭomena yajeta" ityatra traivarṇikasyaiva yogyatvam |
loke yathocyate---"dhuri dhuryo niyujyate" iti | yo yaḥ kaścidartho samarthaḥ śāstreṇāparyudastaḥ sa yogya ityucyate || 85 ||
asya vākyāntare dṛṣṭālliṅgādbhedo'numīyate |
ayaṃ śabdādapod‌dhṛtya padārthaḥ pravibhajyate || 86 ||
asya vākyāntare dṛṣṭālliṅgāt bhedaḥ pratīyata iti | śāśtre yathā---`oḥ puyaṇ‌jyapare' iti vacanāṇ‌ ṇau kṛtaṃ sthānivadbhavatīti |
vede yathā---"aktāḥ śarkarā upadadhāti" ityatra kenāktā ityākāṅ‌kṣāyām "tejo vai ghṛtam" iti ghṛtastutervākyāntarālliṅgād ghṛtenāktā iti viśeṣaḥ pratīyate |
loke yathā---rāmo'sau bhuvaneṣvatyādau dāśārathiḥ paraśurāmo veti saṃśaye vākyāntaragatāt "ekabāṇahataśreṇībhūtaviśālatālavivarod‌gīrṇaiḥ svaraiḥ saptabhiḥ" iti liṅgād dāśarathipratipattireveti | ayaṃ śabdādapoddhatya padārthaḥ pravibhajyata iti |
śāstre yathā---dhṛṣiśasī vaiyātye ityāsmādvaiyātyaśabdādapoddhatya viyātabhāvo vaiyātyamiti vibhajyate |
vede yathā---vāyavyaṃ śvetamālabhetetyasmādvākyādvāyavyapadārthādapod‌dhṛtya "vāyurvai kṣepiṣṭhā devatā" iti pravibhajyate | loke'pi rājapuruṣa ityukte kasya rājñaḥ, śūdrakasyeti praśanottarayo rājapadārthapravibhāgaḥ || 86 ||
idānīṃ prakṛte codyamupasaṃhartumāha---
iti vākyeṣu ye dharmāḥ padārthopanibandhanāḥ |
sarve te na prakalperan padaṃ cet syādavācakam || 87 ||
anaṃśe vākye'bhyupagamyamāne vākyeṣu padasamudāyarūpeṣu satyapadārthopanibandhaneṣu ye dharmā vākyārthānugrāhiṇaḥ padārthaviśeṣasaṃpratyayapratibaddhaste sarve'trā'vidyamānoddeśapravibhāge na pratiṣṭhāṃ labheran, yadi satyaṃ padaṃ vācakaṃ na syāditi padavādī pratyavatiṣṭhate || 87 ||
evaṃ padavādinā'khaṇḍavākyavādino dūṣaṇavrāte samāpite idānīmetat samādhātumakhaṇḍavākyavādyāha---
avibhakte'pi vākyārthe śaktibhedādapod‌dhṛte |
vākyāntaravibhāgena yathāktaṃ na virudhyate || 88 ||
etatsava yathoktamasmatpakṣe na virudhyate | tathā cāsmatpakṣe'vibhakte nirvibhāge vākyārthe ekasminnapi tasmin pānakarasādivatsamāśrīyamāṇe śaktibhedasamāśrayaṇena cāpod‌dhṛte kṛtāpoddhāre satyavāntaravākyārthopajananāt sarvametatsidhyatīti tātparyam | yathā śākyadarśane nirvibhāgamekameva sakalatrailokyavilakṣaṇaṃ sattvaṃ svalakṣaṇamabhyupagamyate, tattaditarapadārthavyāvṛttisamāśrayaṇena ca jātyādivyavahāraḥ kaścinnirvāhyate, tathaivākhaṇḍavākyavādinā śaktibhedādvākyārthapravibhāge kṛte sarvaṃ yujyata iti na kaścid doṣaḥ | `vākyāntaravibhāgena' |
`avibhakte'pi vākyārthe' iti ca vākyavākyārthayorekayogakṣematvāduktam | padārthāsaṃbhavapūrvake codye `vākyāntaravibhāgena' ityuttaramasamīcīnamiva lakṣyata iti cet, bādhyabādhakabhāvādinyāyo vākyeṣvapi dṛśyate | tato mahāvākyāpekṣayā'vāntaravākyopaplāvanena tadapi na virudhyata ityupadarśitam, tadupadarśanena parimitaparimāṇe'pi vākye padārthāpoddhāranibandhanā apyete nyāyāḥ sambhavantītyupadarśitameva bhavati||88|| etadeva prasiddhadṛṣṭāntopadarśanena draḍhayitumāha---
yathaivaikasya gandhasya medena parikalpanā |
puṣpādiṣu tathā vākye'pyarthamedo vidhīyate || 89 ||
strak‌candanādāveka upasanniviṣṭa eva gandhastasya tvapoddhārasamāśrayaṇena bhedaḥ kalpyate'yaṃ puṣapagandho'yaṃ candanagandha ityādi | tathā vākya evārthāpoddhārasamāśrayaṇena padārthabheda upapadyate---ayaṃ devadattapadārthaḥ, ayaṃ gopadārtha ityādi || 89 ||
gavaye narasiṃhe vāpyekajñānāvṛte yathā |
bhāgaṃ jātyantarasyaiva sadṛśaṃ pratipadyate || 90 ||
dṛṣṭāntāntaramāha--
ekajñānenābhinnenaivāvṛte viṣayīkṛte paricchinne gavayādau sati tadekadeśaṃ prasiddhajātyantarasyaiva pratipadyate | evamapoddhārasamāśrayaṇena sarvanyāyasamarthane kṛte tatsamānayogakṣematayā pratinidhiḥ stutivākyavirodhaśca samarthita eva | agre tvavāntaravākyānāmarthavattvaṃ samarthayiṣyate || 90 ||
aprasiddhaṃ tu yaṃ bhāgamadṛṣṭamanupaśyati |
tāvatyasaṃvidaṃ mūḍhaḥ sarvatra pratipadyate || 91 ||
adhunā tamevāpoddhāramāśritya pikādisaṃdehe codyamuddhartuṃ prastāvanāṃ karoti---
tatra ca gavayādau bhāgamaprasiddhamadṛṣṭamaniścitamanupaśyati mūḍhaḥ paramārthatastu saṃvittasya sarvatra nirvibhāge tasmin kutaścitkāraṇānnotpannā | sarvatrāyamasaṃvidaṃ tāvatpunaḥ (masaṃvidāno'pyasaṃvidaṃ tāvatyeva punaḥ) pratipadyata iti || 91 ||
tathā pikādiyogena vākye'tyantavilakṣaṇe |
sadṛśasyeva saṃjñānamasato'rthasya manyate || 92 ||
prakṛte yojayitumāha--
vanāt pika ānīyatāmityetadvanād ṛkṣa ānīyatāmityetasmādvākyāntarādatyantavilakṣaṇameva | vanādānīyatāmiti cātrāsannevārtho vanād ṛkṣa ānīyatāmityasya kramavaśāt sadṛśa iti manyate | paramārthatastu pikādiyogāt sakalamevātyantavilakṣaṇam | ekapadārthasaṃdehe sakalamevājñātaṃ vākyamityucyate || 92 ||
ekasya bhāge sādṛśyaṃ bhāge medaśca lakṣyate |
nirbhāgasya prakāśasya nirbhāgeṇaiva cetasā || 93 ||
dṛṣṭāntamāha--
yathaikameva nīlapītādijñānaṃ prakāśasvabhāvād niraṃśamevopajātaṃ tasyajñānatvena sādṛśyaṃ manyate | nīlapītādinā ca bhedaḥ | vastutaḥ punarbhinnameva nīlajñānaṃ pītajñānāditi na tatrānugamaḥ kaścit |
athavā citrajñānayoreva bhāge sādṛśyaṃ bhāge bhedaṃ pratipadyate | kiñciddhi citrajñānaṃ nīlaharitollekhi | kiñciddhi nīlapītollekhīti nīlādinā tatra sādṛśyaṃ haritādinā bhedaṃ pratipadyata iti || 93 ||
tathaiva bhāge sādṛśyaṃ bhāge medo'vasīyate |
bhāgābhāve'pi vākyānāmatyantaṃ bhinnadharmaṇām || 94 ||
dārṣṭāntike yojayitumāha--
pratītārthaḥ ślokaḥ || 94 ||
rūpanāśe padānāṃ syāt kathaṃ cāvadhikalpanā |
agṛhītāvadhau śabde kathaṃ cārtho vivacyate || 95 ||
idānīmakhaṇḍavādī padavādinaṃ dūṣayitumāha---
yadi pādanyeva satyāni, tadādadhyānayetyādisaṃhitāyāṃ rūpavināśāt padasya niyatasyābhāve kamavadhiṃ gṛhītvā tadartho vivicyatām, ataḥ pravibhāgaśūnyaṃ vākyamevaikaṃ satyamabhyupagantavyam || 95 ||
saṃsarga iva rūpāṇāṃ śabde'nyatra vyavasthitaḥ |
nānārūpeṣu tadrūpaṃ tantreṇāparimiṣyate || 96 ||
athākhaṇḍapakṣe śveto dhāvatītyetatpraśradvayā'pākaraṇāya kathamekaṃ vākyam, atra hi śvā ityetadrūpaṃ saṃhitāvaśādvinaṣṭamityetatpadārthāsaṃbhavāt kathaṃ tadavagatiḥ ? tatrāha--
śveta ityādau śabde anyatrākhaṇḍapakṣe rūpāṇāṃ saṃsarga iva vyavasthitaḥ, ataśca tadrūpamaparaṃ tantreṇāvasthitaṃ teṣu nānārūpeṣu pratyāyakamiṣyata ityadoṣaḥ||96||
tasminnabhede bhedānāṃ saṃsarga iva vartate |
rūpaṃ rūpāntarāttasmādananyat pravibhajyate || 97 ||
tadeva vyācikhyāsurāha--
tasminnabhede ekasminneva śveta ityevaṃ rūpe bhedānāṃ śvā itaḥ śvetaśca ityeteṣāṃ saṃsarga iva sthitaḥ | tasmāttadrūpaṃ rūpāntarādananyadapi tantranyāyasamāśrayaṇenobhayārthapratyāyakatayā pravibhajyata ityasmin pakṣe śveta ityetadakhaṇmepava pratyāyakam || 97 ||
śāstre pratyāyakasyāpi kkacidekatvamāśritam |
pratyāyyena kkacidbhedo grahaṇagrahyayoḥ sthitaḥ || 98 ||
athātraiva prasaṅgāt pratyāyyapratyāyakayorviṣayabhedena bhedābhedau smṛtāvityāha---
ū ityabhedāśritya yathāsaṃkhyaṃ prakalpitam |
tatrābhedaṃ pratyāyyapratyāyakayoḥ, darśayati --
ūkālo'jjhrasvadīrghapluta ityatroktam | hrasvādiṣu samasaṃkhyā'prasiddharuddeśanirdeśavaiṣamyāt | siddhaṃ tu samasaṃkhyatvāt trayāṇāṃ hi vikāranirdeśa iti tataśca ūkāla ityatra mātrikadvimātratrimātrāṇāṃ saṃsṛjya nirdeśāt pratyāyyapratyāyakayorabhede samasaṃkhyatvānnirdeśasāmye saṃkhyātānudeśe siddhe hrasvadīrghaplutasaṃjñāḥ pṛthagavatiṣṭhanta iti na kaściddoṣaḥ |
lṛṅ‌lṛṭorgrahaṇe bhedo grāhyābhyāṃ saha kalpitaḥ || 99 ||
pratyāyyapratyāyakayorbhedaṃ nidarśayitumāha---
syatāsī lṛluṭorityatra lṛśabdena lṛṅ‌lṛṭau pratyāyyeta iti nimittanimittinorvaiṣamyāt saṃkhyātānudeśābhāvaḥ prāpnoti | yathāsaṃkhyamanudeśaḥ samānāmityatroktam---"saṃkhyāsāmyaṃ śabdaśced ṇalādayaḥ parasmaipadānām | ḍāraurasaḥ prathamasya | eco'yavāyāva ityanirdeśaḥ | arthataścet lṛluṭornandyarīhaṇasindhutakṣaśilādiṣu doṣaḥ" iti codyamevaṃ pakṣadūya upasthitam |
tatrocyate-lṛluṭorityatra lṛrūpamutsṛṣṭānubandhasāmānyamātraṃ pratyāyakamabhinnameva, na punaḥ pratyāyyabhedādbhinnamatrābhyupagamyate | tataśca nimittanimittinoḥ sāmyāt saṃkhyātānudeśaḥ saṅgacchata iti na kiñcidaniṣṭam || 99 ||
yasyetyetadaṇo rūpaṃ saṃjñināmabhidhāyakam |
nahi pratīyamānena grahaṇāsyāsti sambhavaḥ || 100 ||
atha pratyāyyapratyāyakayoranyatrāpyabhedaṃ daśaryitumāha---
iśca aśca tadyaṃ tasya yasya yadetatsaṃsṛṣṭekārākārayo rūpamaṇoḥ pratyāyakaṃ tatsaṃjñināmivarṇāvarṇānāmabhedātpratyāyakaṃ bhavati, tena īkārākārayorapi sauparṇeyo vainateya ityatra lopaḥ pravartate | yadi cātra pratyāyyapratyāyyakayorabhedo nāśrīyate tadā pratīyamānena pratyāyyamānenānyeṣāṃ grahaṇasya pratyāyanasyāsaṃbhava iti nātreṣṭaṃ sidhyet | tasmāttantreṇoccāritamekamevobhayoḥ pratyāyakaṃ saṃsaṣṭarūpatvādityastyeva śveto dhāvatītyetasmādubhayārthapratītiḥ || 100 ||
ū ityetadabhinnaṃ ca bhinnavākyanibandhanam |
bhedena grahaṇāṃ cāsya pararūpamiva dvayoḥ || 101 ||
avāntaravākyopaplāvanenaitadvobhayārthapratyāyakaṃ bhaviṣyatīti dṛṣṭāntena pradarśayitumāha---
ūkāla ityetadupāttam | tad‌dhrasvadīrghaplutānāṃ trayāṇāṃ sāmānyenābhinnaṃ rūpaṃ bodhavyam | tataścaitadekaṃ grahaṇakavākyasthānīyam , avāntaravākyanibandhanaṃ bhavatītyāha--bhinnavākyanibandhanamiti | ukālo'jjhrasvasaṃjñaḥ | ūkālodīrghasaṃjñaḥ | u3kālaḥ plutasaṃjño boddhavya iti | ataśca yadā saṃsṛṣṭatvādasyābhedenaiva grahaṇaṃ pratyāyake sthitaṃ tadā ū ityetadrūpaṃ bhinnavākyanibandhanameva bhavati | yathā pararūpaṃ saṃsṛṣṭatvādekamapi dvayoḥ pratyāyakaṃ dṛśyate | tathaitad boddhavyam | tataśca śveto dhāvatītyādāvavāntaravākyopaplāvanenobhayārthatā bhaviṣyatīti yojanīyam || 101 ||
plutasyāṅgavivṛddhiṃ ca samāhāramacostathā |
vyudasyatā punarbhedaḥ śabdeṣvatyantamāśritaḥ || 102 ||
śabdānāṃ bhedapakṣa eva vārtikakārasyābhirucita iti darśayitumāha--
plutāvaica idutāvityatroktam "aṅgavivṛddhirnopapadyate | na hyaico'vayavo'kāra ikāra ukāro vā" ityevamaṅgavivṛddhiṃ vyudasyatā tāveva śabdāvekatra saṃmilitāviti ya upadarśitaḥ prāgabhedaḥ sa parākṛtaḥ | tathā'coḥ samāhāraṃ vyudasyatā bheda eveṣyata iti | yadāha "samāhāro'coścennābhāvād" iti | tasmāt śveto dhāvatītyādau sadṛśayormelanamanupadamavāntaravākyopaplāvanena tantranyāyasamāśrayaṇena vā samarthanaṃ (yat samarthitaṃ na) tajjyāya iti || 102 ||
arddharcādiṣu śabdeṣu rūpabhedaḥ kramādyathā |
tantrāttathaikaśabdatve bhinnānāṃ śrutiranyathā || 103||
atha tantramupasaṃhartumupakramate--
yathā kramavaśena ṛco'rddham arddharca ityekasyaiva śabdasya rūpabhedastathā tantranyāyāśrayaṇenai kaśabdatve bhinnānāṃ rūpāṇāmanyathā śrutirabhinnā śrutirboddhavyeti tantramupasaṃhṛtam || 103 ||
saṃhitāviṣaye varṇāḥ svarūpeṇāvikāriṇaḥ |
śabdāntaratvaṃ yāntīva śaktyantaraparigrahāt || 104 ||
etadeva sphuṭīkartumāha--
sa eva śabdo'nekaśaktivarṇatayā saṃhitāviṣaye pratibhāsata ityekasyaiva śvetaśabdasya saṃhitayoccāraṇācchaktyantaraparigraheṇobhayārthapratyāyakatvaṃ manyate || 104 ||
indriyādivikāreṇa dṛṣṭaṃ grāhyeṣu vastuṣu |
ātmatyāgādṛte bhinnaṃ grahaṇaṃ sa kramaḥ śrutau || 105 ||
ekasyāpi nimittabhedādbheda upajāyata iti dṛṣṭāntapradarśanenāha--
yathā kācādyupahatacakṣuṣāmekākāramapi vastu nānārūpatāyā'vabhāsate, tathā saṃhitāvaśādeko'pi śabdo rūpāntareṇāvabhāsate || 105 ||
abhidhānakriyāyogācchabdeṣvavikṛteṣvapi |
rūpamatyantabhedena tadevaikaṃ prakāśate || 106 ||
etadevopasaṃhartumāha---
abhidhānakriyā saṃhitayoccāraṇameva tayā yogāttatsambandhādavikṛteṣvapi śabdeṣvekameva śaktyantaraparigrahādatyantabhedena prakāśate || 106 ||
ṛco vā gītimātre vā sāma dravyāntaraṃ na tu |
gītibhedādvigṛhyante tā eva vikṛtā ṛcaḥ || 107 ||
athaitadevāgamaviṣaye dṛśyate tena saṃvādayitumāha--
ṛca eva tathodīritāḥ sāmākhyāṃ yathā pratilabhante | viśeṣeṇodīraṇamātraṃ vā sāma | yathocyate "gītiṣu sāmākhyā" iti | ṛco vā sāmetyetad jñāpayitumāha---gītibhedādityādi |
tadevaṃ bhedābhedavivakṣābhinnena pratyāyyapratyāyakabhāvenātyantabhedarūpeṇa vā "saṃhitāviṣaye varṇāḥ" ityatroktaprakāreṇa tantreṇa tatpratipakṣeṇa vā'vāntaravākyopaplāvanarūpeṇa śveto dhāvatītyatraikatve'pi vākyāsyārthabhedo bhaviṣyatīti nāsmatpakṣe padānāmanabhyupagame'pi kācit kṣatiḥ || 107 ||
upāyācchrutisaṃhāre (ro) bhinnānāmekaśeṣiṇām |
tantreṇoccāraṇe teṣāṃ śāstre sādhutvamiṣyate || 108 ||
atha punarapi tantranyāyenaitat samarthayitumāha---
upāyāttantralakṣaṇādbhinnānāmapi śabdānāmekasyāṃ śrutau saṃhāraḥ saṃśleṣo gīrṇatvam | kīdṛśānāṃ bhinānanāmityāha--ekaśeṣiṇāmiti | ekaśeṣasādharmyāttantreṇoccāritā apyekaśeṣiṇa ucyante || 108 ||
parigṛhya śrutiṃ caikāṃ rūpabhedavatāmapi
tantreṇoccāraṇaṃ kāryamanyathā te na sādhavaḥ || 109 ||
tasmādevaṃvidheviṣaye bhinnānāsapi śabdānāṃ kiṃcatsādṛśyamupādāya tantreṇaiva pratipādanaṃ kāryamityāha---
yadyapi ca sarūpāṇāṃ vākyānāṃ śāstreṇa sākṣāttantreṇa pratipādanaṃ na kṛtam , nāpyekaśeṣasya pratipādanam , tathāpi samānanyāyatvātsarvamapi śabdānuśāsanopayogīti pratipāditamuktamevetyūhyata iti pratipādayitumāha---
yathoktaṃ vārttikakṛtā "halantyamekaśeṣanirdeśādvā" iti | tenaikaśeṣiṇāṃ tantranyāyavatāmiti yāvat | upāyādityādeḥ pūrvasya ślokasya sphuṭīkaraṇāyektaṃ tantreṇoccāraṇa ityādi || 109 ||
sarūpāṇāṃ ca vākyānāṃ śāstreṇa pratipādatam |
tantreṇoccāraṇādekaṃ rūpaṃ sādhūpalabhyate || 110 ||
ekasyānekarūpatvaṃ nālikādiparigrahāt |
yathā tathaiva tantrāt syāt bahūnāmekarūpatā || 111 ||
etadeva dṛṣṭāntaprardaśanapūrvakamupasaṃhartumāha--
yathaiko'pi dhvanirnālikādiparigrahopadhānavaśānnānāvidhaṣaḍ‌jaṛṣabhādirūpabhedavānupajāyate, tathā tantrasamāśrayaṇena śvā itaḥ śveta ityevamātmakānāṃ bhinnānāmapi śabdānāmekarūpatā śveta ityevarūpateti na kaścittatra doṣaḥ || 111||
yathā padasarūpāṇāṃ vākyānāṃ sambhavaḥ pṛthak |
tathā vākyāntarābhāve syādeṣāṃ pṛthāgarthatā || 112 ||
idānīṃ yaduktamavāntaravākyānāmarthavattvaṃ na syāditi tatpratividhātumāha---
yathā'khaṇḍapakṣe vākyānāṃ padasarūpāṇāmavāntaravākyānāmapoddhārabuddhyā sambhavamupakalpyārthasteṣāṃ mahāvākyopayogī vyavasthāpyate | yadi tathā na prakalpeta na tadā mahāvākyārthasampratyayaḥ syāt | tathā vākyāntarābhāva eṣāṃ pṛthagarthatā syāt | yāvatā'poddhārasamāśrayaṇena vākyāntarāṇyupakalpya pṛthagarthatvamasatyamapyeṣāmabhyupagamyati iti nāstyavāntaravākyānupapatticodyam || 112 ||
abhidheyaḥ padasyārtho vākyāsyārthaḥ prayojanam |
yasya tasya na saṃbandho vākyānāmupapadyate || 113 ||
idānīṃ prayojanaṃ vākyārtha iti pakṣaṃ dūṣayitumāha---
vākyāsyārtho vākyaprayojanamucyate | na tvabhidheyaḥ | kasyāyamarthaḥ syādityāha--abhidheyaḥ padasyārtha iti | padānāmartho'bhidheya ucyate | etannirākaroti---yasyā tasyetyādi | evaṃ vādinaḥ parasparaṃ vākyānāṃ sambandho na syāt | kīlāyaḥ--śalākākalpānāṃ vākyānāṃ kiṃ kṛtaḥ saṃbandho bhavati ? abhidheyadvārakaḥ parasparaṃ saṃbandhaḥ syāt | abhidheyaṃ ca vākyānāṃ nāstītyasambandhāni vākyāni prāpnuvantīti yatkiñcidetat || 113 ||
tatra kriyāpadānyeva vyapekṣante parasparam |
kriyāpadānuṣaktastu sambandho'taḥ pratīyate || 114 ||
athānvitābhidhānasamāśrayaṇenaitatsamarthayitumāha--
kriyāpadamākṣiptasamastasādhanavrātaṃ nirākāḍ‌kṣaṃ saṃpadyate, kriyāpadānuṣaktaḥ parasparasambandho nirākāḍ‌kṣastasmādupapanna iti na kācit kṣatiḥ || 114 ||
āvṛttiranuvādo vā padārthavyaktikalpane |
pratyekaṃ tu samāpto'rthaḥ sahabhūteṣu vartate || 115 ||
