nanu cānvitābhidānaṃ na yuktamiva pratibhāti | tathā hi--yadi prathamameva sakalaviśeṣayukto vākyārtho'vagataḥ syāt taduttarakālabhāvināṃ gavādīnāmabhidhāne na kiṃcitprayojanamutpaśyāmaḥ | avagatārthānāṃ hi padānāṃ punarvacane vaiyarthyamāpadyata ityāśaṅkya samarthayitumāha--
avagatārthānāmapyāvṛttirniyamāya bhaviṣyati | uktasya vārthasya sphuṭīkaraṇāyānuvādasteṣāmasāviti nāstyānarthakyam | ekamapi pūrvasya pūrvasya tirohitatvāt sahatvāsambhavānvayasyāsambhavādarthanavagama eva | ekasmādeva ca padātsamastaviśeṣānvitasya vākyārthasyāpratiteruttareṣāṃ cānavagatārthānāṃ niyamānuvādaparikalpanāyogādasamañjasa evānvitābhidhānapakṣaḥ | yadā punaḥ sahabhūteṣvevāsau pratyekaṃ samāpto'rtha ityucyate |
yathoktam---"vyaktopavyañjanā siddhirarthasya pratipattṛṣu" iti | tadā nāstyeva sahabhūtānāmupādāne vaiphalyamiti na kaściddoṣaḥ || 115 ||
avikalpe'pi vākyārthe vikalpā bhāvanāśrayāḥ |
atrādhikaraṇe vādāḥ pūrveṣāṃ bahudhā gatāḥ || 116 ||
tadevaṃ saṅghātādīnyuddiṣṭāni vākyalakṣaṇāni prāsaṅgikavicārasahitāni vyākhyātāni | ākhyātaṃ vākyamiti darśayiṣyate | vākyāvyākhyāprasaṅgena ca vākyārthā āpe saṃsargasaṃsṛṣṭinirākāṅ‌kṣapadārthaprayojanalakṣaṇāścatvāra upadarśitāḥ | pratibhāṃ kriyāṃ ca darśayiṣyati | nanvekasyaiva vākyārthasya kathaṃ vikalpaprapañca ityāśaṅ‌kya nirūpayitumāha---
vākyārtho'vikalpa eva nirvibhāga evābhyupagantuṃ yuktaḥ, tasmiṃśca tathābhūto'pi ye'mī vikalpāste puruṣāṇāmanekaśāstrabhāvanāsamāśrayā boddhavyāḥ | na vastvanupātina iti tadvākyārtha eka eva yuktaḥ |
etadeva pratipādayitumāha--atrādhikaraṇa iti | asminnadhikaraṇe vicārasthāne pūrveṣāmācāryāṇāṃ pravādā bahudhā gatāḥ śāstrasaṃskāravāsitacetasāṃ teṣāmiti kasya paryanuyogaḥ kriyate || 116 ||
abhyāsāt pratibhāhetuḥ śabdaḥ sarvo'paraiḥ smṛtaḥ |
bālānāṃ ca tiraścāṃ ca yathārthapratipādane || 117 ||
paramārthatastu vākyārtha eva eva, sarvo'pi śabdaḥ pratibhāyā eva heturiti tatsvarūpamidānīṃ prastāvayitumāha---
aparairācāryauḥ | sarvaḥ yaḥ kaścicchabdaḥ sa pratibhāhetuḥ | jaḍānāmapi pratibhāheturityāha--bālānāmityādi | āstāṃ viditasamayasya kiṃ na bhaviṣyatyasau pratibhāhetuḥ | ye'pyaviditasaṃketā amī bālā jaḍaprāyā vā tiryañcaḥ, teṣāmapyanādivāsanāvaśāttadarthaḥ pratīyamāno dṛśyate śabdaḥ | tathā ca jaḍānāmapi prāṇināṃ niyatapadaḥ śabdaḥ sambodhanāyodīryate | tena pratiniyatajātyanavusāreṇaiva niyataiva kācit pratibhā prabodhyata iti tanmūla eva sarvaḥ kaścitteṣāṃ vyavahāraḥ | anenaitaducyate--- yadiyaṃ pratibhā sarvaprāṇisaṃvedyā śabdanimittā sakalavyavahāramūlabhūtā'napahnavanīyā tadapahnave svātmaiva vipralabhyate | tatpratibhā'bhyupagamo'vasyāśrayaṇīyaḥ || 117 ||
anāgamaśca so'bhyāsaḥ samayaḥ kaiścidiṣyate |
abhyāsāt pratibhāheturityuktaṃ, tatrābhyāsaḥ kimidānīntana uta janmāntarabhāvī, tasya ca kiṃ svarūpamityāśaṅ‌kyāha---
anantaramidaṃ kāryamasmādityupadarśanam || 118 ||
sa cābhyāso'nāgama idānīntano na bhavati | nahi bālasya tadaivopadiṣṭaṃ kenaciditi janmāntarabhāvyeva sa ca samaya iṣyate | saṃketasvarūpo'sāviṣyata iti svarūpamevāsya sphuṭayitumāha--
sa cānantaramidaṃ kāryamityupadarśanasvabhāvaḥ | yathā kaśābhighātamātrasamanantarameva vājino'tiyānti, aṅkuśābhighātena ca gajāḥ, evamanye'pi yathāsvaṃ prāṇino'nādivāsanābhyāsavaśena pratibhātaḥ samucitavyavahāraṃ kurvanto lokayātrāṃ nirvāhayantīti sthitam | evamakhaṇḍameva vākyaṃ pratibhā ca vākyārtha iti samāśrayaṇīyam | padapadārthāpoddhāramāśritya pratinidhyādikalpanaṃ prāsaṅgikādinyāyanirvāhaśca bhaviṣyatīti vyasthāpitam || 118 ||
astyarthaḥ sarvaśabdanāmiti pratyāyyalakṣaṇam |
apūrvadevatāsvargaiḥ samamāhurgavādiṣu || 119 ||
atha padārthapravibhāgaścet samāśritastaducyatāṃ padasyārtha iti pravibhāgaprasaṅgāt padārthavivecanaṃ matabhedena kartumāha--
sarvaśabdānāmaparāmṛṣṭākāraviśeṣamarthamātraṃ vācyamiti kecidāhuḥ | etatsarvaśabdānāṃ pratyāyyalakṣaṇaṃ pratyāyyasya vācyasya lakṣaṇaṃ boddhavyam | kena tulyametat syādityāha--apūrvadevadetyādi | apūrvadevatādipadeṣu hi nākāraprathanam | yattu gavādipadeṣvākāraprathanaṃ tannāntarīyakatayā boddhavyam | anyathā'pūrvaśabdāddevatāśabdāt svargaśabdādaśvagavādiśabdavadākārādiprathanaṃ syāt | yataśca tebhyo nāstyākārādiprathanam, ato'rthamātrameva taiḥ pratyāyya iti yuktam || 119 ||
prayogadarśanābhyāsādākārāvagrahastu yaḥ |
na sa śabdasya viṣayaḥ sa hi yatnāntarāśrayaḥ || 120 ||
atha gāvādiśabdebhya ākāradiprathanaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ tataśca tadvaktuṃ śakyaṃ yadviśiṣṭapadārthapratyayo yukta itītyāśaṅ‌kyāha--
sāsnādimatsveva yadā gośabdaprayogaṃ paśyati taddarśanābhyāsācca tatrākāraparigraho yaḥ sa śabdasya pratyayo na bhavati | kasmādityāha--sa hītyādi | tasmāt prayogābhyāsena (prayogadarśanābhyāsena) yatnāntareṇa śabdāvagamyatiriktena sa prathate tataśca śabdavyāpāro'sau na bhavatīti śabdasyārthamātramevāparāmṛṣṭākāraviśeṣaṃ vācyaṃ yuktamityekaḥ pakṣaḥ || 120 ||
kecid bhedāḥ prakāśyante śabdaistadabhidhāyibhiḥ |
anuniṣpādinaḥ kāṃścicchabdārtha iti manvate || 121 ||
idānīṃ kaścicchabdavācyaḥ kaścittatrākāro'nuniṣpādīti pakṣāntaramāha--
kecidbhedā jātyādayaḥ śabdavācyāḥ, kecittatrārthaprayojakā anuniṣpādina eva | tathā tāṃśca śabdārtha ityapare manyante || 121 ||
jāteḥ pratyāyake śabde yā vyaktiranuṣaṅgiṇī |
na tad vyaktigatān bhedān jātiśabdo'valambate || 122 ||
etadeva pratyākhyātumāha--
jātiśabdā jātimātraṃ pratyāyayanti | vyaktistu tatrānuṣaṅgiṇī | niradhikaraṇāyā jāterasambhavāditi kṛtvā | tadvyaktigatānākāraviśeṣān jātipadārthapakṣe jātiśabdo nāvalambate || 122 ||
ghaṭādīnāṃ na cākārān pratyayati vācakaḥ |
vastumātraniveśitvāt tad‌gatirnāntarīyakī || 123 ||
etadeva vyaktīkartumāha--
ghaṭādīnāṃ prasiddhānāmākārān vacakaḥ śabdo ghaṭādirna pratyāyayati, pṛthubudhnodarākāramātraniveśitvāt | nahi sakalaviśeṣasahitamarthaṃ śabdaḥ pratyāyayitumalamiti tatrākāraviśeṣāvagatirnāntarīyakyevānuniṣpādi yeva boddhavya || 123 ||
kriyā vinā prayogeṇa na dṛṣṭā śabdacoditā |
prayogastvanuniṣpādī śabdartha iti gamyate || 124 ||
nāntarīyakatvameva pradarśayitumāha--
yadetetiśabdacoditā kriyā kartṛkarmasādhanasāmagrīṃvinā na dṛśyate | tataścāsau sādhanayogoyathā tatrānuniṣpādī tathā śabdārtho'vagantavya ityupasaṃhṛtam || 124 ||
niyatāstu prayogā ye niyataṃ yacca sādhanam |
teṣāṃ śabdabhidheyatvamaparairanugamyate || 125 ||
atha sarva evākārā guṇapradhānabhāvena padasyārtha iti tṛtīyaṃ pakṣaṃ darśayitumāha--
yena kenacidvinā śabdasyābhidheyaṃ na nirvahati tatsarvaṃ sādhyasādhanātmakaṃ śabdābhidheyaṃ vaktuṃ yuktam | kiñcit pratyāyyate, anyattatra nāntarīyakatayā'vagamyata ityapi na śobhanam, kintu sarvākāramevābhidheyaṃ guṇapradhānabhāvena tasmāt pratītamityayaṃ pakṣaḥ śobhanaḥ || 125 ||
samudāyo'bhidheyo vā'pyavikalpasamuccayaḥ |
samudāya eva tulyakakṣatayā śabdasyārtha iti caturthapakṣaṃ darśayitumāha--
nanu yadyākārasamudāyaṃ samuccitameva pratyāyayati, tahiṃ bahuvacanameva tatra syāt | atha vikalpitaṃ pratyāyayati tadā vacanavikalpaḥ syādityāśaṅ‌kyāha--avikalpasamuccaya iti| avidyamānau vikalpasamuccayau yasyāsau tathābhūtastasmāt pratīyata iti sambhāvyate | etaccopamāsamuddeśe'pyarthavicāraṇāvasare savistaraṃ pradarśayiṣyati |
asatyo vā'pi saṃsargaḥ śabdārthaḥ kaiścidiṣyate || 126 ||
atha jātiguṇakriyātmakasyārthasyāsatyabhūtaḥ saṃsarga eva śabdārtha iti pañcamaṃ pakṣaṃ darśayitumāha--
ghaṭādibhiḥ śabdairghaṭādīnāṃ jātyādisaṃsarga ucyate | sa cātra tad‌vyatirekeṇānupalambhādasatyabhūta evocyate | tasmāt saṃsṛṣṭaḥ padārtha eva satyabhūta iti||126||
asatyopādhi yatsatyaṃ tadvā śabdanibandhanam |
atha satyamevāsatyopādhivicitritaṃ śabdavācyamiti ṣaṣṭhaṃ pakṣamāha--
śabdo vāpyabhijalpatvamāgato yāti vācyatām || 127 ||
śabdasya vā svarūpamevābhidheyamiti saptamaṃ pakṣaṃ darśayitumāha--
abhajalpatvamadhyasarūpatvamāgataḥ śabda eva svarūpalakṣaṇaḥ śabdasya vācyaḥ||127||
so'yamityabhisambandhād rūpamekīkṛtaṃ yadā |
śabdasyārthena taṃ śabdamabhijalpaṃ pracakṣate || 128 ||
abhijalpasvarūpamāha--
so'yamityabhisambandho'dhyāsākhya ucyate | tena padārthasvarūpamācchaditamekīkṛtamiva pratyāyyate | tadā'bhijalpaḥ śabda ucyate | adhyāsavaśācchabdārthayorekātmatve'pyarthāṃ śasyaiva prādhānyamupayogavaśāt || 128 ||
tayorapṛthāgarthatve rūḍheravyabhicāriṇi |
kiñcideva kkacid rūpaṃ prādhānyenāvatiṣṭhate || 129 ||
kkacittu viṣayabhedena dvayorapi dṛśyata iti prasaṅgādabhidhāmāha--
tayoḥ śabdārthayoradhyāsavaśād rūḍherniyamādevāvyabhicāriṇyapṛthagarthatve ekarūpatve sati kiñcidevarūpaṃ yogavaśāt kkacideva loke śāstre vā prādhānyenodriktayā'vitiṣṭhate || 129 ||
loke'rtharūpatāṃ śabdaḥ pratipannaḥ pravartate |
tatra loke'rthaṃśasyaiva prādhānyamityapi darśayitumāha--
artharūpatāṃ pratipanno'rthena sahaikatvamiva prāptaḥ śabdaḥ pravartate | ayaṃ gaurityādi | tatrārtha eva bāhyatayā pradhānamavasīyate |
śāstre tūbhayarūpatvaṃ pravibhaktaṃ vivakṣayā || 130 ||
śāstre tu śabdasyobhayarūpatāpi vibhāgena paridṛśyat ityāha--
śāstre hi svarūpapradhāno nirdeśaḥ kvacit kvaciccārthapradhāno'pītyubhayarūpatā śabdasya dṛśyate || 130 ||
aśakteḥ sarvaśaktervā śabdaireva prakalpitā |
ekasyārthasya niyatā kriyādiparikalpanā || 131 ||
idānīmathaṣu na śaktiḥ pṛthagasti kintu śabdādhīneti | yathā te śabdairvidhīyante tathaivāvagamyanta iti svamāhātmyopasthāpita eva śabdārtha ityaṣṭama pakṣaṃ darśayitumāha-
athavā sarvaśaktirartho vyavasthitaḥ | tasya pratiniyataśaktyabhidhānaṃ śabdenetinavamaṃ pakṣaṃ darśayitumatraivoktam--sarvaśakterveti | śaktyārthaḥ kadācit kriyārūpatayābhidhīyate, kadācit siddharūpatayeti niyatā kriyādirūpatā śabdārthatayā pratipādyate || 131 ||
yo vārtho buddhiviṣayo bāhyavastunibandhanaḥ |
sa bāhyavastviti jñātaḥ śabdārthaḥ kaiścidiṣyate || 132 ||
athavā buddhyupārūḍha eva śabdasyārtho na bāhya iti daśamaṃ pakṣamupadarśayitumāha--
śabdasya buddhyapārūḍhasya vaikalpikasya yo buddhyupārūḍho bāhyavastunibandhanaḥ, bāhyaṃ vastu vikalpajananadvāreṇa nibandhanaṃ yasya sa tatābhūtaḥ | sa ca vaikalpiko'rtho bhramavaśād dṛśyavikalpaikākāreṇābahīrūpo'pi bahīrūpatayā'dhyasto'dhyastameva vastvavagacchāmi śabdādeti śabdanimittamiti (nimitta iti) śabdārtha iṣyate || 132 ||
ākāravantaḥ saṃvedyā vyaktasmṛtinibandhanāḥ |
ye te pratyavabhāsanta saṃvinmātraṃ tvato'nyathā || 133 ||
idānīṃ gāvadīnāṃ śabdānāmākāraviśeṣavānartho'pūrvaprabhṛtīnāṃ saṃvinmātramaparāmṛṣṭākāraviśeṣamartha ityekādaśaṃ pakṣamāha--
kaiścicchabdaiḥ saṃvedyāḥ pratyāyyā ākāraviśeṣavanto vyaktasmṛtinibandhanāḥ pratyavabhāsante | kaiścinnirākārāḥ saṃvidrūpāḥ pratyāyyante | teṣāṃ tathaivārtho vyavasthāpyate || 133 ||
yathendriyaṃ sannipatadvaiṃcitryeṇopadarśakam |
tathaiva śabdādarthasya pratipattiranekadhā || 134 ||
idānīṃ pratiniyatavāsanāvaśenaiva pratiniyatākāro'rthastattvatastu kaścidapi niyato nābhidhīyat iti dvādaśaṃ pakṣamāha--
aviparītamapyarthamindriyaṃ doṣavaśānnānārūpamavabhāsayati yathā, niyatavāsanāvāsisāṃ śabdārthapratītiriti nāsti kaścinnayata ekaḥ śabdasyārthaḥ || 134 ||
vaktrānyathaiva prakrānto bhinneṣu pratipattṛṣu |
svapratyayānusāreṇa śabdārthaḥ pravibhajyate || 135 ||
etadeva vyākhyātumāha--
tathāhi--sāṃkhyajainasaugataprabhṛtayaḥ pratipatranusāreṇānyathaiva śabdārthaṃ pratipadyante , vaktrā tu vaiseṣikādinā svapratyayānusāreṇa vaktuṃ prakāntaḥ | tathā ca vaiśeṣi keṇāvayavinaṃ pratipādayituṃ ghaṭaśabdaḥ prayuktaḥ, sāṃkhyairguṇasamāhāramātramabhimanyate, jainasaugataiḥ paramāṇusaṃcayamātramiti tathaiva tasamātteṣāmarthapratipattiḥ ||135||
ekasminnapi dṛśye'rthe darśanaṃ bhidyate pṛthak |
kālāntareṇa caiko'pi taṃ paśyatyanyathā punaḥ || 136 ||
etadeva vyaraktayitumāha--
vastuta ekasminnekarūpe dṛśye'rthe śāstravāsanābhedāddarśanaṃ jñānamasmin bhidyate | eko'pi ca puruṣaḥ sugatadarśanasaṃskṛtamatiranyathādhyavasyatyarthaṃ kālantareṇa vaiśeṣikakaśāstraśravaṇādanyatheti || 136 ||
ekasyāpi ca śabdasya nimittaikhyavasthitaiḥ |
ekena bahubhiścārtho bahudhā parikalpyate || 137 ||
ataḥ kimityāha--
ekasya ghaṭaśabdasya nimittaiḥ śāstrasaṃskāraikyavasthitairekena puruṣeṇāniyataśāstravāsanāvaśāt krameṇa buhadhārthaḥ prakalpyate, bahubhiśca nānāśāstrasaṃskṛtabuddhibhiryugapata svapratyayānusāreṇa bahudhāpi parikalpyata iti kimatra kurmaḥ || 137 ||
tasmādadṛṣṭatacvānāṃ sāparādhaṃ bahucchalam |
darśanaṃ vacanaṃ cāpi nityamevānavasthitam || 138 ||
ataḥ kimityāha--
yata evaṃ tasmādadṛṣṭatattvānāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ darśanamanavasthitam | adṛṣṭatattvayā ca sāparādhamata eva bahucchalaṃ bahuvidhabādhakāghrātaṃ tathā sati vacanamapi teṣāṃ tathaiveti tattvakathanaṃ sudūramavasthitam || 138 ||
ṛṣīṇāṃ darśanaṃ yacca tacve kiñcidavasthitam |
na tena vyavahāro'sti na tacchabdanibandhanam || 139 ||
nanu santyeva parāvarajñā munayastadanusāreṇa sarvaṃ vyavasthāpayiṣyāma iti tadarthamāha--
paramarṣoṇāṃ bhagavatāṃ darśanaṃ tāttvikaṃ bhavati, kintu paramārthena vyavahārāsambhavaḥ, vyavahārasādhanānāṃ nibandhanaṃ na bhavatīti na tena vyavasthā | vyavahāravelāyāṃ va te'pyadṛṣṭatattvasadṛśā iti punaravyavasthaiva | yaducyate--"rūpaṇavyapadeśābhyāṃ laukike vartmani sthitau | jñāne pratyabhilāpe ca sadṛśau bālapāṇḍatau"|| 139 ||
talabad dṛśyate vyoma khadyoto havyavāḍiva |
naiva cāsti talaṃ vyonmi na khadyoto hutāśanaḥ || 140 ||
nanu puruṣabuddhayo vicitrā bhavantu, pratyakṣeṇa khalu vayaṃ yathārtho dṛṣṭastathaiva vyavahariṣyāma ityāśaṅkya pratyakṣasyāvyavasthitimāha--
atinirmalaṃ gaganatalamityaviplutadṛśāmapyuktirdṛśyate, tadatra kiṃ kurmaḥ || 140 ||
tasmāt pratyakṣamapyarthaṃ vidvānīkṣeta yuktitaḥ |
na darśanasya prāmāṇyāt dṛśyamarthaṃ prakalpayet || 141 ||
yatpunarupapattyā niścīyate tad dṛṣṭa mityeva tathaivopagamyatetyupasaṃharannāha
asamākhyeyatattvānāmarthānāṃ laukikairyathā |
vyavahāre samākhyānaṃ tatprājño na vikalpayet || 142 ||
yasya yathaiva svadarśanānusāreṇa pratibhāti tathaiva tasya sa śabdārtha ityevāśrayaṇīyamityalaṃ nirvastubahuvikalpapradarśanenetyāha--
tasmādvyavahāravelāyāmasamākhyeyatattvānāmarthānāṃ yathā laukikairanvākhyānaṃkriyate tathaiva tadanusāreṇa śabdārthamāśritya vyavahāraṃ nirvāhayenna piṣṭapeṣaṇamācaraṇīyamiti| evaṃ matabhedena pradarśitasya dvādaśadhā padārthasya padakāṇḍe jātyādiprapañcaiḥ pravibhajya svarūpaṃ nirṇeṣyati | etadatra (eṣo'tra) vaiyākaraṇasyākhaṇḍe eva sphoṭalakṣaṇo vākyārtho'dhyāsaḥ sambandhaḥ padārthastvasatya eveti nirṇayaḥ || 142 ||
vicchedagrahaṇe'rthānāṃ pratibhā'nyaiva jāyate |
vākyārtha iti tāmāhuḥ padārthairupapāditām || 143 ||
atha pratibhāsvarūpameva pūrvopakrāntamanubadhnannāha--
devadattādipadebhyo vicchinnebhyastadarthānāṃ vicchedenaiva grahaṇe pratyayavelāyāmekā pratibhā padārthamativyatiriktaiva jāyate tāṃ ca vākyārthaṃ vaiyākaraṇā āhuḥ | kastasyā upāya ityāha--"padārthairupapāditām" iti | padārthairasatyairevopādhibhūtairupapāditāmabhivyaktāmiti || 143 ||
idaṃ taditi sānyeṣāmanākhyeyā kathañcana |
pratyātmavṛttisiddhā sā kartrāpina nirūpyate || 144 ||
kīdṛśīṃ tāmityāha--
sā copajāyamānā ākhyātumanyasya na śakyate, kevalaṃ svasaṃvedanasiddhaivāsau, pratipattrāpi svasaṃvedanasamaye niyatena rūpeṇa nirūpayitumaśakyaiva sā || 144 ||
upaśleṣamivārthānāṃ sā karotyavicāritā |
sārvarūpyamivānnā viṣayatvena vartate || 145 ||
kiṃ svabhāvā'sāvityāha--
asaṃsṛṣṭānāṃ padarthānāmasāvupaśleṣaṃ melanaṃ karoti, sarvarūpeva vākye padārthānāṃ vāsau viṣayatvena vartate, tanniṣṭhāste sāphalyaṃ bhajanta iti ||145||
sākṣācchabdena janitāṃ bhāvanānugamena vā |
itikartavyatāyāṃ tāṃ na kaścidativartate || 146 ||
tāṃ ca na kiñcitprāṇimātramativartate, atikramya tiṣṭhatītyāha--
sā sākṣācchabdena kadācidvyavahārakāle janyate janmāntarabhāvanāvaśena vā gajavājiprabhṛtīnāmiti tanmūla evetikartavyatārūpaḥ sarvasya vyavahāraḥ || 146 ||
pramāṇātvena tāṃ lokaḥ sarvaḥ samanupaśyati |
samārambhāḥ pratāyante tiraścāmapi tadvaśāt || 147 ||
etadeva sphuṭayati--
sarvaḥ kaścittāmeva bhagavatīṃ svapratibhāṃ pramāṇatvena paśyati | tathā cocyate--`satāṃ hi sandehapadeṣu vastuṣu pramāṇamantaḥ karaṇapravṛttayaḥ' iti | tiraścāṃ ca jātamātrāṇāṃ tanmūla eva vyavahāra iti na tadapahnavena ātmā vañcanīyaḥ || 147 ||
yathā dravyaviśeṣāṇāṃ paripākairayatnajāḥ |
madādiśaktayo dṛṣṭāḥ pratibhāstadvatāṃ tathā || 148 ||
siddhaiva ceyaṃ sarvasya pratibhetyupapādayitumāha--
yathā dravyaviśeṣāṇāṃ paripākavyatiriktayatnāntaranirapekṣā madādiśaktayo dṛśyante, tathaiveyaṃ pratiniyatasaṃskārajanyā pratibhāvatāṃ sphuṭamupalabhyata eva || 148 ||
svaravṛttiṃ vikurute madhau puṃskokilasya kaḥ |
jantvādayaḥ kulāyādikaraṇe kena śikṣitāḥ || 149 ||
janmāntarābhyāsahetukeyamiti sanidarśanamupapādayitumāha--
pañcamasvaravirāvī madhumāse puṃskokila ityayantajametatsiddham, lūtājantūnāṃ kulāyaracanā ca pratibhāmāhātmyādeva dṛśyate || 149 ||
āhāraprītyapadveṣalpavanādikriyāsu kaḥ |
jātyānvayaprasiddhāsu prayoktā mṛgapakṣiṇām || 150 ||
evadeva sphuṭayitumāha--
pratipraṇyāhārādikriyā niyatā'nādipratibhāvaśādeveti prasiddham || 150 ||
bhāvanānugatādetadāgamādeva jāyate |
āsattiviprakarṣābhyāmāgamastu viśiṣyate || 151 ||
pratibhāyāśca śabda eva mūlamityāha--
sa cāgamaḥ kadācidāsanno'sminneva janmanyavagataḥ kadācijjanmāntara ityāsattiviprakarṣābhyāṃ śabda eva pratibhāhetuḥ || 151 ||
svābhāvacaraṇābhyāsayogādṛṣṭopapāditām |
viśiṣṭopahitāṃ ceti pratibhāṃ ṣaḍ‌vidhāṃ viduḥ || 152 ||
kecidācāryyā manyante--kācit svābhāvikī pratibhā | tadyathā--parasyāḥ (prakṛteḥ pra) thamaṃ sattālakṣaṇamātmānaṃ mahāntaṃ pratyānugaṇyaṃ suṣuptāvasthāsyeva prabodhānuguṇyaṃ phalasattāmātraṃ nidrāyāḥ | caraṇanimittā kācit pratibhā | tadyathā--kā (ca) raṇenaivāvadhṛtaprakāśaviśeṣāṇāṃ (vasiṣṭhādīnām) ; abhyāsanimittā kācit | tadyathā -- kūpataṭākādīnām (kādikhanakānām) | yoganimittā kācit | tadyathā--yogināmavyabhicāreṇa parābhiprāyajñānādiṣu | tathā kācidadṛṣṭanimittā | tadyathā rakṣaḥ piśācādīnāṃ parāveśāntardhānādiṣu | kācidviśiṣṭairupahitā | tadyathā--sañjayādīnāṃ kṛṣṇadvaipāyanādibhiḥ |
evaṃ pratibhā bahuvidhā'pi sarvaivāgamikavākyanibandhanā vākyapratipādyā vyākaraṇātyaye'pi sarvaśaktipratyastamaye pratyastamitaniviṣṭaśabdaśaktibījakāraṇā'ntarbhūtā nibaddhabījā vṛttikāle prathamaṃ sūkṣmeṇāpi vartmanā vivartamātrāmanubhūya krameṇa varṇavākyaniyatābhiravyavasthābhiḥ saṃmūrcchatī prāptabījaparipākākārāpunaḥ punarvyaktena rūpeṇa pratyavabhāsate || 152 ||
tasyāśca nimittabhedena ṣāḍ‌vidhyaṃ darśayitumāha--
svabhāveti | svabhāvena yathā kapiḥ | caraṇādiṣūdāharaṇānyūhyāni | evamakhaṇḍe'pi vākye'bhyupagate padapadārthapravibhāgamanteraṇa vyavahāro na nirvahatīti padārthaḥ sāmanyena matabhedapradarśanapūrvakaṃ nirṇotaḥ || 152 ||
yathā saṃyogibhirdravyairlakṣite'rthe prayujyate |
gośabdo na tvasau teṣāṃ viśeṣāṇāṃ prakāśakaḥ || 153 ||
ākāravarṇāvayavaiḥ saṃsṛṣṭeṣu gavādiṣu |
śabdaḥ pravartamāno'pi na tānaṅgīkarotyasau || 154 ||
dravyapadarthikasya jātipadārthikasya vā śabdapravṛttikāle śabdārthavilakṣaṇabhūto'rthaḥ prathamamapi pratīyamānena śabdenopagṛhyata ityeṣa pakṣaḥ | tadyathā--gavādīnāṃ niyatasvāmiviśeṣāṇāṃ payodānādisaṃyogyupalakṣaṇāni paricchedārthamapyupādīyamānāni nābhidheyatvena śrutibhiḥ prakāśyante | tathaikādiprakāśādibhi (tathākārādibhiḥ) (?) rupalakṣaṇairniya (saṃ) sṛṣṭeṣvākārādyaḥ pratipattihetutvena ā... ma.. pi (ādyāyā madhyayā vāpi) buddhyā parigṛhyamāṇāḥ śabdābhidheyatvaṃ na pratipadyante || 153 - 154 ||
idānīṃ mukhyanāntarīyakavibhāgena padārthavicāropakramamāha--yatheti | iha śabdasya sāmānyaṃ vājapyāyanamatenārthaḥ, vyaktirvā vyāḍimatenārthaḥ | tatreha sāmānyamātraṃ vā vyaktimātraṃ vā tasya prayojakarthatvenāvabudhyate, viśeṣāstu nāntarīyakatayātato'vagamyante tataḥ śabdasyādṛṣṭavyabhicāraṃ sāmānyamtramevārthaḥ | yathā saṃyogino dravyaviśeṣāḥ sūkṣmā maṇyādaya upalakṣaṇāmātrabhāvena gavādīnāmarthānāṃ sthitā na gavādiśabdavācyā bhavanti tathāntaraṅgā apyākāravarṇasaṃsthānādaya iti na teṣāmasau prakāśaka ucyate || 153 | etadeva sphūṭīkartumāha--ākāreti | ākārādayo vyabhicāritvācchabdavācyā na bhavantītyarthaḥ || 154 ||
saṃsthānavarṇāvaivarviśiṣṭe yaḥ prayujyate |
śabdo na tasyāvayave pravṛttirupalabhyate || 155 ||
saṃsthānaviśiṣṭopakramaḥ parimaṇḍalo dīrghaścaturastra iti tadavayavo nābhidhīyate | tathā muṣṭigranthisandhi......(saktakuṇlaikādayaḥ śabdāstadavayaveṣu na prayujyante | varṇaśabdānāṃ citraḥ kalmāṣaḥ sāraṅga iti tadavayaveṣvapravṛttiḥ | avayavaśabdena śataṃ sahastraṃ prastho droṇo māsaḥ saṃvatsara ityādayo gṛhyante | avayave gṛhyamāṇe jātirabhiṣaktā'tastāvati viṣaye jātiprayuktaḥ śabdaḥ pravartata iti | kvacideva hi dṛṣṭe kadāciddantaśṛṅge khurādāvapyayaṃ gauriti prayujyata eva | tathā vṛko vā grāmyasūkara iti | yataḥ kaścidavayavo'nena lakṣyata iti tadetannyāyāpetaṃ darśanamityapare manyante | katham ? yadi jātimātravācī śabdaḥ sa jātibhāvameva pratyāyati, kiṃ tatropavyañjanaiḥ || 155 ||
nanvākāravācarakānāṃ sthūlahrasvakarburaśabalādīnāṃ śabdānāṃ kimākārādivacakatvaṃ nāṅgīkāryamevetyāśaṅkyāha--saṃsthāneti | svaśabdairākārādaya ucyanta eveti na sarvatra vayaṃ tadapratītiṃ brūmaḥ, yaddhi prayojakaṃ śabdasya tadeva tasya vācyam , anyannāntarīyakamiti brūmaḥ | ata ākārādivācakānāṃ nāvayavamātre ekadeśamātre pravṛttiraṅgīkāryā, ataḥ śabdairarthasya kkacidviśeṣa ucyate, kkacitsāmānyamātram || 155 ||
saṃkhyāpramāṇasaṃsthānanirapekṣaḥ pravartate |
bindau ca samudāye ca vācakaḥ salilādiṣu || 156 ||
yatrākṛtinirapekṣaṃ sāmānyasya rūpāvadhāraṇaṃ tatra yāvadeva bhavati tāvadevābhidhīyate śabdena | tathā coktam--kevalaṃ ghṛtamiti bindāvapi bhavati khāryāmapīti || 156 ||
tataśca śabdo'parāmṛṣṭaviśeṣe vastumātra eva pravartata ityāha--saṃkhyeti | ekāpi jalakaṇikā''po bahulamapi saritstrotastathaivocyate , ekāpi śilā śuklā himavānapi śukla iti śabdāḥ prayojakamātrameva jātyādikaṃ svārthokṛtya pravartante, ākārādiviśeṣāvabhāsastu nāntarīyaka iti sthitam || 156 ||
saṃskārādiparicchinne tailādau yo vyavasthitaḥ |
āhaikadeśaṃ tattvena tasyāvayavavartitā || 157 ||
iha saṃskārapakṣa upaghātapakṣo vā yadā kasmiṃścinnirjñāte'rthaṃ śabdapravṛttau vyavasthitaḥ, tadāvayavopayogāpekṣāyāmidamupanyastam | yattatkākenopahataṃ tadanena bhuktam | yadvā yādaturārthaṃ saṃskṛta taddevadattena pītamiti sāmānādhikaraṇyamuddeśapratinirdeśayoriti || 157 ||
nanu samudāyeṣu hi vṛttāḥ śabdā avayaveṣvapi vartante;yathā tailaṃ bhuktaṃ;ghṛtaṃ bhuktaṃ, śuklo nīlaḥ kapiśa ityuktaṃ tadetatkatham | uktaṃ ca--
na jātiguṇaśabdeṣu mūrtibhedo vivakṣitaḥ |
te jātiguṇasaṃbandhabhedamātranibandhanāḥ ||
tathā--
"nekṣitā jātiśabdānāṃ samudāyānupātitā |
jātimcakṣate te hi vyaktīrvā jātisaṃgatāḥ || " iti | iha ca --
"saṃkhyāpramāṇasaṃsthānanirapekṣaḥ pravartate |
bindau ca samudāye ca vācakaḥ salilādiṣu ||" iti |
tadetadāśaṅ‌kyāha--saṃskārādīti | saṃskāropaghātādiparicchinne tailādau tailaghṛtādiḥ śabdo vyavathito'sāvekadeśaṃ samudāyādhyāropeṇāha |
etaduktaṃ bhavati--na te jātiśabdāḥ , api tu tatsadṛśā eva te niyataparimāṇābhidhāyinastadadhyāropeṇa tadekadeśavācina ucyanta iti |
atasteṣāmavayavavartitā bhāṣya ukteti na kaścid doṣaḥ | uktaṃ ca--
"saṃskārādupaghātādvā vṛtto'ktaparimāṇake |
tailādau jātiśabdo'tra samatvādavagamyate || "iti || 157 ||
yenārthenābhisaṃbaddhamabhidhānaṃ prayujyate |
tadarthāpagame tasya prayogo vinivartate || 158 ||
prayujyate śabda ityanye, tat prayojanasyābhidheyasya niyataṃ lakṣaṇamācakṣate || 158 ||
etadarthaṃ paramārthata idaṃ boddhavyamityāha--yenārtheneti | yenārthena jātyādinā prayojakena || 158 ||
yāṃstu saṃbhavino dharmānantarnoya prayujyate |
śabdasteṣāṃ na sānnidhyaṃ niyamena vyapekṣate || 159 ||
ye śabdasyāprayojakāḥ prayojakasahakāriṇaḥ sambandhinaḥ śabdapravṛttikāle padārthaikadeśabhūtā ivopalabhyante, teṣāṃ sānnidhyamasānnidhyaṃ vā śabdapravṛttāvakāraṇam ||159||
vakturicchayā dharmāntarbhāvanena tu prayujyamāno'pi śabdo na teṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ niyamena pratyāyanaṃ karotītyāha--yāṃsviti || 159 ||
yathā romaśaphādīnāṃ vyabhicāre'pi dṛśyate |
gośabdo na tathā jāterviprayoge pravartate || 160 ||
śṛṅgaromasaphādīnāṃ (nāma) prayojakānāmasānnidhye'pi gośabdasya mukhyā pravṛttiḥ | gotvena pratyaye tu jātiviśiṣṭe jātyāśraye dravye vartate | tatrāvayavipravartanāyāmavayaveṣu `abhakṣyo grāmasūkaraḥ' ityatra bhakṣayatikriyā tathābhūtameva sādhanabhūtaṃ dravyāvayavamapekṣate | dṛṣṭā ca vikāre ca prakṛtau ca prakṛtiśabdapravṛttiḥ | avayave ca samudāye ca samudāyaśabdapravṛttidarśanam || 160 ||
etadevānvayavyatirekābhyāṃ sphuṭīkurvannāha--yathā rometi || 160 ||
durlabhaṃ kamyacilloke sarvāvayavadarśanam |
kaiścittvavayavairdṛṣṭairarthaḥ kṛtsno'numīyate || 161 ||
nahi paripūrṇāvayavaṃ kaścit kalāpaṃ prākṛtadarśano hyavi (kalaṃ) pratipadyate | tatra keṣāñcidavayavānāṃ grahaṇe vyakti (kti) jātīyo'vayavī nirdhāryate | tadyathā--gavādīnāṃ pūrvārdhasyāparārdhasya vā darśane | kvacittu sandeho naiva nivartate | tadyathā--dadhimātradarśane | paṭaprāvaraṇādidarśane tvavayavā dṛśyamānā niyatā niyatānumānahetavo bhavanti | tatrāpi kecijjātyantaranivṛttyarthāyāṃ śrutau śrutipakṣasya manyante, keciddesāntarbhūtebhyastebhyo'vayayebhyo'numānāt svaviṣaye śabdāḥ pravartanta ityācakṣate || 161 ||
evaṃ ca na śabdasyaivaṃrūpaṃ (vācyaṃ) pratyakṣamapyarthasākṣātkāropanāyakamevamevārthatvarūpaparicchedakaṃ dṛṣṭamityāha--durlabhamiti | yugapatsarvāvayavadarśanasyāsaṃbhavāt katipayāvayavadarśanena sakalārthaparicchetastānumānika eveti pratyakṣamapi naiva sakalamarthasvarūpaṃ paricchinatti || 161 ||
tathā jātyutpalādīnāṃ gandhena sahacāriṇām |
nityasaṃbandhināṃ dṛṣṭaṃ guṇānāmavadhāraṇam || 162 ||
gandhotpalabuddhyanumito (jātigandhotpalagandhabuddhyanumitito) hi jātyutpalādiṣu yaḥ śabdaḥ prayujyate, na sa gandhamātramāśritya gandhasamavāyaṃ vā dravyamātraṃ pratyayati, sahacārīṇi guṇāntarāṇyapi tatrānumīyante | na ca tadvācinaḥ śabdā dṛṣṭe sahacāriṇyanumānena hetau pravartanta ityabhyupagamyante | keṣāñcit samudāyavāci (di) nāmutpalādiśabdavācyatvamiti saṃkhyāpramāṇasaṃsthānajanakatvena vinā gāvadiṣu gośabdasya viṣāṇādisannidhiprayuktābhimukhya pravṛttirdṛśyate || 162 ||
tathaiva śabdādekadeśāvasāyena nityasahacāridharmāntarāvagamo jāyata ityāha--tatheti | jātigandha utpalagandha iti śabdādviśiṣṭasya gandhamātrasyāvagatiḥ, tatsahacārirūpasparśādyavadhāraṇaṃ tatra nāntarīyakaṃ na mukhyamiti boddhavyam || 162 ||
tasmāt saṃbhavino'rthasya śabdāt saṃpratyaye sati |
adṛṣṭaviprayogo'rthaḥ sambandhitvena gamyate || 163 ||
tasmāt saṃpratīyamāno'pi sahacāriṇaḥ (cārī) saṃbhavinaḥ (vī na) śabdārtha iti vijñāyate | nahi tathābhūtenārthatmanā śabdasya sambandho'pi yujyata || 163 ||
upasaṃhartumidānīmāha--tasmāditi naiyatyenādṛṣṭaviprayogo jātyādireva śabdasya sambandhitvena vācyatvena gamyata iti boddhavyam || 163 ||
vācikā dyotikā vā syurdvitvādīnāṃ vibhaktayaḥ |
syādvā saṃkhyāvato'rthasya samudāyo'bhidhāyakaḥ || 164 ||
vinā saṃkhyābhidhānādvā saṃkhyābhedasamanvitān |
arthān svarūpabhedena kāṃścidāhurgavādayaḥ || 165 ||
yathaiva vākyāt padārthapravibhāgeṇa vyavahāraḥ kriyate, tathā padādapi prakṛtipratyayāpoddhāreṇa śāstre bhūyān vyavahāro dṛśyate |
tatra kecittāvanmanyante--satyevānvayavyatireke yāvānevānvayavyatirekābhyāmarthaḥ samadhigamyate tāvānevāsti, na tu kaścidanyaḥ samudāyārthaḥ | sa tu samudāyārthaḥ padasya vākyavadaśabda iti |
nyāyavidastu manyante--svabuddhiparikalpitasamarthāpitā eva śiṣṭairbahudhā prakṛtipratyayādayaḥ | teṣāṃ cārthāḥ śāstra evamācāryārthe nimittabhūtā anvayavyatirekābhyāṃ vyāvahārikābhyāṃ kṛtapravibhāgā evāśrīyante | kathaṃ buddhyorarthapratipādanopāyamātrametat | sarvathā ca pratipattau laukikasyārthasya bhedo nāsti |
tathā hi keṣāñcit svārthadravyaliṅgasaṃkhyākarmādayaḥ prātipadikenābhidhīyante, dyotikāstu karmādīnāṃ vibhaktayaḥ |
keṣāñcit svārthadravyaliṅgamātrābhidhāyinī prakṛtiḥ, vācikāḥ saṃkhyākarmādīnāṃ vibhaktayaḥ | prātipadikārthe vikalpena saṃkhyākarmādīnāṃ yathāsaṃbhavamabhidhānaṃ vijñāyate |
liṅgamapi keṣāñcid dyotyaṃ keṣāñcidabhidheyam | dyotanamapi dvividham--anāvirbhūtāvirbhāvanam, avyudāsaprasaṅge vā prakārāntaravyudāsena kasyacidavadhāraṇam | tadyathā--pratiṣṭhate utpucchayate'bhimanāyata iti | tadapi prasiddhāprasiddhāviyutaprayogāṇām | upāste, prapacati, adhīte, adhyetīti yathā | sahābhidhānaṃ vā | yāvako gopāyitā brāhmaṇādhīnaṃ jugupsata iti || 164 ||
athavā saṃkhyāvato'rthasyāvibhaktod‌deśaḥ samudāyaḥ saṃsṛṣṭānekaśaktirabhidhāyakaḥ | vinā saṃkhyābhidānena śabdapravṛttikāle taistairabhidhīyamānaiḥ saṃkhyāviśeṣaiḥ kākakaṇṭhe guṇakambalādivanīyaiḥ (vadanityaiḥ) paricchinnāstadvanto'rthāḥ svarūpabhedayuktaiḥ samudāyairabhidhīyante || 165 ||
evaṃ nāmapadasyārthavicāraṃ kṛtvedānīṃ tasyaiva bhāgārthavicāraṃ prastauti | tatra pratyayabhāgasyārthavicāraṃ tāvadāha--vāciketi | tena pratyayabhāgasya saṃkhyākarmādayo vācyatvena dyotyatvena vārthā iti jñeyam | idānīṃ prakṛtibhāgasyārthamabhidhātuṃ (prakṛtibhāgasya pratyayabhāgasya cānarthakyamabhidhātuṃ) prakṛtipratyayasamudāya eva saṃkhyādiviśiṣṭasyārthasyābhidhāyaka ityāha--syādveti | athavā saṃkhyādyupalakṣitamevārthaṃ prakṛtipratyayasamudāyo'bhidhatta ityabhidhātumāha--vineti | svarūpabhedena dvitvādibhedenetyarthaḥ || 164 - 165 ||
ye śabdā nityasambandhā viveke jñātaśaktayaḥ |
anvayavyatirekābhyāṃ teṣāmartho vibhajyate || 166 ||
bhinneṣu kūpayūpādivatsamudāyeṣu yathāyathaṃ śabdeṣu nityasambandheṣu parikalpitānāmavayavānāṃ sambandhibhiravyabhicaritasambandhānāṃ buddhyā kṛtāpoddhārapravivekāṇāṃ rūpabhedapratyayaparakalpapratyayaviṣayāṇāmaupacārikābhyāṃ pratipādanārthamanvayavyatirekābhyāmabhidhāyakatvena dyotakatvena vā vyabhicāra (rī) pravibhāgaḥ kriyate || 166 ||
nanu yadā śabdā nityasambandhā vivekena jñātaśaktayaḥ svārthasya pratītau tadā kathametadavagatamayaṃ prakṛtyartho'yaṃ pratyayārtha ityāśaṅkyāpoddhārasyānvayavyatirekau nimittamiti pratipādayitumāha--ya iti |
viveke sati śabdārthavibhāge kṛte sati ca pratipadike pratyaye cāsatyekatvādivirahitaṃ vṛkṣatvamātramavagamyata ityevamanvayavyatirekābhyāṃ prakṛtipratyayārthapravibhāgo vyavasthāpyate || 166 ||
yatra cāvyabhicāreṇa tayoḥ śakyaṃ prakalpanam |
niyamastatra na tvevaṃ niyamo nuṭ‌śabādiṣu || 167 ||
anvayayavyatirekāvartharūpaviṣayāvanugamyamānāvavyabhicāreṇa yāvadanugantuṃ śakyete tāvadanugamyete | kūpayūpasūpeṣu tu yūpasamanvaye'pyarthāsamanvayānnānumanyete | `ta-thās'śabdādīnāma(nva) rthasaṃjñāpratipādite'pi pratyayatve liṅādiṣvadarśanādanvayavyatirekābhyāmartho na prakalpyate | tatrāpi kaiścidekatvādinibandhanatvameva tiṅāmabhyupagamyate | tathā kaiścit syati syataḥ syanti ityekameva pratyayarūpamanvākhyānena pratipāditam | bhāṣye'pi bhūśabdaḥ prakṛtiḥ, atiśabdastu pratyaya ityuktam | adhunādīnāṃ cāpe..(cāpakṣīṇarūpāṇāṃ) ṇa rūpāṇāṃ va kaścidarthaḥ prakalpitaḥ | kevalaṃ tvarthavato hyāgamastad‌guṇībhūtastad‌grahaṇena gṛhyata ityuktam || 167 ||
tatrāpi śakyatvāśakyatvābhyāmanvayavyatirekāvāśritya tatpratipādanaṃ kartavyamityāha--yatra ceti |
yatrānvayavyatirekāvupalabhyete tatraiva niyamaḥ, na tvaśakye viṣaya ityāha--niyama iti | bhavatāmattītyādāvasati śabnuḍādāvarthadarśanād vṛkṣāṇāṃ pacatītyādau tasya sāhāyyamātraṃ sthāpitaṃ na pṛthagarthateti | uktaṃ ca--"bhāvakarmakartāraḥ sārvadhātukārthā iti cedekadvibahuṣu niyamānupapattiratadarthatvāt, vikaraṇārthā iti cet, kṛtābhihiteṣu vikaraṇābhāvaḥ" iti || 167 ||
sambhave vābhidhānasya lakṣaṇaṃ tu na kalpyate |
āpekṣikyo hi saṃsarge niyatāḥ śabdaśaktayaḥ || 168 ||
abhidhānasaṃbhave sati yaḥ kaścidapi śabdābhidheyamarthamabhyupagacchati, na tasya lakṣaṇabhāvābhpupagamo yuktaḥ | śabdasāmarthyamevaṃ sati bādhitaṃ syāt | icchātaśca sarvasya lakṣaṇatvamabhyupagamyeta | tasmādāgame yasya sampratyayaḥ sa tasyābhidheyatvena vyavasthāpyate |
yadyapi kevalānāṃ prayogeṣvadṛṣṭaḥ (prayoga i) tya (vyabhicāra) saṃsargādipravibhāgā ivāvasthitāḥ śaktayaḥ, tathāpi tvāsāmitaretarānapekṣaivābhivyaktirabhyupagamyate | pratiniyamena kṛtavibhāgā vyavasthitāḥ śabdānāṃ śaktayaḥ pratijñāyante || 168 ||
yatra tu pṛthageva tayoḥ prakṛtipratyayayorarthavattvaṃ dṛśyate, tatra pṛthagarthābhidhānamevāṅgīkāryam, na tūpalakṣamārthatvaṃ kalpanīyamityāha--saṃbhava iti |
prakṛtipratyayayoḥ pṛthagarthābhidhānasambhave prakṛtyartha eva padavācyaḥ pratyayārthastūpalakṣyamāṇaḥ, pratyayārtha eva padavācyaḥ prakṛtyarthastūpalakṣyamāṇa iti na yuktā kalpanā |
nanu yadi prakṛtipratyayayoḥ pṛthak pṛthagarthamabhidhātuṃ śaktirasti tatkimiti parasparāpekṣitayā svārthābhidhānamityāha--āpekṣikya ityādi | yasmāt saṃsarge prakṛtipratyayārthayoḥ śabdaśaktayo'nvayavyatirekāpekṣitā niyatā eva prātisvikya eva pratīyanta iti || 168 ||
na kūpasūpayūpānāmanvayo'rthasya dṛśyate |
ato'rthāntaravācitvaṃ saṃghatasyaiva gamyate || 169 ||
yadi tarhi yāvatkiñcittulyarūpaṃ tasyaikatvamabhyupagamyate, yāvāṃśca bhinno'rthaḥ sarvo'sau bhinnarūpanibandhanaḥ pratijñāyate satyapi sambandhyantarābhede, tathā sati kūpasūpayūpeṣu yo'yamarthabhedaḥ sa varṇamātranibandhanaḥ prayujyate | syādetadevaṃ yadi bhedābhedāvatra viṣaye syātām | na tvabhinnamasti yadūpaśabdo'nūpatadvibhāgavyavasthāṃ kuryāt | tasyānvayābhāvād viṣayāpravibhāgeṇāvyatirekeṇa vyavatiṣṭhata ityarthāntaranibandhanatvamavibhaktāvayavārthānāṃ samudāyānāmāśrīyate || 169 ||
yatra tvapekṣāyāmapi na pṛthagarthatopalabhyate tatrāpoddhāro nāśrayaṇīya ityāha--na kūpeti | nahyekāpagame kkacid yā kācidarthānāṃ vedanopajāyate || 169 ||
anvākhyānāni bhidyante śabdavyutpattikarmasu |
bahūnāṃ sambhave'rthānāṃ nimittaṃ kiñcidiṣyate || 170 ||
laukikasyābhidheyasyābhedena savyāpāramupalakṣaṇabhūtaṃ vā nimittamupādāyopādāya viśiṣṭaiḥ sādhuviṣayāṇi nipātanena labhaṇena vā kriyāmāṇaśabdavyutpattikarmasu bahudhā bhinnānyanvākhyānāni dṛśyante | anekaśaktiyukte'rthe yā kācinnimittabhāvenāśrīyamāṇa śaktiḥ sādhutvānvākhyāne'ṅgatvaṃ pratipadyate | tadyathā vṛñluṭitanitāḍibhya ulac taṇḍaśca | śakyo hyanyebhyo'pi dhātubhyaḥ śabdavyutpattikarmaṇyulac‌pratyayo vidhātuṃ taṇḍādeśaśca kartumiti || 170 ||
tadevaṃ śakyāśakyāvanvayavyatirekāvāśrityāpoddhāreṇānvākhyānaṃ padabhāgayoḥ kāryamityuktam | tataśca kiṃ sanimittamatha nirnimittamevetyāśaṅ‌kya sanimittameva padabhāgayoḥ padasya cānvākhyānaṃ kāryamitīdānīmupapādayitumāha--śranvākhyānānīti |
yatra khalu bahūni nimittāni sambhavanti tatra kiñcidevānaiyatyenāśrityānvākhyānaṃ kriyata ityucyate || 170 ||
vairavāsiṣṭhagiriśāstathaikāgārikādayaḥ |
kaiścitkathāñcidākhyātā nimittāvadhisaṅkaraiḥ || 171 ||
vīrakarma vairam, vīreṣu bhavaṃ vairam, vasiṣṭhena dṛṣṭaṃ proktaṃ vā vāsiṣṭham, vasiṣṭhaśabdo'smin vartata iti vāsiṣṭham girau ḍaśchandasi giriśaḥ, girau śota iti vā, girau śirā (śiro yasya) iti vā, aikāgārikaṭ caure, aikāssoḍhāhiṃsoraikāgāritatviti (ekāgāraṃ soḍhā, ekamasāyamagāraṃ prayojanamasya jighāṃsoraikāgārika iti, mumuṣiṣoḥ) aikāgārika iti vā | tathā tapparvamarudbhyām, dadāti, vṛttaṃ ceti nimittabhūtānāmarthānāṃ prakṛtipratyayāvadhīnāṃ vā'niyamenānvākhyātāraḥ pravṛttāḥ || 171 ||
etadeva darśayitumāha--vaireti | vīrasyedaṃ vairaṃ vīrāyā vā, tathā vasiṣṭhasyedaṃ vasiṣṭhena kṛtaṃ proktaṃ vā vāsiṣṭham, girau śete iti `girau ḍaśchandasi' iti ḍapratyaye'thavā giriṃ śyatīti `āto'nupasarge kaḥ'  iti ke giriśaḥ ; ityevaṃ nimittāvadhisāṅkaryeṇānvākhyānaṃ kṛtam || 171 ||
yathā pathaḥ samākhyānaṃ vṛkṣavalmīkaparvataiḥ |
aviruddhaṃ gavādīnāṃ bhinnaiśca sahacāribhiḥ || 172 ||
ekasya hi mārgādeḥ pratipattavyasyārthasya kaścidanvākhyātā vṛkṣeṇānvā khyānamaparo valmīkenānyaḥ parvatādibhiḥ karoti | sarveṣāṃ hi teṣāṃ sannidhānāt pratipādakatvamapratiṣiddham | gavādīnāṃ cārthānāṃ sambandhibhirjātiguṇasvāṅgasaṃyojanādibhaḥ sarvathā pratipādanaṃ kriyate || 172 ||
nanu niyatameva nimittamatra kiñciducyatāmityāśaṅ‌kyopāyānāmaniyatatvādaniyatamiti pratipādayitumāha--yatheti | yathā vṛkṣādibhirbhinnairupāyabhūtaireva kasyacitpathaḥ samākhyānamaviruddhaṃ tathā gavādīnāṃ śabdānāṃ bhinnaireva sahacāribhiranvākhyānamiti boddhavyam || 172 ||
anyathā ca samākhyanamavasthāmedadarśibhiḥ |
kriyate kiṃśukādīnāmekadeśāvadhāraṇāt || 173 ||
kaściddhi kāñcicchaktiṃ paśyati | sa yathādarśanaṃ tadvyācaṣṭe | padārthe vākyārthe vā tulyarūpamapi padaṃ kvacideva kayācicchaktyānugrahaṃ karoti | tataśca vākyāt padasyāpoddhāre kriyamāṇe sā śaktirnimittatvenāśrīyate | niyatakālāvadhayo vā śaktiviśeṣāḥ pratikālaṃ kecicchabdaviśeṣeṇopādīyamānāḥ sādhutve nimittatvenāvatiṣṭhante | te ca pratikālaṃ tathaivānvākhyātṛbhiḥ śiṣṭaiḥ parigṛhyante | paryyāyeṇa samuccitā virodhinya ekasyāparimāṇāḥ śaktayo rūpabhedaṃ darśayanti, tatra ca viruddhairnimittairupalakṣaṇaṃ kiṃśukānāmiva kālabhede śaktau kasyāścicchabdasya vyavasthāyāṃ na virudhyate || 173 ||
arthasya cāvasthābhedā bahavaḥ santi yena ca yo'vasthābhedaḥ paridṛṣṭistenaivāsau tatsamākhyānaṃ karotītyāha--anyathā ceti |
kiṃśuko neti kiṃśukaśabdaṃ prayuñjata iti bhinnameva nimittam || 173 ||
kaiścinnirvacanaṃ bhinnaṃ giratergarjatergameḥ |
gavatergatadervāpi gaurityatrānudarśitam || 174 ||
yathaiva hi (gavi) gamikriyā jātyantaraikārthasamavāyinībhyo gamikriyābhyo'tyantabhinnā tulyarūpatvavidhau tvantareṇeva gamimabhidhīyamānā gauriti śabdavyutpattikarmaṇi nimittatvenāśrīyate, tathaiva girati garjati gadatītyevadamādayaḥ sādhāraṇāḥ sāmānyaśabdanibandhāḥ kriyāviśeṣāstaistairācāryyairgośabdavyutpādanakriyāyāṃ parigṛhītāḥ | vyutpattivākyasthebhyo vyā (hyā) khyatapadebhyaḥ sarūpān varṇānupādāya tatsaṅghāta iva (pa) thi padamanvākhyāyate yāvaddhātvarthamātrā sanādibhātrā vā yāsvṛkṣu vā (yājyānuvākyāsvṛkṣu vā) vākyārthānugrāhiṇī labhyate | yathā hyāditya ityekasminnevāmnāyavākye taddhitārthenāpatyena sambandho dṛśyate | vākyāntarasambandhini tu tasminnādityāśabde nirvacanāntarāṇi kriyante | yadi nirvacaneṣu viṣayānapekṣaṃ vyutpattimātraṃ kriyate, sarvo rūḍhiśabdaḥ sarvebhyo dhātubhyo rūḍhānugamamātrāyāṃ taṇḍulādivacca prakṛtyādeśān kṛtvā vyutpādyeta | sarvatra hi rūḍhyarthe sarvanimittaṃ sambhavati || 174 ||
evadeva vyaktīkartumāha--kaiściditi |
golakṣaṇasyārthasya nānāvidhā avasthā dṛṣṭāḥ, tadanugamenaivārthamāhurācāryāḥ || 174 ||
gaurityeva svarūpādvā gauśabdo goṣu vartate |
vyutpādyate na vā sarvaṃ kaiściccobhayatheṣyate || 175 ||
apare vācāryyā aukthikyādayo gauḥ kasmād gaurityeva gauriti nirvacanamāhuḥ | gośabdavācyo gośabdena nityasambaddhaḥ | tasmād gauriti vākyārthe padārthamātrāśaktiviśeṣasanniveśanārthaṃ viśṣṭaṃ vakṣyāmīti vyutpattirārabhyate | ajāśvo vā pṛthū(da) kaṃ vā pādīyaṃ bhṛtyabharaṇīya ityevamādiṣu | bhāṣye tu dvāvapi pakṣāvekekasminneva kāryārthamāśritau | kaściddhi paramārthameva niścitya śāstravyavahāro vyavatiṣṭhate | kaścit sādhupratipādanopāyaṃ śāstrasamayamevāpekṣate | śāstragato vyavahārastatrāparamārtho dhātupratyayādibhedadarśanaṃ ca | ekatvādivṛttibhedastu tadā yo yathaiva dhāturūpāṇi tathāyubhpagamyate (bhyupagacchati) | vyavahārapakṣe tu dhātavo'pi kaiścidvarṇāśca dhātvantarebhyo varṇāntarebhyaśca prakṛtipratyayādyanugameva vyutpādyante || 175 || evaṃ śabdasya prakṛtivācyameva nimittaṃ tataśca bahuvidhanimittapradarśanam | idānīṃ svarūpameva śabdānāṃ pravṛttinimittamanvākhyanāyopādīyata iti pakṣaṃ pradarśayitumāha-gaurityeveti | atha kasmād gaurityucyate gaurityeva hi gaurgavivartata ityaukthikyāḥ | ataśca svarūpamātraprayuktāḥ sarve śabdā ityavyutpattipakṣa evetyāha--vyutpādyate na vā sarvamiti | kaiścit svarūpaṃ vācyaṃ ca nimittamucyata ityāha--kaiścicceti | evaṃ sanimittamanvākhyānaṃ nimittaṃ ca vācyaṃ bah‌dhā kaiścit kathañcit kiñciduktaṃ svarūpaṃ nimittamubhayameva veti darśitam || 175 ||
sāmānyenopadeśaśca śāstre laghvarthamāśritaḥ |
jātyantaravadasyāpi viśeṣāḥ pratipādakāḥ || 176 ||
iha rūpānugamenārthānugamena vā yāvatsāmānyenopadeṣṭuṃ śakyate tāvaduṣadiśyate | viśeṣastvarthaviṣayo rūpaviṣayo vā jātyantarayuktamivānyaṃ śabdamayamiva cārthaṃ pratipādayati | tatra yo rūḍhiviṣayo gamyarthaḥ, nāsau prākṛte gamanamātre vartate | yathaiva stravati spa (sya) ndate plavate patati gatisāmānye'pi paṭhitā gativiśeṣaṃ sāmānyamātrayā'nugamyamānaṃ svabhāvādavalambante, tathā gaurityatra pratipattavyam | na cāvaśyamatra gamiḥ pādaviharaṇe kriyate | evaṃ yāvati (tī)rūḍhiśabdārthaviśiṣṭā kriyā saṃbhavati sarvatrānekārthatvāddhātūnāṃ pravṛttirapratiṣiddhā gameḥ | dṛṣṭaṃ cedaṃ gurutalpagādiṣu vyāpārāntaraviṣayatvaṃ gameḥ | yathaiva rūḍhiṣu kriyāṇāṃ phalarūpabhedastathā kārakabhedo'pi | tasmādrūḍhiṣu jātyantaravat sāmānyābhidhāne'pyarthāntarapratipattiriti || 176 ||
idānīṃ kiṃ bhinnameva rūpaṃ śabdasya, āhosvidabhinnamiti vicāryate | yadi bhinnameva tadā gamanaṃ garalaṃ gaja ityādiṣu gādīnāṃ bhinnatvādbhedenaivāpādānaṃ prāpnoti, tataścānantyādaśkyatvamanvākhyānasyetyāha--
śabdabhedadarśane bhinnānāṃ sāmānyasamāśrayeṇa lāghavādupadeśaḥ śāstre kriyate, viśeṣā ye te'syaiva jātyantaravat pratipādakā ucyante || 176 ||
arthāntare ca yad vṛttaṃ tatprakṛtyantaraṃ viduḥ |
tulyarūpaṃ na tad rūḍhāvanyasminnanuṣajyate || 177 ||
ye rūḍhiviṣayā gamyadayaḥ prakṛtyantarāṇyevaitāni | karmakartṛviṣayavat satyapi tulyaviṣayarūpatve'tyantabhedānna rūḍhiviṣayāṇāmarūḍhiṣvarūḍhiviṣayāṇāṃ vā rūḍhiṣu kaścidanuṣaṅgo vidyate || 177 ||
etadevāha--
rūḍhau ca tulyarūpaṃ svarūpeṇānyasminnā nuṣajyate | tattvatastadbhinnameva sādṛśyāttatraikatvaṃ manyate | paramārthatastu bhinnāḥ śabdā gavādayaḥ ||177||
bhinnāvijiyajī dhātū niyatau viṣayāntare |
kaiścid kathañciduddiṣṭau citraṃ hi pratipādanam || 178 ||
yathaiva hi rūpasāmāmānye satyapi svabhāvasiddho rūḍhiṣvarthabhedastathārthānugamasāmānye satyapi śāstre ca svarūpasāmānyaparigrahaṇopadeśe kṛte'pi yajeranya evejiḥ kidviṣayaḥ | asteścānyadeva samātraṃ staḥ santītyanyadeva viśiṣṭa viṣayam | etadapi ca sarvaṃ paramārthapratirūpakaṃ vyāvahārikameva darśanam | nahi dhāturūpaṃ paramārthena kiñcidvidyate vyavahārastu kaiścit kriyate | kecidasti sakāramātramātiṣṭhante, tasya tvakārāgamo viṣayaviśeṣe tairvidhīyate | tadyathā niga...ntīti prakṛtyantaraṃ gatyartheṣu nirukte paṭhyate | tathā''hidhātuṃ pañcapadaviṣayamanye vacanārtha paṭhanti | ta (dya) thā--
gau(glau) rivāsitapakṣasya sā (') mude cāruhāsini |
a(ā)heḥ pañcapadānīva tvameva śaraṇaṃ mama || iti |
ijerakṛta (rakitsvāde) svāderyaśabdameke kurvanti | citrā hi pratipādanopāyāḥ || 178 ||
svataśca yajirbhinna evetyāha--bhinnāviti |
anyo yajirany ijiriti niyatau boddhavyau | ijiḥ kityeva yajistu taditarasminniti | ācāyaḥ punaḥ kkacid bhedāśrayeṇa nirdiṣṭau kkacidabhedeneti pratipādayitumāha--kaiścidityādi | kaścidyajeḥ kiti samprasāraṇaṃ śāsti--iṣṭaḥ, iṣṭ‌veti | tṛjādau tasya tannacchati--yaṣṭā yaṣṭuṃ yaṣṭavyamiti | kaścidijimevopadiśati, tasya tṛjādau yādeśaṃ vidadhātīti pratipādanavaicitryam || 178 ||
evaṃ ca bālavāyādijitvarīvadupācaret |
bhedābhedābhyupagame na virodho'sti kaścana || 179 ||
vaiyākaraṇā hi vyavasthiteṣu samudapeṣu parikalpitamavayavaṃ vyavasthāpayantaḥ prakṛtyantaraṃ vā vidūraśabdaṃ śāstrasya vyavahāraviṣayamalaukikaṃ jitvarī vadupācaranto vyācakṣīran | bālavāyaśabdasya vā tulyārthaṃ vidūraśabdamādeśaṃ kuryuḥ | nahi (a) bhedenādeśābhyupagame prakṛtyantarasya vā niyataviṣayasya pratijñāne laukikasyārthasya samudāyaśabdasya vā kaścidapi bhedo vidyate || 179 ||
avasthābhedāśrayeṇāpi pratipādanaṃ dṛśyata ityāha--evaṃ ceti |
iha vidūrāt prabhavati vaidūrya iti vaidūryaśabdaṃ vyutpādayanti | na ca vidūrādasau prabhavati | bālavāyādutpanno vidūre kevalaṃ saṃskriyate, tatroktam--
bālavāyo vidūraṃ ca prakṛtyantarameva vā |
na vai tatreti ced brūyājjitvarīvadupācaret || iti |
bālavāyo vṛttiviṣaye vidūramāpadyate, tataśca bālavāyāt prabhavati vaidūryo maṇiriti siddham | ato bālavāyavidūrayorabhedo'bhyupagataḥ | athavā'nyo vṛttiviṣaye vidūraśabda ucyate | yathā vaṇigbhirvārāṇasī jitvarīti | ādiśabdādviśravaṇaravaṇaśabdāviti bhedo'vagantavyaḥ | ato'bhedābhyupagame bhedāśrayaṇe vā na kaściddoṣaḥ | bhedapakṣāśrayaṇe ca sāmānyamāśritya lāghavenopadeśaḥ kriyate | abhedapakṣe tvabhinnarūpasamāśrayaṇenaiveti na kiñcidavadyam || 179 ||
aḍādīnāṃ vyavasthārthaṃ pṛthaktvena prakalpanam |
dhātūpasargayoḥ śāstre dhātureva tu tādṛśaḥ || 180 ||
tathāhi saṃgrāmayateḥ sopasargādvidhiḥ smṛtaḥ |
kriyāviśeṣāḥ saṃghātaiḥ prakramyante tathāvidhāḥ || 181 ||
kriyāviśeṣaviṣayā hi dhātavaḥ kāryārthaṃ bhedenopadiṣṭāḥ | nivāsayatyāsphoṭayati jugupsate mūtrayatoti lyab‌dvirvacanādīni vibhāge satīṣṭāṃ vyavasthāṃ labhante | `saṃgrāma yuddhe' iti kriyāviśeṣavācī sampūrvaḥ saṅghāta eva prakramyate | punaścoktam--avaśayaṃ saṃgrāmayateḥ sopasargādutpattirvaktavyeti || 180-181 ||
tato yadi śabdabhedapakṣastādadhātūpasargayoḥ pṛthaktvakalpanamityāha--
aḍ‌dvirvacanavyavasthārthaṃ kevalaṃ dhātavaḥ pṛthagupadiṣṭāḥ, vastutaḥ punarviśiṣṭakriyāvacanā eva ta iti sopasargāṇāmeva dhātutvam || 180 ||
etadeva pratipādayitumāha--tathāhiti |
asaṅ‌gramayata, sisaṅ‌gramayiṣate, sopasargasyaivāḍ‌dvirvacanadarśanāt sopasargasyaivāsya dhātutvama ata upakrama evākhyāte viśiṣṭaiva dhātuvācyā kriyā nirvartayitumupakramyata ityākhyātānāṃ svarūpapradarśanārthamāha--kriyāviśeṣā ityādi | saṃghātairdhātūpasargasamudāyairityarthaḥ | tathāvidhā abhinnā bhinnā vā || 181 ||
kāryāṇāmantaraṅgatvamevaṃ dhātūpasargayoḥ |
sādhanairyāti saṃbandhaṃ tathābhūtaiva sā kriyā || 182 ||
upasargasambandhādhīnā svārthavyavasthā dhātūnāma | svārthayoge ca siddhe sambandhyantarasya sannidhānena bhavitavyam | tatra gaurakharādivad viśiṣṭārthe prakṛtirūpe pratilabdhe bāhyāḥ sambandhina upajāyante | tasmād viśiṣṭaprakṛtirūpavācyā viśiṣṭā kriyā tathābhūtaiva sādhyā satī sādhanasambandha pratipadyate || 182 ||
ataḥ kiṃ bhavatītyāha--kāryāṇāmiti |
evaṃ dhātūpasargāśrayāṇi yāni kāryāṇyantaraṅgāṇītyucyante pūrvaṃ tānyevapravartante, yathā suḍādayaḥ | tathābhūtaiva ca sā kriyā sādhanasambandhaṃ gacchatītyāha--sādhanairiti | tathābhūtaivopasargaviśiṣṭaiva kārakasambandhamupagacchati | evaṃ cānubhūyata ityatra karmaṇi lakāraḥ siddhyati, tathā `ṣatvatukorasiddhaḥ'  ityārambhaṇīyam | `aḍabhyāsavyavāye'pi' ityanārambhaṇīyamevati sthitam | uktaṃ ca-- kārakāṇāṃ pravṛttirviśiṣṭakriyāyāmanyathā kṛtvaḥ māṃsaudane pravartante, anyathā ca śuṣkaudane' iti | vṛttopasargasambandhāyāśca tasyā vaiśiṣṭyamiti kramāśrayaṇena pūrvavopasargeṇa sambandhaḥ || 182 ||
prayogārheṣu siddhaḥ san bhettavyo'rtho viśiṣyate |
prāk ca sādhanasambandhāt kriyā naivopajāyate || 183 ||
iha prasiddhaṃ viśeṣyamanekaprakārasaṃbhave sati dṛṣṭaprayogeṇa śabdenābhidhīyamānaṃ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaṃ pratipadyate | sādhyatvācca kriyāyāḥ sādhana sambandhanirvṛttiḥ | tasmāt prākra sādhanasambandhādanupajātā kriyā nirātmikā dyotakenopasargeṇa saha viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyasambandhaṃ notsahate pratipattum | pūrvaṃ dhātuḥ sādhanena yujyata ityekeṣāṃ darśanam || 183 ||
idānīṃ pūrvaṃ dhātuḥ sādhanena yujyata iti kramasamāśrayaṇenākhyātasvarūpaṃ pratipādayitumāha--prayogārheṣviti | labdhātmanastasyā viśeṣyatvopapatteḥ prayogārheṣu dhātuṣu siddhaḥ sannartho bhettavyo viśeṣyo bhavatyupasargādibhaiḥ, na tu pūrvakāla ākhyāte viśeṣaṇayogaḥ | yadi prāksādhanasambandhāt kriyāviśeṣa ityucyate, tathā'vyu (nu) tpannāyāstasyāḥ svarūpābhāvena kathañcit śeṣasambandhaḥ syādityāha--prākcetyādi | uktaṃ ca--`sādhanaṃ kriyāṃ nirvartayati tāmupasargo viśinaṣṭi' iti | pūrvaṃ sādhanasambandhastata upasargaistadviśeṣaṇamupapannam | asmiṃśca pakṣe `aḍabhyāsavyavāye'pi'ityārambhaṇīyaṃ `ṣatvatukorasiddhaḥ' iti tuki kartavye ekādeśāsiddhatvaṃ na vaktavyam, pratyaya ityantaraṅgatvāt sādhanābhidhāyakārdhdadhātukāśrayo guṇaḥ pravartata iti siddham || 183 ||
dhātoḥ sādhanayogasya bhāvinaḥ prakramādyathā |
dhātutvaṃ karmabhāvaśca tathānyadapi dṛśyatām || 184 ||
atha pūrvaṃ dhāturupasargeṇa yujyata ityamuṃ pakṣaṃ samādhātumāha
kriyāvacano dhāturityuktam, sādhanasambandhācca prāk kriyānirvṛtterasambhavādyathā bhāvisādhanasambhandhasamāśrayaṇenopakrama eva dhātutvaṃ dhātusaṃjñocyate , yathā ca dhātoḥ karmaṇa ityucyate, karma yo dhāturitīṣikarmatvasya bhāvitvādupakrama eveṣikarmatvamuktaṃ tathānyadapi dṛśyatāṃ bhāvisambamdhātupakrama eva viśiṣṭakriyāvacanatvaṃ dṛśyatāṃ ko doṣaḥ | evaṃ ca bhinnapakṣāśrayaṇena tathāvidhaviśeṣanirvartana śobhata ityucyate `kriyāviśeṣāḥ saṅghātaiḥ prakamyante tathāvidhāḥ' iti || 184 ||
bījakāleṣu sambaddhā yathā lākṣārasādayaḥ |
varṇādipariṇāmena phalānāmupakurvate || 185 ||
upakrama eva cāsau kriyā viśiṣṭaivābhyupagantuṃ yukteti dṛṣṭāntapradarśana pūrvakamāha--
bījavāpakāla eva yathā lākṣārasādayo bījasaṃbandhāduttarakālaṃ varṇarasādipariṇāmena phalopakāraṃ kuvanti || 185 ||
buddhisthādabhisambandhāttathā dhātūpasargayoḥ |
abhyantarīkṛto bhedaḥ padakāle prakāśate || 186 ||
tathādārṣṭāntike yojayitumāha--
dhātūpasargayoḥ sambandhabuddhyā samullikhito yo'ntarṇotaḥ kevalaṃ tasmāt sambandhāttayorddhātūpasargayoḥ sambandhe padakāle padaniṣpattau satyāmasau bhedaḥ prakāśate, na tu svata iti vṛtto pasargasambandhāyā eva sādhanayoga upapannaḥ || 186 ||
kvacit saṃbhavino medāḥ kevalairanidarśitāḥ |
upasargeṇa sambandhe vyajyante praparādinā || 187 ||
evamapoddhāraprastāve vākye padasya padabhāgayoḥ prakṛtipratyayayoḥ śakyāśakyānvayavyatirekasamāśrayaṇena sanimittamanvākhyānaṃ kartumanekadhārthaḥ kvacinnimittaṃ svarūpaṃ vetyākhyātam tataśca padamekamanekaṃ veti nāmapadaṃ leśato nirṇotam | ākhyātamapi `kriyāviśeṣāḥ saṅghātaiḥ prakamyante tathāvidhāḥ'  ityādinā bhedābhedavicārapūrvakamapi nidarśitaprāyam, idānīm `nāmākhyātopasarganipātāśceti catvāri padajātāne 'iti niruktakārastatra nāmākhyātasvarūpe pradarśite | upasargāṇāṃ pradarśanīyamiti tatsvarūpaṃ pradarśayitumāha--
kvacitpacatyādau prakarṣādīnāṃ sambhavāt kevalaisteṣāmapratīterupasargasambandhāt tadavagama iti teṣūpasargāṇāṃ viśeṣadyotakatvamucyate | ata eva coktam `tameva viśinaṣṭyanyaḥ' iti || 187 ||
sa vācako viśeṣāṇāṃ sambhavād dyotako'pi vā |
śaktyādhānāya dhātorvā sahakārī prayujyate || 188 ||
tarhi dyotakatvameva kiṃ teṣāmāhosvitpakṣāntaramapītyāha--
kevalaṃ na dyotakā yāvadvācakā api dṛśyante | yathā pratiṣṭhata ityādau dhātorgatinivṛttivācakatvaṃ preṇa tu gativācakatvaṃ vyavasthāpyate | tathā coktaṃ `dhātvarthaṃ bādhate kaścit, iti | sambhavād dyotako'pi vā' ityetadādāveva kārikāyāṃ vyākhyātam| atha tṛtīyamapi pakṣaṃ darśayitumuktam śaktyādhānāyetyādi | sambhūya dhātūpasargāvarthamāhaturiti śaktimātramupasargaḥ kuruta ityarthābhidhāne sahakāriṇa upasargāḥ | atrāpyuktam `kaścittamanuvartate' iti || 188 ||
sthādibhiḥ kevalairyacca gamanādi tu gamyate |
tatrānumānād dvividhāttaddharmā prādirucyate || 189 ||
pratiṣṭhata ityādau prasiddhyā dhātorgatinivṛttivācakatve upasargasya gativācakatvaṃ sthāpitam, idānīmanumānena dyotakatvameva sarvatrāsya vyavasthāpayitumāha--
tiṣṭhatirgatiniravṛttiṃ prasiddhyābhidadhāti | ataḥ kevalena tena gamanaṃ na pratipādyata ityanekārthā dhātava iti kṛtvānumānād gativācakatvamapi tasyā vyavasthāṣyate, upasargastu tad‌dyotaka eva | gatinivṛttau tu prasiddhatvāttiṣṭhateḥ praśabdasya gativācakaratvamucyate, vastusthityā tvanumānena prāderdyotakatvameva sāmānyato dṛṣṭena viśeṣato dṛṣṭena cetyāha--tatretyādi | dhāturanekārtha upasargaśca dyotaka ityanumānena vyavasthāpyate | dvividhamanumānaṃ bhavati-- viśeṣato dṛṣṭaṃ, sāmānyato dṛṣṭaṃ ceti | tatrāviśeṣeṇopasargāṇāṃ dyotakatvaṃ tathā ca praśabdo dharmo ādikarmadyotaka iti sādhyo dharmaḥ praśabdatvāt pūrvoditapacyādi (pūrva) dṛṣṭapraśabdavaditi | viśeṣato dṛṣṭenānumānena taddharmapraśabdasya samānadharmā sarvo'pi prādirupasargo dyotakatvadharmayukta ucyata iti | dhātuśca sāmānyato dṛṣṭenānumānenānekārthaḥ | yathā tiṣṭhatirdharmmo anekārtha iti sādhyo dharmo dhātutvād ubhayavādisammatānekārthayajatyādidhātuvaditi | evaṃ sāmānyate dṛṣṭānumānāt taddharmānyo dhāturapyanekārtha ucyata iti yojanā||189||
aprayoge'dhiparyośca yāvad dṛṣṭaṃ kriyāntaram |
tasyābhidhāyako dhātuḥ saha tābhyāmanarthakaḥ || 190 ||
idānīṃ saṃbhūyārthābhidhāyakatvamapi darśayitumāha--
adhyāgacchati paryāgacchatītyatrādhiparī anarthakāvāgacchatītyasmādevoparibhāvaviśṣṭasya vā sarvatobhāvaviśiṣṭasya vā'pyāgamanasya prakaraṇādināvagatatvād laukikaśabdavyavahāre lāghavaṃ pratyanādarāditi spaṣṭārthamevādhiparyoḥ prayogaḥ | samudāya eva viśiṣṭārthābhidhāyaka ityadhiparyoḥ kevalayordhātoścā'trānarthakatvāmanarthāntaravācakatvamityarthaḥ | ato dhātūpasargau sambhūyaivārthaviśeṣaṃ brūta iti dhātorarthābhidhāne sahakāriṇa upasargāḥ | upasargāṇāṃ rūḍhito'rthavattva eva tāvadhiparī anarthakāviti  kevalānarthakatayā | nahi tayorūpasargayoḥ kevalayostatrārtho'sti, ata evoktam--kaścittamanuvartate'iti || 190 ||
tathaiva svārthikāḥ kecit saṅghātāntaravṛttayaḥ |
anarthakena saṃsṛṣṭāḥ prakṛtyarthānuvādinaḥ || 191 ||
prasaṅgāt svārthikapratyayānāṃ svarūpamāha--
yāvaka ityādau kanādayaḥ sambhūyaivārthabodhakā boddhavyāḥ | yāvaśūbdāt kevalāt pṛthageva kanprakṛtiryāvaśabdo'dhyavasita iti saṃghātāntaravṛttayaste boddhavyāḥ | ata evāha--anarthakena saṃsṛṣṭā iti | yāvaśabdaḥ kanprakṛtiranarthaka eva, samudāyastu parasparaśaktyāhitaviśeṣastatrārthavān nāsaṃbhūya svārthamāhetyāha `prakṛtyarthānuvādinaḥ'iti |
nanu prakṛtibhāgasyedānīmevānarthakatvamuktamataḥ kathaṃ prakṛtyarthānuvādina ityucyate ? sādṛśyamātrādityabhiprāyaḥ | kanprakṛtiḥ kevalā yāvaśabdena sadṛśamabhimanyata iti tadabhiprāyeṇa prakṛtyarthānuvādina ityuktam, vastutastu `saṅghātāntaravṛttayaḥ' ityeva boddhavyam || 191 ||
nipātā dyotakāḥ kecit pṛthagarthābhidhāyinaḥ |
āgamā iva ke'pi syuḥ saṃbhūyārthasya vācakāḥ || 192 ||
atha nipātānāmanaiyatyena svarūpaṃ pradarśayitumāha--
teṣāmupasargavad dyotakatvaṃ kkacid yathā vṛkṣaśca lpakṣaścetyādau | cādīnāṃ kevalānāṃ ca keṣāñcit pṛthagarthābhidhāyitvaṃ vācakatvameva siddhamityāha--kecidityādi | kecinnapātā āgamavatsaṃbhūya vācakāḥ, yathā yeṣāṃ pṛthagarthaprakalpana iti pāṭhaḥ, teṣāṃ mate nipātānāṃ dvaividhyam--kecidarthavantaḥṣa kecidanarthakā iti | tatra kecinnipātāḥ pṛthagarthaprakalpane satyarthābhidhāyinastato dyotakā ityarthavatāṃ svarūpakathanam, ye tvanarthakāsteṣāṃ svarūpamāha--āgamā ityādi || 192 ||
upariṣṭāt purastādvā dyotakatvaṃ na bhidyate |
teṣu prayujyamāneṣu bhinnārtheṣvapi sarvathā || 193 ||
tathā ca laukike prayoge'niyama ityāha--
pūrvaṃ paścādvā prayuktāstadarthadyotanaṃ kurvantīti teṣu vikalpasamuccayādyartheṣu dyotakatvameva prayujyamāneṣu sthitam || 193 ||
cādayo na prayujyante padatve sati kevalāḥ |
pratyayo vācakatve'pi kevalo na prayujyate || 194 ||
atha vācakā eva kasmānnocyante, kiṃ dyotakatvenetyarthadyotakatvaṃ dṛḍhīkartumāha--
ete hi cādayaḥ kevalā na prayujyante tato vācakā na bhavantīti boddhavyam | cādayo dharmivācakāna bhavantīti sādhyo dharmaḥ, kevalānāmaprayogāt | yadi hi vācakāḥ syustadā gavādivat kevalānāmapi teṣāṃ prayogaḥ syādityanumānam |
nanvatra pratyanumānamasti...cādayo dharmidyotakā na bhavantīti sādhyo dharmaḥ, kevalānāmaprayogāt | pratyayavattatrāha--padatve satīti |
etaduktaṃ bhavati...na nirviśeṣaṇo'yaṃ heturapi tu padatve sati kevalānāmaprayogād dyotakā eta iti padatve satītyanena pratyayavyāvṛttiḥ | etadeva darśayitumāha--pratyayo vācakatve'pītyādi | pratyayasya kasyācidvācakatve'pi padatvābhāvāt kevalasyāprayogaḥ|| 194 ||
samuccitābhidhāne'pi vyatireko na vidyate |
asattvabhūto bhāvaśca kriyā'nyenābhidhīyate || 195 ||
atha śabdaśaktisvābhāvyāccādipadasyāsattvabhūto yaḥ pṛthagarthastadvācakatvādvācakatvaṃ vyavasthāpyate, tadanupapannam;śaktyanugrahādyathā tadarthavācakānāṃ samuccayādīnāṃ prayoge ṣaṣṭhī śrūyate, vṛkṣasya samuccayaḥ, plakṣasya samuccaya iti, tadvannipātaprayoge ṣaṣṭhī śrūyeta, vṛkṣsya ca plakṣasya ceti | syādevaṃ yadi samucyābhidhāyakāḥ syuḥ, na caivam, kiṃ tarhi samuccitābhidhāyina eta ityucyate tadabhidhāne ca vyatireko nāstītyāha--
yadyevaṃ samuccitasya sattvabhūtasyābhidhāne'sattva iti pratiṣedhānnipātasaṃjñāyā abhāve tatpūrvikāyā avyayasaṃjñāyā abhāvāccāderapi vibhakteḥ śravaṇaṃ prāpnotītyāha--asattveti |
etaduktaṃ bhavati--iha śabdairarthābhidhānaṃ svābhāvikamiti sthitam | atra nipātāḥ śabdaśaktisvabhāvādevāsattvabhūtārthābhidhāyinaḥ pratīyanta iti sanidarśanamāha--kriyate | atra yathetyanuṣaṅgaḥ | yathā pāka evobhayatra nāmapadasyākhyātasya ca vācyaḥ śabdaśaktisvābhavyāttathā pacatītyākhyātenāsattvabhūto'sāvabhidhīyate, pāka ityatra nāmapadena pariniṣṭhitasvabhāvaḥ siddha iti, tadvannipātaiḥ samuccitāderasattvabhūtasyābhidhānamiti na vibhakterutpattiḥ |
uktaṃ ca--"nedaṃ vācanikaṃ liṅgasaṃkhyādisvābhāvikameva | tadyathā--samānamadhīyānānāṃ kecidarthairyujyante apare na"  iti | evaṃ vācakatvāt samuccitābhidhāne'pyākyātapadavadasattvabhūtārthābhidhāyitvādvibhakterabhāvaḥ || 195 ||
samuccitābhidhāne'pi viśṣṭārthābhidhāyinām |
guṇaiḥ padānāṃ sambandhaḥ paratantrāstu cādayaḥ || 196 ||
astvevamapi samuccitābhidhāyitvādyathā svatantrāṇāṃ tadabhidhāyakānāṃ viśeṣaṇena yogastathā nipātānāmapi sthāt, atha ca guṇavacanānāmāśrayato liṅgavacanāni bhavantītyasattvavācakatvādvibhaktyabhāvāt śobhanaṃ ca vṛkṣa iti prāpnoti | tathā cānyatroktam--pratiprayogaṃ jātyaṅge sambandhamupagacchati | viśeṣaṇaṃ, tato dharmān jātisthān pratipadyate | tataśca pañcālā janapado bahudhano ramaṇīya iti bhavati | atha lubantasya viśeṣaṇaṃ na jātestataḥ pañcālā ramaṇīyā janapada iti bhavati, etadāśaṅ‌kya samarthayitumāha--
guṇairviśeṣaṇaiḥ padānāṃ viśiṣṭārthābhidhāyināṃ sambandha upapadyate | nipātānāṃ tu śaktisvābhāvyādasattvavācitve'pi niyataparatantratvādviśeṣaṇayogo nāstīti na kaściddoṣaḥ | etaduktaṃ bhavati--etadapi śaktisvābhāvyameva yatteṣāṃ nityaparatantratvaṃ nometi | ataḥ samuccitābhidhāne'pi na kevalaḥ prayogo nāpi viśeṣaṇasambandha iti sthitam || 196 ||
janayitvā kriyā kācit sambandhaṃ vinivartate |
śrūyamāṇe kriyāśabde sambandho jāyate kvacit || 197 ||
evaṃ nāmākhyātopasarganipātalakṣaṇaṃ padacatuṣṭayaṃ vyākhyātam , atha karmapravacanīyāḥ pañcamaṃ padamabhyupagatamiti tadvicārayitumāha--
sambandhavacchedahetavaḥ karmapravacanīyā iṣyante | yadvakṣyati `sambandhasya bhedakāḥ'  iti | sambandhasca sarvaḥ kriyākārakapūrvako bhavati | tatra kkacit sambandha janayitvā kriyā vinivartate, yathā rājapuruṣa iti | atra hi rājñaḥ puruṣo'yaṃ yasmāt sa rājā puruṣaṃ bibhartti, ato bharaṇalakṣaṇā kriyā āśrayāśrayibhāvalakṣaṇaṃ sambandhaṃ janayitvā nivṛttā | kvacit kriyāpadaṃ śrūyamāṇasambandhamupajanayati, yathā mātuḥ smaratīti | atra hi māturiti karmapadamato mātṛsambandhi smaraṇamiti nimittinimittabhāvalakṣaṇaṃ sambandhaṃ smarati kriyā śrūyamāṇaiva janayati | etadevānyatroktam--"sambandhaḥ kārakebhyo'nyaḥ kriyākārakapūrvakaḥ | śrutāyāmaśrutāyāṃ vā kriyāyāṃ so'bhidhīyate || " vākyapao sādhana 156) iti || 197 ||
tatra ṣaṣṭhī pratipadaṃ samāsasya nivṛttaye |
vihitā darśanārthaṃ tu kārakaṃ pratyudāhṛtam || 198 ||
sambandhasāmānye ṣaṣṭhīti kimartham adhīgarthadayeśāṃ karmaṇī'tyādi  prakaraṇārambha iti prasaṅgādvicārayitumāha--
mātuḥ smaraṇamityādau karmaṇi śeṣatvena vivakṣite siddhaiva ṣaṣṭhīti punaḥ prātipadyenādhīgarthetyādinā  yā ṣaṣṭhī vihitā sā niyamāya bhavati | karmādau śeṣatvena vivakṣite ṣaṣṭhyeva bhavati | yadanyat prāpnoti tanniṣidhyate kiṃ cānyat prāpnoti ? tatra nidānocchedanaṃ vinā na lugādinivṛttiḥ kartuṃ śakyeti samāsanivṛttireva kriyate | tataśca ṣaṣṭhyeva bhavati | yadanyataḥ pṛṣṭ‌vā''yāti samāsalugādi prāpnoti, tannivāryata ityataḥ pratipadaṃ punaḥ ṣaṣṭhī samāsasya nivṛttaye vihiteti boddhavyam | ataśca `pratipadavidhānā ca ṣaṣṭhī na samasyate' iti bhāṣyaṃ nārambhaṇīyameva | yadyevaṃ `karmaṇīti kiṃ māturguṇaiḥ smaraṇam" iti kathaṃ pratyudāhṛtam | yathā guṇānāṃ smartavyatvasyāsambhavaḥ, tathā śeṣatvasyāpi | yadi śeṣatvenāsya (yadi śeṣatvasyāpi) vivakṣitāḥ syustadā teṣāṃ ṣaṣṭhī syāt, tṛtīyā na bhavet | tataśca dvyaṅgavaikalyametasyetyetadāśaṅkyāha--darśanārthaṃ tvityādi | māturguṇānāṃ smaraṇamityukte saṃdihyeta, guṇā karma karaṇaṃ veti | tatroktaṃ guṇaiḥ smaraṇamiti | guṇairiti karaṇaṃ yadā śeṣatvena vivakṣyate tadā pratipadavidhānā ṣaṣṭhī mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ karmaṇītyuktamiti dvyaṅgavaikalyābhāvaḥ | punaḥ ṣaṣṭhīvidhānaṃ samāsādinivṛttaya eveti sthitam | uktaṃ ca--"sādhanairvyapadiṣṭe ca śrūyamāṇakriye punaḥ | proktāpratipadaṃ ṣaṣṭhī samāsasya nivṛttaye" iti | sādhanairvyapadiṣṭe śeṣasambandhe ityarthaḥ |
evaṃ karmaṇyeva śeṣatvena vivakṣite ṣaṣṭhī, kārakāntare tvekaiveti vṛttikārāḥ | teṣāṃ mate guṇaiḥ smaraṇaṃ na tu guṇānāṃ smaraṇamiti kācidapi ṣaṣṭhī |
ṭīkākāramate tu karaṇasya śeṣatvavivakṣāyāṃ guṇānāṃ smaraṇaṃ guṇasmaraṇamityapi bhavatīti matabhedaḥ || 198 ||
sa copajātaḥ sambandho vinivṛtte kriyāpade |
karmapravacanīyena tatra tatra niyamyate || 199 ||
enaṃ kriyayā sambandho janyata iti sthitam, tataḥ kimityāha--
sa ca kriyayopajanitaḥ sambandhaḥ tasmiṃścopajāte yatā kriyāpadaṃ kkacinna śrūyate, tadā kriyājanito'yaṃ syāditi sandahe karmapravacanīyena tatra tasyāṃ kriyāyāṃ niyamyata iti sambandhaviśeṣaḥ kramapravacanīyaiḥ pratyāyyate | ata eva karmaproktavantaḥ kriyākṛtaṃ viśeṣasambandhaṃ dyotayantīti karmapravacanīyā ucyante || 199 ||
yena kriyāpadākṣepaḥ sa kārakavibhaktibhiḥ |
yujyate viryathā tasya likhāvanupasargatā || 200 ||
athā'śrūyamāṇāyāḥ kriyāyā ākṣepakāḥ karmapravacanīyāḥ kasmānnāśrīyanta ityāha--
iha tena śabdena kriyāpadasyākṣepaḥ kriyate, sa kārakavibhaktyā yujyata iti dṛśyate | yathā prādeśaṃ viparilikhatīti | atra viśabdo mānakriyāyā ākṣepakaḥ, prādeśaṃ vimāya parilikhatītyarthāvagateḥ | tato vimānakriyayā'tra prādeśalakṣaṇaṃ karmākṣiptamiti tasya kārakavibhaktyaiva dvitīyayā yogaḥ |
yadā ca kriyāntarākṣepako viśabdastadā'sya likhatyasaṃbandhāt taṃ pratyanupasargatvameva | tataśca `gatirgatā' viti  nighātābhāvaḥ | tadvat karmapravacanīyairyadi kriyāpadamākṣipyeta, tadā tadyoge kārakavibhaktireva syāt | tataśca karmapravacanīyayukte dvitīyā'  iti nārambhaṇīyameva syāt | kintu sambandhasāmānye ṣaṣṭhī prāpnoti tad‌bādhanāya dvitīyā''rabhyeta, tadārambhaḥ śobhate ||200||
tiṣṭhaterupayogaśca dṛṣṭo'pratyajayanniti |
sunbantītyābhimukhye'bhiḥ kevalo'pi prayujyate || 201 ||
kriyāpadakṣepakatvamanyatrāpi dṛṣṭamiti tadeva dṛḍhīkurvannāha--
apratyajayannityatra pratiśabdaḥ sthitikriyāyā ākṣepakaḥ paridṛṣṭaḥ | devā asurānapratitiṣṭhataḥ pratiṣṭhāmalabhamānānajayanniti tiṣṭhaterupayoga ākṣepaḥ paridṛṣṭaḥ | tathā dhātunā sambandhe'pi sunvantītyatrābhiśabdasya kevalasya cābhimukhye vṛttiḥ paridṛṣṭeti prasaṅgādāha--sunvantīti | tadevaṃ karmapravacanīyānāṃ sambandhaniyāmakatvamanvarthasaṃjñāśrayeṇaiva sthāpitam || 201 ||
karmapravacanīyatvaṃ kriyāyoge vidhīyate |
ṣatvādivinivṛttyarthaṃ svatyādīnāṃ vidharmaṇām || 202 ||
atha svatyādīnāṃ tadrapatvāsambhave kathaṃ karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā syādityāha--
atra svatyādīnāṃ karmapravacanīyatva vidhīyate saṃjñāntaravyudāsāyaivetyataścaikasaṃjñādhikārād gatyupasargasaṃjñābhāve tadāśrayaṃ ṣatvādikam "upasargād"  ityādinā na bhavati || 202 ||
hetuhetumatoryogaparicchede'nunā kṛte |
ārambhāddhādhyate prāptā tṛtīyā hetulakṣaṇā || 203 ||
anyadapi prasaṅgādāha--
lakṣaṇetthaṃbhūtetyādinā  siddhā'noḥ karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā | lakṣaṇaṃ hi jñāpakaṃ yathā tathā heturapyucyate | tataśca yathā jñāpyajñāpakabhāve vṛkṣamanu vidyotate vidyudityatrānoḥ karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā, tathā śākalyasya saṃhitāmanu prāvarṣadityatrāpi | tatra hetuhetumaddhāvalakṣaṇavyatirekavyavacchede'nunā kṛte hetutṛtīyaivaparatvāt prāpnoti, tathā ca tṛtīyāyā avakāśo dhanena kulamityādi | lakṣaṇetthaṃbhūte tyasyāvakāśo'nurjñāpyajñāpakabhāvalakṣaṇasya sambandhasyāvacchedakaḥ, yathā vṛkṣamanu vidyotate vidyuditi | ihobhayaṃ prāpnoti śākalyasya saṃhitāmanu prāvarṣaditi | atra hetuhetumadbhāvasambhavāt tṛtīyā prāpnoti | paratvāt `anurlakṣaṇe' iti punarvidhānānna bhavati || 203 ||
kriyāyā dyotako nāyaṃ sambandhasya na vācakaḥ |
nāpi kriyāpadākṣepī sambandhasya tu bhedakaḥ || 204 ||
evaṃ karmapravacanīyānāṃ prāsaṅgikaṃ vicāraṃ kṛtvā vācakatvādiprakāratritayanirākaraṇena sambandhaviśeṣakatvameva vyavasthāpayannāha--
prapacatītyādāvupasargavad naivāyaṃ kriyādyotakaḥ | ṣaṣṭhyapavādabhūtayā ca dvitīyayaivoktaḥ sambandha iti na tasya karmapravacanīyo vācakaḥ | nāpi prādeśaṃviparilikhatītyādau viśabdavat kriyāpadasyākṣepakaḥ | kiṃ tarhi viśiṣṭakriyājanito'yaṃ sambandha iti sambandhasya bhedako viśeṣakaḥ karmapravacanīyaḥ || 204 ||
anarthakānāṃ saṅghātaḥ sārthako'narthakastathā |
varṇānāṃ padamarthena yuktaṃ nāvayavāḥ pade || 205 ||
ityevamapoddhāraprasaṅgena pañcadhā padavibhāgaḥ pradarśitaḥ | evaṃ darśitaṃ padapravibhāgamagre'nūdya saprapañcaṃ padārthabhedamupapādayiṣyati | yathā
"dvidhā kaiścitpadaṃ bhinnaṃ caturdhā pañcadhāpi ca |
apod‌dhṛtyaiva vākyebhyaḥ prakṛtipratyayādivat ||
padārthānāmapoddhāre jātirvā dravyameva ca | " ityādi |
evamakhaṇḍavākyāvādinā'poddhārasamāśrayeṇa prāsaṅgikādikāryasamarthane vihite tatprasaṅgātpadapadārthapadabhāgārthapadabhāgavicāraḥ kṛtaḥ, niruktakāramatānusāreṇa ca nāmākhyātopasarganipātalakṣaṇapradarśanaṃ kṛtam, karmapravacanīyāḥ pañcamapadajātamiti kecitpratijānata iti tadapi pradarśitam, evaṃ ca dūṣiteṣu parapakṣeṣu svapakṣe ca dūṣaṇanirākāraṇapūrvakaṃ sthāpite punarapyakhaṇḍapakṣameva samarthayitukāmo vārttikavirodhamāśaṅkayāha..||205||
padānāmarthayuktānāṃ saṅghāto bhidyate punaḥ |
arthāntarāvarodhena sambandhavigameva ca || 206 ||
kiñca,
arthantarasya saṃsargalakṣaṇasyāvarodhena parigrahaṇena kaścideva devadatta gāmabhyājetyādikaḥ padasaṅgāto'rthavān kaścitta daśa dāḍimādiḥ parasparasambandhavigamenānarthaka iti sambandhād vyapetaḥ || 206 ||
sārthakānarthakau mede sambandhaṃ nādhigacchataḥ |
adhigacchata ityeke kṛṭīrādinidarśanāt || 207 ||
tadeva darśayitumāha--
bhede kriyamāṇe sati yau varṇasamudāyau sārthakānarthakau, yathā kuṭīśabdoraśabdaśca, tau sambandhamanarthakatvānnādhigacchata iti kecit | dyotyenārthenārthavattvādapare sambandhamadhigacchata ityāhuḥ || 207 ||
arthavadbhyo viśiṣṭārthaḥ saṅghāta upajāyate |
nopajāyata ityeke samāsasvārthikādiṣu || 208 ||
saṅghātārthavattvādavayavārthavattvamapi darśayitumāha--
rājapuruṣa ityādāvarthavadbhyaḥ saṅghāto'rthavānupajāyate | svārthikādiṣu tvavayavārthaprakṛtikamarthāntaraṃ nāvirbhūtamiti nāstyavayavārthavadbhyo vyatiriktaḥ saṅghātārthasya sambhavaḥ || 208 ||
kecittu yutāsiddhārthā bhede nirjñātaśaktayaḥ |
anvayavyatirekābhyāṃ kecit kalpitaśaktayaḥ || 209 ||
dvividharūpatayā'vasthitāsta ityāha--
yutaḥ siddho'rtho yeṣāṃ te tathāvidhāḥ yathā śamīvṛkṣo dāḍimīvṛkṣa ityādayaḥ | kasmādevamityāha--bheda ityādi | bhede vākye sati, rūpasyā'vinaṣṭatvāt pṛthagevanirjñātaśaktayaḥ kecit saṃjñupajñ‌vādayo'nvayavyatirekābhyāṃ kalpitaśaktaya iti | atra hi `pragate jānunī yasya' saṅgate jānunī yasya' `prasaṃbhyāṃ jānunorjñuḥ'  iti lakṣaṇānugamenārthaḥ kalpyaḥ, na tu pṛthageva, vākye dṛṣṭasya jānuśabdasya naṣṭatvāt | tasmāt saṃghātārthavattvāditi bhāgāsiddhamanaikāntikaṃ ca boddhavyam || 209 ||
śāstrārtha eva varṇānāmarthavacve pradarśitaḥ |
dhātvādīnāṃ viśuddhānāṃ laukiko'rtho na vidyate || 210 ||
kṛttaddhitānāmarthaśca kevalānāmalaukikaḥ |
prāgvibhaktestadantasya tathaivārtho na vidyate || 211 ||
abhivyaktataro yo'rthaḥ pratyayānteṣu lakṣyate |
arthavattāprakaraṇādāśritaḥ sa tathāvidhaḥ || 212 ||
yadyapyuktam "arthavanto varṇā dhātupratipadikapratyayanipātānāmekavarṇānāmarthadarśanāt" iti, tatrāha-- || 210 - 121 ||
ātmabhedo na cet kaścid‌varṇābhyaḥ padavākyayoḥ |
anyonyāpekṣayā śaktyā varṇāḥ syādabhidhāyakaḥ || 213 ||
varṇānāmarthavattvābhyupagame padavākyayorabhidhāyakatā bhajyetetyāha--
subodham || 213 ||
varṇona kenacinnayūnaḥ saṅghāto yo'bhidhāyakaḥ |
na cecchabdāntaramasāvanyūnastena gamyate || 214 ||
idānīṃ matabhedaṃ pradarśayitumāha--
yadi kenacidvarṇena nyūnaḥ saṅghāta iṣkartāramityādāvabhidhāyakastadā dvayī gatiḥ--śabdāntaratvamekaśabdatvaṃ vā | yadi na śabdāntaratvamiṣkartāramityasya tadā nyūnavarṇo'pi (varṇenāpi) pūrṇavarṇo niṣkartāramiti śabda eva gamyate, tasmāt svārthapratītiriti boddhavyam || 214 ||
sa tasmin vācakeṃ śabde nimittāt smṛtimādadhat |
sākṣādiva vyavahitaṃ śabdenārthamupohate || 215 ||
etadeva pratipādayitumāha--
yadi kenacidvarṇena nyūnaḥ sa nyūnavarṇaḥ paripūrṇaśabdavācakarūpe nimittācchāstrābhyāsāt smṛtimupajanayan sākṣādiva vyavahitamapyarthaṃ śabdena smṛtyupasthāpitenopohate samarpayatīti | atha śabdāntaratvaṃ tadā yathā paripūrṇavarṇo vācakastathā tatsambandhād nyūnavarṇo'pīti na kaścidviśeṣaḥ || 215 ||
padavācyo yathā nārthaḥ kaścat gaurakharādiṣu |
satyapi pratyaye'tyantaṃ samudāye na gamyate || 216 ||
samanvita ivārthātmā padārthairyaḥ pratīyate |
padārthadarśanaṃ tatra tathaivānupakārakam || 217 ||
tasmādavayavānāṃ tadarthapratipādanamanupapannameveti pratipādayitumāha--
gaurakharaḥ kṛṣṇasarpa ityādau yathā naiva padānāṃ cānyaḥ kaścidartho'sti, satyapi vā tacchravaṇakāle tadarthapratyaye gaurakhara ityasmin samudāye'tyantaṃ sarvathā naivāyamartho gamyate, jātyantarameva hi padārthasaṃsparśamātravirahitaṃ samudāyāttatrāvagatm, tathaiva devadatta gāmabhyājetyādibhiḥ padārthairyaḥ pratibhālakṣaṇo'rthaḥ samanvita iva, paramārthatastu nirvibhāgaḥ pānakarasādivat pratīyate, tatra padārthadarśanamavayavāthapratibhāso'nupakāraka eva mantavyaḥ || 216 - 217 ||
samudāyāvayavayorbhinnārthatve ca vṛttiṣu |
yugapad bhedasaṃsargau viruddhāvanuṣaṅgiṇau || 218 ||
yadi caitannābhyupagamyate tadā samudāyāvayavayorbhinnārthatve sati vṛttau samakālame viruddhadharmasaṃsargaḥ prāpnotīti padavādimataṃ dūṣayitumāha--
vṛttiṣu samāsādikāsu | tulyakālaṃ samudāyena pāṃsūdakavadavibhāgāpannasyārthasya pratipādanāt saṃsargaḥ samāsārthaḥ padebhyaśca bhinnasyārthasya pratīterbhedasaṃsargau viruddhau yugapat prāpnutaḥ | na caitad yuktaṃ pratītyabhāvāditi || 218 ||
kaśca sādhanamātrārthānadhyādīn parikalpayet |
aprayuktapadaścārtho bahuvrīhau kathaṃ bhavet || 219 ||
padapadārthānāṃ ca satyatve'dhyādīnāṃ vākye sādhanābhidhāyitvaṃ prāpnoti | na caitad dṛṣṭaṃ sādhanābhidhāyakatvena svatantrāṇāṃ teṣāṃ prayogādarśanādityāha--
adhistrītyādau samudāyasyādhikaraṇavṛttitvaṃ paridṛṣṭaṃ na kadācidapyavayavasyeti | yadā ca padāni satyārthāni vidyante tadā bahuvrīhyartho nāvakalpetetyāha--aprayuktetyādi | citragurityādāvavayavānāṃ satyārthatve citraśabdasya guṇaḥ kaścidabhidheyo gośabdasya gojātayaḥ kāścidityaprayuktaṃ vācakaṃ padaṃ yasyāsāvaprayuktapado devadattārthaḥ kasyābhidheyaḥ syāt || 219 ||
prajñasaṃjñvādyavayavairna cāstyarthāvadhāraṇām |
tasmāt saṃghāta evaiko viśiṣṭārthanibandhanam || 220 ||
yadi cāvayavānāmarthavattvaṃ syāttadā prajñuḥ saṃjñurityatrāpi jñuśabdasyārthaḥ pṛthagupalabhyeta, na copalabhyata iti pratipādayitumāha--
upasaṃhartumāha--tasmāditi | tasmāt samāseṣu viruddhārthopasthāpanādadhyādīnāṃ sādhanamātrārthavṛttitvāsambhavād buhavrīhyarthasyāsaṅgateḥ prajñasaṃjñvityādāvavayavārthānupalambhādityupapatticatuṣyena satyārthānāṃ padānāmanupapatteḥ saṅghāta evaiko'khaṇḍaḥ pravibhāgaśūnyaḥ sphoṭātmā viśiṣṭasyaiva pratibhātmakasyārthasya nibandhanamabhyupagantuṃ yukta iti siddham | saṅghātasādharmyācca sphoṭa evātra saṅghātaśabdenoktaḥ | saṅghāto hyavayavairācchurito bhavati, sphoṭaścāpi dhvanibhirācchrurita iti saṅghātasādharmyam || 220 ||
gargā ityeka evāyaṃ bahuṣvartheṣu vartate |
dvandvasaṃjño'pi saṅghāto bahūnāmabhidhāyakaḥ || 221 ||
idānīmakhaṇḍavādyātmīyapakṣe parakīyacodyasaptakamāśaṅkya krameṇa samarthayitumupakramate | tathā ca yadi padārtho naiva vidyate tadā devadattayajñadattaviṣṇumitrā bhojyantāmityatra dvandvenaika evākhaṇḍaḥ samudāyo vākyārtho vidhīyate, tataśca padārthabhedasyānabhyupagamādekatve ca sati bahuvacanaṃ sati nopapadyetetyāśaṅ‌kya samarthayitumāha--
yathā gargasyāpatyāni bahūni gargā ityatraikaśeṣe kṛte gargaśabda eva eva nirastāvayavavibhāgo bahvarthavṛttitvād bahuvacanāntaḥ, tathaiva dvandvasaṃjñaḥ saṃghāto nirastāvayavabhedo'pi śabdaśaktimāhātmyād bahutvamabhidhatta iti satyapi bahuvacane nāsti tāvatā vākyārthavyatirekeṇa padārthasadbhāvaḥ || 221 ||
yathaikadeśe bhujyādiḥ pratyekamavatiṣṭhate |
kriyaivaṃ dvandvavācye'rthe pratyekaṃ pravibhajyate || 222 ||
atha dhavakhadirapalāśāḥ sacyintāmityatra vākyārthavyatirekeṇa padārthāsambhavāt pratyekaṃ vākyāparisamāptyayogāt samudāyasya ca yugapatsecanakriyā'sambhavādvākyārthasyānupapattirityāśaṅ‌kya samarthanārthamāha--
brahmaṇā bhojyantāmityatra yathā vināpi vākyārthavyatirekeṇa padārthasadbhāvaṃ padārthānāṃ bhujikriyā pratyekamavatiṣṭhate, tathā dvandvavākye samudāyalakṣaṇe'rthe pratyekaṃ pravibhajyata iti na kaściddoṣaḥ |
etaduktaṃ bhavati--brāhmaṇā bhojyantāmityatra yathā satyāmapi samudāyaptipattāvapoddhārabuddhyā prakalpyāvayavān pratyekaṃ bhujakriyā samāpyate, tathaiva dvandvāt samudāye pratipanne buddhiparikalpitapravibhāgasamāśrayaṇena pratyekaṃ vākyāpari samāptirboddhavyā || 222 ||
yacca dvandvapadārthasya tacchabdena vyapekṣaṇā |
sā'pi vyāvṛttarūpe'rthe sarvanāmasarūpatā || 223 ||
punarapyāśah‌kya parihartumāha--
dvandvāntavartinaḥ padārthasya vākyārthavyatirekeṇāsambhavāt sarvanāmnā parāmarśo nopapadyate | yathā `janapadatadavadhyośca' iti  | atra hi janapadāttacchabdena parāmṛṣṭācca tasmādevāvadhibhūtāt pratyaya iṣyate | vākyārthavyatirekeṇāsati ca padārthe kathamasataḥ sarvanāmnā'pekṣaṇamiti parābhiprāyamanūdya samādhatte--sā'pītyādinā | nātra kiñcit sarvanāma vidyate | tatkuta eva tatra dvandvapadārthaparāmarśaḥ syāt ? kevalavyāvṛttarūpe viśiṣṭa evātra vākyārthe pratibhāmātre'nvayāt sarvanāmasārūpyamātramābhāti, na tu vāstavo'tra tatpadārthapratyayaḥ kaścit pratipannaḥ | yadvakṣyati--
"yadantarāle jñānaṃ tu padārtheṣūpajāyate |
pratipatterūpāyau'sau prakamānavadhāraṇāt || " iti || 223 |

yathā ca khadiracchede bhāgeṣu kramavāṃśchidiḥ |
tathā dvandvapadārthasya bhāgeṣu kramadarśanam || 224 ||
nanvasati padārthe dhavakhadirapalāśāśchidyantāmityatrākramikanirvibhāgo vākyārtha iṣṭastataśca yathaiva śabdādavagato'rthastathaivānuṣṭhānamiti yugapadeva cchidikriyā prāpnoti, na caivamanuṣṭhātuṃ pāryata ityāha--
yatrāpi bhavataḥ padārthavākyārthayorbhedaḥ khadiraśchidyatāmityādau, tatrāpi yugapadevānuṣṭhātuṃ na yāti | yāvatā khadirasya prathamaṃ tvagbhāgaṃ chindanti, tato'pyasthibhāgaṃ tadanantaraṃ sārabhāgamiti kramavartinyeva chidikriyā paryavasyati | tathaiva dvandve yaḥ padārtho'poddhārabuddhiparikalpitastasya krameṇa darśanaṃ vyavasthitiranuṣṭhānamiti yāvat || 224 ||
saṃghaikadeśe prakrāntān yathā saṅghānupātinaḥ |
kriyāviśeṣān manyante sa dvandvāvayave kramaḥ || 225 ||
athāsmin parvate dhavakhadirapalāśāśchidyantāmiti dhavakhadirapalāśacchedanaṃ nirūpitaṃ vākyārthaḥ, tatraikadeśamātre'pi cchinne yadādiṣṭaṃ tat kṛtamiti bruvanti, tadetadanaṃśe vākyārthe kathamupapattimadityāśaṅ‌kyāha--
yathā brāhmaṇā bhojyantāmityatra saṅghātānupātinyapi bhujikriyā tadekadeśe prakrāntā pravartitā, ato bhuktaṃ brāhmaṇairityucyate; tathā dvandvavācyasamudāyāntaragatāvayavapravartitāpi śabdārthaparityāgakāraṇatāṃ na pratipadyata iti vijñeyam || 225 ||
pratipādayatā vṛttimabudhān vākyapūrvikām |
vṛttau padārthabhedena prādhānyamupadarśitam || 226 ||
yadi ca padapadārthasambhavastadā pūrvapadārthapradhāno'vyayībhāvaḥ, uttarapadārthapradhānastatpuruṣa ityādikaṃ samāseṣvarthābhidhānamanupapannamityāśaṅ‌kya parihartumāha--
vākyapūrvikāṃ vṛttiṃ samāsalakṣaṇāmabudhān pratipādayatā tadbhedena samāseṣu padārthaprādhānyamācāyeṇopadaśitam | vākyapūrvikāmiti | padā vākyameva vṛttau bhavati kāryavaśādanvākhyānapakṣe tadaivamuktamityarthaḥ |
etaduktaṃ bhavati--abudhabodhanāya tathā śāstre kriyāmātrapradarśanaṃ kṛtam, na punastāvatā padapadārthasattā'bhyupagatā || 226 ||
abhedādabhidheyasya nañ‌samāse vikalpitam |
prādhānyaṃ bahudhā bhāṣye doṣāstu prakriyāgatāḥ || 227 ||
abrāhmaṇa ityādau nañ‌samāse'pi yat padārthaprādhānyaṃ bahudhā bhāṣye vikalpitam tadapyabudhabodhanāya śāstraprakriyāmātrapradarśanameva bodbhavyamityāha--
paramārthastvekameva | tatrābhidheyarūpaṃ sakalajanaprasiddhaṃ sthitamiti na tatra kaścit pūrvottarapadārthavyavahāra upapadyata iti boddhavyam | pratipādayiṣyate ca--
śāstravṛttibhedena laukiko'rtho na bhidyate |
nañ‌samāse yatastatra trayaḥ pakṣā vicāritāḥ ||"iti || 227||
jahatsvārthavikalpe ca sarvārthatyāgamicchatā |
bahuvrīhipadārthasya tyāgaḥ sarvasya darśitaḥ || 228 ||
atha padārthāsambhave vṛttiṣu jahatsvārthavikalpo nopapadyate kila padārthasambhave kutraitaducyata ityāśaṅ‌kya samarthayitumāha--
yata evamata eva tatpradarśanāyācāryeṇa vṛttiṣu jahatsvārthapakṣe sarvārthatyāgamicchatā bahuvrīhau samāse sarvasya padārthasya tyāga upadarśitaḥ | tatra hi padārthavyatirekeṇānya eva samudāyārtho viśiṣṭa eva pratibhātītyataḥ sarvathā na vāstavaḥ kaścit padārthavyavahāro'ṅgīkārya iti |
tadevaṃ dvandvabahuvacanaṃ pratyekaṃ vākyaparisamāptiḥ sarvanāmapratyavamarśaḥ krameṇānuṣṭhānamekadeśānuṣṭhāne samudāyārthānuṣṭhānābhimānaśceti pañca codyānyapoddhārasamāśrayeṇākhaṇḍavādinā parihṛtāni | bahuvrīhau ca jahatsvārthapakṣe sarvārthatyāgopadasenādakhaṇḍameva vākyāmabhipretimiti lakṣyate || 228 ||
śāstre kkacit prakṛtyarthaḥ pratyayenābhidhīyate |
prakṛtau vinivṛttāyāṃ pratyayārthaśca dhātubhiḥ || 229 ||
idānīṃ sarvo'yaṃ padapadārthavyavahāraḥ kālpaniko'satyabhūta eva nānāvidhaśāstraprakriyāmātraśaraṇo'vagantavya ityupapādayitumāha--
tathā ca padasya prakṛtibhāgāśritamabhidheyaṃ prakṛtyasadbhāve'pi pratyayaevābhidadhāti, yathā iyānityādau | tathā pratyayārthaśca vinivṛtte'pi prakṛtyaivābhidhīyate, yathā'hannati || 229 ||
yamarthamāhaturbhinnau pratyayāveka eva tam |
kkacidāha pacantīti dhātustābhyāṃ vinā kkacit || 230 ||
punarapyavyavasthāṃ pradarśayitumāha--
tatra pacantītyādau bhinnau pratyayau śaptiṅau samarthaṃ kartṛlakṣaṇamāhatustamevaiko'pyāha, atti, juhotītyādau | kkaciddhātureva tamarthaṃ tābhyāṃ vinaivāha, ahan vṛtramindra ityādāviti | kimetatpadārthānāṃ vāstavatve pramāṇadhurāmavagāhata iti yatkiñcidetat || 230 ||
anvākhyānasmṛtau ye ca pratyayārthā nibandhanam |
nirdiṣṭārtha (ṣṭāste) prakṛtyarthāḥ smṛtyantara udāhṛtāḥ || 231||
śāstraprakriyāṇāmapyavāstavātvamupapādayitumāha--
kasyāñcicchabdānuśāsanasmṛtau ye pratyayavidhāne pratyayārthā nibandhanaṃ nirdiṣṭāsta eva smṛtyantare prakṛtyarthā nibandhanamudāhṛtā iti nāstyeva naiyatyaṃ padapadārthānām || 231 ||
prasiddherudvamikarītyeva śāstre'bhidhīyate |
vyavahārāya manyante śāstrārthaprakriyā yataḥ || 232 ||
prasiddhatvācca śāstrābhyāsādhivāsitamānasāḥ śāstravyavahāreṣu padavibhāgamapi prayuñjata eva | yathā udvamatītyevaṃ prayoktavye udvamīti lāghavārthaṃ prayuñjate | karoṣi karomīti prayoktavye karītyatadekadeśamātraṃ prayuñjata evetyabhidhātumāha--
nanu vastubhūtāḥ śāstraprakriyāḥ kimiti nāśritā) ityāha--śāstrārtheti | śāstrārthaprakriyāḥ kevalamabudhānāṃ vyutpādanāya | ato na śāstrāṇi tattvaṃ vaktuṃ pārayanti || 232 ||
śāstreṣu prakriyābhedairavidhaivopavarṇyate |
anāgamavikalpā tu svayaṃ vidyāpavartate || 233 ||
athāvidyaivāsatyā prakriyābhedenopavarṇyata ityāha--
yadyevaṃ kimavidyopadarśakaśāstraprakriyāsamāśrayeṇa prekṣāpūrvakāriṇāmityāha--anāgameti | avidyopamardena hyuttarakālamāgamavikalparahitā śāstraprakriyā prapañcaśūnyā vidyopāvartate prakaṭībhavati | etaduktaṃ bhavatyavidyaiva vidyopāya iti || 233 ||
anibaddhaṃ nimitteṣu nirupākhyaṃ phalaṃ yathā |
tathā vidyā'pyanākyeyā śāstrepāyeva lakṣyate || 234 ||
nanu kathamavidyā vidyāsvarūpavilakṣaṇā vidyāyā upāyaḥ syādityāha--
nahi kāraṇeṣu kāryaṃ kenacid vyyapadeśyena rūpeṇa sambaddhaṃ vaktuṃ pāryate | yatra yathā kāryalakṣaṇaṃ phalaṃ nimitteṣu kāraṇeṣūpākhyāvirahitaṃ kāraṇasamanvayavirahitamapyad‌bhutena rūpeṇopajāyate | tathaivāvidyāvilaye svayaṃ vidyopāvartamānā śāstrādupajāteti nākhyātuṃ śakyate, kevalamadūraviprakarṣeṇa śāstrābhyāsādyadasāvanuśīlyate tato vidyāyāṃ śāstro (śāstrāṇyu) pāyā iva lakṣyante, vastusthityā tu pravivekādasau prakāśata iti boddhavyam || 234 ||
a(ya)thābhyāsaṃ hi vāgarthe pratipattiṃ samīhate |
svabhāva iva cānādirmithyāso vyavasthitaḥ || 235 ||
śāstreṣu prakriyābhedairavidyaivopavarṇyate'  ityuktam, tataśca śāstrābhyāsānatikrameṇaiva lokasya vāk‌śabdo'(śabdādaḥrthapratipattiṃ samīhata ityāha--
sa cānādirabhyāso mithyābhūta eva svābhāvika iva pratibhātītyāha--svābhāva iti || 235 ||
utprekṣate sāvayavaṃ paramāṇumapaṇḍitaḥ |
tathāvayavinaṃ yuktamanyairavayavaiḥ punaḥ || 236 ||
mithyātvameva pratipādayitumāha--
tāratamyayogādapakarṣaprāptiṃ parimāṇasyānumāya paramāṇuḥ sthāpitaḥ, tasyāpyanyaḥ sāvayavatvamutprekṣata iti nāstyeva puruṣabuddhīnāṃ vāstavatvam | avayavinamapyavayavāntarayoginamutprekṣate || 236 ||
ghaṭādidarśanāllokaḥ paricchinno'vasīyate |
samārambhācca bhāvānāmādimad brahma śāśvatam || 237 ||
tathā parimitaparimāṇaṃ ghaṭādikaṃ dṛṣṭ‌vā locyata iti loko'yaṃ viśvaprapañcarūpaḥ paricchinnatayā'vasthito'dhyavasīyata ityāha-- || 237 ||
upāyāḥ śikṣamāṇānāṃ bālānāmapalāpanāḥ |
usatye vartmana sthitvā tataḥ satyaṃ samīhate || 238 ||
samārambādutpādācca bhāvānāmidaṃ śāśvatamapi brahmādimaditi loke vyapadiśyate | tasmādupāyāḥ śāstrāṇi jijñāsūnāmabudhānāmapalāpanāḥ pratāraṇā eva boddhavyāḥ | yasmāttatrāsatyarūpe śāstraprakriyāmātre'rthe sthitvā avidyāmutsṛjya satyaṃ vidyāsvarūpaṃ brahma samīhate prāpnotīti yāvat || 238 ||
anyathā pratipadyārthaṃ padagrahaṇapūrvakam |
punarvākye tamevārthamanyathā pratipadyate || 239 ||
idānīṃ punarapi padapadārthanirākaraṇaṃ pratipādayitumāha--
yadi ca satyabhūtāḥ padārthāḥ syuḥ, tadā padārthapratipattyavasare sarvamanyathā pratipadyate | vākyārthāvasare tatparityāgenānyathaiva pratipattirdṛśyamānā nopapadyate | etaccāgre stutinindetyādinā vyaktīkariṣyati || 239 ||
upāttā bahavo'pyarthā yeṣvante pratiṣedhanam |
kriyate te nivartante tasmāt tāṃstatra nāśrayet || 240 ||
yathā ca padagrahaṇapūrvakamādau padārthaḥ pratipannaḥ, paścādvākyārthapratipattyavasare tadarthaparityāgenānya evārtha upajāyata iti pratipādayitumāha--
ihādya dhavakhadirapalāśārachedanīyā netyatra padārthapratibhāsasamaye'nya eva dhavādicchedanalakṣaṇo'rtha upādīyate, paścānniṣedhena tannivartanaṃ kriyate, na caitatadyuktam; upāttasya tyāge śabdārthasaṃbandhasyānityatvaprāptariti teṣāṃ tatrānāśrayaṇameva yuktamityāha--tasmāttāṃstatra nāśrayediti || 240 ||
vṛkṣo nāstīti vākyaṃ ca viśiṣṭābhāvalakṣaṇam |
nārthena buddhau sambandho nivṛtteravatiṣṭhate || 241 ||
ato vākyavākyārthayoreva satyatvamatra yuktamabhyupagantumityāha--
