etadvākyamevākhaṇḍaṃ viśiṣṭābhāvalakṣaṇamiti vṛkṣābhāvāvagatirūpasya vākyārthasya lakṣaṇaṃ pratyāyakamiṣyate | yadi punaḥ padārtho'tra vyatirikto'bhyupagamyate, tadā vṛkṣalakṣaṇe padārthe vyavasthite nañsambandhastasya nopapadyate, tasya hi svakāraṇāllabdhātmalābhasya na jātanivṛttiḥ kartuṃ śakyate | athāsata eva nañā sambandhastadā'sattvādeva nivṛtto'sāviti naño vaiyarthyam | yaducyate--
"satāṃ ca na niṣedho'sti so'satsu ca na vidyate |
jagatyanena nyāyena nañarthaḥ pralayaṃ gataḥ ||" iti |
tasmādarthasya svata eva nivṛttestena saha nivṛttivācakasya sambandho na vidyate || 241 ||
vicchedapratipattau ca yadyastītyavadhāryate |
aśabdavācyā sā buddhirnivarteta sthitā katham || 242 ||
athocyate vicchedena padārthaviṣayāstibuddhiravadhṛtā sā nañā nivāryata ityāha--
evaṃ ca buddhāvapi nañ‌sambandho nopapadyata ityāha--aśabdavācyeti | nañā śabdavācyo'rthaḥ pratiṣidhyate na ca buddhiḥ śabdavācyā | śabdena hi bāhyo'rtho'bhidhīyate, buddhistvarthālambanā (na) śabdābidheyatvamarhatītyataḥ kathaṃ nañā sā pratiṣidhyate || 242 ||
atha yajjñānamutpannaṃ tanmithyeti nañā kṛtam |
naño vyāpārabhede'sminnabhāvāvagatiḥ katham || 243 ||
atha buddhirna nivartate; api tu tasyā nañā mithyātvamāvedyata ityāha--
etadapi nirākartumāha--naña iti | naña evamātmake vyāparāviśeṣe buddhiniṣedhātmake'ṅgīkriyamāṇe sati vṛkṣasyābhāvāvagatirna syāt kila paryudāse sadṛśapratipattividhāyini nañvācya etadupapadyate | prasajyapratiṣedhe tu naitadupapadyate, vṛkṣābhāvo hi tatra vākyārtha iti || 243 ||
nirādhārapravṛttau ca prāk‌pravṛttirnaño bhavet |
athādhāraḥ sa evāsya niyamārthā śrutirbhavet || 244 ||
atha nivartyamāna evāsyādhāro'bhidheyaḥ kalpyate, tatrāpyāha--
ādhāramanapekṣyaiva nañ pravartata iti yadyucyeta tadā nañaḥ prāgeva pravṛttiḥ prayogaḥ syāt | pratiṣeddhamiṣṭe sarvatra netyevābhidadhyuriti | atha viṣayaniyamārthamādhāraprayogo na vṛkṣa iti vṛkṣasya niṣedho na ghaṭāderiti pratipādayitumāha--athādhāra iti | atrāpi dūṣaṇamabhidhātumāha--niyamārtheti | nañaiva tadarthaniṣedhe jāte punarasau tacchratiniyamāya vā syāt || 244 ||
niyamadyotanārthā vā anuvādo'thavā bhavet |
kaścidevārthavāṃstatra śabdaḥ śeṣāstvanarthakāḥ || 245 ||
nipātā dyotakāḥ kecidityabhiprayeṇāha--
athavā'nukramya vispaṣṭārthaṃ punarvacanamanuvādaḥ syādityāha-- anuvāda iti | sarvathaivamānarthakyameva padārthānāṃ syādityāha--kaściditi | na brāhmaṇa ityādau naña evārthavattvamityanyeṣāmānarthakyaṃ syāt, na caitadupapannam | tasmād vṛkṣo nāstītyasmādakhaṇḍādakhaṇḍa eva viśiṣṭābhāvarūpo vākyārthaḥ, na punastattvataḥ pṛthageva padārthaḥ satyabhūtaḥ kaścidupapannaḥ || 245 ||
viruddhaṃ cābhisambandhamudahāryādibhiḥ kṛtam |
vākye samāpte vākyārthamanyathā pratipadyate || 246 ||
atha `anyathā pratipadyārtham' ityetad vyākhyātumāha--
udahāryādibhiḥ padairviruddhapadārthapratibhāsāvasare'bhisambandhamavagacchati | yathā udahāri--"bhagini ! yā tvaṃ śirasānaḍ‌vāhaṃ vahasi sā tvaṃ prācīnaṃ kumbhamabhidhāvantamadrākṣīḥ" ityatrottarakālaṃ vākyārthapratipattyavasare'nyathaivārthapratipattiriti na padārthaḥ kaścidupapannaḥ || 246 ||
stutinindāpradhāneṣu vākyeṣvartho na tādṛśaḥ |
padānāṃ pravibhāgena yādṛśaḥ parikalpyate || 247 ||
etadevānyathā pratipādayitumāha--
stutipradhānaṃ vākyaṃ kiñciddhavati yatra padārtho nindā--
"indorlakṣma smaravijayinaḥ kaṇṭhamūlaṃ murāri-
rdignāgānāṃ madamalamaṣībhāñji gaṇstha lāni |
ādyāpyurvovalayatilaka ! syāmalimnā'nuliptā
nyudbhāsante vada dhavalitaṃ kiṃ yaśobhistvadīyaiḥ || "
atra padārthapratibhāsavelāyāṃ nindāvagamyate--yasmāddhe rājannalīkamevoddhatāṃ kandharāṃ vahasi, tathāhi na sarvavyāpi tvadīyaṃ yaśaḥ ; yadi hi tathā syāt , tadā kimityadyāpi prasiddhā eva śaśalakṣmādayaḥ padārthāḥ śyāmalatayā bhāsante ? yaśaso hyavadātatayā tadīyasya vyāpitāyāṃ tadvyāptāste śvetā bhaveyureveti padārtho'tra nindā, stutistu vākyārthaḥ | tathā ca rājan sarvameva jagadyakhasā tvadīyena dhavalitaṃ kevalaṃ svabhāvasya dustyajatvādyadi paraṃ cattvāryeva vastūni trijagati śyāmaguṇayuktānyanyatsarvameva tvadīyena yaśasā vyāptamiti sarvatra trilokyāmapi prathitapratāpastvamiti vākyārthaḥ | nindāpradhāne stutiḥ pādartho yathā--
"he helājitabodhisattva vacasāṃ kiṃ vistaraistaiyadhe
nāsti tvatsadṛśaḥ paraḥ parahitādhāne gṛhītavrataḥ |
tṛṣyatpānthajanopakāraghaṭanādaurmukhyalabdhā'yaśo-
bhāraprodvahane karoṣi kṛpayā sāhāyakaṃ yanmaroḥ || "
atra bodhisattavacaritasyāpi tvadīyenānena toyanidhe ! parārthasampādanaṣāṅ‌(sād)guṇyena parājaya iti padebhyaḥ stutiravagamyate, vākyārthastu niratiśyagarhāpātratvamudadheravekṣyati iti | tataśca padapadārthānāṃ vāstavatve kathametatsaṅgacchata iti ||
247||
athāsaṃsṛṣṭa evārthaḥ padeṣu samavasthitaḥ |
vākyārthasyābhyupāyo'sāvekasya pratipādane || 248 ||
athātra padavādimatamāśaṅkatumāha--
padeṣvartho'saṃsṛṣṭa eva vākyārthasyaikasya saṃsargalakṣaṇasya pratipādane'bhyupāyaḥ sthitaḥ | padārthapūrvako hi vākyārthāvasāyo vyavasthita iti || 248 ||
pūrvaṃ padeṣvasaṃsṛṣṭo yaḥ kramādupacīyate |
chinnagrathitakalpatvānna viśiṣṭataraṃ viduḥ || 249 ||
etannirākartumāha--
ādau padeṣvasaṃsṛṣṭa eva sthitaḥ kramācca saṃsṛjyopacīyate yo vākyārthaḥ sa viśiṣṭataraḥ sudṛḍhaṃ viśiṣṭa eva, kasmāt ? chinnagrathitakalpatvāditi pūrvaṃ chinnaḥ paścād grathito yastattulyo'sāvityasaṃsṛṣṭapadārthapūrvako vākyārthāvasāyo na yujyata iti tadevaṃ prakṛtipratyayayoḥ parasparamekāpāyenāpyarthāvagateḥ, ubhayato'rthasya sampratyaye satyekasmādeva pratyayāt kkacidarthapratipatteḥ, prakṛtipratyayārthayośca sāṅkaryeṇa śāstreṣvabhidhānāt, vākyārthasya ca padārthapratipattivilakṣaṇatvāt, nañarthānupapatteḥ, sarvatropāttatyāgaprasakterityupapattiṣaṭ‌kena vṛttiṣu viruddhārthopapādanādinā ca pūrvoktopapatticatuṣṭayena satyabhūtānāṃ padārthānāmanupapatteḥ, akhaṇḍapakṣe ca pratinidhyādicodyapañcakasya tathā dvandvāśrayeṇa codyasaptakasya pariharaṇānniravadyamakhaṇḍameva sphoṭātmakaṃ vākyaṃ pratibhaiva ca vākyārtha iti sthitam || 249 ||
ekamāhuranekārtha śabdamanye parīkṣakāḥ |
nimittabhedādekasya sārvārthyaṃ tasya bhidyate || 250 ||
idānīmapoddhārasamāśrayeṇāpi padārthasyābhyupagatatvānmukhyagauṇavicāramapyāsūtrayitumāha--
atraikaśabdadarśanamanekaśabdadarśanaṃ citi dvau pakṣau | tatrāpi padapadārthayoḥ satyatvaṃ padavādimatena, asatyatvaṃ ca vaiyākaraṇamateneti catvāraḥ pakṣāḥ | pratikṣiptamapi pakṣaṃ vyavahārārthamaṅgīkarotyeva ṭīkākāraḥ | yataḥ sarvapārṣadamidaṃ hi vāyakaraṇaṃ śāstram tatra cāyaṃ sthita ityatra punaḥ padapadārthāvaṅgīkaroti | tatraikaśabdadarśane śabdopacāraḥ prasiddhyaprasiddhinimittakaḥ | tatraiva cārthopacāro dvidhā--svarūpārthatvena bāhyārthatvena ca | iti trayaḥ pakṣāḥ | evamanyatra | tadevametaistribhiḥ pakṣaiścatvāro'pi pakṣā abhihitā dvādaśa sampadyanta iti boddhavyam| tatraikaśabdadarśanasamāśrayaṇena tāvad gauṇamukhyavicāram `ekamāhuri' tyādinā karoti, sarveṣvapyartheṣveka eva gośabdo vācakaḥ | yadyevaṃ yugapadeva sarvārthaprakāśanaṃ kasmānna karotītyāha--nimittabhedādityādi | nimittabhedo vakṣyamāṇastasmāt sārvārthyaṃ bhidyata iti || 250 ||
yaugapadyamatikramya paryāye vyavatiṣṭhate |
arthaprakaraṇābhyāṃ vā yogācchabdāntareṇa vā || 251 ||
tataśca kimitya āha--
nimittavaśād yugapat sarvārthaprakāśanaṃ na karotītyarthaḥ | nimittabhedamāha--arthaprakaraṇābhyāmiti || 251 ||
yathā sāsnādimān piṇḍo gośabdenābhidhīyate |
tathā sa eva gośabdo bāhīke'pi vyavasthitaḥ || 252 ||
yaugapadyamatikramya paryāye vyavatiṣṭhata ityasyodāharaṇamāha--
sarvaśaktestu tasyaiva śabdasyānekadharmaṇaḥ |
prasiddhibhedād gauṇatvaṃ mukhyatvaṃ copavarṇyate || 253 ||
yadyevaṃ gauṇamukhyavibhāgaḥ kuta ityāha--
sarvaśāṃktamattvaṃ cānekadharmaṇa ityanena vyākhyātam | prasiddhibhedāt prasiddhiviśeṣād gojātīye sātiśayā gośabdasya prasiddhiḥ | bāhīke tvīṣaditi | tasmāt prasiddhyaprasiddhikṛto gauṇamukhyabhāvaḥ || 253 ||
eko mantrastathādhyātmamadhidaivamadhikratu |
asaṅkareṇa sarvārtho bhinnaśaktirvyavasthitaḥ || 254 ||
tathaikadarśana eva prakriyāṃ darśayati--
tathā caika eva mantra ātmanyapi japāvasare deveṣvapi krato yajanasamaye'pi viniyujyate, bhinnaśaktitvādasāṅkaryeṇa pratiniyatārthatayā vyavasthitiṃ labhata ityarthaḥ || 254 ||
gotvānuṣaṅgo bāhīke nimittāt kaiścidiṣyate |
arthamātraṃ viparthastaṃ śabdaḥ svārthe vyavasthitaḥ || 255 ||
evaṃ śabdopacāraḥ prasiddhyaprasiddhinimittakaḥ pradarśitaḥ | etasmiṃśca śabdopacāre śabdārthasambandhasyānityatvaṃ syādityāśaṅ‌kyārthopacāramāśrityāha--
arthaḥ śabdasya dvividhaḥ--svarūpaṃ bāhyaśca | tatra nimittājjāḍyādergotvaṃ bāhīke'pyanuṣajyate, śabda'mtu gotvamevābhidhatta iti bāhyārthopacāraḥ | iyāṃstu viśeṣaḥ--goratyitra mukyameva gotvam gaurbāhīka ityatra tūpacaritaṃ tadeva vācyamiti || 255 ||
tathā svarūpaṃ śabdānāṃ sarvartheṣvanuṣajyate |
arthamātraṃ viparyastaṃ svarūpe tu sthitiḥ sthirā || 256 ||
atha svarūpopacāramāha--
śabdānāṃ svarūpameva sarvatra vācyam, tattu gojātīye kadācidanuṣajyate, kadācidvāhīka ityanityatvaṃ nāsti śabdārthasambandhasya | prasiddhyaprasiddhikṛtastu goṇamukhyavibhāgo boddhavyaḥ || 256 ||
ekatvaṃ tu svarūpatvācchabdayorgauṇamukhyayoḥ |
prāhuratyantabhede'pi bhedamārgānudarśinaḥ (nusāriṇaḥ) || 257 ||
athānekaśabdadarśanamāśrityāha--
bhedamārgānusāriṇaḥ śabdabhedavādinaḥ gauṇamukhyārthābhidhāyinorgośabdayorbhedamevāhuḥ| te hyarthabhedācchabdabhedaṃ manyante; yataḥ śabdārthayorihādhyāsalakṣaṇaḥ sambandho vyavasthitaḥ | ekatra cedadhyastastasmiṃstenaivābhedamāpannaḥ kathamanyena sahādhyāsamupeyādityārthaḥ | tadevaṃ śabdabheda evopapannaḥ | etacca bhedābhedasvabhāvaṃ darśanadvayaṃ śabdānāṃ bhāṣyakāreṇa vārtikavyākhyānāvasare darśitam | tatra hyuktam--`tatrānuvṛttinirdeśe savarṇāgrahaṇamanaṇ‌tvāt' |
atrottaram--`ekatvādakārasya siddham' iti | yadyevam, anubandhasaṅkarastu, ekājanekāj‌grahaṇeṣu cānupapattirityādīni codyāni prāpnuvanti, tatraivaitāni parihṛtāni, viṣayeṇa tu nānāliṅgakaraṇāt siddham, ekājanekāj‌grahaṇeṣu cāvṛttisaṃkhyānādityevamekaśabdadarśanaṃ sthāpitam |
athānekadarśanamāśritya tatraivoktam--ānyabhāvyaṃ tu kālaśabdavyavāyād yugapacca deśapṛthaktvadarśanādityevaṃ bhedābhedau śabdeṣu vyavasthāpitau | tadvyākhyānāyaiva ca ṭīkākāraḥ svatantrapakṣadvayadarśanaṃ karotīti boddhavyam || 257 ||
sāmidhenyantaraṃ caivamāvṛttāvanuṣajyate |
mantrāśca viniyogena labhante bhedamūhavat || 258 ||
athaitadeva śabdabhedadarśanaṃ prasaṅgadvaidikaṣvapi śabdeṣu yojayitumāha--
trayodaśaikādaśa vā samindhanārthā ṛcaḥ sāmidhenyaḥ | tatra triḥ prathamāmanvāha, triruttamāmanvāha | evaṃ cāvṛttyā saptadaśa pañcadaśa vā sāmidhenyo bhavantīti sthitam | tatrāvṛttaṃ sāmidhenyantarameva vibhinnasvarūpamanuṣaktaṃ boddhavyam, na tattve(nai) kaivāsau punarāvṛtteti śabdabhedavādinaḥ |
evaṃ ca mantrāṇāmapi bhedamāhuriti pradarśayitumāha--mantrāśceti | viniyogenābhyupayogādinopalakṣitā api mantrā bhinnā eva boddhavyāḥ | yathā āha--`devīrāpaḥ śuddhāḥ' ityasmādanya eva stutyarthabādo'bhyūhyate deva ājyaṃ suddhami tyādi | evamūhamantrāṇāmanyatvam tathaiva viniyuktānāṃ māntrāṇāmanyatvameva || 258 ||
tānyāmnāyāntarāṇyeva paṭhyate kaścideva tu |
anarthakānāṃ pāṭho vā śeṣastvanyaḥ pratīyate || 259 ||
anyatve ca teṣāṃ kiṃ vedatvaṃ syānna vetyāśaṅkya vedatvameva teṣāṃ boddhavyamityāha--
mantrāṇāṃ sarvaṃṣāṃ vedatvameva, vede tu kaścideva mantraḥ paṭhyate | na caitāvatā teṣāmeva vedatvam, anyathā vede'narthakā eva sarve paṭhitā ityāha--anarthakānāmiti | upalakṣaṇabhūtā anadhikārā eva vede mantrāḥ paṭhitāḥ, taistu viniyogāvasare pratīyamānānāmanyeṣāmeva vedatvaṃ boddhavyam || 259 ||
śabdasvarūpamarthastu pāṭho'nyairupavarṇyate |
atyantabhedaḥ sarveṣāṃ tatsambandhāttu tadvatām || 260 ||
tadevamarthabhedācchabdasya bhede mantrāṇāṃ bheda eva, paṭhitānāṃ copalakṣaṇārthateti pradarśiṃtam | atha svarūpārthameva pāṭhaḥ sarveṣāṃ vaidikānāṃ kaiściducyata ityāha--
tataśca sarveṣāṃ svarūpavatāṃ bheda evetyāha--atyanta iti | nanu pāṭhyamānānāmeva svarūpārthatvāt svarūpavattā yujyate, itareṣāṃ tu yāgādau viniyuktānāṃ kathaṃ svarūpavattvameva syādityāha--tatsambandhāditi | tatrāpi pravṛttinimittasya svarūpasyaiva vidyamānatvāttadvattvameva boddhavyam || 260 ||
anyā saṃskārasāvitrī karmaṇyanyā prayujyate |
anyā japaprabandheṣu sā tvekaiva pratīyate || 261 ||
tasmānmantreṣu saṃskārādiviniyogabhedāt pāṭhopalakṣitānāṃ cābhinnānāmeva pratītiḥ svarūpārthatvādvā, bhinnānāmeṣāṃ bheda eva mantavya ityupasaṃhartumāha--
sārūpyāt tvekatvavyavahārastatra boddhavyaḥ | tadevamanekaśabdadarśane'rthabhedācchabdabhede gauṇo'rtho'nyaḥ, mukyo'rthaścānya eva; kintu sārūpyādabhede mukyārthasya prasiddhatvāt tadvācaka upacaryata eveti | śabdopacāra eva tatra kalpayituṃ śakyaḥ, na tvekaśabdadarśana iva śabdasambandhasyānityatvādupacāro'rthasyāśrīyate | ata evābhiprāyavatā ṭīkākṛtā tatra śabdopacārārthopacārau vyākhyātau || 261 ||
arthasvarūpe śabdānāṃ svarūpādvṛttiriṣyate |
vākyarūpasya vākyārthe vṛttiranyānapekṣayā || 262 ||
tatsambandhāttu tadvatām' ityatra svarūpeṇa pravṛttinimittena sambandhaḥ pratipāditaḥ | tadeva ca sarveṣāṃ śabdānāṃ pravṛttinimittaṃ boddhavyamiti vispaṣṭayitumāha--
arthasvarūpe'rthavastunīiti yāvat | tatra sarveṣāṃ svarūpādeva nimittāt pravṛttirboddhavyā | na kevalaṃ padānāṃ sarvatra svarūpameva pravṛttinimittam, yāvadvākyarūpasyāpi śabdasya vākyārthe vartamānasya vṛttiranyānapekṣayā svarūpeṇaiva boddhavyeti prasaṅgena pratipādayitumāha--vākyārūpasyeti || 262 ||
anekārthatvamekasya yaiḥ śabdasāyanugamyate |
siddhyasiddhikṛtā teṣāṃ gauṇamukhyaprakalpanā || 263 ||
idānīmekaśabdadarśane gauṇamukhyavibhāga ityupasaṃharannāha--
siddhyasiddhibhyāṃ prasiddhyaprasiddhibhyāṃ tatra gauṇamukyavibhāgo voddhavyaḥ | anenaikaśabdadarśane'pi sādṛsyādabhede punarapi prasiddhyaprasīddhibhyāmeva gauṇamukyavibhāga ityuktameva || 263 ||
arthaprakaraṇāpekṣo yo vā śabdāntaraiḥ saha |
yuktaḥ pratyāyayatyarthaṃ taṃ gauṇamapare viduḥ || 264 ||
athobhayatrāpi gauṇamukhyavibhāge nimittāntaraṃ darśayitumāha--
arthaprakaraṇaśabdantarasaṃnidhānāni gauṇamukhyabhāvamubhayatrāpi prayojayatītyucyate ||264 ||
śuddhasyoccāraṇe svārthaḥ prasiddho yasya gamyate |
sa mukhya iti vijñeyo rūpamātranibandhanaḥ || 265 ||
etadeva saṃgrahakāroktaślokapradarśanena saṃvādayitumāha--
etanmukyārthaśabdalakṣaṇam || 265 ||
yastvanyasya prayogeṇa yatnādiva niyujyate |
tamaprasiddhaṃ manyante gauṇārthābhiniveśinam || 266 ||
gauṇārthaśabdasvarūpamapyāha--
yatnādiveti | arthaprakaraṇāderityarthaḥ || 266 ||
svārthe pravartamānasya yasyārthaṃ yo'valambate |
nimittaṃ tatra mukhyaṃ syād nimittī gauṇa iṣyate || 267 ||
atha prakārāntareṇa gauṇamukhyavibhāgamāha--
yo bāhike pravartamānaḥ svārthe sāsnādimati vartamānasya gośabdasya sambandhinamarthe nimittatvenāvalambate, tatra viṣaye mukhyo'rtho nimittaṃ syāt gauṇastu nimittītyucyate |
etaduktaṃ bhavati--yatrāskhalad‌gatiḥ śabdastatra mukyo'rthaḥ, skhalad‌gatitve tu gauṇārthateti boddhavyam | nanvetenārthopacāra uktaḥ, sa caikaśabdadarśanesthitaḥ | tatra yasyārthaṃ yo'valambata iti śabdabheda uktaḥ syāt | asadetat; atrāpi śaktibhedāśrayaṇe kalpitasya bhedasyopapatteryujyata etaditi na kaściddoṣaḥ || 267 ||
purārāditi bhinne'rthe yau vartete virodhini |
arthaprakaraṇāpekṣaṃ tayorapyavadhāraṇam || 268 ||
athārthaprakaraṇādeḥ śudvasya gauṇamukhyavibhāgahetutve'tiprasaṅgamāha--
purārācchabdau bhāvibhūtadūrāntikalakṣaṇeṣu yathāyogaṃ parasparaviruddheṣvartheṣu vartete, tatraitayorartha (prakaraṇādinārthanirṇayaḥ | tataścātrāpi gauṇamukhya bhāvaḥ syāt, na caitadiṣṭam ; anayorubhayatrādi (mukhyārtha) tvamiṣyata ityato'rthaprakaraṇādīn kevalān gauṇamukyabhāvo na prayojayatīti boddhavyam || 268 ||
vākyasyārthāt padārthānāmapoddhāre prakalpite |
śabdāntareṇa sambandhaḥ ka (ta) syaikasyopapadyate || 269 ||
idānīmakhaṇḍapakṣamāśritya gauṇamukhyatāmāha--
pūrvamekaśabdadarśane'nekaśabdadarśane vā padapadārthayoḥ satyatvamabhyupagamyoktam, tatra tvasatyau padapadārthau boddhavyau | ataścākhaṇḍameva vākyaṃ vākyārthasya pratyāyakamiti padapadārthāsadbhāve kīdṛśo gauṇamukhyabhāvaḥ kila ? gaurvāhīka ityatra padapadārthābhyupagame viruddhasāmānādhikaraṇayānyathānupapattyā gopadasyopacaritārthatvamucyate; yadā tu gaurbāhīka ityanenākhaṇḍenaiva gogatadharmāvacchinno bāhīkalakṣaṇo'rtho'khaṇḍa eva pratipādyate, tadā padapadārthānāmasatyatvāt ka (ta) syaikasyāvidyamānasyaiva tathābhūtenaivetareṇa sambandha iti tastyo gauṇavibhāgaḥ ?
yadyevametasmin pakṣe kathaṃ gauṇamukhmayavibhāgaḥ syāt ?
ucyate--apoddhārasamāśrayaṇena padapadārthavibhāgamupakalpya prasiddhyaprasiddhinimittako gauṇamukhyavibhāgo'bhyupagantavya ityabhiprāyaḥ || 269 ||
yaccāpyekaṃ padaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ caritāstikriyaṃ kkacit |
tadvākyāntaramevāhurna tadanyena yujyate || 270 ||
nanu svatantraṃ padaṃ padāntaramantareṇa prayujyata eva, atastatra vāstavaḥ padapadārthapravibhāga ityāha--
ekaṃ padaṃ caritakriyatvādvākyamevākhaṇḍamiti pratipādayiṣyati | atastadanyena naiva yujyata iti boddhavyam || 270 ||
yacca ko'yamiti praśne gauraśva iti cocyate |
praśna eva kriyā tatra prakrāntā darśanādikā || 271 ||
etadeva sphuṭīkṛtya pratipādayitumāha--
ko'yamiti praśne dṛśyate bhavatīti vā kāpi kriyā gārbhokṛtā, saivottare'pi garbhokṛteti tadapi caritakriyamekaṃ vākyameveti mantavyam || 271 ||
naivādhikatvaṃ dharmāṇāṃ nyūnatā vā prayojikā |
ādhikyamapi manyante prasiddhernyūnatāṃ kvacit || 272 ||
idānīṃ nyūnādhikabhāva eva gauṇamukyavibhāgakāraṇaṃ kaiścidabhyupagatamityāśaṅkya nirākartumāha--
kasmādetyāha--ādhikyamapīti | āpekṣikatvādasyāvyavasthitatvameveti na tena gauṇamukhyavyavahāraḥ kalpayituṃ śakyaḥ || 272 ||
jātiśabdo'ntareṇāpi jātiṃ yatra prayujyate |
sambandhisadṛśāddharmāt taṃ gauṇamapare viduḥ || 273 ||
sādṛsyamidānīṃ nimittatvenāha--
gośabdo gotvajātiṃ vināpi svavyaktigataguṇasādṛśyād bāhīke prayujyata iti sādṛśyaṃ gauṇamukhyabhāve nimittam || 273 ||
viparyāsādivārthasya yatrārthāntaratāmiva |
manyante sa gavādistu gauṇa ityucyate kkacit || 274 ||
atha viparyāsameva nimittatvenāha--
arthasya bāhīkalakṣaṇasyārthāntaratāṃ gorūpatāṃ viparyāsādiva yatra manyante, tatra tasmiṃstadvācako gośabdaḥ pravṛtto gauṇa iti kkacinmatam | vipāryāsaścādhyava sāyena bhavati adhyāropeṇa ca | rajatamidamityatra viparyayādhyavasāya eva | iha tvadhyāropyagogatān guṇān bāhīke'dhyavasyatītyadhāropitatadbhāvo'yaṃ viparyāsaḥ | ata eva viparyāsādivetyuktam, tasmādadhyavasitatadbhāvanimittaprayukto nāsti gauṇamukhyavyavahāra iti || 274 ||
niyatāḥ sādhanatvena rūpaśaktisamanvitāḥ |
yathā karmasu gamyante sīrāsimusalādayaḥ || 275 ||
atha rūpaśaktinimittiko gauṇamukhyavyavahāra iti pakṣāntaraṃ dṛṣṭāntapradarśanapūrvakaṃ darśayitumāha--
khaḍ‌gagamānayetyukte sannaddhānāṃ saṃgrāmakathā vartata iti rūpaśaktimāhātmyādabhidhīyate | evaṃ sīrādiṣu || 275 ||
kriyāntareṇa caiteṣāṃ bhavanti nahi śaktyaḥ |
rūpādeva tu tādarthyaṃ niyamena pratīyate || 276 ||
kriyāntare latācchedādau naiteṣāṃ śaktayo bhavantīti vaktuṃ pāryate | tataśca rūpe niyata eva karmaṇi sāmarthyameṣāṃ vyavasīyata ityāha--
tathaiva rūpaśaktibhyāmutpacyā samavasthitaḥ |
śabdo niyatatādarthyaḥ śaktyā'nyatra prayujyate || 277 ||
prakṛte yojayitumāha--
utpattyā svabhāvenaiva | yathocyate--`autpattikaḥ śabdasyārthena sambandhaḥ |" sahaja eveti gamyate | anekaśaktisaddhāvāccānyatrāpi prayujyate || 277 ||
śrutimātreṇa yatrāsya tā(yā) darthyamavasīyate |
mukhyaṃ tamarthaṃ manyante gauṇaṃ yatropapāditam || 278 ||
tataśca gauṇamukhyabhāvaḥ kathamatra jñāyetetyāha--
gauṇaṃ catropapāditamiti tadabhidhānaśaktisadbhāve'pyaprasiddhatvādyatnena prakaraṇādinā gauṇatvādhyavasāya ityarthaḥ | tadevamarthaprakaraṇaśabdāntarasannidhānamātraṃ prasiddhyaprasiddhisahitaṃ cārthaprakaraṇādikamatrānādisamuccayena aṅgāṅgibhāvena ceti dvau pakṣau | nyūnādhikabhāvaḥ sādṛśyaṃ viparyāso rūpaśaktimati sapta pakṣāḥ | atrāthaprakaraṇamātraṃ purārādityādibhiratiprasaṅgādanimittameva | nyūnādhikabhāvasyāvyavasthiteranimittatvameva | sādṛśyasyāpi kāśyapapratikṛtiḥ kāśyapa ityādau nimittayukte'pi gauṇatvāsadbhāvādanimittataiva | pāriśeṣyāt prasiddhyaprasiddhisahitāḥ prakaraṇādayaḥ prakaraṇādisahite vā prasiddhyaprasiddhī viparyāso'dhyāropaḥ lakṣaṇau rūpaśaktiriti catvāraḥ prakārā gauṇamukhyayornimittatvaina parigṛhītāḥ | ityetairnimittaiḥ śabdopacāro'rthopacāro vā | sa ca dvividhaḥ--vākyā (cyā) rthopacāraḥ svarūpopacāro vetyevaṃ gauṇamukhyavibhāgo mantavyaḥ || 278 || goyuṣmanmahatāṃ cvyarthe svārthādarthāntare sthitau | arthāntarasya tadbhāvastatra mukhyo'pi dṛśyate || 279 ||
idānīmetadeva lakṣye yojayitumāha-- gāvādīnāṃ śabdānāṃ svārthādarthāntare'gavādilakṣaṇo āśritapūrvāvasthopacaritottarāvasthātmake sthitau pravṛttau satyāmarthāntarasya bāhīkādestadbhāvo gāvādirūpatāpattilakṣaṇo yadā tadā gauṇo'rthasteṣāṃ dṛśyata iti boddhavyam | na kevalaṃ gauṇo'rthastathā yāvanmukhyo'pi dṛśyata iti boddhavyam | tatrāgaurgauḥ samapadyata go'bhavat; atvaṃ tvaṃ sampadyate tvadbhavatītyātrāgavi ayuṣmadi ca gorūpatā yuṣmadrapatā cottarāvasthā'vidyamānaivoparyata iti gauṇārthatā | amahān mahān, aśuklaḥ śuklaḥ sampadyateḥ mahad‌bhūtaścandramāḥ, śuklībhavati paṭa ityatra tūttarāvasthā vastusatyeveti mukhya evārthe mahacchuklīśabdau sthitāviti nāsti gauṇatvam | ataśca gau'bhavadityatra gauṇārthatvādodantasya nipātatve'pyoditi pragṛhyasaṃjñāyā nāstyeva prāptiḥ | tathā tvadbhavatītyatropacaritasya yuṣmadarthasya pratītergauṇārthatvādeva madhyamapuruṣasyāpyabhāvaḥ | yato gauṇamukyayormukhye sampratyaya iti bhāṣye sthāpitam | vārttikakārastu go'bhavadityatra cvyarthavṛttitvānnipātasya gośabdasya cvyarthalakṣaṇaṃ mukhyameva sarvamarthamavagacchan gauṇamukhyabhāvāsambhavamevābhimanyamānaḥ pragṛhyasaṃjñānivṛttaye `otaścvipratiṣedhaḥ' iti yatnamārābdhavān | bhāṣyakārastvabhiprāyānabhijña evāntaraṅgatvād gauṇamukhyayormukhye sampratyava ityevamtra (na) pragṛhyasaṃjñā | ato'ntaraṅgasya kāryasyāprāptiriti sthitam | nanu gauṇārthatve śabdānāṃ kāryāpravṛttau gaurbāhīkastiṣṭhati, gāṃ bāhīkamānayetyatra bṛd‌dhyātve (na) prāpnutaḥ | atra hyupacaritārtho gośabda iti ucyate--dvividhaṃ hi śabdānāṃ kāryamasti prātipadikakāryaṃ padakāryaṃ ca | tatra padakāryeṣu gauṇamukhyanyāyaḥ, na prātipadikakāryeṣu | padasya viruddhapadasāmānādhikaraṇyānyathānupapattyā gauṇārthatā, prātipadikasya prayogānarhasya padāntareṇa sāmānādhikaraṇyāsambhavād gauṇārthatā naiva niścetuṃ sakyate, prātipadikakāryaṃ ca vṛd‌dhyātve iti tatpravartata eva | taduktam--"arthāśraya etadevaṃ bhavati, śabdāśraye ca vṛd‌dhyātve" iti || 279 ||
mahacvaṃ śuklabhāvaṃ ca prakṛtiḥ pratipadyate | bhedenāpekṣitā sā tu gauṇatvasya prayojikā || 280 ||
tadevaṃ go'bhavat tvadbhavatīti cātra gauṇārthatve sid‌dhyatīṣṭaṃ mahad‌bhūtaścandramā ityatra tu candramasaḥ paurṇamāsyāṃ mahattvasya sadbhāvādanuparitatvamiti mahacchabdasya `ānmahata'ityādinā prāpnotyevātvamityāśaṅ‌kyātrāpi gaumārthatāṃ pratipādayitumāha-- mahad‌bhūtaścandramāḥ suklībhavati paṭa ityatrāpi prakṛtirmahattvaṃ śuklabhavanaṃ ca bhedenāśritapūrvāvasthopacaritottarāvasthatayaiva pratipadyate, tataśca yadyapi vastuvṛttyā eva evārthaḥ, tathāpi vaktrāpekṣitā āśritā satī gauṇatvaṃ prayojayati | etaduktaṃ bhavati--yadyapyatra mahattvaṃ śuklabhāvaśca tathaiva vidyate, tathāpyatra śabdavṛttyonmajjadrūpā prakṛtyavasthaivocyata iti tadāśrayeṇopacaritatvānmahattvasya na bhavatyatra mahacchabdasyāttvam | śuklībhavati paṭa ityasya kāryaṃ na kiñcidasti, arthapradarśanāya kevalamatra pradarśyate || 280 ||
agnisomādayaḥ śabdā ye svarūpanibandhanāḥ | saṃjñibhiḥ saṃprayujyante'prasiddhesteṣu gauṇatā || 281 ||
athāgnisomau māṇavakāvityatra saṃjñāśabdatvānmukhyārthatve `agneḥ stutsatomasomāḥ"  iti ṣatvaṃ kasmānna kriyata ityāha-- ihāgnisomādayaḥ śabdā devatāvācakāḥ svarūpanimittakāśca saṃjñābhūtārthavṛttayaśceti trividhāḥ sambhavanti | tatra devatāyāṃ svarūpanimitteṣu caite mukyārthā eva | tatra saṃjñāyāṃ gauṇateti | devatāyāmagnisomādayaḥ prarūḍhimupagatā māṇavake cāprasiddhā ityevamaprasid‌dhyā teṣāṃ gauṇārthatvamucyate, na tvadhyāropeṇeti boddhavyam | ataśca ṣatvāpravṛtireva || 281 ||
agnidattastu yo'gniḥ syāt tatra svārthopasarjanaḥ | śabdo dattārthavṛttitvād gauṇatvaṃ pratipadyate || 282 ||
yatra tvatasmiṃstadadhyāropeṇāgnisomādayaḥ pravartyante, tatra sphuṭaiva gauṇārthatā teṣāmityāha-- svārthaṃ devatālakṣaṇamupasarjanīkṛtyārthāntarameva tadavyāropeṇa yatrābhidadhati, tatra gauṇārthatvaṃ sphaṭamevaite śabdāḥ pratipadyanta iti boddhavyam || 282 ||
nimittabhedāt prakrānte śabdavyutpattikarmaṇi | hariścandrādiṣu suṭo bhāvābhāvau vyavasthitau || 283 ||
atha hariścandro māṇavaka ityatra suṭ‌samarthanārthaṃ prastotumāha-- hariścandrādiṣu suṭo bhāvābhāvau niyatāveva, yasmācchabdavyutpattikriyāyāṃ tatra nimittabhedaḥ samāśrīyate | ṛṣāvanādibhūte prasiddho hariścandraḥ sādhuḥ hariścandro yasyetyetasmiṃstu vyutpattikarmaṇyabhāva eva sphuṭa ityasāṅkaryameva || 283 ||
ṛṣyādau prāptasaṃskāro yaḥ śabdo'nyena yujyate | tatrāntaraṅgaḥ saṃskāro bāhye'rthe na nivartate || 284 ||
atha yadā purātanahariścandragatagumasaṃdarśanena sākṣāddhariścandro'yaṃ māṇavaka ityucyate, tadā kiṃ gauṇārthatvānna bhavitavyameva suṭetyasāṅkaryaṃ darśayitumāha-- hariścandraśabdastāvadṛṣāveva saṃskṛta uttarakālaṃ prāptasaṃskāraḥ sannasau yadā hariścandraguṇasadharmaṇyanyatra prayujyate tadāntaraṅgaḥ saṃskāro vākyārthavelāyāmarthāntarasambandhāvasare na nivartata iti vaiyākaraṇasamayaḥ | yathā kariṣyati śvaḥ, varṣaṇa gamiṣyatītyatra śvaḥ śabdasannadhānādbhaviṣyadanadyatanalakṣaṇakālaprādurbhāve bhaviṣyatsāmānyasamāśrayaṇena vihitasya lṛṭo na vivṛttiḥ kartum, evamatrāpi hariścandro māṇavaka iti gauṇārthatve'pi suṭ‌siddhireveti || 284 ||
atyantaviparīto'pi yadā yo'rtho'vadhāryate | yathāsaṃpratyayaṃ śabdastatra mukhyaḥ pravartaṃte || 285 ||
idānīṃ nyāyadarśanacchāyayā bauddha eva śabdārtho nāsti kaścicchabdeṣu gauṇamukyavibhāga ityāśaṅ‌kyāha-- iha vakturicchayā viṣayīkṛte'rthe kaścidyāvacchabdaḥ pravartate, tāvadyadā yathā viparyayeṇa cārthāvadhāraṇaṃ kriyate, tadā yathāsaṃpratyayaṃ pratyayānusāreṇaiva śabdaḥ pravartamānaḥ sarvatra mukyatayaiva pravṛtta iti vākye na śabdeṣu gauṇamukhyavibhāgaḥ kaścit || 285 ||
yadyapi pratyayādhīnamarthatatvāvadhāraṇam | na sarvaḥ pratyayastasminnasiddha iva jāyate || 286 || darśanaṃ salile tulyaṃ mṛgatṛṣṇādidarśanaiḥ | tulyatve darśanādīnāṃ na jalaṃ mṛgatṛṣṇikā || 287 || yadasādhāraṇāṃ kāryaṃ prasiddhaṃ rajjusarpayoḥ | tena bhedaḥ paricchedyastayostulye'pi darśane || 288 ||
idānīmatrāpi gauṇamukhyavibhāgaṃ samarthayituṃ satyāsatyavibhāgaṃ tāvadupakramitumāha-- prasiddhārthaviparyāsanimittaṃ yacca dṛśyate | yastasmāllakṣyate bhedastadasatyaṃ pracakṣate || 289 ||
atha darśaṃnasya viṣayāsatyatvenāpyasatyatvamupadarśayitumāha-- yacca naimittikadarśanaṃ prasiddhārthaviparyāsanimittamiti prasiddhaḥ satyarūpo'rthaḥ tasya viparīto yo mithyātvalakṣaṇastasya nimittaṃ kāraṇamindriyaviṣayagato doṣa iti | yaśca tasmādbhedo viśeṣo lakṣyate dvicandrādistaṃ tathābhūtaṃ darśanaviṣayaṃ pracakṣate || 289 ||
yacca nimnonnate citre sarūpaṃ parvaṃtādibhiḥ | na tatra pratighātādi kāryaṃ tadvat pravartate || 290 ||
punarapi darśanabhedamāha-- parvatādibhiḥ sarūpaṃ nimnonnata citrabhittau dṛśyate, na ca tāvatā tatra pratighātādikāryabhedo jñānāntareṇa tatra bhedāvagatirevetyarthaḥ || 290 ||
sparśaprabandho hastena yathā cakrasya santaḥ | na tathā'lātacakrasya vicchinnaṃ spṛśyate hi tat || 291 || vapraprākarātalpaiśca sparśanāvaraṇe yathā | nagareṣu na te tadvad gandharvanagareṣvapi || 292 || mugapaśvādibhiryāvān mukhyairarthaḥ prasādhyate | tāvānna mṛnmaye'pyasti tasmātte viṣayaḥ kanaḥ || 293 || mahānāvrayate deśaḥ prasiddhaiḥ parvatādibhiḥ | alpadeśāntarāvasthaṃ pratibimbaṃ tu dṛśyate || 294 || maraṇādinimittaṃ ca yathā mukhyā viṣādayaḥ | na te svapnādiṣu svasya tadvadarthasya sādhakāḥ || 295 ||
etadeva dṛṣṭāntāntaraiḥ pratipādayitumāha-- atra hastikān vikrīṇīte, aśvakān vikrīṇīte ityādau kāryabhedādeva bhedamavasāya kanpratyayāntān pratikṛtivācakānīritavāniti mṛgapaśvādibhirityasya ślokasyārthaḥ | anyat spaṣṭam || 291 - 295 ||
deśakālendriyagatairbhedairyad dṛśyate'nyathā | yathā prasiddhirlokasya tathā tadavasīyate || 296 ||
idānīmupasaṃhartumāha-- deśabhedenāsati viprakarṣarūpeṇa, kālabhedena yathā grīṣme marīcayo bhaumenoṣmaṇā spandamānā dūrasthasya jalajñānamupajanayanti, indriyabhedena yathā taimirikasya dvicandrajñānamupajanayanti tairdeśakālaṃndrigatairbhedairanyathā dṛśyamānaṃ vastu lokaprasiddhivaśād dārḍhyādārḍhyapratyayabhedenārthakriyābhedena ca yathāvadavaiparītyenādhyavasīyate || 296 ||
yaccopaghātajaṃ jñānaṃ yacca jñānamalaukikam | na tābhyāṃ vyavahāro'sti śabdā lokanibandhanāḥ || 297 ||
tataścedamatrārthatattvaṃ boddhavyamityāha-- upaghātajaṃ satyatva viparītaṃ graiṣmatimirikādijñānam, alaukikaṃ ca yadapi paramarṣoṇāṃ sambandhi jñānaṃ tābhyāmubhābhyāmapivyavahāranirvahaṇamaśakyamityatoyathaivā'visambādhaṃ lokaprasid‌dhyā sakalavyavahāranirbahaṇanipuṇaṃ jñānaṃ yathāvadarthatattvāvadhāraṇāya samāśrīyate | yathoktam -- "asamākhyeyatattvānāmarthānāṃ laukikairyathā | vyavahāre samākhyānaṃ tatprājño na vikalpayet || " iti,  tathaivārthasvarūpapratyāyanāya śabdā lokanibandhanā lokavyavahāranimittabhūtāḥ pravartamānāḥ prasid‌dhyaprasiddhibhyāmeva skhalad‌gatitvāskhalad‌gatitvābhyāṃ gauṇamukhyavibhāgamāpādayantīti bauddhe'pi śabdārthe vyavasthita eva gauṇamukyavibhāga iti siddham || 297 ||
ghaṭādiṣu yathā dīpo yenārthena prayujyate | tato'nyasyāpi sācivyāt sa karoti prakāśanam || 298 ||
evaṃ gauṇamukhyavibhāgamuktvā tatprasaṅgena ca satyāsatyavibhāgaṃ vidhāya punarapi śabdānāṃ mukyanāntarīyakavicāraṃ vaitatyena kartumāha-- iha yatpratipādanāya śabdāḥ prayujyante, tattasya prayojakaṃ mukhyaṃ tatpratipādanāvasare ca sannidhānādyadanyata pratyāyayati tattasya nāntarīyakamucyate | etad‌ dṛṣṭāntadvayena pradarśayati--ghaṭādiṣvityādinā | tatra yathā dīpa iti jñāpakadṛṣṭāntopadarśanaṃ ghaṭādiṣu jñāteṣu viṣayeṣu yathā jñāpako dīpo yenārthena ghaṭādijñāpanalakṣaṇena tataḥ prayojakādanyatprakāśaṃ nāntarīyakaṃ yathā karoti || 298 ||
saṃsargiṣu tathā'rtheṣu śabdo yena prayujyate | tasmāt prayojakādanyānapi pratyāyayatyasau || 299 ||
evaṃ dārṣṭāntike yojayitumāha-- yathā bhāva ityādāvartheṣu bahuṣu saṃsargiṣu mavyādyenārthena siddhatvādinā'sau bhāvaśabdaḥ prayujyate tasmādanyanapi liṅgasaṃkhyādīn nāntarīyakatayā sthitān sannidhānāt pratyāyayatyeveti boddhavyam || 299 ||
nirmanthana yathā'raṇyoragnyarthamupapāditam | dhūmamapyanabhipretaṃ janayatyekasādhanam || 300 ||
kārakahetudṛṣṭāntopadarśanārthamāha-- araṇyoḥ sambandhi yannirmathanaṃ tadagnyartham agniniṣpattaye, agnistasya grayojaka ityarthaḥ | yasmānnāntarīyakatayā dhūmamapyanupayoginaṃ janayatyeva | kīdṛśam ? ekasādhanamekahetukamityarthaḥ | araṇyorityanenottaraṇiradharāraṇiśca tatrocyata iti darśitam || 300 ||
yathā śabdo'pi kasmiścit pratyāyyārthe vivakṣite | avivakṣitamapyarthaṃ prakāśayati sannidheḥ || 301 ||
punarapi dārṣṭāntike yojayitumāha-- kasmiṃścit pratyāyye'rthe siddhatākhye dharme'vivakṣitamapyarthaṃ puṃstvaikatvalakṣaṇaṃ prakāśayati pratyāyati sannidhānāditi || 301 ||
yathaivātyantasaṃsṛṣṭastyaktumartho na śakyate | tathā śabdo'pi sambandhī pravivektuṃ na śakyate || 302 ||
nanvastu vastugatirīdṛśyeva, yathā dīpādinā nāntarīyakapratyāyanena prayojakaṃ prakāśyate tatsannidhānād nāntarīyakatayā'nyadapi ghaṭakuḍyādīti tatra yuktam, śabdastu yatpratipādanāya vaktrā pratipādayitumaṣṭaḥ, tathaiva bhūtvā tatpratipādanaṃ karotu;kiṃ tasya nāntarīyakapratyāyanenatyāśaṅkyāha-- yathā matsyamāṃsārthinā matsyamāṃsasaṃsṛṣṭastokatvakkaṇṭakādiranupayogyapi tyaktuṃ na śakyate, tathā śabdo'pyatyayantasambandhalliṅgasaṃkhyāpratipādakaḥ, tatra na kevalā prakṛtiḥ prayoktavyā, na ca kevalaḥ pratyaya iti pravivektuṃ parihartuṃ na śakyate || 302 ||
vyarthānāṃ sannidhāne'pi sati caiṣāṃ prakāśate (ne) | prayojako'rthaḥ śabdasya rūpābhede'pi śasyate || 303 ||
ataśca tatrārtheṣu bahuṣu sannihiteṣu kaḥ śabdasyārtho vācyaḥ syādityāha-- bahūnāṃ saṃsargiṇāmarthānāṃ tatra sannidhānādeteṣāṃ ca satyapi śabdād dīpādivāviśeṣeṇa prakāśane yamtasya prayojakaḥ; sa eva vācyo'rthaḥ, anyo nāntarīyakaḥ na tasya prayojakatvaṃ tatrāpi rūpasyābhede samānarūpatve iti|| 303 ||
kkacid guṇapradhānatvamarthānāmavivakṣitam | kkacit sānnidhyamapyeṣāṃ pratipattāvakāraṇam || 304 || yaccānupāttaṃ śabdena tatkasmiṃścit pratīyate | kkacit pradhānamevārtho bhavatyanyasya lakṣaṇam || 305 ||
etadeva vaitatyena prakārabhedadarśanapūrvakamāha-- atra ca guṇapradhānatāviparyayaḥ padārthaikadeśāvivakṣā sakalapadārthāvivakṣā, upāttapadārthāparityāgainaivānyārthopalakṣaṇamityevamanena ślokadvayena prakāracatuṣṭayasyoddeśaḥ kṛtaḥ || 304 - 305 ||
ākhyātaṃ taddhitārthasya yatkiñcidupadarśakam | guṇāpradhānabhāvasya tatra dṛṣṭo viparyayaḥ || 306 ||
athādyaprakārapradarśanārthamāha-- tenadīvyatītyākhyātaṃ taddhitārthasya nimittatvenoktam | ataśca tatra kriyāpradhānamākyātamiti tadarthasyaiva taddhitāntādavagatiḥ syāt | yataśca tatra kriyāpradhānatve'pi cākhyātasya taddhitaḥ svabhāvāt sādhanapradhāna iti sādhanārthasyaiva prādhānyenāvagatiriti | tena dīvyatyādau nirdeśe guṇapradhānabhāvo na vivakṣitaḥ, akṣakaraṇakadevanādikriyākartṛmātrameva tatra prayojakamiti sa eka mukhyo'rthaḥ | vakṣyati ca-- "guṇapradhānatābhedaḥ puruṣādiviparyayaḥ | nirdiṣṭasyānyathā śāstre nityatvānna virudhyate || yathānirdeśamarthāḥ syuryeṣāṃ śāstraṃ vidhāyakam | kiñcitsāmānyamāśritya sthite tu pratipādanam || yo'śve yaḥ pīṭha ityatra bhūtayoraśvapīṭhayoḥ | yathopalakṣaṇārthatvaṃ tathārtheṣvanuśāsanam ||"iti || 306 ||
nirdeśe liṅgasaṃkhyānāṃ sannidhānamakāraṇam | pramāṇameva hrasvādāvanupāttaṃ pratīyate || 307 ||
atha kkacit sānnidhyamityetasya pratipādanāyāha-- siddhalakṣaṇo bhāvo ghañādīnāṃ nimittatvenābhīṣṭa iti tatpratipādanāya bhāva ityasmin nirdeśe liṅgasaṃkhyayornāntarīyakatayā pratipattāvapi sannidhānamakāraṇam, na tatra tayoḥ prayojakatvamiti yāvat | nanu nāntarīyakatayā pratipattau kathaṃ kkacit sānnidhyamapyeṣāṃ pratipattāvakāraṇamityuktam | prayojakārthavat tad‌vyavahāraparyantāyāṃ pratipattāvakāraṇamityabhiprāyaḥ | idānīṃ yaccānupātmatamityetasya pratipādanāyāha--pramāṇameveti | iha udāttānudāttasvarasamāhāraḥ svarita ityuktam, hrasvadīrghaplutāśca mātrikadvimātrikatrimātralakṣaṇā udāttānudāttasvarasamāhārarūpā bhavanti | tatra hrasvasvaritādīnāṃ kiyadudāttaṃ kiyadanudāttam ? ādau kimudāttamathānudāttaṃ madhye'nte veti sandehāpākaraṇāyoktam--"tasyādita udāttamardhahrasvam" iti | atra cārddhahrasvagrahaṇamarddhamātrālakṣaṇasya pramāṇasyopalakṣaṇamiti tadeva tasmāt pratīyate ityardhahrasvagrahaṇapratipādyasyāpradhānasyāvivakṣaivoktā || 307 ||
hrasvasyārddhaṃ ca yad dṛṣṭaṃ tattasyā'sannidhāvapi | hrasvasya lakṣaṇārthatvāt tadvadevābhidhīyate || 308 ||
etadeva pradarśayitumāha-- ataśca hrasvasyārdhaṃ ca dṛṣṭamardhamātrātmakaṃ tattasya hrasvasyāsannidhāvapi dīrghaplutayorapyādibhūtārddhamātrodāttetyucyate | kasmādityāha--hrasvasya lakṣaṇāparthatvāditi | arddhahrasvamityatra hrasvagrahaṇaṃ mātrāyā upalakṣaṇārtham | ato dīrghaplutayorapyādibhūtārddhamātrodātteti boddhavyam | etadevānyairuktam--ardhahrasvamityanenārddhamātrā lakṣyate hrasvagrahaṇamatantramiti | tasmād‌dhrasvasyātra lakṣaṇārthatvād dīrghaplutayorapyarddhamātrodāttā bhavatītyabhidhīyate | kiṃvadityāha--tadvadeveti | yathā tasya hrasvasyārddhamātrocyate, tathā tadasannidhau dīrghaplutayorapītyarthaḥ || 308 ||
dīrghaplutābhyāṃ tasya syād mātrayā vā viśeṣaṇam | jātervā lakṣaṇā yasmāt sarvathā saptaparṇavat || 309 ||
athavā prakāratrayamatra pratipādyate, tatrādyaprakāramāha-- hrasvagrahaṇena "ū3kālo'jjhrasvadīrghaplutaḥ" ityatraikayoganirdiṣṭatvād dīrghaplutāvapi lakṣyete, tataśca dīrghaplutābhyāṃ tasyārddhasyāvacchedaḥ syāt | viṣamavibhāge'pyarddhaśabdo dṛṣṭo gramārddhaṃ nāgarārghamiti | tathā'treti dīrghaplutayorapyarddhamātrodāttā bhavati | dvitīyaṃ prakāramāha-- mātrayā athavārddhasyāvacchedaḥ, hrasvasaṃjñakatvasyāvivakṣitatvāt | etacca nidarśitaṃ hrasvasyārddhamityanena | athavā nirastāva yavavibhāgo'rddhahrasvaśabdo'khaṇḍa evārddhamātrājāteḥ saptaparṇādivadupalakṣaka iti | tṛtīyamatra prakāramāha--jāterveti || 309 ||
gantavyaṃ dṛśyatāṃ sūrya iti kālasya lakṣaṇe | jñāyatāṃ kāla ityetatsopāyamabhidhīyate || 310 ||
idānīṃ kkacit pradhānamevārtho bhavatyanyasya lakṣaṇamiti vyākhyātumāha-- pathikaiḥ kkaciditthamabhidhīyate tvaryatāmadyāparo'dhvā gantavyaḥ sūryaśca dṛśyatāmityatra sūryadarśavanaprādhānyena śabdaḥ śrūyamāṇo jñāyatāmalpīyāna bhāgo'hnaḥ pariśiṣyata ityarthasya sopāyasya saniścasyopalakṣakaḥ sampadyata iti pradhānenārthenānyārthopalakṣaṇamiti lakṣitaparārtho mukhyaḥ śaktyartho'pi na tyakta iti ||310||
vidhyatyadhanuṣetyatra viśeṣeṇa nidaryate | sāmānyamāśrayaḥ śakteryaḥ kaścatpratipādakaḥ || 311 ||
etadeva ślokatrayeṇa śāstralokayorudāharaṇeṣu vitatya pradarśayitumāha-- adhanuṣetyanena viśeṣaṇa karaṇasāmānyamtraṃ nidarśyate | tatkīdṛśamityāha--śakteḥ karaṇaśarkerāśrayo'dhikaraṇamātram tataśca tasyā yaḥ kaścitpratipadāka upādīyate | etaduttaṃ bhavati--karaṇaniṣedhaparāyāṃ codanāyāṃ dhanurlakṣaṇasya viśeṣasyāparityāgenaiva karaṇamātrasya mukhyatvamiti (lakṣyatvamiti) śāstrīyamudāharaṇam | uktaṃ ca--"vidhyatya-karaṇenetītarathā hyatiprasaṅgaḥ"  iti || 311 ||
kākebhyo rakṣyatāṃ sarpiriti bālo'pi coditaḥ | upaghātapare vākye na śvādibhyo na rakṣati || 312 ||
viśeṣābhidhāyake'pi vākye sāmānyamātrameva prayojakaṃ loke'pi dṛśyata ityāha sarpiṣaḥ kākebhyo rakṣaṇamatra viśiṣṭameva vihitamapyupaghātamātranivāraṇaphale paryavasyatīti tadeva tatra prayojakaṃ boddhavyam || 312 || prakṣālanaṃ śarāvāṇāṃ sthālīnāṃ mārjanaṃ tathā | anuktamapi rūpeṇa bhujyaṅgatvāt pratīyate || 313 ||
kkacit sākṣādanuktamapi mukyārthanāntarīyakatayā pratipadyata eveti darśayitumāha-- bhojanamasyopapādyatāmityatra bhojanopapādanaṃ śabdaḥ pratyāyayaṃstadaṅgānāmāsanadānapātraprakṣālanādīnāṃ nāntarīyakatayā pratyāyanaṃ karotyevam | prakṣālane iti vā pāṭhaḥ | śarāvāṇāṃ prakṣālane śabdanopātte sthālīnirmārjanādyanuktamapi sambhavād bhujyaṅgatvāt pratīyata eveti | tadevam "prayojakamidaṃ teṣāmatredaṃ nāntarīyakam" ityetadeva vitatya prasaṅgādvaicitryeṇopadarśitam | evam `pramāṇamarddhahrasvādau" ityādinā "prakṣālanaṃ śarāvāṇām"ityantena pranthena yaccānupāttamityādiśloko vyākhyātaḥ | etena ślokena prakāradvayena lakṣaṇāpradarśitā | kadācinmukhyārthatyāgenaivānyasyopalakṣaṇametadevāvivakṣitavācyamucyate | kadācinmukhyārthāvirāmopāyapūrvakamanyārthopalakṣaṇametadeva vivakṣitānyaparavācyamuktaṃ vijñeyam | ityevaṃ mukhyanāntarīyakavibhāga upadarśitaḥ || 313 ||
vākyāt prakaraṇādarthādaucityād deśakālataḥ | śabdārthāḥ pravibhajyante na rūpādeva kevalāt || 314 ||
athātredaṃ gauṇamidaṃ mukhyamidaṃ nāntarīyakamityevaṃ śabdarthanirṇayaprastāve tattanniścayopāyānupadarśayitukāma āha-- tatra vākyācchabdārthanirṇayo yathā kaṭaṃ karoti bhīṣmamudāraṃ darśanīyamiti tulyāyayāmapi śrutau yadā kaṭasyaiva karotikriyayā sambandhaḥ, tadā dravyasya ca nirguṇasyānupapatterguṇānāṃcaniradhikaraṇānāmasambhavādākāṅ‌kṣādinā tatsāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ vākyīyāt samanvayāditi bhīṣmagumānvitasyaiva kaṭasya karaṇaṃ vākyārthaḥ | vakṣyati ca "āśrayāśrayimorvākyād nirṇayastvavatiṣṭhate" iti | tathā ca śāstre " karmaṇi dvitīyā" ityādīni pṛthagava prakaraṇāni viracitāni | tatra prātipadikādanabhihite karmādau yadekatvādi tatra dvitīyādyā vibhaktayo bhavantītyevamarthasya saṅgaterākāṅ‌kṣādivaśād bhinneṣvapi prakaraṇeṣu tātparyālocanake śrotarivākyīyaḥ sambandho'thaniścayāya paryavasyatīti vākyācchabdārthanirṇayaḥ | tathātra prakaraṇamapyaśabdaṃ śabdārthanirṇanimittam, yathā saṃgrāmaprastāve saindhavānāṃ codananaśvānayanaparyavasāyi bhavati, bhojanaprastāve tu tadeva lavaṇapratītimupajanayatīti | śāstre yathā dhātuprakaraṇād dhāturityuktam | tathā cobhayāvagatau satyām "kartṛkaraṇayostṛtīyā" ityatra kārakāṇāṃ prakāntatvāt karaṇaśabdena kriyāgrahaṇaṃ na vijñāyate, śabdavairetyādau sūtre ca dhātvadhikāre kāraṇaśabdāt kriyā pratīyata iti | arthastu śābdatvācchabdārthanirṇayaṃ prakalpayati, yathā añjalinā juhoti, añjalinā sūryamupatiṣṭhate, añjalinā pūrṇapātramāharatītyatra juhotityādyathavaśād vibhinnārthavācako'ñjaliśabdaḥ | śāstre'pa pūraṇaguṇasuhitārthetyatra guṇena saha ṣaṣṭī na samasyata ityarthasāmarthyādadeṅāmasampratyayaḥ | tathā "na śasadadavādiguṇānām" ityatranāśrayiṇo grahaṇaṃ bhavatyarthāditi | aucityādapi śabdārthavyavasthānaṃ dṛśyate, yathā sīrāsimusalaiḥ kevalairanirdiṣṭakriyāparairapyaucityād vilekhanayuddhāvahananalakṣaṇasamucitakriyāpadākṣepe śabdārthanirṇayaḥ paryavasyati | yathā vā praṣṭhādayaḥ śabdā agragāmitvādinimittasamāśrayaṇena pravarttamānāstasya ca nimittasyaucityāt puṃsyeva sambhavāt puṃśabdāsta ucyante tadyogāt striyāṃ vartante na sākṣāditi praṣṭhasambandha eva praṣṭhyādīnām "puṃyogādākhyām " ityanenanimittatvenopadarśitaḥ | yathā ca "yaśva nimbaṃ paraśunā yaśvainaṃ madhusarpiṣā | yaścainaṃ gandhamālyābhyāṃ sarvasya kaṭureva saḥ || " ityatrānuraktakriyāpadāni sādhanānyevaucityavaśāt svasamucitakriyāpadavagatyā avāntaravākyopaplāvanapratyāyanapūrvakāprastutapraśaṃsālakṣaṇasya vākyārthasya pratītimupajanayanti | tathā ca yo nimbaṃ paraśunā chinatti yaścainaṃ gandhenānulimpati sarvasya tasya dustyajā prakṛtiriti kṛtvā kaṭureva daurmanasyadānanipuṇa eveti kasyacit khalatvapratipādanamatra tātparyārthaḥ | śāstre yathā--`puṃyogādākyāyām"  ityatroktaṃ puṃsiśabdapravṛttinimittasya sambhavāt puṃśabdā eta iti | deśācchabdārthanirṇayo yatā mathurāyāḥ prācīnādudīcīnādvā nagarādagacchāmītyukte nagaraviśeṣāt pāṭaliputrādāgacchāmīti gamyate | pāṭaliputrasya mathurāsambandhinośca prācīnodīcīnabhāgayorvidyate pratyāsattiriti kṛtvā deśavaśādatra nirṇayaḥ | kālāt khalu vyavasthā dṛśyate, yathā śiśire dvāramityukte pidhehīti, grīṣmasamaye tvevamabhidhāne samud‌ghāṭayeti gamyate | etacca śabdārthanirṇayopāyānāṃ diṅ‌mātrapradarśanaṃ boddhavyam | anye'pi sanniścayāya prakārā anusandhātavyāḥ | ślokavaśāccodāharaṇamātrameva darśitamiti mantavyam | sarvathā na rūpamātrācchabdārthapravibhāganirṇayaḥ kartuṃ śakya iti pratipādayitumuktam--na rūpādeva kevalāditi || 314 ||
saṃsargo viprayogaśca sāhacaryaṃ virodhitā | arthaḥ prakaraṇaṃ liṅgaṃ śabdasyānyasya sannidhiḥ || 315 || sāmarthyaṃmaucitī deśaḥ kālo vyaktiḥ svarādayaḥ | śabdārthaṃsyānavacchede viśeṣasmṛtihetavaḥ || 316 ||
tathā cāparaiḥ saṃsargādayaḥ śabdārthāvacchedahetavaḥ pradarśitā ityāha-- iha kaiścidarthabhedācchabdabhedo'bhyupagataḥ, tadaparairekaśabdateti dvau pakṣau | tatra nānātvapakṣe svabhāvabhinneṣu tulyaśrutiṣu rūpābhedānavacchinneṣu nimittāntaraiḥ saṃsargādibhiravacchadaḥ kriyate | ekatvapakṣe tvarthābhidhāne bhinnāsu śaktiṣu śrutisārūpayamātrādalabdhavibhāgāsu tathaiva saṃsargādibhirarthanirṇayaḥ kriyata ityubhayatrāpi prakaraṇādayaḥ śabdārthanirṇayanipuṇā iti tadupanyāsaḥ kathyate | tadatra kecit sāmarthyemevaikaṃ śabdārthanirṇayanimittamiti manyante | yo'pyarthaprakaraṇādinā tatra bhedaḥ samadhigamyate, so'pi sāmarthyādevātra pratīyata iti kathayanti| sāmarthyameva hi saṃsargādibhirvyajyata iti | tatra saṃsargādyathā saṃsargādyathā sakiśorā dhenurānīyatāmityatra niyatena saṃsargiṇā kiśoralakṣaṇena viśeṣāvasāya nimittena vaḍavāyā eva sampratyayaḥ , yathā ca savatsā dhenurityatra vatsasaṃsargād gordhenoreva sampratyaya iti saṃsargādarthanirṇayaḥ | rūḍhyā gaureva dhenurucyate iti tu yeṣāṃ darśanaṃ teṣāmatra saṃsargo viśeṣasampratyaye nopayujyata iti boddhavyam | śāstre yathā `āvād graḥ "  ityatra yasyāvenopasargeṇa sambandhaḥ sambhavati sa eva gṛhyate giratiḥ, gṛṇotestu svabhāvādarthavirodhādeva saṃbandho nopapadyata eva | tathā saṃsargavadviprayogo'pyavacchedahetuḥ | yathā nirjñātasambandhasyocyate akiśorā dhenuḥ avatsā akarabhāvā ānīyatāmiti kiśorādiviprayogena viśiṣṭajātīyāyā eva dhenoravagatirupajāyata iti | śāstre'pi "bhujo'navane"  iti yasya bhujeravanamanavanaṃ cārthastasya grahaṇaṃ vijñāyate, na tu kauṭilyārthasya | nirbhujati pāṇimiti | sāhacaryādyathā rāmalakṣmaṇāvityukte lakṣmaṇasāhacaryād dāśarathereva pratītiḥ | atra yadyapyeko dṛṣṭavyabhicārasāhacaryāt tattuvalyadharmā jñāyata iti boddhavyam| śāstre yathā "viparābhyāṃ jeḥ"  ityatra parāśabdo'dṛṣṭavyabhicāreṇa vinā sāhacaryādupasarga eva guhyate | yadyapi bahuvivanamityādau viśabdo'nupasargo'sti, tathāpi samudāyo'rthavān | jahatsvārthāvṛttipakṣe'vayavā anarthakā eva | ajahatsvārthāvṛttipakṣe kathamupasargabhāvamāpanno viraprādhānyād grahītumaśakya eveti nāsti viranupasargaḥ | vījayate ityatra tu vīśabdo na viśabda iti | bhāṣye'pyuktamasya gordvitīyenārtha iti gaureva pratīyate, nāśvo na gardabha iti | yathā ca "antarāntareṇa yukte"  ityatra dvāvapi ṭāptṛtīyāntayoḥ sambhavād dṛṣṭāpacārau | ataḥ parasparasāhacaryānnipātayoreva grahaṇamityevaṃsāhacayamarthanirṇayahetuḥ śabdānām | virodhādapyartho'vadhāryate, yathā rāmārjunāvityatrārjunasannidhāne nisargavairiṇo jāmadagnyasyaiva pratītiḥ | arthaprakaraṇadeśakālaucityairviśeṣe'vasthāpanaṃ vākyadarśitam | liṅgācca vākyāntare dṛṣṭād bhedaḥ prasiddhaḥ pratīyate, yathā aktāḥ śarkarā upadadhātītyatrānekasyāñjanadravyasya sabhave tejoghṛtasya stutiruktaḥ | etasmālliṅgād ghṛtasādhanatvamañcikriyāyāḥ śarkarākarmikāyā nirddhāryate | tathā paśumālabhetetyatra paśutvasaṃbandhiṣu prāṇiṣu satsu chāgasya haviṣo vapāya medasa iti liṅgacchāgaikārthasamavāyi paśutvaṃ pratīyate | śāstre'pyūhyam | śabdāntarasannidhānādapi viśeṣāvagatiḥ | yathā arjjunaḥ kārtavīryo rāmojāmadagnya iti | samārthyādviśeṣapratipattiryathā--anudarā kanyeti | sāmarthyādudaraviśeṣapratiṣedhapratītiḥ | tathā--abhirūpāya kanyā deyeti | abhirupava (ta) rāyeti sāmarthyāt pratīyate | śāstre'pi "prathamānirdiṣṭaṃ samāsa upasarjanam " iti samāsārthe śāstre samāsaśabdasya pravṛttiḥ | "ekavibhakti cāpūrvanipāte"  ityatra yaḥ samāsaśabdo'numīyate tasya prāthamakalpika eva | vṛttirvyaktirliṅgam | tasmānnirṇayo yathā tad‌gramasyārthaṃ labhetetyatrasamapravibhāge'rdhaśabdo napuṃsakena parāmarśāt (grāmasyārdhaṃ svayameva pratīyate) | śāstre'pyūhmam | svarādyathā sthūlapṛṣatīmālabhetetyatrāntodāttasya śravaṇāt sthūlā cāsau pṛṣatītyevaṃvidhārthapratītiḥ | pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvadarśane sthūlāni pṛṣanti yasyāmityanyapadārthapratītiḥ | tathā vaipāśaḥ kūpa ityatrādyudāttasyāśravaṇādvipāśa uttarasya viśiṣṭasyaiva pratītiḥ | antodāttaśravaṇe tadviparītasyeti | sattvādyathā susiktamatistutamityādau pūjātikramaṇayoḥ karmapravacanīyasaṃjñāyāmupasargatvābhāve tayoreva pratipattiḥ | upasargasaṃjñāyāṃ tu satyāṃ suṣiktaṃ suṣṭutamityādau ṣatvapravṛtterarthāntarasya pratipattiḥ | ṇatvanatvābhyāṃ yathā praṇāyaka ityatropasargāśrayaṇatvasadbhāve praṇayanakriyākartuḥ pratītiḥ, ṇatvābhāve tu pragatā nāyakā asmād deśādasau pranāyako deśa ityasya padārthapratītiriti | tadevamete śabdarthasya sandehanirākaraṇadvāreṇa niyatārthāvasāyahetutvādviśeṣasmṛtihetavo nirṇayahetavaḥ saṃsargādaya iti boddhavyam || 315-316 ||
bhedapakṣe'pi sārūpyādbhinnārthāḥ pratipattiṣu | niyatā yāntyabhivyaktiṃ śabdāḥ prakaraṇādibhiḥ || 317 ||
na tvekatvadarśane bhedābhāvācchabdānāmathasya sandehe tannirṇayāya prakaraṇādaya ucyanta iti śobhanam, bhedapakṣe tu vibhinnatvādeva śabdastadarthapratyāyanaṃ kariṣyatītyāśaṅ‌kya tatrāpi rūpasādṛśyotpāditasaṃśītīnāṃ vyavahartṝṇāṃ prakaraṇādibhireva śabdārthanirṇaya iti pratipādayitumāha-- bhedapakṣe'pi pratipattiṣu bhinnārthā api śabdāḥ sārūpyādabhinnā iveti prakaraṇādibhirevoktasvarūpairniyatā avacchinnā arthābhivyaktāvupayogaṃ yāntīti na kutracit prakaraṇādimantareṇa śabdārthanirṇaya iti boddhavyam || 317 ||
nāmākhyātasarūpā ye kāryāntaranibandhanāḥ | śabdā vācyāśca teṣvartho na rūpādadhigamyate || 318 ||
yuktaṃ caitat , kasmādityāha-- iha vākye nāmarūpā ākhyātaśabdā api sambhavanti | yathā aśva iti ṭu ośvi gativṛddhyorityasmālluṅi madhyamapuruṣaikavacane sipi `nityaṃ ṅitaḥ"  "itaśca"  itīkāralope clipratyasya `jṝstambhumrucu'  ityādinā caṅādeśe śvayaterantasyāto guṇarūpatve sakārasya rutvavisarjanīyayoḥ kṛtayorluṅ‌lṛṅ‌kṣvityādinā'ṭi kṛte aśva ityākhyātapadaṃ śvayati kriyāyāḥ kartravacchinnāyā atītakālāyāḥ pratipādakam, aśva iti ca nāmapadamaśvajātīyasyārthasya sattvabhūtasyābhidhāyakamiti sārūpyāt sandehe prakaraṇādibhirarthavyavasthā | yathā'jāpaya ityetad ji jaye ityasmāddhātoḥ kaścidajeyaṃ jitavān tamanyo'nuprayuktavānityarthavivakṣāyāṃ hetvarthe ṇici "krīṅ‌jīnāṃ ṇau" ityātve `artihrīvlī' tyādinā puki jāpītyevaṃsthite laṅi śapi guṇāyadeśayoḥ kṛtayoḥ sakārasya satvavisarjanīyayośca `luṅ‌laṅi' tyādinā aḍāgame ca kṛte'jāpaya ityākhyātam | athavā'jāyāḥ payo'jāpaya ityapi nāmapadaṃ tatsadṛśamittyarthādinā tanniścayaḥ | ākhyātasarūpāśca nāmaśabdāstena yasya tasyetyādayaḥ | tathā tanu vistāre ityasmālliṭi madhyamapuruṣabahuvacane dvirvacane kṛte "ata ekahalmadhye" ityādinā etvābhyāsalopayoḥ kṛtayostene tyākyātm, tacchabdasyatṛtīyāntasya sadṛśamiti | tasu upakṣaye, yasu prayatne ityābhyāṃ vidhyādau loṭi tasya ca sipi "serhyapicca"  iti hyādeśe divāditvācch‌yano'nubandhalope "ato heḥ"  iti herluki tasya yasyetyākhyātapadaṃ yattadoḥ ṣa ṣṭhyekavacanāntayoḥ sadṛśamiti sārūpyāt sandehe prakaraṇādibhistanniścīyate | kīdṛśāḥ ? kāryāntaranibandhanāḥ | kāryāntaraṃ viśiṣṭapratyayalakṣaṇaṃ prakaraṇādinā tannibandhanaṃ nimittaṃ yeṣāṃ te tathābhūtāḥ | teṣu na rūpamātrādartho'vagamyate | tasmāt tvamaśvo'jāpayaḥ śatrubhavanānītyādivākyārthaparyālocanayaivārthanirṇayaḥ | āha ca "nahi kiñcitpadaṃ nāma rūpeṇa niyataṃ kkacit | padānāmartharūpaṃ ca vākyārthādeva jāyate || " iti || 318 ||
yā pravṛttinivṛttyarthā stutinindāprakalpanā | kuśalaḥ pratipattā tāmayathārthā pratīyate || 319 ||
atha śabdārthanirṇayaprastāve padapadārthānāmasatyatvamakhaṇḍasyaiva ca vākyārthasya satyatvamabhyupagantavyamiti pradarśayitumāha-- yā pravṛttaye stutiprakalpanā nivṛttaye ca nindāprakalpanā prekṣāvān ayathārthāmabhimanyate | paramārthatastu tathāvidhasya vākyasya pravartasva nivartasveti vā satyabhūtaṃ vākyārthaṃtatrāvagacchatītipadapadārthapratyayaḥ sarvatrāsatya eveti saivaiṣāṃ tātparyaśaktiriti kaiścid vyavasthāpitam || 319 ||
vidhīyamānaṃ yatkarma dṛṣṭādṛṣṭaprayojanam | stūyate sā stutistasya katureva prayojikā || 320 ||
etadeva prakaṭīkartumāha-- dṛṣṭaprayojanaṃ kiñcitkarma stūyate, yathā yo rājānaṃ bhajate sa sāraṃ bhuṅ‌kte| adṛṣṭaprayojanamapi-yo'griṣṭomena yajate sa svargaṃ gacchatīti vilakṣaṇaḥ pravṛttinivṛttiprayojano'nya evāvibhāgo vākyārthastathāvidhavākyanibandhana evābhyupagantavya iti sthitam || 320 ||
vyāghrādivyapadeśena yathā bālo nivartyate | asatyo'pi tathā kaścit pratyavāyo vidhīyate || 321 ||
nanu kathaṃ na tatraspaṣṭameva kṛtvā pravṛttinivṛttī vidhīyete, kimanupayoginindādyarthapratipādanāsaṃbhāreṇetyāśaṅ‌kyāha-- yathā rudantaṃ vyāghro bhakṣayatīti, bālasyocyate na tatra vyāghrabhakṣaṇaṃ vastusthityā saṃbhavi, kevalaṃ mā kadācit tvaṃ rodīriti rodananiṣedha eva tasya kriyate, tathā tatra pratiṣiddhācaraṇānnarakapāto bhavatītyetāvanmātraṃ pratigrāhyata iti tattadarthasamāśrayaṇena satyarūpapadapadārthābhyupagamo na yuktaḥ || 321 ||
na saṃvidhānaṃ kṛtvāpi pratyavāye tathāvidhe | śāstreṇa pratiṣiddhe'rthe vidvān kaścit pravartate || 322 ||
tathā pratyavāyopadeśena ca yacchāstreṇa pratiṣiddhaṃ na tatrāhopuruṣikayā pratyavāyasaṃvidhānamāracayya prekṣāpūrvakāriṇaḥ pravṛttirucitetyāha-- sarpeṣu saṃvidhāyāpi siddhairmantrauṣadhādibhiḥ | nānyathā pratipattavyaṃ na dato gamayediti || 323 ||
dṛṣṭaprayojanapratyavāyapratividhānanidarśanapūrvakametadeva vyākhyātumāha-- `na dato gamayed yaddato gamayet sarpā enaṃ ghātukā bhavanti" ityanena puroḍāśasya dantopadaṃśanapūrvakaṃ bhojanaṃ niṣiddhyate yatra kaścit sarpāṇāṃ pratividhānaṃ mantrauṣadhādibhiḥ kṛtvā yadi tathā pravṛttastadā'nena śāstrānuṣṭhānaṃ parityaktamiti na śobhanamācaritam || 323 ||
kkacit tattvasamākhyānaṃ kriyate stutinindayoḥ | tatrāpi ca pravṛttiśca nivṛttiścopadiśyate || 324 ||
astvevaṃ vidhiniṣedhapareṣu stutyarthādīnāmasatyatvam, yatra tu stutininde eva prayojike tatra tadarthānāṃ satyasvamevocitamityāśaṅ‌kyāha-- yatrāpi kvacit stutinindayorviṣaye tayoḥ sambandhi vā tattvākhyānaṃ kriyate, tatrāpi sarvathā stutinindayoḥ kevalayorna kiñcit prayojanamutpaśyāma iti pravṛttinivṛttī evopadiśyete iti boddhabyam || 324 ||
rūpaṃ sarvapadārthānāṃ vākyārthopanibandhanam | sāpekṣā ye tu vākyārthāḥ padārthaireva te samāḥ || 325 ||
evaṃ padapadārthānāmastyatve vākyavākyārthayorakhaṇḍayoreva satyatve pratiṣṭhāpite padārthānāṃ svarūpasya vākyārtha eva nibandhanamiti darśayitumāha-- etasminma vākyārthe rūpanibaddhāste sāphalyaṃ bhajante, anyathā viśarārava eveti vākyārtha eva teṣāṃ parasparasamanvaye nibandhanam | vakṣyati ca-- pṛthag‌viśiṣṭatattvānāṃ pṛthagarthānupātinām | indriyāṇāṃ yathā kāryamṛte dehānna kalpate || tathā padānāṃ sarveṃṣāṃ pṛthagarthaniveśinām | vākyebhyaḥ pravibhaktānāmarthavattarne vidyate ||  iti | yathocyate--nahi kiñcidityādi | nanu vākyārthasyāpi kasyacidaparipūrṇatve kiṃ tasyāpyaparavākyārthanibandhanatvamaṅgīkāryamityāśaṅ‌kyāha--sāpekṣeti | etaduktaṃ bhavati--avāntaravākyārthāḥ sākāṅ‌kṣattvāt padārthatulyā eveti na tatra vākyārthavyapadeśaḥ kāryaḥ || 325 ||
vākyaṃ tadapi manyante yatpadaṃ caritakriyam | ākhyātaśabde niyataṃ sādhanaṃ yatra gamyate | tadapyekaṃ samāsārthaṃ vākyamityabhidhīyate || 326 ||
atha yatraikasmāt padānnirākāṅ‌kṣo'rthaḥ pratiyate, tatrāpi kiṃ tasyā'satyārthatvaṃ yuktamabhidhātumityāśaṅkyāha-- etaduktaṃ bhavati--santi vākyeṣu vākyaikadeśāḥ prasiddhyādinā vākyārthapratyāyakā iti | tadapyekapadaṃ vākyameva | yasmāttaccaritakriyamiti, caritā gārbhokṛtā ākhyātakriyā yasya tad‌garbhokṛnakriyāpadaṃ nāmapadaṃ vākyaṃ prayuñjate, caritakriyāpadādasmādarthāvagatirnirākāṅ‌kṣopajāyamānā dṛśyata itipadamātrasyaivātra vākyatvam | evaṃyathānāmapadaṃ kevalamapigarbhokṛtākhyātaṃ nirākāṅakṣārthapratyāyanādvākyameveti tatpratyāyitādarthāt pravṛttiparyantavyavahārasiddhau satyataiva tadarthasya, tathaivākhyātaṃ kevalamarthaucityādivaśādviśiṣṭābhidhāyakaṃ vākyamevocyata ityāha--ākhyāta iti | yathā varṣatītyukte devo jalamiti kartṛkarmākṣepāt paripūrṇārthatve varṣati devo jalamiti yathā vākyamevaṃ tadapyekaṃ padaṃ samāptārthaṃ paripūrṇārthaṃ vākyamevābhidhīyate | taduktamādāveva ākhyātaśabda iti vākyamityarthaḥ || 326 ||
śabdavyavahitā buddhiraprayuktapadāśrayā | anumānāt tadarthasya pratyaye heturucyate || 327 ||
atra mīmāsakaḥ prāha-- kevalāt padādyā sādhuvadbhāvanā buddhiḥ sā sādhuvattadarthasya tasyāprayuktasya padāntarasya yo'rthastasya heturucyate | kīdṛśī ?śabdavyavahitā | yathā dhūmena svārthānumāne śabdamantareṇa vahnerākṣepaḥ, naivamatrāpi | (kintu) śrutārthāpattyā parikalpito yo'sau tiṣṭhatyādiśabdaḥ, tena vyavahitā | atha tasyā'śravaṇāt kathaṃ tadavyavahitetyāśaṅ‌kyāha--aprayuktapadāśrayeti | aprayuktamanuccāritaṃ vācakaṃ śrutārthāpattyākṣiptamāśrayo dvāramupāyastiṣṭhatyādyarthapratyaye yasyā sā tatheti | kasmāttadarthasya pratyaye heturityāha--anumānāditi | tiṣṭhatyādikaṃ śabdaṃ śrutārthāpattyopasthāpitamanumāyākṣipyāsau buddhistadarthapratyayamupajanayatīti yāvat | ato na kevalameva nāmapadaṃ sakriyasyārthasya vācakam, ākhyātaṃ ca sasādhanasyeti kathamucyate ? santi vākyeṣu vākyaikadeśā vākyārthapratipādakā iti || 327 ||
yasmiṃstūccarite śabde yadā yo'rthaḥ pratīyate | tamāhurarthaṃ tasyaiva nānyadarthasya lakṣaṇam || 328 ||
śrutārthāpattyā śabdābhisambandhasya kiṃ prayojanamekapadādeva tasmād vṛkṣastiṣṭhatītyādivannirākāṅ‌kṣārthapratyāyanamuktaṃ kathaṃ vākyaikadeśasyasakalavākyārthapratipādakatvamantareṇa śabdāntaraparikalpanaṃ yujyata iti paramatamāśaṅ‌kyāha-- iha yasmāduccaritād yadarthapratyayo dṛśyate taṃ tasyārthamāhuḥ, vṛkṣa ityasmādeva cārthaprakaraṇādinā vṛkṣastiṣṭhatītyarthapratīteḥ | etadevārthavācakatvādvākyamityuktameva || 328 ||
kriyārthopapadeṣvevaṃ sthānināṃ gamyate kriyā | vṛttau nirādibhiścaiva krāntādyartho'vagamyate || 329 ||
evaṃ kṛtvā kriyārthopapadasyetyanena nārambhaṇīyaiva caturtho, tātarthyena siddhatvādityāha-- kriyārthopapadeṣu viṣaye kriyārthopapadānāṃ ceti ṣaṣṭhīprayoge saptamī | sthānināmaprayuktānāṃ dhātūnāṃ saṃbandhinī kriyāharaṇalakṣaṇā edhebhyo vrajatītyatraidhaśabda eva haraṇamabhidadhātītyedhāharaṇārthaṃ vrajatīti pratītiḥ | atastādarthyaṃ sphuṭameveti siddhā caturtho | evaṃ ca kṛtvā vṛttau nirādayaḥ krāntādyarthapratipādakā ityāha--vṛttāviti | niṣkauśāmbirityādau nirādaya eva sāmarthyāt krāntārthapratipādakā iti gatārthatvāt krāntādīnāṃ śabdānāṃ vṛttāvaprayoga eva | uktaṃ ca-- "upasargā hyevamātmakā yatra kriyāvācī śabdaḥ śrūyate tatra kriyāṃ viśiṃṣanti, anyatra kriyāviśiṣṭaṃ sādhanamāhuḥ " iti || 329 ||
tāni śabdāntarāṇyeva paryāyā iva laukikāḥ | arthaprakaraṇābhyāṃ tu teṣāṃ svārtho niyamyate || 330 ||
yadyevaṃ vṛbhastiṣṭhati, niṣkrāntaḥ kauśāmbyā ityādau tiṣṭhatyādīnāṃ kiṃ prayogeṇa kevalaṃ vṛkṣa ityādikaṃ sarvatra nāmapadamākhyātaṃ vā prayujyatāṃ kevalaireva sarvatra vākyārthapratipādanamityāha-- kevalo vṛkṣaśabdo vākyārthapratipādako'nya eva vṛkṣastiṣṭhatīti cānyadeva vākyaṃ sādṛśyād‌ vṛkṣastiṣṭhatītyatra vṛkṣaśabdaṃ vṛkṣa ityekapade vākye'bhimanyata iti | bhavatvevaṃ sarvadā vṛkṣaśabda eva kevalaḥ kiṃ na prayujyate ? tata eva hi sāmarthyādinā vṛkṣastiṣṭhatītyarthapratīteḥ kimanena vitatena vṛkṣastiṣṭhatītyādikena prayuktenetyāha--paryāyeti | etaduktaṃ bhavati -- laukike śabdavyavahāre lāghavaṃ pratyanādarāt kkacid vṛkṣaḥ kkacid vṛkṣastiṣṭhatīti prayudyate | yathā taruśabdenaiva lāghavād vṛkṣārthapratītau pādapaśabdaṃ prayuñjata eva laukikā iti na kañcid doṣaḥ | atha vṛkṣa iti kevalaṃ nāmapadaṃ kkacidvṛkṣo dṛsyatāṃ kkaścid vṛkṣo'stītyevaṃvidhasya niyatasyārthasya viśeṣabhedena kathaṃ pratipādakaṃ syādityāha--artheti | eṣāmekapadānāṃ vākyānāṃ pratiniyato'rtho'rthaprakaraṇābhyāṃ vyavasthāpyate || 330 ||
pratibodhābhyupāyāstu ye taṃ taṃ puruṣaṃ prati | nāvaśyaṃ te'bhisaṃbaddhāḥ śabdā jñeyena vastunā || 331 ||
evamakhaṇḍavākye vākyārthe satyarūpe sthite kiṃ padapadārthānāṃ vākyānāṃ padavibhāgapadabhāgārthakalpanayetyāha-- etaduktaṃ bhavati--ye vākyārthapratibodhanopāyāste pratiniyatapuruṣasamāśrayāḥ | te cāsatyarūpā eva ca padapadārthā ityāha--nāvaśyamiti | jñeyena vācyena vastunā satyarūpeṇa laukikena naiva te'vaśyaṃ saṃbaddhā ityāsatyabhūtā ityucyanta iti || 331 ||
asatyāṃ pratipattau ca mithyā vā pratipādane | svairarthairnityasambaddhāste te śabdā vyavasthitāḥ || 332 ||
atha yasminnuccarita ityādikaṃ yadi śabdārthalakṣaṇamāśrīyate, tadā śabdāduccaritāt pratipatturanyākṣittacittatvādakṛtasaṅketatvādvā'satyāmarthapratipattau kutaścid‌bhramādvā'nyathāpratipattau tadarthānavagateranityatvameva śabdārthasambandhasya syāt, na caitadyuktamiti śrutārthāpattivādī pratipādayitumāha-- te te śabdā nityatvācchabdasambandhasya niyatārthapratipādakā eva vyavasthitāḥ || 332 ||
yathāprakaraṇaṃ dvāramityasyāṃ karmaṇaḥ śrutau | badhāna dehi vetyetadupāyādadhigamyate || 333 ||
kutaścinnimittādarthānavagatau śabdārthasambandhahāniḥ prāpnoti, tasmādekapadeṣu padāntarādhyāhāreṇa vākyārthāvagatirupapanneti pratipādayitumāha-- prakaraṇānatikrameṇa sādhanaṃ kriyāyā avinābhāvitayā ākṣepakaṃ bhavatīti dvāraṃdvāramityatra karmaśrutirbadhāna dehi vetyetamarthaṃ prakaraṇāderupāyāttadvācakadvāreṇākṣipatītyetadeva yuktam || 333 ||
yatra sādhanavṛttiryaḥ śabdaḥ sattvanibandhanaḥ | na sa pradhānabhūtasya sādhyasyārthasya vācakaḥ || 334 ||
evaṃ `yasminnuccarite' ityādike śabdārthalakṣaṇe śabdārthasambandhasyānityatvamabhidhāya dūṣaṇāntaramabhidhātumāha-- svārthamātra prakāśyāsau sākāṅ‌kṣo vinivartate | arthastu tasya sambandhī prakāśayati sannidhim || 335 ||
yasmāt sādhanavṛttābhidhāyī sattvapradhānaḥ śabdo na sa eva pradhānabhūtasyā(rthasya pratipādyasyāsattavabhūtasyā) bhidhāyaka upapadyate, virodhāt | tasmādidamatra vaktuṃ yuktamityāha-- asāvākhyātaśabdo nāmaśabdo vā svārthameva kevalaṃ pratipādya sāpekṣaḥ sākāṅ‌kṣa eva vinivartate | tasya vinivṛttasya sambandhī tvarthaḥ | arthāntarasya tadvācakaśabdaprakalpanadvāreṇa saṃnnidhimupakalpayati, tataśca vākyārthapratyayaḥ paripūrṇa upajāyata ityeva yuktamiti || 335 ||
parārthyasyāviśiṣṭatvānna śabdācchabdasannidhiḥ | nārthācchabdasya sānnidhyaṃ na śabdādarthasannidhiḥ || 336 ||
idānīmakhaṇḍavādī śrutārthāpattivādinaṃ nirākartumāha-- iha pīno devadatto divā na bhuṅ‌kte ityatra bhojanaṃ binā pīnatvaṃ devadattasyānupapadyamānaṃ rātribhojanaṃ tadvācakaśabdaparikalpanadvāreṇa gamayatītyucyate, tadatra kiṃ śabdena śabda ākṣipyate, utārthena śabdaḥ, āhosvicchabdenārthaḥ, utārthenārtha iti catuṣṭayī gatiḥ | tatra śabdena śabdasyākṣepo na yujyate; svārthapratipādana eva śabdākṣepāt | tatrāha--na śabdācchabdasannidhiriti | athārthena śabdākṣepa ityucyate tatrāha--nārthācchabdasya sānnidhyamiti | nāpi śabdākṣepo yujyate, vācye tu vācakamākṣipatīti yuktam | ato'nyaśabdārthasya śabdāntarasya ca vācyavācakatāvirahāt kathamarthena śabdasyākṣepaḥ | atha śabdenoccāritena śrutārthāpattiparikalpitaśabdavācyo'rtha ākṣipyata ityucyate, tadapyanupapannamityāha--na śabdādarthasannidhiriti | na śabdācchabdāntaravācyasyārthasya sannidhirupapadyate, vācyavācakabhāvābhāvādeveti kathaṃ śabdenārthasyākṣepaḥ ? athārthenārthogamyata ityucyate, anumānamevaitatspaṣṭaṃ bhavati, na śabdārthasyāsāvartha (na śabdasyāsāvartha) iti śabdaikatvameva parityaktaṃ syat | ata evātra caturthapakṣapradarśanamaucityaṃ na jahātīti tannirāso na kṛta eva | tasmādekapadeṣu śrutārthāpattyā śabdāntarākṣepe vākyārthāvagatiriti yatkiñcidetat | ekapadameva śabdāntarābhisambandhamantareṇa prakaraṇādivaśāt tattadarthapratyāyananipuṇamityeva mantavyam || 336 ||
naṣṭarūpamivākhyātamākṣiptaṃ karmavādinā | yadi prāptaṃ pradhānatvaṃ yugapad bhāvasattvayoḥ || 337 ||
punaḥ śrutārthāpattivādyāha-- dvāraṃ dvāraṃ karma ityatra (dvāram ityatra) karmapadenaivākhyātamasatkalpamākṣiptaṃ yadyatrocyate, tadā yugapatparasparaviruddhyoḥ siddhāsiddhayorarthayorekasmin śabde pradhānatvena vācyatvamāpatitam, na caitatparidṛṣṭam, pūrvaṃ yatra sādhanavṛttirityanena yaḥ sattvapradhāno nāsāvākhyātārthavācaka upapanna ityuktam. idānīṃ punaḥ pratyayasya ca viruddhārthavācakatvamucyata iti viśeṣaḥ || 337 ||
taistu nāmasarūpatvamākhyātasyopavarṇyate | anvayavyatirekābhyāṃ vyavahāro vibhajyate || 338 ||
siddhāntavādyāha-- dvāraṃ dvāramityetadā (dvāramityetadā) khyātameva, nāmapadasarūpaṃ tu varṇyate | ataścānyākhyātavat prādhānyena kriyāyā etadapi nāmapadasarūpaṃ pratipādakameva | yadyevaṃ kathamasmād dvitīyā śrūyata yatyāha--anvayeti | bhāṇḍaṃ bhāṇḍaṃ pidhehi, dvāraṃ dvāraṃ pidhehītyādāvākhyātasya kriyābhidhāyatvaṃ paridṛṣṭam, nāmno dravyavācakatvamityanvayavyatirekābhyāmanyatrāpyekapade dvāramityādau sādṛśyāt sādhanābhidhāyitvameveti bhavatyeva dvitīyā || 338 ||
na cāpi rūpāt sandehe vācakatvaṃ nivartate | ardhaṃ paśoriva yathā samarthyāt tadvikalpyate || 339 ||
atha dvāraṃ dvāramityasyānekārthavācakatvāt sandehe kathamasya vācakatvaṃ bhavedityāha-- rūpasādṛśye'pi sāmarthyādinā'rthanirṇayo vyavasthāpyata ityāha--ardhamiti | atra paśvavayavo'rddhaṃ devadattāvayavo vārddhaṃ paśusvāmikamiti sandehaḥ | tatra kiṃ sandehe vākyamavācakameva, arthaprakaraṇādinā'rthastatra kalpyata eva || 339 ||
sarvaṃ sattvapadaṃ śuddhaṃ yadi bhāvanibandhanam | saṃsarge ca vibhakto'sya tasyārtho na pṛthagyadi || 340 || kriyāpradhānamākhyātaṃ nāmnāṃ sattvapradhānatā | catvāri padajātāni sarvametadvirudhyate || 341 ||
codayati-- spaṣṭo'rthaḥ || 340 - 341 ||
vākyasya buddhau nityatvamarthayogaṃ ca laukikam dṛṣṭ‌vā catuṣṭ‌vaṃ nāstīti vārtakṣaudumbarāyaṇau || 342 ||
etaccodyaṃ nirākartumāha-- vākyasyākhaṇḍasya buddhau pratipattṛbuddhau nityatvaṃ dṛṣṭ‌vā tathā tasyaivārthena pratibhālakṣaṇena yogaṃ saṃbandhaṃ dṛṣṭvā pade tatpadaparikalpanaṃ padārthaparikalpanaṃ ca tatrāstyeva naivopapadyata ityācāryāvāhatuḥ | ato'smākameṣā bibhīṣikā yatpadānāṃ catuṣṭ‌vaṃ nopapadyata iti || 342 ||
vyāptimāṃśca laghuścaiva vyavahāraḥ padāśrayaḥ | loke śāstre ca kāryārthaṃ vibhāgenaiva kalpitaḥ || 343 ||
yadyevaṃ kiṃ śāstreṇetyāha-- padāśrayo vākyāvyavahāraḥ śāstreṇopadiṣṭaḥ san vyāptimān sakalasādhuśabdaparijñānaheturvibhāgena parikalpita iti kimatrānupapannam || 343 ||
na loke pratipattṝṇāmarthayogāt prasiddhayaḥ | tasmādalaukiko vākyādanyaḥ kaścinna vidyate || 344 ||
atha yadi padapadārthavibhāgaḥ sarvathaivāsatyabhūtastatkathaṃ laukikānāṃ tadāśrayeṇa vṛttyādaya ityāśaṅ‌kyāha-- loke pratipattṝṇāṃ sarvāthā na satyārthayogādeva prasiddhayo vyavahāraniṣpattayaḥ, asatyenāpyupayena marīcikāsvapi jalaprasiddhisteṣāṃ dṛśyate | athavā rekhāgavayavadasatyanāpyanenopāyena satyabhūtavākyaparijñānaṃ bhavatyeva, sarvathā na lokasyārthaṃ vinā pravṛtttyādayo na santīti vaktavyam, kadācit satyāgavayena gavayārthapratītirasya janyate, kadācid rekhāgavayeneti boddhavyam | yata evaṃ tasmādvākyāt satyabhūtādakhaṇḍādvākyārthapratyayo janyata iti na kaścidalaukikaḥ satyabhūtaḥ padārthaḥ padaṃ vā vidyate, upapattivirahāditi || 344 ||
anyatra śrūyamāṇaiśca liṅgairvākyeṣu sūcitāḥ | svārthā eva pratīyante rūpābhedādalakṣitāḥ || 345 ||
jñāpakagamyaścārthaḥ sarvatra vākyādevāvagamyata ityāha-- aktāḥ śarkarā upadadhātītyatra tailena ghṛtena veti saṃdehe'nyatra tejo vai ghṛtamiti ghṛtasya stutirupakrāntā, tayaitatsūcyate'bhyañjanaṃ ghṛtenaipopadiṣṭamiti | ato'trāktā ityādau vākye ghṛtāktā upadadhātīti vākyārtho jñāyata iti vijñeyam | yadyaktā ityasyaiva ghṛtāktā upadadhātīyartho'vagataḥ kiṃ jñāpakānusāreṇetyāha--rūpābhedādalakṣitāḥ | aktāḥ śarkarā upadadhātīti vākye rūpamaviśiṣṭaṃ paśyanto viśeṣamavagantumakṣamā iti liṅgānusaraṇenātrārthanirṇayo vyavasthāpyata iti vākyeṣu vākyaikadeśāḥ santītyetadapramāṇameva || 345 ||
utsargavākye yattyaktamaśabdamiva śabdavat | tad bādhakeṣu vākyeṣu śrutamanyatra gamyate || 346 ||
atha bādhyabādhakabhāvaṃ nirṇetumāha-- utsargavākye sāmānyalakṣaṇe upakrama eva yatyaktamapavādākrāntaṃ kiṃ tatra śabdena parityaktam, netyāha--aśabdamiveti | bodhakaviraheṇeva kathaṃ tyaktam ? śabdavad bodhakavadeva tyaktam, dhātoḥ karmaṇyupapade'ṇ‌pratyayastāvadeva bādhakānākrāntadhātuviṣayamevāṇ‌pratyayavidhānamiti gamyata eva, anyathā tvaviśeṣaṇa pravṛttāvuttarakālamākārantebhyaḥ kathaṃ nivāryate ? atastātparyaparyālocanavaśād bādhakānākrāntadhātuviṣaye bhavatīti vākyārtho jñāyata eva, tadṛrśina etattatkāla eva nāvadhāritam, uttarakālaṃ tu bādhakeṣu vākyeṣu tacchrataṃ sadanyatra sāmānyalakṣaṇe varjitamiti gamyate || 346 ||
brāhmaṇānāṃ śrutirdandhi prakrāntā māṭharaṃ vinā | māṭharastakrasambandhāt tatrācaṣṭe yathārthatām || 347 ||
laukikena dṛṣṭāntenaitadeva vyākhyātumāha-- dadhi brāhmaṇebhyo dīyatāmityatra śrutyā māṭharavarjamevātra brāhmaṇānāṃ dadhidānamupakrāntamiti boddhavyam, uttarakālaṃ takraṃ māṭharāyetyetattatra yathārthabādhaka (bodhakaṃ sva)- viṣayaparihāreṇaivārthavattāṃ gamayatītyevaṃ bhinnavākyatāsamāśrayaṇena tāvadaprāptyanumānaṃ bādha iti bodhavyam || 347 ||
anekākhyātayoge'pi vākyaṃ nyāyyāpavādayoḥ | ekameveṣyate kaiścidbhinnarūpamiva sthitam || 348 ||
idānīmekavākyatāmevāśrityotsargāpavādayorbādhyabādhakabhāvaṃ darśayitumāha-- kaiścit prāpyāpavādayorutsargāpavādayorākhyātabhede'pi ekavākyataiveṣyate bhinnavākyataiva tatkālaṃ pratibhāti | vastutastvākāṅ‌kṣāyogyatā saṃnidhivāśādekavākyatāṃ gataṃ vākyaṃ boddhavyam || 348 ||
niyamaḥ pratiṣedhaśca vidhiśeṣastathā sati | dvitīye yo lugākhyātastaccheṣamalukaṃ viduḥ || 349 ||
evaṃ satīdaṃ tatra boddhavyamityāha-- iko guṇavṛddhī ityādiko niyamaḥ sārvadhātukārdhadhātukayorityasya guṇavidheḥ śeṣaḥ, tena sahāsyaikavākyatāyāṃ sārdhathātukārdhadhātukayoḥ paratā'ṅgasyeko guṇo bhavatītyevaṃ vākyārtho jñāyate, anyathā'ṅgasyeganikoḥ sthāne guṇavṛddhyoḥ prabṛttayoruttarakālaṃ niyamena kimatra kṛtyam | uktaṃ ca--yo hi bhuktavantaṃ brūyānmā bhuṅ‌kthā iti kiṃ tena kṛtaṃ syāditi | tathā pratiṣedho'pi vidhinā sahaikavākyatāṃ gatvā sāphalyaṃ bhajatītyāha--pratiṣedhaśceti | pratiṣedhaśca vidhiśeṣa eva tathā sati boddhavya ityarthaḥ | aluguttarapada ityanenottarapade parato lukpratiṣedha ucyamānaḥ supo dhātuprātipadikayorityasya lugvidheraṅgabhāvamupagacchan vākyaikavākyatayā'rthapratyāyanaṃ karotīti boddhavyam | etadeva darśayitumāha--dvitīya iti | dvitīye'dhyāye ya ākhyāto lug‌vidhistasya ṣāṣṭhikaṃ lukkapratiṣedhaṃ śeṣamaṅgaṃ vidurvyākhyātāra iti || 349 ||
nirākāṅ‌kṣāṇi nirvṛttau pradhānāni parasparam | teṣāmanupakāritvāt kathaṃ syādekavākyatā || 350 ||
atha vākyabhedavādyāha-- nirvṛttau viśeṣaparipūrṇatāyāṃ vākyāni nirākāṅ‌kṣāṇyeva | ataḥ parasparaṃ gradhānānitānyabhidhīyante, nateṣāmaṅgāṅgibhāva iti | ataḥ pararaparamupakāryopakārakabhāvābhāvāt kathaṃ teṣāṃ niṣprayojanāpekṣā parikalpyate, (ato) naikavākyateti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ ||350 ||
viśeṣavidhinā'thiṃtvād vākyaśeṣo'numīyate | viśeṣavannavartye'rthe tasmāttulyaṃ vyapekṣaṇam || 351 ||
athaikavākyavādyāha-- utsargavākyaśeṣaḥ sarvatrānumīyate, kasmādityaha--viśeṣavidhinetyādi | anyathā vākyāntaravadaviśeṣaṇa tasya pravṛttiḥ syāt | na caitadyaktam, tataśca nivartye pratiṣedhye'rthe'pekṣaṇamupayujyata eva | tasmāt tayoḥ parasparāpekṣaṇaṃ tulyameveti kṛtvā'rthaparyālocanāvaśenākāṅ‌kṣādinā parasparasambandhenāṅgāṅgibhāvāpattavekavākyataiva jyāyasītyuktam || 351 ||
saṃjñāśabdaikadeśo yastasya lopo na vidyate | viśiṣṭarūpā sā saṃjñā kutā ca na nivartate || 352 ||
uddhāreṇa vākyeṣu vākyaikadeśāḥ santīti caturbhiḥ prakārairnirūpitam | arthaprakaraṇābhyāṃ yathā vakṣa ityādau | prasidveryathā varṣatītyādau | liṅgādyathā aktāḥ śarkarā ityādau | ākāṅ‌kṣādinā vākyāntarasya sannidhānādyathā dadhi brāhmaṇebhyo dīyatāṃ takraṃ kauṇḍinyāyetyādau | yathā ca "karmaṇyaṇ" "ātonupasarge kaḥ" ityādau | idānīmapodvārasamāśrayeṇa prasaṅgāt padeṣu padaikadeśāḥ santīti vicārayituṃ prastauti-- iha devadattādayaḥ saṃjñāśabdāḥ sthitāḥ, tatra kadāciddevaḥ kadāciddatta iti prayuñjānā dṛśyante | tadetatkathamupapadyate ? yasmātteṣu saṃjñāśabdeṣvekadeśāsteṣāṃ lopastāvacchāstre na kutracidupadiśyate | upadeśo'pi tena kartuṃ na pāryata ityāha-- viśiṣṭarūpetyādi | yatā loke niyatavarṇānupūrvokaḥ padasamudāyaḥ saṃjñātvena viniyujyate, tadā tadantargatā avayavā viniyuktā eva, yathā vṛkṣaḥ pracalan sahāvayavaiḥ pracalatītyācārānurodhena kimasau nyūnavarṇā vācikā bhavati, sā hi niyatānu pūrvokā paripūrṇaiva kṛtā na nivartate || 352 || saṃjñāntarācca dattādernānyā saṃjñā pratīyate | saṃjñinaṃ devadattākhyaṃ dattaśabdaḥ kathaṃ vadet || 353 ||
athocyate dattaśabdādasau sakalā pratītā svasaṃjñinaṃ pratyāyayatītyāśaṅ‌kyāha- dattaśabdaḥ svatantro'nya eva kasyacit saṃjñāntaram | tasmāt kathamanyā devadatteti saṃjñā pratīyate śabdāntaratvādakṛtasaṃṅketatvāccetyabhiprāyaḥ | nāpi tadvācyaṃ saṃjñinamavagamayitumalaṃ dattaśabda ityāha-- saṃjñinamiti | dattaśabdasyānya evaṃ saṃjñī pratyāyyastatkathaṃ śabdāntarābhidheyamasau pratyāyet | tadevaṃ niyatavarṇānupūrvokāyāstasyā lopastāvadekadeśasya nopapadyate, nāpi dattaśabdāddevaśabdādvā tadekadeśabhūtadevadattaśabdapratītirupapadyate, tatrāpi tadvācyapratipattiriti yatkiñcidetat || 353 || sarvairavayavaistulyaṃ sambandhaṃ samudāyavat | kecicchabdasvarūpāṇāṃ manyante sarvasaṃjñibhiḥ || 354 ||
atra matāntaraṃ darśayitumāha-- sarvairavayavaistulyameva samakālameva saṃjñinaḥ sambandhaḥ kathaṃ samudāyavat | yathā samudāyastasya vācakatvena niyuktaḥ tathā tatkāla eva tadavayavā apītyatastadekadeśastasya pratyāyanaṃ karotīti ko doṣaḥ || 354 ||
varṇānāmarthaṃvattvaṃ tu saṃjñānāṃ saṃjñibhirbhavet | sambaddho'vayavaḥ saṃjñāpraviveke na kalpyate || 355 ||
atra dūṣaṇadvayaṃ darśayitumāha-- saṃjñānāṃ ye varṇāsteṣāṃ saṃjñinā'rthavattvaṃ prāpnoti | tataḥ svabhimataikadeśavadeko'pi varṇo vācakaṛ syāt | na caitatparidṛṣṭam | api ca tadavayavaḥ pṛthagvācako nopapadyata ityāha--sambaddha iti | yo'sau bhavatā vācako'vayava ekadeśaḥ parikalpyate, sa saṃbaddha eva vācakatvena viniyuktaḥ, samudāyācca tasya praviveke pṛthagbhāve vācakatvaṃ na kalpya (pa) te, vilakṣaṇatvāt || 355 ||
sarvasvarūpairyugapat sambandhe sati saṃjñinaḥ | naikadeśasarūpabhyastatpratyāyanasambhavaḥ || 356 ||
etadevāpareṇa ślokena pratipādayitumāha-- yugapat sarvāvayavasvarūpaiḥ sambandhe naikadeśāstadvācakā upapannāḥ, athavā tadekadeśāste na bhavantīti pratipādayitumāha--naikadeśāsarūpabhya ityādi | ekadeśasarūpabhya ityuktam| ekadeśasadṛśāste dattādayaḥ, na punastadekadeśā iti || 356 ||
ekadeśāttu saṅghāte kaṃṣāñcijjāyate smṛtiḥ | smṛtestu viṣayācchabdāt saṅghātārthaḥ pratīyate || 357 ||
matāntaramāha-- spaṣṭo'rthaḥ || 357 ||
ekadeśāt smṛtirbhinne saṅghāte jāyate katham | kathaṃ pratīyamānaḥ syācchabdo'rthasyābhidhāyakaḥ || 358 ||
etannirākartumāha-- sadṛśavastusandarśanāt smṛtirupajāyata iti prasiddham | tatra saṃṅ‌ghāte bhinnasvarūpe kathaṃ tasmāt smṛtiḥ, kathaṃ ca tasmāt pratīyamānā devadattasya saṃjñino'bhidhāyaka upapadyate ? pratīyamānasya vācakatve'tiprasaṅgaḥ syāt | śrutipathamavatīrṇāḥ śabdā vācakā iti prasiddham || 358 ||
ekadeśasarūpāstu taistairliṅgaiḥ samanvitāḥ | anuniṣpādinaḥ śabdāḥ saṃjñāsu samavasthitāḥ || 359 ||
siddhāntamāha-- yadā tu samudāyaḥ saṃjñātvena viniyujyate, tadaiva tadantargatāvayavasarūpā api saṃjñātvena viniyujyanta iti teṣvanuniṣpādinyayena siddhāḥ saṃjñātvena boddhavyā iti || 359 ||
sādhāraṇatvāt saṃdigdhāḥ sāmarthyānniyatāśrayāḥ | teṣāṃ ye sādhavasteṣu śāstre lopādi śiṣyate || 360 ||
tadantargatāvayavasarūpā anuniṣpādinyāyena viniyuktā api sādhāraṇatvāt saṃjñinamabhidhaātumasamarthāḥ | tathaā hi--devaśabdo devānāṃ vācakaḥ kasyacit saṃjñino'pi, tathā dattaśabdaḥ kriyāśabdo'pi saṃjñāśabdo'pi, tatra kathaṃ niyatasya saṃjñinastebhyaḥ pratipatti syādityāśaṅ‌kya niyatārthatāmeṣāṃ samarthayitumāha-- sāmarthyādibhirniyatāśrayāḥ saṃjñyabhidhāyakā vyavasthāpyante, teṣāmanuniṣpādināmeva śāstre lopādividhipraṇālikayā sādhutvamucyata ityāha--teṣāmityādi | tena devadatte svatantraḥ kriyāvācakadattaśabdasādhāraṇo dattaḥ saṃjñāśabdaḥ , devo'pi saṃjñāśabdo'nuniṣpāditvānn tadantargato'pīti boddhavyam | etadeva śāstre lopādidvāreṇānvakhyāyate, yathāktam..."caturthādanajādau ca lopaḥ pūrvapadasya ca" ityādi || 360 ||
tulyāyāmanuniṣpattau jye drā ghā ityasādhavaḥ | nahyanvākhyāyakaṃ śāstre teṣu dattādivat smṛtiḥ || 361 ||
etatsphuṭīkaraṇāyāha-- samudāye yathā padānyanuniṣpādinyāyena tatra viniyujyante, naivamatra samānāyāmapyanuniṣpattau varṇānāṃ varṇā vinyujyante | athaśca jyeṣṭhādiṣu na jyādayo varṇamātrā vṛddhavyavahāre sādhavo'bhyanujñāyanta iti, śāstre'pyanvākhyāyakena tathā bhūtānāmanugamaḥ kriyata iti boddhavyam | ato naite ghādayo varṇā maghādivācyeṣvartheṣu vācakā iti || 361 ||
kṛtaṇatvāśca ye śabdāḥ nityaṃ kharaṇasādayaḥ | ekadravyopadeśitvāttān sādhūn saṃpracakṣate || 362 ||
atha padeṣu padaikadeśāḥ santīti vicāraprastāve saṃjñāśabdānāṃ śabdārthasambandhasyānityatvamāśaṅkya samarthayitumāha-- iha saṃjñāśabdānāṃ saṃjñisambandhāt prāglakṣaṇayoga uta taduttarakālama ? yadā prāk‌ tadāsau na kasyacit saṃjñeti tannibandhanaṃ kāryaṃ kathaṃ sāyt ? atrocyate--atra (yatra) saṃjñāsaṃjñisambandhāt saṃjñātva tatra lakṣaṇamiti | athottarakālaṃ saṃjñātvam (athottarakālaṃ lakṣaṇayogaḥ), tadā cākṛtaṇatvo'sau śabdaḥ samprati ṇatvaṃ bhajata ityanityatvaṃ śabdānāṃ syādityāśaṅkyāha--kṛtaṇatvā ityādi | iha dvau rāśī kṛtaṇatvānāmeko rāśirnityaeva, akṛtaṇatvānāmapara iti | tatra ye kṛtaṇatvāste sādhavo nityā eva, ekadravyopadeśitvāt svabhāvenaiva te saṃjñāśabdā ityathaḥ | śāstre pūrvapadāt saṃjñāyāmagaḥ' ityanena kṛtaṇatvānāmeva teṣāṃ sādhutvamanvākhyāyata iti kṛtaṇatvatā śāstre prakriyāsamāśrayaṇenaiṣāmukteti na kaścidvirodhaḥ || 362 ||
gotraṇyeva tu tānyāhuḥ saṃjñāśaktisamanvayāt | nimittāpekṣaṇaṃ teṣu svārthe nāvaśyamiṣyate || 363 ||
etadeva pratipādayitumāha-- saṃjñāśabdakulāni vyavasthitāni, na teṣu svārthe saṃjñini nimittānveṣaṇamiṣyate nityatvācchabdārthaṃsambandhasya | tadvācakāste svavācye niyatā iti svarūpavyatirekeṇa nimittāntarānveṣaṇamavyāpakameva || 363 ||
vyavahārāya niyamaḥ saṃjñānāṃ saṃjñini kacit | nitya eva tu sambandho ḍitthādiṣu gavādivat || 364 ||
nanu ca nityatvaṃ saṃjñāśabdānāmanupapannaṃ samprati kriyamāṇatvāt, yasmātpuruṣecchayā yathā kathañcinniyujya saṃjñāḥ kriyante | uktaṃ ca-- "kṛtakatvādanityatvaṃ sambandhasyopajāyate | saṃjñāyāḥ sā hi puruṣairyathākāmaṃ niyujyate || " yathā hi pāṃsurekhāṇāṃ bālakairmadhurādayaḥ saṃjñāḥ kriyante, saṃjñāsu sarvāṣveṣaiva kalpanā ityāśaṅ‌kya samarthayitumāha-- saṃjñāśabdānāṃ kacitsaṃjñini yadi paraṃ vyavahārārthaṃ puruṣairniyamamātraṃ kriyate | yathā'smin gṛhe'dyaprabhṛti ḍitthaśabdavācyo'yamiti boddhavyam śabdārthasambandhastu ḍitthādiṣvanādiryogyatālakṣaṇo nitya eva, yadvakṣyati -- "indriyāṇāṃ svaviṣayeṣvanādiryogyatā yathā | anādirarthaiḥ śabdānāṃ sambandho yogyatā tathā || " iti |  tadevaṃ yathā gavādiṣvanādiyogyatāsambandhādvācakatvaṃ gośabdādīnāṃ tathaiva ḍitthādīnāṃ boddhavyam || 364 ||
vṛddhyādīnāṃ ca śāstresmiñchaktyavacchedalakṣaṇaḥ | akṛtrimo'bhisambandho viśeṣaṇāviśeṣyavat || 365 ||
śāstre'pi tathaiva vyavahāraniyamaḥ saṃjñāśabdānāmavasātavya ityāha-- śāstre vṛddhyādīnāṃ saṃjñāśabdānāṃ sarvārthaprakāśanaśaktiyogaḥ saṃjñināmādaijādīnāṃ ca kvaśabdavācyatā yogyatā, ataḥ kevalaṃ śāstre saṃjñāntarādavacchidyādaijādipratyā yana eva śaktirvṛddhyādīnāṃ niyamyate, ādaijādīnāṃ vṛddhyādiśabdavācyatvameva vyavasthāpya iti sahajaśaktipratiniyama eva vācyavācakayorucyate, na punaḥ kṛtrimasambandhādhānaṃ vijñeyam, yathā viśeṣaṇāviśeṣyayoranādiḥ śabdavācyatātmaka eva sambandhaḥ, na punastatra puruṣeṇa nīlādiyogaḥ kriyata iti || 365 ||
saṃjñāsvarūpamāśritya nimitte sati laukikī | kācit pravartate kācinnimittāsaṃnidhāvapi || 366 ||
atha saṃjñāpravṛttinimittaṃ vicārayitumāha-- sarvasaṃjñāśabdānāṃ svarūpameva pravṛttinimittaṃ boddhavyam | tasmin sati kutrajidarthānupāttaṃ nimittaṃ vidyate, kutracittasyābhāva eva ḍitthādāviti kaiścit tatrāpyucyata eva || 366 ||
śāstre tu mahatī saṃjñā svarūpopanibandhanā | anumānaṃ nimittasya saṃnidhāne pratīyate || 367 ||
na kevalaṃ tatraikākṣarāṇāṃ svarūpameva pravṛttinimittaṃ vidyate, yāvanmahatīnāmapi svarūpamevopanibandhavaṃ pravṛttinimittaṃ boddhavyamityāha-- kevalaṃ tatra nimittasyāvayavārthasya saṃnidhāne satyanumānaṃ tatsadbhāve pratīyate, anumānenāvayavārtho'pi tatra nimittamiti pratīyata ityarthaḥ || 367 ||
āvṛtteranumānaṃ vā sārūpyāttatra gamyate | śabdabhedānumānaṃ vā śaktibhedasya vā gatiḥ || 368 ||
kathaṃ tadanumānamityāha-- sa eka eva dvirāvartate tata ekena svarūpanirūpatasaṃjñinaḥ pratipattirapareṇāvayavārthanibandhānatā vyavasthāpyate | nanvāvṛttiranumīyate kiṃ yadi ha tatra tavābhīṣṭaṃsyād dvidhoccāraṇādityāha-sārūpyāditi | sārūpyādeka evoccāratiḥ śabdaḥ iti gamyate | athavā tantreṇa dvāveva śabdāvuccāritāvityanumīyata ityāha--śabdabhedānumānaṃ veti | tata ekena svarūpācchāditasaṃjñinaḥ pratipattirapareṇāvayavārthanibandhaneti | tṛtīyama pe pakṣaṃ pradarśayitumāha--śaktibhedasya vā gatiriti | sa evaiko dviśaktiruccāritastata ekathā saṃjñinaḥ pratipattirapareṇā (raparayā) vayavārthasaṅgatiriti || 368 ||
kkacidviṣayabhedena kṛtrimā vyavatiṣṭhate | saṃkhyāyāmekaviṣayaṃ vyavasthānaṃ dvāyorapi || 369 ||
idānīṃ laukikasyākṛtrimasya kkacid‌grahaṇaṃ, kkacid kṛtrimasya pāribhāṣikasya, kkacidubhayagatiriha śāstre sambhavatītyubhayorapi kṛtrimākṛtrimayoḥ kkacidakṛtrima eva vyāpteḥ parigṛhīta itarasyāpi viṣayaṃ vyāpnotīti cāturvidhyaṃ saṃjñāśabdānāṃ pradarśayitumāha-- kṛtrimā sāśtrīyā pāribhāṣikyucyate | sā viṣayabhedena vyavatiṣṭhate, na tu sarvatra tathaiva vyavasāthā | yathā "kateri karmavyatihāre" ityatrākṛtrimā gṛhyate, vyatihārasyātra kṛtrimasaṃjñā (saṃjñāyāmā) śrayaṇānupapatteḥ | `karmaṇyaṇ‌' ityatra kṛtrimā śabdavairetyādāvakṛtrimā dhātvadhikārātkṛtrimāyā atrānupapatteḥ | `kartṛkaraṇayostṛtīyā' ityatra kṛtrimeti kkacidekatrobhayarūpatāyā grahaṇamiti darśayitumāha--saṃkhyāyāmiti | saṃkhyāviṣaye śāstre kṛtrimākṛtrimayorapi samāśrayaṇaṃ śāstrīyāyā `bahuguṇavatuḍatī' tyādikāyā api kṛtrimāyā laukikyā atha (pya) kṛtrimāyā viśaṃtyādikāyā atiśadantāyā iti pratiṣedhādatra jñāpakād grahaṇam || 369 ||
viṣayaṃ kṛtrimasyāpi laukikaḥ kkaciduccāran | vyāpnoti dūrātsambuddhau tathāhi grahaṇaṃ tayoḥ || 370 ||
kkacidakṛtrimaḥ saṃjñāśabdo gṛhītaḥ kṛtrimasyāpi pratyāyanaṃ karotīti pradarśayitumāha-- laukiko'kṛtrimaḥ saṃjñāśabdaḥ samuccaran kṛtrimasyāpi śāstrīyasya viṣayaṃ vyāpnoti, yathā `ekaśruti dūrāt sambuddhau' ityatra sambodhanaṃ sambuddhiriti laukikena śāstrīyamapyekavacanaṃ sambuddhiriti gṛhyata eva, tatrāpi sambodhanasya vidyamānatvādityaryaḥ || 370 ||
saṅghaikaśeṣadvandveṣu kecitsāmarthyalakṣaṇam | pratyāśrayamavasthānaṃ kriyāṇāṃ pratijānate || 371 ||
athedānīṃ vākyavicāraprastāve kkacitpratyakaṃ vākyaparisamāptiḥ kkacitsamudāya iti pradarśayitumāha-- vākyavadvākyārthasyāpi pratyekasamudāyaparisamāptivākyaparisamāptiṃ prasaṅgānmatabhedena nirupayati | tatra vākyārthasya pratyekaparisamāptiriti tāvaddarśayatigagasaṅghaikaśeṣadvandveṣvityādinā | kadācitsaṃghenaikaśeṣeṇa dvandvena vārthapratipādanaṃ kriyate, yathā brāhmaṇā bhojyantāṃ `brāhmaṇo bhojyatā' devadattayajñadattaviṣṇumitrā bhojyantām | atra brāhmaṇakartṛkāyā bhujikriyāyā vākyārthabhūtāyā pratyāśrayamavasthānaṃ pratijānate'bhyupagacchanti | kīdṛśama ? sāmarthyalakṣaṇamiti, sāmarthyaṃ samarthabhāvātmakamagre nirupyamāṇalakṣaṇaṃ svarūpaṃ (nirūpyamāṇaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ nimittasvarūpaṃ) yasya tattathāvidhaṃ sāmarthyalakṣaṇatvādityarthaḥ || 371 ||
bhojanaṃ phalarūpābhyāmekaikasmin samāpyate | anyathā hi vyavasthāne na tadarthaḥ prakalpyate || 372 ||
atha bhujikriyā kārakasamudāya eva nāṭyakriyāvat ki na samāpyata ityāha-- ihaikena pādaprakṣālanamapareṇāsanopaveśanamapareṇānnadānamanyenānnanigaraṇamiti naivaṃ bhujikriyā nirvartayitumāyāti, yasmādasau bhujikriyā phalena tṛptilakṣaṇena rūpeṇānnadānādīnāṃ (ṇānnādanādinā) caikādhikaraṇena nirvartyate, tathā'nāśrayaṇena ('nāśrayaṇe ca) bhujyarthāniṣvatteḥ, bhinnādhikaraṇā sā svarūpaṃ na pratibhajata iti pratyakṣasaṃddhameva || 372 ||
annādānādirūpāṃ ca sarve tṛptiphalāṃ bhujim | pratyekaṃ pratipadyante na tu nāṭyakriyāmiva || 373 ||
etadeva sphuṭayitumāha-- niyatasvarūpā hi vastugatayo dṛśyante, nāsyakriyā'nekasādhanasādhyā satī phalavatyupajāyate, bhujikriyā tvekaikakārakanirvartyeti vastugatiḥ || 373 ||
