pādyavat sā vibhāgena sāmarthyādavatiṣṭhate | bhujiḥ karoti bhujyarthaṃ na tantreṇa pradīpavat || 374 ||
etadeva dṛṣṭāntāntareṇa vyācaṣṭe-- śrāddhakarmaṇi brāhmaṇeṣu kartrā yathā pādyamanekādhikaraṇaṃ tadabhyarcanāyopakalpyate, tathaiveyaṃ bhujikriyā sāmarthyādvastusvābhāvyādvibhāgenaivāvatiṣṭhata iti | natu tantreṇa sādhāraṇyenāsau pradīpavadekādhikaraṇaiva bhujyarthaṃ tṛptilakṣaṇaṃ karoti || 374||
dṛśyādistu kriyaikāpi tathābhṛteṣu karmasu | āvṛttimantareṇāpi samudāyāśrayā bhavet || 375 ||
atha bhujikriyāvadanyāsāmapi kriyāntara (ra) samāśrayaṇena samudāyaparisamāptimupadarśayitumāha-- devadattayajñadattaviṣṇumitrā dṛśyantāmityatra dṛśikriyā tathāmūteṣu yogyadeśasthiteṣu viṣayeṣu pratyekaparisamāptiṃ vinā bhuktivannopapadyata iti notyate, yugapadevātra darśanakriyādhigamaphalā samudāyamāpnotītyasau samudāyāśrayā bhavet || 375 ||
bhinnavyāpārarūpāṇāṃ vyavahārādidarśane | kartṝṇāṃ darśanaṃ bhinnaṃ saṃbhūyārthasya sādhakam | 376 ||
atha pacyādikriyā kiṃ samudāyaparisamāptā, kiṃ vā pratyekaṃ samāptetyāśaṅ‌kyāha-- devadattaḥ kāṣṭhaiḥ sthālyāmodanaṃ pacati, viklidyatastaṇḍulān vikledayatītyatra bhinnavyāpārarūpāṇāṃ kārakāṇāṃ darśanaṃ bhinnaṃ prārthanādiko vyāpāro bhinnaḥ, sa sambhūya saṅghādarthasya pākakriyālakṣaṇasya sādhako dṛśyate vyahārādidarśana iti | vyavahāraḥ kaścinniyataviṣaya evopayogo'trābhiprataḥ | ādigrahaṇena tadanyeṣāṃ parigrahaḥ | teṣāṃ darśanaṃ samārambhaḥ prārambha iti yāvat | tasmin satītyarthaḥ | etaduktaṃ bhavati--kartṛsthā vā kriyā bhavati karmasthā vetyatra pacikriyā karmaṇi samavetā na samudāya iti kecit | anye tvāhuḥ--yadyapi karmaṇi samavetā, tathāpyadhiśrayaṇopasarjanaviklittirapi pacerartha ityavāntarakriyānyābhāve pradhānakriyāsamāśrayaṇena vyāvṛttavyāpārasyāviśeṣāt saṃbhūya sarvairnirvartyata iti samudāya eva parisamāpyata iti || 376 ||
lakṣyasya lokasiddhatvācchāstre liṅgasya darśanāt | arthitvādaikṣubhedena vṛddhisaṃjñā samāpyate || 377 ||
atha śāstre pratyekaṃ vākyaparisamāptimupadarśayitumāha-- `vṛddhirādaic' ityatra vṛddhiśabdaḥ pratyekamādaikṣvarthiṣau saṃjñātvena niyujyate, yasmālloke, tathaika lakṣyaṃ sidhyati--āmraguptāyaniḥ, aitikāyaniḥ, aupagava iti | tathā śāstre pratyekamādaicāṃ vṛddhisaṃjñā liṅgād dṛśyate, yathā `prasthe'vṛddhamakarkyādīnām' mālādīnāṃ ca' `vṛddhiryasyācāmādistad‌vṛddham' ityatra prasthe uttarapade pūrvapadamavṛddhamādyudāttaṃ bhavati, tadanantaraṃmālādīnāmādirudāto bhavatītyuktam, yadi caikaikasya vṛddhisaṃjñā tadā mālādīnāṃ `vṛddhiryasyācāmādistad‌vṛddham' iti mālādayo vṛddhā bhavanti || 377 ||
śatādāne pradhānatvād daṇḍane śatakarmake | arthināṃ guṇabhede'pi saṃkhyeyo'rtho na bhidyate || 378 ||
idānīṃ kvacit samudāye vākyaparisamāptiriti pradarśayitumāha-- gargāḥ śataṃ daṇḍyantāmityatra jñatakarmakaṃ daṇḍanaṃ samudāye parisamāpyate | arthinaśca rājāno hiraṇyena bhavanti, na ca pratyekaṃ daṇḍayanti yasmādvākyārthajñā rājāno vivecayanti, yathātra dve karmaṇī pradhānamapradhānaṃ ceti | tatra śatakarmake daṇḍane śatādānameva pradhānam | yadi ca pratyekaṃśatakarmadānaṃ samāpyeta, tadā gargāḥ śatāni daṇḍyāḥ syuḥ | tataśca pradhānakarmaṇaḥ svarūpabhraṃśo bhavet | na ca pradhānārthaparityāgo yuktaḥ , ataḥ saṃkhyāntarāśrayaṇe virodho vākyasya syāt, vīpsāyāṃ bādhaprāpteḥ | atra guṇabhede'pi daṇḍyabhede'pyapradhānatvātteṣāṃ nātra pratyekamapi tvarthināṃ rājñāṃ śatarmakaṃ daṇḍanaṃ samudāya evāvatiṣṭhata iti boddhavyam | etaduktaṃ bhavati--pratyekaṃ vākyaparisamāptiḥ samudāye vākyaparisamāptirityetanna rājājñāvaśād vyavasthāpyate, api tvarthatathābhāvāditi nyāyasiddhamevaitad veditavyam || 378 ||
saṃghasyaiva vidheyatvāt kāryavatpratipādane | tatra tantreṇa sambandhaḥ samāsābhyastasaṃjñayoḥ || 379 ||
śāstre pradarśayitumidānīmāha-- samāsaṃjñā'bhyastasaṃjñā ca samudāya eva parisamāpyate--`saha supā' `ubhe abhyastam' iti ca | atra samāsasaṃjñāyā abhyastasaṃjñāyāśca tantreṇa sādhāraṇyena samudāyasyaiva sambandhaḥ | kasmādityāha--saṅghasyaiva vidheyatvāditi | yasmādatra saṅgha eva vidhīyate | pūrvapadottararūpe hi samāsasaṃjñā vidhīyate | tathā'bhyastamityatra yugapad dvayorabhyastasaṃjñā vidhīyate kiñcitkārthaṃ vidhātumiti | nanu samāsasaṃjñāyāṃ kathaṃ rājapuruṣa ityādau samudāyo vidhīyate, yāvatā nityatvācchabdārthasambandhānāṃ tavidheyatānupapattirityāśaṅ‌kyā--kāryavatpratipādana iti | yadā kāryavanvākhyānamiti pakṣaḥ pratipādyate, tadaitaduktamityarthaḥ || 379 ||
lakṣaṇārthā stutiryeṣāṃ kañcideva kriyāṃ prati | tairvyastaiśca samastaiśca sa dharma upalakṣyate || 380 ||
idānīṃ kkacidekatraivobhayathāpi vākyaparisamāptirdṛśyata iti pratipādayitumāha-
vṛṣalairna pravṛṣṭavyamityetasmin gṛhe yathā | pratyakaṃ saṃhatānāṃ ca praveśaḥ pratiṣidhyate || 381 ||
udāharaṇamāha-- atra vṛṣalajātīyasya praveśaniṣedhaḥ kriyate | tatra caikasyāpi vṛṣalatpasma sadbhāvāt sāmarthyāt pṛthak‌ samudāye ca praveśaniṣedhārthaḥ sampadyata iti || 380 - 381 ||
sambhūya tvarthalipsādipratiṣedhopapādane | pṛthagapratiṣiddhatvāt pravṛttirna virudhyate || 382 ||
prakārāntareṇopadarśayitumāha-- bhavadbhiḥ samagrairevādyaprabhṛti rājopasevā na kāryā, samud‌gamanaṃ vā na vidheyam, kṛṣikarma vā nānuṣṭheyamityatra samudāye pratyekaṃ vā niṣedhe vākyasya na pravṛttyanupapattiḥ || 382 ||
vyavāyalakṣaṇārthatvādaṭ‌kupvāṅādistathā | pratyekaṃ vā samastairvāṇatvaṃ na pratiṣidhyate || 383 ||
atrāpi śāstrīyamudāharaṇaṃ dārśayitumāha-- vyavāyo vyavadhānaṃ tadupalakṣaṇārthatvādaṭ‌kupvāṅādibhiriti pratyekaṃ samudāye'pi teṣāṃ sthitervyavāyasya siddhatvāttathaiva ṇatvaṃ prarvatata iti na kaścid doṣaḥ || 383 ||
anugrahārtha bhoktṝṇāṃ bhujirārabhyate yadā | deśakālādyabhedena nānugṛhṇāti tānasau || 384 ||
idānīṃ bhujikriyāyā ekatvānekatvavicāraḥ | tatrāpi kimekasmin deśe kāle pātre'nuṣṭhitā svarūpamāsādayati, uta deśādibhedanānuṣṭhiteti vicārayitumāha-- deśakālādyabhedeneti nātra bhujeranugrahārthāyā viśeṣaḥ kaścit, ubhayathāpi tadanugrahasya nirvṛtteriti || 384 ||
pātrādibhedānnānātvaṃ yasyaikasyopadiśyate | viparyaye vā bhinnasya tasyaikatvaṃ prakalpyate || 385 ||
athāsyā ekatvānekatve vicārayitumāha-- yasya mate ekaiva bhujiḥ , tṛptilakṣaṇasamānaphalatvāt , tasya deśakālabhedāt‌nānātvaṃ svatastvekatvameva | kasyacinmate tu bhoktṛbhedāt phalabhede bhujikriyābheda eva | tasya viparyaye pātrādyabhedādekatvaṃ tasyā boddhavyaṃ svabhāvatastu bhinnatvameveti matabhedaḥ || 385 ||
saṃhatyāpi ca kurvāṇā bhedena pratipāditāḥ | svaṃ svaṃ bhojyaṃ vibhāgena prāptaṃ saṃbhūya bhuñjate || 386 ||
kiñca-- devadattayajñadattaviṣṇumitrā bhojyantāmityatra sāmarthyādbhedega vākyārthapratipattāvicchāvaśāt saṃbhūya svaṃ svaṃ bhojyaṃ vibhāgena prāptaṃ saṃbhūya bhuñjate || 386 ||
vīpsāyā viṣayābhāvād virodhāyanyasaṃkhyayā | dvidhā samāptyayogācca śataṃ saṅghe'vatiṣṭhate || 387 ||
atha śatādānapradhānatvādityetatpratipādyasyārthasyopapattiṃ pratipādayitumāha-- yadyekaikaṃ śataṃ śataṃ daṇḍyeta, tadā vīpsāviṣayo'pahṛtaḥ syāt, tathā śatakarmakamatra daṇḍanaṃ prādhānyena vidhīyate | yadi tu pratyekaṃ śatadaṇḍanaṃ prādhānyena vidhīyate, pratyekaṃ śatadaṇḍane saṃkhyāntaropajananācchatasaṃkhyā virudte | na cāpyatra dvidhā vākyaṃ samāpyate | yata ekena pradhānakarmaṇaḥ sambandho'pareṇa guṇakarmaṇāmiti vākyārthajñaiḥ paryālocya saṅgha eva śatādānamavatiṣṭhata ityucyate || 387 ||
bhujidvandvaikaśeṣābhyāṃ yatrānyaiḥ saha śiṣyate | tatrāpi lakṣaṇārthatvād dvidhā vākyaṃ samāpyate || 388 ||
atha bhujikriyāyāḥ pratyekaṃ parisamāptāvapi yatra devadattayajñadattaviṣṇumitraiḥ saha bhoktavyamityucyate, tatra dvidhāpi pratyekaṃ samudāye ca vākyārthaśca parisamāpyata ityāha-- lakṣaṇārthatvāditi yasmādatra saha bhojanaṃ sahaiva vā tatpratiṣedha ityeva tāvallakṣyate | tatra bahubhiḥ saha boktavyam dvābhyāṃ tribhirvā na vetyetadatrābhidhīyate | evaṃ ca sahaiva bhoktavyaṃ na veti samudāya eva vidhirvā pratiṣedho vā vidhīyate, kevalaṃ saha bhojanavidhistatpratiṣedho vā'bhīṣṭa iti pratyekaṃ samudāye ca vākyārtho'tra samāpyata iti boddhavyam || 388 ||
vākyāntaraṇāṃ pratyekaṃ samāptiḥ kaiścidiṣyate | rūpāntareṇa yuktānāṃ vākyānāṃ tena saṃgrahaḥ || 389 ||
evaṃ vākyārthāśrayaṇena pratyekaṃ vākyaparisamāptiḥ samudāye ca vākyāparisamāptiriti pradarśitam | idānīṃ vākyasamāśrayaṇena pratipādayitumāha-- ihaikaṃ yadvākyaṃ śrutaṃ tena vākyāntarāṇāṃ vākyarūpāṇāṃ saṃgraho lakṣaṇaṃpratyāyanamiṣyate | tāni vācakāni | tasmānmahāvākyaṃ pratyekaṃ samāpyate | tataśca tathaivarthāvagatiriti || 389 ||
na vākyasyābhidheyāni bhedavākyāni kānicit | tasmiṃstūccarite bhedāṃstathānyān pratipadyate || 390 ||
atha vākyāntaraṇāṃ kamekameva tanmahāvākyamabhidhāyakamucyata ityāśaṅ‌kyāha-- tasmāduccaritādarthapratipattāvarthaparyālocanāvaśenāvāntaravākyapratipattiḥ sampadyata ityucyate, na punastena tānyabhidhīyanta iti || 390 ||
yeṣāṃ samasto vākyārthaḥ pratibhedaṃ samāpyate | teṣāṃ tadānīṃ bhinnasya kiṃ padārthasya sattayā || 391 ||
atrākhaṇḍavākyavādī prauḍhavāditayā padavādimataṃ nirākartumāha-- pratyekamakhaṇḍasyaiva vākyārthasya parisamāpteḥ padārthānāmamupayogāt padārthakalpanā vṛthaiva || 391 ||
atha taireva janitaḥ sau'rtho bhinneṣau vartate | pūrvasyārthasya tena syādvirodhaḥ saha vā sthitiḥ || 392 ||
vākyavādī vikalpayitumāha-- athocyate padārthaireva vākyārtho janito bhinneṣu vartate | pūrvasya tena saha virodhaḥ sahānavasthānalakṣaṇo vā syāt, athavā sahāvasthitiriti dvayī gatiḥ||392||
sahasthatau virodhitvaṃ syād viśṣṭāviśiṣṭayoḥ | vyabhicārī tu sambandhastyāge'rthasya prasajyate || 393 ||
tatra sahasthitau codyamāha-- bhedasaṃsargau viruddhāvatrānuṣajyeyātāmityarthaḥ | atha padārthavākyārthayoratra sahānavasthānaṃ yatpūrvaḥ padārtho vākyārtho vākyārthe tatra samāpte vinivartate, tadāyaṃ doṣa ityāha--vyabhicārīti | vākyārthaphalānāṃ padānāmupāttarthaparityage śabdārthasambandho vyabhicāryanityaḥ prāpnoti | ataḥ pratyekaṃ vākyaparisamāptipakṣe satyabhūtapadapadārthāsambhava eva || 393 ||
ekaḥ sādhāraṇo vācyaḥ pratiśabdamavasthitaḥ | saṅghe saṅghiṣu cārthātmā saṃnidhānanidarśakaḥ || 394 ||
atha samudāyavākyaparasamāptipakṣe kiṃ samudāyārthena saṅgha evārthavān nāvayavāḥ, āhosvittadavayavā apīti vicārayitumāha-- so'rthātmā vācyaḥ satyabhūto vākyārthalakṣaṇa eko'khaṇḍaḥ pratiśabdamavasthito boddhavyaḥ | yato'sau sādhāraṇaḥ sarveṣāṃ vācyabhūtaḥ sthitaḥ | atha teṣveva sthito'sau netyāha--saṅghiṣu ceti | sādhāraṇatvāt samudāye'pyucyate tadavayaveṣvapīti | yadi pratiśabdamavasthitaḥ , tata ekapadopalambhakāle kimityasau nāvagamyata ityāha--saṃnidhānanidarśaka iti | itarapadasaṃnidhānaṃ nidarśakaṃ yasyāsau tathābhūtaḥ | yathoktaṃ purastāt--"pratyekaṃ tu samāpto'rthaḥ sahabhūteṣu vartate"  iti | ataḥ sakalapadopalambhakāle pratīyata iti na kaściddoṣaḥ || 394 ||
yathā sādhāraṇe svatvaṃ tyāgasya ca phalaṃ dhane | prītiścāvikalā tadvat sambandho'rthe na tadvatā || 395 ||
etad‌ dṛṣṭāntadvāreṇa vyaktīkartumāha-- dhane bahūnāṃ sādhāraṇe svatvaṃ svasvāmibhāva ātmīyatvaṃ vā sarveṣāṃ tyāgasya ca dānalakṣaṇasya phalam | tadapi sarveṣāmasmākaṃ bahu dhanamastīti | cetasaśca prītinirvṛttilakṣaṇā sāpyavikalā sādhāraṇatvādeva sarveṣāṃ bhavati | tadvattenārthena samaṃkṛtvā tadvātāṃ saṅghasaghināṃ sambandho boddhavyaḥ || 395 ||
varṇānāmarthavattāyāṃ tainaivārthena tadvati | samudāyena caikatvaṃ bhedena vyavatiṣṭhate || 396 ||
idānīmetatprasaṅgena saṅghātasyaikārthyāt subabhāvo varṇādityetad vyākhyātumāha-- yadā varṇā apyarthavantaḥ samudāye'pyarthavattā, tadā tatrārthavattvasya sādhāraṇyenaivaikatvāt samudāyādevaikatvapratipādanāyaikavacanamutpadyate, na pratyekaṃ varṇebhya iti || 396 ||
ekenaiva pradīpena sarve sādhāraṇaṃ dhanam | paśyanti tadvadekena supā saṃkhyā'bhidhīyate || 397 ||
etadeva dṛṣṭāntapradarśanapūrvakaṃ darśayitumāha-- santamase sādhāraṇadhanasvarūpaparijñānaṃ yathaikenaiva pradīpena sampadyate, tadvadatrāpi sādhāraṇārthavattā'bhivyaktaye ekenaiva sabhudāyādutpannena supā ekatvalakṣaṇāṃ saṃkhyā samudāyā pagatā'bhidhīyata iti na tapṛthak‌ pṛthak‌ subutpattiḥ || 397 ||
nārthavattā pade varṇe vākye caivaṃ viśiṣyate | abhyāsāt prakramo'nyastu viruddha iva dṛśyate || 398 ||
ata evaṃ sādhāraṇaivāsāvarthavattā ekenaiva supā'bhihitā, tasmādasau varṇapadayorapi vākye ca bhavantīti na viśiṣyate na pṛthagabhidhātumupayujyata iti boddhavyamityabhidhātumāha-- nanu pūrve vākyasyaivārthavattvaṃ mahatā prabandhena vyavasthāpitam, padānyanarthakānyevābhihitāni | varṇānāmarthavatve kaiva kathā ? idānīṃ varṇe pade vākye ca samaṃkṛtvaivārthavattod‌ghoṣyata iti kimetaducyata ityāśaṅ‌kyāha--abhyāsāditi | iha bhinnānyāgamadarśanāni laukikaiścārvāgadaśiṃbhistatrābhiniviṣṭaiḥ parasparaṃ śāstrāṇāṃ pṛthak‌ pṛthak prakramāḥ paripāṭayo dṛśyante viruddhā iva, paramārthatastattvaṃ satyarūpamekamaviruddhameva sarvatra sthitamiti | ataśca sarvapārṣadatvādetadanuṣaṅgāt kathañacidāśritam, naitāvatā'bhyupetasyākhaṇḍapakṣasya tyāga āyāta iti boddhavyam || 398 ||
viniyogādṛte śabdo na svārthasya prakāśakaḥ | arthābhidhānasambandhamuktidvāraṃ pracakṣate || 399 ||
idānīṃ śabdasyārthabhidhāne svavyāpāraṃ vicārayitukāma āha-- ihaika eva śabdo vahvarthaḥ | sa yadā vaktraḥ pratiniyata evārthe viniyujyate, tadā tamarthaṃ prāśiyatīti dṛṣṭam | ataḥ śabdasyārthapratipādanayogyatā uktidvāraivetyāhuḥ || 399 ||
yathā praṇihitaṃ cakṣurdarśanāyopakalpate | tathā'bhisaṃhitaḥ śabdo bhavatyarthasya vācakaḥ || 400 ||
atha kiṃ svābhāvikaḥ śabdārthasambandho'thedṛśī daśāmupeto yadamo śabdā vaktṛ-viniyogamukhaprekṣaṇasambandhāḥ | intaivaṃvādinā bhavatā vibhūṣitaiva-vaiyākaraṇadhuretyāśaṅ‌kyaitatsamarthanārthamāha-- yathā sahajayaiva yogyatayā cakṣurindriyamarthaviṣaye darśanamupakalpayad draṣṭasambandhi praṇidhānamapebhate, anyathā savedā daśanopajananaprasaṅgāt ; tathaiva śabdaḥ svābhāvikenaiva sambandhenārthapratyāyako'pyabhidhātṛsambandhyabhisandhānamapekṣata eva | etaduktaṃ bhavati--vākyāni svavyāpāre pratiniyatasvārthabhāñji bhavantyabhidheyārthaṃ prakāśayantyabhidhākhyaṃ svavyāpāraṃ puraskṛtyārthaprakāśanaṃ kurvantīti boddhavyam, sa cābhidhākhyo vyāpāraḥ prayoktṛ-sambandhyabhisandhānanimittaka ityabhisandhānatvenopacaryate | yadāha--tathābhisaṃhitaḥ śabdo'rthasya vācako bhavatītyabhisandhānameva hyatra śabdasyoktilakṣaṇavyāpāratayā'tidiśati | yadā tvabhedapakṣastadā vakturantarullasitā pratibhaivābhisandhairūpā śabdamayī bhavatī | spaṣṭa evābhisandhānokterabhedanirdeśaḥ | ataḥ pracāraścakṣuṣo'pi vyāpāraḥ praṇidhānātmaka eva "uktiḥ karaṇavinyāso na vinā śabdabhāvanām" ityanusandhānakāraṇakaḥ śabdasya svavyāpāro'bhidhā'nusandhānameva vā śabdamayī bhūtamabhidheti vijñayem || 400 ||
kriyāvyavetaḥ sambandho dṛṣṭaḥ karaṇakarmaṇoḥ | abhidhā niyamastasmādabhidhānābhidheyayoḥ || 401 ||
nanu cābhidhānamabhidheyaṃ sambandhaśca tayorityetāvadeva suprasiddham , yattvatra viniyoga uktirabhisandhānamabhidhetyevaṃrūpasya catuṣkasyopayogaḥ pratipādyate tadaprasiddhamevetyāśaṅ‌kyāha-- iha kārakāṇyayaḥ śalākākalpāni parasparamasambaddhānyeva teṣāṃ ca yathā kriyāvyavadhānena kriyāsamāśrayaṇena sambandho dṛśyate, tathaivābhidhānābhidheyayorvācyavācakabhāvalakṣaṇaḥ sambandho'bhidhākhyena śabdavyāpāreṇa niyamyata iti nāpūrvamatrābhihitamiti || 401 ||
bahuṣvekābhidhāneṣu sarveṣvekārthakāriṣu | yatprayoktābhisandhatte śabdastatrāvatiṣṭhate || 402 ||
etadeva sphuṭīkartumāha-- tathā ca bahuṣvartheṣu gavādiṣu vastuṣvekābhidhāneṣvekaśabdapratipādyeṣu śabdeṣu ca tatrārthaṣu sajātīyatvādekārthakāriṣu sannihiteṣu satsu prayoktā yattatrārtharūpamabhisandhatte'bhisandhānena viniyogenābhidhāviṣayīkaroti, tatraivārthe vācakatvena śabdo'vatiṣṭhate nānyatreti sphuṭameva paridṛṣṭam || 402 ||
āmnāyaśabdānabhyāse kecidāhuranarthakān | svarūpamātravṛttīṃśca pareṣāṃ pratipādane || 403 || abhidhānakriyābhedādarthasya pratipādakāt | niyogabhedānmanyante tānevākatvadarśinaḥ || 404 ||
prakaraṇāntareṇāpyetadeva sphaṭayitumāha-- tathā cāmnāyaśabdā vaidikā abhyāsavelāyāṃ na kañcidapyarthamabhidadhati, tadā'narthakāneva tānāhuḥ | yadā ta eva svarūpagrahaṇāya śiṣyāṇāṃ pratipādyante, tadā svarūpapradhānāsta iti tatra tadarthā evocyante | yadā punaḥ kutracidyājñe karmaṇi niyogabhedenābhisandhānabhedena ta eva viniyujyante, tadā svavyāpāreṇābhidhākhyena tattarthapratipādakāstadarthaniṣṭhāḥ sampadyanta iti sphuṭamevābhidheyavyatiriktonmajjantya bhidhā pratibhātyeveti na tadapahnava upapannaḥ || 403 - 404 ||
teṣāmatyantanānātvaṃ nānātvavyavahāriṇaḥ | akṣādīnāmiva prāhurekajātisamanvayāt || 405 ||
evamekaśabdadarśane'bhisandhānanimittābhidhālakṣaṇavyāpārasamāśrayaṇena śabdasya tattadarthābhidhānaṃ samupapaditamidānīṃ śabde bhedaṃ samāśrityaiṣāṃ prakaraṇādibhireva tattadarthaprakāśanamupapadayitumāha-- teṣāṃ śabdānāṃ bhedavādino nānātvamāhuḥ | kevalamekajātisamanvayasteṣāṃ sādṛśyarūpo'sti | udāharaṇamāha--akṣādīnāmiveti | yathā'kṣādayaḥ śabdā bhinnā eva sthitāḥ | sādṛśyāttvabhedenaiva pratīyanta iti || 405 ||
prayogādabhisandhānamatpadeṣu na vidyate | viṣaye yataśaktitvāt sa tu tatra vyavasthitaḥ || 406 ||
ataśca kimityāha-- prayoga uccāraṇam | tasmādanyatteṣvabhisandhānamuktirabhidhā naiva vidyate | kathaṃ tarhi niyatamevārthamabhidadhātītyāha viṣaya iti | tatra tatra viṣaye niyataśaktitvādvibhinnaśaktitvādeva sa śabdastatra tatra vyavasthita iti || 406 ||
nānātvasyaiva saṃjñānamarthaprakaraṇādibhiḥ | na jātvarthāntare vṛttiranyārthānāṃ kathañcana || 407 ||
tathā bhinnatvaṃ sādṛśye'pi satyarthaprakaraṇādibhirnigṛhītārthābhidhānādavagamyata ityāha-- yuktaṃ caitadanyathaikatrārthāntaravṛttitvaṃ śabdasyopalabdham, punastasyaivānyārthatvaṃ kathamupapadyatetyabhidhātumāha--najātvityādi || 407 ||
padarūpaṃ tu yadvākyamastitvopanibandhanam | kāmaṃ vimarśastatrāyaṃ na vākyāvayave pade || 408 ||
idānīṃ pūrvoktagrahaṇāya punarakhaṇḍavākyopakrameṇa vākyavākyārthanirṇayaṃ saṃkṣepeṇa kartumāha-- yo'yamatra vimarśo vicāraḥ, kāmaṃ sa pade tadekapadarūpameva vākyaṃ vācakaṃ tatropapannaḥ | kīdṛśaṃ tatpadarūpaṃ vākyamityāha--astitvopanibandhanamiti | astitvamastikriyā vākyatve vācakatve upanibandhanaṃ yasya | yadvakṣyati--"astitvenānuṣakto vā" ityādi | athavā prakaraṇādināstitvopanibandhanamityetaccopalakṣaṇaṃ kadācinnavṛttayātmatayā ceti boddhavyam | tatraiṣa vicāro yadutābhidhāvyāpāradvārakaṃ vācakatvaṃ pratiniyataśaktikṛtaṃ ceti, na tu vākyāvayavabhūte'poddhāre parikalpite pada iti, tasyārthavattāvirahādityabhiprāyaḥ || 408 ||
yathaivānarthakervarṇaiviṃśiṣṭārtho'bhidhīyate | padairanarthakairevaṃ viśiṣṭārtho'bhidhīyate || 409 ||
tasmāt sphoṭarūpamakhaṇḍameva vākyaṃ nirākāṅ‌kṣaṃ vācakamabhyupagantavyamiti dṛṣṭāntadvāreṇābhidhātumāha-- yathā tvanmate varṇairanarthakairabhivyakto viśiṣṭārthaḥ padarūpaḥ sphoṭātmā vācako'bhidhīyate, evaṃ padairanarthakairabhivyakta eva viśiṣṭārthaḥ sphoṭātmā vācako'bhidhīyata iti || 409 ||
yadantarāle jñānaṃ tu padārtheṣūpajāyate | pratipatterūpāyo'sau prakramānavadhāraṇāt || 410 ||
nanu padārthasampratyayastatropajāyata eva, padānāṃ tvanarthatve kathaṃ tatsadbhāva ityāha-- yadetatpadapadārthajñānaṃ vibhramarūpamantarāle vākyavākyārthapratipatterevīpāyabhūtaṃ boddhavyam | tasmānniraṃśatve'pi vākyavākyārthayoḥ prakrama eva prathamasamaya eva rūpaṃ tayornāvadhāryata iti || 410 ||
pūrvairarthairanugato yathārthātmā paraḥ paraḥ | saṃsarga eva prakāntastathā'nyeṣvarthavastuṣu || 411 ||
evaṃ vācakāśrayaṇe prakāratritayamuktvedānīṃ vācyasamāśrayaṇena tathaiva pratipādayitumāha-- anena ślokenānvitābhidhānasamāśrayaṇena saṃsṛṣṭaṃ vākyārthapradarśanaṃ kriyate | tathā tvabhihitānvayavādinaḥ pūrvapūrvārthānugataḥ saṃsargo vākyārthaḥ, anvitābhidhānavādinastūttarottarapadārthāvagataḥ prathamatarameva saṃsṛṣṭa eva | yadi paramatra sannidhānaṃ nidarśakaṃ yasyetītikartavyatāmātrasvarūpāvagatāvapekṣanta iti boddhavyam || 411 ||
aṅgīkṛte tu keṣāñcit sādhyenārthena sādhane | ādhāraniyamārthaiva sādhanānāṃ punaḥ śrutiḥ || 412 ||
yadā keṣāñcinmate tatra sādhyenārthena sādhyārthaniṣṭhena saṃsargeṇeti yāvat | sādhane upakāralakṣaṇe'ṅgīkṛta āśliṣṭe'vinābhāvitayā svayamavadhṛte sati yā tatra vākye sādhanānāṃ punaḥ śrutiḥ, sā niyamārthaiva boddhavyā kārakāṇām, yadi tatra paramādhāraniyamaḥ kriyata iti boddhavyam | indhanadhārā karaṇaśaktiḥ sthālyādhāraivādhikaraṇaśaktirevamanyatra || 412 || ādhāraniyamābhāvāt tadākṣepo na vidyate | sāmarthyātsambhavastasya śrutistvanyanivṛttaye || 413 ||
tatra nissādhanā kriyā na bhavatīti sādhanamātramaniyatādhāramākṣiptaṃ na tvādhārasahitamityāha-- sādhanānāmādhāraniyamo nāsti | karaṇādiśaktayo hi niyatādhārā dṛśyanta ityādhārākṣepaḥ | tatra sādhanaṃ nāsti | sāmarthyādyadi paraṃ tasya sādhanasya tatra sambhava evābhyūhyate, tataḥ kriyādhārā etāḥ sādhanaśaktayaḥ syuriti daṇḍena gāmityādikā śrutiranyādhāranivṛttaye tāsāṃ paryavasyatīti boddhavyam || 413 ||
kriyā kriyāntarādbhinnā niyatādhārasādhanā | prakrāntā pratipattṝṇāṃ bhedāḥ sambodhahetavaḥ || 414 ||
atha kriyāṃ vākyārthamāśrityāha-- kriyaiva viśiṣṭā sarvatra prathamatarameva vākyārthatvena prakrāntā kriyāntarādbhinnetyanena viśeṣakathanam | etadeva sphuṭīkartumāha--niyatādhārasādhaneti | tatra vākye bhedānāṃ viśeṣāṇāṃ prayogo'sau sambodhanopāyamātramiti boddhavyam || 414 ||
avibhāgaṃ tu śabdabhyaḥ kramavadbhyo'padakramam | prakāśate tadanyeṣāṃ vākyaṃ vākyārtha eva ca || 415 ||
atha svapakṣānusāreṇa vākyārthapradarśanaṃ kartumāha-- akrama eva nirvibhāgaḥ pānakarasādivat pratibhātmako vākyārthaḥ sphoṭātmakaṃ ca vākyamityekayogakṣematvādevamuktam vākyaṃ vākyārtha eva ceti || 415 ||
svarūpaṃ vidyate yasya tasyātmā na nirūpyate | nāsti yasya svarūpaṃ tu tasyaivātmā nirūpyate || 416 ||
idānīmasatyopādhiḥ satyarūpaḥ śabdārtha iti vicārapūrvakaṃ nidarśayitumāha-- yasya vastunaḥ pratyakṣādipramāṇaparicchinnasvarūpaṃ vidyate nīlaṃ pītamiti, tasya tāvatā nātmā nirūpyate na vyavahāragocaratāṃ nīyate | etaduktaṃ bhavati--padārthaḥ pṛthag‌rūpaḥ sannapi paṅguprāyo'sāviti vyavahārapadavīṃ netuṃ vāryate, sasargasya tvanvayātmanaḥ pradhānasya taditaropapatteḥ padārtho yāvadupāyo dvāramiti tannirūpaṇameva sāphalyaṃ bhajata iti tasyaiva satyatvaṃ yuktam || 416 ||
aśabdamapare'rthasya rūpanirdhāraṇaṃ viduḥ | śarthāvabhāsarūpā hi śabdebhyo jāyate smṛtiḥ || 417 ||
atha padārthāsatyatvapratipādanapūrvakaṃ tadācchuritasyaiva saṃsargasya vākyārthatvaṃ parighaṭayitumupakramate--- arthasya rūpanirdhāraṇasya svarūpaparicchedo'śabda eva, na tatra śabda upāyabhāvamupayāti | taddhi nirvikalpakaikasamadhigamyamityarthaḥ | tarhi śabdasya tatra kvopayoga ityāha--arthāvabhāsetyādi | arthapratibhāsasadṛśāyāṃ smṛtāveva śabdānāmupayogaḥ, śabdasyārthena saha sudūrameva viprakarṣaḥ | tataśca kathaṃ śabdo'rthamabhidadhītetyasatya eva śabdārthaḥ paryavasyati || 417 ||
anyathaivāgnisambandhāddāhaṃ dagdho'bhimanyate | anyathā dāhaśabdena dāhādyarthaḥ pratīyate || 418 ||
ataścaitadeva boddhavyamityāha-- yadi śabdena yathāvad bāhyo'rthaḥ pratyāyyeta tadā śabdasannidhāpito'sau tāmarthakriyāṃ kathaṃ na kuryāt yataścāgnisambandhāddagdho dāhamanyathā'nubhavati dāhaśabdena ca dāhamanyathā'vagacchatīti śabdarthayornāsti kaścidvāstavaḥ samanvaya iti boddhavyam || 418 ||
pṛthaṅ‌niviṣṭatattvānāṃ pṛthagarthānupātinām | indriyāṇāṃ yathā kāryamṛte dehānna kalpate || 419 ||
tadevaṃ padārtho viparītakhyātirupo'satkhyātisvarūpo vā boddhavya iti padārthasyāsatyatvamabhidhāya tadācchuritasya vākvārthasya satyatvaṃ pratipādayitumāha-- pṛthaṅ‌niviṣṭaṃ tattvaṃ svarūpaṃ pārthivatvādinā bhedena, athavā pratinayatasthānasamāśrayaṇena niviṣṭamabhivyaktaṃ tattvaṃ svarūpaṃ yeṣāṃ tāni tathā teṣāmiti tathā pṛthak‌ pṛthagarthaṃ śabdādilakṣaṇamanupatanti viṣayīkurvanti tacchīlāste tathā teṣām, yathā satyapi tapṛthak‌svabhāve dehādvinā kāryaṃ prātisvikaṃ nopakalpate, tathaiva padānāṃ kevalānāṃ vākyavyatirekeṇa sthitānāmarthavattāvirahaḥ paridṛśyata iti || 419 ||
tathā padānāṃ sarveṣāṃ pṛthagarthaniveśinām | vākyebhyaḥ pravibhaktānāmarthavattā na vidyate || 420 ||
prakṛtaṃ yojayitumāha-- saṃsargarūpaṃ saṃsṛṣṭeṣvarthavastuṣu gṛhyate | nātropākhyāyate tatvamapadārthasya darśanāt || 421 ||
vākyārthasvarūpaṃ pratipādayitumāha-- na punaratra pṛthak‌padārthapratibhāsāvasare tasya tattvamupākhyāyate prakaṭībhavati, yasmāt padārtharūpādvilakṣaṇameva vākyārthasvarūpaṃ dṛśyata iti || 421 ||
darśanasyāpi yatsatyaṃ na tathā darśanāṃ sthit‌m | vastusaṃsargarūpeṇa tadarūpaṃ nirūpyate || 422 ||
nanu ca śaśo nāsti viṣāṇamastītivadapratītikaṃ kathaṃ sarvamabhidhīyate, padapadārthapratibhāsaḥ saṃvedyamāno'pi nābhyupagamyate, padārthopahito vākyārthastu satyatvena nirūpyata ityāśaṅkaya sarvopari nirūpitameva vyavahāragocaratāmupayāti, na svarūpeṇeti pratipādayitumāha-- iha sarvopari bodha eva pāramārthikastad‌vyatirekeṇānyasya vicāryamāṇasyānupapatteḥ | sa ca yathā satyatvena svacchatvādirūpatayā sthito na tathā tadvodhasvarūpadarśanaṃ padārthapratibhāsāvasare sthitam | tadavasare vivastu saṃsargarūpeṇa nīlapītādyupasṛṣṭatayā nīlabodhaḥ pītabodha iti tad‌rūpavirahitamapi nirūpyate | evametatsaṃsargādikaṃ vastusaṃsargarūpeṇa padārthopahitaṃ tathārūpaṃ tadrūpavirahitamapi nirūpyata iti kimatrāparāddham | tasmāt sarvathā kevalaḥ padārthaḥ padaṃ vā'vyavahāryameva, athaścaitadasatyamityucyate || 422 ||
astitvenānuṣakto vā nivṛttayātmani vā sthitaḥ | artho'bhidhīyate yasmādato vākyaṃ prayujyate || 423 ||
vākyavākyārthau tu vyavahāryatvāt satyabhūtāvityarthapratipattaye vākyameva prayujyata ityāha-- kriyānuṣaṅgeṇa vinā na padārthaḥ pratīyate | satyo vā viparīto vā vyavahāre na so'styataḥ || 424 ||
etadeva sphuṭayitumāha-- ato vyavahāre kevalaḥ padārtho nāstyeveti boddhavyam || 424 ||
sadityeva tu yadvākyaṃ tadabhūdasti neti vā | kriyābhidhānasambandhamantareṇa na manyate || 425 ||
yatrāpyekameva padaṃ sadityetannirākāṅ‌kṣāyāḥ sattāyāḥ pratipādakam , tatrāpi tadabhūtasti nābhūnnāsti veti kriyāpadasambandhamantareṇa parisamāptārthaṃ na bhavatīti sarvathā kevalasya padamātrasya nāstyarthavatteti pratipadāyitumāha-- tatra ca vākye sādhyasādhane parasparamavinābhāvinī anyonyāpekṣake spardhayaiva vyavasthite | tathā hi--sādhanaṃ yathā niṣkriyaṃ na bhavatītyākāṅ‌kṣāvaśāt kriyāpekṣakamucyate | tathā kriyāpi niḥ sādhanā na bhavatītyākhyātapadapratipādye kriyālakṣaṇe sattvābhidhānena vinā''kāṅ‌kṣā na nivartata iti || 425 ||
ākhyātapadavācye'rthe sādhanopanibandhane | vinā sattavābhidhānena nākāṅ‌kṣā vinivartate || 426 ||
tatra sā kriyā sādhanamākāṅ‌kṣatyeveti pratipādayitumāha-- prādhānyāttu kriyā pūrvamarthasya pravibhajyate | sādhyaprayuktānyaṅgani phalaṃ tasyāḥ prayojakam || 427 ||
sādhanamupanibandhanaṃ yasyākhyānapadavācyasyārthasya tasmiṃstathābhūte tasmāt sattvābhidhānena vinākāṅ‌kṣā na nivartate | sādhanaṃ hi sattvābhidhāyi | tatastadavatiṣṭhate | kiṃ kṛstatra guṇapradhānabhāvastayoryaducyate sādhyasyaiva pūrvaṃ pravibhāga ityāśaṅ‌kyāha-- arthasya vākyārthalakṣaṇasyākhyātapratipādyasya kriyāpradhānatvāt kriyaiva pradhānyāt pūrvaṃ pravibhajyate na sādhanāni, yasmāt sādhyārthaṃ sādhya niṣpattaye prayuktāni sādhanāni, ato'ṅgāt pradhānabhūtāni tānīti na teṣāṃ tatra pravibhāgaḥ | evaṃ kriyāprayuktāni boddhavyāni | prasaṅgāt kriyāyā api prayojakamāha--phalaṃ tasyāḥ prayojakamiti | phalaprayuktā kriyā'pīti phalāpekṣayā kriyāyā aṅgatvaṃ boddhavyam || 427 ||
prayoktaivābhisandhatte sādhyasādhanarūpatām | arthasya vā'bhisambandhakalpanāṃ prasamīhate || 428 ||
idānīṃ sarvo'yaṃ sādhyasādhanavyavahāraḥ kālpanikaḥ, tayośca sādhyasādhanayoḥ parasparasambandha āpekṣika eva na vāstava iti pratipādayan punarapi padārthāsatyatvaṃ vyavasthāpayimumāha-- idaṃ sādhyamidaṃ sādhanaṃ tayoścābhisambandhaḥ sarvametatkālpanikam | tatastattvaṃ ca śūnyameva prayoktṛsamīhāmātrajīvitamiti yāvat || 428 ||
pacikriyā karomīti karmatvenābhidhīyate | paktiḥ karaṇarūpaṃ tu sādhyatvena pratīyate || 429 ||
yadi hi vāstavametat syāttadā vastusvabhāvasya brahmaṇā'nyathāpyakartuṃmaśakyatvād vyavasthitamevaitadbhavet, na ca tathā paridṛśyata iti pratipādayitumāha-- devadattaḥ pacatītyatra yā pākakriyā prādhānyenopalabdhā, saiva pacikriyā devadattaḥ karotītyatra karmatvenaiva paktiḥ pākakriyā vyavasthāpitā, pacikriyākaraṇaṃ tu ? prādhānye majjadrūpaṃ pratipāditamiti naiṣā vastugatiḥ, sādhanasamuddeśe ca sarvametadvaivakṣikamiti vistareṇa pradarśayiṣyati | tathā sambandhasyāpi kālpanikatvameva vakṣyatīti neha pratanyajyate || 429 ||
yo'sau yenopakāreṇa prayoktṝṇāṃ vivakṣitaḥ | arthasya sarvaśaktitvāt sa tathaiva vyavasthitaḥ || 430 ||
athavā'nekaśaktirarthaḥ sthito'pi yad‌yadupakāravaśād yathā prayoktṛbhirvivakṣyate tathaivātmānamupadarśayatītyāha ārād vṛttiṣu sambandhaḥ kadācidabhidhīyate | āśliṣṭo yo'nupaśliṣṭaḥ sa kadācit pratīyate || 431 ||
tathā cedamapi vastūnyanekaśaktikhacitatvāt sahanta iti pradarśayitumāha-- ārād‌vṛttiṣvatidūramapi viprakṛṣṭeṣu padārtheṣu kadācit parasparasambandhaḥ saṃśleṣo'bhidhīyate, kadācittu ya āśliṣṭaḥ sambaddho'pi so'nupaśliṣṭo'sambaddho dūrata iti vivakṣāvaśāt pratīyate || 431 ||
saṃsṛṣṭānāṃ vivekitvaṃ saṃsargaśca vivekinām | nānātmakānāmekatvaṃ nānātvaṃ ca viparyaye || 432 ||
rūpāntaramapyāha-- ekatve'pi ca kalpanāvaśānnānātvaṃ vastūnāṃ dṛśyate rāhoḥ śira iti yathā, nānātmakānāṃ ca dhavakhadirapalāśādīnāmekatvamekarsyā buddhau saṅkalanarūpaṃ dṛśyate, vanamiti yathā; vivekināṃ parasparavilakṣaṇānāṃ padārthānāmayaḥ śalākākalpānāṃ saṃsargo vākyārtharūpo dṛśyate, yathā devadattaḥ kāṣṭhairityādau; saṃsṛṣṭānāṃ ca vibhaktatvam, yathā māthurāḥ pāṭaliputrakebhya āḍhyatarā ityādau | eṣāṃ bud‌dhyā saṅkalitānāṃ satāṃ paścādvibhāgenāvasthāpanaṃ kriyate || 432 ||
sarvātmakatvādarthasya nairātmyādvā vyavasthitam | atyantayataśaktitvācchabda eva nibandhanam || 433 ||
tadetatkathamupapadyata ityāha-- sarvaśaktirarthastenatena rūpeṇa nirūpatastattad‌vyapadeśapātraṃ bhavatīti niyataśaktibhiḥ śabdaistathā tathā vyapadiśyata iti sthitam | athavā nirātmaka evāsatyabhūto'sāviti yathā yathā vivakṣayā nirūpyate tathā tathā avasthānamupadarśayatīti śabdaistathaiva vyapadiśyata iti boddhavyam || 433 ||
vastūpalakṣaṇaṃ śabdo nāpakārasya vācakaḥ | na svaśaktiḥ padārthānāṃ saṃspraṣṭuṃ tena śakyate || 434 ||
idānomarthasvarūpaṃ śabdā naiva spṛśanti, kevalaṃ tatra dūraviprakarṣeṇārthasyopalakṣaṇabhāvena sthitā vyavahāropayogitāmupayāntītyabhidhātumāha-- sambandhidharmā saṃyogaḥ svaśabdenābhidhīyate | sambandhaḥ samavāyaśca sambandhitvena gamyate || 435 ||
śabdārthayorna bācyavācakabhāva upapadyate, tathā sati śabdānāmarthasvarūpaṃ prakāśyatāmupeyāt, na ca tathā dṛśyata ityāha-- saṃyogaśabdāt saṃyogodravyayoriti yathāvatpariniṣṭhitasvarūpaḥ, tatra sambandhaisvabhāvaḥ pratīyate, na ca tasya tadrapam | evaṃ samavāyaśabdāt samavāyaḥ pratīyata ityāha--sambandhaḥ samavāyaḥ" ityādi | sambandhitvena sambandhasvarūpaviraheṇa samavāya ityasmāt pratīyate | athavā yadā saṃyogaśabdenāsau sambandhaḥ svatantro'bhidhīyate tadā tatra samavāyaḥ sambandhatvena gamyata iti yadā sambandhatvena gamyata iti pāṭhastadaivaṃ yojanīyaṃm || 435 ||
lakṣaṇād vyavatiṣṭhante padārthā na tu vastutaḥ | upakārāt sa evārthaḥ kathañcidanugamyate || 436 ||
padārthānāṃ svato rūpaṃ na kiñcid vyavatiṣṭhate yathā yathā nirupyante tathā tathātmānamāsādayantītyāha-- sa evārthaḥ kenacit kathañcidupayogādanyathā vyapadiśyata ityevamanekaprapañcairasatyabhṛta eva padārtha iti saṃgṛhya vyavasthāpitam || 436 ||
vākyārthe yo'bhisambandho na tasyātmā kkacit sthitaḥ | vyavahāre padārthānāṃ tamātmānaṃ pracakṣate || 437 ||
idānīṃ vākyārthastu satyabhūta iti pratipādayitumāha-- parasparābhisambandhasvarūpaḥ pānakarasādivadanirvibhāgo'naṃśa eva yo vākyārthastasya kkacit pṛthagrūpatayātmāsthito'vadhārayituṃ na śakyata iti yāvat | padārthānāṃ punarayaḥ śalākākalpānāṃ vyavahārāvasare tamātmānaṃ jīvitamiva pracakṣate, tadvaśattatpratipāditapadārthoddeśena sarvasya kasyacit pravṛttinivṛttisāphalyāt | sa caikasmin padārthe samudāya eva vā parisamāpto boddhavyaḥ || 437 ||
padārthe samudāye vā samāpto naiva vā kkacit | padārtharūpabhedena tasyātmā pravibhajyate || 438 ||
athavā naivāsau kkacit parisamāpta idaṃ taditi pṛthagrūpatayānupalakṣaṇāt kevalaṃ padārthasambandhinā svarūpeṇākhaṇḍasya vākyārthasya svarūpaṃ pratipadyate iti pratipādayitumāha-- etaduktaṃ bhavati-na pṛthageva śrṛṅgagrāhikatayā (tasya) svarūpaṃ vivektuṃ śakyate, paropādhidvārakameva sarvadā tasya nirūpaṇamavasātavyamityucyate || 438 ||
anvākhyānāya yo bhedaḥ pratipattinibandhanam | sākāṅ‌kṣāvayavaṃ bhede tenānyadupavarṇyate || 439 ||
etadeva sphuṭīkaraṇamā (ṇāyā) ha-- tasyānvākhyānāya yo bhedaḥ padārthabhedo'pod‌dhriyate, sa tasyaiva pratipattinibandhanaṃ boddhavyaḥ | ataḥ padārthānāṃ bhede kriyamāṇe sati tenāpod‌dhṛtena padārthabhedenānyadeva padārthavyatiriktaṃ vākyārthasvarūpamupavarṇyate prakaṭīkriyate | kīdṛśam ? `sākāṅ‌kṣāvayavam' iti | bhede sati sākāṅ‌kṣā avayavāḥ padārthasvarūpāḥ pratipattyupāyā yasya tattathābhūtamiti || 439 ||
anekaśakterekasya pravibhāgo'nugamyate | ekārthatvaṃ hi vākyasya mātrayā'pi pratīyate || 440 ||
tathābhūtasya ca vākyārthasya nānāśaktikhacitasya nirvibhāgasyopādhikṛtaḥ padārthadvārakaḥ pravibhāgo nānārūpatvamanugamyate | pratīyate paramārthatastveka evāsāvityāha-- vākyasya sphoṭātmano vācakarūpasyaikārthatvameka eva nirvibhagāsvarūpo vācyārtho yasya tattathā, tasya bhāvastattvaṃ pratīyate, katham `mātrayā'pi'iti | yadā tasya mātrayā niyatasaṃkhyākenālpīyasā śabdena yogo'bhisanbamdho dṛśyate | yathoktam--igyaṇa iti yoge sthānyādeśabhāvalakṣaṇo vākyārthaḥ sa saṃprasāraṇamiti vyapadiśyate | ataḥ samprasāraṇamityevamekasaṃkhyena laghīyastvānmātrayā vyapadiśyate tasya yogo yadā na paridṛṣṭastadaitadavagamyate yadutānaṃśa eka evākhaṇḍasvarūpo'sau vākyārtho'nyathā samprasāraṇamityanenaikasaṃkhyākena kathaṃ yujyeta vaktum || 440 ||
saṃpratyayārthād‌ bāhyo'rthaḥ sannasanvā vibhajyate | bāhyīkṛtya vibhāgastu śaktyapoddhāralakṣaṇaḥ || 441 ||
tadidaṃ vākyārthaḥ satyarūpaḥ padārthastvasatya eveti nirṇotam | sa ca vākyārtho bauddha evābahīrūpa iti pratipādayitumāha-- sampratyayo buddhirvijñānamityanarthāntaram | sampratyayo'rtho'bhidheyarūpo yasyāsau tathā tathābhūtāttasmādvauddhāddhākyārthādvāhyārthaḥ san bahīrūpatayā vidyamāna evāthavā'sanbahirasatyabhūta eva vibhajyate vibhāgenānugamyate vyavasthāpyate | kathaṃ kṛtvetyāha"bāhyīkṛtya'iti | abāhya evāsau bāhyarūpatayā prathate, vivekānavadhāraṇād‌dṛśyavikalpaikīkāreṇa vākyārthaṃ pratipadya paścādasau vibhāgenānugamyata iti yāvat | vibhāgastatra kīdṛśa ityāha--`śaktyapoddhāralakṣaṇaḥ' iti | śaktīnāṃ padārthaṃsambandhinīnāmapoddhāraḥ pṛthakkaraṇaṃ lakṣaṇaṃyasyāsau tathā | padārthaśaktayastasmādapodidhrayanta ityarthaḥ | atra tu bauddhe vākyārthe samāśrite śaktīnāṃ tatrāvidyamānatvāt tasmādapoddhārastāsaṃ kīdṛśaḥ syāt | tāḥ padārthavyaktayo na (tatra) vyavasthitāḥ | yadi hi tatra tāḥ suḥ, tadā hyatīte'vagate'rthe syādevārthakriyāvāptiḥ | tasmād bauddhādarthādanyatra bāhya evārthetāḥ śaktayo vyavasthitāḥ, tataśca bauddhādarthādanyatra bāhye'rthe vidyamānamapi tāsāṃ rūpaṃ nirākāreṇa vijñānenopalabhyate | tasmādvijñānākārasya bāhyasya cārthasya śaktita ekākāreṇa vinā vyavahāro nopapadyata eveti bāhyīkṛtyetyuktam | tathā caikayogakṣematvād bauddhārthabāhyārthayoryukto bauddhe'pyarthe śaktyapoddhāralakṣaṇo vibhāgaḥ | tatra yadi vijñānākārasya vikalpavāsanāmāhātmyād bāhyenaikīkṛtasya satyato bahirartho'sti, yenopajanyate ; tadā bāhya eva śabdārthaḥ, na cedasanneva bahirbauddha eva śabdārtha iti nirṇayaḥ || 441 ||
bahuṣvapi tiṅnteṣu sākāṅ‌kṣeṣvekavākyatā | tiṅantebhyo nighātasya paryudāsastathārthavān || 442 ||
atha vākyavicāraprastāve vākyānāmekavākyātvaṃ vā vākyanānātvamevavākyatvaṃ vā iti matabhedena pratipādayitumāha-- iha vārttikakāreṇākhyātaṃ sāvyayakārakaviśeṣaṇaṃ vākyamityatraikavacanasya vivakṣitatvādekatiṅiti vākyalakṣaṇāntarapratipādanādanekākhyātasadbhāve vākyabheda eveṣyate sūtrakāreṇa tvatiṅ‌ iti pratiṣedhopādānasāmarthyāt satsvapi buhaṣu tiṅanteṣvarthasya sākāṅ‌kṣatvāt tatraikavākyataiveṣyata iti pradarśitaṃ bahuṣvapītyanena || 442 ||
ekatiṅ‌ yasya vākyaṃ tu śāstre niyatalakṣaṇam | tasyātiṅ‌grahaṇenārtho vākyabhedānna vidyate || 443 ||
vārttikakāramatena vākyabhedastatretyupadarśayitumāha-- niyatalakṣaṇamiti vivakṣitaikatvamityarthaḥ || 443 ||
tiṅantāntarayukteṣu yuktayukteṣu vā punaḥ | mṛgaḥ paśyata yātīti bhedābhedau na tiṣṭhataḥ || 444 ||
keṣāñcit punaranekākhyātasadbhāve'pi vākyārthasya bhedābhedau vyavasthitāvevetyāha-- iha mṛgaḥ paśyata yātītyatra tiṅantāntarasadbhāvādvākyabheda eva, tathā ca mṛgaśabdasya yātītyasya ca sambandhādekaṃ vākyam | anantaraṃ vibhaktivipariṇāmeva karmapadena pratyavamarśādetaṃ mṛgaṃ paśyateti dvitīyaṃ vākyam | anyastvāha--yuktayuktatvād bahuṣvapa tiṅanteṣvabheda eva | tathā hyatra mṛgaśabdena yātipadasya yogaḥ, tadyuktena yātipadenākhyātāntarasya yogaḥ | tenātrapadenākhyātāntarasya yogaḥ | tenātra mṛgakarttṛkaṃ saraṇaṃ paśyateti dṛśikriyāpekṣayāpyekatiṅityatraikatiṅ‌tvaṃ pradhānatiṅantāpekṣayā pratipādyamānaṃ sūtrakāramatānuguṇyaṃ bhajata evetyanayornāsti matabhedaḥ | tadapareṣāṃ matabheda eva boddhavyaḥ || 444 ||
itikartavyatā'rthasya sāmarthyādyasya kāṅ‌kṣyate | aśabdalakṣaṇākāṅ‌kṣaṃ samāptārthaṃ taducyate || 445 ||
atha vākyaparisamāptijñānapūrvikā nānāvākyataikavākyatā vājñātuṃ śakyā, nānyathetyaśaṅkya śabdalakṣaṇā vākyaparisamāptirboddhavyā, nārthalakṣaṇetyatra sākāṅ‌kṣatvānākāṅ‌kṣatvavicāramāha-- avidyamānā śabdalakṣaṇā śabdāśritāṃ ākāṅ‌kṣā yasmiṃstadvākyaṃ samāptārthamucyate | tadavagatasyārthasya tu yatra sāmarthyādarthatathābhāvalakṣaṇāt tadīyāyāmi tikartavyatāyāmākāṅ‌kṣā jāyate, tāvatā na tatra tadvākyamaparisamāptamityucyata iti boddhavyam, yathā vrīhayo bahavo'vahanyantāmityatra śabdāpekṣā tāvannāstyeva, vrīhīṇāṃ tvavahananamulūkhalamusalakarmakartrādisannidhānamantareṇa na sampadyata iti tadapekṣaṇādvākyaṃ nātra parisamāptamiti na yuktaṃ vaktum, śabdalakṣaṇāpekṣā'yogāditi ||445||
tattvānvākhyānamātre tu yāvānartho'nuṣajyate | vinā'pi tatprayogeṇa śrutervākyaṃ samāpyate || 446 ||
vrīhīṇāmavahananamātramatrānvākhyāyate, tasmiṃśca sati ulūkhalādisannidhānaṃ yadatrānuṣajyate tasya prayogeṇa śabdena pratipādanena vinā'pi tatra tadvākyaṃ śrutyā śabdavyāpāreṇa samāptameveti boddhavyam || 446 || caṅ‌kramyamāṇo'dhīṣvātra japaṃścaṅ‌kramaṇaṃ kuru | tādarthyasyāviśeṣe'pi śabdādbhedaḥ pratīyate || 447 ||
idānīmarthapratyāyanābhede'pi śabdavṛttena guṇapradhānarūpatayā'bhidhānaṃ śabdeṣu sambhavatīti prasaṅgācchabdadharmapratipādanaṃ kartumāha-- caṅ‌kramyamāṇo'tra japaṃ kuru athavā japaṃścaṅ‌kramaṇaṃ kurvityatra ubhayathā japavidhiḥ pratīyate, kevalaṃ caṅ‌kramyamāṇo japetyatra japaḥ prādhānyenābhidhīyate, caṅ‌kramaṇaṃ guṇavṛttyā; japaścaṅ‌kramaṇaṃ kurvityatra tu japasya guṇabhāvaḥ, prādhānyaṃ tu caṅ‌kramaṇasya | athavobhayathā'pi japayuktatvāccaṅ‌kramaṇasyārthabhedo na kaścit | śabdapratipādanavailakṣaṇyamātramevāvasīyata iti || 447 ||
phalavantaḥ kriyābhedāḥ kriyāntaranibandhanāḥ | asaṃkhyātāḥ kramoddeśairekākhyātanidarśanāḥ || 448 ||
evamarthābhede'pi śabdapratipādanavaicitryamupadarśitamidānīṃ śabdabhedāt sāmarthyādarthapratipattivaicitryaṃ bhavatītyatrāśābdamapi vyāpāraṃ pradarśayitumāha-- "yāvajjīvamagnihotraṃ juhoti", tathā "yajate devadattaḥ" ityādāvekākhyātanidarśanāḥ ekamākhyātapadaṃ nidarśanaṃ vācakaṃ yeṣāṃ te tathābhūtāḥ kriyābhedā pratīyante | bhedaśca svarūpeṇa phalena ca bhavatītyāha-"phalavantaḥ" iti, phalabhedavanta ityarthaḥ | svargakāmaḥ kadācid yajate, kadaciddhastikāmaḥ kadāciptutrakāmo dhanakāmo veti | phalabhedasvarūpamāha-"kriyāntaranibandhanāḥ" iti | itikartavyatāyāṃ kriyāntarāṇi nibandhanaṃ yeṣāṃ te tathābhūtāḥ | kiṃ ca bahunā, krameṇa prātisvikenetikartavyatayoddeśena phalasvarūpeṇa ca te saṃkhyātumaśakyā eva, kriyābhedāstenākhyātenaikarūpeṇābhinnenaiva nidarśyanta iti boddhavyam || 448||
nivṛttabhedā sarvaiva kriyā''khyāte'bhidhīyate | śruteraśakyā bhedānāṃ pravibhāgaprakalpanā || 449 ||
etadeva sphuṭīkṛtya pratipādayitumāha-- ākhyātapade kriyā sarvaiva nivṛttabhedā sāmānyenābhidhīyate, yasmācchratimātrācchabdamātrāt sāmānyena śrutādbhedānāṃ pravibhāgarūpatā'vasātumaśakyā ||449||
aśvamedhena yakṣyante rājānaḥ satramāste | brāhmaṇā iti nākhyātarūpādbhedaḥ pratīyate || 450 ||
udāharaṇamāha-- atra phalasādhanabhedād yajikriyāyāḥ satyapi bhede naivākhyātaśabdāt tatpratītirasti, arthasāmarthyāttu bhedastasyā avagamyate iti nānā śabdadharmāḥ || 450 ||
sakṛcchrutā saptadaśasvanāvṛttāpi yā kriyā | prājāpatyeṣu sāmarthyāt sā bhedaṃ pratipadyate || 451 ||
vaidikamapyudāharaṇamāha-- saptadaśa prājāpatyānekavarṇānajāṃstūparānālabhatetyatrānāvṛttāpyālambhanakriyā sakṛcchratā śabdenānāvṛttenaikenāvagatottarakālaṃ tvālabhyabhedādbhedenāvatiṣṭhata iti boddhavyam || 451 ||
devadattādiṣu bhujiḥ pratyekamavatiṣṭhate | pratisvatantraṃ vākyaṃ vā bhedo na pravibhajyate || 452 ||
yasmāccākhyātāntargato dhāturnivṛttabhedāyā eva kriyāyāḥ pratipādakaḥ tasmād bhedāsambhavād yathāsaṃkhyena sambandhānupapatterbhujikriyā devadattādiṣu pratyekamavatiṣṭhata ityāha-- devadattādikartṛkā bhujirvākyārtharūpā'tra pratyekamavatiṣṭhata ityarthasamāptidarśanaṃ śabdasya samāptimapyupadarśayitumuktam `pratisvatantram" ityādi | vākyamevātra pratyekaṃ devadattādiṣu bhedenāvatiṣṭhata iti boddhavyam || 452 ||
uccāraṇe tu vākyānāmanyadrūpaṃ nigṛhyate | pratipattau tu bhinnānāmanyadrūpaṃ pratīyate || 453 ||
nanu devadattayajñadattaviṣṇumitrā bhojyantāmityabhedarūpameva vākyaṃ prayuktam, ataḥ kathamasmād bhedenāvasāyaḥ syādityāha-- śabdānāmanyathoccāraṇasamaye svarūpavṛttiḥ pratipattyavasaretvanyathaiva svarūpāvasāya iti satyapyākhyātasyābhede'rthaparyālocanenātra pratyekaṃ samāptirvākyavākyārthayoḥ paryavasyatītyucyate || 453 ||
ekaṃ grahaṇakaṃ vākyaṃ sāmānyenābhidhīyate | kartarīti yathā tacca paśvādiṣu vibhajyate || 454 ||
śāstraviṣayamapyetadeva pradarśayitumāha-- śāstre'pi ca kartari kṛdityekaṃ pratyayārthapratipādakaṃ sāmānyena grahaṇakavākyamupādīyate, tacca pratyekaṃ pratyayārthopādhiṣu paśvādiṣu vibhinneṣu viṣayeṣu vibhāgena sambandhamupanīyābhimatalakṣyaniṣpattaye vyāpāryata iti pratyekameva tatparisamāpyate || 454 ||
yadyākāṅ‌kṣā nivarteta tadbhūtasya sakṛcchrutau | naivānyenābhisambandhaṃ tadupeyāt kathañcana || 455 ||
yadi punaḥ saṃyuktavidhinopādīyeta tadā'bhimatasiddhayena syādityāha-- yadi sakṛdeva pratyayavidhāyakenaiva sa "vopādāyārthaparisamāpterākāṅ‌kṣā nivāryeta, tadā tadyogena tatraiva parikṣīṇaśaktitvād grahaṇakavākyatāvirahādanyena pratyayavidhāyakena sambandhe (ndhaṃ) naivopeyādityabhimatalakṣyāniṣpattireva || 455 ||
ekarūpamanekārthaṃ tasmādupanibandhanam | yonirvibhāgavākyānāṃ tebhyo'nanyadiva sthitam || 456 ||
tasmādetadupanibandhanabhūtaṃ sāmānyenāsaṃyuktaṃ vidhinaivopāttaṃ sakṛd‌grahaṇa (ka)vākyaṃ sadvibhāgavākyānāmavāntaravākyānāṃ yoniḥ kāraṇaṃ boddhavyamityāha-- aneke'rthāḥ pratyāyyā yasya tattathaā avāntaravākyānyupanibadnte'sminnityupanibandhanam | atha tebhyo'nanyadivābhinnamiva sthitam | atha ca pratyekaṃ bhedena sambandhamupagatya yathāvallakṣyasiddhaye vibhavatīti || 456 ||
kkacit kriyā vyaktibhāgairupakāre pravarttate | sāmānyabhāga evāsyāḥ kkacidarthasya sādhakaḥ || 457 ||
athākhyāte ghātuvācyā'sattvabhūtā pūrvāparībhūtāvayavā sādhyamānāvasthā kṣaṇapracayātmikā yā kriyā tasyāḥ kīdṛśo jātivyaktivyavahāra samāśrīyata ityāha-- "kkacit" iti bādhavikalpasamuccayātiśayapraśaṃsādau viṣaye kriyā vyaktibhāgaiḥ samīhitārthasiddhau pravarttate, jātisamāśrayeṇa vikalpasamuccayādyanupapatteḥ | na hi devadattaḥ pacati, yajñadattaḥ pacatītyādau jāteḥ samuccayādirupapadyate | kkacittu yajate pacata ityādau deśakālasādhanāde (ranupanyāsenai) kavyaktivyavahāro'vāstavaḥ syāditi saṃvṛttyā lokavyavahārasiddhaye tatra kkacitkriyāparāmarśāt sāmānyabhāga eva vākyārthamuparoti || 457 ||
kālabhinnāśca bhedā ye ye cāpyuṣṭrāsikādiṣu | prakrame jātibhāgasya śabdātmā tairna bhidyate || 458 ||
ihāpi jātibhāgameva kriyāsambandhinaṃ śabdāḥ pratyāyantītyāha-- ye kriyābhedāḥ kriyāviśeṣāḥ kālabhinnāḥ pacatyapākṣītpakṣyatītyevamādayo ye cāpyuṣṭrāsikādiṣu viṣaye sādhanabhinnā uṣṭrāsikā āsyante, hataśāyikāḥ śayyante ityādau teṣu kriyāsambandhato jātibhāgasya prakrame sāmānyenaivāparyālocitadeśakālasādhanatayā prakrame ca śabdātmā śabdasvarūpaṃ na bhidyate sādhanasambandhakṛtastatra bhedo na prathata iti yāvat || 458 ||
ekasaṃkhyeṣu bhedeṣu bhinnā jātyādibhiḥ kriyāḥ | bhedena viniyujyante tacchabdasya sakṛcchrutau || 459 ||
tadevaṃ "devadattādiṣu bhujiḥ pratyekamavatiṣṭhate" ityādinā śabdalakṣaṇabhedamāśrityaikā kriyā'nekaiḥ sādhanaiḥ pratyekamarthasamāptyā vākyasambandhamupayātīti pradarśitam | idānīṃ yatra vijātīyā vibhinnapadavācyā kriyā, ekaśabdavācyāni ca sādhanāni tatra kathaṃ bhinnābhiḥ kriyābhasteṣāṃ sādhanānāṃ sambandhaḥ syādityāśaṅkya tatrāpi pratipattikālasamāśrayaṇena bhinnānyeva sādhanānyavagatānīti tathaivaitāḥ kriyāstairbhinnaireva sādhanaiḥ pratyekamarthasamāptyā vākyasambandhamupayāntīti pratipadayitumāha-- sāmānasaṃkhyeṣu bhedeṣu sādhanaviśeṣeṣu teṣu "jātyādibhiḥ" iti | jātyā ādigrahaṇāditikarttavyatādibhiśca yāḥ kriyā bhinnā asambaddhā upāttāstāḥ sādhanābhidhāyinaḥ śabdasya sakṛdabhedena śrutāvapi pratipattibhedasamāśrayaṇena bhedenaiva viniyujyante sambandhamupagacchantīti boddhavyam || 459 ||
akṣādiṣu yathā bhinnā bhañjibhakṣidivikriyāḥ | prayogakālābhede'pi pratibhedaṃ pṛthak sthitāḥ || 460 ||
udāharaṇamāha-- akṣā bhajyantāṃ bhujyantāṃ dīvyantāmiti yā bhinnajātikā bhinnaśabdavācyāśca kriyā yāstā vākyabhedopādānarahitā api pratyekaṃ samāptyā bhedenaiva sthitā iti | yasmādanyasādhanāni tatra nibaddhāni bhedenaivopāttānīti pratipattivelāyāṃ bhebenaiva kriyā yathāsvaṃ sambandhamupayāntīti || 460 ||
akṣāṇāṃ tantriṇāṃ tantramupāyastulyarūpatā | eṣāṃ kramo vibhaktānāṃ tannibaddhā sakṛcchrutiḥ || 461 ||
tantranyāyapratipādanapūrvakamabhidhātumāha-- tulyarūpatetyanena tantraṃ vyācaṣṭe | yuktaṃ caitat | yasmācchabdāḥ krameṇa vibhāgenaiva kadācit prayujyante kadācittantranyāyasamāśrayaṇena yugapadeveti śabdānāṃ prayogavelāyāṃ kramayaugapadye upāyastadatra tantreṇa yugapadeva bhinnāḥ prayuktā akṣā iti kriyābhedevaiṣāṃ sambandhaṃ gacchanti || 461 ||
dvāvabhyupāyau śabdānāṃ prayoge samavasthitau | kramo vā yaugapadyaṃ vā yau loko nātirttate || 462 ||
atha kramayaugapadyasvarūpamatroddiśya vyākhyātumāha-- krame vibhidyate rūpaṃ yaugapadye na bhidyate | kriyā tu yaugapadye'pi kramarūpānupātinī || 463 || bhedasaṃsargaśaktī dve śabdādbhinne iva sthite | yaugapadye'pyanekena prayoge bhidyate śrutiḥ || 464 ||
tatra.-- rūpavibhāgenaiva kramaḥ sādhāraṇyena yaugapadyaṃ tatra bhinnākriyā yaugapadyeti (pi) śabdānāṃ prayoge kramarūpamevānupatatītyarthatathābhāvātkramarūpānupātinyeva boddhavyeti pratipādayitumāha--kriyeti | tathā ca śakaṭākṣasyaiva bhañjanaṃ na vibhītakadevanākṣayoḥ, tathā vibhītakākṣasyaiva bhakṣaṇaṃ netarayoḥ, devanākṣasyaiva devanaṃ na pūrvayorityarthatathābhāvādyaugapadye'pi kramānupātinyevāsāviti | tataśca te kramayaugapadye bedasaṃsargaśaktirūpe śabdavyāpārarūpe api śabdebhyo bhinne iva vyatirikte iva sthate lakṣyete ||463||
paramārthatastu śabdaśaktī eva kramayaugapadye ityabhidhātumāha-- kintarhi, śabdasyaivaite dve śaktī, yadbhedaśaktyā krameṇāvabhāti, saṃsargaśaktyā tu yugapaditi | nanvevaṃ bhedaprayoge'nekena kriyāpadena sambandhādbhidyata eva sādhāraṇyād yaugapadyakramasvarūpayorbhedāt kathaṃ yugapatprayoge kramarūpānupātitvameva kriyāyāḥ śruteruktamityāha--yaugapadya iti | yaugapadye'pi sādhanasya prayoge bhedena kriyāpadasambandhādbhidyata eva sādhāraṇī śrutiriti, tantre hi sā bhinnaivopāttetyarthaḥ || 464 ||
abhinno bhedarūpeṇa ya eko'rtho vivakṣitaḥ | tatrāvayavadharmeṇa samudāyo'nugṛhyate || 465 ||
athavā akṣā ityatrod‌bhūtāvayavabhedaḥ samudāya eva pratinirdiśyate, tatrāvayavadharmeṇa samudāyo vyapadiśyate ityevaṃ bhedamupapādyayathāyogaṃ pratyekamarthasamāptyā vā kriyāṇāṃ bhinnānāṃ viniyogaḥ kriyata ityāha-- abhinnaḥ samudāyasvarūpo bhedarūpeṇod‌bhūtāvayavabhedatayā yo'trārtho vivakṣitastatrāvayavadharmeṇa bhedena krameṇeti yāvatsamudāyo'nugṛhyate upod‌balīkriyata iti bhedapratipattau bhedenaiva kriyāṇāṃ sambandhaḥ | ataścāsya samudāyasya bhedapratipādane pratyekaṃ vākyārthaḥ parisamāpyate || 465 ||
bhedanirvacane tvasya pratyekaṃ vā samāpyate | śrutirvacanabhinnā vā vākyabhede'vatiṣṭhate || 466 ||
athavā vacanabhinna ekaśabda evākṣo bhujyatām, akṣo dīvyatāmityevamavāntaravākyopaplāvinī sādhanaśrutirbhedenaivāvatiṣṭhata ityāha-- tatraikavacanānto vā so'kṣaśabdaḥ prayujyate | pratyekaṃ vā bahutvena pravibhāgo yathāśruti || 467 ||
śabdaparisamāpterbhedaprakāramāha-- ekasamādvākyādvākyabhedena sambandhinīvyavahrayamāṇe satyakṣo bhakṣyatāmityādyekavacanasyaivākṣaśabdasya prayogaḥ kadācit | athavā yathāśruti pratyekaṃ bahuvacanāntenaivavākyābheda ityāha pratyekamiti | akṣā majyantāmityādikaḥ pravibhāgaḥ śrutyanatikrameṇaika vākyānāṃ karaṇīyaḥ || 467 ||
dviṣṭhāni yāni vākyāni teṣvapyekatvadarśinām | anekaśakterekasya svaśaktiḥ pravibhajyate || 468 ||
idānīmabhedavādināmapi mate dviṣṭhānāṃ vākyānāṃ śaktibhedenaiva vibhāgamabhighātumāha-- dvayorarthayostiṣṭhantīti dviṣṭhāni śāstrīyāṇi laukikāni ca yāni vākyāni teṣvapi śabdaikatvadarśināṃ mate ekasyaiva tasya pratipādakasya śabdasyānekaśkterasau svaśaktireva pravibhajyate | yathā "igyaṇaḥ samprasāraṇam" "dvirvacane'ci" taddharati vahatyāvahati bhārādvaśādibhyaḥ `tadasya brahmacaryam" ityādīni śāstrīyāṇi | tathā śveto dhāvati, alambusānāṃ pātetyādīni laukikāni vākyāni | teṣvapyarthadvayapratipādanāya śaktirvibhajyata iti śaktitantrapratipādanam || 468 ||
atyantabhinnayorvā syāt prayogastantralakṣaṇaḥ | upāyastatra saṃsargaḥ pratipattṛṣu bhidyate || 469 ||
bhedadarśināṃ punarmate bhinnāveva śabdau tantreṇopāttāviti śabdatantraṃ pratipādayitumāha-- tatraivaṃ tantreṇa dvyarthe tasmin prayoge pratipattyayoge pratipattyanusāreṇobhayātmāsau saṃsargo vākyābhidheyalakṣaṇo bhidyate | yathā yaṇsthānikasyeg‌lakṣaṇasya varṇasya kā saṃjñā syādityekena pṛṣṭam, tadapareṇa yaṇi ko'rthaḥ ? sthānyādeśabhāvalakṣaṇaḥ sambandhaḥ, sa kiṃ saṃjña iti, lāghavādācāryastantranyāyasamāśrayaṇāt samprasāraṇamityekenaiva śabdenottaramāha | tathaikena pṛṣṭaṃ kiñjātīyo dhāvatītyapareṇa kiṃvarṇo dhāvatyanayorlāghavāt prativakti śveto dhāvatīti | tatrāsau vākyārthaḥ pratipattṛṣu bhidyate, yena pṛṣṭaṃ kiñjātīyastasya śvā ito dhāvatītyevaṃrūpatayā vyavatiṣṭhate | yena ca kiṃvarṇa ityuktaṃ tasya śvetaguṇayukto dhāvatītyartharūpo'sau jāyata iti tantranibandhanā dvidhātrārthavyaktirupajāyata iti | evamanyatra vyākhyeyam || 469 ||
bhedenāvagatau pūrvaṃ śabdau tulyaśrutī punaḥ | tantreṇa pratipattāraṃ prayoktrā pratipāditāḥ || 470 ||
etadeva vyākhyātumāha-- pūrvaṃ yau śabdau bhedena rūpavailakṣaṇyenādhigatau śvā itaḥ śveta iti tāveva tulyaśrutī bhinnāveva tantreṇa pratipattāraḥ, yasmāttantranyāyasamāśrayaṇenātra prayoktrā pratipāditāḥ pratibodhitāḥ || 470 ||
ekasyāpi vivakṣāyāmanuniṣpadyate paraḥ | vinā'bhisaṃdhinā śabdaḥ śaktirūpaḥ prakāśate || 471 ||
idānīmatra vakturekasyaiva śabdasya pratipādane vivakṣopajāyate, tasyāṃ satyāmaparo'nuniṣpadyata iti śabdabhedamate prakārāntareṇa tantramupapādayitumāha-- vaktricchāvirahādapi sādhāraṇatvādaparasya niṣpattistato'rthadvayapratipattiḥ | abhedavādināmapi mate tantrasya prakārāntaramāha--vineti | prayoktrabhisandhānamantareṇa tatrāsau śabdaḥ sādhāraṇatvācchaktidvayayuktaḥ prakāśate | etaduktaṃ bhavati--śulkajātīyapratyāyanaśaktiḥ prāṇiviśeṣapratyāyanaśaktirvā śvetaśabdastatrodīritaḥ, sa tatraikamarthaṃ pratyāyayaṃstantreṇa sāmarthyādarthāntaraprakāśanaṃ karotyeva || 471 ||
anekaśaktirekasya yugapacchrīyate kkacit | agniḥ prakāśadāhābhyāmekatrāpi niyujyate || 472 ||
athavā tulyakakṣatayā śaktidvayayogādyugapadeva arthadvayaprakāśanaṃ karotīti śaktitantratāmāśrityaha-- ekasyaiva śabdasya kkacit śveto dhāvatītyādau viṣaye yugapadevārthadvayapratyāyanasamarthaṃ śaktidvayamāśrīyate, yathā kkacidavasare dāhaprakāśābhyāṃ yukto'gnirekatrāpi prakāśe dāhe vā niyujyate upayogavaśāddharmadvayāyāpyupādīyata ityarthaḥ | tathaivānekaśaktiyogādyugapadarthadvayaprakāśanāya śabdaḥ samāśrīyata iti || 472 ||
āvṛttiśaktibhinnārthe vākye sakṛdapi śrute | liṅgādvā tantradharmādvā vibhāgenāvatiṣṭhate || 473 ||
idānīṃ śāstraviṣayamapyetadupadarśayitumāha-- igyaṇaḥ samprasāraṇamityetasmin vākye sakṛdapi śrute kīdṛśe śabdabhedavādināṃ mate āvṛttibhinnārthe, ekatvavādināṃ mate śaktibhyāṃ bhinnārthe | tatra hi śaktibhedādarthabhedaḥ, anantaraṃ tadvākyaṃ pratipattiśabdabhedamate liṅgād jñāpakādvibhāgenāvatiṣṭhate varṇavākyārthapratyāyakatayā'vatiṣṭhata ityarthaḥ | yasmātyamprasāraṇasyeti bhūtavibhaktinirdeśaṃ paśyati, tato'vasyati varṇaḥ saṃjñīti vasoḥ samprāsaraṇamityādau bhāvivibhaktinirdeśādvākyārthasyāpi saṃjñitvamavasyatītyāvṛttimeva śabdabhedavādyanuminoti | abhedavādī tu śaktibhedaṃ tantradharmācchaktitantralakṣaṇādanuminotītyatra samprasāraṇaśabdaḥ śaktidvayavaśādyugapadvarṇavākyalakṣaṇasyārthadvayasyāpi pratipādanaṃ karotyeva || 473 ||
samprasāraṇasaṃjñāyāṃ liṅgābhyāṃ varṇavākyayoḥ | pravibhāgastatra sūtre ekasminneva kalpate || 474 ||
liṅgābhyāmupadarśitābhyāṃ bhāvibhūtavibhaktinirdeśalakṣaṇābhyāṃ tatra ekasminneva sūtre varṇavākyārthayoḥ saṃjñinoḥ prayogo labhyata iti || 474 || tathā dvirvacane'cīti tantropāyādilakṣaṇaḥ | ekaśeṣeṇa nirdeśo bhāṣya evopavarṇitaḥ || 475 ||
uktaṃ ca vibhaktiviśeṣanirdeśastu jñāpaka ubhayasaṃjñātvasya' iti | tantraṃ cedamekaśeṣasamānaphalaṃ bhāṣye pradeśeṣūpanyastamiti bhāṣyakārābhyupagamenārthatantrasiddhimupapādayitumāha-- iha dvirvacane'cītyatra dvirvacananimitte'ci yo'jādeśaḥ sa dvirvacana eva kartavye sthānivaditi sūtrārtho vyākhyāyate, tatroktaṃ yatpunardvitīyaṃ dvirvacanagrahaṇaṃ karttavyaṃ na karttavyamityāha--"ekaśeṣanirdeśāt siddham" iti | yadyekaśeṣastadā dvirvacanaṃ prāpnotītyata ekaśeṣasamānaphalasādhāraṇalakṣaṇaṃ tantramevātraikaśeṣaśabdenoktam | tena tantropāyāddhetorlakṣaṇa evaikaśeṣanirdeśaḥ pradarśitaḥ | tasmādekaśeṣamantareṇāpi tantranyāyasamāśrayaṇād dvirvacane'cītyatrārthasaṅgaterekaśeṣasamānaphala śāstrapravṛttyupāyabhūtaṃ tantramabhyupagataṃ bhāṣya iti siddham || 475 ||
prāyeṇa saṃkṣeparucīnalpavidyāparigrahān | saṃprāpya vaiyākaraṇān saṃgrahe'stamupāgate || 476 ||
atha mahābhāṣyasyāvatārānvākhyānapūrvakaṃ ṭīkākāro mahattāmupavarṇayan svaracitasya granthasya gurupūrvakramamabhidhātumāha-- iha purā pāṇinīye'smin vyākaraṇe vyāḍyuparacitaṃ granthalakṣaparimāṇaṃ saṃgrahābhidhānaṃ nibandhanamāsīt | tacca kālavaśāt sukumārabuddhīn vaiyākaraṇān prāpyāstamupāgatam | tasmāt kleśabhīrutvāt saṃkṣeparucayaste jānāḥ | ata evālpo vidyāsu parigrahaḥ svīkāro yeṣāṃ te tathā | tatastaiḥ saṃgrahādhyayana upekṣite satyastaṃ yātaḥ saṃgrahaḥ ||476||
kṛte'tha pacañjalinā guruṇā tīrthadarśinā | sarveṣāṃ nyāyabījānāṃ mahābhāṣye nibandhane || 477 ||
sādhutvajñānaupayikatayā dharmasādhanatvenopajātopayogāya vyākaraṇasmṛteravicchedāya karuṇāprayuktenātha bhagavatā patañjalinā vārttikavyākhyānapuraḥsaraṃ mābhāṣyanibandhanamuparacitamityabhidhātumāha-- guruṇeti bhāṣyakarttuḥ pūjāpade | tīrthānyāgamaviśeṣāḥ | tān paśyati vijānātīti tīrthadarśo | anena gurutvanibandhanaḥ prabhāvātiśayo bhagavata uktaḥ | tacca bhāṣyaṃ na kevalaṃ vyākaraṇasya nibandhanaṃ yāvatsarveṣāṃ nyāyabījānāṃ boddhavyamityata eva sarvanyāyabījahetutvādeva mahacchabdena viśeṣya mahābhāṣyamityucyate loke || 477 ||
alabdhagādhe gāmbhīryāduttān iva sauṣṭhavāt | tasminnakṛtabuddhīnāṃ naivāvāsthita niścayaḥ || 478 ||
atha mahattvameva viśeṣaṇadvāreṇāsyopapādayitumāha-- gādho niṣṭhāpariccheda iyatteti yāvat | asāvalabdho yasya | kasmādityāha--gāmbhīryāt iti | gāmbhīryaṃ gahanatā prameyabāhulyena durvagāhatvam | atigambhīraṃ hi bhāṣyamuparacitaṃ bhagavatā pacañjalineti na tasyābhidheyaṃ vyavacchettuṃ kenacichakyata iti | kimevamekāntaṃ gahanamidaṃ bhāṣyam ? netyāha--uttāna iva ityādi | uttānaṃ sṣaṣṭaṃ sauṣṭhavaṃ paripāṭī yasmādetadbhāṣyaṃ paripāṭilakṣaṇādatra sauṣṭhavāduttānaṃ spaṣṭaprāyaṃ yata eva pratibhāti | atonedamasevyaṃ sajjanamānasamiva nisargasukumāramatigambhīraṃ caitadata eva mahābhāṣyamityucyata ityarthaḥ | etena saṃgrahānusāreṇa bhagavatā patañjilinā saṃgrahasaṃkṣepabhūtameva prāyaśo bhāṣyamupanibaddhamityuktaṃ veditavyam | tadevaṃ brahmakāṇḍe "kāyavāg‌buddhiviṣayā ye malāḥ"ityādiślokena bhāṣyakāra praśaṃsoktā | iva caivaṃ bhāṣyapraśaṃseti śāstrasya śāstrakarttuśca ṭīkākṛtā mahattopavarṇitā | ata evedaṃ māhabhāṣyamakṛtabuddhayo naiva bod‌dhumalamityāha--tasminniti | kṛtā vyutpattyā prakarṣaṃ prāptā mahatī buddhiryeṣāṃ te, tathā tadrūpavaikalyenākṛtabuddhayaḥ svalapaprajñā ucyante | teṣāṃ niścayo nirṇayaparyanto bodho naivātrāvāsthita na pratiṣṭhāmalabhata | na tenāsmad‌gurostatrabhavato vasurātādanyaḥ kaścidimaṃ bhāṣyārṇavamavagāhitumahamityuktaṃ bhavati || 478 ||
baijisaubhavaryyakṣaiḥ śuṣkatarkānusāribhiḥ | ārṣe viplāvite granthe saṃgrahapratikañcuke || 479 ||
tathā ca saṃgrahapratipakṣabhūtairācāryaistarkavidyāmātravedibhirbuddhyapāṭavādidamāplāvitamāmāsīkṛtamityāha-- śuṣkatarkaḥ kevala evānyaśāstraparimalarahito bhaṇyate | tamevānusaranti prameyanirṇayāyeti tadanusāriṇaḥ | mahābhāṣyaṃ hi bahuvidhavidyāvādabalamārṣaṃ vyavasthitam, tataścānvākṣikīmātrakuśalaḥ kathaṃ tanniścinuyāditi tarkamātrānusāribhistaistadviplāvitam | tarkaśca puruṣāṇāṃ svabuddhimātranirmitavigraho'vyavasthita eva | yaduktam -- "yatnenānumito'pyarthaḥ kuśalairanumātṛbhiḥ | abhiyuktatarairanyairanyathaivopapādyate" || iti 479 ||
yaḥ patañjaliśiṣyebhyo bhraṣṭo vyakaraṇāgamaḥ | kāle sa dākṣiṇātyeṣu granthamātre vyavasthitaḥ || 480 ||
itthaṃ ca parasparavaimatyādāgamasaṃjñātyagācca yathāvasthito vyākaraṇāgamaḥ patañjaliśiṣyebhyaḥ kālaparivāsād bhraṣṭaḥ san granthamātre pāṭhamātra eva vyavasthito dākṣiṇātyeṣvityāha-- tadevamutsannakalpaḥ saṃjāto vyākaraṇāgamaḥ ||480||
parvatādāgamaṃ labdhvā bhāṣyabījānusāribhiḥ | sa nīto bahuśākhtvaṃ candrācāryādibhiḥ punaḥ || 481 ||
atha kālāntareṇa candrācāryādibhirāgamaṃ labdhvā tena copāyabhūtena sakalāni bhāṣyāvasthitāni nyāyabījāni tānyanusṛtya vyākaraṇāgamaḥ punarapi sphītatāṃ nīta ityabhidhātumāha-- parvatāt trikūṭaikadeśavarttitriliṅgaikadeśāditi | tatra hyupalatale rāvaṇaviracito mūlabhūtavyākaraṇāgamastiṣṭhati, kenacicca brahmarakṣasā''nīya candrācāryavasurātaguruprabhṛtīnāṃ datta iti | te khalu yathāvad vyākaraṇasya svarūpaṃ tata upalabhya satataṃ ca śiṣyāṇā vyākhyāya bahuśākhitvaṃ nīto vistaraṃ prāpita ityanuśrūyate || 481 ||
nyāyaprasthānamārgāṃstānabhyasya svaṃ ca darśanam | praṇīto guruṇā'smākamayamāgamasaṃgrahaḥ || 482 ||
atha kadācid yogato vicārya tatra bhagavatā vasurātaguruṇā mamāyamāgamaḥ saṃjñāya vātsalyāt praṇīta iti svaracitasyāsya gurupūrvakramamamidhātumāha-- nyāyasya pratiṣṭhā prasthānaṃ tasya mārgān nyāyaprasthānamārgān nyāyapratiṣṭhitairbahubhirmārgairiti yāvat | nyāyaprasthānamārgāstaṃstān svaṃ ca darśanaṃ vyākaraṇasiddhāntalakṣaṇamabhyasyāyaṃ praṇītaḥ | anena guruṇā saṃjñāyana tathā mamāyamāgamasaṃgrahaḥ praṇītaḥ, yena sandaho bhavetapi tu sāvadhānenetyuktaṃ bhavati | asmākamiti bahuvacanādanyeṣāmapi sahādhyāyināṃ grahaṇam | athavā mayā tu tadanucchedāyāmupanibandhaḥ kṛta ityātmano bahumānaḥ prakaṭitaḥ || 482 ||
vartmanāmatra keṣāñcid vastumātramudāhṛtam | kāṇḍe tṛtīye nyakṣeṇa bhaviṣyati vicāraṇā || 483 ||
nanvetāvāneva kimayaṃ kāṇḍadvayaprokto vyākaraṇāgama ityāśaṅkyāha-- atrāsmin vākyakāṇḍe kāṇḍadvaye vā keṣāñcideva nyāyavartmanāṃ vastumātraṃ bījamātraṃ pradarśitamiva | śiṣṭe tu tṛtīye'sya granthasya padakāṇḍadvayaniṣyandabhūte nyakṣeṇādaraviśeṣaṇa svasiddhāntaparasiddhāntavartināṃ vicāraṇā yuktāyuktavicāra pūrvakanirṇotirbhaviṣyati | tato nāyametāvān vyākaraṇāgamasaṃgraha iti ||483||
prajñāvivekaṃ labhate bhinnairāgamadarśanaiḥ | kiyadvā śakyamunnetuṃ svatarkamanudhāvatā || 484 ||
nanu tattannyāyapratthānamārgābhyāsena kiṃ kṛtyaṃ svadarśanameva niścitaṃ kiṃ na vicāryata ityāha-- nānāvidhairāgamadarśanairāgama siddhāntaiḥ khalu prajñā vivekaṃ labhate vaiśāradyamāproti | tataśca niḥ saṃdigdhaṃ svasiddhāntameva saṃpariṣkarturbhinnāgamadarśanaiḥ śaktirjāyate | anyathā'dṛṣṭaparakīyāgamasvarūpeṇa pratipattrā svotprekṣāmeva teṣu teṣu cāvasthāneṣvanusaratā vi yacchakyāmunnetuṃ pratividhātum | kadācitparamarṣayo yogajadharmotpannasāmarthyād yathāvatpadārthān paśyantaḥ siddhāntamalamiti śobhate | ye tvārurukṣavaḥ prāthamakalpikā malinacittavṛttayaḥ śāstrādevātītānāgatavyavahitapadārthasvarūpaṃ niścinvanti, teṣaṃ nānāgamopasevayaivānuprasīdati bhagavatī pratibheti yuktam || 484 ||
tattadutprekṣamāṇānāṃ purāṇairāgamairvinā | anupāsitavṛddhānāṃ vidyā nātiprasīdati || 485 ||
etadeva nirupayitumāha-- pratiṣṭhāmupagataiḥ pūrvairāgamairbahuvidhairvinā svayameva tattadityayathāyathamevotprekṣamāṇānāṃ vikalpayatāṃ pratipatṝṇāṃ śāstropajñamedhāvirahiṇāṃ paṇḍitammanyānāmabhimānāgrahāghātānāṃ teṣāṃ bhagavatī vidyā viśuddhaprajñā pratibhālakṣaṇā na prasīdati atyartham, kiṃ tarhi vṛddhopasevāśālināmāgamajuṣāṃ vigalitābhimānānāmevaiṣā bhagavatī prajñā prasādamupayātīti siddhaḥ || 485 ||
tadayamatra meyasamuccayaḥ-- vākyānāmaṣṭadhaivādau vibhāgaḥ parikīrtitaḥ | śāstrīyamaimāṃsakayoḥ kīrtanaṃ vākyayostataḥ || 1 ||
bālābalavicāro'pi śāstrīyo vyāptinirṇayāt | tataścātra samāsena vākyalakṣaṇanirṇayaḥ || 2 ||
sandehaścāgamenāpi vākyabhedasya darśitaḥ | sphoṭa eva tu siddhānte vākyaṃ vākyeṣu sādhitam || 3 ||
padavādastvanumato neti vyākaraṇe sthitam | tato'nvitābhidhānasyābhihitānvayakasya ca || 4 ||
śabdabhāgārthabhāgābhyāṃ dūṣaṇavrātakīrtanam | prasaṅgenāpare'pyatra vākyārthāḥ ṣaṭ pradarśitāḥ || 5 ||
akhaṇḍavākyapakṣe ca codyapañcakakīrtanam | upapattiḥ pratinidhernāstīti prathamaṃ yathā || 6 ||
pikādipasandeho nopapadyata ityapi | śrutivākyavirodhe tu śrutireva balīyasī || 7 ||
pratiṣṭhitasya nyāyasyāpyevaṃ tyāgaḥ prasajyate | avāntarāṇāṃ vākyānāmupapattirvirudhyate || 8 ||
prāsaṅgikādiṣu tathā lakṣaṇeṣvapyasambhavaḥ | prānpotyevamakhaṇḍe'sminvākye doṣā udāhṛtāḥ || 9 ||
apoddhāraṃ samāśritya doṣāstvete nirākṛtaḥ | saṃhitāyāṃ vibhāge'tha padayorvilayaṃ gate || 10 ||
upādānāvadhiṃ karttuṃ tayorarthaḥ prakalpyatām | iti dūṣaṇamatrādhātpade vākye ca vākyavit || 11 ||
tatra nyāyavaśādatra svapakṣe doṣasaṃvṛtiḥ | vākyārthasyātra bhedo'pi vikalpya parikalpitaḥ || 12 ||
pratibhedaṃ ca siddhānte vākyārtha upapāditaḥ | pravibhāgāśrayādatra padārthasyāpi sambhavaḥ || 13 ||
sa ca dvādaśadhā bhinna ityatropapāditam | pratibhālakṣaṇaṃ samyagvidhātuṃ saṃhitaṃ kutam || 14 ||
padabhāgārthabhāgāśca vitatya pratipāditāḥ | anvayavyatirekābhyāṃ vivaktitopapāditā || 15 ||
sanimittā ca sā'pyatra nāmākhyātasamāśrayā | upasarganipātāśca karmapravacanīyakāḥ || 16 ||
padabhedāḥ prasaṅgena lakṣaṇenopalakṣitāḥ | sārthakānarthakatvābhyāṃ vicāre varṇaniṣṭhite || 17 ||
kṛte'pyakhaṇḍapakṣo'tra pratiṣṭhāmupanāmitaḥ | padavāde'tha doṣāṇāṃ caturṇāṃ parikīrtanam || 18 ||
samāseṣu viruddhārthaprāptirādāvudāhṛtā | adhyādīnāṃ tathā vākye sādhanasyābhidhāyitā || 19 ||
arthāsaṅgatirapyatra bahuvrīherudāhṛtā | prajñusaṃjñvādiṣu tathā nāstyartho'vayaveṣvapi || 20 ||
iti codyacatuṣkeṇa padavādaḥ parākṛtaḥ | sthāpite'khaṇḍapakṣe'pi codyasaptakamāhitam || 21 ||
dvandve samāsenaiva syād bahvarthasyābhidhāyikā | vibhaktiriti doṣo'tra prathamaṃ parikīrttitam || 22 ||
vākyasyārthasamāptistu pratyekaṃ nopapadyate | parāmarśaśca naiva syāt sarvanāmabhireva ca || 23 ||
anuṣṭhānaṃ krameṇātha vākyārthasya na jātucit | syādakrame tvanuṣṭhānaṃ śakyate na kathañcana || 24 ||
ekadeśasya karaṇe samudāye'rthakāritā | abhimanyata ityetadakhaṇḍe nopapadyate || 25 ||
etāni pañca codyānyapoddhārasya samāśrayāt | samarthitāni vai samyagakhaṇḍaṃ vākyamicchatā || 26 ||
athākhaṇḍaṃ yadā vākyaṃ samāseṣvarthavarṇanā | pṛthak‌ pṛthak‌ tadā tasyāḥ sā ca śāstre prakīrtitā || 27 ||
nañ‌samāse padārthasya vikalpairbahubhiḥ punaḥ | prādhānyaṃ parikalpyātha bhāṣye pakṣāḥ parīkṣitāḥ || 28 ||
yadyakhaṇḍamidaṃ vākyaṃ naiṣā syāt kalpanā kkacit | doṣāvetāvapi śabdaprakriyāmātrameva ca || 29 ||
śāstrapravṛttāviti ca nirākaraṇametayoḥ | tataścākhaṇḍapakṣasya sa bādha upadarśitaḥ || 30 ||
jahatsvārthavikalpena bahuvrīhyādigāminā | pratyuta prajñudoṣaśca padavāde prakīrttitaḥ || 31 ||
prakṛtyarthaḥ pratyayārtha iti bhinno parasparam | yāvat sthitau tayorekāpāyenāvagatiḥ katham || 32 ||
ihā'haṃ nāstīti ca sā dṛṣṭā syādvāstave katham | padārthaṃ prati doṣo'thaṃ padavāde samud‌dhṛtaḥ || 33 ||
pratyayadvayagamye'rthe ekasmādeva tanmate | attītyādau kathaṃ ca syāt satyatā padapaddhateḥ || 34 ||
satyatve'tha padānāṃ syāt prakṛtipratyayārthayoḥ | kathaṃ lakṣaṇaśāstreṣu sāṅkaryeṇa vyavasthitiḥ || 35 ||
padārthamanyathaivādau pratipadyānyathā punaḥ | vākyārthapratipattiśca dṛṣṭā naitatsamañjasam || 36 ||
satyabhūteṣvatha padeṣviti vākyavido jaguḥ | nañarthānupapatteśca nāsti vādaḥ padāśrayaḥ || 37 ||
upāttatyagasaṃprāpte sarvatreti ca dūṣaṇam | saha prāguktadauṣaiścāpyekādaśa samīritāḥ || 38 ||
padavāde'tra doṣāstu pṛthak pakṣadvayaṃ punaḥ | śabdabhāgārthabhāgābhyāṃ vistareṇa vicakṣaṇaiḥ || 39 ||
nirākṛtamato yukto vākyavādaparigrahaḥ | doṣaḥ saṃjñinyatikrāntaḥ sūtrakārābhisaṃmataḥ || 40 ||
apoddhārāśrayādatra gauṇamukhyavicāraṇā | tataḥ kṛtā suniyataṃ ṭīkākāreṇa sādaram || 41 ||
satyāsatyavibhāgo'pi jñānānāmupapāditaḥ | mukhyānāntarīyakayorarthayoranivartanam || 42 ||
tatastvarthacatuṣkasya cintanaṃ vihitaṃ kramāt | śabdārthanirṇayopāyāḥ sādaraṃ parikīrttitāḥ || 43 ||
tātparyaṃ paripāṭyāścārthatātparyamapīti ca | vākyaniṣṭhaṃ samāsena vicāritamataḥ pṛthak || 44 ||
utsargasyā'pavādasya vivekaḥ parikīrtitaḥ | saṃjñāśabdeṣvatha kṛtā nirṇayaḥ parivatsarān || 45 ||
pratyekaṃ samudāye ca samāptyā vākyaniścitiḥ | nyāyaḥ sañcintitaścātra lakṣito'pyabhidhīyate || 46 ||
atha pūrvoktasaṃkṣepadvāreṇāpyupapāditaḥ | vākyavākyārthaniṣṭhaśca padaniṣṭhaśca nirṇayaḥ || 47 ||
vākyaikavākyatāyāśca vicāro'pi nirūpitaḥ | sākāṅakṣatvaṃ nirākāṅ‌kṣā vākyānāṃ parikīrtitā || 48 ||
yadvā cintāsamāse'pyanyasmādvastunirūpitā | athātra tantranyāyasya siddhirbhāṣyānugā smṛtā || 49 ||
avatāro'pi bhāṣyasya saṃgrahe'stamupāgate | nibandhahetau śāstrasya ṭīkākāreṇa kīrtitaḥ || 50 ||
saṃgrahārthādyanuguṇarūpatvaṃ copapāditam | viplāvanamathaitasya saṃgrahapratipakṣataḥ || 51 ||
kṛtamācāryadaivajñairāveśavivaśaistataḥ | bhraṣṭasyāmnāyasārasya vaiyākaraṇagāminaḥ || 52 ||
mūlabhūtamavāpyātha parvatādāgamaṃ svayam | ācāryavasurātena nyāyamārgānvicintya saḥ || 53 ||
praṇīto vidhivaccāyaṃ mama vyākaraṇāgamaḥ | mayāpi gurunirdiṣṭādbhāṣyānnyāyāviluptaye || 54 ||
kāṇḍatrayakrameṇāyaṃ nibandhaḥ parikīrtitaḥ | granthakāreṇa granthe'smin svasmingurvāgamaḥ sphuṭam || 55 ||
ityevaṃ vākyakāṇḍasya prameyaviṣayā sphuṭam | saṅgatiḥ kīrtitā laghvī samāsena nirākulā || 56 ||
vidvajjanānāṃ yaḥ khalu sarvatra gīyate jagati | tata upasṛtya viracitā rājānakaśūra varmanāmnā vai || 57 ||
śaśāṅkaśiṣyācchru tvaitadvākyakāṇḍaṃ samāsataḥ | puṇyarājena tasyoktā saṅgatiḥ kārikāśritā || 58 ||
gurave bharttṛharaye śabdabrahmavide namaḥ | sarvasiddhāntasandīhasārāmṛtamayāya || 59 ||
iti śrīpuṇyarājakṛtā vākyapadīyadvitīyakāṇḍaṭīkā samāptā || <3.1> śrī gaṇeśāya namaḥ | || om namaḥ śrībhagavatpāṇinikātyāyanapatañjalibhyaḥ ||  yasminsaṃmukhatāṃ prayāti ruciraṃ ko'pyantarujjṛmbhate nedīyānmahimā manasyabhinavaḥ puṃsaḥ prakāśātmanaḥ | tṛptiṃ yatparamāṃ tanoti viṣayāsvādaṃ vinā śāśvatīṃ dhāmānandasudhāmayorjitavapustatprātibhaṃ saṃstumaḥ || 1 ||
kāṇḍadvaye yathāvṛtti siddhāntārthasatattvataḥ | prabandho vihito'smābhirāgamārthānusāribhiḥ || 2 ||
taccheṣabhūte kāṇḍe'sminsaprapañce svarūpataḥ | ślokārthadyotanaparaḥ prakāśo'yaṃ vidhīyate || 3 ||
 iha padārthaṣṭakavicārauparatvād vākyapadīyasya prathamakāṇḍena prayojanādipadārthe nirṇīte'nantarakāṇḍopapāditopapattibhiḥ vākyatadarthayoranvākhyeyasthitalakṣaṇayoḥ padārthayornirṇītatvāt tadaupayikāpoddhārarūpapadavicāraḥ prakramyate | tatrāniyatavikalpo yathābhiprāyamapoddhāra iti yathāsaṃbhavaṃ padabhedānuddiśati-- dvidhā kaiścitpadaṃ bhinnaṃ caturdhā pañcadhāpi vā | apauddhṛtyaiva vākyebhyaḥ prakṛtipratyayādivat || 1 ||
 vākyasyaiva niraṃśasya vācakatvādantarā padapratipattirvibhrama iti kimasatyena padena vyutpāditenetyāśaṅkya `apoddhṛtyaiva vākyebhyaḥ' ityāha | apoddhṛtya kalpanābuddhyā pṛthak padaṃ niṣkṛṣya | akhaṇḍavākyavyutpattāvupāyaḥ padavyutpattirvākyavādinām, akhaṇḍapadavyutpattāviva parikalpitarūpaprakṛtipratyayāgamādeśādipyutpattiḥ padavādinām | ānantyāddhi vākyānāṃ svālakṣaṇyenāśakyā vyutpattiḥ kartumiti sadṛśapadadvārā tadupapattirityarthaḥ ||  ubhayorapi cāpoddhṛtasyāsatyatvaṃ samānam | tathā hi-aniyatānupūrvīko yathārthaṃ parikalpitānvayavyatirekanibandhano vākyavādināṃ padāpoddhāraḥ | evaṃ padavādināṃ śāstrīyānvayavyatirekanimittārthāpoddhāravaśaḥ prakṛtipratyayādyapoddhāraḥ | yadāha vākyakāraḥ-- `siddhaṃ tvanvayavyatirekābhyām'  iti | tatra bhinnatvaṃ sāmānyam, dvidhā-ityādiko viśeṣa iti vidhārthe dhāpratyayopapattiḥ | prakāro hi vidhārthaḥ, sa ca sāmānyasya bhedako viśeṣaḥ, sādṛśyameva sarvatra prakāraḥ kaiścidiṣyate ityekīyamatam, kaiścid iti vacanāt | bhede'pi tu prakārākhyā kaiścidabhyupagamyate ityukteḥ | yadi vā atra buddhirūpaprakalpitaṃ sādṛśyameva vidhārthaḥ | jñānapratibimbitasya hi bāhyānukāritvena sādṛśyaṃ sarvatra prakārārthaḥ, saṃkalpitasādṛśyasya bāhyasya nirvartanāt vākyāccāpod‌dhriyamāṇasya padasya vākyārthāṃśaparikalpanayā arthavata evāpoddhāro yuktaḥ | arthāpoddhāra eva hi padāpoddhārasya nimittam | animitte hi tasminvarṇāpoddhārasyāpi prasaṅgāteṣāmapi vyutpādyatā syāt |  vākyārthaśca sthitalakṣaṇo niraṃśaḥ kārakotkalitaśarīrakriyāsvabhāvaḥ | tatra cāṃśāṃśikalpanayā apoddhāre kārakātmā kriyātmā cāṃśo vibhāgārha iti siddhasādhyalakṣaṇāṃśadvayaviṣayaḥ, padāpoddhāro dvividho nāmākhyātarūpaḥ prāthamakalpikaḥ, śaktiśaktimatorabhedāt kārakātmā siddharūpoṃ'śaḥ | yadyapi ca nāmapadānāṃ pratyayārthasya saṃkhyādeḥ śābdaṃ prādhānyaṃ tathāpyarthataḥ prātipadikārthasya jātyācchuritasya dravyasyaiva prādhānyaṃ siddharūpasya, saṃkhyākārakaśaktīnāṃ tadāśrayatvāt, anayoreva ca nāmākhyātayorviśeṣaṇatvānnipātepasargakarmapravacanīyalakṣaṇaḥ padabhedo'ntarbhavati |  tathā hi-siddhārthābhidhāyi nāmapadamiti tadarthagataṃ viśeṣaṃ dyotayannipātaḥ tatraivāntarbhavati | siddhaṃ hyarthaṃ sākṣād vābhidadhātu tadgataṃ viśeṣaṃ vā prakāśayatu, neyatā bhedaḥ | svarādayastu kecit sattpradhānā eveti te'pi nāmapadameva | ye tu hirugādayaḥ kriyāpradhānāḥ teṣāmākhyāte'ntarbhāvaḥ | na hi tiṅntamevākhyātam, kriyāpradhānasya sarvasyaiva tallakṣaṇatvāt | ata evopasargakarmapravacīyapadānyapyākhyātapadameva, sādhyārthagataviśeṣadyotanāt | evaṃ nipāto'pi | tadgatabhedāntaravivakṣāyāntu nipātopasargayorapi kaiścit pṛthakkaraṇam | tathā hi-astyevāpoddhāre'rthamātrāviśeṣo'nayoḥ | na hyetau sākṣādarthaṃ vadataḥ, api tu tadgataviśeṣadyotakāviti vācakābhyāṃ nāmākhyātābhyāṃ pravibhaktau | siddhasādhyārthaviṣayaviśeṣadyotakatvānnipātānāṃ sādhyaikaniyatatvāccopasargāṇāṃ parasparato bhedaḥ | karmapravacanīyāstu kriyāviśeṣopajanitasaṃbandhāvacchedahetava iti saṃbandhaviśeṣadyotanadvāreṇa kriyāviśeṣaprakāṣanādupasargeṣvevāntarbhavantīti caturdhā eva kaiściti padaṃ bhinnam |  sākṣātkriyāviśeṣaprakāśanābhāvāttadapi pañcamaṃ padamiti kaiścit | tathā hi-karma proktavantaḥ karmapravacanīyā iti atikrāntakriyākhyānalakṣaṇasya vyāpārasyātra saṃbhavo na tu vartamānasyetyupasargebhyo bhedaḥ | kriyāgataviśeṣadyotanapūrvakaṃ hi saṃbandhāvacchedanamatra vartamānam | tathā hi sarvaḥ saṃbandhaḥ kriyākṛtaḥ, upakāraprabhāvitatvāt tasya, kriyāmantareṇopakārabhāvāt | tatra kvacit kriyāśabdaḥ śrūyate kvacinna | yatra śrūyate tatra śrauta eva saṃbandhaviśeṣavasāyaḥ | tadyathā mātuḥ smarati, mātuḥ smṛtam, sarpiṣo jānīte ityādau | kriyā hi svabhāvādeva kriyāntaravyadhānamantareṇa dravyaiḥ saṃyujyate | anye tu yasmānmātṛviṣaye pravartate'vatiṣṭhate vā tasmānmātṛsaṃbandhīdaṃ smaraṇamiti kriyākārakabhāvapūrvaka evāyamapi saṃbandha iti varṇayanti |  aśrute tu kriyāpade dvayī gatiḥ | kvacit saṃbandhisvarūpamahimnaiva niyatakriyākṣepasiddheḥ pratiniyatakriyākārakabhāvapūrvakatvaṃ śeṣasaṃbandhasya vinaiva karmapravacanīyamavagamyate | tadyathā-upagorapatyam, vṛkṣasya śākhetyādāvapatyāpatyavatsaṃbandho janikriyānimitto'vayavayavisaṃbandhaśca sthitikriyānimitta ityādi | kvacittu saṃbandhānāṃ pratiniyatakriyāpūrvakatvāvadhāraṇe nāsti sāmarthyam | tadyathā-rājñaḥ puruṣa ityatra svasvāmibhāvo bharaṇādyanekakriyānimitta ityevāvagamyate | kriyāviśeṣastu nāvadhāryate tannimittabhūtaḥ | tathā ca bhāṣyam-- `yadetatsvaṃ nāma taccaturbhiḥ prakārairbhavati bharaṇādapaharaṇātkrayaṇādyāñcayā' | iti | dānādīnāṃ tvanyatamāvinābhāvātkriyā anumīyata eva | kvacittvavinābhāvinī kriyāpi na pratīyate | tathā caivaṃjātīyake viṣaye karmapravacanīyo niyataviśiṣṭakriyākṛtatvaṃ saṃbandhasya viśeṣamavagamayati | taduktam-- "janayitvā kriyā kācitsaṃbandhaṃ vinivartate | śrūyamāṇe kriyāśabde saṃbandho jāyate kvacit ||  sa copajātaḥ saṃbandho vinivṛtte kriyāpade | karmapravacanīyena tatra tatra niyamyate || "  iti | niyamastasya niyatakriyājanitatvam | tathā hi--śākalyasya saṃhitāmanu prāvarṣaditi yo'yaṃ saṃhitāpravarṣamayorhetuhetumadbhāvalakṣaṇaḥ saṃbandhaḥ sa niyatakriyājanita ityanunā vedyate | anuniśamyetyatrānorniśamayatikriyāsāhacaryopalabdheriha saṃpāṭharūpatvātsaṃhitāyāstadanumānasyaucityāt tatra kriyāvacanatvamasyānyatra dṛṣṭaṣakterna kalpyam |  dyotyārthaniṣṭhaṃ ca dyotakatvamiti tadapi kriyāpadāprayogādatra nāsti | na ca kriyāpadākṣepakatvam, yathā prādeśaṃ viparilikhatīti | atra verlekhanāsamanvayānupapatternirmātikriyākṣepakatvam | kārakavibhaktirhyatra prādeśamiti dvitīyeti yuktastatsamucita kriyākṣepaḥ | iha tu saṃhitāmiti śaiṣikīyaṃ vibhaktiriti kathaṃ kriyākṣepaḥ | kriyākārakayoreva parasparamākṣepyākṣepakabhāvasyāvinābhāvena nyāyyatvāt | tadyathā praviśa, piṇḍīmityādau | nāpi saṃbandhavācitvamatrānoḥ, vibhak‌tyaiva tadabhidhānāditi saṃbandhāvacchedasya pratyāyako nānyaḥ saṃbhavatīti pāriśeṣyādanoratra sāmarthyāmadhyavasīyate | taduktam-- `kriyayā dyotako nāyaṃ saṃbandhasya na vācakaḥ | nāpi kriyāpadākṣepī saṃbandhasya tu bhedakaḥ ||  iti | bhedako viśeṣadyotaka ityarthaḥ | ayamatra bhāvaḥ | yadananyathāsiddhaṃ tatrānorvyāpārakalpanā yuktā | yatpunaranyathā arthasāmarthyādinā nimittena sidhyati na tatra tasya śaktiḥ kalpayituṃ pāryata iti padāntarāṇāmarthāntara niveśātsaṃbandhaviśeṣasya tato'navagatasya karmapravacanīyaviṣayatā siddhā | nanu ca `yadatrādhikyaṃ vākyārthassaḥ' iti kriyāviśeṣajanitatvalakṣaṇaḥ saṃbandhasyāvacchedo vākyārthaḥ kimiti na kathyate | anostu paścādbhāvamātravṛttitvameveti |  atrocyate--ihādhikyaṃ vākyārthatvenodhyamānaṃ padārthapṛṣṭhapātitvenaivānusaraṇīyam na tu padārthollaṅghanena | tattadvākyopāttasya hi sādhyasya vā viśeṣyasya vopāttaireva sādhanairviśeṣaṇaiśca saṃsargastatrādhikyam | tadyathā--gāṃ śuklāmānaya, nīlotpalamiti ca | ata evocyate-- `āśrayāśrayiṇorvākyānniyamastavavatiṣṭhate |' iti | itthaṃ cānupāttasyaiva padārthasya vākyātpratītirnāstīti na saṃbandhāvacchedo'trāpadārtho vākyārthaḥ śakyate kalpayitumiti karmapravacanīyaviṣaya evāyam | yadvakṣyati-- `nimittaniyamaḥ śabdātsaṃbandhasya na gṛhyate | karmapravacanīyaistu sa viśeṣe'varudhyate ||'  iti | atra ca darśanadvayam--svarūpeṇaiva saṃbandhāntaravilakṣaṇaḥ karmapravacanīyena saṃbandho'vacchidyate, kriyāviśeṣajanitatvena veti | tatra svarūpeṇāvacchede viśiṣṭakriyājanitatvapratītiḥ saṃbandhiviśeṣaparyālocanālabhyā | tathā hi--adhi brahmadatte pañcālāḥ iti svasvāmibhāvo'yaṃ saṃbandha ityadhinā vedyate | brahmadattaśca svāmī īśvaraḥ pañcālāśca janapadaḥ svamiti tayoḥ saṃbandhinoḥ paripālanakarādānākriyāprabhāvita evāyaṃ saṃbandho nyāyya ityavagamyate | evamabhimanyurarjunataḥ pratīti pratinā sādṛśyalakṣaṇo'yaṃ saṃbandha iti dyotyate | sa punaḥ saṃbandhisvarūpaparyālocanādatra saṃpraharaṇādikriyākṛta ityavagamyate | itthaṃ ca śākalyasya saṃhitāmanu prāvarṣadityatrāpi hetuphalabhāvo nāmāyaṃ saṃbandha ityetāvatyevāyamanurviśrāmyati | pāṭhaviśerūṣapatvāt saṃhitāyā niśamanakriyāvagatiḥ | śabdaśravaṇena hi devo'varṣaditi saṃbandhamahimnā viśiṣṭakriyāprabhāvitatvamavasīyate | kecidiyānanoreva vyāpāra ityāhuḥ |  svarūpāvacchede'pi ca kriyāyāḥ kāryabhūtasaṃbandhāpekṣayā atītatvātkarma proktavanta ityarthassamanvetyeva | vastutaḥ kriyāphalasyaiva saṃbandhasya prakāśanāt | yathā tu tatrabhavadbhartṛharestatra tatrābhiprāyo lakṣyate tathā nimittaviśeṣāvaccheda eva karmapravacanīyakṛta iti rāddhāntaḥ | adhi brahmadatte pañcālāḥ iti paripālanakriyāhitatvaṃ svasvāmibhāvasyādhinā vyajyate | abhimanyurarjunataḥ pratītyamitraparājayādikṛto'nukāryānukaraṇabhāvaḥ pratinā prakāśyate ityādi sarvatra yojyam | sustutam, ati stutamityādau tu `suḥ pūjāyām'  `atiratikramaṇe ca'  ityādinā karmapravacanīyasaṃjñādhikārikī svārthanirapekṣaivopasargasaṃjñābādhanāya pravartate | yathoktam-- `karmapravacanīyatvaṃ kriyāyoge vidhīyate| ṣatvādivinivṛttyarthaṃ svatyādīnāṃ vidharmaṇām ||'iti | ārthena tu rūpeṇa vibhāge prastute kriyāviśeṣāvadyotakatvādupasargapade svatyādirantarbhavatīti nāvyāptiḥ | tadevaṃ vākyādapod‌dhriyamāṇasya padasyāpoddhārārthaviśeṣāśrayeṇa yathāsaṃbhavaṃ bhedo niraṃṣakavākyavyutpattyupāyabhūtaḥ pradarśitaḥ | ata eva svādipadaṃ vākyavyutpattyanaṅgatvācchastre saṃketitaṃ subantapadavyutpattyupāyabhūtaṃ neha gaṇanārhaṃ prakṛtipratyayavaditi dṛṣṭāntapakṣanikṣiptamiti nāvyāptiḥ | padātkilāsāvapoddhāro na vākyāt || 1 ||
 taditthaṃ padāpoddhāre pradarśite tadarthasyāpoddhṛtasya siddhasādhyarūpadvayayogino matabhedena svarūpāpadarśanārthamāha-- padārthānāmapoddhāre jātirvā dravyameva vā | padārthau sarvaśabdānāṃ nityāvevopavarṇitau || 2 ||
 arthadvāreṇa padaṃ parīkṣyata iti darśanabhedena prathamamapoddhārapadārthavicāraḥ | tathā hi--sarveṣāmapi śabdānāṃ padarūpāṇāṃ nāmākhyātādisvabhāvānāṃ jātivādimate jātirevārtho na dravyam | dravyavādimate tu dravyameva na jātiḥ | dvitīyena vā śabdena padārthāntaraṃ sūcitaṃ jātiviśiṣṭadravyābhidhānamiti | ata eva tadeva saṃkalanārūpaṃ padārthāviti sphuṭīkṛtam | anyathā vārthe prakrānte cārthopasaṃhāro'yaṃ nopapadyate | tadvadabhidhāne tu abhidhānaṃ tāvad dvayorapi samānam, viragya vyāpārābhāvācchubdasya | ārthastu jātidravyayorguṇapradhānabhāvaḥ | yadvā prādhānyenaiva bhinnaviṣayatayā pāṇinidarśane jātidravye śabdenābhidhīyete ityayamatra pakṣaḥ padārthau ityuktaḥ | tatra nāmapadasya gaurityādeḥ gotvādijātiḥ niyatakriyāviṣayasādhanaikārthasamavetasaṃkhyājātiviśeṣabhāvamāpannā abhidheyā | anāśrayāyā jāteranupapatteḥ | sāmarthyātpratītaṃ dravyam |  evamākhyātapadasyāpi vibhinnakriyākṣaṇasamavetābhinnābhidhānapratyayahetukriyājātiviṣayā sākṣādvācakaśaktiḥ | kārakādijātistvatra guṇabhūtā nāmapadagatayā ca kārakajātyā kriyājātirākhyātapadagatā vyaktidvāreṇa samanvayameti | dravyajātistvekārthasamavāyātsādhanaśaktidvāreṇa kriyāyogamanubhavati | saṃkhyājātirapyekārthasamavāyātsvavyak‌tyātmanā śaktimukhenaiva kriyānvayinīti sarvapadārthasamanvayopapattau kalpate vākyārthaḥ | yathā cotkṣepaṇādikṣaṇaivarasamasamayabhāvibhirapyāvṛttyotkṣepaṇatvādijātirabhivyajyate tathā adhiśrayaṇādibhiḥ kriyākṣaṇaiḥ pacatyādikriyājātiriti vicārayiṣyate | vyaktidvārakaṃ cāsyā nityāyā api sādhyatvamupapadyate |  upasargādibhirapyatra darśane nāmākhyātasahabhāvī tadarthasya viśeṣāvadyotakatvājjātipadārtha eva | viśeṣasya viśiṣṭaviśrāntarayaivāvasāyātkarmapravacanīyo'pi saṃbandhajātiniṣṭha eva | guṇaśabdānāmapi śuklādīnāṃ guṇajātirvācyā | saṃjñāśabdānāmapi ḍitthādiśabdānāṃ jātivācitvaṃ samarthayiṣyate |  taditthaṃ vājapyāyanācāryamatena sārvatrikī jātipadārthavyavasthopapadyate | vyāḍitame tu sarvaśabdānāṃ dravyamarthaḥ, tasyaiva sākṣātkriyāsamanvayopapatteḥ vākyārthāṅgatayā codanāviṣayatvāt | yathāha-- `codanāsu ca tasyārambhāt' iti | ekajātisamanvayavaśena cātra saṃketopapattiḥ | anabhidhīyamānāpi jātirupalakṣaṇīkriyate śabdārthe yathā gṛhādau kākādi | ākhyāte'pi ca sādhanādhāradravyaprādhānyaṃ vyāḍimate | devadattaḥ pacatīti dravyeṇaiva sākṣātsāmānādhikaraṇyopapatteḥ | kriyā tu guṇabhūtātra, vyāpārāviṣṭaṃ hi dravyamākhyātārthaḥ, idaṃ taditi sarvanāmapratyavamarśayogyaṃ cātra dravyamiti sārvatrikīyaṃ vyavasthā | tathā ca vakṣyati-- `dravyadharmā padārthe tu dravye sarvo'rtha ucyate |' iti | ata eva śuklādīnāmapi dravyapadārthatā siddhā | tattadupādhivyavacchinnaṃ vā brahma dravyaśabdavācyaṃ sarvaśabdānāṃ viṣaya iti vakṣyata eva | vyaktiparyāyo vā dravyaśabda iti jātivyaktivikalpena sarvaśabdaviṣayaḥ | tathā ca sarvaśabdānāmityabhidhānātpadādapyapoddhāre prakṛtipratyayarūpasyāpi śabdasya yathāyogaṃ kriyākārakasaṃkhyādirapoddhārapadārtho jātivyaktibhedena samāmnātaḥ | ubhayasyāpi vā śabdātpratīterubhayaṃ padārthaḥ | guṇapradhānabhāvabhedāśrayastu matavikalpaḥ | nityatvopavarṇanaṃ ca `siddhe śabdārthasaṃbandhe' ityatra bhāṣye-- `yasmisatattvaṃ na vihanyate' iti dravyasyāpi nityatvam, pravāhanityatayā śabdātsadaiva pratīteḥ || 2 ||
 tadevaṃ darśanabhedena jātirdravyaṃ vā padārtha ityukte jātipadārthaviṣayaśāstropayogī vicāro'tra samuddheśe | padasya hi parīkṣārthamidaṃ kāṇḍam, arthadvāreṇa ca padaparīkṣā, vākyārthaupayikatvena ca tadvicāra iti jātipadārthanaye vākyārthabhūtayā ākhyātapadavācyayā kriyayā kathaṃ samanvayaḥ | sādhanena hi kriyā anveti | na ca jātiḥ sādhanam | tadāśrayaḥ sādhanamiti cet, evamapi jāteḥ sākṣācchabdena coditatvātsāmarthyāttadādhārapratipattau yathācoditānuṣaṅga iti-- `asaṃbhave pratinidhirmā bhūnnityasya karmaṇaḥ | kāmyasya vā pravṛttasya lopa ityapadiśyate ||' iti pratinidhyanupapattirityāśaṅkya tatsamarthanāmāha-- `keṣāñcitsāhacaryeṇa jātiḥ śaktyupalakṣaṇam | khadirādiṣvaśakteṣu śaktaḥ pratinidhīyate || 3 ||
