 iha keṣāñcit jātivādināmekārthasamavāyācchakteḥ pratipādane jātiḥ upalakṣaṇam--upāyaḥ iti matam | anyeṣāṃ punastātparyeṇa jātireva śabdena pratipādyate, kāryayogastu tasyāḥ kvacitsākṣāt, kvacivdyaktidvāreṇeti matam | athavā keṣāñcid iti śabdānām | ye sādhanābhidhāyinaḥ tatra śaktitātparyeṇa jāterupalakṣaṇatvānnāntarīyakamupādānam, śaktivācinyā vibhakteḥ kevalāyā aprayogārhatvāt | tataśca prātipadikasyāvaśyamupādānamiti tadvācyayā jātyā śaktiravacchidyate sati saṃbhave | tadabhāve tu tatsadṛśāparajātisahacaritāpi śaktirgṛhyate, tātparyeṇa codanāt | vākyārthabhūtayā hi kriyayā sādhanamātrasyākṣepe siddhe viśiṣṭajātīyapratipattyarthaṃ sādhanaśrutyapādāne'pi jātiviśeṣasyāsaṃbhave kriyāsādhanaśaktyāvedanaparatayā jāteḥ prayogānmābhūtpradhānabhūtāyāḥ śakterapi tyāge kriyāyā asaṃpattiriti śiṣṭasamācārādanyajātīyadravyagatāpi śaktiḥ parigṛhyate | na caivamatiprasaṅgaḥ, coditapratinidhiviṣaya evaitasya nyāyasyeṣṭatvāt | tathā ca godohādicodanāsu tadasāmarthye na mahiṣyādyākṣepaprasaṅgaḥ |  upasakṣamatvācca jātirniyamaṃ na vidhatte | tadyathā--upaghātakanivāraṇapare vākye kākādiriti sadṛśopādāne śrautārthatyāgo na bhavati | yatra ca saṃbhavaścoditasya śrotasyārthasya, tatra śrutiḥ saphalā | tasmāt `khadire badhnāti, palāśe badhnāti' ityādau khadirāderbandhanasamarthasyālābhe tatsadṛśakadarādiśaktasādhanaparigraho yujyate | anādhārāyāḥ śakterasaṃbhavāt nāntarīyakatvena jāterupādānam, niyamasyāvidhānāt | jātirhi śak‌tyupalakṣaṇam na kāryayoginīti tadāśrayasyāśaktatve tamantareṇa dravyāntaragatāpi śaktirgṛhyate | yadi tu tajjātīyameva śaktaṃ syāt tadā sannihitaparityāge kāraṇābhāvāt tajjātīyamevopādīyeta | tadaśaktatve tūpalakṣaṇasyopalakṣaṇe caritārthatvāt anyasyāpi tatkāryayoge tadupalakṣitā śaktiḥ śāstracoditetyarthāntaragatāpyaparyudastatvādupādīyate iti niyamo nāsti | sadṛśārthāntaragatā ca śaktirgṛhyata iti nātiprasaṅgaḥ || 3 ||
 atha yeṣāṃ jātivādināṃ mate tātparyeṇa jātirabhidheyā na śak‌tyupalakṣaṇam, teṣāṃ kathaṃ pratinidhirupapadyata ityāśaṅkyāha-- ? asvātantryaphalo bandhiḥ pramāṇādīva śiṣyate | ato jātyabhidhāne'pi śaktihīnaṃ na gṛhyate || 4 ||
 ata iti | asvātantryaphalasya bandhervidhānāt codanāt jāteḥ pratipādyatve'pyupalakṣamatvābhāve'pyasvātantryaprayojanabandhividhisāmarthyācchaktihīnasya khadirādestyāge śaktaṃ kadarādi pratinidhīyate | vākyārthabhūtā hi bandhikriyā pradhānamiti tatsaṃpādanaśaktasya padārthasya parigraho nyāyyaḥ | nanu ca dṛṣṭaphale bandhau ko'nurodha ityāśaṅkyoktam pramāṇādīva śiṣyate iti | yathā dṛṣṭaphalaṃ pramāṇādi coditaṃ tathā tadaṅgabhūto'pi bandhiriti sarvathāsāvanurodhyaḥ | tathā hi-asati paśoryūpe bandhane pramāṇādyanupapattāvavadānagrahābhāvāt svargaphalasya yajerevāsaṃpattiḥ syāditi tadanurodhāttadaṅgasaṃpattyarthaṃ tatsamucitasādhanakṣepaḥ | tatra pramāṇaṃ hisāprārambhaḥ | mīño hiṃsārthasya lyuṭyejviṣaye rūpam, ātve ca kṛte mānam, tasyārambhaḥ praśabdena dyotyate | ādigrahaṇādālambhanāderavadānagrahaṇaparyantasya taduttarasya prākaraṇikasyāṅgakalāpasyānurodhaḥ | ayamatra pakṣadvaye'pyāśayaḥ | yadi nāma jāteḥ prakṛtyarthabhūtāyāḥ śak‌tyavacchedakatvenopāttāyā asaṃbhavaḥ tajjātyavacchinnasyāśaktatvāt tathāpi pratyayārthasya śakteravacchedyāyā api tyāgo na yuktaḥ, api tvanyagatāpi sā gṛhyate | mā bhūttadvācinaḥ padasyānarthakyam, vākyārthasya ca kriyāyā asaṃpattiriti gāmālabhetetyādau ca sarvatra yogyavyakritaviṣayaiva kriyāvṛttiṣṭhate iti pratinidhāvapi kimiti saṃbhramaḥ || 4 ||
 idānīmatraiva liṅgenāpi pratinidhimupapādayati-- `saṃśleṣamātraṃ badhnātiryadi syāttu vivakṣitaḥ | śak‌tyāśraye tato liṅgaṃ pramāṇādyanuśāsanam || 5 ||
 badhnātyartha upacārād badhnātiḥ ityuktaḥ | saṃśloṣo yūpe paśoryojanam tadevāsvātantryalakṣaṇaphalānapekṣaṃ tanmātram | tadyadi badhnātyartho'bhimataḥ tadā tasya khadiralatayāpi saṃpādyatvasaṃbhave kadaropādane sāmarthyaṃ nāstīti tataḥ saṃślevāduttarakāsaṃ pramāṇādīnāṃ `paśumālabheta', `hṛdaye'vadyati atha vakṣasi' ityādivacanena yadanuśāsanaṃ tadatra samarthadravyopādāne liṅgam anumānam | athavā pūrvaṃ bandhireva liṅgamāsīt, idānīṃ yadi saṃśleṣamātraṃ badhnātistataḥ pramāṇādyanuśāsanaṃ liṅgamityarthaḥ | paśuviśasanāṅgasya hi bandhyarthasyātropādānaṃ yuktam | asamarthaśca viśasane badhnātyartho na tadaṅgamiti ekaprakaraṇopāttapramāṇādyarthaparyālocanālabhyaḥ pratinidhiḥ | pūrvaṃ padārthasāmarthyādanantaraṃ vākyārthasāmarthyātpratinidhiruktaḥ, saṃprati prakaraṇasāmarthyāditi pakṣatraye viśeṣaḥ | śakterāśrayaḥ kadaradravyaṃ tatropādīyamāne liṅgamiti saṃbandhaḥ | yadvā śaktiḥ kāryasya nirvartako dravyasyātmātiśayaḥ, tadāśraye tadabhyupagame ityarthaḥ | tadevaṃ yaduktaṃ vākyakāṇḍe-- `yaśca jātisamuddeśe pratinidhiṃ pratyaparo darśanabhedaḥ' | iti so'yamiha vyākhyātaḥ | tatra punaranyo darśanabhedaḥ pratipāditaḥ-asaṃbhavaniyamatyāgo niyamamātrabādhaśceti | tathā hi--trīhibhiryajeteti devatoddeśena dravyatyāgasya yajyarthatvādyajatikriyaikadeśabhāvāpannaṃ dravyamātraṃ yajetetyeva sāmarthyātprāptam | etāvāneva hi yajyartha iti śrutiprāptasannidhānameva dravyamātram | dravyadevatārahitasya tyāgamātrasya yajyarthatvāyogātpratīte tasminnarthasāmarthyādanantaraṃ dravyākṣepasyāyogāt | itthaṃ ca kriyāpradhānatve'pyākhyātasya tadekadeśabhūtaṃ sādhanādhāramapi dravyasāmānyaṃ śrutiprāptasannidhānaṃ śābdameva | tatra vrīhibhiriti vrīhitvenāviruddhaikārthasamavāyena viśeṣeṇa paripoṣaḥ, nirviśeṣasya sāmānyasyābhāvāt | adhyāvāpārthā hi vrīhiśrutiḥ śabdasāmarthyaprāptaṃ dravyatvamātramavirodhānna bādhate | taddhi śrutisāmarthyaprāptam, vrīhitvaṃ punararthasāmarthyāyātam, nirviśeṣasya sāmānyasyābhāvāt | evaṃ ca dravyatvamātrasya śrutyā aṅgabhāvaścodito na rvīhitvasya viśeṣasyeti tadasambhave'pi viśeṣāntareṇa sāmānyamātrasya paripoṣe pratinidhi viṣaye coditasya bādhā na bhavati |  nanu cādhyāvāpe vrīhibhirdravyatvasyābidhitatvādvikalpaḥ prāpnoti sarvatra vrīhibhiryavairvetyādi | aviśiṣṭaṃ hi dravyatvaṃ śrutisāmarthyaprāptam, tasya ced vrīhiśrutyā viśeṣāntarādavacchedo na kriyate tadā tadapi viśeṣāntaraṃ tena svīkṛtaṃ prāptasannidhyeveti vikalpaprasaṅgaḥ tathā ca vrīhiśruterānarthakyam | atrocyate-iha vrīhitvena dravyatve viśeṣite vastusāmarthyādyavatvādīnāmasaṃbhavaḥ | na hi yatra vrīhitvaikārthasamavāyi dravyatvaṃ tatraiva yavatvaikārthasamavāyi saṃbhavati | tataścāsaṃbhavaniyamo nāmāyam | dviprakāro hi niyamaḥ--kaścicchabdasāmarthyāyāto bhavati yatra pakṣe prāptau satyāṃ śrutiḥ | yathā vyaktau padārthe `vipratiṣedhe param' iti | kaścitpunarasatyapi śabdavyāpāre padārthānāmitaretararūpasāṅkaryābhāvādekacodanā tadanyanivṛttiphaleti padārthasvarūpavimarśāyāto'saṃbhavaniyama ityucyate | tathā ceha śabdasāmarthyāyātaṃ dravyatvamiti vrīhibhiriti tatrādhyāvāpaḥ śabdavyāpāraḥ | akhaṇḍe'pi hi vākyārthanaye'roddhāradaśāgato bhedasaṃsargādivikalpaḥ | tatra vyāḍimate bhedo vākyārthaḥ, padavācyānāṃ dravyāṇāṃ dravyāntaranivṛttitātparyeṇābhidheyatvāt | jātivādino vājapyāyanasya tu mate saṃsargo vākyārthaḥ, sāmānyānāṃ padārthānāṃ saṃśleṣamātrarūpatvādvākyārthasya | iyati caritārthe vrīhiśabde vrīhitvasya yavatvādibhirviruddha ekasminnarthe samavāya iti tatra tāni nivartante | tataśca pratinidhau vastusāmarthyāyātasya niyamasya bādhe'pi śābdasya dravyatvamātrasyābādhitatvānna coditārthatyāgaḥ |  nanu ca nirviśeṣasya sāmānyasyāsaṃbhavāt yajinā viśeṣaniṣṭhameva dravyatvamākṣiptamiti sarvaviśeṣāṇāṃ śrutisāmarthyaprāptatvāt vrīhibhiriti punaḥ śrutirniyamaphalaiva śrautenāpi rūpeṇa saṃjāteti kathaṃ na śrautārthatyāgaḥ | pratinidhau naitannyāthyam | na hi śabdo vastucintāmanusarati, kasyacideva vastubhāgasya śabdavyāpāraviṣayatvāt | tathā ca ṭajatiśabdasyeyatyeva sāmarthyaṃ dravyamātrākṣepe na tu tadviśeṣe | anyathā nirguṇasya ca dravyasyāsaṃbhavāt guṇasyāpyākṣepako'sau kimiti na varṇyate | tasmād dravyatvamātrasyaivākṣepaḥ śābda iti tatparipoṣāya viśeṣāntarāvāpo na niyamaphala iti śāstreṇāparyudastānāṃ viśeṣāntarāṇāṃ pratinidhisiddhiḥ | taditthamasaṃbhavaniyamatyāgo varṇitaḥ | niyamamātrabādhaścāpyucyate | iha sravatraiva kriyāpradhānaṃ vākyārthaḥ | tathā ca svasiddhyarthaṃ yogyadravya mākṣipyate sādhanam | tadeva ca padāntareṇa viśiṣṭaṃ kathyate | itthaṃ sthite yatra śrutasya sādhanasyāsaṃbhavastatra pradhānabhūtakriyāsaṃpattyarthaṃ sādhanāntaraṃ pratinidhīyate | kriyā hi na pratinidhīyate prādhānyāt | kriyāntarāśrayaṇe ca karmāntarasyācoditasyānuṣṭhānācchāstrārthollaṅghanaṃ syāditi guṇabhūtasya sādhanasyaiva pracinidhirācaritaḥ śiṣṭaiḥ | tatra ca pradhānabhūtakriyāpadārthākṣiptasya śāstracoditasya sādhanamātrasya na tyāgaḥ, api tu vrīhyādi padopāttasya dravyaviṣayasya niyamamātrasya bādhaḥ | sa ca na doṣāya, śaktimātrasya sādhanarūpasya kriyāsāmarthyākṣiptasya prādhānyācchāstracoditārthollaṅghanābhāvāt || 5 ||
 tadevametadanantarakāṇḍe darśanadvayamupapāditamiti yathāsaṃbhavaṃ pratinidhiśca cintitaḥ | idānīṃ jātau śabdenābhidhīyamānāyāṃ tatra jātyantarābhāvānnirnimittā śabdasya pravṛttirāyātetyāśaṅkyopapādayitumāha-- svā jātiḥ prathamaṃ śabdaiḥ sarvairevābhidhīyate | tato'rthajātirūpeṣu tadadhyāropakalpanā || 6 ||
 svā asādharaṇī ātmīyā gośabdatvādikā na tu sakalaśabdasādhāraṇī śabdatvādiḥ | evaṃ cāsādhāraṇatvena viśeṣaṇāttayā saṃbandhāvyabhicāraḥ śabdasyārthajātyā saṃbandhavyabhicāre'pīti svā jātiḥ eva mukhyamabhidheyamityuktaṃ bhavati | tathā ca vākyakāraḥ-- `na vā śabdapūrvako hyarthe saṃpratyayaḥ' iti | ata evāvyabhicāriṇyāḥ svārūpajāterarthajātyabhidhāne śabdasya nāntarīyakamabhidhānamiti prathamam ityāha | yadabhedena yatpratipattiḥ tadavaśyaṃ tatra pratipattavyamityetāvatātra prāthamyam, na tu krameṇābhidhānāt | yadvā saṃbandhavyutpattikālāpekṣaṃ prāthamyam | tathā hi-saṃbandhavyutpattikāle'rthajātyā nāsti saṃbandhaḥ | tathātve vācakatvena tatra viniyogo'narthakaḥ syāt, arthasya pratipannitvāditi so'rthastāvattena śabdena na pratipannaḥ | yadi ca svajātyabhidhānaṃ tadānīṃ na syāt tadānarthakatvādvibhaktiyogo na syāditi `prāk saṃjñinābhisaṃbandhātsaṃjñā rūpapadārthikā' ityuktam | rūpaṃ hi svarūpaṃ svā jātirveti darśanabhedena kathyate | sarvaiḥ iti | svarūpaparairarthaparaiśca, tasyā eva svarūpatayā vyavahārāt | tathāvyutpannairapi śabdairavinābhāvācchabdasvarūpeṇāvasthitā jātiḥ pratipadyate | arthasya jhaṭityeva śabdasvarūpābhedenāvabodhe'pi yathā pratipāditakramāśrayeṇa tataḥ svajātipratyāyanādanantaramarthajātīnāṃ gotvādīnāmātmasu tasyāḥ śabdajāteḥ samāropasya kalpanā na paramārthaḥ, śabdavivartatvenārthasya śabdāttattvato bhedābhāvāt |  yadvā saṃbandhavyutpattikāle gorayamartha ityarthajātyā śabdajāteratyantabhedātsāmānādhikaraṇyānyathānupapattyā abhedādhyāropaḥ kalpyate | yathā gorvāhīka iti | anyathā saṅketasyaiva kartumaśakyatvāt | yathā cāyamanādirapauruṣeyo vācyavācakabhāvaḥ tathādhyāroro'pi | anyathā vācyavācakabhāva eva na ghaṭeta, yathā bauddhasya dṛśyavikalpārthaikīkāro bhedānadhyavasāyalakṣaṇaḥ, na tu yathā gaurvāhīka ityatra puruṣecchayā adhyāropaḥ | vyavahāre śabdārthayoḥ sadaivābhedāvasāyātkathamiyaṃ prativarṇanabhivyaktāsādhāraṇī jātirasamasamayabhāvibhirvarṇairabhivyajyata iti cet yathotkṣepaṇatvādijātiriti brūmaḥ | tathā hi--pratyekaṃ karmakṣaṇānāmupavyañjakatve'pi yaḥ prathama utkṣepaṇakṣaṇaḥ sa paramāṇumātradeśākramaṇamātrarūpatvāt bhramaṇakṣaṇāt sārūpyavaśādanavadhāryamāṇabheda ekaiko'samartho niyatajātyabhivyañcane iti kṣaṇāntaramapekṣate | na ca tasya bhramaṇakṣaṇādviśeṣo nāsti, upakrama enotkṣipāmītyevaṃprayatnajanitatvāt | evaṃ gośabdamuccārayāmītyayaṃ prayatno yadyapi gānagaganaśabdajanakātprayatnādanya eva, hetubhedācca gakārayorapi bheda eva tathāpi sādṛśyādasau duravadhāra iti vyañjako'pi san prathamo dhvanirasphuṭamabhivyaktītyāvartamāno'pi na viśadatarasāmānyaviśeṣābhivyaktau hetuḥ | yadā tvavayavaprabandhaḥ krameṇopalabdho bhavati, atha śabdajātiviśeṣopādhiyuktāḥ vyavahārā avatiṣṭhante | tadānīṃ sāhacaryātparasparāvacchedavaśena vilakṣaṇatayā pratibhāsanāt | yathā ca ślokaḥ sakṛtpaṭhyamāno nāvadhāryate, abhyāsena tu sphuṭāvabhāsaḥ tathā caramacetasi cakāsti ratnatattvavatsphoṭatattvam | prathamākṣareṇa hi jāterābhāsamātraṃ janyate taduttarottaravarṇakalāpena tu sphaṭatarasphuṭatamaparicchedādhānam | saṃskāraviśeṣotpādanadvāreṇābhivyaktiviśeṣasya ratnatattvādau dṛṣṭeḥ | tasmācchabdādarthaṃ pratipadyāmahe iti vyavahārādvarṇānāmarthāvasāyajanakatvānupapatteḥ prakriyābhaṅgasya prathamakāṇḍa eva vihitatvānniravayavaṃ pratyāyakaṃ śabdatattvaṃ jātivyaktibhedena bhinnaṃ sphoṭasvabhāvamevāṅgīkāryam | gaurayamartha iti ca vācakābhedena vācyapratīteḥ tadadhyāsakhacitavapurvvavahāryo'rthaḥ | tatra ca svarūpasya vācyatā prathamakāṇḍa eva nirṇītā, iha tu saṃbandhasamuddeśe'pi nirṇeṣyate || 6 ||
 tatraitat syāt--śabdasamavāyi sāmānyaṃ vyadhikaraṇatvātkathamarthajātimabhedena vyapadiśedityāśaṅkya nidarśanenaitadvyutpādayati-- yathā rakte guṇe tattvaṃ kaṣāye vyapadiśyate | saṃyogisannikarṣācca vastrādiṣvapi gṛhyate || 7 ||
tathā śabdārthasaṃbandhācchabde jātiravasthitā | vyapadeśe'rthajātīnāṃ jātikāryāya kalpate || 8 ||
 rakte guṇe tattvam | tasya raktasya guṇasya bhāvo raktatvaṃ lauhityasāmānyaṃ guṇavyaktisamavetamucyate | tatsamavetasamavāyāt kaṣāye raktaguṇādhāre dravye vyapadiśyate vyapadeśāya kalpate | tadviśeṣaṇabhūtaṃ hi tatkaṣāyadravyamabhidhīyate lohitā lākṣeti | tena saṃyogino vastrādayaḥ tayoḥ saṃyoginoḥ kaṣāyavastrayoḥ saṃnikarṣaḥ saṃbhedaḥ, tasmānnimittāttatrāpi tallauhityaṃ gṛhyate | saṃyuktasamavetasamavāyādvastrādiṣvapi lauhityanimitto vyapadeśaḥ, lohitaṃ vastramityarthaḥ | tathā śabdārthasaṃbandhāt iti | lohitaguṇakaṣāyadravyasaṃbandhasthānīyātsamānādhikaraṇatayāvasthitāt svābhāvikāttathā kevalaṃ vyutpattikāle nirjñātāttadanyathānupapattyaivādhyāropasya kalpanātsaṃbandhādeva śabdajātyā vyapadeśaḥ | artho'trārthajātiḥ, tasyā eva vācyatvaprakramāt | vyapadeśe kalpate svarūpābhedena, jātikāryāya kalpate-jātyādiśabde jātiṣu vācakatvena pravartamānā sthitā jātirna kevalaṃ vyapadeśāya kalpate yāvajjātikāryāya ca | athavā vyapadeśe sati jātikāryāya kalpata ityarthaḥ | niḥsāmānyāni sāmānyānītyarthajātīnāṃ svato jātirahitatve tatkāryaṃ śabdapratyayānuvṛttilakṣaṇaṃ śabdārthayoḥ so'yamityabhedena saṃbandhācchabdasamavāyinī jātirarthenādhyāropitābhedā saṃpādayantī tadātmanā saṃpadyata ityupacaryate | vyaktirūpe ca śabde jātessamavāyo na tu varṇeṣviti avasthitā ityupapadyate | varṇānāṃ hi yaugapadyābhāvādavācakatvamiti kathaṃ tatra śabdajāteḥ samavāyassyāt | kevalaṃ sphoṭasya jātivyaktibhedena darśanadvayamiti vyaktisphoṭe jātiḥ samavetā | arthabhedena hi bhinnasya nityasya śabdasyābhinnābhidhānapratyayaheturjātiravaśyābhyupagantavyā | ata eva jātyācchuritāyā vyaktereva vācakatvam | upalakṣaṇabhūtā tu jātirāśrīyate iti kathamatrānanuyāyinyā vyaktervācakatvamiti na codanīyam |  śabdārthasaṃbadhaścātra yogyatālakṣaṇo'bhipretaḥ | sarvo hi śabdaḥ saṃjñātvena niyujyamānaḥ sarvatrārthe yogyatālakṣaṇena saṃbandhena saṃbaddhaḥ | kevalaṃ śak‌tyavacchedamātre saṃjñākarturvyāpāro na tvapūrvasaṃketakaraṇe, arthasaṃbandhasyāpauruṣeyatvāt | evaṃ cādaikṣu vṛddhiśabdo nāpūrva eva saṃketita iti sarveṣāmanekārthatvādvaktṛbhedādvānekatve samānākārapratyayanibandhanajātireṣaṇīyā | tadyathākāśasya saṃyogibhedena kalpitābhedasyānekatve satyākāśatvaṃ lakṣyate | na caivaṃ sarvasmātsarvārthapratītiprasaṅgaḥ, prasiddhivaśenārthapratīteḥ kutracit kasyacit prasiddhatvāt | prasiddhānāṃ cārthānāmarthaprakaraṇādayo vibhāgahetava uktāḥ | tadyathā gośabdena navasvartheṣu sannihiteṣvapi prakaraṇādeḥ pratiniyatārthāvasāyaḥ | tadevaṃ śabdajātyā śabdavyaktirvācikā prathamamabhedena vyapadiśyate tato'rthajātiḥ tatastavdyaktirityayaṃ vāstavaḥ kramaḥ | pratyāyane tvakramataiva | śabdācchuritatve'pi cārthasya na svarūpavyapagamaḥ | yathā hyālokācchurito'pi ghaṭo na svarūpeṇa tirobhavati, evaṃ śabdasvarūpoparakto'rthaḥ | svarūpāropeṇa śabdālokayorarthaprakāśakatvasyaivaṃvidhasya dṛṣṭeḥ | yathā ca gaurvāhīka ityantra na gotvamātraṃ pratīyate, api tvadhyāropitagorūpo vāhīkaḥ, evamihāpi, na tu sphaṭikamaṇāvivārthe śabdajāteḥ samāveśo vivakṣitaḥ, tasyaiva vāhīkavat pratyāyyatvāt | svābhāvikaścāyamarthapratyāyane śabdānāmabhedajasaṃbandho'bhyupāya iti pratipādyo'pi tathaiva pratipadyate | na hi puruṣādhīnametat | anādau saṃsāre'nenaiva prakāreṃṇa saṃbandhavyutpatteḥ ko'tra niyato'dhyāropayitā kalpyatām | avyutpannasaṃketasyāpi cābhinnapratyayotpatterarthajātirapyastīti na śabdajātirevādhyāropitāstviti vācyam | śābdī ceyamevaṃvidhā pratītiriti cākṣuṣeṇa raktādipratyayena nidarśanabhūtena vyutpāditā | vastusanniveśitvābhāve'pi ca śabdajāterayamanādiradhyāropo rūḍhaḥ | sadaiva vyavahāre śabdārthayorabhedāvasāyādbhedasyāpi ca gorvāhīka itivat pratibhānānmityājñānamidaṃ na bhavati | prāk ca saṃbandhasaṃvedanasamayādarthajātayo bhedenāvabhāntyeva | avyutpannasaṃketasya bālakasya puro'vasthiteṣu sāsnādimatsu piṇḍeṣu bhinnaḥ pratyaya utpadyate tadā vācakasannidhānābhāvādabhinnapratyayaheturarthajātiravadhāryate | ata eva kathaṃ bhedenānirdhāritāyāmarthajātau śabdajātiḥ samāropyate ityādi na codanīyam || 7,8 ||
 jātikāryāya kalpata ityuktamevārthamabhivyanakti-- jātiśabdaikaśeṣe sā jātīnāṃ jātiriṣyate | śabdajātaya ityatra tajjātiśśabdajātiṣu || 9 ||
 "ākṛtyabhidhānādvaikavibhaktau vājapyāyanaḥ"  iti jātipakṣe pratyākhyānādekaśeṣasya tatphalamekaśabdaprayogo'traikaśeṣa uktaḥ | sahavivakṣā caikaśeṣeṇa lakṣyate | jātiśabdaikaśeṣe prasakta iti vā yojanīyam | sā iti śabdajātiḥ | arthajātīnābhedena pratyavasyamānā jātiśabdagatā jātirekaśabdatvaṃ saṃpādayati jātikāryam | tadyathā gāvo vṛkṣā ityādirabhinnasāmānyanibandhanastadekārthasamavāyāt samāśritaviśiṣṭasaṅkhya ekaśabdaprayogaḥ | tathā jātaya imā ityayamapi jātyāśrayāparajātyabhāvādvācarajātyadhyāsāśraya upapadyate | śabdagataṃ ca sāmānyaṃ jātikāryamupacaratītyucyate na tvarthajātiṣveveti niyamaḥ kenacitkriyate iti | yadā śabdajātayo'pi pratyāyyāḥ tadā āsvapyabhidhānagataṃ jātikāryāya kalpata evetyāha śabdajātaya ityatra iti | tajjātiḥ śabdajātiḥ śabdagataṃ sāmānyam | śabdajātaya imā ityatraika padaprayoge tasyoccaritasya śabdajātiśabdasya yā jātiḥ sā śabdajātiṣu hośabdatvādikāsu vyaktisthānīyāsu pratipādyāsvabhinnaśabdaprayoge nibandhanamityarthaḥ || 9 ||
 yadyevaṃ śabdajātiḥ śabdagatānāmapi jātīnāmanyā vācakajātistāsāmapyanyetyanavasthāprasaṅga ityāśaṅkyāha-- yā śabdajātiḥ śabdeṣu śabdebhyo bhinnalakṣaṇā | jātissā śabdajātitvamapyatikramya vartate || 10 ||
 prayoktṛbhedādvahuṣu śabdajātiśabdeṣu, abhinnapratyayanibandhanā yā jātistebhya eva śabdebhyaḥ svāśrayabhūtebhyo bhinnasvabhāvā sā gośabdātvādiśabdajātivargāntaḥ pātinī na tu vyapadeśāntarārhā | śabdajātiśabdasyāpi hośabdatvādivat śabdajātaya ityanenaivaikaśabdaprayogeṇa sāpi pratyāyyata iti na prayogānavasthāpattirityabhiprāyaḥ || 10 ||
 tadevaṃ svanikāyasiddhādhyāsadarśanāśrayeṇa sārvatrikī jātipadārthavyavasthā darśitā | svarūpabhūtā hi jātiḥ sarveṣāṃ śabdānāmantaraṅgatvādasādhāraṇatvādaheyatvācca prathamaṃ pratipādyā | idānīmadhyāsānāśrayeṇāpi prauḍhavāditayā jātipadārthavyāptimupapādayitumāha-- arthajātyabhidhāne'pi sarve jātyabhidhāyinaḥ | vyāpāralakṣaṇā yasmātpadārthāḥ samavasthitāḥ || 11 ||
 anyathā cātra saṃbandhaḥ | tathā hi--astu śabdajāterarthajātīnāṃ jātikāryam, saṃbandhavyutpattistu na ghaṭate | yatra hi saṃketastatra śabdajātiradhyasyate | sa eva tvanekatvādarthajātīnā sāmānyāntaramantareṇa na saṃbhavatītyāha-arthajātyabhidhāne'pi ityādi | yadā viśuddhā enārthajātayaḥ śabdairabhidhīyanta ityāśrīyate tadāpi sarve jātyabhidhāyinaḥ jātyādiśabdā api tadā jātivācina eva | nanu nissāmānyāni sāmānyānīti siddhāntātkathaṃ jātyādiśabdā api jātyādhāraṃ jātimabhidadhyurityāha--`vyāpāralakṣaṇāḥ' iti | vyāpāraḥ kāryaṃ prayojanaṃ tadeva lakṣyate'neneti lakṣaṇaṃ heturyeṣāṃ padapratyāyyānāmarthānāṃ te tathā niyamitasvarūpāḥ | ayamāśayaḥ | vaiśeṣikādīnāṃ bhavantu niḥsāmānyāni sāmānyāni | tāni hi vyaktiṣvanvayapratyayāvaseyāṃni paropādhirūpāṇi svatantravyaktivadidantāvabhāsitvābhāvāt sāmānyāntareṇa nopādhīyante | vaiyākaraṇānāṃ śabdārtho'rtha ityabhyureyatāmanvayirūpāvacchedena śābdasya pratyayasyotpatterjātiṣvapi jātiraviruddhābhyupagamyā | etadeva hi vyaktiṣavapi jātyabhyupagame nimitamityatrāpi tathābhyupagame kaḥ pradveṣaḥ | pratyakṣā api ca padārthāḥ svākāryaṃ vijñānādikaṃ kurvantaḥ santīti vyavahriyante, kiṃ punavaḥ śabdavācyāḥ padārthā iti sāmānyavacanād dravyādayo'pi śabdavācyatvenaiva lakṣyante | śabdapramāṇakānāṃ hi yacchabda āha tatparamārtharūpam | tathā cānvayirūpeṇa guṇo'pyabhidhīyamāno jātireva | yathopamāsamāse śyāmādiḥ | tathā ca `upamānāni sāmānyavacanaiḥ'  ityucyate |  evaṃ kriyāpyabhedenābhidhīyamānā jātiḥ | tathedaṃ taditi svātantryeṇa viśeṣyatayābhidhīyamānā jātiguṇakriyā api dravyamiti yathāvasaramagre nirṇeṣyata eva | etacca laukikavyavahārānuguṇyena śāstre'smin vyutpādyate | śāstrāntaraprasiddhā hi vyavasthā lokaviruddhā | loke hi `gavi śṛṅgam', `vṛkṣe śākhā' iti vyavahāraḥ | tathaiva ca vyākaraṇe'pyādhārasaptamī | śāstrāntare tvavayaveṣvavayavīti `śṛṅge gauḥ',`śākhāyāṃ vṛkṣaḥ' iti syāt | itthaṃ ca śabdābhidheyasyehārthatvātsarve jātyabhidhāyinaḥ, yasmācchabdavyāpāreṇa padārthā lakṣyante | yadyapi bahirvastūni na santi tathāpi śabdaistathā pratyāyyante, ato'bhidhāvyāpāravaśādanvayirūpeṇa pratyāyanāvdyāptirjātau padārthe siddhetyeṣo'pyarthaḥ || 11 ||
 abhidhālakṣaṇavyāpāratvameva vyaktayati-- jātau padārthe jātirvā viśeṣo vāpi jātivat | śabdairapekṣyate yasmādataste jātivācinaḥ || 12 ||
 jātau padārthe iti pakṣāvacchedaṃ karoti | atra hi pakṣe sarva eva śabdo jātivācīṃtyabhyupagantavyam | bhavatu mā vā bhūjjātiṣu jātiḥ | śabdaistu jāti vyatiriktayā jātyaikasvabhāvaiva apekṣyate pratyāyyatvenāṅgīkriyate | svālakṣaṇyena hi vastūnāṃ bhedaḥ śabdaiḥ spraṣṭuṃ na śakyate, anvayirūpāveśena saṃbandhavyutpattau śabdasya vācakatvāt | tathā ca jātīnāmitaretarabhedo vastusannābhidhīyate, api tvabhedakalpanena tā abhidhīyante | abhedaśca sāmānyamiti siddhamekaśabdatvājjātaya iti |  tathā yo'pi viśeṣaḥ saṃjñāśabdānāṃ vācyaḥ pratītiniyataḥ so'pi jātivat prasiddhajātyā tulyam, apekṣyate śabdaiḥ | tatrāpi bālyakaumārādyavasthābhedaḥ śabdena na spṛśyate, api tvavasthātṛrūpamevānugatam, taddhi pratyabhijñāpratyayanimittaṃ tatrāvaśyābhyupagantavyam | ataḥ yasmājjātivatsarvamapekṣyate śabdaistasmājjātiṃ viśeṣaṃ vā pratipādayantaḥ sarve jātyabhidhāyinaḥ iti jātyabhidhānavyāptiṃ nigamayati | itthaṃ ca saṃjñāśabdānāmapi jātivādimate jātiśabdatvamityekaiva śabdānāṃ pravṛttiḥ || 12 ||
 evaṃ darśanāntare'pi śabdavyāpārāśrayaṇa eva vyāptisiddhirityāha-- dravyadharmā padārthe tu dravye sarvo'rtha ucyate | dravyadharmāśrayād dravyamataḥ sarvo'rtha iṣyate || 13 ||
 na kevalaṃ mayaiva jātipadārthavādinaitadaṅgīkṛtaṃ sarvo'rtho jātiriti, yāvad dravye api padārthe, dravyapadārthapakṣe'pi dravyadharmā sarvo'rtha ucyate, kutaḥ ? dravyadharmāṇāmāśrayaṇāt | dravyamataḥ sarvo'rtha iṣyate | vyāptirataḥ siddhā bhavatītyarthaḥ | dravyavādināpyetadabhyupetavyaṃ vyāptisiddhaye | śabdena yo'rtha ucyate sarvo'sau dravyadharmayukta evetyabhiprāyaḥ | yathā tava dravyavādinaḥ kecideva śabdā mukhyadravyābhidhāyinastadanye tūpacapitadravyābhidhāyinaḥ tathā mamāpi jātivādino mukhyāṃ jātimabhidadhati kecit, upacaritāmanya iti matadvaye'pi sāmyam | tatra dravyadharmā idaṃ taditi pratyavamarśayogyatvam, pariniṣpannatā, svātantryam, liṅgasaṅkhyāyogaścetyevamādayaḥ | teṣāṃ śuklādiguṇeṣvapyadhyāropātte'pi dravyasyeva dharmo yeṣāmiti dravyadharmāṇaḥ | tathā hi--śuklo nīlaṃ strīpunnapuṃsakāni sattvaguṇāḥ | tathaikatvādayaścetyādibhiḥ śabdaiḥ pratyāyyamānā guṇādayo dravyadharmāṇaḥ svātantryādirūpeṇāvabhāsanta iti sarvo'rtho dravyarūpeṇābhidhīyate || 13 ||
 evaṃ śabdavyāpārāśrayeṇa vyāptirupapāditā | adhunā vaiśeṣikadṛṣṭyāpyarthagatasamānadharmāśrayeṇa jātipadārthavyāptimāha-- anuvṛttidharmo vā jātissyātasarvajātiṣu | vyāvṛttidharmasāmānyaṃ viśeṣe jātiriṣyate || 14 ||
 jātīnāmetajjātitvaṃ yeyaṃ svāśrayānuvṛttiḥ sarvajātīnāṃ sādhāraṇo dharmaḥ | sā ca tābhyo'nanyāpi sādṛśyādabhedena parāmṛṣṭā satī sarvāsāṃ jātiḥ | sarvaiva hi jātiḥ svavyaktīranuvartate | upalakṣaṇaṃ caiṣa dharmaḥ | tena svānurūpapratyayajanakatvam, yadbalād dravyaṃ tadrūpamābhāti | svānurūpābhidhānahetutvam, yadvaśād dravyaṃ yadvaśād dravyaṃ tadrūpābhidhānavācyaṃ bhavati | pratyāśrayaṃ ca sarvātmanā parisamāptiḥ sādhāraṇo jātidharmaḥ | yadi bhāgaśo jātirvarteta tadā bhāgaśa eva gotvādipratyayaḥ syāt | saṃpūrṇaśca viṣāṇādyavayavadarśane'pi jhaṭiti gotvākāraḥ pratyayaḥ prasūyate | pratyāśrayaparisamāptā api ca guṇāḥ pratidravyaṃ bhinnāḥ, jātistekaivetyevamādayo'sādhāraṇā dharmā vācyāḥ | yathā ca gotvādijātissarvā vyaktīrvyāpnoti tathaite dharmāḥ sarvajātīrvyāpnuvantīti jātyā tulyarūpatvājjātikāryāya kalpante | evaṃ sarva eva viśeṣā vyāvartante | anyathānugamāt sāmānyāni syurna viśeṣā iti sarvaviśeṣeṣu sādhāraṇī vyāvṛttiḥ sāmānyasamo dharmo bhavaṃsteṣu jātiḥ ityucyate |  nanvevaṃ gopiṇḍeṣvapi sāsnālāṅagūlakhurakakudaviṣāṇādyavayavasaṃbandhasya sādhāraṇatvātsaiva jātirastu | maivam | sāsnādimattvena sāsnājimānityādipratyayo jāyate na tu gaurgauriti | anurūpaṃ hi kāryaṃ kāraṇaṃ kalpayati,tadyathā daṇḍīti pratyaye daṇḍasaṃbandho nimittaṃ na tu daṇḍaupāditsā | yadyevamanupravṛttāvapi na jātirjātiriti pratyayo yuktaḥ, vyāvṛttyā ca viśeṣo viśeṣa iti | naitadevam | gatyantarābhāvādatra sadṛśā eva dharmā jātiḥ kalpate, mukhye jātimattve nirṇītam | nityadravyavṛttiṣu vyāvṛttipratyayajanakeṣu viśeṣeṣu sāmānyābhyupagame saṃśayāpanodāya viśeṣāntarakalpane teṣāmapi sāmānyasamavāye sandehaviṣayatvādviśeṣāntarābhyupagame'navasthāprasaṅgaḥ | atha kaścinnissāmānyo'sti viśeṣaḥ, tadā tadaviśeṣātsarve'pi tathā syurityanyatra vistareṇoktam | gopiṇḍeṣu sāmānyābhyupagame na kiñcidbādhakamiti na tatra yathākathañcinnimittaṃ parikalpyam | tadevaṃ yatra jātyabhyupagame pramāṇabādhāsti tatra sadṛśadharmarūpā jātiḥ | tathā cābhāve'vapi sāmānyābhyupagame bhāvatvāpatterabhavanātmakadharmasāmānyādanvayipratyayaviṣayateti saiva tatrāpi jātiḥ || 14 ||
 kālākāśādiśāmekatvānnityatvenāvasthābhedābhāvācca kathaṃ jātiḥ, yena vyāptisiddhirityata āha-- saṃyogidharmabhedena deśe ca parikalpite | teṣu deśeṣu sāmānyamākāśasyāpi vidyate || 15 ||
 yathā sāmānyaviśeṣāṇāmanvayidharmopādhirabhedaḥ tathākāśasyāpi saṃyogopādhirbheda iti prakṛtāpekṣaḥ samuccayaḥ | ākāśena saṃyogo vidyate yeṣāmākāśādhikaraṇānāṃ ghaṭādīnām, te saṃyoginaḥ | ākāśaṃ hi sarveṣāṃ mūrtānāmadhikaraṇam | avakāśadānāddhi tadākāśam | mūrtāstu bhāvāḥ parasparaṃ pratibandhakā iti na te'vakāśadāyinaḥ | saṃyogināṃ dharmabhedaḥ pratyakṣādipramāṇasiddhaṃ parimitatvaṃ tadvaśādvā lokaprasiddhaṃ parimitadeśavṛttitvam | yatra hi deśe saṃyogaḥ parisamāpto vartate sa pradeśo bhavatyākāśasyānekaḥ | kāryaṃ prati deśaḥ pradeśa iti nirvacanāt | guṇāśca kecivdyāpyavṛttayaḥ, yathā rūpādayaḥ | saṃyogastu mūrtiparicchinnavastuvṛttiriti sarvadā pradeśavṛttireva | ataḥ saṃyogasya niyatadeśatayā saṃyogino'pi niyatadeśavṛttaya iti saṃyogidharmabhedena ākāśasya bhedo bhavatyupādhikṛto na svataḥ | yadāha-deśe ca parikalpite iti | deśabhedācca sāmānyamākāśasyāpi vidyate | ataśca pratideśam `idamākāśam, idamākāśam' ityabhinnābhidhānapratyayānuvṛttilakṣaṇamākāśasāmānyamākāśaśabdagocaro'sti |  evaṃ samānanyāyatvātkālādīnāmapi pradeśaparikalpanena sāmānyamupavarṇanīyam | tathā hi-kālasya yudhiṣṭhirādisaṃyogavaśena bhede satyabhinnaṃ kālasāmānyaṃ kālaśabdavācyamasti | evaṃ meruṃ pradakṣiṇamāvartamānasya saviturlokapālagṛhītairdeśaviśeṣairye saṃyogāḥ tadupādhinā sūryeṇa diśaḥ saṃyoge sati bhede'bhinnaṃ dik‌sāmānyaṃ dik‌śabdavācyaṃ parikalpyam | ātmā tu pratiśarīramanya eveti tatrāpyastyevātmatvasāmānyam | evaṃ samavāyasyāpi saṃbandhibhedānnānātvopacāre sarvatrehabuddhyanuvṛtterjātiḥ parikalpanīyā | nanu ca saṃyogideśenākāśasya deśaparikalpaḥ tena saṃyogināmitītaretarāśrayatvam | naitadasti | itaretaravyāvṛttirūpataiva rathādīnāṃ mūrtatvāparicchinnaparimāṇatvaṃ bodhayati | kalpitāstvākāśadeśā lokaprasiddhāḥ saṃyogivastugatāṃ paricchinnadeśatāṃ jñāpayanti | sāmānyena hyākāśadeśatve rathādīnāṃ pratyakṣādipramāṇāvasitarūpaviruddhaṃ vyāpitvamāropitaṃ svagatena parimitatvenākāśasya pradeśakalpanayā nirākriyeta | yadyevaṃ kalpitā deśāḥ kathamākāśasya svato niravayavasya deśabhedanibandhanaṃ kāryaṃ jātipraklṛptilakṣaṇaṃ jātiśabdapravṛttilakṣaṇaṃ vā kuryuḥ, yena tadnatā jātirabhidhīyeta | ucyate | vyaktisthānīyānāṃ deśānāmadvaitadarśane yathāsatyatvam `asatyā vyaktayaḥ smṛtāḥ' iti vakṣyate tathehāpyākāśasya satyatve vyaktīnāṃ na kaścidvirodhaḥ || 15 ||
 athavā mukhyā evākāśasya deśā ghaṭājīnāmivetyāha-- adeśānāṃ ghaṭādīnāṃ deśāssaṃbandhino yathā | ākāśasyāpyadeśasya deśāssaṃbandhinastathā || 16 ||
 iha deśo'vayava ucyate | ghaṭādayaścāvayavinaḥ svātmani niravayavāḥ | ye hi teṣāmavayavabhūtāḥ kapālādayaste ārambhakāḥ kāraṇabhūtā vyatiriktā eva samavāyasaṃbandhena saṃbandhinaḥ | evamākāśamapi kenacidapyanārabdhatvādamūrtaṃ vyāpi niravayavamityātmabhūtadeśābhāvād dravyādayaḥ saṃyogina evāsya deśāḥ, tathā tadbhedādākāśabhede sarvatrābhinnapratyayānugamājjātiparikalpaḥ | ākāśaṃ hyavacchindanto'rthā deśāstasya bhavanti | tatkṛtāvacchedaṃ cākāśamapi teṣāmādhārabhāvāpatterdeśa ityanyonyadeśatvaṃ mūrtāmūrtayoḥ mūrtāstvavyāpakāḥ parasparamavacchedakā na bhavantītyādhāra evaiteṣāṃ deśaḥ || 16 ||
 kathaṃ tarhi deśe gauṇatvavyavahāraḥ | yadi hi kasyacinmukhyāḥ pradeśā ātmabhūtāḥ syustadāyaṃ yuktaḥ syānnānyathetyata āha-- bhinnavastvāśrayā buddhiḥ saṃyogiṣvanuvartate | samavāyiṣu bhedasya grahaṇaṃ vinivartate || 17 ||
ataḥ saṃyogideśānāṃ gauṇatvaṃ parikalpyate | avivekātpradeśebhyo mukhyatvaṃ samavāyinām || 18 ||
 bhinne pṛthak‌siddhe vastuni āśrayo yasyā buddheḥ | aprāptayoḥ prāptiḥ saṃyoga iti pṛthak‌siddhapadārthaviṣayā saṃyogabuddhiḥ | bhedasya grahaṇaṃ vinivartate iti, yato'pṛthak‌siddhānāmihabuddhihetuḥ samavāyaḥ, yathā `iha kapāleṣu ghaṭaḥ' iti | ataḥ iti, bhedena grahaṇāt | avivekāt, vivektumaśakyatvāt | yato bhinnā buddhiḥ saṃyoginām, ataḥ tatpradeśānāṃ gauṇatvam | yataśca samavāyināmabhinnā buddhiḥ, atastatra mukhyatvam | samavāyaprabhāvāddhi pradeśebhyo vivektuṃ samavāyino na śakyanta iti teṣveva deśeṣu kapālādiṣveva tadārabdhamavayavi dravyamupalabhyate | atastatra mukhyāḥ samavāyinaḥ pradeśatvena vyavasthāpyante | saṃyuktānāṃ tu naivamiti gauṇatvamityanenaupacārikatvamākāśadeśānāṃ samarthitam | nanu ca ghaṭādīnāṃ saṃyogināṃ parasparasaṃyoge'pi parasparadeśabhāvo na bhavati, evamākāśenāpi na syāt | naitadasti| ākāśena sadā saṃbaddhā rathādaya iti tatrādhyāropo yukto na tu ghaṭādīnāmaniyatasaṃyogānām | ata eva ghaṭādiṣvākāśānugataḥ pratyayo dṛśyata eva ghaṭākāśaḥ paṭākāśa ityādi, adhyārope ca na bhedavigalanamityuktam || 17,18 ||
 tadevaṃ vaiśeṃṣikadarśanāśrayeṇa jātipadārthavyāptirupapāditā | idānīṃ vijñānavādenāpi padārthavyavasthāmāha-- anupravṛttirūpāṃ yāṃ prakhyātāmākṛtiṃ viduḥ | kecivdyāvṛttirūpāṃ tu dravyatvena pracakṣate || 19 ||
 `sarvapārṣadaṃ hīdaṃ śāstram' iti, śabdārtho'rtha iti vā padārthavyavastheyam | anugatākārā yā buddhistasyāṃ pratibhāsamānastadākāro'rtharūpatayāvasīyamānavapurdṛśyavikalpayorabhedādhyavasāyātsāmānyamāhuḥ | vyāvṛttākārabuddhisanniveśitvākāro'tra ca darśane dravyamiti prasaṅgāduktam | evaṃ ca bāhyasya sāmānyasyābhāvādākāśādāvapi tatsamarthane na prayatitavyam | anapahnavanīyābhinnākārapratyayopajanasya sarvatraiva siddhervijñānanaye ca sarvameva pratyayātmakamaṅgīkṛtameva | śabdāduccaritādvākāravatī buddhirutpadyata iti tadākārasyaiva śabdārthatvam, na buddheḥ | sa hyākāro bāhyo'stu, na vā, śabdavācyatvasya na kācitkṣatiḥ || 19 ||
 nanu ca vastūnāṃ deśakālādinimitto bheda iti tadanādareṇābhinnānyeva tānu siddhānīti kimarthaṃ vyatiriktasāmānyakalpanāyāṃ prayasyata ityāśaṅkyāha-- bhinnā iti paropādhirabhinnā iti vā punaḥ | bhāvatmasu prapañco'yaṃ saṃsṛṣṭeṣveva jāyate || 20 ||
 nirupādhino vastuno'vyavahāryatvātsarva eva paropāśrayo vyavahāra iti sāmānyādau vyatiriktasāmānyakalpanaivamakārītyatra tātparyārthaḥ || 20 ||
 etadeva vyatirekamukhenāpi prapañyati-- naikatvaṃ nāpi nānātvaṃ na sattvaṃ na ca nāstitā | ātmatattveṣu bhāvānāmasaṃsṛṣṭeṣu vidyate || 21 ||
 ekatvasaṅkhyīdhīna ekatvena vyavahāraḥ, pṛthak‌tvanibandhano nānātvena, sattānibandhanaḥ sattvena, svarūpasattvena tu sāmānyādīnāmabhāvopādhirnāstīti vyavahāra iti saṃsargadarśane sarvaḥ paropāśrayo'yaṃ prapañco vaicitryam || 21 ||
 evaṃ vyatiriktopādhidarśanamupanyasyādhunā svaśaktaya evopādhaya ityadvaitadarśanāśrayeṇāpi prāha-- śarvaśak‌tyātmabhūtatvamekasyaiveti nirṇayaḥ | bhāvānāmātmabhedasya kalpanā syādanarthikā || 22 ||
 ekameva brahma sarvaśaktīti pramāṇena siddhe'sminnarthe'vidyāpārikalpitasya bhāvabhedasyāpāramārthikatvātkāryanānātvonnīyamānaḥ śaktibheda evaikasya yukto na tu svarūpabhedaḥ || 22 ||
 tathā ca tasmād dravyādayaḥ sarvāḥ śaktayo bhinnalakṣaṇāḥ | saṃsṛṣṭāḥ puruṣārthasya sādhikā na tu kevalāḥ || 23 ||
 dravyaguṇakarmasāmānyaviśeṣasamavāyalakṣaṇāḥ padārthā na pṛthagbhūtāḥ | ekasyaiva śaktayo vilakṣaṇavyāpārānumeyā iti tā yathāyathamupagatasamanvayāḥ prāvaraṇādyarthakriyākāriṇya ityasmin mate sarvatraiva jātivyaktipravibhāgaḥ kalpitaḥ `satyāsatyau tu yau bhāgau' ityatra vakṣyamāṇa iti nākāśādīnāmapi kaścidviśeṣa ityarthaḥ | yathā hi vaiśeṣikāṇāṃ vyatiriktaṃ sāmānyam,naivamiha, kevalaṃ viśvamūrteḥ padārthasya śaktimātram | na kevalaṃ sāmānyameva, yāvad dravyādayo'pīti prasaṅgātkathitam | bhedābhyupagame'pi dravyādīnāṃ saṃsṛṣṭānāmarthakāritve varamekameva śaktimadastvityarthaḥ || 23 ||
 tatraitatsyāt saṃsṛṣṭānāṃ sādhanatve tāsāmasāmarthyam, saṃsargasyaiva tathātvāt, tasya ca vyatireke dvaitāpattirityāśaṅkyāha-- yathaiva cendriyādīnāmātmabhūtā samagratā | tathā saṃbandhisaṃbandhasaṃsarge'pi pratīyate || 24 ||
 cakṣūrūpālokamanaskārā ātmamanaindriyārthā vā parasparāhitaviśeṣāḥ saṃghaṭitā vijñānahetavo'nvayavyatirekābhyāṃ dṛṣṭā iti neyamebhyaḥ sāmagrī nāma padārthāntaraṃ janikā | ata eva hi sāmagrījanakāḥ sāmagrīśabdavācyāḥ, vastvantarasyānupalabdheḥ | evamekena saṃbandhinā sarvaśaktīnāmādhārabhūtatvena prakṛtatvātsaṃbandho dravyādiśaktīnām | tato ya ekasmādādhārādavyatirekātsaṃsargo rūpasaṃmūrcchanaṃ tasminnapi saṃsarge sati puruṣārthasādhake svabhāvabhūtā samagratā vijñāyate | tatrāpi hi ātmabhūtā eva nyāyāyātā, dravyamātreṇa guṇādisaṃsargarahitena dravyavyavahārābhāvāt | evaṃ guṇādimātreṇetyavaśyaṃbhāvinaḥ saṃsargasya dravyādibhyo vivekānavadhāraṇāt tatsvabhāvataiva | kvacitpāṭhaḥ--tathā saṃbandhisaṃbandhasaṃsargo'pi pratīyate iti | tatrāpi saṃbandhinā sarvaśak‌tyādhāreṇa, saṃbadhyanta iti saṃbandhāḥ dravyādiśaktayaḥ, tāsāṃ saṃbandhānāṃ śaktīnāmanyonyasaṃsargo'pyātmabhūta eveti vyākhyā | yadvā sarvaśakteḥ padārthasya saṃbandhinīnāṃ śaktīnāṃ saṃsarge'pi saṃsargāvasthāyāmapi tathaivāsau saṃbandhaḥ, ātmabhūta evāsau saṃsarga ityarthaḥ | citsāmānyānugamācca viśvasya pramāṇasiddho'bheda iti prathamakāṇḍa eva nirṇītam || 24 ||
 tadevaṃ yathādarśanaṃ jātiḥ śabdena pratipādyate ityupapāditam | sā ca nityeti nityaḥ śabdārthaḥ | tathā ca "nityāvevopavarṇitau" ityuktam | tatra jāternityatve kāryopayogamāha-- na tadutpadyate kiñcidyasya jātirna vidyate | ātmābhivyaktaye jātiḥ kāraṇānāṃ prayojikā || 25 ||
 vyak‌tyadhīnā jātyabhivyaktiriti svāśrayakāraṇānāṃ prayojakakartṛtvamivāvalambate jātiḥ | sadā sannihitā kāryotpattau kāraṇānāṃ sahakāriṇītyarthaḥ | nimittakāraṇatvādvaiśeṣikadarśane jātīnāmeṣo'rthaḥ prayojakapadena bhaṅgyābhihitaḥ || 25 ||
 nanu kāraṇeṣvasannidhānātkathaṃ teṣāṃ prayojiketyāha-- kāraṇeṣu padaṃ kṛtvā nityānityeṣu jātayaḥ | kvacitkāryeṣvabhivyaktimupayānti punaḥ punaḥ || 26 ||
 sarvagatatvājjātīnāṃ kāraṇeṣu api sannidhānātpadabandhaḥ | tathā ca jātyātmanā kāraṇeṣu kāryāṇāmavasthānājjātirūpoparāgeṇa tadavasāyāt tatra sādhanānāṃ pravṛttau kāryārambhe tatsamavetajātyabhivyaktirasakṛdāśrayopalabdhau bhavati | nityāḥ paramāṇavaḥ kāraṇāni, darśanāntare vā pradhānapuruṣādayaḥ | anityā vīraṇādayaḥ | `kvacit' iti | dṛśyeṣu kiñcit kila kāryaṃ jātyāśrayaṃ niṣpannamapyadṛśyaṃ yathā vāyurdravyamiti | tatra hi tajjātyabhivyaktirnāsti || 26 ||
itthaṃ ca kṛtvā prāk prabhavādapi jātervidyamānatvānnityatvaṃ poṣitam | tathā ca jātipadārthanaye'tra jāterupayogaṃ darśayati-- nirvarttyamānaṃ yatkarma jātistatrāpi sādhanam | svāśrayasyābhiniṣpattau sā kriyāṇāṃ prayojikā || 27 ||
 ghaṭaṃ karotīti kathamasato nirvarttyamānasya kriyāyāṃ sādhanabhāvaḥ karmaṇa ityetadatra codyaṃ nāvatarati | jāteḥ sattvāt svāśrayanirvarttanāya kriyāṃ pratyuktena kāraṇapadabandhanyāyena prayojakatvāditi jātirūpāśrayeṇa ca sādhanatā, vyaktirūpāśrayeṇa ca karmatā, nirvarttyata iti kārakaṃ karmeti sāmānādhikaraṇyopapattiḥ | na hi jātivyaktī atyantabhinne gavāśvavat, saṃmūrcchitasvabhāvatvādityubhayarūpāśrayo vyapadeśo'viruddhaḥ | prāpyavikāryayostu karmaṇossattvāt svata eva sādhanatopapattiriti `nirvarttyamānam' iti viśeṣamāha | jātyātmanā ca nirūpya vastu kāraṇeṣu yogyeṣu pravartante tadarthinaḥ iti `prayojikā' ityucyate | etacca jātyabhidhānapakṣe saṃbhavati ghaṭaśabdena jāterabhidhānāt | vyaktipadārthapakṣe tu upacārasattāśrayaṃ sādhanatvaṃ vakṣyati-- vyaktau padārthe śabdārjanyamānasya karmaṇaḥ | sādhanatvaṃ tathā siddhaṃ buddhirūpaprakalpitam ||  iti | kāraṇānāṃ prayojikā jātiritiyuktam | tathā ca jātipadārthapakṣe na dravyasya kriyāsādhanatvam, api tu saiva vidhipratiṣedhayoḥ sādhanaṃ jātirityāha-- vidhau vā pratiṣedhe vā brāhmaṇatvādi sādhanam | vyak‌tyāśritāśritā jāteḥ saṃkhyājātirviśeṣikā || 28 ||
 jāteḥ padārthatve tatra vidhau codite prativyaktiparisamāptatvāttasyāḥ sakṛdanuṣṭhāne'pi kṛtaḥ śāstrārtho `brāhmaṇamālabheta' iti | evaṃ `brāhmaṇaṃ na hanyāt' ityādirapi pratiṣedho jātāveva | sakṛdanuśṭhane'pi ca punarullaṅghane coditasya doṣaḥ | tathā hi--ahananaṃ coditam, hananaṃ tu kvacidanuṣṭhitamiti viruddhakriyācaraṇātpratyavāyaeva | kvacittu vidhyanuṣṭhāne'nyatra tadabhāve'pi na virodhaḥ | tathā cāhuḥ-- nākāraṇāni vidhiṃ bādhante pratiṣedhastu kriyāṃ nirvartayati' iti | tasmādyadā yadā hananabuddhirutpadyate tadā tadā pratiṣedhaḥ sarvatra brāhmaṇajātau vyāpriyate | atra ca jātyavacchinnakartavyatāpratiṣedhāvabhāsasya saṅkalpasyānuṣṭheyatvam | itthaṃ pravṛttinivṛttimaye puruṣārthe sarvatra jāterupayogo darśitaḥ | anuṣṭhānasya prādhānyāttadaṅgam-- `parāṅgabhūtaṃ sāmānyaṃ yujyate dravyasaṃkhyayā' . iti vakṣyamāṇanyāyena | saṅkhyāvivakṣāmatrāha "vyak‌tyāśritā" iti | vyaktiṃ dravyamāśritā yā ekatvasaṅkhyā tadādhārā yā jātiḥ āśrayabhedabhinneṣvekatvaguṇeṣu pratyayānuvṛttinimittaṃ sā prātipadikavācyāṃ dravyajātikārthasamavetasamāvāyādavacchinatti | jāteḥ padārthatve vibhakterapi saṃkhyājātyabhidhāyitvāt vāstavena ca rūpeṇa saṃkhyājātirviśeṣikā | śābdena tu pratyayārthasya prādhānyādviśeṣyāsau | evaṃ caikatvasaṅkhyāyā atra vivakṣitatvānna yugapadanekavyaktiviṣayamanuṣṭhānaṃ coditam | satyapi jātipadārthatve ekasyāmapi ca vyaktau sarvātmanā parisamāptā jātiriti na kācitkṣatiḥ | kāmanāhetukaśca vidhiriti satyāṃ kāmanāyāṃ vyak‌tyantare'pyanuṣṭhānāvirodhaḥ | evaṃ pratiṣedhe'pi hananabuddhirnimittamiti tadutpattau sarvatra tatpravṛttiḥ | tadevaṃ jāteḥ padārthatve codanāsūpapattiḥ | yadāha vākyakāraḥ-- `dharmaśāstraṃ ca tathā' |  iti nanu jātireva padārtha ityavadhāraṇānupapattiḥ, tasyāḥ svāśrayasamavāyāviyogāt | ata eva cāsāṃ kāryasiddheḥ kāraṇānāmāśrayeṣu bhāva ityāśrayādutkarṣayitumaśakyā jātiḥ kevalā kathaṃ śabdenābhidhīyata ityāśaṅkyā dṛṣṭāntenaitadupapādayitumāha-- yathā jalādibhirvyaktaṃ mukhamevābhidhīyate | tathā dravyairabhivyaktā jātirevābhidhīyate || 29 ||
 pratibimbe bhāvāntarotpattiḥ `viriddhaparimāṇeṣu'  ityādinā pūrvaṃ nirākṛteti mukhādipratinimbamādarśādau bhrāntyāpi dṛśyamānaṃ muśaśabdābhidheyamādarśādivyañjakarahitaṃ śuddham | evaṃ śabdo'pi jātiṃ vyaktirahitāmabhidadhāti | ayamāśayaḥ--āśrayasamavāyāviyoge'pi sarvatrābhedātsaṅketopapattau jātiḥ śabdābhidheyā śuddhā, śābde jñāne tathā pratīteḥ | aindriyake tu jñāne vivekānavasāyādbhavatu jātivyak‌tyoḥ ṃsamūrcchitāvabhāsaḥ | śabdasya tu yathāśaṅketaṃ pratītihetutve na kācitkṣatiḥ || 29 ||
yadyevaṃ śabdādapratīyamānā vyak‌tayaḥ kathaṃ śabdajñānaviṣayatayā jātīrviśiṣyurityāśaṅkāha-- yathendriyagato bheda indriyagrahaṇādṛte | indriyārtheṣvadṛṣṭo'pi jñānabhedāya kalpate || 30 ||
tathātmarūpagrahaṇāt keṣāṃcid vyaktayo vinā | sāmānyajñānabhedānāmupayānti nimittatām || 31 ||
 śabdādyupalabdhyanyathānupapattyānumitasatvānīndriyāṇi nityaparokṣatvādanupalabhyamānasvagatacakṣuḥ śrautrādiviśeṣāṇi śabdasparśarūparasagandheṣu indriyārtheṣu cākṣuṣādipratyayaviśeṣahetubhāvaṃ niyamena pratipādyante | na hi cākṣuṣaṃ jñānaṃ śrotrendriyakāryam | evamagṛhyamāṇasvabhāvā vyak‌tayaḥ | śabdenābhidhānavelāyāṃ keṣāṃcid eva sāmānyajñānabhedānāṃ kāścana pratyakṣapratyayānāmivopayānti hetutāṃ vyaktayaḥ | śābde pratyaye śabdārthabhūtānāṃ sāmānyānāṃ vastutaḥ samavāyaniyamāt viśeṣamāvedayantīti na sāṅkaryaṃ śabdārtha ityarthaḥ | agṛhyamāṇasyāpi tadānīṃ vyaktirūpasyānyadā pratyakṣakāle gṛhītatvād vyutpannasaṃbandhasyāpi tadviṣayāvasāyāvirodhāt saṃpratyagṛhyamāṇasyāpi dṛṣṭaṃ pratītiviśeṣahetutvamiti | etāvatā sāmyenātrendriyāṇi dṛṣṭāntaḥ | `keṣāṃcit sāmānyajñānabhedānām' ityarthāt kāścanaiva vyak‌tyaya iti labhyate | tadevaṃ kevalaṃ jātyabhidhānapakṣaḥ samarthitaḥ | tadvadabhidhāne tu jātiranabhidhīyamānaivopalakṣaṇamabhedena saṅketārthaṃ dravyasyeti tatraiva kriyāyogopalabdhe| śabdavācyatvam | yathoktam-- `codanāsu ca tasyārambhāt'  iti || 30,31 ||
idānīṃ yaduk‌taṃ prāk `sarvaśak‌tyātmabhūtavibhāgamāha-- satyāsatyau tu yo bhāvau pratibhāvaṃ vyavasthitau | satyaṃ yattatra sā jātirasatyā vyaktayaḥ smṛtāḥ || 32 ||
 avidyāpravṛttirūpasya sarvapadārtheṣvāgamāpāyino'satyatvād vyaktiriti vyavahāraḥ | `tadeva hi satyaṃ yasmiṃstattvaṃ na vihanyate' ityanvayirūpaṃ bhedapratyayeṣvabādhyamānaṃ satyaṃ jātiḥ' iti vyavahṛtamadvaitibhiḥ | tadyathā--rucakasvastikakuṇḍalādayo vikārāḥ paralparopamardena bhavanto'sthirapratyayaviṣayāḥ, suvarṇamityeva tu satyamanvayivijñānāvaseyasatattvam | evamabhedāntaravivakṣāyāṃ teja ityeva satyam | tatrāpyabhedastatkāraṇamityantyā parā prakṛtiḥ satyā sarvavikārānuyāyinī praśāntakallolā cidekaghanā brahmetyāgamavidaḥ | taduktam-- `pṛthivīdhātau kiṃ satyam, vikalpaḥ, vikalpe kiṃ satyam, vijñānam, vijñāne kiṃ satyam ūm̐ atha tadbrahma |' iti | pratibhāvam' iti | paramatena vastūnāṃ bhedādvīpsā ṣa citsāmānyasya sarvatrānugamādeva mahāsattārūpamabhāvapratiyogi viśvasya jagataḥ satyarūpamavadātadarśanaiḥ sākṣātkṛtyopadiṣṭam | pramāṇaṃ naste bhagavantaḥ || 32 ||
itthaṃ cātrādvayanaye paramārthasatyekaiva jātirmahāsattākhyā parabrahmasvabhāvā, tasyā eva gotvādijātibhedena vivartte vyavahāra ityāha-- sambandhibhedātsattaiva bhidyamānā gavādiṣu | jātirityucyate tasyāṃ sarve śabdā vyavasthitāḥ || 33 ||
 vakṣyamāṇairāśrayādibhiḥ svasaṃbandhibhiḥ bhidyamānā upacaritabhedā gavāśvādiṣu sattaiva mahāsāmānyameva jātiḥ gotvāśvatvādikā, aparasāmānyam, nānyā paramārthabhinnā sā vidyate | tathā hi goḥ sattā gotvam, nāparamanvayi pratibhāsate | evamaśvasya sattā aśvatvamityādi vācyam | tasyām eva ca gavādibhedabhinnāyāṃ sattākhyāyāṃ jātau sarve gavādayo ḍitthādayaśca śabdā vācakatvena vyavasthitāḥ ityasāṅkaryeṇa niyatopādhivaśājjātyabhidhāyinaḥ siddhāḥ || 33 ||
sarvaśabdaviṣayatvamevābhivyanakti-- tāṃ prātipadikārthaṃ ca dhātvarthaṃ ca pracakṣate | sā nityā sā mahānātmā tāmāhustvatalādayaḥ || 34 ||
 sarvabhāveṣu sadrūpaṃ sāmānyamanugatam | abhāvasyāpi buddhyākāreṇa nirūpaṇāt, mahāsattayānayāviyogāt prātipadikamātravācyā sattā | taduktam prātipadikārthaḥ sattā' iti dhātubhirapi sādhanadhīnalabdhajanmasu kriyāvyaktiṣu samavetā yathopādhyupagṛhītanānātvā sattaivābhidheyatvamāpādyate | siddhasādhyarūpārthadvayātmanā ca tasyā eva vṛttestadaparaśyabhāvāt sarvaśabdaviṣayatvaṃ sattāyāḥ | pratyayabhāgenāpyatra yathāyathaṃ saṅkhyākārakādyupādhiviśiṣṭā sattaivābhidhīyate | sā codayavyayarahitatvāt nityā, satpratyayasya sarvadānuvṛtteḥ | ete sattāmātrasyātmano mahataḥ ṣaḍ viśeṣapariṇāmāḥ, yattatparaṃ viśeṣebhyo liṅgamātraṃ mahattatvam, tasminneva sattāmātre mahatyātmanyavasthāya vivṛddhikāṣṭhāmanubhavanti | pratisaṃsṛjyamānāśca tasminneva sattāmātre mahatyātmanyavasthāya yattanniḥsattāsattaṃ niḥsadasadavyaktamaliṃṅgaṃ tasminpratiyantītyevaṃ sāṅkhye buddhitattvaṃ mahacchabdavācyamādyaṃ jagatkāraṇaṃ nirdiṣṭamityato'nantarasya vikāragrāmasya kāraṇarūpānugamātsattārūpatvamaviruddhamiti sattārūpaṃ sarvaṃ jagadākhyātaṃ bhavatīti sattādvaitavādaḥ sāṅkhyanayenāpyupabṛṃhitaḥ | evaṃ ca sravaśabdavācyā sattā śabdapravṛttinimittabhūteti yathāyathaṃ bhinnopādhibhāvapratyayābhidheyā saiva | nanvevaṃ gotvamiti prakṛtipratyayorekārthatāprasaṅgaḥ | naitat | upādhibhedena sattāyā bhedāt | prātipadikena gavāśrayāyāstasyā abhidhānam, pratyayena tu niṣkṛṣṭāśrayasya sāmānyasyābhidhetyadoṣaḥ | prakṛtyarthanimittaśca bhāvapratyayabhedaḥ iti na sāṅkaryaprasaṅgaḥ || 34 ||
yaduktam-- `tāṃ prātipadikārthaṃ ca dhātvarthaṃ ca pracakṣate'  iti | etadevopapādayitumāha-- prāptakramā viśeṣeṣu kriyā saivābhidhīyate | kramarūpasya saṃhāre tatsattvamiti kathyate || 35 ||
 kriyāvācī dhātuḥ sattvavācitāmeti | gīyate kriyāsattve ca sattaiva | tathā hi--sādhanāparispandavaśātkriyāṇāṃ vyaktisthānīyānāṃ viśeṣaśabdavācyānāṃ paurvāparye tadnatāpi jātistathātvena pritibhāsata iti saiva sakramā kriyā sakaladhātuviṣayā | tasyā evāvāntaro dhātvarthabheda ityanantarameva vakṣyate | sādhanasamparkahetukapratāyamānarūpāparāmarśe sattaiva sattvaṃ dravyamityucyata iti siddhasādhyarūpo dvidhā vivartaḥ sanmātrarūpasya parasya brahmaṇaḥ pratipāditaḥ | tadeva hi sarvatrānugatam | na cātra darśane sadbhyaḥ sattā vyatiriktā bhāvata iti sarvaṃ tanmayam | tataśca sarvaśabdānāṃ sattāvacanatvājjātipadārthavyāptiḥ | yadyapi ca dravyapadārthe'pi brahmadravyasyābhidhānamupādhibhedabhinnasya vakṣyati tathāpi tātparyabhedādavasthābhedaḥ | jātipadārthe sarvatrānvayirūpaṃ jātyātmanā brahma vivakṣitam | dravyapadārthanaye tu pariniṣṭhatarūpaṃ paramārthatayeti darśanavikalpaḥ | ayameva ca pakṣadvaye'pyekapakṣībhāvarūpaḥ siddhāntaḥ paramārthadṛṣṭyā | atra sarvapārṣadatvātpunarasya śāstrasya darśanāntaropanyāsaḥ | eṣa ca sarvatraivāsya granthakārasyābhiprāyaḥ, padārthacarcāviṣaye brahmadarśananayenaiva saṃbandhādivicāre vinigamanāt || 35 ||
idānīṃ samagra kriyākalāpaḥ sattāvivarta eveti niruktakāramatena saṃvādamāha-- saiva bhāvavikāreṣu ṣaḍavasthāḥ prapadyate | krameṇa śaktibhiḥ svābhirevaṃ pratyayabhāsate || 36 ||
 `ṣaḍ bhāvavikārā bhavantīti hi smāha bhagavān vārṣyāyaṇiḥ'  iti niruktakāraḥ | tatra ca bhāvasya paramārtharūpasya sattātmakasya janmādayo vikārā ityarthaḥ | sanmātrasvabhāvā hi sattottarottaravikārāpattau `jāyate'sti vipariṇamate vardhate'pakṣīyate vinaśyati' iti vyapadeśamāsādayati | prathamataraṃ ca sanmātraṃ rūpamastiśabdena nābhidhīyate api tu janmottarakālabhāvī tasyā avasthāviśeṣaḥ | janmānantarabhāvi hi rūpaṃ tasyā loke saditi vyavahāryam | tataḥ prākpaścādbhavinyaḥ punaravasthā janmavipariṇāmādirūpeṇa vyavahāryāḥ | tathā hi--svaśaktimāhātmyātpūrvaṃ jāyata ityavasīyate paścādastīti | avasthitasya vikārāpattiriti vipariṇamate | tacca vipariṇamanmuhūrtamapi nāvatiṣṭhate iti vardhate yāvadanena vardhitavyam, tato'pakṣīyate muhūrtamapyanavasthānādeva | ata evoktaṃ-- `tato'pāyena yujyate' iti | tato'pi vināśa ityevaṃ kramasthitiḥ | evaṃbhūtāstasyāḥ kāścana śaktayo vidyante yenaikaiva satī tathā tathā vicitreṇa rūpeṇa pratibhāsate | na ca pariṇati darśanābhiprāyeṇāyaṃ vikāraśabdaḥ, anityatvaprasaṅgāt, api tu vivarttaparyāyo'yam | tathā hi--sarvaśak‌tyātmabhūtatvādbrahmaṇo'nekavikārapradarśanasāmarthyalakṣaṇā avidyākhyā śaktiḥ kāryabhedādupacaritanānātvā samastītyāgamavidaḥ | itthaṃ ca svābhireva śaktibhiravyatiriktābhirjanmādirūpatayā avidyāyāmābhāsate | tadeva brahma sarvabhāveṣu samānarūpaṃ sattātmakamanyasya tavdyatiriktasyābhāvādityeṣo'trārthaḥ || 36 ||
yadi tarhi svaśaktimāhātmyājjanmādirūpatayā sattaivāvabhāsate kathaṃ na yugapadavabhāsaḥ | krameṇeti katham ? na hi kramo nāma kaścitkriyāviśeṣa ityāśaṅkya kālākhyāpi śaktirbrahmaṇa evetyāha-- ātmabhūtaḥ kramo'pyasyā yatredaṃ kāladarśanam | paurvāparyādirūpeṇa pravibhaktamiva sthitam || 37 ||
 yo'yaṃ kriyāṇāṃ kramaḥ so'pi ātmabhūto'syāḥ sattāyāḥ | na kevalaṃ tāḥ kriyā eva, kramavadbhayo vyatiriktasya kramasyāsañcetanāt | yatra krame idaṃ kāladarśanam, kālaṃ nāma padārthāntaraṃ tīrthikāḥ paśyanti paurvāparyādirūpeṇa pravibhaktam | kālasya pravibhaktatvāddarśanamapi pravibhaktamityuktam | tātparyeṇa tu kālaḥ paurvāparyādirūpeṇa pravibhakta iva kriyopādhivaśāt | kramākhya hi kālaśaktiḥ brahmaṇo janmavatsu padārtheṣu janmādikriyādvārakameva paurvāparyeṇāvabhāsopagamavidhāyinī nāparo dravyabhūtaḥ kāla iti `adhyāhitakalāṃ yasya kālaśaktimupāśritāḥ | janmādayo vikārāḥ ṣaḍ bhāvabhedasya yonayaḥ ||  ityatra śabdaprabhāyāṃ nirṇīto'yamarthaḥ || 37 ||
nanu ca janmanāśāvastutvātkathaṃ sattātmakau syātāmityāśaṅkya nāśasya tāvatsattātmakatvamupapādayati-- tirobhāvābhyupagame bhāvānāṃ saiva nāstitā | labdhakrame tirobhāve naśyatīti pratīyate || 38 ||
 napāyopajanavikāritvānnityā brahmātmikā sattā niranvayavināśāsahetyabhāvo nāma na bhāvāvdyatiriktaḥ | kevalaṃ prāgūrdhvaṃ ca tirobhāvamātraṃ bhāvāvabhāsasya yadasmābhirabhyupagamyate saiva nāstitā kathyate | sattaiva tirobhūtā svakāraṇeṣu śaktirūpatayāvasthitā vastūnāṃ nāśo na tu nirūpākhyo'sau | samasteṣu ca bhāveṣu tirobhūteṣūpasaṃhṛtakramaḥ siddharūpaḥ `tirobhāvo nāśa' ityādināmapadapratyāyyaḥ| yadā tu saiva nāstitā tirobhāvāvasthārūpā sādhanasamparkavaśātpratāyamānasvabhāvā vivakṣitā tadākhyātapadapratyāyyā | pūrvāvasthā `apakṣīyate' ityucyate, taduttarā tu `vinaśyati' iti dvau bhāvavikārau prātilomyapariṇāmalakṣaṇau | tatra ca bhavanadharmaṇo bhāvasyābhavanavirodhāttirobhāvāmātraṃ vināśaḥ || 38 ||
evaṃ sattāpratiyogino'pi prathamaṃ tadvikāratvamavasthāpya janmanastadvikāratvaṃ vyācaṣṭe-- pūrvasmātpracyutā dharmādaprāptā cottaraṃ padam | tadantarāle bhedānāmāśrayājjanma kathyate || 39 ||
 kāraṇe śaktirūpeṇāvasthānākhyātpūrvadharmātpracyutā, dharmāntarābhivyaktiguṇāṃ niṣṭhām aprāptā sattā, gṛhītakramā kāryābhimukhottarottarāvasthāviśeṣamāsādayantī jāyata iti vyapadiśyate, na tvasata evotpādo janma | tadyathā na sato'tyantaṃ vināśaḥ tathā janmāpi nābhūtapūrvasyāvirbhāvaḥ | etacca `nābhāvo jāyate bhāvo naiti bhāvo'nupākhyatām'  ityādinā prakaṭayiṣyati | ata eva cāvasthāmātratvātkāryakāraṇayorabhedādyathāvivakṣaṃ janikriyākartṛtvopapattiḥ `aṅkuro jāyate' ityādau | etacca nipuṇataraṃ kārakasamuddeśe vakṣyate | pūrvāparāvasthāntarālavarttikṣaṇaparamparākramavivakṣāyāṃ ca janikriyānvayona pariniṣṭhāvasthāyām | tathā ca vakṣyati-- `pūrvavasthāmavijahatsaṃspṛśan dharmamuttaram | saṃmūrcchita ivārthātmā jāyamāno'bhidhīyate ||  iti | uttarāvasthāyāśca pūrvāvasthāsu samāropātkartṛtvam | vyāpṛtaṃ hi kārakaṃ nirūpayanto jāyata iti vyavaharanti | niṣṭhāyāṃ punarastīti janmottarakālā sattā vyapadiśyate | tato'pi dharmāntarāvirbhāvonmukhatāyāṃ vipariṇamate | tatrāpi vṛddhau vardhata iti janmaviśeṣā evaitena pṛthagupāttāḥ | tadayamānulomyapariṇāmaḥ | tatraiva ca siddharūpatāyāṃ dravyatā | siddhirhi niṣpattiriti kriyā pūrvabhāvinī nātyantamarthāntarabhūtā || 39 ||
atha yaduktam-- `saṃbandhibhedātsattaiva bhidyamānā'  iti, tadidānīṃ saṃbandhinaḥ pradarśayitumāha-- āśrayaḥ svātmamātrā vā bhāvā vā vyatirekiṇaḥ | svaśaktayo vā sattāyā bhedadarśanahetavaḥ || 40 ||
 kriyādravyayoḥ sattātmakatvapratipādanāt tavdyatirekeṇa vastvantarābhāvād yadyapi sarvaṃ sattātmakaparabrahmamayam, tathāpi vyavahāre'vidyāpravṛttirūpe yathāvabhāsaṃbhedasyāsatyasyānapahnavanīyatvād dravyādisattāśrayaḥ pravibhāgo'yamaviruddhaḥ | tatra āśrayaḥ sattāyāḥ svādhāraḥ vyañjakatvāt, bhedadarśanasya bhedāvabhāsasya na tu bhedasyaiva svato'bhedāt hetuḥ | tadyathā--ekamapi mukhaṃ tailodakādarśamaṇikṛpāṇādāvanekarūpamavabhāsate | evaṃ vyañjakānāṃ gavādīnāṃ bhedātsattā gotvāśvatvādirūpatayāvabhāsata ityarthaḥ | svātmīyā vā mātrāḥ kalāḥ parikalpitā bhāgā aṃśā gotvādisāmānyaviśeṣāḥ paricchinnaviṣayāḥ sarvaviṣayāyāḥ sattāyāḥ vicchinnāvabhāsatāṃ darśayanti, yenu taireva sā vicchinnevāvicchinnāpyavabhāsate | te cāśrayabhedādeva tataḥ parikalpitabhedāḥ | tathā ca-- `sāmānyānyabhidhīyante sattā vā tairviśeṣitā' iti gotvādibhiḥ sattābhedaṃ vakṣyati | dṛṣṭaśca svāṃśaireva parikalpitairbhedāvabhāsaḥ | tadyathāvayavinaḥ | ātmā paro'pi saṃbhavati kalpanānirmitena bhedeneti svagrahaṇena viśeṣyate svaścāsāvātmā ceti | dṛṣṭaśca kālpaniko bhedaḥ yathā hantyātmānamātmanā' iti | na hyātmavyatirikto hantā kaścit pratyavabhāsate | arthāntaratvenāvabhāsamānā vā deaiśarāvendriyādayo bhedadarśanahetavaḥ sattāyāḥ | ihedānīmidamanyatrānyadānyaditi deśādinimittovastubhedaḥ | tathā deśāsattiviprakarṣakṛto'nyathāvabhāso vastūnām | yathāhuḥ-- `dūre yathā vā maruṣu mahānalpo'pi dṛśyate' | iti | tathā rātrau nīlotpalānāmanyathāvabhāsaḥ, anyathāhanīti kālakṛto bhedaḥ | tathā kācakāmalādyupahatanayanānāṃ śukle śaṅkhe pītāvabhāsa iti indriyanimitto bhedaḥ | deśādāvapi ca sattāyāḥ saṃbandhino'nye bhedakā iti viṣayabhedānnetaretarāśrayatā | tathā cāyamatra paramārthaḥ--ātmīyā eva śaktayo yogyatākhyāssattāyāstathāvidhāḥ santi yābhirviśvaprapañcaṃ racayati | tadyathā cintāmaṇirarthināṃ yathāśayamākāranānātvamuddarśayati tathānantaśakti sanmātraṃ brahma avidyāvilasitasahaṃ sāṃsārikapramātṛviṣaye nānārūpaṃ cakāstītyante vastusatattvamuddhāṭitam || 40 ||
itthaṃ ca darśanāntaropanyāsapūrvakaṃ svadarśane jātipadārthavyavasthāmupapādya vyavahāre bhinnāyā gotvādijāteryathāsaṃbhavaṃ svagato dharmaścarcyate-- pṛthivyādiṣvabhivyaktau na saṃsthānamapekṣate | anucchinnāśrayājjātiranitye'pyāśraye sthitā || 41 ||
 pṛthivītvāptvatestvādayo jātiviśeṣāḥ pratiniyatāvayavaracanānapekṣā eva mahati parimite cāśraye'bhivyaktimāsādayanti | tathā hi--loṣṭo'pi pṛthivīrūpeṇa pratīyate, mṛtsamūho'pi ghaṭo'pi parvatau'pītyādi | evaṃ samudro'pi biṃdurapi codakatvena pratīyata ityādi vācyam | kvacittu gotvādikā sālatvatālatvādikā ca jātiḥ saṃsthānamabhilyaktau niyatamapekṣata evetyarthāduktaṃ bhavati | tathā samavetatve'pi na guṇavadāśrayavināśājjātirvinaśyati | ghaṭādau guṇā hyāśrayapratibaddhodayāḥ yuktaṃ yadāśrayavināśamanu vinaśyeyuḥ | jātīnāṃ tvāśrayapratibaddho nātmalābhaḥ | kevalaṃ pratītāvāśrayamapekṣante tāḥ | ekavyaktivināśe'pi ca tadanyatrānugatasaṃvidanyathānupapatteranumitisadbhāvājjātiḥ samavasthitaiveti anucchinnāśrayāt āśrayāducchedo'syā nāyāti, āśrayo'syā nocchedaheturityarthaḥ | āśrayaśca vinaśyannucchedahetuḥ saṃbhāvyata iti nāśrayavināśādasyā vināśa ityarthaḥ | tṛtīyārthe vā pañcamī | āśrayeṇa saha na vinaśyatītyarthaḥ || 41 ||
nanu mahāpralaye nityānāṃ sarveṣāṃ vināśādāśrayābhāve kathaṃ jātayo'vatiṣṭheran ityāha-- anucchedyāśrayāmeke sarvā jātiṃ pracakṣate | na yaugapadyaṃ pralaye sarvasyeti vyavasthitāḥ || 42 ||
 eke iti | ya ādhāraṃ vinā tāsāmavasthānamante necchanti ta āśrayocchedo nāstyevetyāhuḥ | tathā hi-- iti vadnto mahāpralayasyābhāvamicchantaḥ paramāṇutvādijātivad ghaṭatvādijātīnāmāśrayo'nucchedyaḥ sarvathocchettumaśakya ityāhuḥ | tathā ca sadaiva vyavasthitā jātayaḥ kasyacidāśrayasyāpāye'pyaparāśrayavṛttitvāditi nityatvasiddhiḥ | athavā pṛthivyādau vinaṣṭe'pi pārthivādiparamāṇuṣu pṛthivītvādayo viśrāmyanti, tadgateṣu ca rūpādiṣu, rūpatvādayaḥ | ādisargavat yugapatsarvabhāvapralayo nāstītyasminmate vyavasthitā eka iti samanvayaḥ | evaṃ ekasminnapi brahmāṇḍe yugapatsarvabhāvānāṃ pralayo nāstīti darśanāśrayeṇoktam | yadvā brahrāṇḍāntare vinaṣṭe'pi brahmāṇḍāntarasya saṃbhavādyugapatpralayo nāsti | tathā cāhuḥ-- aṇḍānāmīdṛśānāṃ tu parisaṃkhyā na vidyate | iti || 42 ||
ye tarhi mahāpralayamicchanti tanmate kathamityāha-- prakṛtau pravilīneṣu bhedeṣvekatvadarśinām | dravyasattlaṃ prapadyante svāśrayā eva jātayaḥ || 43 ||
 ekatvamabhedaṃ mūlaprakṛtyā pradhānena saha parabrahmaṇā vā ye paśyanti jagataḥ, teṣāṃ mate sarvathā bhāvaprapañcasya niranvayavidhvaṃsābhāvānmahāsāmānyarūpe tatra parasminmūlakāraṇe pravilayamātraṃ mahāpralaya iti śaktirūpeṣu padārtheṣu yathāyathaṃ svajātiyogastadānīmaviruddha eveti dravyātmanā jātīnāṃ tadānīmari sattvam, dravyādarthāntarābhāvāt | ata eva sattvamityeva vaktavye dravyagrahaṇaṃ dravyādabhinnatvaṃ bodhayitum | yadvā-dravyaṃ mūlakāraṇam, tatra sattvaṃ tasya vā yatsattvam, kāraṇasattāmavalambata ityarthaḥ | advaitināṃ hi kāraṇamevānugataṃ sāmānyam | dravyaśabdo vā vastuparyāyaḥ | tena dravyasattvaṃ vastuna eva vidyamānatvaṃ mukhyaṃ sattvam, na tūpacaritaṃ sādhāraṇameva, śaktirūpatayāvasthānādityarthaḥ | vaiśeṣikadarśane tu nirādhārā eva ghaṭatvādijātayo mahāpralaya āsate | na hi gurutvādadhaḥpatanamāsāṃ mā bhūdityādhāraḥ, abhivyaktimātre tasyopayogāt | tadānīṃ cānabhivyaktā eva āsatām , ko virodhaḥ ?| śāstrakārastu svasiddhāntenaiva nigamitavān || 43 ||
evaṃ vyaktisarvagatatvaṃ sāmānyānāmāśrityoktam | idānīṃ sarvasarvagatatvanayenāpyāha-- brāhmaṇātvādayo bhāvāḥ sarvaprāṇiṣvavasthitāḥ | abhivyaktāḥ svakāryāṇāṃ sādhakā ityāpi smṛtiḥ || 44 ||
 bhavanti sarvatreti bhāvāḥ brāhmaṇatvakṣatriyatvādayaḥ sāmānyaviśeṣāḥ | te prāṇiṣu piṇḍeṣu kṣatriyādiṣvavasthitatvātsarvagatāḥ | tathāpi ca `brāhmaṇamālabheta' ityādau na sāṃkaryaprasaṅgaḥ, yasmātsarvahatatve'pi pratiniyatābhivyañjakavyaṅgyā iti pratītasya kriyāṅgatvāt yatraivābhivyaktimāsādayantyupadeśādinā vyañjakena tatraiva svakāryasampādakā ityavicchinnāhamapāramparyeṇa smaryate | yathā sarvagatatvaṃ pāramparyāgataṃ tathā pratiniyatavyañjakavyaṅgyatvamapītyarthaḥ || 44 ||
evaṃ ca pralaye ghaṭatvādijātayaḥ paramāṇvādiṣvavasthitā iti prakaraṇasāmarthyāduktaṃ bhavati | ādigrahaṇena hyacetanajātīnāmapi sarvagatatvamatra vivakṣitam, cetanajātayo'pyacetaneṣvavasthitā iti pūrṇaṃ sarvagatatvamāha-- citrādiṣvapyabhivyaktirjātīnāṃ kaiścīdiṣyate | prāṇyāśritāstu tāḥ prāptau nimittaṃ puṇyapāpayoḥ || 45 ||
 ālekhyanirmite pustakarmaṇā dārvādinā vā kṛte'pi brāhmaṇe sādṛśyāttadākārānukārapratyayodaya iti tatrāpi tajjātiprakāśaḥ | prāṇyupaghātātpunaradharma iti citrasthopaghāte tadabhāvaḥ | evaṃ dharmo'pi citrasthabrāhmaṇapūjāyāṃ na bhavati | kaiścid iti vacanādatrāruciṃ sūcayati kila | mukhyasādṛśyātpratikṛtiṣu pratyayānugamopapattirna tu tadvaśājjātisamavāya iti yuktama | tadeva pūrvaṃ `nirvattyamānaṃ yatkarma'  ityādinā prāk prabhavanādapi jāteḥ sadbhāvānnityatvamupapāditam | idānīṃ punarāśrayadhvaṃse'pyavasthānāditi pūrvāparakoṭigāmitvāt prākpraghavaṃsābhāvābhyāmayogātparipūrṇasya nityatvasya siddhiḥ || 45 ||
nanvaviditaśabdārthasaṃbandhasyānyebhyo vyāvṛttaṃ goṣvanugataṃ rūpaṃ gaurgauriti na pratibhāsate | yadi ca tābhirvyaktibhirabhivyaktaṃ tatsāmānyaṃ kathaṃ tatpratyayo na syāt | athānyebhyo'vyutpannaḥ pratipatsyate te'pi kuta iti sākṣāddarśinaṃ sarvajñaṃ draṣṭāramantareṇāndhaparamparā prasajyate | sarvatra ca śabdārthasaṃbandhe'ndhaparamparāyā eva vṛddhavyavahāra iti nāma kṛtaṃ syāt, nirmūlatvāt | brāhmaṇatvādīnāṃ rūpavyañjanasādṛśyād bālamūkādijñānasadṛśo'pyasau gotvādīnāmivāvṛttavyāvṛttarūpāvabhāso nāstītyavaśyameva sarvajño'bhyupagantavya iti manyamāna āha-- jñānaṃ tvasmadviśiṣṭānāṃ tāsu sarvendriyaṃ viduḥ | abhyāsānmaṇirūpyādiviśeṣeṣviva tadvidām || 46 ||
 asmad iti pañcamībahuvacanam | pañcamyā at  ityadādeśe kṛte pratiniyatapadārthadarśibhyo viśiṣṭāḥ sarvadṛśa ādigurava santi | tathā ca patañjaliḥ-- `sa pūrveṣāmapi guruḥ kālenānavanchedāt'  iti | sarvajñānāmīśvaro gururupadeṣṭā | tasya ca buddhīndriyadehānāṃ kālenānavacchedānnityatā | anyathā pralaye vṛtte punarutpanneṣu brahmādiṣu ka upadeṣṭā syāt | tataśca niḥśāstraṃ niranuṣṭhānaṃ vidhiniṣedhayorandhamūkaprāyaṃ jagatsyāt | atha pralayo naivāsti, api tu `na kadācidanīdṛśaṃ jagat' iti jaiminīyāḥ | tadetadasat | sarvaśāstreṣu pralayasmṛteḥ | athāmnāyasya kriyārthatvādbhūtārthaprātipadikaṃ vākyamapramāṇamityucyate | tathā hi--kāryaparatvenaiva vṛddhavyavahārācchabdārthasaṃbandhavyutpattipratipatteḥ `yatparaśca śabdasya śabdārthaḥ' ityākhyāyikāmātravarṇane siddhārthābhidhāne prayojanābhāvādvidhiniṣedhacodanābhāvatkasyacidapyaśāsanād bhūtārthaṃ vākyaśāstratvādena na pramāṇatāmarhati | pravartakavākyāṅgabhānena tu samanvayameti | śāstre stāvakatvena hyarthavādavākyāni vidhivākyāṅgabhāvagamanādanvayabhāñji bhavanti | evaṃ hi vidhirupodbalito bhavati | atra brūmaḥ | kimanarthakāni varṇavadevārthavādavākyāni mahāvākye vidhāyake kāryārthapratipādake'ṅgabhāvamupayānti, āhosvidātmīyaḥ kaścideśāmartho'sti yatra pratipattimādadhati kāryaparāṇi saṃpadyanta iti pakṣadvayam | prathamaḥ pakṣo na yuktaḥ | yathāyathaṃ siddhārthānāṃ svārthapratipattidarśanādakiñcitkarasyānarthakasya paratrāṅgabhāvānupapatteḥ kevalaṃ sā pratipattiḥ tatra svārthe pramāṇabhūta anyathā veti vicāryam | yatra bādhaḥ tatrāpramāṇam | abādhe tu pramāṇameva | abādhitā hi saṃvit svataḥ pramāṇamiti jaiminīyanayaḥ | sarvajñeśvaradevatānāṃ ca śāstradadhigatānāṃ na kiñcana bādhakamutpaśyāmaḥ | nanu ca mārjārādīnāṃ śāstre sārthakaṃ vacanaṃ śrūyate | na ca tatra saṃvādo'stītyevameva sarvamadṛṣṭārthamapramāṇam | maivaṃ vocaḥ | sarvajñabhūtānāṃ vacanasyāgamāntareṇāpi sārthakatvasya saṃbanādopalabdherabādhitatvameva | carmacakṣuṣaḥ parametanna manyante | tathā hi bhagavān patañjaliḥ-- `śabdārthasaṃyamanātsarvabhūtarutajñānam' ādideśa | tasmādyatra nāsti saṃvādo bādhakamātraparyavasānamarthavādavākye, tadasatyārthapratipādanenāstu kāryamātrapratipādanaparam | yatra tu nāsti bādhaḥ śāstrāntareṇa saṃvādaḥ tatpramāṇameva | na ca tatra kāryaparatā | siddhārthapratipādanena purāṇetihāsavākyānāṃ tāvatyeva praśnottarayoḥ samāptatvadarśanāt tatparijñānamātrācca dharmotpattyabhyupagamāt | kiñca dhyeye nirjñāte dhyānādiramuṣṭhātuṃ śakyate iti niṣprayojanatāpi nāstīśvarādipratipādakānāṃ vākyānām | tathā ca śāstram-- `ātmā jñātavyo mantavyo nididhyāsitavyaḥ' iti | pātañjalamapi-- `tasya vācakaḥ praṇavaḥ tajjapastadarthabhāvanam, tataḥ pratyakcetanādhigamo'ntarāyābhāvaśca'  iti | smṛtikārāṇāṃ ca manvādīnāmabhyupagamo mahendrarudrādīnāṃ pratyākhyānamiti pakṣapātaṛḥ | na hi manvādayo maharṣayo na sarvajñā vītarāgā vā | rāgādimattve'jñatve vā teṣāṃ kathaṃ tadvacanaṃ pramāṇam | "tasmātsākṣātkṛtadharmāṇa ṛṣayo babhūvuḥ te'varebhyo'sākṣātkṛtadharmabhya upadeśena mantrānsaṃprāhurupadeśāya glāyanto'vare vilmagrahaṇāyemaṃ granthaṃ samāmnāsiṣurvedaṃ ca vedāṅgāni ca"  ityāgapramāṇyātsanti sarvajñāḥ, yeṣāmandhaparamparāvyudāsārthamādigururbhagavān sarvaśāstrapravaktā taireva munibhirāgamyate | śāstrasya hi śabdanityatve'pi racanāvattvādīśvarapraṇītatvameva | tathā ca śāstradīśvaraḥ samadhigamyate | tasmācchāstraṃ pravṛttamiti tasya śāstraṃ nimittam | śāstraṃ punaḥ kinnimittam ? īśvaranimittam | tadetayoḥ śāstrotkarṣayorīśvarasattve vartamānayoranādiḥ saṃbandha ityuktam | tathā ca gītāsvāviṣṭamaheśvarabhāvena bhagavatā kṛṣṇāvatāreṇābhihitam-- `vedāntakṛdvedavideva cāham' iti | evamapi ca śāstrasya nityatve kṣatirnāstīśvarabuddhirūpatvāttasya | īśvarasya nityatvaṃ kālenānavacchedāduktameva | viśiṣṭaracanāvata eva vedasyeśvarabuddhau darśanātmani sadāvasthitatvamiti smṛtivadyathākālaṃ manvādivadasya racanākartāpi nāstītyuktaṃ brahmakāṇḍe-- `anādimavyavacchinnāṃ śrutimāhurakartṛkām | śiṣṭairnibadhyamānā tu na vyavacchidyate smṛtiḥ ||' iti | tadevamāgamapramāṇyādbhāvatattvadṛśaḥ śiṣṭāssantyatīndriyārthadarśina iti te yathāyathaṃ gotvabrāhmaṇatvādijātīrāśrayavivekenādhyakṣayanti | tacca teṣāṃ śiṣṭānāṃ jñānaṃ sarvendriyaṃ pratiniyamānapekṣatvāt | sarvajñā hīndriyāntareṇāpīndriyāntaravyāpāraṃ kurvanti | tathā cāgamaḥ-- `nadenīmindriyaireva paśyanti, ghrāṇataḥ śabdaṃ śrṛṇoti, pṛṣṭhato rūpāṇi paśyati, apyaṅgulyagreṇa sarvendriyārthānupalabhate' iti | athavā na cākṣuṣameva teṣāṃ viprādijātiviṣayaṃ vijñānam, api tvindriyāntarasaṃbandhyapi | śabdādau sūkṣmajātiviśeṣāvadhāraṇakṣamamityarthaḥ | tadevamāgamaprāmāṇyamāśrityasarvajñasiddhiratra sūcitā pūrvārdhena | vistareṇāgamaprāmāṇyaṃ vākyapadīye'smābhiḥ prathamakāṇḍe śabdaprabhāyāṃ nirṇītamiti tata evāvadhāryam | uttarārdhenāgamasiddhe sarvajñe'trānumānaṃ tadupodbalakamāha--`abhyāsād' ityādinā | ihābhyāsavaśājjñānaiśvaryādīnāṃ puruṣaviśeṣeṣvatiśayo dṛṣṭaḥ | yathā vaikaṭikānāṃ ratnatattvaparīkṣāyām, rūpyatarkāṇāṃ ca rūpyagatātiśayaparicchede yathābhyāsaṃ prakarṣatāratamyam | yacca sātiśayaṃ datavaśyaṃ kvacitkāṣṭhāprāptaṃ sambhāvyate | yathāditye tejaḥ, dāhakatvamagnau śaityamapsu | tathā jñānaiśvaryaśaktibalādayo guṇāḥ sātiśayāḥ puruṣeṣu dṛṣṭāḥ sarvajñeyavyāpikāṣṭhāprāptamatiśayamāvedayantaḥ tatsamucitamādhāraṃ pūrṇasamastasampatkamanumāpayantyeva | atiśaya eva hi jñānādīnāṃ tāratamyena dṛśyamānaḥ sarvajñabījam | na ca yatrāpyatiśayo dṛṣṭaḥ sa svārthanatilaṅghanāditi vācyam | svārthasya svāśrayānusāreṇa vyavasthāpayitumaśakyatvāt, ādityādau ca prakāśakatvādeḥ svārthātilaṅghanena dṛṣṭatvāt | tasmātsaṃbhāvanānumānenāpi sarvajñasiddhirucitā | taduktam-- `tatra niratiśayaṃ sarvajñabījam' iti | yadetatsarvajñabījaṃ jñānādīnāmatiśayalakṣaṇaṃ tattatra niratiśayam | yatra niratiśayaṃ sa sarvajña ityarthaḥ | sarvajñagrahaṇaṃ cātraiśvaryopalakṣaṇam, tena yatra niratiśayamaiśvaryaṃ sa sarveśvaraḥ parameśvara ityapi siddham, rājādīnāmaiśvaryatāratamyadarśanāt | itthaṃ ca mūlabhūteśvarasambhavāt `ṛṣīṇāmapi yañjñānaṃ tadapyāgamapūrvakam'  ityuktam | parameśvarastu kālenānavacchinnaḥ sahajajñānaiśvaryādidharmayuktaḥ | tasya cetana syācetanaṃ jagadicchānuvidhāyi pratyagātmana iva śarīramityupakāryopakārakabhāvasaṃsthānaviśeṣayogādijñātā sa etannirmimīta iti buddhimatkartṛkamapīdamatra viśvaṃ siddhamiti sthitam | tadevamāgamasiddhāḥ santyasmadviśiṣṭāḥ | indriyapratiniyamānapekṣaṃ ca sākṣātkārarūpaṃ teṣāṃ jñānamityatītānāgatasūkṣmavyavahitāviprakṛṣṭārthasatattvadṛśo yoginaḥ sarvā gotvabrāhmaṇatvādijātīradhyakṣayantaḥ tadupadeṣamasaṅkareṇārabhante | brāhmaṇatvādiṣvasti kiñcitsāsnādisthānīyamupavyañjanamasmākaṃ paramatīndriyam | śiṣṭaistadavadhārya saṃjñāḥ praṇītāḥ | taduktaṃ-- `pratyakṣapūrvakaṃ saṃjñākarma' iti | tatrabhavatāmupadeśādvayamapi sampradāyapāramparyādyathāyogaṃ gotvādijātīradhyavasyāmaḥ | asmadviśiṣṭānāṃ cedaṃ saṃjñāpraṇayanaṃ yathāvasthitaśabdārthasaṃbandhaprakāśanamātraṃ na tvapūrvasaṅketakaraṇaṃ svābhāvikatvācchabdārthasaṃbandhasyeti śiṣṭapramāṇyātsanti brāhmaṇatvādijātayo viviktā yathāyathaṃ bhāvapratyayābhidheyāḥ || 46 ||
tatredaṃ vicāryate | `tāmāhustvatalādayaḥ'  ityuktam, jātigandhatvam, utpalagandhatvam, mallikāgandhatvamityatra kiṃ parajātau gandhasāmānye bhāvapratyayaḥ kiṃ vāparajātāvaparasāmānye viśiṣṭāśrayagandhasamavāyinītyāśaṅkyāha-- jātyutpalādigandhādau bhedatattvaṃ yadāśritam | tadbhāvapratyayairloke'nityatvānnābhidhīyate || 47 ||
 iha laukike śabdavyavahāre vivakṣādhīne yadā jātigandhādiśabdātsamāsādbhāvapratyayaḥ kriyate tadā sāmarthye samāsavidhānāttadeva pravṛttinimittamiti tatraiva bhāvapratyayaḥ, `samāsakṛttaddhiteṣu sambandhābhidhānam' iti vacanādityādhārādheyasambandhaḥ saptamīsamāse, tatpūrvakaḥ śeṣasambandho vā ṣaṣṭhīsamāse tadvācyaḥ | yadā tu gandhaśabdādeva pūrvaṃ bhāvapratyayaḥ paścātsamāsa iti vivakṣā tadā bhedasya jātyutpalādyāśritasya viśiṣṭasya gandhasya yattattvaṃ pāramārthikaṃ tatkarmabhūtaṃ yadāśritaṃ kartṛbhūtamaparasāmānyaṃ tadbhāvapratyayavācyaṃ na bhavati, anityatvātsarvatrāsannidhānāt | bhedasya vā gandhaviśeṣasya tattvaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ sāmānyam, yadāśritaṃ samavetamiti samānādhikaraṇe pade | ayamatrārthaḥ--yadutpalagandhasamavetaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ sāmānyaṃ na taccandanagandhādivyaktau sannihitamiti vyabhicārādanityam, na tu sāmānyamanityaṃ bhavati | gandhaśabdaścāviśeṣeṇa gandhamātre vartata iti gandhamātravyāpinaivāsya pravṛttinimittena bhāvapratyayābhidheyena bhavitavyam | na cotpalagandhasamavetaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ sāmānyaṃ sarvagandhavyāpīti nedamabhinnaṃ gandhaśabdapravṛttinimittam | āśrāyaviśeṣeṇa tu jāteḥ gandhatvaṃ utpalagandhatvamiti samavetasamavāyādviśeṣaṇe viśiṣṭāvasāyasiddhiḥ | na caivaṃ nāstyeva sāmānyaviśeṣaḥ, āśrayabhedena gandhavyaktīnāṃ bhedāt śābaleyatvādivaduparajātiyogopapatteḥ | tathā ca bhedatattvaṃ yadāśritam ityāha | guṇānāmāśrayabhedādbheda iti vakṣyatyeva | astyeva cotpalagandhānāmanyato vyāvṛtto'nvayī pratyaya iti tannimittasāmānyasambhavaḥ kena vāryate | ata eva loka grahaṇam | lokavyavahāre paraṃ nābhidhīyate | gandhayuktividastvabhiyuktāḥ paśyantyeva viśiṣṭaṃ sāmānyam | samāsādapi ca bhāvapratyaye sāmānyaviśeṣasaṃbandhasya samāsavācyatvācchabdenāpratipādanādanitya iti nābhidhīyate || 47 ||
kāścittu jjātayo'saṃvijñānapadā api santītyāha-- asvaśabdābhidhānāstu narasiṃhādijātayaḥ | sarūpāvayavevānyā tāsu śrutiravasthitā || 48 ||
 narasiṃhagaurakharatvādijātayo'vidyamānāsādhāraṇavācakāḥ | samānaṃ rūpaṃ yayoktāvavayavau yasyāḥ narasiṃha ityādi śruteḥ śabdasya sā tatra vācikā | eṣā hi śrutiḥ naratvasiṃhatvajātiviṣayanarasiṃhaśabdadvayasādṛśyenāvabhāsamānā naratvasiṃhatvajātipratibhāmatrotpādayati | na ca narasiṃhābhyāmārabdho narasiṃhaḥ, api tu jātyantaramevātra śabalarūpe vastuni samavetam, citra iva rūpe citratvamiti tadasādhāraṇameṣā na śaknoti pratyāyayitum | bhāvataśca niraṃśaiveyaṃ śrutirityavayavasādṛśyamapi na vāstavamiti ivaśabdaḥ, sādṛśyābhimānamātramatra param | yathā niraṃśavākyasthānāṃ padānāmiti bhrāntyā naratvādijātau pratibhotpādanānneyamasādhāraṇā narasiṃhajātau śrutiḥ na cānyāpi vidyata iti asvaśabdābhidhāna-na vidyate svaśabdaḥ abhidhīyate'nenetyabhidhānaṃ yasyā iti || 48 ||
tadevamarthadvāreṇa pade parīkṣyamāṇe prakṛtibhāgasya jātyarthatayā vyāptimupapādya pratyayabhāgasyāpi tadupapādanena jātyabhidhāyitāyāṃ prakṛtipratyayayossamabhivyāhāramupapādayitumāha-- jātyavasthāparicchede saṅkhyā saṅkhyātvameva vā | viprakarṣe'pi saṃsargādupakārāya kalpate || 49 ||
 dravyajāteḥ kriyājāteśca subantatiṅntapadagataprakṛtivācyāyāḥ svāśraye dravye'vasthānaṃ avasthā samavāyaḥ tatra paricchedaḥ, kimekatra dravye tasyāḥ samavāyo vivakṣitaḥ kiṃ vānekatretyevaṃrūpaḥ | tasminnirṇīyamāne yathāyathaṃ suptiṅpratyayavācyā saṅkhyājātirekārthasamavetasamavāyātsākṣātsambandhābhāve'pyupayogāya saṃpadyate | tiṅantapadavācyāyā api saṅkhyājāteḥ kriyājātyā svāśrayadvāreṇāstyevaikārthasamavetasamavāyaḥ | jātervā avasthā rūpabhedaḥ svāśrayaviśeṣeṇa saṃsargalakṣaṇaḥ | śabdapratītayā vā saṃkhyājātyā sāmarthyādākṣiptā saṅkhyāvyaktirekārthasamavāyātprakṛtivācyāṃ jātiṃ viśinaṣṭi | pratītasya hyavacchedakatvam | pratītiśca śabdādarthatsāmarthyādvā bhavantī na viśiṣyate | yadvā dravyapadārthapakṣe saṃkhyā vyaktiḥ śabdavācyā viśeṣaṇam | jātipadārthapakṣe tu saṅkhyā jātiriti vikalpaḥ | tatra gauḥ, pacati, pacata ityādau viśiṣṭajātīyo viśiṣṭasaṅkhyāvacchinnaścārthaḥ prādhānyena pratīyata iti pratyayārthasya viśeṣaṇatvam prakṛtyarthasya ca viśeṣyatvaṃ | tathā ca `kriyāpradhānamākhyātam' ityupapattiḥ | pacatītyādau sādhyatvātprakṛtyarthasya prādhānyātkārakādinā pratyayārthena tasya viśeṣaṇāt | aupagava ityādau tu prakṛtyarthoparaktasya pratyayārthasyāpatyalakṣaṇasyābhidhānaṃ prādhānyenetyetadviṣayamevedam `prakṛtipratyayau pratyayārthaṃ saha brūtaḥ' iti | prāyikametat | tathā hi--saṅkhyā prakṛtyarthānugrahāyehokteti `gāmānaya'ityādau tadviśiṣṭasya prādhānyam || 49 ||
evaṃ tāvatsamānyena pratyayārthaviśiṣṭaḥ prakṛtyartho'bhidhīyate padeneti dravyadvāreṇa sambandhājjātyoḥ prakṛtipratyayoḥ samabhivyāhāropapattiruktā | idānīṃ kvacittātparyabhedācchuto'pyartho na vivakṣyata iti vākyārthaupayikatvaṃ padārthasya vicārayitumāha-- lakṣaṇā śabdasaṃskāre vyāpāraḥ kāryasiddhaye | saṅkhyākarmādiśaktīnāṃ śrutisāmye'pi dṛśyate || 50 ||
 karmādayo'pi śaktayo vibhaktivācyāḥ saṅkhyāvaditi tāsāṃ saṃkhyākarmādiśaktīnāṃ śruteḥ śabdasya svavācakasyāmādeḥ sāmye'pi, dvivido vyāpāro vākyārthe | lakṣaṇā ekaḥ | sa ca śabdāsaṃskāre śabdasaṃskāraviṣaye | saṅkhyākarmādirahitasya prātipadikārthamātrasyāsambhavāt `na kevalā prakṛtiḥ prayoktavyā' iti śabdasaṃskārārthaṃ svārthena prakṛtyarthamanavadhārayantyapi vibhaktiḥ prayujyate kvacit | tadyathā `grahaṃ sammārṣṭi' iti | kathamatraikatvaṃ na vivakṣitam ? śabdasaṃsakāramātraphalameva tvekavacanamiti codye nyāyaṃ vakṣyati | iha vastumātropakṣepaḥ | tathā karmādiśaktīnāṃ śabdasaṃskārārthamupādāne'vivakṣā | yathā `saktūn juhoti' iti | atra hi saktusādhano homa ityetāvanmātraṃ vivakṣitam | havanakriyāyā adṛṣṭārthatvena phalavattvātprādhānyāt kriyāviṣayatvamātreṇepsitatamā api saktavaḥ kriyāsamanvayamātre caritārthāḥ | na hi kathaṃ nāma saktavo bhasma sampadyeran iti homaḥ kriyate, api tu saktusādhanena tenādṛṣṭaṃ sampadyatāmiti | yadyevamadṛṣṭārthatvātkriyāyāḥ saktavo naivepsitatamā iti nāstyevātra karmaśaktiḥ | tadasatyāstasyāḥ kathamavivakṣā | sato hyavivakṣā śabdopāttasya nyāyyā | tadyathā `graham' ityekatvasya, na tvasataḥ | na hi `kāṣṭhāni pacanti ityuk‌tvā kāṣṭhānāṃ karmaśaktiravivakṣitetyucyate, api tu karaṇaśaktiḥ | satyametat | adṛṣṭameva tu na sampadyeta yadi saktava īpsitatamatvena nāśrīyeran, ananyopāyasādhyatvādityadṛṣṭārthatvasāmarthyādeva sak‌tvarthitābhyupetavyā kriyāyāḥ | tadyathārādhanasya devatārthatā | adṛṣṭārthameva hi devatārādhyate ityadevatārthatve tasyādṛṣṭārthatvameva hīyeta | evamiha pradhānamaṅgaṃ saktavo'dṛṣṭasyeti bhavantyevepsitatamāḥ | avivakṣitantu tadīpsitatamatvam, tāvanmātraphalatvena kriyāyā anabhisaṃhitatvāt, phalāntaraprayuktatvācca saktūnām | kriyāphalatvasya na grahāṇāmiva rūpāntareṇopādānādavivakṣitatvam | tasmādīpsitatamatvaṃ kārakāntarāpekṣayāsaccāvivakṣitaṃ ca rayācidapakṣayātreti sthitam | kvacittu kāryasiddhyarthaṃ saṅkhyākarmādiśaktīnāṃ vyāpāraḥ kāryasya vākyārthabhūtāyāḥ kriyāyāḥ siddhinimitto dravyāvacchedopayogaḥ | saṅkhyādiviśeṣavatā dravyeṇa sādhyamānāyāḥ kriyāyāḥ pratipādanāt | tadyathā paśunā yajeteti | atra hi yajirekenāpi paśunā avikalo niṣpadyata iti vivakṣitaiva sā saṅkhyeti vakṣyate nyāyaḥ | karmaśakteśca vivakṣā `vrīhīnavahanti' iti | vrīhayo hyavaghātena saṃskāryatvādīpsitatamāḥ na tvavaghātamātrārthaṃ kaścitpravartate, api tu vrīhyartham | teṣāmavaghā tena saṃskṛtānāṃ puroḍāśayogyasvabhāvātiśayapratilambhena yajyaṅgatāsiddherityavahananakriyātrāpradhānam, saṃskāryā vrīhaya eva pradhānam, taṇḍulīkṛtānāmuttaratropayogāt | skatūnāṃ tu bhasmībhūtānāmasattvannottaratropayogaḥ | tadāhuḥ-- "bhūtabhāvyupayogaṃ hi dravyaṃ saṃskāryamiṣyate | saktavo nopayokṣyante nopayuktāśca te kvacit ||" iti | avahananakriyā cātrāpradhānaṃ vāstavena rūpeṇa kathyate | śābdena tu rūpeṇa kriyaiva sampādyatayā codyate sarvatreti saiva pradhānam | tathā ca tadapekṣaṃ karmaṇaḥ kārakatvamatreti vākyārthapradhānabhūtā kriyeti kriyāviveke vistareṇāsmābhirabhihitamiti tata evāvadhāryam | itthaṃ ca `tāni dvaidhaṃ guṇapradhānabhūtāni' iti bhāvaśabdānāṃ dvaividhyakathanaṃ vāstavarūpābhiprāyamavagantavyam | pūrve tu `lakṣaṇā śabdasaṃskāro vyāpāraḥ kāryasiddhaye' iti paṭhanto lakṣaṇā dravyopalakṣaṇam, tatra śabdasaṃskāramātropayogisaṅkhyopādānamiti tadviṣayatvācchabdasaṃskāro lakṣaṇeti sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ vyācakṣate || 50 ||
idānīṃ śabdasaṃskāre lakṣaṇākhyo vyāpāro vibhajyate-- na vinā saṅkhyayā kaścitsattvabhūto'rtha ucyate | ataḥ sarvasya nirdeśe saṅkhyā syādavivakṣitā || 51 ||
 idaṃ taditi sarvanāmapratyavamarśayogyaṃ dravyaṃ saṅkhyāsamanvayasaham, `tasyāpatyam' ityādau nirdeśe sākṣānnirdidikṣitamiti nāntarīyakatvānnirdeśamātre `na kevalā prakṛtiḥ prayoktavyā' iti caritārthā saṅkhyā na vivakṣyata ityutsargaḥ | taduktam-- `tadvitārthanirdeśe liṅgavacanamapramāṇam, tasyāvivakṣitatvāt' iti | jātistu dravyasya dravyāntarādvivekamavagamayitumupādīyata iti na tadavivakṣā nyāyyā | sarvathā vivakṣābhāve prakṛtipratyayārthayoḥ śabdaprayogasyaivābhāvāt | tathā ca prakṛtivācyā saṅkhyā vivakṣyata eveti hi vakṣyati || 51 ||
asyotsargasya kecidviśeṣamāhuḥ-- ekatvaṃ vā bahutvaṃ vā keṣāñcidavivakṣitam | taddhi jātyabhidhānāya dvitvaṃ tu syādvivakṣitam || 52 ||
 yajjātau na saṃbhavati tavdyaktigataṃ pāramparyeṇa vyavacchedakatayāvasīyate iti dravyagatā saṅkhyā jāteravacchedikā nyāyyā na tu svagatā ekatvabahutvalakṣaṇā | ekatvaṃ hi jāteravyabhicāri bahutvam apyātideśikam | nanu jāternaiva saṅkhyāsti, dravyadharmatvāttasyāḥ | neha śāstrāntaraprasiddhā prakriyā pramāṇam, api tu svakṛtāntaḥ kaścidāstheyaḥ | asti ca pramāṇamekatve | jāteḥ pramāṇenaikatvaviśiṣṭāyā eva siddheḥ | tathātideśikaṃ `jātyākhyāyāmekasminbahuvacanam' iti | jātiparāyāṃ codanāyāmekatvabahutve na vivakṣyate `brāhmaṇo na hantavyaḥ', `surāna peyā', `vṛṣalairna praveṣṭavyam' | yatra tu vivakṣā tatra dravyaparā codaneti | dvitvaṃ tu na jātyākhyāyāṃ vihitamiti tatsarvathā dravyāśrayameveti vivakṣyate sarvatra || 52 ||
tadapi kvacinna vivakṣyata ityāha-- yadyetau vyādhitau syātāṃ deyaṃ syādidamauṣadham | ityevaṃ lakṣaṇe'rthasya dvitvaṃ syādavivakṣitam || 53 ||
 auṣadhadānaviṣayabhūtavyādhitopalakṣaṇārthasyaivamanena prakāreṇa vyādhiṃ nimittatvenopādāya pravṛttasyopalakṣaṇasyaitāvityevamupāttasya yadvācyaṃ dvitvaṃ tadatrāvivakṣitam | saptamī ceyam | lakṣaṇe jñāpane, arthasyauṣadhadānaviṣayasyopalakṣaṇe vetyarthaḥ | auṣadhasvarūpamahimnaivātra vyādhiviṣayatāsiddheḥ | taddānasyaitāviti vyādhitāntaranivṛttyarthamupādīyamānamekasyāpi tayormadhyātsaṃbhāvyamāne vyādhyudbhave tadauṣadhadānasyeṣṭeravivakṣātra dvitve | sambhāvanāviṣayatvācca vyādhisambhavasya yadā dvayorapi tatsambhavaḥ tadā samuditāvevauṣadhadānasya viṣaya iti sahavivakṣayā codanārthavatī | vyādhipratīkāraprayuktaṃ punarauṣadhadānamityekasyāpi vyādhitatve tatsambhavaḥ | bahuṣu ca prakṛteṣu etāviti parāmarśasyānupapatteravivakṣāyāmapi dvitvasya bahuṣu tadauṣadhadānāprasaṅgaḥ | kiñcauṣadhadānena dvāvanugrāhyāviti pradhāne'tra saṅkhyā na vivakṣyate | yatra nu krameṇāpi dvayoreva codanārthapratipattiḥ vakṣau chettavyāviti tatra vivakṣaiva | iha tu sambhāvanāviṣayaṃ vyādhitattvaṃ bhaviṣyadutprekṣyacodaneti krameṇa yugapadvā vyādhisambhave tadupapattiḥ | na hi bhaviṣyato niyamena sāhabhāvyaṃ nirṇīyate || 53 ||
tadevaṃ pratyayopāttāyā vivakṣitāvivakṣitatvaṃ vākyārthaparyālocanayā viṣayavibhāgena pratipādyādhunā prakṛtyupādānāyā ekāntenaiva vivakṣetyāha-- ekādiśabdavācyāyāḥ karmaṇyaṅgatvamiṣyate | saṅkhyāyāḥ khanati dvābhyāmiti rūpāddhi sāśritā || 54 ||
 dvābhyāṃ mantrābhyāṃ mṛdaṃ khanati, `caturbhirādatte', `ṣaḍabhirharati' ityatra pravṛttinimittabhūtāyāḥ prātipadikavācyāyā vdyādisaṅkhyāyāḥ kriyāvacchedakatvamabhyupagamyate, sā saṅghyā vivakṣitaiva | anyathā śabdārtha eva tyaktaḥ syāditi prātipadikasyānyathānupapannaprayogasya rūpāt svabhāvāt, viśiṣṭasaṅkhyābhidhāyinaḥ sāmarthyādatra vivakṣā | rūpaśabdo vā prātipadikaparyāya iti rūpāt prātipadikāt na vibhakterityarthaḥ, yathā dviputra ityādau | atra hi vibhaktivācyo bhedaḥ samāsa ekārthībhāvānnivartate | prakṛtivācyastvavatiṣṭhata eva | tadabhāve hi śabdaprayoga eva niṣphalaḥ syāt,grahamityādau tu pratyayaḥ prātipadikārthapratyāyane sāhāyyaṃ gacchatītyarthavānityatrāvivakṣā yuktā | `yasyobhayaṃ havirārttimārcchet aindraṃ pañcaśarāvamodanaṃ nirvapet' ityatrāvayavadvayārabdhaḥ saṅgha ubhayaśabdavācyo na tu saṅkhyāvācyubhayaśabda ityekāvayavavināśe'pi samudāyasya vināśānnirvāpaḥ kriyata eva || 54 ||
idānīṃ yaduktaṃ `vyāpāraḥ kāryasiddhaye' iti tadvibhajyate | tatra dvitvameva vivakṣyate naikatvabahutve iti pūrvamuktam | adhunā tvekatvamapi kvacidvivakṣyata ityāha-- yajeta paśunetyatra saṃskārasyāpi sambhave | yathā jātistathaikatvaṃ sādhanatvena gamyate || 55 ||
 śabdasaṃskārārthatvaṃ yadyapyatra vibhakteḥ saṃbhāvyate tathāpi paśujāteryathā prātipadikavācyāyāḥ kriyāṅgabhāvaḥ, `tathaikatvam' api vibhaktivācyamekapadopādānānna tyajyate | jātivadekatvamapi kriyāṅgamityarthaḥ | ekapadopādāno hyartha ekatvena buddhau viparivartamānaḥ kathaṃ bhedena `paśunā yajeta', `ekena ca' iti sambadhyeta | prakṛtipratyayābhyāṃ hi yo viśiṣṭaḥ padārtho'bhidhīyate tenābhinnayaiva pravṛttyā saṃspṛśyate yajyarthaḥ | ekapadatve'ntaḥpadasambandhasyāpauruṣeyatvāt | ataścobhayamapi śakyavidhānam | bhedena tu saṃsparśe vākyabhedaprasaṅgādaśakyavidhānaṃ syāt | bhinnapadopādānaṃ tu kadācidbhedena sambadhyetāpi, śakyavidhānatvāt | yathāraktamaśvamānayeti, tatra ca vākyabhedo raktamānaya, aśvamānayeti vākyīyassamanvayaḥ | ekapadopādāne tu śoṇamānayetivad aupādāniko viniyogaḥ | `grahaṃ sammārṣṭi' ityatra tu yathā na śakyavidhānaṃ tathā darśayiṣyate | anena ca paśuśabdārthasya pūrvamanirjñātatvamapradhānatvaṃ ca vivakṣānibandhanaṃ dhvanati | asmādeva vākyāt sādhanatvena pratīyata ityarthaḥ | agre tu sphuṭameva darśayiṣyati | nanu viniyojikayā śrutyā dravyasya kriyāsādhanatvaṃ vihitam, na tu guṇasya saṅkhyāyāḥ, viniyojakapramāṇasya dravya evopakṣīṇatvād guṇaviniyoge pramāṇābhāvaḥ | satyam | śrutyādipramāṇaṣaṭkavyatirikto'yamupādānākhyaḥ | na hi saṅkhyārahitaṃ dravyamātraṃ vidhirūpādatte | ekapadopāttasya guṇasya tyaktumaśaktayatvāt | pratīyate hi saguṇaṃ dravyamekarasayā śābdyā pratītyeti yathāyogaṃ guṇadravyayoranvayaḥ || 55 ||
tadevamayaṃ vādī bādhakamantareṇāvivakṣāṃ na manyate | ye tu śabdasaṃskārārthatvameva saṅkhyāyāḥ pratijānate te kathamatraikatvaṃ vivakṣantītyāha-- liṅgāttu syād dvitīyādestadekatvaṃ vivakṣitam | ekārthaviṣayatve ca talliṅgaṃ jātisaṅkhyayoḥ || 56 ||
