 śabdasaṃskārārthameva paśunetyekatvam | vivakṣā tu liṅgājjñāpakādvākyāntaragatāt | tathā hi `āgneyamajamagniṣṭoma ālabheta' ityuk‌tvā `aindrāgnaṃ dvitīyamukthye, aindraṃ pṛśniṃ tṛtīyaṃ ṣoḍaśini' iti dvitīyāditvenājo viśeṣyate | yadi cājamityekatvamavivakṣitaṃ syāttadā dvitīyāditvasyāsiddhatvāt dvitīyamityādi punarvidhānaṃ na syādityasmādabhidhānasāmarthyād vivakṣitamekatvam' iti niścīyate | nanvavivakṣāyāmapyekatvasyātra dvitīyaṃ tṛtīyamityapapadyata eva| aniyatasaṅkhyāprasaṅge dvitīyāditvena viśeṣaṇāt | naitadasti | evaṃ hi pakṣe'nuvādadoṣaḥ syāt | liṅgatve tu dvitīyāditvamapūrvameva vihitaṃ nityamavikalpitaṃ śrutaṃ noparudhyate | pakṣe'nuvāde hi śrutasya vaikalpikatvaṃ syādityavikalpitaṃ śravaṇaṃ parityaktaṃ bhavediti doṣaprasaṅgaḥ | ekāśraye parisamāptatvaṃ caikatvasaṅkhyāyā jāteścaitadeva liṅgamiti prasaṅgādāha | yathā hyekatvaṃ pratyāśrayaparisamāptaṃ tathā satyapyanekārthasamavāye jātirapītyasmādavasīyate | tathaikatvasaṅkhyāyā ekaḥ samāno'rtho viṣaya āśrayo'syā jāterityatrāpi tadeva dvitīyāditvaṃ liṅgam | anyathāśrayeṣu jāterekadeśena pravṛttau yo dvayoḥ pūraṇo nāsau tajjātīyaḥ syāt, api nu jātyekadeśaḥ | na ca jātyekadeśo jātirbhavati | samānāśrayatve ca jātyekatvayorjātiḥ prakṛtyarthaḥ sākalyena kriyāṅgatayopādīyate | anyathaikatvavattatrādhāre sarvātmanā jāteḥ parisamāptyabhāve ekatvamaśkayopādānam, ekasmin sarvātmanā jāteraparisamāptatvāt | ataśca dvitīyāditvaṃ vighaṭeta | tasmādekatvamanumāpayattadāśraye sarvātmanā jātessamāptimapyanumāpayatyetalliṅgam | yāvatā hi vinā nopapadyate tāvato'rthasyaitalliṅgam | yathā caikatvaṃ vivakṣāṃ vinā nopapadyate tathā jātestatsamānaviṣayatvamapi vineti | anyathā tatra jāteḥ samāptyabhāve sākalyena prakṛtyarthaḥ kriyāṅgatayā nopāttaḥ syāditi prakṛtyarthoparodhaprasaṅgaḥ | dvitvāderanekāśrayavṛttitvātpratyāśrayaparisamāptyabhāvānna tena saha jāterekārthaviṣayatve liṅgametat | evaṃ hmanekāśritatvameva jñāpitaṃ syāt | tacca jātitvādeva siddhamityekatvenaiva saha jāteretadekārthasamavāye liṅgamavagantavyam || 56 ||
idānīṃ yaduktaṃ `yajeta paśunā' ityatraikatvaṃ jātivadvivakṣyate iti tatra pūrvasūcitaṃ vivakṣānibandhanaṃ grahavailakṣaṇyena prakaṭayati-- anyatrāvihitasyaiva sa vidhiḥ prathamaṃ paśoḥ | kriyāyāmaṅgabhāvaśca tattvetasmādvivakṣitam || 57 ||
 yajeḥ kartavyatā vākyāntarātsiddheti `paśunā yajeta' iti guṇavidhistātparyataḥ | tathā cājñātasya paśuguṇasya pramāṇāntarāt prathamam anenaiva jñāpanamityutpattividhirayaṃ paśoḥ | asmādvākyātprathamamutpanna iva paśuranenaiva jñāpitatvāt | jñaptireva hi prathamotpattirbhaṇyate | sa cotpattividhiratrāṅgatvena yajikriyāviṣayeṇa nāṅgitvena ityasmātkāraṇadvayāt tat ekatvamatra vivakṣitam | tathā hi śabdapramāṇakā vayam | śabdena caikatvaviśiṣṭo'rthaścodita iti kathaṃ tadekatvaṃ tyajyatām | taduktam-- `yathā jātistathaikatvaṃ sādhanatvena gamyate' iti | yathā śabdacoditā jātistathaikatvamapītīhatyastatra nyāyassūcitaḥ | śabdaśca prathamamidamāha na tu śabdāntaraṃ saṅkhyāntarayuktaṃ grahādivadastīti prathamopadeśo vivakṣā kāraṇam | aṅgatvopadeśaśca yāgasya prādhānyāt | yadi hyaṅgitayopadeśaḥ syātpaśoḥ tadā `grahaṃ sammārṣṭi' itivadbhavedavivakṣetyarthaḥ | tasmācchrutasaṅkhyāhāne hetvabhāvādekatvaviśiṣṭasādhanasādhyatvena niyatarūpaṃ pradhānamavagataṃ bhavatītyaniyatānekasaṅkhyopādānamapramāṇakam | atra kecit `kriyāyāmaṅgabhāvasya' iti paṭhantaḥ prathamaṃ kriyāyāmaṅgabhāvasya vidhiriti yojitavantaḥ || 57 ||
etannyāyavaiparītyena `grahaṃ sammārṣṭi' ityatra lakṣaṇākhyaṃ vyāpāramāha-- grahāstvanyatra vihitā bhinnasaṅkhyāḥ pṛthak pṛthak | prājāpatyā navetyevamādibhedasamanvitāḥ || 58 ||
aṅgatvena pratītānāṃ sammārge tvaṅgināṃ punaḥ | nirdeśaṃ prati yā saṅkhyā sā kathaṃ syādvivakṣitā || 59 ||
 `prājāpatyā nava grahā bhavanti, daśaitānadhvaryuḥ prātaḥsavane grahān gṛhṇāti, aindravāyavaṃ grahaṃ gṛhṇāti, maitrāvaruṇaṃ grahaṃ gṛhṇāti' ityādāvutpattivākye grahāṇāṃ somādhārāṇāṃ pātrāṇāṃ bhinnasaṅkhyānāṃ pṛthak pṛthak teṣu prakaraṇeṣu bhedenopāttānāṃ tathaivānubhūtānāṃ `grahaṃ sammārṣṭi' ityatra smṛtyopasthāpitānāṃ yathotpattivākyānubhavamevātra smṛtibuddhāvupasthānaṃ yuktamiti bhinnasaṃkhyā eva pratīyante | utpattivākye hi grahāṇām aṅgatvena somadhāraṇārthamupadeśa iti tatrāprādhānyādvivakṣyate saṅkhyā | apūrvopadeśācca `paśunā' itivat `nava daśa' iti prātipadikārthatvādapi tatra niyogato vivakṣā | sammārge tu vāstavena rūpeṇa sammārgasya grahaśuddhyutpādanārthatvāt saṃskāryā grahā evāṅginaḥ pradhānabhūtāḥ śābdena rūpeṇa kriyāprādhānye'pi | tataścotpattivākyāpekṣayā sammārgavākyena punaryo'yaṃ `graham' iti nirdeśaḥ tatra pūrvaśrutā eva te sammārjanaviṣayabhāvārthamupāttāstātparyata iti pūrvasaṅkhyānvayinaḥ | prakaraṇārthaṃparyālocanayā hi vākyārtho'vatiṣṭhate na tu yathāśrute padārthamātre'vasthātavyam-- `stutinindāpradhāneṣu vākyeṣvartho na tādṛśaḥ | padānāṃ pravibhāgena yādṛśaḥ parikalpyate' iti nyāyāt, avāntaravākyānvayena mahāvākyārthānusaraṇena padārthāpoddhāra ityatra prakaraṇānubhūtabhinnasaṃkhyākagrahagrahaṇam | tadanenāvivakṣāyāṃ hetudvayamuktam--anyatra vidhānaṃ prādhānyaṃ ca | yadyapi bahuṣvekatvamapyaviruddhamanubhūtaṃ tathāpyanekamadhyapātyekatvamanubhūtaṃ na tu kevalamityanekasahacāriṇā evātra smṛtiḥ | ata eva `pṛthak pṛthak' ityanekasaṅkhyāyā bhūyodarśanena tatprabhavavāsanotpattisthairyaṃ smṛtyavyabhicārasthāpanārthamāha | pṛthak pṛthagbhinnasaṅkhyānāmanubhūtatvāttathaiva smṛtiḥ sammārge anuvāde'tretyarthaḥ | `grahairjuhoti' iti havane grahāṇāmupayogātsaṃskāryatvam | aṅgānāṃ pradhānopakārāya saṃskārarhatvāt | na ca grahaikatvaviśiṣṭaḥ sammārgavidhirnyāyyaḥ | guṇasya dravyasamakakṣyatayā kriyāyāmaṅgabhāvābhāvād dravyadvāreṇāṅgatvāt dravyānuyāyitve'nubhūtadravyabhedāśrayaṇāt | `citragavīrbadhnāti', `śoṇaṃ yojaya' ityatra tu citraśoṇaśrutyanyathānupapattyā guṇavivakṣautpattikī || 58,59 ||
idānīmavivakṣautsargikī sarvatra, śabdasaṃskārārthaṃ vibhak‌tiyupādānāditi yatnādvivakṣāmāha-- nānyatra vidhirastīti saṃskāro nāpi cāṅgitā | hetuḥ saṅkhyāvivakṣāyāṃ yatnātsā hi vivakṣitā || 60 ||
 vākyāntare grahāṇāṃ bhinnasaṅkhyānāṃ vidhirasti iti ato hetoratra `grahaṃ sammārṣṭi' ityekavacanaṃ śabdasaṃskārārthamātramityetanna yuktam | nāpyatra sammārge grahāṇāṃ aṅgitā prādhānyam, ekatvasya vivakṣābhāve hetuḥ nimittam, api tu `na vinā saṅkhyayā kaścit'  ityuktānnyāyāt sarvatraiva prātipadikārthasyopalakṣaṇārthaṃ vacanamityavivakṣitam | yatra tu kaścinnyāyo yuktirūpo'sti tatra tasmāt yatnāt saṅkhyā vivakṣyata ityautsargikyā avivakṣāyā vivakṣāpavādaḥ || 60 ||
na ca vivakṣāheturyatno'sti `graham' ityādāvityāha-- sammārjane viśeṣaśca na grahe kvacidāśritaḥ | vihitāste ca saṃskāryāḥ sarveṣāmāśrayastataḥ || 61 ||
 `grahaṃ sammārṣṭi' ityanupāttaviśeṣasya pūrvāvadhṛtasya grahasya saṃskāraścoditaḥ | pūrvaṃ ca bhinnā grahā dṛṣṭāḥ | tadāha-vihitāste iti | na hyeko grahaḥ svotpattivākye vihitaḥ | api tu bahavo `nava, daśa' ityevaṃ vihitāḥ | na ca teṣāṃ madhyāt kaścideva saṃskārārhaḥ, api tu sarva eva te tathetyāha te ca saṃskāryāḥ iti | sarveṣāṃ saṃskāra upayujyate, uttaratra somadhāraṇe sarveṣāṃ saṃskṛtānāmupayogāt | tataśca bhūyasāṃ vihitānāṃ yadyeko vivakṣito'bhaviṣyattadā tasya cihnabhūtaḥ kaścidviśeṣo niradekṣyata `ārkamāśvinaṃ maitrāvaruṇaṃ vā grahaṃ sammārṣṭi' iti | na cāsau nirdiṣṭaḥ | ekavacanaṃ tu na viśeṣaḥ | tasya pratiniyataikaviṣayatvābhāvādaniyataikopādāne kasyeti viśeṣāvadhāraṇābhāvādaśakyānuṣṭhānārthopadeśaprasaṅgāditi jātāvidamekavacanaṃ boddhavyaṃ na tu vyaktāviti nāsmādyatnādvivakṣāsiddhiḥ | kiñca sarvatra śabdasaṃskārārthamekavacanamityevamidamurakrāntam | tathā caikavacanaṃ na yatnaḥ | tasmātsāmānyopadeśātsaṃskāryatvasya ca samānatvādutpattivākyāvadhṛtasaṅkhyānāṃ sarveṣāmeva grahāṇāṃ saṃskāryatvaparigraha iti siddham || 61 ||
`paśunā yajeta' ityatra ko yatnaḥ saṅkhyāvivakṣāyāmityāha-- pratyāśrayaṃ samāptāyāṃ jātāvekena cetkriyā | paśunā na prakalpeta tatsyādeva prakalpanam || 62 ||
 jāteḥ pratyāśrayaparisamāptatvaṃ pūrvaṃ liṅgenāpi sādhitamityekatrāpi paśutvajāteravaikavyātkriyāṅgatopapattau kimarthaṃ dvitīyādhyupādīyeta | yadi hi jātirāśraya ekadeśena varteta tadaikavyaktyupayoge jātiḥ padārtho bādhyeta jātyaṃśasyājātitvāditi prakṛtyarthasāmarthyād dvitīyādyupādīyeta | na caivam | ekatrāpi jāterniṣṭhitatvāt | syādetat | bhavatvekatrāpi prakṛtyarthopapattiḥ | vākyārthabhūtā tu kriyā naikasādhanasādhyeti pradhānānurodhādaṅgāntaramupādīyetetyāśaṅkyāha--ekena cetkriyā paśunā na prakalpeta iti | adṛṣṭaphalasya yāgasya paśunaikenāpyavadānadvāreṇopakārānniṣpatterasampattirnāsti, yatastadanekatvaprakalpanamatra bhavet | sāmarthyād buddhisthamanekasaṅkhyotprekṣaṇaṃ `tad' ityanena nirdiśati | asmādeva `paśunā yajeta' iti pramāṇabhūtādvākyādekasya kriyāsādhanatāvasīyate | anyathā grahavadvākyāntarātsaṅkhyāntarasyānavasāye'niyataikaparigrahe'śakyānuṣṭhāno'rtha upadiṣṭaḥ syāt || 62 ||
nanvaṅgabhūtastavātphabhūyastvamiti yathāsambhavaṃ paśvantaropādānaṃ bhaviṣyatītyāśaṅkyāha-- ekena cetprasiddhāyāṃ kriyāyāṃ yadi sambhavāt | paśvantaramupādeyamupādānamanarthakam || 63 ||
 athamarthaḥ--ihaikasya paśoḥ kriyāsiddhau hetubhāvo'sti na vā | dvitīye pakṣe śāstrellaṅghanamityādyaḥ pakṣaḥ | tatra ca lāghavādekenaiva kriyāniṣpattāvadhihagatasamīhitāḥ kimarthaṃ sādhanāntarānveṣaṇaprayāsamanubhaveyuradhikāriṇaḥ | na hi yathāsambhavamiti śāstracodanā | acoditānuṣṭhāne ca śāstrellaṅghanādānarthakyamiti phalabhūyastvasyāpyabhāvaḥ | na hyekenānekena vā yajau niṣpādyāyāṃ phalahetuḥ kaścitsvarūpātiśayaḥ | tasmādupāyalāghavātprathamenaiva paśunāvadānagaṇasya niṣpatterekasya paśorālambhe'parasyālambho niṣprayojanaḥ || 63 ||
kva yathāniṣpannasya niṣpattyarthaṃ yatnāntaraṃ nādriyata ityatra dṛṣṭāntamāha-- yathaivāhitagarbhāyāṃ garbhādhānamanarthakam | tathaikena prasiddhāyāṃ paśvantaramanarthakam || 64 ||
 āhitaḥ bījātmanopakṣiptaḥ, garbho yasyāṃ tatra punaḥ garbhādhānam aphalam, āhitasyādhāne viśeṣābhāvāt | evamekapaśusādhye yāge paśvantaram aphalam, siddhasya sādhanavaiphalyāt | paśvantaropādāne tu tatsādhanaṃ kriyāntarameva syāt | na ca tatra vidhipratipattiḥ | itthaṃ dārṣṭāntikānuguṇyād garbhādhānamanarthakam ityuktaṃ nāśakyamiti | ānarthakyasya sādhyasya prakrame nidarśane sambhavadapyaśakyatvaṃ sādhyena samanvitaṃ na syāt | garbhārdhānārthā vā saṃskārā garbhādhānaśabdenātra vivakṣitāḥ śāstracoditā iti teṣāmāhitagarbhāyāmānarthakyamiti dṛṣṭāntadārṣṭāntikayoḥ sāmyaṃ suṣṭhu saṃgacchate || 64 ||
tadevaṃ lāghavāccoditamekatvaṃ paśāvāśrīyata ityekīyaṃ matam | anye tu nyāyāntaramatrāhuriti pradarśayati-- tāvatārthasya siddhatvādekatvasyāvyatikramam | kecidicchanti na tvatra saṅkhyāṅgatvena gṛhyate || 65 ||
 nātraikatvasaṅkhyā paśuviṣaye vivakṣyate, api tu prātipadikārthopalakṣaṇameva sā | saṅghyāmātrayuktaḥ prātipadikārthaḥ sādhanam | tasya tu pūrvaṃ lāghavamekatvasyopādāne nimittamabhihitamū | idānīṃ tvekatvapūrvakatvādanekatvasya kramavyatikrame prayojanābhāvādekasaṅkhyākasyaivaipādānaṃ kathyate, tatparimāṇenaiva kriyāsiddhiriti sāmarthyādekatvasya avyatikramaḥ atyāgaḥ | tadevaṃ lāghave pūrvokte sāmarthye vehopātte śeṣabhūtamidam-na tvatra saṅkhyāṅgatvena gṛhyata iti | ekavākyatayaivopapattervākyabhedena vyākhyānaṃ pūrvairdūṣaṇarasikatayā kṛtam | sāmarthyādekatvasyāvyatikrame tu na saṅkhyāṅgatvena gṛhyate | na vacanaprāpitaḥ saṅkhyāyāḥ kriyāṅgabhāvaḥ syāt sāmarthyādavyatikramamātramiti śabdena vihitamekatvamityacoditārthānuṣṭhānaprasaṅga iti dūṣaṇaṃ kārikāvayavādvibhajya pūrvaiḥ kalpitam | granthakārastvatra mate kārikāntareṇaiva `anvayavyatirekābhyām'  ityādinā dūṣaṇaṃ dāsyati || 65 ||
kathaṃ tarhi dvitīyādi liṅgamekatvavivakṣāyāmanyantroktamityāha-- dvitīyādiṣu yalliṅgamuktaṃ nyāyānuvādi tat | na saṅkhyā sādhanatvena jātivattena gamyate || 66 ||
 ekatvavivakṣāsiddhyarthaṃ naitalliṅgam, api tu lāghavādekena siddhatvātkriyāyā anekopādānasya niṣprayojanatvāt kramavyatikrame prayojanābhāvāccaikatvasaṅkhyāparigraha iti yadetannyāyadvayamuktaṃ tadanuvādaparam, ukthe dvitīyamityādi liṅgaṃ nāpūrvamarthaṃ gamayati, yasmāttenānantaroktena nyāyadvayenaikatvasyāparityāgācchābdena rūpeṇa na saṅkhyā sādhanatvena gamyate, śabdasaṃskāramātrārthatvādekavacanasya | tena vā kāraṇena saṅkhyātra na vivakṣyate, yasmādavivakṣāyāmapi nyāyādiṣṭasiddhiḥ | yadvā tena liṅgena saṅkhyā sādhanatvena nāvedyate nyāyādeveṣṭasiddheranuvādamātraṃ tadityarthaḥ | jātivaditi vaidharmyadṛṣṭāntaḥ | yathā śabdacoditā jātiraṅgamiti gamyate naivamekatvamuktādeva nyāyāt tadanaṅgatve'pi samīhitasiddheḥ || 66 ||
keciditi vacanātparamatam, etad dūṣayati-- anvayavyatirekābhyāṃ saṅkhyābhyupagame sati | yuktaṃ yatsādhanatvaṃ syānna tvanyārthopalakṣaṇam || 67 ||
 vibhaktipratyayamanveti anuvartate, tasmin sati pratīyate tadabhāve vyatiricyate vyāvartate na pratīyate saṅkhyeti paśumālabhetetyādau śabdopādānāyāstasyāḥ pratītiścedabhyupagamyate vidhānamapi kathaṃ nāstīti śabdopāttāyāstyāgo na yuktaḥ, api tvetadeva yuktaṃ yatsādhanatvaṃ kriyāṅgatvam na tvanyārthopalakṣaṇaṃ prakṛtyarthopalakṣaṇaṃ yuktamityarthaḥ | sattvabhūtasyārthasya śabdenābhidhāne tatsaṃskārapratipattaye vacanamiti prakṛtyarthopalakṣaṇamātraṃ tadbhavati | na caitannyāyyam | yathā hyanvayvayatirekābhyāṃ prakṛtivācyā jātiḥ śabdavakī na tyajyate tathā saṅkhyāpīti nyāyyam | na hyekayogakṣemasyāṅgaṅgitayā ekapadopāttasyārthasya khaṇḍaśo viniyogāviniyogau yuktāviti bhāvaḥ | śabdenācodite tvekatve sāmarthyātpratipattau yadaikapaśūpāttānāmekādaśānāmavadānānāṃ daivānmānuṣādvā vaiguṇyādanyatamavilopaḥ tadā paśvantarāṇyavadānārthamupādīyeran | na hyevaṃ kācicchabdārthabādhā tadānīṃ bhavati, śabdenācoditatvādekatvasya | tathā ca tatkarmājyena na nirvarttyeteti pratinidhyabhāvaḥ | mukhyābhāve hi pratinidhirupādīyate | mukhyaṃ ca vacanena saṅkhyānupādāne vidyata eva | yasya punaḥ śabdacoditamekatvaṃ tasyopapanno'tra pratinidhirityavadānalope tatkarmājyena sampādyate, na tu paśvantaramupādīyate, coditaikatvatyāgaprasaṅgāt, yadyevaṃ vapāvināśe'pi paśvantaraṃ nopādīyeta | naitadasti | yasmānnālambhanamātrasampattyarthaṃ paśorupāṃdānam, api tu yāgārtham | tatraiva ca tadekatvaṃ vivakṣyate | yāgaśca vapāṃ vinā na sampadyate | tasmātpaśvantaropādāne'pi nātikrāntamekatvam | tatraikenaiva yāgasya nirvṛttatvāt avadānāntarārthantu paśvantare codite satyekatve na labhyate ityavadānāntarakāryaṃ ghṛtena sampadyata iti nyāyaḥ || 67 ||
yataśca sādhanatvaṃ yuktam, ataḥ-- sādhanatve padārthasya sāmarthyaṃ na pradīyate | saṅkhyā vyāpāradharmo'tastena liṅgena gamyate || 68 ||
 yadā śabdopāttatvājjātisaṅkhyayostulyatvam tadā sādhanatve padārthasya sāmarthyaṃ na prahīyate | padasyeti vākyaśeṣa | sakalasya hi padārthasya sādhanatve padasya tadabhidhānalakṣaṇaṃ sāmarthyaṃ na dāpitaṃ bhavati | ataśca paripūrṇasya padārthasya sādhanatvātsaṅkhyāyā ekatvalakṣaṇāyāṃ kriyāyā vyāpārākhyo dharmaḥ tena liṅgena gamyate | yatastatpadasya sāmarthyamapraheyam atastena sāmarthyavakṣaṇena, liṅgena hetunā gamyate saṅkhyā vyāpāradharmaḥ | yatastadapraheyam atastadbhavati hetuḥ saṅkhyāvyāpārādhigatau | yathā yato'vinābhūto dhūmaḥ atassa bhavayatyagnyadhigamahetuḥ | athavā-tena liṅgena dvitīyādinā etad gamyate na tu pūrvoditasya sāmarthyādaparigrahamātrasya na tadanuvādi liṅgaṃ yathā tairuktam, api tu madīyanyāyenaiva tatsaṅgatamityarthaḥ | yatra tu liṅgaṃ nāsti saṅkhyāvyāpārasūcakam, tatrāvivakṣeti bhāvaḥ, tadyathā `grahaṃ sammārṣṭi' iti | ata eva saṅkhyāyāḥ kvacidavyāpāralakṣaṇo dharmaḥ, tena liṅgena gamyate ityakārapraśleṣaṃ kecivdyācakṣate kila | liṅgābhāve `grahaṃ sammārṣṭi' ityādau nyāyādavivakṣeti liṅgamabhavattatra sādhakatamam | yathā sādhanābhāvaḥ stokānmuktaḥ ityādau | tadevamanena ślokadvayena sa evārtho nirvāhito yo "anyatrāvihitasyaiva"  ityādau nirṇītaḥ || nanu ca vivakṣāṃ pratijānatābhyupetaḥ saṅkhyāyāḥ sādhanabhāvaḥ | saṅkhyā ca dravyaviśeṣaṇam, śaktistu sādhanamiti kathamatadviśeṣaṇaṃ tathā syāt | naiṣa doṣaḥ | śakternirādhārāyā anupapattestadabhedāpannaṃ phalato dravyameva sādhanaṃ nyāyyam | tathā ca kaṭaḥ karma devadattaḥ karteti sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ dṛśyate | atha karmādiśabdairdravyāyamāṇaṃ tadabhidhīyate tarhi `karmaṇi dvitīyetyādau vibhaktividhāne śaktyavacchinnasya dravyasyaiva saṅkhyādiviśeṣaṇatvam | yuktaṃ caitat | na hi śaktiṣu saṅkhyā samavaiti | tasmādāśrayasya sādhanatvātsaṅkhyāpi tathā | etadeva hi saṅkhyāyāḥ kriyāṅgatvaṃ yatsādhanāvaccheda iti sarvaṃ sustham || 68 ||
pūrvaṃ grahāṇāṃ saṃskāryatvādārthena rūpeṇa prādhānye satyavivakṣoktā | atha punaḥ prakārāntareṇātra vivakṣāvivakṣe vyavasthāpayitumāha-- apūrvasya vidheyatvātprādhānyamavasīyate | vihitasya parārthatvātvāccheṣabhāvaḥ pratīyate || 69 ||
 vāstavena rūpeṇa pūrvaṃ guṇapradhānabhāvaścarcitaḥ | ayantu vākyavyāpārāśrayeṇeti viśeṣaḥ | tathā hi--paśorūtpattivākyena apūrvasya vidheyatvātprādhānyam iti yathāśrutamekatvaṃ na tyajyate | vidheyatvādityanenaivāpūrvasyākṣepe sati punarvacanaṃ vyāptyartham | kriyāyā vākyārthatvena prādhānye'pi sarvatrāpūrvasya prādhānyam, aprajñātajñāpanena vidhīyamānatvādityarthaḥ | vihitasya tu jñātasya sato'nyārthatvenānuvādādaprādhānyamiti tatra vidhivākyagatarūpānusaraṇa nyāyyam || 69 ||
etadeva prākaraṇike'rthe yojayati-- saṃmārgasya vidheyatvādanyatra vihite grahe | vidhivākye śrutā saṅkhyā lakṣaṇāyā na bādhyate || 70 ||
 `grahaṃ sammārṣṭi' ityapūrvasya sammārgasya vidheyatvātprādhānyam | anyatra `prajāpatyā nava grahāḥ' ityādau vidhivākye, vihite prathamaṃ jñāpite, grahe grahasāmānya ityarthaḥ | tatra ca vidhivākye yā śrutā nava daśetyādikā saṅkhāpadopādānā saṅkhyā sā lakṣaṇāyāṃ `grahaṃ samārṣṭi' ityatra pūrvoddiṣṭagrahopalakṣaṇapare'nuvādavākye na bādhyate na tyajyate, asyā vidhau prādhānyāt | iha tvanuvādavākye grahaṇamātropalakṣaṇaparāyāṃ codanāyāṃ nāntarīyikā dravyopalakṣaṇārthā śabdasaṃskāramātraparā saṅakhyā, grahaśrutistvanarthikā mā bhūditi grahajātyupalakṣaṇārtheti yathāvihitabhinnasaṅkhyākagrahopādānāpthaṃ mā bhūdguṇena pradhānoparodha iti | guṇā hi pradhānopakārāya pravartanta iti pradhānasaṅkhyayā guṇasaṅkhyātra bādhyate | nanu ca `daśaitānadhvaryuḥ prātaḥ savane grahāngṛhṇāti' ityupattivākyaṃ kriyāviṣayam | `grahaṃ sammārṣṭi' ityanuvādavākyaṃ sammārjanakriyāviṣayamiti viṣayabhedādavirodhe bahavo grahā gṛhyantām, ekastu sammārjyatāmiti nāsti bādhaḥ | atrocyate | yadyapi bahirvyāpārabhedābhinnaviṣayatvādavirodhaḥ, tathāpi pratipattau tayoḥ saṅkyayorvirodha eva | tathā hi--pūrvaṃ nava daśa vā buddhau samavasthitāḥ, idānīṃ tadunmūlanenaiko buddhāvupārohayitavyaḥ | evaṃ cānyathāvagate pradhāne'nyathā punarapradhānavelāyāmavagamo na yuktaḥ | api tu yathāsiddhasyaivānuvādātsaṃmārge pradhānavelāvagatasaṅakhyākānāmevāvadhāraṇaṃ grahāṇāṃ yuktam | yatrastho hi graho'nūditaḥ tata evāsya svarūpamanusartavyam | evaṃ ca sādhanapracayātsaṃmārgasyāpi pradhānasyopakārādubhayānugrahaḥ sampadyate | bahuṣu madhye'vasthitaścanumūta iti tathaivātra smṛtyā anuvādo nyāyyaḥ | tathā ca pradhānopakārānurodha evehānyathoktaḥ | pūrvaṃ grahārthatvātsaṃmārgasya saṃmārgavākya eva grahāṇāṃ prādhānyamuktam, iha tu vidhivākyagataṃ prādhānyamabhihitamityetāvatā viśeṣaḥ || 70 ||
`paśunā yajeta' ityatrāpi tarhi yāgasya vidheyatvātpaśoraprādhānyamiti tadīyamekatvaṃ tyajyetetyāśaṅkyāha-- vidhivākyāntare saṅakhyā paśornāsti virodhinī | tasmātsaguṇa evāsau sadekatvena gamyate || 71 ||
 paśuguṇaviśiṣṭo yāgo vidhīyata ityajñātapanātpaśorapi vidhānam | utpattivākyagatā ca saṅkhyā na tyajyata ityutsargaḥ | tadyathā paśau | grahe tūtpattivākyāpekṣayā saṃmārgavidhivākye tadvirodhinī saṅkhyā tyajyate | paśau tu vidhivākyāntaraṃ nāstīti prāthamakalpikī na tyajyate saṅkhyaikatvalakṣaṇeti, tena sahāsau kriyāṅgabhāvamanubhavati | saguṇa iti | saha liṅgalakṣaṇena puṃstvākhyena guṇena vartata ityarthaḥ | yadvā guṇaḥ śuklādiḥ | yatra guṇaśrutirnāsti, yathā--`paśunā yajeta' iti, tatrākṣiptaguṇasāmānya ityarthaḥ | yatrāpi guṇaśrutirnāsti , yathā `gāmabhyāja śuklām' `śvetaṃ chāgamālabheta' iti, tatrāpi tadguṇaḥ sa gṛhyate ekavākyopāttaguṇayukta ityarthaḥ | etacca vakṣyamāṇārthopoddhātārthamuktam | kecitpunarāhuḥ--saguṇa ityetadeva sphuṭīkṛtaṃ sadaikatveneti | atra tu paunaruk‌tyaṃ doṣaḥ | na hi kārikābhāgasya bhāgāntareṇa vyākhyānaṃ yuktam | yadi vā guṇo viśeṣaṇaṃ jātiḥ paśutvalakṣaṇā, tayā saha gamyate | jāteriva śrutasyaikatvasya tyāge kāraṇābhāvāttadekatvamapi gamyata iti dṛṣṭāntagarbhaṃ vacanam | tadevaṃ nyāyavādimatānusāreṇa siddhānto'trāvasthāpitaḥ | tathā hi--nyāyavādibhiḥ pūrvapakṣo'tra kṛtaḥ-- `ekatvayuktamekakatvasya śrutisaṃyogāt' iti | `ya evaṃ vidvān somena yajeta' iti somayāge `daśāpavitreṇa grahaṃ saṃmārṣṭi' iti śrūyate | tatraikasya grahasya saṃmārgaḥ prāptaḥ, ekatvaśrutisaṃyukto hyayaṃ padārthaḥ śrūyate | evaṃ pūrvapakṣaṃ kṛtvā siddhāntitam-- `sarveṣāṃ vā lakṣaṇatvādaviśiṣṭaṃ hi lakṣaṇam' prāpte dvitīyādau saṃmārgo vidhīyate | paśostu yāgārthatvātparicchennena tena yāgopakārādekatvavivakṣetyuktam-- codite tu parārthatvādyathāśruti pratīyeta  iti vākyavidāṃ rāddhāntaḥ || 71 ||
idānīṃ saṅkhyāvadanyasyāpi guṇasyāśrayāvacchedakatvadvāreṇa kriyāṅgatayopādānamanupādānaṃ veti saṅkhyāprasaṅgena vicārayituṃ saguṇa evāsāvityupoddhāte satyāha-- nirjñātadravyasaṃbandhe yaḥ karmaṇyupadiśyate | guṇastenārthitā tasya dravyeṇeva pratīyate || 72 ||
 nirjñātaḥ prathamaṃdravyasaṃbandho yasya tasminkarmaṇi kriyāyāṃ yo guṇaḥ śuklādiḥ vidhīyate tenāpi tasya karmaṇaḥ kriyālakṣamasya dravyavat arthitā | tathā ca saṃbandha iti vicārabījopakṣepaḥ | dravyasaṃbandha iti ca dravyapadārthapakṣe prāhra | jātipadārthapakṣe tu vakṣyati-- `yadā tu jātiḥ śaktirvā' ityādi | nanu ca kriyā janakatvātsādhanamapekṣatām, guṇe tu kāpekṣā tasyāḥ | atha saguṇena dravyeṇa nirguṇasyāsaṃbhavājjanyā kriyetyubhayāpekṣā tarhi kramo'yaṃ kutaḥ ? nirjñātadravyasaṃbandhe paścād dravyavadguṇe'pyapekṣeti apekṣā'sāmyāccopamā nopapadyate | atrocyate | kriyā tāvatsādhyasvabhāvatvāt sādhanamapekṣate, tacca dravyamiti tadapekṣopadiśya mānaguṇapekṣāpi tasya guṇasya sādhanāvacchedopayogādvidyata eva kriyāyāḥ | tatra yadavyavahitamantaraṅgaṃ tatprathamamapekṣyam, tathā ca dravyam | guṇastu tadādhārastanmukhena saṃbandhasaho bahiraṅgaḥ paścādapekṣaṇīyaḥ | ata eva nirjñāta iti bhūtābhidhānam | dravyasya śaktyādhāratvātprathamaṃ kriyasaṃbandha ityarthaḥ | evaṃ ca sākṣādasamanvayādupamā | etaccārthakramāpekṣayocyate na tu śabdavyāpārāpekṣayā | `gāmabhyāja śuklām' iti hi vākyaṃ sakṛdeva guṇapradhānabhāvena saṃbandhaviśiṣṭamarthamāheti na tatra kaścid viramyaṃ vyāpāraḥ || 72 ||
evaṃ guṇadravyayoḥ śrautaḥ kriyāsaṃbandha uktaḥ | idānīṃ tayoḥ parasparaṃ vākyīyasamanvayapratipādanāyāha-- kaścideva guṇo dravye yathā sāmarthyalakṣaṇaḥ | ādhāro'pi guṇasyaivaṃ prāptaḥ sāmarthyalakṣaṇaḥ || 73 ||
 nirguṇasya dravyasyāsambhavaḥ sāmarthyam tena lakṣyate, tatra dravye | ādhāro'pi dravyaṃ guṇasya sāmarthyena nirādhāraguṇāsaṃbhavasvabhāvena lakṣyate, guṇamātraṃ ca dravyeṇāpekṣitaṃ dravyamātraṃ ca guṇena, asmātsāmarthyādityāha--kaścideveti | aparāmṛṣṭajātibhedau dravyaguṇau paraspareṇāpekṣitau | prāpta iti | pratītilabdhaḥ ityarthaḥ | sāmānyamātre pratītyavyabhicārāt, viśeṣāṇāṃ vyabhicārāt || 73 ||
evamādhārādheyasāmānyasaṃsarge labdhe śrutayoreva tayorekavākyatvādvākyīyena samanvayena parasparasaṃbandhamāha-- tayostu pṛthagarthitve saṃbaṃdho yaḥ pratīyate | na tasminnupaghāto'sti kalpyamanmanna cāśrutam || 74 ||
 pūrvopavarṇitena sāmarthyena pṛthak parasparaṃ guṇadravyayorākāṃkṣāyāṃ satyāmekavākyopāttayoreva samanvayo yaḥ pratīyate na tatra bādhaḥ, śraute'rthe tyāgābhāvāt | asati tatparityāgahetāvaśrutaparikalpanā na nyāyyā | ata eva pratīyata iti nirbādhapratītipramāṇatāmāha | apoddhārabudhdyāśrayaṇe caitaducyate | niraṃśe hi vākye pūrvameva viśeṣavivakṣā | tathā hi--niravayavena vākyena viśiṣṭa evārthaḥ pratipāditaḥ | tatra pratipattyarthamaṃśāṃśikatayā apoddhārapadārthaḥ parikalpyate sāmānyātmā | sa eva viśeṣo bhavati viśeṣasaṃbandhe satīti pratipādanopāyakramaḥ | tathā ca viśeṣasaṃbandhe'pi sāmānyātmā padārtho na svarūpātpracyavate, api tu tadviśeṣaniṣṭha evāvatiṣṭhate | na tu satyataḥ sāmānye'vasthitānāṃ padānāṃ viśeṣe'vasthānamupapadyate | sāmānyavṛttīnāmuccaritānāṃ tathābhūtānāmeva tirobhāvāduttarakālaṃ ko'sau viśeṣe'vatiṣṭhatām | na ca sāmānyaviśeṣayoryugapadvivakṣā saṃbhavati | viśeṣavivakṣāyāṃ hi sarvasyāṃ niyamena sāmānyādavacchedo vijñāyata ityupāttasya sāmānyasya tyāgaprasaṅgaḥ | sa ca nitye śabdārthasaṃbandhe na yuktaḥ | tirobhūtaśca nivṛtto'navadhāryamāṇātmā śabdo'nyasyāpi padasya sāmānyaniṣṭhatvākenacidapyapratipādite viśeṣe nirviṣayaḥ kvāvatiṣṭhatām | yaduktam-- `sāmānyārthastirobhūto na viśeṣe'vatiṣṭhate | upāttasya kutastyāgo nivṛttaḥ kvāvatiṣṭhatām ||' iti | tasmādviśiṣṭa evārtho vākyādavagantavya ityaśrutasya kalpitasya kalpanāvakāśa eva nāsti | nāpi śrutasyārthasya tyāgasaṃbhavaḥ | āpoddhārapadārthāśrāyeṇa tvayaṃ vicāraḥ prastutaḥ | tathā ca śrutyādīnyakhaṇḍavākyapakṣe nopapadyanta ityākṣipya vākyakāṇḍe'poddhārapadārthakalpanenaivopapāditāni | śrutipratipāditasya yogyasya tyāge'śrutakalpanā na yujyate ityekavākyopāttatvamatra saṃbandhahetuḥ | parasparasaṃbandhe hi ekavākyatāpīṣyate | vākyārthena pradhānena guṇānāmākṣepādaśrutaparigrahe sarvatra vākyabhedaprasaṅgānna kvacidekavākyatā bhavet || 74 ||
nanu ca kriyākārakasaṃbandhe viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāve ca pratipādye vākyabhedaprasaṅgaḥ | na cāsau nyāyyaḥ | naiṣa doṣaḥ | guṇapradhānabhāvenātra saṃbandhadvayasaṃbhavaḥ | sa caikasminvākye'viruddhaḥ | tathā hi--śrutivākyalakṣaṇamatra pramāṇadvayamastītyāha-- kriyayā yo'bhisaṃbandhaḥ sa śrutiprāpitastayoḥ | āśrayāśrayiṇārvākyānniyamastvavatiṣṭhate || 75 ||
 śrutyā kārakavibhak‌tyā kriyāyāṃ saṃbandho dravyaguṇayoḥ samaśīrṣakatayā prātipāditaḥ | vākyādakhaṇjapratibhotpattāvapoddhāreṇa `gāmabhyāja', `śuklāmabhyāja' iti padārthavibhajanāt gāmeva śuklāmeveti guṇaguṇinorekavākyopāttayorviniyogo vākyasya prāmāṇyenāvatiṣṭhate | aśrutaguṇadravyaparikalpane hi pratipadārthaṃ kriyābhedāt `gāmabhyāja, śuklāṃ ca' iti vākyabhedaḥ syādityekarasayaiva pravṛttyaupāttaguṇaviśiṣṭasya dravyasya kriyāsamanvaye tadekavākyatvaṃ poṣitaṃ bhavati | niyamo dravyaguṇayorādheyāntarādādhārāntarācca vyavacchedaḥ sati parasparasaṃbandhe | na cānyanivṛtteḥ śabdāntaramasti vācakamityekavākyākhyaśabdopādānāso na śrautīti vākyīyāvatiṣṭhate | taduktaṃ nyāyavādibhiḥ-- `arthaikatve dravyaguṇayorekakarmyānniyamaḥ syāt'  iti | yatrāthaikatvaṃ śrūyate vākye tatra dravyaguṇayorniyamo bhavati parasparasaṃbandhātmakaḥ | kutaḥ ? ekakarmyāt | ekaṃ hi karma vākyārthabhūtaṃ kriyālakṣaṇam | pradhānamuddiśya dravyaguṇau śeṣabhūtau vidhīyeti iti tayoḥ parasparākākṣatvādekavākyatāyāṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyāvasāya iti sūtrārtho'smannayānuguṇaḥ || 75 ||
evamavasthite satīdamatrāpapatītyāha-- tatra dravyaguṇābhāve pratyekaṃ syādvikalpanam | śrutiprāpto hi saṃbandho balavānvākyalakṣaṇāt || 76 ||
 śrutiprāptaḥ śrutyopasthāpitaḥ kriyākārakasaṃbandhaḥ vākyaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ lakṣyate'neneti prātipadikaṃ yasya tasmādbalavān iti tasya sarvathā tyāgābhāvaḥ | sākṣāddvitīyāśrutistiṅ‌vibhaktiśca śrautasaṃbandhāvedikā, anyonyasvarūpānuviddhayoḥ kriyākārakayoḥ pratīteḥ | vākyayasya tu saṃbandhasya sākṣādvācakaṃ nāsti kevalamubhayasmaikavākyopādānādyogyārthasamanvayapadāntarasamavadhānātparaspareṇa saṃbandho vyavasthāpyata iti śrutyapekṣayā durbalatvam | padāntarāpekṣaṇācca padāntarasya niyatasya sannidhānābhāvānnāvaśyaṃ vākpīyasaṃbandho viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvalakṣama iti tasminbahiraṅge nivṛtte'pi śrautasyāntaraṅgasyapānivṛttiḥ || 76 ||
evaṃ ca `śvetaṃ chāgamālabheta' iti vākye śvetābhāve kṛṣṇasyālambhanavacchāgābhāve piṣṭapiṇaḍīmālabhya kṛtī syāditi codyamatra darśane | jātipadārthanaye tu siddhyatīṣṭavyavasthetyāha-- yadā tu jātiḥ śaktirvā kriyāṃ pratyupadiśyate | sāmarthyātsaṃnidhīyete tatra dravyaguṇau tadā || 77 ||
 `keṣāṃcitsāhacaryeṇa jātiḥ śaktyupalakṣaṇam'  iti jātyupalakṣitā śaktiḥ | jātipadārthe pratinidhyupādānārthaṃ kriyāsādhanatveva codyate ityuktatvājjātiḥ śaktirvetyāha | atra darśane na dravyaguṇayoḥ śrautaḥ kriyābhisaṃbandhaḥ, api tu jātikriyayoḥ śaktikriyayorvā vibhaktiprāpitaḥ saṃbandhaḥ | nirādhārayośca jātiśaktyorasaṃbhavāt sāmarthyātsaṃnidhāpitaṃ svādhāraṃ dravyaṃ tenāpi svādheyo guṇa iti dvayorapi dravyaguṇayoḥ sāmarthyaprāptatvam || 77 ||
tataśca pratinidhiviṣaye-- jātīnāṃ ca guṇānāṃ ca tulye'ṅgatve kriyāṃ prati | guṇāḥ pratinidhīyante chāgādīnāṃ na jātayaḥ || 78 ||
 dravyavyavadhānād‌dvāvapi jātiguṇau kriyāṅgabhāvamanubhavata iti tulyatvam | tatra tathāpi chāgādīnāṃ saṃbandhinyo jātayo na pratinidhīyante chāgābhāve meṣo nālabhyate, api tu guṇānāmeva pratinidhiḥ prasiddhaḥ--śvetābhāve kṛṣṇo'pi chāga ālabhyate || 78 ||
kātra yuktirityāha-- vyaktiśakteḥ samāsannā jātayo na tathā guṇāḥ | sākṣād‌dravyaṃ kriyāyogi guṇastasmādvikalpate || 79 ||
 vyaktiśakteḥ dravyaśakteḥ, śaktasya dravyasyetyarthaḥ | śaktyāyatto dravyasya kriyāpayoga iti śaktigrahaṇam | utpattiprabhṛtyāvināśādanvayādadhiṣṭhānasaṃbandhayoścaikakālatvādāsannā dravye jātiḥ | guṇāstu tanniṣṭhottarakālabhāvinaḥ kālāntaraparivāsādanyonyasvabhāvapariṇāmina iti dravyādviprakṛṣṭāḥ | yadi nāma na samāsannā guṇāḥ kathametāvatā vikalpa ityāha--sākṣād dravyaṃ kriyāyogi iti | etaduktaṃ bhavati | yadi dravyamanapekṣya guṇaḥ sākṣātkriyāyogī syānna vikalpeta | yadā tu dravyaṃ sākṣātkriyāyogi, jātiguṇau tu taddvārema tadā pratyāsattiviprakarṣacintā jāyate | tathā hi--dravyaṃ sākṣācchaktaṃ kriyāsaṃbandhakṣamamiti taddvāreṇa samanvayayogyam | tatrāsannaṃ na vikalpate jātirūpamityanyajātīyasya na pratinidhiḥ, api tvanyaguṇasya | kṛṣṇe'pi chāge chāgabuddhiranvetyeva | anyajātīyasyopādāne tu jāterātmakalpāyāstyāge sarvathaiva sādhanabhedātkriyāntarameva syāt | kadare tu jāterātmakalpāyāstyāge sarvathaiva sādhanabhedātkriyāntarameva syāt | radare tu sādṛśyātkhadirabuddheranapagamaḥ | etacca jātipakṣe yujyate, śrautasya jātirūpasyātyāgāt | dravyapadārthapakṣe tu jāteranabhidheyāyā upalakṣaṇatvāttattyāge'pi nāsti śrautārthatyāga iti anyajātīyasyāpi pratinidhiprasaṅgaḥ | śrautasya saṃbandhasya ca dravyapadārthapakṣe pūrvaṃ guṇadravyayoḥ sāmyamuktam , iha tu sāmarthyādākṣepe pratyāsannā jātirna tyajyate iti jātipadārthamutkarṣayitumevaṃ vicāritam, ata eva `yadā tu jātiḥ' iti tu śabdaḥ pūrvasmādviśeṣaṇārthaḥ | tadetadbhāṣye'bhihitam-- `yatra hyantarad dravyaṃ tatpradhānam, na hi śuklāmālabheteti piṣṭapiṇḍīmālabhya kṛtī bhavati' iti | pratyāsannataratvājjātestadvācī dravyaśabdo'bhipretaḥ na guṇopasarjanadravyavācī | anirdhāritarūpasya hi dravyasya jātirātmarūpanirdhāraṇopayoginī svātmapradānenārūpitā tadākāratāṃ prāpnoti | tatpratinidhau vastvantarabhāvāccoditasya tyāgaprasaṅgaḥ || 79 ||
pūrvoktaṃ pakṣamanyamatatvenopasaṃharati-- sāmyenānyatarābhāve vikalpaḥ kaiścidiṣyate | atadguṇo'taśchāgaḥ syānmeṣo vā tadguṇo bhavet || 80 ||
 yathā jātirdravyopalakṣaṇam, nirupādherarthasyāvyavahāryatvāt, evaṃ guṇo'pi | tathā jātivadādhāraniyato guṇo nīlādirvāyvākāśādestadabhāvāditi sati sāmye ye dravyavadbhedyatvādyravyalakṣaṇaprāptaṃ guṇamapyabhidheyaṃ manyante vyāḍidarśanasthitā dravyapadārthikāḥ, teṣāṃ guṇo'pi kriyāsaṃbaṃndhaṃ jātivadyravyadvāreṇārhati iti śrautasaṃbandhaparipoṣārthaṃ vākyīyasamanvayatyāgena dvayorapi guṇadravyayoḥ pratinidhyupapattirityanabhimatamapi pakṣaṃ matāntaratvena nirdiśati kaiściditi | dravyasya hi pratinidhirbhāṣyakāraprabhṛtibhiḥ śiṣṭairnāṅgikṛtaḥ || 80 ||
evaṃ prāsaṅgikaṃ parisamāpya prakṛtamevānusandhātumāha-- jāterāśritasaṃkhyāyāḥ pravṛttirupalabhyate | saṃkhyāviśeṣamutsṛjya kvacitsaiva pravartate || 81 ||
 prāsaṅgikena pūrvaprastutasya vyavadhānāduktamapyetatpunaḥ smāritaṃ sāmānyenādhikaṃ viśeṣaṃ vaktum || 81 ||
tathā hi-- parāṅgabhūtaṃ sāmānyaṃ yujyate dravyasaṃkhyayā | svārthaṃ pravartamānaṃ tu na saṃkhyāmavalambate || 82 ||
 pūrvaṃ śābdena vyāpāreṇa vidhīyamānānūdyamānatvena guṇapradhānabhāvamāśritya guṇe'pi grahe saṃkhyāvivakṣiteti pratipāditam | idānīṃ tu vāstavaṃ guṇagradhānabhāvamāśritya guṇe saṃkhyā vivakṣyate iti nyāyo'vatāryate || 82 ||
yajeta paśunetyatra yajyarthāyāṃ paśuśrutau | kṛtārthaikena paśunā pradhānaṃ bhavati kriyā || 83 ||
 yāgasya prādhānyāttatsādhanabhūtaḥ paśurityekena yāgasaṃpattau pradhānasya kriyālakṣaṇasya vākyārthasya niṣpatterguṇabhedaṃ pratyanādarātparāṅgabhūtamatra paśusāmānyaṃ draṃvyasaṃkhyayā yujyate iti jāterāśritasaṃkhyāyā atra pravṛttiḥ | tathā hi--pradhānaṃ guṇabhede satyāvartteteti kriyāntaramevaitatsyāt | tataśca na pradhānānuyāyino guṇāḥ syuḥ, api tu pradhānaṃ guṇānuyāyītyetadaniṣṭaṃ prasajyetetyāha || 83 ||
yāvatāṃ saṃbhavo yasya sa kuryāttāvatāṃ yadi | ālambhanaṃ guṇaistena pradhānaṃ syātprayojitam || 84 ||
 yasya iti | adhikāriṇaḥ | aṅgaprayukte ca pradhāne pradhānatvameva tasya na syāt, tatprati guṇānāṃ ca guṇatvamiti saṃrakṣyo'yaṃ naya ityabhiprāyaḥ || 84 ||
`svārthaṃ pravartamānaṃ tu na saṃkhyāmavalambate'  ityatrodāharaṇamāha-- saṃmṛjyamānatantre tu grahe yatra kriyāśrutiḥ | saṃkhyāviśeṣagrahaṇaṃ naiva tatrādriyāmahe || 85 ||
 samṛjyamāno grahārthastantraṃ yatra grahe grahaśabde | viśeṣaṇasamāso vāyam | saṃmṛjyamānaṃ ca tantraṃ ca tasmin grahe saṃskāryatvātpradhāne saṃmārjanakriyāyāḥ śabde na pradhānabhūtāyāḥ yatra śrutiḥ `grahaṃ saṃmārṣṭi' ityatra, tatra svaśabdena pratipāditasyāpi saṃkhyāviśeṣasyaikatvalakṣaṇasya vivakṣā na bhavati | utpattivākyānusāreṇānekasaṃkhyasyaiva tasyātra vivakṣitatvāt | na hi saṃsargo'tra tantram, yenaikenāpi grahalakṣaṇena sādhanena tasya saṃpattāvanekopādānaṃ paśuvanniṣphalaṃ syāt, api tu grahastantramiti yathāsaṃbhavaṃ tasya saṃskāra iti saṃkhyāviśeṣamutsṛjyātra jātiḥ pravartate || 85 ||
tadevaṃ `guṇe saṃkhyā vivakṣyate' na tu pradhānabhūta ityatra śāstrīyaṃ jñāpakamāha-- śiṣyamāṇapare vākye yadekagrahaṇaṃ kṛtam | śeṣe viśiṣṭasaṃkhye'pi vyaktaṃ talliṅgadarśanam || 86 ||
 `sarūpāṇāmekaśeṣaḥ' ityatra śiṣyata iti śeṣa iti karmasādhanaśeṣaśabdāśrayeṇa śiṣyamāṇaḥ avatiṣṭhamānaḥ, paraḥ pradhānaṃ ekaśeṣalakṣaṇena saṃskāreṇa saṃskāryatvādbhavatītyekavacanāntatvādekasaṃkhyāyukte'pi pratīte śeṣaśabde yatpunarekaśabdopādānam tatsvārthaṃ pravartamānaṃ pradhānabhūtaṃ sāmānyamādhāragatasaṃkhyāśrayeṇa na pravartata ityasyārthasya jñāpakaṃ sphuṭam | bhāvasādhane tu śeṣaśabde śeṣaṇakriyāyāḥ prādhānyam, na śiṣyamāṇasyeti dvibahvorapi śeṣaṇamekameveti, ekatve vivakṣite'pi dvibahvornivāraṇārthamekaśabdo'rthavāneveti na jñāpakaṃ syāt || 86 ||
evaṃ `guṇe saṃkhyā vivakṣyate ' iti nyāyaṃ vaidikodāṃharaṇapṛṣṭhapātitayāvasthāpya prakṛtopayogitāṃ darśayituṃ vyākaraṇe'pyudāharaṇamatrāha-- samāsapratyayavidhau yathā nipatitā śrutiḥ | guṇānāṃ paratantrāṇāṃ nyāyenaivopapadyate || 87 ||
 `supsupā' ityatra samāsasya vidhiriti tasyaiva prādhānyam | na hyavayavānāmidamanuśāsanam, samudāye teṣāmantarbhūtatvāt svātantryābhāvāt | na cāpyavayavāḥ kecanātra vastutaḥ santi | viśiṣṭe'rthe samāsapadasyābhinnasyaiva pravṛtteḥ | yathoktaṃ vākyakāṇḍe-- `brāhmaṇārtho yathā nāsti kaścid brāhmaṇakambale' iti | abhinnasya samāsapadasyaiva parikalpitapūrvaparāvayavavibhāgasya sañcikīrṣitatvam ṣa anvayavyatirekābhyāṃ hi viśiṣṭārthaśabdāvadhāraṇam | tau cātra samāsapade rājapuruṣādau staḥ | samudāyena viśiṣṭasya saṃbandhasya pratipādanāt, avayavābhyāmapratipādanāt | samudāyasaṃskāraprayukta eva cāvayavānāṃ vibhaktilopahrasvatvapuṃvadbhāvādisaṃskāraḥ | avayavasaṃskāranāntarīyakatvātsamudāyasaṃskārasya | tasmādatra samāsavidhau yena prakāreṇaikasaṃkhyāmupādāyaikatvaṃ pratipādayantī śrutiḥ `supsupā' iti śabdopanipatitā śrotraviṣayabhāvamāgatā, tenaiva prakāreṇa nyāyenopapadyate yujyate | śrutamekatvaṃ vivakṣyata ityarthaḥ | ko'sau nyāya ityāha `guṇānāṃ paratantrāṇām' iti | pradhānavaśavartitvādguṇānām avayavānāṃ yāṃ saṃkhyāmupādāyārthe pravṛttā satī `supsupā' iti śrutistatsaṃkhyāyoginamevārthaṃ pratipādayatītyekaikasya subantasya samāsaḥ kaṣṭaśrita ityādau bhavati na tu bahūnām | mahatkaṣṭaṃ śrita iti dvitīyāntajāterāśrayādanekasya hi samāse tasyāniyatatvādanavasthānātpradhānabhūtaḥ samāso'niyamena pratīyata iti viplavāttasyānugraho nirākṛtaḥ syāditi pratyavayavaṃ samāsabhedāt guṇāyattaṃ pradhānaṃ syāt na tu guṇāḥ pradhānānuyāyina ityarthaḥ | dvandvabahuvrīhyostu `anekam' iti vacanasāmarthyādanekapadāvayavaḥ samāso'bhyupagata eva | ata eva ca liṅgādanyatra saṃkhyāvivakṣāsiddhiḥ | pratyayavidhau api `ṅyāpprātipadikād' ityatra samāhāradvandvanirdiṣṭāyāḥ prātipadikalakṣaṇāyāḥ prakṛteḥ siddharūpāyā anuvādātsvādividhivākye'dhikārādapūrvasya svāderekavākyatayā pratyayasya vidhānamiti tasya prādhānyāttadaṅge prātipadike yathāśrutasaṃkhyāṅgīkāraḥ | nanu ca `supsupā' iti vibhaktyaikatvasya pratipāditatvādastu saṃkhyāvivakṣā, `ṅyātprātipadikād' ityatra tu kāsāvekatvasaṃkhyā śrutā yasyā vivakṣocyeta | yadi samāhāraikatvaṃ tadayuktam, tasya samudāyasaṃbandhitvāt, samudāyācca pratyayotpatteravivakṣitatvānna tasyaikatvamatra vivakṣitatvena pratipādyam, api tu pratyekamavayavānām | teṣāṃ cātra vṛttāvantargatatvāvdyitvādipratiyogyekatvaṃ na pratīyate, api tvanirjñātasaṃkhyāviśeṣāṇi svarūpamātreṇa ṅyāpprātipadikāni | bhavataiva tarhyasmākaṃ dik pradarśitā, layamapyadhunā tarhyevaṃ vyācakṣmahe | yathā nipatitā śrutiḥ yenaiva prakāreṇa nipatitā arthavacchabdarūpaṃ ca svarūpamātreṇa pratipādayantī nipatitā | tathā ca tāvati tātparyamiti na dvitīyamapekṣate, dvivacanabahuvacananāntānāmasamāsād vṛttau saṃkhyāviśeṣānavagateḥ pratiyogāpekṣāmantareṇa ca dvitvādyanutpatteḥ | ataścārthātpratyekamekatvaṃ `ṅyāpprātipadikād' iti vadato vivakṣitam | anye tu grahaṇakavākyādasmādyat‌prātipadikaṃ jāyate ṅyantādābantātprātipadikāditi, tatra śrutamekatvaṃ vivakṣyata iti vyācakṣate, atra tu `yathā nipatitā śrutiḥ' ityavācakam | na hi prātipadikamupaplavamānaṃ vākyaṃ śrutiviṣayam | tadatra saṃkhyāvivakṣāyāṃ bahubhyo ṅyāpprātipadikebhyaḥ svādeḥ pratyayasya paratvāsaṃbhavādyathāprakṛtyāvarteta pratyayaḥ | tathā ca guṇānuyāyi pradhānaṃ syānna tu guṇāstadanuyāyinaḥ | nanu ca svādīnāṃ prakṛtisaṃbandhasya vidhīyamānatvātkathaṃ teṣāṃ prādhānyam | evamapi prakṛtīnāṃ tāvadguṇatvaṃ siddhamiti tatra `guṇe saṃkhyā vivakṣyate' iti siddho'smannayaḥ | na ca prakṛtireva pratyayaparatayā saṃcikīrṣitā | prakṛtipratyayaparikalpanena padasyaivānvākhyeyatvāt tasyaiva loke prayogāt | yadyapi ca pratyayaparatvena saṃskṛtā prakṛtireva padam, tathāpi tātparyadṛśā prakṛteḥ prakriyābhedenāsatyatvādavikalpaṃ padameva satyamuddiśya saṃskārapravṛttiḥ | vākyārthaprādhānye tvapūrvasya pratyayasyaiva lidhīyamānatvātprādhānyam | ata eva `samāsapratyayavidhau' ityāha | itthaṃ ca nātra bhinnavākyatayā saṃbandhividhānam , prakriyāyāṃ prakṛtyanuvādenaikavākyatayā svādīnāṃ vidhānāt | suptuṅoraviśeṣavidhānāditi tu saṃkhyāvākyabhedābhiprāyam, na tu prakṛtivākyenāpi naikavākyatātra vivakṣiteti mantavyam | na caikavākyatayā vidhāne pratyayasaṃjñāsaṃbandho vilakṣaṇaḥ pravṛttibhedena vinā na śakyate vidhātum | vidhisaṃbandhau hi pūrvam tato vidhānāllabdhasattānāṃ svādīnāṃ pratyayasaṃjñāsaṃbandhaḥ | sato hi kāryiṇaḥ kāryeṇa bhavitavyamiti vācyam | bhāvino'pi buddhayā viṣayīkaraṇādbhāvyamānāvasthānāmeva pratyayādisaṃjñāsamanvayādityekavākyatayaivātra pratyayavidhirgranthakārābhimataḥ || 87 ||
kimeṣa evotsargaḥ guṇe saṃkhyā vivakṣyata iti | netyāha-- guṇe'pi nāṅgīkriyate pradhānāntarasiddhaye | saṃkhyā kartā tathā karmaṇyaviśiṣṭaḥ pratīyate || 88 ||
 tathā karteti | evaṃ ca sati kartā aviśiṣṭaḥ pratīyate | iti saṃbandhaḥ | sa hi guṇaḥ | īpsitatamaṃ tu karma saṃjādvāreṇādhīyamānasaṃskāraṃ pradhānam | `karmaṇi' iti | `kartṛrīpsitatamaṃ karma' ityatra karmasaṃjñāyāṃ vidhīyamānāyāṃ tasyā eva tayā vā saṃskriyamāṇasya karmaṇaḥ prādhānyāt kartuḥ kriyayā īpsitatamamiti svāśrayakriyāsaṃbandhitayā kartā nirdiśyamāno guṇo'viśiṣṭaḥ sūtropāttaliṅgasaṃkhyābhyāmanavacchinnaḥ, kartroḥ kartṝṇāṃ ca kriyayepsitatamasyāpi karmasaṃjñāsiddhayarthaṃ bhūyaḥ pradhānānugrahāya pratīyate avagamyate | samāsapratyayavidhau tu bahūnāṃ subantānāṃ samāse'vyavasthā syāt, bahutvasyāniyatatvāt | karmasaṃjñā tu bahuviṣayā pracayamanubhavatīti na doṣaḥ | pratyayavidhirapi bahubhyaḥ prakṛtibhyo nāsti, paratvasyānirvāhāt | tathā ca sarūpavārttika uktam-- `ekavibhaktāviti cennābhāvādvibhakteḥ'  iti | tadevaṃ pradhānapracaye bhūyānanugrahaḥ kṛto bhavatīti pradhānasyāvivakṣitasaṃkhyatve siddhe na guṇagatā saṃkhyāśrīyate | anyathā pradhānasaṅkoce taduparodhaḥ syāditi pradhānāntarasiddhiḥ | prayojanametadyuktigarbhaṃ draṣṭavyamiti guṇānāṃ pāratantryādeva nyāyāt `karturīpsitatamaṃ karma' ityatra na vivakṣyate saṃkhyetyuktā yuktiḥ || 88 ||
atraipodvalanārthamāha-- yasyānyasya prasaktasya niyamārthā punaḥ śrutiḥ | nivṛttau caritārthatvātsaṃkhyā tatrāvivakṣitā || 89 ||
 yasya punaḥ śrutiriti saṃbandhaḥ | pūrvaṃ sāmānyenākṣepādekaiva śrutiḥ punaḥ śrutirityucyate | yatheha kartuḥ | punaḥ śabdo vā tuśabdārthe | pūrvamapradhāne vivakṣyate saṃkhyetyuktam, tadapekṣayeha viśeṣadyotanārthaḥ | kimarthamasau punaḥ śrutirityāha anyasya karmādeḥ, prasaktasya prāpnuvataḥ, niyamārthā nivṛttyarthā | tathā hi īpsitatamasya saṃbandhiśabdatvādyenopsitatamaṃ karma tasyākṣepastavatsiddha iti karaṇāderapīpsitatamaprasaṅge karturityucyamānaṃ kārakāntaranivṛttitātparyānniyamārthamiti | dvau bahavo vā kartāro na nivāritāḥ, tathāpi kārakāntaranivṛttirvivakṣitā siddhyatyeveti nirdeśārthaivātra saṃkhyā | nanvevamanenaiva nyāyena yajinā aniyatāṅgākṣepātpaśuneti karaṇāntaranivṛttitātparyeṇocyamānamavivakṣitasaṃkhyaṃ prasajyeta | naiṣa doṣaḥ | yathepsitatamasya saṃbandhiśabdatvādavaśyaṃ sādhanamātrākṣepe siddhe karturiti punaḥ śrutirbhavati, naivaṃ yajeḥ karaṇākṣepo'vaśyaṃbhāvī | devatoddeśena haviḥprakṣepamātrasya yajyārthatvāttyajyamānasyaivākṣepo na karaṇasyeti karaṇākṣepanāntarīyakatvābhāvānna paśuneti punaḥśrutiḥ, api tvapūrva evāyamaṅgavidhiḥ | paśurevātra tyajyamāna iti cet, tyāgamātre'pi tarhi yajeḥ prayogo dṛśyate--agnau suṣṭhu yajata iti | atrāpi haviṣa akṣepa iti cet evaṃ tarhi dṛṣṭārthānāṃ kriyāṇāṃ loke bhavennāma sāmarthyātsādhanākṣepaḥ | adṛṣṭārthāsu tu śabdapramāṇakatvāttyajetetyato yāgaḥ kartavya ityeva pratīteḥ paśorapūrvaiva codaneyamiti yathāśrutasaṃkhyāvivakṣaiva nyāyyā | na ca tasminyāge dvābhyāṃ pradhānāntarasiddhirasti | nāpi yāgāntare, ekenaiva sarvasya yāgasya siddheḥ | nanu ca kārakāntaranivṛttitātparye kartuḥ sārthāddhīyate pathika ityatrāpādānena sārthenepsitatamasya pathikasya karmasaṃjñābhāvāddhīyata iti karmaṇi lakārotpattiḥ katham ? na cāyaṃ karmakartṛviṣayaḥ, karmasthakriyāṇāṃ karmavadbhāvasyokteḥ | jahātiśca tyāgamātravacanaḥ kartṛsthakriyaḥ | sārtho hi tyajati pathikam, taṃ nānugacchati | tataśca pathikasyāpāyastatphalaṃ na dhātuvācyaḥ | kiñca pūrvaṃ karmaṇaḥ sataḥ kartṛtvaṃ karmakartṛtvam | iha tu sārtāpekṣameva pathikasya karmatvam , sa ca sārtho'pādānamiti kathaṃ tadapekṣaṃ karmatvamityetadeva codyate | atrocyate--iha kārakāṇāṃ svavyāpāre svātantryaṃ sarveṣāmeva vidyate, akiñcitkarasya kriyāṅgabhāvāyogāt | tathā ca sāmānyasaṃjñāpūrvako viśeṣasaṃjñāsaṃbhava iti sārthasya jahātau svātantrcamapādānasyānapagatameva | sārtho hi pathikaṃ jahadapāye sādhanabhāvamanubhavati | yathā jvalanti kāṣṭhāni pāke | tataśca sāmarthyātpratīyamānaṃ svātantryaṃ karmasaṃjñāheturatropapadyate--yathā praviśa piṇḍīmiti | yadyevaṃ karmādīnāmapi svavyāpāre svātantryamastyeveti tadāśrayāpi karmasaṃjñā syāt māṣeṣvaśvaṃ badhnātītyanarthakaṃ karturiti viśeṣaṇam | naitadasti | sadapi tatra svātantryaṃ pradhānena kartrā nyagbhāvitamiti na karmasaṃjñāhetuḥ | iha tu sārthasyāpagamāṅge tyāge jahātervartanādapagame'pādānatvaṃ nyāyyam | tyāge tu svātantryaṃ na virudhyata iti bhavati tadapekṣaṃ kartṛtvam | nanvevamapi svātantryasyātra nyagbhāvābhāve `apādānamuttarāṇi'  iti kartṛsaṃjñāyā apādānasaṃjñāyā bādhanātkartṛṃtṛtīyaiva syāt | tadyathā `dhanuṣā vidhyati' iti karaṇe tṛtīyā | naiṣa doṣaḥ | nāntarīyakayoḥ śak‌tyoḥ śabdasāmarthyādubhayoḥ pratītau yugapadvivakṣāyāṃ bādhyabādhakabhāvaḥ | tathā hi --dhanuṣaḥ śaranissaraṇe'vadhibhāvagamanaṃ vinā vedhane sādhakatamatā nopapadyata iti dvayoryugapadvivakṣāyāṃ karamasaṃjñayā apādānasaṃjñābādhanāt tṛtīyā | kṛtāyāmapi tṛtīyasyāmasyābadhibhāvaḥ pratīyata eveti | abhinnaphalatve sati tulyabalatvātparatvena vyavasthā | sārthena hi pathiko hīyate | yāvaccāsāvapi tato'napetastāvatsārthasya kutastaṃ pratyapādanatvamiti tadabhidhātumapādāne pañcamyevātra nyāyyā | tatra ca tyāgaphalarūpāpāyasya pratītestyāge svātantryamavagamyata eva | nanu sārthena hīyata ityatrāpāyo gamyata eva | tathā hi--hīyata iti ko'rthaḥ ? tyajyata iti | yadi ca tataḥ sārthādapeyātpathikaḥ, tato'sya sārthasya tasyāṃ jahātikriyāyāṃ kartṛtvamupapadyate nānyathā | satyametat, kintu sārthena hīyata ityukte saṃśayo jāyate--kiṃ sārthenātmanaḥ sakāśāt pathikaḥ parityajyate kiṃ vā anyataḥ sārthenāpakṛṣyate iti | avadhibhāve tu sārthasya pañcamyā pratipādite tasyaiva kartṛtvaṃ niyatamavagamyate | tasmādanyathāsiddhāvadhibhāvapratipattyarthamapādānasaṃjñaiva tatra vidheyā na tu vipratiṣedhaḥ phalabhede satyatulyabalatvādāśrayituṃ śakyaḥ dhanuṣā vidhyatītyatra tṛtīyasyāṃ kṛtāyāṃ dhanuṣaḥ śarāvadhibhāvo'pi abhinnaphalatve sati tulyabalatvena paratvādapādānamuttarāṇi bādhanta iti yuktam | sārthe tu vivakṣitārthapratipādanasāmarthyātkartṛsaṃjñā na pravartate | yadyevaṃ kartṛriti kartṛsaṃjñakenopsitatamasya karmasaṃjñāyāṃ pathikasya tadabhāva iti tadavasthaṃ codyam | naitat | kartṛgrahaṇasya svātantryopalakṣaṇāditi sāmānyena kartṛsaṃjñakatvātkartṛsaṃjñakatvamanapekṣya pradhānabhūtaṃ svātantryamātraṃ yasyāsti kartṛsaṃjñakasyākartṛsaṃjñakasya ca tasyobhayasyāpyekavākyatayā saṃgraha iti vākyabhedānavatārātsarvaṃ sustham | evaṃ `laḥ karmaṇi ca bhāve cākarmakebhyaḥ' iti vacanāt bhāvakarmakartṛṣu sāmānyena vidhānātparasmaipadātmanepadayoraviśeṣeṇa prasaktau bhāvakarmaṇoḥ `śeṣātkartari' iti niyamārthā punaḥ śrutirnivṛttitātparyādavivakṣita saṃkhyeti pratyayaniyamapakṣe niyamyamānatvātpratyayasya prādhānye'rthānāṃ guṇatvādguṇe'pi saṃkhyā nāṅgīkriyate'treti dvibahuṣvapi karmādiṣvātmanepadaparasmaipadasiddhiratrodāharaṇatvena yojanīyā | ayameva hyasya mukhyo viṣayaḥ, pūrvaśrutyaiva vidāvupādānātpunaśśabdena niyamārthamevānuvādāt | tathā ca `yajeta paśunā' ityādāvatiprasaṅgo na bhavati | paśorutpattivākyaṃ kiledaṃ prathamamityaviṣaya evāyamasya ślokasya | evaṃ `sarūpāṇāmekaśeṣaḥ' ityatra śiṣyamāṇapare vākye virūpanivṛttyarthatvātsarūpaśruteḥ śrutasaṃkhyā'vivakṣāyāṃ dvayorityekaśeṣaḥ siddhayati || 89 ||
gatamadaḥ | uktamidam-- `samāsapratyayavidhau yathā nipatitā śrutiḥ | guṇānāṃ paratantrāṇāṃ nyāyenaivopapadyate ||'  iti | tathā ca prātipadikebhya ekasyā vibhakterabhāvāt `ekavibhaktāviti cennābhāvādvibhakteḥ'  iti prātipadikaikaśeṣa ekavibhaktinimitto dūṣitaḥ | atra tu bhāṣye `athavā punarastvekavibhaktāvekaśeṣaḥ' iti sa eva siddhāntitaḥ, tatkathamupapadyata ityupapādayitumāha-- sarūpasamudāyāttu vibhaktiryā vidhīyate | ekastatrārthavānsiddhaḥ samudāyasya vācakaḥ || 90 ||
 sahavivakṣāyāmekaśeṣavacanātparasparāpekṣāvayavārthopapāditasamudāyārthaprādurbhāvātsarūpaprātipadikaviṣaye'vayavānāṃ samudāyasya ca pṛthagevārthavattvādbhinnaiva prātipadikasaṃjñā | tataśca samudāyātprātipadikādastyekā vibhaktiḥ `ṅyāpprātipadikāt'| ityatra saṃkhyāvivakṣāyāmapi | nanu ca samudāyātprātipadikādivāvayavebhyo'pi prātipadikebhyo vibhakterutrattiratra syāt | tathā ca samudāyavibhakterantyāvayavavibhaktyā vyavadhānātkathaṃ `ekavibhaktau' ityarayopapattiḥ | atha subantānāṃ sarūpāṇāmekaśeṣo na prātipadikānāmiti nāsti vyavadhānam, evamapi yo'sāvekaḥ subantaḥ śiṣyate tadīyā vibhaktirapi śiśyata iti sā samudāyavibhaktiśceti dve śrūyeyātām | atrocyate--samudāyāvayavasannidhāne samudāyakāryameva pravartate nāvayavakāryam | samudāyapāratantyādavayavānām | asti ca samudāyakāryeṇa vibhaktyākhyenātrāvayavānāmanugrahaḥ | tathā hi--samudāyādutpadyamānā vibhaktiravayavārthagatamapi saṃkhyāviśeṣaṃ vibhajati spaṣṭam | avayavārthānāmeva parasparāpekṣitarūpāṇāṃ samudāyārthatvāditi lāghavenaikenaiva prayatnena tantralakṣaṇenāvayavānugrahaḥ kṛto bhavatīti nāvayavebhyaḥ pṛthagvibhak‌tyutpattiḥ | tadyathā--papācetyatra samudāyaikāca eva dvirvacanenāvayavaikācāmapyanugrahaḥ | virūpasamudāyaviṣaye tu sahavivakṣāsambhave'pi na samudāyārthaprādurbhāvaḥ | tathā hyuktam-- `yābhyāṃ caikamanekārthaṃ tābhyāmevāparam ' iti | avayavārthānāṃ prādhānyātpratyavayavaṃ tatra vibhak‌tyutpattau dvandvaḥ subantānāṃ siddhayati | nanu ca sarūpaviṣaye'pi parasparāpekṣaivāvayavānāṃ samudāyaprādurbhāvabījam, na tu sarūpārthasamavetajātisambhavātsamudāyasya, tadvācakatve'bhinnasamudāyārthopapattiḥ, jātipadārthadarśane pratyākhyānādekaśeṣasya | kiñca jāterabhidheyatve dvivacanabahuvacanānupapattiḥ, ekatvāttasyāḥ | kāmaṃ bahuvacanaṃ tāntrikaṃ bhavet na tu bahudravyāvasāyaḥ | tasmādudbhūtāvayavārthabhedaḥ samudāyo'pekṣitetaretarāvayavārthābhidhāyitvātsarūpavirūpaviṣaye'pi samāna eva | evaṃ tarhi subantānāṃ dvandvavacanasāmarthyāttantreṇa virūpasamudāyādekāvibhaktirnotpadyate | sarūpaviṣaye tu na kiñcidbādhyate iti tatraivāyaṃ nyāyaḥ | yadi vā vyaktipadārthanaye'pyārabdhe ekaśeṣe jātiranabhidhīyamānāpi sambandhavyutpattyarthamavaśyamupalakṣaṇatvenāpekṣaṇīyeti tannibandhanā sarūpāṇāṃ saṅghaṭanā | prātipadikānāṃ virūpāṇāṃ tvekakriyāviṣayatvenā pekṣitasubantāvasthāyāṃ saṃghaṭanam, na prātipadikāvasthāyāṃ ghanamityādau samudāyasyaivārthavatvānnāyaṃ tantrākhyo nyāyaḥ saṃbhavatītyataḥ satyāṃ prātipadikasaṃjñāyāmarthavadgrahaṇe'vayavebhyo'pyanarthakebhyo vibhak‌tyutpattau nalopādicodyodbhāvanaṃ yuktameva | aprayogasamavāyino'pi ca prātipadikasya parasparārthāpekṣā prayoktrākāṃkṣāyattā padavadupacaryata eva | na hi padamapi vākyamapi vā aprayogasamavāyi svataḥ kiñcidapekṣate | prayoktradhīnā hyākāṃkṣāparaparyāyecchā yogyeṣu śabdeṣavadhyāropyate | asati ca prātipadikasyāpekṣaṇe niyatakriyāviṣayasādhanabhāvāparijñānād dvitīyādyanupapatteḥ padameva nāvatiṣṭheta ityapekṣāsiddhau samudāyārthopapattiḥ | sāmarthye ca samāsavidhānāt prātipadikārthānāmapekṣānumānam | sarvatraina ca prakṛtipratyayādīnāmapoddhārārthenārthavattābhyupagame parasparamanvayopapattiḥ | tadeva samudāyārthopapattau tasya vācakaḥ prātipadikasamudāyo'rthavattvātprātipadikasaṃjñakaḥ siddhaḥ | samāsagrahaṇena tulyajātīyaviṣayatvānniyamasya, subantasamudāyasya vākyasyaiva prātipadikasaṃjñā nivāryata ityekavibhaktau prātipadikaikaśeṣaḥ samarthitaḥ saṃkhyāvivakṣāyāmapi || 90 ||
evaṃ ca kṛtvā bhūyānpradhānasyānugrahaḥ kṛto bhavatītyāha-- pratyayasya pradhānasya samāsasyāpi vā vidhau | siddhaḥ saṃkhyāvivakṣāyāṃ sarvathānugraho guṇe || 91 ||
 `ṅyāttprātipadikāt' iti prakṛtyanuvādenāpūrvasya pratyayasya vidhau vivakṣitadāyāmapi saṃkhyāyāṃ guṇe kevalātprātipadikātsamudāyāccotpattiḥ tasya siddheti sarvathā sarveṇa prakāreṇa, pradhānasya pratyayarūpaviṣayavyāptilakṣaṇaḥ anugrahaḥ siddhaḥ | tathā `supsupā' iti samāsasyāpi pradhānasya vidhau vivakṣitāyāmapi guṇe saṃkhyāyāṃ dvandve'nekagrahaṇāt bahūnāṃ samāsaḥ kariṣyate | bahuvrīhau tvanekapadāvayave svarasamāsāntapuṃvadbhāveṣu doṣo'vayavatatpuruṣāśrayeṇa nivārita iti nāstyaniṣṭam | avivakṣitāyāṃ saṃkhyāyāṃ bahūnāmavyavasthitatvānniyamena samāso na vijñāyetetyuparodhastasya kṛtaḥ syāt | uttarapade dviguvidhānācca liṅgātsusūkṣmajaṭakeśādāvanekapado bahuvrīhiḥ siddhaḥ | dvayośca dvandve kṛte punarapareṇa saha dvandva ityekavacanamupasarjanārthamityuktam || 91 ||
evaṃ pūrvaṃ prātipadikārthabhūtāṃ jātiṃ nirūpya vibhaktyartho'pi saṃkhyājātirityuk‌tvā tatprasaṅgena vivakṣāvivakṣe vicārya idānīṃ tasyāmeva jātau yadadhikaṃ vicāryamavaśiṣyate tadeva vicārayitumāha-- abhedarūpaṃ sādṛśyāmātmabhūtāśca śaktayaḥ | jātiparyāyavācitvameṣāmapyupavarṇyate || 92 ||
 iyamatra śaṅkā | anvayavijñānonnīyamānasadbhāvā jātirityudghoṣyate | sā ca vyaktibhyo vyatirekeṇātmānaṃ no darśayati | tadetā eva vyaktayaḥ sādṛśyādekākārapratyayaprasavahetavaḥ prakṛtyaivaikapratyavamarśajananasāmarthyādadhyāsādvā santu, kimapareṇa sāmānyena kṛtyam | tadetadabhyupagacchati | abhedarūpam avyatiriktaṃ vyaktīnāṃ yatsādṛśyam ekapratyavamarśajanakaṃ vā vyatiriktameva śaktilakṣaṇaṃ sāmarthyaṃ tadapi jātiriti vyapadiśyata eva | anvitākārajñānajanakaṃ hi vyaktīnāṃ kiñcana rūpaṃ sāmānyamiti sarvapārṣado nyāyaḥ | tataśca sādṛśyaṃ śaktirityāpi nāmāntareṇocyatām, na kācidanupapattiḥ | vyatirekāvyatirekacintā tu pravādināṃ graha evetyabhiprāyaḥ || 92 ||
atra vaiśeṣikadarśanāśrayeṇa vyatirekapakṣaṃ jātīnāṃ samarthayitumāha-- daṇḍopāditsayā daṇḍaṃ yadyapi pratipadyate | na tasmādeva sāmarthyātsa daṇḍīti pratīyate || 93 ||
necchānimittādicchāvāniti jñānaṃ pravartate | tasmātsatyapi sāmarthye buddhirarthāntarāśrayā || 94 ||
 ayamatrārthaḥ--ihānugatākāre jñāne vyaktīnāṃ vyāvṛttākārāṇāṃ hetutvaṃ nopapadyata iti sāmānyaṃ parikalpyate | sādṛśyasāmarthye tu vyak‌tyavyatirikte | tadvadanuyāyinī vyatiriktā jātirabhyupagantavyā | nanu ca sāpi kathamanavayavena vyaktiṃ nānuyāyāt | tathā ca gavāśvādau sāṃkaryaprasaṅgaḥ | naitadevam, pratiniyatāśrayavṛttitvātsāmānyānām | kimatra nimittamiti cet viśiṣṭasaṃsthānayogitvaṃ vyaktīnām | anyo hyavayavasanniveśo gavām, anyastvaśvānāmiti gotnāśvatvayorādhāraniyamasiddhiḥ | tata eva tarhi viśiṣṭātsanniveśātsādṛśyāparaparyāyātpratiniyamenānugatākārapratyayo'stu | yathā hyavayavasanniveśaḥ prativyakti bhinno'pi sāmānyasyābhinnasyāśrayāvacchedahetuḥ tathā anugatākārasyāpi jñānasya heturbhavatītyalamantargaḍunā sāmānyena | taduktama-- `tulyabhede yathā jātiḥ pratyāsattyā prasarpati | kvacinnānyatra saivāstu śabdajñānanibandhanam || ' iti | atrocyate--iha kāryāṇāṃ pratiniyatakāraṇajanyatvānna sarvo janakaḥ sarvatra kārye vyāpārayituṃ pāryate| tathā hi--daṇḍīti pratyaye daṇḍasaṃbandho nimittam | sa tu daṇḍasaṃbandhaḥ sarvatra kiṃ na bhavatītyukte daṇḍajighṛkṣā tasya nimittaṃ bhaṇyate | na caitadatra vaktuṃ śakyate | daṇḍopādānecchāyā eva daṇḍasaṃbandhaṃ prati niyatahetorastu daṇḍīti pratyayaḥ, kimapareṇa tatra daṇḍasaṃbandhena nimittena kṛtyam iti | daṇḍopāditsā daṇḍasaṃbandhasya nimittam | tasyā api kiṃ nimittamityukte daṇḍasya yatra kārye viniyogaḥ tatra sāmarthyādidarśanaṃ tadupāditsānimittaṃ vaktavyam | tathā ca tata aivacchānimittād daṇḍopāditsāvānityastu pratyayaḥ, kimatrecchasamavāyaḥ svātmani nimittamudghoṣyata iti | naitacchakyate'bhighātum | anurūpaṃ kāryaṃ anurūpakāraṇajanyamitīcchāsaṃbandhādicchāvāniti jñānam, na daṇḍīti | evaṃ sādṛśyādeḥ sāmānyasya viṣayaniyamasāmarthye satyapi na tasmādeva sāmarthyādanugatākārajñānajanakatvaṃ yuktaṃ tatsadṛśamityādijñānaditi tannimittaṃ vyatiriktaṃ sāmānyamavaśyāśravaṇīyamiti siddham || 94 ||
anyathā atiprasaṅga ityāha-- svabhāvo'vyapadeśyo vā sāmarthyaṃ vāvatiṣṭhate | sarvasyānte yatastasmāvdyavahāro na kalpate || 95 ||
 iha kāryāṇāṃ pratiniyatakāraṇānabhyupagame kāraṇakāraṇādeva siddhāvabhyupagamyamānāyāṃ tatrāpi tatkāraṇādityanavasthāyāmāpāditāyāṃ sarvānte mūlakāraṇe'vasthātavyam | tacca mūlaṃ kāraṇaṃ sarvasya vastunaḥ sarvasya vādino'nte paryanuyogāvasāne nityasya pradhānādeḥ kāraṇasya svabhāvo'vyapadeśyo'yamasya svabhāvo'smāddhetorityevaṃ vyapadeṣṭumaśakyaḥ avatiṣṭhate | ata evāsminnavadhau hetupraśnaparamparā nivartate | yeṣāṃ tvanityaṃ kāraṇam, teṣāṃ sāmarthyaṃ hetuśaktiḥ praśnaparamparāvasāne'vatiṣṭhate | tadapi sāmarthyamavyapadeśyameva, vailakṣamyena `idaṃ tat' iti śabdena vyapadeṣṭumaśakyatvāt | athavā nityakāramaparigraha eva tasyātyantaparokṣatvātsvabhāvo'vyapadeśyaḥ | anekaśak‌tyātmakatve tu sāmarthyamapyasya parokṣatvādevāvyapadeśyam | ekameva vā vastu svabhāvaśabdena sāmarthyaśabdena ca vyavaharantīti taduktibhireva pratipādayati | evamavyapadeśyasvabhāve'vasthānāt tasmādavyapadeśyācchābdo vyavahāro na prakalpate | vākye yathānuyātavastunibandhano hi paridṛśyamānaḥ sthūlārthāśrayo gāmānaya, odanaṃ bhuṃkṣveti vyavahāraḥ so'ntyahetuvaśaḥ iti svabhāvaḥ sāmarthyaṃ vā ānaya bhuṃkṣva cetyevaṃ vaktavyam | avyapadeśyatvācca svābhāvādestena vyavahāro nopapadyata ityayuktama vyavahāryaṃ vastūpakṣeptumityarthaḥ | tadevamabhinnavyavahāranibandhanāni sāmānyānyabhyupagantavyāni | sādṛśyāttu sadṛśa iti vyavahāraḥ śaktimattvāttu śaktimāniti | anyacca sādṛśyajñānaṃ sāmānyajñānādbhinnajātīyeṣvapi gogavayādiṣu bhāvāt | atha nāvadhāryante vivekena jātaya ityanugatasya jñānasya nimitaparikalpanāyāṃ yadeva kiñcinnimittaṃ syāditi ko graho jātiṣviti | ucyate--tatra rūpisamavāyāt cākṣuṣāṇyeva sāmānyānīti brūmaḥ | vipratipannaṃ tu prati kāryakalpyatvamucyate | na ca jñānaṃ nāma kāryaṃ jaḍāṅkurājisadṛśam, api tu bodharūpamiti | tasya tatsāmānyaṃ na cakṣurādivadadhipatipratyayarūpaṃ kāraṇam, api tvālambanapratayayarūpam | ālambanaṃ ca saṃvedyamānam | ataścehāpi tadevāyātaṃ saṃvedyate tasya svarūpamupayujyamānamiti | atha vikalpasya sāmānyaṃ viṣayo na tu pratyakṣasya | tadayuktam | asati sāmānye vikalpo na pratyakṣam | na sati, satyaviṣayatvāt | vikalpaviṣayatvācca tasyāsatyatvam, asatyaviṣayatvācca tasya satyavikalpatvamiti itaretarāśrayatā | kiñca pratikarmavyavasthāyāṃ jñānasya bauddhairucyate yato nīlākāramato nīlasya saṃvedanamiti | tadvat sāmānyavādibhiraṣyucyate yato'bhinnākāramato'bhinnasya saṃvedanamiti | ko'nayoruktoyarviśeṣaḥ ? ye na nīlaṃ pratyakṣaṃ sāmānyamīdṛśamevāpratyakṣamiti | evamasya na kaścidviśeṣo daṇḍādibhya iti nāsti vaisādṛśyaṃ nidarśanaiḥ | ekārthakāritvācca bhinnaḥ pratyayo nāsti hetubhedāt kāryāṇāmapi bhedāt ityekapratyavamarśa evāsati sāmānye nodiyāt | rūpādivyatirekeṇa ca dravyānabhyupagamāt pratyarthamapi nāstyekārthasādhyā kācidarthakriyā kimutārthabhedo bhavet | udakāharamādyapi rūpādisamudāyasādhayamekamiti tatra samudāyabuddhirbhavennaikabuddhiḥ, yathaikāṅkurajanakatve'pi kṣitibījādīnām | mithyārūpasaṃviccaikabuddhirityāpi kvacit samyaksaṃvedanamūlatvānmithyābuddheravaśyaṃ kācidbhedabuddhiḥ satyāpyeṣṭavyetyanapahnavanīyāni pratiniyatakāryasādhanāni sāmānyānīti sthitam || 95 ||
adhunā sāṅkanayainādvaitanayena vā vyatiriktāṃ jātiṃ samarthayitumāha-- yadā bhedānparityajya buddhayaika iva gṛhyate | vyaktyātmaiva tadā tatra buddhirekā pravartate || 96 ||
 ihaikarūpasamanvayādekakāraṇapūrvakaṃ viśvam | asadanutpatteśca kāryakāraṇayorabheda iti sarvaṃ kiñcidbhedābhedātmakaṃ vastu | ekasyaivānekadhāvaśtānāttato'bhedaḥ sāmānyaṃ bhedo viśeṣaḥ | tatra sarvābhedo mahāsāmānyam, tasyaiva ca yathābhāgamavacchedādavāntarasāmānyāni | avacchedakāśca dharmāstasyaiva tathā pariṇāma iti na tato'tiricyante | sarvaṃ hyekasyaiva pariṇāmo vivarta iti vā | evaṃ ca kṛtvā kāryakāraṇayordharmadharmiṇoḥ sāmānyaviśeṣayośca nātyantaṃ bhedaḥ, evamapratīteḥ | nāppatyantamabhedaḥ, tathāpyapratīteḥ | kevalaṃ svasaṃvijñānapadābhāvādagatyā bhedābhedaśabdābhyāṃ yadābhidhīyate tadā śabdasādṛśyāmātrādavivakṣitabhedābhedarūpādhyāropeṇa parairvirodho nirviṣaya ivāpadyate | tatra yadā bhedānparityajya bhedābhedarūpāvivakṣayā vyak‌tyātmaiva vyakterātmaiva vyaktirūpameva buddhyā eka iva gṛhyate, abhinnaṃ pratīyate tadā tadeva sāmānyamekabuddhivaṣayo na tato'nyatkiñcit | vyak‌tyātmano hi mūlabhūtamekatvamātmabhedahetuparityāgādaviruddham | yadyapi ca prakṛtirūpānvayātsarvamekameva tattvataḥ tathāpi pariṇāmavaicitryādvikārāṇāmanarthāntarabhūtānāmapi sāṃvyavahārikamanekatvamapyanavagatamiti iva śabdaḥ | tatra yadā samastabhedaparityāgaḥ tadā sadvastumātraṃ padārtha iti caikabuddhiḥ pravartate | dharmatiraskāre tu dharmimātraṃ dravyamiti buddhiḥ | sajātīyagatabhedahetuparityāge vijātīyabhedārekṣāyāṃ pṛthivyāpasteja ityādivyavahāraḥ | tatrāpyarthāntarādbhedahetuparityāge vijātīyabhedāpekṣāyāṃ pṛthivyāpasteja ityādivyavahāraḥ | tatrāpyarthāntarādbhedāpekṣāyāṃ svasadṛśābhedāpekṣaṇe gauraśvo ghaṭa ityādi bheda iti yathāyathamudāhāryam || 96 ||
tadevaṃ darśanadvayena bhinnākārāyā jātibuddherviṣayamavasthāpya jātipadārthe pratyākhyānādekaśeṣasya tadviṣaye samūhabuddherviṃṣayamavasthāpayitumāha-- bhedarūpairanusyūtaṃ yadaikamiva manyate | samūhāvagrahā buddhirbahubhyo jāyate tadā || 97 ||
 bhedarūpāṇyapi yatra saṃcetyante'bhedarūpaṃ ca tatra samūhamavagṛhṇāti paricchinatti yā buddhiḥ sā pravartate | `ekamiva' iti | bhinneṣvapi ekatvasyādhyāropāt | evamapi caikatvopasarjanebhyo bahubhya eveyaṃ buddhirjāyate na cu jātipratyayavadekasmādeva | ayamāśayaḥ--yadyapi tā eva vyaṭaktabhedo vyaktayo jātiriti darśanam tathāpi saṃbhavatyekaśeṣasya viṣayo bhedaprādhānyenaikadharmāveśanimittābhedopasarjanatayā tāsāṃ pratīteḥ | ata eva ca dvandvaikaśeṣayorvacanabhedopapattiḥ | jātipratyayastu sarvathā abhedaprādhānyenaiva || 97 ||
idānīṃ sadṛśabuddherviṣayamāha-- sakṛtpravṛttāvekatvamāvṛttau sadṛśātmatām | bhinnātmikānāṃ vyaktīnāṃ bhedāpohātprapadyate || 98 ||
 iha bhedahetūnāṃ tyāge sāmānyabuddhirityuk‌tvā teṣāmapi ca parigrahe samūhabuddhiriti rāśyantarābhāvānnirviṣayā sādṛśyabuddhiḥ syādityaśaṃkyedamucyate--bhinnātmikānāṃ vyaktīnāṃ sakṛtpravṛttau bhedāpolat anālīḍhabhedaṃ tadanusyūtaṃ vā ekatvaṃ jātyātmakaṃ samūhātmakaṃ vā pratipadyate buddhiḥ | āvṛttau tu sadṛśyātmatām | bhedahetuparityāgenābhinnātmikā vyaktīravagṛhya kāryāntaraviṣayatayā gṛhītabhedā eva tā gṛhṇātītyaviśrāntā saiva buddhiḥ sāmānyaṃ gṛhṇāti | gogavayayostu pūrvaṃ bhedaṃ pratipadyānantaramavayavasanniveśāyatto'bhedo'vasīyata iti sādṛśyabuddhistatra | evaṃ ca buddhibhedādeva na sādṛśyaṃ sāmānyamutyuktaṃ bhavati || 98 ||
tadevaṃ vyatiriktajātidarśanamavyatiriktajātidarśanaṃ ca vistarato'bhidhāyedānīṃ saugatānāṃ saṃbandhi kālpanikaṃ jātidarśanamāha-- anupravṛtteti yathābhinnā buddhiḥ pratīyate | artho vyāvṛttarūpo'pi tathā tattvena gṛhyate || 99 ||
 ihābhinnapratyayāvaseyā jātirityucyate | na cābhinnaḥ pratyayo'sti | na hi ya evaikasyāṃ vyaktau gauriti pratyayaḥ sa eva dvitīyasyām , api tvanya eva, pratyarthaniyatatvād buddhīnām | ataśca naiva kaścidbhinneṣvabhinnapratyayaḥ, kevalaṃ bhinnāpi satī buddhiranuṃpravṛttā anugatā abhinnā pratīyate | na ca tatra budditattvavyatirekeṇānyatsāmānyaṃ gotvādijñānatvādyasti | tasyāpyabhinnapratyayasya pratibuddhi bhedāt | tatrāpyaparasāmānyakalpanāyāmanavasthāpātāt | na ca buddhiṣvaparasāmānyasyāsādhāraṇaḥ kaścidvācako'stīti kiṃ tatsāmānyaṃ nāma, yataścānādikālīnabhedāvagrahasāmarthyapratighātanimittavibhramavaśādyathā buddhīnāmabhedāvasāyo bhinnānāmapi vastutaḥ, tathārthānāmapi vyaktilakṣaṇānāṃ svarūpapararūpābhyāṃ vyāvṛttasvabhāvānāṃ tattvena abhedena sāmānyāvagraheṇāvasāyo bhaviṣyatīti bheda eva paramārtho'bhedāvasāyo mithyeti saugatāḥ || 99 ||
kimanādikālīnavibhramavaśādevāyam uta bahirasyābhedāvasāyasya kiṃcana nimittamastītyāha-- sarūpāṇāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ na bhedopanipātinaḥ | vidyante vācakāḥ śabdā nāpi bhedo'vadhāryate || 100 ||
 prakhyopākhyātmako dvividho vyavahāraḥ | tatra samānaṃ rūpameṣāṃ vāstavasya bhedasyānavadhāraṇādarvāgdarśanānāṃ vastūnāṃ pratibhāsate | na hi tattvato vāstavaṃ sārūpyamasti, saugatanaye tasya nirākṛtatvāditi duravadhārabhedatvena yatsarūpatvam , tadeva nirdiśyata iti sādṛśyanibandhano'bhedāvasāyalakṣaṇaḥ prakhyātmako vyavahāraḥ | asādhāraṇabhāvarūpaniveśasaṃvijñānapadābhāvāccopākhyātmako'pyabhedenaiva vyavahāraḥ | upākhyāyā vācakasya śabdasya sāṃketikatvātsvalakṣaṇe vṛttyanupapatteḥ | "śabdāḥ sāketikaṃ prāhuḥ vyavahārāya saṃsmṛtāḥ | tadā svalakṣaṇaṃ nāsti saṃketastena tatra naḥ ||" ityādinā veditatvāt | yadyapi cāvadhāraṇābhāvādeva vācakābhāvo'vagataḥ, avadhāraṇapūrvakatvādvācakānām, tathāpi yatrāpi gavādiṣvavadhāryate bhedaḥ tatrāpi tasya vācakā na santi | svalakṣaṇasya śabdenābhidhātumaśakyatvāt api tvabhedādhyavasāyānuvidhāyina eva te tatrāpīti darśayituṃ bhedena vācakābhāva uktaḥ | itthaṃ ca viśeṣāṇāmavivecanādapyanugamābhimāno vācakābhāvāccābhinnā śabdapravṛttirna tu bahirvastubhūtaṃ sāmānyaṃ nāma kiñcanākṣa nimittamityuktaṃ bhavati || 100 ||
sarveṣāmiti vyāptirhyatroktā, tāmevopapādayitumāha-- jñānaśabdārthaviṣayā viśeṣā ye vyavasthitāḥ | teṣāṃ duravadhāratvājjñānādyekatvadarśanam || 101 ||
 jñānānāṃ tāvadviṣayabhedādbhedo nyāyyo'pyarvāgdarśino gorgaurityabhedāvasāyādaśakyapariccheda ityekatvamasadadhyāropitaṃ tatra paśyanti | evaṃ ca śabdānāmanunāsikatādīnāṃ dharmāṇāṃ bhedādvaktṛbhedācca bhede'pyabhedenāvasāyaḥ sa evāyaṃ gośabda iti | kramavatāmavasthāyināṃ śabdānāṃ na kiñcitsāmānyamasti | athābhedenāvasīyante sūkṣamāṇāṃ viśeṣāṇāṃ duravadhāratvāt, arthānāmapi khaṇḍamuṇḍādiḥ sphuṭa eva bhedo nādṛto'rvāgdarśanaiḥ vijātīyavyāvṛttyā anvayirūpollekhanāt | tathā ca maṇimuktāpravālādīnāmabhiyuktapraṇidhānagamyo viśeṣo na sarvairvicyate || 101 ||
avadātadarśanāstu yathātattvaṃ vivekina eveti bhedavādinayaḥ | jātivādinastu manyante-- jñāneṣvapi yathārtheṣu tathā sarveṣu jātayaḥ | saṃsargadarśane santi tāścārthasya prasādhikāḥ || 102 ||
 anapahnavanīyo'yamabhinnāvasāyaḥ sarvatra jātisadbhāvāvedaka iti jñānānāmapi sāmānyaviśeṣāḥ santu kānupapattiriti vastūnāṃ bhedābhedādirūpamarthāntarasaṃsarganimittaṃ manyamānāḥ prāhuḥ | tā eva jñānajātayo arthasya prasādhikāḥ bāhyānāmarthajātīnāṃ niścāyikāḥ | buddheranvitāvabhāsasiddhau vyaktīnāmapi sāmānyāvadhāraṇāt | arthasyātmīyasya vā sāmānyakāryasyānuvṛttyādeḥ prasādhikāḥ | yatra tatra ca satyapyavāntaraviśeṣe'bhinnaḥ pratyayo'sti tatra tatra pramāṇasiddhānāṃ sāmānyaviśeṣāṇāmaṅgīkaraṇamānantye'pi na doṣāya | asādhāramasaṅketābhāve'pi ca jātyutpalādigandhādīnāmiva sattvamastyeva || 102 ||
saṃsargadarśana eva prakārāntaramāha-- jñeyasthameva sāmānyaṃ jñānānāmupakārakam | na jātu jñeyavajjñānaṃ pararūpeṇa rūpyate || 103 ||
 yathā jñeyaṃ vyatiriktasāmānyarūpeṇa rūpyate kriyate naivaṃ jñānaṃ saṃvidātmasamavetena vyatiriktasāmānyarūpeṇa rūpyate | jñeyadharmaḥ kilāyaṃ yat pararūpeṇa rūpaṇam | jñānaṃ tu svatantraṃ jñeyameva na bhavati | jñeyaniṣṭhatayā hi jñānānāṃ jñeyasthasya sāmānyasyābhedena tadabhedāvasāyaḥ pratyarthaniyatatve'pyupapadyate | bāhyaparavaśatvenāsvādhīnatvāj jñānānāṃ svata eva vailakṣamyānupapatteḥ bahirabhinnena nimittena tatra bhāvyam | tadyathā ghaṭo ghaṭa iti ghaṭākāre bāhyaṃ nimittaṃ tathā bhede'pi tadgataṃ sāmānyamiti yuktam || 103 ||
kathaṃ punarjñānaṃ jñeyaṃ na bhavatīti pararūpeṇa na rūpyata ityāha-- yathā jyotiḥ prakāśena nānyenābhiprakāśyate| jñānākārastathānyena na jñānenopagṛhyate || 104 ||
 yathā ghaṭādīnāṃ dīpaḥ prakāśakaḥ svaprakāśe dīpāntaraṃ nāpekṣate tathārthasya prakāśakaṃ jñānamātmaprakāśanāya prakāśāntarānapekṣamiti svaprakāśakaṃ siddham | jaḍavailakṣaṇyaṃ hi prakāśakatvamiti tasyāpi prakāśyatve jaḍatāpattiḥ | arthaprakāśakāle ca prakāśakasyāprakāśe'rthasaṃvedanameva na syāt | prakāśāsañcetane tallagnārthasañcetanāsiddheḥ | uttarakālaṃ tu vedanaṃ kvopayogi | utpannāyāṃ ca prakaṭatāyāṃ ātmasamavetasya tadānīṃ jñānasyāsañcetanānmama prakaṭito'rtha ityātmagāmi saṃvedanaṃ na syāt | tasyājjñānāntareṇa svaprakāśakaṃ jñānaṃ na gṛhyate paraprakāśyatve prakāśakatvābhāvāditi tadākārasya pareṇa rūpeṇabhāvājjñeyasthamevābhinnaṃ sāmānyamasyābhedanimittam | tadvaśādasya grāhyākārasya jñānāntareṇābhedagrahaṇāt | svasamavetasāmānyavaśena tvabhedapratibhāse bahiḥ sāmānyaparikalpo nirnibandhana eva syāt | anyathaivābhedapratibhāsasyopapatteḥ | arthānāntu vyatiriktatvādabhinnaṃ sāmānyamupapadyate | jñānānāṃ tu sāmānyākāro na vyatirikta iti nābhinna upapadyate | pratyarthaniyatatvena teṣāṃ bhedāttadabhinnasya tasyāpi tathātvopapatteriti nārthaiḥ sāmyamasti | buddhyākārāṇāmākārasāmyādeva ca jñānānāmabhedāvasāyasiddherna saṃvedanabhāge'pi sāmānyayoga iti sākārāḥ svaprakāśāḥ niḥsāmānyā buddhayaḥ siddhāḥ | yadyapi ca vaiśeṣikā jñeyasthameva sāmānyaṃ jñānānāmupakārakamicchanto na sākāraṃ nāpi svaprakāśaṃ vijñānamicchanti, tathāpi na vayaṃ darśanāntaraprakriyāṃ brūmaḥ | api tu yatpramāṇopapannamitīdamatra darśanamupakṣiptam || 104 ||
nanu ca yathā ghaṭo'yamiti jñāne ghaṭo'vasīyate tathā ghaṭajñānametaditi jñāne ghaṭajñānam | ko hyatra viśeṣaḥ ? yadi tu viṣayasaṃvedanarūpā buddhirnānubhūyeta śabdenāpi tathā nābhidhīyeta, anubhavapūrvakatvādabhidhānasya | na cātmanā ātmānamanubhavati buddhiḥ , svātmani vyāpāravirodhāt | bodharūpatvāttu svayamajñātaivārthamavabhāsayatu | etāvānasya bāhyādviśeṣo'stu | tadbubhutsāyāṃ tu buddhantaramevāpekṣyam | jñānajñeyasiddhimātraniṣṭhatvācca vyavahārasya pratyayāntarānapekṣaṇād buddhimālāpi nānuṣajyata ityāha-- ghaṭajñānamiti jñānaṃ ghaṭajñānavilakṣaṇam | ghaṭa ityāpi yajjñānaṃ viṣayopanipāti tat || 105 ||
 ghaṭajñānamiti jñānaṃ ghaṭādyākāraṃ jñānaṃ yadā jñānāntareṇa parāmṛśyate evaṃ mamātrānubhavo bhūta iti pratyayaviṣayaṃ yatparāmarśajñānaṃ taddhaṭajñānādbhinnalakṣamaṃ sākṣādviṣayoṇājanitatvāt | anukāryapratyayā eva hi viṣayeṇa janyante nānye jñānālambanāḥ, vyavadhānāt; sārūpyabalena ca grāhyagrāhkabhāvena vaidharmyeṇa na ca ghaṭajñānaṃ jñānāntare pratibhāsate | ato na tad gṛhyate | athocyate--sarūpameva tajjñānaṃ ghaṭa ityevamanusandhānādityāha--ghaṭa ityapi yajjñānaṃ viṣayopanipāti tat | na tu jñāne upanipatati | ato na buddhirbuddhimālambanate, svayameva tu prakāśata ityarthaḥ | anye vyācakṣate, ghaṭajñānād bāhyaviṣayāt ghaṭajñānamiti evaṃ jñānaṃ bhinnaṃ na viṣayapraviṣṭaṃ svātmavyavasthitaṃ jñānaṃ sa?ñcetyate yasmādghaṭa ityevamākāraṃ yadvicchinnaṃ grāhyaprasṛtaṃ tadapi viṣayamanupatati grāhyaparavaśam | viṣayāprakāśane jñānāstitāyā evānibandhanatvāt | evaṃ ca bodhatvāviśeṣāt yadyapi jñānatrānamiti mataṃ tadapi bāhyaviṣayamevetyuktaṃ bhavati | anye tu vyācakṣate--ghayajñānamiti jñānaṃ viṣayo yasya tad ghaṭajñānavilakṣaṇam, evaṃsvarūpamanākāram | na hi saṃvidākārastajjñānābhimate pratibimbībhavati | sārūpyavaśena grāhyagrāhakabhāvaḥ, anyathā jñānatvāviśeṣādidamasya saṃvedanamiti pratiniyamo na syāt | ghaṭa iti tu yadetadbāhyaviṣayaṃ jñānaṃ tadviṣayopanipāti viṣayākāramupādatte | atha vā-ghaṭa jñānamiti jñānaṃ ghaṭajñānavilakṣaṇam | kiṃ tadvailakṣamyamityāha-ghaṭa ityapi yajjñānaṃ viṣayopanipāti tat | nirākāramapi tadliṣayamanupatati paricchinatti nirūpayati-evaṃrūpo'yamartha iti | ghaṭajñānamiti tu jñānaṃ na jñānarūpānupāti, yato ghaṭajñānagataṃ viṣayaṃ nirūpya jñānarūpaṃ kimapi tadityetāvadyadi paraṃ nirūpayituṃ śaknoti, na tu sā tadīyā bodharūpatā tasya pratibhāsate parasaṃvedana iva | pareṇa hi ghaṭajñānamasyotpannamiti kayācidyuk‌tyā jñānaṃ paricchidyate, na tu svavatparasya pratibhāsate iti tato vilakṣaṇaṃ na tasya paricchedakam | upalambhātmakatvātsvayaṃ prakāśata iti svasaṃvedanaṃ jñānamucyate | na tvātmanāmarthamiva prakāśayatīti na svātmanyasya kaścivdyāpāraḥ || 105 ||
nanu jñānasya grāhyākāro na vyatiriktaḥ, sa ca ghaṭajñānamiti jñānena saṃvadyeta iti buddhireva saṃveditā bhavatītyāśaṅkyāha-- yato viṣayarūpeṇa jñānarūpaṃ na gṛhyate | artharūpaviviktaṃ ca svarūpaṃ nāvadhāryate || 106 ||
 nirākāravāde'pyayaṃ parihāro lagati, yatastatrāpi ghaṭajñānametaditi grāhyasvabhāvena jñānaṃ jñānānatreṇopalakṣyati, na tadrahitamātmatattvaṃ tasyāvadhārayati | na ca grāhyākāro jñānasvarūpam, aupādhikatvāt | yathā sphaṭikasya nīlādi | na ca grāhyākāraviviktaṃ grāhakarūpaṃ jñānāntareṇopalakṣyate śuddhabuddhyanukāreṇa buddhyantarānupapatteḥ | evaṃ ca viṣayāprakāśane jñānatvāyogāt jñānajñānābhimatamapi viṣayaniṣṭhameva | tathā copasarjanena viṣaya eva tena viśiṣṭo'vasthāpyate jñāto'yamartha iti | nīlajñānamityetadapi nīlaniṣṭhatayā viṣayaprabhavaṃ jñānaṃ parāmṛśyate | evaṃ ca kṛtvā saṃvidākārasya jñānāntareṇāgrahaṇānna vyatiriktasāmānyanimittam, tena tasya grāhyākārasyāvilakṣaṇasya janena tathaiva buddhyantareṇa grahaṇāditi na tatra sāmānyāntaramupayujyate | nāpītaretarāśrāyadoṣaḥ | jñeyasāmānyasyābhinnajñānajanakatvenābhinnajñānasya ca jñeyatāpratipādakatvena vyāpārabhedāt | tenaitadacodyam | yathā vinaiva sāmānyamabhedāvasāyo buddhīnām evamarthānāmapi bhaviṣyatīti buddhīnāmari sāmānyavaśenaivoktaprakāreṇābhedāvasāyāt iti | nanu yadi jñānarūpamartharūpaviviktaṃ nāvadhāryate svato'pyasya siddhirna syāt | satyam | sarvadaiva grāhyākāraḥ sahabhāvyanubhūyate'sya, kintu tatpa ṛṣṭhabhāvino hlādanīyaprakāmā ahaṅkārāspadavicchinnagrāhyākāravidharmāṇa uttararūpā ahaṅkārāspadatayā saṃcetyanta iti svatastadviviktarūpāvadhāraṇamasti buddhīnām | jñānāntareṇa tu hlādādayo gṛhyamāṇā api tathā na saṃvedyanta iti anubhavasiddhametadanapahnavanīyam ityalamativistareṇa | tadevaṃ pramāṇapariśuddhā jātiḥ śabdenābhidhīyamānā dṛṣṭādṛṣṭaviṣayavyavahārasādhanasamartheti jātipadārthasiddhiḥ || 106 ||
iti bhūtirājatanayahelārājakṛte prakīrṇaprakāśe jātisamuddeśaḥ samāptaḥ || -------- 3,2ḥ ḍhravyasamuddeśaḥ -------------  jātirvā dravyaṃ vā padārthāvityuktam | tatra vājapyāyanadarśanena jātiṃ viśeṣaṇabhūtāṃ padārthaṃ vyavasthāya vyāḍidarśanena viśeṣyarūpaṃ dravyamapi padārthaṃ vyavasthāpayituṃ yathādarśanaṃ tadeva paryāyāntarairuddiśati | ātmā vastu svabhāvaśca śarīraṃ tattvamipyapi | dravyamityasya paryāyāstacca nityamiti smṛtam || 1 ||
 ihārthakriyāyāṃ dravyamevopayujyate iti tadeva pravartakamarthinām | ataḥ śabdena tadevocyate | anabhidhīyamānā tu jātiravacchedikā guḍaśabde mādhuryādaya iveti dravyavādināṃ darśanam | dravyaṃ ca dvividham, pāramārthikaṃ sāṃvyavahārikaṃ ca | tatra dvitīyaṃ bhedyabhedakaprastāvena guṇasamuddeśe vakṣyate `vastūpalakṣaṇaṃ yatra....'  ityādinā | anena ca dravyeṇa vyāḍitadarśane sarve śabdā dravyābhidhāyino bhavanti | iha tu pāramārthikaṃ dravyaṃ nirūpyate | tathā hi ātmā advaitavādibhirātmaśabdena tad dravyamuktam | ātmaiva hyupādhibhinnaṃ pratibhāsamānaṃ `dravyaṃ padānāmartha iti teṣāṃ darśamihaiva vakṣyamāṇam | vastu svalakṣaṇamarthakriyākāri dravyamiti śākyairuktam | svabhāvaḥ iti sattādvaitavādibhiḥ svabhāva ātmabhūtā satteti kṛtvā | tathā hi kramarūpopasaṃhāre sattaiva sattvamiti svasaṃbandhibhirupādhibhirupahitabhedā saiva dravyam | prakṛterekadeśaḥ cetanaḥ puruṣaḥ taddvāreṇa śarīraśarīriṇokhyatirekāt `śarīram' dravyaṃ pradhānameveti prākṛtikaiḥ śarīramevaika ātmā yeṣāṃ taiḥ śarīrātmabhirucyate | `tattvam' iti caturbhūtatattvādibhiścārvākairdravyamucyate | pṛthivyaptejovāyuriti tattvāni, tatsamudāye śarīrendriyaviṣayasaṃjñā iti vacanāt | tadevametaiḥ paramārthata ekameva vastūcyate | `dravyamityasya' iti | dravyaṃ nāma yaḥ padārthaḥ tasyaiva eva paryāyāḥ | eteṣāmeva pāramārthikarūpābhidhāyitvāt | nānye ghaṭādiśabdāḥ | satyapi tadabhidhāyitve vakṣyamāṇanayenātmādiśabdānāmeva sarvatra ghaṭādāvavyāhataprasaratvam | tathā ca bhāṣyam-- `eko'yamātmā udakaṃ nāma' iti | atrātmaśabda udake prayujyamāno dravyavacanaḥ | ākṛtidvāreṇa cānye śabdā dravye vartante | ime tu tatparityāgena mukhyayā vṛttyeti viśeṣaḥ | `siddhe śabdārthasaṃbandhe' ityatra dravyaṃ nityamākṛtiranyā cānyā ca bhavati itivadatā bhāṣyakāreṇa nityaṃ dravyaṃ smṛtam | saṃgrahoktasya tasyārthasyānuvādāt smṛtam ityāha | yadyapi śākyādidarśane nityaṃ na bhavati dravyaṃ tathāpi tanmatasyānabhyupagamādadoṣaḥ | kevalaṃ yadasmākaṃ dravyamanyairevamabhidhīyata ityevamatropanyāsaḥ | yadvā bhāṣyānusāreṇa svarūpānyathātvānāpattiḥ vikārabhede'pi nityatvaṃ vivakṣitameveti sarvatra tatsiddhiḥ || 1 ||
evaṃ darśanāntarāśrayaṇenoddiṣṭeṣvapi dravyabhedeṣu svasiddhāntāśrayeṇa sārvatrikīṃ dravyapadārthavyavasthāṃ kartumāha-- satyaṃ vastu tadākarairasatyairavadhāryate | asatyopādhibhiḥ śabdaiḥ satyamevābhidhīyate || 2 ||
 iha sarvaśabdānāṃ pāramārthikaṃ tattvaṃ sākṣāt spraṣṭumaśaktānāmanekopādhiviṣayanihitapadānāṃ tadrūpāliṅganaṃ vyavahāre sama0ālakṣyate | upādhīnāṃ cāgamāpāyavaśavidhuritanijasvarūpāṇāmarthisārthasamāśāpūraṇapratihataśaktitvānna tāvatyeva paryavasānamityupavakṣitarūpapṛṣṭhapātinaḥ śabdā vyavasthāpyante | avadhṛtarūpaniveśitvācca śabdānāmavadhāraṇānusāramarthe pravṛttiḥ, avadhṛtiścākāradvāreṇa | nirākārasya buddhyupārohāyogāt yathāpratyayaṃ bhedāvasāyasya bādhyamānatvādanuyāyyabhinnameva rūpaṃ paramārthataḥ | tadeva brahmarūpaṃ satyam || 2 ||
syādetat | upādhiṣu śabdānāṃ viśrāntyabhāve śabdārthopādhitvaṃ teṣāṃ na syāt | avācyasya tadupādhitvāyogadityetadvicārayitumāha-- adhruveṇa nimittena devadattagṛhaṃ yathā | gṛhītaṃ gṛhaśabdena śuddhamevābhidhīyate || 3 ||
 ado devadattasya gṛhaṃ yatrāso kākaḥ prativasatītyatrāniyatasvāmikagṛhopalakṣaṇāyopalakṣaṇabhūtasya kākasyotpatite'pi tasminnupalakṣamasya kṛtatvād adhruvatvamnityatvamiti tadanādareṇaiva tadupalakṣitaṃ gṛhamabhidhīyate gṛhaśabdena yathā tathā prakṛtasaṃbandhādasatyopādhyupalakṣitaṃ satyamupādhirūpānādareṇa śabdairabhidhīyata ityanabhidhīyamānasyāpyabhidhānaviṣayaniyāmakatvādupalakṣamatve satyupādhitvanidarśanena samarthitam | tathā hi ityanubandhasyāprayogasamavāyitvādadhruvasyopalakṣaṇatve tadrahitasya śuddhasya pratyayarūpasya saṃjñāprasaṅga ityatredaṃ bhāṣye nidarśanamuktam | nanu kāko'tivilakṣaṇād gṛhād bhedenāvadhāryamāṇo mā bhūdgṛhaśabdābhidheyaḥ | ghaṭādayastvākārāḥ pṛthaganupalabhyamānatattvāḥ kathamiva tacchabdairnābhidhīyeran | anyo hyupādhirupalakṣaṇabhūtaḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyenāvacchedakaḥ | tadyathā dṛtiharirityatra paśuḥ | anyattu viśeṣaṇamapṛthakcchabdāvācyamuparaṃjakam | tadyathā vāneyamudakamiti | vanasabandhopādhīyamānarūpaviśeṣamudakam | `abhidhīyate' iti | vanasaṃbandho viśeṣaṇamuparaṃjakatayābhidheyakamāpadyata iti | tathā coktam | arthaviśeṣa upādhistadantavācyaḥ samānaśabdo yaḥ | anupādhirato'nyaḥ syāt ślāghādiviśeṣaṇaṃ yad‌vat || ityāśaṅkya sadṛśataramatra nidarśanamāha-- suvarṇādi yathā bhinnaṃ svairākārairapāyibhiḥ | rūcakādyabhidhānānāṃ śuddhamevaiti vācyatām || 4 ||
 rucakakuṇḍalādyākāraviśeṣopādhīyamānarūpabhedamapi sarvatrānapāyirūpaṃ satyamiti `apāyibhiḥ' ākāraviśeṣaistatsādhyārthakriyākaraṇānna tatraiva rucakādiśabdāḥ kṛtapadasaṃbandhāḥ | kintu tadatiricyamānamarthavastvabhidhāyakatvena samāviśanti tadvat prakṛtisaṃbandhādākāropahitanānātvamapi paratattvaṃ śabdagocara ityarthaḥ | tatra ca apāyibhiriti heturnirdeśaḥ sādhyasamakakṣyatayā kṛtaḥ | tataścopādhīnāmavācyatvamasatyatvaṃ ca siddhyati | asatyatvādevārthakriyākaraṇāttadarthaṃ ca śabdavyavahārādavācyatvaṃ teṣāmityarthaḥ | nanu rūcakādau prakṛtyanvayo'vadhāryata eva | ihāpi vastūnāṃ jñāyamānatvena satvāt, jñānasya vaikalpikākārānavasthānānnirākāraśuddhasaṃvinmātrānugamasya svasaṃvitsiddhatvādadoṣaḥ | nanu viśeṣaṇoparaktaṃ viśeṣyābhidhānaṃ yuktamityupasarjanībhūtasyābhidhāne kā kṣatiḥ | na kācit , kevalamupādhiṣvevātra tātparyadṛṣṭyā padabandho nivāryate | gumatvena tvabhidhānamastu na tāvatyeva viśrantiriti dravyaniṣṭhatāsiddhiḥ || 4 ||
ata eva viśeṣaṇoparāgāt sāṅkāryadoṣaṃ parihartumāha | ākāraiśca vyavacchedāt sārvārthyāmavarudhyate | yathaiva cakṣurādīnāṃ sāmarthyaṃ nāḍikādibhiḥ || 5 ||
 sarvabhāveṣu brahmaṇo dravyalakṣamasyābhedāttadabhidhāyitve śabdānāṃ sarvatra tasya bhāvāt sārvārthyaṃ śabdāntarābhidhīyamānārthatvaṃ sāṅkaryaṃ prasajyetetyatredamucyate | pratiniyatākāraparicchinnavṛttitvāt sarvārthatvapratibandhādasaṅkara ityarthaḥ | ghaṭākāropadhāna puraḥsaraṃ ghaṭaśabdena brahmadravyamabhimukhīkriyate paṭākāropadhānena tu paṭaśabdenetyādyupādhirūpopāhitavivekitvamabhidhānīyam | tadyathā nāḍikāśuṣiravartmanihitanayanāstadavakāśāvasthitamevārthabhāgaṃ paśyanti tatāvidyāvacchinnadṛkśaktibhirākārabhedaireva vastūpalakṣyate | tathaiva ca yathādhyavasāyaṃ śabdanivośācchabdairebhidhīyata ityarthaḥ | yathāvaraṇādinendriyasyaiva prakāśaśaktiḥ pratibadhyate na viṣayo vikriyate tathānādyavidyāvacchedaprakalpitavibhāgānāṃ jīvānāmeva saṃvedanaśakirniyamyate yena vicchinnārthābhidhānena bhedaviṣayāṇyabhidhānāni prayujyante, na tu tattvamavidyayāvilīkriyate iti nāḍikānidarśanena sūcayati | nāḍikādibhirityādigrahaṇādavadhānapratighātamūrttyabhijanādyavarodhaḥ | yatraiva hyavadhānaṃ tadeva hyavadhāryate | mūrttyabhijano rūpasaundaryaṃ tenāpahato'nyaṃ na paśyati || 5 ||
ye tarhyākāramātraniveśinaḥ sanniveśādiśabdāḥ te dharmamātramabhidadhyuḥ iti sārvatrikī dravyapadārthavyavasthā viśīryetetyāśaṅkyāha | teṣvākāreṣu yaḥ śabdastathābhūteṣu vartate | tattvātmakatvāttenāpi nityamevābhidhīyate || 6 ||
 upādhimātrasvabhāveṣvapi sanniveśādyākāreṣu sanniveśādiśabdā vartamānāḥ paramārthatastattvādavyatirekādupādhīnāṃ tanniṣkarṣe svarūpāsyāsvarūpattvāttadātmanaiva sattvāt tadeva niyatyamupādhimad‌dravyamevamapyabhidhāne'bhihitaṃ bhavati | tattvamātmā hyupādhīnām, na tu te tasyātmana iti vyāvartakatvāt sarva evopādhayastadātmanā santaḥ tathaivābhidhīyante | yadā hyupādhimallīnatā tadopādhaya upādhayo na bhavanti | tatastu niṣkarṣe dharmāntarāśrayatayā svātantryādupādimattmeva nopādhitvamityāśayaḥ || 6 ||
yadyevaṃ dharmāṇāmavasthāntare dharmirūpatvānnityatve satyatve cākārāṇāmasatyatvam, dravyasya tu satyatvamityetasya niyamasyānupapattirityāśaṅkhyāha | na tattvātattvayorbheda iti vṛddhebhya āgamaḥ | atattvamiti manyante tattvamevāvicāritam || 7 ||
 ayamatrārthaḥ | nehādvaitanaye satyāsatye dve rūpe staḥ, advaitahāniprasaṅgāt | kintu pāramārthikamekamevādvayaṃ tattvam | taccānādisiddhāvidyāvilasitasahaṃ pramātṛviṣayatayā yathātattvamanavabhāsamānamutyanekavikalpaparighaṭitākārarūpatayā vyavahāramavatarati | tathā ca tadevākāranānātvonnīyamānasvarūpabhedaṃ cakāsti, nānyat | tad‌vyatiriktasyānyasyābhāvāt | tatra ca yo'yaṃ prakāśaḥ sa vidyā | aprakāśastu tamo'vidyā | na ca prakāśābhāvo'prakāśo nāma kaścipramāmasiddho nirūpyaḥ | tataśca yo'yaṃ bhedaprakāśaḥ sa evaikaghanaprakāśābhāvaḥ nāma prakāśavicchedo'vidyā | tatra vicchinnānvayo'vacchedo'vadhāryata iti vicchinnaprakāśaḥ satyā vidyaiva | vicchedamātraṃ tu apradhānasvabhāvaṃ ca kiṃcidavidyeti paramārthavicāre na kiṃcittattvaṃ vyavatiṣṭhate | tattvameva yathāpratibhāsaṃ bhedena cakāsadavicāritaramaṇīyaṃ prapaṃco'tattvamiti vyavahriyata iti brahmavidaḥ | tathā cāvicāritaramaṇīyaṃ parūkṣayā vyavasthāpitaṃ tattvamevābhinnaṃ tīrthikā bhedadarśanavyavasthitā bhedātmakamatattvaṃ manyanta iti vicāreṇāvidyāvilaye brahmaikaniṣṭhatā darśanānām | taduktam | satyā viśuddhistatroktā vidyaiva ityādi || 7 ||
evaṃ tena tena rūpeṇa brahmaiva vikalpitaṃ bhavatīti sarvaśabdānāṃ tattadupādhimukhaṃ tadeva viṣayaḥ siddha ityāha-- vikalparūpaṃ bhajate tattvamevāvikalpitam | na cātra kālabhedo'sti kālabhedaśca gṛhyate || 8 ||
 paramārthataḥ avikalpitaṃ vikalpānāviṣayo yattattvaṃ tadeva vyavahāre'nyasyābhāvādvikalpamātram, vikalparūpaṃ nānāvidhabhedāvabhāsam, anādisiddhāvidyāvaśāt samavalaṃbate | jīvātmabhedenāvatiṣṭhamānaṃ tadgatatveneti mūrtivivartāśrayadik‌cchapravibhaktadeśanānātvaṃ nimittapaurvāparyāvalaṃbanasaham | evamakālakalitamapi tattvamanādinidhanaṃ kālāravyasvatantraśaktiviniveśitapratibandhābhyanujñāvaśājjānmādibhāvavikārābhidhīyamānapaurvāparyaṃ cakāstītyarthaḥ || 8 ||
