nanvavidyamānasya tattve pratibhānamayuktamityāśaṅkya dṛṣṭāntenopapādayati | yathā viṣayadharmāṇaṃ jñāne'tyantamasaṃbhavaḥ | tadātmeva ca tat siddhamatyantamatadātmakam || 9 ||
 vijñānavāde viṣayākārasya bhāvato'satyatvānnīlādistadgato dharmo jaḍo'jaḍe jñāne'saṃbhavī atyantam iti jaḍājaḍayorna kenacidaṃśena sārūpyamityāha | tathā coktam -- `ekadeśena sārūpya sarvaṃ syāt sarvavedanam | sarvātmanā tu sārūpye jñānamajñānatāṃ vrajet || iti || 9 ||
athavā saṃbhavidharmācchuritaṃ vijñānaṃ viśuddhabodhasvabhāvamapyavidyāyāṃ vyavahāre'vabhāsata iti iṣṭaṃ nidarśanāntaramāha | tathā vikārarūpāṇāṃ tattve'tyantamasaṃbhavaḥ | tadātmeva ca tattattvamatyantamatadātmakam || 10 ||
 sāṃkhyābhimatamavikṛtaṃ pradhānattvaṃ sarvavikāragranthi bījāvasthamabhinnamanuprasṛṣṭameva mahadādivikārarūpaiḥ paramārthataḥ | taddhi mahadādivikāraśaktiyuktaṃ guṇasāmyāvasthātmakaṃ guṇavaiṣamyavimardavaśopajāyamānavikāranānātvādvilakṣaṇameva | atha ca vyavahāre mahadādivikārarūpāvadhāraṇena vinā tadupalaṃbhāsaṃbhava iti sarvadarśaneṣvavidyānvayinī | evamasatyākāropadhānena tattvapratibhāsaḥ siddha iti sādhyānvayo gṛhītaḥ || 10 ||
kathaṃ punaretadavagamyate ākārā asatyāḥ, tato'nyat satyamityāha | satyamākṛtisaṃhāre yadante vyavatiṣṭhate | tannityaṃ śabdavācyaṃ tacchabdatattvaṃ na bhidyate || 11 ||
 `tadeva hi nityaṃ yasmiṃstattvaṃ na vihanyate' iti bhāṣyānusāreṇaitaducyate | tathā hi tatroktam | `kanakamityeva satyaṃ punaraparayākṛtyā yuktaṃ khadirāṅgārasavarṇe suvarṇakuṇḍale bhavataḥ' ityanenaiva dṛṣṭāntena vikārāpekṣayā bhinnasya brahmaṇaḥ satyatocyate | yathā hi tatra rucakādyākāropamardena suvarṇamityeva satyam, evamanantavikāragrāmāpāye sarvānte'vatiṣṭhamānamanapāyi brahmarūpaṃ satyaṃ tadeva ca bhāvato nityam | āpekṣikaṃ tu jātyādīnāṃ vyavahāre nityatvamucyate | tathā hi vyak‌tyapāye jātiravatiṣṭhamānā gotvādikā nityā | tatrāpyaśvatvādibhedatyāge pṛthivītyeva satyam | tatrāpyapūtvādibhedāpāye vastityeva satyaṃ sarvanāmapratyāyyam | tatrāpi saṃvidrūpasyānapāyino'nugamād viṣayākāraviveke tadeva pāramārthikaṃ satyamiti netinetyupāsīteti bhāvanāya codyate | saṃvicca paśyantīrūpā parā vāk śabdabrahmamayīti brahmatattvaṃ śabdāt pāramārthikānna bhidyate | vivartadaśāyāṃ tu vaikharyātmanā bhedaḥ | tatra ca tadeva nityaṃ jātyādirūpeṇa śabdavācyam | tatrāpyāntaropādānaviśrāntyā vācakatvasya vyavasthāpanāt svarūpāntargatasyārthasya vācyatvād vācyavācakayoravibhāgaḥ siddha iti prathamakāṇḍe nirṇītam | ata evānantaramihābhidhāsyati `tasya śabdārthasaṃbandharūpamekasya dṛśyate" iti || 11 ||
yaduktaṃ `tadātmeva ca tattattvamatyantamatadātmakam' iti tatrātyantamatadātmatāṃ tāvad vyācaṣṭe | na tadasti na tannāsti na tadekaṃ na tat pṛthak | na saṃsṛṣṭaṃ vibhaktaṃ vā vikṛtaṃ na ca nānyathā || 12 ||
 vaikārikasarvavyavahārātītatvāt pāramārthikena rūpeṇa vikārātmakaṃ tattvaṃ na bhavati | tathā hi | asti iti na śakyate vyavahartum | sattvopādhikasya svarūpasya tattvasvarūpāyogāt tenātmanā vyavahārānavatārāt | nāpi nāsti iti, abhāvopādhikasyāpyatathātvāt pramāṇena bhāvātmakasya tattvasyācoditatvāt | ekasaṃkhyopādhīyamānasvarūpaviśeṣaṃ tattvaṃ na bhavati | nirūpādhinaḥ tattvasya vastuto'bhinnatvāt | tathā caikamityapratīteḥ | nāpi pṛthak‌tvāhitaviśeṣam, tadbhinnasyāsatyatvāt | nāpi saṃsargopādhikam, vibhāgopādhikaṃ vā, tato dvitīyasya pramāṇenānupapatteḥ, kuto'bhinnaṃ vibhaktaṃ ca kena vā saṃsṛṣṭa syāt | pariṇāmaniṣedhena vivartābhyupagamānna vikṛtam | anekābhāvagrāmarūpatayā cādbhutayā vṛttyā vivartanādavikṛtamutyapi na śakyate vyavahartumiti sarvavyapadeśātītaṃ tattvaṃ paraṃ brahma || 12 ||
atha ca tadātmaivāvidyāyāmavadhāryata ityāha | tannāsti vidyate tacca tadekaṃ tat pṛthak pṛthak | saṃsṛṣṭaṃ ca vibhaktaṃ ca vikṛtaṃ tattadanyathā || 13 ||
 bhāvābhāvavikārāvabhāsajananaśakti tadevāsti nāstīti ca sattāsattopādhikavyavahārasahaṃ bhāvatastu niḥsattāsattaṃ niḥsadasat paraṃ brahma | vyāvahārikaṃ caikānekavyavahāraṃ jātivyak‌tyātmanā tadeva vartata iti saṃkhyopādhikamapi ca | evaṃ saṃyogopādhikamapi, anyasaṃsargitayāvabhāsanāt | evaṃ vivekāvasāyastatra | tathā samastavikārātmanā janyamānamivākāśādyātmanā kūṭasthatayā tadevāvabhāsata iti tadātmaiva tattvamityuktam || 13 ||
evaṃ ca kṛtvā sarvasya tanmayatvādvirodhino'pi vyavahārāstatraivopalīyanta ityāha | tasya śabdārthasaṃbandharūpamekasya dṛśyate | tad dṛśyaṃ darśanaṃ draṣṭā darśane ca prayojanam || 14 ||
 vācyavācakasaṃbandhānāṃ bhāvato'dvayarūpatā | tatra hyāntare tattve śrutyarthaśaktī saṃsṛjyete iti vivartadaśāyāṃ śrutyarthaśākhātmanā tasyaiva vikāsādvācyavācakarūpatayā bhedāvabhāsau, jñānajñeyarūpatayaivāvidyeti brahmakāṇḍa eva prapaṃcenāyamartho'smābhinirṇīta iti tata evāvadhāryam | draṣṭṛdṛśyarūpatayā ca tasyaiva vivartaḥ | tathā hi dṛśyaṃ tāvadbhāvajātaṃ saṃvidrūpārūḍham | vedyamānaikatvādeva vedanaikaparamārtham, aprakāśasya prakāśamānatāyogāt iti pūrvakāṇḍe advayasiddhau ca vitatya vicāritam | draṣṭāpi jīvātmā avidyākṛtāvacchedo niyataḥ saṃsārī bhoktā brahmaiva cetanatvādbhāvato bhedānupapatteriti tatraivāveditam | anena ca pradhānakartṛkarmarūpakārakanirdeśena kārakāntarasyāpyākṣepāt siddharūpo vivartaḥ pratipāditaḥ | darśanaśabdena ca pradhānakriyānirdeśakena kriyāntarasyākṣepāt sādhyasvabhāvakriyāvivarto'pyuktaḥ | kālaśak‌tyavacchinno hi kriyāvivartaḥ | dik‌cchaktyavacchinnaśca mūrtivivarta iti mūrtikriyāvivartarūpaṃ viśvaṃ pratipāditam | prayojanaśabdena ca samastakriyāphalanirdeśa iti sādhyāsādhanaphalarūpatayā viśvasaṃkalanāyāmaśeṣavivartānuguṇyaṃ brahmaṇaḥ pratipāditam | etacca ekasya sarvabījasya yasya ceyamanekadhā | bhoktṛbhoktavyarūpeṇa bhogarūpeṇa ca sthitiḥ || iti brahmakāṇḍe pratipāditam | tatraiva ca satattvanirṇayo'smābhirabhyadhāyi | prakhyopākhyātmakatvācca vyavahārasya dvitve śabdārthasaṃbandharūpaṃ tad dṛśyaṃ darśanaṃ ceti bhedenātra nirdeśaḥ | etaccāvidyamayaṃ rūpaṃ kathyate | pāramārthikantu praśāntaprapaṃcarūpaṃ vakṣyati | yatra draṣṭā ca dṛśyaṃ ca darśanaṃ cāvikalpitam | tasyaivārthasya satyatvaṃ śritāstrayyantavedinaḥ || iti || 14 ||
uktamidam `ākṛtisaṃhāre'nte yadavitaṣṭhate tatsatyam' iti | tatraitat syāt | ante na kiṃcidavatiṣṭhate | asadapadamevaitadviśvamāvirbhavatītyāśaṅkyāpi hetunābhinnakāramapūrvakatvamanvayamukhena dṛṣṭāntopakramaṃ sādhayitumāha | vikārāpagame satyaṃ suvarṇaṃ kuṇḍale yathā | vikārāpagame satyāṃ tathāhuḥ prakṛtiṃ parām || 15 ||
 kuṇḍalāvasthātmakavikārāpāye kuṇḍale suvarṇamekaṃ satyamavatiṣṭhate yathā tathā pṛthivyādivikāravigame'nvayinī prakṛtirabhinnā satyāvatiṣṭhate ityupeyam | āhuriti āgamapramāṇasiddhatāṃ dhvanayati brahmaṇaḥ | tathā coktam | `ekameva yadāmnātam' iti | `ātmaivedaṃ satyam' | iti hi śrutiḥ | upodbavanamātraṃ cānumānam | tathā hi | nirupākhyādasato'padādvikāraprādurbhāvo na yuktaḥ | abhāvasya bhāvarūpatvavirodhāt | na hi śaśaśṛṅgātkasyacidudbhavo dṛśyate | asti ca vijñānarūpatayā jagatyanvaya iti tatpūrvakamevaitat | tathā ca vakṣyati | "nābhāvo jāyate bhāvo naiti bhāvo'nupākhyatām" iti | tasya cidrūpasya cicchaktirapariṇāminīti vikārābhāvānnedaṃ sāṃkhyanayavatpariṇāmadarśanam, api tu vivartapakṣaḥ | viśeṣaścānayorvākyapadīye'smābhirvyākhyāta iti tata evāvadhāryam | ihāpi saṃbandhasamuddeśe vakṣyate | kāraṇāntaravyudāsaścādvayasiddhāvabhihita iti satyarthitve tata evāvagantavyaḥ || 15 ||
vācyā sā sarvaśabdānāṃ śabdāśca na pṛthak tataḥ | apṛthak‌tve ca saṃbandhastayornānātmanoriva || 16 ||
 tattadupādhiparikalpitabhedabahulatayā vyavahārasyāvidyābhūyastve pratiniyatākāropādhīyamānarūpabhedaṃ brahmaiva sarvaśabdaviṣaya ityukto'rthaḥ | ātmā, brahma, tattvam, ityādayo'pi hi śabdāḥ samavalaṃbitopādhayo'pi dravyātmānamanu parivartante | nirupādino vāg‌viṣayātītatvāt | vāṅmanasātītaṃ hi tattvamityupadiśanti brahmavidaḥ | ghaṭādiśabdāpekṣayā tvātmādiśabdāḥ pratyāsannāḥ | sarvasya ca tanmayatvācchabdā api tadātmakaḥ yathāvibhaktaṃ prāk | abhede'pi ca pāramārthike sāṃvṛto lokayātrāyāṃ bhedo'satya itīvaśabdaḥ | ata eva dviṣṭhasaṃbandhopapattiḥ || 16 ||
nanu cendrajālamidaṃ yadavadhṛtarūpabhedānāmapi bhāvānāmanādṛtya tattvamanavasīyamānābhedaparamārthopadeśanamutyāśaṅkya dṛṣṭāntenaitat sādhayitumāha | ātmā paraḥ priyo dveṣyo vaktā vācyaṃ prayojanam | viruddhāni yathaikasya svapne rūpāṇi cetasaḥ || 17 ||
ajanmani tathā nitye paurvāparyavivarjite | tattve janmādirūpatvaṃ viruddhamupalabhyate || 18 ||
 svapnāvasthāgataḥ prapaṃco jāgarayā bādhyamānatvādasatya iti sarvavādyabhyupagamaḥ | tenaiva dṛṣṭāntena jāgarāyāmapi bhāvabhedasturīyadaśāyāmananuvṛtterasatyo'vasthāpyate | yatkila sarvāvasthāsvanugataṃ tadeva satyam | tacca saṃvinmātrarūpamabādhyamānam | avasthābhedastvāgamāpāyitvādbādhito'san sukhaduḥkhādivat | tathā hi rāgādayaḥ sukhādayaścāsvabhāvatvāt saṃvinmātrarūpaṃ na vikurvanti | tathāvasthābhedo'pyanekākārakāluṣyopahṛtaḥ| tatra svapne viruddhākārollekho vaikalpikī dṛṣṭiḥ pratipramātṛniyatā | vaikalpiko hi manovyāpārānusārī saṃsārī bhoktā, sa ca bhāvataścotanatvād brahmeva | tathā ca tāvati svātantryān nirmitāvīśvaro'nanyopādānāt bhāvānābhāsyopabhuṅ‌kte priyāpriyarūpatayā rāgadveṣādimayena saṃsāramohena svaparavibhāgānusārī parasaṃkathādiṣu | tadāhuḥ vedāntatatattvanipuṇāḥ | pravibhajyātmanātmanaṃ sṛṣṭavā bhāvān pṛthagvidhān | sraveśvaraḥ sarvamayaḥ svapne bhoktā pravartate || iti | bhokteti vacanāt pratyagātmasṛṣṭiriyamuktā | tasya ca sarveśvaratvāt brahmarūpatve sṛṣṭisāmarthyamuktam | sarvamayatvāccānanyopādānavicitrabhāvaracanāmātmopādānamāhuḥ | ata eva pravibhajyātmanātmānamiti kartṛkarmabhedābhāvācca vaikalpikatvamasyāḥ sṛrṣṭeḥ sphuṭamuktam | bāhyopādānā tu jāgarāyāmaiśvarī sṛṣṭirviśvaśabdāvācyā sarvapramātṛsādhāraṇī | sthiratvāsthiratvagrahāveṣanimittastu bhedaḥ | avidyāpravṛttacirūpatvāt punarasatyatā samānaiva | kevalaṃ satyāmavidyāyāmaparo mohaścicchakterāvārako nidrā nāma | tadvaśādatraiva bhrāntatvābhimāno'rvāgdṛśām | paramārthadṛśāṃ tu jananamaraṇarahite'pravibhakte kūṭasthe parasmin brahmaṇi cidānandarūpe sarvameva jagajjāgratsvapnādyavasthāgataṃ mūrtikiyāvivartarūpamasatyam | anvayicitsāmānyaṃmātraṃ tu paramārtha iti siddham | viruddhamupalabhyate iti vadannavidyāyāṃ virodhamabhyupaiti | etadeva hyavidyāyāḥ svarūpaṃ yadanupapadyamānamapyābhāsopagamaṃ nayati, upapannatve vidyaiva syāt | tasmādasatyaprapaṃcaprakāśanaśaktirbrahmaṇo'nādisiddhā grāhyagrāhakayugalaṃ svānurūpamāparacayya jagannāṭyamātanotītyavicāritaramaṇīyāmimāmapanayanti tattvadṛśaḥ || 17-18 ||
iti bhūtirājatanayahelārājakṛte prakīrṇaprakāśe dravyasamuddeśo nāma dvitīyaḥ || ---------- 3.3ḥ sambandhasamuddeśaḥ --------------  samuddeśadvayena jātidravye darśanabhedena śabdārthamavasthāpya śabdenārthasyābhidhāne saṃbandho hetuḥ, anyathā sarvaṃ sarveṇa pratyāyyeteti tatra saṃbandhaṃ pratipādayitumāha-- jñānaṃ prayokturbāhyo'rthaḥ svarūpaṃ ca pratīyate | śabdairuccaritaistaiṣāṃ saṃbandhaḥ samavasthitaḥ || 1 ||
 prayogoṇābhijvalitaiḥ śabdaistritayamavagamyate-ātmīyaṃ rūpam, arthaśca phalasādhanaḥ, prayokturabhiprāyaśca na caitadasati saṃbandhe niyamena ghaṭata iti vāstavasaṃbandhāvasāyo na sāmayikaḥ śabdārthayoḥ saṃbandhaḥ, amidhāniyamanādanādeḥ | ata eva samavasthita ityāha | svabhāvata eva nirūḍho na tu puruṣeṇa niveśita ityarthaḥ |  tatra svarūpamantaraṅgabhidheyamiti tena mukhyasaṃbandho'midhānaniyamaḥ | ata evānyathāpi pāṭhakrame sāmarthyāt svarūpe prathamaṃ pratipattirvibhajanīyā tato'dhyastasvarūpe'rthakriyākāriṇītyābhyāmarthasvarūpābhyāṃ śabdasya vācyavācakasaṃbandhaḥ prayotkrabhiprāyeṇa tu saha kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ |  nanu ca vācyāvācakabhāvalakṣamaḥ saṃbandhaḥ prastutaḥ | tatra kaḥ prasaṅgo jñānasvarūpayoḥ satyam | sarvapārṣadaṃ punaridaṃ śāstramiti ye bāhyasyārthasya śabdavācyatvaṃ necchanti tanmatopasaṅgrahārthaṃ vaktrabhiprāyārūḍhasyaiva śabdārthatve tatra kāryakāramasaṃbandhamāha |  yathāhuḥ-- vaktrṛvyāpāraviṣayo yo'rtho buddhau prakāśate | prāmāṇyaṃ tatra śabdasya nārthatattvanibandhanam || iti | ata eva dvividhaḥ saṃbandhapadārtho vyavatiṣṭhate, yogyatā kāryakāraṇabhāvaśca | adhyāsastu dvayorapi paramārtha eva, na pṛthagrūpaḥ || 1 ||
 yathā cehopacārasattāsamāviṣṭaṃ vastu śabdārthaṃ vakṣyati tathā kāryakāraṇabhāvo'pi saṃbandhaḥ svarūpasya tu mukhyameva vācyatvamityāha-- pratipattirbhavatyarthe jñāne vā saṃśayaḥ kvacit | svarūpeṣūpalabdheṣu vyabhicāro na vidyate || 2 ||
 ayaṃ gaurayamartha iti śabdārthayorabhedāvabhāsanāt svarūpamabhidaghadeva śabdo'rthamabhidhatta iti niścayite | svarūpāvivekenaiva hyarthaparāmarśo'bhidhānamucyate | vṛddhavyavahārāttathaiva saṃbandhavyutpatteḥ | tathā hi ayaṃ gauriti saṅketaḥ kriyate, bhedenaiva ghaṭaśabdasyāyamartha iti tu vyākhyātṛbhūmirna vyavahāradaśā atrāpi cāyamiti śabdābheda eva | yadā gaurityucyate tadāyaṃ sāsnādimānartho boddhavya ityapyayamityabhedenaiva parāmarśe saṅketapravṛttiḥ vyavahāraphalo hi saṅketaḥ | yathā ca laukike vyavahāre pratītistathāsau nyāyyaḥ | abhedena ca tatra pratītiḥ |  pratītau hi kiñcittaṭasthameva tāmananupraviśadevopāyamātraṃ dṛṣṭaṃ yathendriyam | kiñcit punastatrānupraviśadeva pratītiṃ janayad vyadhikaraṇaṃ bhavati daṇḍa iva, yathā dhūmādi liṅgam | śabdastu na janakatāmātreṇārthapratītau saṃbandhamanubhavati, api tu tatrārthaḥ śabd‌yamānaḥ śabdamaya evāvabhāti | tādṛśā eva hi sa pratītisvabhāvaḥ | rūḍhatvācca na bhramaḥ |  nanu na varṇamālārthe samupalabhyate | darśanānabhijño devānāṃpriyaḥ | iha śabdo nāma vācakaḥ sa ucyate yo'yaṃ cicchaktervāgātmā vyāpāraḥ śabdanāparaparyāyo'brūyamāṇo'pyupāṃśuprayoge śabda iti vyavahriyate yataḥ | tasya ca prathamamudbhidyamānāvasthasyāvibhāgāpannaśabdārthamayasvabhāvasya paravāgātmanā svarūpeṇāvasthānam | paratastu prāṇavṛttyanuprāṇitamanobhūmisamavalamvitanijasvabhāvasya vācyavācakarūpabhinnaśākādvayāvalambinaḥ samavasthānam |  asyāṃ ca madhyamāvasthāyāṃ parāmarśanātmā vācakaḥ śabdo'bhinnacaitanyodrekātmikāṃ paravāgasthāmatyajanneva svarūpavācyamukhena tatsaṃbhinnamarthaṃ parāmṛśati sāmānādhikaraṇyena, gaurayamartha iti | tathā ca sa vācyo'rtho vācakādhyāsavānucyate | tadanu ca sa eva paramarśakaḥ śabdaḥ pūrvāvasthāvaṣṭambhenaiva sthānakaraṇābhihananātmāvasthopārūḍhaḥ śravaṇaviṣayatāyogyenātmanā vibhinnavācyavācakarūpatayā vyaktimāsādayan sphuṭībhavatītyetāvatī śabdavyāptiḥ | tataśca paravāgrūpaniṣpandātmakasyāsya śabdasya tdarūpānugamācchabdanātmakavyāpārarūpasya svasāmānādhikaraṇyenārtharūpaśabdanādabhedenaivaikayā vṛttyā svarūpaviśeṣeṇa viśiṣṭamarthābhidhānamavatiṣṭhate | tadyathā śuklaḥ paṭo'yamiti śuklaguṇacchuraṇayā sakṛdeva viśeṣyapaṭapratyavamarśaḥ | na hyatra śuklaguṇasya pṛthak parāmarśaḥ | evaṃ ghaṭo'yamiti pradhānabhūtaviśeṣyānupraveśenaiva ghaṭasvarūpaparāmarśa ityekaiveyaṃ śabdanātmikā pratītiḥ śabdārthayoḥ |  kvacittu svarūpa eva viśrāntiḥ, tadyathā-`agnimantodāttamadhīṣva,'`agnerḍhak' ityādau | atra hyanukāryaṃ svarūpameva prādhānyenāvasthitam | bāhyārthapratipipādayiṣāyāṃ tu svarūpārthayoḥ sambhedenaivāvabhāsa iti na pṛthak svarūpapavimarśaḥ, api tu sa etasyāpi yatastadabhedabhājo'rthasya | ghaṭa iti hi ghaṭaśabdenārthavat svarūpabhidhayaiva viṣayīkriyate | jñānaśabdapradīpāstrayo hi prakāśā yenaiva prakāśena paraṃ prakāśayanti tenaivātmānamapi | tathā ca jñānamarthaṃ prakāśayati prathayati tathaivātmānamapi prakāśayati | evaṃ pradīpo rūpabhāsayannātmānamapyābhāsaviṣayabhāvopagamanena prakāśayati |  tathā śabdo'pi vācako'rthamabhidhīyamānatayā prakāśayannātmānamabhidhayaiva prakāśayatītyucitam | na tu śrotrendriyaviṣayabhāvopagamanena arthasāmānādhikaraṇyāpannaṃ ca svarūpamarthavat parāmṛśyamānaṃ śabdasyābhidhānaviṣayo'bhidheyam | na tu vācakatāyāmabhidhīyamānatāsti, paramārśasya paravagātmanaḥ kartṛbhūbhyupārūḍhasya prakāśasya vācakatvāt tatra ca parāmṛśyamānātmakavācyatāvirodhātā tathā cāha-- na ca vācakarūpeṇa pravṛttasyāsti vācyatā | iti |  evaṃ ca kṛtvā sarvaghaṭaśabdasādhāraṇaṃ sāmānyarūpamarthapakṣanikṣiptamarthasamānādhikaraṇaṃ svarūpamasya vācyam | arthavattatsāmānādhikaraṇyāt, tatrāpi tathā pratīteḥ, sāmānyarūpa eva ca saṅketopapatteḥ tenaivārthasya sāmānādhikaraṇyāt, tathaiva ca vyavahāre śrotrā pratīteḥ, tadanusāreṇaiva pratipādyapratipādakabhāvārthamekaparāmarśāvasthitau saṅketopapatteḥ ata evaca svābhiprāyānusāreṇa śrotrā vaktṛjñānasyānumānāt svayaṃ śabdasvarūpādhyastamarthamavabudhya tathaiva vaktaryanumānamucitamityabhedenaiva ghaṭaśabdādhyastaṃ prayoktṛjñānamavasīyate | tathā ca jñānamapyadhyāsenaiva śabdaḥ pratipādayati vaktravagatamiti tatrāpi paramārthadṛśādhyāsa eva sabandhaḥ |  lolībhūtāni śabdārthajñānāni ghaṭa ityevamavagamyante | yathoktam-- na so'sti pratyaya.... .... ityādi | ata eva gaurityatra kaḥ śabdaḥ iti praśnaḥ | tadaharjātasyapyāyamastyeva śabdasaṃbhedaḥ | saṅketasahatvāt | evaṃ ca kṛtvā tātparyadṛśādhyāsa eva yogyatāyāṃ kāryakāraṇabhāve ca phalataḥ saṃbandhayo'vatiṣṭhata iti sa eva mukhyaḥ | jñānasyaiva ca parasparasaṅkrāntirvyavahāra iti śabdena svarūpādhyastaṃ jñānamapi pratipādyate paratreti tadapi tasyābhidhayaiva pratipādyamupapadyate | ghaṭamānayeti niyukto ghaṭānayane'hamanena preṣita iti śabdapūrvakameva pratipadyate | tadāha vārtikakāraḥ-- na vā śabdapūrvako hyarthe sampratyayaḥ | iti |  tadevaṃ śabdanātmakena vyāpāreṇa paravāgātmano vyavahāre pravṛtte prakāśasya tajjīvitatvādekaśabdanānupraveśācchabdārthayoḥ sāmanādhikaraṇyādabhedādhyāsāravyasaṃbandhaviṣayatā siddhā | avibhāgadaśāyāṃ tu paśyantyabhidhānāyāṃ vācyavācakabhedānullāsānnādhyāsacintā kācit itthaṃ ca kṛtvā śabdaikajīvitatvād vyavahāre'pyarthasya tadaviyogāttadvivarttarūpaṃ viśvaṃ siddhamityāstāmetat, pūrvameva saṃprapacamasyārthasya nirūpitatvāt |  tatrāntaṅgatvādaheyatvādasādhāraṇatvācca svarūpaṃ mukhyamabhidheyam | tatra hi saṅketānapekṣā śabdasya vṛttiḥ | tacca jātyādipakṣabhedena brahmakāṇḍe nirūpitam | abhidhānābhidheyanimittabhedācca bhinnarūpamiti svarūpeṣu ityāha | tathā hi-kāra-ṇasanniveśi vācakam, svarūpamarthapakṣanikṣiptaṃ bāhyābhedena sañcetyamānaṃ vācyam, saṃbandhasavedanasamayānubhūtamabhinnaśrutiviṣayaniyāmakatvādarthe pravṛttinimittamiti tritayaṃ sarvatrāvyabhicāri | vyavahārābhyāsācchutisāmyācca naitatritayaṃ vivekenāvadhāryate | śrutyaviśeṣācca tatsvarūpamiti vyavahriyate na tu sarvathaivāvibhedāt | apravṛttasaṅketasya arthe tyayamapi vakatṛjñānaviṣayaḥ sandeho jāyata evāpravṛttasaṅketasyāpyakṣādisāmānyaśabdādeva cākṣādau sandeho na tu svarūpa iti siddham || 2 ||
 saṃbandhaḥ samavasthitaḥ svabhāvata eva nirūḍhaḥ, na tu sāmayikā ityuktam | tasya sadbhāve liṅgamāha | asyāyaṃ vācako vācya iti ṣaṣṭhyā pratīyate | yogaḥ śabdārthayostattvamityato vyapadiśyate || 3 ||
 asyārthasyāyaṃ śabdo vācako'sya śabdasyāyamartho vācya iti ṣaṣṭhyanyathānupapattyāstyeva svabhāvikaḥ śabdārthayoryoga ityavasīmate | asaṃbaddhānāṃ ghaṭapaṭādīnāmevamanyonyāpāratantryeṇa vyavahārāyogāt | ata eva ca svābhāvikāt ghaṭapaṭadīnāmevamanyonyapāratantryeṇa vyavahārāyogāt | ata eva ca svābhāvikāt saṃbandhācchabdārthayostattvaṃ gaurayamartha ityabhedena vyavahriyata ityarthaḥ | yadi vā ataḥ ṣaṣṭhyāḥ sakāśāttattvaṃ svarūpaṃ saṃbandhasyocyate || 3 ||
nanu ṣaṣṭhī saṃbandhasya kāryam, svarūpaniveśi tu lakṣaṇamucyatāmityāśaṅkyāha-- nābhidhānaṃ svadharmeṇa saṃbandhasyāsti vācakam | atyantaparatantratvādrūpaṃ nāsyāpadiśyate || 4 ||
 iha padārthānāṃ svarūpamavadhārya tadanugāmiśabdaniveśena lakṣaṇaṃ kriyate | tatra svena asādhāraṇe dharmeṇa svabhāvenopalakṣitasya vācakaṃ pratyāyakam, abhidhānaṃ ṣaṣṭhīvyatiriktaṃ nāsti, idaṃtayā svarūpānavadhāraṇāt | guṇā dravyādhīnā api prādhānyena śukladiśabdena kadāciducyante, naivaṃ saṃbandha iti atyanta grahaṇam | nityaparatantro hi saṃbandhaḥ paropādhisvarūpaḥ saṃbandhino parasparaunmukhyasvabhāvo dharmamātralakṣaṇaḥ | tato niṣkṛṣya saṃbandhaśabdena svapradhānaḥ saṃbandhirūpatayābhidhīyamāno na sākṣāt spraṣṭaṃ śakyata ityasaṃvijñānapadaḥ kāryaikagamyaḥ || 4 ||
tadāha-- upakārātsa yatrāsti dharmastatrānugamyate | śaktīnāmapi sā śaktirguṇānāmapyasau guṇaḥ || 5 ||
 upakāryopakārakayorupakāraprabhāvitaḥ saṃbandho'saṃbaddhānāmupakārābhāvāt | dharma iti nityapāratantryamāha | dharmitve svātantryāt saṃbandhāntaraprāpteranavasthāpātāt | na ca śaktireva saṃbandhaḥ, śaktīnāmapyādhārapārataṃtrye niyatakāryajanane ca saṃbandha eva niyāmako yataḥ, guṇanāmapi ca dravyāśritatvāsthāpakaḥ saṃbandha eveti paratantrāṇāmapyupakārakatvāt sarvatrānumīyamānasvarūpo nityaparatantraḥ || 5 ||
nanūkta eva saṃyogasamavāyalakṣaṇaḥ saṃbandhaḥ parairiti ko'tiśyastapratipādana ityāśaṅkyāha-- taddharmaṇostu tācchabdyaṃ saṃyogasamavāyayoḥ | tayorapyupakārārthā niyatāstadupādhayaḥ || 6 ||
 pāratantryaṃ saṃbandhalakṣaṇamiti saṃyogasamavāyayordravyaguṇādiṣu tattvāt saṃbandhaśabdapravṛttiḥ| tasya saṃbandhasyeva dharmaḥ pāratantryalakṣaṇo yayostau taddharmāṇau | svarūpamātreṇa hi tau saṃbandhamanukurutaḥ | tathā ca tasya saṃbandhasyeva śabdastayoḥ, gauṇaḥ saṃbandhaśabdaḥ saṃyogasamavāyayoḥ, na tu mukhyatastāveva saṃbandhaḥ | tathā hi-yadā svatantrapadārthantaravat tayorapi svagatopādhivivakṣā tadā tadupakriyamāṇatvātsvātantrye sati pāratantryābhāvāt svatantrapadārthavat saṃbandharūpatāhāniḥ | upakārārthā upakāraprayojanāḥ | niyatadā asādhāraṇāḥ | tadupādhaya iti | saṃbandhasya upādhiryeṣām, asaṃbandhānāmaniyāmakatvāt | itthaṃ copādhimantau svatantrau yau, yayoścopādhyavacchede saṃbandha upayogī, tau saṃyogasamavāyau kathamupādhirūpeṇa paratantreṇa saṃbandhanaikātmyaṃ bhajetāmiti svāśraye saṃbandhipratītihetutvāt saṃbandhasadharmāṇau tau || 6 ||
tatra saṃyogasya tāvadupādhayaḥ | kācideva hi sāvasthā kāryaprasavasūcitā | kasyācit kenacidyasyāṃ saṃyoga upajāyate || 7 ||
 parasparasaṃyogenāvayavānāmupasarpaṇapratyayāhitenāvayavi dravyaṃ jāyata ityasamavāyikāraṇaṃ saṃyogo'vayavyanyathānupapattyāvasīyate | tathā ca dravyaikaniyatatvaṃ guṇatvena sattāsaṃbandhaḥ saṃyogastenopādhiriti tatropakāraḥ saṃbandhena tasyāvacchidyate | yatparatantraśca saṃyogastenopādhinā saṃbandhānugṛhītenāvacchidyata iti pāratantryaṃ nāma saṃbandhasāmānyarūpamasyānvayi na tu tadekajīvitaṃ pāratantryam asya guṇakarmasāmānyādāvapi bhāvādasya ca dravyaikaniyatatvāt | kiṃ ca saṃyogasya guṇatvāt saṃbandho guṇatvasaṃyogatvasaṃbandhaśca na padārthasaṃbandhasya sarvapadārthopakārasya tadyogo dravyaguṇakarmabhyo'nyatvāt | vastubhūtakāryakāritvaṃ ca saṃyogasya, yojanāmātrahetustu saṃbandha iti bhedaḥ | samavāyādapi saṃbandhasya bhedaṃ niyatopādiniyamitasamavāyasvarūpānuvādenāha-- nirātmakānāmutpattau niyamaḥ kvacideva yaḥ | tenaivāvyapavargaśca prāptyabhede sa yatkṛtaḥ || 8 ||
ātmāntarasya yenātmā tadātmevāvadhāryate | yataścaikasya nānātvaṃ tattvaṃ nādhyavasīyate || 9 ||
tāṃ śaktiṃ samavāyākhyāṃ śaktīnāmupakāriṇīm | bhedābhedāvatikrāntāmanyathaiva vyavasthitām || 10 ||
dharmaṃ sarvapadārthānāmatītaḥ sarvalakṣaṇaḥ | anugṛhṇāti saṃbandha iti pūrvebhya āgamaḥ || 11 ||
 satkāryavāde kāraṇameva kāryaṃ bhavatīti pratiniyataiḥ śabdaistajjanyata iti tatraiva tadupalaṃbho yuktaḥ | asatkāryanaye tu niyateṣveva kāraṇeṣu kāryam, tantaṣveva paṭaḥ, kapāleṣveva ghaṭa ityādibuddhihetuḥ samavāyo'bhyupagataḥ | satyapi ca bhede kāryakāraṇayoḥ tenaiva niyamaviṣayeṇa kāraṇenaiva kāryasyāviyogo deśakālabhedāt prāpteḥ saṃbandharūpatāyāḥ saṃyogena sahāviśeṣe'pi samavāyakṛtaḥ | tathā ca saṃyogāt samavāyasya bhedaḥ | ata eva kāryakāramayoravayavāvayavinordharmadharmiṇorjātitadvatorguṇaguṇinora padārthāntaratve'pi tādātmyenāvamāsaḥ | yathāyogaṃ svagataviśeṣasadbhāvāttu tādātmyamatattvamiti iva-śabdaḥ | tenaivāvyapavarga ityuktasyaivedaṃ phalakathanamiti na paunaruk‌tyam | avyapavargādeva hyanyasyātmanāvabhāsaḥ | ata eva pravādināṃ vimatiḥ, avayavāvayaninordharmardhārmaṇoścaikatvaṃ kecidicchanti kecinnānātvamiti samavāyavyāmohādapi paramārthato na vyavatiṣṭhate | anena cāyutasiddhiḥ samavāyaspopādhiruktaḥ |  evamayutasiddhānāmihapratyayahetuḥ samavāyo nānyeṣāmityayaṃ niyamaḥ saṃbandhenasamavāyasyāvedyate | yatraiva hi pāratantryamasya tatravaihabuddhimabhedamiva ca prakalpayati dravyaguṇakarmasāmānyeṣu śaktayo'pi vādhārapāratantryeṇa tena niyamyante | samavāyiṣviva ca samavāyasyāpi bhedastebhyo nāvadhāryate | saṃmūrchitarūpatvenāvabhāsāt | iha pratyayakāryavaśāttvanumīyate satattvataḥ saṃbandhivyatirekeṇetyevaṃ paraprasiddham | yena iti samavāyamanūdya tāṃ śaktimiti śaktitvamasya vidhatte| anugrāhakatvena padānāmasya taistulyakakṣatayā nirdeśānupapattirityarthaḥ | śaktitvādeva ca bhedābhedāvatikrāntatvam | tattvanyatatvābhyāmanirvācyā hi śaktayaḥ | tathoktam-- śaktīnāṃ vasturūpatve tattvānyatvavicāraṇā | yujyate kalpitānāṃ tu yuktādvayaviyuktatā || iti |  tathā hi-samavāyisammūrcchitatvenāvabhāsānna tato bhinnā nāpyabhinnā | āśrayāsaṃbhavinaḥ kāryasyehapratyayalakṣaṇasya jananāditi tattvānyattvābhyāmanirvācyatā | ataśca anyathaiva padārthavailakṣaṇyeneyamavasthitā | yadi vehapratyayakāryasyābhedātsvato'bhinnā, tasyaiva tu samavāyiprakalpitabhedatvādbhinnāpītyevamekāpi satī saṃbandhinānātvātkalpitabhedeti anyathā vyavasthitā | sādhanādiśaktīnāṃ cāśrayāvasthānena upakāriṇī | tadevaṃrūpāmapi samavāyākhyāṃ śaktiṃ sarvapadārthagatasvādhīnatvalakṣaṇaṃ dharmamatikrānto nityapāratantryalakṣaṇo'ta evopakārāpekṣaṃ sarvaṃ vastu lakṣaṇaṃ jñāpakamasya na samavāyasyeva pratiniyataṃ saṃbandhirūpamevetyevaṃrūpaḥ saṃbandho'nugṛhṇāti niyamayati, paratantre evāyutasiddhe'vasthāpayati, pāratantryasāmānyāt svavyapadeśaṃ ca niveśayatītyāgamajñāḥ saṃbandhalakṣaṇaṃ pāratantryamāhuḥ | evaṃvidhakāryakārī saṃbandho nāma padārthavilakṣaṇa ityāgamena draḍhayati || 9-11 ||
evaṃ ca kṛtvā saṃyogasamavāyāveva neha saṃbandhau yathānyeṣāṃ darśanamityāha-- padārthīkṛta evānyaiḥ sarvatrābhyupagamyate | saṃbandhastena śabdārthaḥ pravibhaktuṃ na śakyate || 12 ||
 ṣaṭpadārthavādibhirvaiśeṣikairguṇapadārthe saṃyogaḥ prakṣiptaḥ | samavāyastu svatantraḥ padārtha ityuktanayena pāratantryācchaktirūpo'padārtho'pi padārthaḥ kṛta iva tadrūpasamāropāt saṃbandhaḥ | na cehāsya śabdasyāyamartha iti niyamena pravibhāge śabdārthayoḥ so'bhyupagantuṃ pāryata iti tad‌vyatiriktastayorasti saṃbandha ityavyāptiḥ padārthasaṅ‌grahe vaiśeṣikāṇām | tathā hi-- samavāyāt sva ādhāraḥ svā ca jātiḥ pratīyate | ekārthasamavāyāttu guṇaḥ svādhāra eva ye || 13 ||
 khākāśagaganādayaḥ śabdāḥ svārthamākāśākhyaṃ tatra samavāyāt pratipādayanti, svasamavetāṃ jātiṃ svarūpalakṣaṇāṃ sarve śabdāḥ samavāyasaṃbandhāt pratyāyayanti, tasyāḥ śabdavyaktiṣu samavāyāt | śabdatvamapi śabdaśabdastatra samavāyāt pratyāyayati | ye tvākāśaguṇā mahattvādayastānekārthasamavāyācchabdāḥ pratyāyayanti, mahattvādiśabdānāmasādhāraṇānāṃ mahattvādiviśeṣaguṇānāṃ vākāśe ekatra samavāyāt | evaṃ śabdavyaktilakṣaṇā garjitakūjitabhaṇitaheṣitādayo gaganasyāsādhāraṇā guṇāstadabhidhāyakā api garjitādayaḥ śabdāstadekārthasamavāyādeva || 13 ||
tathā-- dravyatvasattāsaṃyogāḥ svanyādhāropabandhanāḥ | tatpradeśavibhāgāśca guṇā dvitvādayaśca ye || 14 ||
 dravyatvamaparasāmānyaṃ sattā ca mahāsāmānyamekārthasamavāyād dravyatvādiśabdaiḥ pratyāyyate | sattādravyatve hi dravyatvādiśabdasya yaḥ sva ādhāra ākāśastatrānyatra ca pṛthivyādau varteta iti svānyādhārābhyāmupabadhyete, svātmani niyabhyete | tathā ca svānyādhāravṛttinī, svāśrayuparisamāptatvāt, sāmānyānāmāśrayāntarasamavāye'pyekaikatra samavāyāvirodhāt tathā cākāśena padārthāntarāṇāṃ ye pradeśavṛttayaḥ saṃyogavibhāgadvitvapṛthak‌tvādayaśca te'pi saṃyogādiśabdairekārthasamavāyādeva pratyāyyante dviṣṭhatvāt saṃyogādīnāmākāśe'pi samavāyāt || 14 ||
tathā-- kecit svāśrayasaṃyuktāḥ kecit tatsamavāyinaḥ | saṃyuktasamaveteṣu samavetāstathā pare || 15 ||
 svaśabdānāmāśraya ākāśaḥ, tena saṃyuktā rathaghaṭādayo rathaghaṭādiśabdaiḥ samavetasaṃyogāt pratyāyyante | ghaṭādisamavetāstu rūpādayo guṇā utkṣepaṇādayaśca karmaviśeṣāḥ svāśrayasaṃyuktasamavāyādrūpādiśabdaiḥ pratyāyyante ghaṭādisamavetarūpādisamavetāstu rūpatvādayo rūpatvādiśabdaiḥ svāśrayasaṃyuktasamavetasamavāyādabhidhīyante || 15 ||
tathā-- svāśrayeṇa tu saṃyuktaiḥ saṃyuktaṃ vibhu gamyate | samavāyasya saṃbandho nāparastatra dṛśyate || 16 ||
 dik‌kālātmanāṃ vibhūnāmākāśena sahāprāptipūrvikāyāḥ prāpterasaṃbhavātsākṣāt saṃbandhābhāvāddikkālādiśabdaiḥ svāśrayasaṃyuktasaṃyogātte pratīpādyante | ākāśena hi saṃyuktāḥ pṛthivyādayaḥ, taiḥ saṃyuktā hi dikkālātmānaḥ | evaṃ pūrvānusāreṇa viṅudravyasamavetāḥ guṇāḥ tatsamavetāśca sāmānyaviśeṣāḥ svaśabdaiḥ svāśrayasaṃyuktasamavāyāt svāśrayasaṃyuktasamavetasamavāyāccābhidīyanta ityadhyavasīyata iti pṛthaṅ noktam | tadevaṃ dravyaguṇakarmaṇāṃ sāmānyānāṃ ca pratīteheturuktaḥ | viśeṣasthāpi paramāṇumanaḥsamavetasya svāśrayasaṃyuktasamavāyāt svaśabdenābhidhānām | ākāśasamavetasya tvekārthasamavāyāt dik‌kālātmasamavetasya svāśrayasaṃyuktasamavāyāpekṣayā pratītiruktā | evamatra yathāyogaṃ vibhajane'pi samavāyaśabdasya svārthapratipādane na kaścit saṃbandhaḥ syāt samavāyasyādravyatvāt kenacit saṃyogābhāvāt svarūpavṛttitvāt samavāyāntarābhāvācca | syādetat-samavāyaśabda ākāśe samaveto ghaṭādayaścākāśena saṃyuktāsteṣu ca samavāyaḥ sthita iti svāśrathasaṃyuktasaṃbandhāttamabhidhāsyati | naitadyuktam, samavāyāntarābhāvāt samavāyasya ghaṭādiṣūktā kalpanā na yujyate || 16 ||
tathā hi-- saṃbandhasyāviśiṣṭatvānna cātra niyamo bhavet | tasmācchabdārthayornaiva saṃbandhaḥ parikalpate || 17 ||
 yadāyamartho viśiṣṭasya saṃbandhasyābhāvāditi tadāntareṇa saṃbandhaṃ samavāyaśabdaḥ svārthaṃ na pratyāyayedityanarthakaḥ, yadvā pratyāyanna niyamena sarvamarthaṃ pratyāyayediti vyākhyā | prakṛtāpekṣayā vāniyamaḥ | nimittaṃ vinā samavāyaśabdasya svārthābhidhāne'nibandhanalakṣaṇasya saṃbandhasyāviśiṣṭatvāt sarvaḥ śabdaḥ sarvamarthaṃ pratyāyayet | yadā tu saṃbandhasyāviśiṣṭatvāttulyatvād anyena sādhāraṇatvādityarthastadeyaṃ vyākhyā | ākāśaśabdena samavāyāt svāśrayābhidhāne ghaṭādayo'pi śabdā gaganābhidhāyinaḥ syuḥ, ākāśasamavāyasyāviśeṣāt | evaṃ ca svasamavetajātyabhidhāne śabdaśabdasya guṇatvaṃ sattā ca pratipadyā syāt | ghaṭadiśabdeśca svāśrayasaṃyogāviśeṣāṃt paṭādayo'pi pratyāyyerannitīyaṃ avyāptyativyāptibhyāṃ vyavasthā śabdārthasaṃbandhe viśīryate yatastasmātsaṃyogasamavāyarūpatayā nātra saṃbandhapadārthaparikalpanaṃ nyāyyam || 17 ||
prauḍhivāditayā vaiśeṣikadarśanaṃ samarthayitumetadāha-- adṛṣṭavṛttilābhena yathā saṃyoga ātmanaḥ | kvacit svasvāmiyogākhyo'bhede'nyatrāpi sa kramaḥ || 18 ||
 vyāpakasyātmanaḥ sarvairdravyaiḥ saṃyogasyāviśeṣe'pi dharmādharmavaśāccharīrādāveva svasvāmibhāvalakṣaṇaḥ saṃbandho yathā, evamihāpyaviśeṣṭe'pi svāśrayasamavāye svāśrayasaṃyoge vādṛṣṭavaśādeva pratiniyataḥ śabdārtho vyavasthāsyata ityativyāptyabhāvaḥ | adṛṣṭasya dharmādharmalakṣaṇasyātmaguṇasya vṛttiḥ phaladānaṃ prati vyāpāraḥ tasyā lābho deśakālādisahakārivaśāt prāptiḥ | tuccho'yaṃ parihāro heyatvādasya pakṣasyābhihitaḥ | bhogasya svasukhaduḥkhasādhanabhūtasya yuktaṃ karmākṣiptatvaṃ na tu sarvasya tathābhāvo yuktaḥ | atha śabdenārthapratipādananiyame sati tasya bhogyatvamityetadapi karmākṣiptamevetyucyate tadā sarvasya jagatastathābhāvādadṛṣṭahetupratyākhyānaṃ sarvatrāyātam | athāyamatrāśayaḥ-yathā saṃyoge samāne'pi na sarvaṃ svamātmanaḥ, nāpi sarveṣāmātmanāṃ pratyātmagatādṛṣṭaniyamāt tathā saṃbandhābhede'pi na sarvaṃ sarvavācyam, prayogadarśanābhyāsajanasaṃskārapāratantryāditi tadā sarva eva pratiniyataviṣayaḥ prayogadarśanābhyāsāt saṅketādavasīyamānasvarūpaḥ saṃskāro yogyatārūpaḥ saṃbandho'stu, kimanyenānibandhanena saṃyogasamavāyalakṣaṇena nāntarīyakeṇa kṛtyam || 18 ||
samavāyasya tvavācyatvamevābhyupaiti | prāptiṃ tu samavāyākhyāṃ vācyadharmātivartinīm | prayoktā pratipattā vā na śabdairanugacchati || 19 ||
 śabdapratipādyānāṃ vācyānāṃ gavādīnāmarthānāṃ dharmaḥ saṃsargirūpācchuritatvam , nirupādhīnāṃ śabdaviṣayatāyogāt | samavāyastu nirupādhiḥ, na hi tasya guṇasāmānyādiḥ kaścidupādhiḥ parairaṅgīkriyata iti vācyadharmamatikrāntaḥ | tayedaṃ taditi pratyavamarśayogyatvaṃ vācyadharmamatikrāntaḥ | nityaparatantrarūpaścāsau samavāyaśabdādapi nāvadhāryate prayoktṛpratipattṛbhyāmiti na tatsvarūpaniveśisaṃvijñānapadaṃ kiṃcanāsti ityavācya eva bhāvato'yam | saṃbandhirūpatayā tu svatantraḥ samavāyaḥ śabdādavagamyate | tathā ca dharmitayā pratīterdharmāntarayogasahatvādastyeva svāśrayasaṃyogaḥ, tadabhidhāne samavāyaśabdasya saṃbandha iti na kaściddoṣaḥ | arthāntare samājādau ca prayogadarśanāt samavāyaśabdo nāsādhāraṇaṃ saṃvijñānapadamasya laukikam | kiṃ tarhi ? vaiśeṣikasamaya eva rūḍham | vācyamarthaṃ prayoktā vivakṣitvā yogyaṃ śabdaṃ prayuṅkte | samavāyasya tu pāratantryātmano vācyatvābhāvāt prayokturyogyaśabdodāhāre vyāpārābhāvaḥ, tadabhāvāt pratipattāpi na tatra kaścidityubhayopādānam || 19 ||
atrāvācyatve samavāyasyokte naiyāyiko vākcchalamudbhāvayati-- avācyamiti yad vācyaṃ tadavācyatayā yadā | vācyamityavasīyeta vācyameva tadā bhavet || 20 ||
avācyamityanena śabdena yad vācyaṃ vaktumabhipretaṃ tadyadaivāvācyatayā avācyaśabdena vācyaṃ vyavahartavyamiti pratīyate tadaiva vācyaṃ bhavati, pratipādanakāla eva vācyatāmupaitītyarthaḥ | tathā ca vācyamityukte'vācyaśabdasyaiva vācyamityavācyatvaṃ virudhyate || 20 ||
athāpyavācyamityevaṃ na tad vācyaṃ pratīyate | vivakṣitāsya yāvasthā saiva nādhyavasīyate || 21 ||
 avācyaśabdasyāpyavācyatve pratipipādayiṣitaṃ śabdānabhidheyatvaṃ samavāyasya na gamyetetyasya vācya eva | tathā ca virodha ityarthaḥ || 21 ||
atha pāratantryātmanāvācyo na sarvathetyāśaṅkyāha-- tathānyathā sarvathā ca yasyāvācyatvamucyate | tatrāpi naiva sāvasthā taiḥ śabdaiḥ pratiṣidhyate || 22 ||
 pāratantryātmanā na vācya ityapi prakārapratiṣedhe prakāravata eva pratiṣedhaḥ kṛto bhavati | na hi tenānyena sarveṇa vā prakāreṇāvācya iti prakāramātrasyāvasthālakṣaṇasyaitaiḥ śabdaiḥ pratiṣedhaḥ | dharmyapratiṣedhe tadāśritadharmapratiṣedhānupapatteḥ | tasmādviśiṣṭaniṣedhe'pi pratiṣiddhameva vācyatvaṃ samavāyasyeti kathamavācyaśabdasyāyaṃ vācyaḥ syāditi codyameva | yadi vā tathānyathā ityādinā niṣedhe'pi na saivāvasthā niṣeddhuṃ śakyā yāvadavasthātā na niṣiddha iti nāntarīyako'sya niṣedhaḥ | śabdaviṣayatāpratyavamarśamantareṇākāraviśeṣaḥ pratiṣeddhuṃ na śakyata iti śabdaviṣayatvena tasya vācyatvopapatteravācyatve na virodha iti pūrve vyācakṣate || 22 ||
asya vakturabhipretādarthāntarādhyāropeṇa vākcchalasyottaraṃ vaktumetat sadṛśaṃ nidarśanamāha-- na hi saṃśayarūpe'rthe śeṣatvena vyavasthite | avyudāse svarūpasya saṃśayo'nyaḥ pravartate || 23 ||
 samānadharmopalaṃbhādviśeṣānavadhāraṇād viśeṣasmṛteścārthe saṃśayite sthāṇvādau sthāṇurvā syāt puruṣo veti yadidaṃ saṃśayajñanamājāyate tatra saṃśayarūpe jñāne ṃsaśayite'rthe svaviṣaye śeṣatvena tadviṣayavyavasthāpanāṅgatvena sthite tadupari tadainānyasaṃśayajñānaṃ notpadyate, asyārthaparatantrasyāparityaktapāratantryasvarūpasya svaviṣayavijñānaṃ prati viṣayabhāvopagamavirodhāt | yadi hi svaviṣayasya saṃśayarūpasya jñānasyedaṃ viṣayabhāvamupeyāt, tadā svarūpeṇaiva saṃdigdhatvādalabdhapratiṣṭhaṃ svasmin bāhyavimarśasvabhāve saṃśayātmani svarūpe nāvatiṣṭheta | tathā ca bāhyasyārthasya dolāyamānatvaṃ na paricchidyate yugapadviṣayaviṣayibhāvasyānupapatteḥ | tenaiva cārthupravṛttena saṃśayena viṣayavat svarūpasyāpi saṃśayyamānatāyogo vyāpārasyaikatvāt | tadevaṃ yathā saṃśaya ātmarūpaṃ varjayan viṣayaṃ sandehayati tathā avācyaśabda ātmānaṃ varjayan viṣayīkṛtaṃ vācayatīti sādharmyam | saṃśayarūpe'rthe saṃśāyabhidhāne jñānavastuni vetyarthaḥ | śeṣatvena vyavasthitiratrārthād vastuviṣayā || 23 ||
udāharaṇāntaramapyāha-- yadā ca nirṇayajñāne nirṇayatvena nirṇayaḥ | prakramyate tadā jñānaṃ svadharmeṇāvatiṣṭhate || 24 ||
 viśeṣāvadhāraṇarūpe nirṇīyamānārthaviṣaye nirṇayajñāne tadaivārthaparicchedavyāpṛte'paraḥ svagato nirṇayo na pravartate | jñānasya hyarthapāratantryaṃ svadharmaḥ | tatastu niṣkṛṣya svarūpavicāre svadharmād viprakṛṣyeta, svātantryeṇa viṣayabhāvāpatteḥ ata eva jñānāntaragrāhyatvaṃ na bhavatīti ghaṭajñānamiti prāgeva pratipāditamiti jñānāntaraviṣayatve viṣayitvatyāgāt svadharmasya hāniḥ | tadevamanyatra vyāpṛtasya tadaiva svaviṣayavyāpārābhāvādyathā jñānasya jñeyatvaṃ nāstyekasyāṃ saṃvittau tathā vācakasya vācyatvaṃ nāstītyavācyaśabdaḥ pratipādanāvastho nātmana eva vācyatāmarthasya niṣedhati,svātmani kriyāvirodhāt | na ca śabdāntaraṃ tadānīṃ tadvācyatāniṣedhakamastītyavācyaśabdasyābhidhāviṣabhabhāvamatropagacchatyevārthaḥ | tathā hi śabdāntarasya samavāyaśabdasya samavāyasvarūpeṇa na vācya ityetadvakturvivakṣitaṃ pratīyata eva || 24 ||
tadyathā-- sarvaṃ mithyā bravīmīti naitadvākyaṃ vivakṣyate | tasya mithyābhidhāne hi prakrānto'rtho na gamyate || 25 ||
 svavākyānāmasatyārthatāpratipādanāya sarvam ahaṃ mithyā bravīmi ityukte'syāpi vākyatvān mithyārthatā na prasañjanīyā | evaṃ hi prakrāntaṃ vivakṣitaṃ svāvākyāntarāṇāṃ mithyātvaṃ na pratīyeta atha satyapi mithyārthatve pratipādakatvamasya vākyasya vākyāntarāṇāmapi tathaiva syāditi teṣāṃ mithyārthapratipādanaṃ prakrāntamaphalamityaparo'trārthaḥ || 25 ||
atraiva yuktimāha-- na ca vācakarūpeṇa pravṛttasyāsti vācyatā | pratipādyaṃ na tattatra yenānyat pratipādyate || 26 ||
 karaṇasanniveśinastadaivābhidheyatā viruddhā, anyapratipādanapravṛttasya tadaiva pratyudāvṛtyātmani vyāpārābhāvāt | vastusvabhāvo'yaṃ yat kartṛśaktiyuktaṃ na tat karmaśaktenadhikaraṇaṃ tadaiva bhavati, svātantryapāratantryayorekadaikatra virodhādityarthaḥ | pratipādyaṃ na tattatra ityādinā sarvanidarśanasādhyamante nigamitavān | yat pratipādakaṃ na tat pratipādyam | yathā saṃśayajñānaṃ niścayajñānaṃ vā | pratipādakaṃ cābhidhānamato naitat pratipādyamiti prayogaḥ || 26 ||
nanu mā bhūd vācakaṃ vācyam, virodhāt | ātmakartṛkavākyasamānyānupraveśāttvasya mithyātmanā kena dhāryata ityetadāśaṅkyaitadeva nidarśanāntareṇopapādayati-- asādhikā pratijñeti neyamevābhidhīyate | yathā tathāsya dharmo'pi naiva kaścit pratīyate || 27 ||
 sādhyanirdeśaḥ pratijñā sādhanāṅgaṃ na bhavatītyukte neyameva saugatasya pratijñātvāviśeṣāttathā bhavati, anarthakatve vivakṣitārthāsiddheḥ | api tvetadvarjaṃ pratijñāntarāṇāṃ tattā | evaṃ sarvaṃ mithyā bravīmītyasyāpi vākyasyāyathārthatāpratipādane kriyamāṇe dharmo'nṛtatvaṃ na gamyate tathābhāve vivakṣitārthapratipādanābhāve prayogavaiphalyāt || 27 ||
evamavācyaśabde'pi praṣṭavyam | upasaṃharati-- vyāpārasyāparo yasmānna vyāpāro'sti kaścana | virodhamanavasthāṃ vā tasmāt sarvatra nāśrayet || 28 ||
 avācyaśabdasya svārthapratipādane yo vyāpāro'bhidhālakṣamastasyānyo vyāpāraḥ svaviṣayastadānīmeva nāsti yenaikena vyāpāreṇa śabdāntarābhidheyatāṃ niṣedhatyapareṇātmano'pyabhidheyatāmityavācyaśabdasyāpyasāvārtho na vācyaḥ syāditi vivakṣitaṃ śabdāntarāṇāmapyavācyatvaṃ na pratīyeteti virodhaḥ syāt | nirnimittavyāpārāntarābhyupagame cānavasthā syāt | tathā hi-yadyavācyaśabdasyāpi viṣayabhāvaniṣedhāya vyāpārāntaraṃ saṃbhavet tadā tasyāpi vyāpārāntarasya svaviṣaye pravṛttiniṣedhāya vyāpārāntaraṃ tadaivetyanavasthānādapratipattiḥ syādityarthaḥ | vyāpārāntarābhāvāttu naiṣa prasaṅgaḥ | sarvatra iti na kevalaṃ vācyatāyāmeva, api tu saṃbandhe'pi, saṃbandhasya saṃbandhibhyāṃ sahānyasya saṃbandhasyābhāve tayorapi saṃbandhinoḥ śabdārthayoḥ saṃbandho mā bhūt | saṃbandhāntarakalpane vānavasthetyeṣānavasthā nāśrayitavyā | saṃbandhasya svayaṃ saṃbandharūpatvādanyatyopaśloṣakasyāyogādityarthaḥ | athavā sarvatra iti sarvaṃ mithyā bravīmi, asādhikā pratijñetyādāvityarthaḥ | tadevaṃ paraprasiddhasaṃyogasamavāyalakṣaṇasaṃbandhāśrayeṇa śabdārthapravibhāge'tivyāptiradṛṣṭavaśāt parihṛtā | avyāptirapi, sākṣāt samavāyasyāvācyatve kalpitena rūpeṇa saṃbandhitayā vācyatve nāstyeva taṭasthasya samavāyaśabdenāmukhīkṛtasya samavāyasyāvācyatvavidhāne virodhabhāvāditi prauḍhivāditayā śāstrāntarasiddhasaṃbandhāśrayeṇāpi śabdārthaniyamo vyavasthāpitaḥ || 28 ||
idānīṃ svanikāyasiddhaṃ saṃbandhapapādayitumāha-- indriyāṇāṃ svaviṣayeṣvanādiryogyatā yathā | anādirarthaiḥ śabdānāṃ saṃbandho yogyatā tathā || 29 ||
 samavāyādinimittānapekṣayaivoccaritamātrācchabdārthapratyayotpatterakṛtrimā śaktiravasīyate | arthamātreṇa hi śabdamātrasyāviyogamapravṛttasaṃketā api pratipadyante | tathā ca yogyatā svābhāvikī siddhā, saṃketastu tāmeva dyotayati | tadyathā cakṣurādīnāṃ rūpādiviṣaye puruṣaprayatnānapekṣā grāhakatā | na hi yatnenāpi rūpe rasananiveśaḥ śakyakriyaḥ | evaṃ gavārthe ghaṭaśabdaniveśo'sādhuḥ | tathā hi bhāṣyam-- "yo hi gāmaśva iti brūyānna jātucit sampratyayaḥ syāt" iti | yathāruci saṅkete hi na vācakaśaktipuraḥsarīkāreṇānyaviṣaye śabdāḥ pravartante prasiddhārthāḥ, api tu samayamātraṃ tat | saṃjñāśabdānāṃ tu sarvasaṃjñipratyāyanaśaktiyuktatve'pi viśiṣṭe saṃjñini śak‌tyavacchedaḥ sāmāyikaḥ | iyaṃ ca yogyatā śabdānāmarthapratītyanusāreṇaiva vyavasthāpayitavyetyabhedena śabdārthayoḥ pratyayādadhyāsaphalaivāvasthiteti sa eva mukhyaḥ saṃbandhaḥ | ata eva pratītāvarthasyāpi viṣayabhāvenāpekṣaṇāt pāratantryasāmānyāt saṃbandha iti vyapadiśyate | yadāpi cendriyāṇi kārakatvādajñātānyeva jñānaṃ janayanti, śabdastu jñāpakatvāt svajñānenānyadhīhetuḥ, tathāpi puruṣaprayatnānapekṣā śaktiḥ sādhāraṇīti sāmyam || 29 ||
ihārthagatyarthaḥ śabdaprayogaḥ | sādhīyaścārthagatirapaśabdebhya iti teṣāmapi sambandho'rthena prasakta ityāśaṅkyāha-- asādhuranumānena vācakaḥ kaiścidiṣyate | vācakatvāviśeṣe vā niyamaḥ puṇyapāpayoḥ || 30 ||
 daivī vāgaśaktairvyavakīrṇā bālavadandhādivadanumitamūlaprakṛtirviduṣāṃ vācikā | na hi vidvāṃso'rthamapaśabdāt sākṣādavasyantīti nāpaśabdānāmarthena kaścitsaṃbandhaḥ | ata eva purākalpe'nṛtādibhirivāpabhraṃśairapi rahitā vāgāsīditi brahmakāṇḍa uktam | avācakā evāpabhraṃśāḥ | te tu sādṛśyāt sādhuśabdamanumāpayanti | tebhyo'rthasampratyaya iti | tathā ca saṃgrahakāraḥ-- śabdaprakṛtirapabhraṃśaḥ | iti | adyatve tvadharmabāhulyādanṛtādivad vāṅmatlānāṃ rūḍhiḥ | tathā cāvyavadhānenaivāpaśabdebhyo'rthapratītau na mlecchitavai nāpabhāṣitavai sādhubhirbhāṣitavyamiti śāstraprāmāṇyātsādhūnāmeva dharmāṅgatvamiti tadanusṛtiḥ śāstreṇa | tathā ca bhedasyobhedapūrvakatnātpuruṣavikalpāniyamenānantatvādaśabdānāmabhinnasādhuśabdapūrvakatvameva niścīyata iti śabdaprakṛtirapaśabdaḥ siddha iti śabda eva vidyā | tadatra yatā vidyāvasthābhinnabrahmātmikā tathā sādhuśabdāvasthā vidyā | yathā ca vidyāyāṃ bhedo viṣayaḥ tathāpabhraṃśāvasthā vāṅmalarūpeti paramārthataditarāvasthāpekṣo vikalpaḥ | avidyādaśāpekṣameva "samānāyāmarthagatau śabdena cāpaśabdena ca" iti bhaṣyam | arthagatāviti vacanādarthābhidhānamapaśabdānāmavakarṇayanti | avidyāyāṃ bhūyasāpaśabdairvyavahārādarthapratītimātraṃ bhavennāmetyarthaḥ | rūḍhatvāttu vyavahārasyāviśeṣaṃ granthakāra āha | tatra ca śāstraṃ niyāmakaṃ sādhuśabdairevārtho vaktavyo nāpaśabdairevaṃ kriyamāṇamabhyudayakāri bhavatīti | puṇyapāpayoḥ puṇyapāpanimittaṃ niyamaḥ kriyate sādhūnāṃ jñānācchāstrapūrvakādvā prayogādabhyudaya iti | asādhuprayoge tu dhamābhāva eva pāpatvenopacaryate | na mlecchitavai ityetasya niṣedhasyātikramātpāpameva kecidicchanti || 30 ||
samavāye saṃbandhāntarābhāvaḥ pūrvamuktaḥ, asmiṃstu darśane sa na prasajatītyāha-- saṃbandhaśabde saṃbandho yogyatāṃ prati yogyatā || 31 ||
ka kha)  saṃbandhaśabdo yogyatālakṣaṇaṃ saṃbandhaṃ yogyatayaiva pratipādayati | evaṃ samavāyaśabdo'pi yogyatayaivānādisiddhayā svārthapratipādakaḥ | tathā yogyatāśabdo'pi iti sarvatrāsya saṃbandhasya vyāptiḥ | saṅketasya tarhi kvopayoga ityāha-- samayādyogyatāsaṃvinmātāputrādiyogavat || 31 ||
ga-gha anādisiddhārthaviṣayavyāpārasya śabdasya vṛddhavyavahāraparamparāparaparyāyāt samayāt svābhāvikyeva yogyatā niścīyate, na tu samayamātrādatathābhūte'pi tathābhāvaḥ samucitaḥ | na hīyamasya putrasya mākeki janyajanakabhāvaḥ sāmayikaḥ, vastusiddhasyaivaivaṃ pratipādanāt | atha pratyakṣapūrvakaṃ saṃjñākarma ityasmadviśiṣṭānāmarthe śabdaniyogaḥ sāmayika eva | naitat | tairapi yogyatānusāreṇa pūrvābhyāsātayā niveśāt | taduktam-- anāgamaśca so'bhyāsaḥ samayaḥ kaiścidiṣyaye | iti | kiṃ bhavānāhetyarthamātrāvinābhāvamavagatya viśeṣapraśnādavadhāryate | aviditasaṃketānapi prati śabdasya yogyatā, puruṣeṇānyatra saṃṅkete'pi prarūḍhe'rthe gavādiśabdājjhaṭiti pratipattiḥ | na ca puruṣeṇa niyogaḥ śakyakriya iti vakṣyati || 31 ||
idānīṃ kāryakāraṇabhāvaṃ śabdārthayoḥ sambandhamāha-- śabdaḥ kāraṇamarthasya sa hi tenopajanyate | tathā ca buddhiviṣayādarthācchabdaḥ pratīyate || 32 ||
 śrotṛbuddhyupārūḍhasyārthasya śabdaḥ kāraṇaṃ janakatvāt | śabdārtho hyartho bahīrūpatayāvasīyamānaḥ | tathā cānyacca, vaktṛbuddhiniveśino'rthāt kāraṇabhūtāt śabdaḥ śrutiviṣayamanuprāptaḥ pratīyata ityartho'pi śabdasya kāraṇam | evaṃ cobhayathā kāryakāraṇabhāvavarṇanāddhūmāgnivelakṣaṇyena śabdārthayorabhedena saṃbandho'dhyāsalakṣaṇaḥ pratipādito bhavati | tathā hi buddho śabdārthayoḥ pūrvamabhedenāvasthānam | na hi vivakṣito'rthaḥ śabdasambhedaśūnyaḥ, antaḥsañjalparūpasya tasya pratibhānāt | anādiśabdabhāvanānuviddhaṃ hi tiraścāmapi jñānam | ata eva sthānakaraṇavyāpārādabhivyakto'rthasvarūpaśabalaḥ śabdaḥ śrotṛbhiravadhāritastathaiva svarūpācchuraṇayārthamavagamayati | pratipādyapratipādakayorhi parasparābhiprāyasaṅkrāntirvyavahāra ityantaḥ sthitamarthaṃ mūlāvasthāmāpyaparityaktaṃ vaktṛbuddhisamāviṣṭaṃ śrotaryarpayati śabdaḥ | śrotāpi ca tathaiva svavāsanāvikāsānusāreṇa pratipādyate samāviṣṭaśabdabhāvanaḥ | tena codbodhitaśabdabhāvanaḥ pravartata iti nirṇītaṃ vākyapadīye | tadevamekapakṣībhāva evaikavākyatayā sambandhe tatra sthitaḥ siddhāntānuguṇaḥ | yathāvivakṣaṃ ca śabdo'rthamavagamayati niyatasvaravarṇānupūrvīka iti svaraviparyaye vivakṣāntaramindraśatruśabde'vagantavyaṃ svarabhedenānyatvāt | svakāraṇameva gamayati śabda ityantarā vivakṣāntaraṃ lāghavādasphuṭapratibhāsaṃ prathamavarṇoccāraṇānantaraṃ dvitīyavarṇoccāraṇavadanumīyate || 32 ||
nanu buddhupārūḍhe śabdārthe kathamodanaṃ bhuṅkta ityādivyavahāra ityāśaṅkyāha-- bhojanādyapi manyante buddhyarthe yadasaṃbhavi | buddhyarthādeva buddhyarthe jāte tadapi dṛśyate || 33 ||
 buddhiviparivartinoḥ kriyākārakayorvijñānanaye sādhyasādhanabhāvaḥ siddhaḥ pratibhāsasāraḥ | tathā hi buddhyarthe buddhau śabdārtho bhojanaṃ bhoktā tatsaṃbandhaśca yadasambhavitvenābhimataṃ tadapi sambhavatyeva | kadetyāha--buddhyarthādeva odanādipratibhāsādaparasmin bhujyamānāt | kārakajñānasaṃvedane jāte sati, vākyavādinaḥ padamātrāt pratīteraparisamāpteḥ | abhyupagamavādaścāyam | bāhyanaye'pi hi śabdārthasya buddhiparivartinaḥ pratīteḥ | kriyākārakabhāve dṛśyavikalpayorabhedādhyavasāyāt vyavahārasiddhirbhavatyeva | tathā hi bāhyārtho sati darśanam | darśane'rthanirbhāsaḥ, tasmin sati vaktumīhā tataḥ prayatnādeḥ śabdoccāraṇamiti paramparayā bāhyārtha eva vācyeta tatra pravṛttiriti vināpi tu bāhyārthaṃ śakyate vijñānamātradarśane'pi tannirbhāsavaśena kriyākārakasaṃbandho melayitumityevopanyastam || 33 ||
yataśca buddhiparivartī śabdārthaḥ tataḥ śabdārthasaṃbandho nitya upapadyata ityāha-- anityeṣa?vapi nityatvamabhidheyātmanā sthitam | anityatvaṃ svaśaktirvā sā ca nityānna bhidyate || 34 ||
 ghaṭādiśabdāduccaritādarthākārāvagrahasya pratyayasya sadaivopajananād bāhyena rūpeṇa pradhvaṃsitve'pyabhidheyakena śabdārthasya nityatvānnityo hyarthavatāmarthairabhisaṃbandha iti pravāhanityatāśrayeṇa paspaśāyāmuktam | kūṭasthanityatāśrayeṇāpyāha-- padārthānāṃ satāmasattvavirodhādatītānāgatayoradhvanornāstīti pratyayajanakamadvayasya tattvasya svasya ātmano brahmaṇo dravyalakṣaṇasya sāmarthyameva tatrānityatvamiti tasya nityādadvayarūpāttasmādbhedābhāvādanityaśabdenopādhibhedabhinnasya pūrvoktenaiva nyāyena tasyaiva pratipādanānnāstyabhāvo nāma tadabhāvato bhāveṣu kaścidityarthaḥ | tataśca ghaṭādiśabdaiḥ sarvāvasthāsūpādiviśiṣṭabrahmadravyameva nityaṃ pratipādyata iti nityaḥ śabdārthasaṃbandhaḥ siddhaḥ | taduktam-- dravye'pi padārtha eṣa vigraho nyāyyaḥ siddhe śabde'rthe saṃbandhe ceti || 34 ||
evaṃ saṃbandha svābhāvikamavasthāpya tatraipodbalaka paramatenāha-- śabdenārthastha saṃskāro dṛṣṭādṛṣṭaprayojanaḥ | kriyate so'bhisaṃbandhamantareṇa kathaṃ bhavet || 35 ||
 ihārthaṃ kaṃcanāpyanabhidadhatīnāṃ śābarādividyānāṃ viṣādiśamane sāmarthyaṃ dṛṣṭam | pratitantraṃ prasiddhānāṃ ca bījākṣarāṇāṃ japyamānānāmadṛṣṭahetutvamata evonnīyata ityavācakakeṣvapi śabdeṣvarthena saha saṃskāranyathānupapattyā saṃbandhabhāvāt sarvatra saṃbandhāvasāya iti kaścit || 35 ||
etannivārayati-- nāvaśyamabhidheyeṣu saṃskāraḥ sa tathāvidhaḥ | dṛśyate na ca saṃbandhastathābhūto vivakṣitaḥ || 36 ||
 ghaṭādiśabdebhyo'rthasya ghaṭāderdṛṣṭādṛṣṭaprayojanasya saṃskārasyādarśanādatra saṃbandho na syāditi nedṛśasaṃskāranimittamasau vivakṣitaḥ || 36 ||
api tu sati pratyayahetutvaṃ saṃbandha upapadyate | śabdasyārthe yatastatra saṃbandho'stīti gamyate || 37 ||
 pratiniyatārthapratyāyanānyathānupapattyā śabdārthayoḥ saṃbandho yogyatālakṣaṇaścakṣūrūpādīnāmivetyasmadupajñameva jyāya ityarthaḥ | arthe niyate niyatasya pratītihetutvaṃ sati saṃbandhe yujyate nānyatheti yatastasmādarthapratyāyanākhyāt kāryāt asti saṃbandhaḥ śabdasyārtha iti niścīyate | nārthaviśeṣādhanarūpaḥ saṃskāro'tra saṃbandhāvedakaḥ, tasyānupūrvīmātrādviśiṣṭena prabhāvavatā racitādapi niṣpatteḥ pratyāyakatvānapekṣaṇādityarthapratītiniyamahetuḥ śabdārthayoḥ saṃbandhaḥ pratītikṛto na prāptilakṣaṇa iti pratītilakṣaṇādupakārāt tatsiddhiḥ | yadapi mīmāṃsakairyacchabde vijñāte'rtho vijñāyate sa saṃbandha ityuktaṃ tadapyanenaiva darśanena vyākhyeyam | yataḥ kāraṇācchabdaśravaṇānantaramarthajñānaṃ bhavati sa saṃbandha iti sati pratyayahetutvam ityevoktaṃ bhavati, anyathā śabdārthayoḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvavarṇane nimittaṃ niyamenoktaṃ syāt || 37 ||
sāmayikastu saṃbandho na yujyata ityāha-- nitye'nitye'pi vācye'rthe puruṣeṇa kathaṃcana | saṃbandho'kṛtasaṃbandhaiḥ śabdaiḥ kartuṃ na śakyate || 38 ||
 nitye tāvadarthe jātyādau nityaśabdārthadarśane vā sarvasmin puruṣeṇedaṃ prathamatayā śabdasya saṅketaḥ kartuṃ na pāryate | nityatvādevedānīmupajātasya puruṣasya tatrāvyāpārāt | pūrvamapi tasmādākāśakāladigādiśabdānāṃ nityaśabdadarśane vā brahmaṇaḥ śabdavācyatvāt sarveṣāmarthasaṃbandhādādipuruṣeṇāpi kṛte śaktyanusārasya pratipāditatvāt , ādisargāt prabhṛti ca pravṛttau kimanyannityatvāt syāt | anitye'pyartheḥ ghaṭādau kāryaśabdadarśane vā pratyakṣeṇa sarvagrahaṇāyogājjātidvāreṇāpi grahaṇe jātīnāmekasminnarthe bhūyasīnāṃ saṃbhave vivecanānupapatteranumānenāpi śabdābhedenārthasya pratipatteḥ śabdārthasiddhau tasyāyogāt pāriśeṣyācchabdaireva nirūpya viṣayaṃ saṅketaḥ kriyeta | tathā ca nirūpakāṇāmapi śabdānāṃ saṅkete saiva vārteti tatrāpi śabdāntarairnirūpaṇe'navasthā, akṛtasamayairnirūpaṇānupapatteriti sudūramapi gatvā kasyacicchabdasya svābhāvikī yogyataiṣaṇīyā | tathā cāviśeṣāt sarveṣāmapi tatprasaṅga iti siddhaḥ svābhāvikaḥ śabdārthayoḥ sambandhaḥ samayavaśādabhivyajyamānasvarūpaḥ || 38 ||
idānīṃ yanmatub‌vārtike bhāṣye'bhihitam-- "sampratisattāyāṃ yathā syād bhūtabhaviṣyatyasattāyāṃ mā bhūd "  iti, tatra bhūtabhaviṣyatoḥ sattāvyākhyānamiṣeṇa prakṛtaṃ saṃbandhanityatvaṃ nirvāhayitumāha-- vyapadeśe padārthānāmanyā sattaupacārikī | sarvāvasthāsu sarveṣāmātmarūpasya darśikā || 39 ||
 vyapadeśe vyapadeśanimittaṃ śabdena pratyāyane padapratyāyyānāmarthānāṃ bāhyānāṃ vastūnāṃ bāhyavilakṣaṇā sattā buddhyopacaritā bāhyārthasattāyā hi anyā buddhisamārūḍhārthākārarūpā sattā | ata evaupacārikī iyam | upacāro'dhyāropaḥ prayojanamasyāḥ sarvāvasthāsu iti tītānāgatāsvavasthāsvapyartharūpaṃ darśayati, tadrūpeṇa buddhyākārasya pratibhāsanāt | evaṃ cātītānāgatādiśabdānāmapyarthasadbhāvātsaṃbandhanityatāstyeva | viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyāvasthāyāmapīyameva sattārthānām | anyathā sadaina viśiṣṭasya niraṃśasya vastunaḥ kathaṃ pravivekaḥ sarveṣāmityabhāvaviṣayāṇāṃ śaśaviṣāṇādiśabdānāmapyākārollekhinī | tathā hi buddhyā nirūpitavastuviṣayāḥ śabdāḥ | buddhiśca bahirasatyapyarthe svabījavāsanāparipākavaśādākārāvagraharūpopajāyate vaikalpikī | tathaiva ca śabdāt pratīyata ityavadhīribahirgatabhāvāḥ śabdāḥ buddhipratibhāsinamarthamabhiniviśanta ityalātacakaśaśaviṣāṇādīnāmapi śabdānāṃ nityamarthairaviyogāt saṃbandhanityatāsiddhiḥ | saṃvidupārohe hi vyāvahāra iti tanmayyevārthasya sattā nyāyyā | prāk tu saṃvido'prāmāṇikatvāt śraddhāmātragamyā sā | tatra ca prahataḥ sattābhimāna iti tadanurodhenopacārasattāvācoyuktiḥ | ata eva hi arthānāmātmalābha iva śabdaparāmarśamantareṇaiṣāṃ rūpasaṃsparśasyābhāvāt || 39 ||
evaṃ cānayaiva sattayā pūrite vyavahāre yadyarthakriyākaraṇādinā kāṣṭhabusaprāyeṇa kenacinnibandhanenānyasattā kalpyate tadvardhatāṃ sā, na tatra cintāsmākaṃ vyavahāre tu tasyā nāstyanupraveśaḥ, yadi paramasyāmeva sā pratibiṃbitā vyavahriyata ityetat pratipādayituṃ nidarśanopakramamāha-- sphaṭikādi yathā dravyaṃ bhinnarūpairupāśrayaiḥ | svaśaktiyogāt saṃbandhaṃ tādrūpyeṇopagacchati || 40 ||
tadvacchabdo'pi sattāyāmasyāṃ pūrvaṃ vyavasthitaḥ | dharmairupaiti saṃbandhamavirodhivirodhibhiḥ || 41 ||
 bāhyasya vastuno niyatarūpatvāt bhāvābhāvasādhāraṇyānupapatterghaṭa ityukte'sti nāstīṃti śabdāntaropadhīyamānarūpasaṃsargavirodhaḥ syādityupacārasattāsamāviṣṭaḥ śabdārthaḥ | tathā hi--sarvasādhāraṇāt padāntaropadhīyamānarūpaviśeṣasahaḥ kācābhrasphaṭikādrivat so'rtha iti yathāyathamasti nāsti iti bhāvābhāvasamanvayavaśena niyataḥ pratīyate | tathā hi--svacchatvāt sphaṭikādidravyaṃ nīlādisaṃsarge'parityaktasvarūpaṃ tadrūpamivābhāsate | tathā copacākasattāpi sphaṭikamaṇisthānīṃyā tad‌rūpamatyajantī pratiṣedhādibhirupadhānairabhisaṃbadhyamānā tādrūpyamivāyāti, pratiṣedhādyātmikevābhāti | svaśaktiracchatvaṃ sphaṭikādernānākāropagrahayogyatvaṃ sattāyā api sarvaviśeṣasvīkārayogyatvam | sāmānyātmakatvāt | śabdo'pīti, śabdārthaḥ, śabdyata iti kṛtvā | yadbā śabdo'syāḥ pratyāyakatvenāvasthito'rthadvāreṇa, śabdāntaravācyairdharmaiḥ sambandhyate | virodhivacanaṃ sākalyapratipādanārtham | sattāyāmasyām iti, jñānākārarūpāyām | pūrvam ityābhāsāvasyāyāṃ padāt kācādyavarodhaḥ | avirodhino dharmā bhāvātmakāḥ | te copacārasattāyāmanuguṇāḥ yathā sphaṭikasya mallikākusumādaya iti na te rūpatiraskriyāhetavaḥ | ata eva tat‌sannidhāne tadātmanopacārasattāyā viśrāntiḥ | aviruddhā hi bāhyā sattā tasyāḥ pūrṇarūpatayā pratyāsannā | tathā cocyate-- "yatrānyat kriyāpadaṃ na śrūyate tatrāstirbhavantīpara..." ityādi | vartamānāvasthā ca pūrṇatvopakāriṇīti bhavantīpara ityuktam | sattā vā viruddhadharmasāmānyamiti yathāyathaṃ viśeṣaistasyā eva paripūraṇam | virodhinastu dharmā abhāvātmakaḥ te hi pratiṣedhātmakāḥ rūpatirodhānamupacārasattāyā japākusumādaya iva sphaṭikasya kurvanti | yadyapi copacārasattāyāmubhayeṣāmapi samanvāyadvirodhābāvastathāpi bāhyāpekṣayātraitaduktam | bāhyastha nīlotpalāderabhinnasya viśiṣṭatvānnīlamutmalamityupacārasattāyāmeva vivekād dravyātmā guṇasaṃsargabhedādaśrīyate pṛthagityādiviśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāve ca vakṣyamāṇā prakriyopapadyate | sphaṭikaṃ vimalaṃ dravyairyathāyuktaṃ pṛthak pṛthak | nīlalohitapītādyaistadvarṇamupalabhyate || ityaparo'trāgamapāṭhaḥ || 40-41 ||
tameva virodhyavirodhidharmasaṃbandhaṃ krameṇa vyācaṣṭe | evaṃ ca pratiṣedhyeṣu pratiṣedhapraklṛptaye | āśriteṣupacāreṇa pratiṣedhaḥ pravartate || 42 ||
 buddhyākārasya nānāvidhadharmasamanvayayogyatve'brāhmaṇādiṣu nañarthopapattiḥ | tathā hi--sattāvirodhānniṣedhāyogānna brāhmaṇo'tra san | asattve tu kathaṃ tatra śabdapravṛttirbāhyaśabdārthavādinām | tathā ca punarapi niṣedho'nupapannaḥ | taduktam-- satāṃ ca na niṣedho'sti so'satsu ca na vidyate | jagatyanena nyāyena nañarthaḥ pralayaṃ gataḥ || iti | yadā tūpacārasattāsamāviṣṭaḥ śabdārthastadā sāmānyena bhāvābhāvasādhāraṇatayā brāhmaṇaśabdena kṣitriyādiṣuṃ sādṛśyādhyāropito brāhmaṇārthaḥ samullikhita iti pratiṣedhyaviṣaye darśite neti niṣedhaḥ pravartate | nirviṣayasya niṣedhasyāpravṛtteḥ | tatrāpi ca buddhyākārasya bhāvaikāniyatatvād buddhisattayaiva sattvānnāsti sādhāraṇatvena niṣedhayoga iti tasya yeyaṃ bahīrūpatā vyāvahārakairdṛśyavikalpaikīkārādadhyasitā tatraiva niṣedhaḥ phalati | tathā hi yo'yaṃ brāhmaṇārthaḥ sa bahirasan kevalaṃ bhrāntyā kṣatriye'dhyavasita iti svābhāvikabrāhmaṇārthanivṛttiratra nañā dyotyate | taduktaṃ bhāṣye-- "yadi punarayaṃ nivṛttapadārthako brāhmaṇaśabdaḥ kimarthaṃ prayujyate, evaṃ yathā vijñāyeta, neti hyukte sandehaḥ syāt kasya padārtho nivartata |"  iti | atra sarvathā nivṛttapadārthakatve prayoga eva na syāditi bāhyārthāpekṣayaiva nivṛttapadārthakatvam | upacārasattāpekṣayā tu prayoga iti sphuṭamuktaṃ bhavati | pratiṣedhaviṣayaprakalpanārthaṃ ca prayoga iti tadevopacāraphalam || 42 ||
avirodhidharmasaṃbandhamupacārasattāsamāviṣṭasyaiva pratipādayituṃ mukhyasattāyāṃ tāvadasaṃbhavamāha-- ātmalābhasya janmākhyā sattā labhyaṃ ca labhyate | yadi sajjāyate kasmādathāsajjāyate katham || 43 ||
 ātmalābho vastunaḥ svarūpaprāptiḥ janma kathyate | tatra ca tritayamanvayi, labdhā kartā, labhyaṃ karma , lābhaśca kriyā | etacca tritayaṃ sadviṣayam | tathā ca janmavirodhaḥ sat ātmalābhāyogāt | labdhātmā hi sannucyate | kāraṇe śaktirūpatayāvasthāne'pi sarvathāsato janmāyogādavaśyamapūrvasya kasyacidaṃśasya lābho'bhyupagantavya iti yena rūpeṇa sanna tena rūpeṇa janma yena ca janma na tena sanniti jāyate'ṅkura iti prayogānupapattiḥ | janmānurodhādasattvābhyupagame dhātvarthe kartṛtvānupapatteḥ pratyayārthavirodhaḥ | tadanurodhātsattvābhyupagame janmalakṣaṇadhātvarthavirodha ityarthaḥ || 43 ||
atraivārthe sadṛśaṃ dṛṣṭāntamāha-- sato hi ganturgamanaṃ sati gamye pravartate | gantṛvaccenna janmārtho cettadvanna jāyate || 44 ||
 svarūpaprasaraṇalakṣaṇa gamikriyā janikriyāsadṛśī | tatra ca sata eva gamanaṃ ganturdṛśyate vyatiriktasadrūpakarmaviṣayam | evamihāpi prādurbhāvituḥ gantṛvat janmānupapattiḥ | atha janmānurodhastadā sattvājjāyate ka iti kartṛtvāyogaḥ | gamyavacca labdhavyo'pyatra vyatirikto nāstīti bāhyaśabdārthābhyupagame'nupapattiḥ || 44 ||
upattārasattāśrayeṇa tūpapattirityāha-- upacarya tu kartāramabhidhānapravṛttaye | punaśca karmabhāvena tāṃ kriyāṃ ca tadāśrayām || 45 ||
athopacārasattaivaṃ vidheyāstatra lādayaḥ | janmanā tu virodhitvāt mukhyā sattā na vidyate || 46 ||
 tuśabdo bāhyasattāyā viśeṣamupacārasattāyāḥ sarvaṃsahatvena dyotayati | iha sarvātmanā pariniṣṭhitaṃ jāyata iti na vyapadiśyate | nāpi sarvātmanāsadrūpam, api tu sadasadrūpamāśritapūrvāparāvasthaṃ sattāsādanonmukhaṃ vastu jāyateśabdaviṣayaḥ | tathā ca tatrottaramasadrūpamavasyāviśeṣaṃ pūrvavasthāyāṃ kāraṇānāṃ kāryaunmukhyalakṣaṇāyām upacarya aṅkura ityabhidhānasya pravṛttau jāyata iti kartṛtvopapatiḥ | āśritapūrvāvasthātvācca janmārthopapattiḥ | evaṃ ca kṛtvāśritapūrvāvastha upacaritottarāvasthaśca saṃmūrcchito'rthātmā jāyata ityabhidhānasya viṣayaḥ | pūrvāvasthāśrayaṇācca labhyatvena kartaivopacaritaḥ karma nānyaditi buddhyā vivecanamidamāśritya tadāśrayām tayoḥ sādhanayoḥ kartṛkarmaṇorāśrayamāspadaṃ kriyāpekṣatvāt sādhanabhāvasya tannibandhanam, te vā kartṛkarmaṇī āśrayo yasyāḥ sādhanādhīnajanmatvādityubhayathāpi pāṭhaḥ | tām janikriyāṃ pūrvāparībhūtāvayavasamāhārātmikāmadhyāropya jāyate'ṅkura iti prayogasamarthanam | atha ityabhyupagadyotanāya | evaṃ ca satyupacārasattaivamāśritā bhavati | tathā ca tatraiva kartaryaya jāyata iti lakāro jāta iti ca ktaḥ, jātavāniti ca ktavatuḥ, janmāṅkurasyeti ṣaṣṭhī | yadvā kartṛkalpanayā lakāraḥ kartari pratyayaḥ, kriyākalpanayā dhātuḥ prakṛtiḥ, karmakalpanayā karmakartṛvyākhyāne vākye'ṅkura ātmānaṃ labhata iti dvitīyā karmaṇi | evamātmānamātmanā bibhradastītyādāvapi vācyam | evaṃvidho vā sarvaḥ parikara upacārasatteti tannibandhanatvādevamabhedena vyapadeśaḥ | mukhyā tu sattā pūrvoktādvirodhānna saṃgacchate | ataḥ ātmalābhasya janmākhyā iti pūrvapakṣo'yam | siddhānta ātmalābhonmukhatā janma | tathā ca vakṣyati-- pūrvasmāt pracyutā dharmādaprāptā cottaraṃ padam | tadantarāle bhedānāmāśrayājjanma kathyate || iti | tathā-- pūrvāmavasthāmajahat saṃspṛśan dharmamuttaram | sammūrchita ivārthātmā jāyamāno'bhidhīyate | iti | punaśca karmabhāvena `tam' iti kvacit pāṭhaḥ | tatra taṃ kartārameva punaḥ karmabhāvenopacaryeti yojanā || 45,46 ||
idānīṃ janmottarakālabhāvinamastitvaṃ bhāvavikāramaṅkuro'yamastītyayaṃśabda upacārasattāsamāviṣṭameva pratipādayati, anyathāyogādityāha | ātmānamātmanā bibhradastīti vyapadiśyate | antarbhāvācca tenāsau karmaṇā na sakarmakaḥ || 47 ||
 ātmanātmānaṃ dhārayatītyasterarthaḥ | tathā ca niruktakāraḥ | "astītyutpannasyātmadhāraṇamucyate" iti | vyatiriktakartṛpratiṣedhārtham ātmanā iti vacanam | tathā ca vāstavasya kartṛkarmakriyābhedasyābhāvo bhinnarūpatvādvastuna ityarthaḥ | ātmanā sakarmakatvāttarhyasteḥ prasiddhamakarmakatvamapāvartetetyatrāha-antarbhāvād ityādi | asau ityasidhātustadartho vā | dhātvarthena karmaṇa upasaṃgrahādakarmako'yaṃ dhātvartha iti prasaṅgād vyutpādayati | jīvatāviva prāṇānāmapyātmalakṣaṇasya karmaṇo dhātuvācyatvātkriyāntaramevedamātmanātmānaṃ dhārayatīti vyākhyāyate, na tvatra bhāvataḥ karmayoga ityarthaḥ | yathā vakṣyati "na tatra dhārirna prāṇājīvatistu kriyāntaram" iti | evaṃ jāyata ityatrāpyātmānaṃ labhata ityarthanirvacane'ntarbhūtakarmatvaṃ draṣṭavyam | yo hi dhātvarthādbahirbhūtaḥ kramārthaḥ sa sakarmakavyapadeśahetuḥ | dhātorarthapūraṇe hi saṃpanne tasmād bāhyasya tenārthena saṃbandhe bhedādhiṣṭhāne sati yā karmatā gāmāneyeti śābdī praviśa piṇḍīmityādau ca sāmarthyalabdhā sā sakarmakavyapadeśanibandhanam | iha tu kriyākārakasaṃsargaparyanto dīrgho dhātvartha iti bhedābhāvaḥ || 47 ||
evaṃ bhedābhāvānnāyaṃ vastuto vyavahāro yujyata iti pratipādyādhunā jāyata itivat kartṛtvāyogāt svarūpābhāvājapyasaṃbhavamuktopacārasattāyāmevopapattiṃ pratipādayati-- prāk ca sattābhisaṃbandhānmukhyā sattā kathaṃ bhavet | asaṃśca nāsteḥ kartā syādupacārastu pūrvavat || 48 ||
 astīti pūrvāparībhūtā sattā sādhyamānāvasthā pratīyate | asyāṃ cāvasthāyāṃ niṣpannarūpaḥ kartā nāsti, sādhanasaṃbandhātpūrvamapi sadbhāvo nāsti | na cānyastabd‌yatirikto'rthaḥ sādhanamatra prajñāyate iti saiva sattā sādhyaṃ ca sādhanaṃ ca mukhyato na saṃbhavati | tathā hi siddharūpeṇa sādhanena bhavitavyam | na ca sattāmanubhavanneva siddhatayā prajñāyate, anubhūtasattāsaṃbandhaśca na sādhya iti labvātmalābhasyātmadhāraṇalakṣaṇā sattā buddhyā pūrvāparībhūtatayaivābhidhīyate | tatra copasārasattārūḍhasya pūrvabhāgaḥ kartā tadaparastu sādhyaḥ karma, tadubhayāśrayakriyāsvarūpāntarbhūtamiti pūrvaṃ jāyata itivadupacārasattayā kartṛtvamāśrityāstīti prayogopapattiḥ | tadevamasti, nāsti, jāyata iti prayogamupacārasattāsamāśrayaṇena samarthitam | eta eva trayo bhāvavikārāḥ | eteṣveva cānye trayo'ntarbhavanti | tathā hi, janmani vuddhiravayavovoracayātmikāntarbhūteti jāyata itivad vardhata ityayamapi prayogaḥ samarthanīyaḥ | evaṃ pariṇāmo dharmāntarāvirbhāvalakṣaṇo'traivāntarbhūṃta iti pariṇamata ityanenaiva nyāyenāvagantavyam | parikṣayastu nāstīti vināśe'ntarbhavati, tatrāpyupacārasattāśrayeṇa parikṣīyata iti prayogaḥ samarthanīya iti ṣaḍbhāvavikārayonitvātsarvasya kriyāprapañcasya bauddhasattāśrayeṇa prayogaḥ || 48 ||
kriyābhiḥ sādhanānāmākṣepāttadvācināmapi tathaiva prayoga iti sārvatrikīmupacārasattāyāḥ śabdārthatve vyāptiṃ nigamayitumāha-- tasmādbhinneṣu dharmeṣu virodhiṣvavirodhinīm | virodhikhyāpanāyaiva śabdaistairupāśritām || 49 ||
abhinnakālāmartheṣu bhinnakāleṣvavasthitām | pravṛttihetuṃ sarveṣāṃ śabdānāmaupacārikīm || 50 ||
etāṃ sattāṃ padārtho hi na kaścidativartate | sā ca sampratisattāyāḥ pṛthagbhāṣye nidarśitā || 51 ||
 bāhyo yeṣāṃ virodho bhāvādīnāṃ dharmāṇāṃ tairupacārasattāyā avirodho yathoktena nyāyena | ata evāha--`virodhikhyāpanāyaiva' iti | virodhināṃ prakāśanāya taistairbāhmaṇādiśabdairupagṛhītām | etairhi śabdairviṣaya upadarśayate dharmāṇām | te ca dharmā bāhyādvastuno bhinnāḥ, śabdenaiva bhedasya parikalpanāt | nīlotpalādau virodhinā vā bhinnād vartamānādvastuno'tītānāgatādayaḥ vīpsayā viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaviṣayanīlotpalādiśabdairapi upāśritām ityāha | tatrāpi pravibhajya melanamupacārasattāyāṃ yujyate | anyathā saṃsṛṣṭe vastuni neyaṃ kalpanā ghaṭata ityuktam | atītānāgatakālavyāpitvācca niyatakaleṣavapi bāhyeṣvartheṣviyamabhinnakālā sārvatrikī | ata eva sarveṣāmapi śabdānāṃ pravṛttiheturiyam | caitro'bhūd bhaviṣyatīti buddhyārtaṃ nirūpya tatra śabdapravṛtteḥ, anirūpite'rthe tadayogāt | tathā hi vidyamāno'pi vartamānakāliko'rtho yāvad buddhyā nāvadhṛtastāvadaviṣayaḥ śabdānāmiti sarvatropacārasattārūḍha eva śabdārtha ityuktaṃ bhavati | kriyākārakabhāvenāpi cārthānāṃ nirūpaṇaṃ bauddhameva | tathā hi-bhāvyamānatvādeva kriyā samprati nāsti, tadabhāvāttadapekṣaṃ sādhanatvamapi kuta iti ākhyātaśabdasya kriyāvācinaḥ subantasya ca kārakavācinaḥ sarvasyaiva buddhiparigṛhīta upacārasattāsamāviṣṭo vācyo'rtho'vatiṣṭhata iti sarveṣāṃ vyāptisiddhiḥ | abhāvasya ca jñāyamānatvena sattvādetāmupacārasattāṃ sarva eva padārtho nātikrāmatīti sarveṣāmeva tadviṣayatvādabhāvādiśabdānāmapyarthena nityāviyogaḥ | siddhaḥ | asyāścopacārasattāyā na nirmūlatvamapi tu bhāṣyakārābhyupagatatvameva | matubvārtike na sattāṃ padārtho vyabhicaratītyastiśabdārthākṣepe tatsamarthanāya sampratisattāyāṃ yathā syād bhūtabhaviṣyatsattāyāṃ mā bhūt gāvo'syāsan, gāvo'sya bhavitāraḥ | iti bhāṣyavacanāduvapacārasattāstīti gamyate | pramāṇabhūtatvādasya vacanasya | na hi bhūtā bhaviṣyantī vā kācit sattā yā astītyanena vicāryeta | bhūtabhaviṣyatorapyanupākhyatvānna kācinmukhyā sattā | atītasyānubhūtatvādanāgatasya praguṇakāramasāṃmukhyena buddhyā tu parāmarśe pratyayaparivartinyarthe śabdaprayoga ityupacārasattā bhūtabhaviṣyatorupapadyate | tathā ca tad‌vyudāsāya bāhyasattāparigrahārthamastīti viśeṣaṇaṃ yuktam | bāhyā hi sattā samprati vartamāne kāle bhavatītyanyā, tato bhūtabhaviṣyatoḥ pratyayātmanā satteyam | yadyapi vartamānavasthāsyāpi bāhyasya pratītigrāhyatvenaiva vyavahāryā sattā tathāpi saiva bahirapi bhāvādastītyanena viśeṣaṇena vivakṣitavartamānakālena gṛhyate | pratītimātraśaraṇā tvitarā vyudasyate | tadevamupacārasattāyāṃ samarpitasvabhāvānāṃ bāhyānāmevārthānāmatītādibhāvena pratyāyanādyathārtha eva śābdo vyavahāra iti saṃbandhanityatvamupapāditam || 49,50,51 ||
idānīṃ sarvaṃsyaiva śābdasya vyavahārasya yathātattvamapravṛtterviṣlutatve gavādiśabdānāmavicārasiddhārthavattābhyupagantavyā | tathā ca satyatītādyabhāvaviṣayāṇāmapi śabdānāṃ bhāvābhimatavastuviṣayairghaṭādiśabdaiḥ tulyatāṃ pratipādayitumupakramate-- pradeśasyaikadeśaṃ vā parato vā nirūpaṇam | viparyayamabhāvaṃ vā vyavahāro'nuvartate || 52 ||
 iha śābdo vyavahāro'yathātattvaṃ pravṛtto'rvāg‌dṛśām | tathā hi pūrṇasya tattvasya sākṣācchabdaiḥ spraṣṭumaśakyatvādavidyāparikalpitapratiniyataghaṭādipradeśagataḥ śābdo vyavahāraḥ | pradeśaśabdena ghaṭāderbramhaikadeśatvādabhidhānaṃ kṛtsnārthaparigrahāsāmarthyaṃ śabdānāṃ pratipādayitum | tatrāpi ca mātrākalāpātmako na pradeśaḥ samastaḥ śabdenābhidhīyate api tu tadekadeśaḥ | ghaṭaśabdena hi ghaṭatvajātirucyate | tatraiva raktaśabdena guṇaḥ | evaṃ śabdāntarairapi pratiniyatabhāvābhidhānamudāhāryam | pareṇa jātyādinā ca nirūpaṇam | saṃsargadarśane svato gaurna gauḥ, gotvābhisaṃbandhādgauriti brahmakalpaṃ sākṣādavyavahāryameva dravyaṃ paropadhīyamānarūpaviśeṣaṃ vyavahāramanupatati | tatra viparyayo'bhinnasya brahmaṇo nānopādhivaśena bhedaḥ | vijñānanaye vā bahīrūpasya bahīrūpatayā bhānaṃ viparītakhyātiḥ | abhāvaḥ śūnyavādimate vyāvahārikaḥ, bāhyasya sarvathaiva niṣedhāt vijñānamātrasyākāranānātvāyogādasevedaṃ bhedajātaṃ śabdaviṣayam | tadeṣu caturṣu darśaneṣu śabdānāmarthasaṃbandho na bhāvikaḥ | tathā hi-ādye darśane'rtho'sti gavādiśabdānām, tatropapadyate saṃbandho yadi so'rthabhāgo jñānasya gocarībhavet | na ca bhavati, vivekenānavadhāraṇāt | atīndriyā api cānye dharmā abhyupeyante | ato'trāpi na saṃpūrṇo'rthasaṃbandhaḥ | itareṣu pakṣeṣvarthābhāvādeva saṃbandhāsiddhiḥ | tathā hi parato nirūpaṇe''dhīyamānarūpameva nīrūpaṃ nirūpyate'bhidhīyate ceti na satyavastuviṣayaḥ saṃbandhaḥ | evaṃ viparyayābhāvapakṣayorapi vācyam || 52 ||
etadeva dṛṣṭāntena sādhayati-- yathendriyasya vaiguṇyāt sattādhyāropavāniva | jāyate pratyayo'rthebhyastathaivoddeśajā matiḥ || 53 ||
 timiropahatanayanaścandramekamapyanekaṃ paśyati | kāmalī ca śuklamapi pītaṃ śaṅthamiti | indrayadoṣādākārāntarārūṣitārthāmabhāsī pratyayo'rthebhyo jāyate | arthānāṃ tatrāvaṃbanatvānniyataviṣayatvādbhāntīnāṃ pratyayadharmādhyāropo na vastu pracinotīti iva śabdaḥ | evamuddiśyate pratipādyate'neneti uddeśaḥ śabdaḥ | tata utpannā buddhirasadākārādhyāropavatī bhavati || 53 ||
indriyavat kiṃ śabde vaiguṇyamityāha-- ākṛtsnaviṣayābhāsaṃ śabdaḥ pratyayamāśritaḥ | arthamāhānyarūpeṇa svarūpeṇānirūpitam || 54 ||
 iha kāraṇānurūpaṃ kāryaṃ bhavati | śabdasya ca nirūpitārthaviṣayatvānnirūpaṇāpratyayaḥ kāraṇam | taduktam-- tathā ca buddhiviṣayādarthācchabdaḥ pratīyate | iti | nirūpaṇāpratyayaśca vikalpaḥ | sa caikaikavyāvṛttiniṣṭhatvādvikalpanām akṛtsnaviṣayāvabhāsaḥ | na hi vikalpena yathātattvaṃ vastu spṛśyate, pradeśaikadeśādinā saṃsparśādityuktam | ataścākṛtsnamevārthamadhyāropitarūpabhedaṃ śabdaḥ pratipādayati | kāryakāraṇasaṃbandhavaśādvikalpātmako hi pratyayaḥ śabdājjāyate | taduktam--vikalpayonayaḥ śabdā vikalpāḥ śabdayonayaḥ | iti | tathā "kāryopādānavikalpaparigṛhītaḥ śabdārthaḥ" iti | evamavidyāmāndyādvikalpānāṃ yathātattvamavasāyapāṭavābhāvāt samaropitarūpeṇāvasāyasya sarvavādibhirabhyupagatatvāttadupadarśitaviṣayaviṣayāḥ śabdāḥ sarva eva bahirasadarthaviṣayāḥ pratyayopārūḍharūpābhidhāyinaḥ siddhā ityatītādyabhāvādiśabdānāmapyarthasaṃbandhe na vipratipattavyamiti sthitam || 54 ||
tatraitat syāt nirāvaraṇakhyātīnāṃ bhāvatattvadṛśāṃ yathārtha eva śābdo vyavahāraḥ, te cāsmākamupadeṣṭāra iti nāyathārthaḥ sa ityāśaṅkyāha-- rūpaṇavyapadeśābhyāṃ laukike vartmani sthitau | jñānaṃ pratyamilāpaṃ ca sadṛśau bālapiṇḍitau || 55 ||
 parasparābhiprāyamelanātmakatvādvayavahārasyāvadātadarśanā bhāvatattvadṛśo'pi vyavaharanto lokapathavartinaḥ sadṛśo'nyairarvāg‌darśanaiḥ | rūpaṇam ālocanam | ālocya śabdena prāpaṇaṃ vyapadeśaḥ | ābhyāṃ vyavaharanto laukike mārge tulyāḥ | kva viṣaya ityāha jñānaṃ prati ityādi | bālasya viparyāsitamateryaj‌jñānamarthasaṃvikalpam, abhilāpo vyapadeśarūpaśca te prati tadviṣaye | yathā bālo vikalpayatyarthamabhidhatte ca, evaṃ paramārthadarśanā vidvāṃso'pi | tathā hi te'pi nirūpya vivakṣitvā viṣayaṃ yathāvivakṣameva vyapadiśantaḥ parābhiprayamelanamārabhanta iti | yathā parābhiprāyameva pūrvaṃ nirūpayanti tathā ca teṣāmapi nirūpaṇājñānaṃ vikalpaḥ tatpūrvakaścābhilāpaḥ śabdo laukikasadṛśaḥ | yā tu teṣāṃ vyavahārātītā daśā tasyāṃ śuddhaṃ jñānaṃ pāramārthikamanirūpakam || 55 ||
pratiniyataviṣayagrāhakameva jñānaṃ sadaiveti kāsya śuddhirityāha-- sarvārtharūpatā śuddhirjñānasya nirupāśrayā | tato'pyasya parāṃ śuddhimeke prāhurarūpikām || 56 ||
 dve daśe śuddherupakramaparisamāptirūpe | indriyasannikarṣādirūpopāśraya nirapekṣatayāśeṣārthāvabhāsakhacitaṃ sarvajñajñānamupakrame śuddhamityucyate | indriyādyapekṣārūpāyāḥ svaviṣayagrahaṇe'śudderanavagamāt | niṣṭhāyāṃ cākārakāluṣyāpagamāt prabhāsvaraṃ praśāntakallolaṃ saṃvinmātramekaghanaṃ śuddhaṃ grāhyagrāhakaprapaṃcaśūnyaṃ paraṃ brahma || 56 ||
niyatākārāvagraho hyaśuddhirityāha-- apaplavo hi jñānasya bāhyākārānupātitā | kāluṣyamiva tattasya saṃsarge vyatibhedajam || 57 ||
 svacchajñānasyārthena saṃsarge sati yastenaivārthena vyatibhedaḥ pratibibavaśādabhedo vyāmiśrībhāvaḥ tato jāto'yam upaplavo bāhyaviṣayaprāvaṇyam, udakasyeva rajaḥsamparkādāvilībhāvaḥ tadapagame krameṇa svasmin svaccharūpe'vasthānam parā śuddhiḥ sarvadarśanābhyupagatā | taduktam "tadā draṣṭuḥ svarūpe'vasthānam"  iti | ivaśabdenārtarūpasambhede'pi svaprakāśaṃ jñānarūpamanavagatamityāha || 57 ||
arthasyāpi vyavahāre'śuddhimāha-- yathā ca jñānamālekhādaśuddhau vyavatiṣṭhate | tathopāśrayavānarthaḥ svarūpādviprakṛṣyate || 58 ||
 ālekho viṣayarūpoparāgaḥ | tato'śuddhaṃ jñānamiti prasādhitamarthamarthāśuddhau sādhyāyāṃ dṛṣṭāntayati | upāśrayo jātyādirupadhānam, tena ca dvāreṇa yathādarśanamartho vyavahārpathamavatarati | nirūpādhestasyāvyavahāryatvāt | upādhisaṃsargaścātattvamityarthasyeyamaśuddhiḥ | jātyādyupādhirūpeṇa samavetena śabalitamarthavastu pratīyate'bhidhīyate ceti tathā tad vyavahāramavatarati | na tu sarvathāvyapadeśyaṃ dravyam, etadeva hi tasya rūpaṃ yadupādhisaṃsṛṣṭam, sadaiva tatsaṃsṛṣṭasya pratyayāt || 58 ||
uktamartha prakṛte yojayati evamarthasya śabdasya jñānasya ca viparyaye | bhāvābhāvavabhedena vyavahārānupātinau || 59 ||
 jātyādisaṃsargarūpoparāgo'rthasyāśuddhiḥ | śabdasyāpyakṛtsnārthābhidhānāttadupādhirūpeṇābhidhānād aśuddhiḥ | jñānasya bāhyākāroparāgaḥ | evaṃ tritayamapi viparyastam | tathā ca bhāvasyāpi śabdenābhidhīyamānasya jāyamānasya vā paropādhirūpatayābhāvasamakakṣyatā | abhāvo'pi hi ghaṭābhāvaḥ paṭābhāva iti paropādhireva śabdapratyayāvanupatatīti sāmyam | buddhyā nirūpyamāṇo hyabhāvo bhāvarūpeṇaivāvacchidyate | yattu paramaṃ rūpaṃ tatraiva vyavahārāspadam | nanu ca viparyāsaḥ pratipattṛdharmaḥ, tena pratipattaiva viparyastaḥ kathyatām, arthastu kathaṃ viparyastaḥ | ucyate | viparyāsaviṣayatvāt svarūpeṇāpratibhāsanādartho'pi tathā, śabdo'pi viparyāsahetutvāt tathocyate || 59 ||
kathamabhedena vyavahārānupāta ityāha-- yathā bhāvamupāśritya tadabhāvo'nugamyate | tathābhāvamupāśritya tadbhāvo'pyanugamyate || 60 ||
 nirupādherabhāvasyāviśiṣṭatvāt bhāvopādhervyavahārāvatāraḥ | bhāvasyāpi madyāvasthāyāmeva sattvāt prāgabhāvāvacchinnameva vyavahāre tattvam | nityānāmapyabhivyaṃjakakālāt prāganabhivyakterasattayā vyavahāro na viśiṣyate || 60 ||
evamanyonyāpekṣitve bhāvābhāvayorvyavahāre sāmyaṃ bhedamabhyupagamya pratipāditadam | idānīṃ bhāvavyatiriktamabhāvaṃ nirasitumāha-- nābhāvo jāyate bhāvo naiti bhāvo'nupākhyatām | ekasmādātmano'nanyau bhāvābhāvau vikalpitau || 61 ||
dvaitanaye prāgabhāvopamardena bhāvaniṣpattiḥ | bhāvopamardena pradhvaṃsasaṃbhavaḥ | dvayamapi caitadayuktam, bhāvābhāvayoranyonyasvabhāvopagamasaṃbhavāt, svabhāvasyānapāyāt | ataścātyantaviveke bhāvopādhitayābhāvasyābhāvopādhitayā bhāvasya pratītirna syāt | tasmādekamevādvayaṃ tattvamātmaśabdavācyaṃ vyavahāre vikalpadaśāyāṃ bhāvābhāvopādhirūpapravibhaktaṃ cakāsti | prakāśarūpasya hi parasya tattvasya sarvathāvibhinnasvabhāvasya mahāsattātmano'bhāvapratiyogino'vidyāvaśātsāṃvṛtalokayātranirvartanasamarthasya bahiridantayā pratibhāne vartamānakālopādhitayārthakriyākāriṇo bhāvarūpatā, atītānāgatakālopādhitayā cāntareva saṃskārarūpatayānuvartanādbāhyendriyaviṣayatānupagamāt sarvapramātṛsādhāraṇārthakriyākaraṇādabhāvarūpatayā vyavahāraḥ | na ca sarvathā tadānīmasattā smaryamāṇatvādutprekṣyamāṇatvācca | tathā ca yasya saṃskārarūpāste bhāvāstasya smṛtyutprekṣāgatāḥ kalpayantyeva kāmapyarthakriyām | ata eva ca madhyāvasthasya bhāvasvabhāvasyaiva prāgabhāvaḥ sphuṭena rūpeṇendriyāparicchedyāvasthā, pradhvaṃsaścottarakālamabhāvo vyavahriyate, na tu sarvathā bhāvasaṃskāranivṛttāvabhāvaḥ kaścit sarvaśaktivirahalakṣaṇaścākāsti cetasi | ata eva trayyadhvikāḥ padārthāḥ samuddhoṣyanta iti nābhāvo nāma kaścit || 61 ||
tatraitat syāt-kathaṃ bhāvābhāvau vikalpitau ityucyate, kāraṇabhedāt satyabhūtau yathāvasāyaṃ kasmānna bhavata ityāśaṅkya sadasatpakṣabhedena kāryakāramabhāvānupapattipratipādanapūrvakaṃ dvaitadarśanamapodya vivartāśrayeṇādvaitanayaṃ svamatena siddhāntayitumupakramate-- abhāvasyānupākhyatvāt kāraṇaṃ na prasādhakam | sopākhyasya tu bhāvasya kāraṇaṃ kiṃ kariṣyati || 62 ||
 iha kāryasyātmalābhamuddiśya kāraṇaṃ pravartate | tatra niḥsvābhāvasyoddeśatvāyogāt kimavalaṃbya kāraṇasya padabandhaḥ syāt | jātyātmanā sattve tasyā nityatvātkāryatānupapatteḥ punarapi kāraṇaṃ kva varteta | kathaṃcidabhedo jātivyaktyoriti ced vyak‌tyātmanā tarhi kāryateti tadavastho doṣaḥ | niyatakāraṇaparigrahaśca na syāt | asattvasyāviśeṣāt sikatābhyo'pi taivaṃ stravet | niyataśakti kāraṇamiti cet kuto'vasitametat | tasmin sati sadbhāvāditi cet tadevedaṃ paryanuyujyate `kathamatyantāsatastasmin sati bhāva iti | pratītitvādadoṣa iti cet tadevedaṃ paryanuyujyate `kathamatyantāsatastasmin sati bhāva iti | pratītatvādadoṣa iti cet pratītimātramastu kimayuktikena kāryakāraṇabhāvopavarṇanena | tathā ca siddhāntayiṣyati-- "bhāvānāṃ prāgabhūtānāmātmatattvaṃ prakāśate" iti | atha sat kāryaṃ kāraṇa iti naite doṣāḥ, atrāpi kṛtasya karaṇayogādakiṃcitkaraṃ kāraṇam | na hyetadyujyate kāraṇaṃ cātropayujyate, na cāpūrvaṃ kiṃcit prāpyāt iti | athābhivyaktiḥ kāraṇena kāryasya kriyate sā'pi tato'nyā'nyā vā | anyatve satī vā syādasatī vā | sattve prāgiva kāraṇānupapattiḥ | abhivyak‌tyantarakaraṇe tvetadeva punarāvartate'navasthā ca | asattve prāptamasato janma | tathā ca kārye ko vidveṣaḥ | abhivyaktau ca kāraṇavyāpārāt kāryasya kāryatā na syāt | vastvantarotpattau ca kiṃ tasya yenāsāvaśaṅkitamevodbhavet | tatsaṃbandhābhivyaktikāraṇāditi cet, ko'yaṃ janyajanakayoḥ saṃbandhaḥ | tattve'pyabhivayaktau tajjanyāyāṃ tadviṣayaḥ kāraṇavyāpāro na syāt, kāryeṇaiva tasyā jananāt | tathā kāryasya janane tadviṣayo'pi kāraṇavyāpāro na syāt | tathā ca tasyāsato janane'satkāryaprasaṅgaḥ | sato'pyabhivyaktau punarapyetadāvartate | upakāryopakārakabhāvaḥ saṃbandho'bhivyaktikāryayoriti cet, kena karayopakāraḥ | sa ca kiṃ vyatirikta utāvyatiriktaḥ | vyatireke tasyeti kaḥ ṣaṣṭhyarthaḥ | upakārāntarakalpane'pyetadeva codanīyamanavasthā ca | avyatireke tu janyajanakabhāva eva paryavasyati | tatra cokto doṣaḥ |ananyatve'bhivyakteḥ kāryāttadeva kṛtaṃ syādityasatkāryanayāśrayaḥ | tatra cānupapattirāvediteti saṅkaṭo'yaṃ panthāḥ || 62 ||
itthaṃ ca kāryatāniṣedhāt prāgabhāvapradhvaṃsābhāvāvapi kṛtakavastuviṣayau na sta iti pūrvoktamevāvasthābhedena vikalpitatvaṃ bhāvābhāvayornigamayati-- tasmātsarvamabhāvo vā bhāvo vā sarvamiṣyate | na tvavasthāntaraṃ kiṃcidekasmāt satyataḥ sthitam || 63 ||
 kāryakāraṇabhāvābhāvānmadhye jāto'bhivyakto vāsan pūrvottarayoravasthayorajāto'nibhavyakto vināśakāraṇayogādvinaṣṭaśca bhāvo nopapadyata iti bhāvābhāvau naikasyāvasthātuḥ pariṇāmadarśanāśrayeṇa satyabhūtāvasthātmakau, api tu vyavabāradaśāyāmavidyāpravṛttirūpāyāṃ satyasyābhinnasaṃvinmātrasya satyabhūtāvasthātmakau, api tu vyavahāradaśāyāmavidyāpravṛttirūpāyāṃ satyasyābhinnasaṃvinmātrasya tattvasya yathārthamanavabhāsāt paramārthataḥ sarvaṃ prapaṃcajātamabhāva evāparamārtha eva | sa ca nīrūpo na kaściditi bhāvavyatirekaṃ na sahate | kiṃcidrūpaṃ hi kutaścid vyatiricyate | bhedamātrasya cābhinnatattvāgrahaṇarūpasya śūnyatvāt | sāṃvṛtena tu rūpeṇa sarvaṃ bhāvātmakam , prathamānasya vastutvāt, avastunaḥ prathanāyogāt | bhāvānāṃ hi jñāyamānatvena jñānopārūḍhatayā sattvameva, bahiradhyavasānāccāpi sattvam | kevalaṃ yo'yaṃ bhedo'vacchedo grahaṇamasau na kiṃcidavidyā | tatra ca bhinnaḥ prakāśo'nugata iti vidyāvasthataiva | tathā ca "vidyāvidyāpravibhāgamapravibhāgaṃ brahma" iti | brahmakāṇḍa uktam || 63 ||
yataścaivaṃ sarvaṃ saṃvṛtisat tataḥ pravādināṃ darśanavikalpāstatrābhimānamātramityāha-- tasmānnābhāvamicchanti ye loke bhāvavādinaḥ | abhāvavādino vāpi na bhāvaṃ tattvalakṣaṇam || 64 ||
 āvirbhāvatirobhāvamātraṃ janmanāśau sata eveti vadanto bhāvavādinaḥ paramarṣayaḥ | teṣāmabhāvo nāma bhāvapṛthagbhūto na kaścidbhāvasyaiva pūrvottarayokavasthayorabhāvavyavahārāt | tathā hi-mṛdavasthā ghaṭasya prāgabhāvaḥ , kapālāvasthā ca pradhvaṃsābhāva iti vācyam | sarvaṃ śūnyamidaṃ jagadityabhāvavādināmapyabhāvaḥ pāramārthiko na kaścit iti na bhāvaṃ tattvasakṣaṇaṃ paramārtharūpamicchanti | evamapi bruvanto vyavahāre bhāvābhāvabhedamarthakriyākāraṇākaraṇanimittaṃ nāpahruvate | tataśca saṃvṛtyā sarvamupapadyate sāmyenetyabhiniveśo'tra tyājyaḥ || 64 ||
abhāvapratikṣepe tarhi nirnibandhano bhāvābhāvabheda ityata āha | advaye caiva sarvasmin svabhāvādekalakṣaṇe | parikalpeṣu maryādā vicitraivopalabhyate || 65 ||
 sarvasmin paridṛśyamānabhedajāte svabhāvāt paramārtharūpāt, na sāmānyasamāveśavaśādekasvabhāve brahmamaye vicitreṣu vikalpeṣu bhāvābhāvavādinānātvenānādiniyatiśaktiniyamiteyamavidyāvaśān maryādā vyavasthā nānārūpā dṛśyate | asatyapi vāstave bhede'vidyānimitto'yaṃ bhedo vyavahāre rūḍha ityavicāritasiddho'vagantavya ityarthaḥ || 65 ||
na tu satyato'yaṃ bhāvābhāvabheda iti nidarśanena vyutpādayati-- catasro hi yathāvasthā nirupākhye prakalpitāḥ | evaṃ dvaividhyamapyetad bhāvābhāvavyapāśrayam || 66 ||
 prākpradhvaṃsātyantetaretaralakṣaṇopādhivaśena nīrūpasya rūpabhedāyogādyathā'bhāvasya caturdhā bhedaḥ kālpanikaḥ tathaiva bhāvābhāvalakṣaṇo'pi bhedaḥ kālpanika evāvagantavyaḥ ityarthaḥ | baharindriyagocarārthakriyopādhirbrahmabhāgaḥ kalpito bhāvaḥ, bahirarthakriyāśūnyastvabhāva iti saṅ‌ketaḥ || 66 ||
vastutastu sarvavyavahārātītau na pṛthag bhāvābhāvāvātmatattvamuddarśayata ityāha-- avirodhī virodhī vā sannasan vāpi yuktitaḥ | kramavānakramo vāpi nābhāva upapadyate || 67 ||
 nīrūpatvādabhāvasya bhāvena saha virodhāvirodhau yuk‌tyā na saṅgacchete | na hi bhāvamabhāvaḥ samucchinatti anugṛhṇati vā yena tadvirodhī vā yathāsaṃkhyaṃ bhavet sato'satvāyogāllabdharūpasyātiśayāyogāccha sattvamabhāvasyātmaviruddham | asattvamapyasya tadrūpatvādeva vyatiriktaṃ bhāvavannopapadyate | evaṃ hi bhāvatāprasaṅgaḥ kramo'pi bhāvadharmo nābhāvasya yujyate, bhāvasyocchettumaśakyatvād hi tadapekṣo bhāvasya kramaḥ, nāpyabhāvāntarāpekṣaḥ, tasyaivāsiddhatvāt, nīrūpasya bhedābhāvāt | evamakramo'pi, yaugapadyamarthāntarāpekṣatvādasya nāsti, anyena sahāsamānakālatvāditi yuktito nopapadyate || 67 ||
abhāvo nāmaivaṃdharmo yataḥ evam avirodhī virodhī vā sannasannapi tattvataḥ | kramavānakramo vāpi tena bhāvo na vidyate || 68 ||
 yato'bhāvasyetthamanupapadyamānatā tena bhāvaḥ apyevaṃ paramārthato nopapadyate | tathā hi-bhāvasyānucchedyatvānniratiśayatvāccābhāvena saha virodhitā avirodhitā ca na yuktā | evaṃ kramākramāvapi | atha bhāvāntareṇa saha bhāvasya virodhitvāditi cintyate tatrāpi svato'nucchedyasya niratiśayasya ca kenaciducchettumanugṛhītaṃ vāśaktestadanupapattireva | kramākramāvapi bhedābhāvānna pāramārthikau | sattvamapi niyatārthakiyānimittamarthakriyāntarākaraṇānna tattvato vyavatiṣṭhate | sattāsaṃbandhasya cānupalabdherna tannimittaṃ pratibhāsanāccāsattvamapyapāramārthikam | itthaṃ sarvavyavahārā vikalpaparighaṭitā eveti bhāvābhāvāvapi tathā vijñeyau kalpanā cāvidyāśaktiḥ | sā ca tattvānyattvābhyāmanirvācyeti brahmakāṇḍe nirṇītam || 68 ||
kālanimitto'pyatra bhedo na pāramārthika ityāha-- abhāve triṣu kāleṣu na bhedasyāsti sambhavaḥ | tasminnasati bhāve'pi traikālyaṃ nāvatiṣṭhate || 69 ||
