 triṣu kāleṣu iti | kālatrayanimittako bhedo'bhāvaviṣayo nāsti | tathā hi nīrūpatvādabhāvasya vartamānakṛtastāvat paricchedo nāsti | tadabhāvattadapekṣo'tītānāgatakālayogo'pi na bhāvikaḥ | evaṃ ca bhāvasyāpyābhāvāpekṣaṃ traikālyaṃ nāsti | tathā hi prāgabhāvāśrayaṃ bhaviṣyatvaṃ pradhvaṃsāpekṣaṃ ca bhūtatvamiti prāgabhāvapradhvaṃsayorbhedābhāvādayuktaṃ tat | tadabhāvādvartamānatvamapi nāsti | nāpi svāpekṣaṃ pūrvāparakoṭyorbhedabhāvat, bhāvasya kālatrayayuktatvam, bhāve tu sāṃkhyānāṃ pūrvāparakoṭyorbhāvasyaikatvamevābhinnarasamiti punarapi kālatrayāyogaḥ | avasthāstato na vyatiricyatanta iti tāsāmapi tadabhāvaḥ | vyatireke'pi vā tadvataḥ kālabhedo na bhāvasya śakyate lakṣaṇamanayornopapadyata ityāha-- ātmatattvaparityāgaḥ parato nopapadyate | ātmatattvantu parataḥ svato vā nopakalpate || 70 ||
 kāraṇād bhāvasya sato vināśo nopapadyate | nīrūpasya kāramasāmarthyena janyamānatāyāṃ nāśasya rūpavattvaprāpterbhāvena sambandhe prāgiva tasyopalabdhiḥ syāt | tena tasya vināśe tatrāpi tathainetyanavasthāpātāt, bhavanasvabhāvasyābhavanavirodhācca svato'pi vināśābhāva ityabhāvaśabdārtho na kaścidavatiṣṭhate | bhavanamapi bhāvasadbhāvapariniṣṭhatasya kāraṇānnopapadyate | svato'pi bhavato bhavanāyogaḥ, abhavanaśīlasya bhāvatā viruddheti bhāvaśabdārtho'pi na kaścit || 70 ||
na caivamapi bhāvābhāvāvekaṃ tattvata ityāha-- tattve virodhe nānātva upakāro na kaścana | tattvānyatvaparityāge vyavahāro nivartate || 71 ||
 vidhipratiṣedhayorokatvaṃ viruddham | nānātve tu bhāvābhāvayoḥ parasparāpekṣayā nirupakāriṇorvyavahāro na syāt tadatad‌vyatirekeṇa vikalpāsaṃbhavo rāśyantarābhāvāditi sarvavyavahārātītatvaṃ bhāvābhāvādirūpatayā pratibhāsamānaṃ jagat sāṃvṛtena rūpeṇāvicāritasiddhamiti sthitam || 71 ||
paramārthastvayamatretyāha-- yatra draṣṭā ca dṛśyaṃ ca darśanaṃ vā vikalpitam | tasyaivārthasya satyatvaṃ śritāstrayyantavedinaḥ || 72 ||
 grāhyāgrāhakādiprapañcam vikalpaparighaṭitasyāsatyatvātsarvaprapañcasamatikrāntaṃ vāṅmanasātītatattvamavikalpaṃ paraṃ brahmānādinidhanaṃ satyamiti brahmavidaḥ prāhuḥ | ṛgyajuḥsāmātmako vedastrayī, tasyā antaḥ sārabhūtārthanirṇayamaya upaniṣadbhāgaḥ | tatra hi samāptau saṃkṣipya śāstrārthasatattvamākhyāyate, taṃ jāyate tacchīlā ye ta evamabhedaṃ paramārtharūpamāhuḥ, na karmānuṣṭhānākṣiptaṃ bhedam | avidyāparikalpito hi bhedo vitatho vaikalpikaḥ | avidyāpi ca tattvānyattvābhyāṃ parasmādanirvācyānādisiddhajīvātmagatabhedapratibhāsakāriṇītyupapāditaṃ brahmakāṇḍe vistarata iti tata evāvadhāryam || 72 ||
tadevaṃ yathāvabhāsamasatyārthaniṣṭhaḥ śābdo vyavahāra ityalabdhābhinnatattvāviśrāntirbhedaṣvatropaplavata ityāha-- sāmānyaṃ vā viśeṣaṃ vā yasmādāhurviśeṣavat | śabdāstasmādasatyeṣu bhedeṣveva vyavasthitāḥ || 73 ||
 sāmānyamapi sāmānyāntarād vyāvṛttaṃ śabdairucyate | tathā viśeṣo viśeṣāntarād vyāvṛtta ityasatyeṣu bhedeṣveva śabdāḥ kṛtapadabandhā nābhinnamadvayaṃ tattvaṃ saṃspraṣṭuṃ śaktā iti vitatha eva śābdo vyavahāraḥ | sannityapi vyavahāro'bhāvapratiyogī | evaṃ jñeyaṃ prameyamityādayo'pi śabdāḥ parikalpitāḥ jñeyādivyāvṛttaviṣayā iti sarvaṃ bhedopanipāti śabdajātam | taduktaṃ bhāṣye-- "sāmānyamapi yathā viśeṣastadvad" iti | viśeṣavadityarhārthe vatiḥ | viśeṣamarhati yadabhidhānaṃ tadviśeṣavad, viśeṣo vā yatrāstīti matvarthīyaḥ | sāmānyopahitasya viśeṣasyābhidhānaṃ saṃbhāvyeteti tannivṛttaye viśeṣaṇametaditi viśeṣeṇāpi saṃbadhyate || 73 ||
evaṃ tāvannīrūpamavastvabhāvamāśritya bhāvābhāvayorvirodhādyuktam | idānīṃ vaiśeṣikanayena saptamaṃ padārthamabhāvamāśrityāha-- na hyabhāvasya sadbhāve bhāvasyātmā prahīyate | na cābhāvasya nāstitve bhāvasyātmā prasūyate || 74 ||
 bhāvādarthāntaramabhāva iti pradhvaṃsasyopajane kimiti bhāvo vinaśyati | prāgabhāvasya ca vyāvṛttau kimiti bhāvo jāyate || 74 ||
etadeva dṛṣṭāntena draḍhayati-- na śābaleyasyāstitvaṃ bāhuleyasya bādhakam | na śābaleyo nāstīti bāhuleyaḥ prakalpate || 75 ||
 pṛthagbhūtayorbhāvayorasaṃbandhayoryathā parasparasya sattāsatte na prayojike tathā bhāvābhāvayorapi tathābhūtayoḥ syādityarthaḥ || 75 ||
tadetadbhāvādarthāntarasyābhāvasya vastutve'bhyupagamyamāne doṣajātamityupasaṃharati-- abhāvo yadi vastu syāttatreyaṃ syādvicāraṇā | tataśca tadabhāve'pi syādvicāryamidaṃ punaḥ || 76 ||
saptamapadārtharūpe'bhāvasya vastutve'bhyupagamyamāne tat‌sannidhānāsannidhānābhyāṃ bhāvasyāsannidhānasannidhāne na yujyete itīyaṃ cintā yujyate | tathā ca vastutve'bhāvasya tatrāpyabhāvāntarasya vyatiriktasyodayāstamayayorabhāvasya yathāyogaṃ tau na syātām, tatrāpyabhāvāntaramityanavasthā ca syādityapi vācyam || 76 ||
yadā punarbhāvapracyutirnīrūpa evābhāvo bauddhadṛṣṭyābhyupagamyate tadā-- avastutvādatītaṃ yad vyavahārasya gocaram | tatra vastugato bhedo na nirvacanamarhati || 77 ||
 tirobhavati bhāvo na tvabhāvo nāma kaścid vyatirikto jñāyata iti naye nedaṃ vicāraṇīyaṃ na hyabhāvasya sadbhāva ityādi | bhāvapracyurūpatvādabhāvasya kathamavatiṣṭheta | bhāva iti nedaṃ dūṣaṇamavatarati | prāgabhāvavyāvṛttau ca na bhāvo jāyate api tu bhavitṛrūpatvāditi tuccharūpo'bhāvo vāstavaṃ nānātvaṃ nārhati | itthaṃ ca sarvavyavahārātīto'sattnānnīrūpatvādabhāvo vāstavabhedādinirūpaṇamāha iti prāgevoktamupasaṃhṛtam || 77 ||
idānīṃ kāryakāraṇabhāvānupapattiṃ pūrvoktāmanadyasvadarśane vivarttaṃ siddhāntathitumāha-- apade'rthe padanyāsaḥ kāraṇasya na vidyate | atha ca prāgasadbhāvaḥ kāraṇe sati dṛśyate || 78 ||
 utpatteḥ pūrvaṃ kāryalakṣaṇo'rtho'pado'vidyamānapratyāyako'sattvāditi tatra kāraṇasya padanyāso vyāpāro nopapadyate | jananakriyāveśayogyavastubhūtakāryaniṣṭho hi kāraṇānāṃ vyāpāraḥ padanyāsaḥ | sa cāsati kārye nāsti | na hyakiṃcidrūpamuddiśye kāraṇāni pravartitumutsahante | asata uddeśyatvāyogāt | sattve tu kāraṇānupapattirityuktam | atha viniyoktṛbuddhyanusaṃdhānaṃ kāryasya padanyāsaḥ so'pyasatyasambhavī | jaḍasya ca kāraṇasya sutarāṃkārye padanyāso'yaṃ nāsti| dṛśyate ca kasmiściddhetau sati kāryamiti tatraiva yadeva tattvamevaṃ pratibhāsamānaṃ na tu vāstavo hetuphalabhāvaḥ kaścidityarthaḥ || 78 ||
athotpatteḥ pūrvaṃ prāgavasthā bhāvasyeti nāpadastadānīmasāvartha ityucyate tatrāpyāha-- kā tasya prāgavastheti vastvāśritamidaṃ punaḥ | prāhavastheti na hyetad dvayamapyastyavastuni || 79 ||
 utpatteḥ pūrvaṃ kāryasya kā prāgavasthā itīdaṃ codyaṃ vastvāśritaṃ vastvālaṃbanametat paryanuyogarūpamityarthaḥ | tathā hi prāgiti cāvasyeti caitad‌dvayamatra paryanuyoge | na caitad dvayamapyavastuni | deśataḥ kālato vā pūrvaṃtvasyābhāve nīrūpe deśakālayogāyoginyasambhavāt | avastheti cāvasthātrapekṣam | na cāvasthātā kaścidanvayī vidyate pūrvamityasattvameva tatra | evamasatkāryanaye prāgasattvādetanna yujyate | satkāryanaye'pi prāgarthānupapattiḥ, idānīmapi sattvād bhāvasya | ata eva ca janmāyogādavasthātṛrūpābhāvaḥ | kenacidrūpeṇa janane tadapekṣayā prāptamasato janma | tathā ca tatrāpyapado'rthaḥ || 79 ||
vināśe'pyasattvameva nīrūpamagocaro vāco bhāvasyetyāha-- na cordhvamasti nāstīti vacanāyānibandhanam | alaṃ syādapadasthānametadvācaḥ pracakṣate || 80 ||
 pracyuteḥūrdhvaṃ niranvayadhvaṃsādasati bhāvabhāge'sti nāstītyabhidhānāya na samarthaṃ vastu | sāṃkhyā hi tadānīmapyastīti vyavaharanti | tacca na yuktam | kutaḥ | anibandhanaṃ yataḥ | vacane nibandhanamupalabhyamānatā | sā ca dhvastasya nāstīti śabdāgocaramanibandhanamasattvamiti pūrvāparāvasthayoravyavahāryo bhāvaḥ || 80 ||
madhyāvasthāyāmeva kevalaṃ dṛśyata ityāha-- atyad‌bhutā tviyaṃ vṛttiryadabhāgaṃ yadakramaṃ | bhāvānāṃ prāgabhūtānāmātmatattvaṃ prakāśate || 81 ||
 sadasat‌pakṣabhedena vāstavasya kāryakāraṇabhāvasya nirākṛtatvādupapattiśūnyayā''ścaryabhūtayā vṛttyā vyāpāreṇa kāryaṃ prāgadṛṣṭaṃ niraṃśaṃ jhaṭityevākramaṃ kasmiṃścinniyate sati dṛśyate iti pratibhāsamātrasāraḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvo vitatho vekalpiko'vidyānetrairyathāyathaṃ vikalpanāt | ekasya tattvādapracyutasya bhedānukāreṇāsatyavibhaktānyarūpopagrāhitārūpavivartaḥ paramārtha ityarthaḥ | atyadbhuteyaṃ vṛttiḥ | kāsāvityāha yadabhāgam ityādi | ityevaṃ padasamanvayaḥ | yadvā yasyāṃ vṛttau satyām abhāgaṃ niraṃśamata eva akramaṃ tattvaṃ bhāvānāṃ prakāśat iti saṃbandhaḥ | sāṃśatve sati krameṇopajane vilaṃbya vṛtteḥ kāraṇasāmarthyāvadhāraṇānnāścaryamidaṃ bhavet | yatastu jhaṭityapadamakramameva sarvavādimate'pi kāryamājāyate'taḥ kāraṇavyāpārasya vicāryatānupapatteḥ tathā prakāśo'vidyāvasādāścaryabhūto rūḍhaḥ || 81 ||
tathā hi-- vikalpotthāpitenaiva sarvo bhāvena laukikaḥ | mukhyeneva padārthena vyavahāro vidhīyate || 82 ||
 madhyāvasthābhāvi dṛśyamānaṃ rūpamapekṣya pūrvāparāvasthāparikalpanayā kramikatve sati kāryakāraṇabhāvena bhāvābhāvarūpatayā vāvicāritasiddho lokavyavahāro rūḍhaḥ | evamanyo'pi yaḥ kaścid vyavahāraḥ sa sarvastattvato bahirvidyamānasya vastuno bhinnasyābhāvādanādimithyābhyāsavāsanāvaśopajāta eva sāṃvṛtastattvādhyavasāyādasāṃvṛta ivāvidyāpravṛttirūpe jagati prarūḍhaḥ || paramārthatastu na bhedo nāma paridṛśyamānaḥ satyaḥ, api tu advayameva tattvam || 82 ||
avidyānetrairevamavidyākhyatacchaktivaśādavadhāryata ityāha-- bhāvaśaktimataśvaināṃ manyante nityavādinaḥ | bhāvameva kramaṃ prāhuḥ na bhāvādaparaḥ kramaḥ || 83 ||
nityadvayaṃ brahmatattvaṃ ye vadanti te bhāvasya parasyādvayasya brahmaṇa evaivaṃvidhāmanādijīvātmagatāṃ śaktiṃ manyante | yad‌vaśāttirodhāya tattvamatattvena bhedena vyavahāraḥ kramikaḥ | akrame'pi brahmaṇi bhedāvabhāsanamavidyākṛtam | tatraiva kramābhāsanaṃ kālākhyasvātantryaśaktikṛtam | te ca śaktī na brahmaṇo bhāvāt paramārthato minne iti sa eva tattvata evaṃ cakāsti | anyasya tadatirekiṇo bhāsamānatānupapatteḥ | bhāsamānasya prakāśāvyacirekādaprakāśasya tadayogādityanyatra nirṇītam | tathā ca brahmamayabhāvopadhānena kramasyāvabhāsanād vyavahāre bhāvavyatiriktaṃ tasya na kiṃcidrūpamiti hetuhetumadbhāvena yojanādapaunaruktyam || 83 ||
atra kramapratiyogi yogapadyamapi tathā pratibhānamātramityāha-- kramānna yaugapadyasya kaścidbhedo'sti tattvataḥ | yathaiva bhāvānnābhāvaḥ kaścidanyo'vasīyate || 84 ||
 ekameva tattvamavidyānetrāṇāmapāramanavacchinnamaśakyapratibhāsamiti svagatadeśakālapaurvāparyādhyāropeṇa sakramamābhāti | padārthāntarasācivyena cākramamiti bhāvataḥ kramākramau na staḥ | yathā bhāvābhāvāvityuktam | kramābhāvo yaugapadyam | kramaścoktadṛśā nānyo bhāvādityabhāvasya pūrvaṃ bhāvād bhedasya vastutvasya ca niṣedhādyaugapadyamapi tadātmakaṃ na kiṃcidityabhāvadṛṣṭāntena dhvanati | bhāvopadhānena ca pratīyamānatvāt bhāvāntarasāhityaṃ bhāvasyātmaiva | tannyāyyam , na hi sāhityaṃ nāma sahitādanyad vivekenāvadhāryate || 84 ||
nanu krameṇa kṛtaṃ yugapat kṛtamiti bhedena pratīyete kramākramāvityāśaṅkyāha-- kālasyāpyaparaṃ kālaṃ nirdiśantyeva laukikāḥ | na ca nirdeśamātreṇa vyatireko'nugamyate || 85 ||
 adya bhavo'dyatanaḥ kālaḥ śvo bhavaḥ śvastanaḥ kāla iti loke vyapadeśādavidyamāno'dyatano'nadyatano'stīti laṅvidhau bhāṣye vacanādityevaṃ samudāyāvayavabhedaparikalpanayā kālatattvasyaikasyaivādhārādheyabhedena nirdeśo dṛṣṭaḥ | na caitāvatā vastutaḥ kālo bhidyate, vaikalpikatvād bhedasya | evaṃ kramākramayorvyatirekeṇa nirdeśe'pi na tattvato bhāvāt parasparataśca bheda ityarthaḥ || 85 ||
etadeva poṣayati-- ādhāraṃ kalpayan buddhyā nābhāve vyavatiṣṭhate | avastuṣvapi notprekṣā kasyacit pratibadhyate || 86 ||
 śatrorabhāve sukhaṃ suhṛdabhāve duḥkharātivargasya rāgādikleśarāśeranutpattāvabhāve nirvāṇaṃ mokṣa ityevamādau vyavahāre saptamyanyathānupapattyā abhāve parikalpyādhāraśaktiṃ suravādyādheyaṃ na kaścidavatiṣṭhate | antarbhāvitaṇyarthatvānna kaścidavasthāpayitumutsahata ityarthaḥ | kalpayannapi vādhārabhāvaṃ na kaścidabhāve'dhikaraṇabhūte sthitimādheyatvaṃ labhate | na tatrāsya padabandho vastutaḥ, atha ca kalpayantītyarthaḥ | nīrūpasya sarvasāmarthyavirahalakṣaṇasyābhāvasyādheyaṃ prati sthityādhārabhāvāyogāt | utprekṣya tvādhārabhāvamevaṃ vyapadeśaḥ pravartate | evamaṅgulyagre kariyūthaśatamāsta ityādi cotprekṣayābhidhīyamānaṃ dṛśyata iti nāsti vikalpanāmabhūmiḥ || 86 ||
yata evam-- tasmācchaktivibhāgena nityaḥ sadasadātmakaḥ | eko'rthaḥ śabdavācyatve bahurūpaḥ prakāśate || 87 ||
 sarvaparikalpātītaṃ tattvaṃ samāviṣṭaṃ sarvābhiḥ śaktibhirbrahma yathāyathaṃ vyavahāre bhāvābhāvarūpatayā tattadupādikhacitaṃ śabdāḥ pratipādayantītyabhāvābhidhāyināmapi bhāvaśabdaistulyaḥ saṃbandho'viśeṣācchabdānāmiti prakaraṇatātparyamupasaṃhṛtam | eka iti | bhedasyābhāvanirāsena pratiṣiddhatvāt | ata eva nityaḥ, abhāvabhāvāt kāryakāraṇabhāvasya ca niṣedhāt | śabdavācyatve iti | śabdavyavahārārthaṃ nimittasaptamyā prayojanakathanāt | bahurūpāḥ iti kramākramādirūpatayā prāguktayādvayasyaiva tattvasya prakāśanāt || 87 ||
itthaṃ ca sāṃvṛto'yaṃ lokayātrāsu padārthaprayogo nirūḍha iti tathaivāsmin śāstre'nugamyata ityaviṣayāstārkikavikalpā ityāha-- vyavahāraśca lokasya padārthaiḥ parikalpitaiḥ | śāstre padārthaḥ kāryārthaṃ laukikaḥ pravibhajyate || 88 ||
 vitāritamapi tarkavikalpairbhāvatattvaṃ na yathāvicāraṃ loke vyavahāramavatarati | na hi darśanāntaravyavasthitaviruddhabhāvarūpānugamo vyavahāre | na cāvicāreṇa yathātattvaṃ pāryate niscayaḥ kartum | "rūpaṇavyapadeśābhyāṃ sadṛśau bālapāṇḍitau" parasparābhiprāyamelane pravartteti iti gajanimīlitenāvadhārya padārthayāthātathyaṃ vyavaharanto laukikā dṛśyaṃte | idaṃ ca laukikānāmeva śabdānāmanuśāsanaṃ śāstram | tadatra lokaprasiddhaiva padārthaprakriyā samāśrayaṇīyetyakhaṇḍād vākyārthāt kriyāvacano dhātuḥ sattvapradhānāni nāmāni, pratyāyakaḥ pratyaya ityādiḥ śāstrīyakāryaprasiddhyarthaṃ laukika eva kriyādravyaguṇādilakṣaṇo'poddhārapadārthaḥ pravibhajyata iti lokayātrāyāmekayogakṣemāḥ sarve śabdā bhāvābhāvābhimatārthaviṣayā ityarthasya pravāhanityātvācchabdohāramātratvācca pratīternityaḥ śabdārthasaṃbandha iti siddham || 88 ||
iti bhūtirājatanayahelārājakṛte prakīrṇaprakāśe saṃbandhasamuddeśastṛtīyaḥ | 3,4ḥ bhūyodravyasamuddeśaḥ  tadevaṃ śabdārthayoḥ saṃbandhamuk‌tvānvākhyānopayogī padārthaḥ śāstre kāryārthaṃ laukikaḥ pravibhajyata ityupakṣitaḥ | jātidravye hi sarvaśabdānāmartha iti "siddhe śabdārthasaṃbandhe" ityatrārthanityatāsamarthanārthaṃ pūrvamukte | idānīmanvākhyānāṅgamapoddhārapadārtho dravyaguṇādikaḥ samuddeṣṭavya iti pravibhajyata ityukte tasya kutaḥ pravibhāga ityāha-- saṃsargarūpāt sambhūtāḥ saṃvid‌rūpādapoddhṛtāḥ | śāstre vibhaktā vākyārthāt prakṛtipratyayārthavat || 1 ||
nimittabhūtāḥ sādhutve śāstrādanumitātmakāḥ | kecit padārthā vakṣyante saṃkṣepeṇa yathāgamam || 2 ||
 niraṃśasya vākyasyaiva vācakatvāt tadarthāt pṛthakatvena padārthā vyavasthāpyante | sa ca vākyārthaḥ saṃsarga eva rūpam ātmā yasya sa tathā | kriyā kārakatadviśeṣaṇasaṃsargo vākyārthaḥ | etena ca pravibhāgabījamāha | sarvathā niraṃśe vākyārthe pravibhajanīyarūpābhāvāt | saṃsarge tu yuktaṃ saṃsṛṣṭārthapravibhajanam | ata eva sambhūtā ityāha | saṃsargāvasthāyāṃ sambhavanto vidyamānā ityarthaḥ | tena saṃsṛṣṭā vidyamānā apoddhartuṃ śakyante | asatāmayaḥśalākākalpānāṃ ca parasparānanvayenāpoddhārābhāvāt |  saṃvit saṃvedanam , apoddhārabuddhistvasyā rūpam ātmā | tato hetoḥ apoddhṛtāḥ pṛthak‌kṛtāḥ |  etaduktaṃ bhavati | yadyapi vākyārthe padārthāḥ kadācidapi vivekena nāvadhāryante tathā ca kīdṛśaḥ saṃsargaḥ , tasya bhedapūrvakatvāditi, tathāpi pratipattṛbhiranaṃśasya yugapat pratyetumaśakyātvāt krameṇāṃśāśikayā saṃvedane bhedapūrvakasaṃsargavyavahārāt tadabhiprāyeṇa tayaivāpoddhārabuddhyā hi vivicyante'rthāḥ | tadyathā pānakadravye guḍādimātrā vivekaśūnyā apyāsvādayitṛbhī rāsanavijñānavivekena pṛthak‌kṛtya vyavahriyante |  yadā tu rūpaśabda ākāraparyāyastadeyaṃ lyab‌lope pañcamī | saṃvidaḥ kalpanābuddhe rūpam ākāramāśrityerthaḥ |  vākyārthasyānaṃśasya jhaṭiti pratyetumaśakterantarā padārthākārabuddhayo vibhramāstattadaṃśācchuritā iti tad‌buddhiniviṣṭa eva tvākāro vastityadhyavasāyāt padārthatvena parikalpyatade pūrvakakṣyāyāmupāyabhūtāyām | pratipanne tu samaste vākyārthe sāmānyamātrasya bhinnasyābhinnena tena satyabhūtena bādhaḥ |  kimapoddhāre prayojanamityāha--śāstre vibhaktā iti | pratyāsattyā vyākaraṇaśāstra ityavagantavyam | atra hi lakṣaṇavākyānāmupāyabhāvena dravyaguṇādayo'rthā viṣayavibhāgenopāttā iti vākyārthādapoddhāra etat prayojanaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ yathāvibhāgaṃ niyataviṣayamavatiṣṭhatāmiti |  tathā hi-upalakṣaṇatvenārthānāmaṅgabhāvaḥ śāstre samāmnāto na vidheyatvena, "arthānādeśanāt" iti lokaprasiddhamarthamanūdya svarādisaṃskārāyopadeśaḥ |  prakṛtipratyayārthavat iti | prakṛtipratyayayornāmākhyātapadaviṣayayoḥ svārtho'tra kālpanikaḥ | tena yathā niraṃśāt padārthāt prakṛtyarthaḥ pratyayārthaścāpoddhārabuddhyānvayavyatirekābhyāṃ padavādibhirapod‌dhriyate tathā vākyāvādimirakhaṇḍād vākyārthāt padārtha ityubhayatrāpyapoddhāraḥ samāna ityarthaḥ |  nimittabhūtā iti | yatasteṣāṃ nimittabhāvaḥ śabdasādhutvaviṣayo'to vibhaktā ityarthaḥ | te cārthā dvividhāḥ | lokaprasiddhāḥ vaiśeṣikādiśāstraparibhāṣitāśca | tatra lokaprasiddhāḥ paśurapatyaṃ devatetyādayaḥ | te ceha prasiddhatvādeva na paribhāṣyante | ye tu śāstrāntare paribhāṣitāste svanikāyavyavasthayā lakṣyanta ityāha |  kecit eva śāstrādanumitātmakā iti | śāstrādasmādeva pratyāsatteḥ vyākaraṇākhyānna vaiśeṣikādeḥ | anumānenādhigata ātmā svabhāvo lakṣaṇaṃ yeṣāmityarthaḥ | tathā hyekaśeṣārammād bhedyatvaṃ dravyalakṣaṇamanumitam | dravyāṇāṃ prādhānyena vācyatve śabdabhedaprasaktestadāraṃbhasyārthavattvāt | "yasya guṇasya hi bhāvād dravye śabdaniveśastadabhidhāne tvatalau"  iti vākyakāravacanād āśritatvaṃ guṇalakṣaṇamanumitam |  jātirapi bhāvapratyayābhidheyeti guṇo'sāvevamupapadyate | tathā "voto guṇavacanāt"  iti guṇamuktavān guṇavacana iti guṇasya bhūtapūrvatvena dravye pratyāyye'bhidhānaṃ viśeṣaṇatve sati kalpate |  kālasyāpi kriyātmakatvalakṣaṇaṃ bhūte vartamāne bhaviṣyatīti caiṣāṃ dhātvarthopādhitvena vijñāyate |  saṃkhyāyāśca bhedagaṇanātmakatvaṃ "jātyākhyāyāmekasmin"  iti vacanādavasīyate | vaiśeṣikaprasiddhāyā guṇatvena dravyapratiniyamāt striyāṃ puṃsi napuṃsaka iti sāmānyena śabdānvākhyāne'rthasyāṅgabhāvāpādanāt saṃstyānaprasavasthitayo liṅgalakṣaṇamanumīyate | na hi khaṭ‌vādīnāṃ laukikaṃ strītvaṃ śāṇṭakādīnāṃ ca puṃstvaṃ kuṇḍādīnāṃ ca napuṃsakatvaṃ sambhavati |  śaktiḥ sādhanaṃ na dravyamiti śeṣavyavahārāt, karmakartṛtvopagamāt, vibhak‌tyarthe'vyayībhāvavacanāccānumīyate | dravyasya hyekasvabhāvātvāt sādhanatve śeṣabhāvaḥ karmakartṛbhāvaśca nopapadyate | vibhak‌tyarthe ca dravyasyaiva vṛtteradhistrīti strīśabdaprayogābhāvāt kasya kena samāsaḥ |  upasargācchandasi dhātvartha iti cārthagrahaṇaṃ liṅgasaṃkhyāvato dravyasya pratipattyarthaṃ tasyāsādhanatvamāvedayate | anyathā sādhana ityevocyeta kimanena dhātukṛto'rto dhātvartha iti |  puruṣopagrahayostu pūrvācāryavyavahārādeva lakṣaṇaprasiddhiḥ |  dik‌kriye tu lokaprasiddhe eva śāstre'pi pūrvādīnāṃ vyavasthāyāmiti viśeṣaṇātpadārthopādhitvaṃ tallakṣaṇamanumīyate |  kriyāpi bhūvādivārtike bhāṣye pūrvāparībhūtā sādhyasvabhāvānumānagamyā lakṣitā |  padārthā iti | yadyapi saṃsṛṣṭānāmeva sarvathā bhāvastathāpyapoddhṛtāḥ | athaikaikasya padasya guṇapradhānabhūtā bahavo'rthāḥ | tadyathākhyātasya kriyākālasādhanasaṃkhyāpuruṣopagrahāḥ, nāmapadasyāpi dravyaliṅgasaṃkhyāsādhanāni kriyā kāla ityādi |  padavācyatvena vā padārthatopapattiḥ | kevalānāṃ pacatyādipadavācyatvābhāvāt |  `yathāgamam' iti | yādṛśo vaiyākaraṇānāmāgamastamanullaṃghya | vyākhyātṝṇāmupadeśapāramparyānatikrameṇa yasya padārthasya yasminnanvākhyāne'ṅgabhāvaḥ sa kathyata ityarthaḥ || 1,2 ||
 tatra guṇādīnāṃ dravyaparatantratvāt prathamaṃ tadāśrayaṃ dravyaṃ lakṣayati | vastūpalakṣaṇaṃ yatra sarvanāma prayujyate | dravyāmityucyate so'rtho bhedyatvena vivakṣitaḥ || 3 ||
 iha sarvanāmnāṃ dvayī gatiḥ | vastumātrābhidhāyinaḥ kecid yathā sarvādayaḥ | viśiṣṭavastuvācakāścānye yathāntarādayaḥ |  tatra pūrvairdravyaṃ lakṣyate | tathā hi-idaṃ taditi sarvanāmapratyavamarśayogyaṃ dravyam | idamiti pratyakṣārthavācakam, taditi pramāṇāntarāvagataparokṣārthābhidhānam, tena pratyakṣaparokṣārthākāraparāmarśena vastumātravācitvamidaṃtadorupādānena sarvanāmnāmuktaṃ bhavati | tathā ca pratyakṣaparokṣākārabhedavadhīraṇena vastumātraṃ tadvācyaṃ dravyaṃ lakṣitaṃ bhavati |  pratipiṇḍaṃ hyaparimitasvabhāvo dravyāṇāmaśakyo lakṣayitumiti sarvadrvayasādhāraṇalakṣaṇamevamucyate, vasturūpatāyāḥ sarvatra bhāvāt | etadevaṃ niruktakāreṇāyuktam | "ada iti yat pratīyate tad dravyam" iti |  dvitīyamapi viśeṣalakṣaṇamāha-bhedyatvena vivakṣita iti | sāmānyādibhirupādhibhiravacchedyatvena viśeṣyatvena vaktumabhipretamityarthaḥ | vivakṣitagrahaṇena na vastvarthasyedaṃ lakṣaṇamapi tu śabdārthasyetyāha | tathā ca jātyādirapi viśeṣyatvena ced vivakṣitastadā dravyamiti tīrthāntarīyadravyalakṣaṇānādarāt vyāḍidarśanena sārvatrikī dravyapadārthavyavasthā siddhayati |  yathā vājapyāyanadarśane jātiranvitapratyayanimittaṃ sarvaśabdānāmarthaḥ | kriyāsvapyanvitāvabhāsapratyayānyathānupapattyā jātisiddhiḥ | kathamanyathā pratyavasthaṃ pacatītyabhinnaḥ pratyayaḥ syāt | vikledasyaiva pacatyarthatve'dhiśrayaṇādīnāṃ sāmarthyagamyatve śabdārthatvābhāvāt devadattasya kartṛtvaṃ na syāt | na hi tad‌vyāpāro'dhiśrayaṇādirdhātuvācyaḥ |  sāmarthyagamye ca lakāravācyasya karturvyāpāre samanvayābhāvaḥ | itthaṃ ca viklittereva dhātuvācyatvāttatraudanaḥ karmakartṛvat kartā syāt, na kadācidapi karma | sa cāpi vikledo'tyakṣamarūpo'kramo na paciḥ, āśritapaurvāparyasyaivārthasya kriyātvāt | itthamadhiśrayaṇādirapi tatrānupraviśatyeva | tāvanmātre'pi ca pacatīti pratyayotpatteriti pratikṣaṇamabhinnapratyayāvaseyā kriyājātiraṅgīkāryā |  evaṃ bhramyādikriyākṣaṇavyaṅgyā bhramaṇatvādijātirapi grāhyā | tatrāpyupakrama eva viśeṣṭecchādikāraṇajanyakarmakṣaṇavailakṣaṇyāt sādṛśyād duravadhārānniyatasāmānyābhivyakteḥ | tathā hi-kamavatāmapi kṣaṇānāṃ spaṣṭāspaṣṭatvena jāterabhivyaṃjakatvam | vyaktidvārakaśca sādhanasaṃbandhaḥ, tasyāḥ sādhyatvājjāternityatve'pi, yathā jāterdohābhāve vyaktidvārakaḥ kriyāsaṃbandho gaurduhyatāmiti |  astikriyāyāśca sādhanabhedāt kālabhedācca bhede'bhinnapratyayanimittamaparaṃ sāmānyaṃ na virudhyate | nityatve'pi ca sāmānyasya vyaktiniṣpattau phaladānasāmarthyamiti yajeteti vyaktiniṣpādanārtā codanārthavatī | vinaśyatyapakṣīyata ityatra tirodhānamapakṣayaśca kriyājāterāśrayo'stu, tathaiva śabdenāvasīyamānatvāt | śabdārthasya cehārthatvāt | śiṣṭaṃ kriyājātisamarthanaṃ pūrvameva vihitamityevaṃ dravyapadārthasyāpi sārvatrikī vyavasthāsmin dravyalakṣaṇe satyupapadyate |  tathā hyākhyātasyāpi dravyameva sādhanasvabhāvaṃ vācyam | kriyāprādhānye'pi guṇabhūtasya tasya vācyatvopagamāt | anyathā kimapekṣaṃ prādhānyaṃ syāt | tathā ca vyāpārāviṣṭaṃ tadeva prādhānyena vācyamastu | darśanāntare'pi hi na sarvathā guṇabhūtatvena tirobhāvo'sya vṛttāvivopasarjanapadārthasya, devadattaḥ pacatīti sāmānādhikaraṇyābhāvaprasaṅgāditi paraṃ prādhānyameva sāmānādhikaraṇyānyathānupapattyāstu | sarvanāmapratyavamarśayogyatvaṃ tvayaṃ pacatīti evaṃ dṛśyata eva | bhedyatvamapi sādhutvādisvaviśeṣaṇāpekṣayā samastyeva | lakṣaṇānāṃ ca sāmpratikavyāpārānapekṣaṇāt bhedayogyatā bhedyatvamatra | evamāsyate sthīyate iti kimādibhiḥ parāmarśāt sukhamityevamādibhiśca viśeṣyatvād dravyatvamityākhyātārtho'pi vyāḍidarśane dravyam |  nanu ca kriyārūpasyaiva bhāvyamānasya pratīterniṣpannāniṣpannayośca virodhādbhāvanāvacanāstiṅaḥ. arthasāmarthyād dravyapratipattiḥ sāmarthyalabhyā, na śabdārtha iti mīmāṃsakāḥ | asadetat | anvayavyatirekābhyāṃ dhātoreva bhāvanāvacanatvāt | pratyayasya ca sādhanābhidhāyitvāt, sādhyasādhanabhāvena siddhāsiddhayorapyasti samanvayaḥ | tathā ca prakṛtipratyayoḥ samabhivyāhāraḥ | anyathā sāmarthyalabhya iti vaiyākaraṇānāṃ sādhanābhidhānaṃ paryavasitavivādameva | sādhanaṃ ca śaktaṃ dravyaṃ na kevalā śaktiriti dravyārthatā siddhā |  cādayo'pi dravyakriyātmabhūtasamuccayādidyotanād dravyavacanāḥ kriyāvacanā vā | tena tadarthasyāpi tathaiva vyak‌tyākṛtivikalpaḥ | guṇā api sāmānyaviśiṣṭā ucyamānā dravyaṃ padārtha ityekaśeṣaṃ rūpādayo bhajante | tathā samānādhikaraṇena samānena dravyeṇeti vyākhyāyamāne guṇenāpi samāso bhavati sarvagandha ekarasa iti |  nanvevaṃ `vipratiṣiddhaṃ cānadhikaraṇavāci|'  ityatrāpyadhikaraṇaṃ dravyamiti śītoṣṇaṃ sukhaduḥkhamityekavadbhāvaḥ kathamudāhṛtaḥ | śītādīnāmanena lakṣaṇena dravyavacanatvādanadhikaraṇavācīti paryudāsaprāpteḥ |  atrocyate | subantāvayavasya dvandvasyairavadbhāvavidhānāt subantasya ca sarvasya jātyupahitadravyapacanatvenānadhikaraṇavācīti pratiṣedhaḥ sārvatrikaḥ syāditi vidhernirviṣayatvamāyātamiti vidhisāmarthyāt pratiṣedhaḥ prasiddhadravyaviṣayo vijñāyate śītoṣṇe udake iti | prasiddhaṃ hi loke kriyāvad guṇavad samavāyikāraṇaṃ dravyamiti tadvācyeva paryudasyate | tathā ca śītoṣṇāderukādidravyavācitve na bhavatyekavadbhāvaḥ | śaityādiguṇavācitva eva bhavati |  evaṃ samarthavārtike `atha hi guṇaḥ padārthaḥ bhavati tadā sāmarthyam | `anyo hi vīratvaṃ guṇaḥ anyo hi puruṣatvam ||' iti vīraśabdasyānena lakṣaṇena dravyābhidhāyitve'pi dravyopasarjanabhūtasya paratantrasya svārthasya sāmarthyaviṣayasyābhidhānāt saṃsargyādilakṣaṇalakṣitaguṇāśrayeṇābhidhānam |  tathā hi puruṣatvamapyevameva | tatra guṇamāha | laukikaprakriyayā jātirūpamapi tasya bhāva ityatrābhiprāyādāvatiprasaṅgaparihārārthaṃ `yasya guṇasya hi bhāvād dravye śabdaniveśaḥ' ityukte dravyaguṇayoravyatirekaṃ manyamānaḥ prakṛtipratyayārthayorbhedaṃ nāvagacchedityanyacchabdādibhyo dravyamityuktamiti nāsmādbhāṣyādetallakṣaṇena śabdādayo dravyaṃ na bhavatīti bhramitavyam | tathā hyasmin dravyasakṣaṇe rūpādīnāmapi dravyatvādadravyaprakarṣa ityāmupratyayābhāvaḥ samayātaraṃ śītam, upāṃśutaraḥ śabdaḥ, uccaistaro dhvaniriti | iti bhūtirājatanayahelārājakṛtau prakīrṇakaprakāśe bhūyodravyasamuddeśaścaturthaḥ || ----------- 3,5ḥ guṇasamudeśaḥ  idānīṃ guṇasya śāstrīyaliṅgānumitaṃ lakṣaṇamāha-- saṃsargi bhedakaṃ yad yat savyāpāraṃ pratīyate | guṇatvaṃ paratantratvāttasya śāstra udāhṛtam || 1 ||
saṃsargi ādhāreṇa saṃsṛṣṭam, rūpasambhedena vartamānam, na saṃbandhāmātreṇa | ata evāśrayāntarāvacchedamādhārasya karoti śuklo'yaṃ (na) nīla iti | evaṃ gaurayaṃ nāśya ityatrāśrayāntarādyavacchade gotvamapi guṇo bhavati | tathā yadyad iti vīpsāpadena sarvasyaivaṃprakārasya sāmānyāderapi guṇatvamiti paribhāṣāṃ kathayan, nedaṃ vasturūpāvasthitamiti sūcayati | anena cāvacchedyād dravyādavacchedakatvena guṇasya viśeṣamāha | savyāpāram, avacchedakarūpeṇa pratīyamānaṃ guṇavyapadeśyaṃ na rūpāntareṇetyarthaḥ | yadevaṃvidhaṃ tasya guṇatvamiti saṃbandhaḥ |  nanu kimayaṃ paribhāṣaiva guṇa iti, atha nibandhanamatrāstītyāha `paratantratvāt' iti | loke hi paratantro guṇa ityācyate iti pratītiriyaṃ na paribhāṣāmātramityarthaḥ | tathā ca laukikasyaivāyaṃ lakṣaṇasya vaiśeṣikaprasiddhyapākaraṇāyānuvāda ityuktaṃ bhavati | itthaṃ ca vīpsā saphalā | `śāstra udāhṛtam' iti | vyākaraṇe'nvākhyānavākyāṅgaṃ laukika eva guṇo gṛhīta ityarthaḥ | tathāhi samarthavārtike | "samānādhikaraṇeṣūpasaṃkhyānamasamarthatvāt" "dravyaṃ padārtha iti cet |" iti vīrapuruṣo dravyayoratyantābhedāt sāmarthyābhāve dravyapādārthapakṣe samāsābhāve codite | atha hi guṇaḥ padārtho bhavati (tadā) sāmarthyam | anyo hi vīratvaṃ guṇaḥ, anyo hi puruṣatvam | itadi jāterapi pāratantryāt dravye samavāyād guṇatvamuktam | tathā ca guṇabhedāt pratīyamānaṃ dravyaikatvāśrayaṃ sāmarthyamiti siddhaḥ samāsaḥ | tathā "yasya guṇasya bhāvād dravye śabdaniveśaḥ |" iti bhadeko guṇo bhedyaṃ dravyamityetadeva lakṣaṇamanusṛtam | tathā hi-viśeṣyamātravacanād viśeṣaṇamātravacane guṇe bhāvapratyayaḥ |  gośabdasya jātyavacchinnadravyavācitve jātau gotvamiti jātimātravacanatve tu śabdasvarūpe'vyabhicāriṇi pravṛttinimitte, tasya ca vācyatvaṃ bhinnatvaṃ ca pūrvamevopapāditam | svarūpeṇa hi paramuparañjayadviśeṣaṇam | yathā jātyādiguṇaḥ | tathā svarūpoveśenārthaṃ pratyāyayataḥ śabdasya bhavati svarūpamuparañjakatvādguṇaḥ pravṛttinimittamarthe tadrūpādhyāsena cārthapratītiḥ | abhidhāvyāpārāviṣṭasyaiva na vācyatvamapi tu sādhāraṇasya prayogagatasya | yathā rakte guṇe tattvamityādinā ca saṃbandha upapāditaḥ | śuklādīnāṃ guṇāvacchinnadravyavācitve śuklatvamiti guṇe tattvamityādinā ca saṃbandha upapāditaḥ | śuklādīnāṃ guṇavacchinnadravyavācitve śuklatvamiti guṇe bhāvapratyayaḥ | guṇābhidhāyitve jātau tadvācitve pūrvavat svarūpe | evaṃ cādyāyāṃ śabdapravṛttau ḍitthādīnāmapi svarūpa eva bhāvapratyayaḥ | svarūpādhyāsena saṃjñāyāḥ saṃjñipratyāyanāt tadeva tatra pravṛttinimittam | tadetadasya ḍitthatvamiti tu kriyāguṇādhyāsādanyatra pravṛttau ḍitthatvasahacarutayoḥ kriyāguṇayorbhāvapratyayaḥ | tathā kriyāguṇayorabhedādhyāsābhiprāyaṃ `ḍitthatvaṃ ta etat' iti bhāṣyam | yadvotpattiprabhṛtyāvināśāt piṇḍasyāvasthāntare'pi pratyabhijñāpratyayanimittaṃ jātireva bhāvapratyayavācyā ādyāyāṃ śabdapravṛttau | rājapuruṣatvaṃ pācakatvamaupagavatvamityādau tu saṃbandho yathāyathaṃ svarūpeṇoparañjakaṃ pravṛttinimittaṃ bhāvapratyayābhidheyam | viśiṣṭasaṃbandhāvacchinno hi saṃbandhī pratīyate'treti saṃbandhasyainoparañjakatvād guṇatve bhāvapratyayavācyatā | na hi rājādisaṃbandhyavacchinnaḥ puruṣādiḥ pratīyate api tu tatsaṃbandhāvacchinnaḥ | bhedasya codbhūtatvādbhedādhiṣṭhānaḥ saṃbandha eva pravṛttinimittamabhihito'ntarbhūtaḥ |  yatra tu saṃbandhyanuraktā pratītiḥ bhedasya ca tirodhānaṃ tatra saṃbandhyeva jātyādi pravṛttinimittaṃ guṇo gotvaṃ śuklatvamityādau bhāvapratyayavācyaḥ | atra hi na samavāyoparaktā pratītiḥ api tu jātiguṇocchuritā dravye samavāyaśāttirohitabhede | saṃbandhastu jātiguṇayorādhārāvacchedakaḥ | hastitvamityādau rūḍhiviṣaye jātireva vācyā | evaṃ kumbhakāratvamityādau | atra hi śabdavyutpattinibandhanaṃ saṃbandho jātireva śabdavācyā | sattetyatrāpi sattāsatoḥ saṃbandhasyāvyabhicārādanavacchedakatve jātireva bhāvapratyayavācyā | taduktam "samāsakṛttaddhiteṣu saṃbandhābhidānamanyatra rūḍhayabhinnayogāvyabhicaritasaṃbandhebhyaḥ" iti | itthamatra viśeṣaṇaṃ svarūpeṇa paramuparañjayatsūtre bhāvaśabdena pratipāditam, bhavatyasmāttenākāreṇa dravyamiti bhāvaḥ | tathā hi gotvādgavākāreṇa dravyaṃ pratīyate, śuklādiguṇāttadākāreṇeti, paropādhimantareṇārthānāmavyavahāryatvenāsatkalpatvāt | tataśca viśeṣaṇenābhedamāpāditaṃ śabdo'bhidhatta iti śabdapravṛttikāraṇamapi bhavatyartharūpasaṃbandhi | tena ṇenābhedamāpāditaṃ śabdo'bhidhatta iti śabdapravṛttikāraṇamapi bhavatyartharūpasaṃbandhi | tena `yasya guṇasya bhāvāt' ityatra pakṣe'rthavācinī prakṛtiḥ, gorbhāvo gotvamiti | "yadvā sarve bhāvāḥ svena bhāvena bhavanti sa teṣāṃ bhāvaḥ"  ityatra tu pakṣe śabdavācinī prakṛtiḥ, gośabdasya bhāvo gotvamiti | tathā hi sarve bhāvāḥ sarve śabdāḥ svena bhāvena bhavantyasmāditi vyutpattyā pravṛttinimittalakṣaṇenārthena bhavanti | anekārthatvāddhātūnāṃ bhavateḥ prayogavacanatvātprayujyanta iti | sa pravṛttinimittalakṣaṇo bhāvasteṣāṃ śabdānāṃ pratyayavācya iti tacchabdavācyā śabdātmikā prakṛtiratra pakṣe bhavati | tadevaṃ guṇalakṣaṇamatra śāstra udāha-tam |  yatra tvasya guṇasya na grahaṇaṃ śāstre tatra yuktirvaktavyā | tathā hi | "voto guṇavacanāt"  ityatra nāyaṃ guṇaḥ, prātipadikādhikārāt | strītvasya ca dravyadharmatvād dravyābhidhāyyeva kiṃcit prātipadikaṃ guṇavacanagrahaṇād gṛhyate | guṇamuktavān guṇavacana iti paṭvādibhyo guṇopasarjanadravyavacanebhyaḥ pratyayaḥ | guṇaścātropasarjanabhūto na saṃsargyādilakṣaṇo jātiśabdebhyo'pi prasaṃṅgāditi paribhāṣito'sau gṛhyate `satve niviśate'paiti |' ityādiḥ | nanvevaṃ vaiśeṣikapraṇītasyaiva guṇasya grahaṇaṃ syāditi paṭ‌vī mṛdvītyādāvīkāro na syāt | naiṣa doṣaḥ | pāṭavādīnāmapyasya lakṣaṇasya sambhavāt, etadarthameva hīyaṃ paribhāṣā''rabdhā | anyathā pratītibalādeva rūpādīnāṃ guṇatvamitīyamanarthikā syāt | "giṇavacanabrāhmaṇādibhyaḥ"  ityatrāpi pāribhāṣika eva guṇo gṛhyate | tathā hi vākyakāreṇa arthavat prātipadikam |  guṇavacanaṃ ca |  iti prātipadikamātrasya guṇavacanasaṃjñārabdhā | yadyevaṃ prātipadikādhikārādeva siddhe kimarthaṃ guṇavacanam | brāhmaṇādigrahaṇaṃ cānarthakam | ucyate | prātipadikādhikārādaprasakte guṇavacanasaṃjñānāmeva yathā syāditi vidhānam | guṇavacanasaṃjñāyā hi bādhikāḥ "samāsakṛttaddhitā'vyayasarvanāmā'sarvaliṅgā jātiḥ |"  iti ca samāsādisaṃjñā samārabdhāḥ |  tathā ca samāsāvivaktaṃ prātipadikaṃ ṣyañamutpādayati | ata eva ca brāhmaṇādigrahaṇamapyupapadyate | brāhmaṇaśabdasya taddhitāntatvād guṇavacanasaṃjñābhāvāt | māṇavaśabdo'pi taddhitānto manorapatyamiti | tathā vāḍavaśabdo'pi `vaḍavāyā vṛṣe vācye' iti | `arhato num ca'  iti tu kṛtsaṃjñakaḥ | evamanyadapi brāhmaṇādigaṇe guṇavacanasaṃjñābādhakaṃ yojyamiti | tatrāpi ṣyañ yathā syāditi brāhmaṇādigrahaṇam | ye ca ṣyaño bādhakāḥ pratyayāstānapi bādhitvā ṣyañ yathā syādityapi brāhmaṇādigrahaṇamupapadyate | tathā hi brāhmaṇaśabdasyāvyutpattipakṣe `prāṇabhṛjjāti...'  ityañ prāptaḥ | māṇavavāḍavayorgotratvāt `gotracaraṇāt....'  iti vuñ prāpnotītyevamanyatrāpyūhyam | yeṣāṃ tu na taddhitādisaṃjñā nāpi kaścidapavādaḥ prāpnoti teṣāmatra prapañcārthaḥ pāṭhaḥ |  sūtrakāramate tu guṇamuktavān guṇavacana iti guṇopasarjanadravyavacano vacanagrahaṇādatra gṛhyate | `tṛtīyā tatkṛtārthena guṇavacanena' ityatrāpi khaṇḍādistṛtīyāntārthakṛtaḥ kaścideva guṇopasarjano dravyaviśeṣo gṛhyate | khaṇḍanaguṇayogāddhi dravyaṃ khaṇḍaśabdavācyam | `saṃkhyāyā guṇasya nimāne...' ityatra samabhāgo guṇo grāhyaḥ | na yathoktalakṣaṇaḥ, nāpi `sattve niviśate...' ityādilakṣaṇaḥ | dvimayamudaśviditi dvau samau bhāgau yavānāṃ nimānamekasyodaśvitaḥ krīyamāṇasyetyarthaḥ | sāpekṣatve'pi gamakatvād vṛttiḥ | dṛṣṭaśca samāvayavavacano guṇaśabdaḥ, yathā triguṇā rajjuriti | `guṇavacanebhyo matupo luk' ityatra ye'bhinnarūpā guṇamabhidhāya tadvati vartante śabdaśaktisvābhāvyāt te gṛhyante śuklādayaḥ | tathā ca `avyatirekāt siddham'  iti pratyākhyānamabhedopacārayogyatāśrayeṇa | tena rūpādayastadayogyā nivartitā bhavantīti matvarthīyāntā eva tadvati te sādhavo rūpavān ghaṭa ityādi |  `prakāre guṇavacanasya' ityatra sarvasyaiva padasya dvirvacanamiti svatantraṃ guṇopasarjanaṃ dravyaṃ paṭvādi gṛhyate | `pūraṇaguṇa....' ityatra guṇaśabdenārthagrahaṇābhisaṃbandhādeteṣāṃ tāvat pratyāyanaṃ nāsti | āśritamātrasyāpi dharmasya saṃsargyādilakṣaṇasya parigrahe dravyasāmarthyādyasiddhiḥ | tasmāt `sattve niviśate....' ityādilakṣaṇo guṇo gṛhyate | sa ca vaiśeṣikaśāstraprasiddhaḥ | tathā hi--pārthivānāṃ rūpādīnāmagnisaṃyogādupajanāpāyau dravye staḥ | kālākāśātmasu paramamagattvādīnāṃ cākriyājanyatvamapīti vyāpyate tena lakṣaṇena guṇapadārthaḥ | tathā ca rūpādibhirapi pratiṣedhaprāptau "tatstheśca guṇaiḥ "  māṇārthagatatvenāsambhavādyuktaṃ yatpratīyamānakriyāguṇanimittattvam | samāsastvīṣatpiṅgala ityādau sāvakāśa iti kathamatra prasajet | yadapi bhāṣyam-- `ākṛtetihyucyamāne...iha na syāt samāsaḥ īṣaktaḍāraḥ iti'  tadapi katham | yāvatā naivātra kriyākārakasaṃbandhaḥ pratīyata ityavyutpanna evāyam | kevalaṃ svararṇānupūrvījñāpanāya `gaḍeḥ kaḍa ca' ityevamasatyeva vyatpattirāśritā | tasmātsūtrārthadarśanaparatvenevanaitad bhāṣyaṃ vyākhyeyam | guṇavacanatvādatra samāsa iti | `ajādī guṇavacādeva'  ityatra `sattve niviśate' ityevaṃlakṣaṇo guṇo gṛhyate na tu saṃsargyādilakṣaṇaḥ | evaṃ hi sarvasya prātipadikasyopādhiviśiṣṭārthābhidhāyakatvāt prātipadikamātrāt pratyaye guṇavacanagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt |  `naño guṇapratiṣedhe sampādyarhahitālamarthāstaddhitāḥ'  ityatra saṃsargyādirūpa eva guṇa āśrīyate | tathā hi--naña uttarāṇi sampādyarhādyarthataddhitapratyayāntāni guṇapratiṣedhe'ntodāttāni bhavantīti sūtrārthaḥ | atra pratiṣedha bhājaścatvāraḥ--prakṛtyarthaḥ, pratyayārthaḥ, tadupādhiḥ , saṃbandho vākyārtharūpa iti | tatra guṇapratiṣedha iti vacanādakārṇaveṣṭakakaṃ mukhamityatra na karṇaveṣṭakādanyadāśrīyate, nāpi tadabhāvaḥ | kiṃ tarhi| karṇaveṣṭakābhyāṃ na sampadyate mukhamiti yāso mukhasya saṃmpadyamānasyācchedikā sampattirupasarjanamupādhibhūtā sā pratiṣidhyate | tadā ca prakṛtyā karṇa veṣṭakaśabdena naño'saṃbandhādasamarthasamāso'smādeva jñāpakādavaseyaḥ | satyapi ca pratiṣedha ādyavidhipadopāttārthanibandhanatvāttaddhito bhavatyeva | uttarakālaṃ tu padāntareṇa naña pratiṣedho bahiraṅgo na bādhakaḥ śabdasaṃskārasyāntaraṅgasya | tathā ca grāmaṃ na gacchatītyādo kriyāpratiṣedhe'pi karmādau dvitīyādayo bhavantyeva | vākyārthasya karṇaveṣṭakābhyāṃ sampadyate mukhamityevaṃrūpasya pratiṣedho nañā kriyate ityanye | vākyārthaśca sāmānye vartamānānāṃ padānāṃ viśeṣe'vasthāpakaḥ saṃbandhaḥ | sa ca padārthāvacchedakatvādupasarjanaṃ guṇa ityucyate | saṃbandhe ca nirvartamāne prakṛtipratyayārthayorapi saṃbandhinoṛ nivṛttipratītiḥ | atrāpi pakṣe prakṛtyarthāsaṃbandhe naño'samarthasamāso'smādeva jñāpakādvijñeyaḥ | asāmarthyaṃ ca prakṛteḥ pratyayārthasāpekṣatayā | sāpekṣasyāsāmarthyāt | pratyayārthasaṃbandhe tu na doṣaḥ | pradhānaṃ hi tadā pratyayārthaḥ | pradhānasya sāpekṣasyāpi bhavatyeva vṛttiḥ |  anye tvāhuḥ | prakṛtyartho'tra pratyayārthaṃ pratyupasarjanatvād guṇa iti bhāṣyakāramatamunnīyate | tathā hi-- `na nañ‌pūrvāttatpuruṣāt....'  ityatra bhāṣyakāreṇoktam-- `ācāryapravṛttirjñāpayati sarva eva taddhitaḥ sāpekṣādbhavatīti yadayaṃ naño guṇapratiṣedhe sampādyarhetyādikamāha' iti | tathā hi --na pṛthorbhāvo'pārthivamaprathimeti prakṛtyarthaḥ pratiṣidhyate nañā | tathā cāsāmarthyāt taddhitau naiva syāt `samarthānāṃ prathamādvā' iti vacanāt | ato jñāpakenāyamartha uktaḥ | tatra ca yathā pratiṣiddhasya pṛthorbhāvaḥ, pṛthorvānyasya bhāvaḥ ityayamarthastathā pratiṣiddhābhyāṃ karṇaveṣṭakābhyāṃ saṃpādi mukhaṃ tato vānyena saṃpādītyevaṃ prakṛtyarthena nañaḥ saṃbandhādimavasīyate prakṛtyartho guṇatvena bhāṣyakārasyābhimata iti | etattu na yuktam | pradhānāpradhānasannidhau pradhāna eva kāryayoga iti sampadyāmānārthaviṣayaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ sampatteryukto nāpradhāne prakṛtyarthe | ekapadopāttaścārtho'ntaraṅgaḥ saṃsargībhavatyato'pi sampattireva guṇo yukto na padāntaropāttaḥ prakṛtyartho viprakṛṣṭaḥ | jñāpakaṃ ca nyāyānuvartanaṃ na kārakam | nañaśca pradhānārthenābhisaṃbandhe prakṛtyā na syāt samāso'sāmarthyāditi jñāpakena prakṛterāśritasamāsāyāḥ pratyayo jñāpito bhāṣyakāreṇa | tadevaṃ pūrvapradarśita eva sūtrārtho yuktaḥ | abhaidikamityarhārthataddhito'trodāhāryaḥ | avasīya iti hitārthe | asāmparāyikamityalamarthe samparāyāya prabhavatīti taddhitaḥ | anayā diśānyatrāpi guṇapradeśe yathābhāṣyaṃ sūtravārtikeṣu guṇasvarūpaṃ vyākhyeyam | diṅmātramiha pradarśitam || 1 ||
 atiśāyanasūtre bhāṣyam-- `prātipadikārtho vai dravyam, na ca dravyasya prakarṣāpakarṣau staḥ | evaṃ tarhi guṇaḥ prātipadikārthaḥ | nanu ca dvayamapi prakṛtyarthaḥ | tatra kuta etat, guṇasya prakarṣa iti | tatraitaduktam-- `yasyāsti prakarṣastatprakarṣe bhaviṣyati' iti | `ubhayaṃ vai prātipadikārthaḥ' ityetalliṅgaṃ saṃsargyādilakṣaṇo guṇo gṛhyata iti | sa hi dravyopasarjanabhūtaḥ śuklādiprātipadikena pratyāyyate | tatra ca guṇasyaiva prakarṣo'sti na dravyasyetyatra kāraṇaṃ vaktavyam | śabdena niṣpannarūpasya dravyavad guṇasyāpi pratipādanāt kāraṇāyattuguṇavat kāryadravyamapi kathaṃ na prakṛṣyeta | tathā guṇaḥ pratīyamānaḥ kaścidabhidhīyamāno'nyaḥ | tatrābhidhīyamānaguṇāpekṣa eva dravyasya prakarṣa ityatrāpi kāraṇaṃ vaktavyam | ekasminnapyarthe bahutaropādhīnāṃ sambhavānniyamenaikasyopādānamayuktam | sarvatra dravyātiśāyanāspadaṃ sa guṇaḥ sannidhīyata ityetat katham | na hi guṇaparo guṇo nirguṇā guṇā iti vacanāt | sāmānyeṣu cāvacchedako nāsti | niḥsāmānyānīti siddhāntāt | tathā karmādiṣvapi nāsti guṇa iti tatra kiṃnibandhanaḥ prakarṣo bhavet | kathaṃ cānyasmin prakakṛṣyamāṇe'nyasya prakarṣo yukta ityetadapi vaktavyam | na hyarjunaśauryeṇa caitrastathā | dravyaṃ ca prakṛṣyamāṇaṃ lokaḥ pratyeti śabdāt | ityetān vikalpān kmeṇa nivārayitumāha-- dravyasyāvyapadeśasya ya upadīyate guṇaḥ | bhedako vyapadeśāya tatprakarṣo'bhidhīyate || 2 ||
 ihopādhivivekena nirūpayitumeva na pāryate dravyam | na hi sāmānyādipadārthaṃ vinādhyakṣayitumidantayā śakyate | yacca svena rūpema nirūpayitumapi na śakyate tat kathaṃ svataḥ prakarṣeṇa yujyeta | ataḥ `avyapadeśasya' iti sāmānādhikaraṇyacchalena heturupāttaḥ | taditthaṃ saṃsargidharmāntaranimittaḥ prakarṣaḥ | guṇādibhireva saṃsargibhirviśeṣyamāṇaṃ dravyaṃ sajātīyāt prakṛṣyate | tatra saṃsargiṇo guṇādatho bahavaḥ sannihitā iti kiṅkṛto'tiśaya ityāha--`ya upādīyate guṇo bhedako vyapadeśāya' iti| dravyaṃ vyapadeṣṭuṃ vyavacchedako'nyasmādyo guṇa upādīyate , śabdena gṛhyate tatkṛtaḥ prakarṣaḥ pratyayavācyaḥ | na tvanabhidhīyamānāparasanniyamakāraṇābhāvāt pratīterupaplavamānatvād bahiraṅgatvāt | abhidhīyamānastu guṇo'ntaraṅgo niyatapratītiḥ | yadāveśena hi dravyamabhidhīyate tadātmana evātiśayyamānatā nyāyyā | prakṛtyarthopādhitvādatiśayasya, abhidhīyamānasyaiva ca prakṛṃtyarthatvāt | `guṇo bhedakaḥ' iti svaśāstralakṣitaṃ guṇarūpamatra gṛhyate ityāha | saṃsargi bhedakaṃ yad yad iti hi lakṣaṇam | bhedakatvaṃ cātra mukhyaṃ guṇavakṣaṇam | samavetasyāpi daṇḍasya daṇḍini guṇatvād, adaṇḍivyavacchedena | tadevaṃ śuklataraḥ paṭa iti śuklaguṇanimitto dravyaprakarṣo na garimīdipratīyamānaguṇanimittaḥ || 2|| yathā ca nirupādhino dravyasya prakarṣo nāsti tathā dravyānniṣkṛṣṭasya svatantrasya guṇasyāpi śuklataraṃ rūpataraṃ rūpamiti svataḥ prakarṣo nāsti, api tu tadavasthāyāṃ dravyāyamāṇatvād guṇasyāparasaṃsargidharmāntaranimitta eva prakarṣa ityāha-- sarvasyaiva pradhānasya na vinā bhedahetunā | prakarṣo vidyate nāpi śabdasyopaiti vācyatām || 3 ||
 guṇo'pi prādhānyena śabdenābhidhīyamāno dravyalakṣamamidaṃ taditi sarvanāmapratyavamarśayogyasvabhāvamanupatatīti tasya nirupādhervyapadeśāviṣayatvādyadupādhirvyapadeśastannibandhana eva prakarṣaḥ | tatra jātirvyapadeśaheturapi na prakarṣe savyāpārā | samānajātīyāddhi prakarṣaḥ | tatra jāterabhedaḥ | ata evoktaṃ bhāṣye `jananena prāpyate iti jātiḥ | na caitasyārthasya prakarṣāpakarṣau staḥ |' iti | janmakālasaṃbandhājjātiḥ, na tūtpanne dravye kāraṇāntarasannidhānāyatto niveśo'syāḥ, yena kāraṇabhedācchuklādivat prakṛṣyate | tasmānnityatvājjāternāsti sāvasthā yā jātiśūnyeti janmakāle'pi tenaiva rūpeṇa sāvasthitā vyakteraviyogena pravartamānā tajjātīyādeva vyavacchedaṃ prāpayituṃ śaknotītyarthaḥ | ataśca jāteratiśāyakatvāsambhavāttadekārthasamavāyi bhāsuratvaṃ vaimalyaṃ rāgāntarāvyatibhinnatetyevamādayo viśeṣāḥ prakarṣavṛttinibandhanam | yadyapi cāgnisaṃyogādinā svata eva guṇasya prakarṣo bhavati tathāpi vyapadeśo paropādhere veti tannimitta eva prakarṣo nyāyyaḥ | na hi svagato viśeṣaḥ śabdena sarvaḥ śakyate'bhidhātum, rūpādiśabdena rūpatvādijātīyasyāviśeṣeṇa sarvasyābhidhānāt | ata eva yadā bhāsuratvādayo'pi prādhānyena vyapadiśyante tadā tadāśritadharmāntaradvāraka eva prakarṣo vijñeyo bhāsuratara iti | tatrāpi dharmāntarasya prādhānye tadaparāśritadharmanimitta eva prakarṣa iti yāvat sambhavati śabdavyāpārastāvadaparyavasānameva dharmāṇāmiti guṇaḥ prakarṣaheturyaḥ svātantryeṇopadiśyate | tasyāśritaguṇādeva prakṛṣṭatvaṃ pratīyate || ityuktameva | ata evātra `sarvasyaiva pradhānasya' iti vyāptiriktā sarvagrahaṇena | yadā tu śabdavyāpāroparamastadā dharmāntaraparyeṣaṇā paryavasyati || 3 ||
nanu ca bhāsuratvādayaḥ śuklaśabdasya na vācyā ityaśabdavācyapratīyamānadharmadvārake'tra prakarṣe'nekopādhisannidhānādaniyamaḥ prasajyetetyāśaṅkyāha-- vigyāmānāḥ pradhāneṣu na sarve bhedahetavaḥ | viśeṣaśabdairucyante vyāvṛttārthābhidhāyibhiḥ || 4 ||
 iha pradhāneṣu dravyeṣu vastusanto bahavo'nyasmātsajātīyavijātīyād vyavacchedahetavo dharmāḥ | te ca sarve na kenacicchabdena śakyante'bhidhātum | anekavyāvṛttiniṣṭhasyaikasya śabdasyābhāvāt | ekaikāvyāvṛttiniṣṭhā hi bahavaḥ śabdā vastuni pravartante | tathā ca te tatra viśeṣaśabdā ityucyante, pratiniyataviśeṣābhidhāyitvāt | yadi sarvaviśeṣaviśiṣṭaṃ dravyamekena śabdenābhidhīyeta syādasāvekaḥ śabdaḥ sādhāraṇaḥ | na caivam | tasmātpratiniyatavyāvṛttiviśiṣṭārthābhidhāyibhiḥ śabdaiḥ sarvaviśeṣāṇāmasaṃsasparśādupāttaviśeṣaheturaka eva prakarṣaḥ | sūkṣmāṇāṃ ca viśeṣaṇāmasaṃvijñātapadānāṃ bhāsuratvādīnāmastveva śuklādiśabdairvācyatā tadupādhivivaktasya śuklasya pradhānasya śabdaviṣayabhāvopagamāyogāt | saṃsargirūpopahitattvācchabdavācyasya jātihetukaprakarṣābhāvāt śuklataraṃ rūpamityādiprayogadarśanāccātra bhāsuratvādihetukaḥ prakarṣo niścīyate | na cāśabdavācyadharmanimittaḥ saḥ, atiprasaṅgāditi bhāsuratvādīnāmapi prayogaprāmāṇyādatra śabdavācyatvaṃ niścīyatām || 4 ||
nanu bhavatu svato'vyapadeśasya dravyasya saṃsargidharmanimittā vyapadeśapravṛttiḥ | tatraiva tu vyapadeśe saṃsargiṇa upakṣayāt prakarṣe'pi kataṃ tasya vyāpāraḥ kalpyata ityāha-- vastūpalakṣaṇe tatra viśeṣo vyāpṛto yadi | prakarṣo niyamābhāvāt syādavijñātahetukaḥ || 5 ||
 vastunirdeśamātracaritārthatve viśeṣasyopādhibhūtasya yaḥ śuklo dṛṣṭaḥ sa garimādinā prakṛṣṭaḥ śuklatara iti pratīyeta | tathā ca viśeṣaḥ prakarṣasya nibandhanaṃ na jñāyeta | na caivaṃ prasiddhiḥ śuklaguṇanimittasyaiva prakarṣasyāto'vagamāt | tataśca yathā pratītiḥ , yathā ca yuktiḥ pratyāsannataratvācchabdavācyasyeti tathā prakarṣe vyapadeśahetoreva viśeṣasya vyāpāraḥ kalpayituṃ nyāyya ityarthaḥ || 5|| iha kathaṃ prakarṣapratyayaḥ nikṛṣṭataraḥ prakṛṣṭatara ityāśaṅkyāha-- sarvaṃ ca sarvato'vaśyaṃ niyamena prakṛṣyate | saṃsargiṇā nimittena nikṛṣṭenādhikena vā || 6 ||
 vyapadeśahetuprakarṣe prakarṣapratyaya iti nikarṣopādherabhidhāne nikarṣāpekṣa eva prakarṣo vācyaḥ, prakarṣopādeścābhidhāne prakarṣopekṣa iti sajātīyāpekṣāyāṃ sarvasya prakarṣasammavādetadupapadyate | nikṛṣṭasya nikṛṣṭātvādeva prakṛṣṭasya prakṛṣṭātvādevātiśayaḥ sambhavatyeva | evaṃ guṇaprādhānye'pyaparadharmanimittaḥ tatprādānye'pyaparanimittaḥ prakarṣa ityanavasthāṃ pūrvapradarśitāmaryanenāha || 6 ||
iha gotareti prayogo dṛśyate | tatra ca na jātinimittaḥ prakarṣa ityuktam | na cānyanimittamatra savyāpāraṃ pratīyata iti nirnimittaḥ prakarṣo dravyasya | evaṃ śuklatarādāvapi bhaviṣyatīti kimiti guṇahetukaḥ prakarṣaḥ samuddhoṣyata ityāśaṅkyāha-- nāpekṣate nimittaṃ ca prakarṣe vyāpṛtaṃ yadi | dravyasya syādupādānaṃ prakarṣaṃ pratyanarthakam || 7 ||
 pariniṣṭhitarūpaṃ dravyaṃ nirhrāsopacayasaṃbandhāyogyaṃ svata iti na svanimittaṃ prakarṣamanubhavati | tadyadupādhirūpaṃ nimittaṃ prakarṣe savyāpāraṃ nāṅgīkaroti tadā prakarṣe pratipādye tasyopādānaṃ niṣprayojanam | śuklatara ityādiprayoga eva na syādityarthaḥ | tasmātprayogaprāmāṇyādyathopapatti prakarṣo'nuvidheya iti vyapadeśahetusvasaṃsargidharmanimittaḥ sa vyavasthāpyaḥ sarvatra | jāteśca vyapadeśahetubhūtāyāstadasambhave yathā śuklataraṃ rūpamityatraikārthasamavetabhāsuratvādidharmadvārakaḥ prakarṣo vyavasthāpyate tathā gotaretyatrāpyekārthasamavetādvāhadohāderdharmādasau vyavasthāpyaḥ | bhāsuratvāderiva cātra prayogaprāmāṇyādvāhadohāderapi śabdārthatvamavaseyam | tataśca prakṛṣṭavāhadoho gaurgotareti bhaṇyata iti sarvaṃ sustham || 7 ||
prakaraṇārthaṃ samāpayitumāha-- savyāpāro guṇastasmātsvaprakarṣanibandhanaḥ | dravyātmānaṃ bhinattyeva svaprakarṣe niveśayan || 8 ||
 dravyasya svato niratiśayatvāt svanimittabhūtaprakarṣādhānodyuktaḥ saṃsargiguṇaḥ svātiśayahetukena viśeṣeṇāśrayāntarād vyavacchedaṃ vidadhāti | kathamanyasya prakarṣa'nyatprakṛṣṭamityāśaṅkyāha-- arūpaṃ pararūpeṇa dravyamākhyāyate yathā | aprakarṣaṃ prakarṣeṇa guṇasyāviśyate tathā || 9 ||
 nīrūpasya nirupādhino dravyasya śābdavyavahāropagamāyogādupādhirūpācchuritasya tadupagame sarvaśabdārthapṛṣṭhapātī vyavahāraḥ svopādhiniyamitaśarīra ityarthaḥ | upādhyupādhimatośca vivekasya duravadhāratvāt saṅkara iti vyavahāre guṇuprakarṣo guṇini viśrāmyati, na guṇātmanyeva niṣkṛṣṭaguṇini vyavatiṣṭhate, nāpi guṇyātmanyeva niṣkṛṣṭaguṇa iti siddham || 9 ||
iti bhūtirājatanayahelārājakṛte prakīrṇakaprakāśe guṇasamuddeśaḥ (pañcamaḥ) | diksamuddeśaḥ  sampratyekayogakṣemān padārthāṃstantreṇoddhiśya krameṇa vicārayitumāha-- dik sādhanaṃ kriyā kāla iti vastvabhidhāyinaḥ | śaktirūpe padārthānāmatyantamanavasthitāḥ || 1 ||
digādiśabdāḥ siddhasvabhāvadravyadharmatayā svārthaṃ pratipādayanto yathālakṣitadigadyarthasaṃsparśavikalāḥ | tathā hi paropādhirūpāḥ śaktayo digādyāḥ, pāratantryaṃ ca śaktilakṣaṇamiti kriyāpi dravyaparatantrā śaktiriti vyapadiśyate | vaiśeṣikanaye ca dik dravyaṃ nopapadyate, kāryānumeyatvena padārthopakārakarūpasya śaktitvasya nyāyyatvāt | evaṃvidhaṃ śaktirūpaṃ siddhasvabhāvavastuvācakaiḥ śabdaiḥ sākṣānna spṛśyata ityasādhāraṇametatpadārtharūpaṃ lakṣaṇenāvasthāpayitavyam | asti hyeṣāṃ śāstre'smin vyavahāro `dik‌śabdebhyo digdeśakāleṣu....' ityādiḥ | tatra ca sādhanādīnāṃ śāstrādanumitameva lakṣaṇaṃ vibhajanīyam | dik‌kālādīnāṃ tu svarūpaṃ vaktavyam | tatra diśastāvadanumānena svarūpaṃ lakṣayati-- vyatirekasya yo heturavadhipratipādyayoḥ | ṛjvityeva yato'nyena vinā buddhiḥ pravartate || 2 ||
karmaṇo jātibhedānāmabhivyaktiryadāśrayā | sā svairupādhibhirbhinnā śaktirdigiti kathyate || 3 ||
 idamasmāt pūrvaṃ paścādvetyevamasmādityavadheridamiti pratipādyasya cāvadhimato yo vyatirekaḥ prātipadikārthabhedo'vadhyavadhimatsaṃbandhalakṣaṇaḥ sa padārthasvarūpādanupapadyamāno nimittāntaramāvedayate | tannimittāntaraṃ digityucyate | na hi jātyādinimitto'yaṃ pratyayaḥ | tadanurāgāpratīteḥ | pariśeṣāddiṅnimittaḥ | yadāhurvaiśeṣikāḥ | `ita idamiti yatastaddiśo liṅgam' iti | kāryakalpyatve ca sadaiva padārthopādhitayā pratīteḥ svatantradravyarūpatā nāsti diśaḥ | na hi pṛthivyādivad digupalakṣyate | ata eva kālo'pi śaktiriti vakṣyate | samavāyaśca `tāṃ śaktiṃ samavāyākhyāṃ....' ityuktaḥ | tathā `ṛjuḥ svaṣṭo'yaṃ vaṃśaḥ ' iti pratyayaḥ anyena vinā, avadherapyanapekṣaṇāt pṛthivyādinimittāntaropakāramantareṇa jāyate | sa caikadikkamavayavānāṃ prasaraṇāditi diṅnimittaḥ | ṛjvarthasyopalakṣaṇatvād vakādibuddhirapi diṅnimittā vyākhyeyā | tathā karmakṣaṇānāṃ tiryagūrdhvamadhaśca jāyamānānāṃ karmatvamahāsāmānyavyatirekeṇa bhramaṇatvotkṣepaṇatvādyaparajātivyaktirdiṅ‌nimittā | tathā hyūrdhvādidik‌saṃyogavibhāgakāryāḥ karmakṣaṇā viśiṣṭāḥ santo niyatajātivyaṃjane samarthā bhavanti | karmaṇaḥ iti, karmasāmānyasya avāntarajātibhedāḥ utkṣepaṇatvādayaḥ | jātāvekavacanam | bhramaṇādikriyākṣaṇānāṃ ye jātibhedā ityarthaḥ | diṅ‌liṅgāviśeṣādviśeṣaliṅgābhāvāccaikā digiti kāṇādāḥ | ekāpi ca diṅ niyatopādhiprakalpitanānātvā daśadhā vyavahriyate | tathā ca ta evamāhuḥ-- `ādityasamprayogād bhūtapūrvād bhaviṣyato bhūtācca prācī'  iti | savituraharaharādau yena prakalpitadik‌pradeśena saṃyogo'bhūdbhavati bhaviṣyati vā tasmādādityasamprayogāt prācīti vyapadeśaḥ, prāgañcatyata iti kṛtvā | tathā `dakṣiṇāpratīcyudīcī ca'  iti sūtram | tasmādevādityasaṃyogād pratīpādivyapadeśaḥ | tathā hi yatra pratīpamañcatyastagamanādraviḥ sā pratīcī | mūrtiparicchinnena hyādityamaṇḍalena yaḥ saṃyogaḥ sa parimitadeśavyāpī | tena cātītena bhaviṣyatā vartamānena vāvacchinno bhāgo niyatadigbhāgavyavasthāpako bhavatītyadṛśyamānagāmikriyo'pi yāṃ pariharati pṛṣṭhakaraṇena sā dakṣiṇā | yāṃ na pariharati sā uttarā | madhyāhne hi ravibimbamudaṅ‌mukhamañcatyato'sāvudīcītyapi bhaṇyate | anenaiva ca prakāreṇa pūrvadakṣiṇādīnyantarālarūpāṇyapi digantarāṇi vyākhyātānītyuktaṃ sūtram-- `etena digantarāṇi vyākhyātāni' iti | tathā hi meruṃ pradakṣimamāvartamānasya saviturlokapālaparigṛhītapradeśasaṃyogāpekṣo daśadhā vibhāga iti śāstrāntare vistareṇa nirṇītaṃ tata evāvadhāryam | iha tvanūdyate paraṃ digiti na vibhajya kathyate | na cāyamasyā upacarito bhedo yat upacārasya pratyayadharmatvāddiśi na samāviśet sūryasaṃyogaviśeṣaṃ tu sahakāriṇamapekṣya vicitrakāryaṃ prabhāvayatīti kalpanayā bhedo'pi diśo vyapadiśyate | ata eva vāstave'pi bhede sahakāriṇo'bhivyañjakatvenāpekṣyāḥ | ta eva kāryabhede'pekṣiṣyanta iti tasyānyathopapatterdiśa ekatvamupeyate | ko hi prāmāṇikaḥ kāryasya bhedamupagacchat kāraṇanānātvaṃ pratyācakṣīta | vāstave ca diśāṃ nānātve sarvatra kāryadarśanāttāsāṃ vibhutvāt pūrvāparādipratyayāḥ saṅkīryeran | tasmādbhāvata ekā dik, kāryavaicitryaṃ tu sahakāribhedādityevamuktam || 2,3 ||
na ca sahakāriṇa eva diganapekṣāt kāryaṃ yuktam, tasya svato'pūrvāparādirūpasya (tvāt?) tadbhāvasya diksaṃbandhakṛtatvāt, na ca tadanurūpaṃ kāraṇamiti dik pratyākhyeyā pūrvāparādipratyayaliṅgā kālaśceti tayoranyatve liṅgasya viśeṣamāha-- parāparatve mūrtānāṃ deśabhedanibandhane | tata eva prakalpete kramarūpe tu kālataḥ || 4 ||
 mūrtirasarvagatadravyaparimāṇam | abhedādhyavasāyācca dharmiṇo'tra nirdiṣṭāḥ | vyāpakānāmākāśādīnāṃ parāparatve na staḥ | pūrvaḥ para iti bhāveṣvavyāpakeṣu pūrvāparadeśasaṃbandhanimitto vyavahāraḥ | deśasyāpi pūrvāparatvaṃ diṅnimittamiti tata eva diśaḥ paratvāparatve deśanimitte tātaparyataḥ | pūrvamabhūdbhaviṣyati paramiti tu kriyāpaurvāparyaṃ kālaśaktikṛtapratibandhābhyanujñāvaśād vyavatiṣṭhata iti nāsti dik‌kālayorliṅgasaṃkara ityāśayaḥ || 4 ||
amūrtānāmapi kālpanike paratvāparatve sta ityāha-- ākāśasya pradeśena bhāgaiścānyaiḥ pṛthak pṛthak | sā saṃyogavibhāgānāmupādhitvāya kalpate || 5 ||
 saṃyogidharmabhedenākāśasya deśavibhāga uktaḥ | tathā ca mūrtadravyasaṃyogena pradeśavṛttinā parikalpito yaḥ pradeśa ākāśasya tena saha mūrtadravyagatairbhāgeravyāpyavṛttitvāt yathāyathaṃ ye saṃyogavibhāgāsteṣāṃ digavacchedāya pūrvāparādibhinnā prabhavatīti tadupādhiḥ pradeśānāmākāśasya kalpitānāṃ pūrvāparādivyavahārastathā ca pūrvākāśasaṃyuktaḥ pūrvaḥ parākāśasaṃyuktaḥ para ityādirmūrtteṣu vyavahāraḥ sidhyatītyamūrtapūrvako'sāvityarthaḥ || 5 ||
iha deśānāṃ dik‌kṛtā pūrvāparādivyavasthā, diśastu kiṃkṛtā | arthāntaranimittatve tasyāpi kuta ityanavasthā | diśaḥ svata eva pūrvāparāditve deśairapi kimaparāddhamityāśaṅkyāha-- diśo vyavasthā deśānāṃ dig‌vyavasthā na vidyate | śaktayaḥ khalu bhāvānāmupakāraprabhāvitaḥ || 6 ||
 deśānāṃ svatantraṃ rūpamādhārādisvabhāvamavadhāryata iti tatra pūrvāparādibhāvasya svarūpādevābhāvādanyannimittaṃ digākhyaṃ kalpyate dik‌kṛtenaivopakāreṇa| tatra paratantrasvabhāvā kalpyamānā nāparaṃ pūrvāparādibhāvārthaṃ nimittāntakameṣaṇīyaṃ syāt | yādṛk‌svabhāvā hi sā kāryaparikalpyā tāvadeva tattvaṃ nāparam, tatra śaktināṃ pāratantryasyaivopapatteḥ | śak‌tyantarakalpane śaktimattvāpatteḥ śaktitvahāniprasaṅgāt | sūryasaṃyogastu pūrvāparāditvaṃ nāpūrvaṃ tatrādhatte, api tu svabhāvamevābhivyanaktītyabhiprāyaḥ || 6 ||
śaktitvamevāsyāḥ svatantrabhāvarūpatākaraṇāya poṣayitumāha-- pratyastarūpā bhāveṣu dik pūrvetyabhidhīyate | pūrvabuddhiryato dik sā samākhyāmātramanyathā || 7 ||
 pratyastam upadhitvena bhāveṣu samāropitaṃ rūpam asyāḥ, tathābhūtā pūrvādig iti vyavahriyate | yato yasyāḥ sakāśāt, pūrvabuddhiḥ pūrvo'yamartha iti jñānam | pūrvatvamupalakṣaṇam , paratvādirapi gṛhyate | dik sā paropādhirūpetyarthaḥ | anyathā tūpādhirūpānapekṣāyāṃ svātantryāśrayaṇe bhāvato diṅ na bhavati, api tu sā tadānīṃ samākhyāmātraṃ digiti, svatantradravyaviṣayaṃ śabdamātraṃ vastvasaṃsparśi | tathā hyuktam-- dik sādhanaṃ kriyā iti vastvabhidhāyinaḥ | śaktirūpe padārthānāmatyantamanavasthitāḥ || iti | tadevaṃ nityapāratantryāddiśaḥ kāryaikakalpyāyāḥ svatantrapadārthagatavikalpānavasara iti svato nānāsvabhāvatve sahakārisūryasaṃcāraviśeṣeṇa kimekasvabhāvatve vā sahakāribhede'pi na vicitraṃ kāryaṃ kuryādityetadaśakyaṃ vaktum | yathā hi pūrvāparādipratyayalakṣaṇena kāryeṇānumitasatatvā tathābhyupagantavyā śaktirūpā dik || 7 ||
nanu ca pūrvāparādipratyayaḥ sammukhāsammukhādinimitto bhaviṣyati | yathoktaṃ bharate `yato'bhimukhaṃ bharatāḥ praviśanti sā pūrvā diṅ‌mantavyā' iti | loke'pyabhimukhasthaḥ purovartī bhaṇyate pṛṣṭhataḥ sthitaḥ paścāt sthita ityucyate | tathā "iha hastadakṣiṇaḥ panthāḥ, iha hastavāmaḥ" ityādivyavahāraḥ svāṅganimitta iti nāsti dik‌kalpanānimittamityāśaṅkyāha-- svāṅgād vyavasthā yā loke na tasyāṃ niyatā diśaḥ | pratyaṅmukhasya yat paścāttatpurastādviparyaye || 8 ||
 svāṅgaṃ mukhamavadhimapekṣya yā pūrvādivyavasthā tatra diśo niyatāḥ na yavatiṣṭhante | paścānmukhasya hi yadvastu paścādabhūttadeva prāṅmukhatve tasya pūrvasmin deśe bhavatīti prāṅmukha udaṅmukho vā bhūñjīteti vyavasthā na syāt | tasmādanādirūḍhadiṅ‌nimittā pūrvāparādivyavasthāṅgīkāryā || 8 ||
kācittu diganapekṣāpi pūrvāparāditā deśānāṃ rūḍhetyāha-- deśavyavasthāniyamo dikṣu na vyavatiṣṭhate | rūḍhamapyaparatvena pūrvamityabhidhīyate || 9 ||
 dikṣu diṅnimittaḥ pūrvadeśadakṣimāpathottarāpathādīnāṃ niyamo na vyavasthitaḥ | tathā hi digapekṣayā pāścātyo'pi pūrvadeśa iti vyavahriyate | tathā ca dakṣiṇāpathāt pūrvadeśaṃ gacchan pūrvadeśaṃ gacchamīti brūte | dig‌vyavasthayā tu sa uttaro bhavati | tasmāt pūrvāditvamātra diganapekṣaṃ rūḍham | digapekṣayā tu yathāyathaṃ vyavahāro'trāpyupapadyate | tathā ca "iha kasmānna bhavati pūrvasmin deśe vasati"  iti bhāṣye codayitvā "naiṣa doṣaḥ, deśaviśeṣaṇametat" iti parihṛtam | nāyaṃ pūrvaśabdo rūḍhitvādavadhyapekṣaḥ pravṛttaḥ, tena na dik‌śabdaḥ sandeśe vartate | deśasāmānyaṃ tu deśaśabdādavagamyamānaṃ viśinaṣṭi | tato dik‌śabdaddeśavṛttervidhīyamānaḥ pratyayo nāto rūḍhaśabdād bhavatīti bhāṣyārthaḥ | kecid vyācakṣate-nāyaṃ pūrvaśabdo deśaṃ deśarūpeṇa kathayati, deśaśabdenaiva tasyābhihitatvāt | deśādhikaraṇastu kaścidviśeṣo deśaśabdādapratīyamānaḥ pūrvaśabdenābhidhīyate dig‌viśeṣāvacchedanipabandhana iti | etadayuktam | deśasāmānādhikaraṇyāddeśavṛttibhyaḥ pratyayasyeṣṭeḥ | avaśyaṃ hi dikkālayorvyavacchedārthaṃ deśaśabda upādātavya iti tatra pratyayābhāve ko viṣayaḥ syāt | tadevaṃ pūrvadeśo dakṣiṇāpatha ityādāvananyāpekṣe rūḍhe'pi pūrvāditve sahaje diṅ‌nimittamaparaṃ rūpāntaramapi bhavati | yathā svaṅganimitte'nyathā vyavahāre diṅ‌nimitto'nyathā vyavahāra iti mukhyadiṅ‌nimittameva pūrvāditvamityupapāditam || 9 ||
tathā ca diśyaparopādhikā pūrvādīnāṃ vṛttiḥ deśe tu dik‌saṃbandhāditi bhāṣyeṇa saṃvādayati | ato bhāṣitapuskatvāt puṃvadbhāvo na siddhyati | asminnarthe na śabdena prasavaḥ kvaciducyate || 10 ||
 `dakṣiṇottarābhyāmatasuc' ityatra bhāṣyam-- `akāraḥ kimarthaḥ, na tasujeva kriyatām | evaṃ ca svarārthaścakāro na kariṣyate pratyayasvareṇaiva siddheḥ' tata uktam-- `liṅgaviśiṣṭaparibhāṣayā dakṣiṇāśabdādapyayaṃ bhavati | tatrāsatyakāre yasyeti lopo na syāt' iti | atra pratyayasyākāramākṣitya liṅgaviśiṣṭaparibhāṣayā ṭābantābhyāṃ vidhāvasatyakāre yasyeti lopābhāvāddakṣiṇata uttarata iti rūpaṃ na siddhyediti satyakāre ākāralope na tathākārastu śrūyeteti prayojanamuk‌tvā puṃvadbhāvena siddhamiti punarākṣipya na siddhyati, bhāṣitapuṃskasya puṃvadbhāvaḥ, na caitau bhāṣitapuṃskāravityuktam | punarapyākṣiptam-nanu caitāvapi bhāṣitapuṃskau, dakṣiṇa uttara iti pumān bhāṣyata iti | tata uktam | samānāyāmākṛtau bhāṣitapuṃskasya puṃvadbhāvaḥ | ākṛtyantare caitau bhāṣitapuṃskau | dakṣiṇottarā iti dikśabdau, dakṣiṇa uttara iti vyavasthāśabdau | tadetad bhāṣyaṃ rūḍhiśabdatve diśi pūrvādīnāṃ yujyate nānyathā | tathā hyayamarthaḥ | bhāṣitaḥ pumān yasminnityartho'nyapadārthaḥ samāśrīyate, sa cābhidheyo nopapadyate | tasya padārtha ātmā svabhāva ityantato vyapadeśena bhāṣitapuṃskatāvyabhicārātkimanena vyavacchidyeta | tasmāt pravṛttinimittalakṣaṇo'rtho'nyapadārthaḥ | tatrāpi bhinne pravṛttinimitte sarvatraiva bhāṣitapuṃskatā | antato'rthasvābhāvādiśabdenetyekasmin pravṛttinimitte sāmarthyāt bhāṣitapuskatā samāśrīyate | arthe ca kāryasyāsaṃbhavādabhidheyadharmeṇa tadvacanaḥ śabdo bhāṣitapuṃska ityucyate iti pravṛttinimittasyānyapadārthatve samānāyāmākṛtau yo bhāṣitapuṃskaḥ śabdastasya puṃvadbhāva ityartho'vatiṣṭhate | diśi ca dakṣiṇottareti svābhāvikatvādabhidhānasya, asmin dig‌lakṣaṇe'rthe prasavaḥ puṃstvamābhyāṃ śabdābhyāṃ na kvacidviṣaye'bhidhīyate, api tu diṅ‌nimittā, yadā deśena tayorvṛttistadā vyavasthāśabdau prasavamabhidhattaḥ | parasparāpekṣātmasthitirvyavasthā | yathā dakṣiṇaḥ śailabhoga ityākte kuta ityavadhipratītiḥ | tatra caitau bhāṣitapuṃskāvityākṛtyantare bhāṣitapuṃskatvādekasmin pravṛttinimitte tadabhāvāt puṃvadbhāvo na bhavati | atra sautraḥ sarvanāmno vṛttimātre puṃvadbhāva ityaupasaṃkhyānikaṃ puṃvadbhāvamāśritya ṭābantābhyāmapi dakṣiṇottaraśabdābhyāmatasuco'kāraṃ vināpi siddheḥ ṣaṣṭhyatasarthapratyayeneti valiśeṣaṇārtho'kāro vyavasthāpitaḥ | atra tu coditam | nanu ca dakṣiṇottaretyavaśyamavadhirapekṣaṇīyaḥ | vinā tena svārthāsambhavāt | tathā ca diśyapyavadhyapekṣatvāt pūrvādiśabdānāṃ pravṛttestatrāpi vyavasthāśabdatvamityekasyāṃ vyavasthākṛtāvastyeva bhāṣitapuṃskatvam | kevalaṃ ca paropāśrayatvāddiśi vṛtterdeśaśabdebhyo dik‌śabdā bhidyante | ataḥ paramuktam-dikśabdakāryāṇyeva na prāpnuvantīti | nāmadheyatvena diśāmapravṛtternaite dikśabdhāḥ syurityāśayaḥ | tatrottaram-- "diśo yadā vyavasthāṃ vakṣyanti | yadi tarhi yo yo diśi vartate sa sa dikśabdo ramaṇīyādiṣvatiprasaṅgaḥ"  iti | yathā hi pūrvādayaḥ śabdā vyavasthānimittā deśakālasādhāraṇā api yadā diśi vartante tadā dikśabdā ityucyate tathā ramaṇīyādayo'pi guṇanimittā diśi vartamānā dik‌śabdāḥ syuḥ | atra parihāra uktaḥ | "diśi dṛṣṭaḥ śabdo dik‌śabdaḥ | diśaṃ yo na vyabhicaratīti |"iti | tatra deśakālayorapi vyavasthāśabdāḥ pūrvādayo vartante | tathā cābhedena dik‌śabdāebhyo dik‌deśakāleṣu ityucyate iti | kathaṃ diśaṃ yo na vyabhicaratītyuktamityetadbhāṣyaṃ samarthayitumāha-- dik‌śakterabhidhāne tu niyataṃ diśi darśanam | pūrvādīnāṃ yathā ṣaṣṭerjīvitasyāvadhāraṇe || 11 ||
 śaktigrahaṇena tatrārthāntarānapekṣārūḍhā pūrvādiśabdānāṃ pravṛttiḥ, deśakālayostu tadupādhitvād vyavasthānimitteti sūcayati | tathā ca niyatamavyabhicāri diśi darśanaṃ pūrvādiśabdānāṃ prayogaḥ | deśakālayostu vyavasthānimittatvena na rūḍhaḥ prayogaḥ pūrvā digityukte nāmadheyatvenāntarṇītāvadhibhāvā rūḍhipratītiḥ | pūrvo ghaṭa iti tu kuta ityavadhimapekṣate | ghaṭaśabdācca svārtho'vagamyate, tadupari vyavasthāṃ gamayati pūrvaśabdo na tu tasya nāmadheyam | tathā ca dik‌śabdebhyo deśakālaśabdānāmeṣāṃ bhāvato bheda eva, sādṛśyāttvekatvādhyavasāyaḥ | na hi rūḍhīnāṃ naimittikaiḥ sahābhedaḥ sambhavati | tathā ca "dikśabdebhyo dik deśakāleṣu...." ityatra pūrvādiśabdānāṃ kāryabhāk‌tvena vivakṣitatvāt śabdagrahaṇasāmarthyād dikśabda iva śabdo yeṣāmiti deśakālapravṛttayo rūpasāmyād viśeṣyante | sādṛśānāṃ ca śabdānāṃ kvacid viṣaye svabhāvānniyamena pratyāyanaśaktirdṛśyate | tadyathā ṣaṣṭiṃ bhūtaḥ ṣaṣṭika iti jīvitaparimāṇe pratipādye kālavācī niyamena saṃkhyāśabdopi ṣaṣṭiśabdaḥ | tathā ca kālādhikāravihitaṃ pratyayamutpādayati `tamadhīṣṭo bhṛto bhūto bhāvī'  iti | vṛttiviṣaye'tra ṣaṣṭiśabdo vākye saṃkhyāśabdo'pi niyataṃ kālaṃ saṃkhyeyamupādatte śabdaśaktipratiniyamāt | ato hi śabdād varṣākhya eva kālo janmanaḥ parimāṇaṃ pratīyate | na ca vṛttau kālavacanaḥ prayujyate yena tatsāmānādhikaraṇyātkālavṛttitvaṃ saṃkhyāśabdasyāpi pratīyeteti māsādiśabdavat padāntarānapekṣaḥ kāle'yaṃ varṣākhye rūḍhaḥ | tathā ca `tadasya parimāṇam' ityatra "jīvitaparimāṇe cetyanarthakaṃ vacanam, kālāditi siddhatvāt" ityuktam | yo hi ṣaṣṭiṃ varṣāṇi bhūtastasya ṣaṣṭirjīvitaparimāṇaṃ bhavatyevetyupasaṃkhyānena nārthaḥ | na caivaṃ ramaṇīyādiṣvatiprasaṅgaḥ, teṣāṃ kāle niyatatvasyāpratīteḥ | prayuktānāṃ cedamanvākhyānamiti laukikī pratītiranusartavyā | tathā coktam-- `anabhidhānādramaṇīyādiṣūtpattirna bhaviṣyati' iti | tadevaṃ yathā ṣaṣṭiśabdaḥ saṃkhyāśabdaḥ saṃkhyeyaviṣayo'tra svabhāvāt kāle saṅkhyeye rūḍhaḥ, tathā pūrvādiśabdo'nyatra deśe kāle ca vyavasthāvacano'pi diśi svabhāvānniyamena rūḍha iti yuktamuktaṃ diśaṃ yo na vyabhicaratītyarthaḥ | itthaṃ ca diśi niyatatvāt prayogasya samānāyāmākṛtau bhāṣitapuṃskatvābhāvāt puṃvadbhāvābhāvāt `sarvanāmno vṛttimātre' ityuktam | `vyavasthāyāmasaṃjñāyām' iti tu sarvanāmasaṃjñāyāmavadhiniyamamātrānugamād digdeśakālavacanā api pūrvādayo viśeṣeṇa viśeṣyante | tathā hi avadhinā yaḥ pratipādito rūpāvacchedaḥ pūrvāditvaṃ tasyānugamo'sti | deśakālayoriva dikṣvapi vyavasthitārthābhidhānāt | pūrvaśabdo hyavadhibhinnāmeva vyavasthitāṃ diśamāha | avadhiṃ tūpādhitvena na spṛśati | yathā śoṇaśabdo lohita evārthe vartate | atha ca lauhityaṃ pravṛttinimittatvena nāpekṣate | kṛṣṇaśabdaśca bhagavati vāsudeve vartate | na ca kṛṣṇaṃ guṇaṃ nimittatvenopādatte | taditthamantarbhāvitāvadhayo dikśabdāḥ pūrvādayo rūḍhāḥ | deśakālayostu śabdopāktāvadhyapekṣā ityetāvān viśeṣaḥ | avadhiniyamastu samāna iti vyavasthāyāmityapi viśeṣaṇe digvācināṃ pūrvādīnāṃ sarvanāmasaṃjñākāryaṃ pravartata eva || 11 ||
idānīṃ kāryāntaramapi diśaḥ prāha-- chāyābhābhyāṃ nagādīnāṃ bhāgabhedaḥ prakalpate | ataddharmasvabhāveṣu bhāgabhedo na kalpate || 12 |  chāyā nirālokatā | ābhā ālokaḥ | dinakarakaranikararaṃjitaḥ parvataśikhara eko bahuvacchāyācchuritaścāpara ityavayavavibhāgaḥ, chāyātapābhyāmupalakṣito'satyāṃ diśi na kalpate, pūrvāparāditvābhāvāt tadupādhikāvayavamānātvāyogāt | tatha hyavidyamānaḥ sa digupādhiko dharmaḥ pūrvāparāditvaṃ yeṣāmamūrtānāmarthānāṃ teṣvevaṃvidhāvayavabhedabhāva iti dik‌saṃbandhanimitto'vayavabhedo'pi diṅliṅgamityarthaḥ || 12 ||
tathā hi mūrttānāṃ prathamata eva bhāgabhedaprakalpanaṃ digāyattamityāha-- paramāṇorabhāgasya diśā bhāgo vidhīyate | bhāgaprakalpanāśaktiṃ prathamāṃ tāṃ pracakṣate || 13 ||
 akṛtakatvānnityānāṃ niravayavānāmapi paramāṇṛnāṃ pārśvacatuṣṭayamūrdhvādhobhāgarūpaṃ ca diśā parikalpyate | na hi paramāṇorabhāgasya vāstavo bhāgabheda iti digāhita eva saḥ | tathā ca tatrasthaiḥ ṣaḍ‌bhiḥ paramāṇubhiryogo bhavati | sati ca yoge dvyaṇukādikrameṇa kāryamājāyate | tataśca tatrāpi pūrvāparādivyavahāraḥ | asatyāṃ tu diśi ṣaṅ‌bhiryoge'pi niravayavaḥ piṇḍaḥ syādaṇumātraka iti sthūlāvayavavyutpattirna syāt | tasmādutpattiprabhṛtibhāgasamārope prathamā diśāmeva śaktiriti digbhiḥ sarve padārthā mūrttā bhāgabhedaprakalpanenopakriyante | anye nagādīnāṃ sāvayavānāṃ chāyātapābhyāṃ bhāgabhedaḥ prakalpate | yeṣāṃ tu niravayavānāṃ chāyātapanimittaḥ sa na bhavati teṣāṃ paramāṇūnāṃ diṅ‌nimitta iti vyācakṣate | tathā hi yatra nimittāntaraṃ nāsti tatrātaddharmasu niravayaveṣu diśāṃ vyāpāro yatra tvanyannimittamasti bhāgabhedasya jñāpakaṃ chāyātapādikaṃ sāvayavānāṃ parvatādīnāṃ tatra tadeva bhāgabhedavyavahārapravartakam | etatprathamaślokenoktam | dig‌vyāpārastu dvitīyaślokena kathitaḥ | tathā hi yato na niravayavatvācchāyādiko bhāgabhedaprakalpako'to'tra paramāṇau diśā dik‌padārthena bhāgo'bhidhīyate | bhāgavyavahāraḥ pūrvāparādikaḥ pravartata ityarthaḥ | yatā hetvantarakṛto bhāgabhedavyavahāraḥ parvatādiṣu tathā paramāṇuṣvapi chāyātapasaṃyogavivakteṣu nimittāntarameṣaṇīyam, tacca digiti dṛṣṭāntopanyāso'yamādyakārikayā kṛta iti apare vyācakṣate | tadetat sarmanupapannam | tathā hi ye ghaṭasyaikasmin pārśve ca chāyayā kapālānāmeva saṃyoga iti ghaṭasya chāyātāpābhyāmasaṃbandhaḥ | atha taddeśatvātsasannihitamavayavavidravyamapi saṃbandhayate avayavavat sarvātmanā tarhi parisamāptatvāt sarvaprakāraṃ so'vabhāseta ātapeneti pārśvāntarābhāvāt chāyayātyantamasaṃbandhaḥ syāt | atha taddeśo'pi nātapena saṃbadhyate tadābhinnadeśatvamavayavāvayavinoḥ syāt, ātapena saṃyuktāsaṃyuktatvādavayavo'pi cāvayavīti tatrāpi chāyādisaṃbandho'vayavānāmevānena nyāyena | tatrāpyavayavāntarāṇāmiti paramāṇuparyantatā | tataśca dik‌saṃbandhādeva paramāṇuvat sthūlo'pi padārthaḥ pūrvāparādibhāgavyapadeśamuccanīcāditvaṃ ca pratipadyate | tathā ca `nirbhāgātmakatā tulyā paramāṇorghaṭasya ca' ityādi vakṣyatyeva || 13 ||
nanu svata eva padārthā viśiṣyasaṃsthānāṃ prabhavanti, ka eṣāṃ dik‌kṛta upakāra ityāśaṅkyāha-- adeśāścāpyabhāgāśca niṣkramā nirūpāśrayāḥ | bhāvāḥ saṃsargirūpāttu śaktibhedaḥ prakalpate || 14 ||
 vibhūnāmākāśādīnāṃ nāsti deśaḥ | pṛthivyādīnāṃ tu mūrtānāmavayavināmātmabhūtadeśābhāvaḥ | ubhayeṣāmapi ca kalpitā deśāḥ saṃyoginaḥ samavāyinaśca | evaṃ svataḥ padārthānāmavayavā na santi, kalpitāstvārthāntarabhūtāḥ saṃsargiṇaḥ | avayavabhedābhāvācca kramo'pyamukhyaḥ, bhedādhiṣṭhānatvāt kramasya | tathā avidyamāna upāśraya upādhiḥ svabhāvānyathātvāpādako yeṣāṃ te nirupāśrayāḥ | evaṃbhūtā api ca bhāvāḥ saṃsargirūpohitena śaktibhedenāsatyapi svarupānyathātve deśādibhedena pratīyante | tathā hyaparayā diśā yogāt saṃbandhāviśeṣe'pi kaścidādhāratāṃ prāpto deśa iti pratīyate iti diṅ‌nimitto deśavyavahāraḥ | sa eva ca deśaḥ samavāyavaśena tirohitabheda iti bhāgo'vayavaśca vyavahriyate | tadvaśena ca krameṇotpatteḥ | kramāvabhāso guṇādibhiśca samavāyādbhedāpohe viśiṣṭāvasāya iti saṃsarginimitte | bhāvānāṃ vyavahāraḥ | ātmā tu teṣāṃ tatra yogayasvabhāvaḥ | tadevaṃ yathā deśādikāryamadeśādyā api bhāvāḥ saṃsargibhedāt pratipadyante tathā diśā sampāditabhāgāḥ pūrvādibhāgabhedavyavahāraṃ pratipadyanta iti dṛṣṭāntopanyāsena samarthitam || 14 ||
nanu deśabhedabhinnaḥ pratīyamānavayavo mahāparimāṇo ghaṭādiravayavī dṛśyata iti kathaṃ tatrādeśatādyupapadyata ityāśaṅkyāha-- nirbāgātmakatā tulyā paramāṇorghaṭasya ca | bhāgaḥ śak‌tyaṃntaraṃ tatra parimāṇaṃ ca yattayoḥ || 15 ||
 svabhāvabhūtā'vayavaśūnyatā ghaṭaparamāṇvoḥ samānā | diglakṣaṇena śaktiviśeṣeṇa tu prakalpitāpaurvāparyāḥ svādhārabhūtā eva samavāyavaśādavivekena bhāsamānāḥ śaktinimittatvācchaktivyapadeśyā bhāgā iti vyavahriyante | svato bhāgavattva ekatvāyogāt | arthāntarasaṃbandhanimittā ca bhāgavattā na mukhyā, paramāṇorapi prasaṅgāt | na cāpi parimāṇakṛto mukhyo bhāgabhedaḥ, parimāṇasyāpi tayorghaṭāṇvormahatvāṇutvalakṣaṇasya bhāvādarthāntaratvāt, mahadaṇutvapratyayaheturhi śaktiviśeṣaḥ parimāṇam | ata eva parimāṇaviseṣād ghaṭāṇvorviśeṣaḥ | na tvavayavasaṃbandhāsaṃbandhābhyāmityupādhisaṃbandhānapekṣāyāmavyapadeśyaṃ vastu brahmakalpaṃ sarvaṃ samānam || 15 ||
na cāpi vastūnāmupādhinihito bhedaḥ svarūpasamavāyītyāha-- yataḥ prakalpate bhedo bhedastatrāpi dṛśyate | adṛṣṭoparatiṃ bhedamato yuktataraṃ viduḥ || 16 ||
 avayavairavayavināṃ bhedaḥ, avayavānāmapi svāvayavaiḥ, taiṣāmapi svāvayavairiti yāvatparamāṇuparyantaṃ prāptiḥ | tatrāpi diśā bhāgabhedaprakalpanam | digapyanāśritabhedā kathaṃ bhedāyopakalpeta | digbhedo'pi sūryasaṃyogabhedāhitaḥ | te'pi sūryasaṃyogā merupradeśabhedāt | tatrāpyavayavabhedādbhedaḥ | tatrāpyavayavabhedāditi punardiśyevāvasthānam | tatrāpyevamiti cakratulyamidamityadṛṣṭā uparatirniṣṭhā yasya bhedasya tamanavasthādoṣādatiśayenānupapannaṃ manyante | na kevalaṃ svato bhedo yukto bhāvānāṃ yāvadupādhīnāmapyanyāpekṣaṇādaparyavasito bhedaḥ sutarāṃ bhāvabhedāya nālamiti prakarṣaḥ | tadevaṃ deśādibhedasya bhāveṣu svata upādhivaśāccāpyogād vyavahāramātraṃ sāṃvṛttena rūpeṇa prarūḍhamaśakyāpahnavamiti nigamayiṣyati caitanyavadityādinā || 16 ||
samprati vyāpakatvamamūrtatve diśaḥ prāha-- sarvatra tasya kāryasya darśanādvibhuriṣyate | vibhutvametadevāhuranyaḥ kāryavatāṃ vidhiḥ || 17 ||
 vyatirekādeḥ pūrvoditasya kāryasya sārvatrikatvād vyāpinī dig‌vibhusvabhāvā | amūrtānāṃ hyetadeva vibhutvaṃ sarvatra svakāryasampādakatvam, mūrtānāṃ tu śarīraṇāmavayavairtitatadeśavyāptirvibhutvam || 17 ||
idānīṃ pūrvoktaṃ nigamayati--- caitanyavat sthitā loke dik‌kālaparikalpanā | prakṛtiṃ prāṇināṃ tāṃ hi ko'nyathā sthāpayiṣyati || 18 ||
 sannapi hi padārtho yāvanna saṃvedyate tāvadaprāptasatva iva nārthakriyāsūpayujyata iti caitanyaṃ jñānaṃ sarvavādibhiraśakyanihnavam | ātmāvācaitanyam | yathāhuḥ sāṃkhyāḥ `caitanyaṃ puruṣasya svarūpam' iti | taccāśakyāpahnavam | tadvadanupapadyamānabhedāpi dik‌kālayoḥ parikalpanā yathāpratīti rūḍhā | bhāvānāṃ hi paramārthataḥ pūrvoktanayena bhedābhedabhāvābhāvādi rūpairayogādanādipurūḍhāvidyāvaśādvicitro vyavahāro rūḍhaḥ prakṛtiṃ svabhāvamiva vyavahartṝṇāṃ prāpta iti vidvadbhirapi yathātattvavedibhiranyathā vyavasthāpayituṃ na pāryate | yathā hi caitanyaṃ svabhāvabhūtamevaṃ sarvavyavahārāṇāṃ pūrvāparāditvena dik‌kālāvapi rūḍhau, tāvantareṇārthakriyāniṣpatteḥ | prāṇitvameva vighaṭeteti prāṇigrahaṇena sūcayati | vyavahāre ca yathāpratīti padārthapratyākhyānaṃ na yujyate || 18 ||
yasmāt | saṅkaro vyavahārāṇāṃ prakṛteḥ syādviparyaye | tasmāttyajannimān bhāvān punarevāvalaṃbate || 19 ||
 dṛṣṭādṛṣṭaphalā vyavahārāḥ prāṅ‌mukho'nnāni bhuñjīta, pūrvāhṇe śrāddhaṃ kuryādityādayaḥ pratyākhyāne dikkāvayorna kalperan | prakṛteḥ svabhāvarūpatāṃ prāptāyā dikkālakalpanāyāḥ, viparyaye vaiparītye, apūrvāparādinimittatve'ṅgīkriyamāṇe miśrībhāvo'navasthitatvaṃ pratyakṣāgamarūḍhānāṃ saṃdhyopāsanādirūpāṇāṃ vyavahārāṇāṃ syāt tasmād yadyapi apūrvāparaṃ hīdaṃ viśvaṃ mūrtitaḥ kriyātaśca tathāpi vidvān vyavahārapatitastyaktaprapañcāvabhāso'pi prapañcamavalambata eveti imān dik‌kālaprākārānarthān bādhakābhāsopanyāsena nirākurvannāpi avalambate | tadupādhipratyayasyānivāryatvāt | bahuvacanenāvayavyādirapyartho'śakyaparityāgo vyavahāra iti darśayati | tyajannavalambate iti samānakālatvena tyāgāvalambanayoratiśayok‌tyā yugapadviruddhārthābhyupagamāt parasya svavacanavirodhaṃ dhvanayati || 19 ||
yathā ca kālo brahmaṇaḥ śaktiḥ bhāveṣu pratibandhābhyanujñāvyāpāropādhyadhyastanānātvā tathā digapi svopādhibhinnā pūrvāparāditvena bhāvabhedavyavahāranibandhanītyāha--- tasyāstu śakteḥ pūrvādibhedo bhāvāntarāśrayaḥ | bhinnā dik‌ tena bhedena bhedāyaivopakalpate || 20 ||
 sā svairupādhibhirbhinneti sāmānyenokte'pi pūrvāditayā viśeṣarūpeṇa bhedaḥ punarihopāttaḥ | sūryasaṃyogāśca bhāvāntarākhyā vyākhyātāḥ | bhedāyaiva iti svaviśeṣaṇoparaktaviśeṣyapratyayajanananāyetyarthaḥ | avadhāraṇena bhinnaviśeṣyapratyayakāla evaupādhikaṃ bhedaṃ samavalambate nānyadā svato'bhinnā digityāha || 20 ||
idānīṃ diṅ‌nimittaṃ śāstre kāryamāha--- avadhitvena cāpekṣāyoge diglakṣaṇo vidhiḥ | pūrvamasyeti ṣaṣṭhyeva dṛṣṭā dharmāntarāśraye || 21 ||
 idamasmāt pūrvaṃ paramiti maryādārūpeṇāpekṣaṇaṃ laukikaṃ kāryam, tatraiva śāstrīyadigyogalakṣaṇapañcamī viśeṣaviṣayā | kathaṃ tarhyatra viṣaye ṣaṣṭhī dṛśyata ityāha-- `pūrvamasyeti ṣaṣṭhyeva dṛṣṭā' ityādi | avadhyavadhimatsaṃbandhe'pekṣite pañcamīti tayā ṣaṣṭhī tatraivāpavādatvād bādhyate | dharmāntarasya avayavayatvasya tvapekṣāyāmavayavini ṣaṣṭhyeva bhavati `pūrvaṃ kāyasyeti' na hyatrāvadhitvenāvayavino'pekṣeti digyogapañcamyā aviṣayo'yam | avayavāvayavisaṃbandhe hi na pañcamī, kiṃtvavadhyavadhimatsaṃbandhe | ata eva cāvayavāntarāpekṣayā avayavāntakasyāvadhitve bhavatyeva pañcamī pūrvaṃ kāyasya nābheriti kāyāvayavyapekṣāvayavatā, avayavāntarāpekṣā tu pūrvateti saṃbandhibhedādavirodhe vibhaktidvayopapattiḥ | samāsāvidhau tvekadeśinetyavayaviparigrahe digrūpatā nāśrīyate || 21 ||
vyavahāre ca pūrvādibhāvaḥ pūrvādidiṅ‌nimitto'rthānāṃ na svāṅganimitta iti nānavasthita ityāha-- pūrvādīnāṃ viparyāso'dṛṣṭaścāvadhyasaṅkare | ṛjvetadasyetyetacca liṅgaṃ na vyatikīryate || 22 ||
 avadheḥ apekṣamīyasya asaṅkare aniyamābhāve pūrvādīnāṃ vipayāso na dṛṣṭa iti vyavasthita evāyaṃ vyavahāraḥ | tathā hi yadapekṣya pūrvatvaṃ vyavahniyate na tadevāpekṣya tasyaivāparatvamiti paratvāparatve dikkṛte niyate | evamasya vaṃśasya ṛju spaṣṭaṃ mūlamityetadapi diśo liṅgaṃ na vyatikīryate avadherevānapekṣaṇādavadhyapekṣāyāṃ hi sāṅkaryaṃ saṃbhāvyetāpi | avadheranavasthitatvāt | na cātra liṅge'vadhyapekṣetyavyatikīrṇā eva diśaḥ | itthaṃ ca svāṅgādapi vyavasthāne'vadhiniyamādasāṅkaryameva | dṛṣṭādṛṣṭaprayojanastu vyavahāro'nādisiddhādityasamprayogākhyāvadhinibandhanadigvyavasthāniyataivaiṣaṇīyeti na yaḥ kaśranāvadhirāśrayaṇīyaḥ || evaṃ tāvad bāhyārthanayena dik samarthitā | idānībhantarjñeyanayenāha--- antaḥkaraṇadharmo vā bahirevaṃ prakāśate | asyāṃ tvantarbahirbhāvaḥ prakriyāyāṃ na vidyate || 23 ||
 antaravasthitasya karaṇaṃ vyāpāro'syeti caitanyamevamucyate | tasya hyanādyavidyāvaśāt svarūpaniṣkarṣeṇedamiti bahirākārāvabhāse'pi paramārthato bāhyasyāyogāt svakukṣāveva jagat pratyavabhāsate ityantaravasthitasyaiva vyāpāraḥ | tathā ca vakṣyati-- dyauḥ kṣamā vāyurādityaḥ sāgarāḥ sarito diśaḥ | antaḥkaraṇatattvasya bhāgā bahiravasthitāḥ || iti | tasyāntaḥkaraṇasyāyaṃ dharmo bāhyārthānapekṣo'vidyāvaśāt svabhāvabhūto'vabhāsate | evaṃ pūrvādyākāreṇa bahuradhyavasīyate | asati bāhye kathaṃ bahirityucyeta iti cedāha | asyāmavidyāvaśādavabhāsasyaiva bāhyatvāvasāyarūpāyāṃ kalpanāyāmantārūpatā bahīrūpatā ca na mukhyā parānurodhāttu pratibhāsavaśenaivamucyata ityarthaḥ | asati hi bāhye kadapekṣamāntaratvamapi na mukhyamiti kālpaniko'ntarbahirbhāvaḥ | evaṃ ca pūrvāparatvamavidyādhyastaṃ bhāveṣu āntararūpeṣvanādimithyābhyāsavāsanālakṣaṇāntaḥkaraṇadharmarūpaṃ cakāstīti na bāhyā kācid digasti || 23 ||
ataścaikatvanānātvavicāro'pi niṣphala evetyāha-- ekatvamāsāṃ śaktīnāṃ nānātvaṃ veti kalpane | avastupatite jñātvā satyato na parāmṛśet || 24 ||
 bhāvopādhirūpāṇāṃ pūrvāditvena bhinnānāṃ dik‌śaktīnāṃ mukhyamekatvam, upādhibhedāttu nānātvam | mukhyameva cānādisiddhaṃ nānātvaṃ bhinnakāryānumeyamityete dve kalpate avastupatite | diśaḥ paramārthato'vastutvād vijñānanaye vyatiriktavastvabhāvādityavastuviṣaye budhvā paramārthato na vicāraṇīye ityarthaḥ | yathāpratīti vyavahārasiddheḥ | ata evaṃ saṃvedyamānaṃ pratītibhedānnānātvamabhipretyāsāmiti bahutvena nirdeśaḥ || 24 ||
na ca padārthavicāre kiṃcit prayojanamasti | tathā hi--- vikalpātītatattveṣu saṅketopanibandhanāḥ | bhāveṣu vyavahārā ye lokastatrānugamyate || 25 ||
 iha padārthāstīrthikaparikalpitaniyatasaṅketaparighaṭitaśarīrāstāṃstīrthikaparikalpitān vikalpānatikramya bhāvato vartante | na hi pratidarśanadarśitaviruddharūpayogastattvaṃ bhāvānām | tasmādavicāritaramaṇīyā lokasiddhāḥ padārthāḥ samāśrayaṇīyāḥ vidvadbhirapi | alamebhirapratiṣṭhitaistarkavikalpaiḥ | tathā ca loke prasiddhā daśa diśaḥ siddhāḥ || 25 ||
tarkavikalpaistu bhedābhedau na vyavatiṣṭhate ityāha-- naikatvamastyanānātvaṃ vinaikatvena netarat | paramārthe tayoreṣa bhedo'tyantaṃ na vidyate || 26 ||
 anyonyāśrayasya rūpasyekāsiddhāvitarāsiddherubhayāsiddhiprasaṅga iti diśāmekatvanānātve na vyavatiṣṭhete | vyavahāre gajanimīlanena tu yathāvabhāsaṃ laukiko vyavahāro rūḍhaḥ | paramārthavicāre tu parasparapratiyoginorbhedābhedayorapyasatyatā mukhyābhinnasya parasyaiva tattvarapatvādityarthaḥ | kiṃ ca paropādhitayā śaktirdigityuktam || 26 ||
śakteśca bhedābhedavicārānarhatetyāha--- na śaktīnāṃ tathā bhedo yathā śaktimatāṃ sthitiḥ | na ca laukikamekatvaṃ tāsāmātmasu vidyate || 27 ||
 śaktimatāṃ svatantrāṇāṃ padārthānāṃ pṛthagevāvadhāraṇādbhedo niścīyate na śaktīnāmādārapāratantryeṇāvabhāsamānānām | tasmādādhārātparasparataśca bhedaḥ pratyakṣasiddhaḥ | nāpi svatantrasya śaktimato yathā bhedo ghaṭāderekatvaṃ lokaprasiddham, abhedāvabhāsāt | tathā śaktīnāṃ kāryanānātvonnīyamānabhedānāṃ svata ādhārāccābhedo'stītyanirvācyā eva bhedābhedābhyāṃ sarvāḥ śaktayaḥ | ata evāvidyāśaktirbrahmaṇo bhedaṃ na vidhatte yena dvaitāpattiḥ || 27 ||
yaduktaṃ--- `naikatvamastyanānātvam....' ityādi tadevāvyavasthitatvena nigamayam̐stārkikāṇāmekapakṣāvalambanaṃ na yuktamityāha--- naikatvaṃ vyavatiṣṭheta nānātvaṃ cenna kalpayet | nānātvaṃ cāvahīyeta yadyekatvaṃ na kalpayet || 28 ||
 pratiyogibhūtaṃ nānātvaṃ yadi buddhyā na kalpayet nāśrayet ekatvaṃ kartṛ tadā na svarūpaṃ niyataṃ labheta | evaṃ nānātvamapi yadi pratiyogyekatvaṃ nāśrayet tadā tadapi nāvatiṣṭheteti parasparāpekṣatvādanayornaikatrāvasthātuṃ pāryate ityavicāritaramaṇīyā digāśrayaṇīyā laukikīti siddham || 28 ||
iti bhūtirājatanayahelārājakṛte prakīrṇaprakāśe dik‌samuddeśaḥ ṣaṣṭhaḥ || sādhanasamuddeśaḥ  `dik sādhanam' iti diśo'nantaraṃ sādhanamuddiṣṭaṃ lakṣayitumāha-- svāśraye samavetānāṃ tadvadevāśrayāntare | kriyāṇāmabhiniṣpattau sāmarthyaṃ sādhanaṃ viduḥ || 1 ||
 kriyānirvṛttau dravyasya śaktiḥ sādhanam, sādhyate'nayā kriyeti bhāṣyakāraprabhṛtayo viduḥ | tathā hi "giṇaḥ sādhanam "iti bhāṣya uktam | śaktirevātrādhārapāratantryādanyasmācca svāśrayasya bhedakatvād guṇaśabdenoktā | kṛdākhyātābhihitayorbhāvayorbhedābhidhānaprasaṅge tu yad bhāṣyam--- "dravyaṃ kriyābhinirvṛttiṃ pratiṃ sādhanabhāvamupaiti"  iti tadanyatrāhatya dravyasya sādhanatvavyudāsācchaktivyavadhānāśrayeṇa gamayitavyam | śaktaṃ hi dravyaṃ sādhanam, na tu nirādhārā śaktiḥ sambhavati | "parokṣe liṭ"  ityatrāpi "yadi guṇasamudāyaḥ sādhanam, sādhanamapyanumānagamyam | athānyadguṇebhyaḥ sādhanam, bhavati pratyakṣaparokṣatāyāḥ saṃbhavaḥ"  iti yad bhāṣyaṃ tadapyevameva netavyam | śakternityaparokṣatvāt kriyāvadviśeṣaṇamavyabhicārādayuktamiti parokṣatāviśeṣaṇasāmarthyācchak‌tyāviṣṭaṃ dravyaṃ sādhanamupanyastam | evam "upasargācchandasi dhātvarthe" ityatra "sādhane'yaṃ bhavaṃlliṅgasaṃkhyābhyāṃ yokṣyate" iti bhāṣyaṃ sādhanaśaktiviśiṣṭe dravya iti vyākhyeyam | tathā hi-dhātāvityevokte śabde vṛttasambhavāt kriyāpratipattau siddhāyāmarthagrahaṇāddhātukṛto'rtha iti samāsappatipattyarthād dravyamāśritam | vastuparyāyo hyarthaśabdaḥ | dravyasya ca svarūpeṇa siddhasvabhāvatvāt kriyayā karaṇānupapatteḥ karmādikārakarūpeṇaiva tasya karaṇam | kriyā hi kārakāṇi karoti, tadapekṣatvāttad‌vyavahārasyeti sādhanātmanā dravyasya kriyayā karaṇādevamuktam | dhāturarthaḥ prayojanamasyetyetattu bhāṣyāvyākhyānamayuktam | evaṃ hi śaktereva kriyā sādhyatvena prayojanamiti dravyaṃ na pratyāyyeta | yattu "sādhanaṃ vai dravyam, na ca dravyasya prakarṣāpakarṣau staḥ" ityadravyaprakarṣavyākhyāne bhāṣye dravyasya sādhanatvābhidhānaṃ tacchaktiśaktimatorbhedāvivakṣayetyavagantavyam | tathā hi-tiṅantāt kriyāsādhanābhidhāyinaḥ prakarṣapratyaya iti śakteḥ kriyāvakṣaṇakāryānumeyāyāḥ kāryadvāreṇaiva prakarṣa iti kriyāprakarṣe pratyayasyeṣṭasya saṃgrahe dravyādhāratvācchakteḥ kāryamukhavat kāraṇabhūtadravyamukhenāpi kathaṃ na prakarṣa ityāśaṅkya dravyasya tadabhāvamabhidhātumetaduktamiti vyatireko'nādṛtaḥ tatra kartṛkarmaṇoḥ kriyā samavaitīti svāśrayasamavotakriyāniṣpattau tayoḥ kārakatā, karaṇādīnāṃ tu parāśrayasamavetāyāṃ kriyāyāṃ sādhanabhāvaḥ | na hi karaṇādiṣu kriyā samavaiti | kriyāṇām iti vyaktibhedāpekṣaṃ bahuvacanam | guṇakriyāpekṣayā vā sarveṣāṃ svāśrayasamavetakriyāpekṣaṃ sādhanatvam | guṇakriyāyāṃ hi kartāraḥ sarve| akiṃcitkarasya sādhanatvānupapatteḥ | ata eva karaṇaṃ kārakamityādisādhanasāmānādhikaraṇyopapattiḥ | itthaṃ ca kriyāṇām iti bahuvacanaṃ suṣṭhu gamitaṃ bhavati | kartṛkarmasthā tu pradhānakriyā karaṇādīnāmāśrayāntarasamavetā || 1 ||
kathaṃ punaretadavagamyate śaktiḥ sādhanaṃ na punardravyamityāśaṅkyāha--- śaktimātrāsamūhasya viśvasyānedharmmaṇaḥ | sarvadā sarvathā bhāvāt kvacit kiṃcid vivakṣyate || 2 ||
