 ghaṭādayo bhāvā viśvaśabdavācyāḥ | te ca tattadudakāharaṇādikāryasādhikānāṃ śaktīnāṃ samūharūpāḥ | ata eva tāḥ śaktayastatra mātrā bhāga iti śaktisamāhāramātraṃ ghaṭādayaḥ | tāśca śaktayo'nekavidhāḥ | kāścit svahetoreva prabhavanti, āśrayavināśamanvapi ca vinaśyanti | yathā bodhapradīpādīnāṃ prakāśaśaktayaḥ | kāścit pauruṣeyyaḥ sthita evāśraye nirudhyante | yathā balādiśaktayaḥ | tā hi śramābhyāsena vṛṣyad‌dravyopayogena ca jāyante | anyāḥ satyevāśraye puruṣaprayatnena vidhāryyante | yathā viṣasya māraṇaśaktiḥ | bījasyāṅkurajananaśaktiḥ | anyāḥ prabāvātiśayavatā viparivartyante | yathā yoginā sarvabhāvānāṃ rūpaparivṛttirādhīyate | kāścit kālaparivāsena vyajyante, yathā dharmādharmādiśaktiḥ phaladāna ityādyanekavidhamunneyam | evamanekasvabhāvatve śaktisamudāyasya vicitre kārye yathāśakti bheda vivakṣāyāṃ pratiniyatasādanabhāvopapattiḥ | dravyasya tu sādhanatve tasyaikarūpatvāt kāryavaicitryaṃ na syādityarthaḥ | taduktaṃ bhāṣye "guṇasamudāyaḥ sādhanaṃ"  iti | pradhānakriyāyā ekaikaśaktisādhyatvābhāvāt samudāyagrahaṇam | guṇakriyāpekṣayā tu pratyekaṃ śakteḥ sādhanatā | tasyāśca pradhānakriyāpekṣayā vaicitryāt karmādirūpatā | yad vā pratyekaṃ sādhanatve'pi samudāyagrahaṇaṃ śaktīnāṃ sādhanatve tāsāṃ bhedādekasya kāryabhedopapattiravyāpanārtham | tenānekaśakterapi padārthasya sadaiva tathāvasthāne'pi kācicchaktiḥ kvacidudbhūtā vivakṣyata iti ghaṭaṃ paśya, ghaṭenodakamānaya, ghaṭe udakaṃ nidhehītyādi karmakaraṇādibhāvo niyamenopapadyata iti na kārakasāṅkaryaprasaṅgaḥ | dravyasya tvekasvabhāvatvāt karmakaraṇāditvaṃ nopapadyata iti garbhīkṛteyamatra yuktiḥ śakteḥ sādhanatve boddhavyā || 2 ||
nanu ca yatra santi śaktayastatra yuktaṃ yanniyamena vivakṣyeran | yatra dṛśyante punarasatyastatra kathaṃ tāsāṃ vivakṣā | tadyathā śaktimādadhāti, śaktyā sādhayati, śaktāvāyatate, śaktervyapaitīti | na hi śakteḥ śak‌tyantarayogaḥ, anavasthāpātāt | tathā dhanavināśaṃ karoti, dhanābhāvena yukta iti nirūpākhye bhāve kā śaktiḥ | sthālyāṃ pacati, sthālyā pacati, iti sambhavanadhāraṇopakārā sthālī karaṇādhikaraṇabhinnā kathamityāśaṅkyāha-- sādhanavyavahāraśca buddhyavasthānibandhanaḥ | sannasan vārtharūpeṣu bhedo buddhyā prakalpyate || 3 ||
 vivakṣārūpāyā buddheḥ śabdanimittā ye'vasthāviśeṣāḥ pratiniyataśabdanibandhanāḥ tadāśrayaḥ kartrādikārakavyavahāraḥ | tathā hi--nirūpite'rte śabdaprayogād yathānirūpaṇaṃ śabdopapattiḥ | nirūpaṇaṃ cānapekṣyāpi bāhyamarthaṃ svātantryāt parikalpayati tāṃstānarthaviśeṣān | tatra śakterdravyāyamāṇāyā buddhayā svātantryeṇa nirūpaṇācchabdenābhidhāne śak‌tyantarayogo viruddhaḥ | na hi tadā śak‌tyavasthāyāmeva tasyāṃ tadyogo yenānavasthā syāt, api tu dravyāvasthāyāmabhāvo'pi buddhyā nirūpitākāro dravyāyamāṇa eva śabdavācyaḥ | evaṃ tanutarakapālatvāt sthālī pāke'napekṣitakartṛviniyogot svātantryeṇa vivakṣyata iti kratrī, indhanopakārānapekṣayā tasyā eva sādhakatamatvavivakṣāyāṃ tu karaṇam, vāstavādhāravivakṣāyāṃ tvadhikaraṇamiti sarvamupapadyate | ata eva hantyātmānamātmanā, ātmanaḥ svātmanyavasthānam, ityādayo'pi prayogāḥ prathitasādhimānaḥ | vakṣyati caitat--- "buddhyaikaṃ bhidyate bhinnamekatvaṃ copagacchati " ityādi | dṛśyavikalpayorabhedādhyavasāyena vyavahāropapatterbahiranyāvyāvṛttiparatayā samanvayo'tra samarthanīyaḥ, svātmani nānyasmin, svātmana eva nāparasyāvasthānamityādi | yathā śilāputrakasya śarīramiti | itthaṃ ca vākyādapoddhṛtasyāpi padasya saṃskāre prathamata evāprayukte padāntare vivakṣitasyāpi viśeṣasya rūpasāmānyādanavadhāraṇe saṃbhavatyeva padāvadhikamanvākhyānaṃ saṃbadhisāmānye'pekṣite | anyathā buddhyā niyatamartharūpaṃ kriyādisaṃbandhyapekṣaṃ kathaṃ nirūpyeta | anapekṣitasaṃbandhirūpasyārthasāmānyasyābhāvādabhyupagataṃ padāvadhikamanvākhyānam | śāstre "dhātusaṃbandhe pratyayāḥ" ityevamādīnāṃ pratyākhyānāt | yatra ca sarvathā'saṅgatiḥ sthālīmodanena kāṣṭhe pacatītyādau tad vākyameva na bhavatīti kataṃ vākyādapoddhṛtānāṃ padānāmanvākhyāne'tra prasaṅgaḥ | ata eva cākṣīṇi me darśanīyānītyāderviprayogasya nivṛttaye śāstramarthavadeva | sāmānyamapi hi padārtharūpamarthāntarasaṃsargayogyameva saṃstūyate, na tvaṅgulyagre kariśatamāsta ityādyasamanvitameva | evaṃ ca kṛtvā chandasi "caṣālaṃ ye aśvayūpāya takṣati" ityādavasādhutvaśaṅkāpanuttaye vyatyayo'rthavāneva | niyatānupūrvīkasya chandovākyasya saṃbhavāttatastathaiva padāpoddhārasya nyāyyatvāt | loke tu nānavasthitaṃ niyatānupūrvīkamasaṅgata vākyamiti na tato'poddhāraprasaṅgaḥ | tasmāddhākyādapoddhṛtya padānuśāsane'pi nirdoṣameva padāvadhikamanvākhyānam | tatra ca samastaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭasyārthasya niraṃśatvādapoddhāre sāmānyamātrā buddhiparikalpitaśarīraiva | upakrama eva tu viśeṣāpekṣāyāṃ vākyāvadhikamanvākhyānaṃ kathyate | na tu vākyasyānantyāt sākṣādanvākhyānaṃ yujyate | prakṛtipratyayādivibhāgakalpanayā hi padasyaivānuśāsanumupapadyate | tasya ca kevalasyāsaṃbhavādvākyasthatve saṃbandhisāmānyāpekṣāyāṃ padāvadhikaṃ tadvākyopāttasaṃbandhiviśeṣāpekṣāyāṃ tu vākyāvadhikamanvākhyānamitīyānanayoḥ pakṣayoḥ viśeṣaḥ || 3 ||
bauddhe sādhanavyavahāre bhāṣyakārābhyupagamasaṃvādakamāha--- buddhayā samāhitaikatvān pañcālān kurubhiryadā | punarvibhajate vaktā tadā'pāyaḥ pratīyate || 4 ||
 kurubhyaḥ pañcālā abhirūpatarā iti "pañcamī vibhakte"  iti pañcamyarthaṃ sūtraṃ bhāṣye pratyākhyātam, bauddhasyāpāyasya sambhavādapādāna ityeva siddheḥ | tathā hyābhirūpyeṇa samānena guṇena kurubhiḥ saha pañcālān buddhyaikatvaṃ samudāyabhāvamāpādyātiśayābhirūpatāvaśāt kurubhyaḥ pañcālāḥ pṛthak kriyanta ityasti saṃśleṣapūrvako viśleṣo'pāyaḥ | taduktaṃ bhāṣye "yastaiḥ sāmyaṃ gatavān sa evaṃ prayuṅkte" iti | taiḥ kurubhiḥ paṃcālānāṃ sādṛśyaṃ sampradhāraṇāsāmarthyādābhirūpyeṇa prathamaṃ yo jñātavānityarthaḥ | anena caikabuddhiniveśitvena kurupaṃcālānāṃ deśapratyāsattimāha bhāṣyakāraḥ | tatpūrvakastu sātiśayasya niratiśayādvibhāgaḥ | paṃcamīśabdo'pādānasaṃjñānatvānnokto bhāṣyakṛtā | sūtrāraṃbhavādināpi nirdhāraṇāśrayatvenaiṣāṃ buddhyaiva samudāyabhāvaḥ samānaguṇatvādāśrayaṇīyaḥ | anyathā nirdhāraṇādhikārādeva vibhāge labdhe vibhaktagrahaṇādatthantavibhāgapratītau na vāstavaḥ samudāyabhāvo yujyate | tadevaṃ bauddhaḥ sādhanabhāvo'smādavasīyate | kārakaprakaraṇe ca tamab‌grahaṇāt prakarṣo na vivakṣyata iti gauṇe'pyatrāpāye'pādānasaṃjñā bhavati || 4 ||
anyadapi bhāṣyoktaṃ saṃvādakamāha-- śabdopahitarūpāśca buddherviṣayatāṃ gatān | pratyakṣamiva kaṃsādīn sādhanatvena manyate || 5 ||
 "hetumati ca"  ityatra "ākhyānāt kṛtastadācaṣṭe...." ityevamādyupasaṃkhyānaṃ "na vā sāmānyakṛtatvāddhetuto hyaviśiṣṭam" ityevaṃ pratyākhyātam | citrapustādau hi pratikṛtirūpasya prayojyaprayojakabhāvādhyavasāyāt kaṃsaṃ ghātayati, baliṃ bandhayatīti siddham | evaṃ kṛtānukaraṇe nāṭye'pi naṭānāṃ kaṃsavāsudevānukāreṇa sādṛśyāttadrūpatopapattiḥ | tatra " granthikeṣu katham " iti coditam | tatra granthikāḥ kathakā iti vṛttarūpeṇaiva kaṃsavadhamācakṣate | tatra ca pratikṛtirūpasyābhāvāt kathaṃ prayojyaprayojakatvamiti paryanuyogaḥ | atra parihāra uktaḥ | "te'pi hi teṣāmutpattipṛbhṛtyā vināśādṛddhīrvyācakṣāṇāḥ sato buddhiviṣayān prakāśayanti "  iti cirakālātītatvāt kaṃsādīnāṃ bahirasatvāt buddhigocaratayā sato vidyamānāṃstān prakāśayanti śabdenāvabhāsayanti | buddhipratibhāsyeva hyākāro śabdārtho na vastvarthaḥ | tathā ca kathakaḥ śrotari kaṃsādyākārapratyayajanatāt buddhivāṃsudevena buddhikaṃsaṃ ghātayatīti prayojakatvasamāropāt prayogopapattiḥ | tathā hi-kathakodīritaśabdasāmarthyopajātarūpaviśeṣān śrotṛbuddhigocaramāpannān savyāpārarūpān kaṃsādīn karmādisādhanatayā bhāṣyakāro manyata iti buddhyavasthānibandhanaḥ sādhanavyavahāraḥ siddhaḥ | gauṇe'pi ca prayojake kārakaprakaraṇe prākarṣānāśrayāddhetusaṃjñāyāṃ tadvayāpāre'tra ṇic sautraḥ | pratyakṣam ityavyayībhāvaḥ | mananakriyāviśeṣaṇaṃ caitat | indriyanimittena jñānena parisphuṭānavadhārayatītyarthaḥ | etacca `ṛddhīrvyācakṣāṇā' iti bhāṣyāsyābhiprāyavyākhyānam | prabhāvātiśayayukte hi vastunyādaravaśāt spaṣṭarūpaḥ pratyayaḥ prasūyate | spaṣṭe ca jñāne'vabhāsamāna ākāro bāhyātmako'vasīyate || 5 ||
tadevaṃ buddhyā sādhanavyavahāropapattau ekasyāpi vastunaḥ śaktinānātvaṃ bauddhamupapadyata iti nigamayati | buddhipravṛttirūpaṃ ca samāropyābhidhātṛbhiḥ | artheṣu śaktibhedānāṃ kriyate parikalpanā || 6 ||
 buddheḥ pravṛttiḥ vyāpāraḥ paricchedalakṣaṇaḥ | tasyā rūpamākāro viṣaya ābhāsamānaḥ | tamartheṣu bāhyeṣvadhyasya teṣāṃ śaktinānātvaṃ parikalpyate vak‌tṛbhiḥ | ayayarthaḥ | dṛśyavikalpayorabhedādhyavasāyād bauddhaḥ śaktibhedo bāhya evetyabhimānāt tatra vicitraṃ sādhanabāvamabhimanyante | buddhipratibhāsasya svapratiṣṭhatvenānavagamāttatra kriyābhedaṃ pratipattṛvyapekṣāṃ cānuvartya vastvena nānāśaktikamavagamyata iti bahirarthe śabdaḥ pramāṇam | kriyākārakasaṃsargasya bādhakābhāvāt sati saṃvāde ca vākyasya pramāṇyamavagamayanti vyavahartāraḥ | saugatānāṃ vikalpapratibiṃbasya bhedānadhyalasāyāt bahiṣvapravṛttiḥ | prāmāṇyaṃ tu vaktrābhiprayā eva śabdānāṃ na bāhye vyabhicārāśaṅkanāt, anyavyāvṛttimātraniṣṭhatā tu bahiḥ | vaiyākaraṇānāṃ tu vyāvṛttavastuviṣayatā, tathādhyavasāyāt tatraiva prāmāṇyamiti darśanabhedaḥ | niyatopādiniyamitatvācca na sāṅkaryam | upakārakāśca śaktayaḥ pratyupādhibhinnāḥ saṃmūrcchitaśarīrātvādvastunastattvānyatvābhyāmanirvācyā iti nānupādhyupakārāṅgatvāderaprasaṅgaḥ || 6 ||
buddhyāvasthāsamāśraye ca sādhanabhāve satīdamapi siddhaṃ bhavatītyāha--- vyaktau padārthe śabdāderjanyamānasya karmaṇaḥ | sādhanatvaṃ tathā siddhaṃ buddhirūpaprakalpitam || 7 ||
 jātau padārthe tajjātīyābhedenānāgataṃ nirūpya yogyasādhanaviniyogājjātidvāreṇa kriyāsiddhāvaṅgatā vyaktidvāreṇa tu nirvartyamānatā karmaṇo yujyata ityuktam "nirvartyamānaṃ yatkarma jātistatrāpi sādhanam " iti | vyaktau tu padena pratyāyyāyāṃ śabdaṃ janayati saṃyogaṃ karotītyādau janyamānasya nirvartyasya śabdādeḥ karmaṇo'nāgatasyāpi vartamānavyaktisārūpyādasatyapi jāteḥ pratyāyane bhedānadhyavasāyād buddhyākāramullikhya yogyasādhanaviniyogāt bauddhasyaiva bahīrūpatādhyavasāyād bāhyena rūpeṇa nirvartyamānatā, bauddhena tu sādhanabhāvo yujyata ityarthaḥ | janyamānasyetyanena vikāryaprāpyayorvyavacchedaḥ || 6 ||
vikāryaṃ hi prakṛtirūpeṇa sthitameva | prāpyamapi svata eva kiyadvā buddhyā nādhyāropyata ityāha--- svatantraparatantratve kramarūpaṃ ca darśitam | nirīheṣvavi bhāveṣu kalpanopanibandhanam || 8 ||
 sadasat‌pakṣabhedena kāryakāraṇabhāvasya nirākṛtatvāt sarve bhāvāḥ kriyārahitāśceṣṭāśūnyāḥ | tatra kriyayāṃ svātantryapāratantryādilakṣaṇaṃ kartṛkaraṇādirūpaṃ kārakatvam | kriyārūpameva ca sakramattvaṃ yathāvabāsamanādimithyābhyāsavāsanāvaśena kalpanābuddhyuparacitasatattvam | apūrvāparasyāpi bhāvato viśvasya pūrvāparatayā svātantryādinātrāvabhāsanāditi mityāvabhāso'yamartheṣu kriyākārakabhāva ityarthaḥ | advaitanaye hi sarvamupaplavate, asatyatvāditi vikalpaparighaṭitaḥ śābdo vyavahāro yathāpratītyavicāritasiddho'bhyupagantavya iti digādipadārthavat sādhanapadārthasiddhiḥ |`darśitam' ityadvaitanayāvalambibhirbhāṣyakāraprabhṛtibhiḥ, "kūlaṃ pipatiṣati" ityādiprayogasiddhyarthamākhyātamityarthaḥ || 8 ||
evaṃ tāvad dravyavyatiriktaśaktidarśanena sādhanaṃ lakṣitam | avyatiriktaśaktidarśanenāpyāha--- śaktayaḥ śaktiṃmantaśra sarve saṃsargavādinām | bhāvāsteṣvasvaśabdeṣu sādhanatvaṃ nirūpyate || 9  samavāyavaśāddharmadharmiṇorabhedamiva bhede'pi ye vadanti te saṃsargavādino vaiśeṣikaḥ | te ca svarūpaṃ sahakāriṇaśca bhāvānāṃ svakāryajanane śaktiriti pratipannāḥ | sahakāriṇaḥ śaktiḥ, kāraṇaṃ śaktimat | evaṃ sahakāriṇāmapi kāraṇaṃ śaktiḥ svakārye sahakāri rūpamiti śaktiśaktimantaḥ sarva eva bhāvāḥ, na tvanyā kācidatīndriyā śaktiḥ ṣa ṭpadārthalyatiriktā vidyate | evamapi sādhanatvaṃ bhāvānāṃ padārthānāmapādānādiśabdairna pratyāyyate, api tu vibhaktibhireva | tathā ca pratyāyanaṃ yogyatāmātreṇa tvapādānādiśabdapravṛttiḥ | `ghaṭaṃ paśyati' ityādāveva dvitīyādibhirmahattvādyādhāraniyataṃ pratyāyyamānaṃ śaktiḥ sādhanaṃ bhavati | ādhārānavacchinnastu mahattvādiḥ karmādiśabdavācyo na kiṃcanāpi sādhayatīti vibhak‌tyekasamadhigamyaḥ | prātipadikādādhāravācinastadutpatteḥ | ādhārasamavāye sādhanatvasya saṃsparśādupakārāvasthāyāṃ śaktitvamupakāryāvasthāyāṃ tu śaktimattvaṃ pramāṇadṛṣṭamiti na kācidanupapattiḥ | ata eva śaktyavasthāyāṃ śaktyantaremāyogādanavasthāpi nāsti | abhāvasyāsmin darśane spatamapadārtharūpatvena bhāvyatvācchaktiyogo'viruddhaḥ || 9 ||
tatra ko bhāvaḥ kasya kva śaktirityudāharaṇamāha-- ghaṭasya dṛśikarmatve mahattvādīni sādhanam | rūpasya dṛśikarmatve rūpatvādīni sādhanam || 10 ||
 `ghaṭaṃ paśyati' iti darśanakriyākarmabhāvāpannasya ghaṭadravyasya mahattvānekadravyavattvarūpāṇi śaktisvasamavotāni sādhanaṃ karmakārakam | tathā hi kaṇādasūtram --- "mahatyanekadravyavattvādrūpāccopalabdhiḥ"  iti | asyārthaḥ | anekadravyaṃ samavāyikāraṇaṃ yasya tadanekadravyaṃ dvayaṇukādi | tadyasyāsti tadārabdhasya tadanekadravyavat | tadbhāvastattvam | tasmāddhetorupalabdhirmahati dravye | tena bahuvrīhiṇā matupā ca dvau matvarthāvuktau | tatraikena paramāṇoryavvacchedaḥ | sa hi rūpavānapyanekasya dravyasyāraṃbhakasyābhāvānnopalabhyate | apareṇa tu matvarthena dvayaṇurādervyavacchedaḥ | ata eva sūtrāntaramuktam --- "adravyatvātparamāṇāvanupalabdhiḥ" iti | paramāṇugrahaṇamatrādṛśyamānasyopalakṣaṇārtham | mahati dṛśyamāne cānekadravyavattvaṃ darśanaheturiti tryaṇukasya kāraṇabahutvamahatvapracayebhyo mahattvasyotpattiriti tribhirdv‌yaṇukairāraṃbhānmagato'nekadravyavattve'pi tadabhāvaḥ | mahato hi dṛśyamānasyānuvādenedaṃ vidhīyata ityadṛsye nāyane raśmau nāsyādṛśyatāpattiḥ | na hi mahattvamapyatra darśanakāraṇaṃ vidhīyate | evaṃ hyekasyā ākṛteścaritaḥ prayoga iti nyāyāt prakramo bhedārthaḥ paṃcamyeva kriyeta | anekadravyavataśca mahattvāvyabhicārān `mahati' iti na hetunirdeśaḥ, api tu viṣayopalakṣaṇameva | `rūpāt' iti ca dvitīyo darśanahetuḥ | nīrūpasya vāṇormahato'nekadravyavataścāpyanupalaṃbhāt | taduktaṃ sūtram--- "rūpasaṃskārābhāvācca vāyāvanupalabdhiḥ" iti | yataścānekadravyatvasya rūpasya darśanahetutvaṃ na mahattvasyāpi tato dvayoreva vyatirekaḥ pradarśitaḥ | mahattvasyākāraṇatve'pi ca tadviṣayatvāddarśanasya pāramparyeṇopayogān `mahattvādīni sādhanam' iti bahuvacanam | yadvā dravyatvādīnāṃ sāmānyaviśeṣāṇāmapyādiśabdena saṅgrahaṇāt bahuvacanam | atra sāmānyaviśeṣā hi pradhānaṃ darśananibandhanam | tadupādhikatvenārthānām, pararūpavyāvṛttisyātmana upalaṃbhāt | `mahati ityeva tūkte vyabhicāra ākāśādinetyanekadravyavattvāditi matupā'vayavidravye pratītirabhivyajyate | `anekadravyavattvāt' iti punarucyamāne tatpuruṣasaṃbhāvanayā dravyapracayamātraṃ gamyeta | `rūpaṃ paśyati' ityatra rūpasya darśanakriyāyāṃ rūpatvaṃ svasamavetaṃ sāmānyamanekadravye ca dravye samavāyaḥ sādhanam | tathā ca sūtram--- "anekadravyasamavāyādrūpaviśeṣācca rūpopalabdhiḥ"  iti | aneke āraṃbhakā yasyāvayavidravyasya tadanekadravyam, tena samavāyāt, tatra samavetatvāt | rūpasya viśeṣa udbhūtatvam | ato nāyanaraśmirūpaṃ bāhyataijasadravyarūpeṇābhibhūtamapohyate | anye tu rūpaṃ viśeṣyate vyāvartyate'nenānyasmādrasāderiti rūpatvameva sāmānyaviśeṣa evamupadiṣṭa iti varṇayanti | anekadravyatvābhāvācca paramāṇostadgatarūpasyādṛśyatā | yogyadeśatvādayo'pi sāmarthyāt sādhanamiti bahuvacananirdeśaḥ || 10 ||
svaiḥ sāmānyaviśeṣaiśca śaktimanto rasādayaḥ | niyatagrahaṇā loke śaktayastāstathāśrayaiḥ || 11 ||
 rasaṃ rasayati, gandhaṃ jighrati , sparśaṃ spṛśati, śabdaṃ śṛṇoti iti ra,tvādayaḥ sāmānyaviśeṣāḥ samavetāḥ rasanādīnāṃ rasanādikriyāsādhanam | tathā hi taistaiḥ niyatagrahaṇāḥ niyataṃ svajātibalādeva gṛhyante, na tu dravyavadaniyatagrahaṇāḥ | dravyaṃ hi kadācitsāmānyopādinā gṛhyate `dravyam' iti, kadācid guṇena śuklamiti, kadācit karmaṇā `gacchati' iti | rasatvādīnāṃ tu śaktīnāṃ svādhārā evāvacchedakāḥ svarūpagrahaṇe śaktiḥ | yathā hi rasasyopalaṃbhe rastavamapyupalabhyate tadviśiṣṭasya tasyopalaṃbhādityāśritākṣepaḥ tathā rasatvopalaṃbhe'pi svāśrayākṣepaḥ | tathā rasasyopalaṃbhe tadāśrayaṃ dravyamapi śaktirityāpi jñeyam | pūrvavaccānekadravye samavāyo'pi gṛhyate, paramāṇugatasya rasāderanupalaṃbhāt | evaṃ śeṣeṣvapi vācyam | itthaṃ parasparaṃ śaktiśaktimanto bhāvāḥ | tathā ca na kācinniyatā śaktiḥ | saṃsargiṇāṃ parasparaṃ śaktiśaktimanto bhāvāḥ | tathā ca na kācinniyatā śaktiḥ | saṃsargiṇāṃ parasparaṃ tattvāt, anyasya ca yogyadeśatvādeḥ sahakāriṇaḥ tathātvāt || 11 ||
indriyārthamanaḥ kartṛsaṃbandhaḥ sādhanaṃ kvacit | yadyadā yadanugrāhi tattadā tatra sādhanam || 12 ||
ātmendriyamano'rthasannikarṣāt jñānaṃ niṣpadyate rūpādāviti saṃyoga eva sādhanam | sukhādau tvātmāntaḥ karaṇasaṃyogāditi `kvacit' ityāha | kiṃ vātra parigaṇanayā, yadyatropakaroti tattatra sādhanamiti yathāyogaṃ sarve bhāvāḥ śaktiśaktimantaḥ | tathā hi saṃkhyāḥ parimāṇāni pṛthak‌tvaṃ saṃyogavibhāgau karma ca rūpadrivyasamavāyāccākṣuṣāṇyuktāni | avayavānāmavayaviniṣpattau saṃyogaḥ śaktiḥ | guṇaniṣpattau tvavayavinaḥ samavāyaḥ śaktiḥ iti paropakāri paratantraṃ sarvaṃ śaktilakṣaṇamanupatati || 12 ||
sā ca svakāryaparatantrāvasthā sādhanādinā siddhasvabhāvārthābhidhāyinā śabdena nābhidhātuṃ śakyate , api tu yathāyathaṃ vibhak‌tyādirasyāḥ pratyāyane samartha ityāha-- svaśabdairabhidhāne tu sa dharmo nābhidhīyate | vibhak‌tyādibhirevāsāvupakāraḥ pratīyate || 13 ||
 sa dharmaḥ, kriyāṃ prati śeṣabhāvaḥ | kārakaṃ sādhanamapādānamityādiśabdaiḥ kriyopakāropalakṣitaṃ dravyamabhidhīyate prādhānyena, na tu kriyopakāralakṣaṇaḥ sādhanabhāvaḥ samudbhūto'smāt pratīyate | tathā hi-atrāpi dravyarūpatayā sādhanamāmukhīkaroti | kriyopakāralakṣaṇo dharmo dvitīyāṃ pratipādyata iti parigṛhītakriyopakāraṃ dvitīyādivibhaktipratipādyaṃ vastviti śaktirvibhaktivācyā | kvacittaddhitavācyā | śatena krītaḥ śatyaḥ śatika iti kraye sādhakatamatvaṃ pratyayavācyam | `yatra' `tatra' ityādhārabhāvastral‌vācyaḥ | payaḥ payo jarayati, madhu nirīkṣate, dadhi samaśnāti iti prātipadikādeva śaktiḥ pratīyate | antarā tvāṃ ca māṃ ca kamaṇḍaluparityantarāśabdo'vyayo'dhikaraṇamāhetyādigrahaṇam || 13 ||
kaḥ punarasāvupakāralakṣaṇo dharmaḥ sādhanamityāha--- nimittabhāvo bhāvānāmupakārārthamāśritaḥ | natirāvarjanetyevaṃ siddhaḥ sādhanamiṣyate || 14 ||
 sādhyasvābhāvāyāṃ kriyāyāmupakārāya siddhasvabhāvānāṃ bhāvānāṃ nimittabhāvo hetubhāvaḥ | natiḥ namanamupakārābhimukhyam, `āvarjanam' aṅgabhāvena svātmapratyarpaṇam, kriyāopajananatātparyyam | iti śabdaḥ prakāre | ityevamādibhiḥ śabdairabhidhīyamāno'nyo'pi siddhaḥ niṣpannatayā pratīyamānaḥ, evaṃ bhūtena vā dharmeṇa niścitaḥ, na vastu saṃbhavamātreṇa sādhanamityucyate || 14 ||
evaṃ mīmāṃsakavaiśeṣikadarśanena śaktiḥ sādhanamityupapādya svadarśane vyatirekāvyatirekagrahaṃ tyajati | sa tebhyo vyatirikto vā teṣāmātmaiva vā tathā | vyatirekamupāśritya sādhanatvena kalpyate || 15 ||
 `saḥ' iti hetubhāvaḥ śaktyaparaparyāyaḥ | "śaktayaḥ sarvabhāvānāṃ kāryārthāpattigocarāḥ" ityatīndriyāḥ padārthād vyatiriktāḥ śaktayaḥ keṣāṃcid bhavantu | sahakārisamavadhānopakṛto bhāvaḥ svarūpeṇaiva kāryajanakaḥ kimadṛṣṭaśaktiparikalpanenetyātmaiva bhāvānāṃ śaktiḥ | saṃsargiṇaḥ sahakāriṇo vārthāntarabhūtāḥ | svakāraṇaparaṃparayā hi padārthaḥ samupajāto viśiṣṭo yastattatsahakārisaṃparke tattatkāryajanane śakta iti kimadṛṣṭayā vyatiriktyā śak‌tyā | tatkalpane tasyā niyamaheturbhāvasvabhāva eva vak‌tavya iti varaṃ sa evāstu | tadatrāvyatirekavādo vāstu vyatiriktā vā śaktayaḥ santu | nāsmākamatra kaścid graho vyatirekāvyatirekavāde | śabdapramāṇakā hi vayam, yacchabda āha tadasmākaṃ pramāṇam | śabdaśca padārtānāṃ vyatiriktameva sādhanabhāvaṃ pratyāyayati ghaṭasya dṛśikriyāyāṃ karmabhāva ityādāviti vyatirekopāśrayaḥ śabdanibandhano vyavahāraḥ | tathā ca prātipadikena dravye'bhihite śaktau kṛtabandhā śaktiḥ pravartate || 15 ||
"yad yadā yadanugrāhi tattadā tatra sādhanam" iti vyāptimuktāṃ kriyāyā api sādhanatvena bhāṣyakārābhimatena saṃvādayitumāha-- saṃdarśanaṃ prārthanāyāṃ vyavasāye tvanantarā | vyavasāyastathāraṃbhe sādhanatvāya kalpate || 16 ||
pūrvasmin yā kriyā saiva parasmin sādhanaṃ matā | sandarśane tu caitanyaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ sādhanaṃ viduḥ || 17 ||
 saṃpradānasaṃjñāyām "kriyāgrahaṇamapi kartavyam"  ityukte iha kaścit kaṃcidarthaṃ sampaśyati, sa dṛṣṭvā prārthanayā vyavasāyaṃ karoti, adhyavasāye prāraṃbhaḥ, prāraṃbhe phalaprāptiriti sandarśanādibhirāpyamānatvāt "kriyāpi kṛtrimaṃ karma" iti bhāṣya uktam | tatra sādhyasvabhāvāyā api sandarśanādibhirāpyamānatvāt "kriyāpi kṛtrimaṃ karma" iti bhāṣya uktam | tatra sādhyasvabhāvāyā api sandarśanādikriyāyāḥ sādhanatvamāpekṣikam | samyak samantādvā darśanaṃ sandarśanaṃ phalaviṣayaḥ saṃkalpaḥ | tat prārthanāyāṃ phalopāyaviṣaye'bhilāṣe, sādhanatvāya kalpate, sādhanaṃ bhavati | arthadarśane hi satyabhilāṣotpattiḥ | vyavasāyo dṛḍhagrāhitā, kriyāviśeṣasya ulasādhanatvena niścayaḥ | tatra `anantarā' prārthanā sādhanam, abhilāṣe sati niścayakaraṇāt | vyavasāyaścāṃrabhakriyāyāṃ mānasyāṃ pravṛttau sādhanam, vyavasāyabalenārthakriyākaraṇāṃrabhāt | tayā ca kriyayā''pyamānatvād bhautikī kriyā karma bhavati saṃkṣepataḥ | pūrvasmin pūrvasmin vyāpāre'pekṣite yā kriyā kartavyatvāt saiva pūrvasmānnivṛttā pūrvakālabhāvinī kriyā parasmin uttarottarabhāvini sādhye sādhanaṃ bhavati | tadātmalābhe siddhatvenopayogāt | tadayamarthaḥ | pūrvasmin sandarśane yā kriyā prārthanādikā saivottarāṃ prati sādhanaṃ matā | atha sandarśanakriyāyāḥ kiṃ sādhanamityāha--- "sandarśane tu caitanyam" iti | `tuḥ' viśeṣadyotakaḥ | cidgūpa ātmā yo bhuṅkte bhāvān | viśeṣo'sya phalamilāṣayogyatā | yadyapi ca kriyā sādhyasvabhāvā'niṣpannā tathāpi niṣṭhāvasthāyāṃ siddhatvāt, sādhanaśabdena ca śaktestatrāsamavāye'pi vyatirekeṇāśrayād yuktaḥ sādhanabhāvaḥ | kriyāyāṃ ca kriyāntarasyāsamavetatvāt saiva kriyāntarabhāvane kartuḥ karaṇam | ayamatra paramārthaḥ | yadapekṣayā yat siddhaṃ tattasya sādhanaṃ niṣpādakaṃ kārakaṃ bhavati | tadānīṃ hi kartuḥ kriyāniṣpattau karaṇāntaraṃ nāsti | bhāvī cāṃśo bhūtenāṃsenāpyamānatvāt karma bhavati | kartā hi kriyayā yadīpsati tatkarma | atra ca kriyāṃśa evepsyate'pareṇa siddhena kriyāṃśenetyāraṃbheṇa mānasavyāpāreṇāpyamānatvād bhautikī kriyā karmeti tenābhipreyamāṇasya saṃpradānatvaṃ siddham, `yuddhāya sannahyate', `śrāddhāya nigahlate' iti | gatyarthadhātuviṣaye saṃdarśanādīnāṃ bhedābhedavivakṣā, pacyādāvabhedavivakṣaiva, śrāddhāya nigahlata ityādau bhedavivakṣaiveti ca vakṣyate | tadevaṃ `vyatirekamupāśritya sādhanatvena kalpata' iti kriyāyā api sādhyasādhanabhāvo vyatirekāśrayeṇopakāryopakārakabhāvena bhāṣyokta udāhṛta iti sthitametat śaktivyatiriktā kriyopakārārthamāśritā sādhanamiti sāmānyenocyata iti || 16,17 ||
vārttike kārakamiti saṃjñā sādhanamiti saṃjñinirdeśena kartavyā | anvarthasaṃjñāvijñānādvā sādhakasya lābha iti | "anvarthamiticedakartari kartṛśabdānupapattiḥ"  ityuktam | tatrākartari karaṇādau kartṛśabdasya kārakamityasyopapattiṃ samarthayitumāha-- niṣpattimātre kartṛtvaṃ sarvatraivāsti kārake | vyāpārabhedāpekṣāyāṃ karaṇāditvasaṃbhavaḥ || 18 ||
 sāmagrīsādhyatvāt kriyāṇāṃ sarve kārakatvaṃ kriyāniṣpattiviṣayabhedena pratipadyante iti | yadā tu kaḥ kathaṃ pacatīti vivakṣā tadā pradhānakriyāniṣpādane vicitravyāpārāṇi kārakāṇi yathāsvaṃ vyāpārātiśayavaśena karaṇādisaṃjñāḥ pratilabhante | tathā hi sādhanāntaraviniyogavyāpāraḥ kartā | nirvṛttivikāraprāptyāhitasaṃskāraṃ kartuḥ kriyeyapsitatamaṃ karma | jvalanādyanubhavat kārakāntaravyāpārairavyavahitavyāpāraṃ karaṇam | preraṇānumananānirākaraṇavyāpāraṃ karmaṇā saṃbandhayamānaṃ saṃpradānam | apāyamavadhibhāvopagamanena sādhayadapādānam | rtṛkarmavyavahitakriyādhārakamadhikaraṇam | svatantraṃ preṣayaddheturiti | sāmānyapūrvakatvācca viśeṣasyāvāntaravyāpāre'pi kārakatvamanuvṛttimiti karaṇaṃ kārakamiti sāmānādikaraṇyopapattiḥ | akārakasya ca viśeṣasaṃjñābhāvaḥ, vṛkṣasya parṇaṃ patatīti | anapekṣite ca kartṛvyāpāre sthālī pacati, edhāḥ pacanti, asiśchinatti iti pradhānakriyāyāmevaiṣāṃ kartṛtvam | saṃpradānāpādānayoḥ svavyāpāre svātantryavivakṣā nāsti | dvitīyasyādāturapagantuścāpekṣaṇāt | ata eva "siddhaṃ tu pratikārakaṃ kriyābhedāt..." iti pradhānakriyārtheṣu yathāsvaṃ kārakavyāpāreṣu pacādīnāmeva vṛttirvarṇitā | tadetadbhāṣya uktam--- "sāmānyabhūtā kriyā vartate, tasyā nirvartakaṃ kārakam"  iti || 18 ||
atraiva dṛṣṭāntamāha--- putrasya janmani yathā pitroḥ kartṛtvamucyate | ayamasyāmiyaṃ tvasmāditi bhedo vivakṣayā || 19 ||
 pitarau putraṃ janayata ityavivakṣite jananavyāpārabhede janikriyā kartṛtvamubhayoḥ prasiddham | kaḥ kathaṃ janayatīti bhedavivakṣāyāmayaṃ pitā bījamādadhadasyāṃ mātari garbhamādhatte | iyaṃ tu mātā'smāt pituḥ patad bījaṃ dhārayantī janikriyākartṛtvamanubhavatītyadhikaraṇatvaṃ mātuḥ | kartṛtvamapādānatvaṃ ca pituḥ, kartṛtvaṃ māturiti bhidyate pravṛttiḥ | sāmānyapūrvakatvācca viśeṣasya jani sāmānyenātmalābhavacano viśeṣaviṣaye preṣaṇaviṣayabījadhāraṇabījacyutivacanaḥ | yadvā prakṛtyarto'viśiṣṭaḥ, pratyayārthastu ṇijartho janayatīti preṣaṇādiḥ yatrāyaṃ vibhāgaḥ | sādhayapakṣanikṣiptamapīdaṃ prasiddhatvānnidarśanam || 19 ||
tadevaṃ pradhānakriyāyāmeva sāmānyaviśeṣabhāvena kārakaṃ karaṇamityādisāmānādhikaraṇyamupapāditam | idānīṃ guṇakriyāpekṣayā svātantryaṃ pradhānakriyāpekṣayāsvātantrye satyapyanapagatamiti prakārāntareṇa `sāmānyabhūtā kriyā vartate' ityetadbhāṣyaṃ gamayitumāha--- guṇakriyāṇāṃ kartāraḥ kartrā nyakkṛtaśaktayaḥ | nyaktāyāmapi sampūrṇaiḥ svairvyāpāraiḥ samanvitāḥ || 20 ||
karaṇatvādibhirjñātāḥ kriyābhedānupātibhiḥ | svātantryamuttaraṃ labdhvā pradhāne yānti kartṛtām || 21 ||
 jvalādyavāntaravyāpārarūpāṇāṃ guṇakriyāṇāṃ svātantryāt sarve kartāraḥ, pradhānakriyāviṣaye tu kartrā svatantreṇa viniyoktrā nyakkṛtā śaktiḥ svātantryameṣāmiti tena yathāyathaṃ nyagbhāvamasvātantryamāpāditāḥ santaḥ nyaktāyāṃ nyagbhāve'pi svavyāpāre svātantryānapagamāt akiṃcitkarasya kriyāsiddhau hetubhāvānupapatteḥ yathāsvaṃ svavyāpārānuṣṭhāne pradhānakriyāṅgabhāvagamanāt kartṛviniyāge'pi yathāyathamātmīyaiḥ sarvaireva jvalanādivanyāpārairaviyuktāḥ tatkriyāviśeṣaviṣayaiḥ karaṇādisaṃjñārūpairadhigatāḥ tadrūpamatyajanta iva viniyogottarakālamapi svavyāpārānuṣṭhānalakṣaṇaṃ svādhīnatvāmāsādya svasmin kriyābhede svatantrāḥ pradhānakriyāyāmeva kartṛtāṃ kārakatvaṃ bhajanta iti karaṇaṃ kārakamityādyupapattirityarthaḥ | karaṇādīni hi kartṛpraiṣe nyagbhūtāni svavyāpāramanutiṣṭhanti tathā bhavantīti kartrā svavyāpāre kartṛtvārthamevaiṣāṃ niyogāt, niyuktānāṃ satāṃ svavyāpāre svātantryamanubhavatāṃ karayaṇāditve pradhānakriyāniṣpattirityavirodhaḥ svātantryapāratantryayoḥ | yadeva hi svavyāpāre svātantryaṃ tadeva pradhānakriyāyāṃ pāratantryaṃ nānyat kiṃcit | tacca kratṛviniyoge satyuttarakālameva bhavati | pūrvantu kartṛviniyogādyogyatāmātreṇa svātantryamucyate | itthaṃ ca karaṇaṃ kārakamiti viṣayabhedo'pi nāsti| svavyāpāre, svātantryasyaiva pradhānakriyāyāṃ karaṇāditvāt | tadetataduktam | "siddhaṃ tu pratikārakaṃ kriyābhedāt pacādīnāṃ karaṇīdhikaraṇayoḥ kartṛbhāvaḥ"  iti | tatra `adhiśrayaṇodakāsecana...' ityādinā kartṛkaraṇādhikaraṇānāṃ guṇakriyāmuk‌tvā `apādānādīnāṃ tvaprasiddhiḥ' iti punaścodite "na vā svatantraparatantratvāttayoḥ paryāyeṇa vacanaṃ nacanāśrayā ca saṃjñā" iti punaḥ siddhāntitam | tathā hi valāhako vidyotate iti vidyudabhedāvivakṣāyāṃ prayogāt svavyāpāre'styevāpādānasya svātantryam ityāhuḥ | grāma āgacchatīti tūkte'rthāntarāvagamādapādānavyāpārānavasāyāt prayogābhāvaḥ | asti tu grāmasyāpādānasya kriyāsiddhau kaścid vyāpāro'vadhibhāvāpattilakṣaṇaḥ | anyathā grāmasya samīpādāgacchatītivat grāmādāgacchatītyatrāpi grāmasyākārakatvaṃ syāt | saṃpradānasyāpi anirākaraṇāt kartuḥ, preraṇānumatibhyāṃ ca tattvamityastyeva svavyāpāraḥ | brāhmaṇo dadātīti tu prayogābhāvaḥ, saṃpradānatve brāhmaṇasyāsmādvivakṣitārthānavasāyāt | ata evāpādānasaṃpradānavyāpāre dhātorna vṛttiḥ, api tu karmakaraṇādivyāpāra eva, pacyate odanaḥ svayameva, asiśchinatti, sthālī pacatītyādau | tadevaṃ sarvatra kriyābhedasaṃbhava iti tatra svātantryāt karaṇāditve'pi kartṛśabdaḥ pravartate | yadyevaṃ karaṇāditve'pi svātantryāt kartṛsaṃjñā syāt | naitadasti | kārakādhikārāllabdhe svātantrye svatantraḥ karteti punaḥ śrutiḥ pāratantryānācchuritasvātantryapratipattyartheti mukhya eva svatantre kratṛsaṃjñāvatiṣṭhate | evamapi paratvāt karaṇādīnāṃ karaṇādisaṃjñāṃ bādhitvā kartṛsaṃjñā prāpnoti | naiṣa doṣaḥ | karaṇādisaṃjñānāmanavakāśatvāt tābhiḥ kartṛsaṃjñāyāṃ atra bādhanāt | kārakavyapadeśastavanuvṛttisāmarthyādbhavati | atha vā svātantryanimittā kārakasaṃjñeti nātra bādyabādhakabhāvo nimittanimittinoḥ | atra hi svātantryanimittaṃ pāratantryamiti karaṇādibhāve'pyanumitaṃ svātantryaṃ niviśata eva kārakasaṃjñātyapādānādisaṃjñābhiḥ samāveśa evāsyāḥ | yatra tu pāratantryavivakṣānāntarīyikā svātantryavivakṣā tatra karaṇaṃ parāṇi bādhanta ityucyate | tadyathā dhanuṣā vidhyatīti | tatra hi dhanuṣaḥ sādhakatamatvāvinābhāvinī svātantryavivakṣā | svatantraḥ kartetyatra ca naivamavadhāryate yat sarvāsvavasthāsu svatantramiti, api tu yat svatantrameveti sthālī pacatītyādāvapi kartṛsaṃjñāsiddhiḥ | adhikārasāmarthyācca karaṇādyavasthāyāmapyanumitasvātantryahetukakārakaśabdapravṛttiraviruddheti sarvaṃ sustham | tadevaṃ pūrvaṃ kriyāyā abhedamāśritya niṣpattimātre kartṛtvamiti sāmānyabhūtā kriyā niṣpattimātrasvabhāvā vyākhyātā | idānīṃ tu guṇapradhānabhāvena kriyābhedamapyāśrityākartari kartṛśabdupapāditaḥ | tatra ca sāmānyabhūtā sādhyatvena sarveṣāṃ sādhāraṇatvaṃ prāptā pradhānakriyā vartata iti bhāṣyārthaḥ || 20,21 ||
svavyāpāre svatantrāṇāmeva pradhānavyāpāre pāratantrye dṛṣṭāntamāha--- yathā rājñā niyukteṣu yoddhṛtvaṃ yoddhṛṣu sthitam | teṣu vṛttau tu labhate rājā jayaparājayau || 22 ||
tathā kartrā niyukteṣu sarveṣvekārthakāriṣu | kartṛtvaṃ karaṇāditvairuttaraṃ na virudhyate || 23 ||
 yathā rājñā svāminā niyukteṣu preṣiteṣu yoddhṛtvaṃ vyūhavibhāgādinā yoddhṛṣu sthitam | teṣu yudhyamāneṣu ca yā vṛttiḥ śatrumahgadeśotsādanādikā tasyāṃ kṛtāyāṃ rājā jayaṃ parājayaṃ vā'pi paryāyeṇa labhate | etadāha | yoddhāro yoddhṛtve kartāraḥ | pūrvaṃ tadvyāpārasya tatrasthatvāt | punā rājaniyogādasvatantrāḥ | punaśca tanniyoge nirapekṣāḥ svatantrāḥ | evaṃ kartrā niyukteṣu saṃbhūyārthaṃ pākādikaṃ kurvatsu bhṛtyeṣviva karaṇādiṣu yat svātantryaṃ jāyate niyogāduttarakālabhavaṃ tatkaraṇatvādibhirniyogakālabhāvibhirna virudhyate ityarthaḥ | tadevaṃ `kāraka iti saṃjñānirdeśaścet saṃjñino'pi nirdeśaḥ | itarathā hyaniṣṭaprasaṅgo grāmasya samīpādāgacchatītyakārakasya'  ityādinā sādhakaṃ nirvartakaṃ vā saṃjñi nirdeṣṭavyamiti codite, anvarthasaṃjñāvijñānādviśiṣṭasaṃjñisiddhyā parihṛte, adhikāreṇottaratrānuvṛtteḥ kārakasaṃjñāyāḥ karaṇādiṣvanupapatterudbhāvitāyāṃ niṣpattimātrāpekṣyā kartṛtvāśrayaṇena pratikārakaṃ kriyābhedena guṇakriyāyāṃ svātantryāśrayaṇena ca parihṛtamiti prakaraṇārthaḥ || 22,23 ||
anvarthasaṃjñāśrayeṇa kriyānirvartakasya sādhakatve'bhihiteheturapi kriyānirvarta iti karaṇa ityeva siddhāyāṃ tṛtīyasyāṃ kimarthaṃ hetāviti punarvidhinamityāśaṅkyā hetoḥ sādhanādvayatirekaṃ darśayati | anāśrite tu vyāpāre nimittaṃ heturiṣyate | āśritāvadhibhāvaṃ tu lakṣaṇe lakṣaṇaṃ viduḥ || 24 ||
 vyāpāramanāśritya vivakṣitārthasiddhau yogyatāmātreṇa nimittatvenāśriyate yaḥ sa hetuḥ | sa cākārakavibhakteḥ śeṣalakṣaṇāyā viṣayaḥ tṛtīyasyāḥ saṃbandhaṣaṣṭhībādhikāyāḥ | tadyathā adhyayanena vasatīti | adhyayanaṃ hetuḥ, vāso hetumān | tayoḥ saṃbandhe śeṣaṣaṣṭhyāṃ prāptāyāṃ hetau tṛtīyā | naiyāyikāstvācakṣate, guṇadravyayoryannimittaṃ sa hetuḥ | sa cākārakavibhakterviṣayaḥ | yattu kriyāpadopāttāyāḥ kriyāyā nimittaṃ tatkārakameva | yathā `vidyayā vasati' ityādāviti `anarlakṣaṇe'  ityatra hetorapi lakṣamaśabdenākhyānādaviśeṣamanayoḥ saṃbhāvyāpākarotyāśritetyādinā | lakṣaṇe ityatra lakṣaṇaśabdo bhāvasādhanaḥ | `lakṣaṇaṃ viduḥ' ityatra tu karaṇasādhanaḥ | lakṣaṇe lakṣyamāṇavastuprakāśane | yad `āśritāvadhibhāvam,' āśrito'vadhibhāvo maryādārūpaṃ yatra tallakṣyate'neneti lakṣaṇaṃ jñāpakaṃ viduḥ jānanti tajjñāḥ | yatrāvadhibhāvaḥ prajñāyate hetāvapi tallakṣaṇam | ata eva tuḥ' viśeṣāvadyotakaḥ | anye tvāhuḥ | kāryotpattāvupayogo hetoḥ, pratyayotvattau tu lakṣamasyeti | tadasat | hetorapi pratyayotpattau vyāpāradarśanādvidyāderapi hi vāsādiniśraye vyāpārāllakṣyamāṇavastūpajane yogyatāmanādṛtyāvadhitvenāśrito janako bhavati mā vā bhūditi lakṣaṇam | tadyathā vṛkṣamanu vidyotate vidyuditi vṛkṣo lakṣaṇaṃ vidyotanasya | vṛkṣaṃ prāpya vidyotata ityarthaḥ | kathaṃ tarhyanurlakṣaṇa ityatra śākalyasya saṃhitāmanu prāvarṣad ityudāharaṇam | yāvatā saṃhitā nāvadhimātreṇa varṣaṇasya paricchedikā pratīyate , api tu janakatvena | janakaśca hetuḥ, na lakṣaṇamiti heturevātra jñāpakatvasāmānyāllakṣamaśabdenokta ityavirodhaḥ | nanu ca dhūmo'gninā prasiddhasāhacaryo'sakṛddarśanāvadhṛtaḥ kevalo'pyadṛśyamānamagniṃ kāraṇāntaraprabhavaṃ lakṣayatītyevaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ syāt | saṃhitā tu prathamameva dṛśyamānā, na tasyā asakṛdṛrśanaṃ darśanāvṛttirastīti kathamasau lakṣaṇaṃ syāt | atrocyate | yadyapyetadasti loke yenāsakṛllakṣyate tallakṣaṇamiti tathāpi pratītā kāryodaye śaktiryasya kāraṇasya tathāvidhamapi kāraṇaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ bhavati | kāryasya hi yaḥ paricchedaḥ tatra hetubhāvena kāraṇamapi lakṣaṇam, kāryaparicchedakatvāt | yathaiva hi bhūyodarśanena gṛhītāvinābhāvo'nyaṃ gamayati tathā heturapi parānapekṣo janayan kāryasyāvyabhicārāt paricchedakatvena bhavati lakṣaṇam | yathā meghodayo vṛṣṭeḥ kāraṇatvena niścito'satyāmapi vṛṣṭau tatparicchedaka iti lakṣaṇaṃ bhavati yalloko meghodayaṃ dṛṣṭvā vṛṣṭimanuminoti | nanvanvayavyatirekabalāddhetutvaṃ niścīyate | yasmin sati yadbhavati anyasmiṃstu satyapi vinā tena na bhavati sa tasya hetuḥ | anvayavyatirekau cāsakṛdṛrśanādbhavataḥ | sakṛddarśane'nvayavyatirekayoraniścayāt | saṃhitā ca yadyapi kāraṇaṃ pravarṣaṇasya tathāpi sakṛtpravṛtterna niścīyate tatra kāraṇatvam, tatkālasannihitārthāntarādapi kadācit kāryotpatteḥ saṃbhāvanāt | evaṃ ca meghodayavanna lakṣaṇamasau yujyate | atra brūmaḥ sakṛddarśanādapi hetubhāvo'vagamyate | yasya hi yajjanakaṃ na bhavati tasmāt sakṛdapi tanna dṛśyate, yathā śālyaṅkuro yavāt | na ca tatkālabhavo'nyo janako'nyadā tasmādadṛṣṭeḥ | tathā cāhuḥ yasmin sati bhavatyeva yattato'nyasya kalpane | taddhetutvena sarvatra hetūnāmanavasthitiḥ || iti | na ca kākatālīyanyāyena tata utpattiḥ, atat‌svabhāvasya satṛdapyajananāt | saṃhitā ca pratyakṣeṇa dṛśyate varṣaṃ janayantīti sakṛddarśanādapi hetubhāvo'tra niścīyate | kiṃ cāgamādapi hetutvamatra niścitaṃ saṃhitāyāḥ pravarṣaṇa iti heturevātra jñāpakatvasāmānyāllakṣamamityuktam | taduktaṃ bhāṣye `lakṣaṇena heturapi vyāptaḥ' iti | lakṣamasya vyāpakatvāt | kāraṇamapi hi kāryaṃ lakṣayallakṣaṇaṃ bhavati, yathā meghodayo vṛṣṭeḥ | na ca vyabhicāraḥ | samagrasyāvikalasya janakatvāt | tathā vivecane cāvyabhicārāt | prāpaṇaśaktiśca prāmāṇyaṃ na prāpaṇameveti nyāyaḥ | yadi tarhi lakṣaṇaśabdena padārthāntaraparicchedahetubhāvo varṇyate tadāśritāvadhibhāvetyetat katham | āśritāvadhibhāve'pi lakṣaṇe paricchedahatutvameva lakṣaṇamanyathā kathamalakṣayallakṣaṇaṃ syāt | iyāṃstu viśeṣaḥ, yad vṛkṣo'vadhibhāvena paricchedahetuḥ, saṃhitādestvavadhitvānāśraye'pi jñāpakatvasāmānyāllakṣaṇatvam | bahudhā hi lakṣaṇaṃ bhavati | kvacidavadhibhāvena yathā vidyotamānāyāstaḍito vanaspatiravasāyanibandhanam | kvacit kāraṇāvacchedena yathā dhūmo vanheḥ | kvacit kāryaparicchedahetutayā yathā meghodayo vṛṣṭeḥ | saṃhitāpi coktena prakāreṇa lakṣaṇaṃ hetuśceti | yadyevaṃ `lakṣaṇetthaṃbhūtākhyāna....' ityādinā sāmānyalakṣaṇenaiva siddhāyāṃ karmapravacanīyasaṃjñāyāṃ `anurlakṣaṇe'  iti punarvidhānamanarthakam | taduktam | `anurlakṣaṇevacanānarthakyaṃ sāmānyakṛtatvāt' iti | atrottaram--- `hetvarthaṃ tu vacanam'  ityuktam | nāyamabhidheyaparyāyo'rthaśabdaḥ, kiṃ tu nivṛttivacanaḥ | kārye ca kāraṇa śabdamupacarya hetuśabdena hetutṛtīyoktā | bādho'pi bādhyānnānyeti `heturevārtho nivartyo yasye'ti samāsaḥ | tena hetusaṃjñābādhanārthaṃ punaḥ saṃjñāvidhānamityuktaṃ bhavati | nanu ca punaḥ saṃjñāvidhānāt pradeśeṣu saṃjñipratyayaḥ sthirataro bhavet | tṛtīyā tu kathaṃ bādhyeta | paratvena hi bādhikāsau | naitat | asakṛdvidhīyamānā saṃjñā `karmapravacanīyayukte dvitīyā' ityādipradeśeṣu dvirupatiṣṭhate | tatraikabhupasthānaṃ dvitīyārtham | yattu dvitīyamupasthānamanurlakṣaṇa iti tadanarthakaṃ mā bhūditi hetutṛtīyaṃ bādhitvā dvitīyameva sthirayati | nanu dvirupasthānāt saṃjñipratyayo dvirbhavet, na tu dvitīyāvidhiḥ pracayamanubhavati | kāryārthā saṃjñā guṇabhūtā | kāryaṃ dvitīyākhyaṃ pradhānam | na ca guṇabhede pradhānabhedaḥ | kimartha tarhi guṇo dviruktaḥ | nirarthako bhavatu, na tviyatā pradānamāvartate | yadyapi ca pradhānamātmasaṃskārārthaṃ guṇadeśaṃ gacchati yathoddeśe saṃjñāparibhāṣe tathāpi sākāṃkṣasya gumadeśagamanādekenaiva gumena nairākāṃkṣyādaparaguṇadeśaṃ kimarthaṃ vrajediti ekaiva dvitīyā | tāṃ paratvāttṛtīyā bādheta | nanu ca pradhānamantareṇa guṇānāṃ svarūpahānaprasaṅgāt guṇāntaramakṛtārthaṃ pradhānāntaramāvirbhāvayet | yathā amātyā rājābhāve svātmano guṇarūpamīhamānā rājāntaraṃ syāpayanti | tat‌sthāpane teṣāmātmarūpaṃ saṃpadyate | rājānamantareṇāmātyāderabhāvāt | naitat samānam, rājāmātyayoḥ parasparamupakāryopakārakabhāvāt | guṇapradhānabhāvaniyamasyaivāniścayāt | tathā hi rājā prakṛtīrdharmaśāstroktayāṃ maryādāyāṃ sthāpayati | svayaṃ cānuvartate | tāḥ prakṛtayo'pi rājānaṃ vinayantīti pradhānabhedādeva tatra guṇabhedaḥ | evaṃ tarhi upāyavidhirevopeyavidhirbhavati | tadyathā `anīkastho bhava' ityukte'nīkasthatā hastināmannayavasarakṣāsaṃpādanamiti anīkasthatāvidhānadvāreṇa tadeva kāryaṃ vihitaṃ bhavati | evaṃ karmapravacanīyasaṃjñāvidhānadvāreṇa tatkāryaṃ dvitīyākhyameva vihitaṃ bhavati | tathā ca punardvitīyā vidhīyamānā bādhakabādhanārthā jāyate, yena nāprāptinyāyena | saṃbandhe hi ṣaṣṭhī prāptā, tasyā bādhikā | atra vacanasāmarthyaṃ nibandhanam | anyathā punaḥ saṃjñāvidhānameva dvitīyāvidhānārthaṃ kathamupapadyate | itthaṃ ca kṛtvā kalpanāntaramapyupapadyate | guṇabhedena pradhānabheda iti vacanena nyāyasya bādhanāt | tathā ca bhāṣyam--- `dṛṣṭāntasyāpi puruṣāraṃbho nivartako bhavati 'iti | yadvā saṃjñābhedādanuśabdaḥ saṃjñī bhidyate | na tu dvitīyāvidhiḥ pradhānabhūtaḥ, yena nyāyyo guṇabhedāt pradhānabhedo bhavet | saṃjñibhedācca labdhabalātiśayo dvitīyāvidhistṛtīyāvidhiṃ bādhate | yathoddeśapakṣe ca guṇadeśaṃ gacchat pradhānamekena guṇena kṛtārthaṃ na bhavati | tatprakaraṇagatena sarveṇārthitvāt, saṃbandhasyāviśeṣāt | ata eva pradhānāntaraṃ guṇo'kṛtārthaḥ kalpayatu rājāntaraṃ yathā prakṛtayaḥ | na ca vaisādṛśyaṃ prakṛtīnāṃ rājakṛtopakārāpekṣitve'pi sarvathā guṇatvāt tadaṅgabhāvaparipoṣārthameva hi tatkṛtopakārāpekṣaṇam' na tu svapradhānyārtham | kāryakālapakṣe'pi kāryavākye saṃjñādvayaṃ bhedenaiva saṃjñidvayamupapasthāpayati | tasmāt punaḥ saṃjñāvidhānalakṣaṇādvacanasāmarthyāt prāptātiśayaḥ kakṣyāntaraprāpto dvitīyāvidhiḥ paramapi tṛtīyāvidhimapasārayatītyeva yuktam | tathā ca vakṣyati | hetuhetumatoryogaparicchede'nunā kṛte | āraṃbhād bādhyate prāptā tṛtīyā hetulakṣaṇā || iti | taditthamanurlakṣaṇa ityatra hetureva lakṣaṇavyāpakatvaṃ kathayituṃ lakṣamatayopāttaḥ satyapyavāntarabhede'nayoḥ | tathā hi `lakṣaṇahetvoḥ kriyāyāḥ'  ityatra lakṣaṇādbhedena janakatvavivakṣayā heturupāttaḥ | tadevaṃ nimittasāmānyaṃ tridhā vibhaktam | svarūpabhedena kriyānirvartakaṃ kārakam, sāmānyena janako hetuḥ, jñāpake lakṣaṇamiti || 14 ||
janakatvasāmye'pi hetusādhanayorviṣayabhedāt bhedamāha--- dravyādiviṣayo hetuḥ kārakaṃ niyatakriyam |  dravyaguṇakriyāsādhanasamarthaṃ vastu dravyādīnāṃ hetuḥ | tadyathā bījenāṅkuraḥ, dhanena kulam, kanyayā śokaḥ, vidyayā yaśaḥ, śilpābhyāsena naipuṇyam, agninā pākaḥ | kriyāsādhanasamarthamapyanāśritavyāpāraṃ hetureveti pākādayo yadyapi kriyāḥ tathāpyatroparatavyāpārāṇāṃ sannidhinātropakāritayā tejaḥprabhṛtīnāṃ vivakṣitatvādavidyamānakaraṇabhāvāste hetutṛtīyayā saṃbadhyante | dhanena saha saṃpattikriyāprabhāvitaḥ kulasya saṃbandhaḥ | kulasya hi dhanena prasiddhirupajanyate | tatra coparatavyāpāraṃ dhanaṃ yogyatāmātrātkulasya heturiti śeṣaṣaṣṭhībādhikayā hetutṛtīyayā saṃyujyate kanyāpi janayituḥ śokasya jananakriyādvāreṇa | vidyāpi yaśasvinā prāpyamāṇaiva yaśaso heturiti prāptikiyājanito'tra śeṣasaṃbandhaḥ | evamanyatrāpi yathāyogamabhyūhyam | śilpābhyāsena naipuṇyamadhyayanena vasatīti guṇakriyāviṣayatā hetoḥ | kriyāsādhananiyataṃ tu kārakam | tatra hi kriyaiva viṣayabhūtā niyatā, vyāpārāviṣṭatvaṃ ca svarūpabhedaḥ | kasyacittu vyāpāraviṣṭasyāpi kriyāviṣayasya śāstrīyaṃ hetutvamuktamityāha | kartā kartrantarāpekṣaḥ kriyāyāṃ heturiṣyate || 25 ||
kartā prayojakaḥ prayojyakartṛśaktivyavadhānena kriyāyamupayujyamānaḥ prayojyakartāraṃ preṣayan tatprayojako hetuḥ iti śāstre hetutveneṣyate | vacanāt kārakaviśeṣo'pi na tvayaṃ rūḍho heturityarthaḥ || 25 ||
idānīṃ kriyāviṣayatve samāne'pi hetukāraṇayorviśeṣamāha | kriyāyai karaṇantasya dṛṣṭaḥ pratinidhistathā | hetvarthā tu kriyā tasmānna sa pratinidhīyate || 26 ||
 kriyāsādhanāya prakṛṣṭopakārakaṃ karaṇamapradhānam, kriyā tu sādhya svabhāvā pradhānam | ata eva pradhānānurodhitvād guṇānāmasati śrute karaṇe śiṣṭaiḥ pratinidhirācaritaḥ | pradhānabhūtā hi kriyā sādhyatvāt yogyasādhanākṣepasamartheti sādhanasāmānyasyākṣepe'dhyāvāpārthaṃ śrutaḥ sādhanaviniyoga iti tadasaṃbhave'pi pradhānena kriyāsvarūpeṇa yadākṣiptaṃ sādhanasāmānyaṃ tadviśeṣāntareṇāpi paripoṣyamāṇaṃ na śrautārthatyāgāya prabhavati | sāmānyasyāpi śrutatvāt tasya ca sarvaviśeṣasvīkārayogyatvāditi pratinidhyupapattiḥ pūrvameva carcitā vistarataḥ | aṅgabhreṣe'pi pradhānānucchedāt pradānakriyāsvarūpasaṃrakṣaṇāya śiṣṭaiḥ saṃpradāyapāraṃparyāvagataṃ sadṛśamaṅgaṃ mukhyabuddhyaivopādīyata iti kriyāyāḥ prādhānyasyaitat phalam | ata eva kecit karaṇaśabdo'tra sarvakārakavacano jātau caikavacanamiti sarvāṇi kārakāṇi guṇabhūtānīti guṇasya pratinidhirupapadyata iti vyācakṣate | adhyayanena vasatīti tu vasatikriyā''khyātāt prādhānyenāpi pratīyamānā vastusāmarthyādadhyayanākhyahetuparatantrā | tathā hyadhyayanārtho mamātra vāsa iti vaktāro bhavanti | na ca guṇānurodhi pradhānamityadhyayanābhāve vāsārthamanyat kiṃcidatra pratinidhātuṃ yuktam | anyasya hyupādāne tādarthyaṃ kriyayāḥ pratīyeteti tadānīṃ sa eva mukhyo hetuḥ syāt | tasmādadhyayanena vasatīti neyaṃ karaṇatṛtīyā, api tu hetutṛtīyaiveti | na hyadhyayanena vyāpārāviṣṭena vāso nirvartyate api tu vāsasyādhyayanameva saṃpādyaṃ pradhānamiti nirvyāpāraṃ yogyatāmātreṇoddeśyamadhyayanaṃ vāsasya hetuḥ | vyāpārāviṣṭatve'dhyayanasya vāsaṃ pratyānukūlyavivakṣāyāṃ bhikṣādivat tatsamarthācaraṇāt prayojakakartṛtvam , adhyayane vāsayatīti | tadevaṃ kārakaviṣaye kriyāpradhānaṃ kārakaṃ guṇabhūtam | hetuviṣaye tu viparyaya ityanenāpi viśeṣeṇa kārakāddhetoryatireka uktaḥ || 26 ||
idānīṃ caturthīviṣayaṃ tādarthyaṃ tṛtīyāviṣayāddhetoryatirecayitumāha | pratilomyānulomyābhyāṃ heturarthasya sādhakaḥ | tādarthyamānulomyena hetutvānugataṃ tu tat || 27 ||
 apacīyamānāvastho heturapatikameva kāryaṃ janayan prātilomyopalakṣitaḥ | tadyathā jalamātapasaṃsargaviśeṣopajātāpacitarūpamuttarottarāpacitatarāpacitatamalakṣaṇāvasthāparaṃparāsādanānuguṇam | arthāntarasaṃsargopacīyamānarūpaviśeṣaṃ tu kāryamupacitatarameva janayan kāraṇamānukūlyopalakṣito hetuḥ | tadyathā bījamudakātapasaṃyogāhitaviśeṣamucchūnatarāvasthamaṅkuraprasavasamartham | itthaṃ dviprakāro hetuḥ | tadviśeṣastu tādarthyam | ānukūlyaikaniyatamarthasiddhinimittamānukūlyena yaddhetutvaṃ janakatvaṃ tadanugataṃ hetuviśeṣarūpam | tādarthyaṃ kāryakāraṇasaṃbandhasyodbhūtarūpamityarthaḥ | tatra caturthī tadanugataṃ hetuviśeṣarūpam | tādarthyaṃ kāryakāraṇasaṃbandhasyodbhūtarūpamityarthaḥ | tatra caturthī kuṇḍalāya hiraṇyamiti | `tasmā idaṃ tadartham' iti idamopakārakasya nirdeśaḥ, tacchabdenopakāryasya | samāsādbhāvapratyayena saṃbandhasyodbhūtarūpābhidhānam | tatra cottarapadārthasya kāraṇarūpasya prajñāpanīyatvena prādhānyāttacchabdavācye guṇe saṃbandhaḥ padaṃ badhnāti | tatra hyasāvudbhūta iti tādarthye kāraṇasyopakāritve gamyamāne kāryakāraṇasaṃbandhodbhave caturthī vidhīyamānā kāryavācina eva bhavati | tathaiva kāraṇagatasyāpi saṃbandhasya nirbhogāt | kāraṇavacanāttṛtīyā na bhavati | kāryameva prayojakatayā pariṇataṃ tadarthamityucyata ityayuktamabhidhānam | uttarapadārthapradhānatvāttadarthaśabdasya kāraṇavacanatā nyāyyā yataḥ | ata eva hetutvānugataṃ tādarthyam | kāraṇaviśeṣo na kāryam | yadarthamasya gamanaṃ tadanena sādhitamityatra tūpasarjanasyaiva yacchabdenoddiṣṭasya samānādhikaraṇena tacchabdena nirdeśāt sarvanāmarthaḥ kāryayogī yuktaḥ | na tvetāvateha sarvanāmārthasya prādhānyamuttarapadārthe guṇatvāt || 27 ||
tadevaṃ kārakaṃ heturlakṣaṇaṃ tādarthyamiti nimittatvasāmye'pi pravibhaktasvarūpaviṣayāḥ padārthāḥ iti na tatra lakṣamasāṅkaryaprasaṅga ityānuṣaṅgike'rthe nirṇīte prastutameva kārakaviṣayaṃ vicāraṃ prastāvayitumāha | sarvatra sahajā śaktiryāvad‌dravyamasthitā | kriyākāle tvabhivyakterāśrayāduparakāriṇī || 28 ||
 anityānāṃ padārthānāṃ svahetoreva śaktānāmudbhava iti sahajātā śaktiḥ | na hyanādheyātiśayatvād bhāvānāmaśaktasyotpattāvanantaramādhātuṃ śakyate śaktiḥ | nityānāṃ tu svābhāvikī śaktiḥ | āśrayasamavetāstu śaktayaḥ | tadapāye nirādhārā nāvasthātuṃ pārayantīti yāvaddravyabhāvinyaḥ | evamapi sahakārisannidhāne svakāryodyuktāḥ śak‌tyābhivyaktimāśrayante bhāvā ityabhivyaktikāla eva kāryopayogitvāt sādhanamityucyante nānyadā satve'pi | tathā hi | kuḍyasyāvaraṇe śaktirasyādīnāṃ vidāraṇe | sarvadā sa tu san dharmaḥ kriyākāle nirūpyate || 29 ||
 āvarakaṃ kuḍyam, pāṭakaṃ ca śastram , chedyāvarītavyavastusannidhāne jñāyata iti vidyamānā śaktirviṣayāyattā'bhivyaktiḥ | paricchidyate trikālā'pyarvāgdarśanaiḥ | upādānaniyamāddhi kāryāt pūrvamapi śaktirasti | punarapi kāryakāraṇāduttarakālamapi | āgamenāpyetat saṃvādayati | svāṅgasaṃyoginaḥ pāśā daityānāṃ vāruṇā yathā | vyajyante vijigīṣūṇāṃ dravyāṇāṃ śaktayastathā || 30 ||
 daityānāṃ svakarmanirmāṇā vāruṇāḥ pāśāḥ svahastatalāvalīnāḥ sadā sannihitāḥ śaktirūpeṇetyāgamaḥ | te tu parasainyāvajayavelāyāmabhivyajyanta iti śrūyate | evaṃ dravyāṇāṃ sadā sannihitāḥ śaktayaḥ svakāryaniṣpādanakāle prakāśanta ityapi yuktam || 30 ||
yaduktamastrādīnāṃ vidāraṇe śaktiriti tadeva pratanyate | taikṣṇyagauravakāṭhinyasaṃsthānaiḥ svairasiryadā | chedyaṃ prati vyāpriyate śaktimān gṛhyate tadā || 31 ||
 nibiḍatarasaṃhananānāmavayavānāṃ krameṇāgre sūkṣpībhavatāṃ tanutvaprakarṣastaikṣṇyam, chedanimittaṃ dharmaḥ | bhinnajātīyāvayavasaṃbhedavicchede vicchinnāntarālānāmavayavānāmupacayād gauravaṃ nipatanaheturdharmaḥ | tāpanottejitānāṃ lohāvayavānāṃ nibiḍatvaṃ kāṭhinyaṃ nāma dharmo yataḥ prahāraviśeṣo niṣpadyate | saṃniveśaviśeṣo maṇḍalāgrādivyapadeśanibandhanamasyantarādvibhāgahetuḥ saṃsthānam | yataḥ prahāravaicitryamājāyate | tadetairdharmairasiyaṣṭiśchedyavipāṭanamārabhamāṇā śaktimatīti gṛhyate | vyāpāraśūnyā tu satsvapyeteṣu dharmeṣu na tathāvasīyate | evamanyeṣāmapi padārthānāṃ yathāyogaṃ vācyam | aserupalakṣaṇatvāt || 31 ||
pakṣāntarāṇyapyatra sādhane saṃbhavantītyāha | prāṅ nimittāntarodbhūtaṃ kriyāyāḥ kaiścidiṣyate | sādhanaṃ sahajaṃ kaiścit kriyānyaiḥ pūrvamiṣyate || 32 ||
 siddhe satve'bhivyaktipratīkṣā śobhate | sattvameva tu śaktīnāṃ kāryānumeyatvāt kriyātaḥ pūrvamasiddhamiti kriyāyāḥ pūrvamapekṣaṇīyānnimittācchaktayo dravyāṇāṃ kriyānuguṇā jāyanta eva | satve'pyabhivyaktinimittamapekṣaṇīyamiti tadeva janakam | tathā hi sahakārisavyapekṣāṇāṃ bhāvānāṃ janakatvāt parasparahitaśaktayaste svakāryahetava ityunnīyante, kevalānāmajanakatvāt na tadānīṃ śaktā iti na svādhārajanakādeva śaktijanma, api tu nimittāntarādeva | pratyabhijñāyamānatvācca śaktāśaktatve'pi na vastubheda iti kecit | ata evopādānaniyamo'pi yogyatāvadhāraṇat siddhaḥ | anye tu śaktervastuno'nanyatvāt svabhāvabheda eva śaktāśaktatve manyante | sahajaṃ kaiścit sādanaṃ śaktirdravyāṇāmiṣyata iti pūrvapratipāditapakṣānuvādaḥ | kecitu na yenaiva kāraṇena kriyā janyate tenaiya sādhanam, api tvanyenaiveti kriyāpekṣayā nimittāntaratvaṃ manyamānāḥ sahajatvamapi kriyāpekṣayaiva vyācakṣate | tathā hi itaretarasya śaktimarpayantaḥ kriyāṃ nirvartayanti bhāvāḥ sahakāriṇaḥ iti sādhanaśaktibhiḥ sahaiva kriyāṇāṃ vyāpārarūpāṇāṃ janma manyate | tathā ca yebhya eva kriyā jāyante tebhya eva śaktaya iti sahajatvam | upajātaśaktayastu kṣaṇāntare kriyānirvartakā iti sādhyasādhanabhāve nāsti kṣatiḥ na hi sādhyasādhanayoḥ sahabhāvaḥ pramāṇopapannaḥ || 32 ||
anye tu sādhanāt pūrvabhāvinīṃ kriyāṃ manyante | tat kathaṃ yujyata ityāha | pravṛttireva prathamaṃ kvacidapyanapāśritā | śaktirekādhikaraṇe srotovadapakarṣati || 33 ||
 anapekṣitahetuvyāpārā nityā kriyā anapāśritā kvacidapi bhaṇyate | svāśraye tu samavetaiva | ata eva tatrāśraye sādhanaśaktīrāvirbhāvayati pratiniyatasvakāryasaṃpādikāḥ | anye tvanāśritaivetyāhuḥ | satatavyāpārapravahadrūpā nadīpravāha iva tṛṇaparṇalatādīn sādhanaśaktiḥ pravṛttilakṣaṇā kriyā karṣati vahatīti keṣāṃcijjaranmīmāṃsakānāmāgamaḥ | rajolakṣaṇā vā pravṛttirnityā sarvabhāveṣvanuyāyinī svakāryaprasavasamarthā kāryāṇi janayatīti sāṃkhyanayaḥ | vyāpārāviṣṭasya sarvasya kāryajanakatvād vyāpāraḥ pūrvabhāvī samavasthitaḥ | tena ca śak‌tyākṣepa iti yuktam || 33 ||
keyaṃ pravṛttiranapāśrayā nityetyāha | [ito granthapātasandhānāya phullarājakṛtirlikhyate | ] idānīṃ matāntarānusāreṇa sādhanasvarūpaṃ varṇayitumāha | apūrvaṃ kālaśaktiṃ vā kriyāṃ vā kālameva vā | tamevaṃlakṣaṇaṃ bhāvaṃ kecidāhuḥ kathaṃcana || 34 ||
 apūrvaṃ dharmādharmākhyamadṛṣṭasaṃjñakaṃ kecidevaṃrūpaṃ taṃ sāmarthyalakṣaṇaṃ bhāvamāhuḥ | adṛṣṭavaśāddhi sarvaṃ bhavati vā na vetyadṛṣṭameva sarvakāryāṇāṃ nimittaṃ boddhavyam | kecittu vādinaḥ kālaśaktim eva bhagavato brahmaṇaḥ saṃbandhinīṃ sādhanamāhuḥ | kālaśak‌tyanuprāṇitaṃ hi sarvaṃ kriyāyai prabhavati | kriyāṃ vā rājasīmanantaropavarṇitasvarūpā sādhanamāhuḥ | na tūttarakālabhāvi kiṃcana sādhanaṃ nāma śakyaṃ nirūpayitum | pūrvaṃ kriyāmūlaṃ sādanaṃ vyākhyātam | adhunā kriyaiva sādhanamiti viśeṣaḥ | saiva hi svayaṃ pravartamānā viśeṣībhavatīti kālamevā vā nityamekamityādilakṣaṇalakṣitaṃ dravyakālavādinaḥ sādhanamāhuḥ | kālavaśāddhi sarve bhāvāḥ prabhavanti kāryasaṃpattaye iti kāla eva sādhanam | yathā vakṣyati `yadi na pratibadhnayāt...'  iti || 34 ||
atha śakteḥ sāmarthyalakṣaṇāyāḥ sādhanatvena pūrvaṃ nirūpitāyāḥ saṃkhyāvicāraṃ kartumāha | nityāḥ ṣaṭ śaktayo'nyeṣāṃ bhedābhedasamanvitāḥ | kriyāsaṃsiddhaye'rtheṣu jātivat samavasthitāḥ || 35 ||
 anyeṣāṃ matenārtheṣu nityāḥ paṭ śaktayaḥ pṛthaglakṣaṇalakṣitāḥ karmādyā vyavasthitā iti sthitam | kīdṛśyaḥ | bhedābhedasamanvitāḥ, ekāntenārthebhyaścedbhedasamanvitā abhidhīyerannarthasya śaktivaikalyānnīrūpatā syāt | athābhinnāḥ kathyante tarhi vibhinnakāryodayo nāvatiṣṭhate | tasmāt kathaṃcid bhedena, kathaṃcidabhedeneti bhedābhedābhyāṃ samanvitāḥ śaktayo'rthajātivadavasthitāḥ yathā satvadravyatvagotvaśābaleyatvādijātayaḥ satataṃ bhedābhedasamanvayenārtheṣvityeke manyante || 35 ||
tāsāṃ tu dravyādibhedenānantye'pi ṣaṭ‌tvameva ṣaḍ‌vidhatvameva tattvaṃ nātivartata ityāha | dravyākārādibhedena tāścāparimitā iva | dṛśyante tattvasāyāṃ tu ṣaṭ śaktīrnātivartate || 36 ||
 dravyabhedena bhinnā śaktiḥ | yathā dātramanyathā chinatti, khaṅgo'nyatheti | ākārabhedena khaṅgo'nyathā khaṅgalatā tvanyatheti | ādigrahaṇāddeśakālabhedena saiva dahanaśaktiragnivaicitryamupayāti, ṣaṭ‌tvaṃ punastatsvarūpaṃ nātikrāmati || 36 ||
athaikaiva śaktirnimittabhedādviśeṣarūpatayā ṣoḍhātvamāpannā vā sādhanamityāha | nimittabhedādekaiva bhinnā śaktiḥ pratīyate | ṣoḍhā kartṛtvamebāhustatpravṛtternibandhanam || 37 ||
 yasmāt kartṛtvameva nimittabhedenepsitatamatvādinā jvalanatvādinā vā ṣoḍhāvasthitaḥ san tat‌pravṛtteḥ śaktibhedapravṛtteḥ kārakavyavahārabhedasya nibandhanaṃ nimittabhūtaṃ boddhavyam | yathoktam-edhāḥ pakṣyantyā viklitteḥ jvaliṣyantīti jvalanakriyākaraṇasya pāka ityādinyāyena kartṛtvamevāvāntaravyāpāravivakṣayā karaṇādivyapadeśarūpatāṃ bhajate || 37 ||
tadevamekānekā vā śaktirupapāditā | athāsau vyatiriktā vā syādavyatiriktā vetyāśaṅkyāha--- tattve vā vyatireke vā vyatiriktaṃ taducyate | śabdapramāṇako lokaḥ sa śāstreṇānugamyate || 38 ||
 bhedābhedābhyāṃ tāvadanirvācyasau kevalaṃ bhedābhedasamanvitetyuktam | athātra niṣkoṣāṇikāṃ karoṣi tattvayā sahāsmākaṃ kiṃ prayojanam | sarvathā śaktiśaktimatorekāntena tattvamavyatireko vābheda eva vā | vaiyākaraṇanayānusāribhistvasmābhiḥ sāmarthyaṃ vyatiriktamevocyate | yasmāt śabdapramāṇako lokaḥ | śāstrema cānena sa evānugamyata ityāha `sa śāstreṇānugamyate | lokapratītyanusāreṇa hi śabdasyārtho vitanyate | lokaśca śabdakriyānimittāyāḥ śaktervyatirekamevānugacchati | avyatireke hi satataṃ kriyāniṣpattiprasaṅga ityuktam || 38 ||
atha paramārthaparyālocanāṃ vinā na nirvṛtimupalabhase tadatrocyate kiṃcidityāha | paramārthe tu naikatvaṃ pṛthak‌tvādbhinnalakṣaṇam | pṛthak‌tvaikatvarūpeṇa tattvameva prakāśate || 39 ||
 pṛthak‌tvādbhinnalakṣaṇaṃ pṛthak‌tvavyatiriktaṃ naikatvamasti, pṛthak‌tvaikatvarūpeṇa hi tattvameva prakāśate | taddhi vyatahāradaśāyāṃ pṛthak‌tvena prakāśate | avidyāvilaye tvekatvena prakāśate iti boddhavyam || 39 ||
etadeva vyākhyātumāha | yat pṛthak‌tvamasaṃdigdhaṃ tadekatvānna bhidyate | yadekatvamasaṃdigdhaṃ tat pṛthak‌tvānna bhidyate || 40 ||
 asaṃdigdhaṃ yāthātmyāvagamāt sandehaṃ vinā kṛtaṃ yat pṛthak‌tvaṃ tadekatvānna bhidyate | yaccaikatvamasaṃdigdhaṃ vigatabhramaṃ tat pṛthak‌tvān nānātvān na bhidyate || 40 ||
tathā ca yadaikatvaṃ kāṣṭhāmanuprāptaṃ tadā sarvatra tadeva prakāśata ityāha | dyauḥ kṣamā vāyurādityaḥ sāgarāḥ sarito diśaḥ | antaḥ karaṇatattvasya bhāgā bahiravasthitāḥ || 41 ||
 athavāstāṃ katipayavastuviṣayo nānātvaikatvavicāraḥ | ya ime dyauścākāśaṃ ca pṛthivī ca dyāvāpṛthivyau mahatyau mahābhūtasaṃjñike vastunī, tadantare ca vāyurapi tṛtīyaḥ, tathādityalakṣaṇamapi sakalatejasāṃ pradhānaṃ divyaṃ tejaḥ, āpaḥ saritsamudrā vā vikārāḥ, sarvāṇyetāni mahābhūtāni sakalajagajjīvitabhūtāni, diśo vā lokavyavahāranimittabhūtāḥ, kālaśca vakṣyamāṇaḥ, tadetat sarvam `antaḥkaraṇatattvasya' iti antaḥkaraṇasaṃjñakaṃ antaḥkaraṇatvenāntararūpatayā pratibhāsamānaṃ yat tattvaṃ tasyaivaite bhāgāḥ pratibiṃbakāḥ ābhāsā bahiravasthitāḥ | paramārthe tu kīdṛśo'ntarbahirbhāvaḥ | ekameva saṃvinmayaṃ paraṃ śabdabrahma tathā tathāvasthitamiti kārikārthaḥ || 41 ||
mahābhūtarūpatvaṃ digrūpatāṃ cābhidhāya kālarūpatāṃ tasyaiva pratipādayannāha | kālavicchedarūpeṇa tadevaikamavasthitam | sa hyapūrvāparo bhāgaḥ pararūpeṇa lakṣyate || 42 ||
 sa hyapūrvāparaḥ paramārthena | athavā kālaśaktivaśāt cirakṣiprādikrameṇa lakṣyate | tadevaṃ padārthasāmarthyena lokaprasiddhyā vaiyākaraṇamatena sādhanam | atha vā buddhiprakalpanārūpaṃ vijñānavādābhiprāyeṇa, saṃsargirūpaṃ vā padārthāntarabhūtaṃ saṃsargavādānusāreṇa, adṛṣṭalakṣaṇapūrvaśabdavācyaṃ vā mīmāṃsakadṛṣṭyā, brahmasaṃbandhinī lā kālaśaktiradvaitadarśanena, kriyā rājasī pravṛttirūpā vā sāṃkhyadarśanānusāreṇa, nityamekaṃ dravyalakṣaṇaṃ vā kālarūpaṃ dravyakālavādināṃ matena vijñāyam | sādhanaprastāvena ca kārakaśabdavicāraḥ tat prasaṅgena ca hetulakṣaṇakārakakaraṇatādarthyānāṃ bhedanirūpaṇapūrvakaṃ leśataḥ svarūpamuktam | tataḥ śakteḥ kiṃ saha prāguttarakālaṃ vā bhāva iti kālavikalpaḥ | sā ca kiṃ karmadibhedena bhinnaivāhosvidekaiva tathā tathā parikalpyata iti saṃkhyāvikalpaḥ | sā ca kiṃ padārthādvyatiriktaivāthāvyatirikteti vyatirekāvyatirekacintā tatprastāvena ca brahmasvarūpanirūpaṇamiti prakaraṇasya samudāyārthaḥ || 42 ||
idānīṃ prakṛtaṃ vaiyākaraṇamatamevānubadhnan śaktervyatirekamevānvayavyatirekamukhena parighaṭayan sadbhāvamupapādayitumāha | dṛṣṭo hyavyatireke'pi vyatireko'nvaye'sati | vṛkṣādyarthānlayastasmādvibhak‌tyartho'nya iṣyate || 43 ||
 avyatireke abhede'pi prakṛtyarthasya vṛkṣo vṛkṣaṃ vṛkṣeṇa vṛkṣāyetyādau vibhak‌tyarthasya sādhanalakṣaṇasya vyatirekaḥ tathā tatraiva vibhaktyarthasyāsatyanvaye prātipadikārthasyānvayo'nugamo dṛṣṭaḥ | tato manyāmahe asti kaścid vyatiriktaḥ pratyayārthabhūto'napahnavanīyaḥ sādhanalakṣaṇaḥ śaktiśabdavācyo'rtha iti sādhanasiddhiḥ || 43 ||
idānīṃ vyākhyātasyopasaṃhārāya vyākhyeyasyopakramāya kārikāmāha | sāmānyaṃ kārakaṃ tasya saptādyā bhedayonayaḥ | ṣaṭ karmākhyādibhedena śeṣabhedastu saptamī || 44 ||
 sāmānyaṃ kārakamiti vyākhyātārthopasaṃhāraḥ | tasya saptetyādinā vyākhyeyārthopoddhātaḥ | tatra ādyāḥ pradhānabhūtāḥ sāmānyasādhanāpekṣayā bhedarūpāśca tā yonayaḥ svakānāṃ bhedānāmiti bhedayonayaḥ | atha vādyāḥ sapta bhedānāṃ ca svakānāṃ yonayaḥ kāraṇāni | kathamityāha `ṣaṭ karmākhyādibhedena' ityādi | karmādivyapadeśabhedena sapta kārakaśaktayo lakṣyante'dhuneti sādhanasamuddeśasaṅgatiḥ || 44 ||
karmādibhedena saptabhedabhinnā tāvat kārakamuddiṣṭam | atha tadanukrameṇa karma tāvat saṃkhyābhedapradarśanapūrvakaṃ vyākhyātumāha | nirvartyaṃ ca vikāryaṃ ca prāpyaṃ ceti tridhā matam | tatrepsitatamaṃ karma caturdhānyattu kalpitam || 45 ||
 kārakaviśeṣanirdeśaśca vibhak‌tyanukramānusāreṇeha pradarśitaḥ | sūtreṣu tu vipratiṣedhaparibhāṣāmanurudhyāpādānādikrameṇoktam | tatra vibhaktayaḥ svaujasamādyāḥ | kārakamabhihitamanabhihitaṃ ca bhavati | tatra prathamābhihitakārakavibhaktiḥ prātipadikārthamātra eva vidhīyate | dvitīyādayaśca sarvā anabhihite kārakavibhaktaya ityekaprakamatvād dvitīyādyarthānusāreṇaivopakrame | dvitīyādyarthaśca karmādiḥ | yaduktam `karmaṇi dvitīyā'  ityādi | ataḥ karmaṇa evādau vyākhyāvasaraprāptā | tatra kartuḥ kriyayā yadīpsitatamamāptumiṣyamāṇatamaṃ tadeva lakṣaṇaṃ prathamasūtranirdiṣṭam | karma tridhā tribhiḥ prakāraiḥ nirvartyavikāryaprāpyarūpairbhinnamanekāntarnirdiṣṭaṃ boddhavyam | athā anyat sūtrāntaranirdiṣṭamapi bhedāyitumāha caturdhānyattu kalpitam iti || 45 ||
kathamityāha | audāsīnyena yat prāpyaṃ yacca karturanīpsitam | saṃjñāntarairanākhyātaṃ yadyaccāpyanyapūrvakam || 46 ||
 audasīnyena tāṭasthyena yat prāpyam | yathā grāmaṃ ganturvakṣamūlādi | tathā yata karturinīpsitam coraviṣādi | etat `tathāyuktaṃ ca nīpsitam'  iti dvitīyasūtranirdiṣṭaṃ tāvad dvividham | tathā ca yenaiva prakāreṇa karturīpsitatamaṃ tenaiva cet anīpsitam īpsitādanyad dveṣyaṃ viṣādi, itaracca yadaudāsīnyena prāpyaṃ vṛkṣamūlādyuktam | tathā saṃjñāntaraiḥ apādānādisaṃjñābhiranākhyātamapi kriyānimittam | etad `akathitam ca'  iti tṛtīyasūtranirdiṣṭaṃ veditavyam | tathā `yad yaccāpyanyapūrvakam' iti | anyat kārakaṃ pūrvaṃ yasya | yathā `devadattamabhikrudhyati', `devadattamabhidruhyati' iti | atra hi `krudhadruhorupasṛṣṭayoḥ karma' P.1.4.38 ityanena kudhadruhorupasṛṣṭayoḥ upasargasaṃbandhayoḥ yaṃ prati kopaḥ tat kārakaṃ pūrvasūtreṇa saṃpradānasaṃjñamapi karmasaṃjñameva bhavati | tathākṣān dīvyatītyatra `divaḥ karma ca ' ityanena divaḥ sādhakatamaṃ yat pūrvasūtreṇa karaṇasaṃjñameva karmasaṃjñaṃ bhavati || 46 ||
atha nirvartyādi trividhamuddiṣṭaṃ vyākhyātumāha | satī vāvidyamānā vā prakṛtiḥ pariṇāminī | yasya nāśrīyate tasya nirvartyatvaṃ pracakṣate || 47 ||
 yasya nirvartyamānasya ghaṭādeḥ prakṛtiḥ satī vā yathā mudādikā, avidyamānā vā yathā śabdaḥ saṃyogādeḥ pariṇāminī abhedena nāśrīyate mṛdaṃ ghaṭaṃ karotītyādyevaṃrūpatayā na vivakṣyate, kiṃ tarhi, mṛdā ghaṭaṃ karotītyādibhedenaiva | yadā prakṛtyā saha vivakṣā tadā tannirvartyaṃ karma pracakṣate karmavidaḥ | vikāryaṃ vyākhyātumāha--- prakṛtestu vivakṣāyāṃ vikāryam  prakṛteḥ kāramasya pariṇābhitvena yadā vivakṣā kriyate mṛdaṃ ghaṭaṃ karoti, kāśān kaṭaṃ karoti, aṅgārān bhasma karoti ityādi tadā vikāryaṃ karma pracakṣate | athāparaya matāntaropanyāsacchalena prakārabhedakathanavāñchayā nirvartyavikārye nirūpayitumāha--- kaiścidanyathā nirvartyaṃ ca vikāryaṃ ca karma śāstre pradarśitam || 48 ||
kathamityāha yadasajjāyate sadvā janmanā yatprakāśyate | tannirvartyaṃ vikāryaṃ ca karma dvedhā vyavasthitam || 49 ||
 yadasad vaiśeṣikādyanusāreṇa jāyate sāṃkhyamatena sadeva vā jāyate tadubhayamapi janmanā prakāsyamānatvānnirvartyaṃ kathyate | etaduktaṃ bhavati | satkāryavādināmasmākaṃ nirvartyaṃ karmāstīti vaktuṃ pāryate | satī tasya prakṛtirbhavatvasatī vā | sarvathā janmanā prakāsyamānatvena nirvartyatvasya na kācit na kṣatiḥ | sadasadvā janmanā yat prakāśyate tannirvartyam | asajjāyate ityavidyamānaprakṛteḥ karmaṇā nirvartyamānatā pūrvoktaivānūditā, asajjanmanā prakāśyata iti | ayamatra viśeṣaḥ | tadyathā putraṃ prasūte, śabdaṃ prayuṅkte ityatra kukṣisthasya sata eva putrasya vivakṣitasya ca śabdasya prasavaprayogābhyāṃ prakāśanam | sataḥ prakāśanaṃ hi janmātra vivakṣitasya ca śabdasya prasavaprayogābhyāṃ prakāśanam | sataḥ prakāśanaṃ hi janmātra vivakṣitam | janmagrahaṇena pravṛtivivakṣāyāṃ vikāryatāmāha | anyathābhivyajyamānasya nirvartyakarmatābhāvamapi janmagrahaṇenāha | tena vedamadhīte ityādau vedāderadhyayanena prakāśyamānasya nirvartyakarmatābhāvāt "karmaṇi nirvartyamānavikriyamāṇe iti ced vedādhyāyādīnāmupasaṃkhyānam |"  ityucte | itthaṃ ca prakṛtyarthavivakṣāyamevaitannirvatyaṃ karpoktamiti kaiścidanyathā ityasaṅgam | tasmāt sadasat‌kāryavādimatabhedenaitad vyākhyeyam | pūrvaṃ lokapratītyanusāreṇoktam | iha tu tīrthikamatāśrayeṇāpīti viśeṣaḥ || 49 ||
"vikāryaṃ ca karma dvedhā vyavasthitam" | prativyakti lakṣaṇaṃ vaktuṃ vyaktibhedaḥ pūrvamuktaḥ | lakṣaṇamāha--- prakṛtyucchedasaṃbhūtaṃ kiṃcit kāṣṭhādibhasmavat | kiṃcid guṇāntarotpattyā suvarṇādivikāravat || 50 ||
 niranvayavināśāt prakṛterucchedaḥ | tadyathā kāṣṭhāderbhasmādi | kāṣṭhāni bhasma karoti | pūrvavat prakṛtivikārayoḥ kriyāsaṃbandho yojyaḥ | pūrveṇa tu lakṣaṇena nirvartyametat karma prakṛteravivakṣāyām | vivakṣāyāṃ tu vikāryam | iha tvavivakṣāyāmapi prakṛtau bhasmādikāryaṃ rūpaviśeṣādeva kāṣṭhādimupamṛdyopajātamiti pratitervikāryam | pūrvatra tu prakṛtiḥ sākṣādvikāryaṃ karma, tadabhedena vikāro'pi | iha tu sākṣādvikāra eveti viśeṣaḥ | kāṣṭhāni dahatīti tu prakṛtireva śabdavatī, sāmarthyagamyastu vikāro bhasm | evaṃ kāṇḍāni lunāti, carma karotītyādau veditavyam | kācittu prakṛtiratyajantī svarūpaṃ saṃstānāntarāpattyā vikṛtetyucyate iti guṇāntarasya sanniveśāderdharmasyotpattyopalakṣitamaparaṃ vikāryaṃ karma | tadyathā suvarṇī kuṇḍale bhavata iti | asatkāryanaye yadyapyatrāpūrvotpattiḥ tathāpi pratyabhijñānālloke tattvādhyavasāyādguṇāntaramātrāpattirucyate | etacca prakṛtivivakṣāyāṃ pūrvalakṣaṇenāpi saṅgṛhītam || 50 ||
idānīṃ prāpyakarmalakṣaṇamāha--- kriyāgataviśeṣaṇāṃ siddhiryatra na gamyate | darśanādanumānādvā tatprāpyamiti kathyate || 51 ||
 nirvartye karmaṇi nirvṛttarātmalābha eva kriyākṛto viśeṣo darśanāt pratyakṣādevāvadhāryate | vikārye tu bhasmakuṇḍalādau vikāraḥ kriyākṛto viśeṣo'vadhāryate pratyakṣeṇa | kvacit punaranumānādviśeṣāvasāyo yathā paratra janitānāṃ mukhaprasakādādinā liṅgenāvasāyaḥ | jalāvasekādikriyāveśitaśca vanaspatīnāṃ viśeṣaḥ pratikalamavāptajanmā sūkṣmatvādutpattyanantaramanavasīyamānaścaramāvasthāyāṃ pracitataraviśeṣadarśanādavadhāryate | na hyaṃ pracitataro viśeṣo'napekṣitakramo jhaṭityaśaṅkita evodetuṃ prabhavatīti pratikṣaṇamanumīyamānaḥ sūkṣmarūpaḥ, tasya hi sūkṣmasya rūpasya duravadhāratvam | yathā ṣaḍ‌jādisvaraviśeṣayostārātitārayoḥ | tadevaṃvidho viśeṣo yatra kriyākṛto na saṃdṛśyate tatkartuḥ kriyāyā viṣayabhāvamātreṇepsitatamatvāt prāpyaṃ karma | tadyathā ādityaṃ paśyati, nagaramupasarpati vedamadhīta ityādi | ādityādīnāṃ hi saṃdarśanādikriyayā kaścidāhito viśeṣo nāvadhāryate | pramāṇābhyāṃ kriyāsaṃbandhamātraṃ tu lakṣyate, na ca sa eva viśeṣaḥ | vṛtte kriyāsaṃbandhe vastugatasya bhedasya nirvartyavikāryayordṛṣṭatvāt | nagare tu gamanakriyājanitaḥ saṃyogo dviṣṭho viśeṣo bhavannapi nagarasya mahāparimāṇatvādalpaparimāṇena devadattena himavadaṅgulisaṃbandhavadalakṣyaḥ | pṛthivyekadeśaśca svāvayavāpekṣayā kalpito viśiṣṭasvādheyādhārarūpo nagaraśabdavācyaḥ prasiddha eveti na kācidanupapattiḥ || 51 ||
nāstyeva prāpyaṃ karma, sarvatra kriyākṛtaviśeṣāvadhāraṇāditi kecit | tathā hi--- viśeṣalābhaḥ sarvatra vidyate darśanādibhiḥ | keṣāṃcittadabhivyaktisiddhirdṛṣṭiviṣādiṣu || 52 ||
 darśanādikriyāhitaviśeṣalābho vikāraḥ sarvatra vidyate, saukṣmthāttu nāvadhāryate sarveṇeti keṣāṃcinmatam | tasya viśeṣasya dṛṣṭau viṣaṃ yeṣāṃ teṣu tadviṣaye'bhivyakterniścayasya siddhiḥ | dṛṣṭiviṣairahibhirnirīkṣito hi viṣayo jvalanajvālālīḍho lakṣyate | tatsādharmyādanyatrāpi darśanādināhitaḥ kaścidviśeṣo viṣaye samunneyaḥ | taijasaṃ hi cakṣuḥ prāpyakārīti tena yukto viṣayo'vaśyaṃ vikriyate yathā dṛṣṭiviṣadarśanena | iṃyāstu viśeṣo dṛṣṭiviṣe teja utkaṭaṃ viṣasaṃparkādviṣayaṃ dahati, anyatra tanutarasthiti | ādiśabdenāyaskāntādīnāṃ grahaṇam | tatsannidhau lohaṃ bhramati | katakaphalasannidhau hi jalaṃ prasīdatītyādāvastyeva kriyākṛto vikāraḥ | etacca na śāstrakārasya matam | keṣāṃcidityanyamatatvenopanyāsāt | kvacidviśeṣadarśane'pi na sarvatra tathā bhāvo'dṛśyamānaviśeṣe'pi yuktaḥ | kiṃ ca kriyāphale'tra vikāro'bhipretaḥ | paridṛśyamānastu viṣayo kriyāyā heturna phalam | dṛṣṭiviṣādāvapi tejaḥsaṃyogādviṣaye vikāro na kriyābalāt | evamayaskāntādervastusvabhāvo'yaṃ na kriyākṛto vikāraḥ kaścit | tasmādastyeva prāpyaṃ karma kriyākṛtopakārānapekṣam || 52 ||
na cedvikārayogaḥ prāpyakarmaṇaḥ kathamasya kriyāsiddhāvaṅgabhāvaḥ sādhanatāsampattyarthaḥ | ucyate | ābhāsopagamo vyaktiḥ soḍhatvamiti karmaṇaḥ | viśeṣāḥ prāpyamāṇasya kriyāsiddhau vyavasthitāḥ || 53 ||
 yogyadeśāvasthānena darśanapathamavatarati viṣaya iti yogyadeśāpattiḥ ābhāsopagamaḥ svabhāvadasya darśane upakāraḥ | yogyadeśasthitasyāpi nīhārādiprakāśapratibandhakabhāvābhāvadipradīpādinimittā vyaktiḥ aṅgam | viṣayasya prakāśayogyadeśasthitasyāsatyāvarake'dṛṣyasvabhāvaḥ piśācādiriti soḍhatvam, bodhakṣamatā, dṛśyasvabhāvatāṅgam | etairatiśayairdarśane sādhanabhāvamanubhavati prāpyaṃ karma | ete ca darśanakriyāhetavo na tatkṛtāḥ | grāmaṃ gacchatītiyādāvapi yathāyogaṃ soḍhatvādayo grāmādervācyāḥ | samīhāviṣayīkṛtā hi grāmādayo'vabhāsamānā gamanādisahāḥ sādhayanti gamanādikriyām | evamadhīyamānaṃ vedādi adhyamanasaham | mātaraṃ smaratītyapi mātā kṛtopakārā krūrahṛdayasyāpi smṛtipathamanupatantī sādhayati smṛtim | ipsitatamatvānapekṣāyāṃ tu saṃbandhitvasāmānyavivakṣāyāṃ śeṣaṣaṣṭhī mātu smaratīti || 53 ||
evaṃ tāvād yathāvibhāgaṃ karma lakṣitam | idaṃ tu vaktavyam--pūrvamuktaṃ guṇakriyāṇāṃ kartāraḥ sarve sādhanaviśeṣā iti | tatkathaṃ karmatāsaṃbhava iti karmakartṛvicārapātanikāṃ karoti | nirvartyādiṣu tatpūrvamanubhūya svatantratām | kartrantarāṇāṃ vyāpāre karma saṃpadyate tataḥ || 54 ||
 nirvṛttivikriyābhāsāpattikriyāsu yathāsaṃkhyaṃ nirvartyavikāryaprāpyalakṣaṇaṃ karma svātantryaṃ kartṛtvamāśritya tadapekṣayānyeṣāṃ nirvartyādikarmaviṣayatvād bahūnāṃ kartṝṇāṃ nirvartanādivyāpāre praiṣalakṣaṇe karma jāyate tenāpyamānatvāt | tathā hi nirvartate vikurute ābhāsamupaiti prakāśate iti kartāraḥ svavyāpāre karmabhedāt pradhānakartṛvyāpāre vivakṣite nirvartayati, vikārayati, ābhāsādiviṣayabhāvamāpādayatīti kartṛpraiṣe svāmisannidhāviva bhṛtyā nyagbhavantaḥ karmabhāvamanubhavanti || 54 ||
evaṃ tarhi kartā karma bhavatīti karma bhūtvā kartā kathaṃ bhavati yena karmakartṛtvasaṃbhava ityata āha--- tad‌vyāpāraviveke'pi svavyāpāre vyavasthitam | karmāpadiṣṭān labhate kvacicchāstrāśrayān vidhīn || 55 ||
 bhidyate kusūla ityādau yadā kartṛpraiṣasya nirvṛttiḥ kusūlāderviśarārurūpatayā svayameva bhidānubhavāt, lūyate kedāra ityādavapi śuṣkataratvāt kartṛprayatnānapekṣaṇāt, pacyate odanaḥ svayametevetyādāvapi saukaryātiśayavaśāt karturanapekṣaṇāt tadā svavyāpāre svātantryāśraye kartṛtve śāstreṇa yatnena karmakāryaprāptyarthaḥ karmavadbhāvo vidhīyata iti karmaṇi apadiṣṭān vihitān vidhīn kāryāṇi kartā'pi san prāpnoti | karmakartrantakavyāpārapātanena hi svavyāpāre kartṛtvāt karmakāryāṇi na syuriti śāstrāraṃbhaḥ | kvacid iti | karmasthabhāvānāṃ karmasthakriyāṇāṃ ca dhātūnāṃ viṣaya ityarthaḥ || 55 ||
nanu ca kartṛpraiṣe nivṛtte tadāyattaṃ karmatvamatra mā bhūt kartṛtvaṃ tu kathaṃ yena karmakarteti vyapadeśaḥ | tathā hi | sati pradhānakartari karmaṇaḥ svakriyāyāṃ vyāpāro dṛṣṭa iti tadabhāve karmatvavat kartṛtvamapi kuta ityāśaṅkyāha | nivṛttapreṣaṇaṃ karma svakriyāvayave sthitam | nivartamāne karmatve sve kartṛtve'vatiṣṭhate || 56 ||
 dhātvarthānukūlyena ceṣṭanaṃ kartuḥ preṣaṇaṃ svavyāpāraḥ kārakāntaviniyogalakṣaṇam | tadanabhidhīyamāne kartari pacyate odanaḥ svayamevetyādau nivartate | kartrāśrayasya vyāpārasya kartari pratyayenābhidhīyamāne dhātunā'nabhidhīyamānatvāt | pratīyamānatvaṃ tu tasya dvayarthaḥ paciriti bhāṣyavirodhādasaṅgatamityākhyātam | tāni dhātvantarāṇi iti ca vakṣyamāṇatvād viṣayavibhāgena dhātvarthatā kartṛvyāpārasya granthakṛto'bhipretā | tasminnivṛtte svasmin kriyāvayave pradhānakriyāpekṣayā guṇabhūte svavyāpārekarma sthitam,kartṛtayā bhūtapūrvagatyā tvasya karmavyapadeśaḥ | yadyapi ca kartṛvyāpārevivakṣite svakriyāyāmevāvasthānaṃ tad‌dvāreṇa pradhānakriyānirvartanāt, kārakaṃ karmeti sāmānādhikaraṇyācca, tathāpi sāmarthyādatra prādhānyenāvasthānaṃ boddhavyam | ata eva kartṛvyāpārāpekṣayā karmatvasya nivṛttāvātmīye sarvatrabhavati svakriyāviṣaye kartṛtve'vatiṣṭhate iti kartṛvyāpārāpekṣayā pūrvaṃ karma bhūtvā saukaryātiśayapratipādanaparatayā tadavivakṣāyāṃ kartā sampadyata iti bhavati karmakartā | ayaṃ bhāvaḥ | na kevalaṃ kartṛvyāpārasyāvivakṣāmātre karmakartṛtā, api tu svavyāpāre svātantryavivakṣāyāmapi satyām | tataścāprāptāni yagādīni karmakāryāṇi "karmavat karmaṇā tulyakriyaḥ"  iti śāstreṇa prāpyante | taduktaṃ vārtikakṛtā "karmakartari kartṛtvaṃ svātantryasya vivakṣitatvāt "  iti | tatra parāyattopajane'pi bhidādau kusūlādeḥ parānapekṣā prātipāditā bhāṣye "yastu khalu nivāte nirabhivarṣe acirakālakṛtaḥ kusūlaḥ svayameva bhidyata iti |" nivāta iti samīrasampātamanavāpyeti kartṛvyāpāro vyudastaḥ | nirabhivarṣa iti salilakalāsaṃsparśo vyudastaḥ | acirakṛta iti kālāntaparivāsādīyamānaviseṣavyudāsaḥ | ete hi pātahetavaḥ kusūlasya saṃbhāvyeran iti vyudastāḥ | evaṃ cādṛḍhasaṃniveśitvāt svayameva viśīryata iti kartṛtvopapattiḥ | yatrāpi dātrahasto devadattaḥ paripatan dṛśyate lūyate kedāraḥ svayameveti atrāpi tīvrakarakiraṇasamparkasamutsāritasnehaḥ parijarjaritanālaḥ viśīryamāṇaḥ kedāraḥ tātsthyāt vrīhirūpo lavane sukaratāmeti | sāmagrīsādhyatvācca kriyāṇāṃ pratyekaṃ vyāpārotkarṣaṇārthaṃ svātantryādhyāropeṇāpyupapannaḥ prayogaḥ devadatta chinatti, asiḥ chinatti, sthālī pacatītyādiḥ | tatra ca karmaṇa eva kartuḥ karmavadbhāvo nānyasya, chidyate rajjuḥ, pacyate odanaḥ svayameveti tadetaduktaṃ bhāṣye--- "tatrāpi yā'sau sukaratā nāma tasyā nānyaḥ kartā..." iti | saukaryātiśayavad‌vyāpāre kedāre samīhite na devadattaśchedasya kartṛvyapadeśaṃ pratipattu yogyo'pi tu kedāra evetyarthaḥ | odanaviklittau tu chedanavat kartṛvyāpāro'pi nāvaśyamapekṣyaḥ | anapekṣitakartṛprayatnā eva hi taṇḍulā viklidyanti | karaṇādikārakaviniyoga eva hyatra mukhyaḥ kartṛvyāpāro lakṣyate || 56 ||
nanu caika eva pacyādirdhātuḥ kvacit kartṛvyāpāre guṇabhūtamarthamāha pacatyodanaṃ bhinatti kusūlaṃ lunāti kedāraṃ devadatta iti | kvacittu kartṛvyāpāre'pratipannaguṇabhāvaṃ svapratiṣṭhamarthamāha pacyata odanaḥ svayamevetyādāvityeṣo'sati rūpabhede dhātūnāṃ viveko durlabha iti kartṛpratyayavācyaiva bhāvanā bhavatvityāśaṅkyāha--- tāni dhātvantarāṇyeva pacisiddhyativad viduḥ | bhede'pi tulyarūpatvādekatvaparikalpanā || 57 ||
 karmakartṛviṣayāṇi pacyādīni viklittyādināmātravacanāni tadupasarjanavikledanādivyāpāravācipacyādidhātubhyo dhātvantarāṇi boddhavyāni | arthabhedena śabdabhedāt | pradhānaṃ hi śabdānāṃ pratipādyo'rthaḥ | pradhānānuyāyī ca guṇa iti nyāyāt pratyarthaṃ bhidyate śabdaḥ | tadyathā pacervikledanavacanāt sidhyatiranyo dhāturviklittivacanaḥ | dhātvantaratve'pi caikatvena rūpābhedādupadeśo dhātupāṭhe ḍupacaṣ pāka ityādi | abhinnarūpaṃ hyekatvakalpanāsahaṃ vastu | yatra tūpadeśabhede phalabhedo'sti tatra dvistrirupadeśaḥ, tadyathā kṣiyatyādīnāṃ vikaraṇabhedāt kṣi kṣaye bhvavādau, kṣi nivāsagatyoriti tudādau divādau ca, kṣīñ hiṃsāyāmiti ca krayādau || 57 ||
idānīm ekamāhuranekārthaṃ śabdamanye parīkṣakāḥ iti nayenāha--- ekadeśe samūhe ca vyāpārāṇāṃ pacādayaḥ | svabhāvataḥ pravartante tulyarūpasamanvitāḥ || 58 ||
 tulyenābhinnena rūpeṇa svabhāvena yuktā ete dhātavo'bhinnāḥ , abāṣyamānasyaikākārapratyayasyābhedāvedakatvāt | anekārthatvameva vādhakamiti cenna | śaktibhedenatadupapatteḥ | anekārthapratipādanaśaktirhyeko'pi śabdo dṛṣṭaḥ | yathā grāmaśabdaḥ śālāsamudāyavāṭakaparikṣiptadeśajanasamudāyavacanaḥ | yathā vākṣādiśabdāḥ | tatra karmakartṛviṣaye viklittimātravacanaḥ paciḥ, pacyate odanaḥ svayameveti | devadattasya kartuḥ pratyayenānābhidānāttad‌vyāpārasyātra dhātuvācyatvābhāvaḥ | pradhānabhūto hi pacyartho viklittiḥ, sarvatra saṃbhavāt | apekṣite'pi hi kartṛvyāpāre devadattaḥ pacatītyatra viklityarthatvādvikledanasya kartṛvyāpārasyārthena rūpeṇa viklittereva prādhānyāt, atra ca dvayasyābhidhānāt samūhavṛttitvam | atraiva dvayarthatopapattiruktā | karmakartṛviṣaye tu kartṛpratyayasyābhāvāt tadvyāpāro bhāvanā nābhidhīyate | karmaiva hyatra kartā, tadvyāpāraśca viklittireveti saivābhidhīyate | tadyathā viklidyanti siddhyanti taṇḍulā iti viklittereva kartṛvyāpārasyābhidhānam| evaṃ bhidyate kusūlaḥ svayameveti dvidhābhavanaṃ dhātvarthaḥ | bhinatti kusūlaṃ devadatta iti tadupasarjanaṃ dvidhābhavanamityudāhāryam || 58 ||
tadevaṃ vicitraśaktitvācchabdānāṃ viṣayabhedenārthavivekaḥ samuditaḥ | idānīṃ karmakartṛprasaṅgena "ṇeraṇau yatkarma" ityatra "karmakartṛtvāt siddham" ityuktatvāt vicārayati--- nyagbhāvanānyagbhavanaṃ rūhau śuddhe pratīyate | nyagbhāvanā nyagbhavanaṃ ṇyante'pi pratipadyate || 59 ||
avasthāṃ paṃcamīmāhurṇyante tāṃ karmakartari | nivṛttapreṣaṇāddhātoḥ prākṛte'rthe ṇijucyate || 60 ||
 ihārohayate hastī svayamevetyayaṃ hastivyāpārābhidhāyī prayogo'sti karmakartṛviṣayaḥ | tasya cānvākhyānopāyaparikalpanā kartavyā | tatra rūpasāmānyānugamapravartitena rekhāgavayavadavayavāpoddhāreṇa tadarthāśrayaṇena cānvākhyānaṃ pravartyate | tathā ca yāvatīṣu sopānasthānīyāsu arthavibhāgabhūmiṣu padaṃ vinyasyeyaṃ prāyogikī paryantabhūmiḥ prāpyeta tā antarālabhāvinyo gaṇyamānā bhūmayo'vasthāśabdavācyāḥ | tatrādye bhāge ruhidhātuḥ pratyabhijñāyate | tasya cānyatrāvasthādvayarūpo'rthaḥ prasiddhaḥ, sa evehāṅgīkriyate | tadetadāha--- nyagbhāvanā nyagbhavanaṃ rūhau śuddhe pratīyate | iti śuddhe kevale ṇij‌rahita ityarthaḥ | ārohanti hastinaṃ hastipakā ityatra nyagbhavantaṃ nyagbhāvayantītyarthaḥ | atra ca dhātvarthamātrapradarśane tātaparyam | vikaraṇapratyayādyupādānaṃ tu nāntarīyakam | nānyathā prayogārhaḥ śabdo labhyata ityārohayate hastī svayamevetyasyaiva dhātorayamamarthaḥ pradarśito bhavati | evaṃ ca kṛtvaikena śabdena dhātunā nāntarīyakatayopāttapratyayasahāyenāvasthādvayaṃ nyagbhāvanānyagbhavanalakṣaṇamupāttam | dhātubhāgādūrdhvaṃ cātra guṇāyādeśalakṣaṇakṛtavikāro ṇic pratyabhijñāyate | sa yadi yathāsthitaprakṛtyarthaniṣṭhe prayojakavyāpāre'nvākhyāyate tadā nyagbhāvaniṣṭhāparaprayojakavyāpārapratītiprasaṅgāt prakṛtavaiguṇyaṃ syāt | tena ruhidhātvarthasaṅkocalabhyaṃ madhye'vasthāntaraṃ prakṛtyarthatvena ṇica āśrīyate hastivyāpāramākṣarūpam | tatparyante pūrvaśaṅkāparihārāya darśitam | nivṛttapreṣaṇād ityādinā | tatastanniṣṭhe prayojakavyāpāre prāgavasthopacayakāriṇi ṇijutpāditaḥ kevalaruhitulyārthatāṃ sampādayati | tadāha nyagbhāvanānyagbhavanaṃ ṇyante'pi pratipadyate | iti | ārudyate hastī svayameva, ārohayanti hastinaṃ hastipakā ityudāharaṇadvayamātra | ekena prayojyavyāpāro ṇic prakṛtyartharūpo darśitaḥ | sa ca nānyathā śakyadarśana iti yagātmanepage karmavadbhavāt prāpte nāntarīyakatayopātte | dvitīyena ṇijartho hastipakavyāpāraḥ pradarśitaḥ | sa ca prayojyavyāpārapṛṣṭhapātitvena śakyadarśana iti ruhirupāttaḥ | pratyayādyupādānaṃ tu nāntarīyakatayā pūrvavat | tadetāścatastro'vasthāḥ | tata urdhvamātmane padasarūpo bhāgo dṛśyate hastivyāpāramātrapratītiśca | etacca karmakartravasthāmantareṇāśakyamiti pūrvāvasthāsaṃkocalabhyā sāśrīyate | tadāha--- avasthāṃ paṃcamīm ityādi | tadevaṃ karmakartṛtvād ārohayate ityātmanepade siddhe ṇeraṇau ityatra "karmakartṛtvāt siddhamiti ced yak‌ciṇornivṛtyarthaṃ vacanam"  iti vārtikakāreṇoktam | tatra "na vā yak‌ciṇo pratiṣedhāt"  ityādinā karmavadbhāvenaivātrātmanepadamiti siddhāntitam | gaṇayati gaṇaḥ svayamevetyatra tu ātmanepadanivṛttyarthaṃ niyamārthatayā `ṇeraṇau' iti sūtraṃ vārtikakāreṇa sthāpitam | nyagbhavanaṃ ca viklittivat karmasthamiti ruhiḥ karmasthakriyo vākyakārasya karmavadbhāvaviṣayaḥ || 59,60 ||
dṛśyate ca dhātūnāṃ prakṛtyantaṇyantānāṃ keṣāṃcit samāno'rtha ityatra dṛṣṭāntamāha-- bravīti pacaterarthaṃ siddhyatirna vinā ṇicam | sa ṇyantaḥ pacaterartho prakṛte vyavatiṣṭhate || 61 ||
 siddhyatyodana iti viklittimātravacano dhātuḥ | pacatyodanamiti viklittyupasarjanaṃ vikledanalakṣaṇaṃ pacatyarthaṃ ṇic‌sahito'bhidhatte sādhayatyodanamiti | evamārūhirṇyanto'pi kacittadarthe vartata iti | idamatra tātparyam | bhinnāvevāruhī prakṛtyantaṇyantūrapau pacatisādhayativadekārthau, ṇyante tu praiṣasya nivṛttāvārohayate hastī svayamevetyapi nyagbhavanavacano'nya eva dhāturevamupāyaparikalpanayā vyutpādyate | na tvayamatra paramārthato ṇic yenārthanivṛttau kathamavatiṣṭhateti codyeta | anvākhyeyaṃ hi laukikaṃ śabdamuddiśya pratipādakaśabdaniṣṭhamupāyaparikalpanayā prakṛtipratyayavibhāgenāsatyena sarvatrānuśāsanaṃ laukikārthānusāreṇaivaṃ kriyate | nanvevamapyasatyasyāpoddhārapadārthasyāsaṃbhave kathaṃ śāsanaṃ laukikārthānusāreṇaivaṃ kriyate | nanvevamapyasatyasyāpoddhārapadārthasyāsaṃbhave kathaṃ tacchabdaḥ | evaṃ tarhi karmavyāpārātiśayasya ṇic‌pratyāyyasyāsti saṃbhava ityadoṣaḥ || 61 ||
evaṃ praiṣasya nivṛttyā karmaṇaḥ kartṛtvamupapādya praiṣadhyāropeṇāpyupapādayitumāha--- keṣāṃciddevadattādervyāpāro yaḥ sakarmake | sa vinā devadattādeḥ kaṭādiṣu vivakṣyate || 62 ||
 kaṭaṃ karoti ityādau sakarmake dhātvarthe devadattādipradhānakartṛviṣaye pradhānakartuḥ prayojakasya yaḥ praiṣalakṣaṇo vyāpāraḥ asau yadā saukaryātiśayavivakṣā karmaṇaḥ tadā kartāramantareṇa tatra karmaṇi vivakṣyate | yathā hi devadattaḥ prayuṅkte evaṃ kaṭo'pi sukaro devadattamiti bhavati vivakṣā || 62 ||
tadetat sāmānyenoktaṃ prakṛte yojayati--- nivṛttapreṣaṇaṃ karma svasya kartuḥ prayojakam | preṣaṇāntarasaṃbandhe ṇyante lenābhidhīyate || 63 ||
 kartṛvyāpāraḥ praiṣaḥ karmaṇodhyāropita iti nivṛttapreṣaṇaṃ tadavivakṣitaprayojakavyāpāraṃ svātantryavivakṣāyāmātmīyasya prayojakasya prayojakatāṃ saukaryātiśayavaśāt pratipadyamānaṃ tatra kaṭādikarmasaṃbandhini devadattādikartṛviṣaye preṣaṇāntare prayojakavyāpārāntare ṇici sati kārayate kaṭaḥ svayameveti ṇyantāllakāreṇa karmakartṛviṣayeṇābhidhīyata iti ṇijabhidheyaḥ praiṣo'stīti bhāvaḥ | atra copāyaparikalpanā praiṣau ṇico na tu vastutastatsaṃbhava iti prayojyāpekṣābhāvaḥ | tathā ca prayojyakarmasaṃbhavādavidyamānakarmāntarasaṃbandhāddhātorvidhīyamānaṃ ṇeraṇāvityātmanepadaṃ kathamiti na codanīyam | tathā hi-saukaryātiśayapratipādanāya karmaṇo vāstavaḥ praiṣo'dhyāropita iti pratīte tasmin prayokatvasyāvivakṣā, karmakartṛpratītisāmarthyāt tu bhūtapūrvapreṣaṇāvasthāvagamyata iti tadviṣayo ṇiñ na nivartate | evaṃ karmakartṛprasaṅgena ṇeraṇāvityatra vicāritam | "tyadādiṣu dṛśo'nālocane kañ ca" ityatra vārtike "kṛdarthānupapattistu"  iti coditam | kartari kṛditi vacanāt kartrā pratyayārthena bhāvyam | sa cātra nopapadyate | sadṛśalakṣaṇaṃ hyarthaṃ tādṛśādayaḥ śabdāḥ prāhuḥ, na tu darśanakriyāyāḥ kartāramiti vārtikārthaḥ | tatroktam | "ivārthe cāyaṃ taddhitaḥ" iti | ive pratikṛtāvityatra prakaraṇe'yaṃ taddhitasaṃjñaḥ pratyayo vaktavyaḥ | tathā ca sa iva tādṛśa ityādyarthasiddhirityarthaḥ | evaṃ vārtikakāreṇa siddhantitam | bhāṣyakārastu kṛdarthānupapattiriti codyaṃ yathānyāsameva parihartuṃ "karmakartṛtvāt siddham" iti | tatra dṛśaḥ kartṛsthabhāvakatvāt kartṛvyāpāradarśanamātravācyatayā praiṣasyābhāvāt kathaṃ karmakartṛtvasaṃbhavaḥ | preṣaṇādhyārope tu ṇic syāt | aṇyantaśca sūtre dṛśirupāttaḥ || 63 ||
atra nivṛttapreṣaṇaṃ karma svakriyāvayave sthitam | nivartamāne karmatve sve kartṛtve'vatiṣṭhate || ityanena nyāyena karmakartṛtvaṃ kecit samarthayamānāḥ prāhuḥ | sadṛśādiṣu yatkarma kartṛtvaṃ pratipadyate | āpattyāpādane tatra viṣayatvaṃ pratikriye || 64 ||
 sadṛśatādṛśādiṣu śabdeṣu vyutpādyeṣu yatkarmakartṛtvaṃ pratipadyate yatkarmaṇaḥ kartṛtvamuktaṃ tatra dṛśerviṣayabhāvaviṣaye hi āpattyāpādane kriye vācye iti tadāśrayeṇa karmakartṛtvasamarthatā | tathā hi paśyatīti ko'rthaḥ | viṣayaṃ ghaṭādikaṃ darśanaviṣayabhāvamāpadyamānamāpādayatīti | tatra viṣayasya paricchedyatvena vyāpāra āpattiḥ, karmabhūtasya tadviṣayamāpādanaṃ kartṛvyāpāro dṛśyartho na kevalaḥ | tatra kartṛvyāpāre āpattilakṣaṇo viṣayavyāpāro nyagbhavatīti tatsannidhau svavyāpāre svātantryaṃ viṣayasya tirobhavati | yadā tu yogyadeśavasthitaḥ spaṣṭatarāvokamadhyaparivartī viṣayaḥ tadā sudarśano bhavan svayamabhivyaktadarśanaḥ kartṛviniyogamapākarotīti svavyāpāre svātantryavivakṣāyāṃ karma bhūtvā kartā sampadyata iti bhavati karmakartṛviṣayaḥ | etattu nopapadyata ityāha | kutaścidāhṛtya padamevaṃ ca parikalpane | karmasthabhāvakatvaṃ spāddarśanādyabhidhāyinām || 65 ||
 iha dṛśeḥ kartṛsthaṃ darśanamātraṃ vācyaṃ paśyatīti | na hyato viṣayabhāvāpattiravagamyate | kiṃ tu viṣayajñānameva dhātvarthaḥ | viṣayabhāvāpattirhi sarvasya dhātvarthasyāstīti viśiṣṭameva darśanaṃ dṛśerabhideyaṃ nyāyyam | tacca darśanaṃ viṣayapratiṣṭhamityasmāt kutaścit sāmarthyāt viṣayākṣepadvāreṇa viṣayabhāvāpattyādivācipadādhyāhāre viṣayagatavyāpārapratyāyanāttadupasarjanakartṛvyāpāracitvakalpane darśanāsanādyabhidhāyināmapi karmasthabhāvakatvameva syāditi na kaściddhātuḥ kartṛsthabhāvakriyo nāma syāt | ataitadayuktamiti pratipādayitumāha āpadyamānamāpādayatītyevaṃ vicakṣaṇatayā yataḥ kutaścit padamadhyāhṛtya bhavatedamupakalpyate | tadevaṃ sati darśanādyabhidhāyināṃ dṛśyādīnāṃ dhātūnāṃ karmasthabhāvakatvaṃ syāt | ādigrahaṇādāsanādyabhidhāyināmāsiprabhṛtīnāmapi | na caitadupapannaṃ kartṛsthabhāvakatvādṛśyādīnāmiti | atra karmasthabhāvakatvaṃ syāt ityabhidadhatā kartṛsthabhāvakatvaṃ yadupapannameṣāṃ tadevaṃ vighaṭetetyuktaṃ bhavati || 65 ||
atha kathaṃ kartṛsthabhāvakatvaṃ kathaṃ vā karmasthabhāvakatvaṃ vijñāyetevyāśaṅkya prasaṅgād vyākhyātumāha | viśeṣadarśanaṃ yatra kriyā tatra vyavasthitā | kriyāvyavasthā tvanyeṣāṃ śabdaireva prakāśyate || 66 ||
