 yatra kartari karmaṇi vā viśeṣaḥ kaścit paridṛśyate tatraiva kriyā vyavasthiteti boddhavyam | saparispandasādhanasādhyā kriyā, aparispandasādhanasādhyo bhāva itiviśeṣamanapekṣya sūtrakārābhiprāyeṇa kriyāpi bhāvo'bhidhīyata iti ṭīkākārasyābhiprāyaḥ | tathā ca lakṣaṇahetvoḥ kriyāyāḥ  yasya ca bhāvena bhāvalakṣaṇam  ityādāvameda eva sūtrakārasya kriyābhāvayoścetasi vartate | anye tvetannecchantītyāha | anyeṣāṃ mate kriyāvyavasthā śabdaireva prakāśyate | etaduktaṃ bhavati | ye'pi karmasthabhāvakāḥ pacyādayastatrāpi kartaryapi pariśramādiko viśeṣaḥ paridṛśyate | tato naitadvayavasthāpakam, viśeṣadarśanaṃ yatra tatra kriyeti | tasmācchabdaireva ca yatra viśeṣaḥ prakāśyate prātipādyate tatraiva kriyā sthiteti vaktu yuktam | śabdapramāṇakānāṃ hi śabda eva yathā yathārthamabhidhatte tathaiva tasyābhidānamupapannam | na tu vastumukhaprekṣitayā | śabdaśca paśyati ghaṭamityādau dṛśikriyāviṣayaviśiṣṭameva pratyāyayati | kāṣṭhaṃ bhinattītyādau tu bhidikriyāviṣayaṃ saviśeṣamabhidhatta iti tadvaśenaiva kartṛsthabhāvakatvaṃ karmasthabhāvakatvaṃ cābhidhānīyam | evaṃ ca dṛśyate svayameveti na bhavatyeveti mantavyam | yattvaparispandasādhanasādhyo bhāva ityādi lakṣaṇamabhidadhāya karmasthaḥ pacaterbhāva ityādikamabhidadhati tadapyavyavasthitamiva lakṣyate | tathā ca pīlupāke ghaṭaṃ pacatīti ghaṭasyānalasaṃparkādavayavakriyādvāreṇāvayavasaṃyogavināśapūrvakaṃ pūrvapūrvakāryavināśe uttarottarakāryadravyavināśāt saparispandaparamāṇuviṣayapākakriyāpi | tataścāvyavasthitamevaitat || 66 ||
eva tāvat prathamasūtralakṣitaṃ nirvartyavikāryaprāpyabhedena tridhā bhinnaṃ karma vyākhyāya tatprasaṅgena ca nirvartyavikāryaviṣayaṃ matabhedena nivṛttapreṣaṇaṇyantāṇyantadhātuviṣayamadhyāropitapreṣaṇaṃ ca karmakartāraṃ pradarśya prāpyaviṣayasya pradarśanapūrvakaṃ pratyākhyānamuk‌tvā tatprasaṅgenaiva karmasthabhāvakatvakartṛsthabhāvakatve matabhedenaiva vyavasthāpyedānīṃ sūtrāntaranirdiṣṭānyapi karmāṇi vyākhyātumupakramate | tatrākathitasūtre | "kālabhāvādhvagantavyāḥ karmasaṃjñā hyakarmaṇām deśaśca |" ityuktaṃ tāvadanāraṃbhaṇīyamiti pratipādayitumāha | kālabhāvādhbadeśānāmantarbhūtakriyāntaraiḥ | sarvairakarmakairyoge karmatvamupajāyate || 67 ||
 akarmakāṇāṃ kathaṃ karmaṇā yogaḥ syāditi kālādīnāṃ tatsaṃprayoge karmatvaṃ vaktavyamupajāyate | atrocyate | nātra karmasaṃjñā vaktavyā yasmāt kālīdīnāmakarmakairdhātubhiryoge karmatvamupajāyata eva | kathamiti viśeṣayitumāha antarbhūtākriyāntaraiḥ iti | antarbhūtaṃ pradhānakriyāpekṣayā kriyāntaraṃ yeṣāmiti te tathā | taiḥ yoge saṃbandhe sati | ataśca kriyāntarāpekṣayā teṣāṃ karmatvaṃ siddhameveti kimupasaṃkhyānena | tathā ca māsamāste, godohamāste, kośaṃ svapiti, kurūn svapitītthādau māsādīn vyāpyāsta iti vyāptyaṅgāyāmāsanādikriyāyāṃ dhāturvṛttaḥ | vyāptyadikriyayāptumiṣṇamāṇatvāt kālādīnāṃ sphuṭameva karmatvemitita yatnāntareṇa nārthaḥ | yadyevanamidānīmāsiprabhṛtayaḥ kālabāvādhvakarmabhiḥ sakarmakāḥ sampannāḥ, tataśca tebhyaḥ kālarādiśveva karmasu lakṛtyaktakhalarthāḥ prāpnuvanti na bhāve | tatra māsamāsyate devadatteneti bhāve lakāro na syāta | māsamāsitavyam, māsamāsitam, svāsaṃ māsam iti ca kṛtyaktakhalarthā bhāve na syuḥ | "bhāve cākarmakebhyaḥ" iti vacanāttatrāpīṣyate | tasmātkālādikarmasadbhāvādakarmakatvaṃ katham | sakarmakatve bhāve lakāraḥ kathamiti | ucyate | dvividhaṃ karma, antaraṅgaṃ bahiraṅgaṃ ca | tatra dravyakarmāntaraṅgam, tenaiva ca pūrvaṃ saṃbandhaḥ | bahiraṅgaṃ kālādilakṣaṇaṃ karma | yad vakṣyate | śaktipramāṇa....... ityādiślokena | tatra sakarmakatvākarmakatvavyapadeśo'ntaraṅgeṇaina nyāyyaḥ | tathā coktamakarmakāṇāmityucyata ityādinā bhāṣyeṇa | evaṃ ca lādibhirapyantaraṅage bhāvyamityantaraṅgabahiraṅgatāmevāha `ādhāra' iti | godohaṃ svapiti | yāvatā kālena gavāṃ dohaḥ samāpyata iti kośādiḥ punaḥ svakālaparimāṇena kriyāntaraṃ paricchinatti | deśo'pi kutaścidavadheḥ prāpyamāṇatayā paricchinnakālasvāpādiviśeṣaheturiti bhinnāḥ kālādayaḥ | eteṣāṃ kālādīnāṃ sarvairevākarmakaiḥ sakarmakaiścāpi dhātubhiryoge prākṛtameva karmatvamupajāyata iti naiṣāṃ karmasaṃjñopasaṃkhyeyetyarthaḥ | tathā hi | na dvitīyāvidhānārthameva karmasaṃjñātra, api tu lādyarthā api | tathā ca "kālādhvanoratyantasaṃyoge" ityatra vārttikam "atyantasaṃyoge karmavallādyartham" iti | lakṛtyakhalarthā api saṃjñāphalabhiṣyanta ityarthaḥ | atra kriyāntarasya vyāptilakṣaṇasyāpyāsyādidhātubhiraṅgīkṛtatvād vyāptikriyāviṣayabhāvopagamanena māsādi prāpyaṃ karmepsitatamameveti prākṛtamevaitat karma yathā ghaṭaṃ karoti śakaṭaṃ karotīti bhāṣya uktam | tathāhi, māsamāste, godohamāste, krośaṃ svapiti, kurun svapitīti vyāpanāṅgamāsanādi dhātubhirabhidhatte māsaṃ vyāpyāste, māsamāsanayā vyāpnotītyarthaḥ | evamanyatra yathāyogaṃ yojyam | tadyathā valāhakādvidyotate vidyuditi niḥsaraṇāṅge vidyotane dhāturvartate tathātra prāptyaṅge'rthe dhātorvṛttiḥ | kriyāntaramevedamantarbhūta vyāptikaṃ kālādiviṣayam | devadattaḥ ki karoti, āsta ityatra tu vyāptirahite dhāturāsanamātre vartate | tadetade yathāha ekadeśe samūhe vā vyāpārāṇāṃ pacādayaḥ | svabhāvataḥ pravartante tulyarūpasamanvitāḥ || pacati, pacyate svayameveti tathātra bodhyam | evaṃ copasaṃkhyānasya pratyākhyānādakarmakagrahaṇamanarthakam | sakarmakāṇāmapi māsamodanaṃ pacatītyādau māsādervyāptiviṣayatvena karmatāsiddhiḥ | māsamodanapākena vyāpnotītyatrārthaḥ | etadarthaṃ cātra sarvagrahaṇaṃ vyākhyātam | kālādikarmaṇā pacatyādīnāṃ dvikarmakatve'pi pradhāne dravyakarmaṇi lādividhiruktaḥ pradhānakarmaṇyākhyeye lādīnāhurdikarmaṇām | iti | satyapi vāsyādīnāṃ vyāptikriyāntarbhāve kaṭa āsta ityādau kaṭāderāsanayā vyāptirnāsti, api tu māsādirevāsanādikriyāparicchedāyopādīyamāno vyāpyata iti tasyaiva karmatā na tu kaṭāderupaśliṣṭamātrasyādhikaraṇasyeti sarvaṃ sustham || 67 ||
 kartṛkarmavyavadhānenādhāraḥ kriyāṃ dhārayati yathā, evaṃ māsādirapītyādhāracchāyāṃ bhajate | tathā hi udite juhoti, rātrau bhuṅ‌kte iti prayogaḥ | krośaṃ śete, `kurūn svapiti' iti ca sphuṭamevādhikaraṇatvamadhvadeśayoḥ kartṛdhāraṇāt | māsamodanaṃ pacatītyādau dravyakarmaviṣaye ca dravyakarmadhāraṇaṃ sphuṭameva | vyāptivivakṣāyāṃ tu karmatvamādhārabhāvasyāpagamanāditi iva śabdaḥ | yadvā kartṛkarmavyavadhānena yathādhāraḥ kriyāyogaṃ bhajate tathā dravyakarmavyavadhānena kālādītyupamārthaḥ | dravyakarmaṇā ca pūrvaṃ kriyāyogaḥ | taddvāreṇa tu kālādikarmaṇeti bhinnā kakṣyā avasthāsya karmatvasya | tathā hi śaktipramāṇasaṃkhyāderdravyadharmādviśiṣyate | kriyāsu kālayogo'taḥ prāgyogo dravyakarmaṇā || ityuktam | kaṭhinasya hi pākyadravyasya cireṇa niṣpattiḥ, mahāparimāṇasya bahusaṃkhyākasya ca viparītasya tvacireṇeti dravyakarmāpekṣaḥ kālādiviśeṣaḥ | evaṃ godohaṃ svapiti, iṣupātaṃ pacatītyatrāpi vācyam | kośamadhīte svādhyāyam, kurūn pañcālānadhīte ityatrādhyayanapracayāpacayāyattāvadhvadeśayorvṛddhihrāsāviti viprakṛṣyate kālādikarma kriyāsaṃbandhaṃ prati dravyakarmāpekṣayā | ata evottarakālabhavameteṣāṃ karmatvam | samastasādhanasaṃbandhe hi vṛtte kriyāyāḥ paricchedahetavaḥ kālādayo'pekṣyante iti bhinnakakṣyāste `akathitaṃ ca'  ityuttareṇa yogena karmasaṃjñāṃ labhante, nepsitatamatvena, īpsāprakarṣābhāvāt | duhyādiparigaṇane cākathitasūtre "kālabhāvādhvagantavyāḥ karmasaṃjñā hyakarmaṇām deśaśca |  ityatraivoktam | guṇapradhānasannidhau ca pradhānameva kāryeṇa yujyata iti dravyakarmaṇi lādividhiḥ | māsamodanaḥ pacyate, pakvaḥ, paktavyaḥ, supacaḥ krośamadhīto'nuvāka ityādyudāhāryam | dvitīyā tu bhinnaśabdopādānā kālādikarmaṇyapi bhavati | eko hi lādirguṇapradhānabhūtaṃ karmadvayamaśakto'bhidhātumiti pradhāne kāryasampratyayaḥ | bhinnarūpaprātipadikadvayāttu vibhaktirutpadyamānā karmadvayamapi pratyāyayati | yataśca kālādīnāṃ sarvadhātuviṣayaṃ bhinnakakṣyaṃ ca karmatvam, atastaiḥ karmabhirdhāturyukto'dravyairakarmakaḥ | lasya karmaṇi bhāve ca nimittatvāya kalpate || 69 ||
 yatrāsti dravyakarma tatra tadapekṣayā kālādikarmaṇo'pradhānyāllādistatra na bhavati | yatra tu dravyakarmaṃ nāsti tatra kālādāveva karmaṇi lādiḥ | lagrahaṇasyopalakṣaṇārthatvācca | lakṛtyaktakhalarthāḥ āsyate māsaḥ, āsitavyaḥ , āsitaḥ svāsa ityādi | akarmakavyāpadeśaśca dhātūnā dravyakarmābhāvanimittaḥ, kālādikarmaṇaḥ sarvatra saṃbhavāt, saṃbhavyabhicārābhyāṃ viśeṣaṇayogāt, iti kālādikarmasaṃbhave'pyakarmakavyapadeśasya dravyakarmābhāvanimittasyāvyāvṛtterbhāve lakāraḥ siddhyati, māsamāsyate bhavatetyādi | māsamāsito devadatta iti cākarmakatvāt kartari ktaḥ | gatyādisūtre cākarmakatvāśrayā prayojyasya karmasaṃjñā siddhayati māsamāsayati devadattamityādau | ata eva tatra "akarmakagrahaṇe kālakarmaṇāmupasaṃkhyānam" "siddhaṃ tu kālakarmaṇāmakarmakavad‌vacanāt" iti vārttikārtho nyāyasiddhaḥ | tathā ca bhāṣyam | "na ca kecit kālabhāvādhvabhirakarmakāḥ | ta evaṃ vijñāsyāmaḥ kvacidye akarmakā iti | athavā yena karmaṇa sakarmakāścākarmakāśca bhavanti tenākarmakāṇām | na caitena karmaṇā kaścidapyakarmakaḥ | atha vā yatkarma bhavati na ca bhavati tenākarmakāṇām | na caitat karma kvacidapi na bhavati |" iti | parihāratraye ko viśeṣaḥ | ucyate | śabdakarmākarmakāṇāmityatra avivakṣitakarmakā akarmakā āśriyante | evaṃ hyāste śethe iti kriyāmātravivakṣāyāṃ kālādibhirapyakarmakatvaṃ saṃbhavati | tathaiva pacādīnāmapyavivakṣayā karmasaṃbandhe'pākṛte aṇi karturṇau karmasaṃjñāprasaṅgaḥ | tasmādyasyātyantamasaṃbandhaḥ karmaṇā so'karmakaḥ | sa ca yadi dhātvartha āśrīyate tadā tasya kriyātmano vivakṣāvaśena karmasaṃbandhāsaṃbandhayorbhede kālādibhirapyakarmakatve vacanasya caritārthatvaṃ bhavet | tasmādavidyamāne karmāsyeti dhāturanyapadārthatvenāśrīyate | gatyādyarthatvenāṇau ṇāviti ca tasyaiva viśeṣaṇatvena prakramāt | rthadvārake ca dhātoḥ karmayoge'yoge ca rūpasyāviśeṣāt akarmakatvaṃ nopapadyate , kālādikarmabhiḥ sarveṣāṃ dhātūnāmaviyogāt | evaṃ ca viśeṣaṇasāmarthyād viśiṣṭā eva dhātavo dravyakarmasamanvayarahitāḥ samāśrīyante | dravyakarmaviṣaye'karmakā iti pūrvaparihārārthaḥ | dvitīye tu parihāre vartipadārthasya karmaṇaḥ sākṣāt kriyopakārakatvenāntaraṅgatvaṃ viśeṣaḥ samāśritaḥ | tṛtīye tu parihāre bhavati na bhavatītyabhidhānānniṣidhyamānasya saṃbandhasya viśeṣa āśrīyate | yena karmaṇā kadācit saṃbandho bhavati tenaiva dravyakarmaṇā akarmakāṇām, na nityasaṃbaddhena kālādikarmaṇetyarthaḥ | dravyakarmāpekṣatvācca sakarmakākarmakavyapadeśasya | "udaścaraḥ sakarmakāt " ityanena māsamuccarati dhūma ityātmanepadaṃ na bhavatītyāhuḥ || 69 ||
na ca kālādikarmaiva bhinnakakṣyam ,api tu sarvaṃ vākathitaṃ karma bhinnakakṣyaṃ pratīyate | dhātvarthoddeśabhedena tannepsitatamaṃ kila || 70 ||
 gāṃ dogvi payaḥ, pauravaṃ gāṃ yācate, gāmavarumaddhi vrajam , māṇavakaṃ panthānaṃ pṛcchati, vṛkṣamavacinoti phalāni, ityādi sarvamevāpādānādiviśeṣakathābhirakathitam | dravyakarmāpi gavādi payaḥprabhṛtipradhānakarmāpekṣayopāyabhūtaṃ nāntarīyakatvād bhinnakakṣyam | dhātvarthasya hi dohādeḥ uddeśa eva bhedo viśeṣaḥ tena hetunā gavādīpsāprakarṣarahitam | payaḥprabhṛti kiloddiṣya dhātvarthaḥ pravṛttaḥ | tatra tūpāyabhūtā gavādayo nāntarīyakāḥ | dhātvarthena voddeśo viṣayīkaraṇaṃ tasya bhedaḥ pūrvāparakālajam | pūrvaṃ hi dhātvarthena pradhānaṃ payaḥprabhṛti viṣayīkṛtaṃ paścānnimittabhūtaṃ gavādi | dhātvarthaṃ vā dohādikamuddiśya yasmād gavādayo bhedenopāyatvena pravartante, ataste bhinnakakṣyāḥ | `kila' ityasmin pakṣe'ruciṃ sūcayati | tathā cābhinnameva karmeti siddhantayiṣyati | nanu kālādīnāṃ dravyakarmāyattatvād bhavatu bhinnakakṣyatvam, gavādau tu viparyayāt kathametat | tathā hi gavādyāyattāni payaḥprabhṛtīni karmāṇi | tathā coktam--- "guṇakarmaṇi lādividhiḥ pūrvaṃ guṇakarmaṇā bhavati yogaḥ | mukhyaṃ karma prepsuryasmādgavyeva yatate prāk | tasmācchuddhasya duherbhavati gavā pūrvameva saṃbandhaḥ || gorduhinā payasastu prāk, tasmāllādayastasmin "  iti | satyametat | pradhānāpradhānakṛtastavatra kakṣyābhedaḥ || 70 ||
tathā hi pradhānakarma kathitaṃ yat kriyāyāḥ prayojakam | tatsiddhaye kriyāyuktamanyattvakathitaṃ smṛtam || 71 ||
 yadudviśya phalabhūtaṃ kriyāpravartane sādhanāni sajjībhavanti yadavāptāvudāsate tadīpsāprakarṣagṛhītaṃ pradhānaṃ karturīpsitatamamiti karmasaṃjñayā prathamameva kathitam | tacca payaḥprabhṛti tadarthaṃ tu yadanīpsitamapi nāntarīyakaṃ kriyayā samanveti tadanavārtaviśeṣamakathitakarmāpradhānatvād bhinnakakṣyamityarthaḥ | tadyathā gavādi | evamaprādhānye'pi copāyatvāt prathamaṃ kriyāyoge lādividhau nimittatvāya kalpate| anapekṣite tu payasi gaureva pradhānam, kṣīravicchedastu tasya mā bhūdityevamanarthyapi kṣīreṇa samprati gosaṃskārārthaṃ dohe pravartata iti | apādānamuttārāṇi  gāṃ dogdhi' ityudāharaṇamupapadyate vipratiṣedhena | anyathākathitakarmatve'pādānādisaṃjñā prāpt‌yabhāvāt kathaṃ vipratiṣedhodāharaṇametadbhavet | apādānādiviśeṣakathābhirasaṃspṛṣṭaṃ hyakathitaṃ karma | tadevaṃ nimittanimittibhāvenāvasthitatvād bhinnakakṣyatve kathitākathitayoḥ karmaṇorbhedādaprāptā gavādīnāṃ karmasaṃjñā akathitaṃ ca | ityanenārabhyata iti sthitam || 71 ||
idānīm "nīvahyorharateścāpi gatyarthānāṃ tathaiva ca | dvikarmakeṣu grahaṇaṃ draṣṭavyamiti niścayaḥ |"iti bhāṣyoktaṃ vyācaṣṭe | duhyādivannayatyādau karmatvamakathāśrayam | ākhyātānupayoge tu niyamāccheva iṣyate || 72 ||
 ajāṃ nayati grāmam, edhān vahati nagaram, harati bhāraṃ saṃvāham | gatyarthagrahaṇena gatibuddhītyādinā yeṣāṃ dvikarmakatvaṃ te lakṣyante | `tathaiva ca ityanenānuktasamuccayārthena jayatyādayo gṛhyante, jayati śataṃ śatānīkam sa gargān daṇḍayati śatamiti | atrepsāprakarṣayuktamajādikarma kathitaṃ pradhānaṃ payovat | grāmādi tvavadhisthānīyatvāt guṇakarma gavādivadeva nāntarīyakatvādakathitakarmaiva draṣṭavyam parigaṇanalakṣaṇena tu niyamenākhyātānupayoge karmasaṃjñayā vyāvartyate | naṭasya śṛṇotītyādau naṭādirupayoge hyakhyātāpādānamityanupayoge viśeṣakathānākrāntatvād bhavedakathitakarmeti parigaṇanalakṣaṇāniyamāccheṣo'ḍayaṃ ṣaṣṭhīviṣayaḥ || 72 ||
tadevaṃ pradhānetarabhāvena karmabhāva uktaḥ | kecittu pradhānamekamevedaṃ karmetyāhuḥ | tathāhi antarbhūtaṇijarthānāṃ duhyādīnāṃ ṇijantavat | siddhaṃ pūrveṇa karmatvaṃ ṇijantaṃ niyamastathā || 73 ||
 antarbhūto vācyatayā ṇico'rthaḥ prayojakavyāpāraḥ praiṣalakṣaṇo yeṣāṃ duhiyāciprabhṛtīnāṃ teṣāṃ prayoge gāṃ dogvi paya ityādau "karturīpsitatamam" ityanenaiva gavādīnāmapi siddhā karmasaṃjñā | yathā "gamayati grāmaṃ devadattaṃ yajñadattaḥ" ityatra ṇijantaviṣaye prayojyasya prayojakavyāpāreṇāpyamānatvāditi `gatibuddhi' iti ca niyamārthaṃ sūtraṃ gamyādīnāmeva ṇyantānāṃ prayojyaḥ karma, nānyeṣāṃ pacyādīnāmityaṇyantaviṣaye'tra na pravartate | tathā hi gauḥ payaḥ kṣarati, devadattaḥ tāṃ kṣarantīṃ kṣārayati,iti duherarthaḥ | tatra kṣaraṇenāpyamānatvāt payaḥ karma, kṣāraṇenāpyamānatvād gauḥ | yadyapi cārthena rūpeṇa payaḥ pradhānabhūtam , upāyabhūtā tu gauḥ tathāpyābhidheyakena kṣaramopasarjanasya kṣāraṇasya śabdārthatvād gaureva pradhānaṃ karmeti tatraiva lādayaḥ, duhyate gauḥ, payaḥ dogdhavyā, dugdhā, sudohā, iti | "apradhāne duhādīnām" ityārthena rūpeṇāprādhānyamucyate yadyapyapāyavivakṣāṃ vinā kṣāraṇaṃ nopapadyate tathāpi "apādānamuttarāṇi" iti karmasaṃjñaivātra bhavati paratvāt | yadi hyakathitasūtreṇa karmasaṃjñātrocyeta tadāpādānatvāt kathitatvenāsau na syāt | pūrvasūtreṇaiva tu karmasaṃjñāyāmubhayasaṃbhave paratvād `apādānamuttarāṇi, "gāṃ dodhi" ityuktam | tathā cātrāparādānavivakṣāvarṇanamasamīcīnam | evaṃ pauravaṃ gāṃ yācate, dāpayatītyarthaḥ | pauravo gāṃ dadāti, taṃ prayuṅkte yācakaḥ śraddhotpādanena iti yācerṇyarthaḥ praiṣo vācyatvenāntarbhūtaḥ | yācanasya gauḥ karma, praiṣasya tu gauḥ | yadā tu sthāpayatītyarthaḥ tadā vrajasyādhikaraṇatā, ubhayasaṃjñāprasaṅge tu paratvāt karmasaṃjñoktā, adhikaraṇaṃ karma gehaṃ praviśatīti praveśopasarjanamatra sthānamarthaḥ gehaṃ praveśanena vyāpya tiṣṭhatīti | nimittanimittibhāvena praveśasthāne pratīyete | tatra praveśāpekṣayā karma sthānāpekṣayādhikaraṇamityubhayaprāptau paratvātkarmodāhṛtam | māṇavakaṃ panthānaṃ pṛcchati iti ācaṣṭe panthānaṃ māṇavakaḥ, taṃ prayuṅkte ākhyāpayatītyarthaḥ | ācikhyāsati vā māṇavakaḥ, taṃ prayuṅkte ācikyāpayiṣatītyarthaḥ | evaṃ pauravo gāṃ ditsati, taṃ prayuṅkte yācaka ityapyartho'vagamyayate | evaṃ bhikṣerapyartho veditavyaḥ | vṛkṣamavacinoti phalāni, muñcati vṛkṣaḥ phalāni , taṃ mocayatītyarthaḥ | apāyavivakṣāyāmapi `apādānamuttarāṇi' iti karmasaṃjñaivātra | māṇavakaṃ dharmaṃ brūte, pratipādayatītyarthaḥ | tatra pratipatterdharmaḥ karma, praiṣasya tu māṇavakaḥ | `māṇavakamanuśāsti dharmam' iti | śikṣate dharmaṃ māṇavakaḥ, taṃ śikṣayatadītyarthaḥ | karmaṇābhipreyamāṇasya tu māṇavarasyātra saṃpradānasaṃjñāyāṃ pradhānavyāpāraviṣayayā karmasaṃjñayātra saṃpradānasaṃjñā bādhyata iti vaktavyam | yadvā karturyadīpsitatamaṃ karma tenābhiprayemāṇasya saṃpradānasya saṃpradānatvam | yathopādhyāyāya gāṃ dadātīti | gaurhi dāturvallabhā | tata eva guṇavate dīyate | dharmastu karturnābhimataḥ , pūrvameva siddheḥ | tena tu māṇavako'nugrahītumabhipreta iti prayojyasyātropsitatamaṃ karma, na prayojakasyeti na saṃpradānasaṃjñāyā viṣayo'yamityanye | evaṃ nayatyādāvapi pūrvasūtreṇaiva karmatvam | ajāṃ nayati grāmam, prāpayatītyarthaḥ | prāpaṇena pradhānena saṃbaddhājā pradhānaṃ karmeti "pradhānakarmaṇyākhyeye lādīnāhurdvikarmaṇām"  iti nyāyasiddham, ajā nīyate grāmam, netavyā nītā, sunayeti | evamanyatrāpi yatāyogamudāhāryam | satyapi cātra ṇyarthāntarbhāve gatyādiniyamena prayojyasya karmasaṃjñā na vyāvartyate sajātīyāpekṣatvānniyamasya, anyatra ṇyanta eva tena nivāraṇāt | atra ca praiṣo ṇyartho dhātunaiva svīkṛta iti ṇic na bhavati || 73 ||
nanu ca vāstavena rūpeṇa payaādeḥ prādhānyāttasyaivepsitatamatvaṃ nyāyyam, na tu gavādeḥ pratīyamānopasarjanabhūtakriyāpekṣamīpsitatamatvaṃ yujyate pradānasannidhāne guṇasyepsāprakarṣaviṣayatvābhāvāt | na ca kārakaprakaraṇe `sādhakatamaṃ karaṇam'  iti tamab‌grahaṇāt prakarṣo na vivakṣyate iti śakyate tatra vaktum, `īpsitatamam' iti sākṣāt prakarṣavivakṣārthaṃ tamap‌śruterupādānāt | liṅgasya tvanyatra kṛtārthatvam | gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣa ityādāvadhikaraṇasaṃjñā yathā syāditi | śrutyā hi liṅgabāṃdhā | `śrutiliṅgavākyaprakaraṇasthānasamākhyānāṃ pūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ balīyo'rthaviprakarṣāditi nyāyavidbhiruktatvāt kataṃ gavādeḥ pūrveṇa karmasaṃjñetyāśaṅkyāha--- karaṇasya svakakṣyāyāṃ na prakarṣāśrayo yathā | karmaṇo'pi svakakṣyāyāṃ na syādatiśayastathā || 74 ||
 yathā kārakāntarāpekṣayā labdhātiśayasya karaṇasaṃjñāyāṃ sajātīyakaraṇāntarāpekṣayā prakarṣo nāśrīyate, yena sarvasyaiva karaṇakāryaṃ pravartate, aśvena pathā dīpikayā yāti, padābhyāṃ pathā vrajati, balena pādenādatta iti | anyathā aśvādereva prakṛṣṭatamasya bhavediti | tathā karmaṇo'pi | karaṇādīnāmapi kriyāyāmupayogādīpsitatamatvamiti iti siddhā nimittanimittibhāvavasthitasyāpi sarvasya karmaṇaḥ pūrveṇova yogena kamasaṃjñeti nāstyakathitakarmetyekīyamatenopanyāsaḥ || 74 ||
etattu na yuktamityāha | karmaṇastvāptumiṣṭatva āśrite'tiśayo yataḥ | āśrīyate tato'tyantaṃ bhedaḥ pūrveṇa karmaṇā || 75 ||
 iha sādhanabhāvasya sarvakārakaviṣayatvād yuktaṃ yatkārakāntarāpekṣayā labdhātiśayasādhanabhāvaṃ karaṇaṃ svakakṣyāgataṃ prakarṣaṃ nādriyeta | karma tvīpsāprakarṣabhāvaṃ kārakāntarāpekṣayā pratipattumamasartham | na hi kārakāntarāṇīpsitāni | kartrā kriyayā yadāptavyaṃ tadīpsitam | kārakāntarāṇi tu kriyāyai karaṇīdīnyāptavyāni, na tu kriyayā | tasmāttulyajātīyāpekṣatvādatiśayasya karmaṇa āptumiṣṭatamatvaṃ īpsitamityevamāptumabhipretatve āśrīyate | tamapa upādānādatiśayo yasmādaṅgīkriyate tasmādīpsitārthāntarāpekṣa evāsau prakarṣo'bhyupagantavya iti svakakṣyāgata eva saḥ | tathā ca payaḥprabhṛti gavādīpsitāpekṣayā prakaṣṭamīpsitaṃ pūrvayogasya viṣayo gavādestu pūrveṇāsiddhāyāṃ karmasaṃjñāyāmakathitamityanena siddhirityeṣa eva pakṣo nyāyyaḥ | tataścabhinnakakṣyaṃ karmadvayameva tat | svakakṣyāpekṣe'nāśrite tu karmaṇaḥ prakarṣe tamapaśrutiranarthikā syāt | tathā cepsitamātrasya karmasaṃjñāyāṃ `vāraṇārthānāmīpsitaḥ' ityatra yavebhyo gāṃ vārayati, kūpādandhaṃ vārayati, agnermāṇakkaṃ vārayatītyudāharaṇaṃ na syāt | yavodarapi karmasaṃjñāprasaṅgāt | tataścaitat sūtraṃ nirviṣayaṃ bhavediti viṣayavibhāgārthaṃ karmāpādānayoḥ svakakṣyāgataḥ karmaṇo'tiśayaḥ siddhāntitaḥ | tathā ca vārtikam--- "vāraṇārthānāṃ karmānarthakyaṃ karturīpatitatamaṃ karmeti vacanāt"  bhāṣyamapi | yattu kathitaṃ purastād īpsitayuktaṃ ca tasya siddhyarthamīpsitatamagrahaṇam iti vāraṇārthānāmityanena kathitamiti `akathitaṃ ca' ityanenāndhāderīpsitena kūpādinā yuktasya karmasaṃjñā na siddhyatīti `īpsitatamam' ityanena siddhyatītyarthaḥ | yatpuranīpsitamātramapādānādisaṃjñābhirakathitaṃ tasyākathitasūtreṇa gavādeḥ karmasaṃjñeti bhāṣye'bhihitam | īpsitameva tu yat syāt tasya bhaviṣyatyakathiteneti || 75 ||
yat punaretaduktaṃ duhyādīnāṃ ṇijantavat siddhaṃ pūrveṇa karmatvamiti tatrāpyāha | ṇijante ca yathā kartā sakriyaḥ san prayujyate | nayatyādau tathā kartā niṣkiyo'pi prayujyate || 76 ||
 gamayati grāmaṃ devadattamityādau ṇijante prakṛtipratyayavācye dve kriye bhinne pratīyate iti tadapekṣaṃ dvayoḥ karmatvaṃ yujyate | gāṃ dogdhi paya ityādau tu prakṛtivācyaikaiva kriyeti kathaṃ karmadvayayogaḥ | na cāpyantarbhūtaṇijarthatvena tadupapattiḥ | ṇijarthasyātrāyogāt | praiṣo hi ṇijarthaḥ | sa ca pravṛttakriyasya savyāpārasya karturupapadyate | tathā hi tasya svatantrasya prayojako yo hetuḥ tadvayāpāro ṇijuktaḥ | ata evāpravṛttikriyāṇāṃ karaṇādīnāṃ prayojakasya svatantrasya karturhetusaṃjñā na bhavati | tadevaṃ gavāderniṣkriyatvānna tadvayāpāreṇāpyamānatvāt payaādeḥ karmatā, api tu dohena devadatta vyāpāreṇaiva gopayasordvayorapi āpyamānatvamityatiśayayogāt payaādoreva pūrveṇa karmatvam, gavādestvakathitamityanenārabhyate || 76 ||
nanu ca yathā gacchantaṃ saṃprayukte gamayatīti prayogaḥ tathā kṣarantīṃ kṣārayati dogdhi ityartha ityāśaṅkyāha | bhedavākyaṃ tu yat ṇyante nīduhitaprakṛtau ca yat | śabdāntaratvānnaivāsti saṃsparśastasya dhātunā || 77 ||
 gacchantaṃ prayuṅkte ityādinā gamayatītyādau ṇyante prakṛtipratyayārthayorvibhāgapradarśanāya yad vākyam, grāmaṃ prāpnuvantīmajāṃ prayuṅkate , kṣarantīṃ gāṃ prayuṅkte ityādi ca nayati dogdhi ityādau prayogācchabdāntaraṃ bhinnārthameva | na hyeṣo'tra dhātvarthaḥ paramārthataḥ, adūraviprakarṣeṇārthamātrakathanametat | yathā rājapuruṣādau rājñaḥ puruṣa ityādi | tathā hi gacchantaṃ prayuṅkta ityādau vākye prayojyakarturnidarśanaṃ gamayatītyādau ṇyante prayojyakriyāmātraṃ pratīyate | prayojyastu svaśabdopādāno devadattamiti | yatra caitad bhedavākyaṃ vidūraṃ ṇyante tatra nayatyādīnāṃ sutarāṃ vidūratā | na hyatra vākyārtho dhātūpādānaḥ kaścit | atastasya vākyasya vākyārthasya vā duhādidhātunā nāsti saṃbandhaḥ | tasmānnātra ṇyarthāntarbhāva iti kriyādvayāśrayeṇāpi karmaviśeṣasamarthanamasamīcīnam | tadevamekaiveyaṃ vilakṣaṇā karmadvayaviṣayā kriyeti sarvaṃ cākathitaṃ karma bhinnakakṣyaṃ pratīyate | dhātvarthoddeśabhedena tannepsitatamaṃ kila || ityeṣa pakṣo'vasthāpitaḥ | aprādhānye'pi cākathitakarmaṇo'ntaraṅgatvāt prathamaṃ kriyāyogāllādividhiruktaḥ | nayatyādau tu prādhānyamajāderiti tatraiva lādayaḥ | ṇyante tu ṇyarthasya prādhānyāttenāpyamānatvāt kartaiva pradhānaṃ karmeti tatraiva lādayaḥ | tataśca pradānakarmaṇyākhyeye lādīnāhurdvikarmaṇām | apradhāne duhādīnāṃ ṇyante kartuśca karmaṇaḥ || iti nyāyasiddhamidamudāhṛtam || 77 ||
idānīṃ siddhāntamud‌ghāṭayati | yathaivaikamapādānaṃ śāstre bhedena darśatam | tathaikameva karmāpi bhedena pratipāditam || 78 ||
 dhruvamapāye  ityanenaiva sarvatrāpādānasaṃjñā bhāṣye'pi pratipāditā | bhītrārthādiviṣaye'pi bauddhāpāyasya bhāvāt | abudhabodhanārthaṃ hi `bhītrārthānām'  ityādinā bhedena kathanam | tathā ca vakṣyati | nirdhāraṇe vibhakte yo bhītrāryānāṃ ca yo vidhiḥ | upāttāpekṣitāpāyaḥ so'budhapratipattye || iti | evaṃ karmāpīpsitatamamekameva, kartuḥ kriyayāpyamānatvasya sarvatra bhāvāt | mandabuddhayanugrahāya tūttarasūtraprapañca iti kārikārthaḥ | yadyapi ca payaḥprabhṛtyarthaṃ gavāderupādānaṃ tathāpyastyeva dhātvarthena tasyāpyamānatvam | tadyathā taṇḍulānodanaṃ pacatīti | akṣa taṇḍulānāṃ viklittiviśiṣṭā hi vikledanā pacerarthaḥ | tatra viklittyākhyaguṇadvāreṇa taṇḍulā api karma vikledanasya, sākṣāttvodanam | taṇḍulan vikledayanodanaṃ nirvartayatītyarthaḥ | itthaṃ ca guṇapradhānabhūtaikadhātuvācyakriyābhedāśrayeṇātra yathā karmabhedaḥ tatā kṣaraṇopasarjanakṣāraṇārthatāyāṃ duhergopayasī samameva karmabhāvamanubhavataḥ | tathā ca ṇyarthāntarbhāvo'pi yuktaḥ | ṇyante'pi prakṛtyarthaviśiṣṭasya pratyayārthasya prādhānyānniṣkriyatvaṃ svatantrasya | na hyatra ṇic kriyate yena sakriyasya prayogastu yadā sa viṣayo ṇicaḥ | iti nyāyo'nuvarṇyeta | dhātuvācyastu ṇyarthaḥ | tadyathā sādhayatīti ṇyarthaḥ pacativācyaḥ, bhedavākyaṃ tu bhavatyadūraviprakṛṣṭaṃ bhinnārthamatyantaviśeṣāpekṣayā | sāmānyapekṣayā tvekārthameva rājapuruṣavṛttivākyavat | tathā ca pratīyata evaitadvākyārtho'tra prayoge | na cāpi gavādīnāṃ niṣkriyatvaṃ nyāyyaṃ kriyāsamavāyabhāve kārakatvābhāvāt | ārabhyamāṇe'pyakathitayoge karmasaṃjñā na syāt | prāk prayogānniṣkriyatvamiti cet ṇyante'pi samānametat | yathā ca tatra saṃbhāvitakriyasya kartuḥ prayojaka iti tad‌vyāpāropapattiḥ tathātreti na kiṃcidavadyam | tamab‌grahaṇasya ca pratyākhyānādīpsāprakarṣānāśrayaṇam | yattu tamab‌grahaṇasyodāharaṇaṃ `dadhnā bhuñjīya' iti tatra samakakṣyatayā dadhyodanayorīpsitatve tamab‌grahaṇamakiṃcit‌karam | saṃskārakatve hi dadhnastat‌saṃskṛtasyaudanasyaivepsitatamatvamiti nāstyetadudrāharaṇam | tathā ca bhāṣyam | "tasyāpyodana evepsitaḥ, na tu guṇeṣvasyādaraḥ" iti | yadapi karmāpādānayorviṣayavibhāgapradarśanārthaṃ tamab‌grahaṇamityuktaṃ tatrāpi vāraṇārthānāṃ vārayitavyānāṃ vāraṇamarthayanta iti vāraṇayogyānāṃ yadīpsitaṃ tadapādānamityevaṃ vyākhyānādadoṣaḥ | tathā hi vārayitavyāḥ pratiṣeddhavyāḥ gavādayaḥ; teṣāmīpsitā yavādaya evāpādānam | tadevamīpsitameva sarvaṃ karma | itthaṃ ca duhyādyudāharaṇārthaṃ na parigaṇanametat | naṭasya śṛṇotītyādau naṭādi śṛṇotikriyayā nimittamātraṃ na tu tayepsitatvena vivakṣyata iti karmasaṃjñābhāvaḥ | śṛṇotikriyāyāṃ ca savyāpāro naṭaḥ kārakamupayogagrahaṇādapādānasaṃjñāyā vyudasyate | na cānyā saṃjñāsya vihiteti śeṣo'yaṃ ṣaṣṭhīviṣayaḥ | hetutṛtīyāyāstvayamaviṣayaḥ anāśrite tu vyāpāre nimitte heturiṣyate | dravyādiviṣayo hetuḥ kārakaṃ niyatakriyam || iti vacanāt || 78 ||
nanu nirvartyādibhedaḥ karmaṇo'bhihita iti kathamekameva karmetyāśaṅkyāha | nirvartyo vā vikāryo vā prāpyo vā sādhanāśrayaḥ | kriyāṇāmeva sādhyatvāt siddharūpo'bhidhīyate || 79 ||
 iha sādhanāśrayaḥ śaktyādhāro niṣpannarūpo nāmapadairucyate | ākhyātapadaistu sādhyasvabhāvaḥ kriyātmārtho'bhidhīyata iti kriyādravyayoḥ siddhasādhyāsvabhāvarūpaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ śabdapratipādyena tadrūpeṇa kathyate | yad bhāṣyam--- "kriyā caiva hi bhāvyate, svabhāvasiddhaṃ dravyam"  iti | tathā ca kaṭaṃ karoti, taṇḍulānodanaṃ pacati, sūryaṃ paśyati iti nāmapadaiḥ karma śaktyādhāramavilakṣaṇaṃ siddhatayā pratyāyyata iti nāsti tasya svarūpabhedaḥ svagataḥ | kriyārthatvācca vastutaḥ sādhānānāṃ kriyādharmeṇa vyapadeśaḥ | nirvṛttivipariṇatiprāptilakṣaṇā hi kriyāḥ svasāmarthyāyattamupakāraṃ karmaṇi darśayantyo vibhinnavyapadeśanimittatāmāsādayanti | evaṃ ca kṛtvā śābdena rūpeṇa siddhatvāt karmaṇaḥ sādhanamāvo'pyupapadyate | kriyāviśeṣāveśitavyāpadeśabhedānāśraye tu kriyāviṣayakārakanimittatayepsitamityeva sāmānyākhyayā sarvaṃ karma kathyata iti siddham || 79 ||
gatamadaḥ | iha kathamīpsitatvam, `viṣaṃ bhakṣayati', `corān paśyati ' ityāśaṅkyāha | ahiteṣu yatā laulyāt karturicchopajāyate | viṣādiṣu bhayādibhyastathaivāsau pravartate || 80 ||
 vāyvādidhātuvaiṣamyanimitteṣu yatā''turasya hitamiti bhojananiyamāsahiṣṇorabhilāṣo bhavati tathā svāmyādibhayaparipīḍitasya kṣetriyavyādhiduḥkhārtasya vā paraṃ viṣabhakṣaṭhameva jyāya iti manyamānasya bhavati viṣaṃ bhakṣaṇenepsitamiti tathāyuktaṃ cānīpsitam |  ityetadapi karma pūrveṇaiva siddham | tadāha bhāṣyakāraḥ | "yaca eṣa manuṣyo duḥkhārto bhavati so'nyāni duḥkhānyanuniśamya viṣabhakṣa ṇameva jyāyo manyate |" iti | `laulyāt ' iti | na prekṣāpūrvakāritāghaṭitā sarvatrepsā, api tu prakārāntareṇāpi sambhavatītyarthaḥ | bhakṣaṇakriyāviṣayabhāvāpattirevātrepsitatvaṃ tathāyuktagraha ṇādevāvasīyate | sūtrāraṃbhe'pi paropahitaṃ cāvijñātaviṣabhāvaḥ bhakṣyamāṇīpsitameva viṣam | evaṃ dṛśikriyayā corādīpsitameva | yadīpsitādanyannaivepsitaṃ nānīpsitaṃ vṛkṣamūlādi tadapi pūrvamanabhisaṃhitamapi tadānīmanupasarpaṇavelāyāmīpsitameva, anyathopasarpaṇakriyaviṣayabhāvameva nopeyāt | tamab‌grahaṇaṃ ca pratyākhyātamiti śramāpanodanārthaṃ grāmagamane'pyantarā vṛkṣamūlopasarpaṇamapi saṃhitamiti siddhyatīpsitamātrasya karmasaṃjñā pūrveṇaiva | saṃjñāntarapūrva kamapi karmepsitamityeva sāmānyalakṣamena siddham | grāmamadhiśete, nagaramupatiṣṭhati, ityādāvupasargasaṃbandhe sakarmakatvāddhātūnāṃ paratvāt karmasaṃjñāyāmadhikaraṇaṃ karma gehaṃ praviśatītyuktam | anupasargatve'dhikaraṇasaṃjñā bhavati | akṣān dīvyati' iti vijigīṣopasarjanapātanavacane dīvyatāvīpsitatvamakṣāṇām, krīḍārthatve tu `akṣairdīvyati' iti karaṇatākṣāṇāmityubhayasiddhau samāveśārthaṃ sūtram--- `divaḥ karma ca '  iti | taduktaṃ vārtike `gatidivihetumatsu ca grahaṇam' iti | asati samāveśārthe sūtre karmasaṃjñāyā avakāśo `manasā dīvyati' iti | manasādeva iti karmaṇyaṇ‌pratyayaḥ | karaṇasaṃjñāyāstu devano'kṣa iti karaṇe lyuḍiti paratvād dvitīyāṃ bādhitvā tṛtīyaiva syāt | `manasastṛtīyāyāḥ' ityaluki, karaṇasaṃjñāyā apyavakāśo manasādeva ityetadevodāharaṇam | sūtrāraṃbhe tu cakārasahite saṃjñādvayasamāveśānyathānupapattyā dvitīyāpi siddhayati | evaṃ kudhadruhorapyanupasargayoḥ sampradānatā upasṛṣṭayostu paratvāt karmatetyevaṃjātīyameva karma prāgeva pratipāditamasmābhiḥ punarapi smāritam || 80 ||
gatametat | idamidānīṃ cintyate | iha karmadvayayoge prādhānyamārthamāśrityapradhāne lādiruktaḥ | dvitīyā tu prātipādikadvayādapyutpadyata iti tatra guṇapradhānabhūtakriyādvaya viṣayāyāmapi karmaśaktāvekasyā lādinoktatve'paraśak‌tyabhidhānāya dvitīyā kasmānnotpadyata ityāśaṅkyāha | pradhānetakayoryatra dravyasya kriyayoḥ pṛthak | śaktirguṇāśrayā tatra pradhānamanurudhyate || 81 ||
 ihārthānāmekavākyopāttānāṃ samanvayo bhavati | tatra dvayoḥ pradhānayoḥ samatvān mitho'ṅgāṅgibhāvo nopapadyate, nāpi dvayorguṇayoḥ "guṇānāṃ ca parārthatvādasaṃbandhaḥ samatvāt syāt"  iti | guṇapradhānabhāvena tu samanvayopapattāvekavākyatā bhavatītyāha--- `pradhānetarayoryatra' iti || 81 ||
tatra pradhānānumāyitvād guṇānāmapradhānakriyāviṣayakarmaśak‌tyabhidhāne dravyasya guṇakriyāviṣayāpyabhihitavat prakāśyata iti pradhānānurodhaṃ sāmānyenoktaṃ vyākhyātumāha | pradhānaviṣayā śaktiḥ pratyayenabhidhīyate | yadā guṇe tadā tadvadanuktāpi prakāśate || 82 ||
 pradhānakriyāvācino dhātorutpannena pratyayena lādinā yadā pradhānakriyāviṣayā karmaśaktiḥ pratyāyyate tadā guṇakriyāviṣayāpi sākṣād anuktāpi tadvat prakāśate itīyamanuvṛttirvyākhyātā | atrodāharaṇamāha | pacāvanuktaṃ yatkarma kttvānte bhāvābhidhāyini | bhujau śak‌tyantare'pyukte tattaddharmaḥ prakāśate || 83 ||
 `pak‌tvaudano bhujyate' ityudāharaṇam | atra k‌tvāpratyayasya tumarthaghaṇānuvṛtyā bhāṣyakāramatena bhāve vidhānam | vārtikakāro hi `ā ca tumunaḥ samānādhikaraṇe'  iti papāṭha | yathāvakāśaṃ `śakadhṛṣaḥ.....' ityādisūtravidhīyamānāj ā tumun‌pratyayādanuprayogadhātunā samānābhidheyā ṇamulādayaḥ pratyayā vaktavyā iti vārtikārthaḥ | tena `svāduṃkāraṃ bhujyate yavāgūrdevadattena iti ṇamulā karmābhidhānādyavāgūśabdād dvitīyā na bhavati | devadattaśabdācca tṛtīyā bhavati | anyathā kṛtatvāt kartari ṇamulutpattau devadattaśabdāttṛtīyā na syāt | anenaiva nyāyena `pakūtvau dano bhujyate' ityatrāpi k‌tvāpratyayo `bhujyate' ityanuprayogadhātu nā samānābhidheye karmaṇyevotpadyata iti nāsti kasyāścidapi sakteranabhidhānamitita vārtikakāramatenedamucyate | bhāṣyakārastu `pak‌tvaudanaṃ gamyate grāmaḥ " ityatrānena nyāyena dvitīyā na syāditi vārtikaṃ pratyācaṣṭe | tumarthagrahaṇānuvṛttyā ṇamulādīnāṃ bhāve vidhānaṃ manyate | tumartho hi bhāvaḥ | kṛt‌tvātkartari siddhe sek‌tvāprabhṛtīnāṃ tumartha iti vacanāt karturapakarṣaḥ | na cānyastumuno'rtho nirdiṣṭa ityanirdiṣṭārthāḥ pratyayāḥ svārthe bhavantīti svasyāḥ prakṛterartho bhāvaḥ siddhaḥ | evaṃ ktvānte `pak‌tvā' ityasmin bhāvavācini pacikriyāviṣayaudanasya karmaśaktiranuktā | bhujikriyāviṣayāyāṃ karmaśaktau lenābhihitāyāṃ tathaiva taddharmaḥ tasya pradhanasyaiva dharmaḥ pratyāyitatvalakṣaṇo yasya taddharmaḥ prakāśate iti dvitīyā na bhavatyodanāt | `pak‌tvaudanaṃ bhuṅkte ityatra pacikriyāpekṣādeva devadattāt kartulatṛtīyāpyasmānnyāyānna bhavati | pak‌vaudanaṃ gamyate grāma ityatra tu gamipratyayenaudanagatā karmaśaktirnābhihiteti bhavati dvitīyā | yadyapi ca sādhanaikārthasamavetāyāṃ saṃkhyāyāṃ bhujyata iti vibhaktirutpadyate tathāpi paciviṣayakarmopādhisaṃkhyānabhidhānād bhaved dvitīyeti nyāyo'yamuddhoṣyate | ekatvādiṣvapi hi vibhaktayartheṣyavaśyaṃ karmādayo'ṅgatvenāpekṣaṇīyāḥ || 83 ||
udāharaṇāntaramāha | iṣeśca gamisaṃsparśād grāme yo lo vidhīyate | tatroṣiṇaiva nirbhogaḥ kriyate gatikarmaṇaḥ || 84 ||
 `iṣyate grāmo gantum' ityudāharaṇam | atreṣerubhe karmaṇī, gamergrāma eveti grāmastheṣiviṣayāyāṃ karmaśartāvibhihitāyāṃ grāmaviṣayāpi tadvat prakāśate | tatra gamanārthameṣaṇām | tathā ca kriyāyāṃ kriyārthāyāmupapade tumunnati phalabhūtātra gamikriyā pradhānaṃ neṣiriti śaṅkyāmudāharaṇāntaramidam | ākhyātapadavācye hyarthe nirvartyatvāt pradhānatā vartate | pak‌tvā bhujyata ityatra tvārthamapi prādhānyamasti | pākasya bhojanārthatvāt | `gāmisaṃsparśād' iti | iṣerdravyāntarasaṃbandhaḥ kriyāntaramukhenaiva sarvadā bhavati | tadiha darśanādimukhena grāme icchā, api tvekavākyopāttagamidvāreṇetyarthaḥ | nirbhogaḥ carvaṇam, ākhyānam, iti yāvat | `iṣiṇaiva' iti | iṣipratyayena lakāreṇa karmaṇi vihitena | tantreṇa hi śaktidvayamapyabhidadhāti pratyaya iti vākyapadīye nirṇītam || 84 ||
matāntareṇāpyatropapattimāha | pak‌tvā bhujyata ityatra keṣāṃcinna vyapekṣate | odanaṃ pacatiḥ so'sāvanumānāt pratīyate || 85 ||
keṣāṃcinmate'tra vākye pacikriyaudanaṃ nāpekṣate | prathamāntasyaudanasya paktveti saṃbandhābhāvāt | bhujyate ityanenaiva saṃbandho bhavatyodanasyetyekaiva karmaśaktiḥ, sā cābhihiteti kvedamupatiṣṭhate pradhānaśak‌tyabhidhāne guṇakriyāśaktirabhihitavat prakāśata iti | yadi tarhi pacinaudanasyāsaṃbandhaḥ pak‌tvānyat kiṃcidodano bhujyata ityarthaḥ syāt | tathā ca vivakṣitamodanapākasya bhujyaṅgatvaṃ na pratīyetetyāśaṅkyāha `so'sāvanumānāt pratīyate' iti | sa iti parāmṛṣṭasyaudanasya buddhyā sākṣātkṛtasyāsāviti pratyakṣānukāreṇa pratinirdeśaḥ | sākṣātpacisamanvayāyogyo'pyodanaḥ sāmarthyāt pacerapekṣaṇīyatvena pratīyate | kiṃ sāmarthyamiti cet ekavākyatvamiti brūmaḥ | śrutasaṃbandho hyaśrutasaṃbandhaparikalpanāllaghuḥ | etacca satyeva guṇapradhānabhāve nānyatheti pūrvokta eva nyāyo'trāśrayaṇīyaḥ, iti pūrvoktameva darśanaṃ nyāyyam | ata evārucyānyamatatvenopanyāsaḥ kila | bhuji pākamapekṣata iti sannihitenaivākāṅkṣā pūrayitavyā | pākasya bhujyapekṣayā pūrvakālasyeti guṇapradhānabhāvopapattāvekavākyatopapattiḥ || 85 ||
na kevalaṃ karmākhyakārakaviṣayo'yaṃ nyāyaḥ, yāvat kārakāntare'pīti vyāptyarthamudāharaṇāntaramāha | tatrābhiniviśau karma yattiṅante'bhidhīyate | k‌tvānte'dhikaraṇatve'pi na tatrecchanti saptamīm || 86 ||
 `bhuk‌tvā nagaro'bhiniviśyate' ityatrāminiviśaśceti nagarasyābhiniviśerādhārasya karmasaṃjñāyāṃ tiṅntera'miniviśyata ityatra pradhānabhūte viṣaye'mihitā karmaśaktiḥ | bhuk‌tveti k‌tvāntaviṣaye'dhikaraṇaśaktirapi guṇatvāt svakāryaṃ saptamīvibhaktilakṣaṇaṃ na prayuṅkte | saptamyā hyatra pradhānakriyāviṣayā karmaśaktirna pratīyeteti pradhānoparodho guṇena kṛtaḥ syāt | na caiṣa nyāyyaḥ | pradhānānuyāpitvād guṇānāṃ pradhānavirodhini svakārye udāsata eva | prādhānyaṃ ca sarvatra tiṅntārthasya śābdavyavahāraviśrāntisthānasya vākyārthabhūtasya | anenaiva nyāyena nagare'miniviśya bhuṅkte ityatra bhujyāśrayeṇadhikaraṇatvena nagarasyābhiniviśikarmatvamapodyate || 86 ||
gatametat | iha kathaṃ karmatvaṃ `guḍaṃ bhakṣayati' iti | guḍo hi nirvṛtto bhakṣaṇakriyāgataṃ na kaṃcana viśeṣamākāṅkṣati tathepsitam | api tu bhakṣaṇakriyāyā āśrayaviśeṣapradarśanārthamupādīyata iti kriyārthametad dravyaṃ na tu dravyasaṃskārārthā kriyā, dantāvacūrṇanādi na bhakṣaṇakriyāphalam, api tvannādanādirūpābhyavahāralakṣaṇasya bhakṣaṇasya | prītistṛptilakṣaṇā phalamiti nāsti kriyāṃkṛto'tra kaścanotpattyādiviśeṣaḥ | taduktaṃ vārtike | "īpsitasya karmasaṃjñāyāṃ nirvṛttasya kārakatve karmasaṃjñāprasaṅgaḥ, kriyāpsitatvāt "  iti | nirvṛttasya iti nirvatyakarmatāṃ pratikṣipati | upalakṣaṇaṃ caitat | vikārādyabhāvāt karmāntaratāpi nāsti | nirākaṅkṣasya vetyarthaḥ | `kārakatve'iti kriyāsiddhau nimittabhāvamāha | bhakṣaṇakriyāniṣpattyarthaṃ guḍasyopādānāt | ata eva bhakṣaṇāya guḍa iti kriyaiva sandarśanādibhirāpyamānatvādīpsitā karma, na tu dravyam | bhakṣaṇamātraṃ hi guḍasyepsitaṃ na tu bhakṣaṇapratyākhyānenānyastatkṛto viśeṣaḥ | atra vārtike parihāra uktaḥ | `na vobhayepsitatvāt'  iti || 86 ||
tatra kathaṃ guḍāderīpsitatvamityetad vyākhyātumāha | yannirvṛttāśrayaṃ karma prāpterapracitaṃ punaḥ | bhakṣyādiviṣayāpattyā bhidyamānaṃ tadīpsitam || 87 ||
 nirvṛtto niṣpanno'ta eva nirākāṅkṣaḥ āśrayo guḍādi dravyaṃ yasya karmamaḥ karmaśakteriti nirvatyakarmatāvyudāsaḥ | vikārānākāṅkṣaṇācca vikāryatāpi vyadastā | `prāpterapracitam' iti | prāpterbhakṣaṇakriyāsaṃbandhādyo'pi pracāyāpacayayorviśeṣastenāprayuktamapracitamiti prāpyakarmatāpi vyudastā pūrvapakṣe | ādyena hi kārikārdhena pūrvapakṣavārtikārthaḥ saṃgṛhītaḥ | dvitīyenārdhenottaravārttikavyākhyānam | bhakṣibhujyādikriyāviṣayabhāvāpattyā bhidyamānaṃ viśiṣyamāṇaṃ guḍādīpsitaṃ prāpyametat karmetyarthaḥ | tathā hi, na bhakṣaṇādikriyaivātrepsitā | evaṃ hi loṣṭhamapi bhayakṣitvā kṛtī bhavet | nāpi guḍaḥ kriyāntarāśrayatvenepsitaḥ, api tu bhakṣaṇāśrayatvenetyubhayamāśrayāśrayibhāvena samuditamīpsitam | yasya hi guḍabhakṣaṇamīpsitaṃ tasya guḍo'pīpsitaḥ | bhakṣaṇakriyāsaṃbandha eva cātra kriyākṛto viśeṣaḥ prāpyakarmatāyāṃ viśeṣāntarasyānākāṃkṣaṇāt | anyathā nirvatyavikāryābhyāṃ ko viśeṣaḥ syāt | bhakṣaṇasya prītyatiśayo'tra phalam | sa ca guḍasya tatsaṃbandhe sati ghaṭata ityayameva viśeṣaḥ | kriyākṛtaḥ svānurūpaphalapralavayogyatā hi saṃskāraḥ | nanu ca tṛptilakṣaṇāyāṃ prītau guḍo'ṅgamiti kathaṃ pradhānakārakarūpaṃ karmatvamasyāḥ | ucyate | tṛptyaṅgatāyāṃ guḍasyāyamitikartavyātaviśeṣo yadbhakṣikriyāviṣayīkaraṇe tāṃ prati prādhānyam, nānyathā tṛptiḥ sampādayituṃ śakyā | tadasya tṛptyaṅgabhāve'yaṃ prāthamakalpiko vyāpāraḥ | tadyathā guruḥ sevyamāno dharmotpattāvaṅgatāmeti, taccāsya paricaraṇakriyāviṣayabhāvagamanamantareṇa na ghaṭanāmetīti guruṃ śuśrūṣata iti prādhānyopapattiḥ | tadevamatra pūrvapakṣe dravyepsāpahnaveva kriyāmātrasyepsā darśitā | atastadānuguṇyena parihāre dravyasyāpīpsā pradarśitā | yadi tarhi kriyāviṣayabhāvamātragamanena karmatāsiddhiḥ tathā sati sarvatra kriyāmātre'pi sakarmakatā syāt | tataścākarmakavyapadeśāḥ śāstre virudhyeran | na ca virudhyante | na hyavaśyaṃ kriyāmātre bāhyaviṣayasaṃbhavaḥ | kāciddhi kriyā kartaryeva viśrāmyati | na tu bāhyabhāvamapekṣate | tadyathā āste, śete ityādi | dvayarthaḥ paciriti vacanāt sarvadhātuviṣaye'pi bhāvanālakṣaṇe vyāpāre dhātvartha evātra bhāvanāparyavasānāt sa eva bhāvyaḥ | `āsanaṃ karoti' śayanaṃ karoti iti | ata evātra bāhyabhāvaniṣṭhā bhāvanā tatra tena bāhyena karmaṇā bhāvyena sakarmakatvam | tatra ca kimityanuyujyate | pacati kimodanamityādi | dhātvarthasya hi sarvatrāvyabhicārād bhāvyatve'pi na tena sakarmakākarmakavibhāgaḥ śakyakriyaḥ [kālādikarmaṇeva bāhyaṃ tu karma vyabhicaratīti tadapekṣo'yaṃ vibhāgaḥ | attaśca śuddhāyā bhāvanāyā dhātvarthaḥ karma, dhātvarthaviśiṣṭāyāṃ tu bāhyaṃ karma | ata eva bāhyaniṣṭhāyāṃ bhāvanāyāṃ dhātvarthaḥ karaṇamiti nyāyavidaḥ | tenodanaṃ pacati, pākenaudanaṃ bhāvayatīti vākyārthaḥ | yadyapīha darśane bhāvanā dhātvartha eva tathāpi phalaparyantāsau kartṛvyāpārarūpā dīrghatarāvayavakriyāmātrāt pṛthag‌vyavahārasahā | evaṃ sarvatra yojyam || 87 ||
kvacit punarvastuto bāhyakarmasadbhāve'pyakarmakavyapadeśo bhavatītyāha | dhātorarthāntare vṛtterdhātvarthenopasaṃgrahāt | prasiddheravivakṣātaḥ karmaṇo'karmikā kriyā || 88 ||
 prasiddhādarthādanyatrārthe yadā dhāturvartate tadā tatrāsya karmasamanyavayarahitakriyā vācyā pratīyate | tadyathā vahatirdeśāntaraprāpaṇavacanaḥ sakarmakaḥ prasiddho bhāraṃ vahatīti | sa yadā nadī vahatītyatra syandanakriyāmabhidhāyī tadā syandanasya jalasrutirūpasya nadyātmabhūtatvāt kimityanuyogābhāvādakarmaka iti dhātvarthamātrāpekṣayeyaṃ bhāvanā vahati syandanaṃ karotīti | yadāpi dhātvarthakriyāyāṃ karmāntarbhavati tadāpyakarmakatvam | tadyathā `jīvati' iti | `prāṇān dhārayati' iti hyatra dhātvartha iti prāṇalakṣaṇasya karmaṇo'ntarbhāvaḥ evaṃ `mriyate' `prāṇān jahāti' iti | tathā `asti' `ātmānaṃ vibharti' iti | yatrāvyabhicāreṇa pratiniyatasya karmaṇaḥ pratītistatrāpyarkārmikā kriyeti vyavahāraḥ | tadyathā `varṣati' iti | atra hi yathā varṣaṇakriyāyāmapyabhicārāddevaḥ kartā pratīyate tathā karmāpi jalalakṣaṇamiti prasidderakarmakatvāśrayaḥ kartari kta udāhṛtaḥ `vṛṣṭo devaḥ' iti | yattvaprasiddhaṃ karma tena sakarmakatvamevāsyāḥ kriyāyāḥ, `rudhiraṃ varṣati' `śaran varṣati' iti | `pāṃsavo vṛṣṭāḥ' iti karmaṇi ktaḥ | vidyamāno'pi vā yatra karmasaṃbandhaḥ kriyāmātrapratipādanatātparyānna vivakṣyate tatrāpyakarmakatvaṃ saṃbhavati | tadyathā neha pacyate, neha bhujyate iti | kriyāpratiṣedhatātparyādbhāve lakāraḥ | dīkṣito na dadāti, na pacati, na juhoti iti karmaṇo'vivakṣā | atra kimiti nāpekṣyate | kriyāpratiṣedhatātparyāt || 88 ||
tadevaṃ caturbhiḥ prakārairakarmakavyapadeśāḥ śāstre bhavanti | evamanye'pi prakārāḥ saṃbhavantītyāha | bhedā ya ete catvāraḥ sāmānyena pradarśitāḥ | te nimittādibhedena bhidyante bahudhā punaḥ || 89 ||
 ya ete sakarmakāṇāmapi dhātūnāmakarmakatvanibandhanabhūtā bhedāścatvāro'bhihitāste nimittādibhedenānekaprakārā jāyante | nimittaṃ sahāya upasargādiḥ | ādiśabdāddeśakālādayaḥ | tadyathā caratiḥ deśāntaraprayogasya sāmarthyādbhavati | `bāṣpa uccarati', `dhūma uccarati' iti | ucchabdavaśāddhāturayamūrdhvapravṛttāvakarmakaḥ | ādigrahaṇāt kvacidātmanepadaprayogādakarmakatvābhivyaktiḥ `uttapate' `vitapate' iti | `bhāsate' ityarthaḥ | `yāvadbhaktamupatiṣṭhate', bhojanakālaṃ yāvadudīkṣate ityarthaḥ | `akarmakācca'  ityātmanepadam| `sarpiṣo jānīte', `madhuno jānīte', iti | tenopāyena pravartata iti jñānapūrvikāyāṃ pravṛttāmatra dhāturvartate | `apahnave jñaḥ'  ityanuvṛttau `akarmakācca'  ityātmanepadam vākyasāmarthyāt kvacidakarmakatvābhivyaktiḥ | tadyathā `nadī vahati' iti | nadīlakṣaṇakartṛviśeṣasāmarthyāt syandanavacanatāyāmakarmakatvam | evaṃ `vāyurvahati' iti | tathā karmakartṛviṣaye karmaṇaḥ kartṛtvapratītivaśādekadeśavacanatāyāṃ dhātorakarmakatvaṃ `pacyate odanaḥ svayameva' iti | evaṃ ca kṛtvākarmakavyapadeśanimittaṃ śāstramatra viṣaye pravartate `muco'karmakasya guṇo vā'  iti | `mokṣyate vatsaḥ svayameva' iti | evamarthāntare vṛttirdhātorakarmakatvanibandhanaṃ nimittādibhedena bhidyate | dhātvarthenopasaṃgrahe'pi nimittādibhedena bhedaḥ | tadyathā--kvacit kriyā svarūpasāmarthyalakṣaṇānnimittāt tirohitabhedatve karmaṇo'ntarbhāve'karmakavyapadeśo jīvatyādau | kvacidanvākhyānavyavasthayā nirdhāryamāṇarūpabhedasyāpyantarbhāvaḥ | tadyathā putrīyatau putrakarmaṇaḥ | paramārthato'tra putralakṣaṇaṃ karma kriyāśarīrānupraviṣṭaṃ karma kriyāśarīrānupraviṣṭaṃ bhedenāsatyena prakriyāyāmanvākhyānanimittamāśrīyate tathā ca vakṣyati putrīyatau na putro'sti viśeṣocchā tu tādṛśī | vinaiva putrānugamādyā putre vyavatiṣṭhate || iti | ācārakyaci tvatropamānakarmāntarbhūtamupameyakarmaṇā tu sakarmakatvam | `putrīyati chātram ' iti | `muṇḍayati māṇavakam ' iti tu sāmānyakarmāntarbhūtaṃ viśeṣakarmaṇā tu sakarmakatvam | evaṃ `miśrayati tilān' ityādau | bāṣpāyate, ūṣmāyate, romanthāyate ityādau viśeṣakarmaṇa eva nirdhāritarūpasyāntarbhāvaḥ | paceḥ pārthivaṃ bhideśca sāvayavaṃ karma prasiddham, na tvantarbhūtam | tasya svaśabdenāpi vacanāt, pacati pākyam, `bhinatti bhedyam' iti | antarbhāve tu svaśabdena nirdeśo na syāt | na hi bhavati `jīvati prāṇān' iti | `jalaṃ varṣati' iti tu bhavati | antarbhāvācca karmaṇo `namasyati devān ' ityatra namaḥśabdayoge caturthī na bhavati | tathā ca vārtike `namasaḥ kyaci dvitīyānupapattiḥ' iti codayitvā `prakṛtyantāratvāt siddham'  iti parihṛtam | anenaivāśayena dhātvantārameva namasyatiśabdaḥ pūjārtho na saṃbhavatyevātra namaḥśabdo'vayavakalpanādvāreṇa tvevaṃ vyutpādyata ityarthaḥ | bāṣyakārastvanvākhyānavelāyāṃ namasaḥ prakṛtitvena parigrahāt saṃbhavaṃ manyamānaḥ punaścodayati | `nanu namasyatiśabde namaḥ śabbdo'sti, tena yoge caturthī prāpnoti' iti | pariharati ca `arthavato namaḥśabdasya grahaṇam, na ca namasyatiśabde namaḥśabdo'rthavān' iti | sub‌dhātuvṛttiriyam | atra copasarjanārthaḥ pratyayārthe guṇībhūta iti namo devebhya ityatra pradhānabhūtanamaḥśabdayoge sāvakāśatvādatra caturthī na bhavatīti bhāṣyārthaḥ | prasiddherapi yatrākarmakatvaṃ tatrāpyavāntaro bhedo deśakālavaśājjāyate | tadyathā dakṣiṇāpathe pūrvāhṇe `pacyatām' ityukte yavāgūkarmakaḥ pāko'vagamyate | aparāhṇe punarodanasādhanaḥ | māṃsabhūyiṣṭhe tu deśe māsasādhanaḥ pākaḥ prasiddhaḥ | kriyāsvarūpasāmarthyāt kvacit prasiddhaṃ niyataṃ karma, `varṣati' iti jalaṃ pratīyate | kartṛsāmarthyādapi karma prasiddham, yathā `durjanaḥ karoti' ityukte upaghātalakṣaṇaṃ karma gamyate | sujanaḥ karoti' iti tūpakāro'vagamyate | goṣṭhībhedena deśabhedena cāparimitā prasiddhiranugantavyā, kiyadudāhriyate | avivakṣāpi kvacit sādṛśyāmātrapratipādanaparatayā vākyasya karmaṇo dṛśyate | tadyathā "anuvadate kaṭhaḥ kalāpasya" ityatra kaṭhakalāpayorbhāṣaṇasādṛśyaṃ pratipādyamiti karma na vivakṣitam | tathā karmaśaktiviśeṣapratipādane `devadattaḥ kiṃ karoti' iti praśne `pacati' `bravīti' iti karmasaṃbandho na vivakṣyate | kriyāprabandhāvyuparamapratipādane'pi na vivakṣyate karma `pacatyeva dadātyeva' iti yatāyogamanusaraṇīyaṃ prayogajātamiṣṭam || 89 ||
iti bhūtirājatanayahelārājakṛtau prakīrṇaprakāśe karmādhikāraḥ || ----------- iha svādividhivākye yayā''nupūrvyā vibhaktipratyayāḥ sanniviṣyāstadanusāreṇa tadarthānāṃ kārakāṇāṃ vicāraḥ | tatra dvitīyārthe karmaṇi vicārite tṛtīyārthaḥ karaṇaṃ pūrvaṃ vicāryate | kartā tu ṣaṣṭhyā apyartha iti sādhāraṇatvānnyūnatvena paścādvicārayiṣyate | tatra kriyāsaṃsiddhau sāmagvyāḥ sādhanatvāt ko'tiśayaḥ karaṇasya yena tat sādhakatamaṃ syādidityāśaṅkya lakṣaṇamāha | kriyāyāḥ pariniṣpattiryad‌vyāpārādanantaram | vivakṣyate yadā tatra karaṇatvaṃ tadā smṛtam || 90 ||
 sannipatyopakāriṣu sarveṣvapi sādhaneṣu yad‌vyāpārānantarabhāvinī kriyā lakṣyate tadavāptātiśayaṃ sādhakatamaṃ karaṇam | tadyathā chedane dātramanupraviśya chedyamavayavavibhāgaṃ sādhayat prakṛṣṭopakāratāmāsādayatyadhikaraṇādikārakāntarebhyaḥ | evaṃ darśane cakṣuḥ praṇidhīyamānam ityādyudāhartavyam | sādhanavyavahārasya ca buddhyavasthāsamāśrayatvād `vivakṣyate' ityāha | vivakṣopārūḍha eva hyartho vyākaraṇe'ṅgam, na bāhyavastusattetyarthaḥ | tathā ca balena lunāti, `ālokena paśyati' ityādāvanādṛtya dātrādikaṃ valādi sādhakatamatvena vivakṣitaṃ karaṇam | tatra sādhanāntarāṇāṃ vāstave'pyādhārādibhāve buddhyānyathātvam, yathā sthālyā pacyata ityādau | karaṇasya tu rūpameva vivakṣādhīnamiti `sādhanavyavahāraśca buddhyavasthānibandhanaḥ' ityukte'pi `vivakṣyate' iti punaruktam || 90 ||
etadevāha | vastutastadanirdeśyaṃ na hi vastu vyavasthitam | sthālyā pacyata ityeṣā vivakṣā dṛśyate yataḥ || 91 ||
 idameva niyatajātīyaṃ tu vastu karaṇamityevaṃ nirūpayituṃ na śakyate | yasmānna vastu vyavasthitaṃ karaṇatayā niyatamasti | prajñātādhikaraṇabhāvā api hi sthālī tanutarakapālatvācchīghratarapākakāryasādhanatayā'nubhavatyeva vaivakṣikaṃ karaṇabhāvam | tathā hi prayogaḥ karaṇatṛtīyāntaḥ `sthālyā pacyate' iti loke prasiddhaḥ | ārdrendhanāpekṣayā hi susanniveśā sthālī kriyāsiddhau pratyāsīdati || 91 ||
yataśca kriyāsiddhau prakṛṣṭopakārakaṃ karaṇamatastatra kartṝṇāṃ saṃrabha ityāha | karaṇeṣu tu saṃskārabhārabhante punaḥ punaḥ | viniyogaviśeṣāṃśca pradhānasya prasiddhaye || 92 ||
 pradhānasya kriyālakṣaṇasyārthasya prasiddhaye prakṛṣṭopakārakasya karaṇasyaiva phalārthinaḥ saṃskāramuttejanādikamasakṛdvayāpāraṇaṃ cārabhante | upāyadvāreṇopeye pravṛtteḥ | tatra kāṣṭhānāmupadhānaṃ saṃskāraḥ | punaḥ punaścopasthāpanaṃ viniyogaḥ | dātrasya tīkṣṇatādhānaṃ saṃskāraḥ | udatyamananipātane viniyogaḥ | cakṣuṣo'ñjādiḥ saṃskāraḥ, praṇidhānaṃ viniyogaḥ, ityādyanyatrāpi yathāyogaṃ vaktavyam || 92 ||
iha kathamupakāraprakarṣaḥ "aśvena pathā dīpikayā yāti" iti bahūnāmekakālaṃ vivakṣyataityāha | svakakṣyāsu prakarṣaśca karaṇānāṃ na vidyate | āśritātiśayatvaṃ tu paratastatra lakṣaṇam || 93 ||
svasyāṃ kakṣyāyāṃ karaṇabhāvāvasthāyāṃ sajātīyāpekṣaḥ prakarṣo'tra tamap‌pratyayavācyo nāśrīyate, api tu sādhanasāmānyasyānugatasya kārakāntarāpekṣa eva prakarṣastamap‌pratyayavācyaḥ karaṇatvamāvedayate | sādhakaśabdāddhi kārakasāmānyavācinastamabutpannasta ta eva prakarṣaṃ gamayati | parata iti sādhanāntarāt | evaṃ karaṇajātyapekṣasyātiśayasyānāśrayaṇādaśvādīnāṃ sarveṣāmapi sādhanāntarāpekṣayā pratilabdhaprakarṣāṇāṃ karaṇatvamaviruddham | tathā hyaśvo deśāntaraprāptau kartrādyapekṣayā prakṛṣṭopakārakaḥ | panthā api sādhuścorādyupadravarahitaḥ | dīpikā api tamaḥsaṃhatimālokena nirbhatsayantī pratipadyate sādhanāntarebhyo'tiśayam || 93 ||
nanu kartṛviniyogottarakālaṃ sādhanānāṃ pravṛttestadapekṣayā kartureva sādhakamatatvaṃ nyāyyamityāśaṅkyāha | svātantrye'pi prayoktāra ārādevopakurvate | karaṇena hi sarveṣāṃ vyāpāro vyavadhīyate || 94 ||
 yad‌vyāpārānantaraṃ kriyāniṣpattistatkaraṇamityukte kartuḥ karaṇatvāprasaṅgaḥ | na hi kartṛvyāpārānantarameva kriyāsiddhiḥ | sādhanaviniyoge hi kartṛvyāpāraḥ | viniyukteṣu tu sādhaneṣu vyāpārāviṣṭeṣu satsu kriyā niṣpadyate | tatra cādhikaraṇādīnāmiva karturapi vyāpāro viprakṛṣyate kriyāsiddhau kartrantaraprayogābhāvāt | pāratantryayoge'pi sādhanāntarāṇāṃ prayoktāraḥ kartāraḥ viniyuktasādhanāntaravyāpāravyavadhānena kriyāṃ dūrādeva sādhayanti | karaṇavyāpārasamanantarameva tu kriyāsiddhiḥ || 94 ||
atha vā kartrā sahātiśayacintā naiva saṃbhavatītyāha | kriyāsiddhau prakarṣo vā nyagbhāvastveva kartari | siddhau satyāṃ hi sāmānyaṃ sādhakatvaṃ prakṛṣyate || 95 ||
 iha kriyāsiddhiviṣaye sādhanāntarebhyo'tiśayaḥ karaṇasya vivakṣitaḥ | yadā ca pravṛttāni gṛhītavyāpārāṇi kārakāṇi tadā kriyāsiddhirviṣayībhavati | kartṛviniyoge tvapekṣite kartari nyagbhavanti | sādhanānyanāviṣṭasvavyāpārāṇi svātantryanibandhanaṃ sāmānyabhūtaṃ sādhanavyapadeśameva nāsādayantīti kutaḥ tadapekṣayā karturatiśayaḥ syāt | tadāha `siddhau satyāṃ hi sāmānyaṃ sādhakatvaṃ prakṛṣyate |' iti | yatsāmānyaṃ sādhanatvaṃ tatsiddhau niṣpattau satyāṃ prakarṣamāsādayati | niṣpattiśca tasya kartṛviniyogāduttarakālaṃ svavyāpārāveśe sati | tathā ca tasyāṃ daśāyāmatiśayaścintyamāno'dhikaraṇādestulyakakṣyāt karaṇasyaivāvatiṣṭhate na tu kartuḥ | sa hi svāmī prākpravṛtti svatantro na mṛtyaiḥ saha spardhate | sajātīyāpekṣo hi prakarṣaḥ | kartā tu vijātīya eva, kārakāntarāṇāṃ svatantraparatantrarūpatvāt | evaṃ ca kṛtvā kartari parādhīnasyādhikaraṇasya sādhakatvātiśayaḥ kārakāntarāpekṣo yujyate, bhinnaviṣayatvāditi kathamasvādhīnaṃ prakarṣavat sādhanaṃ syāditi na codanīyam || 95 ||
yadi tarhi kartuḥ karaṇasya ca rūpaviprakarṣaḥ kathamidānīṃ karaṇasyāpi kartṛtvamasiśavchanattītyāśaṅkyāha | asyādīnāṃ tu kartṛtve taikṣṇyādi karaṇaṃ viduḥ | taikṣṇyādīnāṃ svatantratve dvaidhātmā vyavatiṣṭhate || 96 ||
 iha yadā chidiṃ prati sutīkṣṇadhāratvāt kartṛviniyogatiraskāreṇāsiḥ svātantryeṇa vivakṣyate tadāsau karaṇameva na bhavati, api tu yadanantarabhāvinī kriyā tasyaiva karaṇatvaṃ taikṣṇyagauravakāṭhinyasaṃsthānādeḥ | tasyāpi kartṛtvavivakṣāyāṃ vivakṣāprāpitarūpabhedāyatta karaṇabhāvaḥ | tathā hi taikṣṇyaṃ chinatti svasāmarthyeneti śabdabhedopahitarūpabhedādekamapi taikṣṇyaṃ bhedenaiva kartṛkaraṇate pratipadyate | svādhīnatvenāśrita ātmā kartā sādhakatamatvenāśritaḥ karaṇamiti dvedhā vyavasthānam | kriyāyāḥ karaṇāvinābhāvāt karaṇāntaravyāvṛttipareyaṃ codanā | taikṣṇyameva chidau sādhakatamaṃ nānyaditi tasyātiśayaparipoṣe tātparyam, tadevaṃ kartṛkaraṇe bhinne eva || 96 ||
yadyevamekatrāprāptau saṃjñayoḥ `karaṇaṃ parāṇi.......' iti vipratiṣedhaḥ kathamupanyasta ityāha | ātmabhede'pi satyevameko'rthaḥ sa tathā sthitaḥ | tadāśrayatvād bhede'pi kartṛtvaṃ bādhakaṃ tataḥ || 97 ||
 vivakṣāprāpite satyapi kartṛkaraṇatayā rūpabhede sa eko'rthaḥ śattayādhārasthito na pracyavate rūpādityarthaḥ | atropapattiḥ `tadāśrayatvāt' iti | kalpanāśrayatvāt | kālpaniko hi bhedo na vāstavikamekatvaṃ vihantītyarthaḥ | yadvā tadāśrayatvaditi tadekārthādhāratvāt kartṛkaraṇasaṃjñayoriti kecid vyācakṣate | śaktibhede'pi tadādāradravyaikatvādekaḥ saṃjñayorvipratiṣedhaviṣaya upadyate | saṃjñā hi śaktiviśiṣṭasya dravyasyaiva | tadevaṃ vastuni vidyamānamekatvaṃ yadā vivakṣopādatte tadaikaviṣayatve vipratiṣedhe paratvāt kartṛsaṃjñā | karaṇasaṃjñāṃ bādhata ityudāhṛtam `asiśchanatti' iti | atra hi sādhakatamatvāvivakṣāvinābhāvinī svātantryavivakṣāserityekaviṣayatve ubhayasaṃjñāprasaṅge paratvāt kartṛsaṃjñā | sādhakatamatve hi sati svātantryamāropyate | yathā dhanuṣā vidhyatītyapāyabhāve satyeva sādhakatamatvaṃ dhanuṣaḥ | tadevaṃ kriyāṃ prati prakṛṣṭopakārakaṃ karaṇamiti sthitam || 96 ||
upakāraśca bhavatā'rthena kriyate, na tvavidyamānenetyetāmāśaṅkāmapyapākaroti | yathā ca sannidhānena karaṇatvaṃ pratīyate | tathaivāsannidhāne'pi kriyāsiddheḥ pratīyate || 98 ||
 dātrādayaḥ sannihitāḥ kriyopākāratiśayamāsādayantaḥ karaṇatayā yathā prajñāyante tathaiva dhanābhāvena mukta ityādāvasannihitamapi dhanaṃ muktiṃ sādhayat karaṇameva prasiddham || 98 ||
atraiva sūtrakāramataṃ saṃvādakamāha | satokasya vābhinirvṛtteranivṛtteśca tasya vā | prasiddhiṃ karaṇatvasya stokādīnā pracakṣate || 99 ||
 `karaṇe ca stokālpa....'  ityatrodāharaṇaṃ stokānmuktaḥ stokena mukta iti | atra satvavacanānāmapi stokādīnāṃ dharmamātrābhidānatātparyeṇa prayogādasatvavacanatā | tacca dharmamātraṃ stokalakṣaṇaṃ sadasadvā muktikriyāyāmatiśayenopakārakaṃ karaṇamityuktam | yasmāt stokaṃ deyavastuno niṣpannaṃ na cānyat saṃbhavati niṣkiṃcanatvāt ato muktaḥ ; yadi vā stokaṃ deyavastuno'vaśiṣṭamavasitaṃ tato muktaḥ | yadi tu bahu deyaṃ syāt na mucyeteti stokenābhavatā muktaḥ | evamekena na viṃśatirekānna viṃśatiriti ekābhāvo viṃśatiniṣedhasya karaṇam || 99 ||
tadevaṃ vivakṣādhīnatvāt sādhanavyavahārasya yadyat sādhakatamatvena vivakṣyate tattatkaraṇam | tathā ca dharmāṇāṃ tadvatā bhedādabhedācca viśiṣyate | kriyāvadhepavacchedaviśeṣād bhidyate yathā || 100 ||
 āśritamātraṃ dharmaśabdenāha | `tadvatā' ityāśrayeṇa | tathā hi `devadattaḥ kāṣṭhaiḥ pacati' itīndhanagatasya tejasastadabhedavivakṣayā prayogaḥ | tathā ca devadattakartṛkendhanakaraṇikā ceyaṃ pacikriyā | yadā tu tejo bhedenandhanād vivakṣyate tadā "edhāḥ pakṣyanti tejasā" iti tejaḥkaraṇikendhanakartṛkā ca pacikriyā | yadāpyauṣṇyaṃ tejaso bhedena sādhanaviśeṣāt kriyā | tadyatā'vadhergrāmāderavacchedaviśeṣād bhedaviśeṣāt kriyā bhidyate viśiṣyate `grāmādāgacchati', `grāmasya samīpādāgacchati' ityādau tadvadatrāpi boddhavyamityarthaḥ | sāraṇyake sasīmake sasthaṇḍilake hi grāmaśabdābhideye'bhedena `grāmādāhacchati' iti prayogaḥ | vāṭaparikṣipte tu grāmaśabdābhidheye'bhedena `grāmādāgacchati' iti bhidyate'vadhiḥ | tadbhedācca kriyā viśiṣyate | evaṃ vaivakṣikakaraṇabhedādapi yathāvivakṣaṃ ca tadeva pradhānakaraṇaṃ tṛtīyāvaddhātupratyayena lyuṭā ghañā vābhidhīyate, pacanamedhaḥ, pacanaṃ tejaḥ pacanī sthālī, pacanamauṣṇyam ityādi yathāvivakṣamudāhāryaṃ prayogajātamiṣṭam || 100 ||
iti bhūtirājatanayahelārājakṛte prakīrṇaprakāśe sādhanasamuddeśe karaṇādhikāraḥ || ---------------  tṛtīyārthe karaṇe vicārite samprati tadarthaḥ kartā vicāryate | tasya lakṣaṇam `svatantraḥ kartā'  iti | sva ātmā tantraṃ pradhānamasya | karaṇādīnāṃ hi paraḥ kartaiva tantraṃ pradhānam | kriyāsiddhau tena prayojyatvāt | kartā tvananyaprayojyaḥ svatantra ityucyate | tatra karaṇādīnāmapi svavyāpāre svātantryāt ko'tiśayaḥ karturityāśaṅkyopapādayati | prāganyataḥ śaktilābhānnyagbhāvāpādanādapi | tadadhīnapravṛttitvāt pravṛttānāṃ nivartanāt || 101 ||
adṛṣṭatvāt pratinidheḥ praviveke ca darśanāt | ārādapyupakāritve svātantryaṃ karturucyate || 102 ||
karaṇādipravṛtteḥ prāk evārthitāderaparasmānnimittāt, na tu sahakāribhya eva sāmarthyamāsādayati | phalakāmo hi kartā karaṇādīnyupārjayate | tathā ca pūrvameva śaktimān svatantraḥ | karaṇādīnāṃ tu kartṛviniyogādeva svavyāpāre svātantryam, na tvanyataḥ | ata eva kartrā nyagbhāvamātmādhīnatāmāpādyante | tadāyattavyāpārāśca | kartā tu phalārthamīhamānaḥ svayaṃ vyāpāravān | atipravṛttāni ca karaṇādīni nivartyante kartrā | sa tu phalaprāptau svayameva nivartate | coditāsaṃbhave karaṇādīnāṃ pratinidhiruktaḥ | kartuḥ sa nāsti | kartrantaraṃ hi kriyāṃ nirvartayat pratinihitaṃ nocyate | tasyāpyarthinaḥ samarthasyāparyudastasyādhikārāt | praviveke ca kārakāntarāṇāmabhāve dṛśyate kartā, tadyathā asti, bhavati, vidyata ityādau | yadyapyatrādhikaraṇādayaḥ saṃbhavanti tathāpi nāntarīyakāste śabdavyāpārādapratīyamānāḥ | tataścākartṛkāyāḥ kriyāyā abhāvāt saṃbhūyakāribhyo'pi viśiṣyate kartā | etena hetukalāpena kartuḥ karaṇāpekṣayā kriyāsiddhau viprakṛṣṭopakārakatve'pi svātantryaṃ prādhānyanibandhanamucyata iti tasyaiva kartṛsaṃjñā, na tu karaṇādeḥ svavyāpāre svatantrasyāpītyarthaḥ | etena cedaṃ bhāṣyaṃ vyākhyātam--- "yat sarveṣu sādhaneṣu sannihiteṣu kartā pravartayitā bhavati" iti | etacca bhāṣyaṃ garbhīkṛtanāntarīyakārthaṃ saṃkṣipyoktamiti garbhīkṛtārthavyaktīkāreṇātra vyākhyātam | tathā hi `tadadhīnapravṛttitvāt' ityanena sākṣāt pravartakatvaṃ vyākhyātam | sāmarthyākṣiptaṃ ca nyagbhāvanādi nirdiṣṭam | tathā hi prayok‌ttradhīnatvāt pravṛtternyagbhāvaḥ karaṇādīnāṃ tatrārthoktaḥ | sā pravartanā ca phalārthamiti tatprāptāvatipravṛttau nivartanāpyākṣiptā | pravartayitā cāvaśyaṃ pravartyādanyataḥ śaktiṃ prāg labhata iti tadapi vyākhyātam | asaṃbhave ca pravartayiturevābhāva iti pratinidhyabhāvaḥ sāmarthyokto vivṛtaḥ | sākṣātsamarthasya kvacidanyānapekṣaṇāt praviveke ca darśanaṃ sāmarthyalabhyaṃ vyākhyātamiti samasyābhihitaṃ bhāṣyaṃ vyasya vyākhyātam || 101,102 ||
acetaneṣu tarhyevaṃvidhadharmakalāpabhāvāt kartṛtā na prāpnotītyāśaṅkyāha | dharmairabhyuditaiḥ śabde niyamo na tu vastuni | karturdharmavivakṣāyāṃ śabdāt kartā pratīyate || 103 ||
 abhyuditaiḥ uktairetaiḥ prāganyataḥ śaktilābhādibhiḥ pravartayitṛtvādilakṣaṇaiḥ dharmaiḥ svabhāvairūpalakṣitaḥ svatantraḥ kartā ityevaṃlakṣaṇo niyamo'vaśyabhāvaḥ śabdaviṣaye samāśrayaṇīyaḥ | śabdena yasyaite dharmāḥ pratyāyyante sa kartā boddhavyaḥ, na tu vastuviṣayatayā dharmāṇāmeṣāṃ sambhavo'nveṣaṇīyaḥ yenācetanaviṣaye `agnirdahati', `edhāḥ pacanti' `sthālī pacati' ityādau `kūlaṃ patati, `nadī vahati' ityādau ca kartṛtvaṃ na syāt | ete hi dharmā yadā kartṛlakṣaṇāya vivakṣyante śabdena ca yathāvivakṣaṃ pratyāyyante tadā śabdāt kartā supratiṣṭhitalakṣaṇaḥ pratīyata iti karaṇamiva kartāpi vaivakṣikaḥ pratipāditaḥ | evaṃ ca kṛtvācetaneṣūpacaritamapi na bhavati kartṛtvam, sarvatrāskhaladvattitvātprayogasya mukhyatāsaṃbhavāt | vyākaraṇe hi śabdārtho'rthaḥ na vastvarthaḥ | tataśca vyākaraṇāntare arthī kartā tathāyuktaśca iti lakṣaṇadvayaṃ cetanācetanaviṣayatayā yat praṇītaṃ tanna kauśalamityuktaṃ bhavati || 103 ||
yadā ca vivakṣādīnaṃ svātantryaṃ tadedemapi siddhaṃ bhavatītyāha | ekasya buddhyavasthābhirbhede ca parikalpite | karmatvaṃ karaṇatvaṃ ca kartṛtvaṃ copajāyate || 104 ||
 `hantyātmānamātmanā' ityekasyaivātmano vivakṣāprāpitarūpabhedādhīnaḥ kārakatrayayogo dṛśyate | sa vāstave kārakavyavahāre na ghaṭanāmeti | na hyekasya vastuno yugapad bhinnānekarūpatā śakyāvasātum | na cāmūrtasyātmanaḥ śastrādivyāpārajanyavadhasaṃbhavaḥ | vivakṣā tu śabdanibandhanā na vihanyate'tra | tathā hi buddheravasthā pratibhāsanānātvam, tadanusāreṇa vivakṣayā bhedaparikalpaḥ | śāstrādyudyamananipatanavyāpāravān hantīti kartā | ātmaivātra viṣayabhāvāpatitastathaiva karma | saukaryātiśayavivakṣāyāṃ śastrādivyāpārasya nirāse karamatvamātmanaḥ | karmakaraṇe hyanyatra bhedena dṛṣṭe iti tannirāsāya kartaivātra tathocyate bhedena | ata eva vārtike karmavadbhāvo'nena nyāyena pratyākhyātaḥ | siddhaṃ tu prākṛtakarmatvāt |  ātmasaṃyoge'karmakartuḥ karmadarśanāt |  iti | "hantyātmānam, ātmanā hanyata iti || 104 ||
anyadapi śābde kartṛtve siddhayatītyāha | utpatteḥ prāgasadbhāvo buddhayavasthānibandhanaḥ | aviśiṣṭaḥ satā'nyena kartā bhavati janmanaḥ || 105 ||
 `aṅkuro jāyate' iti janikartṛtvaṃ sato'sato vā | tatra yadi sajjāyate kasmādathāsajjāyate katham | ityādinā | tatra vaivakṣike kartṛtve upacārārtho'pi na kaścidityucyate | tathā hi vivakṣārūpāyā buddheḥ śabdanimittāyā ye'vasthāviśeṣāḥ pratiniyataśabdanibandhanāḥ tadāśrayeṇātra kriyāntarakartṛtvatulyaṃ janikartṛtvaṃ siddham | vivakṣāprāpitasannidhāne hyarthe'ṅkura iti śabdaḥ prayujyate | sa ca sadeva vastu darśayati | tato `jāyate' iti padasamavadhānāvadhāritajanmano'sya kutaḥ sattvamiti buddhyā niścitasatvasya kriyāsiddhāvupagṛhītasāmarthyasya bāhyena rūpeṇa janmeti vākyārtho'vatiṣṭhate | tataśca yena rūpeṇa sattvaṃ na tena kartṛtvaṃ na tena sattvamiti neyaṃ vāstavī vyavasthā api tu śābdayevetyarthaḥ | śabdārtha eva cārtha ityaskhalad‌vṛttitvāt prayogasya mukhyataiva sarvatra | nopacārārthaḥ kaścit || 105 ||
vastuvṛttacaryāyāmapi cāṅkuro jāyata iti prayoga ityāha | kāraṇaṃ kāryabhāvena yathā vā vyavatiṣṭhate | kāryaśabdaṃ tadā labdhvā kāryatvenātha jāyate || 106 ||
 kāryamukhena kartṛtā janma ca sadasatpakṣabhedena nopapadyata iti buddhyavasthāsamāśrayeṇa pūrvamupapāditam | idānīṃ kāraṇamukhena pratipādyate | ata eva pakṣāntarasūcako vā śabdaḥ | tatra kāraṇāt pṛthageva kāryamājāyate iti pūrvapakṣa uktaḥ | pariṇāmadarśane tvabhedapakṣa idaṃ kathyate | kāryakāraṇayoḥ prakṛtivikārarūpatayā `kṣīraṃ dadhi sampadyate,' bījamaṅkuro jāyata ityabhedena vyavahāradekasyāvasthāturavasthāviśeṣasvīkaraṇamātraṃ satattvamiti kāryonmukhatāyā viśiṣṭavikārābhinirvṛttiprakrame viśiṣṭottarāvasthā viśeṣagatavācakādhyāsāt | kāraṇameva sadrūpaṃ kartṛ bhavaduttarāvasthāsādhanalakṣaṇaṃ janma pratipadyate iti yujyate `jāyate'ṅkura' iti prayoga ityarthaḥ || 106 ||
yuktaṃ caitadyaduta kāraṇameva kāryabhāvenāvatiṣṭhata iti svasiddhāntenaitadupapadayitumāha | yathāheḥ kuṇḍalībhāvo vyagrāṇāṃ ca samagratā | tathaiva janmarūpatvaṃ satāmeke pracakṣate || 107 ||
 pūrvaṃ sadasatpakṣabhedena kāryakāraṇabhāvāsabhavaṃ pratipādya atyadbhutā tviyaṃ vṛttiḥ  ityādinā vivartanayena siddhāntitam | tatra ceyāneva janmārtho vicāryamāṇo'vatiṣṭhate yaduta tathā tathā sanniveśamātram | tadyathā sarpasya kauṭilyamanarthāntaram, pṛthagbhūtānāṃ cāṅgulyādīnāṃ saṅghāto muṣṭyādirityavasthāviśeṣamātrasāraḥ kāryakāraṇabhāva ityavasthāturabhedādavasthāsvanugamāt sattve janikartṛtāsiddhiḥ || 107 ||
idānīṃ kāryakāraṇayorbhedavāde'pi vāstavena rūpeṇa janikartṛtvaṃ pratipādayitumāha | vibhaktayoni yatkāryaṃ kāraṇebhyaḥ pravartate | svā jātirvyaktirūpeṇa tasyāpi vyavatiṣṭhate || 108 ||
 vibhaktā vyatiriktā yoniḥ kāraṇamasya tasyāsato vikāryasya jāyamānasya kāraṇebhyaḥ sakāśādvayariktasyotpatteḥ pūrvaṃ vyaktirūpeṇāsatve'pi jātyātmanā sattvāttajjātīyatayā nirūpya sādhanaviniyogājjātireva kāraṇānāṃ svābhivyaṃjakasampattyarthaṃ prayojiketi saiva vyak‌tyātmanā jāyata iti vyavahārājjātirūpeṇa kartṛtvaṃ vyaktirūpeṇa janyatvamiti atyantaṃ vyatirekābhāvājjātivyak‌tyoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyādupapadyata ityarthaḥ || 108 ||
idānīṃ śabdārtho'rtha iti svasiddhāntaṃ nigamayitumāha | bhāvaṣveva padanyāsaḥ prajñāyā vāca eva vā | nāstītyapyapade nāsti na cāsadbhidyate tataḥ || 109 ||
 ākārāvagraheṇa jñānaśabdayoḥ pravṛtternirālaṃbanatāyogāt pratīyamāne evākāro bhāvaśabdāvācyaḥ sadaiva viṣayaḥ padavinyāsasthānaṃ tayoḥ | tathā hi nāstītyabhāvālaṃbanau kacana paraparikalpitaṃ svayamutprekṣitaṃ vākāramavalaṃbya jāyete yena sadākārāvalabanābhyāṃ jñānaśabdabhyāmanayorviśeṣābhāvaḥ, svākārāvagrahasāmyāditi vyavahāre sarvameva bhāvābhāvajātaṃ samānam | bahirvastucarcā tu nāṅgam, iyataiva vyavahāraparisamāpteriti sadākārāvagrahapravṛttau jāyate'ṅkura iti prayogaḥ sūpapāda ityarthaḥ || 109 ||
buddhiśabdaviṣayabāvātirekeṇa vyavahāre vastūnāṃ bāhyā sattā na kācana vidyata ityāha | buddhiśabdau pravartete yathā bhūteṣu vastuṣu | teṣāmanyena tattvena vyavahāro na vidyate || 110 ||
 abhidhānapratyayāveva vyavahāra iti yathāpratyayaṃ yathābhidhānaṃ ca padārthatattvameṣaṇīyam, nānyat padārthasvarūpamapratīyamānamanabhidhīyamānaṃ cāśritya pratyavastheyamityarthaḥ | tathā cārthollekharahitāyā buddherayogāttatsiddhena tattvena jāyamānaḥ kartā nirūpyate ; nirūpitaścābhidhīyate | yathā nāstīti pratyaye bahirasannapi padārtho niyatadeśakālayorniṣidhyamāno deśakālāntaropalabdhenākāreṇāvabhāsamānaḥ kartṛpratyayenābhidhīyate, tathā kāryonmukhatāyāmanāgatamapi vastu tajjātīyānubhavavāsanayā buddhāvabhimukhībhavatsamarthahetuvaśājjāyata iti janmanaḥ kartṛtvenābhidhīyata iti prakaraṇārthaḥ || 110 ||
idānīṃ saṃbandhasamuddeśoktaṃ nyāyaṃ cetasi sanniveśyādvaitanayena janmanāśāsaṃbhavaṃ pratipādayati | ākāśasya yathā bhedaśchāyāyāścalanaṃ yathā | janmanāśāvabhede'pi tathā kaiścitprakalpitau || 111 ||
 niṣpradeśasyāpyākāśasya nityasya saṃyogipadārthapravibhāgena deśādhyāropād bhedaparikalpanetyuktam | bhāsāmabhāvarūpāyāḥ chāyāyāśca niṣkriyatve'pi vārakadravyakriyānugāmitayā sakriyatvādhyāparopaḥ | evamabhāvasya pūrvaṃ nirākṛtatvāt janmani kāraṇavyāpārasya ca niṣedhād vināśe'pi tadanupapatterāveditatvāt nirhetukalavināśapratiṣedhāccābinnasyādvayasya tattvasya nityasya janmanāśāyogādavidyāvaśāt pratibhāsamātraniṣṭhajanmanāśavaśena parikalpitabhāvābhāvārūpatayā vyavahāra iti saṃbandhasamuddeśa eva vistarato nirṇītam | evaṃ ca bhāvābhāvavyavahāravajjāyata ityartho'vicāritaramaṇīyaḥ siddha ityarthaḥ || 111 ||
nāśasya kalpitatvamupapādayitumāha | yathaivākāṣanāstitvamasannūrtinirūpitam | tathaiva mūrtināstitvamasadākāśaniśrayam || 112 ||
 vyāpakasyākāśasya sarvatra bhavato vastuno na kvacidabhāvaḥ | tataścāsadapyākāśanāstitvaṃ parimitadeśaghaṭādimūrtyavaṣṭhaṃbhavaśena kalpyate | yatra hi ghaṭādayastatrāsadākāśamiti vyavahāraḥ | evaṃ mūrtīnāmapi ghaṭādīnāṃ kvacin nāstitvaṃ bhāvato'vidyamānamari satsvabhāvasya svarūpavināśāyogādasatsvabhāvatve kadācidapyabhāvāditi nyāyādākāsasyāntarāle darśanādadhyavasīyate | antarāle hi mūrtīnāṃ sattāyāstirodhāne gaganameva tadrahitamavadhārayanto janma pratipadyanta ityetat prakaraṇādavagantavyam | tathā ca dvayorapi janmanāśayoḥ kalpitatvamupapāditaṃ bhavati | yathādhyavasāyaṃ ca vyavahārādajanmanirodhā eva padārthāḥ siddhāḥ | na hyākāśamabhāvo vastutaḥ padārthānāmabhāvābhāve ca sadaivāvasthānājjānmārtho'pi na kaścit || 112 ||
idānīṃ vāstave'pi janmani prakārāntareṇa jāyata iti prayogaṃ samarthayitumāha | yathā tadarthairvyāpāraiḥ kriyātmā vyapadiśyate | abhedagrahaṇādeṣa kāryakāraṇayoḥ kramaḥ || 113 ||
 `karaṇaṃ kāryabhāvena' ityādinā kāryakāraṇayorvāstavamabhedamāśritya samarthitam | adhunā tūpacaritābhādāśrayeṇocyate yathā hi pacerviklittiḥ pradhānārtha iti tadarthaiḥ guṇavyāpārairaghiśrayaṇodakāsecanādibhiḥ kartrādigataistādarthyādamadhyāropya pradhānakriyārūpamucyate, adhiśrayaṇodakāsecanataṇḍulāvapanaidhopakarṣaṇakriyāḥ pradhānasya kartuḥ pākaḥ, kāṣṭhāni pacanti ā viklitterjvalantīti karaṇasya pāka ityādinā tathā kāryārthatvāt kāraṇasyaivaiṣānupūrvī kramo'bhedena vyavahāre | tathā ca kāraṇamevāṅkuraśabdābhidheyaṃ satkartṛ kāryātmanā jāyata iti yujyate vyapadeṣṭumityarthaḥ || 113 ||
nanu ca kāryakāraṇayorabhedādhyārope'pi janmanaḥ kartṛtvaṃ kāryasyaiva yujyate na tu kāraṇasya siddhatvādityāśaṅkya prakṛtivikāraviṣaye paryāyeṇa kartṛtvaṃ kāryakāraṇayoḥ prayogabhedenāvasthāpayitumupakramte | vikāro janmanaḥ kartā prakṛtirveti saṃśaye | bhidyate pratipattṝṇāṃ darśanaṃ liṅgadarśanaiḥ || 114 ||
 iha prakṛtivikāraviṣaye sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ dṛśyate kṣīraṃ dadhi sampadyata ityādau | atra ca saṃdehaḥ | tathā hi guṇapradhānabhāvasya samanvayānyathānupapattyavaśyaṃbhāvāt kimatra prakṛtiḥ pradhānaṃ vikāro'ṅgam, uta viparyayaḥ | tatra pradhānasya kartṛtvaṃ janiṃ prati | aṅgasya tu pradhānadvārako janisaṃsparśa iti sāmānādhikaraṇyam | yadā tu bhedena nirdeśo bījādaṅkuro jāyata iti tadā'saṃśayameva vikarasya kartṛtvam | apādānatayā prakṛtekarnirdeśāt, janikartuḥ prakṛtiriti | tatra vikārakartṛkāṇāmāśayaḥ--ātmalābhasya janmākhyā, asatā cātmā labdhavyaḥ | tathā ca vikāra iti sa evātra kartā yuktaḥ | prakṛtikartṛkāstu manyante, asato hi vikārasyātmalābhaṃ pratyābhimukhyāyogāttallakṣaṇe janmani kartṛtānupapattiḥ | ātmalābhonmukhatā hi janma siddhāntayiṣyate | prakṛtirūpeṇa cātmano labdhatvāduttarāvasthālakṣaṇātmalābhaunmukhyamavatiṣṭhata iti tatra prakṛtereva karttutvamucitamiti || 114 ||
tadetaddarśanadvayaṃ liṅgadarśanaiḥ prayogabhedasvabhāvairviṣayavibhāgenāvasthāpayitumāha | klṛpi sampadyamāne yā caturthī sā vikārataḥ | suvarṇapiṇḍe prakṛtau vacanaṃ kuṇḍalāśrayam || 115 ||
 `klṛpi sampadyamāne caturthī vaktavyā' iti vārtikasyāyamarthaḥ sampādānakriyākartari caturthī vidheyeti | prayogamūlatvācca smṛtervikāravacanāccaturthī śrūyamāṇā vikārasyaiva sampattikriyākartṛtvamāvedayate | mūtrāya sampadyate yavāgūriti yāvagūrmatra jāyata ityatra | prakṛteratra vikāradvāreṇa kriyāsamanvayo na sākṣāt | bhedavivakṣāyāṃ tu janikartuḥ prakṛtikityāpādānapaṃcamyevātra kārakavibhaktiḥ, yavāgvā mūtraṃ jāyata iti | abhedavivakṣā tu caturthyā avakāśaḥ | ata eva tatra saṃdehe satyayaṃ nirṇayo vyadhāyi | tathā punarāvṛttaḥ suvarṇapiṇḍaḥ punaraparayā''kṛtyā yuktaḥ khadirāṅgārasavarṇe kuṇḍale bhavata ityatra bhāṣyaprayoge suvarṇapiṇḍasya prakṛtitve'pi na tadnatamekatvaṃ dṛśyate, api tu vikārarūpakuṇḍaladvitvāśrayaṃ bhavata iti dvivacanaṃ kartṛpratyayarūpaṃ dṛśyata ityasmādapi liṅgād vikārasya kartṛtvāva sāyaḥ || 115 ||
liṅgāntaraṃ viṣayabhedena prakṛtivikārayoḥ kartṛtvānumāpakamāha | vākye sampadyate kartā saṃghacvyantasya kathyate | vṛttau saṃdhībhavantīti brāhmaṇānāṃ svatantratā || 116 ||
 abhūtatadbhāve kubhvastivivakṣāyāṃ sampadyakartari cvirvidhīyate | tasyārthapradarśanāya yad vākyaṃ kriyate tatra vikārasya sampadyakartṛtvaṃ dṛśyate | tadyathā asaṅgho brāhmaṇāḥ saṅgho bhavatīti saṅghagataikatvāśrayasya vacanasya ca darśanāt saṅgha eva krtā | vṛttau tūcyate "saṃdhībhavanti brāhmaṇā" iti | atra prakṛtibhūtabrāhmaṇagatabahuvacanadarśanāt prakṛteḥ kartṛtvāvasāyaḥ | tadevaṃ prayogabhedena prarūḍhaṃ prakṛtivikārayoḥ kartṛtvamunneyam || 116 ||
idānīṃ prakṛteḥ kartṛtve bhāṣyakāroktaṃ liṅgamāha | atvaṃ sampadyate yastvaṃ na tasmin yuṣmadāśrayā | prakṛtiḥ puruṣasyāsti prākṛtaḥ sa vidhīyate || 117 ||
 `atvaṃ tvaṃ sampadyate tvadbhavati' iti bhāṣya udāhṛtam | atra yuṣmadathā vikāraḥ | na ca tadāśrayo madhyamaḥ puruṣo dṛśyate api tu `bhavati' ityayuṣmadartharūpaprakṛtigataprathamapuruṣadarśanāt prakṛtereva kartrītvāvasāyaḥ || 117 ||
tadetadviṣayabhedena prayogaprāmāṇyādavasthitaṃ kathaṃ yujyata ityatropapattimāha | pūrvāmavasthāmajahatsaṃspṛśan dharmamuttaram | samūrcchita ivārthātmā jāyamāno'bhidhīyate || 118 ||
 iha na sarvathaivāniṣpanni jāyata ityabhidhīyate, api tu pūrvāṃ kāraṇāvasthāmavijahadatyajaditi prakṛterapi kartṛtvasaṃbhāvanātra | nāpi sarvātmanodāsīnamapi tūttarāvasthāviśeṣaṃ saṃspṛśad āsādayaditi vikārasyāpi kartṛtvasaṃbhāvanā | evaṃ ca pūrvāparāvasthopādhyavacchinnamekaṃ vastu pūrvāvasthānuguṇyenottarāvasthāsādanonmukhaṃ pratāyamānarūpamivādhyavasīyamānaṃ jāyata iti dhātvarthapratyayārthayorānuguṇyamāsādayati | tathā ca prakṛtivikārayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyamubhayorapi ca kartṛtvamupapadyate || 118 ||
yadyevaṃ sarvatraivobhayoḥ kartṛtvaṃ syādityāśaṅkyāha | savyāpārataraḥ kaścit klaciddharmaḥ pratīyate | saṃsṛjyante ca bhāvānāṃ bhedavatyo'pi śaktayaḥ || 119 ||
 dvayorapi prakṛtivikṛtyoruktena nyāyenābhedāpattyā janisamanvayasahatve'pi kartṛpratyayotpattau kvacid vikāraḥ savyāpāraḥ kvacit prakṛtirityuktam | evamapi ca viṣayavibhāgena `jāyate' ityatra yathoktena prakāreṇa dvayorapi kartṛtmupapāditam | yato bhāvānāmanyatra bhinnā api śaktayaḥ kvacit saṃsargamapi prāpnuvantītyarthaḥ | yadvā sarvatraiva dvayorapi kartṛtvamekasya tu sākṣāditi prakarṣaḥ saṃvyāpārataraḥ ityuktaḥ | prakṛtivikṛtyorhi sāmānādikaraṇyānyathānupapattyā ekasya janikartṛtve nāntarīyakamaparasyāpi tadveditavyam | yo hi vidheyaḥ sa pradhānabhūtaḥ prakarṣeṇa janivyāpāravān, anyastvanūdyamāno guṇo'prakṛṣṭavyāpāraḥ || 119 ||
tathā ca saṃsargaḥ kartṛśaktayoryadi tarhi saṃsargaḥ tvadbhavatītyatra vikārāvasthāśrayaḥ puruṣa kasmānna bhavatītyāśaṅkyāha | viparītārthavṛttitvaṃ puruṣasya viparyaye | gamyeta sādhanaṃ hyatra savyāpāraṃ pratīyate || 120 ||
 `atvaṃ tvaṃ sampadyate, tvadbhavasi' ityevaṃ yuṣmadarthāśraye'tra madhyame puruṣe vivakṣito'rtho na pratīyate ayuṣmadarthaḥ prakṛtiḥ, yuṣmadartho vikṛtiriti | api tu yuṣmadarthaḥ prakṛtiḥ savyāpārā pratyayotpattāviti tasyā anyā vikṛtiḥ pratīyate | `saṃpadyase' iti hi sādhanaṃ yuṣmadarthaḥ savyāpāraṃ pratīyata iti tasya phalavattayā vikārāntaramanuṣajyeta | tathā ca yuṣmadarthastadviparītamayuṣmadarthabhāvamāpadyata iti vijñāyeta | tasmādayuṣmapadārthasya prakṛteḥ sampadyamānatvasaṃpratyayārthaṃ prathama evātra puruṣo nyāyyaḥ || 120 ||
viparītārthaṃvṛttitvameva vyācaṣṭe | tvamanyo bhavasītyeṣā tatra syāt parikalpanā | rājñi bhṛtyatvamāpanne yathā tadvadgatirbhavet || 121 ||
 yathā `rājan arājā sampadyase' ityukte rājārthasya prakṛteryuṣmadarthasyākhyātapadena pratyāyanāt savyāpārasya svārthaviparītabhṛtyabhāvena sampattikriyākartṛtvaṃ pratīyate tathātra `tvadbhavasi' ityukte'vyāvasthāsādane yuṣmadarthasya kartṛtvāvasāyāt vivakṣito'rthoṣa?yuṣmadarthatāpattilakṣaṇo na pratīyeteti tatsampratyayārthaṃ prathamapuruṣo jyāyān | na hyanyadabhiditsatānyadabhidhānīyam | suvarṇapiṇḍaḥ kuṇḍale bhavataḥ" ityatra tu vikārasyāpi kartṛtve kuṇḍale suvarṇapiṇḍātmatayā pariṇamete iti viparītārthavṛttitvaṃ na bhavati | bhavatau karturavaśyaṃ vikārāpekṣābhāvāt | cviviṣaya eva hi karturavaśyaṃ vikārāntarāveśaḥ kathyate | yasmāt prakṛtivivakṣāyāṃ cvirvidhīyate, svenātmanā ca siddhā prakṛtiriti vikārarūpamāpadyamānā savyāpārā viśiṣṭavikāranivṛttipratipattaye vikāraśabdābhidheyā kartī nyāyyā, cvyantasya vṛttau hi cvyantasya kriyāyoge gatisaṃjñāvidhānāt | gateḥ kriyāviśeṣaṇatvāt | asatvavacanatve kartṛtvāyogāt prakṛtereva kartrītvamucitaṃ vikārarūpagatisaṃjñakacvyantākhyaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭāyāṃ kriyāyāmatvadbhavati, saṅghībhavanti brāhmaṇā iti vākye tu cvyantasya prakṛtivikṛtyoḥ svaśabdenopādānādyathāvivakṣaṃ guṇapradhānabhāvādubhayoḥ kartṛtve niyamaḥ | tathā hi prakṛternijameva tattvaṃ sampadau vyāpṛtaṃ prādhānyena vivakṣitaṃ bhavati | kadācit samāropitaṃ vikārarūpam | tadyathā mahadbhūtaścandramā ityatrāmahadarthaprakṛtirūpasya kartṛtvāt sa eva mahacchabdena vikāravācinābhidhīyata iti gauṇatvānmahadarthasyātvaṃ na bhavatītyuktam | "mahadbhūtā brāhmaṇī" ityatra tu vikārasyaiva mahadarthasya bhavitṛtvena kartṛtayā vivakṣitatvāt samānādhikaraṇalakṣaṇo bhavatyeva puvadbhāva ityuktam || 121 ||
gatamānuṣaṅgikam | idamidānīṃ vaktavyam | `prāganyataḥ śaktilābhād' ityādinā svātantryaṃ vyākhyātam | tacca prayojyakarturnopapadyate | sa hi karaṇādivat prayojakavyāpāre nyagbhavanna svatantraḥ satyapi svavyāpāre svātantrye | tataśca svātantryanibandhanā kartṛsaṃjñā na syādasyeti pācayatyodanaṃ devadattena yajñadatta ityatra devadattāt prayojyakartuḥ kartṛtṛtīyā na syāt | tathā ca vārttikam--- svatantrasya kartṛsaṃjñāyāṃ hetumatyupasaṃkhyānam, asvatantratvāt "  iti | hetuḥ prayojakaḥ, tadvati prayojya ityarthaḥ | hetusaṃjñāyastvadhyeṣaṇaṃ syādviṣayo yatra niyujyamānasyāpi tatprayojakatvaṃ na virudhyata iti `hetumati' ityupalakṣaṇaṃ yuktam | atra parihāravārtikam `na vā svātantryāt' iti | svavyāpāre'styeva prayojyasya svātantryamiti siddhā kartṛsaṃjñā | nanvevaṃ karaṇādīnāmapi syāt | naitadasti | teṣāṃ yathāsvaṃ karaṇādisaṃjñāvidhānāt | prayojyasya tu na kadācidanyā saṃjñokteti kartṛsaṃjñaiva | evaṃ sthite prayojakāyattatvāt prayojyapravṛtteḥ kataṃ svātactryamityāśaṅkyopapādayati | sambhāvanāt kriyāsiddhau kartṛtvena samāśritaḥ | kriyāyāmātmasādhyāyāṃ sādhanānāṃ prayojakaḥ || 122 ||
prayogamātre nyagbhāvaṃ svātantryādeva niśritaḥ | aviśiṣṭo bhavatyanyaiḥ svatantrairmuktasaṃśayaiḥ || 123 ||
 yastāvadapravṛttakriyaḥ prayojyaḥ so'numitakriyāsāmarthyā eva prayujyate | anyathā prayoga eva na syāt | na hyaśaktaḥ kasyāṃcit kriyāyāṃ kenacid viniyujyate sacetasā | tataścāvadhṛtaśaktiḥ, saṃbhāvitakriyaḥ kartaiva svatantro viniyujyate | yo'pi ātmasādhyāyāṃ kriyāyāṃ pravṛttaḥ savyāpāraḥ karaṇādikārakakalāpaṃ prayojayanneva pralṛttakriyaḥ san prayujyate virāmāśaṅkāyāṃ mā viraṃsīditi buddhyā so'pi svatantraḥ kartaiva prayojyaḥ svavyāpāre svātantryādeva ca prayogamātre prayojakapraiṣe nyagbhāvam āyattatāṃ niśritaḥ prāptaḥ | kriyāsiddhaye hi praiṣaḥ | evaṃ ca kriyā sidhyati yadi sādhanāntaraviniyogalakṣaṇaṃ svātantryaṃ prayojyaḥ pratipadyate nānyatheti na prayogeṇa svātantryaṃ virudhyate | viṣayabhedācca prayoge pāratantryaṃ svavyāpāre svātantryamiti | upāya eva ca svavyāpāre svātantryaṃ prayoge pāratantryasya | evamananyaprayojyatayā svādhīnatayā niścitairaparaiḥ samānaḥ svatantraḥ prayojyaḥ siddhaḥ | taduktaṃ vārtike| "itarathā hyakurvatyapi kārayatīti syāt |  nā'kurvatīti cet svatantraḥ |  iti | udāsīnasyālāsasya | śaktasya prayogānupapatteḥ | sambhāvitasvātantrya eva prayojya ityarthaḥ yadyevaṃ svatantrasya prathojako heturityeva svavyāpāre svatantrāṇāṃ karaṇādīnāmapi prayojakamya prayojyasya katurhetusaṃjñāprasaṅgaḥ | bhavatu ko doṣa iti cet `hetumapi' iti tad‌vyāpāro ṇicūprasaṃgaḥ | dhātunoktatvāttasyāyamadoṣa iti cenna, karmaviṣaya eva praiṣo dhātvarthe'ntarbhavet phalārthatvāt kartṛbhāvanāyā dhātvarthasya tayā saṃsparśāt | akarmakadhātuviṣaye tu karaṇadiviniyogo vastutaḥ sannapyanavadhārita iti tatpratyāyanāya ṇijutpadyeta | śabdādviśiṣṭasādhanakriyābhāvanāmātraṃ gamyate | na tu karaṇādīnāṃ karttā preṣaṇam | kiṃ ca prayojyasyāpi hetusaṃjñāyāṃ tatprayojaka iti svatantrasya pratyavamarśo'narthakaḥ | karaṇādiprayojakavyāvṛttaye hi saḥ | tasyāpi tu karaṇādeḥ svavyāpārasvātantryāśrayeṇa prayojakasya hetusaṃjñāyāmanarthakaḥ pratyavamarśaḥ | kiṃ ca hetusaṃjñaivārnārthikā | kartṛmātrasya tasya `kartṛmati ṇic' ityevāstu | tathā ca | `bhīsmyorhetumaye' `bhiyohetubhaye ṣuk'  `bibheterhetubhaye' ityatra `kartṛbhaye' iti vacane'niṣṭaṃ syāt | tasmāt svatantrasya prayojaka iti karaṇādiprayojakasya hetusaṃjñāvyudāse prayatanīyam | atrocyate | tasya prayojaka iti sarvanāmnānubhavakartṛsaṃjñasya svatantrasya parāmarśādipratilabdhakartṛsaṃjñānāṃ karaṇādīnāṃ prayojakasya hetusaṃjñā na bhavati | tathā hi svavyāpāre svatantratve'pi karaṇādeḥ pradhānavyāpāre pāratantryāt kartṛsaṃjñā na bhavati | svatantraśrutisāmarthyāddhi prakṛṣṭaṃ sāmarthyaṃ vivakṣitam | karaṇādīnāṃ tvanukurvāṇānāṃ kārakatvāyogāt tadanyathānupapattyānumīyamānaṃ svavyāpāre svātantryaṃ yadi paraṃ kārakasaṃjñāyāmupayujyeta | na tu kartṛsaṃjñāyām; pradhānaviniyogenābhibhūtatvāt | prakṛṣṭasya svātantryasyābhāvāt | tataśca na te kartari santaḥ preṣyante | prayojyastu prayokto'pi sādhanāntaraviniyoktṛtvalakṣaṇaṃ prakṛṣṭaṃ svādhīnatvaṃ naiva tyajatīti sarvathā'sau kartaiva yujyate | ata evoktaṃ "kartṛtvena samāśritaḥ" iti | bhūtena bhāvinā vā saṃbhāvyamānena buddhyābhisaṃhitena kartṛtveneti siddhamiṣṭam || 122,123 ||
uktamidaṃ "prayogamātre nyagbhāvaṃ svātantryādena niśritaḥ" iti | tadapi vā nāstītyāha | nimittebhyaḥ pravartante sarva eva svabhūtaye | abhiprāyānurodho'pi svārthasyaiva prasiddhaye || 124 ||
 svārthalipsayā sarvaḥ pravartamānaḥ parādhīnatāṃ pravṛttau nāsādayatīṃti kevalaṃ kasyacit pravṛttiḥ kasyacidarthasiddhaye'pyaṅgamityetāvatā bhṛtyādeḥ svāmyādyāśayānuvartanena prayojyatā kathyate | nirveśanimittā hi bhṛtyānāṃ pravṛttiḥ svārthasādhanāyā bītarāgāṇāmapi kāruṇyāt pravṛttau parārthasampādanameva svārthaḥ phalam, iṣṭalakṣaṇatvāttasya | tadetad bhāṣye'bhihitam--- "sarva ime svabhūtyarthaṃ yatante | neha kaścit paro'nugṛhītavya iti|" iti | svabhūtyarthaṃ pravartamāneṣu kaḥ prayojyārtha iti codye samādhānamapyuktam--- "yadabhiprāyeṣu sajjante" iti | prayojakābhiprāyaḥ kriyāsampādanam | tacca svārthaphalābhisaṃdhānena pravartamāno'pi prayojyaḥ sādhayatyeva | evaṃ ca kṛtvā `hetumati ca' iti | prayojakābhiprāyaḥ kriyāsampādanam | tacca svārthaphalābhisaṃdhānena pravartamāno'pi prayojyaḥ sādhayatyeva | evaṃ ca kṛtvā `hetumati ca '  ityatropasaṃkhyānāni pratyākhyātāni | `na vā sāmānyakṛtatvāddhetuto hyaviśiṣṭam' iti | svarasapravṛttitvāt sūryasya māhiṣmatyāmudgamanaṃ pathikasyābhipretaṃ kākatālīyāt sampannamityabhiprāyānuvartanāt sūryaḥ prayojyo bhavatītyādi yojyam | tadāha vārtikakāraḥ--- `pravṛttirhyubhayatrānapekṣya' iti | muktasaṃśaye'pi prayojye yā pravṛttiḥ sāpi na prayojyasya svārthamapekṣya, api tvātmana evetyarthaḥ | `kaṃsavadhamācaṣṭe' ityādau tu `pratyakṣamiva kaṃsādīn' ityādinā pūrvameva samarthitam | acetanaviṣaye'pi tarhi bhikṣā vāsayati' ityādau vāsādyānukūlyādabhiprāyādhyāropāt prayojakatvaṃ samarthanīyam | evaṃ ca yogyatāmātreṇa nimittamātraṃ hetuḥ prayojaka ityuktaṃ nimittebhyaḥ iti | vārtike'pyuktam--- `hetunirdeśaśca nimittamātram bhikṣādiṣu darśanāt'  ityavasitavicāraḥ kartā || 124 ||
iti bhūtirājatatanayahelārājakṛte prakīrṇaprakāśe kartradhikāraḥ | ------------- kartaiva prayojakaḥ san heturiti kartṛvicārānantaraṃ hetuṃ vicārayati | preṣaṇādhyeṣaṇe kurvastat‌samarthāni cācaran | kartaiṃva vihitāṃ śāstre hetusaṃjñāṃ prapadyate || 125 ||
 ājñāpuraḥsarā vyāpāraṇā preṣaṇam, nikṛṣṭaviṣayo niyoga ityarthaḥ | yatpunarabhyarhitaṃ vyāpārayati tadadhyeṣaṇam | abhyarhitaviṣayaṃ prabodhanamityarthaḥ | tatsamarthāni prayojyakriyāsampattyanukūlāni ceṣṭitāni | ayameva ca mukhyaḥ prayojakavyāpāro yat prayojyakriyāsampattisamarthācaraṇam | vyāpakatvād bhikṣādiṣvapi bhāvāt | asyaiva nikṛṣṭotkṛṣṭaviṣayatayā preṣaṇādhyeṇarūpeṇa pravibhāgaḥ | tathā ca gobalīvardanyāyena tadvilakṣaṇaṃ tatsamarthācaraṇaṃ bhikṣāviṣayamatrābhipretam | vyavahārabhedādbhedenaiṣamupādānam | yathābhiprāyānuvidhānaṃ prayojyatvamuktaṃ tathā svābhiprāyaprakāśanamapi prayojakatvamiti tatsamarthācaraṇameva sarvatra prayojakavyāparaḥ | `kartaiva' iti | `tatprayojako hetuśca'  iti saṃjñāsamāveśārthaṃ cakāraṃ vyācaṣṭe |
