asati cakāre'traikasaṃjñādhikārāt kartṛsaṃjñā na syāditi samāveśārtho'sau | taduktaṃ vārtike | `gatidivihetumatmu ca grahaṇam' iti | vihitāṃ śāstre' iti | pradeśe'syaiva grahaṇaṃ yathā syādityarthaḥ | phalasādhanayogyaḥ padārtho hi laukiko heturdravyādiviṣayaḥ | tasya tvayaṃ viśeṣaḥ | kriyāviṣayatvena kārakaṃ hetuḥ prathojyaprayojakaḥ | ata e kārakatvanibandhanaḥ preṣaṇādiḥ svavyāpāro'tra nirdiṣṭaḥ | tatra `hetumati ca' `bhiyo hetubhaye'  ityatra kutrimasya hetorgrahaṇam | tṛtīyāvidhau tu `hetau'  ityatra prayojako kartṛtvādeva tṛtīyāsiddhelaukikasya hetorgrahaṇam | paṃcamīvidhāvapi `akartari...'  iti pāribhāṣikaḥ paryudasyate | `lakṣaṇahetvoḥ kriyāyāḥ' ityatrāpi prayojyasya kārakatvāt kriyāyogāvyabhicārād viśeṣaṇasāmarthyād dravyaguṇakriyāviṣayatvena saṃmavavyabhicārāllaukika eva hecurgṛhyate | tathā dhātvādhikārācca | na hi dhātuḥ sādhanarūpe hetau vartate | evaṃ hetuhetumatorliṅ  ityatrāpi hetordhātvarthaviśeṣaṇatvāt sādhanasya ca dhātvarthatvābhāvāt laukika eva hetuḥ | `kuño hetutācchīlyānulomyeṣu' ityatrāpi na prayojako hetuḥ | tatra ṇij‌vidhānāt kuña iti ca tijrahitasya nirdeśāt | tenātra kṛttvāt prāptasya kartuḥ laukiko heturviśeṣaṇam | tena ca virodhābhāvānna nivartyate kartā | yogyatārūpeṇaiva ca kṛdbhiḥ karturabhidhānānnimittamātraṃ heturupadīyamāno viśeṣaṇaṃ punaḥ śruteravadhāraṇaṃ prakalpayati `hetureva' iti | tenāvyabhicāri kāraṇaṃ vidyādi yaśaḥ prabhṛtiṣu pratipāditaṃ bhavati | ete cātra hetvādayaḥ kartṛviśeṣapratītisāmarthyād gamyamānāḥ paramparayā padārthā eva | anyathā vākyāvasthāyāṃ pratīyamānāḥ padāvadhikasyānvākhyānasya nimittabhāvaṃ nopeyuḥ | iha praiṣātisarga..... ityādisūtre cakāreṇa samuccito loṭ iti praiṣe ṇijloṭorvidhānādvikalpaprasaṅga iti bhāṣye coditam | pṛcchatu mā bhavān, anuyāṅktāṃ mā bhavānityatra ṇic kasmānna bhavati | iti | `mā bhavān' ityātmanirdeśena prayojakāśritaṃ praiṣaṃ pradarśayan ṇicaḥ prāptiṃ paripuṣṇāti | atra parihāro bhāṣye'bhihitaḥ | `akartṛtvāt' iti | svatantrasya kartuḥ prayojako hi tad‌vyāpāre ṇij vidhīyamāno'tra pṛcchikriyāyāmapravṛttasya tasya kartṛtvābhāvāttatprayojakasya hetusaṃjñābhāvāttad‌vyāpāre praiṣe ṇij na bhavatītyarthaḥ | codakastu kālādeḥ praśnādyaśak‌tasyāprayojyatvāt pravṛttattya ca niyogānarthakyāt saṃbhāvitakriyatvena kartuṃ preṣaṇamidamityāha--- "kiṃ ca bhoḥ vartamānāyā eva kriyāyāḥ kartrā bhavitavyam, na bhūtabhaviṣyatkālāyāḥ" iti | atrottaram | `abhisaṃbandhastatra kriyate |' iti| sāmarthyasambhāvito bhūtabhaviṣyatkriyāviṣaye kriyākārakabhāvaḥ | tatra ca loḍ‌viṣaye prayojyakriyaivaikā sambhāvyata iti `kriyāyāṃ kartā bhava' iti | na tvaparaḥ prayojyavyāpāraviṣayaḥ prayojakavyāpāro'sti | anantaraṃ bhāṣyam | `yacca kartā kathaṃ kartṛpratyayenocyate' iti | atrottaram | kathamasminnapṛcchatyayaṃ pṛcchirvartate |' iti | tat uktam | abhisaṃbandhastatra kriyate, imāṃ kriyāṃ kurvīti |'iti | anantaramuktam | kartrāpi tarhyabhisaṃbandhaḥ kriyate | asyāṃ krithāyāṃ kartā bhaveti iti | tathā ca yathātra saṃpratyapṛcchatyapi pṛcchikriyābhisandhānena pṛcchirdhāturvartate tathā tatkartrāpyabhisaṃbandhāt kartṛpratyayo loṭ kriyata iti kartrāpi tarhyabhisaṃbandhaḥ kriyata ityuktam | evaṃ ca vadatā bhāṣyakāreṇa sampratyakartṛtvādatra ṇij na bhavatītyuktaṃ bhavati | tathā hi navamevāsyādhīyamānaṃ kartṛtvaṃ na tu vidyamānam | kriyāyāṃ kartā bhaveti hi preṣyate, na tu kartaiva san | tena kartuḥ sataḥ praiṣaḥ prayojakasamavāyī ṇijviṣayaḥ, loṭpratyayastu kartrādiṣu vidhīyate | dhātvarthopādhistu tasya praiṣo dyotyaḥ | sa ca na dhātupratyayavācyaḥ, api tu sāmarthyād vaktaiva prayojako'vatiṣṭhata iti taddharmaḥ praiṣo'vatiṣṭhamāno na dhātupratyayena niyatakālatayātrāvacchidyate | tathā ca sampratyapṛcchatyapi pṛcchatviti prayogaḥ | ṇicastu praiṣo vācya iti śabdopādānatvādabhidheyadharmo bhavan niyatakālābhidhāyinā pratyayena laḍādinā kālaniyamenāvacchidyate | śabdena hi ṇyantādutpannena kartṛvācinā lakāreṇa tṛjādinā copātto yaḥ kartā prayojakastasya saṃbandhī pratīyate'sāvityabhidheyadharmaḥ | dvividho hyarthaḥ śāstre'nvākhyānāṅgabhāvenopādīyate | kaścit prayoktṛdharmo yathā vīpsābādhāsūyākutsanādiḥ | anyaḥ pratipādyadharmaḥ | tatrāyaṃ loḍviṣayaḥ praiṣa ābādhādivat prayoktṛdharma ityabhidheyatvād vyāvṛttaḥ || 125 ||
tadetat tātparyeṇa pratipādayati | dravyamātrasya tu praiṣe pṛcchayāderloḍ vidhīyate | sakriyasya prayogastu yadā sa viṣayo ṇicaḥ || 126 ||
 apravṛttakriyasya dravyamātrasya apratilabdhakartṛbhāvasya kartṛtvārtha eva praiṣe dyotye loḍupidaśyate | pṛcchayanuyujyāderdhātoḥ paraḥ pratyayaḥ kartrādikārake vācye | pravṛttakriyasya tu virāmāśaṅkāyāṃ mā viraṃsīdityabhisaṃdhāya kartureva svatantrasya prayojakahetuvyāpāre ṇij vācaka upadiśyate | pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇapakṣo hi `hetumati ca' ityatra siddhāntitaḥ | tathā ca vārtikam | `hetumatīti kārakopādānaṃ pratyayaparigrahārtham |'  iti | tadevaṃ ṇij‌loṭorvibhakta eva viṣayaḥ saukikācchabdaprayogāt praiṣabhedasyātrāvadhāraṇāt | ṇij‌viṣayasya praiṣasyābhidheyadharmatvena ṇij‌vācyatayā ca taddharmabhedālloḍ‌viṣayasya tu dyotyatvena prayoktṛdharmatvena ca bhedāt | ata eva tuśabdadvayena sambandhanīyaḥ | pṛcchatu mā bhavānityādau na praiṣakarturvācakaḥ kaścid vidyate | kevalamuccārayitaiva kartā sāmarthyāt pratīyate ityabhidheyadharmo'tra praiṣo na bhavati | nāpi svarūpeṇābhidheyaḥ loṭā tadanabhidhānāt loḍantaśabdoccāraṇāddhi prayoktṛdharmatvenābādhādivat pratīyate praiṣo na tvasya vācakaḥ kaścidasti | yadi tarhi evamanayoḥ praiṣayoḥ sphuṭo bhedaḥ kathaṃ bhāṣye coditam--- `iha kasmānna ṇij bhavati pṛcchatu mā bhavān' iti | lokavyavahārādhigamyo'yaṃ vibhāgaḥ, śāstre'nvākhyānavibhāgo na kṛta iti praiṣamātraṃ samānaṃ matvā pūrvapakṣaḥ || 126 ||
gatametat | iha prayojyasya praiṣaṇādhyeṣaṇādinā sarvasya prayojakavyāpāreṇāpyamānatvāt karmasaṃjñāprasaṅga ityāśaṅkyāha | guṇakriyāyāṃ svātantryāt preṣaṇe karmatāṃ gataḥ | niyamāt karmasaṃjñāyāḥ svadharmeṇābhidhīyate || 127 ||
 svatantratāmaparityajanneva prayojyaḥ prayojakavyāpāre pārādhīnyaṃ pratipadyate | na hyasya prayojakena svātantryakhaṇḍanā kriyata ityuktam | itarathā hyakurvatyapi kārayatīti syāditi | tathā ca praiṣe'pi svavyāpāre svātantryāt kartṛsaṃjñā bhavatyeva | karmasaṃjñā tu praiṣaṇāpyamānatvena prāptā `gatibuddhi...'  ityādinā niyamitā | gatyādidhātuviṣaya eva prayojyaḥ karmasaṃjño nānyatreti pācayatyodanaṃ devadattenetyādau svadharmeṇa kartṛtvena prayojyaḥ abhidhīyate ityarthaḥ | nanu praṣe'pi svātantryasyānivṛttau kartṛsaṃjñaiva paratvāt syāditi kathaṃ gatibuddhītyādiniyamaḥ kathyate | kartṛsaṃjñāprasaṅge hi karmasaṃjñā ārabhyata iti vidhyarthatā syāt | atrocyate - iha guṇapradhānabhūtakriyādvayaviṣayaśaktidvayaviṣaye pradhānaśaktireva svakāryaṃ prayuṅkte na guṇaśaktiriti prāgeva pratipāditam | tatra dhātuvācyaḥ prayojyavyāpāro ṇyarthaviśeṣaṇatvādapradhānaṃ prayojakavyāpārastu ṇij‌vācyaḥ pradhānam | prakṛtyarthāvacchinnatvāddhi pratyayārthaḥ sarvatraiva pradhānam , prakṛtipratyayo pratyayārthaṃ saha brūta iti | ataścātra prayojakavyāpārasya prādhānyāt tadapekṣayā karmaśaktireva svakāryaṃ prāpayati, na tu prayojyavyāpāraviṣayā kartṛśaktiḥ | tadyathāodanasya viklittau svātantrye'pi na kartṛsaṃjñā, api tu vikledanena devadattvāyāpāreṇepsitatamatvāt karmasaṃjñaiva pācayatyodanamiti | tadevamatrobhayaprasaṅgābhāve vipratiṣedhābhāvāt karta-saṃjñāpratptyā siddhaiva gatyādiviṣaye'pi karmasaṃjñeti niyamārthaḥ āraṃbhaḥ | pacatyādiviṣaye niyamena pradhānakārye prasārite niṣpratipakṣaṃ guṇakriyā svātantryaṃ svakāryaṃ kartṛsaṃjñāṃ pravartayatyeveti siddham || 127 ||
prayojako heturityuktam | karmaṇaścāpi phalabhūtasya kriyāṃ pratyastyeva prayojakatvamiti tasyāpi hetutvaprasaṅga ityāśaṅkya hetukarmaṇorbhedaṃ darśayati | kriyāyāḥ prerakaṃ karma hetuḥ kartuḥ prayojakaḥ | karmārthā ca kriyotpattiḥ saṃskārapratipattibhiḥ || 128 ||
 nirvṛttivikārapratipattibhiryathākramaṃ nirvartyāditrividhakarmasampādakatvāt kriyāphalaṃ karmātmasampattyarthaṃ kriyāṃ prayuṅkte | hetuḥ punaḥ kriyārthī sādhanaviniyoge kartāraṃ prayuṅkte, na tu sākṣāt kriyām | tatparipoṣāya hi kartuḥ pravṛttiḥ | tasya kartuḥ prayojaka iti vacanāt , iti bhinnaviṣayatvāddhetukarmaṇoḥ prayojakatvasya svarūpabhedaḥ sphuṭa ityarthaḥ | `ca' śabdo hetau | yasmādutpattyādibhirupakārāt kriyā karmārthā tataḥ karma kriyāyāḥ prayojakam | yaddhi yadarthaṃ tattasya prayojakamiti vyapadiśyate | taduddeśena tatpravṛtteḥ | kārakāntarāṇi tu kriyārthāni na tu tadarthā kriyeti na tāni tasthāḥ prayojakāni | na hi karaṇādyarthaṃ kriyāpravṛttiḥ | upāyamātraṃ hi tat | tadayamavasitavicāro hetuḥ || 128 ||
iti bhūtirājatanayahelārājakṛte prakīrṇaprakāśe sādhanasamuddeśe hetvadhikāraḥ || --------------- vibhaktividhānakrameṇa sādhanānāṃ vicāre tṛtīyārthe kartari nirṇīte caturthyarthaṃ sampradānaṃ vicārayitumāha | anirākaraṇāt karttustyāgāṅgaṃ karmaṇopsitam | preraṇānumatibhyāṃ vā labhate sampradānatām || 129 ||
 anvarthatvāt sampradānaśabdasya `tyāgāṅgam' iti lakṣaṇalābhaḥ | tyāgo dīyamānasya svatvanivṛttyā parasvatvāpādanam | tatra cāṅgaṃ nimittaṃ pāṇyādyapi bhavatītyāha - karmaṇepsitam iti | yat tyajyamānaṃ karma tena karaṇabhūtena prāraṃbha eva kartrāptumiṣṭamityarthaḥ | tathā ca `karmaṇā yamabhipraiti'  iti lakṣaṇaparigrahaḥ | tadevavidhaṃ tyāgāṅgaṃ kathaṃ kārakaviśeṣarūpāṃ sampradānatāṃ labhata ityāśaṅkya kārakatvanibandhanaṃ vyāpāraṃ kriyāsiddhau nirdiśati anirākaraṇād ityādinā | `upādhyāyāya gāṃ dadāti' ityādau tyajyamānaṃ karma gavādyupādhyāyādinā saṃbadhyate, tadabhiprāyeṇaiva tyāgāt | sa copādhyāyastadamisaṃbadhyamānaṃ na nirākaroti, nāpi tat‌tyaktuḥ `mā tyākṣīḥ' iti nirākaraṇaṃ vidhatte | yadi hi nirākuryāt tyāga eva na sampadyate | parasvatvāpattiparyantatvāttasya | anumanyate ca dīyamānam | tathā dīyamānaṃ na nirākaroti balyādi devatādīti tadapi kriyāṅgam | yāñcāpūrvake ca dāne preraṇam abhyarthanayā dāne pravartanamapi sampradānavyāpāraḥ | tathā ca tyāgopakāritvāt tyāgāṅgaṃ bhavatyeva kārakaṃ sampradānam | nanu ca dānasya tadarthatvāt tādarthye caturthīprayogāt kimarthaṃ sampradānasaṃjñā | naitannyāyyam | dānakriyārthaṃ hi sampradānam, na tu dānakriyā tadarthā, kārakāṇāṃ kriyārthatvāt sampradānārthaṃ tu dīyamānaṃ karmeti vākyārthabhūtāyā dānakriyāyā atādarthyāt tādarthye caturthyā aprāptau tadarthā samprādanasaṃjñā nyāyyā | `rajakasya vastraṃ dadāti ,'`ghnataḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ dadāti' ityādau tu dadātyartho nāsti | tyāgo hi saḥ | tena ca hānātmakena mamatāvicchedasyākṣepādeva paropayogābhisaṃdhinā parasvatvāpādanamapi svīkṛtam | atra ca tadabhāva iti gauṇo'yaṃ dadāteḥ prayogaḥ | devatāviṣaye tu dāne dātustatsvāmikatvasaṅkalpo vidyate eva | evam `arocakine'nnaṃ dadāti' ityādau upayogābhāvastu na śābdaḥ | na śūdrāya yatiṃ dadyādityatrāpi matisaṃtānasyāparakrāmato'styeva paropayogaḥ | tathā ca `upādhyāyādāgamayati' ityadhyayanasaṃtānasyāpakrāmato bhavatthapādānamupādhyāyaḥ matisaṃtānasthokadeśastyajyamāna iti svatvanivūttyaṅgaparasvatvāpādanalakṣaṇo mukhya evātra dadātyarthaḥ | anye tu mateḥ dātṛsaṃbandhānavagamādnauṇa ityāhuḥ | "kānyāṃ dadāti" iti janyajanakabhāvāvyāvṛttāvapi svasvābhisaṃbandhasya nivṛttermukhya eva dadāttharthaḥ "khaṇḍikopādhyāyastamai capeṭāṃ dadāti" ityādau vastuto'satyapi capeṭādisvāmye tadupakāritayā dātuḥ svāmitvābhisaṃdhirastyeva | yadyapi pratikūlarūpatvāccapeṭāyāstadānīmupayogo nāsti tathāpi phalādvareṇāstyeva paropayogitvam | capeṭāsahatve śāstrābhyāsayogyatvāt phalāvāpteḥ | `mṛjirasmāya viśeṣeṇopadiṣṭaḥ' iti tādarthye caturthī | aviśeṣeṇa gaṇe paṭhito mṛjirmārjakaśabdārtho'pi bhavatītyarthaḥ || 129 ||
tadevaṃ prathamaṃ sampradānaṃ vyākhyātam | idānīmuttaraṃ vyākhyātumāha | hetutve karmasaṃjñāyāṃ śeṣatve vāpi kārakam | rucyārthādiṣu śāstreṇa sampradānākhyamucyate || 130 ||
 yathā saṃjñāntarapūrvakaṃ karma prāguktaṃ tathedamapi saṃmpradānamanyapūrvakaṃ śāstreṇa `rucyarthānāṃ prīyamāṇaḥ'  ityādinā vyākhyāyate | tathā hi `devadattāya rocate modakaḥ' ityatrānyakartṛko'bhilāṣo rucyartha ityabhilāṣaviṣayabhāvamāpadyamānaṃ modakaṃ devadattaḥ prayuṅkte laulyāttadānuguṇyamācaratīti hetusaṃjñāyāṃ prayojakasya devadattasya prāptāyāṃ sampradānasaṃjñā kathyate | tathā ca hetusaṃjñābādhe ṇico'bhāvāddhetusamavāyinyā dvitīyasyāḥ kriyāyā apratītermodakaḥ svakriyāyāṃ dhātuvācyāyāṃ kartā bhavati na karma | rocate abhilāṣaviṣayabhāvamāpadyata ityarthaḥ | hetusaṃjñāsaniyuktāyāḥ kartṛsaṃjñāyā api devadattasya bādhanāt kartuḥ kriyayepsitatamatvābhāvāt | svātantryopalakṣaṇāyāmapi kartṛśrutau sārthīddhīyata iti karmaṇi lakārasamarthanārthamatra modakasya karmasaṃjñā na bhavati | yatra hi śabdopāttāyā ṃ kriyāyāṃ svātantryaṃ pratīyate tatra bhavettadāśrayaṃ karmatvam | yathā hīyata iti hāne śabdopātte sārthasyeti tadāśrayā pathikasya karmasaṃjñā | iha tu śabdopāttāyāṃ modakakriyāyāṃ rocata ityasmānna devadattasya svātantryaṃ pratīyate, śabdavyāpārānapekṣāyāṃ tu vāstavasvātantryasya kārakamātraviṣayatvāt kartṛśrutiranarthikā syāt | yadā tu devadattāya rocate modaka ityayamartho devadattaṃmodakaḥ prīṇayatīti, tathā ca prīyamāṇa iti viśeṣaṇaṃ tadā karmasaṃjñāyāṃ prāptāyāṃ sampradānasaṃjñāraṃbhaḥ | dhātorarthāntare hi vṛttau sakarmakatvam | evaṃ `devadattāya ślāghate' iti guṇotkarṣeṇa devadattaḥ śasyamāno guṇavattayā tatsamarthācaraṇādadhyāropitaprayojakabhāvo hetusaṃjñāṃ prāpto guṇākhyānena vā jñāpayitumiṣṭo jñāpanenāpyamānatvāt karmasaṃjña iti `ślāghahnuṅ'  ityādinā sampradānasaṃjñaḥ kathyate | evaṃ hnautiprabhṛtīnāṃ yathāyogaṃ vācyam | hnautiprabhṛtayo hyatra svārthopasarjanajñāpanavacanatvāt sakarmakāḥ | tathā ca jñīpsyamāna iti saṃjñiviśeṣaṇamupāttam | `devadattāya śataṃ dhārayati' iti svarūpe'vatiṣṭhamānaṃ śatamavasthāpayatyaghamarṇo dhārayati | atrottamarṇo devadatto dānakriyādvāreṇa nimittaṃ dhāraṇasya | yato'sau dadāti śataṃ na ca tatra dadātikriyā śrūyate ityaśrūyamāṇakriyāviṣaye'tra kārakaśeṣe ṣaṣṭhyāṃ prāptāyāṃ `dhāreruttamarṇaḥ ' iti sampradānasaṃjñā | yathāsaṃbhavaṃ hi hetvāditrayaṃ prāptamucyate na tu pratyekam | `puṣpebhyaḥ spṛ-hayati' iti puṣpāṇāmīpsitatamatvāt karmasaṃjñāprasaṅga uktaḥ | druhyādau tu karmasaṃjñāprasaṅgaḥ | drohasyāpakāratvāt tadarthāḥ sakarmakāḥ | evamīrṣyāsūyārthā api | `devadattāya rādhyati, īkṣate iti tu daivaṃ paryālocanaṃ gaṇakaṃ devadattaḥ prayuṅkte iti hetusaṃjñāyāṃ prāptāyāṃ `rādhīkṣyoḥ '  iti sampradānatā | `devadattāya gāṃ pratiśṛṇoti, aśṛṇoti' ityatra tu devadatto yāñcayā gāṃ pratijānānaṃ prayuṅkte iti hetusaṃjñāyāṃ prāptāyāṃ `pratyāṅbhyāṃ śruvaḥ' iti sampradānatā | pūrvasya hi dhātvarthasya yācanalakṣaṇasya devadattaḥ kartā bhavan pratiśrave'ṅgīkāpare prayojako bhavati | `hotre'nugṛṇāti, pratigṛṇāti ' ityatrāpi `hotāraṃ śaṃsanena protsāhayati' iti hotuḥ karmasaṃjñāprasaṅge `anupratiguṇaśca'  iti sampradānatā | śatāya parikrīto'nubrūhi' iti sādhakatamasya parikrayaṇe niyatakālasvīkāre sampradānatā vikalpenoktā | tatra rucyarthādiṣvati ādiśabdopāttasya sujñānatvāt karaṇasaṃjñāprasaṅgo noktaḥ | viśeṣavivakṣāyā abhāve cātra sarvatraiva kriyānimittatvamātrāśrayeṇa śeṣatve prāpte sampradānatodāhāryā | duhyādiparigaṇanāddhi akathitakarmatātra nāsti | nanu ca pūrvamapi sampradānaśāstreṇaivoktaṃ `karmaṇā yamabhipraiti'  iti | tatkathamatra śāstreṇeti viśeṣyabhaṇitiḥ | ucyate | anvarthatvād sampradānaśabdasya laukika eva sampradānārthaḥ pūrvamuktaḥ | iha tu rucyarthādiviṣaye tadarthābhāvācchabdasaṃskāramātrapratipādanāya śāstrāraṃbhasāmarthyāt sampradānatvamucyata iti śāstrīyalaukikabhedena dvividhaṃ sampradānaṃ vyākhyātam || 130 ||
iha śrāddhaya nigalhate, yuddhāya saṃnahyate, patye śete ityakarmakadhātuviṣaye karmaṇo'bhāvāttenābhipreyamāṇasya sampradānatā na siddhyatīti `kriyāgrahaṇamapi kartavyam' iti vārtike'bhihitam | kriyayābhipreyamāṇasyātra syāt sampradānasaṃjñā | etadbhāṣye pratyākhyātam | kriyāpi kriyayāpyamānatvāt kṛtrimaṃ karma | śrāddhāya nigalhate ityādau ca kayā kriyayā kriyāpyamāneti sandarśanādikriyayetyuktam | tatra saṃdarśanādikriyayā abhedena dhātunābhidhānāt | kathamabhedāśrayaḥ kriyākārakabhāvo yujyata iti samarthayitumāha | bhedasya ca vivakṣāyāṃ pūrvā pūrvā kriyāṃ prati | parasyāṅgasya karmatvānna kriyāgrahaṇaṃ kṛtam || 131 ||
 sandarśanaprārthanādyavasāyairāpyamānatvāt kriyāpi kṛtrimaṃ karma | tatra praikṣāpūrvakāriṇaḥ pravṛttāvāvaśyakena sandarśanādayaḥ sannihitāḥ pratīyanta iti teṣāṃ pradhānakriyāyā bhedavivakṣāyāṃ pūrvapūrvakriyāpekṣayottarottarasyāṅgasya pradhānakriyārthasya karmatvamaviruddhaṃ pūrvapūrvakriyayāpyamānatvāditi kriyāyā api karmatāyāṃ tayābhisaṃbadhyamānasya sūtreṇaiva sampradānatā siddheti kriyāgrahaṇaṃ pratyākhyātam | dadātikarmaṇetyayaṃ nāṅgīkriyate | tadatra dhātunā pradhānakriyaivocyate | sāmarthyaprāptāstu saṃdarśanādayaḥ tato bhinnā iti kriyākārakabhāvopapattiḥ | tadyathā | sārthāddhīyate iti pratīyamānaṃ sārthasya svātantryaṃ karmatvanimittaṃ yadi vā tādarthyāt pradhānakriyayā prāptābhedānāṃ dhātubhirabhidhāne'pi na sarvathaiva bhedatiraskāra ityabhedākhyakāryānumitabhedapratītyā karmatopapattiḥ || 131 ||
yadyevamodanaṃ pacatītyādāvapi kriyākarmaṇābhipreyamāṇasya sampradānasaṃjñā syāt | odanādeḥ karmasaṃjñā tu kriyākarmasu sāvakāśetyata āha | kriyāṇāṃ samudāye tu yadaikatvaṃ vivakṣitam | tadā karma kriyāyogāt svākhyayaivopacaryate || 132 ||
 sandarśanādikriyāsamudāyaḥ parasparamaṅgābhāvamanāpannaḥ samakakṣyatathā samuccīyamānarūpo yadaikaphalatvādabhedena dhātunāṅgīkriyate tadā bhedanibandhanasya kriyākārakabhāvasyāpratīterapratilabdhakarmabhāvayā kriyayā saṃbadhyamānamodanādikarma svākhyayaiva kriyapepsitatamatvanimittabhūtayā karmasaṃjñayaiva vyavahriyate, na tu sampradānasajñayetyarthaḥ | samuccayenābhidhānādaṅgāṅgibhāvābhāvāt kriyāyāḥ karmarūpatā nāstyatra pakṣe || 132 ||
bhedavivakṣāyāṃ tarhi sampradānatātra syādityāśaṅkayāha | bhedābhedavivakṣā ca svabhāvena vyavasthitā | tasmādgatyarthakarmatve vyabhicāro na dṛśyate || 133 ||
 lokikaprayogaḥ prasiddha iti tamuddiśyānvākhyāne yathāprayogamupāyaparikalpanayā niyatabhedābhedavivakṣetyarthaḥ | evaṃ ca gatyarthakarmaṇi dvitīyācaturthyau api ubhayavivakṣāśrayeṇa siddheti nārthastadāraṃbheṇa | anyatrābhedavivakṣāniyamād vyabhicāro'tiprasaṅgo nāsti || 133 ||
etadevāgamena dḍhayati | vikalpenaiva sarvatra saṃjñe syātāmubhe yadi | āraṃbheṇa na yogasya pratyākhyānaṃ samaṃ bhavate || 134 ||
 bhedābhedavivakṣāniyamānāśrayaṇe sarvatra karmasampradānasaṃjñayorbhāvānniyamārthaṃ gatyarthakarmaṇītyādisūtraṃ bhāṣyakāro na pratyācakṣīta | pratyākhyāne hyatiprasaṅgaḥ syāt | yadā tu vivakṣāniyamaścetasi bhāṣyakārasya spharati tadāraṃbhapratyākhyānayoraviśeṣaṃ manyamāno yuktaṃ yat pratyācakṣīta | tadevaṃ gatyarthaviṣaye vivakṣādvayam | śrāddhāya nigalhata ityevamādau tu bhedavivakṣaiva | pacatyodanamityādāvabhedavivakṣaiva | ceṣṭāyāmanadhvanītyetatpratyudāharaṇayorapi cābhedavivakṣaiva, manasā pāṭaliputraṃ gacchatyadhvānaṃ gacchatīti | sūtrāraṃbhe ca striyaṃ gacchatyajāṃ nayatītyatiprasaṅge `siddhaṃ tvasaṃprāptavacanāt'  ityuktam | asamprāptaṃ gamanenāsaṃbaddhaṃ yatkarma tatra dvitīyācaturthyau vaktavye | ajāstriyau tu samprāpte karmaṇītyatiprasaṅgo na bhavati | evaṃ ca viśeṣasūtrārambhe `adhvanaścānapavādaḥ'  ityuktam | adhvanīti pratiṣedho na vaktavyaḥ | adhvā hi samprāptaṃ karmeha pratiṣeddhumabhipretaḥ | tasya cāsamprāptavacanādeva vyudāsaḥ siddhaḥ | ata eva bhāṣye'bhihitam | āsthitapratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ iti | āsthito'dhvātra pratiṣedhaviṣayo vijñeyaḥ || 134 ||
 `adhvanyarthagrahaṇam'  iti vacanādadhvaparyāyebhyo'pi pratiṣedhaḥ, panthānaṃ gacchatītyādau | āsthita ākrānto gamikriyayā adhvā | udāharaṇam | pravṛttagamano hi mārga āsthita ityucyate | atra yeyaṃ gamikriyā sā dvirūpā bhavati, ākrāntasya patho yo'tikamaṇīyo bhāgaḥ tatra tyāgarūpaṃ hīnarūpaṃ kriyāyāḥ | prāpye tvāsādanīye bhāge saṃsargarūpaṃ prāptarūpamiti tyāgopādānalakṣaṇāvayavabhedāt kriyā dvividhā tathā ca tyāgopādānarūpāvicchinnapravāhagamikriyākrānto'dhvā kriyāviṣayabhāvamātravidhīyamānakarmasaṃjñāgocaro na tu kriyayā karmabhūtayā'bhisaṃbadhyate kriyābhedābhāvāditi sampradānasaṃjñābhāvaḥ | grāmādereva tadupāyāprāpyasyānadhvarūpasya tadyogaḥ | yastvanāsthito'dhvā tatra dve eva vibhaktī bhavataḥ | kathaṃ cānāsthito'dhvā bhavati | yadotpathena prāpnoti panthānaṃ pathe gacchati, panthānaṃ gacchatīti, tadevaṃ sūtrāraṃbhe viśeṣo vaktavyaḥ | pratyākhyāne tu vivakṣāniyamenaiveṣṭaṃ siddham || 135 ||
iti bhūtirājatanayahelārājakṛte prakīrṇaprakāśe sādhanasamuddeśe sampradānādhikāraḥ || --------------  idānīṃ vibhaktividhānakrameṇa tadarthavicāre catuthyarye nirṇīte prāptāvasaraṃ paṃcamyarthamapādānaṃ vicārayitumāha | nirdiṣṭaviṣayaṃ kiṃcidupāttaviṣayaṃ tathā | apekṣitakriyaṃ ceti tridhāpādānamucyate || 136 ||
apāye sādhye yad dhruvamekarūpamanāviṣṭāpāyalakṣaṇakriyamanyasminnapāyenāviṣṭe'pi tatsādhanamapādānamityavadhiviśeṣāpekṣatvāt saṃrabdhodāsīnobhayakartṛko'pāyo'pādānasya viṣayaḥ sa nirdiṣṭaḥ svaśabdenopātto yasya tadekamapādānamū | tadyathā `grāmādāgacchati', `parvatādavarohati' ityādi | upāttaḥ kriyāntarasya guṇabhāvena pradhānabhāvena vā yatrāpāyalakṣaṇo viṣayastadanyadupāttaviṣayapādānam | tadyathā `valahakāt vidyotate', `kusūlāt pacati', `brāhmaṇācchaṃsī' iti | atra hi niḥsaraṇāṃṅge vidyotane nṛvidyotanāṅge vā niḥsaraṇe vidyutirvartate iti niḥsaraṇavakṣaṇo'pāyo vidyotanasya guṇapradhānabhāvenopāttaḥ | valāhakānniḥsṛtya jyotirvidyotate, valāhakādvā vidyotamānaṃ niḥsaratītyarthaḥ | kusūlādadāya pacatītyādānāṅge pāke paciḥ | brāhmaṇād gṛhṇitvā śaṃsatīti grahaṇāṅge śaṃsane śaṃsirvartate | `paṃcamīprakaraṇe brāhmaṇācchaṃsina upasaṃkhyānam'  ityaluk | tatra vārtikakārasya dvitīyārthe paṃcamyeṣābhipretā | yadāha `anyārthe ca'  iti | brāhmaṇāni granthaviśeṣarūpāṇi yaḥ śaṃsati sa kathyate brāhmaṇācchaṃsīti vṛttiviṣaye'tra dvitīyārthe paṃcamī vaktavyā | bhāṣyakārastu brāhmaṇād gṛhītvā āhṛtya śaṃsatītyāharaṇāṅge śaṃsane śaṃsirvartate iti bruvannupāttaviṣayametadupādānaṃ manyate | apekṣitakriyaṃ tvapādānaṃ yatra sarvathaiva kriyāśabdasyānupalabdheraśrutā kriyānumīyamānā saṃbandhiṣu dravyeṣu saṃjñāviśeṣahetūnāṃ śaktibhedānāmāvirbhāve nimitatvāya kalapate | tadyathā māthurā pāṭaliputrakebhya āḍhyatarā iti | atra hi prakarṣapratyasāmarthyāt vibhāgaheturanumīyamānāpakarṣaṇakriyāpāyalakṣaṇetyapekṣitāsāvatra kriyā | upāttaviṣaye tu dhātunaivāpāyaḥ svīkṛtaḥ | anekārthatvena dhātūnām | valāhako vidyotate, caitraḥ pacati, dāśatayīḥ śaṃsati ityādau vidyotanādimātravacanatve'pyanyatra niḥsaraṇādyaṅge vṛtteravirodhāt, paṃcamīśrutisāmarthyāddhyapāyo'tra pratīyate | sa ca niḥsaraṇādyaṅgatve dhātvarthasyopapadyate nānyatheti tadarthatāniścayaḥ || 136 ||
kaḥ punaramapāyaḥ, kiṃ gatimātraṃ netyāha | saṃyogibhedādebhinnātmā gamireva bhramiryathā | dhruvāvadhirapāyo'pi samavetastathādhruve || 137 ||
 saṃyogena sāhacaryādvibhāgo'pyavadhiḥ svīkṛtaḥ | tena digviśeṣāvacchinnasaṃyogavibhāgakāryaṃ yathā gamanameva bhramaṇamiti vyapadiśyate yathā ca gamanagrahaṇād bhramaṇarecanaspandanādayo gṛhyante na jātyantarāṇīti kāṇādāḥ evaṃ dhruvamacalamanāviṣṭāpāyamavadhiryasyādhruve cale samavetasyāsau saṃrabdhodāsīnasādhanasādhyastyāgastadubhayakārakagatavibhāgalakṣaṇaphalo'pāyākhyo gativiśeṣa eva boddhavyaḥ gantari samavetāpīyaṃ kriyā'vadhyapekṣaṇādapāyākhyāṃ labhata iti tatra dhruvasya kriyāsiddhau nimittatvaṃ kārakatvamupapadyata ityāśayaḥ | sa cāpādānasaṃjñāyā viṣayabhāvenāvasthito'pāyo dhātunābhidhīyamāno'numīyamāno vā dhruvamapādānasaṃjñamapāye sādhya iti tatra nimittatvaṃ dhruvasya kārakasya | evamapāyo vyākhyātaḥ | dhruvaṃ hi sthiramacalaṃ loke prasiddham | tataśca vārtike coditam | `gatiyukteṣvapādānasaṃjñā nopapadyate adhrutvāt '  iti | dhāvato'śvāt patitaḥ, sārthād gacchato hīna ityādau gatiyukteṣvapādānasaṃjñiṣu dhruvatvasya sthipatvasyācalatvasyābhāvāt saṃjñā na prāpnotītyarthaḥ || atra parihāro'bhihito `na vā dhrauvyasyāvivakṣitatvāt' iti || 137 ||
etad vyākhyātumāha | dravyatvabhāvo na dhnauvyamiti sūtre pratīyate | apāyaviṣayaṃ ghrauvyaṃ yattu tāvadvivakṣitam || 138 ||
 dhruvaṃ kūṭasthaṃ niṣkriyamiti dravyasvabhāvo dhnauvyaṃ sūtre na pratyevyam, api tvasaṃtuṣṭacalano'tra dhruvaśabdaḥ | tathā hyapāyasādhye yaddhruvaṃ tenāpāyenāsaṃspṛṣṭamityeṣo'rthaḥ | evaṃ ca kṛtvā dhāvatoṣa?śvātpatita ityatra pātasyāśvakartṛkatvābhāvāttenānāveśe dhruvatāśvasya tatrāstyeva | saṃrabdhodāsīnasādhanasādhyo hyapāyaḥ | tatrāśva udāsīnaḥ, apetā tu saṃrabdhaḥ | grāmādāgacchati pathā parvatamiti tu pathaḥ karaṇasya parvatasya karmaṇo'pāyenānāveśād dhruvatāyāṃ satyāmapi paratvāt karaṇādisaṃjñābhirbādhanādapādānasaṃjñā na bhavati | tathā ca vārttikam | apādānamuttarāṇi | dhanuṣā vidhyati, kaṃsapātryāṃ bhuṅkte, gāṃ dodhi, dhanurvidhyati |  iti | tadevamapāyaviṣayasyāśrayaṇādaśvasyāpāyenānāveśādvastutastadviṣayamadhrauvyamabhavadevāvivakṣitamiti vārtikārthaḥ || 138 ||
tathā hi | saraṇe devadattasya dhrauvyaṃ pāte tu vājinaḥ | āviṣṭaṃ yadapāyena tasyādhrauvyaṃ pracakṣate || 139 ||
 saraṇe'śvasamavāyinyāṃ vegitāyāṃ gatau yathā devadattasya dhrauvyaṃ tena saraṇenānāveśāt tathā devadattasamavete pāte patanakriyāyāṃ vājinaḥ aśvasya tayānāveśāt dhrauvyamiti dṛṣṭāntadārṣṭāntikabhāvāntarbhāvenedamudāharaṇam | hetutvenāpāyānāveśo vyatirekamukhenomayatrāpi dhrauvya upāttaḥ | yadyapi cāśvasaraṇe devadattasya dhrauvyaṃ tathāpyapādānasaṃjñā na bhavati `gatirvinā tvavadhinā nāpāya iti gamyate' iti vakṣmayamāṇatvādavadhibhāvena devadattasyānupādānāt | tathopādāne tu bhavatyeva sarato devadattāddhāvatyaśva iti | yatra tarhi dvāvapi saparispandau tatra kathaṃ dhruvādhruvavibhāgo niśceya ityāśaṅkyāha | ubhāvapyadhrūvau meṣau yadyapyubhayakarmaje | vibhāge pravibhakte tu kriye tatra vivakṣite || 140 ||
 sthāṇoḥ śyeno'pasarpatītyanyatarakarmaje vibhāge sphuṭabhevāpāyenānāveśāt tyāṇau dhruvatā niścīyate | apasarpato meṣānmeṣo'pasarpatītyatrāpyubhayakarmaje vibhāge yadyapyubhāvapi meṣāvapāyāveśādadhruvau tathāpītarāpāyenetaralasyānāveśāt kartṛbhedādbhinne evāpāyalakṣaṇe kriye || 140 ||
tataśca meṣāntarakriyāpekṣamavadhitvaṃ pṛthak pṛthak | meṣayoḥ svakriyāpekṣaṃ kartṛtvaṃ ca pṛthak pṛthak || 141 ||
 itaretarakriyametaretarasyānāveśādanyakriyāyāmanyasya dhrauvyaṃ svakriyāyāṃ tu kartṛtvaṃ dvayorapi | yadā tu parasparamavadhibhāvo na vivakṣyate, api tvekaśabdopādāne dvigate'pi kriye vivakṣyate || 141 ||
tadāha | abhedena kriyaikā tu dvisādhyā cedvivakṣitā | meṣāvapāye kartārau yadyanyo vidyate'vadhiḥ || 142 ||
 meṣāvapasarpata ityākhyātapadena kartṛdvayanirvartyā kriyekyena pratyāyiteti dvayorapi meṣayoḥ kriyāveśena kartṛtvamapāyena tvekasyāvadhitvamityapādānatā na bhavati | evaṃ ca kṛtvāpāyakartṛtvaṃ meṣayorbhavati yadānyaḥ parvatādapasarpata iti parasparo meṣāvapasarpata iti parasparato meṣavapasarpata iti | evaṃ tvabhidhāne meṣāntarakriyāpekṣamavadhitvaṃ dvayoḥ svakriyāpekṣaṃ ca kartṛtvaṃmityuktam | kartṛbhedāddhyatra kriyābhedānumānamākhyātādekyenāpi pratīyate || 142 ||
yadyanyo vidyate'vadhiḥ tadā meṣāvapāyakartārau nānyathetyetad bhāṣyagrānthasaṃvādenopapādayitumāha | gatirvinā tvavadhinā nāpāya iti gamyate | vṛkṣasya parṇaṃ patatītyevaṃ bhāṣye nidarśitam || 143 ||
 kārakasūtre saṃjñinirdeśaḥ kartavyatayā coditaḥ , sādhakaṃ kārakamiti vaktavyam, anyathā akriyānimittasyāpi kārakaprasaṅgaḥ `apādānaṃ ca, vṛkṣasya parṇaṃ patatīti'  ityudāhato vārtike | savārtikaṃ ca bhāṣyamiti bhāṣya ityāha | etacca gateḥ sāvadhikāya pāyatve na liṅgam | api tvasya parihārāya `na vā'pāyasyāvivakṣitatvāt'  iti | yaduktamityanena bhāṣyaprabandho'tra nirdiṣṭaḥ | ayaṃ cātrārthaḥ | vṛkṣasaṃbandhinaḥ parṇasya pāto vākyārtho vivakṣitaḥ iti vṛkṣasyāvadhitvavivakṣātra nāsti | tathā cāpāyo'yaṃ na bhavati | apāyatvenāvadhyapekṣārūpeṇāvivakṣitatvādityatrāpādānatā vṛkṣasya na bhavatīti, yadi tvapāyo'tra vivakṣyate tadā vṛkṣasyāvadhitvāt vṛkṣāt parṇaṃ patatīti bhavati, tataśca na jñāyeta kasya saṃbandhi parṇaṃ kaṅkasya vā kurasya vetyuktam | tasmātparṇaviśeṣaṇatvena vṛkṣasya vivakṣitatvād vṛkṣamatyajatyapi parṇe sākhārathe bhūmiṃ spṛśati prayogo'yaṃ bhavatyevetyapāyavivakṣoktā | etasmāccāvasīyate sāvadhikagatirapāyo na śuddhā, anyathāvadhyavivakṣāyāmatrāpāyasambhavādapādānatvaṃ syādeveti jñāpakametat | evaṃ ca cāpāyenaivāvadherākṣepāttasyaiva viśeṣaṇam | śabdavat saṃjñipratipattyarthaṃ dhruvagrahaṇaṃ saṃrabdhodāsīnobhayasādhyatāmapāyasya darśayitumiti vyākhyātām || 143 ||
gatamadaḥ | idamidānīṃ vaktavyam `apādānamuttarāṇi' iti vipratiṣedhaḥ kātyāyanenoktaḥ | tathā coktaiḥ kārakairapādānasya bādhitatvāt valāhakādi vidyotate, valāhake vidyotate, valāhako vidyotate iti bhāṣye saṃjñāsamāveśo darśito viruddha ityāśaṅkya bhāṣyaṃ samarthayitumāha | bhedābhedau pṛthagbhāvaḥ sthitiśceti virodhinaḥ | yugapanna vivakṣvante sarve dharmā valāhake || 144 ||
 dhūmajyotiḥ salilamarutāṃ saṃghāto valāhakaḥ, tatrāvayavasya jyotiṣo vidyotanam | tacca jyotiryadā tasmāt samudāyātmano valāhakād bhedena vivakṣyate tadā bhedavivakṣāyāṃ pṛthagbhāvenaiva vā vivakṣyate tatrāvasthānena vā | yadā pṛthagbhāvena vivakṣyate tadā valāhako'vadhiḥ pṛthagbhāvalakṣaṇasyāpāyasyetyupāttaviṣayamidamapādānaṃ vyākhyātam-kalāhakād vidyotate vidyujjyotīrūpeti valāhakāt pṛthagbhūya niḥsṛtyeti niḥsaraṇāṅge vidyotatane dhātuḥ | yadā tu nirādhārasya tejaso'vasthānābhāvād valāhako'vasthitihetutvādādhārabhāvena vivakṣyate tadādhikaraṇasaṃjño'sau jāyate `valāhake vidyotate' iti, valāhake sthitvā prakāśata ityarthaḥ | abindhanatvādvaidyutasya jātavedaso valāhako jalapūrṇo'pyādhāro yujyate | evamudakasaṃbhedāt pārthivena dhūmena cāvilīkārād valāhakādbhedo nāsti tāvattejasaḥ prakāśakartṛtvābhāva iti bhedavivakṣāyāṃ śaktidvayāvirbhāvo valāhake darśitaḥ | pṛthagbhāvo sthitau ca bhinnaviṣaye eva | yadā tu svacchatvād valāhakadravyasya tatrapyamudakādi tejasaḥ prakāśe pratibandhakaṃ na bhavatītyabhedena valāhakākhyaḥ samudāyastejo'vayavavaśādvidyotanasamartho vivakṣyate tadātra kartṛśaktirevojbhṛmbhate valāhako vidyotata iti | avayavanibandhanā hi samudāyamanupatanti vyapadeśāḥ | tadyathā kisalayita mupavanamiti vṛkṣasamudāyasyopavanaśabdavācyatve tadavayavānāṃ saṃjātakisalayatve samudāyastathā vyapadeśārhaḥ | tadevaṃ vivakṣābhedāt paryāyeṇa bhinnaśaktirvalāhako bhāṣya udāhṛtaḥ, na tu yupacchaktivivakṣāyāmiti na vipratiṣedhavacanenāsya virodhaḥ kaścit || 144 ||
yattu vipratiṣedhodāharaṇaṃ tatra yugapadeva śatkyorvivakṣetyāha | dhanuṣā vidhyatītyatra vināpāyavivakṣayā | karaṇatvaṃ yato nāsti tasmāttadubhayaṃ saha || 145 ||
 dhanuṣā vidhyatīti paratvātkaraṇasaṃjñā'pādānasaṃjñāṃ bādhata ityudāhṛtam | tatra yugapad prāptirāvaśyakena saṃjñayoriti tad dvayaṃ sādhakatamatvamapāyaśca sahaikasmin dravye vartate | yato'pāyavivakṣāmantareṇa sādhakatamatvaṃ vyadhane dhanuṣo nāsti | na hi daṇḍeneva dhanuṣā vidhyati, api tvapasarpataḥ śarasyavādhibhāvamupayaddhanurvyadhananimittatāṃ pratipadyata iti yugapadubhayavivakṣāyāṃ bhinnaviṣayayorapi śaktayoḥ nimittanimittibhāvenāvasthānādekatra dravye samāveśāt svanimittasaṃjñādvayahetutve yugapadekasmāt prātipadikāt tatkāryavibhaktidvayotpattyayogāt ekasaṃjñādhikāropajanite virodhe paratvāt karaṇasaṃjñānimittā vibhaktirbhavati | śaktyorhi nāstyatra virodhaḥ, bhinnaviṣayatvāt | śaraniḥsaraṇe hyapādānaṃ vyadhane tu karaṇaṃ dhanuḥ | āviṣyaśakti ca dravyameva saṃjñāviṣaya iti tadanapekṣayaikatra prāptiḥ | tathā hi vibhaktividhāne `apādāne' `karaṇe' ityādisaṃjñāviśeṣeṇa dravyatvameva viśiṣyate | ekasyānekasaṃjñāpravṛttāvapi ca nāsti virodha iti saṃjñākāryavibhaktimukhena virodho'tra vyākhyeyaḥ | etaccodāharaṇamupalakṣaṇārthamupāttamityanyatrāpi vipratiṣedhodāharaṇe yugapadavivakṣā yojyā | tathā hi `kaṃsapātryāṃ bhuṅkte' ityatrānnādanādirūpāyā bhujeḥ kaṃsapātrī dhārayantyannamatrādhāraḥ | sa cāsyādhārabhāvastāvannopapadyate yāvadapādānatā nāsti | kaṃsapātryā hyannamuddhṛtya bhujyata iti bhavatyapādānam | na hi parṇapuṭena sahānnamabhyavaharato hastyādestatra bhuṅkta iti bhavatyādhārasampratyayaḥ | yadi ca kaṃsapātrī na bhavedannādānasyāvadhistadā bhujirnaiva niṣpadyetetyapāthavivakṣayā vinādhikaraṇatvābhāvādubhayoryugapadvivakṣāyāṃ saṃjñādvayaprasaṅge `apādānamuttarāṇi' ityadhikaraṇasaṃjñayā parayā pūrvā'pādānasaṃjñā bācyate eva | `gāṃ dogdhi' iti kṣāraṇavacane duhau nāntarīyako'pāyaḥ | na hi goranapayati payasi kṣāraṇaṃ sampadyata iti pādānatānāntarīyakā karmaśaktiḥ goḥ paratvāt kāryaṃ prayuṅkte | evaṃ dhanurvidhyatītyapāyavivakṣāṃ vinā vyadhane dhanuṣaḥ svātantryaṃ nāstītyubhayasaṃnidhau `apādānamuttarāṇi' iti parā kartṛsaṃjñaiva bhavati || 145 ||
evamatra viṣame dve śaktī abhyupagamya nāntarīyakatvādekatra dravye samāveśe saṃjñādvayaprāptau vibhak‌tyākhyākāryadvāreṇa virodhe sati paratvena vyavasthoktā | samprati śak‌tyabhedamāśritya saṃjñayorabhinnaviṣayopanipātamāha | ekaiva sā satī śaktirdvirūpā vyavatiṣṭhate | nimittaṃ saṃjñayostatra parayā bādhyate'parā || 146 ||
 bhinnakriyāviṣayāpi dravyasyaikaiva śaktiḥ, tayā hi tad dravyaṃ kriyādvayaṃ sampādayati, iti tatra kriyādvayaviṣaye'pādānakaraṇasaṃjñādvayaṃ labhata ityekatra śaktausaṃjñādvayaprāptau parayā saṃjñayā na parā aparā pūrvā saṃjñā bādhyate virodhād, ekasaṃjñādhikāranimittādityarthaḥ | śaraniḥsaraṇe'vadhibhāvo dhanuṣaḥ sādhakatamatvaśktyaivāntarbhāvitaḥ | tena vānā tadayogāditi tāvatyekaiva śaktirmaṇyate | parasparanirapekṣasya kāryadvayasya pravibhaktarūpaśaktidvayaparikalpakasyābhāvāt | vyadhanakriyāyā hi śarāpagamanakriyātra guṇabhūteti pṛthagātmani śak‌tyantaraṃ nākṣipati | kevalamekaiva śaktirguṇapradhānabhūtakriyādvayaviṣayatayā bhinnarūpeva cakāsti | dravyameva tarhyekaṃ kriyādvayaṃ sampādayat sādhanamastu, kiṃ śaktiparikalpanayā | naitadupapadyate | abhinnasvabāvatvādasya nānākriyāviṣayatāyogāt | śaktistu sāmarthyamanekakāryamapi bhavati | yathoktam --- "na śaktīnāṃ tathā bhedo yathā śaktimatāṃ sthitiḥ" iti | yadyevaṃ pakūtvaudano bhujyatāmityatrāpyekaiva śaktirastu | naitadupapad‌yate | antarbhūtenopāyena pṛthagātmānalabhamānena svanimittaśaktibhedānākṣepāditi sthitam || 146 ||
pūrvaṃ tu guṇapradhānabhāvānāśrayeṇa kriyādvayamātraviṣayaṃ śaktidvayamuktam | tatetadapādānaṃ `dhruvamapāye'pādānam'  ityanenaiva lakṣitaṃ sarvamapādānapaṃcamīviṣayaḥ | aparastu nirdhāraṇe vibhakte yo bhītrādīnā ca yo vidhiḥ | upāttapekṣitāpāyaḥ so'budhapratipattaye || 147 ||
 "pañcamī vibhakte"  iti vibhaktiviśiṣṭe nirdhāraṇe gamyamāne pañcamīlakṣaṇo yo vidhiruktaḥ so'pekṣitāpāyaḥ, apāyasyānumīyamānasyāpekṣaṇādityapādānasaṃjñayaiva siddhaḥ | tasya hi māthurāḥ pāṭaliputra kebhya āḍhyatarā ityetaduhāraṇam | atra nirdhāraṇasya vibhaktaviṣayatvādatyantavibhaktatāpratipattyarthaṃ vibhaktagrahaṇamiti pṛthagbhūtā eva pratipādyamānā etasya viṣayaḥ, na tu gavāṃ kṛṣṇā sampannakṣīratametyādi, gotvenāpṛthagbhāvāt | tatrātyantavibhāge'pi vivakṣite pūrva māḍhyatvena buddhyā sāmyamavaśyāpekṣyam | tathā hyāḍhayatvena samānena guṇena buddhyaikatvamāpādyātiśayaviśiṣṭāḍhyatāvaśāt pṛthak‌kriyetyasti buddhisaṃśleṣapūrvako viśleṣo'pāyākhya ityapādāna ityeva siddhātra pañcamī | apekṣitakriyaṃ hyetadapādānam | taduktaṃ bhāṣye `yastaiḥ sāmyaṃ gatavān sa evaṃ prayuṅkte' iti | kārakādhikāre tamab‌grahaṇādatiśayo na vivakṣita iti gauṇe'pyatra bauddhe'pāye'pādanatāviruddhā | tathā hi kārakavyavahāro buddhyavasthānibandhana eva sarvaḥ | taduktaṃ prāk-- buddhyā samīhitaikatvān pañcālan kurubhiryadā | punarvibhajate vaktā tadāpāyaḥ pratīyate || iti | evaṃ sāmānyenaiva siddhe sūtrāraṃbho bauddhamapāyamapratipadyamānaṃ prati vivakṣāniyamārtham, apāyavivakṣaivātra kartavyetyerthaḥ | tathā `bhītrārthānāṃ bhayahetuḥ' `parājerasoḍhaḥ' ityādiśca yo vidhirapādānasaṃjñālakṣaṇaḥ so'yupātto guṇabhāvena viṣayo'pāyalakṣaṇa kriyā yena sa evaṃvidha iti upāttaviṣayāpādānabhedodāharaṇarūpaḥ pūrvavadabudhabodhanārtha eva | tatha hi vṛkebhyo bhayaṃ corād bimetīti ya eṣa manuṣyaḥ prekṣāpūrvakārī bhavati sa buddhaya paśyati yadi māṃ vṛkāḥ prāpnuyurdhruvamaniṣṭāpāta iti pūrvaṃ buddhyā vṛkān prāpya buddhayantareṇa tato vibhāgaṃ pratipadyata iti bhayapūrvikāyāṃ nivṛttau bibhetervartanād astyevāpāyaḥ | evaṃ caurebhyastrāyata ityanarthapratighātavacane trāyatāvanarthaṃ corasaṃsargaṃ buddhyā niścitya tataḥ svajanamapanayati suhṛditi saṃbhavatyapāyaḥ | adhyayanāt parājayata ityadhyayanābhyāsaparikhinno guruparyupāsanāyāsabhīruḥ | prāpyādhyayanaṃ tato nivartata ityastyevāpayaḥ | parājayatiścātra khedapūrvake nivartane vartate , adhyayanāt khinnaḥ sannivartata ityarthaḥ | pūrvamevāpravṛttau tu khedo buddhyā samīkṣitaḥ | kaṣṭena tapasā nityaṃ dṛṣṭopacarato gurūn || iti yevebhyo gāṃ vārayatīti yavasaṃprāpto gavāṃ yavavināśakṛtaṃ pratyavāyamayaṃ nivartayati tata iti mukhya evāpāyaḥ kūpādandhaṃ vārayati, agnermāṇavakaṃ vārayatīti buddhyā kūpāgnisaṃprāptimaniṣṭahetuṃ manyamāno'nukampayā tato nivartayatīti buddhisaṃśleṣapūrvako'pāyaḥ | upādhyāyādantardhatta ityupādhyāyasamīpaprāptau preṣaṇopālaṃbhādiduḥkhaṃ buddhyā niścitya tato'paitītyapāyaḥ | upādhyāyādadhīte, āgamayatīti ca granthamādatte tata ityapāyaḥ | upādhyāyamukhodīritā hi śabdāḥ santānena vartamānaḥ śiṣyamanupravīśantītyupādhyāyādavadhisthānīyātteṣāmapakramo'vasīyate | taduktaṃ bhāṣye | `saṃtatatvāt |' iti | anupayoge tu naṭasya śṛṇotītyapāyo na vivakṣyate | na hi naṭād granthamādatte, api tu naṭasaṃbandhi śṛṇotītyetāvadatrārthasatattvam | śṛṅgāccharo jāyata iti tato niḥsaratītyevaṃ lokasya pratipatterastyevāpāyaḥ | śāstre ca padārtho laukikaḥ pravibhajyate ityuktamiti tirthikaparikalpitaprakriyānādaraḥ | tīrthikānāṃ hi keṣāṃcit kāryakāraṇayoḥ pariṇāmāśrayeṇa bheda iti vibhāgabhāvaḥ | himavato gaṅgā prabhavatīti srotorūpā gaṅgā tataḥ prasarpatīti mukhya evāpāyaḥ | gauṇaṃ cāpāyamāśritya `jugupsāvirāmapramādarthānāmupasaṃkhyānam' pratyākhyātam | tathāhi adharmājjugupsate viramatītyāstikaḥ paratra duḥkhānubandhinamadharmamavagamya jugupsāpūrvakaṃ tato'paitītyastyapāyaḥ | nāstikaḥ punarihaiva kleśaphalaṃ dharmamavagatya tataḥ pramādena nivartate iti pramādyatītyucyata iti sarvatra pūrveṇaivāpādānasaṃjñāyāmuttaro vidhiḥ prapaṃcāryaḥ | lakṣaṇaprapaṃcābhyāṃ hi vyākaraṇam | yathoktam tata eva vidhaya ityādīti siddham || 147 ||
iti bhūtirājatanayahelārājakṛte prakīrṇaprakāśe sādhanasamuddeśe'pādānādhikāraḥ | --------------- idānīṃ vibhaktividhānukramāyātaṃ ṣaṣṭayarthaṃ śeṣalakṣaṇatikramya kārakaviśeṣaprakramāyātamadhikaraṇaṃ saptamyarthaṃ vicārayati | kartṛkarmavyavahitāmasākṣāddhārayat kriyām | upakurvat kriyāsiddhau śāstre'dhikaraṇaṃ smṛtam || 148 ||
loke'dhikaraṇaviśeṣeṇa dravyaguṇakriyāviṣayamabhidhīyate | śāstre tvasmin kārakaprakaraṇāt kriyākṣepe kriyāyāmevopakāraviśeṣeṇa dhāraṇalakṣaṇenādhikaraṇasaṃjñāvatiṣṭhate | tatra kriyā kartari karmaṇi vāvatiṣṭhata iti tayoḥ kriyādhāraṇādadhikaraṇasaṃjñā vacanāt paryāyeṇa syāt | karmasthakriyāviṣayā vā kartṛsaṃjñā kartṛsthakriyāviṣayā vā karmasaṃjñā syāditi tatra yathāyogaṃ kartṛkarmasaṃjñābāve'dhikaraṇasaṃjñā prasajyata ityāśaṅkyoktaṃ `kartṛkarmavyavahitām' ityādi | kaṭe āste, sthālyāṃ pacatīti kartṛkarmadhāraṇāt tatsamavetāyāṃ kriyāyāmupakārakamadhikaraṇaṃ pāramparyeṇa | asati hyādhāre kartṛkarmaṇī kriyopakāraṃ na pratipadyeyātāmiti tayorādhāra upakurvan kriyāmapi tatsthāmupakaroti | kārakādhikāre ca taratamayogo nāstītyatra paramparayā kriyādhārake'dhikaraṇasaṃjñāyā sāvakāśatvāt sākṣāt kriyādhārakayoḥ paratvāt kartṛkarmasaṃjñe eva | kārakāṇāṃ ca kriyānimittatvaṃ yathā tathāpi bhavadāśrīyata iti vyavadhānena kriyāpakārakatvamaviruddham | `vyavahitām' ityukte'pi `asākṣāt' iti vacanaṃ lokānusāreṇāpi padārthavyavasthāyāmadhikaraṇasya kriyādhāraṇa prati vyavadhānaparipoṣaṇārtham | tathā hi śabdāt pratīyamāno'rtho laukikaḥ saṃskāranimittamucyate | pṛthivyāṃ śete, sthālyāṃ pacyata ityādau cākhyātaśabdāt kriyāviśiṣṭe kartṛkarmaṇī pratipadyete, na kriyāmātraṃ tato nikṛṣṭarūpamiti kriyāśrayadhāraṇādeva loke'dhikaraṇasya kriyopakāraḥ pratīyate na sākṣāt || 148 ||
idānīmaupaśleṣikādibhede'pyadhikaraṇasya sāmānbhetallakṣaṇamanugatamityāha---- upaśleṣasya cābhedastilākāśakaṭādiṣu | upakārāstu bhidyante saṃyogisamavāyinām || 149 ||
 upaśleṣa ādhārasyādheyena saṃbandhaḥ | yadvaśādasāvādhāraḥ | tasya triṣvapyadhikaraṇeṣvabhedaḥ | anyathā tu saṃyoginyādhāre saṃbandhaḥ, anyathā tu samavāyinīti saṃbandhibhedādbhinnatvena vyapadeśaḥ | tathā hi kaṭe āste devadatta iti saṃyoginaḥ kaṭasya sakalāvayavavyāptyā devadattopaśleṣo na dṛśyate, api tu katipayāvayavavyāptetyaviśeṣādaupaśleṣika iti sāmānyasaṃjñayādhāro'yamucyate | tileṣu tailamiti tu samavāyinā tailarasena tilānāṃ samastāvayavavyāptyā lokaprasiddhyā saṃbandhād vyāpakametadadhikaraṇam | khe śakunaya ityatra tvākāśasyā tāttvikāvayavābhāvāt kalpitapradeśatayā saṃbandhādvaiṣayikametadadhikaraṇam | ananyatra bhāvaścātra viṣayārthaḥ | evaṃ jale matsyā ityādhārapradeśāpekṣayā caitadaupaśleṣikamadhikaraṇam | gurau vasatīti śiṣyāṇāṃ gurvadhīnāyāṃ vṛttau vaiṣayikamadhikaraṇaṃ guruḥ | upaśleṣo'pyatra bauddhaḥ | evaṃ yuddhe sannahyatīti yuddhābhisaṃndhinā sannahanasya tanutrādibandhanarūpasya pravṛtteḥ yuddhaṃ viṣayaḥ | gaṅgāyāṃ gāva iti gaṅgāśabdaḥ sāmīpyāt pradeśavṛtirityaupaśveṣikamadhikaraṇam | śatrorabhāve sukhamityādāvabhāvasya bauddhaṃ kārakatvamiti prāgeva nirṇītam || 149 ||
ke punarupakārā ityāha | avināśo gurutvasya pratibandhe svatantratā | digviśeṣādavaccheda ityādyā bhedahetavaḥ || 150 ||
 avināśaḥ tailasya tilakṛta upakāraḥ | tilavināśe hi tailaṃ vikīrṇaṃ naśyet | paryaṅke śeta iti śayiturgurutvapratibandhe svatantraḥ kartā ādhāraḥ | anyathā gurutvāt patanaṃ bhavet | khe śakuntādadaya ityādau khena śakuntādīnāmadharadiśā saṃbandhasyāpāvartanamityayameva tasyādheyopayogaḥ | ādiśabdācchakaṭādinādhāreṇa deśaviśeṣasaṃprāptiḥ | guruṇā ca śiṣyāṇāṃ saṃskārātiśayaḥ paryaṅkādinā ca sausthityamityevamādaya upakāraḥ pratipādyante | prācyāmāditya udeti pratīcyāmastameti dakṣiṇasyāmagastya uttarasyāṃ dhruva iti digviśeṣasaṃbandhapratipādanamātropayogametadadhikaraṇam || 150 ||
mūrtānāṃ sarveṣāmanyādhīnāyāṃ sthitau mūrtasyādhārasyāpyaparamadhikaraṇamiti paryantavarti mukhyamadhikaraṇaṃ kimityāha | ākāśameva keṣāṃciddeśabhedaprakalpanāt | ādhāraśaktiḥ prathamā sarvasaṃyogināṃ matā || 151 ||
 grahanakṣatravimānādīnāṃ tāvadākāśabhevādhikaraṇaṃ prasiddham | yeṣāmapi pṛthivyekadeśo rathādīnāmadhikaraṇaṃ teṣāmapi tasya pṛthivyekadeśasyākāśādharatvāt pāramparyeṇākāśamevādhāra iti sarvagrahaṇenāha | samavāyināṃ tu svāvayavā ādhāraḥ | tatrāpi paryante paramāṇavaḥ | teṣāṃ cākāśameva deśapravibhāgakāraṇamādhāra iti mukhyādhāraśaktirākāśāśrayā bhāvānām | na caivamekadeśatayā saṃkaraḥ svāvaṣṭabdhaparimitadeśamukhakabhāga prakalpane bhinnatayākāśaṃ deśabhāvaṃ pratipadyate yataḥ | taduktam `deśabhedaprakalpanāt' iti | saṃyogināṃ deśatayā vyavahriyamāṇasyākāśabhedasya taireva saṃyogibhiravyāpakaiḥ parikalpanādākāśaṃ sarveṣāmasaṅkareṇādhikaraṇamityarthaḥ | `keṣāṃcit' iti, ye hyākāśamabhyupayanti saṃsarhavādinasteṣāṃ mata ityarthaḥ | tatraitat syāt, kimidamanadhyakṣamāmāṇamākāśaṃ nāma | śabdena guṇena guṇī so'numīyata iti cedākāśaguṇatvasyaivāsiddheḥ śabdasyānanvayyetat | na sparśavadviśeṣaguṇaḥ śabdaḥ | ayāvad‌dravyabhāvitvādāśrayādanyatropalabdherityādihetūpanyāso vāyaṃ rūpādīnāmapi || 151 ||
satyapyāśraye nimittāntarāt parivṛttidarśanādākāśasya ca dravyatvāsiddhau śabdāśrayatvasya vivādāspadatvād yāvad‌dravyabhāvitvaṃ śabde'siddhaṃ karṇaśaṣkulyavacchinnākāśadeśa evopalabdheścāśrayādanyatropalabhyamānatvamasiddham, samānendriyagrāhyakṣaṇikānekaviśeṣaguṇoyogitvamapi sparśavatāṃ svakṛtāntaniyatamityāśaṅkyāśasadbhāve loke prasiddhaṃ liṅgamāha | idamatreti bhāvānāmabhāvānna prakalpate | vyapadeśastamākāśanimittaṃ saṃpracakṣate || 152 ||
 ihādhāraśaktirevānyathānupapatterākāśasadbhāvaṃ gamayati | tathā hi śabdapramāṇākānāṃ śabdārtho'rthaḥ | asti cāyaṃ śabdaḥ--idaṃ nakṣatramatra tiṣṭhatīti | atra iti yannirdiṣṭaṃ tatkicana vastu bhavat pṛthivyāderanyatvādākāśākhyāmavalaṃbate | na cāvastvetat, sarvasāmarthyavirahalakṣaṇādavastuna evaṃvidhavyapadeśābhāvāt | nirūpya hi vyapadeśo nirūpaṇā ca vastunibandhanā, śābde vyavahāre nirūpitasyaiva vastutvāt | ata eva śatropabhāve sukhamityādau nirūpyamāṇasyābhāvasyādhārābhāva ityasti lokaprasiddhavyavahāranimittamākāśamādārabhāvapannam | padārthānāṃ paramārthavicāre tu sarvaṃ prapaṃcarūpamasat, advayasyaiva satvāt, ityavicāritaramaṇīyalaukikapadārthāśrayā lakṣaṇapravṛttireva viruddhetyāśayaḥ || 152 ||
ākāśasya sarvabhāvādhāratvaṃ yaduktaṃ tat siddhasvabhāvaviṣayaṃ sādhyasvabhāvaviṣayaṃ tu kālasyādhāratvamityāha | kālāt kriyā vibhajyante ākāśāt sarvamūrtayaḥ | etāvāṃścaiva bhedo'yamabhedopanibandhanaḥ || 153 ||
 `pratibandhābhyanujñābhyāṃ tena viśvaṃ vibhajyate' iti vakṣyamāṇanayena janmasthitinirodhapravibhāgena bhāveṣupakurvan kālaḥ kriyāsvādhārabhāvopagamanena pravibhāgamavasthāpayati | ākāśaṃ tvasarvagatadravyaparimāṇapadārthasaṃyogāhitapravibhāgamasaṅkareṇādhārabhāvamupayanniyatadeśatayā padārthavyaktīrvibhajate | mūrtikriyāvivarttarūpaṃ cedaṃ viśvaṃ bhedāvabhāsabahulaṃ labhyate vyavahāre yathāyathamādyāyāṃ daśāyāmabhinnamapītyetadapekṣayā kālākāśākhyābhedanimittaḥ | kālākāśākhyo'bheda upanibandhanaṃ nimittamasya mūrttikriyāvivarttasyaityarthaḥ | dik‌śaktinimitto'pi hi mūrtibhedaḥ pūrvāparadeśātmakatvādākāśādhārapravibhāgena niṣṭhāmupaiti | kālākāśayorapi ca bhedaḥ śaktitvādatyantābhinnaparabrahmanimittaḥ tasmāddhi te śaktī pṛthak‌kriyete ityupapāditaṃ prathamakāṇḍe | `upānvadhyāṅvasaḥ'  ityupādipūrvasya vasaterādhāraḥ karmasaṃjñaḥ uktaḥ | tatra vārtikakāraḥ prāha | `vaseraśyarthasya pratiṣedhaḥ |'  iti | grāma upavasatīti | yathā tiṣṭhatirgatinivṛttiviśiṣṭamavasthānamāha evaṃ bhojananivṛttiviśiṣṭaṃ vāsamupavasiriti vāttikakāro manyate | tathā copavasestiṣṭhativad grāmeṇāsti saṃbandha iti prāptā karmasaṃjñā nivartyate | vivakṣāniyamaścānena vārtikenāvedyate | nātra grāmāderīpsitatamatvena vivakṣā, api tvādhārabhāvenetyarthaḥ | bhāṣye tu pratyākhyātametadvārtikam | "nātropapūrvasya vasergrāmo'dhikaraṇam | kasya tarhi ? anupasargasya | grāme'sau vasaṃstrirātramupavasatīti |" tatrāyamāśayo bhāṣyakārasya | iha kālaṣiśeṣāvacchinnā bhujinivṛttirupavaserarthaḥ | tatra kālaviśeṣo'ntaraṅgaḥ, prākṛtameva karma | abhuñjānasya tvavasthānaṃ niradhikaraṇasya nopapadyate, ityādhāro'pekṣito niyataḥ | sa copapūrvasya vaserna saṃbandhītyaprasaktaiva karmasaṃjñā || 153 ||
na hyevamapi yadā kālavaddeśo'pi niyato'pekṣyate tīrthe upavasatītyādau tadā styevopavaserdeśena saṃbandha iti syāt karmasaṃjñetyāśaṅkya bhāṣyaṃ samarthayitumāha | yadyapyupavasirdeśaviśeṣamanurudhyate | śabdapravṛttidharmāttu kālamevāvalaṃbate || 154 ||
 tīrthādideśaviśeṣamavalaṃbya bhojanādinivṛttāvabhisaṃhitāyāṃ deśaviśeṣeṇāpi saṃbandho yadyapyupapūrvasya vaserasti tathāpi nāsau śabdasāmarthyopanipatito deśasabandhaḥ | bhojananivṛttimātraṃ hyupavāsārthaḥ | sa cāniyatakālo nopapadyata iti kālaviśeṣo'ntakaṅgo garbhīkṛtaḥ śābda eva śabdasya pravṛttirabhidhānavyāpāraḥ, tasyā dharmaḥ svabhāvaḥ, śabdaśaktiriti yāvat | deśastu devadattasattāya nirādhārāyā anupapatterabhisaṃhito'pi tīrthādiḥ śabdārthe nāntarbhavati, bhojananivṛttyā deśasya saṃbandhābhāvāt | tatra tvaṅgabhūto yo vāsastenaiva deśasyābhisaṃbandhaḥ | tathā cāṅgabhūtavasatikriyādvāreṇopavāse'dhikaraṇatā deśaḥ pratipadyate | sākṣāt kālenaiva tu tathā yogaḥ | bhojananivṛtterniyatakālatvāt kālavyavadhinā bhojarūpatvāt tasyāṃ tadaṅgastu vāso niyatadeśa iti tad‌dvāreṇātra deśe'dhikaraṇam | ata eva bhāṣye `grāme vaṃsastrirātramupavasati' iti upavāsāṅgasya vāsasya grāmeṇa saṃbandho darśito na tūpavāsasyaiva sākṣāt | sā cātra vasatikriyāṅgabhūtatvādākṣiptaiveti tad‌dvāreṇeṣyate kriyākārakasaṃbandhaḥ | vasatyaṅgā hi bhojananivṛttirniyatakālā upavaserarthaḥ | ataśca grāma upadhasatītyukte'ṅgabhūtavasikriyāpekṣā deśasyādhikaraṇatā || 154 ||
pradhānabhūtabhojananivṛttyapekṣā ca kālasyāprayujyamānasyāpi karmatā pratīyata ityāha | vasatāvaprayukte'pi deśo'dhikaraṇaṃ tataḥ | aprayuktaṃ trirātrādi karmaṃ copavasau smṛtam || 155 ||
 bhāṣya iti śeṣaḥ | śrūyamāṇopavāsakriyāsaṃbandhānarhatvād grāmādiḥ sāmarthyaprāptāyāmaprayujyamānāmapi vasatikriyāyāmadhikaraṇam | sādhanaṃ hyaśrūyamāṇāmapi yogyāṃ kriyāmākṣipati | tadyathā praviśa piṇḍīmiti bhakṣikriyāṃ karmaṃ | atra ca viśeṣapratipattinibandhanābāvādavyabhicaritasaṃbandhā sāmānyarūpeṇa sattā pratīyate | yasya ca grāmādhikaraṇā sattā grāme'sau vasatīti vāsaṃ pratyadhikaraṇaṃ grāmādirdeśo'vatiṣṭhate | śrūyamāṇāyā tūpavasatikriyāyāṃ kāla evāntaraṅgo'dhikaraṇamityaprayujyamānamaryetadyogyatvādākṣipyate praveśanakriyayeva gṛham | tatra ca sākṣādupavasatyādhāre kṛtārthā karmasaṃjñāṅgabhūtavasatikriyādvārāyātamādhāraṃ grāmādideśalakṣaṇaṃ nāvagāhate, pradhānāpradhānayoḥ pradhāne kāryaṃsampratyayāt kārakādhikāre ca tamab‌grahaṇāt sākṣātkārakaśaktīnāṃ prakarṣo nādriyate, na tu kriyāsaṃbandhanimittāntaraṅgabahiraṅgabhāvānādaro'nyathā svavyāpāre svātantryāt karmaṇaḥ kartṛsaṃjñā syāt | karmasaṃjñāyāḥ sandarśanādibhirīpsitatamāyāṃ kriyāyāṃ tadā karmasaṃjñā deśe'pi caritārthā grāmamupavasati, adhitiṣṭhatītyarthaḥ | ataśca bhojananivṛttyarthatāyāmupavaseḥ sākṣātkāla ādhāraḥ karmasaṃjñaḥ, deśastvabhisaṃhito'pyaṅgabhūtavasidvāreṇaivādhāro na sākṣāditi sthitam | yastu nivṛttirūpatvādupavaserādhāreṇāsaṃbandha iti vyācaṣṭe tasya kālenāpyādhāreṇāsaṃbandho'tra ,syāt | asti ca gatinivṛttivacanasyapi tiṣṭhaterādhāreṇa saṃbandhaḥ | sarvavyāpāroparamalakṣaṇasya grāme āste iti nivṛtteḥ kriyāntaramapārtayantyāḥ kriyātvamaviruddhabheva | kārakāṇāṃ hi pravṛttiviśeṣaḥ phalānumeyaḥ kriyā | sa cātra niyatakālabhojananivṛttirūpaḥ sphuṭa eva | na cāpi saṃkalpaviśeṣa eva mānaso vyāpāro nivṛttiḥ | sandarśanādīnāṃ pradhānakriyayā saha bhedābhāvād yuddhāya saṃnahyate ityādāveva bhedavivekṣetyuktam | tathā cātra saṃkalpapūrvakaḥ kartṛvyāpāro niyatakālavyavadhinā bhojanādirūpo dhātorupavaserarthaḥ | kriyātmetyasyādhārasaṃbandhe satyapi sākṣāddeṣalakṣaṇe nādhāreṇa saṃbandho'ṅgabhūtavasatikriyādvāreṇāyogāditi nāntarīyakakālākhyādhārasaṃbandha eva karmasaṃjñāvidhiriti siddham || 155 ||
iti bhūtirājatanayahelārājakṛte prakīrṇaprakāśe sādhanasamuddeśe'dhikaraṇādhikāraḥ || -------------  idānīṃ ṣaṣṭhyarthaḥ saptamaḥ kārakabhedo vicāryate | sa ca śeṣalakṣaṇaḥ saṃbandhaḥ | tasya kathaṃ kārakabhedatvaṃ kathaṃ ca śeṣatvamityetadupapādayitumāha | saṃbandhaḥ kārakebhyo'nyaḥ kriyākārakapūrvakaḥ | śrutāyāmaśrutāyāṃ vā kriyāyāṃ so'bhidhīyate || 156 ||
kārakebhyo'nyaḥ karmādiviśeṣalakṣaṇebhyaḥ ṣaḍ‌bhyo'nyo yaḥ saṃbandhaḥ sa śeṣa ityupayuktetaravacanaśeṣaśabdāśrayeṇa | "kārakaṇāmavivakṣā śeṣaḥ" iti bhāṣyaṃ vyākhyātam | `kriyākārakapūrvakaḥ' ityanena kārakatvaṃ vyācaṣṭe śeṣasya | tathā hi-rājñaḥ puruṣo vṛkṣasya śākhā paśoḥ pādaḥ pituḥ putra ityādāvaśrūyamāṇa kriyāviṣaye svasvāmibhāvāvayavāvayavibhāvajanyajanakabhāvādau saṃbandhe dadātisthitijanyādikriyāprabhāvite pūrvabhāvikārakatvamuttarāvasthāyāmapyanugatamiti bhavatyeva śeṣaḥ kārakam | rājā hi puruṣāya dadāti yatastato rājñaḥ puruṣa iti svasvāmibhāvo'vatiṣṭhati | tatra kriyākārakasaṃbandhaḥ kāraṇabhūtaḥ śeṣasaṃbandhastu phalabhūtaḥ | kriyākārakasaṃbandho hi vṛttaḥ svāśraye śeṣasaṃbandhaṃ phalaṃ niveśyoparamate | tatra pūrvaṃ kartṛsaṃpradānarūpau rājapuruṣābhūtām | śeṣasaṃbandhakāle tu kartrādiviśeṣarūpatānavagama iti taccheṣabhūtaṃ sāmānyaṃ kārakatvamavatiṣṭhate | karaṇādisādhanabhedopākhyānimittābhāvāt | kārakebhyo'nyaḥ kārakāṇāmavivakṣā śeṣaḥ | kārakapūrvaka ityatra ca kārakatvaikārthasamavāyinaḥ karaṇādayaḥ sādhanabhedāḥ kārakaśabdenocyante, na tu kārakasāmānyamapi | dravyāṇāṃ hi siddhasvabhāvānāmayaḥ śalākākalpanānāṃ parasparasaṃbandhābhāvāt kriyākṛta eva saḥ | kriyā hi niḥśrayaṇīva dravyāṇyupaśleṣayati | tathā ca bhāṣyam--- "prātipadikārthānāṃ kriyākṛtā viśeṣā udbhavanti karma karaṇamityādi" tatra karmādirūpavyirekeṇānyasya viśeṣasyādṛṣṭaḥ śeṣākhyaḥ saṃbandhaḥ karmādirūpo'vatiṣṭhamāno'nubhūtakarmādiviśeṣe svādhāre padamupanibadhnannavivivakṣitakarmādibhedarūpamātmānamuddarśayati | tataśca rājapuruṣayorvartamāne dātṛtvasampradānatve eva phalāvasthāyāmanudriktasvasvarūpe sāmānyarūpeṇa saṃbandha iti vyapadeśamarhataḥ | tathā cānulliṅgitaviśeṣarūpā saptamīyaṃ kārakayoniḥ parigaṇyate, śabdārthasampratyayabhedāt | anyo hi sampratyayo rājā puruṣāya dadātīti | na hyasmānniyamena svasvāmibhāvanimittaṃ dānaṃ pratīyate | karaṇādināpi nimittena dānasaṃbhavāt | anyastu rājñaḥ puruṣa iti, svaslāmibhāvāvagamāt | ataśca pratītibhedādanyatve siddhe karmādiviśeṣeṇeva śeṣākhyenāpyanena prātipadikārtho bhidyamāno'bhidhīyate | tadayamaśrūyamāṇakriyāviṣayaḥ saṃbandhaḥ svasvāmibhāvādinimittānāṃ dānādikriyāṇāmaśruteḥ | saṃbandhalakṣaṇakāryānyathānupapattyānumīyamānāśca dānādikriyāḥ saṃnihitā eveti tanmukhena samanvayopapattiḥ saṃbandhinoḥ phalasyāpi ca saṃbandhasya kriyānimittatvaṃ kārakatvanibandhanamastyeva karmaṇa iveti sarvamupapadyate | grāmasya samīpādāgacchati, vṛkṣasya parṇaṃ patati, ityādāvapyastyeva samīpasamīpibhāvādau saṃbandhe kriyākārakapūrvakatvam | samīpasya hi grāma āśrayaḥ evaṃ parṇasya vṛkṣa iti | ayameva sarvatra nyāyaḥ | āgamanādikriyāṃ prati tu grāmāderakārakatvamucyate | śrūyamāṇakriyāviṣayastu saṃbandhaḥ kārakabheda eva, avivakṣitakarmādiviśeṣaḥ saṃbandhasāmānyasvabhāvaḥ kriyākārakasaṃbandha eva sa iti na tatpūrvakaḥ | tadyathā naṭasya śṛṇotītyādi | karaṇādisaṃjñānāmatra nimittābhāvādapravṛtteḥ | duhyādiparigaṇanāccākathitakarmatvābhāvāt | kārakebhyo'nyo'yaṃ śeṣaḥ kāraka eva | tathā copayogagrahaṇamarthavadityuktam | evaṃ mātuḥ smarati, na māṣāṇāmaśnīyāt, sarpiṣo jānīta ityādau karmādikarākabheda evāvivakṣitatadrūpaḥ śeṣa ityuktam | atra ca śeṣe ṣaṣṭhīvibhaktiruktā | saṃbandhasya dviṣṭhatvācca dvābhyāmapi saṃbandhibhyāṃ ṣaṣṭhīprasaṅga iti coditam--- "ṣaṣṭhī śeṣa iti cedviśeṣye pratiṣedhaḥ  iti | rājñaḥ puruṣa iti puruṣaśabdādapi ṣaṣṭhīprasaṅge pratiṣedhaḥ kārya ityarthaḥ | saṃbandhasya codbhūtatvāt prathamā viśeṣyānna prāpnotīti sāpi vidheyetyuktam--- "tatra prathamāvidhiḥ" iti | atrobhayatrāpi parihārāya "uktaṃ pūrveṇa" ityabhihitam | prātipadikāryasūtre "paṭasāmānādikaraṇya upasaṃkhyānamadhikatvāt " iti codite "na vā vākyārthatvāt  ityuktam | tadevātrātidesāyānūditam | rājña ityetat‌padasamanyavayavaśena puruṣasya saṃbandhitvamavagamyata iti vākyārtho'tra saṃbandho'ntaraṅge padārthamātrāśraye saṃskāre nimittaṃ na bhavati, bahiraṅgatvāditi vīraḥ puruṣo nīvamutpalamityādivadatra ṣaṣṭhyabhāvaḥ prathamā ca siddhetyarthaḥ | yadyevaṃ rājaśabdādapi vīrādiśabdādivānena nyāyena ṣaṣṭhī na syāt | prathamā ca syāt | naitadasti viśeṣyagatasyaivādhikyasya vākyārthatvāt | taddhi pradhānaṃ prathamamajahatsvarūpamevopakāryatāmapekṣite guṇe samāpadyata iti tasyaivādhikyaṃ vākyārthaḥ kathyate | guṇasya tu pradhānopakārāya pravartamānasya svātmapratiṣṭhatvopakārakatvāsaṃbhavādupakrama eva pradhānopayogakṣamaṃ saṃbandhisāmānyāpekṣayā rūpāntaraṃ viparivartate | taduktaṃ bhāṣye--- "artharūpamevaitadevaṃjātīyakam"... iti | tathā ca guṇāccheṣaṣaṣṭhī nyāyyā | samānādhikaraṇaṃ tu viśeṣaṇaṃ nīlādi pradhānenotpalādinā sahaikātmyamibāpadyamānaṃ na vyatirekaṃ bhajata iti na tatra ṣaṣṭhī bhavati || 146 ||
etadvastusatattvaṃ pratipādayati--- dviṣṭho'pyasau parārthatvād guṇeṣu vyatiricyate | tatrābhidhīyamānaḥ san pradhāne'pyupabhujyate || 157 ||
 dviṣṭhaḥ ekaḥ saṃbandhaḥ | tatra caikaiva ṣaṣṭhī nyāyyā | ṣaṣṭhīdvaye saṃbandhadvayaṃ pratīyeta | sā caikaiva ṣaṣṭhī bhavantī guṇādeva bhavati na pradhānāt | yasmādasau saṃbandho dvayorapi saṃbandhinoḥ sthitaḥ, tayorguṇapradhānabhāvenaikavākyatvāt, pradhānānurodhitvād guṇānāmeva rūpaparivartanasyaucityāt tatraiva phalatīti guṇādeva saṃbandhakāryā ṣaṣṭhī nyāyyā | tathā hi guṇeṣu vyatirekamādhikyaṃ darśayati saṃbandhaḥ | pradhānaṃ tu svarūpādapracyavamānameva saṃbandhamanubhavati | evaṃ hi tasya prādhānyaṃ bhavati yadi guṇānurodhena rūpaparivartanaṃ nāsādayati | guṇāśrayatayā ca saṃbandhasyābhidhāne ṣaṣṭhyā pradhānagatamapi rūpamupabhuktaṃ spṛṣṭamevābhihitamevetyarthaḥ | etattaducyate pradhānagatasyādhikyasya vākyārthatvaṃ guṇasaṃbandhena pratīteḥ | parasparasākāṅkṣasya padasamūhasya vākyatvāt | rājña iti hi svāmitvamavagamyamānamanyatānupapattyā puruṣe'pi svatvalakṣaṇamatirekamāvedayate | tathā ca puruṣādantaraṅgāt prathamaiva bhavatīti bahiraṅgasya saṃbandhasya padāntarasamanvayānyathānupapattyaiva gamitatvāt prātipadikārtha evādhikāsyānanupraveśāt | yadā tu viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāve kāmacārāt puruṣasya rājetyucyate tadā guṇāt puruṣādeva ṣaṣṭhīti na vyabhicarati lakṣaṇam || 157 ||
uktamidaṃ kriyākārakapūrvakaḥ saṃbandha iti | tatra kriyākārakasaṃbandho'sya nimittam , sa ca phalabhūtāt saṃbandhādanumīyamāno na viśeṣeṇānumātuṃ pāryeta, api tu sāmānyena, evaṃsvabhāvatvādanumānasyeti kuto'yaṃ viśeṣāvasāya ityāha--- nimittaniyamaḥ śabdāt saṃbandhasya na gṛhyate | karmapravacanīyaistu sa viśeṣe'varudhyate || 158 ||
 pituḥ putraḥ, paśoḥ pāda ityādau saṃbandhisvarūpaviśeṣāvadhāraṇādeva niyatasthitijananādikriyāprabhāvitatvaṃ saṃbandhasya pratīyate | rājapuruṣa ityādau tu yāñcāvinimayāpahāraprabhṛtibhirapi svasvāmibhāvasya saṃbhavādādyadyapi niyamanimittattvaṃ nāvadhāryate tathāpi dānādīnāmanyatamāvinābhāvāt kriyānumīyata eva saṃbandhisvarūpāditi nāyaṃ karmapravacanīyaviṣayaḥ | kvacittu śabdasāmarthyānnimittaviśeṣo nāvadhāryate | nimittasāmānyāvadhāraṇaṃ tu | so'yamevaṃvidho viṣayaḥ karmapravacanīyānām | tairanvādibhirnimittaniyamenāvacchidyate saṃbandhathaḥ | tathā hi śākalyasya saṃhitāmanu prāvarṣadityatra saṃhitāpravarṣaṇayorhetuhetumadbhāvo niśamayatikriyājanita ityanunāvedyate | tathā kriyayāsyānyatrānuniśamyetyādau sāhacaryopalabdheḥ karma proktavanta iti ca karmapravacanīyeṣavtikrāntakriyāprakāśanāṅgīkārāt saṃprati kriyāmayaṃ na dyotayati | kriyāpadasya cāśruteḥ dyotyābhidhāyakābhāve tanniṣṭhadyotakatvābhāvāt | svarūpeṇa tu saṃbandho vibhak‌tyaiva pratipādyate iti nāpi tadvācakaḥ | kriyāpadākṣepe tu nāsya sāmarthyaṃm, kārakavibhak‌tyabhāvāditi saṃbandhaviśeṣāvadyotakatvaṃ sthāpitaṃ karmapravacanīyānām | taduktamanantarakāṇḍe "kriyāyā dyotako nāyaṃ na saṃbandhasya vācakaḥ | nāpi kriyāpadākṣepī saṃbandhasya tu bhedakaḥ || iti | evamapi "adhi brahmadatte pañcālāḥ" iti paripālanādikriyānimittatvaṃ svasvāmibhāvasyādhināvedyate | "abhimanyurarjunataḥ prati" iti paraparājayanādikriyākṛto'nukāryānukaraṇabhāvo'rjunābhimanyvoḥ saṃbandha iti pratinā prakāśyate | evamanyatrāpi yathāyogamanugantavyam | tadayamaśrutakriyāviṣaye saṃbandhe karmapravacanīyānāṃ mahimā | śrutakriyāviṣaye tu śrūyamāṇaiva kriyā niyataṃ nimittamavadhāryata iti || 158 ||
tatra tvidaṃ vicāryate | śeṣa ityevaṃ siddhāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ `adhīgartha' ityādinā punarvidhānaṃ kimartham | `karmaṇi śeṣe' iti ca sāmānādhikaraṇyena viśeṣaṇānupapattiḥ (karmatvavivakṣāyāṃ hi na śeṣaḥ, kārakāṇāmavivakṣā śeṣa ityukteḥ | phalabhūtaśeṣavivakṣāyāṃ ca tirohitatvāt karmatvasyetyāśaṅkyāha--- sādhanairvyapadiṣṭe ca śrūyamāṇakriye punaḥ | proktā pratipadaṃ ṣaṣṭhī samāsasya nivṛttaye || 159 ||
 karmādīni sādhanāni śeṣasya vyapadeśārthānyatropādīyante na tu svārtham | śeṣe ṣaṣṭhī | kasmin śeṣe | karmaṇi karaṇa iti vā bhūtāvasthāgatakarmatvādirūpāśrayeṇa śeṣasya viśeṣaṇāt karmādyekārthasamavāyini phalabhūte śeṣa ityartho'vatiṣṭhate | tathā ca viśeṣaṇopapattiḥ | ṣaṣṭhī tu siddhāpi pratipadamadhīgarthetyādinā niyataviṣayatayā vidhīyate, punarvidhānena samāso yathā nivartyeteti | punaḥ śrutirhi niyamārthā | tathā ca ṣaṣṭhyeva bhavatīti vākyārthaḥ | niyame cānyanivṛttiḥ pradhānam, anyaśca pratiyogī vyavacchedyaḥ | sa cātra ṣaṣṭhyābhāvaḥ sa ca samāse bhavatīti sāmarthyāt samāsaniṣedho'yamavatiṣṭhate | tadetaduktam pratipadavidhānā ṣaṣṭhī na samasyate iti | sūtravyāpāra evānena vārtikena nāpūrvo'rthaḥ | kva punarayaṃ samāsapratiṣedhaḥ | yatra samāsasya prāptiḥ | kva ca prāptiḥ | subanteṣu mātuḥ smṛtamiti || 159 ||
tathā hyatra | niṣṭhāyāṃ karmaviṣayā ṣaṣṭhī na pratiṣidhyate | śeṣalakṣaṇayā ṣaṣṭhyā samāsastatra neṣyate || 160 ||
 kṛdyoga ca ṣaṣṭhī samasyata ityuktam | tathā ca "kartṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti" iti yā ṣaṣṭhī tatra bhavatyeva samāsaḥ `dharmānusmaraṇam, arthānusmaraṇam' ityādau | na hyeṣa ṣaṣṭhyā niyamaḥ `kartṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti' iti punaḥ karmagrahaṇāccheṣagrahaṇasya nivṛtterityapūrvavidhānamidam | tena ṣaṣṭhyeveti ṣaṣṭhīniyamadvāreṇa samāsapratiṣedhamāvedayate | mātuḥ smṛtamityādau niṣṭhāprayoge "na lokāvyaya"..... ityādinā `kartṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti' itīyaṃ ṣaṣṭhī niṣiddheti "adhīgarthadayeśāṃ karmaṇi" ityanenaiva karmaṇi śeṣatvena vivakṣite ṣaṣṭhīti sāmānyena siddhāyāṃ punarvidhānāt samāsapratiṣedhārthā vijñāyate | nanu ca "ktasya ca vartamāne"  "napusake bhāva upasaṃkhyānam"  ityanenātra ṣaṣṭhī | naitat | "śeṣavijñānāt siddham"  ityasya pratyākhyānāt śeṣaṣaṣṭhayeveyam | punarvidhānena samāsābhāvaṃ jñāpayati | evamapi mātuḥ smṛtamiti prayogānupapattiḥ | smarateḥ sakarmakatvāt karmaṇi niṣṭhāprasaṅgānmātṛsāmānādhikaraṇyānmātā smṛteti syāt | saṃbandhyantarāpekṣāyāṃ tu mātuḥ smṛtāyā iti prayogo nyāyyaḥ | satyametat | "karmādiṣvakarmakavadvacanam" iti tūktam | tathā cātrākarmakavadbhāve ktapratyayāntena karmaṇābhidhānāccheṣavivakṣāyāṃ tatra ṣaṣṭhī punarvidhīyamānā samāsapratiṣedhasya sampadyata iti sthitametat | evaṃ "jño'vidarthasya karaṇe" ityādau pratipadavidhāne sarpiṣo jñānaṃ madhuno jñānamityādiḥ samāsapratiṣedha udāhāryaḥ | nanu cātra samāse kṛte saṃbandhamātraṃ pratīyate, na tu karaṇapūrvakaḥ saṃbandha iti vigrahavākyārthābhidhāne sāmarthyābhāvādatra samāso na bhaviṣyatīti kimanena yatnena | naitadasti | vākye'pi na śābdaḥ saṃbandhaviśeṣāvasāyaḥ, sādṛśyāt | tathā hi karmaṣaṣṭhyāmapīdṛśameva vākyam | tatra yathārthaprakaraṇādinā jānātervidarthatvasaṃpratyaye karmaṣaṣṭhyā bhavati samāsaḥ tattvajñānaṃ varṇajñānamityādau | tathā ca sarpiṣo jānāmītyatrāpi prakaraṇāderavidarthatvasaṃpratyaye karaṇaṣaṣṭhyā api bhavet samāsa iti śeṣagrahaṇānuvṛttyā'trāpi punarvidhānamāśritya pariharaṇīyaḥ sa iti sthitam | vibhaktividhānasya svādividhinaikavākyatve'pyavayavavavākyānāṃ svavyāpārasya nivṛtteḥ pratipadavidhānatve na kācidanupapattiḥ || 160 ||
dviṣṭhaḥ saṃbandho guṇeṣu vyatiricyata ityuktam | guṇapradhānabhāvasya caikatra virodhāt bhāṣya uktam--- "na tarhīdānīmidaṃ bhavati rājñaḥ puruṣasyeti' iti | tatra pratisamādhānamuktam --- "bhavati bāhyamarthamapekṣya " iti | etadbhāṣyaṃ vyācaṣṭe | anyena vyapadiṣṭasya yasyānyatropajāyate | vyatirekaḥ sa dharmau dvau labhate viṣayāntare || 161 ||
 rājñaḥ puruṣasya kambala ityādau rājñā viśeṣaṇena vyapadiṣṭasya viśeṣyatayā jñāpitasya puruṣasya pradhānabhūtasya anyatra kambalādau pratiyogini pradhāne vyatireka ādhikyaṃ saṃbandho jāyate iti sa bhinniviṣayau guṇapradhānabhāvalakṣaṇau dvau dharmau pratipadyate | `vyapadiṣṭasya' iti bhūtakālepādānena saṃbandhidvayayaugo bhinnakālaguṇapradhānanimitto na virudhyata ityāha || 161 ||
tataśca | prādhānyaṃ svaguṇe labdhvā pradhāne yāti śeṣatām | sahayoge svayoge'taḥ pradhānatvaṃ na hīyate || 162 ||
 ato viṣayabhedāddhetoḥ puruṣasya rājānaṃ saṃbandhinaṃ prati prādhānyaṃ na nivartate | svasmin hi tatra guṇe'pradhāne rājalakṣaṇe prādhānyaṃ pūrvameva tena labdham | kambalādau tvaparasmin pradhāne śeṣabhāvaṃ guṇatvaṃ yātīti tatra svasya kambalāderyoge pūrvapratītaṃ prādhānyaṃ nāvagacchati, viṣayabhedāt | guṇapradhānabhāvasyaikatrāvirodhādityarthaḥ | `sahayoge' iti prasaṅgānnidarśanamabhinnayogakṣemamāha | "sahayakte'pradhāne" ityanenāpradhānāt tṛtīyā vidhīyate putreṇa sahāgata iti | tatra putro devadattasyeti yathā viśeṣyamāṇastadapekṣayā pradhānamapyāgamane sahārthasāmarthyādāgatasaṃbandhādanumīyamānāgamanasaṃbandho'pradhānamiti bhavati tato'pradhānalakṣaṇā tṛtīyā | tathā puruṣo rājāpekṣayā pradhānamapi svaviśeṣyāpekṣayāpradhānatvādrājñaḥ puruṣasya dhanamiti ṣaṣṭhīṃ pratipadyata iti siddham || 162 ||
iti bhūtirājatanayahelārājakṛte prakīrṇakaprakāśe sādhanasamuddeśe śeṣādhikāraḥ || --------------  evaṃ tāvat kārakātmā vibhak‌tyartho vicāritaḥ | prathamā tu "abhihite prathamā" ityevaṃ kaiścid vihitā | tiṅādibhirabhihite karmādau kārake prathamā | pacyate odanaḥ, māṃsapacano vanhiḥ, godhno'tithiḥ, praskandanaḥ staṃbhaḥ , niśā nīśāṇā, pacati devadattaḥ iti yathākramaṃ karmādikartṛparyantakārakābhidhānaṃ tiṅādinodāhṛtam | kṛtaḥ kaṭa iti kṛtā karmābhidhānam, aupagava iti taddhitena saṃbandhābhidhānam, citraguriti samāsena | rājñaḥ puruṣa ityatra parasparāpekṣayoḥ saṃbandhamātre vākyaparyavasāne'nyatarapadanibaddhayā ṣaṣṭhayā dviṣṭhasaṃbandhābhidhāne parasmādabhihitalakṣaṇaiva prathamā | atra tu lakṣaṇe coditam- "astirbhavantīparaḥ prathamapuruṣo'prayujyamāno'pyasti" ityuktaḥ | kriyānuṣaṅgamantareṇāvyavahāryaḥ padārtha iti sāmānyarūpāvyabhicaritasaṃbandhā sarvatrāstikriyā sannidhīyata iti vṛkṣo'stīti vākyaprayogādabhihite tiṅā kartarīyaṃ prathamā | taduktaṃ bhāṣye--- "na sattāṃ padārtho vyabhicarati" iti | vadhṛtapadārthādhikaraṇatvācchabdaprayogasyāvadhāraṇasya ca sattāpekṣatvādupacārasattāsamāviṣṭaḥ sarvaḥ padavācyo'rtha ityarthaḥ | tathā ca prāguktam pravṛttihetuṃ sarveṣāṃ śabdānāmaupacārikīm etāṃ sattāṃ padārtho hi na kaścidativartate || iti | nāsti badhyate nīyate ityādyanuṣaṅgo'pi nirūputasya sato bhavati ityautsargikī sarvatreyaṃ sattā || tathā ca virodhibhiravirodhibhiśca dharmairetasyāmavasthita eva śabdaḥ samanvetīti prāgevoktaṃ tatraiva ca nirṇītam | evamapi "abhihitānabhihite prathamābhāvaḥ" iti coditam | `prasāda āste' ityādāvāsikriyāpekṣayādhikaraṇaśaktirnābhihitā | sadikriyāpekṣayā tvabhihitā kṛtā | tataścābhihitalakṣaṇā prathamā prāpnoti | tathā `phalitā vanaspatayaḥ', `tārasvarāḥ parabhṛtāḥ' ityādau samānādhikaraṇasaṃbandhe prātipadikārthavyatirekābhāvānna kiṃcit kenacidabhihitamityabhihitalakṣaṇā prathamā na syāt | `uccaiḥ' `nīccaiḥ' iti cāstipadādhyāhāreṇādhikaraṇaśaktipradhānasyāvyayasyāsaṃbadhānna kenacidabhidhānamiti kathaṃ prathamā evaṃ "tiṅ‌samānādhikaraṇe prathamā" ityetadapyanenaiva dṛṣṭāntena lakṣaṇamalakṣaṇam | aparamapyatra parisamāptarūpasya padārthasya kriyāyāṃ viniyogārthaṃ yadabhimukhīkaraṇaṃ tāvanmātraṃ saṃbodhanaṃ prātipadikārthādhikaṃ rūpam | mātragrahaṇena karmādisādhanarūpatāṃ saṃbodhanasyāpāvartayati | ya eva hi gamanādau niyujyate kartā sa evābhimukhīkṛtaḥ saṃbodhanādhikaḥ | abhimukhīkṛtasya ca niyogottakālaṃ kriyāsādhanāt paramparayā kriyāpakārakatā manubhavati saṃbodhanaṃ na tu sākṣātkārakam || 163 ||
kriyāpakṣe'pi saṃbodhane viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvavad vākyārthatā nāsti, api tu karmādisādhanavat padārthatvamevetyāha | saṃbodhanaṃ na vākyārtha iti vṛddhebhya āgamaḥ |  niścāyakaṃ pramāṇam āgamaḥ | itarapadanairapekṣyeṇa saṃbodhyatāvagateḥ padārtha eva saṃbodhanaṃ kriyākāṅkṣitve'pi | tad yathā karmādīnāṃ nānapekṣitakriyāṇāṃ sādhanatvamavakalpate iti samāśrayitavyā kriyā na cāto vākyārthaṃtvam, evaṃ saṃbodhanasyāpi | gamyamānakriyaṃ caikapadamapi vākyaṃ vṛkṣa ityādivaditi vākyārtho'pi saṃbodhanaṃ bhavatyeva | idānīṃ prakṛtaṃ nigamayati uddeśena vibhak‌tyarthā vākyārthāt samapoddhṛtāḥ || 164 ||
saṃkṣepavacanamuddeśaḥ | tena hetunā vibhaktīnāmarthāḥ karmādikārakasvabhāvāḥ pāramārthikādakhaṇḍād vākyārthādanekakārakaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭakriyāsvabhāvāt pṛthagapoddhārabuddhyānvayavtirekābhyāmapoddhṛtāḥ | yathā hi vākyādakhaṇḍāt padāpoddhārastathā vākyārthāt padārthāpoddhāraḥ | vibhak‌tyarthaścāpi padārtha eva | tatrāpi tvapoddhāre padārthāt vibhaktyarthāpoddhāro vyākhyeyaḥ vākyārtha eva tu stitalakṣaṇo'satyastu padārtha iti `vākyārthāṃt' ityāha | anye tvāhuḥ | `uddeśena' vākyārthāvayavenopalakṣitād `vākyārthāt' iti vākyārthaikadeśabhūtāt padārthādeva vibhaktā ityayameva spaṣṭo'rthaḥ || 164 ||
idānīṃ vibhaktyarthasya prātipadikārthādanyatve śāstrīyaṃ liṅgāmāha | vibhak‌tyarthe'vyayībhāvavacanādavasīyatām | anyo dravyād vibhak‌tyarthaḥ so'vyayenābhidhīyate || 165 ||
 avyayaṃ vibhakti--- iti vibhak‌tyarthe vartamānamavyayaṃ samarthenottarapadena samasyata ityuktam , `adhistri' iti | tatra yadi dravyameva vibhak‌tyartho bhavet `tadā strīśabdenaiva tasyoktatvādavyayamaprayogārhameva | tadasyāprayujyamānasya kutaḥ samāsaḥ | tasmād vibhaktyarthe'vyayībhāvaśāsanāda vasīyate prātipadikameva karmādīni sādhanāni nābhidhatta iti | tathā hyadhikaraṇaśartimavyayapadamabhidadhaduttarapadenānuvabhavati samāsam | "dṛṣṭo hyavyatireke'pi vyatireko'nvaye sati |' ityādinā pūrvamanvayavyatirekābhyāmayamarthaḥ sādhitaḥ | saṃprati liṅgadarśanenopodbalitaḥ | nanu ca paṃcakaprātipadikārthapakṣe viśiṣṭasya nirbhāgasya dravyasya prātipadikenoktātvād viśeṣadyotanāya vibhaktaya iva avyayamapi prayogārhaṃ syāt | dyotakānāṃ niyamābāvāditi kathametalliṅgaṃ yujyate | satyametat | kiṃ tu trikapakṣe liṅgamidamupanyasyate | tathā hi `avyayaṃ vibhakti....' iti vibhak‌tyartha upalakṣitaḥ | paṃcakapakṣe tu dravyātmabhūtasya viśeṣasya vibhaktibhiḥ prakāśanāt padenaivārtha upalabhyeta, samudāyavācyatvāttasya, na kevalayā vibhak‌tyā | paṃcakapakṣe'pi vā niyatasya śak‌tyātmano viśeṣasya prātipadikāmātrādapratītervibhaktīnāmevāsau viṣayaḥ | tathā ca prātipadikavācyādaniyataśakterdravyādanyo niyataśaktirvibhak‌tyartha iti yuktamucyate | evaṃ ca kṛtvānvayavtirekāvapūrvābhidhāne dyotane vā yathāyogaṃ pakṣadvaye vyāpriyeti || 165 ||
nanu ca samānakartṛkayoḥ paśau kartari ityevamāderliṅgād dravyasya sādhanatvāvagamāt kathaṃ dravyādanyo vibhak‌tyartha ityāśaṃkya śakteḥ sādhanatvamupapādhayitumāha | dravyaṃ tu yad yathābhūtaṃ tadatyantaṃ tathā bhavet | kriyābhede'pi tasyāsau dravyātmā nāvahīyate || 166 ||
sarvāvasthāsvanapāyādekasvabhāvaṃ dravyaṃ sadaivācalamiti vṛkṣaṃ vṛkṣeṇetyādausādhanavecitryanirnibandhanaṃ syāt | vṛkṣaṃ paśya vṛkṣeṇa phalitamityādikriyānānātvanimitto dravyasya bheda ityapi mithyā | kriyānānātve'pi dhruvaṃ dravyaṃ svarūpānna pracyavate | saṃbandhibhedamātrād vastuno'nyathātvāyogāt || 166 ||
evaṃ ca kṛtvā tasmād yat karaṇaṃ dravyaṃ tat karma na punarbhavet | sarvasya cānyathābhāvastasya dravyātmano bhavet || 167 ||
 karaṇabhāvenādhṛtaṃ dravyaṃ karmatayā na prakhyāyate | upalakṣaṇaṃ caitat kārakāntareṣu | karmatayā cāvagataṃ śeṣatayā na vijñāyeta | ekatvācca dravyasya sādhanasya prāsāde āste āsane śete iti lyuḍabhidhānādadhikaraṇasya saptamī na syāt | śaktestu sādhanatve kriyābhedena tadbhedātsadikriyāpekṣāyāmadhikaraṇaśaktivabhihitāyāmapyāsikriyāpekṣāyāṃ tu tasyābhihitādanyatrānabhihita iti paryudāsāśrayaṇāt saptamī sidhyati | tathā ca vārtikam | "anabhihite hi vidhānam" atha kriyāntarayoge karaṇasya karmātmatayā pariṇāmastadā sakalasyaiva dravyasvabhāvasya vastvantarāpattiḥ syāt, na karaṇāṃśasyaiva, tasya dravyādanyatvāt | śaktestu sādhanatve kriyābhedena tadbhede'pi tadādhārasya dravyasyānvayino'vasthānāt śak‌tyantaratyāgopādānayoge yuktaḥ karaṇādirūpatayā saṃbhavaḥ | asamarthasya dravyasya kriyāsiddhāvanaṃgatvāt sāmarthyameva tadādhāraṃ sādhanaṃ yuktam | na caitāvatā dravyasyāpi sādhanādhāratvāt sādhanabhāvaḥ kalpayituṃ nyāyyaḥ | na hi devadattasya pacisādhanatve tadādhārasya pīṭhasyāpi tat kalpyata iti śaktaya eva sādhanaṃ na tu śaktimad dravyam | "samānakartṛkayoḥ" iti tu śaktyādhāradravyaikatvādhyāropanimittaṃ samānatvaṃ kartṛśak‌tyoḥ | `paśau kartari' hastisūcakayoḥ kartroḥ iti phaśau dravye yaḥ kartā hastisūcakayoḥ dravyayoḥ kartārau iti vyākhyeyam | athavā kartṛśaktyāśryaḥ paśureva kartā iti sāmānādhikaraṇyam | "karmaṇi dvitīyā" ityādāvapi śaktīnāṃ saṃkhyāyogāt tadādhāraṃ dravyameva nirdiśyate | tena karmaikārthasamavetāyāṃ saṃkhyāyāṃ vibhak‌taya ityarthaḥ | niradhārāyāsca śakteranupapatteḥ dravyameva śaktyāviṣṭaṃ sādhanaṃ lakāravācyam | tacca viśeṣātmakameva kriyākāri niyatenātmanānabhihitaṃ padāntareṇābhivyajyata iti devadattaḥ pacatītyādisāmānādhikaraṇyena prayogopapattiriti sarvaṃ sustham || 167 ||
iti bhūtirājatanayahelārājakṛte prakīrṇakaprakāśe sādhanasamuddeśaḥ saptamaḥ || <3.2> idānīṃ sādhyāpekṣatvāt sādhanasya sādhanāntara'middiṣṭāyāḥ kriyāyāḥ śāstrīyaṃ lakṣaṇamāha-- yāvat siddhamasiddhaṃ vā sādhyatvenābhidhīyate | āśritakramarūpatvāt tat kriyetyabhidhīyate || 1 ||
iha kriyāvacano dhāturiti pūrvācāryalakṣaṇe "astibhavatividya'tīnāṃ dhātutvaṃ vaktavyam" iti coditam | tathā hi-yathā kiṃ karoti ? pacati, iti pacādīnāṃ karotinā sāmānādhikaraṇyāt kriyāviśeṣavācakatvādhyavasāyaḥ, na tathā bhavatyādīnām | na hi bhavati kiṃ karoti ? bhavati, ityādīti na te kriyāvacanāḥ syuḥ | kiṃ ca parispandasvabhāvā loke kriyā prasiddhā | astibhavatividyatīnāṃ ca na parispandasvabhāvo'rtha iti sakaladhātuvyāpakaṃ kriyālakṣaṇaṃ bhāṣye praṇītaṃ "kārakāṇāṃ pravṛttiviśeṣaḥ kriyā" iti | tatra vicāryate | sarveṣāṃ vā kārakāṇāmekaḥ pravṛttiviśeṣaḥ, pratikārakaṃ bhinnā vā pravṛttiriti | ādye pakṣe kārakāṇāṃ phalabhūtā bhūtipaktyādikā vā pravṛttiḥ syādanyā veti dvaitam | tatra na tāvat sarveṣāmekaḥ pravṛttiviśeṣaḥ | asambhavāt | na hi yaiva karaṇasya pravṛttiḥ saiva kartuḥ, yaivādhikaraṇasya saiva saṃpradānasyetyādi | anekāśrayāyā ekasyāḥ kriyāyā adarśanāt | tasmāt pratikārakaṃ bhinnā pravṛttiḥ kriyā | itthaṃ ca kriyāvācī dhāturiti sakalakārakavyāpārābhidhāyī dhātuḥ prāptaḥ | kimataḥ | idamataḥ | sarvakārakābhidhāyī lakāraḥ syāt | dhātūktavyāpāra sādhano hi lo dhātoḥ paraḥ prayujyamāno nyāyyaḥ | naitadasti | kartṛkarmaṇorlasyānuśāsanāt tadvyāpāra eva lāntāt pratīyate | nanu na śabdanimittena nāmārthena bhavitavyam, api tvarthanimittena śabdeneti sādhanamātre lo'nuśiṣyatām | bhavedetad yadi sādhanamātravyāpāro lāntādavagamyeta, kartṛkarmavyāpāra eva tu pratīyate iti śabdaśaktyanusāreṇānuśāsanaṃ yuktam | na tarhi sādhanamātravyāpārābhidhāyī dhātuḥ | anvayavyatirekābhyāṃ tadanavagamāt, upāyāntarābhāvācca prakṛtipratyayānusaraṇasya | satyametat | kiṃ tu devadattaḥ kāṣṭhaiḥ sthālyāmodana pacatītyādāva viśeṣeṇa pacaterdhātoḥ sarvakārakavyāpārasvīkāropalabdherakhilakārakalāntāt pratīyata ityekīyaṃ mata'm | anye manyante-sampradānādivyāpāre dhātornavṛttiḥ | karaṇādivyāpāra eva tu vṛttiḥ | tathā ca karaṇādāveva svātantryavivakṣā, nāpādānādau | itthaṃ ca "adhiśrayaṇodakāsecana.." ityādinā kartrādīnāmeva vyāpāraḥ pacikriyeti vārtikakāro darśayati | ataśca "kārakāṇāṃ pravṛttiviśeṣaḥ kriyā" iti kriyāsvarūpamātraṃ kathitam, na tu dhātuvācyatvam | yasya kārakasya yā pravṛttiḥ sā kriyā | tato bahukārakaviṣayatvena bahvaya eva pākakriyāḥ | kācideva tu dhātunābhidhīyate karmagatā kartṛgatā vā, pacyate pacatīti | ata eva kartṛkarmaṇorevotpadyate lakāraḥ, tadvyāpārasyaiva dhātunābhidhānāt | anye tu viśeṣapade bharaṃ kṛtvā pravṛttīnāṃ viśeṣaḥ pravṛttiviśeṣa iti sakalakārakajanyā viklittyādirūpā bhūtiḥ phalabhūtā kārakapravṛtteḥ kriyeti vyācakṣate | apare punaḥ kārakamatra pradhānaṃ vivakṣitaṃ kartṛrūpaṃ na punarapradhānaṃ karaṇādi | bahuvacanaṃ tvanekakriyābhedena kartṛbhedāt | kartṛgrahaṇameva tu na kṛtam, karmaṇi lakāradarśanāttadvyudāso'sya mā bhūditi | tena yatra sambhavati karma tatra tadvyāpāro'pi kriyā | yadyevaṃ tadapekṣayaiva bahuvacanaṃ vyākhyeyam | karmārthatvācca pravṛttestadapi pradhānam | naitadasti, karmaṇo'sarvaviṣayatvāt | kartā punaḥ sarvatra sthita iti vyāpakatvāt sa evātra pradhānaṃ kārakaṃ vivakṣitam | atra ca "anyathā śuṣkaudane kārakāṇi pravartante, anyathā māsaudane" iti bhāṣyameva liṅgamāha | tathā hi-māṃsaudane saṃrambhavattvena pravartate kartā, śuṣkaudane mandaprasthānena | yataśca saṃrambheṇa mandatayā ca pravṛttiṃ darśayati ato'vasīyate kartaivātra kārakaśabdenābhidhitsita iti | tathā hi cetanatvāt sa eva tathā pravartate | tadevaṃprakārā sasaṃrambhā tadviparītā vā pravṛttiviśeṣarūpā kriyeti bhāṣyakāreṇa svayamevodāhṛtā | atra keciccodayanti cetana syaivaivaṃ pravṛttisaṃbhavādacetanaḥ kartā na gṛhītaḥ syāditi tatpravṛttiḥ kriyeti noktaṃ syāt | māsaudanādau ca karaṇādīnāmapi sambhavāt kathaṃ kartaivātra nirdiṣṭa iti | atrocyate | saṃrambhasya māndyasya ca kartureva saṃbhavaḥ | na hi kaṃsapātryādikamadhikaraṇamanyadvā kārakaṃ saṃrambhavattvena mandatayā vā pravartate | sāmānyena ca kartṛkarmaṇāṃ grahaṇādacetanapravṛttirapi gṛhītaiva | "anyathā māsaudane...." ityādinā tu saṃrambheṇa mandatayā ca pravṛttiviśeṣa upalakṣitaḥ | na punaḥ pūrvoktā kartṛmātrapravṛttirniyamyate | ataḥ karturyā viśiṣṭā pravṛttiḥ sā kriyetyarthaḥ | evaṃ ca kṛtvā pravṛttireva viśeṣa iti samāsaḥ | karmaṇo'pi sūcitatvāt kārakaśabdena tadvyāpāro|ñapi kriyeti | pratīyate | anyathā kartṛpadamevākariṣyadityuktam | asmin mate "atha kaḥ paceḥ pradhāno'rthaḥ, yāsau taṇḍulānāṃ viklittiḥ " iti bhāṣyaṃ katham | kartṛvyāpāro hi kriyā dhātuvācyā | sā ca vikledanā, na tu viklittiḥ | nāsti virodhaḥ |nātra śabdārtho nirūpyate api tu vastvartha ityārthena rūpeṇa viklitteḥ prādhānyādevamuktam | śābdena tu rūpeṇa viklittyupasarjanaṃ vikledanamarthaḥ | karmaṇi lakārotpattau tu viklittirevārtha iti kecit | vikledanopasarjanā viklittirityapare | tena kartṛkarmavyāpāra eva sarvatra dhātvartha itīdaṃ darśanam | anye tu "sāmānyabhūtā kriyā vartate" ityetadbhāṣyānusāreṇa pravṛttimātramagṛhītaviśeṣaṃ sakalakārakānuyāyinī kriyeti manyante | tathā hi phalajananaiva sādhāraṇātmikā kriyā pravṛttiviśeṣa ityucyate pravṛttiścāyaṃ viśeṣaśceti | viśeṣo'syāḥ phalajananārūpatvaṃ na punaradhiśrayaṇādirūpataiva | tena jananākhye viśeṣaḥ pravṛttīnāṃ kriyā | sarveṣāṃ hi kārakāṇāmekā pravṛttiḥ phalajananālakṣaṇā | sarvāṇi hi phalajananāya pravartante | ato yat phalajananārūpaṃ tat sarvakārakeṣvaviśiṣṭam | kiñcit khalu kārakaṃ kenacideva rūpeṇa janayatīti phalajananā sarvasādhāraṇarūpaiva | avāntarabhādena tu janakatvāt karaṇādivyapadeśaḥ | kaṇādadarśane caikā kriyānekatra na bhavet | tīrthikāntaradarśanaṃ ceha nāśrīyate | ata eva parispandalakṣaṇa eva vyāpāro na kriyā | pravṛttirityetāvatyucyamāne hi lokaprasiddhyā parispandalakṣaṇa eva vyāpāraḥ pratīyeta | viśeṣagrahaṇāttuḥ pravṛttimātramavagamyata iti kecid vyācakṣate | tathā hi sarvā pravṛttiḥ pravṛttyantarād bhidyamānā viśeṣarūpatāmāpadyata iti sakalakriyānuyāyīdaṃ lakṣaṇam | viśeṣaśca sajātīyādvijātīyācca | tatra sajātīyād bhedaḥ `anyathā kārakāṇi śuṣkaudane pravartante, anyathā māṃsaudane' iti pratipāditaḥ | bhujikriyā hi kārakabhedād bhidyamānātroktā | audāsīnyena śuṣkaudane kārakāṇāṃ pravṛttiḥ | saṃrammeṇa tu māsaudane iti viśiṣyate | yadi ca saṃrambharūpataiva sādhanānāṃ kriyā syāt tadā śuṣkaudane bhujiḥ kriyārūpatāṃ na pratipadyeteti pravṛttiviśeṣa iti kriyāsāmānyalakṣaṇam | vijātīyādbhedastu pacati padhatītyādau spaṣṭa eva | nanu dravyādanyatvāmeva tāvat kathaṃ kriyāyāḥ pratipannimiti vaktavyam | tatrāpyuktam | "iha sarveṣu sādhaneṣu sannihiteṣu kadācit pacatītyetadbhavati kadācinna" ityādi | anvayavyatirekābhyāṃ pacatyādiśabdavācyā kriyā dravyāt kārakasaktiyuktādanyā | tathā hi-audāsīnyāvasthāyāṃ satsvapi sādhaneṣu pacatītyādiprakhyopākhyayorabāvādaryāntaraviṣayatvaṃ tayoḥ | tadyathā ghaṭasannidhāne'nutpadyamānānāṃ pākajānāmagnisaṃyogāpekṣitvam | "athavā yathā devadatta iha bhūtvā pāṭaliputre bhavati sā nūnaṃ kriyā" ityaparamatroktam | pūrveṇa granthena kādācitkaḥ prakhyāviśeṣo hetuḥ kriyāyā vyatireke'bhihitaḥ | sa tvasatyapi viṣaye marīcikājalāvasāyavat syāditīdamaparamatra liṅgamupanyastam | tathā hi prāptilakṣaṇaṃ phalaṃ dravyamātrādabhavad vyāpārāntaraṃ tato'nyadāvedayate | mithyāpratyaye viṣayasyābhāvāt phalānutpattiprasaṅgāt | na ca sādhānādeva śaktyātmanaḥ phalopajanaḥ | śaktatve'pi vyāpārābhāve phalādarśanādityasti kaścit so'rthaḥ yaḥ kramaviśeṣāpekṣaḥ kāryamabhinirvartayati | sā ca kriyā na śakyā piṇḍībhūtā nidarśayitumityanumānagamyoktā | nanu ca pacatīti prakhyāyā nirālambanatvena bhrāntatvādanumāpakatvamayuktaṃ syāt | sālambanatve tu pratyakṣaiva kriyā prakhyāviśeṣaviṣayatvāt | phalānumāne'pi pratītāsau śabdena nābhidhīyeta | phalamupajanayya vyatītāyāstasyā vartamānābhidhānaṃ virudhyate | atrocyate-iha vyākaraṇe na vastvartho'rthaḥ, api tu śabdārtho'rthaḥ | tathā cānvayavyatirekābhyāṃ dhātubhāgasya yo'rtho vyavasthāpyate nāsau sākṣādupalabdhuṃ śakyate | samāśritakramo hyarthātmā ākhyātāt prādhānyena pratīyamānaḥ kriyeti śābdena rūpeṇa kriyā caiva hi bhāvyate, svabhāvasiddhaṃ tu dravyamityuktam | vāstavena rūpeṇa sādhanādhīnasiddheranityasya dravyasya kathaṃ svābhāvikī siddhiḥ syāt | śābdena rūpeṇa vastu bhāvyamānātmakamapi prātipadikaiḥ siddharūpamucyate | tathā hi-dravyaśabdāḥ pravartamānāḥ ghaṭaḥ kriyate, paṭaḥ kriyate ityādisādhyamānāvastheṣvapi sanmātrākārāvalambanaṃ pratyayaṃ janayanti | ghaṭasya hi bhāvyamānāvasthā śivakastūkādīnāmavasthānāṃ krameṇa prādurbhāvaḥ | na cāsau ghaṭaśabdāt pratīyate, kriyata iti kriyāśabdaprayogādeva tadavagateḥ | tathā ca yaḥ padāntaranirapekṣācchabdādanvayavyatirekābhyāmartho'vagamyate sa tasyārtha iti ghaṭa ityasmāt kevalāt sattākārasyaivārthasyāvagamāt prātipadikārthaḥ satteti nirṇītam | kriyāpadaprayogāttu āśritakramarūpatāvagamāt tiṅantānāṃ bhāvyamāno'rtho'vasthāpyate | ghaṭaḥ kriyate iti ca ghaṭa ityevaṃ buddhyā gṛhyamāṇo yo'rthaḥ sa nirvartyata ityevaṃ padasamanvayaḥ | ghaṭo'bhūd bhaviṣyatītyādāvapi sadākārapratyayāda bhidhevātmanā nityatvamarthānāmiti "anityeṣvapi nityatvamabhidheyātmanā sthitam"  ityuktam | tasmācchābdena rūpeṇa bhāvyamānā kriyeti | dhvanatītyādāvapi kriyātvamiti vakṣyate | evaṃ ca "pūrvaparībhūtasya sakramasyārthasyāgamāpāyitvād bhāgānāmavartamānatvāt pratyakṣābhāvaḥ" ityapi vakṣyate | tadevamanvayavyatirekābhyāṃ dravyānumitā kriyā | nanvevamapyastyādīnāṃ kriyātvaṃ na syāt | na hi sarveṣu sādhaneṣu sannihiteṣu kadācidasti bhavati vidyate veti bhavati, sarvadā bhāvāt | pacatitarāmityādāviva cāstitarāmityādau prakarṣābhāvāt, kiṃ karoti pacatītyādivacca kiṃ karoti astītyādipraśnaprativacanābhāvāt, sattāyāśca nirviśeṣatvādbhedābhāvaḥ | atra brūmaḥ | iha "anyathā sādhanānyastau pravartante, anyathā mriyatau" iti pravṛttiviśeṣarūpatvaṃ tāvadasti | astau hyātmopagraharūpeṇa sādhanānāṃ pravṛttiḥ | evaṃ bhavatau vidyatau ca | mriyatau tvātmaparityāgarūpeṇetyasti tāvadvijātīyādbhedaḥ | asaṃrabdhasādhanasādhyā ca sattā niyatameva sādhanānāṃ sannihiteti prakhyopākhyayoḥ kādācitkatvābhāvaḥ | prakarṣapratyayaścāpi dṛśyate | vidyatetarāmayamiha nityasannidhānāt | aniyatasannihitāddhi nityasannihitasya sattā viśiṣyate | tena sādhanānyatvādabhidyamānāpi prakarṣeṇa yujyate | kiṃ karotīti ca kriyāviśeṣapraśne'sti, na kāñcit pacyādikāṃ kriyāmanutiṣṭhatītyāsti prativacanam | sāmānyena hyavagatāyāṃ sattāyāmasya praśnasyopapatteḥ nāsti kriyāviṣaya evāyam | pratyāsannavināśe ca kiṃ karoti devadattaḥ, asti tāvad, vidyate
