tāvaditi bhavata eva praśna prativacane | kiñca sarvāsāṃ kriyāṇāmanantaraphalajanakatvamastā vapyetadasti | kimatra phalamiti cedātmāmokṣarūpeṇeti brūmaḥ | ṣaḍ bhāvavikārāḥ iti niruktakāravacanāt bhāvaśabdābhidheyāyāḥ sattāyāḥ samagrakriyāyonitve mūlabhūtāyāḥ kriyātvaṃ pratyasyā na vivādaḥ | yadyapi ca bhāvavikāreṣu tiṣṭhatirnopasaṃkhyātaḥ tathāpyasyāstyeva kriyādharmānvathaḥ | tathā hi-- "kriyā kriyāyā nivartikā bhavati dravyaṃ dravyasya" ityuktam | tiṣṭhatītyukte vṛddhyapakṣayayornivṛttiḥ pratīyate iti kriyaiṣā kārakāṇāṃ pravṛttirūpā | asaṃbdhāni hi vṛddhāvapakṣaye ca kārakāṇyaudāsīnyenāvatiṣṭhante | tathā hi yāvat kārakāṇi pravartante tāvat pūrvāparībhūtāvayavaḥ sādhyamānasvabhāvaḥ pravṛttiviśeṣasteṣāmavadhāryate | yadadhīnā phalaniṣpattiḥ | śabdārtho'rtha iti caitallakṣaṇamiti vastutaḥ siddhamapi sādhyatvenābhidhīyamānā kriyā | tad yathā dhvanatīti | evaṃ sattādīnāmapi sādhyatayākhyātenābhidhānāt kriyātvamityastyādīnāṃ dhātutvaṃ siddham | tathā tiṣṭhaterapi kriyāntaranivṛttivacanatvādetadeva kriyālakṣaṇamanugāmi | tathā hi tiṣṭhatītyukte na vardhate'pakṣīyate veti gamyate | tathā ca kriyāntarāpākaraṇena kārakapravṛttiviśeṣatvāt kriyātvam | sādhanasaṃsargadarśanācca bhūmau tiṣṭhati, balena tiṣṭhatīti | evamupavasatīti bhājananivṛttyākārā pravṛttiḥ kriyā | vinaśyatyapakṣīyata ityasadavasthāpūrvabhāvī kārakapravṛttiviśeṣaḥ samāśritakramaḥ kriyeti bhāvavikāreṣu prapañcayiṣyate | tadevaṃ sādhanebhyo bhinnā kriyā | sādhanebhyaścānyad bhavad vastu kimanyat sādhyāt syāditi sādhyasvabhāvā kriyā dhātuvācyā | na hi saṃyogavibhāgātmakaḥ siddhasvabhāvo'rtho dhātuvācyaḥ, sādhyatayā pūrvāparībhūtatvenāvagamāt | tad‌vyatiriktasya cāparasya kartṛvyāpārasyāpratīterna bhāvanānyā kācid dhātvartho vidyate | samastadhātvarthasāmānyarūpaśca karotyartha iti pacatyādinā sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ pratīyate | pākaḥ pacatīti ca kṛdākhyātābhihitayorbhāvayoḥ siddhasādhyatārūpabhedāt buddhibhedaḥ | pākaṃ karoti pacatīti ca dhātvartha eva viklodanākhyaḥ śabdāt pratīyamāno vāstavakarmagataviklittiniṣṭhatayā vyākriyate | viklidyatastaṇḍulān vikledayatītyarthaḥ | ata eva viklidyanti pacantīti karmakartṛgatavyāpārābhidhānāt pratītibhedaḥ | dvayarthaḥ paciriti ca kartṛvyāpārasya dhātvarthatāyāmupapadyate | tasmānna bhāvanā kāciditi yāgena bhāvayet svargamiti naiṣa vākyārtho yajeteti api tu yajiḥ sādhyamānaśarīro'vasīyate | yadanuṣṭhānāt phalaṃ vastusāmarthyād bhavatīti kriyāviveke kriyaiva pradhānabhūtā vākyārtha iti nirṇītaṃ tata evāvadhāryam | alamiha vistareṇa || 1 ||
idānīmetadeva kriyālakṣaṇamudāharaṇena sphuṭīkaroti | kāryakāraṇabhāvena dhvanatītyāśritakramaḥ | dhvaniḥ kramanivṛttau tu dhvanirityeva kathyate || 2 ||
ghaṇṭā dhvanatīti dhvanirākhyotenopātta paurvāparyaḥ kriyātvamanuprāpto'bhidhīyate | tathā hi-ghaṇṭāḥ dhvaneḥ kāraṇam, kāryaṃ dhvaniḥ | tayoḥ saṃbandhena hetunā kārye savyāpārā ghaṇṭā dhvanatītyevamucyate | dhvanereva vā prabandhena jāyamānasya vīcīsantānavad viprasṛtāvayavatvāt pūrvo bhāgaḥ kāraṇam, uttarastu kāryam | yadā tūparata vyāpārā ghaṇṭā tadā pūrvāparabhāvasya nivṛttau ghaṇṭāyā dhvanirityevaṃ siddhatayā śabdena pratipādito na kriyālakṣaṇamanupatati | dhvaniṃ karotīti tu śabdāntarasaṃbandhāt pratīyamāno vākyārthaḥ, na padāt sādhyatayāvasāyaḥ, na svaśabdāditi kriyātvābhāvaḥ | prātipadikena siddhasvabhāvatāpanno'rtho'bhidhīyate | tatra karotīti tvākhyātāt sādhyarūpatāvasāyaḥ śabdāntarasaṃbandhāt pratīyamāno vākyārthaḥ, na padārthaḥ | evaṃ pākaṃ karotītyādāvapi draṣṭavyam | ākhyātenaiva hi sādhyasvabhāvaḥ kriyārūpo'rthaḥ pratyāyyate, na nāmapadena | śabdaśca svārthe yathābhidhānaṃ pramāṇamiti niścitametat | tathā hi śabdārtho'rtho na vastvartha ityasakṛduktam || 2 ||
atraivodāharaṇāntaramāha | śvetate śveta ityetacchvetatvena prakāśate | āśritakramarūpatvādabhidhānaṃ pravartate || 3 ||
śvete guṇe śvetate ityetat tiṅantam abhidhānam kramarūpāśrayeṇa pravartamānaṃ kriyārūpatāmāvedayate | tatraiva ca śvetaśabdena siddhāvastho guṇaḥ kartṛtvenocyate | tadāha--śvetatvena prakāśate iti | śauklyena guṇenopalakṣitaḥ pratibhāsata iti śvetate ityasyārthaḥ kārikāyāmeva vyākhyātaḥ || 3 ||
tadevaṃ śabdena sādhyatayābhidhīyamānaḥ samāśritakramaḥ paurvāparyavānārthaḥ kriyeti lakṣitam | pūrvāparībhūtasya kṣaṇapravāhasya yugapadasannidhānādekakriyālakṣaṇānupapattirityāśaṅkyāha | guṇabhūtairavayavaiḥ samūhaḥ kramajanmanām | buddhyā prakalpitābhedaḥ kriyeti vyapadiśyate || 4 ||
kramavatāṃ kṣaṇānāmekaphaloddeśena pravṛttānāṃ saṅkalanābuddhyā samāpāditaikyānāṃ kriyātvavyavahāraḥ | tatrāvayavānāṃ samudāye guṇabhāvāpatteḥ śabdabhedaprayojakatvābhāvādekadhātūpādānākriyaikā samudāyasvabhāvāvatiṣṭhate | tasyāścāvayavāśrayaḥ kramaḥ paurvāparyaṃ ca vyavahriyate | samudāyāśrayaṃ caikatvamadhyāropitam, utpattisamanantaraniruddhānāmavayavānāṃ vastubhūtasamudāyābhāvāt | tataścādhiśrayaṇādīnāṃ vyāpārāṇāṃ yaḥ samudāyo vuddhyaikatvena gṛhītaḥ sa pacatyādīnāṃ vācyaḥ | samudāyādeva hi phalaṃ niṣpadyate, na vicaṭanamātrād, adhiśrayaṇādivaiyarthyaprasaṅgāditi vyavahitairapyādhiśrayaṇādibhiḥ samīhitaphalānuguṇairyathāsvaṃ viśeṣa ādhātavyaḥ ityanekāpekṣe kārye nānāntaryamātreṇa kasyacid viśeṣa iti phalaviśeṣasampādakatvena pacādīnāmarthaḥ pratīyamānaḥ phalaikyādekatvenāvasīyamānaḥ kriyā || 4 ||
yadi tarhi samudāyaḥ kriyā adhiśrayaṇādīnāmavayavānāṃ pacikriyātvaṃ na syāt | tathā ca sarvāsvadhiśrayaṇādyavasthāsu pacatīti pratyayo na prāpnotīti keṣucit kṣaṇeṣvatītānāgateṣu tāvanmātrasya pacirūpatvābhāvād bhūtabhaviṣyadvayavahāro na svādityāśaṅkyāha | samūhaḥ sa tathābhūtaḥ pratibhedaṃ samūhiṣu | samāpyate tato bhede kālabhedasya sambhavaḥ || 5 ||
adhiśrayaṇāramṅa eva phalādisandheḥ samastakriyākalāpastatraivādhyasyate | tathā ca pacatīti vartamānakālatāyāṃ prayogaḥ | tāvanmātrasya ca phalopayogino rūpasyātītatvādapākṣīdityapi prayujyate | kṣaṇāntarasya bhāvino'dhyāropitapacirūpasyābhisandhāne pakṣyatīti | tathābhūtaḥ iti | guṇabhūtakramajanmāvayavaḥ | tathābhūtasya hi samudāyasya pratyekamavayave'dhyāsāt tatpratyayotpattiḥ | adhyāsaśca sarvatra pacatīti pratyayasyānuvṛttereva jñāyate | pratyavayavaparisamāptatvācca samudāyasyāvayavānāṃ tadrūpādhyāropa upapadyata eva | evamapyekatrāvayave samudāyarūpāropāt sādhyatāpratyayaḥ katham | ekatraiva hyekīkṛte samudāye'vayavāntarābhāvāt kimaparamavaśiṣṭaṃ yat sādhyaṃ pratīyeta | atrocyate | na samudāyabuddhayaikatvena, nāpyavayavabuddhyā ayaṃ cāyaṃ ceti samuccayena pratyekaṃ samudāyasyāvayaveṣvāropo'tra | kiṃ tarhi ? pūrvāparībhūtāvayavatvenaiva | tathā caikasminnapyavayave vyapagate samudāyasya vyapagamāropādapākṣīditi bhūtakālatā | bhāvini ca pakṣyatīti bhaviṣyatkālatā || 5 ||
yadi tarhi pratyavayavaṃ samudāyādhyāropāt kriyātvaṃ tadā tasyāvayavasya vartamānaraya pratyakṣatvāt kathamidamuktaṃ bhāṣye "kriyā nāmeyamatyantāparidṛṣṭā na śakyā piṇḍībhūtā nidarśayituṃ yathā garbho nirluṭhitaḥ | sāsāvanumānagamyā" ityāśaṅkyāha | kramāt sadasatāṃ teṣāmātmāno na samūhinām | sadvastuviṣayairyānti saṃbandhaṃ cakṣurādibhiḥ || 6 ||
samūhinām kriyākṣaṇānāṃ krameṇa bhavatāṃ sadsadrūpatvāt sadekavastuviṣayairindriyaiḥ saṃbandhābhāvādindriyārthasannikarṣajajñānaviṣayabhāvāpattyayogādatyantāparidṛṣṭā sādhanebhyo'nyānumānagamyā kriyā bhāṣye'bhihitā | ekasminnapi hi kṣaṇe samūho'dhyasyamānaḥ samāśritapaurvāparya evādhyasyate | tathārūpasyaiva kriyātvāt, tena ca rūpeṇendriyāviṣayatvāt || 6 ||
etadeva dṛṣṭāntanopapādayati | yathā gauriti saṅghātaḥ sarvo nendriyagocaraḥ | bhāgaśastūpalabdhasya buddhau rūpaṃ nirūpyate || 7 ||
indriyairanyathā prāptau bhedāṃśopanipātibhiḥ | alātacakravadrūpaṃ kriyāṇāṃ parikalpyate || 8 ||
gauraśva iti varṇasamudāyo'yugapadbhāvyavayavo yathā vartamānāvayavadvāreṇa śrotrendriyaparicchedyo'pi saṃskārakramāyātāntyabuddhinirgāhyaḥ tathā kṣaṇasamāhārātmikāpi kriyā vartamānakṣaṇagatendriyasaṃbandhādhyāropitapratyakṣabhāvā samudāyarūpatayā phalānumeyā | tatra sphoṭaḥ pratyakṣa eveti nāsau dṛṣṭānto'kramodbhinnaśca | samudāyastu varṇānāmuccaritapradhvaṃsināmayugapatkālatvādapratyakṣo buddhyā nirūpitaikatvo dṛṣṭānto varṇasamāhāramātradarśanāśrayeṇātra kriyāyā apyevaṃrūpatvādasamasa mayāvayavasamāhārātmakatvāt | ata eva alātacakravat ityāha | bhrāmyamāṇolmukarājīnāṃ cakrākāratayā bhrāntyādhyavasāyavat kriyākṣaṇanāmekatvaparikalpanā pratyakṣatābhimānaśca | kriyayā pratyakṣatayādhyavasitayā saha gṛhītasaṃbandhamākhyātapadaṃ prayujyate | ekapadopāttāṅgabhūtakārakabhedāvadhāraṇānnirjñātabhedā dhātubhirabhedena pratyāyyata iti śabdārthatvamāśrityocyate ekā kriyā iti | tathā ca sādhanasya lakāreṇānabhidhāne kriyaikatvena vyavahriyate āsyate bhavadbhiḥ iti || 7,8 ||
bhavatvevamadhiśrayaṇādyavayavānāṃ pacādikriyāṇām | adhiśrayaṇādīnāṃ tvavayavakriyāṇāṃ pratyakṣataiva nyāyyetyāśaṅkyāha | yathā ca bhāgāḥ pacatairudakāsecanādayaḥ | udakāsecanādīnāṃ jñeyā bhāgāstathāpare || 9 ||
adhiśrayaṇādīnāmapi saṃskārakāḥ svāvayavā vidyanta iti te'pi pūrvāparībhūtāḥ kramavanta eva kriyāviśeṣāḥ pratyakṣabhāvamativartanta eva | tathā hi svāvayavaparikalpanayā pūrvāparībhūtasamudāyātmakā evaite | tad yathā hastaprasāraṇasthā līvinyāseṣṭakāviniyojanādayo'dhyāropi tasamudāyārūpāḥ kālatrayābhidhāyināpi adhyaśiśrayad, adhiśrayiṣyati, adhiśrayatīti śabdena pratyāyyanta ityavayavasamūhātmakatvāt pacikriyāvadapratyakṣatvameva || 9 ||
atra paryantavartī bhāgastarhi niraṃśaḥ pratyakṣaḥ syādityāśaṅkyāha | yaścāpakarṣaparyantamanaprāptaḥ pratīyate | tatraikasmin kriyāśabdaḥ kevale na prayujyate || 10 ||
alpīyasaḥ paramāṇuprakhyasyāśakyāvayavavibhāgasya kriyākṣaṇasya kriyātvaṃ nāsti | āśritakramarūpatvāt kriyāyā iti na tena kriyāyā apratyakṣatāvyabhicāra udbhāvanīya ityarthaḥ kriyātvābhāvādeva ca kriyāśabdasyāprayogaḥ | śabdārtho'rtha iti nyāyāt | kriyāśabdasyāprayoge kriyātvābhāvamāha | sādhyamānarūpatayā hi tiṅantenābhidhīyamāno'rthaḥ kriyā | kevale ca niraṃśe kṣaṇamātre kriyāśabdāprayogaḥ | ayamarthaḥ | nehavāstavo bhāgabhedaścintyate, api tu śabdāt pratīyamānaḥ | śabdācca kṣaṇamātrasvabhāvāpi viprakīrṇāvayavā samūhātmanaiva sarvā kriyā pratīyata iti siddhaṃ śabdavācyatayā kriyāyāḥ sakramatvamatīndriyatvaṃ ca | kramarūpānadhyāse tu pratyastakramo nākhyātābidheyaḥ || 10 ||
yadā tu prayogastadā-- pūrvottaraistadā bhāgaiḥ samavasthāpitakramaḥ | ekaḥ so'pyasadadhyāsādākhyātairabhidhīyate || 11 ||
so'pyapakarṣaparyantamanuprāpto bhāgaḥ samūhāntaḥ pātī pūrvottarabāgagatapaurvārparyādhyāropitakramaḥ kriyālakṣaṇamanu patatyeveti kramāt sadasatāṃ teṣāṃ samūhināmapratyakṣataiveti sarvathātyantāparidṛṣṭā kriyeti siddham | anenaivāśayena niruktakāraḥ prāha-- "pūrvāparībhūtaṃ bhāvamākhyātenācaṣṭe vrajati pacatīvyupakramaprabhṛtyapavargaparyantam "  iti | na kṣaṇānāṃ pūrvāparībhāvo'tyantabhedāt | na hi yaḥ pūrvakṣaṇaḥ sa eva paraḥ sampadyate | na caikasyārthasya rūpāntareṇāpariṇāme cvipratyaya upapadyate | avayaveṣu tu samudāyādhyāsāt tasyā cābhedāt pūrvāparībhāvo yujyate | pūrvāvayavānusyūtatve rūpāntareṇāvasthānādhyavasāyācvyartho'pi ca saṅgacchate | bhāgaśaḥ pratyakṣatvācca na śakyā piṇḍībhūtā pāṃsurāśivat kriyā nidarśayitumityuktam || 11 ||
evaṃ sādhyasvabhāvaḥ sakramo'rthaḥ kriyeti lakṣaṇe sattāyā nityatvādasādhyatvādakramatvāt kathamastīti kriyā tiṅantāvācyetyāśaṅkyāha | kālānupāti yadrūpaṃ tadastīti pratīyate | paritastu paricchinnaṃ bhāva ityeva kathyate || 12 ||
iha sādhyatvenābhidhīyamāno'rthaḥ siddho|ñapi kriyeti "kriyā caiva hi bhāvyate, svabhāvasiddhaṃ dravyam" iti śābdena rūpeṇa kriyālakṣaṇākhyānāt sattāpi ākhyātāt sādhyatayā pratīyamānā kriyā | tathā ca kālāt kriyā vibhajyata iti kālānupātitā yathāyathamupapadyate, abhūd asti bhaviṣyatīti | kriyādharmasya kālābhivyaṅgyatvasya darśanādastyādīnāṃ kriyātvam, siddhasya kālenāyogāt | na hi ghaṭa ityukte kālaviśeṣāvagatirasti | nirjñātāyāṃ ca sattāyāṃ kiṃ karotīti praśnāsambhavādastīti prativacanābhāvaḥ | na tu kriyātvābhāvāt | vināśā śaṅkāyāṃ kiṃ karoti devadatta iti praśne asti tāvaditi prativacanopapatteḥ | kṛbhvastayaḥ kriyāsāmānyavacanāḥ, pacatyādayaḥ kriyāviśeṣavacanāḥ, karotinā hi pacatyādīnāṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyāt tadviśeṣatvāvasāyo brāhmaṇo gārgya iti yathā | yathā brāhmaṇyaṃ sāmānyaṃ tadviśeṣo gārgyastathā karaṇaṃ sāmānyaṃ pākādayastadviśeṣā iti kiṃ karoti pacatītyādisāmānādhikaraṇyopapattiḥ | itthaṃ ca karotyarthapraśnaḥ pacatyādibhirvyākṛto bhavati | arthabhede tu na praśnasāmānādhikaraṇo nirṇayo bhavet | ata eva viśeṣasāmānādhikaraṇye viseṣavacanā api kṛbhvastaya ityuktam | abhinnāṃ caiva bhinnāṃ ca prāhuḥ kṛbhvastaya kriyām | ekānekaviśeṣastā pravṛttiḥ sārvanāmikā || iti | anekavyaktisamavetā sāmānyātmikā abhinnā | niyatavyaktiniṣṭhā bhinnā | sāmānyasya pratyekaṃ parisamāptatvāt pratiniyataviśeṣapare'bhidhāne sāmānyaśabdo'pi prayogārha eva | tadyathā sarvanāmaśabdāḥ sarvārthāvamarśayogyā eva niyate'rthe prayujyante taṃ brāhmaṇamānayeti | ata eva sarvasmin prātipadikārthe pravṛtteḥ pravṛttiḥ sārvanāmikā' ityuktam | nanu ca karotyartha viśeṣatve sarvadhātvarthānāmāsanamapi karaṇamiti kiṃ karotīti praśne na karotyāste iti karotyarthaniṣedhenottaraṃ kathaṃ saṅgacchate | ucyate | nātra kriyāsāmānyaṃ pṛcchyate, api tu lokaprasiddha eva gamanādiviśeṣaḥ | tatraivalaukikānāṃ kriyātvābhimānāditi yukta eva gamanādivyuparame karotipratiṣedhaḥ | yadā tu yāṃ kāñcit kiyāṃ jijñāsate tadāste śete ityapi prativacanaṃ bhavatyevetyāsanāderapi kriyātvam | kathamaparispandarūpasya tasya tathātvamiti cet, tanna, yasmānna kāyavyāpāra eva kriyālakṣaṇaḥ , ari tu sādhanānāṃ pravṛttiviśeṣa iti prakrāntam | sa ca pravṛttiviśeṣaḥ sarvatraivānubhavasiddhaḥ | parvatastiṣṭhatītyādāvapyāśritakramarūpasyārthasyāvagamāt | na hi sarveṣāṃ sādhanānāmekarūpo vyāpāraḥ kenacidupapādayituṃ śakyate | tasmāt parvatāderapyekadeśāparityāgalakṣaṇastiṣṭhatau vyāpāro'styeva | tadevamākhyātānniyatakālāstikriyā pratīyate | saiva ca sattā nāmapadāt siddhatayā pratīyate bhāva iti | apūrvāparo hi bhāvaḥ śabdaśaktyanurodhāt tiṅantenāsāditapūrvāparo'bhidhīyate pacatīti | kṛtā tu siddharūpaḥ pāka iti | atrāpi ca dhātubhāgena sādyamānāvasthaiva kriyābhidhīyate | etāvāṃstu viśeṣaḥ | ākhyāte prādhānyenocyate pūrvāparībhūtā kriyā, kṛtsu pratyayārte guṇībhūteti | tathā caudanasya pāka iti prakṛtyarthadvārakaḥ sādhanayoga upapadyate | sādhane ca pratyayaḥ | anyathā kasya tat sādhanaṃ pratyayārthaḥ syāt, kasya vā siddhatākhyo dharmo ghañādinocyeta | pratyayārthasya siddhatāyāḥ sattvabhūtasya prādhānyāt tasyābhyāvṛttyayogāt pañcakṛpvaḥ pāka iti prayogāyogaḥ | kriyopapadāśrayastu pratyayaḥ prakṛtyarthāśrayaḥ bhoktuṃ pāka iti bhavatītyanantarakāṇḍe nirṇītamihāpyagre nirṇeṣyate | tadevaṃ pūrvottarabhāga gatakramāśrayeṇākhyātābhidheyā sarvaiva kriyādhyāropitakrameti na sattāyā api kācit kriyātve vicikitsā || 12 ||
yadyevaṃ kramasyāsato'dhyāropādamukhyatvaṃ kriyāyāḥ prāpnotītyāśaṅkhyāha | vyavahārasya siddhatvānna ceyaṃ guṇakalpanā | upacāro hi mukhyasya sambhavādavatiṣṭhate || 13 ||
gośabdasya sāsnādimati mukhyatvāt tatsamānaguṇe vāhīkādāvupacaritā pravṛttiparityucyate | kriyāyāstu samānakālānāśritapaurvāparyāvayavāyā abhāvānna mukhyatā kācit | sarvatra pūrvottarāsamasamayā vayavagatakamarūpādhyāropāditi nopacārārthaḥ kaścit | evaṃvidha eva hi kriyāvyavahāraḥ prasiddhaḥ | tathā caiko'pi kṣaṇaḥ samāśritakramaḥ kriyetyuktam || 13 ||
atra pūrvaṃ `pratibhedaṃ samūhaḥ samūhiṣu samāpyate' iti kramakalpanoktā | adhunā prakārāntareṇāha | āhitottaraśaktitvāt pratyekaṃ vā samūhinaḥ | anekarūpā labhyante kramavantaḥ ivākramāḥ || 14 ||
samūhinaḥ kṣaṇāḥ pratyekamakramā api bhāvataḥ samanantaravartikṣaṇasamūhagatabhedakramādhyāropādanekatvena sakramatvena cāvasīyanta iti pratyekaṃ te kriyālakṣaṇamanupatanti | tathā ca sarvatrādhiśrayaṇādau pacatiśabdapravṛttiḥ, atītānāgatavartamānatāsiddhiśca pacatyapākṣīt pakṣyatīti | pūrvaṃ samūhasyaiva pratyekamadhyāsa uktaḥ | iha tūttararūpasya pūrveṣu, na tu pūrvasya pareṣu tasyānubhavavāsanāvaśenaiva tadviśiṣṭottarapratipatterayatnasiddhatvāditi viśeṣaḥ || 14 ||
athavā pradhānabhūtaiva pacatyādikriyā phalaṃ pratyanantarā adhiśrayaṇādīnāṃ tu tādarthyāt tathātvamityāha anantaraṃ phalaṃ yasyāḥ kalpate tāṃ kriyāṃ viduḥ | pradhānabhūtāṃ tādarthyād anyāsāṃ tu tadākhyatā || 15 ||
yatsamanantaramodanādiphalaniṣpattiḥ sā kriyā phalopāyatvenānuṣṭhīyamānā | tayā hi yat tat vicaṭanaṃ taṇḍulāvayavānāmavayavāntarebhyo vibhāgo yadanantaraṃ mārdavādayo niṣpadyante tad yadādhiśrayaṇādiṣu pratyastarūpaṃ bhavati tadā pacatītyākhyātaśabdābhidheyaṃ kriyārūpamiti | yato hyanantaraṃ phalaniṣpattiḥ sā kriyā | vicaṭanānantarameva caudananiṣpattiriti vicaṭanameva tu pākaḥ | pūrve tu vyāpārāstadupakāriṇo na kāryajanmani sākṣādupayujyante | na hi sākṣādajanayat kiñcit kārakaṃ nāma | yastvadhiśrayaṇadikāle pacatīti pratyayaḥ sa vicaṭanopā yatvādadhiśrayaṇādīnāṃ pradhānabhūtavicaṭanakriyādhyāsavaśāt | nanvevamadhiśrayaṇasya siddhasyopakārakatvā(sva?) bhāvāt siddhatvam, tatra pacirūpādhyāsaśceti pratyakṣaḥpākaḥ prāptaḥ | naitadevam | siddhasvabhāvasyārthasya dhātuvācyatvābhāvādadhiśrayaṇaṃ siddhena rūpeṇa na paciḥ, api tu sādhyena vicaṭanarūpeṇa dhātuvācyam | tadadhyāsāt paciḥ | siddhasādhyayorhi niṣpannāniṣpannaporadhiśrayaṇavicaṭanayoraikātmyāpattau pacatyādiśabda prayogaḥ | vicaṭanasya tarhi niyatakālatvāt pūrvāparībhāvaḥ katham | ucyate | vicaṭanaṃ pāraśabdavācyaṃ bhedābhāvādyadyapi na pūrvaṃ na paraṃ tathāpi guṇakriyāsu tadrūpāropād guṇakriyāṇāṃ paurvāparyāt pūrvāparībhūtamityucyate | anye tu vicaṭanasyaiva rūpamadhiśrayaṇādirūpaṃ pratipannāḥ, na rūpaśūnyānadhiśrayaṇādīna pratyastavicaṭanarūpāniti | pūrvatra mate|ñadhiśrayaṇādiṣu vicaṭanarūpasyādhyāsāt pacipratyayaḥ uktaḥ | samprati tu vicaṭanasyaivānekarūpatvāditi matavikalpaḥ | atra cāyamāśayaḥ | śabdapramāṇakā vayam | śabdāccādhiśrayaṇādayaḥ pākātmanāvagamyante | na ca pacatipratyayasya sarvāvasthāsu viśeṣamupalabhāmahe, yenādhiśrayaṇādiṣu pacatirūpādhyāsād gauṇaḥ sa āśrīyeta | tasmādanekarūpaṃ vicaṭanameva śabdārtha iti kecit | yathā tu kārikārthaḥ tathā vicaṭanameva mukhyaṃ pacirūpaṃ pūrvāparānusandhānena samāśritakramaṃ sādhyamānāvastham | tatsamarthānāṃ tu vyāpārāṇāmupacaritaṃ tat kriyātvam | tathā ca "atha kaḥ paceḥ pradhāno'rthaḥ, yāsau taṇḍulānāṃ viklittiḥ " iti ca bhāṣye kartṛvyāpārasya pacerūpalakṣaṇārthatvāt sarvadhātvarthaviṣayasyābhidhānam, tādarthyādeva dhātubirasmin darśane yujyate | sarvatraiva hi kartṛbhāvanopasarjanamarthamabhidadhati dhātavaḥ | tathā ca kartṛsthakriyāṇāmapi budhye dveṣṭi icchatītyādau bodhanaṃ nirvartayatītyādyarthaḥ | kartṛvyāpāraścātra yathāyathaṃ karaṇapraṇidhānādayaḥ | astītyatrāpyātmānaṃ bibhartītyarthaḥ | tathā cātmabharaṇārthā vyāpārāstādaryyādabhidhīyanta eva | evaṃ ca kṛtvā dvayarthaḥ paciriti pacigrahaṇaṃ sarvadhātūpalakṣaṇārthaṃ veditavyam | udāharaṇamātratvādasya | tadevaṃ pratyekaṃ vyāpārabhedāḥ samāropitasamūharūpāḥ samāropitānantarakṣaṇabhedā vā kramikāḥ kriyārūpatvācca vyavahārasya samānasaṅketāḥ samāropaṃ pratipadyanta eva | phalaprasavayogyo'ntyo bhāgaḥ kriyā | tadarthāstvanye vyāpārā iti darśanabhedenopapāditam || 15 ||
idānīṃ sattāyāḥ kramarūpādhyāse'pi sādhyatā kathamityāha | satsu pratyayarūpo'sau bhāvo yāvanna jāyate | tāvat pareṣāṃ rūpeṇa sādhyaḥ sannibhidhīyate || 16 ||
satsu hetuṣu, pratyayarūpo hetusvabhāva asau padārthaḥ kāraṇātmanā sattvād, yāvanna jāyate kāryātmanā sattvaṃ na pratipadyate, pratyayarūpa āvirbhūtasvabhāvo vā yāvanna sampadyate, tāvat atrāntarāle, pareṣām hetūnām, rūpeṇa upalakṣitaḥ siddhatvāt kartṛbhāvamanubhavan svātmanā sādhyo bhavannākhyātena pūrvāparībhūtaḥ sādhyamānāvasthaḥ'bhidhīyate samudyuktakāraṇavyāpāraḥ pratiṣṭhāmāsādayaṃstiṅantagocaraḥ padārtha ityarthaḥ | tatra ca pūrvabhāgo jāyateśabdagocaraḥ | yathā vakṣyati "pūrvābhāgastu yajjātāt tajjanma vyapadiśyate " iti | uttarabhāgo'stiśabdagocaraḥ | sattāpratilambhābhimukhyaṃ hi janma | tatra vyāpṛtaṃ vastu vyāpārāvasāne sattā samāsādyāstīti pūrvavyāpārādhyāropeṇābhidhīyate | astyātmānaṃ bibharti sattāṃ bhāvayatīti yāvat | evaṃ samāśrite sādhanavyāpāre sādhyatā || 16 ||
tadabhāve punaḥ-- siddhe tu sādhanākāṅkṣā kṛtārthatvānnivartate | na kriyāvācināṃ tasmāt prayogastatra vidyate || 17 ||
parisamāptarūpo bhāve phalābhāvānnirapekṣakāraṇavyāpāre'parigṛhītavyāpāre parigṛhītakramārthavacanāni tiṅantapadāni prayogaṃ nāsādayanti | tathā ca tatra bhāva iti siddhārthavācakaṃ nāmapadaṃ pravartata ityuktam || 17 ||
tadevaṃ sarvaiva kriyā sādhyasvabhāvā kramavatīti nigamayitumāha-- sa ca pūrvāparībhūta ekatvādakramātmakaḥ | pūrvāparāṇāṃ dharmeṇa tadarthenānugamyate || 18 ||
saḥ anantarapratipāditasattattvaḥ kriyākhyo'rthaḥ, ekatvāt pūrvāparabhāvarahito'ta eva pūrvāparabhāgagatānupūrvīrahito'pi tad‌vyatiriktatadarthapūrvāparakṣaṇagatānupūrvīsamāropādāśritakramarūpaṃ kriyālakṣaṇaṃ puṣṇātītyarthaḥ | tadarthena iti tādarthyād guṇakriyāgato dharmaḥ pradhānakriyāyāmupacaryata ityāha || 18 ||
yataḥ phalaikyādabhedādhyavasāyo'tretyāha | asanniravartate tasmād yat sat tadupalabhyate | tayoḥ sadasatoścāsāvātmaika iva gṛhyate || 19 ||
ekaphaloddeśena pravṛttānāṃ kramavatāṃ kṣaṇānāṃ pūrvo vyapagato'san | vartamānaśca upalabhyate kṣaṇaḥ sanniti | tayorbhinnayorapyaikyamadhyavasāyā pūrvāparāpi pūrvāparībhūtā kramavatī kriyā vyavasthāpyate || 19 ||
evaṃ tāvat padārthānāmapoddhāre jātirvā vyaktireva vā |  iti vyaktivādimatena kriyālakṣaṇo'poddhārapadārtho nirṇītaḥ | idānīṃ jātivādimatenāha- jātimanye kriyāmāhuranekavyaktivartinīm | asādhyā vyaktirūpeṇa sā sādhyevopalabhyate || 20 ||
sarvatra pratyayānuvṛttipramāṇasādhitā jātiriti pacatīti pratyayasya kartṛkarmādibhede'pyanuvṛtte kriyāvyaktisamavetā jātipavaśyābyupagantavyā | saiva ca dhātuvācyā | sphoṭavaccāsyā asamasamayabhāvibhirapi kṣaṇairabhivyaktiḥ ata eva anekavyaktivartinīm ityāha | jātitvādevānekavyaktivartitve labdhe sadasad‌vyaktivyaṅgyatvamāvedayitumidamuktam | bhramaṇatvādijātivadupavyaṃ janāvṛttibalena kriyājātirabhivyaktimāsādayati | tathā ca svato nityatve'pyasyāḥ svāśrayamukhena sādhyatvaṃ sakramattvaṃ ca kriyālakṣaṇamavatiṣṭhate | ataśca svāśrayadvāreṇaivāsyāḥ sādhanākāṅkṣā || 20 ||
yathā vyaktidarśane anantaraṃ phalaṃ yasyāḥ...... iti matāntaramupadarśitaṃ tathātrāpi jātidarśane prāha | ante yā vā kriyābhāge jātiḥ saiva kriyā smṛtā | sā vyakteranuniṣpāde jāyamāneva gamyate || 21 ||
yasyāḥ kriyāvyaktoranantaraṃ phalaṃ nirvartate tatra samavetā yā jātiḥ saiva kriyā | pūrvāstu tādarthyāt kriyā iti pūrvānusāreṇa gamyamānatvāt punariha noktam | svāśrayaniṣpādanadvāreṇa cāsyā api sādhanayogaḥ sādhyatvaṃ ca || 21 ||
evamaparā jātirdarśanabhedena kriyetyuktam | idānīṃ parā jātiḥ sattākhyā mahāsāmānyarūpā jāti kriyetyupapādayati | svavyāpāraviśiṣṭānāṃ sattā vā kartṛkarmaṇām | kriyā vyāpārabhedeṣu sattā vā samavāyinī || 22 ||
"saṃbandhibhedāt sattaiva bhidyamānā gavādiṣu | jātirityucyate tasyāṃ sarve śabdā vyavasthitāḥ ||" ityuktatvāt kriyājātitvaṃ saṃbandhibhedopadhānena sattāyāḥ samarthayituṃ kartṛkarmasamavetavyāpārāvacchinnā sattā kriyājātirityāha | vyatirekiṇo'pi hi bhāvāḥ sattāyā bhedopādhaya ityuktaṃ kartṛkarmaṇām iti | tatraiva kriyāsamavāyāt | teṣu ca vyāpārāviṣṭeṣu kriyāvyavahārāt tatsamavetaiva kriyocitā | vyāpārasamavetā vā sattā svāśrayopahitabhedā astu kriyā | kimanena vyavadhānena kartṛkarmagatā satteti || 22 ||
atraiva sattājātidarśane matāntaramāha | antye vātmani yā sattā sā kriyā kaiścidiṣyate | bhāva eva hi dhātvartha ityavacchinna āgamaḥ || 23 ||
yadanantaraṃ phalaṃ tatra vyāpārabhāge yā sattā sā kriyā pūrvāstu tādarthyāt | vyāpāraviśiṣṭā cet sattā kriyā, alamanayā, vyāpāra evāstu kriyetyāśaṅkayāgamenaita dabhyupagamayati bhāva eva hi ityādinā | "ṣaḍ bhāvavikārā bhavantīti ha smāha vārṣyāyaṇiḥ" iti bhāṣyakāreṇaivāgamo'nusṛtaḥ | tathā ca "tāṃ prātipadikārthaṃ ca dhātvarthaṃ ca pracakṣate" iti sattaiva bhāvaśabdavācyā guravaḥ kriyeti manyante | saiva hi saṃbandhibhedopadhānamātreṇa bhidyamānā śabdārthavaicitryamupapādayati | tathāhi saṃbandhino'pyasyāstattvataḥ svaśaktiviṣphārā eveti sattādvaitavādābhiprāyeṇedaṃ nigamayati sattā svaśaktiyogena..... ityādi || 23 ||
idānīṃ buddhiḥ śabdārtha iti bauddhapakṣe kriyāvyavasthāmāha | buddhiṃ tajjātimanye tu buddhisattāmathāpare | pratyastarūpāṃ bhāveṣu kriyeti pratijānate || 24 ||
buddhiriti tatpratibhāsyākāro'tra vivakṣitaḥ | tasyaiva hi bhāveṣvadhyāropo dṛśyavikalpayorabhedādhyavasāyāt | matabhedena cātra jātivyaktī kriye | mahāsāmānyaṃ vā sattā | buddhyākārasamavāyinī sattā kriyā bhāveṣvadhyāropitā ca saivamiti tadāśrayeṇa sādhanākāṅkṣā sādhyatvaṃ ca sarvamupapadyate | etaccopacārasattā śabdārtha iti nayena kathyate | sattāyāḥ kriyātve "saiva bhāvavikāreṣu ṣaḍvasyāḥ prapadyate"  ityuktam | tatra bhāvasya sattāyā vikārā viśeṣāḥ ṣaṭ sarvakriyāṇāṃ yonayaḥ | ṣaṭtvamapi nātyantāya bhedā valambi || 24 ||
yataḥ āvirbhāvatirobhāvau janmanāśau tathāparaiḥ | ṣaṭsu bhāvavikāreṣu kalpitau vyāvahārikau || 25 ||
satkāryanaye padārthānāmāvirbhāvo'bhivyaktirevotpattiḥ | tirobhāvaśca dhvaṃsaḥ | asatkāryanaye tu janmāpūrvotpattirvināśaśca layaḥ | ityetau darśanabhedena bhinno dvau bhāvavikārau ṣaṭsu madhye parikalpitau vyavahāraprasiddhyāropitau | tathā hi-sattālakṣaṇasya bhāvasya nityatvādudayapradhvaṃsāyogaḥ | sadaikasvarūpatvāccāvirbhāvatirobhāvāvapi na staḥ | dharmāntarasya tu tau sattāgatatvena vyavahṛtau | sato vināśavirodho'pi sataśca janmāyogo dharmāntarasyāpi || 25 ||
evaṃ janmanāśāveva kalpitau kriyāvyavahāraṃ sarvaṃ vyāpnuta ityāha | tābhyāṃ sarvapravṛttīnāmabhedenopasaṃgrahaḥ | janmaivāśritasārūpyaṃ sthitirityabhidhīyate || 26 ||
sarvaḥ kriyākalāpo yathāyogaṃ janmānāśābhinnaḥ | upacayāpacayarūpau hi vikārāvajasrapravṛttiṣu bhāveṣu | tau ca tātparyato dharmāntarāvirbhāvatirobhāvalakṣaṇau | tathā hi - janma kenacid dharmeṇāvirbhāvaḥ | tatra savyāpāraṃ pūrvottarāvasthātyāgāvāptyorantarāle vartamānaṃ jāyate ityabhidhīyate vastvātmalābhonmukham | samāsāditarūpaṃ tu savyāpāramivāstītyākhyātapadenābhidhīyata ityastitvamātmalābhaparyāyamāvirbhāvarūpasya janmana evottaro'vasthāviśeṣaḥ | tathā ca niruktakāraḥ "jāyata iti pūrvabhāvasyādimācaṣṭe" ityāha | pūrvabhāvasya vipariṇāmādervyāvahārikāt prathamasyāstitvasyādirjanma ityarthaḥ | tathā "astītyutpannasya sattvasyāvadhāraṇamācaṣṭai"  iti | utpannasya sattvasyeti janmottarakālatāmevābhivyanakti | avadhāraṇaṃ niścayaḥ | astyātmānaṃ bhāvayati | asyāśca bhāvyamānāyāḥ sattāyāḥ santānena pravṛtteḥ pūrvottarakṣaṇa nirodhopajanābhyāṃ saṅgahaḥ | yāvacca sadṛśasantānapravāha stāvadalakṣitaviveko bhāvo'stītyavadhāraṇārthamabhidhīyate | astyātmānaṃ vibhartyeva na dhvaṃsate ityarthaḥ | visadṛśasantānopajane'rthabhedena vipariṇamata iti vyapadiśyate tattvādapracyutaṃ vastu | yadāha niruktakāraḥ | "vipariṇamata ityapracyavamānasya tattvād vikāramācaṣṭe"  iti | atraivopacayavivakṣāyāṃ vardhata iti | yadāha niruktakṛt | "vardhata iti svāṅgābhyuccayaṃ saṃyogināṃ padārthānāmācaṣṭe" iti | vardhate śarīreṇa, vardhate vijayena iti | apacayavivakṣāyāṃ tu pūrvamapakṣīyata iti tadanantaraṃ vinaśyatīti tirobhāvābhidhānamavasthādvayena | yadāha sa eva | "apakṣīyata iti svāṅgāpacayaṃ saṃyogināmarthānāmācaṣṭe, vinaśyatīti pūrvabhāvasyāntamācaṣṭe"  iti | pūrvabhāvo'stitvamuktam | tadevaṃ dvābhyāṃ ṣaḍ vyāptāḥ | tatrāvyāptirbhāvyakṛtodbhāvitā | "sarvathā sthita ityatra dhātusaṃjñā na prāpnoti | bāhyo hyetebhyastiṣṭhatiḥ " ityāśaṅkaya tiṣṭhaterapi kriyātvaṃ vaktumuktam janmaivāthritasārūpyaṃ sthitirityabhidhīyate iti | sadṛśapravāharūpatayānirdhāryamāṇavibhāgaṃ janmaivam(vā?)bhidhīyate sthitiriti | jāyate itivat tiṣṭhatītyapi siddham | kriyāntaranirva(va?)rtakatvena caivamabhidhānād vyāpāraviśeṣaḥ sādhyasvabhāvo dhātunābhidhīyata eva || 26 ||
kiṃ bahunā, janmanāśāvapi nārthāntarabhūtau api tu sattaiva dhātvarthaḥ sarvatretyāha | jāyamānānna janmānyād vināśe'pyapadārthatā | ato bhāvavikāreṣu sattaikā vyavatiṣṭhate || 27 ||
dharmāṇāṃ dharmipārantryeṇāvabhāsāt tato vyatireko na siddhaḥ | ataśca dharmyevānugato vyāvahārikaiḥ sarvāvastho vyavahartuṃ sakṛdāśakya evamabhidhīyate jāyate asti vipariṇamate vardhate iti | sata āvirbhāvavirodhād asato'pi nirūhasyātmāsādanāsamarthatvājjanmārtho'pi vastuto na kaścit | sato niranvayadhvaṃsavirodhācca vināśo'pi na vyatiriktaḥ padārthaḥ kaścit | tasyopajane bhāvasya prāgivopalambhaprasaṅgāt tena tasya vināśe tasyāpi vyatiriktasyodaye pūrvavat prasaṅgādutpadyamānasya ca bhāvatāprasaṅgādityādidūṣaṇamanyairevābhihitamanusandheyam | evañca ṣaṭsvapi bhāvavikāreṣu satyabhūtā sattaiva mahāsāmānyasvabhāvā | tasyāśca nityāyā apyākhyātavācyatvena kramarūpopagrahavaśena sādhyasvarabhāvatālakṣaṇaṃ kriyātvamuktam | nāmapadapratyāyyatvena tu sādhanatvam || 27 ||
asatyapi ca vastuto janmādibhede vyavahāraḥ tattadrūpatayā prasiddhaḥ | tathā hi | pūrvabhāgastu yajjātāt tajjanma vyapadiśyate | āśritakramarūpeṇa nimittatve vivakṣite || 28 ||
pariniṣṭhitarūpo bhāvo jāta iti vyapadiśyate | asmāttu pūrvo'vasthāviśeṣo janma, yadvaśādasau jāta iti vyapadeśamāsādayati | tacca janma nimittatvena sādhanānāṃ savyāpāratve vivakṣite pūrvāparībhūtaṃ jāyateśabdagocaraḥ kriyā bhavati || 28 ||
yataḥ ākhyātaśabdairartho'sāvevaṃbhūto'bhidhīyate | nāmaśabdāḥ pravartante saṃharanta iti kramam || 29 ||
asau jātādvastunaḥ pūrvo bhāgaḥ kāraṇātmanāvasthānalakṣaṇo vastuto'vidyamānakramo'pyākhyātaśabdājjāyata ityasmāt evaṃbhūtaḥ samāśritakramaḥ pratīyata iti kriyā lakṣaṇamanupatatyeva | tathā hi | pūrvasmāt pracyutā dharmādaprāptā cottaraṃ padam | tadantarāle bhedānāmāśrayājjanma kathyate ||  iti pūrvottarāvayavabhedānupūrvīsamāśrayeṇaiva janyartho vyākhyātaḥ | sa eva ca pūrvabhāgo janmeti nāmapadena saṃhṛtakramarūpatayā dravyāyamāṇaḥ siddharūpo'bhidhīyate | ākhyātavācyena cābhedādhyavasāyācca tatra dṛṣṭasya kramasyopasaṃharaṇābhimāna iti saṃharanta iva iti ivaśabdaḥ | tathā ca sarvatra nāmākhyātayoḥ siddhasādhyarūpārthābhidhānamanusaraṇīyam || 29 ||
yathā ca janma pūrvabhāgasvabhāvaṃ tathā vināśo'pyuttarabhāgasvabhāva iti keṣāṃcinmatamityāha | phalaṃ phalāpadeśo vā vastu vā tadvirodhi yat | tadanyadeva pūrveṣāṃ nāśa ityapadiśyate || 30 ||
phalaṃ kāryarūpaṃ kāraṇaviruddhaṃ vināśākhyāṃ labhate | tadyathā saṃyogaḥ karmaṇaḥ, jñānaṃ vā jñānāntarasya, dharmādharmayoḥ sukhaduḥkhasaṃvedanamityādi vācyam | phalāpadeśo yaḥ phalamiti bhrāntyā paramapadiśyate vastuto'phalamapi | tadyathā ghaṭasya kāpālādayo mudgarābhighātajjāyamānāḥ, paṭasya tantavaḥ śīrṇasyānantaryāt phalatvenābhidhīyamānā vināśavyapadeśamāsādayanti | tad iti buddhisthavināśyapratyavamarśaḥ | tasya yo virodhī bhāvo'kāryabhūto'pi so'pi vināśa iti vyavahriyate | tadyathā saṃyogasya vibhāgaḥ, sukhasya duḥkhamityādi | tadevam anyadeṃva vastu vināśaḥ | na tvapadārtho'bhāvarūpastucchaḥ | tasyāvastutvādabhāvyatvam, bhāvyatve vā tucchatāyoga iti cirantanavaiśeṣikāṇāṃ matam | sa cākhyātena kriyārūpakatayābhidhīyate sakramo vinaśyatīti, nāmapadena tu saṃhṛtakramo vināśa iti || 30 ||
nanu ca vastvantaraṃ kathaṃ vastuno vināśa ityāśaṅkyopapādayati | naivāsti naiva nāstīti vastuno grahaṇād vinā | kalpate pararūpeṇa vastvanyadanugamyate || 31 ||
yathā kasyacidrūpasyānubhavaṃ vināstīti vyavahāro na kalpate tathā nāstītyapīti dṛṣṭāntagarbhamabhidhānam | tadayamatrārthaḥ | saṃsargirūpavivekena na kaścidapi vastuno vyavahāra iti yathā sattābisandhānādinā astīti vyavahriyate tathā phalādyupajane nāstitāvyavaharo'pi yujyate | bhāvapratiyogī hyabhāvaḥ | sa ca śūnyatārūpo na yujyate, akiñcidrūpasya pratyetumaśakyatvāt | na hi pratyayaśca jāyate pratyetavyaṃ ca nāstīti yujyate | tasmādvastvantaraṃ phalādyeva vināśa iti yuktamucyate | pararūpeṇaiva hi vastuno brahmakalpasyānyānyarūpatayā vyavahārāvataraṇam‌ || 31 ||
nanu ca vastuno grahaṇaṃ vināndhatamase sparśanendriyeṇa śūnyatārūpānubhavādabhāvo'vasīyata ityāśaṅkyāha | bhāvābhāvau ghaṭādīnāmaspṛśannapi pāṇinā | kaścidvedāprakāśe'pi prakāśe tata eva vā || 32 ||
pāṇinā saṃsparśamantareṇāprakāśe tata eva vastuno grahaṇāt prakāśa iva vastūnāṃ bhamāvāvāvavaityeva kaścit pratiṣattā | tathā hi satyapyāloke tadabhāve vā pramāṇāntarāt puro'vasthitaṃ vastu sambhāvayan bhāvamavaiti, tadvirodhinaṃ cārthaṃ niścityābhāvāmiti, vastugrahaṇāyattāveva bhāvābhāvavyavahārau | sarvasyāmapi daśāyāṃ samandhakāre'pi pūrvapravṛttavastugrahaṇānusmaraṇanimittatvāt pāṇisañcāreṇāpi cābhāvāvasāyo vastugrahaṇādeva hastasyā spṛṣṭasyānubhavāt | hastagataṃ hi spraṣṭavyarūpamarthāntaraviviktamanubhūya sparśanendriyeṇārthāntarasyābhāvo niścīyate | tadevaṃ sthitametad vastvantaraṃ iti || 32 ||
idānīṃ darśanāntarāśrayeṇa janmanāśau vibhajati | vyāpi saukṣmyaṃ kvacid yāti kvacit saṃhanyate punaḥ | akurvāṇo'thavā kiñcit svaśaktyaivaṃ prakāśate || 33 ||
vyāpakaṃ pradhānatattvaṃ kvaciddeśe kāle vā saukṣmyaṃ tanutāmāpadyata iti sāvasthā tirobhāvātmikā nāśo naśyatīti ca nāmākhyātābhyāṃ siddhasādhyarūpatayābhidhīyate | taduktam | tirobhāvābhyupagame bhāvānāṃ saiva nāstitā | labdhakrame tirobhāve naśyatīti pratīyate ||  iti | kvacit punastadeva vyāpi vastu svanimittavaśāt saṃhanyate saṃghātarūpatāṃ bhajate iti sāvasthāvirbhāvātmikā janma jāyate iti ca pūrvavad vyavahriyate | etacca pradānasyāvasthādvayamanavaratapravṛttiśīlarajoguṇavasād bhavatīti kriyārūpamanupatatīti | tadevaṃ niruktakāramatāśrayeṇa bhāvavikārāḥ kriyāsāmānyabhūtāḥ vyākhyātāḥ || 33 ||
yadvā niṣkriya evaiko vyāpakaḥ parabrahmābhidhāno bhāvo'cintyaśaktiyukto janmanāśavyavahāramavidyādaśāyāṃ vartayati | na tu bhāvato janmanāśau kaucit | tathā hi | sarvarūpasya tattvasya yat krameṇeva darśanam | bhāgairiva praklṛptiśca tāṃ kriyāmapare viduḥ || 34 ||
sarvaparikalpātītamapi brahma samāviṣṭasarvaśaktitvāt sarvarūpeṇāvabāsamānaṃ kālākhyasvātantryaśartipravartitakramāvabhāsaṃ pūrvāparībhūtāvayavasamāhārātmikāṃ kriyāpratītimupajanayati sādhyasvabhāvabhāvaviṣayām | siddhasvabhāvabhāvaviṣayetu dik‌śaktiprakalpitabhāgabhedaprakalpanānmūrtivibhāgamāracayati | tathā cā pravibhāgamapi deśakālābhyāṃ pravibhaktamiva cakāstīti | tatpravibhāgānusāriṇau janmanāśau samastakriyābhedānusāriṇau vyāvahārikau prasiddhau | tadevamiyaṃ vivartadarśanena kriyākhyātā pūrvaṃ tu pariṇāmadarśanenoktā | ata evātra krameṇeva itīvaśabdaḥ | ekasya hi tattvādapracyutasya vastutaḥ kramo nāsti | tathā tu darśanamātram | ata eva akurvāṇo'thavā kiñcit svaśaktyaivaṃ prakāśate | iti tattvādapracyutasya niṣkriyasya sakriyasyeva prakāśanaṃ vivarto dyotitaḥ || 34 ||
idānīṃ sattādvaitadarśanena "ṣaḍ bhāvavikārā bhavanti" iti niruktakāramatameva nigamayitumāha | sattā svaśaktiyogena sarvarūpā vyavasthitā | sādhyā ca sādhanaṃ caiva phalaṃ bhoktā phalasya ca || 35 ||
"tāṃ prātipadikārthaṃ ca dhātvarthaṃ ca pracakṣate" tathā "saiva bhāvavikāreṣu ṣaḍavasthāḥ prapadyate'  iti jātisamuddeśe sarvabhāvānuyāyinī satsaditi pratyayahetuḥ sanmātrarūpasya sarvaṃtrānugamānmāhāsamānyasvabhāvā sattā sarvaśabdānāṃ viṣaya iti pratipāditam | tathā ca svaśaktirūpopādhiniyamitaśarīrā sarvātmakatvamanubhavantyapi siddhasādhyarūpatayā nāmākhyātapadavācyatāmanubhavati | tadvyatirekeṇa ca padārthāntarābhāvāt saiva vicitraśaktitvād bhogyabhoktṛtat‌sādhanarūpatayā visvayātrāmudvahati | sarvatra bhoktrādiṣu sanmātrasya saṃvidrūpasyānugamāttasyaiva satyatā | vikalpaparighaṭitastu nānātvavyavahāra iti sarvādvaitāvādiṣu samānametat || 35 ||
adhunā yattat sādhanasamuddeśe pravṛttireva prathamaṃ kvacidapyanapāśritā | śaktirekādhikaraṇe srotovadapakaparṣati  iti kriyālakṣaṇamuktaṃ tadanusmārayati | kriyāmanye tu manyante kvacidapyanapāśritām | sādhanaikārthakāritve pravṛttimanapāyinīm || 36 ||
pravṛttilakṣaṇeyaṃ kriyā nityānā śritā apūrvaṃ kālaśāktiṃ vā...... ityādinā pūrvameva vyākhyātā sādhanaśaktibhiḥ saha sādhyamekaṃ phalaṃ sādhayatīti tāḥ śaktīrdravyāṇāṃ pravahadrūpā satī samākarṣayati || 36 ||
kathamasyā nityāyā sādhyatvamiti cedāha | sāmānyabhūtā sā pūrvaṃ bhāgaśaḥ pravibhajyate | tato vyāpārarūpeṇa sādhyeva vyavatiṣṭhate || 37 ||
prathamāvasthāyāmapūrvādirūpatayā sā pravṛttiḥ sāmānyenābhidhīyate | paratastu yathāsvaṃ sādhanavyāpāropapāditapravibhāgā sādhyamānarūpatayā kriyeti vyavahriyate | tathā cānudbhinnaviśeṣarūpadaśāyāṃ kārakaśaktīnāṃ pravartiṃkā | tato niṣkṛṣya pravṛttiriti sāmānyasamāravyāyānāśrayaiva maṇyate | viśeṣaprakrame tu sādhanasagavāyinī sādhyatāmanubhavantī yathāyathaṃ pacikriyā bhidhikriyetyādi vyavahāraṃ vartayati | ata eva kārakāṇāṃ pravṛttiviśeṣaḥ kriyā"iti lakṣaṇa muddiṣṭam || 37 ||
prakṛti sādhanānāṃ sā prathamaṃ tacca kārakam | vyāpārāṇāṃ tato'nyatlamaparairupavarṇyate || 38 ||
apūrvādisvabhāvāsau sāmānyabhūtā pravṛttirdravyāṇāṃ kārakaśaktīrādadhānā prakṛtiriti maṇyate | ata eva pravartakatvāt srotasā tulyā kathitā | evaṃbhūtāpi ca nityatvādanyasādhanasādhyā na bhavatīti tadeva prathamamādyaṃ kārakam, kārakāṇāmapi sādhakamityarthaḥ | tadeva ca pravṛttirūpaṃ sādhanabhedeṣu pravibhaktaśarīraṃ viśiṣṭakriyāsvabhāvamityekīyaṃ matam | anye tu tataḥ sāmānyabhūtāt pravṛttilakṣaṇāt sādhanabhedasamavetānāṃ viśiṣṭa kriyāsvabhāvānāṃ vyāpārāṇāmanyatvaṃ bhedamabhyupayantīti darśanavikalpaḥ sāmānyaviśeṣayorvyatirekamatāvalambanenoktaḥ || 38 ||
tadevaṃ vibhaktalakṣaṇā kriyākhyātaśabdairabhidhīyate ityuktam | tatrocyate-sādhana-saṃkhyākālapuruṣopagrahā apyākhyātapadāt pratīyanta iti kathaṃ krivāvāci niyamena tadityāśaṅkyopapādayati | bahūnāṃ sambhave'rthanāṃ kecidevopakāriṇaḥ | saṃsarge kaścideṣāṃ tu prādhānyena pratīyate || 39 ||
bahūnāmarthānāṃ sambhave sati saṃbandho'vaśyaṃbhāvī | tatra ca na sarve samaśīrṣikayā saṃbandhabhājaḥ | api tu kecidevopakāriṇaḥ aṅgabhūtāḥ | tato'nyaḥ kaścid-upakāryo'ṅgīti pratiyate | tathā ca pradhānopasarjanabhāve sati saṃbandhaḥ pratiṣṭhāmāsādayati || 39 ||
tataḥ kimityāha | sādhyatvāt‌tatra cākhyātairvyāpārāḥ siddhasādhanāḥ | prādhānyenābhidhīyante phalenāpi pravartitāḥ || 40 ||
vyāpārāḥ kriyārūpāḥ sādhyasvabhāvāḥ tiṅantaiḥ pradānabhāvena abhidhīyante iti sādhanādyabhidhāne'pyākhyātasya kriyāvācitvamupapadyate | kriyāpradhānaṃ hyākhyātam | pradhānena ca vyapadeśā bhavanti | siddhasādhanāḥ iti | siddhaṃ nirvṛttaṃ sādhanameṣāmiti kārakāpekṣayā vyāpārāṇāṃ prādhānyamuddīpayati | bhāvyaṃ hi nirvartyaṃ pradhānaṃ bhūtāpekṣayā | yadyevaṃ kriyāpekṣayāpi phalaṃ pradhānaṃ tadarthaṃ pravṛtterityāśaṅkyāha phalenāpi pravartitāḥ iti | vastuvṛttena bhavatu phalaṃ pradhānam | ākhyātāttu kriyāyāḥ pradhānyādhyavasāyaḥ | pacatīti hi na phalaṃ śabdenopādīyate | api tu padāntaranibandhanaṃ tat | ekapadanibandhaneṣu cārtheṣu guṇapradhānabhāvaścintyate | pacyate ityapi karmaṇi prayoge śabdāt pākasyaiva sādhyatayā prādhānyaṃ pratīyate | pāko nirvartyate, iti hyatrārthaḥ | sa tu pākaḥ phalasādhanāyeti sāmarthyāt pratīyate phalaṃ pratyaṅgabhāvaḥ kriyāyāḥ | sākṣāttu śabdavyāpāreṇa prādhānyamevāsyāḥ | kriyaiva hi pradhānabhūtā coditā satyanuṣṭhīyate | vastusāmarthyāttu phalaṃ bhavati | na tu phalāya kriyā coditā, prādhānyena codanād yajeta ityādi | ata eva saiva prādhānyād vākyārtho vaiyākaraṇānāmiti kriyāviveke'smābhirvivecitaṃ tata evāvadhāryam | sādhanānāṃ tu siddhānāṃ paramanupakurvatāmabhidhāne prayojanābhāvāt tiṅantena guṇabhūtānyeva kriyāyāṃ sādhyāyāṃ tānyabhidhīyante | karmaṇo'pi sādhanasādhāraṇasya kārakatvasya bhāvāt kriyāṃ prati guṇabhāva eva | yatra tu tadeva phalaṃ tatra phalarūpānupraveśādasya vāstavaṃ prādhānyam, na tu śābdam | etacca kriyāvivekādeva vistarato'vagantavyam | saṃkhyāpuruṣau sādhanādhāradravyadharmatvāt sādhanadvāreṇa kriyāmupakarvantau guṇabhūtau | tatra kālopagrahau tu sākṣādeva kriyopakāritayā guṇabhūtau | yatra ca bhāve lakārastatra saṅkhyādyapekṣameva prādhānyaṃ kriyāyāḥ | ekapadopāttasya sādhanasyābhāvāt saṃṅkhyayā sākṣāt saṃbandhaḥ prādhānyādeva na bhavati, kriyāyāḥ sādhyatvāddhyasau pradhānam | na hyanirvṛttaṃ parasyāṅgabhāvamupagantumarhati | tathā cāsyā bhedābhāva iti ekā kriyāiti bhāṣyam | ekaśabdaścāyaṃ bhedābhāvapradarśanaparo na saṅkhyāvacanaḥ | asattvabhūtatvena niḥsaṅkhyatvāt kriyāyāḥ || 40 ||
yadyevaṃ saṃkhyāvācibhyaḥ kriyāgaṇanāvṛttau kṛtvasujādayaḥ kathaṃ pañcakṛtvaḥ pacati dviḥ pacatītītyāśaṅkhyopapadayati | ekatvāvṛttibhāvābhyāṃ bhedābhedasamanvaye | saṃkhyāstatropalabhyante saṃkhyeyāvayavakriyāḥ || 41 ||
niḥsaṃkhyā ekāpi kriyā yadā āvartate tadā āvṛttinibandhanaṃ bhedaṃ svataścābhedamupādāya bhedābhedayoge'syāḥ saṃkhyā dṛśyante | [saṃkhyeyāvayavakriyāḥ iti ?] saṃkhyeyā avavayakriyāyāsām | ayamarthaḥ | ekaphalatvādekakartṛkatvācca kriyaikā punaḥ punaḥ pravṛttilakṣaṇāṃ cāvṛttimanubhavati | tatrākhyātena sakalakriyāpravāho'bhedenābhidhīyate | āvṛttinibandhanaṃ tu bhedamavayavādhikaraṇaṃ saṃkhyāpadamanubhavati | tathā ca kṛtvasujādyutpattiḥ | na hyatyantabhede'bhede vā āvṛttiḥ sambhavati | api tu bhedā bhedābhyām | evaṃ tāvat kriyāyāḥ svataḥ saṃkhyāyogo nāsti | pacati pacataḥ pacanti iti tu sādhanagatasaṃkhyāsampratyaya iti | iha tarhiṃ kathaṃ saṃkhyābhedāvagamaḥ pākaḥ pākau pākāḥ iti | na hyatra sādhanamasti kṛdantaiḥ siddhatayābidīyamānatvāt kriyāyāḥ saṃkhyāyogo na virudhyate || 41 ||
atra yadi siddhatayābhidhānaṃ tadā --- siddhasyārthasya pākādeḥ kathaṃ sādhanayogitā | sādhyatve vā tiṅantena kṛtāṃ bhedo na kaścana || 42 ||
pariniṣṭhitarūpaḥ padārthaḥ sādhanasaṃbandhaṃ nānubhavati |tathā ca pākādiriti tatrāpi sādhanayogābhāvāt kṛtprayoge kartṛkarmaṇoḥ ṣaṣṭhīvidhirnopapadyate | atha kṛdabhihite pākādau sādhyataiva tadā bhāṣyakārābhimataḥ kṛtāṃ tiṅantena bhedo virudhyeta | bhāṣyakāro hi pañcakṛtvaḥ pacatītivat pañcakṛtvaḥ pāka iti prayogaṃ necchati || 42 ||
atha pākādeḥ siddhatve'pi ṣaṣṭhyāḥ sādhyatayābhidhānaṃ yatrākhyāte sa viṣaya ityāśaṅkhya vyudasyati | tatra kārakayogāyā yadyākhyātaṃ nibandhanam | ṣaṣṭhyāḥ sā lena saṃbandhe vyudastā kartṛkarmaṇoḥ || 43 ||
"kartṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti"  iti vacanādākhyātamaviṣaya evārayāḥ ṣaṣṭhyāḥ | abhyupagamyāpi tūcyate na lokāvyaya.......  iti lakāraprayoge pratiṣiddhā ṣaṣṭhīti nāyamasyā viṣayaḥ | ata eva kṛdgahaṇasyaitadvayāvartane'nupayogāt tadanādareṇaitaduktam | śatrādivyāvṛttyarthaṃ tu tatralagrahaṇam || 43 ||
evaṃ tarhi pākādau sādhanasaṃbandhakāle sādhyatvaṃ saṃkhyābhedaprati pattivelāyāṃ tu siddhatvaṃ bhaviṣyatītyāśaṅkyāha | ekābhidhāna eko'rtho yugapacca dvidharmabhāk | na sambhavati siddhatve sa sādhyaḥ syāt kathaṃ punaḥ || 44 ||
eko'rtho yugapad viruddhadharmadvayayogī na saṃbhavatīti siddhasācyobhayarūpatā pākāderekapadopādānasya nāsti | bhinnaśabdopādānastu sa dharmadvayayogī bhavatyeva pacati pācakaḥ pākaḥ ? ityādi || 44 ||
idānīmekābhidhānatvamevātra nāsti api tu bhinnābhidānatvamiti pākādau śabdaddhayena dhātupratyayarūpeṇa siddhasādhyarūpobhayārthapratipādanamaviruddhamityetadupaṣādayitumupakramate | etāvat sādhanaṃ sādhyametāvaditi kalpanā | śāstra eva na vākye'sti vibhāgaḥ paramārthataḥ || 45 ||
ekaśabdopādāne hyarthe'nvayavyatirekavaśena śāstrepoddhārakalpanāyāṃ prakṛti pratyayavibhāgenārthavibhāgaḥ śakyakriyaḥ loke tvakhaṇḍa eva śabdo'khaṇḍasyārthaṃsya vācaka iti na tatrārthapravibhāgaḥ nāpi śabdapravibhāgaḥ satyarūpaḥ | vākyena tatra vyavahārācca vākye ityāha || 45 ||
tatra kiyat sādhanaṃ kiyat sādhyaṃ kva kathaṃ prakalpate śāstre ityāha | ākhyātaśabde bhāgābhyāṃ sādhyasādhanavartitā | prakalpitā yathā śāstre sa ghañādiṣvapi kramaḥ || 46 ||
pacatītyādāvanvayavyatirekavaśena dhātubhāgaḥ | kriyāyāṃ pratyayabhāgastu kārakādau vartata iti śāstre parikalpyate | yadāha vākyakāraḥ | `pratyayārthasyāvyatirekāt prakṛtyantareṣu | dhātoścārthābhedāt pratyayāntareṣvanvaya iti | evaṃ pākādāvapi || 46 ||
tathā hi | sādhyatvena kriyā yatra dhāturūpanibandhanā | satvabhāvastu yastasyāḥ sa ghañādinibandhanaḥ || 47 ||
bhinnābhidhānatve dharmadvayayoge nidarśanamatrāha | prakṛtipratyayānāṃ śāstre'sakṛdupadeśādabhedādhyavasāyenānvayavtirekābhyāṃ prakriyāsiddhyarthamarthavattāpratijñānād ya eva dhāturākhyāte sa evātra kṛdanta iti tannibandhano'pyabhinnaḥ sādhyasvabhāvaḥ | tataścātra dhātubhāgavācyasādhyārthāpekṣitāni sādhanāni svanimittaṃ saṃskāraṃ vibhaktilakṣaṇaṃ prayuñjata eva | dhātoḥ parastu pratyayo ghañādistasya prakṛtyarthasya sattvabhāvaṃ darśayati | yena liṅgasaṃkhyābhyāṃ yogaḥ | ataśca tiṅantena kṛto bhedo'pyupapannaḥ || 47 ||
bhinnābhidhānatve dharmadvayayoge nidarśanamatrāha | bandhutā bhedarūpeṇa bandhuśabde vyavasthitā | samūho bandhvavasthā tu pratyayenābhidhīyate || 48 ||
bandhuśabde bandhutā bhedarūpeṇa vācyāvasthitā | bandhūnāṃ samūho bandhuteti samūhapratyaye'bedena bandhvavasthā vācyā | na hi samūho nāma bandhubhyo'nyaḥ kaścit | evaṃ ca yathā prakṛtipratyayāvatra bhedābhedābhyāmarthamabhidhattastathā siddhasādhyatābhyāṃ pākādau dhātupratyathābhyāmarthābhidhānam || 48 ||
śabdabhedāccātra viṣayabhedenāvirodha ityāha | tatra yaṃ prati sādhyatvamasiddhā taṃ prati kriyā | siddhā tu yasmin sādhyatvaṃ na tameva punaḥ prati || 49 ||
sādhanānyapekṣya sādhyātvādanirvṛttā kriyā dhātūpādānā | kṛtpratyayāpekṣayā tu siddhateti na sādhyatvaṃ taṃ prati | tathā ca na sādhanayoga ityarthaḥ || 49 ||
apekṣaṇīyabhedāt svabhāvadvayayoge dṛṣṭāntamāha | rājñaḥ putrasya napteti na rājñi vyatiricyate | putrasyārthaḥ pradhānatvaṃ na cāsya vinivartate || 50 ||
rājñaḥ putrasya naptā vijayatāmityatra naptrapekṣayā putrasyā prādhānye vyatireke'pi rājāpekṣayā vyatireko na bhavati | tathā ca tadapekṣayā prādhānyaṃ na nivartate yathā evaṃ pākārthaṃsyāpi śabdadvayāpekṣe siddhasādhyate na virudhyete ityarthaḥ || 50 ||
tadṛśataraṃ dṛṣṭāntamāha | mṛgo dhāvati paśyeti sādhyasādhanarūpatā | tathā viṣayabhedena saraṇasyopapadyate || 51 ||
dhāvatīti tiṅupāttakartrapekṣayā saraṇakriyā sādhyā | darśanakriyāpekṣayā sādhanatvaṃ karmatāmanubhavati | na hyatra mṛgaḥ karma, dvitīyāprasaṅgāditi saraṇakriyaiva karmaṃ | tasyāśca sādhanapratyakṣatāyā pratyakṣatābhimānāt paśyeti darśanakriyākarmatopapattiḥ | sādhanatvaṃ ca na sādhyāvasthāyāmeva, aniṣpannatya paramanupakurvataḥ sādhanatvāyogāt | uttarakālaṃ tu sādhanatvaṃ nirvṛttāyāḥ kriyāyāḥ kriyāntaraṃ pratyupapadyate | evaṃ ghañādiviṣaye'pi dhātunā sādhyatvenābhihitāyāṃ kriyāyāṃ pratyayena siddhatābhidhānam | prakṛtipratyayau ca pratyayārthaṃ saha brūta iti siddhatāyāḥ prādhānyāt sādhyatāgatāvṛttyabhāvāt kṛtvasujādayo na bhavanti | kṛtyādayastu lakāravat sādhyāvasthaṃ bhāvaṃ svabāvādācakṣate | kevalaṃ tu śabdāntaropādānameṣāṃ sādhanamiti kṛtvorthapratyayasaṃbandho bhavatyevaiṣām | dviḥ śayitavyaṃ bhavatā | trirbhuktaṃ devadattena | dvirbhuktvā gataḥ | dvirdattavān || 51 ||
tadevam-- lakṛtyaktakhalarthānāṃ tathāvyayakṛtāmapi | rūḍhiniṣṭhāghañādīnāṃ dhātuḥ sādhyasya vācakaḥ || 52 ||
sarvatraivānvayavyatirekābhyāṃ sādhyasvabhāvārthābhidhāyitvaṃ dhātoḥ | saṃjñāśabdānāmapi vyutpattikarmaṇi kriyāyā upayogaḥ | tatra lakāre kriyā prādhānyenābhidhīyate | kṛtyaktakhalartheṣyapi tathaiva | niṣṭhāto bhedena kto napuṃsakaviṣaya uktaḥ | evaṃ sādhyatābhidhānāt sādhanasaṃbandho na virudhyate | atra sādhanasaṃbandhādeva sātyatāvasāyaḥ | dhātuprātipadikābhyāṃ hi svārthasya siddhasādhyate nāvedyete | api tu sādhanasaṃbandhāyattā dhātvarthasya sādhyatāpratītiḥ | sādhanavibhaktayaśca prātipadikādutpadyamānāstadarthasya siddhatāmāvedayante | gatametat || 52 ||
`paridevane śvastanī bhaviṣyantyarthe ityupasaṃkhyānaṃ `kālaviprakarṣāttūpamānam' iti pratyākhyātam | tatra bhāṣya uktam --- `na [vai] tiṅantenopamānamasti' iti | tat kathaṃ tiṅantenopamānaṃ na bhavatītyedupapādayati | sādhyasyāpariniṣpatteḥ so'yamityanupagrahaḥ | tiṅantairantareṇevamupamānaṃ tato na taiḥ || 53 ||
iha tiṅantārthaḥ sādhyasvabhāvo'pariniṣpannarūpaḥ so'yam ityupameyena sahābhedakalpanenopagrahītuṃ na pāryate | tiṅantapadaiḥ siddharūpasyaiva pratyāyanāsaṃbhavāt | ataśca "iyaṃ nu kadā gantā ityādau kriyā kriyayā nopamīyate | tad yathā siṃho māṇavaka iti so'yamityabhedenādhyavasāyādivārthagarbhaḥ saṃbandho naivamatra | asiddhatvādeva so'yamiti saṃbaṃndhasyaivābhāvāt | tataścāvaśabdamantareṇa siṃho māṇavaka itivad atrābhedenopamānopameyabhāvo nāsti | ivaśabdaprayoge tu bhedenopamānopameyabhāvaḥ pratīyate, krandatīva gāyatīti | tatra ca sādhyatvādeva na kriyāgataḥ saḥ | sādhanagatastu yo gāyati sa krandatīveti na kriyayoḥ sārūpyam | api tu sarvanāmnā vyāpāre guṇabhūtamapi sādhanaṃ prādhānyena pratyavamṛśya sambadhyate | tad yathā yaḥ pacati tasyāpatyamiti na tiṅantārthasyāpatyayogaḥ |cha `limpatīva tamo'ṅgāni varṣatīvāñjanaṃ nabhaḥ |' iti tūtprekṣā nopamā, upameyānirdeśāt || 53 ||
nanu svato'siddhatvānmā bhūt kriyāyā upamānopameyabhāvaḥ | sādhanamukhena tu bhaviṣyatītyāśaṅkyāha | sādhanatvaṃ prasiddhaṃ ca tiṅūkṣu saṃbandhināṃ yataḥ | tenādhyāropa eva syādupamā tu na vidyate || 54 ||
tiṅantavācye viṣaye ye saṃbandhina upādīyante teṣāṃ sādhyārthāpekṣayā kārakatvaṃ niścitam | anyathā saṃbandhābhāvāt | ataḥ parvataścalati nabhaścalati ityādau parvatādīnāṃ śrutyā tāvat sādhanabhāvaḥ pratyāyyate | sa tu yadi nāma nāvakalpate ityadhyāropitasāmartyāścalane sādhanabhāvamupayāntyagādayaḥ, na tvato vākyāccalatīvetyupamānopameyabhāvaḥ pratīyate | tadyathā śaktyatiśayakhyāpanāya kaścidabhidhatte parvataṃ bhinatti, mahodadhiṃ prataratīti | nāsmādbhinattīvetyādipratipattiḥ | api tu saṃbhāvitasāmarthyaṃ sādhanamabhisambadhyate kriyayā | evaṃ `vibhetyalpaśrutād vedaḥ' ityādāvadhyāropeṇaiva samanvayo nopamayeti kārakamukhenāpi kriyāyāmupamānopameyabhāvābhāvaḥ | itthaṃ ca `iyaṃ nu kadā gantā'  ityādāvadhyāropeṇaivopapattirvyākhyeyā | bhaviṣyatsāmānye bhaviṣyadanadyatanatvena dīrghakālatayā gamanasya vivakṣite tatra gantṛtvādhyāropaḥ || 54 ||
itaśca kriyayorupamānopameyabhāvo nāstītyāha | nyūneṣu ca samāptārthamupamānaṃ vidhīyate | kriyā caivāśraye sarvā tatra tatra samāpyate || 55 ||
candra iva darśanīyaṃ mukhamasyā ityādāvupamānaṃ paripūrṇaguṇaṃ prasiddham, upameyaṃ tu nyūnaguṇamiti | kriyā tu sādhanasādhyā svādhāre parisamāptā sarvaiva sameti nopamāviṣayaḥ || 55 ||
atrodāharaṇārthamāha | yenaiva hetunā haṃsaḥ patatītyabhidhīyate | ātau tasya samāptatvādupamārtho na vidyate || 56 ||
gamikriyāṃ sādhayan haṃsaḥ pakṣābhyāṃ patatītyucyate, ātirapi pakṣiviśeṣastābhyāmeva svapakṣābhyāṃ tathaiva gamikriyāṃ niṣpādayantī pacatītyabhidhīyate iti pratyāśrayaparisamāptatvāt kriyāyāṃ nyūnādhikabhāvābhāvāt sajātīyatve sati gavaya iva gavaya itivadupamānopameyabhāvo nāstītyarthaḥ | ātiḥ patati haṃsa iveti tu sādhanayorupamānopameyabhāvo na tiṅantavācyayoḥ kriyayoḥ || 56 ||
nanu sajātīyayoḥ kriyayormā bhūdupamānopameyabhāvaḥ | vijātīyayostu syādityāśaṅkyā tatrāpi niṣedhati | kriyāṇāṃ jātibhinnāṃ sādṛśyāṃ nāvadhāryate | siddheśca prakrame sādhyamupamātuṃ na śakyate || 57 ||
bhinnajātīyāḥ pacati gacchatītyādayaḥ kriyāḥ parasparato'tyantāya vyāvartamānāḥ sādṛśyanibandhanamupamānopamebhāvaṃ nāsādayanti | idaṃ taditi siddhatayā parāmṛṣṭumupamānaṃ kriyārūpamanyatra sādhyasvabhāve kriyārūpe saṃbandhamupanetumaśakyam | ākhyātāt pratīyamānāyāḥ kriyāyāḥ siddhatvenāyo(tvāyo?)gāt | tadevaṃ tiṅantārthasyopamāno pameyabhāvabhāvāt `kālaviprakarṣāttūpamānam ityasya vārtikasyāyamarthaḥ | gamanādhyayanayoralasaviṣayatayā sambhāvanāyāṃ bhaviṣyatsāmānyamapi dīrghakālatayopamāyā(mayā?) nadyatanakālavivakṣāyāṃ pratyayaḥ siddhaḥ | anadyatana ivāyaṃ bhaviṣyatkāla ityarthaḥ | lakṣaṇahetvoḥ kriyāyāḥ  iti tu lakṣyalakṣaṇabhāvasya śatṛśānac prayogeṇa pratīterbhavati kriyāyāstadyogaḥ | evaṃ hetuhetumadbhāvasya liṅpratyayādapyavagateḥ | itiśabdaprayogādapi hantīti palāyate varṣatīti dhāvatīti | viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyābhāvo'pi na tiṅantavācyāvasthāyām api tu svātantryeṇa parāmarśe sati kriyāyā upapadyate | tathaivopamānopameyabhāvastu na sambhavati nyūnādhikabhāvābhāvāt | pacatikalpaṃ pacatitarāmiti kriyāsaṃbandhinā(nāṃ?) nyūnādhikabhāva ityāhuḥ | gatametat || 57 ||
idānīmidaṃ vicāryate | iha dhātuvācyo'rthaḥ sādhyasvabāvo ghañādivācyastu siddhasvabhāvaḥ iti bhāṣye'nayorbhāvayorbāhyābhyantarayorbhedo'bhihitaḥ | tameva dṛṣṭāntopadarśanena vyutpādayitumāha | vanaṃ vṛkṣā iti yathā bhedābhedavyapāśrayāt | arthātmā bhidyate bhāve sa bāhyābhyantare kramaḥ || 58 ||
vṛkṣasamudāyo vanamityabhedena kathyate | vṛkṣā iti tu bhedena nānātvena | tathā ca bhidyate'rthasvabhāvo na śabdaśaktimātrakṛto'tra bheda ityātmagrahaṇam | bhedābhedayoranyatvāt samudāyāvayavau bhinnāveva | evaṃ dhātvartho bhāvo'bhyantare prakṛtirūpe vācyatayā bhavaḥ prāthamakalpikatvād ābhyantaraḥ | sa sādhyamānāvasthatayā ghañādipratyayavācyād bāhyāt siddharūpād bhāvād bhidyate | prakṛtivācyo hi bhāvo'bhedena pratīyate, sādhyamānāvasthasya siddhadharmasaṃkhyāyogābhāvāt | sādhanabhedapratītyaiva cākhyāte bhedapratīterdhātubhedenaiva kriyāmācaṣṭe | ghañādipratyavācyastu bhāvaḥ siddhatayābhidhānāt liṅgasaṃkhyābhyāṃ bhedenaiva pratyāyyate pākaḥ pākau pākāḥ iti | ākhyāte ca sādhyamānāvasthasya bhāvasya prādhānyāt svadharmeṇa kālena sādhanadharmeṇa ca pratyāktādinā puruṣeṇa yogaḥ | phalavatvācca kriyāyāḥ kartrabhiprāyādinātmanepadādidyotyena phaladharmeṇopagraheṇa yogaḥ | ghañādiviṣaye tu siddhatvād dravyāyamāṇatvānnaivaṃ kālādiyogaḥ | kevalaṃ dravyadharmeṇa liṅgena saṃkhyayā ca yogaḥ | tadevamanayoḥ prakṛtipratyayārthayorbhāvayorbāhyābhyantarayorbhedaḥ | yastu lakāravācyo bhāvaḥ śayyate syīyate ityādau asau dhātvabhidheyāmeva sādhyatāmanuvartate, na tu ghañādāviva siddharūpam | svātmāvastho hi bhāvaḥ sādhanātmanā siddhatayā cāsaṃsṛṣṭo lakāravācyaḥ | dhātuvācyastu sādhyatayā yukta iti nāyaṃ lakāraḥ svārthikaḥ | tadyathā svātmapratiṣṭhe prātipadikārthe vidhīyamānā prathamā na svarthiṃkatvena vyavahriyate | dhātvabhidheyasādhyatānuvartanāccāsya bhāvasya kālādinā yogaḥ | bhāvyatvācca kartrā na viyujyate'yamiti dvividho bāhyo|ñapi bhāvo vyavahriyate tiṅamihita ekaḥ kṛdabhihito'para iti | tumunnādividhau ca kriyāsāmānyena siddhasādhyarūpobhayadharmānāśrayema upapadamupādīyate | tena bhoktuṃ pākaḥ kārakasya vrajyetyādisiddhiḥ | sādhyamānāvasthamanyadevopalakṣitaṃ vā kriyārūpaṃ dhātvarthamāśritya tumunnādividhirityadoṣaḥ | abhyāvṛttistu bhāvyamānadharma iti siddhatāviṣaye tadabhāvāt kṛtvo'rthapratyayāḥ pākādiprayoge na bhavanti | tadevaṃ ghañādivācyo vilakṣaṇo bhāvaḥ | tatra `kartari kṛt'  iti vacanāt kartari ghañādīnāṃ prāptau `bhāve'  ityartho nirdiśyate sa ca pratyayavidheḥ prādhānyād guṇabhūto'treti guṇe saṃkhyāvivakṣāyāṃ yathāśrutasya ca liṅgasya vivakṣāyāṃ vacanāntare liṅgāntare ca pratyayā na syuriti vārtikakāreṇa "bhāve sarvaliṅgo nirdeśaḥ" kartavyatayā coditaḥ | liṅgagrahaṇasyopalakṣaṇārthatvāt saṃkhyāpi gṛhyate tatra | tena bhūto(tau) bhavane bhāve bhāvayorityadinirdeśaḥ kartavyaḥ | tathā ca paktiḥ pacanaṃ pākaḥ pākāvityādisiddhirityarthaḥ || 58 ||
atra bhāṣyakāreṇa "nirdeśe nāntarīyakartvāllaṅgasaṃkhyamatantram" iti sarvataḥ siddhirupapāditā | tatra kathaṃ nāntarīyakatvenātantratvamityupapādayati | sāmānye bhāva ityatra yalliṅgamupalabhyate | bhedānāmanumeyatvānna tat teṣu vivakṣyate || 59 ||
kriyāsāmānyavacanāḥ kṛbhvastaya iti bhavatinā arthanirdeśaḥ kriyamāṇaḥ sarvadhātvarthaviṣayaḥ kṛto bhavatīti `bhāve' iti sāmanyacodanāyāṃ bhāvaśabdārthe sāmānyarūpe bhinnārthaprakṛtīnāṃ pratyayānāmasambhavād viśeṣaparyavasāne yathāviśeṣaṃ striyāṃ bhāve napuṃsake bhāve iti bhāvasāmānādhikaraṇyānyathānupapattyā pratyayavidherbhūyo'nugrahānurodhānniyatavyaktigataliṅgasaṃkhyopādānamatantramavivakṣitamityarthaḥ | sarvavyaktnuyāyi hi bhavatyarthasāmānyamatra nirdidikṣitam | tacca nirāśrayaṃ nirdeṣṭumaśakyamiti nāntarīyakaṃ niyatavyatkyupādānam | anyeṣāṃ tu vyaktiviśeṣāṇāṃ sāmarthyāt sannidhānamiti yathāviśeṣaṃ sarvaliṅgasaṅkhyāparigrahaḥ | sakalaviśeṣaparigrahāya sāmānyacodanāyāṃ nāntarīyakaniyatopāttaviśeṣaniṣṭhatāyogāt | tad yathā | ayaṃ gauḥ padā na spraṣṭavya iti sāmānyacodanāyāṃ nedantānirdiṣṭaniyatavyaktiniṣṭhataiva || 59 ||
nanu ca sāmānyacodanāyāṃ viśeṣaparyavasānād bhavatu pākādau bahuprakāro'pi pratyayaḥ | prātipadikārthastu bhāva iti puṃstvaṃ kathaṃ tyajyata ityāśaṅkhyāha | nirdeśe caritārthatvālliṅgaṃ bhāve'vivakṣitam | upamāsavidhatvācca bhāvādanyat pacādiṣu || 60 ||
prātipadikārthasya sattvabhūtasya liṅgahitasyāsambhavāt tannirdeśe nāntarīyakaṃ liṅgopādānam | tataśca tannairdeśikamavivakṣitam | kārye nirupādhirbhāvārtha eva vidhāvaṅgam | sa cātropamānasadṛśaḥ, dhātusāmānyād vidheḥ, yathā bhavaterbhāvastathā pacateḥ pākastyajatestyāgo dhātvartho'tra pratyayarthatvena boddhavya ityarthaḥ | ataśca bhāvād bhavatyarthād anyadartharūpaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ pacādidhātuviṣaye pākādirūpaḥ pratyayārthaḥ | tathā bhāvādaparaṃ paktirityādau yadyapi liṅgaṃ tathāpi bhinnaliṅgayorupamānopameyabhāvo na virudhyata ityarthaḥ || 60 ||
" pacaterbhavatau yattannirdiṃśyate" ityatraiva parihārantaraṃ bhāṣye'bhihitaṃ vyācaṣṭe | bhavatau yat pacādīnāṃ tāvadatropadiśyate | na ca liṅgaṃ pacādīnāṃ bhavatau samavasthitam || 61 ||
pūrvaṃ sāmānyacodanāyāṃ sarvavyaktitātparyādatantre liṅgasaṃkhye ityuktam | idānīṃ ye ete puṃstvaikatve upātte te avivakṣite eva sāmānyagate sāmānyaṃ hyekaṃ vyaktibhede'pyanuvartamānamekatvaṃ na jahātyeva | anyathā sāmānyameva na bhavet | ataśca vyaktiviśeṣāṇāṃ liṅgasaṃkhyāntarayoge'pi pacādīnāṃ bhavatau vartamānaṃ yadrūpaṃ sanmātre rūpe'stīti paktiḥ pacanaṃ pākau pākā ityādau sanmātrasya rūpasyājahatsvaliṅgasaṃkhyasyasyānuvṛttestadāśrayo vidhiḥ sarvatropapadyata ityarthaḥ || 61 ||
nanu ca sāmānyasya viśeṣātmakatvād viśeṣagataṃ liṅgaṃ sāmānyasaṃbandhyeveti niyataliṃṅgopādāne'nyatra kathaṃ vidhirityāśaṅkyāha | ekaśca so'rthaḥ sattākhyaḥ kathañcit kaiściducyate | liṅgāni cāsya bhidyante pacirūpādibhedavat || 62 ||
sa eko'rtho bhāvaśabdābhidheyaḥ sakaladhātvarthaviṣayasiddhatāsamavetasāmānyarūpo ghañādipratyayavācyaḥ sattākhyaḥ svaśaktyā kaiścicchabdaiḥ kenacit prakāreṇābhidhīyate bhāvaḥ sattetyevamādibhiḥ sāmānyaśabdaiḥ sāmānyarūpaḥ | pākastyāga ityādiviśeṣaśabdairviśeṣarūpaḥ | tatra ca yathā pace rūpaṃ paṭhe rūpaṃ svabhāva ityādivyaktiviśeṣopāśrayavaśāt sattākhyo'rtho bhidyate tathā śabdebhedena paktiḥ pacanamityādinā liṅgāni strītvādīnyasyaviśiṣyante | evamapi ca viśeṣe sarvavyaktyanuyāyi vyāpakaṃ rūpamakhaṇḍitamiti tadāśrayeṇa sarvatra svakāryaṃ sampādayati | na tu niyatavyaktigatena liṅgasaṃkhyādinā dharmeṇa niyamyate | mahāviṣayatvāt sāmānyasya viśeṣasvīkārasāmarthyāṃt | viśeṣasya tu sāmānyamātmasātkartumasāmarthyāt svaliṅgena niyame liṅgāntare vidhiṃ prāpayitumaśaktiḥ | tathā ca bhāṣyam | "yacca pacaterbhavatirbhavati na tadbhavateḥ pacatirbhavati | kiṃ ca pacaterbhavatirbhavati | sāmānyam | kiṃ ca bhavateḥ pacatirbhavati | viśeṣaḥ" sāmānyaviśeṣabhāvenānyonyasvīkārā sāmarthyamuktam (nyasvīkārasāmarthyamasāmarthyaṃ coktam ?)| bhavatirhi sāmānyaṃ paciṃ svīkaroti, na tu pacirviṃśeṣo bhavatimityarthaḥ || 62 ||
saṃbandhibhedenaika evārtho'nekarūpatvena pratibhāsate ityatra bhāṣye nidarśanamupanyastaṃ vyācaṣṭe | ācāryo mātulaśceti yathaiko vyapadiśyate | saṃbandhibhedādarthātmā sa vidhiḥ paktibhāvayoḥ || 63 ||
uktamidaṃ bhāṣye-- "upādhyāyasya śiṣyo mātulasya bhāgineyaṃ gatvāha upādhyāyaṃ bhavānabhivādayatāmiti | sa gatvā mātulamabhivādayate | tathā mātulasya bhāgineya upādhyāyasya śiṣyaṃ gatvāha mātulaṃ bhavānabhivādatāmiti | sa gatvopādhyāyamabhivādayate |" iti | atra ca yathā eko'rthaḥ kiñcit pratyupādhyāyaḥ kañcit prati mātulo'midhīyate tathā sa prakāraḥ paktibhāvayoḥ boddhavyaḥ | svagataviśeṣāpekṣayā sāmānyasvabhāvo'pi pacirbhāvaṃ prati viśeṣaḥ | bhāvaḥ punaḥ paktiṃ prati sāmānyameva | tataśca yathopādhyāyaśabdena mātularūpatayānabhidhīyamāno'pi mātulo vastuvṛttena tattvāt svakāryaṃ pratipadyate tathā bhāvaśabdena sāmānyavācinā sākṣādanabhidhīyamāno'pi viśeṣaḥ sāmarthyādanumīyamānasannidhiriti sāmānyaprayuktaṃ kāryaṃ pratipadyate | tathā hi nopādhyāyarūpādanyatra(t?) mātulatvaṃ tathā na bhāvādanyat pacirūpam | sāmānyaviśeṣayoratyantabhedābhāvāt sakalaviśeṣaparihāreṇa sāmānyarūpānupapatteriti sarvatra siddhiḥ || 63 ||
iti bhūtirājatanayahelārājakṛte prakīrṇakaprakāśe kriyāsamuddeśo'ṣṭamaḥ || 3,9ḥ kālasamuddeśaḥ ------------- kriyānantaraṃ kāla uddiṣṭaḥ | sa hi kriyāyāḥ paricchedakaḥ | tatra darśanāntaralakṣitaṃ tāvattatsvarūpamāha | vyāpāravyatirekeṇa kālameke pracakṣate | nityamekaṃ vibhu dravyaṃ parimāṇaṃ kriyāvatām || 1 ||
parāparādipratyayaliṅgo vyāpaka eko'mūrto'ta evākṛtakatvānnityaḥ kālaḥ kriyāvyatirikto janmādikriyādvāreṇa bhāvaparicchedako vaiśeṣikairāmnātaḥ | sa vistaratastata evāvagantavyaḥ || 1 ||
kālasya paricchedakāntarebhyaḥ paricchedyabhedena bhedamāha | diṣṭiprasthasuvarṇādi mūrtibhedāya kalpate | kriyābhedāya kālastu saṃkhyā sarvasya bhedikā || 2 ||
mūrtirasarvagatadravyaparimāṇam | sa paricchidyate diṣṭayādyāyāmānena | tadhā ca mūrtiṃmadvastugatametad diṣṭirvitastirityādi | ekadigvibhāgāvacchedena cānena vastuparicchedaḥ | etacca pramāṇam | prasthādinā tu sarvato'vacchedenārohapariṇāhābhyāṃ vrīhyādeḥ paricchedaḥ | prasthaḥ droṇaḥ āḍhakamityetat parimāṇam | pariḥ sarvatobhāve | suvarṇādi tūnmānaṃ gurutvaviśeṣeṇa dravyaṃ paricchinatti | suvarṇaṃ niṣkaṃ phalamityādi | ebhyo vyatiriktaḥ kālo'mūrtakriyāparicchedahetuḥ | sūryādisañcāro hi kālena mīyate māsaḥ saṃvatsara ityādi | saṃkhyā tu mūrtāmūrtasya sarvasya paricchedamādadhāti pramāṇādeśca | dvau ghaṭau | bahava ātmānaḥ | dve kriye | ekā vitastiḥ | dvau hastau | catvāraḥ prasthāḥ | pañca phalāni | saṃkhyāpi ca saṃkhyayā mīyate | dve viṃśatū | pañca pañcāśata iti || 2 ||
kālena kathaṃ kriyāḥ parinchidyante ityāha | utpatau ca sthitau caiva vināśe cāpi tadvatām | nimittaṃ kālamevāhurvibhaktenātmanā sthitam || 3 ||
janmasthitivināśāḥ samastakriyākalāpāntarbhāvanahetava iti tad‌dvāreṇa janmādimatāṃ padārthānāṃ nimitkāraṇaṃ kālamāhuḥ | tadapekṣo hi padārthānāmudayādiravatiṣṭhate pravibhaktaśarīraḥ | tathā hi | kecid vasante prasūyante, apare śaradi, prāvṛṣpyanya ityādi vācyam | evaṃ sthitivināśayorapi | upādhibhedācca bhidyamānaḥ kālaḥ saṃsargiṣu bhedāyālam || 3 ||
yataścotpattyādau bhāvānāṃ kālo nimittamataḥ | tamasya lokayantrasya sūtradhāraṃ pracakṣate | pratibandhābhyanujñābhyāṃ tena viśvaṃ vibhajyate || 4 ||
yantrapuruṣaprakhyaṃ viśvaṃ sūtradhārapuruṣakalpakālapratibaddhaceṣṭam | kālena hi svaśaktyā bhāvānāṃ sthaganonmajjane janmanāśaparyāye vibhajatā sūtradhāreṇeva yantrapuruṣasya sūtrasañcāravaśenonmeṣādikriyākāriṇā viśvaṃ prāptapaurvāparyapravibhāgaṃ pravibhāgalakṣaṇāśceṣṭaḥ kāryante || 4 ||
tathāhi | yadi na pratibadhnīyāt pratinbadhaṃ ca notsṛjet | avasthā vyatikīryeran paurvāṃparyavinākṛtāḥ || 5 ||
kālakṛtapratibandhābhāvād yugapadbhāvānāmutpattiḥ syāditi bījāṅkuranālakāṇḍādīnāmānupūrvīniyamābhāvāt saṅkaraḥ syāditi kāraṇādudayatāmapi bhāvānāṃ kālaparivāsadarśanādavaśyamapekṣaṇīyaḥ kālo nimittakāraṇameṣṭavyaḥ || 5 ||
idānīmekatve vibhāvite kālasya nānātvamupādhibhedanihitamāha | tasyātmā bahudhā bhinno bhedairdharmāntarāśrayaiḥ | na hi bhinnamabhinnaṃ vā vastu kiñcana vidyate || 6 ||
dharmāntarāṇi vakṣyamāṇāni saṃsargīṇi kriyārūpāṇi | tadgatairbhedaireko'pi kālonānātvena vyavahriyate | tathā ca nānāvidhakāryajanakaḥ | sarvatraiva ca padārthānā paropādhika eva bhedaḥ | svato bhedābhedābhyāmanirvācyatvāt | tathā coktam | bhinnā iti paropādhirabhinnā iti vā punaḥ | bhāvātmasu prapañco'yaṃ saṃsṛṣṭeṣveva jāyate ||  iti || 6 ||
na hi bhinnamabhinnaṃ vetyudāharaṇena vyaktayati | naiko nāpyaneko'sti na śuklo nāpi cāsitaḥ | dravyātmā sa tu saṃsargādevaṃrūpaḥ prakāśate || 7 ||
nirūpādhirdravyasvabhāvo vyavahāraṃ nāpatatītyeratvādisaṃkhyāsamavāyādekādivyavahāraḥ | śuklakṛṣṇarūpasamavāyācca śuklakṛṣṇarūpatayā dravyamabhidhīyate | evaṃ gotvādisamavāyād gaurityādivyavahārā boddhavyāḥ | tathā kāle'pyutpattyādikriyāsaṃbandhavaśādutpattikālaḥ sthitikālo vināśakāla ityādivyavahāra ityarthaḥ || 7 ||
ataśca | saṃsargiṇāṃ tu ye bhedā viśeṣāstasya te matāḥ | sa bhinnastairvyavasthānāṃ kālo bhedāya kalpate || 8 ||
saṃsargiṇaḥ kālasya saṃbandhinaḥ sūryādigrahapracārarūpāḥ kriyāviśeṣāḥ | teṣāṃ bhedenopahitātmātiśayo'sāvahorātrapakṣamāsartvayanasaṃvatsarayugamanvantarādivyavasthābhedamāsādayati | tathāhi | divasakarodayāstamayāvadhiparicchinnaḥ kālo'hariti vyapadeśyaḥ | tadudayavicchedopahitabhedastu niśā | āvartamānaścāhorātrābhyāṃ pakṣādivyapadeśaṃ yathāyogamāsādayati | akṣipakṣmagatanimeṣonmeṣādikriyopahitabhedastu kṣaṇalavakāṣṭhādivyavahāraṃ vartayati || 8 ||
tadevamupādhibhedāhitaviśeṣo'saṅkareṇa nimittabhāvamupajanādikriyāvyavacchedena bhāveṣu kālaḥ pratipadyate | tathāhi | viśiṣṭakālasaṃbandhād vṛttilābhaḥ prakalpate | śaktīnāṃ saṃprayogasya hetutve nāvatiṣṭhate || 9 ||
vasantādikāle sādhanaśaktīnāṃ pravṛttidarśanāt tāsāṃ prayojako heturnimittakāraṇaṃ kāla unnīyate | kālapreritā hi śaktayo janmādikriyā bhāvānāṃ sādhayanti || 9 ||
tathā ca janmābhivyaktiniyamāḥ prayogopanibandhanāḥ | nityādhīnāsthiti tvācca sthitirniyamapūrvikā || 10 ||
kālena prayuktāḥ kāraṇaśaktayo'bhyanujñātāḥ satyo janayanti kāryamabhivyañjayanti ca | satkāryadarśane niyamo jātasyābhivyaktasya ca niyatakālamavasthānam | ata eva sthitirniyamapūrvikā ityāha | sāpi ca śāśvatarūpakālāyattā | vināśo'pi vināśakānāṃ kālakṛtaśaktiprayogāṇāṃ sāmarthyād bhāvānāṃ kālāyatta iti | `utpattau ca sthitau ca' ityādi pūrvoktamevānena prapañcitam || 10 ||
anyadapi kālakṛtamāha | sthitasyānugrahastairdharmaiḥ saṃsargiṃbhistataḥ | pratibandhastirobhāvaḥ prahāṇamiti cātmanaḥ || 11 ||
tataḥ kālādavasthitasyāpi vastuno vardhakairvināśakaiścāparaiḥ saṃbandhibhirbhāvaiḥ krameṇānugraho vṛddhikṣayalakṣaṇaḥ, bhāvātmanaśca pratibandhaḥ svakāryāsāmarthyaṃ tirobhāvo'darśanaṃ prahāṇaṃ vinaśyattetyādayaḥ sarva eva vikārāḥ kālādhīnā niyatasamayatvāt ||11 ||
evaṃ ca kṛtvā ye kramavantaḥ kriyāviśeṣāḥ bhāvānāṃ te kālādhīnatvāt pṛthagapratyavabhāsamānāḥ kāla eveti vyavahriyanta ityāha | pratyavasthaṃ tu kālasya vyāpāro'tra vyavasthitaḥ | kāla eva hi viśvātmā vyāpāra iti kathyate || 12 ||
anugrāhakatvādibhedena niyatasthitiprasavanirodhāvasthāsu kālasya vyavahāro'vinābhāvīti viśvasyaitadāyattatvādātmā sūtrasthānīyaśceṣṭāhetutvād vyāpāra evobhedenāsau vyavahriyate || 12 ||
viśvātmatvamevāsya pratipādayitumāha | mūrtīnāṃ tena bhinnānāmācayāpacayāḥ pṛthak | lakṣyante pariṇāmena sarvāsāṃ bhedayoginā || 13 ||
prāṇyaprāṇirūpāṇāṃ bhāvānāṃ tena kālena pariṇāmakaraṇādānupūrvyā vṛddhihrāsā vivekena labhyante yauvanasthāvirāvasthāsu | bhedayoginā iti | saṃsargikriyāviśeṣopahitanānātvenetyarthaḥ | mūrtigrahaṇena nityeṣu kālakṛtopakārābhāvamāha | pratibandhābhyanujñābhyāṃ hi janmavināśavanto bhāvāḥ kāle samāyatante || 13 ||
anvarthena nāmnaiva kālo viśvavaicitryaheturityāha | jalayantrabhramāveśasadṛśībhiḥ pravṛttibhiḥ | sa kalāḥ kalayan sarvāḥ kālākhyāṃ labhate vibhuḥ || 14 ||
jalasyoddharaṇārthaṃ yantramaraghaṭṭaprāyaṃ tasya bhramaḥ parivartanaṃ tenāveśastasyaiva kṣobhaḥ tattulyāḥ parāvartamānasya kālasya punaḥ punarvasantādibhāvenāvṛttayaḥ tābhirayaṃ vibhuḥ vyāpako nityo'pi vikalayati vikṣipati kalāḥ bhāvaparyāyāḥ samutsṛjati svakāraṇebhyaḥ pravartayatīti kālākhyām anvarthāṃ labhate | anenaitat sūcayati | viśvātmaika eva parabrahmābhidhānaḥ satyo bhāvaḥ | sa eva nānāvidhakāryakāritayānantaśaktitvena vyavahriyate | tathā ca kramikāṃścakrabhramavat parāvartamānān bhāvān prakāśayan kālayati bhūtānīti kāla ityucyate | sa vibhuḥ svatantraḥ | ata eva svātantryaśaktiḥ kāla iti vākyapadīye siddhāntitam | adhyāhritakālāṃ yasya kālaśaktimupāśritāḥ |  ityatra | ihāpi ca siddhāntayiṣyati | `śaktyātmadevatāpakṣairbhinnaṃ kālasya darśanam' iti | yathāhi bhrāmako bāhunā jalayantraṃ parivartayati tathā kālaśaktyā vibhurbhāvāniti || 14 ||
pratibandhalakṣaṇāpi kālapravṛttirabhyanujñayaivākṣipteti, sarvathā kālapāratantryaṃ nidarśanopanyāsenāha | pratibaddhāśca yāstena citrā viśvasya vṛttayaḥ | tāḥ sa evānujānāti yathā tantuḥ śakuntikāḥ || 15 ||
hemantādikālabhedāpanne sādhanaśaktayaḥ kālena pratibaddhāstā eva vasantādibhāvamanuprāptaḥ sa evotsṛjatīti kālayatītyucyate | tad yathā | bṛhatpakṣigrahaṇopāyabhūtān sūkṣmapakṣiṇaḥ tantuḥ bandhanasūtrameva prasāritaṃ pravartayatyutsṛjati, punastadeva saṅkocitaṃ prattibadhnāti | dhīvarā hi pakṣyantarāṇāṃ grahaṇāya sūtrapratibaddhān pakṣiṇaśceṣṭayanti | tathā ca te sūtrapratibaddhā statsaṃkocavikāsābhyāṃ pratibandhotsargāvanubhavanti, na tūcchṛṅkhalāivoḍḍīya gantuṃ prabhavanti, tayecchāyāṃ tantunākarṣaṇāt | evaṃ kālasūtrapratibaddhāḥ padārthāḥ saṃkocavikāsalakṣaṇāvutpattidhvaṃsāvanavaratamanubhavantītyarthaḥ | ataśca kālaprasevakāntargataṃ viśvaṃ prāptakālaṃ prasūyate prasūtamavatiṣṭhate, avasthitaṃ kṛtakaraṇīyaṃ vinaśyati || 15 ||
kathamityatraiva kramamāha | viśiṣṭakālasaṃbandhāllabdhapākāsu śaktiṣu | kriyābhivyajyate nityā prayogākhyena karmaṇā || 16 ||
iha prāṇināmupabhogāya viśvaracanāprapañca iti pralayaparyavasānasamaye'dṛṣṭavaśāt paramāṇuṣu yathāsvaṃ kāryajanikāḥ śaktayo'bhimukhībhavanti | darśanāntare pradhāne vā mūlakāraṇe kāryonmukhaśaktiṣu ca nityeṣu mūlakāraṇeṣu parasparasaṃśleṣāya prayogaḥ preraṇākhyaḥ karmaviśeṣo jāyate, yena sāmānyabhūtā pravṛttiriti pūrvavyākhyātasatatvā sarvabhāvagatā nityā kriyā prakaṭīkriyate | tathā ca savyāpārāṇi kāraṇāni parasparaṃ saṃyujyante || 16 ||
tataśca jātiprayuktā tasyāṃ tu phalavyaktiḥ pratīyate | kuto'pyadbhutayā vṛttyā śaktibhiḥ sā niyamyate || 17 ||
tasyāṃ nityāyāṃ kriyāyāmabhivyaktāyāṃ satyāṃ kāraṇeṣu phalavyaktiḥ kāryavyaktiḥ prajāyate | svāśrayas‌yābhiniṣpattyai sā kriyāyāḥ prayojikā || iti jāteḥ prayojakatvamuktam | niyatajātīyābhisaṃdhānena kāraṇānāṃ vyāpāropapatteḥ jāti prayojakakartrī | sadasatpakṣabhedena darśanadvayasya pūrvaṃ pratyākhyānādāha kuto'pyadūbhutayā vṛttyā iti | atyadbhutā tviyaṃ vṛttiryadabhāgaṃ yadakramam | bhāvānāṃ prāgabhūtānāmātmatatvaṃ prakāśate ||  ityatra nirṇītametat | sā ca jātā kāryavyaktiḥ kāraṇaśaktibhirniyamyate yena tatraiva tiṣṭhati | tatsaṃbandhitayā ca vyavahriyate | sadasatpakṣayorapi ca kāraṇānāṃ vyāpārasya parākaraṇāt svātmani kāryasya pratiṣṭhāpanaṃ niyamo'pyadbhutāścaryabhūtā vṛttiḥ || 17 ||
anantaraṃ kiṃ bhavatītyāha | tatastu samavāyākhyā śaktirbhedasya bādhikā | ekatvamiva tā vyaktīrāpādayati kāraṇaiḥ || 18 ||
iha tantuṣu paṭa ityādīhapratyayahetuḥ samavāyaḥ pāratantryasāmyāt pūrvaṃ śaktitvena vyavasthāpitaḥ | sa niyamānantaraṃ kāryakāraṇarbhedaṃ tirodhāpayati | yata ekatvamiva atra bhāsate | tathā ca kecit kāraṇavyatiriktaṃ kāryaṃ necchanti | bhedapratyayaviṣayebhyo'bhedapratyayaviṣayasyāvayavino'vayavebhyo vastuto bhedānnaikatvamiti iva śabdaḥ || 18 ||
evaṃ pratiṣṭhitāyāṃ kāryavyaktau-- athāsmānniyamādūrdhvaṃ jātayo yāḥ prayojikāḥ | tāḥ sarvā vyaktimāyānti svacche chāyā ivāmbhasi || 19 ||
atha iti samuccaye | ūrdhvaśabdenānantaryasyoktatvāt | kāraṇaśaktibhiryadāvyaktiḥsvātmani niyamitā tadanantaraṃ niṣṭhāsaṃbandhayorekakālatvāt kāryavyaktirjātaiva svajātyā saṃbadhyate | prayojikayā | niṣṭhottarakālaṃ tu kṣaṇāntake rūpādiguṇopajanād indriyārthasannikarṣāt saṃyuktasamavāyena rūpidravyasayavāyājjātayaḥ prakāśante | tad yathā nirmale jale vṛkṣādīnāṃ chāyāpratibimbaṃ jalābhedena, evaṃ vyakteraikātmyamiva prāptā jātayo'pi gṛhyanta iti dṛṣṭāntasāmyam | sarvāḥ iti sattādravyatvapṛthivītvādayaḥ || 19 ||
ato'nantaraṃ guṇānāmutpattimāha | kāraṇānuvidhāyitvādatha kāraṇapūrvakāḥ | guṇāstatropalabhyante svajātivyaktihetavaḥ || 20 ||
kāraṇānuvidhāyitvena pūrvaṃ kāraṇotpatteḥ paścāt kāryotpattimāha | tenaikasmin kṣaṇe nirguṇaiva kāryavyaktiḥ tato'vayavaguṇebhyo'samavāyikāraṇebhyaḥ svāvayavisamavāyakāraṇasahitebhyo'vayavini rūpādyutpattiḥ | utpannāśca rūpādayaḥ svajātī rūpatvādikāḥ samabhivyañjayanti | adṛṣṭavaśāt paramāṇuṣu kriyotpannā pūrvadeśasaṃyogavibhāgāvināśapūrvakaṃ parasparopaśleṣeṇa dvayaṇukādiprakrameṇa bhogasādhanān padārthān utpādayatīti piṇḍitārthaḥ | atra sarvatra kramākhyā kālaśaktiḥ savyāpāretyabhyanujñeyam || 20 ||
kālakṛtā janmaparyāyā bhāvānāṃ vyākhyātāḥ | idānīṃ sthitiḥ vyācaṣṭe | āśrayāṇāṃ ca nityatvamāśritānāṃ ca nityatā | tā vyaktīranugṛhvāti sthitistena prakalpate || 21 ||
yāsāṃ tāvat kāryavyaktīnāṃ nityā āśrayāḥ kāraṇāni tāsāṃ kāraṇavināśapūrvakasya vināśasyābhāvādavasthitatvam | ataśca paramāṇvādīnāṃ kāraṇānāṃ nityatvaṃ kartṛtāḥ kāryavyaktīrupakaroti sthāparatvenāvasthāpanāt | anyathādhāravināśānnāvatiṣṭheran | anityāśrayāṇāmapi kāryavyaktīnāmāśritānāṃ jātīnāṃ nityatvādavināśakāraṇamavasthānaṃ svajātibhirevānugṛhyate, tāvantaṃ kālaṃ niyatajātīyatayāvasthānasambhavāt | anyathādheyānāṃ sāmānyānāmapāye dravyāṇyavyavahāryatvādasthitakalpāni syuḥ || 21 ||
itthaṃ cotpattiriva sthitirapi parādhīnetyāha | anityasya yathotpāde pāratantryaṃ tathā sthitau | vināśāyaiva tat sṛṣṭasvādhīnasthitiṃ viduḥ || 22 ||
kāraṇaṃ vinotpattyabhāvāt yathāsau tatparatantrā tathā kāraṇāvaṣṭammamantareṇa svataḥsthityabhāvāt kṛtakamutpattyanantarameva pradhvaṃsamiyāditi vināśāyaiva tat sṛṣṭaṃ syāt, nārthakriyārthamityarthaḥ | tanmā bhūdasyāpārthakaṃ janmeti kāraṇāyattasthitikaṃ tanmanyante vaiśeṣikāḥ || 22 ||
nanu kramayaugapadyābhyāṃ sthirārthakriyānupapatterante vināśadarśanāt tatrāpekṣābhāvāt kṛtakaḥ sannityeva vinaśyatīti sthityabhāva ityāśaṅkyāha | sthitaḥ saṃsargibhirbhāvaiḥ sa kriyāsvanugṛhyate | naiṣāṃ sattāmanud gṛhya vṛttirjanmavatāṃ smṛtā || 23 ||
saṃsargibhiḥ sahakāribhiḥ anugṛhīto bhāvo'rthakriyāsu yogyaḥ | na hyekaṃ kiñcana janakaṃ sāmagrītaḥ kriyāsiddhirityeṣāṃ saṃsargiṇāṃ sahakāriṇāṃ sattvamasvīkṛtya kārye vṛttiḥ vyāpāro nāsti jātānāṃ bhāvānām | tadevaṃ kramabhāvyanekakāryakartṛtvaṃ tattatsahakāriprāptau sthitilakṣaṇamupapadyate | tathā ca sthitiparyantābhyanujñopapattiḥ | yattu sahakāriṇaḥ kiṃ kurvantīti codyate tatra sahakaraṇameva sahakārārtho'tiśayāderanyatra vicāritatvād yathāpratīti sthiratvaṃ samarthitaṃ tadvādibhiḥ || 23 ||
idānīṃ pratibandhalakṣaṇāṃ kālavṛttiṃ vyācaṣṭe | jarākhyā kālaśaktiryā śaktyantaravirodhinī | sā śaktiṃ pratibadhnāti jāyante ca virodhinaḥ || 24 ||
jīryate bhāvo'nayeti jarā nāma kālasya śaktiḥ prāṇyaprāṇisādhāraṇayauvanādiśaktyantarapratibandhinī kāryavyaktīnāṃ kālāntaraparivāsāvadhṛtārthakriyāsu sāmarthyaṃ vighnayati | tataśca sāmarthyavirodhino'vasthāviśeṣāḥ prāṇyaprāṇiṣu prajñāmāndyaśoṣādayaḥ prādurbhavanti | yataḥ pradhvaṃsaḥ pratyāsanna iti lakṣyate || 24 ||
evaṃ jarasādhiṣṭhite bhāve prayojakāstu ye bhāvāḥ sthitibhā gasya hetavaḥ | tirobhavanti te sarve yata ātmā prahīyate || 25 ||
yaiḥ (ye?) pravartitāḥ svakārye bhāvāḥ saṃsargibhiḥ sahakāribhiḥ sthityaṃśahetavaḥ te sarve'sya jarādhiṣṭhitasya kṛtadhnā iva sahoṣitā api nivartante | teṣu nivṛtteṣu kṛtakaraṇīyasyāsya bhāvasya svarūpaṃ pracyavate || 25 ||
na tu vināśakāraṇairasya kiñcit kriyata ityāha | yathaivādbhutayā vṛttyā niṣkramaṃ nirnibandhanam | apadaṃ jāyate sarvaṃ tathāsyātmā prahīyate || 26 ||
janmani sadasatpakṣabhedena pūrvaṃ kāraṇavyāpārasya vyudāsādavibhāvitatattvamavidyamānakāraṇabhūtanibandhamata eva kāraṇavyāpārābhāvāt paurvāparyeṇāṃśāṃśikayāniṣpatterakramaṃ viśvamājāyamānamupalakṣyata iti pūrvameva vivartacintāyāṃ nirṇītametat | evaṃ vināśe'pi | kriyamāṇatāyāṃ bhāvatāpatternirnibandhanameva prahāṇaṃ kālaparivāsādhīnaṃ bhāvānāmityarthaḥ | tadevaṃ sargasthitipralayānāṃ kālakṛtapratibandhābhyanujñāvaśena sambhava iti viśvātmanaḥ kālasya vyāpāro'tra sarvatreti nirṇītam | taduktam pratyavasthaṃ tu kālasya vyāpāro'tra vyavasthitaḥ  iti || 26 ||
idānīmaparamapi kālānumānahetumāha | kriyayorapavargiṇyornānārthasamavetayoḥ | saṃbandhinā vinaikena paricchedaḥ kathaṃ bhavet || 27 ||
iha kriyā tāvadanekakṣaṇasamāhārātmikā yugapat kṣaṇānāmabhāvāt sakrameti kālaśaktyanugṛhītaiva | sarvaḥ krame hi kāladharmaḥ | dvayośca kriyayorudayānantaradhvaṃsitve samāne'pi cireṇa kṛtaṃ kṣipraṃ kṛtamiti vilakṣaṇaḥ paricchedo vinaikaṃ saṃbandhinamupādhibhūtaṃ nāvakalpate | nānārthasamavetayoḥ ityanenāśrayabhedāt kriyābhedāmāha | tataśca naikakriyānimitto'yaṃ vyapadeśaḥ, paṭaścireṇa kṛto ghaṭaścireṇa kṛta iti āśrayabede'pyanuvṛtteḥ | kriyāyā bhinnāśrayasamavetāyā bhede sati tadanupapatteḥ | ata eva na kāryadravyanimitto'yaṃ vyapadeśaḥ, kāryadravyasya bhedādabhinnavyapadeśahetutvānupapatteḥ | na ca kārākādi nimittamatra tasyāpi bhedasyānuvṛtteḥ | tasmād yadatra nimittaṃ sa kālaḥ | so'pi ced bhinno nāsāvanuvṛttaḥ pratyayaḥ syādityuktam ekena iti | eko hi sādhāraṇyāt kālo'nuvṛttaṃ pratyayaṃ janayati || 27 ||
yadyevaṃ vilakṣaṇacirakṣiprādivyapradeśaḥ kuta ityāśaṅkyāha | yathā tulāyāṃ haste vā nānādravyavyavasthitam | gurutvaṃ parimīyeta kālādevaṃ kriyāgatiḥ || 28 ||
suvarṇarajatādidravyasamavetaṃ gurutvameka eva tulādaṇḍo rekhāsūtrasaṃbandhopahitabhedo yathā palādibhāvena paricchinatti tathā kālo'pi svaśaktiyogād vaiśvarūpyamanubhavan nimeṣādikriyābhedopahitanānātvaṃ kriyāsantānaṃ cirācirādibhāvena parimimīte | abhyāsātiśayavatāṃ vaṇijāṃ hasto dravyāṇāṃ gurutvaviśeṣaṃ paricchinattīti so'pi dṛṣṭāntaḥ | yathāsau hastaḥ evaṃ nirupādhireka eva svasāmarthyāt kālaḥ kriyāgataṃ bhedaṃ paricchinatti || 28 ||
evaṃ caikaḥ sa kālaḥ jahāti sahavṛttāśca kriyāḥ sa samavasthitāḥ | vrīhiryathodakaṃ tena hāyanākhyāṃ prapadyate || 29 ||
avasthite ekasminneva kāle nānāvidhāḥ kriyāstatsahacāriṇyo'pyayante | ataḥ sa kālo hāyanākhyāṃ saṃvatsaraparyāyāṃ prapadyate | jahāti kriyā iti hāyanaḥ | tadyathā vrīhibījaṃ sahāvasthitamudakamapajahaddhāyana iti vyapadiśyate | ata eva haśca vrīhikālayoḥ  iti sūtrekāreṇopamāgarbhaṃ sahaiva vyutpattiranuśiṣṭā | yathā jalairvīhiḥ sahāvasthitairūpakriyate tathā kālo'pi kriyābhiḥ sahakāriṇībhirbhāvānukarotīti aupādhiko'sya bhedaḥ | mukhyastvabhedaḥ || 29 ||
yadi tarhyavasthita ekaḥ kālaḥ, kathamasya kramarūpatetyāha | pratibandhābhyanujñābhyāṃ vṛttiryā tasyā śāśvatī | tayā vibhajyamāno'sau bhajate kramarūpatām || 30 ||
kasyāścit kriyāyāḥ sādhanaśaktīnāṃ vyāpāravighāte pratibandhaḥ | tadviparyayo'bhyanujñā | tābhyāmupalakṣitā kālasya nityā pravṛttirbhāveṣu | satatapariṇāmiṣu hi bhāveṣu kiñcidājāyate kiñcidapakṣīyate iti niyatametat | tathā ca kāryaniveśī kramaḥ kāle samāropyate, natvasau tatra bhāvika ityarthaḥ | kriyādharmo hi mukhyaḥ kramastadanyatropacaritaḥ | paurvāparyaṃ hi pūrvāpareṣu vastuṣūpādhibhūtaṃ lakṣyate na tu svatantram | evaṃ yaugapadyamapi kramavirodhī dharmaḥ kāryagataḥ kāle samāropyate || 30 ||
samaviṣamarūpatāpi kālasyopacarityāha | kartṛbhedāt tadartheṣu prakarṣāpacayau gataḥ | samatvaṃ viṣamatvaṃ vā sa ekaḥ pratipadyate || 31 ||
iha yadānuṣṭhātāraḥ śrutismṛtinibandhanamācāramanutiṣṭhanti tadā prakarṣamāsādayan kālaḥ sa evaikaḥ kṛtādirvyapadiśyate | śubhasamācārādhikāribāhulyādi bhinna ityarthaḥ | tadarthaḥ kartṛsādhyaḥ samācāraḥ | yadā tu kartāro viśṛṅkhalā yathāvatsamācāramullaṃghayanti tadā samācārāpakarṣādapacayaprāpteḥ kaliprabhṛtirviṃṣabhaḥ kālo'bhidhīyate | tadayameko'pyanuṣṭhātṛbhedād vibhāgamāsādayati kālaḥ || 31 ||
anyadapyadhyāropitaṃ kālasya vibhāgamāha | kiyābhedādyathaikasmiṃstakṣādyākhyā pravartate | kriyābhedāt tathaikasminnṛtvādyākhyopajāyate || 32 ||
takṣaṇāyovikaraṇā dikriyāviśeṣopalpitā takṣāyasyakārādisaṃjñā yathaikasya kartuḥ pravartate tathā viśiṣṭapuṣpādiprasavalakṣaṇakriyābhedādekasyāpi kālasya vasantādabhedena samākhyā jāyate | ādigrahaṇāt sitāsitapakṣavyapadeśo'horātravyapadeśaḥ pradoṣapratyūṣavyapadeśaśca yathāyathaṃ kriyābhedopahito gṛhyate || 32 ||
anyo'pi kālabhedo'dhyāropito bhavatītyāha | ārambhaśca kriyā caiva niṣṭhā cetyabhidhīyate | dharmāntarāṇāmadhyāsabhedāt sadasadātmanaḥ || 33 ||
utpatteḥ pūrvamasadātmā padārthaḥ | utpannastu sadātmā | tasya buddhyaikatvena vasturūpatayā svīkāre sati vilakṣaṇadharmabhedavaśādārambhādikālo bhedena vayavahriyate | tathā hi buddhyābhisandhāya padārtharūpaṃ yogyasādhanopārjanamārambhakālaḥ | upārjitasādhanasya karaṇaṃ kriyākālaḥ | kartavyasya samāptirniṣṭhākālaḥ | tadevaṃ yathākālaṃ dharmabhedakalpanayārambhādikālapraviyāgaḥ || 33 ||
sa ca sarvatra samāna ityāha | yāvāṃśca dvyaṇukādīnāṃ tāvān bimavato'pyasau | na hyātmā kasyacid bhettuṃ pracetuṃ vāpi śakyate || 34 ||
avayavināṃ niraṃśatvādārambhādikālaḥ sarveṣāṃ samānaḥ | avayavāstu tato'rthāntaram | parimāṇamapi ca guṇo'nya evāvayavina iti na tadbhede tasya rūpaṃ pracetumapacetuṃ vā śakyate | tasmādavayavimātrasya kāryadravyasya samānatvānna tadvaśenālpaparimāṇānāṃ mahāparimāṇānāṃ cārambhādikālo viśiṣyate, api tvavayavivyatiriktadharmāntaravaśenetyarthaḥ || 34 ||
tadāha | anyaistu bhāvairanyeṣāṃ pracayaḥ parikalpyate | śanairidamidaṃ kṣipramiti tena pratīyate || 35 ||
alpaparimāṇamahāparimāṇānāmavayavināmanyairvyatiriktairevāvayavairbahubhiḥ pracayo'lpairapacayaśca parikalpyate'dhyāropyate | tathā ca bahvavayavo'vayavī śanairniṣpadyate, alpāvayavastu kṣipramityārambhādikālastatra vilakṣaṇo'vadhāryate | samavāyatirohitabhedatvādavayavadharmairavayavino vyapadeśaḥ, na tu bhāvataḥ kālo bhidyate'vayavinām || 35 ||
yataḥ asataśca kramo nāsti sa hi bhettuṃ na śakyate | sato'pi cātmatattvaṃ yat tat tathaivāvatiṣṭhate || 36 ||
utpatteḥ pūrvamasan bhāvaḥ | tasya niḥsvabhāvatvāt paurvāparyeṇa vibhāgābhāvāt kramo nāsti | utpannasyāpi vidyamānasya tenaiva prakāreṇāśakyabhedatvena svarūpasyāvasthānādavidyamānaḥ krama iti buddhyānu sandhāne na kramavyavahāraḥ sadasatorityarthādabhihitaṃ bhavat | bhedāśrayo hi kramaḥ | sa ca bhedaḥ padārthasyotpadyamānāvasthā tattvataḥ sadasadavasthādvayarūpasya pratyavasthamasaṃbhavīti tatsaṅkalanayā pūrvāpararūpatādhyāropaḥ | evaṃ prathama eva kramaḥ kālpanika iti sarvastathārūpo na mukhyaḥ || 36 ||
na kevalaṃ kriyābhedanimittāḥ kāle ekasminnṛtvādyākhyāḥ pravartante, yāvad bhūtādi vyapadeśā apītyāha | kriyāpādhiśca san bhūtabhaviṣyadvartamānatāḥ | ekādaśabhirākārairvibhaktāḥ pratipadyate || 36 ||
utpannadhvastā yadā kriyā bhavanti tadā tadupādhiḥ kālo bhūta iti vyapadiśyate | yadā tu sannihitasādhanāḥ sambhāvyamānodayāḥ kriyāḥ tadā tadupādhiḥ kālo bhaviṣyattāṃ pratipadyate | prārabdhāparisamāptakriyopādhistu vartamānasaṃjñaḥ | te ca bhūtādayaḥ kālavibhāgāḥ punaravāntarabhedenaikādaśadhā bhavanti || 37 ||
kathamityāha | bhūtaḥ pañjavidhastatra bhaviṣyaṃśca caturvidhaḥ | vartamāno dvidhākhyāta ityekādaśa kalpanāḥ || 38 ||
