bhūtasāmānyaṃ viśeṣebhyo vyāvṛttereko bhūtabheda iti gaṇyate | tathā coktaṃ "sāmānyamapi yathā viśeṣastadvat " iti | adyatano dvitīyo bhūtabhedaḥ | anadyatanastṛtīyaḥ | adyatanānadyatanasamudāyastābhyāmanyatvāccaturthaḥ | parokṣastavanadyatanabhedo na bhūtabheda iti na pṛthag gaṇyate | yastu bhaviṣyannapyatideśād bhūtakāryāṇi labhate sa pañcamo bhūtabhedo'dhyāropitabhūtabhāvo gauṇaḥ | bhaviṣyatsāmānyamadyatano'nadyatano'dyatanānadyatanasamudāyaśceti catvāro bhaviṣyadbhedāḥ | yastu anadyatanavatpratiṣedhād bhaviṣyatsāmānyakāryāṇi pratipadyate so'nadyatano'pi śāstravyavahāre bhaviṣyatsāmānyameva | mukhyo vartamāna ekaḥ | tatsamīpabhūtastvatidiṣṭavartamānabhāvaḥ vartamānasamīpye... iti bhūtobhaviṣyaṃśca sa dvitīyaḥ | tadete śāstrakāryapravibhāgārthaṃ kālasya bhedāḥ kalpitāḥ, na tvasā viyatsaṃkhyaḥ | evamanantabhedatvāt kriyābhedād bhūtādibheda uktaḥ || 38 ||
kriyā cātītā'vidyamānā kathaṃ bhūtavyapadeśaṃ kāle samarpayedityāśaṅkayāha | kāle nidhāya svaṃ rūpaṃ prajñayā yannigṛhyate | bhāvāstato nivartante tatra saṃkrāntaśaktayaḥ || 39 ||
kriyayā nirvartitāḥ padārthāvyatītā iti bhaṇyanta vyapagatasvarūpāḥ | tatra yatteṣāṃ vartamānāvasthāyāṃ buddhyā svarūpaṃ gṛhītaṃ tat sthāyini kāle svādhāre samarpyavyayante, yato'nubhūtāḥ smaryamāṇāvasthā jāyante | tathā cātīte'dhvani saṃkrāntaśaktayo vyavahāraṃ smārtamanupatanti | etaduktaṃ bhavati | bhāvopādhitayā kālatattvaṃ prakhyāyate | bhāvāśvānubhūtau smaryamāṇāvasthāstasya bhūtavyapadeśameva svopādhitayā kalpayanti | tathā cabhūd ghaṭa ityādivyavahāraḥ | ataścaitadeva kālasadbhāvāvedakaṃ liṅgam | asatyarthe tadvyavahārānupapatteḥ | kālasaṃkrāntarūpatve'bhūditi vyavahārāt kālasiddhiḥ || 39 ||
tarhi bhaviṣyadvathapadeśo'pi kathamityāha | bhāvināṃ caiva yadrūpaṃ tasya ca pratibimbakam | sunirmṛṣṭa ivādarśe kāla evopapadyate || 40 ||
samarthahetusannidhānasamaye saṃbhāvitotpattīnāṃ padārthānāṃ yadrūpaṃ bāhyaṃ yacca tasya bāhyasvarūpasya buddhau niścitaṃ pratibimbarūpaṃ tadākārastayordvayordṛśyavikalpayorekatvādhyavasāyat sthāyini kāle samārohastatra saṃkrāntaśaktitvamiti tadadhyāropāt kāle bhaviṣyattvamadhyavasāya niyatarūpaniścaya ityarthaḥ | kālādiprasevakāntargatā eva padārthāścakāsatītyādarśasāmyam || 40 ||
evaṃ ca kālasaṃkrāntarūpatvād bhāvānāmajasrapariṇāma ityāha | tṛṇaparṇalatādīni yathā sroto'nukarṣati | pravartayati kālo'pi mātrā mātrāvatāṃ tathā || 41 ||
nadīpravāho yathā tṛṇādīni kānicit prerayati svasthānāt pracyāvayati, kānicit punarākṣipya tat‌sthāne niveśayati evamajasrapravṛttiḥ kālo bhāvānākṣipyākṣipyotsṛjati, utsṛṣṭānāṃ ca dharmapariṇāmān vartayati || 41 ||
daṣṭāntāntareṇa tadeva draḍhayati | āviśyevānusandhatte yathā gatimatāṃ gatīḥ | vāyustathaiva kālātmā vidhatte kramarūpatām || 42 ||
yathā prāṇākhyo vāyuḥ śarīriṇāmantaravayavasandhiṣvavasthito gamanāgamanādiceṣṭāḥ sādhayati tathā kālātmā api bhāvānāmātmanyanupraviśya pratibandhābhyanujñābhyāṃ nimajjanonmajjane kurvat kramaṃ paurvāparyalakṣaṇaṃ pravartayati || 42 ||
tataścedaṃ siddhyatītyāha | ayanapravibhāgaśca gatiśca jyotiṣāṃ dhruvā | nivṛttiprabhavāścaiva bhūtānāṃ tannibandhanāḥ || 43 ||
dakṣiṇāyanamuttarāyaṇamiti kālakṛkatamaryādāyattaḥ pravibhāgaḥ | nakṣatrāṇāṃ ca niyatā gatiḥ udayādirūpā kālamanupatati | mahābhūtānāṃ ca sargapralayasamaye janmavinaśāvāvirbhāvatirobhāvalakṣaṇau kālāyattau iti sarvopakārī kālo viśvātmetyucyate || 43 ||
jyotīṃṣi nakṣatraparyāyāṇi kālapravibhāgarūpāṇi nānyattattvamityāha | mātrāṇāṃ parimāṇā ye kālavṛttyanuyāyanaḥ | nakṣatrākhyā pṛthak teṣu cihnamātraṃ tu tārakāḥ || 44 ||
viśiṣṭakālasaṃbandhavaśena ye bhāvānāṃ viśiṣṭāḥ pariṇāmāste pṛthak pṛthak vibhaktāḥ kṛttikādinakṣatrasaṃjñāḥ pratipadyante | tathāhi candramasā yoge puṣyādīnāṃ yo bhāvo jātaḥ sa tadvyapadeśaṃ labhate tiṣyaḥ punarvasurvā māṇavaka iti | ata evātra jātapratyayasyādarśanamanvākhyāyate | svābhāvikaṃ hyarthābhidhānaṃ śabdānāṃ vyutpādyate | tena viśiṣṭopajātaḥ padārthaḥ tiṣṭādivyapadeśya iti bhāvato mātrāpariṇāma eva nakṣatropādhiḥ kālaḥ | pṛthakgrahaṇāt kālasyāpi nakṣatrasamāravyā gamyante kṛttikā rohiṇītyādi | sa hi kālabhāgo bhāveṣūpādhirjanikriyāmukhena | tasyaiva tu jñāpakāni jyotīṃṣi, na tu tāvadeva nakṣatrasya rūpaṃ candramasā yoge tadupapatteḥ || 44 ||
yathā ca niyatakālaviśeṣo jyotīrūpaiścihṇaiḥ kāryabhūtairjñāpyate , tathānyairapītyāha | rutairmṛgaśakuntānāṃ sthāvarāṇāṃ ca vṛttibhiḥ | chāyādiparaṇāmaiśca ṛtudhāmā nirūpyate || 45 ||
ṛtavo dhāma sthānaṃ yasya, tadātmakatvena pratibhāsāt | kālākhyā hi svātanvyaśaktirbrahmaṇo vasantādibhedena pravibhaktā cakāsti | tathā cāsau niyataṛtubhedaḥ puṃskokilādikūjitavaśena navanavakisalayayogena sūyādi sañcāraviśeṣopalakṣyamāṇacchāyātapādibhedena latāvatānaprasūnaviśeṣeṇa cāvadhāryate | tathāhi | sugandhikusumāmodamattaṣaṭpadanirbharaḥ | puṃskokilaravākīrṇavanoddeśo vibhāvyate || madhurmadhurajhaṃkārasukhamārutasaṅgamaḥ | prabodhitapriyābāhumañjarīsaktavallabhaḥ || mallikāmodaruciro dharmārtagajakampatiḥ | prakampipavanaḥ śuṣkalatākusumasañcayaḥ || śuṣyadāsyapipā sārtaprāṇisaṅkaragrahnaraḥ | prataptapāṃsunicayo grīṣmaḥ soṣmā vibhāvyate || praśāntātapasañcārā nīradācchāditāmbarāḥ | jalāplāvitabhūbhāgāḥ sañcāraviṣamāḥ kvacit || mayūrakekāravapūritāśā latāgṛhāntaḥ sthitakāmisaṃghāḥ | utkaṇṭhitaproṣitadattakampā varṣāṃ vibhāvyanta iha krameṇa || haṃsānāṃ ninadena padmanicayairlākṣādravodbhāsibhi-- rnairmalyena diśāṃ viśuddhadhavalairabhrairnabholāñchanaiḥ | śālīnāṃ paripākaśobhivapuṣāṃ hṛdyairmṛgāṇāṃ gataiḥ saṃbhāvyā śaradabhramuktavimalavyomasphurattārakā || prasūnaistatratyairdiśi diśi cakāsadbhiramalai- jaḍimnā sannāṅgaiḥ paśubhiratha kākairvanagataiḥ | niśānāṃ vistārairabhimatatamaiḥ kāntamanasāṃ himairhemantākhyaḥ samaya ihalakṣyaḥ sphuṭavapuḥ || himaprapātasthagitorumārgo viśīrṇaparṇaḥ śiśiro'pi lakṣyaḥ | śītārtasīdacchakuniprakāṇḍo nīhāradhārāvṛtabhūmipṛṣṭhaḥ || praphullakundaprakarapracārastuṣārasaṅghātavibhedadakṣaḥ | vahatyajasraṃ śiśiro nabhasvān yatrābhitaḥ sphītataruprakarṣaḥ ||45 ||
idānīmadvaitavāde'pi kālopayogaṃ bhāvānāmāha | nirbhāsopagamo yo'yaṃ kramavāniva dṛśyate | akramasyāpi viśvasya tat kālasya viceṣṭitam || 46 ||
saṃbandhasamuddeśe pradarśitadiśā'kramaṃ brahmavivartarūpaṃ viśvam | tasya yadidaṃ krameṇāvabhāsanaṃ tat kālaśaktikṛtapratibandhābhyanujñāsāmarthyam | kālākhyā hi brahmaśaktiravidyaiva kramāvabhāsakāritayā jīvātmasu saphaleti brahmakāṇḍa eva nirṇītam | evaṃ tāvat prathamaḥ kālavyāpāro'tra kramāvabhāsaḥ || 46 ||
tadanantaro'pi kālabheda aupādhika ityāha | d‌rāntikavyavasthānamadhvādhikaraṇaṃ yathā | cirakṣipravyavasthānaṃ kālādhikaraṇaṃ tathā || 47 ||
dūro'yamadhvā nikaṭo'yamiti kartṛgatibhedenādhvani vyavasthā, na tu mārgabhedo'tra kaścit | ya eva hi mandagatīnāṃ dūraḥ sa eva caturaceṣṭānāmāsanno'dhvā | evaṃ sthāyinyapi kāle pracitasantānakriyopādhiḥ ciramiti vyavasthānam | apacitasantānakriyopādhiḥ kṣipramiti || 47 ||
idānīṃ pūrvokto'pi bhūtādibhedaḥ kālasya kriyāpādhiḥ | viśeṣamatra vaktuṃ punaḥ pratipadyate | tasyābhinnasya kālasya vyavahāre kriyākṛtāḥ | bhedā iva trayaḥ siddhā yām̐lloko nātivartate || 48 ||
abhinnena kālena vyabahartumaśakyatvālloke trayo bhedā iva paramārthata ekatvāt, kriyopādhayaḥ prasiddhāḥ tasya bhūtabhaviṣyadvartamānākhyāḥ | kriyāvyuparame bhūtaḥ, sambhāvitāyāṃ kriyāyāṃ bhaviṣyan, kṣaṇapravāharūpeṇa pravartamānāyāṃ tasyāṃ vartamānaḥ | mukhya evāyam || 48 ||
kathamasya bhedo na bhavatītyāha | ekasya śaktayaḥ tisraḥ kālasya samavasthitāḥ | yatsaṃbandhena bhāvānāṃ darśanādarśane satām || 49 ||
kāryabhede na kāraṇabhedānumānam, śaktibhedādeva kāryabhedopapatteḥ | kālākhyasya jagatkāraṇasya mukhyo bhedo nāsti | tathāhi | vartamānaśaktisaṃbandhena bhāvānāṃ satāmevābhivyaktirjanma | atītānāgatakālaśaktisaṃbandhena tu satāmeva tirobhāvo'darśanamanabhivyaktirvināśaḥ prākpradhvaṃsābhāvarūpa iti śaktibhedāt kāryabhedopapattau kālabhedakalpanā nirnimittā || 49 ||
darśanādarśane eva śaktipravibhāgena vibhajati | dvābhyāṃ sa kila śaktibhyāṃ bhāvānāṃ varaṇātmakaḥ | śaktistu vartamānākhyā bhāvarūpaprakāśinī || 50 ||
atītānagataśaktibhyāṃ varaṇaṃ tirodhānaṃ bhāvānāṃ satāṃ kālaḥ karoti | vartamānaśaktyā darśane bhāvarūpaprakāśanam || 50 ||
nanu yathānāgataśaktikṛtāvaraṇānāṃ punarabhivyaktirvartamānaśaktisaṃbandho dṛśyate tathātītaśaktikṛtāvaraṇānāmapi kathaṃ na bhavatītyāśaṅkayāha | anāgatā janmaśakteḥ śaktirapratibandhikā | atītākhyā tu yā śaktistayā janma virudhyate || 51 ||
janmasahacaritāyā vartamānaśakteranāgataśaktiravirodhinī pratibandhaṃ na karotyudaye | svakāle hi tayā sā pratibaddhā | samarthahetusampāte tu vartamānaśarterudayānukūlyamanāgataśaktirbhajate | yasya hi kālāntare vartamānatā sa evānāgataḥ kathyate | atītaśaktyā tu janmaśaktirvartanākhyā virudhyate eva na hi mṛtasya punarjanmetinātīte'dhvani patitamāvirbhavati vastu || 51 ||
nanu śaktimadāśritāḥ śaktayaḥ śaktimāniva sadā saṃnihitā iti sadaiva tadyoge bhāvānāṃ yugapad viruddharūpadarśanādarśanaprasaṅga ityāśaṅkyāha | tamaḥprakāśavattvete trayo'dhvāno vyavasthitāḥ | akramāsteṣu bhāvānāṃ kramaḥ samupalabhyate || 52 ||
bhūtabhaviṣyadvartamānākhyāstrayaḥ kālavibhāgā adhvāna ivādhvānaḥ | yathā hyadhvasu gantāro gamanāgamanādiprabandhaṃ vartayanti tathaiteṣu bhāvāḥ pariṇāmamanubhavanto gatāgataprabandhamuparacayanti | bhaviṣyadadhvani ya eva sthitaḥ sa eva vartamānādhvani patitvātīte'dhvani punaḥ patati | tathā ca traiyādhvikāḥ padārthāḥ pariṇāmavādibhirabhyupagamyante | yaduktaṃ pākañjale dharmāstryadhvānaḥ iti | yadyapi caite trayaḥ śaktiviśeṣāḥ kālātmanyakramā evāvasthitāḥ tathāpi tamaḥ prakāśarūpatvādādheyeṣu bhāveṣu pravṛttiṃ vartayanto darśanādarśanābhyāṃ sadasadrūpopakalpanayā paurvāparyaṃ vidadhati | tadyathā sattvarajastamolakṣaṇaguṇā nityatvād yugapadavasthānā api aṅgāṅgibhāvopagamanena yathāyathaṃ svavṛttyullāse vicitrapariṇāmād bhāvānupaparacayanti tatheme kālabhedāḥ svaśaktimāhātmyād bhāvabhedeṣu kramoparacanacaturā ityarthaḥ || 52 ||
tamaḥ prakāśarūpatvameva vibhajati | dvau tu tatra tamorūpāvekasyālokavat sthitiḥ | atītamapi keṣāñcit punarviparivartate || 53 ||
atītānāgatāvadhvānau bhāvāvaraṇahetutvāt tamaḥ svabhāvau | varaṇaṃ hi tamodharmaḥ | `guru varaṇakameva tamaḥ' iti | rajastu pravṛttisāmānyaṃ kālasvarūpaṃ sarvatrānvayi | pratibandhābhyanujñābhyāṃ pravartakaṃ preraṇārūpaṃ rājaḥ kālātmakameva traiguṇyapariṇāmātmakatvaṃ ca brahmadarśane'pi kālasyopapannameva śaktirūpasyāpi | jñānakriyāśaktī hi jīvātmani guṇatrayam | tatraiva ca kālaśaktistādrūpyātītaśaktirjanmaśakteḥ pratibandhiketi pūrvamuktam | kecittu manyante atītādhvapatitamapi punaḥ kālāntare jahataparivarteṣūnmajjati | kṛtapariniṣṭhitā hi bhāvāḥ pradhāna prasevakāntargatā yathākālamuddarśayantyātmā naṃ punaḥ pralaye tatraiva tirobhavanti | pañcādhikaraṇadarśanasthānāṃ sāṃkhyānāmayamāgamaḥ | itthaṃ cātra darśane sutarāṃ traiyadhvikatvamupapadyate, sarveṣāmapi triṣvapyadhvasu sañjārāt | prabandhapravṛtte jagati pūrvamatītānāṃ vartamānatā nāsti | jagatparivarte'pi na tadevāvartate, api tu tatsadṛśamityatītaśaktervartamānaśaktivirodhaḥ pūrvamuktaḥ | iha tu `nābhavo vidyate sataḥ' iti tirobhāvaṃ punastadevāvartate iti darśanāntaraṃ kathyate | tadevaṃ dharmardhārmaṇoḥ kathaṃcid vyatirekamabhyupagamya sthāyī dharmī vartamāno dharmāstu tryadhvāna itīdaṃ darśanamuktam || 53 ||
idānīṃ dharmadharmiṇoravyatirekaṃ bhāvikamāśrityā dharmiṇo yugapadapi vyapadeśatrayaṃ dharmadvārakaṃ pravartate iti mahābhāṣyamatamāha | yugapadvartamānatvaṃ taddharmā pratipadyate | keṣāṃcidvartamānatvāccaiti tadvadatītatām || 54 ||
te atītavartamānānāgatarūpā dharmā yasyāsau taddharmā dharmī yugapad ekavārameva vartamānatvam sāṃpratikatvaṃ pratipadyate | dharmasya vartamānātvāt tadvyatirikto dharmī tathā vartamānatvācca anantarāmapi atītatāṃ tadvad vartamānatvavad eti yugapadevātītatāmapyāsādayati | kasyaciddharmasyātītatvāttada vyatirikto dharmītyarthaḥ | evaṃ kasyaciddharmasyānāgatatvādanāgatatāmapyeti | tadevaṃ dharmī yathāyī bhāvataḥ sadaiva vartamāno'pi dharmatraividhyāt sakṛdapi tryadhvā vyavahriyate | avyatiriktāśca saṃniveśavaddharmā ityanyatra sthāpitam || 54 ||
nanvatītavartamānayorvirodhāt kathamekatra samāveśa ityāśaṅkyāha | hetūrakārādākṣipto vartamānatvamāgataḥ | śāntahetupakāraḥ san punarnopaiti darśanam || 55 ||
yadā saṃrabdhā hetavaḥ kāryopakāramārabhante tadā tatsāmarthyājjāyamāno bhāvo darśanapathamavatarannarthakriyāḥ sampādayan vartamāna iti vyapadiśyate | uparatakāraṇavyāpārastu dānāgataḥ | ityekasyāpi paropādhiprakalpito vyapadeśabhedo'viruddha ityarthakriyāsadasattva nimitto vyapadeśabhedaḥ | nanu yadevārthakriyākāri tadeva paramārthasadityatīte'dhvani tadabhāvāt kathaṃ sattvam | na vayamarthakriyākāri tadeva paramārthasadityatīte'dhvani tadabhāvāt kathaṃ sattvam | na vayamarthakriyānimittaṃ sattvamupemaḥ, api tu svarūpeṇa santaḥ padārthāḥ | svarūpaṃ caiṣāṃ guṇatrayamayam | tasya ca nityasya nāsti vināśaḥ | sarvatra sarvadānugamāt, vītapañcakena sādhitatvāt | taduktam-- `tadetat trailokyaṃ vyakterapaiti, na sattvāt' iti || 55 ||
atītānāgatayoradhvanorbhāvasyādarśanaṃ samānamabhipretya kecit saṃkṣeparucayaḥ kālasya śaktidvayameva pratibandhābhyanujñāparyāyamabhyupayantītyāha | dve eva kālasya vibhoḥ keṣāṃcicchaktivartmanī | karoti yābhyāṃ bhāvānāmunmīlananimīlane || 56 ||
prāk‌pradhvaṃsābhāvayorbhāvasyādarśanamaviśiṣṭamiti ekaiva tatkāriṇī kālasya sarva bhāvagrahiṣṇurūpasya śaktiḥ pratibandhalakṣaṇā | dvitīyātvabhyanujñālakṣaṇā bhāvābhāsavidhāyinī sarvabhāva prabhaviṣṇurūpasya | tadevaṃ kālattvaṃ vyākhyātam || 56 ||
atra tu kecid vipratipadyante-abhinnena kālena vyavahartumaśakyatvād ya eva tadbhedopādhiḥ kriyādiḥ parikalpyate sa eva vyavahāranimittaṃ kimadṛśyamānenānupapannena kālātmanā kṛtyamiti vadantaḥ | yadi ca parikalpitarūpeṇa kālena vinā vyavapahāradausthyaṃ tadīdṛśamastu kālatattvamiti | taddarśanenāha | kālābhiḥ pṛthagarthābhiḥ pravibhakte svabhāvataḥ | kecid buddhyanusaṃhāralakṣaṇe te pracakṣate || 57 ||
bhinnāḥ kriyāḥ saṃkalanābuddhyānusaṃhriyamāṇāḥ saṅkalpyamānāścirakṣiprādivyapadeśasya nimittaṃ bhavanti, evamahorātrādivyapadeśasya | tathā ca buddhyā saṃkalanamātramevābahustattvaṃ cirādikālarūpaṃ vilakṣaṇameva vyavatiṣṭhate | tathāhi cirakālasyāvāntarapravibhāgena bhinnā eva kalāḥ svāṃśāḥ parikalpyante | evaṃ kṣiprakālasyāharādikālasya ca | na tu kriyāpādhivaśādayaṃ cirādibhedaḥ | pūrvoktanayena buddheḥ svayaṃ bhedāt | sa eva ca svaviṣaye saṅkalpyamāne kriyāsantāne samāropyate | buddhidharmo hi viṣayarūpānupātīti dṛṣṭametat | viṣayabhūtalakṣaṇagatāspattvamahattvavaśena cirādibhāvo buddhisaṅkalanasya kālarūpasya vyavahriyate ityetāvat kālatattvam || 57 ||
nāstyanyo bāhyaḥ kaścit kāla iti bauddhaprāyāḥ | bhavatvevaṃ nāsmākaṃ vipratipattiratretyāha | jñānānugataśaktiṃ vā bāhyaṃ vā satyataḥ sthitam | kālātmānamanāśritya vyavahartuṃ na śakyate || 58 ||
jñāne buddhāvanugatāstadākārāḥ śaktayaścirakṣipravartamānādibhedarūpā yasyāsāvelaṃvidho buddhyanusaṃhāramātrasvabhāvo vāstu kālo bāhyo vā kaścit pravibhaktavartamānādiśaktiḥ pāramārthiko dravyapadārthaḥ | nāsmābhirdarśanavivekaḥ prārabdhaḥ, kintu śābde vyavahāre yadaṅgaṃ, tatparīkṣyam | asti ca bhinnakālaḥ śābdo vyavahāro'bhūdasti bhaviṣyatīti | tatra yathāyogamavicāritaramaṇīyaḥ kālo'bhyupagantavya ityarthaḥ || 58 ||
tathā hi kaiścid bhāvebhyo vyatirikta eva kālo'bhyupagata ityāha | tisro bhāvasya bhāvasya keṣāñcid bhāvaśaktayaḥ | tābhiḥ svaśaktibhiḥ sarvaṃ sadaivāsti ca nāsti ca || 59 ||
pāramarṣanaye satatapariṇāmiṣu bhāveṣu sattvarajastamasāṃ śaktimātramatītādikālabhedasamākhyam | tathā ca sarveṣāṃ bhāvānāṃ guṇatrayamayatvācchaktitrayayogitve yathāyathaṃ śaktyudbhavānudbhavābhyāṃ sadasattvena vyavahāraḥ || 59 ||
tathā hi | sattvādavyatirekeṇa tāstisro'pi vyavasthitāḥ | kramastāstadabhedācca sadasattvaṃ na bhidyate || 60 ||
bhāvādavyatiriktāstā eva śaktayaḥ kramaḥ ityucyante | āvirbhāvatirobhāvau hi vartamānādiśaktisamanvayavaśād bhāvāḥ pratipadyamānāḥ kramarūpamātmani darśayantīti śaktayastā eva tātparyataḥ kramaḥ | avyatireke'pi ca bhāvācchaktīnāṃ sadā bhāvavadavasthāne'pi vṛttivaicitryāt saṅkaro na bhavati | darśanādarśane hi tatrāsāṃ vyāpāraḥ | sa ca vilakṣaṇaḥ | tadvaśādeva ca sadasattvavyavahāra iti so'pi bhāvatado na vibhidyate | atītānāgatāvasthasya hi darśanamapravṛttaṃ na sattvamiti darśanābhāva evāsattvavyavahārāt sattvasya ca tadānīmapi vidyamānatvāt sadasattvaṃ na bhidyate || 60 ||
yataḥ darśanādarśanenaikaṃ dṛṣṭādṛṣṭaṃ tadeva tu | adhvanāmekatā nāsti na ca kiñcinnivartate || 61 ||
vartamānaśaktyā prakāśanaṃ darśanaṃ saṃvedanam, atītānagataśaktibhyāṃ tu tirodhānamadarśanamasaṃvedanam, tayo parasparaparihāreṇāvasthānād naikatvamiti kāryabhedādadhvabheda eva na saṅkaraḥ | yatpunastadvastu dṛṣṭaṃ sadadṛṣṭamatītaṃ ca tadekameva dharmirūpam, dharmāṇāmāgamāpāyābhyāmapi dharmiṇastattvādapracyuteḥ | ataścātra bhāvadabhinnānāmapyadhvanāṃ vartamānādirūpāṇāṃ kāryasāṅkaryābhāvādekatvasaṅkaro nāsti | yataśca sadrūpamatyantaniranvayadhvasaṃ nopapadyate, tirobhāvamātraṃ tu | tataḥ sadasattvaṃ na bhidyate, sattvādasattvasya bhedo nāsti, sattvameva hi tirobhūtamasattvamiti vyavahriyate, na tvabhāvo nāma kaścinnirūpya ityarthaḥ | taduktaṃ pātañjale-- "[na] dharmī tryadhvā dharmāstryadhvānaste tallakṣitāstāṃ tāmavasthāṃ prāpnuvanto'nyatvena pratinirdiśyante" iti | tathā cānāgatalakṣaṇaṃ hitvā varmānalakṣaṇaṃ pratipanno na cānāgatātītābhyāṃ viyukta iti || 61 ||
idānīṃ yathāsambhavaṃ kālatattve matāntarāṇyupasaṃharati | śaktyātmadevatāpakṣairbhinnaṃ kālasya darśanam | prathamaṃ tadavidyāyāṃ yadvidyāyāṃ na vidyate || 62 ||
kālākhyā svātantryaśaktirbrahmaṇa iti tatrabhavadbhartṛharerabhiprāyaḥ | vyākhyātārastu kāraṇaśaktireva kāla iti vyācakṣate | tathā hi bījaśaktiraṅkuropajanamabhyanujānatīkāṇḍaprasavaṃ ca tadānīṃ pratibadhnatī kālakāryakaraṇāt kālaḥ | evamaṅkurādiśaktāvapi yathottaramanantarakāryajananād vyavahitakāryapratibandhācca kālatattvaṃ boddhavyam | etaccā yuktamiti lakṣyate | niyatakāraṇā hi bhāvāḥ svakāraṇasannidhāne bhavanti nāpyatheti kāraṇasāmarthyamevedam | tatra tu niyatakālatvāt sahakārī kālastadanya eva yuktaḥ | kāraṇaparamparayā bāvānāmutpadyamānānāṃ ca kramadarśanācca kramākhyā kālaśaktirbhāvopādhirityevopagantavyā | tataśca bhāvabhedāvabhāsane prabhuḥ sa eva tatra tadanuyāyikramāvabhāsane'pīti svatantrasya cidātmana eva jīvātmagateyaṃ śaktiḥ kālākhyā yuktā | tathā hyuktaṃ vākyapadīye'smābhiḥ | ata evaitaddarśanānuguṇadarśanāntaramāha-ātmā puruṣo jīva eva kāla eva jīvastasyaiva kramāvabhāsāt | sa hi yathātattvamarthān pratyetumasamarthaḥ svābhāsakālānusāreṇa tatra kramamadhyavasyati | tataśca tataḥ kālabhedapraklṛpteḥ sa evopacāreṇa kālākhyāṃ pratipadyate | sa eva hi kālaśaktiravidyāśaktisahacāriṇyāḥ phalabhūmiḥ | tadadṛṣṭādivaśenaiva ca bhāveṣu pratibandhābhyanujñe | anye tu vigrahavatīṃ mahāprabhāvāṃ devatāṃ kālatvena pratipannāḥ | atrāpi cidrūpasya brahmaṇaḥ saktirdevataiva sakalajagadgrāsaghasmaretyetadānuguṇyamevetīdamevātra siddhāntarūpaṃ darśanam | ata evaitat kāladarśanam-`avidyāyāṃ saṃsārahetubhūtāyāṃ prathamaṃ bhedavabhāsamayo hi saṃsāraḥ, bhedaśca deśakālābhyām, tatra ca kālabhedo jagat‌sṛṣṭerādyaḥ | akramā hi paśyantīrūpā saṃvit prāṇavṛttimupārūḍhā kālātmanā parigṛhītakrameva cakāsti iti kṛtanirṇayaṃ vākyapadīye śabdaprabhāyāmasmābhistata evāvagamanīyam | niṣkramaṃ hi brahmatattvaṃ vidyāmayamakālakalitamavidyāvaśāt kramarūpopagraheṇa yathāyathaṃ vivartate iti kālānuvedhāt padārthānāṃ krameṇa pratyavabhāso'nādisiddhajīvātmagataḥ, sarvasya bhedajātasyāvidyāmayatvāt | kāle'pi darśanabhedena yo'yaṃ vibhāgaḥ so'pyavidyāvijṛmbhita eva | āvirbhūtāyāṃ tu vidyāyāṃ sarvasya bhedaprapañcasyā pagamādayamapyapaiti | ataścātra yuktāyuktatayā vicāraṇaṃ prayāsamātraphalameva | vyavahāre sarvasyaivāsatyatayā tattvavyavasthayānu (sthānu?) papatterityatra tātparyārthaḥ | tadevaṃ janmavatāṃ padārthānāṃ vyavahāre kāla upayogīti sthitam | kathaṃ tarhi nityānāṃ śabdānāṃ kālakṛto hrasvatvādibhedaḥ | kalpita iti brūmaḥ | tad yathā ciramidaṃ kṛtaṃ kṣipramidaṃ kṛtamiti jñānayoḥ svataḥ samānakālatve'pi viṣayagatapracayāpacayābhyāṃ kālabhedapratibhāsa iva svātmani lakṣyate tathā hrasvādāvapi śabdatattvasya nityatvāt samānakālatve'pi samupacaritaḥ kālabhedaḥ || 62 ||
abhede yadi kālasya hrasvadīrghaplutādiṣu | dṛśyate bhedanirbhāsaḥ sa cirakṣiprabuddhivat || 63 ||
hrasvadīrghaplutāvṛttyā nālikāsālilādiṣu | kathaṃ pracayayogaḥ syāt kalpanāmātrahetukaḥ || 64 ||
vāstavehrasvādau kālasyābhede'pi cirakṣiprajñānavadupacarite kālabhede samāśrīyamāṇe hrasvasya punaḥ punaruccāraṇe nālikāyāḥ pānīyasrutiralpā, tatastribhāgādhikā dīrghasyoccāraṇāvṛttyā, tato'pi plutasya tribhāgādhiketi yo'yaṃ prakarṣasaṃbandhaḥ salilasruteḥ sa kathaṃ kalpanāmātrakṛtakālabhedāt svataḥ kālavibhāgaśūnyād hrasvādibhedād bhavet | hrasvādīnāṃ hyabhinnakālatā pāramārthikī, kalpitā tu bhinnakālatā | na ca kalpanākalpito'rtho'rtha kriyāsvanvayīti hrasvādisamuccāraṇe salilasrutirekarūpaiva syāt | ādigrahaṇādanyeṣāṃ bhāvānāṃ niṣpattibhedo hrasvādisamuccāraṇe dṛśyamāna udāhāryaḥ | tasmāttattvata eva bhinnakālā hrasvādayaḥ śabdā iti kāvavṛttyanurodhānnityatvavyāghāta ityarthaḥ || 63,64 ||
atra samādhiḥ | abivyaktinimittasya pracayena pracīyate | abhinnamapi śabdasya tattvamapracayātmakam || 65 ||
śabdasya hrasvādibhedabhinnasyāpi nityatvāt kālāvacchedābhāve'pi tadabhivyañjakadhvanigrāmasyopacayāpacayābhyāṃ kālabhedād vyaṅgyavyañjakayorbhedānavadhāraṇācchabde'pi kālabhedāva dhāraṇam | prākṛtā hi dhvanayaḥ śabdasvarūpasaṃbhedena śrūyamāṇāḥ svagataṃ kālabhedaṃ tatrāvabhāsayanti | na hi vyañjakadhvanivivekena śabdatattvagrahaṇam | antyena dhvaninā saha buddhau śabdo'vabhāsate' ityuktam | tataścābhivyañjakādhīnattvācchabdatattvopalambhasya yathāvyañjakaṃ taddharmaḥ svarūpaniveśyeveti bhidyate nālikāsalilasrutiḥ | ata eva taparastatkālasya  iti dhvanigatakālādhyāsādupapadyate | vaikṛtadhvanijanitastu vṛttibhedo na bhedaka iti nirṇītameva pūrvakāṇḍe | vakṣyate cāgre-- "sarvaśca hrasvadīrghānunāsikatvādidharmavrātaḥ śabdātmani vyañjakādhīnaḥ" iti | brahmakāṇḍa eva vistareṇoktam-- nādasya kramajanmatvānna pūrvo na paraśca saḥ | akramaḥ kramarūpeṇa bhedavāniva jāyate ||  ityādi | tadatra cirakṣiprajñānavannāyamasvarūpasamavāyī kālabhedo yenābhedasya bhāvikasya bāvāt kāryabhedo na syādityucyeta | api tu vyaṅgyavyañjakayoḥ śabdānādayoravivekena śrotṛbhirabhedādhyavasāyād vyañjakamantareṇa śabdasvarūpāvyavasthānādantaraṅgadhvaninihitaḥ kālabhedo vyavahārāṅgamevetyarthaḥ | na hi yathā jñānasya viṣayastathā śabdasya dhvanayaḥ | viṣayākārasya śatādyātmakasya jñānākārād vivekena saṃvedanācchabdadhvanīnāṃ cāvivekāt | pūrvapakṣe tu svarūpāniveśī gajanimīlitena bheda nirbhāsaḥ śaṅkitaḥ | tathā ca kāryabhedānupapattiścoditā || 65 ||
na kevalaṃ hrasvadīrghādāveva śabdatattvamabhinnaṃ yāvat sarvatraiva padavākyaviṣaya ityāha | evaṃ mātrāturīyasya bhedo dāśatayasya vā | parimāṇavikalpena śabdātmani na vidyate || 66 ||
mātrāyāścaturthasya bhāgasyāpacitataradhvanivyaṅgyasya, daśa avayavā yeṣāṃ te daśatayāḥ samudāyāḥ ṛgātmānaḥ teṣāṃ samūhasya dāśatayasya catuṣṣaṣṭyātmakasya vedarāśeḥ pracitataradhvanivyaṅgyasya kālaparimāṇabhedena viśeṣo nāsti | dvayorapi śabdayornityatvena samānatvād vyañjakagataḥ kevalaṃ kālabheda ityarthaḥ | tadyathā hastimaśakajñāne svarūpeṇaikarūpe'pyākāropaplavād vilakṣaṇe ivānubhūyete evaṃ śabdātmā sphoṭasvabhāvaḥ sarvatra padavākyaviṣaye'vilakṣaṇo'bhivyañjakabhedād vilakṣaṇa iva cakāsti || 66 ||
yadi tarhi dhvanibhedād hrasvādibhedaḥ kāryabhedābhidhāyivṛttibhedo'pi kathaṃ syāt | tataśca drutāyāṃ taparakaraṇe madhyamavilambitayorupasaṃkhyānaṃ kartavyaṃ syādityā śaṅkyāha | anuniṣpādikalpena ye'ntārāla iva sthitāḥ | śabdāste pratipattṝṇāmupāyāḥ pratipattaye || 67 ||
prākṛtadhvanibhirabhivyakte śabdatattdhe'nuraṇanarūpā ye paścātkālabhāvino dhvanayaḥ santānena vartante śrotrāntarāla iva sthitāḥ śīghrasantānavartanātte śrotradeśamanuprāptāḥ śabdapracayagrahaṇahetutāṃ śrotraguṇāt pratipadyamānā drutādivṛttibhedaṃ racayanti | tataśca te śabdatattvād bahirbhūtā na bhindanti tat | taduktam-- śabdasyordhvabhivyaktervṛttibhedaṃ tu vaikṛtāḥ | dhvanayaḥ samupohante sphoṭātmā tairna bhidyate ||  iti | vārtiṃke'pyuktam-- "siddhaṃ tvavasthitā varṇā vaktuścirāciravacanād vṛttayo viśiṣyante" iti | tadevaṃ janmavatāṃ kālenānavacchedād nityānāṃ śabdānāṃ tadanupapattiṃ codayitvā vya?ñjakagatatvena samarthitam || 67 ||
idānīṃ prakṛtameva kālasya paropādhikaṃ bhedavyavahāraṃ darśayati | viśiṣṭamavadhiṃ taṃ tamupādāya prakalpate | kālaḥ kalāvatāmekaḥ kṣaṇamāsartubhedabhāk || 68 ||
kalāvatāṃ sāvayavānāṃ anityānāṃ bhāvānāmavacchedakaḥ kālo niyatapadārthodayādyavadhiparigraheṇa lavamuhūrtādivibāgavyavasthāmāsādayati || 68 |. tathāpi naiṣā vyavasthā bhāvikītyāha | buddhyavagrahabhedācca vyavahārātmani sthiteḥ | tāvāneva kṣaṇaḥ kālo yugamanvantarāṇi vā || 69 ||
kṣaṇasantāno yāvān saṅkalanābuddhyaikatvena gṛhyate tāvānekaḥ kālo māsādirūpo vyavasthāpyate | apacayakāṣṭhāgatastu kṣaṇa ityupacayakāṣṭhāprāpto manvantaramityādīti bhāvato dravyabhūtasyaikatve'pi kālasya kalpaneyaṃ bauddhī | buddhyanusaṃhārakālapakṣe tu mukhyaiveyam || 69 ||
nanu nālikāsrutyā kṣaṇāhorātrādikālavyavahāra iti saivāstu kālaḥ, kimapareṇa tena kalpitenetyāśaṅkyāha | pratibandhābhyānujñābhyāṃ nālākāvivarāśrite | yadambhasi prakṣaraṇaṃ tatkālasyaiva ceṣṭitam || 70 ||
ghaṭikodaravartinaḥ payasaśchidrānniḥsarato yat kasyacid bhāgasya pūrvaṃ nissaraṇamaparasya tadaivānissaraṇaṃ tat kālakṛtaśaktipratibandhābhyanujñāsāmarthyam | anyathā gurutvādambho'vayavī samastāvayavavyāpī yugapannirgacchet | krameṇa tu nissaraṇāt kālo'tra savyāpāro vyatirikta iti nāmbhaḥsrutireva kālaḥ | tatparicchedikātsau | sā hi nimeṣa kriyayā prāṇapravāheṇa buddhikṣaṇasantānena vā paricchinnā tadaparakālaparicchedāyalam | nimeṣādirapi sūkṣmeṇa kramarūpeṇa kālena paricchinnā tadaparakālaparicchedāyālam | nimeṣādirapi sūkṣmeṇa kramarūpeṇa kālena paricchinna iti kramākhyā kālaśaktiḥ sūkṣmarūpānusyūtā sarvabhāveṣvaśakyapratikṣepānubhāyamānatvāt | sarvā hi saṃvit kramarūpācchuriteti akramaṃ paraṃ tattvamagnīṣomasvabhāvaṃ somasūryādirūpavivartadaśāvalambanenāvirataparivartaṃ prāṇināmanugrahopaghātāya jagadaṇḍavṛttimātanute | etacca vākyapadīye vistareṇāsmābhirnirṇītam || 80 ||
kālasya tarhyekarūpatvācchidrāpacayopacayābhyāmambhaḥsrutestadbhedaḥ kathamavadhāryata itcāśaṅkyāha | alpe mahati vā chidre tatsaṃbandhe na bhidyate | kālasya vṛttirātmāpi tamevāsyānuvartate || 81 ||
alpena nālikācchidreṇāmbhaḥsaṃbandhe sati kālasyavyāpāraḥ pratibandhābhyanujñālakṣaṇo na bhidyate | nāpi mahatā chidreṇāmbhaḥsaṃbandhe sati | evamapi ca kālātmābhinnarūpo'pitameva chidrasaṃbandham anuvartate | tadanuvartanāccāyamalpacchidre pratibandhābhyanujñābāhulyād dīrghaḥ kālo'vadhāryate | ayamarthaḥ | abhede'pyatra kālasya chidraviśeṣasaṃbandhopadhīyamāno bhedo'vadhāryata iti | ata eva ghaṭikāvaruddhamambho na patati | chidramuktaṃ tu patatīti kiṃ kālena kṛtyamiti na vācyam | mūlabhūtasya kālavyāpārasyāpratyākhyeyatvāt | ye evopahitapratinbadhābhyunujñe kāvakṛte te eva ghaṭikāvayavacchidrābhyāmanuvidhīyete | yathā bījasyāṅkurajananapratibandhābhyānujñe kālakṛte kusūlakṣetrābhyāṃ poṣyete | ata evātmāpi tamevāsyānuvartate ityuktam | dṛṣṭasya hi kāraṇasya kāla śakteśca parasparamānuguṇyāt sahabhāvānnaikatarāvalambanenetarapratikṣepo nyāyyaḥ || 81 ||
kiṃ bahunā, svaśaktivaicitryādabhinno'pi kālātmā sarvatra bhāveṣu bhedamādarśayatītyāha | ākrīḍa iva kālasya dṛśyate yaḥ svaśaktibhiḥ | bahurūpasya bhāveṣu bahudhā tena bhidyate || 82 ||
kālamukhaprekṣitvād bhāvānāmasau prabhuretairākrīḍairākrīḍamānastadunmajjananimajjane ḍolādikrīḍāvat sampādayan vartamānādirūpavaicitryeṇa svasāmarthyādhyāsitamātmabhedamuddarśayati || 82 ||
tathā hi | tvacisārasya vā vṛddhiṃ tṛṇasārasya vā dadhat | tāvad tadūvṛddhiyogena kālatattvaṃ vikalpate || 83 ||
tāvat eva tat‌parimāṇameva kālatattvaṃ pratibandhābhyanujñāmātrahetvabhinnaṃ vaṃśasya veṇoḥ krameṇa phalaprasavaparyantāṃ vṛddhim upacayaṃ sampādayat tato'dhikatarāṃ tālasya vṛddhiṃ janayat tena vṛddhisaṃbandhabhedena bhāveṣvākrīḍabhūtena bhidyate | tathā ca vaṃśasya vṛddhiparyantaḥ kālo'lpaḥ tālasya tu bhūyānavatiṣṭhate | evamanyatrāpi bhāveṣu janmasthitivināśāvasthābhedasaṃbandhena kālavibhāga udāhāryaḥ || 83 ||
yadi tarhyavasthābhedāt kālabhedaḥ avasthāvināśādapi tasya vināśe nityatvaṃ na syādityāśaṅkyāha | vyatikrame|ñapi mātrāṇāṃ tasya nāsti vyatikramaḥ | na gantṛgatibhedena mārgabhedo'sti kaścana || 84 ||
kālādhikaraṇatvādbhāvānāṃ tadavasthānāṃ cāpagame'pi nādhārāpagamaḥ | yathā gantṝṇāṃ tadgamanānāṃ coparame'pi mārgo'dhvā nāpaiti | kriyāvyuparamādeva hi vasantādikāloparamo vyavahriyate param | na vastutaḥ kālo'paiti, nityātvāt || 84 ||
tathā hi | udayāstamayāvṛttyā jyotiṣāṃ lokasiddhayā | kālasyāvyatipāte'pi tāddharmyamiva labhyate || 85 ||
sūryādisañcāropanītavibhāgaḥ kālātmeti tadapagamādevānapayannapi vyayagata ivāvadhāryate gatamaho vyuṣṭā rajanī nirgataḥ śiśira iti || 85 ||
yataśca jyotirgatyā kālanānātvavyavahāraḥ tataḥ saiva kāla ityārvāgdarśanāḥ kecinmanyanta ityāha | ādityagrahanakṣatraparispandamathāpare | bhinnamāvṛttibhedena kālaṃ kālavido viduḥ || 86 ||
udayavadhirastamayāvasānaḥ sūryasañcāro divasaḥ | astamayādirudayaparyavasāno rātriḥ kālaḥ | sa ca pañcadaśāvṛttiḥ pakṣaḥ | triṃśatkṛtvo māsaḥ | candramasaḥ sakalanakṣatrātikramo māsa ityevaṃ vā kalpanā | bṛhaspaterekarāśisañcaraṇaṃ saṃvatsaraḥ | evamanyeṣāmapi grahanakṣatrāṇāṃ jyautiṣaśāstraprasiddhena gatipracārabhedena yukagamanvantarakalpamahākalpādipravibhāgaḥ kālo'nusartavyaḥ || 86 ||
tadevameṣāṃ kriyā kālaḥ prasiddhā satī kriyāntaraprasiddhaṃ parimāpayatītyāha | kriyāntaraparicchedapravṛttā yā kriyāṃ prati | nirjñātaparimāṇā sā kāla ityabhidhīyate || 77 ||
sūryādīnāṃ gatipracāro divasādiśabdavācyaḥ, godohādikriyāviśeṣaśca paricchinnaparimāṇatvāt tadaparāprasiddhaparimāṇāsyādikriyāviśeṣaparicchedahetutvāt kālākhyāmāsādayati | divasamadhīte, rātrimadhīte, godohamāste | kriyāntarapariccheda pravṛttā ityanenaiva gatatvāt kriyāṃ prati iti punarvacanamapekṣābhedena kriyāyāḥ kālatvāniyamakhyāpanārtham | tathā cānyataḥ prasiddhaparimāṇo godohanādirapi devadattādigatāsyādikriyāḥ paricchindan bhavatyeva kālaḥ || 77 ||
antarmukho'pavarakāntargataḥ sūryādisañcāraṃ nālikāstrutiṃ cānavadhārayan kathaṃ kālapravibhāgamavaitītyāha | jñāne rūpasya saṃkrāntirjñānenaivānusaṃhṛtiḥ | ataḥ kriyāntarābhāve sā kriyā kāla iṣyate || 78 ||
antarmukho'pi prakṛtāṃ kāñcideva prāṇapravāhādirūpāṃ kriyāṃ buddhau saṃkrāntākārāmavaiti | buddhyantaraiśca tān buddhiniveśinaḥ kriyākṣaṇān saṅkalayati | tathā ca bāhyakriyābhāve'pi buddiniveśinīyaṃ kriyā bāhyāparakriyāparicchedakatvāt kāla ityucyate | tathā hi bhūyasīnāṃ buddhīnāmudaye bāhye cirakālatvamavaiti, alpīyasīnāmudaye kṣiprakālatvamiti prāṇacāreṇa kalayantyevārthān yoganaḥ, anye'pi prāṇakṣaṇagaṇanayeti prasiddhametat | tathā hi ṣaṣṭyuttaraśatatrayāvadhiprāṇapracāranālikākalanayā sahasrāṇyekaviṃśatiḥ ṣaṭśatāni cāhorātragaṇanāmāhuḥ || 78 ||
yadi tarhi kriyātirikto nāsti kālaḥ tadā sattākhyāyāḥ kriyāyāḥ sattāntareṇa kriyābhūtena yogābhāvāt bhūtā satteti kathamucyata ityāśaṅkyāha | bhūto ghaṭa itīyaṃ ca sattāyā eva bhūtatā | bhūtā satteti sattāyāḥ sattā bhūtābhidhīyate || 79 ||
bhūto ghaṭa ityatra kasya bhūtatvam | na tāvad ghaṭasya, tasya dravyātmakatvāt kālenāsaṃsparśāt | kriyāṇāṃ sādhyasvabāvānāmadhikaraṇabhūtena kālena saṃbandhāt | dhātuvācyā tu sattākhyā kriyā bhūteti niṣṭhāpratyayenāvedyate | sā tu sattātra ghaṭasamavāyinīti pāramparyeṇa ghaṭena sambandho na tu sākṣād dravyakālayoḥ vyatiriktakāladarśane 'pyasti saṃbandhaḥ | kriyāmukhastu saḥ | evaṃ bhūtā sattā ityatrāpi śābdena dhātuvācyānyā sattā kriyārūpā, anyā ca prātipadikavācyā dravyāyamāṇeti sattāntarayoge dhātuvācyasattābhūtatvadvāreṇaiva dravyāyamāṇasattābhūtatvasampratyaya iti na kācidanupapattirityarthaḥ | nityāyā api sattāyāḥ svāśrayopadhānena bhede sati tad‌dvāreṇa trikālayogo'viruddhaḥ | gatametat || 79 ||
idānīṃ kālasvarūpe nirṇīte tadāśrayaḥ śāstre vyavahāro vicāryate | `vartamāne laṭ'  ityatroktam "nityapravṛtte ca kālāvibhāgāt" iti | nityeṣvartheṣu kālavibhāgābhāvād vartamānatvānupapatteḥ śāsitavyā bhavantī | nanu ca sampratitanatvaṃ vartamānatvaṃ bhūtabhaviṣyat‌pratiyogi | nityeṣu cāvicchedena pravartamāneṣu bhūtabhaviṣyatorabhāvāt sutarāṃ tadupapattiḥ | atrocyate | iheme kālanimittā vyapadeśāḥ parasparavyāvṛttaśarīrāḥ kālakṛtopakārāṇāmeva bhāvānāṃ yuktāḥ | te ca janmavantaḥ | tatra hi niyatāvadhijanmaparigraheṇaitadupapattiḥ | tathā hi sādhanasannidhāne'bhimukhotpattyo bhāvinaḥ | sādhanādavāptajanmāno yāvadavasthānāṃ vartamānāḥ vyapagataśarīrā bhūtāḥ | tadayaṃ vartamānavyapadeśo bhūtabhaviṣyadavadhimadhyavartī yatra bhūtabhiviṣyantau na staḥ tatra naiva sambhavati | taduktaṃ bhāṣye bhūtabhaviṣyat‌pratidvandvo vartamānaḥ... iti | yatra hi bhūtabhaviṣyantau tatra tatpratiyogī vartamāna ityarthaḥ | nityeṣu ca bhūtabhaviṣyatorabhāvāt tadabhāvaḥ | prakramāpekṣayā ca bhavantī śiṣyetyuktam | sarvaṃ eva tu kālapratyayāḥ śiṣyāḥ | ata evāha `kālāvibhāgāt'.... iti | evaṃ ca kṛtvātra kālāvacchedābhāvāt kālopādhirūpā kriyaiva nāsti | sā hi kālopādhiḥ sakramā sādhyamānasvabhāvā | tadabhāvaścātreti kriyākārakopādhinibandhanā sarvaiva vyavastā vaktavyetyuktaṃ bhavati | atra parihāra uktaḥ | `santi ca kālavibhāgaḥ'  iti | sthāsyanti parvatāstiṣṭhanti, asthuriti | punaścoditam-- `kiṃ śakyanta ete śabdā prayoktum iti santi kālavibhāgāḥ |" iti | ayamabhiprāyaḥ | kālavibhāgādevaiṣāṃ śabdānāṃ prayogo'siddha iti codye kathameṣa eva niścāyakaḥ kathyata iti | ata uktam-- `nāvaśyaṃ (śabda) prayogādeva' iti | pūrvāparībhūtasyākhyātāt pratīteḥ śabdapramāṇakānāṃ tata evārthavyavasthānād bhavedapi śabdaprayogaḥ kālavibhāgo pramāṇaṃ kintvavadhīryāpi tamatrārtha eva kālavibhāgaḥ pratipādyata ityarthaḥ | tadāha-- "bhūtabhaviṣyadvartamānānāṃ rājñāṃ yāḥ kriyāstāstiṣṭhateradhikaraṇam"  iti | etadbhāṣyaṃ vyācaṣṭe-- parato bhidyate sarvamātmā tu na vikalpate | parvatādisthitistasmāt pararūpeṇa bhidyate || 80 ||
parvatanadyādīnāmapi nityānāmaparatatsahacaritapadārthagatasattopāśrayeṇa sattābhedāt kālabhedopapattiḥ | sarvameva hi bhāvajātamupādhisaṃsargavaśena bhidyate na tu svarūpeṇeti `bhinnā iti paropādhiḥ'  ityuktameva | rājñāṃ hi kriyāḥ parvatādisthiterbhedakatvād āśrayatvena vyavahriyante | yathā hi rājakriyāṇāṃ traikālyaṃ kramikatvaṃ sādhyamānatā ca tathā tatsahacaritānāmapi parvatādīnāṃ sthitestadadhyāropa iti gauṇastrikālaviṣayaḥ prayogo'tropapanna iti nyāyyā bhavantī || 80 ||
athavā rājakriyāsāhacaryeṇa vartamānā sthitiḥ pratyavasthamāśrayopakāramanubhavantī parvatādīnāṃ svayameva bhidyate | sahacaritakriyābhedena tu bhedastasyāḥ sārūpyādanadhigatasatattvo jñāpyata ityāha | prasiddhabhedā vyāpārā virūpāvayabakriyāḥ | sāhacaryeṇa bhidyante sarūpāvayavakriyāḥ || 81 ||
visadṛśasvabhāvā avayavakriyā yeṣāṃ vyāpārāṇāṃ te pacibhidikriyārūpāḥ prasiddhabhedā bhinnakālā vilakṣaṇā eva pratītāḥ | adhiśrayaṇādāyo hi pacyavayavā vilakṣaṇāḥ, evamudyamanādayo bhidyavayavāḥ | ye tu sadṛśāvayavakriyāvyāpārāḥ parvatāderātmabharaṇalakṣaṇasthitirūpāḥ te sādṛśyādeva duravadhārabhedā rājakriyābhirviṃsadṛśasantānābhiravadhṛtavibhāgābhiḥ sahacaritābhiḥ kālabhinnā jñāpyante | ataśca tā rājakriyāḥ paricchedakatvādādhārabhūtāḥ parvatādisthiteḥ kālatvena vyavahriyante | sūryādisañcāraviśeṣopalakṣyamāṇabhedāścāpi parvatādisthitayaḥ rājakriyāṇāmupalakṣaṇatvāt | prasiddhatarā hi rājñāṃ kriyā bhāṣya uktāḥ | ādhārāvaṣṭammena sthiteḥ pratikṣaṇamupajanāt samāśritakramatve kriyātvamapyaviruddham | tathā hi `janmaivāśritasārūpyaṃ sthitiḥ'  ityuktam | nityānāmapi cādhāreṇa pratikṣaṇaṃ dhriyamāṇatvamavikalpitapaurvāparyameva janmasamākhyāṃ pratipadyate | śābde ca vyavahāre śabdārtho'rtha ityākhyātāt sakramaḥ pratīyamāno'rthaḥ kriyālakṣaṇamanupatatyeva || 81 ||
uktamidaṃ vārtike "pravṛttasyāvirāme śiṣyā bhavantyavartamānatvāt" iti | pravṛttakriyasya mukhyaphalānavāpteryadā virāmo na bhavati, atha ca kriyāntarārambhāt sā pravṛttā kriyātītā, tadā vartamānapratyayo vaktavyaḥ | iha vasāmaḥ | iha puṣyamitraṃ yājayāmaḥ iti | kriyāntare pravṛtto yājayannapyevaṃ prayuṅkte dakṣiṇādimukhyaphalānavāpteśca yājanābhisandheravirataḥ | atra samādhiruktaḥ `nyāyyā tvārambhānapavargāt' iti | mukhyasya phalasyānabhinirvṛttestatparyantātvācca kriyāyāḥ kriyāntaravyavadhāne'pyanapavṛktaiva kriyeti vartamānapratyayo bhavantī nyāyyā | athāntarā kriyāntarairvicchedādavartamānatvamabhimatamatra cakāsti tadā `asti ca muktasaṃśaye virāmaḥ' ityuktam | bhuṅkte ityādāvapi hi vartamāne nissaṃśayo'styevāvāntarakriyāvyavadhiḥ | tathā hi "so'pyavaśyaṃ bhuñjāno hasati jalpati pānīyaṃ vā pibati |" iti bhāṣya uktam | tadetad vyācaṣṭe | vyavadhānamivopaiti nivṛtta iva dṛśyate | kriyāsamūho bhujyādirantarālapravṛttibhiḥ || 82 ||
na ca vicchinnarūpo'pi so'virāmānnivartate | sarvaiva hi kriyānyena saṅkīrṇevopalabhyate || 83 ||
pūrvāparībhūtāvayavasamāhārātmako bhujyādikriyāsamūho'ntarālapatitābhirhāsasaṅkathanādikriyābhiratītānāgatalakṣaṇānāṃ vyavadhānamiva prāpnoti | tṛptiphalatvācca bhujerekaḥ santāno vyavasthita eveti ivaśabdaḥ na hi samūhavyavadhānam, api tu kṣaṇānām | na ca tāvanmātraṃ kriyāsvarūpam | anāgatāvayavābhāvaṃ cābhipretyātītāvayavakalpanayā nivṛtta iva sa kriyāsamūho dṛśyate | evamapi cāntārālakriyābhiravayavadvāreṇa vicchinnasvabhāvo'ḍasāvā phalaprāpteranuvartanādavirato'vasthita eva vartamānasvabhāvaḥ | na kevalaṃ bhujyādireva, yāvaddhāsasaṃkathanādirapi kriyāntarairvyavadhīyatā eva | akṣinimeṣāde (dibhi?)rapi vyavadhānam, antataḥ praśvāsocchāsāderapi bhāvāt | viśramya viśramya ca kriyārambhāt saṅkīrṇeva na tu sarvathā saṅkīrṇā, ā phalaprāptervirāmābhāvāt | antarālakriyāṇāmavaśyaṃbhāvinīnāṃ sahakāritvasyāyogāt | sandarśanādiphalaparyantaḥ kṣaṇasamūhaḥ kriyā | tatra ca bhautikavyāpāroparame'pyantarā sandarśanaprārthanādermānasavyāpārasya yāvat phalādhi gamastāvadavirāma eva | evaṃ bhojanāderapyaviratatvād vartamānatā siddhā || 82,83 ||
evaṃ tāvat phalāvasānaḥ samūhaḥ kriyeti phalāntarahetukriyāntaravyavadhānamupetyāpi vartamānatvaṃ samarthitam | yadvāntarālapravṛttaṃ kriyāntaraṃ bhinnajātīyameva na bhavatītyāha | tadantarāladṛṣṭā vā sarvaivāvayavakriyā | sādṛśyāt sati bhede tu tadaṅgatvena gṛhyate || 84 ||
tasyā bhujyādikriyāyā madhyavartino ye kriyābhedā hasitādayaste bhujyāderavayavā eva, guṇavyāpārarūpā ācamanādivadupakārakatvāt | tataścācamanādibhiḥ sādṛśyāt satyapi hāsādīnāṃ kvacidasannidhāne'pi bhujinirvṛtteḥ prasiddhatarairdadhyupasecanādibhiraṅgairbhede bhūjyaṅgatvena grahaṇaṃ yathā dvipuruṣavāhye bhāre tṛtīyasyopanipatataḥ | tuśabdo'pyarthe | suhṛdohi nirvṛtacetasaḥ parasparaṃ hāsasaṅkathanādi kurvāṇā eva bhujiṃ pratipadyante | tadevamatra pratyavayavaṃ kriyāsamāptimādikarmaṇi "nyāyyā tvādyapavargāt " iti niṣṭhāsamarthananyāyenābhipretya pūrvapakṣaḥ pravṛttaḥ | phalaparyantakriyāsamūhāśrayeṇa tu siddhānta iti sthitam || 84 ||
idānīṃ sarvatraiva vartamānatvaṃ kriyāyā anupapannamityākṣipati | sadasad vāpi vastu syāt tṛtīyaṃ nāsti kiñcana | tena bhūtabhaviṣyantau muktvā madhyaṃ na vidyate || 85 ||
sādhyamānāvasthā kriyā bhaṇyate | tatra ca yaḥ kṣaṇo'tītaḥ sa san siddhasvabhāva iti kriyā tatrātītā | yaścāsan sa sādhyaḥ sa bhāvī kṣaṇa iti tatra bhaviṣyadupādhikā kriyā | na cānyo'sti kaścit kṣaṇaḥ sadasadubhayarūpaḥ | viruddhasvabhāvasyaikatvavirodhāt | tataśca vartamānatā dhātvarthaviśeṣaṇaṃ nopapadyate | taduktaṃ bhāṣye anāgate na patasi kṛtsno lokaḥ patatyayam | himavānapi calati iti | parokṣā kriyā phalenānumīyamānatītatvāt kathaṃ vartamānapratyayenocyeta | eva himavānuparidṛṣṭasaṃyogavibhāgakriyākāryaḥ kasmānna patatīti vartamānapratyayena vyapadiśyetetyarthaḥ || 85 ||
sādhyamānāvasthatvameva kriyāyāḥ svena rūpeṇa sattvaṃ vartamānatvamiti cedāha | nirvṛttirūpamekasya bhedābhāvānna kalpate | sadasad vāpi tenaikaṃ kramarūpaṃ kathaṃ bhavet || 86 ||
ekasyārthātmano vibhāgābhāvānniṣpattirūpaṃ kramarūpatvaṃ kriyālakṣaṇaṃ nāsti | tathāhi sadvā vastu syād asadvā | tatra sad vidyamānatvādevānirvartyamā (nama?) nāśritakramarūpam, asadapyasattvādeva tadavasthāyāmanāśritanirvṛttirūpaṃ kathaṃ kramikaṃ syāt | na hyasataḥ sarvadharmaśūnyasya kaścit kramaḥ | tṛtīyarāśyabhāvācca nirvartyamānaṃ kramikaṃ kriyārūpaṃ nāstīti kathaṃ tad vartamānaṃ syāt || 86 ||
athocyate | bahavaḥ kṣaṇāḥ samāśritapauvāparyāḥ kriyeti sā phalopajanāt prāg vartamānatāmāsādayediti | tadapi na | yataḥ bahūnāṃ cānavasthānādekamevopalabhyate | yathopalabdhismaraṇaṃ tatra cāpyupapadyate || 87 ||
kramajanmāno'vayavā viprakīryamāṇasvabhāvāḥ, na yugapatkālabhāvinaḥ | tataśca sannihita eka eva kṣaṇaḥ samulabhyata iti tasya bhedābhāvāt kramābhāvaḥ | atha bahavaḥ kramikā yugapat smaryanta ityucyate, tadapi na | yasmādanubhavapūrvakaṃ smaraṇamekasya ca kramānubhavo na vṛtta iti kathaṃ smaraṇamapi tatra kramāvedakaṃ syāt || 87 ||
na cāpi bahūnāmekakriyātmakatvaṃ yujyata ityāha | sadasadrūpamekaṃ syāt sarvasyaikatvakalpane | nirvṛttirūpaṃ nirvṛtteḥ sāmānyamathavā bhavet || 88 ||
atītānāgatānāṃ sadasadrūpāṇāṃ kṣaṇanāmekakriyātmatvābhyupagame sarvasya vastunaḥ sadasardūpamayaṃ viruddhamekatvaṃ prasajyeta | na caitadyuktaṃ viruddhānāmanubhavenaikatvabādhāt | yadvā bahūnāṃ bhinnānāmekatvavirodhāt kaścidanvayī svabhāva ekaḥ kalpayitavyaḥ | tathā ca nirvṛtteḥ niṣpadyamānāyāḥ sādyasvabhāvāyāḥ kriyāyāḥ nirvattirūpaṃ niṣpattiyogyatvaṃ pratyekaṃ kṣaṇānāmekakriyātmakatvarūpaṃ sāmānyaṃ bhavet | tathā caikā kriyā na sidhyedityabhiprāyaḥ | bahūnāṃ hyanvayī kaścit svabhāvo'ṅgīkṛtaḥ kriyātmā, na tu bahava ekā kriyeti kriyāvyakterabhāva eva | bhinnānāmeva hi kṣaṇānāṃ nirvṛttirūpānvayo na tu pratyekaṃ kriyāvyaktisvabhāvatā teṣāṃ sidhyati | tataśca kathaṃ vartamānāḥ kriyāḥ || 88 ||
atra samādhimāha | kāryotpattau samarthaṃ vā svena dharmeṇa tat tathā | ātmatattve gṛhyeta sā cāsmin vartamānatā || 89 ||
ihaikatvaṃ kriyāyāḥ kṣaṇasamudāyarūpāyāḥ kalpitam | tathā hi-ekaphaloddeśena pravartamānā niyatapaurvāparyāḥ kṣaṇāḥ kriyeti phalābhedādasāvekā evaṃ yathāyathaṃ phalabhedena bhidyate kriyā | atra ca sadasatve'pi kṣaṇānāṃ vartamānatopapadyata eva | na hi sattvaṃ vartamānatālakṣaṇaṃ kintu prārabdhāparisamāptatvam | tacca yāvataḥ kṣaṇasamūhasya phalāvadhipravṛttiḥ tāvataḥ prāk phalopajānadabhedenādhyavasitasyāstyeva | kāryotpattau ca sa eva samarthaḥ | sa ca manovyāpārapūrvabhāvī kāyavyāpāraparyantaḥ sādhanasaṃrambhaphalānumeyaḥ | tatra ca svena kramātmakena dharmeṇa yuktaṃ tatsamūharūpaṃ yad ātmatattvena ātmīyena vidyamānena svabhāvena gṛhyate tadā tasyaivaṃvidhasya yeyaṃ vidyamānatā sā vartamānatā | vā--śabdo vakṣyamāṇāpekṣayā vikalpadyotakaḥ | ayamarthaḥ | niyatapaurvāparyaḥ samūhastāvat kramikaḥ | tasya ca sadasadrūparakatve'pi phalāvadhi parasparamadhyastakramaḥ svakāle sannihita ekaiko'pi kṣaṇo vartamānatāmanubhavati | yadyapi ca nāsāvekaḥ kramika iti na kriyā tathāpyaparakṣaṇagataḥ kramaḥ tatrānubhavavāsanayā niścīyata eveti na kaścid doṣaḥ | taduktaṃ bhāṣye kriyāpravṛttau yo hetustadarthaṃ yad viceṣṭitam | tada pekṣya prayuñjīta gacchatītyavicārayan || iti | phalakāmanā mānaso vyāpāro bhautikakriyāpravṛttau hetuḥ | kriyārthaṃ viceṣṭitaṃ sādhanānāṃ saṃrambhaḥ | sāmānyaviśeṣabhāvena ca tadarthatā | evañca mānasavyāpārapūrvakaḥ kāyavyāpāraḥ phalāvasāno'bhedenādhyavasito vartamānakriyāsvabhāvaḥ svavācakaśabdapratipādya iti sphuṭamuktam || 89 ||
vāśabdasūcitaṃ pakṣāntaramāha | kriyāprabandharūpaṃ yadadhyātmaṃ vinigṛhyate | saṅkrāntabimbamekatra tāmāhurvartamānatām || 90 ||
pūrvaṃ kṣaṇasamūhasyaikatvamekaphaloddeśena samarthitam | idānīṃ saṅkalanābuddhyupārūḍhasya buddhyākārarūpatvena bhāvikamekatvamucyate | tathāhi-viprasṛtāvayavaḥ kriyākalāpo jñānasvabhāve saṅkrāntākāra ekasmin yadāvadhāryate tadā tasmādekajñānādabhedāt tadvad vartamāna ekaśca niścīyate | krameṇānubhūtānāmapi ca saṅkalanā bhavatyevānubhavavāsanāyāḥ ptyāsannatvāt | anyathā samudāyādivijñānābhāvaḥ | anubhavapūrvakatvaṃ hi smaraṇasya niyataṃ na tu krameṇopalabdhaṃ yugapanna smaryate, śatādipratyayābhāvaprasaṅgāt | buddhyākārasya ca bahīrūpatayādhyavasāyāda bāhyamekaṃ vartamānaṃ kriyārūpaṃ vyavahriyate | tatsiddhau ca tadapekṣayātītānāgatasiddhirnānyatheti siddhaṃ kriyāyāḥ kālatrayaviśeṣaṇam | gatamadaḥ || 90 ||
iha kriyātipattau lṝṅ‌vidhāne bhūtabhaviṣyantāvupādīyete | tayoranupapattiṃ codayati | kriyātipattiratyantaṃ kriyānutpattilakṣaṇā | na ca bhūtamanutpannaṃ na bhaviṣyattathāvidham || 91 ||
`yadi kamalakamāhvāsyanna śakaṭaṃ paryābhaviṣyad' iti kamalakāhvānaśakaṭāparibhavanalakṣaṇāyāḥ kriyāyā atipattiḥ sādhanaśaktivaikalyānniyatānutpattiḥ | na cānutpannaṃ kriyāsvarūpaṃ bhūtaṃ bhaviṣyad vā śakyate vyavasthāpayitum | utpannasya hi satttātikramo bhūtaḥ, samarthaṃsādhanasannidhāne sambhāvitotpattiśca bhaviṣyan | atra ca sādhanābhāvāt sambhāvitāpi notpattiḥ | ata evātyantagrahaṇenānutpattirviśeṣitā || 91 ||
atra bhūtabhaviṣyad‌vyavahāraṃ samarthayate | prāgviruddhakriyotpādānnirvṛtte vā virodhini | vyāpāre'vadhibhedena viṣayastatra bhidyate || 92 ||
yadi kamalakamāhvāsyanna śakaṭaṃ paryābhaviṣyadityaparibhavasya nimittaṃ samarthasādhanāhvānaṃ bhaviṣyadasambhāvayannevamabhidhatte | evaṃ cāhnānavirodhinaḥ kamalakadeśāntaragamanādaparibhavavirodhinaḥ śakaṭagurutabhārāropācca pūrvamapratidvandvino bhaviṣyattve kālasyāpekṣyasya bhedād avacchedāt kriyātipatterapi bhaviṣyadviṣayo vibhajyate | śakaṭa paribhavasya kriyārūpasya niṣpattiḥ kamalakāhvānābhāvāt, tadāhvānaṃ ca deśāntaragamanānna sampatsyata iti tasya bhaviṣyato'sambhāvanāyāmatyantānutpattilakṣaṇasya kriyātipattirūpasyāpi bhaviṣyattā | yadi hi samarthasādhanāhravānaṃ bhaviṣyati tadā kriyā saṃpatsyate iti tasyā bhaviṣyattve tadatyantābhāvo'pi bhaviṣyan | tathā yadi sa tena brāhmaṇārthinādṛṣṭo'bhaviṣyadutābhokṣyatāpyabhokṣyata, na tu bhuktavānityatrābhojanasya bhojanapratidvandvino vyāpārasyātītatvāt kriyātipatterapyavadhibhedādatītaviṣayatayā bhūtatvena vyavahāraḥ | gatametat || 92 ||
idānīṃ kālaprasaṅgenāyathākālapratyayavidhānārthaṃ dhātusaṃbandhe pratyayāḥ . iti sūtraṃ vicārayati | vyabhicāre nimittasya sādhutvaṃ na prakalpate | bhāvyāsīditi sūtreṇa tat‌kāle'nyatra śiṣyate || 93 ||
iga yathāsvaṃ niyata eva kāle pratyayā vihitā iti svakālavyabhicāre kālāntare teṣāṃ sādhutvaṃ na syāt | tadyathā `bhāvyāsīt' `agniṣṭomayājyasya putro janitā' ityādau bhāvīti bhaviṣyatkāle pratyayo'nvākhyātaḥ āsīditi bhūtakālena saṃbandhaṃ na yāyāt | tathā agniṣṭomeneṣṭavān iti bhūte pratyayo'nvākhyāto janiteti bhaviṣyat‌kālena saṃbaddho na syāditi sūtrārambhaḥ | dhātūnāṃ svataḥsaṃbandhābhāvāt tadartho'tra dhāturityuktaḥ | bhedādhiṣṭhānatvācca saṃbandhasya vṛttau anekasaṃkhyāntarbhāvaḥ | sādhanadvāreṇa ca dhātvarthāntaṃ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvalakṣaṇaḥ saṃbandhaḥ | pratyayādhikārācca pratyayaparigrahe siddhe'dhātvadhikāravihitapratyayasyāpi matupo vartamānakālasattopādhiparityāge kālāntare'pi sati dhātusaṃbandhe sādhutvaṃ yathā syāditi punaḥ pratyayagrahaṇasya prayojanamuktaṃ bhāṣye `gomānāsīt, gomān bhaviteti' iti | tadetat sūtraṃ vārtike pratyākhyātam `dhātusaṃbandhe pratyayasya yathākālavidhānāt siddham'  iti | yathāsvaṃ kāleṣu pratyayāḥ padasaṃskāradarśane vihitā ityantareṇāpyetat sūtraṃ siddhamiṣṭamityarthaḥ || 93 ||
atrocyate | svakāla eva sādhuścet kālabhede gatiḥ katham | vākyārthādatadartheṣu viśiṣṭatvaṃ na sidhyati || 94 ||
bhāvyādiśabdasya svakāle saṃskāre'ṅgīkriyamāṇe satyāsīditi prayogasaṃbandhe kālāntarapratītiḥ kutastyā | atrāpyuktaṃ vārtike iti | `upapadasya tu kālānyatvam'  iti upapadasya viśeṣaṇasya viśeṣyasaṃbandhāt tatkālatvaṃ vākyādavasīyata iti vākyārtho'sau padasaṃskāravelāyāmasaṃnihito nāṅgam | etad vyācaṣṭe | so'rtho vākyārthaparyālocanāhamyo yeṣāṃ padānāṃ na bhavati teṣu atadartheṣu vākyārthāyogyārtheṣu satsu vākyārthasya tairava(ranava?)cchedād viśiṣṭatvaṃ na bhavati | tathā ca bhāvītyasya bhūtakālānupādānād āsīdityanena saṃbandhābhāvād vākyārtho viśiṣṭo nāvatiṣṭheta | tasmādekavākyatāvaśād viśeṣyakālānuvṛttau viśeṣaṇasya siddhāyāṃ nārthaḥ sūtreṇetyarthaḥ || 94 ||
pratyuta sūtrāraṃbhe vivakṣito'rtho na pratīyetetyāha | tadarthaścedavayavo bhāvino bhūtatāgatiḥ | na syādatyantabhūtatvamevaikaṃ tatra sambhavet || 95 ||
yad yasmād vacanādbhāvi kṛtyamāsīd ityādau vākye'vayavo bhāvītyādirviśeṣaṇabhūtaḥ, pradhānabhūtākhyātaviṣayabhūtakālābhidhāyī vyavasthāpyate tadā bhaviṣyataḥ kṛtyasya yā bhūtakālatā pratipipādayiṣitā sā na vijñāyeta | kevalamāsīdityanena bhūtatāyāgamitāyā api bhāvītyanena punaḥśrutitulyenāvadhāraṇaṃ pratīyeta | tathā ca yadidaṃ kṛtyaṃ kartavyarūpaṃ vastu tadāsīdeva bhūtameveti vākyārtho'vatiṣṭheta | na caiṣa vivakṣitaḥ | tasmāt svakāla evānvākhyānāt vākyārthaparyālocanād bhāvino bhūtatāgatiḥ sidhyati | vivakṣitā bhāvyavasyāpyasya kṛtyasyātītā | sampratīdaṃ vartamānaṃ jātam | traiyadhvikā hi padārthāḥ pūrvamupapāditāḥ | tathā ca bhaviṣyadadhvano'tītādhvapraveśo nyāyyaḥ | yathoktaṃ bhagavatā vyāsamuninā | avaśyaṃbhāvinaṃ nāśaṃ bhāvitvād vidhyupasthitam | ayameva hi te kālaḥ pūrvamāsīdanāgataḥ || iti || 95 ||
nanvevaṃ svakāle'nvākhyātasya vākyārthāt kālāntarāvahatāvapyupāttakālatyāgaprasaṅgaḥ | na prasaṅga ityāha | viśiṣṭakālatā pūrvaṃ tathāpi tu viśeṣaṇe | āśrayāt so'ntaraṅgatvāt tatra sādhurbhaviṣyati || 96 ||
padāntarasaṃbandhāt pūrvaṃ bhāvyādiśabdasya viśiṣṭa eva svakāle vyutpāditatvāt sādhutvam | viśeṣaṇe'pi ca tasya padāntarasaṃbandhe tathaiva viśiṣṭakālatā | yasmādajahadeva svakālayogaṃ tatra viśeṣyakālamanuvartate | bhāvino hi bhūtatā | ataśca yo'sāvāśritaḥ svakālaḥ saṃskāranimittatvena tasya pūrvamevāśrayaṇādantaraṅgatve sati tatraiva sādhuḥ śabedo bhāvyādiḥ padāntarayoge'pi | na tu svakālatyāgaḥ, tadgatatvenaiva vākyārthād viśiṣṭatāgateḥ | evamagniṣṭomayājyasya putro janitetyatra bhūtasyaiva bhāvitā vākyārthāt | sūtrārambhe tvatyantaṃ bhaviṣyattaiva gamyeteti pratyākhyātaṃ sūtram || 96 ||
vārtikābhiprāyeṇā kecittu samarthayante | kathamityāha | āmiśra eva prakrāntaḥ sa padārthastathāvidhaḥ | kevalasya vimiśratvaṃ nitye'rthe nopapadyate || 97 ||
iha prayuktānāṃ śabdānāmanvākhyānād vyavahārāya śabdaprayogād vākyameva tadaṅgamanvākhyeyam | tathā ca padāntarārthasamanvayayogyapadārthāpoddhārapūrvakaṃ padānāmanuśāsanād vākyāvadhike'nvākhyāne prathamata eva sarvaḥ padārtho viśiṣṭaḥ āmiśraḥ evopāttaḥ yādṛśo vākyaprayogādavasīyate | itarapadārthasamanvayanirapekṣaṃ tu padānuśāsane kevalasya pūrvamavasthi tasya paścāditarapadasamanvaye viśiṣṭatāyāṃ nityaḥ śabdārthasaṃbandho virudhyeta | sāmānyārthastirobhūto na viśeṣe'vatiṣṭhate | upāttasya kutastyāgo nivṛttaḥ kvātiṣṭhatām ||  ityādi cātra dūṣaṇamuktam || 97 ||
evaṃ sāmānyenābhidhāya etadeva prakṛte yojayati | śuddhe ca kāle vyākhyātamāmiśre na prasidhyati | sādhutvamayathākālaṃ tat sūtreṇopadiśyate || 98 ||
bhāvīti bhaviṣyati bhūtenāsaṃsṛṣṭe pratyayaḥ sādhuruktaḥ | sa bhūtasaṃsṛṣṭe na prāpnoti prathamamevāpekṣite | tasmāt sūtreṇa vyāmiśre kāle pratyayavidhānamupapadyate || 98 ||
viśeṣābhāvāt tarhi bhūtakālo'pyāsīditi bhāvītyetadbhaviṣyakālasaṃmiśre kasmāt sādhurna bhavatītyāha | ākhyātapadavācye'rthe nirvartyatvāt pradhānatā | viśeṣaṇaṃ tadākṣepāt tat‌kāle vyavatiṣṭhate || 99 ||
`bhūtaṃ bhavyāyopadiśyate' ityākhyātavācyā kriyā sādhyamānasvabhāvā sarvatraiva vākyārthabhūtā pradhānām | nāmapadavācyaṃ tu siddhasvabhāvaṃ kārakaṃ guṇabhūtam | pradhānānuyāyinaśca guṇāḥ | na tu guṇānuyāyi pradhānamityākhyātavācyenārthena svopakārāyākṣipto nāmapadavācyo'rtho guṇabhūtastatkālamanuvidhatte | evaṃ ca nyāyenaiva samanvayānyathānupapattyā (samanvayasyāpyupayattthā?) guṇapradhānasannidhāvekasmin vākye pradhānānuyāyitvāda guṇānāṃ pradhānānugrahāya tatkāla syāpi svakālāparityāgenaivānuvartanāt bhāvyāsīdityādiprayoge siddhe nārthaḥ sūtreṇeti | etaduktaṃ bhavati | āmiśratvaṃ hi sarvatra saṃbandhe sati padārthānāṃ yathāyogaṃ viśiṣṭamastyeva | kevalaṃ padāntaraprayogaṃ vinā na niścīyate tadityetāvatā sāmānye'rthe padaṃ vartate, viśeṣe'rthe vākyamityucyate | na tu tyāgagrahau kaucit || 99 ||
tathā vidhe cārthe padasaṃskārādāmiśre'pi prakrama eva vṛttaḥ saṃskāraḥ | na hi kālāntaravyatibhinne svakāle niṣedho'sti pratyayasya | tasmānnārtho'tra yatnenetyāha | sampratyayānukāro vā śabdavyāpāra eva vā | adhyasyate viruddhe'rthe na ca tena virudhyate || 100 ||
iha vacanenārthānāṃ svābhāvātikramābhāvāt kālāntare sādhutvānuśāsanamātrāt tatra pratītirnopapadyata ityakiñcitkaraṃ sūtram | saṅgitistu guṇapradhānabhāvena samanvayopapatteḥ pradhānakālānurodhanaikavākyatāvaśena darśitā | athavā yathāsvaṃ kāleṣviva saṃbandhe'pyete pratyayāḥ | adhyāropeṇa tu samanvayaḥ | tathāgniṣṭomayājītyanena bhūtaviśiṣṭa evārthaḥ pratyāyyate | janitetyetat‌saṃbandhe tu sa bhūtakālāvacchinno jñānākāro|ñanupapadyamāno viruddhe tasmin bhaviṣyati kāle adhyasyate samāropyate | yo'yaṃ bhaviṣyan kālo janituḥ tatra janmottarakālamagniṣṭomakaraṇayāgasamāptimāśrityādhunaiva bhūtakālo'yamupāttaḥ | tenāyamarthaḥ | so'sya putro janitā yo'gniṣṭomena yaṣṭeti | yadvā śabdasyāgniṣṭomayājītyasya vyāpāraḥ svārthābhidhānalakṣaṇo bhaviṣyati kāle'dhyasyate | utpatsyamānasyārthasyānena pratipādanānupapatterbhāvī vyāpāro'sya | so'sya putro janitā yo jāto'bhivṛddho'gniṣṭoyamājītīmaṃ vyapadeśaṃ lapsyata ityarthaḥ | tadetaduktaṃ bhāṣye kadā caivaṃ vyapadekṣyate | yadāneneṣṭaṃ bhavati |  iti | taditthaṃ sampratyayānukāreṇa śabdavyāpāreṇa vā adhyasyamānena so'rtho viruddhatvābhimato na virudhyate | nāstyatra samanvayavirodha ityarthaḥ || 100 ||
etadeva nidarśanena vyutpādayati | bhūtaṃ bhaviṣyadityetau pratyayau vartamānatām | atyajantau prapadyete viruddhāśrayarūpatām || 101 ||
tadvastu bhūtaṃ bhaviṣyadanyad ityetau pratyayau jñāne samutpadyamānau svato vartamānakālāvapi viṣayayoḥ svakālaviruddhayorbhūtabhaviṣyatorākāraṃ dhārayato yathā evaṃ svakālāparityāgena kālāntare'dhyāropo'tra yukta ityarthaḥ | saṅ‌gṛhītasādhyānvayabhūtabhaviṣyadākārau hi pratyayau bhūtabhaviṣyadrūpatayā svākāramadhyavasyato'parityaktavartamānasvasaṃvedanarūpau | evamagniṣṭomayājīti sampratyayānukāro'pi svakālamajahadadhyāropaviṣayasya viruddhasya bhaviṣyata āśrīyamāṇasya rūpaṃ pratipadyate | na hyadhyasyamānaṃ svarūpaṃ jahāti gotvamiva vāhīke || 101 ||
idānīṃ kālaprasaṅgena vartamānasārūpyaṃ vicārayati | adhvano vartamānasya yaḥ śeṣo ya upakramaḥ | tad vartamānasāmīpyaṃ śāstre bhedena darśitam || 102 ||
āphalasamāpteḥ kriyāprabandho'vyuparato vartamānaḥ kāla ityuktam | tasya ca yaḥ śeṣaḥ samāptatve'pi saṃskārānuvṛttilakṣaṇaḥ tad bhūtaviṣayaṃ vartamānasāmīpyam | yaśca prārambho mānasaḥ saṅkalpo vartamānasya tad dvitīyaṃ bhaviṣyad‌viṣayaṃ vartamānasāmīpyam | tatra kāyavyāpārādarśanād vartamānatāvasāye bhūtabhaviṣyat‌svabhāve vartamānapratyayā atidiśyante | vāvacanāt pakṣe bhūtabhaviṣyat‌pratyayānāmanusāsanānnedaṃ vartamānameva sad bhedenopādīyate | atrāpi pūrvavat svakāla eva gacchāmītyādipadasya saṃskāraḥ | ato hi vartamānasyaiva pratītiḥ | padāntaraprayoge tu tatkāle'dhyāropaḥ | vāvacanāt pakṣe'dhyāropitarūpāśrayād bhūtabhaviṣyat‌pratyayā bhavantīti nārtho yatnena || 102 ||
prārthanāsvabhāvāśaṃsā pratītiviśeṣatvādū vartamānā pratyupasthitā kathaṃ bhaviṣyatkālāiti bhāṣye'bhihitetyata āha | aśaṃsā vartamānāpi viṣayeṇa bhaviṣyatā | bhāṣye bhaviṣyatkāleti kāryārthaṃ vyapadiśyate || 103 ||
jñānasvabhāvatvād vartamānakālāpi prārthyamānasya viṣayasyānāgatatvād viṣayadharmeṇa bhaviṣyat‌kālāśaṃsā vyapadiṣṭā | tathā ca bhūtapratyayalakṣaṇaṃ kāryaṃ bhaviṣyati viṣaye'tideṣṭuṃ yuktam || 103 ||
yadi viṣayadharmeṇāpi vyapadeśo bhavati tadeṣyamāṇasyānāgatatvādicchāpi bhaviṣyatkālā syāditi tatra cikīrṣatīti vartamānakālapratyayā apyatideṣṭavyā ityāśaṅkyāha icchā cikīrṣatītyatra svakālamanurudhyate | bhaviṣyati prakṛtyarthe tatkālaṃ nānurudhyate || 104 ||
cikīrṣatītyatra yeyamicchā sannantadhātuvācyā sā pradhānam | tadupasarjanabhūtā karotikriyā tadviṣayaḥ | tasyopasarjanasya bhaviṣyatkālatve'pi sanaḥ prakṛtibhūtadhātuvācyasya prakṛtipratyayau pratyayārthaṃ saha brūta iti sannantadhātuvācyāyā icchāyā vartamānatvāt sa eva kālo'nuvartya iti siddho vartamānapratyayaḥ | na hi pradhānaṃ guṇānanuvidhatta iti guṇabhūtakarotikriyākālānuvṛttiratra nāsti || 104 ||
āśaṃsāyāmapi svakālānuvṛttiḥ kathaṃ na bhavatītyāha | āśaṃsyamānatantratvādāśaṃsāyāṃ viparyayaḥ | prayoktṛdharma śabdārthe śabdairevānuṣajyate || 105 ||
yathecchā pratyayārthatvāt pradhānaṃ naivamāśaṃsā | na hi sā pratyayavācyā, api tu tadviṣaya evāśaṃsyamānaḥ pratyayābhidheyaḥ | prayoktṛdharmo hyāśaṃsā, na śabdārthaḥ | tathāhiupādhyāyaścedāgato vyākaraṇamadhītamevetyāśaṃsyamānamupādhyāyāgamanaṃ vyākaraṇādhyayanaṃ ca pratyayavācyaṃ tantraṃ pradhānamiti tatkālānuvṛttireva nyāyyā | etadāśaṃsinā tu prayok‌trā vākyamidaṃ prayuktamiti gamyamānatvamāśaṃsāyāḥ | kathaṃ tarhi prayoktṛdharma āśaṃsā śabdasaṃskāranimittam | śabdārtho hi śabdasaṃskāranimittaṃ nyāyya (nānya?) ityāśaṅkāyoktam prayoktṛdharmaḥ śabdārthe śabgadairevānuṣajyate iti | adhyāropyate prayoktṛdharmaḥ prayojyasya śabdasyābhidheye śabdenaiva | tasmin hi prayukte gamyate sa dharmaḥ prayoktarīti gamyamānatvādā bādhādivad yuktaṃ śabdasaṃskāranimittatvamasya | puruṣadharmeṣvapi hi śāstramadhikṛtamiti vicāritaṃ vākyapadīye | gatametat || 105 ||
iha vārtikakāraḥ papāṭha `aniṣpanne niṣpannaśabdaḥ śiṣyo'niṣpannatvāt'  iti | anirvṛtte kārye bhūtapratyayāḥ vaktavyā ityarthaḥ | tadyathā-- `devaśced vṛṣṭo niṣpannāḥ śālayaḥ' iti | niṣpannasadṛśārtho'niṣpanna iti paryudāsena yogyahetūnipāte sambhāvyamānaniṣpattirucyate | tenānāgatamātre bhūtapratyayā na bhavanti | aniṣpanna ityukte|ñapi cāniṣpannatvāditi hetupradarśanam | upacāreṇāyaṃ prayogo na veditavya ityarthaḥ | anāgatarūpeṇaivānupacaritātītāvasthena kāryamatra pratīyata ityupasaṃkhyeyo bhūtapratyaya ityarthaḥ | ata eva bhāṣyam-- `tatra bhavitavyaṃ niṣpatsyante śālayaḥ'  iti bhaviṣyat pratyayasyaiva yuktatāmāha | asya pratyāśyānam-- `siddhaṃ tu bhaviṣyatpratiṣedhāt' iti | `devaśced vṛṣṭaḥ sampatsyante śālaya' iti kenacidukte maivaṃ vocaḥ, sampannāḥ śālaya ityevaṃ brūhīti bhaviṣyadvācinaḥ śabdasya loke pratiṣedho dṛśyate | bhūtavācina eva tvamyanujñānamiti vārttikārthaḥ | tadetat kathaṃ bhavatīti vārtikābhiprāyamācaṣṭe-- apśālibījasaṃyoge vartate niṣpadiryadā | tatrāvayavavṛttitvād bhaviṣyatpratiṣedhanam || 106 ||
iha niṣpattirdhātvarthaḥ samagrasādhanasampattau phalopajano mukhyaḥ | sa yadāvayavamātre jalaśālisaṃbandhamātre'dhyāropyate tadā tāvanmātrasya varṣamātreṇa sampatteratīto dhātvartha iti siddhāṃ bhūtapratyayāḥ | bhavicyat‌pratyayānāmayamaviṣaya eva jalaśālisaṃyogasya niṣpatteriti bhaviṣyataḥ pratiṣedho yuktaḥ || 106 ||
yadā tu mukhya eva niṣpattyarthaḥ tadātra kathaṃ bhūtakālatetyāha | phalaprasavarūpe tu niṣpadau bhūtakālatā | dharmāntareṣu tadrūpamadhyasya parikalpyate || 107 ||
samagrasādhanasannidhānasādhye yadā niṣpattilakṣaṇe dhātvarthe phalajanmaparyante niṣpadirdhāturvartate tadā pūrveṣu kāryaniṣpatteparanyeṣu kāraṇāśriteṣu bījodakasaṃyogāhitātiśayeṣu dharmeṣu tat kāryaniṣpattirūpamadhyasyate | teṣāmatītatvāt phalaprasavasyāpyatītatā parikalpyata iti siddhā bhūtapratyayāḥ || 107 ||
prakārāntareṇopacāramāha | upayukte nimittānāṃ vyāpāre phalasiddhaye | tatra rūpaṃ yadadhyastaṃ tatkālaṃ tat pratīyate || 108 ||
sāmagrīsādhyatvāt kāryasya bahūni nimittāni sāpekṣāṇi janakāni | teṣāṃ phalajanmani yo vyāpāra upakārastasyopayuktatvāt phalasya yadrūpaṃ bhāvyapi tatra tasmin hetūpakārarūpaṃ tadadhyastaṃ tasya hetuvyāpārasyātītatvādatītakālatve tadabhedāpannaṃ tatphalamapi tatkālam atītakāsamavasīyate | pūrvaṃ kāraṇadharmeṣu phalasyādhyāropaḥ, iha tu phale kāraṇadharmāṇāmiti viśeṣaḥ | upacāraprayojanaṃ tu kāraṇānāmatra samarthataratvapratipādanam | etena ca `hetūbhūtakālasamprekṣitatvādvā' iti dvitīyaṃ pratyākhyānavārtikaṃ vivṛtam | nimittasya varṣasya yo'tītaḥ kālaḥ sa kārye'dhyasyate | kāraṇāntarāpekṣābhāvapratipādanāya pratīyata ityarthaḥ | niṣpannatve niṣpannakāryāṇi śālayaḥ kathaṃ tadānīmeva na kurvantīti codayitvoktam-- `anyadidānīmucyate' iti | yadyarthakriyākaraṇaṃ śālīnāṃ niṣpattiḥ tadā koṣṭhasthā api na niṣpannāḥ syuḥ arthakriyāyāṃ bhujilakṣaṇāyāmavahananādyapekṣaṇāt || 108 ||
atha hetūpakārasamāptimātrādhīnā niṣpattiḥ tadā yathāyathaṃ hetūpayoganiṣpattau niṣpattivyavahāraḥ siddha ityāha | niṣpattāvavadhiḥ kaścit kaścit prativivakṣitaḥ | hetujanmavyapekṣātaḥ phalajanmeti cocyate || 109 ||
iha kaścid bījasalilasaṃyodamātrādhīnāṃ niṣpattiṃ śālīnāṃ manyate | kaściduttarakālabhāvyātapādisaṃyogajanitopakāraparamparādhīnām iti niṣpattiheturanavasthitaḥ | kāraṇasya hyupakāraviśeṣakhyāpanāyaivamucyate | tatra ca prathamataranimittagatopakārādhikyakalpanāyāṃ nimittāntaravyāpārāpahnavena tāvata eva hetorjanmanaḥ phalajanmavyavahāraḥ | ātapādisaṃyogalakṣaṇahetujanmano veti tasyātītatvāt phalamapyatītatāvyavahārayogyam | eṣa copacārāśraya eva vyavahāro hetubhūtakālasaṃprekṣāyā iti narte'dhyāsād bhavatyasau | jalabījasaṃyogamātraṃ tu niṣpadivācyamāśritya pūrvaḥ parihāraḥ | atra niṣpadyarthoṃ gauṇaḥ | uttaratra tu parihāre niṣpadyarthoṃ mukhyaḥ | kāryakāraṇayostvabhedādhyāsaḥ | iti vikalpa upapannaḥ || 109 ||
sāmagrīsādhyatvāt kāryasya kathamekasādhanasampattimātre sampattiḥ syādityetat cocaṃ vicārayitumāha | abahissādhanādhīnā siddhiryatra vivakṣitā | tat sādhanāntarābhāvāt siddhamityupadiśyate || 110 ||
antaraṅge kasmiṃścit sādhane sannihite tato'nyasya bahirbhūtasya sādhanasyāpekṣā tiraskāreṇa vivakṣitaṃ sādhyaṃ sat‌kalpaṃ siddhameveti loke vyavahāraḥ prarūḍhaḥ | tadanusāreṇaiva ca śāstre vyavasthopapattiḥ | lokaprasiddhasyaiva śabdārthavyavahārasya śāstreṇānugamāt | tathā ca yathāvivakṣaṃ kālatrayayogenātra vyavahāraḥ siddha iti || 110 ||
nigamayati-- tasmādavadhibhedena siddhā mukhyaiva bhūtatā | anāgatatvamastitvaṃ hetudharmavyapekṣaṇe || 111 ||
niṣpattau yo'vadhiḥ kāraṇaṃ tasya bhedena yathābhedaṃ tatra kāryasyādhyāsāt tadvadatītatā mukhyā | kāraṇe hi kāryopacāraḥ, na tu bhūtasya kālasya | yadā tu hetvantarasya bhāvikāryajananavyāpāro'pekṣyate tadā mukhyenaiva rūpeṇānāgatatvaṃ bhaviṣyattvaṃ kāryasya | yadā tu hetvantarasya pratyāsannakāryajananavyāpāro vivakṣyate tadā vyāpāraprabandhasya phalāvadherekatvena pūrvottarasadavayavātmakasyāpi sattvāt vartamānatvamiti prayogatrayaṃ siddhaṃ niṣpannā niṣpatsyante niṣpadyante śālaya iti | gatametat || 111 ||
aparamapi vārtikakāraḥ papāṭha-- `astyarthānāṃ bhavantyarthe sarvā vibhaktayaḥ karturvidyamānatvāt'  iti | bhavantyā laṅ‌vibhakterarthe vartamāne kāle bhūtabhaviṣyadaryāstiṅ‌vibhaktayo vaktavyāḥ | vartamāne hi laḍeva syāt | tatra bhavantyartha ityukte'pi karturvidyamānatvāditi hetūpādānaṃ prayokālāvadhṛtaṃ sattvaṃ śabdanibandhanaṃ na tu vāstavamevetyetat‌pratipādanārtham | kūpo'bhūdabhavad‌ babhūva bhaviṣyati prayogakāle'pi kūpasya karturavinaṣṭasyaivopalambhādityarthaḥ | tathā caitad vyākhyānabhāṣyam-- `kūpo'naina kadācidavadhṛto na cāsyāpāyaṃ paśyati' iti vidyamānatvaṃ sampratyavadhriyamāṇatvameva vyācaṣṭe | atra pratyākhyānam-- `siddhaṃ tu yathāsvakālaṃ samuccāraṇāt' iti | ātmīyeṣveva kāleṣu yathāyogaṃ tiṅ‌vibhaktīnāṃ prayogo'yam na tu vartamāna eveti nārtha upasaṃkhyānenetyarthaḥ | etadeva sādhayitumuktam `avātvāt' iti | avikalpatvādeṣāṃ prayogāṇāmātmīya eva kāle samuccāraṇam | vartamāne hyeṣāṃ sādhutvopasaṃkhyāṃne tatraiva sarvāstiṅ‌vibhaktayaḥ paryāyeṇa dṛśyeran | na ca dṛśyanta ityuktam `asiddhaviparyāsaśca' iti | asiddhaṃ ca vaiparītyamityarthaḥ | na hi kaścit kūpo'bhūditi prayuyukṣite kūpo bhaviṣyatīti prayuṅkte | tasmādavikalpitāt prayogādasaṅkareṇa ca prayogād yathāsvaṃ kāle tiṅ vibhaktīnāmuccāraṇaṃ siddham || tadetat kathamupapadyata iti vārttikābhiprāyamācaṣṭe | satāmindriyasaṃbandhāt saiva sattā viśiṣyate | bhedena vyavahāro hi vastvantaranibandhanaḥ || 112 ||
iha padārthānāṃ sarvo vyavahāraḥ saṃsargidharmāntarācchuraṇenetyuktameva | tataścātra yeyaṃ kūpasattā sā gṛhītā satī śabdaprayogasya nimittabhāvamāpadyate, agṛhītāyā asat‌kalpātvāditi grahaṇopādhirvyavahāramavatarati | grahaṇaṃ cendriyārthasannikarṣanimittamiti pathi kūpasyendriyeṇa sannikarṣo yatra bhāvī tatra bhaviṣyantī sattā vyavahriyate | yatra tu bhūtaḥ saḥ, tatra bhūtā | yatra tu sampratitanaḥ tatra vartamāneti trikālaviṣayāḥ prayogāḥ sāmānyaviśeṣabhūtā api siddhāḥ | viprakṛṣṭe hīndriyasaṃbandhe'tīte bhūtaviśeṣaviṣayā laṅādayaḥ | viprakṛṣṭe cāgāmini bhaviṣyad‌viśeṣaviṣayā luḍādayaḥ || 112 ||
nanu ca yathā bhūtabhaviṣyad‌vibhaktayo vartamāna viṣayaṃ nāvagāhante tathā sāpi tadviṣayān nāvagāheteti kūpo'stīti prayogo bhūte bhaviṣyati cendriyasaṃbandhe na syādityā śaṅkyāha | astitvaṃ vastumātrasya buddhyā tu parigṛhyate | yaḥ samāsādanād bhedaḥ sa tatra na vivakṣitaḥ || 113 ||
indiyasaṃbandhāsaṃbandhanimittasya bhūtabhaviṣyallakṣaṇasya bhedasyāvivakṣāyāṃ manasā sanmātre kūpamabhisandhāyāstīti prayogaḥ sāmānyenātropapadyata ityarthaḥ | viśeṣāstu parasparavirodhinā na saṅkīryante || 113 ||
kiṃ vātraupādhikena sattāyā bhedena, tāttvika eva sattāyā bhedaḥ pratyavasthita ityāha | yogādvā strītvapuṃstvābhyāṃ na kiṃcidavatiṣṭhate | svasminnātmani tatrānyad bhūtaṃ bhāvi ca kathyate || 114 ||
"na kaścit svasminnātmani muhūrtamapyavatiṣṭhate,vardhate yāvadanena vardhitavyamapāyena vā yujyate" iti strīsūtre bhāṣyam | tatropacayaḥ puṃstvam, apacayaḥ strītvamiti liṅgasamuddeśe vakṣyati | `utpattiḥ prasavo'nyeṣāṃ nāśaḥ saṃstyānamiṣyate |'  iti | eva strītvapuṃstvābhyāmapacayopacayābhyāmajasrapravṛttibhyāṃ sarvabhāvānāṃ saṃbandha iti pratikalamanyonyarūpasadṛśaprabandharūpabhāvamadhye'vasthābhedagatastrikālayoga upapadyata eva tāttvikaḥ | ataścānyadevātikrāntendriyasaṃbandhaṃ bhūtaṃ rūpam, anyadeva ca bhaviṣyadindriyasaṃbandhaṃ bhāvi, anyadeva ca vartamānendriyasaṃbandham | abhedena tu buddhyā samīkṣya rūpasāmānyamastītiṃ vartamānapratyayavācyaṃ siddham || 114 ||
iti bhūtirājatanayahelārājakṛte prakīrṇakaprakāśe kālasamupaddeśo navamaḥ || 3,10ḥ puruṣasamuddeśaḥ 3,11ḥ saṅkhyāsamuddeśaḥ idānīṃ saṃkhyāṃ vicārayati | saṃkhyāvān sattvabhūto'rthaḥ sarva evābhidhīyate | bhedābhedavibhāgo hi loke saṃkhyānibandhanaḥ || 1 ||
bhedāpoddhāralakṣaṇā saṃkhyā ekādikā parārdhaparyavasānā | bhedaścedaṃ tad iti sarvanāmapratyavamarśayogyavastugataḥ | tathā ca sarva eva dravyātmārtho bhinna eko dvau bahava ityādisaṃkhyāyukto vyavahriyate | dvitvādikā saṃkhyā bhedamekatvasaṃkhyā cābhedamāśraye vyavahārayati | tathā ca kāryādasmād dravye saṃkhyā niścīyate | pṛthak‌tvavaśāddhi dravyāṇāṃ pṛthak‌tvena vyavahāraḥ, ekādivyavahārastu saṃkhyāvaśāt saṃsargavādibhirabhyupugamyate | vṛttāvapi ca sattvabhūta upasarjanārthaḥ saṃkhyāvānevāvadhāryate nissaṃkhyāvyayārthabhedena | saiva cābhedaikatvasaṃkhyā vyākhyāsyate | viseṣapratītinibandhanābhāvācca saṃkhyābhedo nāvadhāryate | yatra tvasti nibandhanaṃ śaurpikādau tatra bhavatyeva viśeṣāvasāya iti vakṣyata eveti sarva eva satvabhūto'rthaḥ saṃkhyāvānabhidhīyate iti vyāptisiddhiḥ | yatrāpi taddhitārthanirdeśādāvanaṅgaṃ saṃkhyā, tatrāpi nāntarīyakatayā sattvabhūtasyārthasya saṃkhyopādānaṃ bhavatyevetyasti vyāptiḥ | taditthaṃ satvabhūtasyārthasyaikatvānekatvabhedaḥ saṃkhyānibandhana iti || 1 ||
vaiśeṣikāṇāṃ dravyāśritā guṇātmikā saṃkhyā | na ca padārtha evāsahāya ekatvaṃ sasahāyaśca yathāyogaṃ dvitvādīti sahāyavirahatadyogayordharmāntaratvābhāvānna kaścidanyo dravyāt saṃkhyālakṣaṇo guṇa iti vyatiriktasaṃkhyābhāva iti vācyam | pratyayabhedāt | nyo hi sasahāyatāpratyayo'nyaśca dvau traya ityādipratyayaḥ | sasahāyeṣvapi caikatvapratyayo'stīti na tadviraha evaikatvasaṃkhyā | abādhyamānavilakṣaṇapratyayāveditasadbhāvā hi padārthā yathā yathaṃ bhinnasvabhāvā eva nyāyyāḥ | anekasaṃkhyā ca śatādikānekasmin dravye samavetāpekṣābuddhiprabāvitāvadhāryate eva vyāsajyavṛttiḥ saṃyogavibhāgādivat | na hyaneka dravyaṃ nāsti, tatra vā neyaṃ pratītiḥ | śatamityādikā kevalamanekāśrayatve'pi sāmānyād bhidyate | saṃkhyāsāmānyasya pratyāśrayaparisamāptatvādarthāntarāpekṣatvāttu saṅkhyāyā ityādivaiśeṣikoktayuktayo'nusaraṇīyāḥ | avyatiriktadharmavādinastvavyatiriktāmāśrayāt saṃkhyāṃ manyante | samavāyena tirohitabhedatvād vyatirekānavadhāraṇāccedaṃ matam | atrāpi taddarśitā yuktayo vācyāḥ | tathā hyatyantabhede tadviśiṣṭapratyayānudaya iti kālpanika eva bheda iti manyante || 1 ||
asmākaṃ tu śabdapramāṇakānāṃ padārthavicārānādarāt yathāyathaṃ padārthakalpanātīrthikaiḥ kṛtā | tāmāśritya lakṣaṇāṅgāḥ padārthā vyavasthāpyā ityāha | sa dharmo vyatirikto vā teṣāmātmaiva vā tathā | bhedahetutvamāśritya saṅkhyeti vyapadiśyate || 2 ||
saṅkhyālakṣaṇo dharmasteṣāṃ sattvabhūtānāṃ saṅkhyeyānāmātmaivābhinna eva vāstu, tebhyo vyatirikto vāstu | kimanena niṣprayojanenāsmābhirvicāreṇa, śabdārthasyeha vicārayituṃ prakramāt | śabdāccaiko dvau traya ityādibhedavyavahāre hetuḥ kaścid dharmo'vadhāryate | na hi padārthamātrādanupādhereva vyavahāro ghaṭate | sa ca dharmaḥ sañcaṣṭa iti saṅkhyetyanvarthena nāmnā vyavahriyate || 2 ||
yadi dravyāśritā saṅkhyā kathaṃ guṇādīnāṃ tannimitto vyavahāra ityāśaṅkhyāha | samavetā paricchedye kvacidanyatra sā sthitā | prakalpayati bhāvānāṃ saṅkhyābhedaṃ tathātmanaḥ || 3 ||
yā dravye paricchedye bhedahetuḥ saṃkhyā sā tatraiva samavetā guṇatvāt | yadā tu guṇādīnāṃ paricchedikā sā tebhyo'nyatra dravye'pi sthitā tatraiva tasyāḥ samavāyānnirguṇānāmapi teṣāmekārthasamavāyāt svanimittaṃ vyavahāraṃ vartayati | ātmano'pi ca saṃkhyā dravye'pi sthitā bhedaṃ vyavahārayati | tad yathā śataṃ śate śatānītyādi | nahi śatasaṃkhyāyāmekatvadvitvabahutvāni samavetāni virodhādadravyatvānnirguṇatvācca | eva dravyagatā saṅkhyā rūpādiṣu samāropyata iti `caturviśatirguṇāḥ' iti vyavahāraḥ | tathaiva `pañca kramajātayo dve sāmānye' ityādi | `tathā catvāro'bhāvāḥ' ityādirapi nirupākhyasyābhāvasya vastudharmāyogādaupādhiko bhedavyavahāraḥ | evañca gauṇamukhyabhedena vyavahāropapattestāvanmātrasya cehopayogāt tīrthikaparikalpitaprakriyānādareṇa bhedagaṇanamātralakṣaṇā saṅkhyā sarvatrāviśeṣeṇa varṇyate || 3 ||
dravyasamavāye'pi guṇādiṣu saṅkhyāyā bhedavyavahāranimittatve dṛṣṭāntamāha | paratve cāparatve ca bhede tulyā śrutiryathā | saṅkhyāśabdābhidheyatvaṃ bhedahetostathā guṇe || 4 ||
iha deśasaṃbandhāt paratvāparatvalakṣaṇau guṇāvapekṣābuddhiprabhāvitau dravye samavetātpadyete | tathā ca tābhyāṃ dravyaṃ paramaparamiti vyavahriyate | tadvadeva ca guṇādayo'pi parāparaśabdābhyāmabhidhīyante | tataśca yathātra guṇaviṣaye bhedavyavahāre tāveva dravyaguṇau savyāpārāviti paraḥ aparaḥ ityabinnamabhidhānaṃ tathā bhedahetoḥ dravyasamavetāyā eva saṅkhyāyā guṇādiviṣaye'pi tathaivaikādiśabdena vyavahāraḥ, na tvaparā guṇādāvekatvādikā saṃkhyā vidyata ityarthaḥ | deśena saṃbandhaḥ sākṣād dravyasyaiveti tannimittayoḥ paratvāparatvayordravya eva samavāyo niścita iti dṛṣṭāntopapattiḥ || 4 ||
kiṃ bahunā svāśrayadharmeṇāśritānāṃ vyavahāraḥ sarva eva dṛṣṭa ityāha | asvatantre svatantratvaṃ paradharmo yathā guṇe | abhedye bhedyabhāvo'pi dravyadharmastathā guṇe || 5 ||
dravyāśrayiṇi nityaparatantre guṇe paṭasya rūpamiti dravyadharmasvātantryaṃ yathā vyavapadiśyate tathā saṅkhyayā vyavacchettumanarhatve'pi tadavacchedyatvaṃ svātantryāvinābhāvī dravyadharmo yokṣyate paṭasya rūpamekaṃ dve trīṇītyādi | ayamatra bhāvaḥ | iha yadā śuklaḥ paṭa ityādirdravyopasarjanabhāvamāpanno guṇo'bhidhīyate tadāsau dravyasāmānādhikaraṇyāt taddharmeṇa samanvayaṃ sahata eva | dravyānniṣkṛṣya tu paṭasya śakla ityādyabhidhāne svātantryamātmīyaṃ dravyarūpamasaṃbhavīti svāśrayāyātaṃ tad vyavasthāpanīyam | tadeva ca śabdaśak‌tyānuvartate || 5 ||
tathā hi svabuddhyā tamapod‌dhṛtya loko'pyagamamāśritaḥ | svadharmādanyadharmeṇa vyācaṣṭe pratipattaye || 6 ||
na kevalaṃ vaiśeṣiko guṇasya dravyadharmeṇa vyavahāraṃ vartayati yāvad dravyādanyo dravye samaveto guṇa ityevaṃbhūtam | vaiśeṣikāgamamanuvartamāno loko'pi tasmād dravyādapoddhārabuddhyā taṃ guṇaṃ bhinnaṃ svatantraṃ niścitya dravyadharmeṇa saṃkhyāvattvādinā guṇadharmavilakṣaṇena paraṃ pratipādayati śabdaśaktimanusṛtya | tad yathā paṭasyedamekaṃ citraṃ rūpam | tadabhāvapakṣe tu pratyavayavamanekaṃ bhinnarūpameva rūpamityavayavini bahūni rūpāṇi || 6 ||
yadi vā śabdena saṃsargidharmācchuritasya vastuno'bhidhāne dravyaguṇādayastatra samānā ityāha | paropakāratattvānāṃ svātantryeṇābhidhāyakaḥ | śabdaḥ sarvapadārthānāṃ svadharmād viprakṛṣyate || 7 ||
pareṇānyena dharmeṇāpakriyamāṇamavacchidyamānaṃ tattvaṃ svarūpaṃ yeṣāṃ te paropahitopakārāḥ padārthāḥ śabdenābhidhīyanta iti vyavahāre sarvārthānāṃ dravyaguṇādīnāmanupādhi svarūpaṃ na śabdena spṛśyate | na hi saṃsargidharmaviviktā nijena śuddhena vāstavena rūpeṇa vyavahāramavatarantyārthāḥ | tathā ca dravyavad guṇo'pi paṭasya rūpamiti svātantryeṇābhidhīyamānaḥ saṃsargisaṃkhyādikṛtopakāra evābhidhīyate | śabdo hi na guṇānāmeva, api tu dravyāṇāmapyaparopādhikena rūpeṇopalakṣitānāṃ svadharmād vācakatvād dūrībhavati | sāmānyādyasaṃsṛṣṭe tasya sambandhavyutpatteḥ kartumaśakyatvāditi sarvatra śabdaḥ paropadarśitaviṣaya eva || 7 ||
artho'pi paropakārāhitaviśeṣa evetyatra dṛṣṭāntamāha | yathaivāviṣayaṃ jñānaṃ na kiñcidavabhāsate | tathā bhāvo'pyasaṃsṛṣṭo na kaścidupalabhyate || 8 ||
jñānaṃ bodhamātrasvabhāvaṃ niyamena vyavahārayogyaṃ viṣayapāratantryāt tatkṛtoparāgavivekenāśakyavyavahāraṃ yathā evaṃ jñeyamapi saṃsṛṣṭadharmoparāgarahitaṃ vastumātrarūpatayāpi jñeyatāmabhidheyatāṃ ca nāsādayatītyatra paropakāratantramevaitat || 8 ||
yadyevamidaṃ sāmānyaṃ bhinneṣvabhinnābhidhānapratyayanimittam , ayaṃ viśeṣo vyāvṛttipratyayaheturityevaṃ dravyasaṃsargaviviktaḥ kathaṃ vyavahāraḥ sāmānyādiṣu aparopādhestasyābhāvādityāśaṅkyāha | bhedena tu samākhyānaṃ yalloko'pyanuvartate | āgamācchāstrasadṛśo vyavahāraḥ sa varṇyate || 9 ||
sāmānyaviśeṣābhyāṃ dravyeṣvabhinnabhinnapratyayāviti niṣkṛṣṭasvabhāvānāmupādhīnāṃ nityaparatantrāṇāmapi bhedena svatantratayā pratipādanaṃ śāstre tāvadapoddhārāśrayeṇa yuktam | loko'pi śāstravāsanayā tadanugacchatīti vaiśeṣikāgamānusāreṇa vyavahāro laukikaiḥ pratanyate || 9 ||
tathā ca prasiddheratrāpi saṃsargidharmaparikalpanā nyāyyetyāha | buddhau sthiteṣu teṣvevamadhyāreṇo na durlabhaḥ | paradharmasya na hyatra sadasattvaṃ prayojakam || 10 ||
dravyānniṣkṛṣyāpoddhārabuddhayaivaṃ bhedena sāmānyādiṣu samākhyāne paradharmasya svātantryāviṣayasyopādhimattvasya adhyāropo na durlabhaḥ, buddhyā sarvanāmapratyavamarśayojyatāpādanādupādhimadrūpatāyāmupādhisaṃsargasya nyāyyatvāt | adhyārope ca vāstave sattvāsattve na prayojake yenopādhibhūte vastusati sāmānye viśeṣe ca svātantryābhāvāt kathamupādhiyogo'san kalpyata iti codyeta | atyantāvidyamāne'pi hi bahirarthe buddhyā samāveśo dṛśyate samudraḥ kuṇḍiketi yatheti kathañcid bahiḥ sattve dharmamātrāropo na virudhyate | ata evāsattvamapi yāvannādhyārope upayujyate | sato'pyasattvāropādaputro'yamitya(na?) tiśayakhyāpanārthamasattvamapyaprayojakamityuktam || 10 ||
yataśca svātantryeṇādhyāropastataḥ-- sāmānyeṣvapi sāmānyaṃ viśeṣeṣu viśiṣṭatā | saṅkhyāsu saṅkhyā liṅgeṣu liṅgamevaṃ prakalpate || 11 ||
gotvādisāmānyabhedeṣu buddhyāvasiteṣu anvayirūpaparikalpanayā sāmānyāntarayogo na virudhyate, dravyāyamāṇānāṃ buddhyā nirūpaṇāt | evaṃ viśeṣeṣu tathāva buddhyā dravyāyamāṇeṣvavasiteṣu viśeṣo viśeṣa ityabhinnābhidhānapratyayahetuḥ sāmānyaṃ parasparavyāvṛttapratyayahetuśca viśeṣo yujyate | dravyavad upādhimattvenāvasāyāt śatādisaṃkhyāyāṃ ca śataṃ śate śatānītyādiprātipadikena dravyāyamāṇāyāmabhidhīyamānāyāmanyā saṅkhyā dravyadharma evāropyate | strītvādiṣu ca liṅgeṣu tathaiva dravyāyāmāṇeṣu śabdenābhihiteṣu dravyadharmaliṅāntarayogaḥ pumān pauṃsnaṃ puṃsteti, gārgyāyaṇī kārīṣagandhyeti ca strītve'pi strītvāśrayo dvitīyastrīpratyayaḥ | tathā ca bhāṣyakāraḥ-- `bhāvo'pi bhāvena yujyate, strītvaṃ strītvena'  ityāha || 11 ||
tadevaṃ prāsaṅgikamabhidhāya prakṛtaṃ nigamayati | ato dravyāśritāṃ saṅkhyāmāhuḥ saṃsargavādinaḥ | bhedābhedavyatīteṣu bhedābhedavidhāyinīm || 12 ||
yato dravyagatayaiva saṅkhyayoktena nyāyena guṇādīnāmapi tannimitto vyavahāraḥ sidhyati, ato dharmāṇāṃ saṃsargamekatra dravye ye'bhyupayanti kāṇādāste dravyasamavetāmeva saṅkhyāṃ bruvate,nirupādhiṣu bhedābhedavyatikrānteṣu dravyeṣu guṇādiṣu ca bhedābhedapratyayanimittabhūtām | ekatvasaṅkhyā abhedapratyayanimittaṃ dvitvādikā bhedapratyayanimittamityarthaḥ || 12 ||
yadi tarhi svayaṃ bhedābhedavyatītāḥ padārthaḥ kathaṃ tebhyo'nyā saṅkhyā tāṃstathā vyavahārayedityata āha | ātmāntarāṇāṃ yenātmā tadrūpa iva lakṣyate | atadrūpeṇa saṃsargāt sā nimittasarūpatā || 13 ||
iha parasparaviviktāḥ padārthā dravyādayo yathālakṣaṇaṃ pramāṇena pratītāḥ | tatra cānyeṣāmapi dravyāṇām atadrūpeṇa guṇādīnāṃ(dinā?) yena saṃsargāt samavāyākhyāt saṃbaṃdhāt tadrūpa iva guṇādirūpa ivātmā lakṣyate samavāyena bhedatirodhānāt, sā ābhāsamātre paraṃ nimittasya guṇādeḥ sarūpatā | tasyeva rūpaṃ svabhāvo'syeti tatsvabhāvatā, na tu paramārthataḥ tatsvabhāvatvameva, yathāyathaṃ svapramāṇato bhinnatvāvedanāditi | paropadhānena vyavahāre'pi na padārthāḥ saṅkīryanta ityarthaḥ || 13 ||
kathaṃ na saṅkīryante, yāvatā tathaiva sarvadaivaiṣāmābāsa ityāśaṅkya kāryabhedād bhedamāha saṃsṛṣṭeṣvapi nirbhāge bhūteṣvarthakriyā yathā | sattvādiṣu ca mātrāsu sarvāsvevaṃ pratīyate || 14 ||
pṛthivyādiṣu bhūteṣu apṛthagbhāvena saṃsargaṃ prāpteṣu dhṛtisaṅ‌grahapaktivyhāvakāśadānalakṣaṇā arthakriyā yathā pratyekaṃ bhinnaiva, sattvarajastamolakṣaṇeṣu ca sarvabhāvagateṣvapi nirbhakteṣu prakāśapravṛttiniyamalakṣaṇārthakriyā vilakṣaṇā tathā dravyaguṇakarmasāmānyaviśeṣalakṣaṇāsvapi mātrāsu anyonyasāhacaryeṇāpi nirbhaktāsu vastubhāgarūpāsvavasthitāsu bhinnā evārthakriyā | tathā hi dravyaṃ guṇānāmāśrayabhāvenārthakriyākāri | guṇāstu dravye svarūpasamarpaṇena yathāyathamupayoginaḥ | evaṃ śeṣeṣvapi yathāyogaṃ vācyamiti nimittanimittinorarthakriyābhedād bhedasiddhiḥ svarūpasambhede'pi | idānīṃ saṃkhyā svarūpeṇa parīkṣyate | tatra dvitvadikā saṃkhyā kimekatvādanyā, nānyā vā | anyatve dvitvādīnāmekatvāpekṣotpattirna syāt | ananyatve'pi tu bhedo nirnibandhana ityata āha | dvitvādiyonirekatvaṃ bhedāstatpūrvakā yataḥ | vinā tena na saṅkhyānāmanyāsāmasti sambhavaḥ || 15 ||
tena ekatvena vinā anyāsām dvitvādīnāṃ saṃkhyānāṃ yataḥ sambhavaḥ utpattiḥ nāsti, ato dvitvādīnām ekatvaṃ yoniḥ kāraṇamiti tadapekṣya dvitvādyutpattiḥ, na tu tadabhinnā dvitvādikāḥ saṅkhyāḥ kathaṃ tena vinānyāsāmasambhava ityatra yuktiḥ bhedāstatpūrvakā yataḥ iti | abhedapūrvakā bhedā iti sahajamekatvaṃ bhāvānāmādyam | dvitvādayastu tatpūrvakāḥ padārthāntarasaṃnnidhau jāyanta iti dṛṣṭam || 15 ||
ekatve buddhisahite nimittaṃ dvitvajanmani | ekatvābhyāṃ samutpannamevaṃ vā tat pratīyate || 16 ||
prathamamindriyasaṃyuktayordvavyayorye ekatve samavete tadāśritaṃ yat sāmānyaṃ tat saṃyuktasamavetasamavāyādindriyārthasannikarṣāt pratīyate | atastadviśeṣaṇāvacchinnayorekatvaguṇayorjñānaṃ, tadapekṣe te ekatve svāśrayapadavyasamavetaṃ dvitvaṃ janayataḥ | dravyadvayaṃ hi dvitvasya samavāyikāraṇam, ekatvaguṇāvasamavāyikāraṇam, kāryaikārthasamavāyalakṣaṇayā laghvyā pratyāsattyā | apekṣābuddhirnimittakāraṇam, na hyapaśyata ekatve dvitvabuddhirityanvayavyatirekābhyāṃ buddheḥ kāraṇatvaniścayaḥ | samavāyitvaṃ ca dravyasyaiva, pratyāsattyabhāvāccāsamavāyitvamapi nāstīti nimittakāraṇaṃ buddhiravasthāpyate | samavāyyasamavāyivyatiriktaṃ hi kāraṇaṃ sāmānyasamākhyayā nimittamityucyate | tadevaṃ kāraṇatritayājjāte dvitve prathamaṃ tatsāmānyajñānaṃ tatastadguṇajñānaṃ tatastadviśiṣṭaṃ dve dravye iti jñānamiti kāṇādanayaḥ | "nāgṛhītaviśeṣaṇā hi viśeṣyabuddhiḥ" iti teṣāmāmnāyaḥ | anyetvekatvabuddhyordvitvapariccheda evānvayavyatirekābhyāṃ vyāpāravadhāraṇādekatve buddhinirapekṣe eva dvitvaṃ janayataḥ | tathā ca jātamekatvabuddhipūrvakaṃ gṛhyata iti manyante | prakriyābhedo'tra granthagauravabhayānna pradarśyate | prathamakāṇḍa eva tu kathitaḥ || 16 ||
dvitvasya rūpe'pi matabheda ityāha | ekatvasamudāyo vā sāpekṣe vā pṛthak pṛthak | ekatve dvitvamityevaṃ tayordvivacanaṃ bhavet || 17 ||
ekatvābhyāṃ nāpūrvaṃ dvitvaṃ janyate | api tu tayo samudāyo vanayūthādivadavayavābhinno dvitvam | tathā cāvayavāśrayastatra bhinnākarāvabhāsaḥ, saṅ‌ghāśrayaścaikākārāvabhāsaḥ pratyaya upapadyate | vṛkṣasamudāyaśca yathā vanamityanena vilakṣaṇena śabdenocyate tathaikatva samudāyo'pi dvitvamiti | evaṃ samudāyapradhānyam | yadā tvavayavaprādhānyavivakṣā, tadā ekatve eva parasparāpekṣe dvitvamiti vyavahriyate, nāto'nyaḥ kaścit guṇa ityetaddarśanadvayamavyatirekapakṣe | atra ca pakṣe tayoḥ ekatvayoḥ dvivacanaṃ bhaved avayavaprādhānyāt | ekavacanaṃ tvekākārāvabhāsapūrvakaṃ dvitvamiti dṛśyate iti naiṣa pakṣo nyāyya ityarthaḥ | tathā hi dvayekayoḥ...... iti dvivacanaṃ dvitve vidhīyamānaṃ dvitvasyaikatvābhyāmavyatirekādekatvayoreva tat syāt | tathā ca dvayekayorityekatvatrayasya dvandvaviṣayatvāt bahuvacanaṃ syāditi bhāvaḥ | tasmādekākārāvabhāsapratyayaviṣayamekatvābhyāṃ janitamanyadeva dvitvamityeva nyāyyam | evaṃ tritvādayo'pi daśasaṃkhyāparyavasānā veditavyāḥ | viṃśatvādisaṃkhyāyāṃ tu vicāro bhaviṣyati || 17 ||
nanvevaṃ dvitvabahutvasaṃkhyābhedasyaikatvāt kathaṃ dvayodvirvacanaṃ bahuṣu bahuvacanamiti vyavahāra ityata āha | eko'pi guṇabhedena saṅgho bheda prakalpayet | āśrayāśrayibhedo hi tadāśrayanibandhanaḥ || 18 ||
dvitvabahutvādilakṣaṇassaṅghaḥ samupajāto vyatiriktaḥ kalpito veti dvaitam | tatrotpattipakṣe janyaparavaśatvājjanakāḥ guṇāḥ | kalpitapakṣe tvavayavāḥ samudāyapāratantryād guṇāḥ | teṣāṃ bhedena dvitvabahutvāderbhedaḥ svātmanā ekasyāpi | tathā ca dvayorbahuṣviti ca vyavahāropapattiḥ | yasmādādhārādheyayoryo bhedo bhedavyavahāraḥ sa tadāśrayeṇa sambandhena hetunā bhavati | tathā hyāśritasya bhedena kvacidāśrayasya bhede vyavahriyate | tad yathā pāṭavasya bhedenaiko'pyarthātmā parudbhavānapaṭurāsīt, paṭutaraścaiṣamo'nya evāsi saṃvṛttaḥ' iti bhinno vyavahriyate | tathehaikatvānā janakatvenāśrīyamāṇatvādāśrayāṇāṃ bhede tadāśritaṃ tajjanyaṃ bahutvādi bhedena vyavahriyata ityarthaḥ | dvayekayoḥ  ityatra tu dvitvaṃ svagatenaivābhedena nirdiśyate || 18 ||
