tadevaṃ daśasaṃkhyāparyavasānā saṅkhyā vicāritā | idānīṃ viśatyādiḥ saṅkhyābhedo vicāryate | tatra cotpattirekatvairevāpekṣābuddhisahitairiti samānaṃ pūrveṇa | kintu tadabhidhāyī śabdaḥ saṅkhyāsaṅyeyobhayavacano dṛśyate, gavāṃ viṃśatiḥ, viṃśatirgāva ityādiḥ | tatra yadi prakṛtamarthanirdeśamanapekṣya dvau daśatau viṃśatiriti svārthe nipātanaṃ varṇyate tadā viṃśatigavaṃ triṃśatpūlīti samāso na syāt | dvau hi daśadvargau viṃśatiḥ, trayo daśadvargāsriṃśaditi saṃkhyeyena sāmānādhikaraṇyābhāvaḥ ekavacanaṃ ca na syāt, viṃśatiḥ, trayo daśadvargāsriṃśaditi saṃkhyeyena sāmānādhikaraṇyābhāvaḥ ekavacanaṃ ca na syāt, viṃśatiḥ, yathāyathaṃ vargabhedanibandhanasya vacanabhedasya prasaṅgāt | taduktaṃ vārttike-- `viṃśatyādayo daśadarthe cet samāsavacanānupapattiḥ'  iti | daśadvargadvayābhidhāyino dviśabdāt svārte śatic‌pratyayo dviśabdasya ca vinubhāva itīṣṭaḥ samāso vacanaṃ ca na syāt | gavāṃ viṃśatirgoviṃśariti samāso bhavatyeva | `krośaśatayojanaśatayoḥ' ityādijñāpakāccātra guṇena neti niṣedho na bhavati | yadi vā guṇātmanyavasthitatvād viṃśatyādīnāṃ tatsthaiśca guṇaiḥ  iti pratiprasavaḥ samāsasya guṇena na  iti niṣiddhasya | atha saṅgha ityanuvṛtteḥ parimāṇopādhikāt parimāṇini saṅghe pratyayo dvau daśatau parimāṇasya saṅghasya viṃśatiḥ saṅgha iti tadā saṅghasyaikatvādekavacanaṃ siddhyati samāsānupapattistu tadavasthā | viṃśatirgosaṃṅgha iti cāniṣṭaṃ syāt | viṃśako gosaṅgha iti hīṣyate | tathā ca vārttikam | `parimāṇini cet punaḥ svārthe pratyayavidhānam  iti | dvau daśatau parimāṇaṃ yasya sa gosaṅgho viṃśatirityabhidhīyate | tatra viṃśatiḥ parimāṇaṃ yasya saṅghasyeti saṅaghāntarasya parimāṇino'sambhavād viṃśakaḥ saṃṅgha iti siddhye `viṃśatitriṃśad‌bhyāṃ ḍvunasaṃjñāyām'  iti ḍvanupratyayaḥ svārthe vaktavya ityarthaḥ | tathā `ṣaṣṭhīvacanavidhiśca' ityuktam | iha saṅghe parimāṇini viṃśatyādīnāṃ kevalānāṃ prayogo neṣyate, bhinneṣu tu dravyeṣu parimāṇiṣu pratyayotpattāvāśrīyamāṇāyāṃ viṃśatiśabdena dravyāṇāmabhidhānād vyatirekābhāvād gavāṃ viṃśatiriti ṣaṣṭhī na prāpnoti | dravyasāmānādhikaraṇyād bahuvacanaprasaṅgaśca | tadevaṃ vyutpattipakṣe dūṣaṇānyabhidhāyāvyutpattipakṣaṃ nirdoṣamāśrityārambhaḥ pratyākhyātavyaḥ `anārambho vā prātipadikavijñānād yathā sahasrādiṣu' iti | vāśabdastarhyarthe sahasrādivadavyatpunnā eva viṃśatyādayaḥ arthavadadhātuḥ...... iti pratilabdhaprātipadikasaṃjñā arthavatsūtreṇānujñātasādhimānaḥ saṅkhyāyāṃ saṅkhyeye ca prayogabhedenākṣādivajanekārthatayā svabhāvato vartamānā rūḍhaśabdatvācca nityaliṅgasaṃkhyā yathā āpo dārā ityarthaḥ | evaṃ vārttikakāreṇāvasthāpite bhāṣyakāro vyutpattipakṣaṃ samarthayate saṃghe parimāṇini pratyayo nipātyate | saṅghaśca samudāyo'tra sāmānyena gṛhyate, na tu prāṇisamūha eva | tena vṛkṣāṇāṃ viṃśatirityapi bhavati | tatra svārthe pratyayavidhānasya parihārabhāṣyam-- "saṃhanane vṛttaḥ saṃhanane vartiṣyate" iti | etad vyācaṣṭe | saṅkhyeyasaṅghasaṅkhyānasaṅghaḥ saṅkhyeti kathyate | viṃśatyādiṣu sānyasya dravyasaṅghasya bhedikā || 19 ||
ayamarthaḥ | gavādīnāṃ saṅkhyeyānāmekaḥ saṅgho dravyasaṅgha ityucyate | tayordvayordravyasaṅghayordaśatoḥ saṅgho'yaṃ viṃśatiśabdo nipātyate | sa ca saṅkhyānasaṅgha ityucyate daśadvargayoḥ saṅkhyānayo samudāyaḥ | sa ca viśaṃtiśabdavācya iti | sā viṃśatiśabdavācyā saṅkhyā anyasya gavādidravyasaṅghasya bhedikā parimāṇopādhirviśeṣaṇamiti | tasmāt saṃkhyānasaṅghavacanād viṃśatiśabdād gavādisaṅghe parimāṇini ḍvun‌pratyayo bhavati viṃśako gosaṅgha ityādi | tathā ca daśatoḥ saṃhanane saṅghe vṛtto viṃśatiśabdo gavādidravyasaṃghe parimāṇini vartiṣyate parārthābhivānaṃ vṛttiriti pratyayamutpādayiṣyatīti bhāṣyārthaḥ | dravyāṇāṃ dravyasaṅghasya daśatāṃ daśatusaṅghasya ca pāramārthiko bhedo nāsti, kevalaṃ buddhyāsau parikalpyate | buddhivyavasthāpitārthanibandhanāśca śabdā buddhimevārthākārāmupajanayanto'satyapi vāstave bhede bhedamavagamayanti | nipātanasāmarthyācca viśiṣṭe dāśate saṅge vartante'mī śabdāḥ | tathā coktaṃ gurubhiḥ | dvervinaḥ parimāṇākhyād daśadarthāt gurubhiḥ | śatijasyeti saṅghāte dāśate tu nipātanāt || iti | asyārthaḥ | dveriti dviśabdāt | vina iti vinbhāvino vin‌śabdādeśādityarthaḥ | sthānyādeśayorhyabhedavivakṣā dviśabda eva vin‌śabda uktaḥ | parimāṇakhyāditi parimāṇopādhikāt | saṅkhyāśabdo hi saṅkhyeyābhidhāyī na parimāṇābhidhāyī, parimāṇopādhikāstu bhavatyeva | yadvākyaṃ `dvau daśatau parimāṇamasya' iti | daśadarthāditi daśadvargasaṃkhyeyavṛtterityarthaḥ | taditi prathamāsamarthācchatic‌pratyayo bhavatyasyeti parimāṇavatyabhidheye saṅghāte | gavāṃ saṃghasya dāśatasya ca saṅghasya pariṇāmitvāviśeṣe dāśata eva saṅghe pratyayo nipātanasāmarthyāt, na gosaṅghe, nāpi goṣu | tathā ca dharmamātravacanāḥ śuklādivad guṇisamānādhikaraṇāḥ kadācit prayujyante abhedopacārād viṃśatirgāvaḥ kuṇḍāni brāhmaṇā iti vā | āviṣṭaliṅgasaṃkhyātvāccānyaliṅgasaṃkhye'pi saṅyeye sāmānādhikaraṇyāvirodhaḥ samāsaścopapannaḥ | ata eva viṃśatigavaṃ triṃśatpūlīti | viṃśatisaṅkhyā hi samuditadravyasamavāyinī, na tu pratyekaṃ śuklādivat parisamāpteti dravyagataliṅgasaṅkhye nānuvartate | pañcādayastu nityaṃ saṅkhyeyavacanā iti tadgataliṅgasaṅkhyānuvidhāyino yuktāḥ | yadā tu guṇaguṇinorbhedena vyavahārastadā ṣaṣṭhī siddhā, gavāṃ viṃśatiriti | nanu ca dāśataḥ saṅgho viṃśatiśabdāvācyastasya ca saṅyeyo guṇī gavādirna bhavati | daśatau hi tasya guṇinau, tat kathaṃ gobhiḥ sa viśeṣyate | ucyate | gavāṃ daśatośca tāttvikabhedābhāvād gāvo'pi guṇinaḥ | tatra daśatā vyabhicārābhāvād viṃśatirna viśeṣyate, daśatorviṃśatiriti | na hi bhavati kṛṣṇasya kārṣṇyamiti, api tu kākasya kārṣṇyamiti | evaṃ vyabhicārād gobhirviśeṣyate'śvādivyāvṛttaye viṃśatisaṃkhyā gavāṃ viṃśatiriti | dāśatasaṅgharūpāyāśca viṃśateḥ pāramparyeṇa gāvaḥ saṃbandhinyo bhavantyeva | bhāvānayane dravyānayanācca goviṃśatimānayetyukte gāva ānīyante | tadevaṃ vyutpattipakṣaḥ samarthitaḥ | sahṛsrādayastu pṛṣodarādittvādanujñātasādhimānaḥ | anayaiva vā diśā te'pi vyutpādyāḥ || 19 ||
upalakṣaṇatvād viṃśatyādīnām ekaviṃśatirekatriṃśadityādayo'pi saṃkhyāśabdāḥ eva | na hyatrāvayavau saṃkhyāvacanau, na samudāyaḥ | yataḥ ekaviṃśatisaṃkhyāyāṃ saṃkhyāntarasarūpayoḥ | ekasyāṃ buddhyanāvṛttyā bhāgayoriva kalpanā || 20 ||
"ekādīnāṃ daśādibhirdvandva iti ced viṃśatyādiṣu vacanaprasaṅgaḥ" iti codayitvā "siddhaṃ tvadhikāntā saṅkhyā samānādhikaraṇādhikāre adhikalopaśca" ityekenādhikā viṃśatirekaviṃśatiriti vārttike tatpuruṣavṛttimuktāṃ svaradoṣādupekṣya ekaśca viṃśatiścetyekaviṃśatirityeva bhāṣye'nvākhyānamaṅgīkṛtam | tathā cāvayavau saṃkhyā syānna samudāya iti vacanaprasaṅgaparihārāya kathyate | avayavārthaparikalpanayā vyutpattimātramidaṃ kriyate, na tvatrāvayava ekasaṃkhyā viṃśatisaṃkhyā vā | paramārthato narasiṃhavannirastāvayavavibhāgā hyanyaiveyaṃ saṃkhyā bhinnabuddhigrāhyā | na hi pratyavayavamāvartate'tra buddhiḥ, saṃkhyāntarasyaivābhedena paricchedāt | upāyaparikalpanā tu vilakṣaṇā | kaścit kila nava dvādaśeti saṅkalayya ekaviṃśatirityavaiti | anyo daśa caikādaśa cetyādi | anyaḥ punarekaśca viṃśatiśceti | anvākhyānāya bhāgayoriva paramārthata ekasyām asyāṃ saṃkhyāyāmiyaṃ kalpanā | yathā jātiviśeṣapratipattyarthaṃ nara iti siṃha iti cāṃśāpoddhāraḥ | na hyaṃśayoratra buddhirāvartate, akhaṇḍatvāt || 20 ||
bhavatu saṃkhyādvayārabdheyaṃ saṃkhyā, kiṃ nirastāvayavavibhāgayā anyayā saṃkhyayetyāśaṅkya śāstrakāryānupapattiprasaṅgenaitannivārayitumāha | asaṃkhyāsamudāyatvāt saṃkhyākāryaṃ vidhīyate | samūhatve tu tanna syāt svāṅgādisamudāyavat || 21 ||
nirastāvayavavibhāgā sarūpāvayavākhaṇḍaśrutigocarā daśādivadanyaiva yato bhavatīyaṃ saṃkhyā. tataḥ saṃkhyāyāṃ vihitakāryaṃ pravartate | ekaviṃśatiradhikāsmin śate ekaviṃśaṃ śatam | evamekatriṃśam | `śadantaviṃśateśca'  iti ḍaḥ | tatraṃ hi "śad‌grahaṇe'ntagrahaṇaṃ pratyayagrahaṇe yasmāt sa tadāderadhikārtham'  ityuk‌tvātiprasaṅganivāraṇāya `saṅkhyāgrahaṇaṃ ca' ityuktam | tathā ca śadanto viṃśatyantaśca saṃkhyāvācī gṛhyate, na tu gotriṃśad goviṃśatirityādi | ekaviṃśatitayamiti ca saṃkhyākāryamavayavini tayap | ekaviṃśatitamamekaviṃśamiti ca pūraṇe ḍaṭ | tatra ca `viṃśatyādibhyastamaḍanyatarasyām'  iti tamaṭ | ekaviṃśatikṛtva iti "saṃkhyāyāḥ kriyābhyāvṛttigaṇane kṛtvasuc"| ekaviṃśatimayam[dvimayam] udaśvadyavānāmiti "saṃkhyāyā guṇasya nimāne......" iti nimāne vartamānāt saṃkhyāśabdānnimeye mayaṭ | ekaviṃśatika iti parimāṇini "saṃkhyāyā atiśadantāyāḥ" iti kan | tyantapratiṣedho'tra(na?) bhavatyarthavatastatra tiśabdasya grahaṇāt | adikaikaviṃśā iti ca `saṃkhyayāvyayāsanna....'  iti bahuvrīhirapi saṃkhyākāryam | avayavasaṃkhyādvayamayyāṃ tvasyāṃ samūharūpāyāmekaviṃśatisaṃkhyāyāṃ saṃkhyākāryaṃ na syāt | tad yathā-pāṇipādena svāṅgasamudāyena bhinnakāryasya svāṅgāntarasyānārambhāt svāṅgasamudāyo na svāṅgamiti kalyāṇapāṇipādeti `svāṅgāt.......' ti ṅīṣ na bhavati | tathā janapadābhyāṃ janapadāntarasyānārambhājjanapadasamudāyo janapadagrahaṇena na gṛhyata iti janapadalakṣaṇo vuñatra na bhavati | kāśikosalīya iti bhavārthe `vṛddhācchaḥ' eva bhavati | evamatra saṃkhyābhyāṃ saṃkhyāntarasya bhinnavyapadeśasya vilakṣaṇasyānārambhāt tatsamūhamātrarūpatve saṃkhyākāryābhāva iti saṃkhyāntaram | ekaviṃśatisaṃkhyā ca yathākathaṃcidavayavaparikalpanayā vyutpādyeteti dvivacanaprasaṅgābhāvaḥ || 21 ||
iha kathaṃ saṃkhyayā samāsaḥ dvidaśā tridaśā ityādau | daśasaṃkhyayā hi dvyādisaṃkhyā sambadhyamānā kiṃ sañcaṣṭa ityāha | saṃkhyeyāntaratantrāsu yā saṃkhyāsu pravartate | āvṛttivargasaṃkhyeyā tāṃ saṃkhyāṃ tādṛśīṃ viduḥ || 22 ||
dvirdaśa dvidaśā iti `saṃkhyayāvyayāsanna.....'  ityādinā bahuvrīhirayaṃ samāsaḥ | tatra ca saṃkhyeyāntaraṃ dvyādisaṃkhyāviṣayāt saṃkhyeyād anyat saṃkhyeyaṃ paricchedyaṃ tantraṃ pradhānaṃ yāsāṃ daśādisaṃkhyānāṃ tāsu saṃkhyeyapradhānāsu daśādisaṃkhyāsu yānyā dvitvādikā saṃkhyā pravartate saṃbandhamanubhavati samāsārthaṃ tasyā daśādisaṃkhyāvṛttiḥ punaḥ punaḥ pravṛttiḥ daśādisaṃkhyāparicchedyo vā vargo daśāvayavasamūhaḥ saṃkhyeyaḥ paricchedya iti tāṃ dvitvādikāṃ saṃkhyāṃ tādṛśīm āvṛttivargasaṃkhyeyapradhānāṃ viduḥ jānanti śābdikāḥ kila | saṃkhyā asyā na paricchedyām̐ | sā hi daśasu saṃkhyeyeṣu guṇabhūteti na dvitvena yogaṃ bhajate | ata eva saṃkhyeyāntaratantrāsu ityanenāsaṃbandhe heturuktaḥ | daśasaṃkhyāsaṃkyeyenāpi virodhād dvitvaṃ na saṃbadhyate | na hi daśa dvāviti yujyate | tasmād daśasaṃkhyāyā āvṛttirdvitvaparicchedyā | dvau vārau hīyaṃ daśasaṃkhyā dvirdaśa iti | ata evābhyāvṛttiviṣayaḥ suc‌pratyayo vākye | daśāvayavo vargaḥ paricchedyo dvau daśatāvityasti samanvayaḥ || 22 ||
śrutaiva daśasaṃkhyā tatsaṃkhyeyā vā daśa kathaṃ dvitvasaṃkhyayā na paricchedyā ityāśaṅkya vyākhyātāmeva yuktimupanyasyati | na saṃkhyāyāṃ na saṃkhyeye dvau daśetyasti sambhavaḥ | bhedābhāvānna saṃkhyāyāṃ virodhānna tadāśraye || 23 ||
daśasaṃkhyā tāvat saṃkhyeyopasarjanatvānnārhati dvitvasaṃkhyāsaṃbandhamatretyuktam | upasarjanatve'pi ca buddhyā pratyavamṛśya sambandhe pradhānena saṃkhyeyena yogo bhaved, yadyupasarjanamarhet saṃbandham | yāvatā daśasaṃkhyāyā ekatvāt dvitvenāsaṃbandhaḥ tatsaṃkhyeya api daśa virodhād dvitvena nāvacchidyante | na hi daśa dvau bhavatītyuktameva | uttarā hi saṃkhyā pūrvasaṃkhyākṛtaṃ vyapadeśaṃ bādhate || 23 ||
tasmāt saṃkhyāyete daśadvargau dvidaśā iti saṃkhyayā | tadrūpe vāpi saṃkhyeye āvṛttiḥ parigaṇyate || 24 ||
daśasaṃkhyāparicchinna eko vargastādṛśamaparamākhyātuṃ dvitvamupādīyate | tena dvayordaśagadvargayordvitvamatrāvedyate | dvau daśatau dvidaśāḥ | saṃbandhānyathānupapattyā daśaśabdo'tra vṛttiviṣaye daśadvarge vartate | vargaśca vargyabhedāpanno vivakṣyata ityavayavagatabhedāśrayaṃ bahuvacanam | vargavācī cātra ḍatipratyayo vṛttau ata eva daśaditi na prayujyate, vargiprādhānyāt | tadrūpe daśasaṃkhya eva saṃkhyeye sati daśasaṃkhyāyā āvṛttiḥ punaḥ punaḥ pravṛttirvā gaṇyate dvitvena | dvau vārau dviḥ, dvirdaśa dvidaśāḥ | daśaśabdo'tra saṃkhyeyamevācaṣṭe | guṇabhūtasaṃkhyādvāreṇa tu dvitvena yujyante daśa saṃkhyeyāḥ | daśasaṃkhyā tu guṇabhūtāvṛttidvāreṇa dvitvasaṃkhyāyogamanubhavati | daśasu saṃkhyeyeṣu hi daśatvamāvartamānaṃ dvitvena paricchidyate | tathā ca saṃbandhisaṃbadhāt saṃkhyeyeṣu hi daśasvapi dvitvamanvayīti tadāśrayaṃ bahuvacanaṃ bhavati | āvṛttigaṇanaviṣayasya ca sucaḥ samāsena gatārthatvāt prayogo na bhaviṣyati | taduktaṃ vārttike--- `sujabhāvo'bihitārthatvāt samāse' iti | gatametat || 24 ||
`saṃkhyāyā avayave tayap' ityatra "iha kasmānna bhavati | bahavo'vayavā asyāḥ saṃkhyāta iti"iti bhāṣye codite'bhihitam | "avayave yā saṃkhyā tasyāḥ pratyaya ucyate | na ca kācit saṃkhyā avayavinyasti, yasyā bahuśabdo'vayavaḥ syād | " iti | ayamarthaḥ | "avayavidhāne'vayavini pratyayaḥ" ityuktam | na ca saṃkhyāśabdavācyā kācid viśiṣṭāvayavinī saṃkhyāsti | nanu ca kathaṃ nāsti yāvatā prayujyata eva vākyam-`bahavo'vayavā asyāḥ saṃkhyāyāḥ' ityāha `nanu ceyamasti saṃkhyetyeva' iti bhāṣyam | asyottaram | naiṣā saṃkhyā | kiṃ tarhi | saṃjñaiṣā |iti | ekatvādisaṃkhyāviśeṣāṇāmaviśiṣṭā saṃjñā nāmadheyametat saṃkhyeti, na tvasya vācyaḥ kaścidavayavī | tataśca saṃkhyāsāmānyaniveśinīyaṃ pratibhedamanuvartate saṃjñā | na ca sāmānyaviśeṣayoravayavāvayavibhāvaḥ | kalpitatve'pi cāvayavinaḥ kāryabhedo rūpabhedaḥ samākhyābhedaśca bhidyate | tadyatā vanāderviviktavṛkṣakāryāddhi samuditavanakāryamanyat | ata eva rūpabhedaḥ | samākhyā ca vṛkṣā vanamiti bhinnā | iha tu paricchedalakṣaṇaṃ kāryamekatvādivyatiriktaṃ saṃkhyāyā nāsti | kiñcidrūpamapi na viviktamekādivyatiriktamavadhāryate śuklādivyatirekeṇeva rūpasya | samākhyā tvarthābhāvādeva na bhinnā | api tu viśeṣaviṣayasāmānyagocareyaṃ saṃjñā saṃkhyeti | bahutvamapi caivaṃ tritvādīnāṃ sāmānyamiti bahavo'vayayā asyāṃ viṃśatau triṃśati vetyapyavayavāvayavibhāvena yogo na bhavati | api tu sāmānyaviśeṣabhāvenaiva | tathā ca yathā bahutayaṃ rūpamiti śaklādivyatirekeṇa kūpāvayavino'bhāvānna bhavati, tathā bahutayī viṃśatiḥ triṃśadityapi na bhavati | na hi paricchinnarūpāyā viṃśatyādisaṃkhyāyāḥ sāmānyarūpamanavadhāritaviśeṣaṃ bahutvamupapadyate viśeṣaṇam | tadetad bhāṣyopakṣiptamanuvadati-- saṃkhyā nāma na saṃkhyāsti saṃjñaiṣeti yathocyate | rūpaṃ na rūpamapyevaṃ saṃjñā sā hi sitādiṣu || 25 ||
sitapītanīlādivarṇavyatirekeṇa yathā vilakṣaṇakāryasvabhāvaṃ rūpaṃ nāma varṇāntaraṃ nāsti, sitādīnāṃ rūpasāmānyanimittā tu saṃjñā rūpamityeṣā, tathaikatvādisaṃkhyābhedavyatirekeṇa saṃkhyā nāma avayavinī na vidyate'nyā | samākhyāmātrameṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ sāmānyabhūtamityukto'rthaḥ || 25 ||
sāmānyasamākhyātvamevopapādayati | saṃkhyānajātiyogāt tu saṃkhyā saṃkhyeti kathyate | rūpatvajātiyogācca rūpe rūpamiti smṛtam || 26 ||
jātinimitto'yamubhayarūpo'pi vyapadeśo bhāṣyakāreṇa smṛto na vyatiriktārthanibandhana iti bahutayī saṃkhyā bahutayaṃ rūpamiti prayogābhāvaḥ | na tarhi bhavati bahutayaṃ citrarūpamiti ?| bhavati, citrarūpasyāvayavina ekatvānnīlādyavayavayogopapatteḥ | ekaṃ citraṃ ceti, citrataramiti ceti bhedasaṃvidāveditatattvāḥ padārthāḥ pratyākhyātumaśakyā evāvayavisāmānyādaya ityadvayasiddhāvasmābhirvicāritam | granthagauravabhayānneha pratanyate | tat tata eva avadhāryam | tathā ca citramiti rūpamekāvayavisamavetamityavayavabahutvenāvacchedamarhatyeva | kiñcit kila citraṃ pītanīlārabdhaṃ dvayavayavam, kiñcit punaḥ sitaraktapītādibahuvidhāvayavārabdhamityasti sāphalyaṃ viśeṣaṇasya | gatabhedaḥ || 26 ||
saṃkhyāviṣayamanyad vicāryate | iha `bahuṣu bahuvacanam'  ityādinā saṃkhyā vibhaktivācyā vihitā | tatra svaśabdenābhihitāyāmasyāmekādibhyo vacanagrahaṇāt prathamā labhyeta | dvitvādayastu katham | tathāhi-karmādiṣvapi vibhak‌ttyartheṣvavasyamekatvādayo nimittattvenāpādeyā ityuktatvāt karmaṇi yadekatvamekatvādyavacchinne vā karmaṇītyāśrayaṇādanabhihitakarmādyāśrayeṣvekatvādiṣu vibhaktaya ityabhihiviṣaye tadabhāvādekaṃ dvau bahūnītyādikaṃ kathamityāśaṃkyāha | nimittamekamityatra vibhaktyā nābhidhīyate | tadvatastu yadekatvaṃ vibhaktistatra vartate || 27 ||
prathamāsādhāraṇamidaṃ pratisamādhānam | tathāhi-prātipadikārthasamavetāyāṃ saṃkhyāyāṃ prātipadikārthe vā saṃkhyāsaṃbandhini pakṣāntarāśrayeṇa vā prathamāyāṃ vidhīyamānāyāmekādiśabdasya pravṛttinimittamekatvādi na tayā abhidhīyate, prātipadikenevaikādiśabdena tasyābhidhānāt | tadvataḥ pravṛttinimittabhūtaikatvādyavacchinnasya prātipadikārthasya yad anyadekatvādi tatra vācye prādhānyena prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇatvena vā vibhaktiḥ prathamā vidhīyate iti prātipadikena svanimittabhūtaikatvādyabhidhāne'pi tadaparaikatvādyabhidhānāya pravartata eva eko dvau bahavaḥ iti | ekaśabdasyodāharaṇārthatvāt tadvatastu yadekatvam ityāha | dvitvādyapi hi gṛhyate dvayādiśabdaviṣayam | tathā vibhaktigrahaṇasya dvitīyādisādhāraṇasyopādānād dvitīyādyapi prātipadikenānuktamekatvādi kathayatītyuktaṃ bhavati ekaṃ dvau bahūn paśyetyādau | na hyatra prātipadikena karmādigatamekatvādi spṛṣṭamiti tadviṣayā dvitīyādyā vibhaktayaḥ || 27 ||
nanu ca nātra prakṛtipratyayavācyaṃ saṃkhyādvayamavadhāryata ityāha | ekasya pracayo dṛṣṭaḥ samūhaśca dvayostathā | nimittavyatirekeṇa saṃkhyānyā bhedikā tataḥ || 28 ||
iha ekasya tadapareṇa samuccīyamānasya pracayo dṛṣṭaḥ | tathā hi sati pracaye'nyasāhabhāvye dvitvādisaṃkhyā jāyante | dvayoḥ ca samūhaḥ samudāyo'bhedo dṛṣṭaḥ | tadyathā dviputra ityādau nivṛtte'pi dvivacane vṛttāvasāvavagamyate'ntaraṅgaḥ | tataḥ pracayasamūhadarśanāddhetoḥ prātipadikārthasya yannimittamekatvādi ekādiśabdaviṣayaṃ tadvyatiriktā anyā vibhaktivācyā ekatvādisaṃkhyā vidyate | bahūnāmapi samūho dṛṣṭa iti yojanīyaṃ bahuputra ityādau | tadiyaṃ viśeṣāvasthāpanena prātipadikārthasya bhedikā avacchedikā saṃkhyā vibhaktivācyātrāvadhāryata eva | tathā hi prātipadikāt pracitāpacitasādhāraṇamekatvamavagamyate | vibhaktestu viśeṣaniścayo'rthasya parisamāptereka ityapacitamidamekatvamiti | evaṃ dvau bahava ityasamūharūpatā | yadyevaṃ pracitaviṣaye ekatve vibhaktirna syād ekaśca ekaśceti | naitannyāyyam | sādhāraṇe ekatve prātipadikavācye vibhaktirviśeṣaṃ dyotayati ityucyate | tathā ca vibhaktyātra dvitvādyupajanahetutāmapratipadyamānamapracitamevaikatvamāvedyate | paścāttu padārthe paryavasite caśabdaḥ pracayaṃ dyotayati padārthapṛṣṭhapātinam, na tu prātipadikārthagatam | prātipadikārthapracayavivakṣāyāṃ hi sahavivakṣāviṣaya ekaśabdāprayoga iti || 28 ||
"saṃkhyāyā anyapadārthatvāt"ityādinā ekaśeṣapratyākhyāne tatsamānārthadvyādiśabdaprayogo dvitvādyupajanāt prātipadikārthapracayaviṣaye samayād vibhaktirbhaviṣyati | yadi sāmayikī niyogato'nyāpi kasmānna bhavanti, karmādīnāmabhāvād ityaparamatra pratividhānaṃ bhāṣya uktam | tathā hi `na kevalā prakṛti? prayoktavyā' iti `paraśca'  iti samayapālanārthaṃ vibhaktau vidhīyamānā(yā?)marthaviśeṣānāśrayaṇād vacanasaṅkara prāpnotīti yathāyathamarthānuguṇyena vibhaktayo'ṅgīkṛtāḥ | tathā cābhihite'pi ravārthe ekādiśabdebhyastadānuguṇyenaiva prakṛtyarthānuvidhāyinyo vibhaktaya ityupagataṃ bhavati | svābhāvikatvādarthābhidhānasya vibhaktyā saha prakṛtiḥ svārthamabhidhatta ityayameva niyamaḥ paravacanena pratipāditaḥ | tadetad vyācaṣṭe | tadekamapi caikatvaṃ vibhaktiśravaṇādṛte | nocyate tena śabdena vibhakttyā tu sahocyate || 29 ||
svābhāvikaṃ sahābhidhānaṃ yathāyathaṃ sarvatraiva vibhaktividhāne pratipādyate | vṛttau tu lukā kevalenābhidhānaṃ jñāpyate | śaktiviśeṣo hi śabdānāṃ vṛttāvupajāyata iti kevalasyāpyabhidhānaṃ na virudhyate | evaṃ saṃbuddhilope'pi kevalaprayogaḥ svābhāvikaḥ || 29 ||
anyo'pyatra parihāro'bhihito bhāṣye "saṃkhyā nāmeyaṃ parapradhānā | saṃkhyeyamanayā viśeṣyam | yadi cātra prathamā na syāt saṃkhyeyamaviśeṣitaṃ syāt |" iti | etad vyācaṣṭe | anvayavyatirekau ca yadi syād vacanāntaram | syātāmasati tasmiṃśca prakṛtyartho na kalpyate || 30 ||
vṛkṣaḥ vṛkṣau vṛkṣā ityādau prakṛtipratyayoḥ anvayavtirekau staḥ | tathā coktam `dṛṣṭo hyavyatireke'pi vyatireko'nvaye sati'  ityādi | tataśca tatra yo'nveti yaṃ śabdamarthastasya bhavatyasau | iti bhedenāpoddhārakalpanā yuktā | iha tvekaśabdādekavacanameva dviśabdād dvivacanameva bahuśabdād bahuvacanameva, na vacanāntaramityasati vyatireke'nvayasyāniścayāt prakṛtyartho vivekena nāvadhāryate | asati hi vacanāntare'nvayavyatirekau na staḥ iti ekādiśabdalakṣaṇāyāḥ prakṛterabhidheyaṃ pratyayārthavyatiriktaṃ na saṃbhavatyatra yena saṃkhyeyamavachindyāt prakṛtiḥ kevalā | tathā ca vṛkṣādāvekavacanādīnāmanvayavyatirekārthanirdhāraṇādiha tadabhāve prakṛtipratyayasamudāyavācyo'yamarthaḥ yenaṃ saṃkhyeyo viśeṣyate saṃkhyālakṣaṇena | tathā cānuktārthatvādeva bhavati | vṛttau tvekasyā eva prakṛterekarājādavu(diru?) pasarjanārtho'vagamyate pradhānārthasambhedamāpanna iti vibhaktiścaritārthatvānnivartate | yathā hi vinā bhāvapratyayaṃ vṛttau tadarthāvagatiḥ nirākulastiṣṭhati sadhīramuvācetyādau evamatra vibhaktimantareṇāpi tatsannidhānadṛṣṭamekatvādyupasarjanārtho'vagamyata eva | tadevaṃ pūrvatra parihāre prakṛtyarthānuvādakatvamabhimatam | satyapi prakṛtyarthe yathāyathaṃ tadarthānuvādakatvena vacanānāmuktatvāt | iha tu sādhāraṇārthatvamabhimataṃ prakṛtipratyayasamudāyavācyenārthena saṃkhyeyaviśeṣaṇasyoktatvāditi parihārayorbhāṣyakāroktayorviśeṣaḥ || 30 ||
anyo'tra bhāṣye parihāra uktaḥ-- "ubhayavacanā evaite dravyaṃ caivāhurguṇaṃ ca | yat stho'sau guṇastasyānuktā ekatvādaya iti prathamā bhaviṣyati" iti| etad vyācaṣṭe ekatvameka ityatra śuddhadravyaviśeṣaṇam | saguṇastu prakṛtyartho vibhaktyarthena bhidyate || 31 ||
śuddhasya dravyasya pūrvaṃ viśeṣaṇād buddhyā nirjñātasya viśeṣaṇabhāvamāpannaṃ ekatvamekaḥ iti prātipadikenābhidhīyate | uktaśabdo hyekatvaviśiṣṭaṃ dravyamāha, na saṃkhyānamātramapi viṃśatyādivat | ata evobhayavacanatvaṃ viśiṣṭavacanatvaṃ vivakṣitaṃ bhāṣye | na tu kevalaguṇābhidhānaṃ śuklādivadeṣāmupapadyate | yadi vā dvyekayoḥ  iti nirdeśāt saṃkhyānamātravacanatvabhamapītyuyavacanatvaṃ spaṣṭam | tadasyaikaśabdavācyasya ekatvaviśiṣṭasya dravyasya vibhaktivācyenaikatvena viśeṣaṇāt saguṇaḥ prātipadikārtho vibhaktyarthena bhidyate viśeṣe'vatiṣṭhate | ekatvaviśiṣṭo'yameko'rtho na tu guṇāntaraviśiṣṭa iti prakṛtivācyamantaraṅgaṃ vibhaktivācyaṃ tu bahiraṅgaṃ bāhyamiti dvyādīnāṃ ca dviputra ityādau bāhyo bhedo nivartate vibhaktivācya iti vakṣyati | anye tu śuddhaṃ ca dravyaviśeṣaṇaṃ ceti samāhāre dvandvaṃ matvā saṃkyānamātrapradhānaṃ saṃkhyeyopasarjanaṃ caikatvaṃ saṃkhyāsaṃkhyeyasāmānyarūpaṃ prātipadikenocyate | saha guṇena saṃkhyānena yo vartate prātipadikārthaḥ sa vibhaktivācyena bhidyate avacchinnaḥ prakāśyate iti vibhaktyantavācyaṃ saṃkhyeyaṃ prādhānyeneti vyācakṣate | yasmin dravye sthito guṇaḥ saṅkhyānaṃ tasyānuktā ekatvādayo dravyāvaccheditayā noktā iti cātra bhāṣyārthaḥ || 31 ||
nanu vibhaktyantena saṃkhyeyasya pratipādanāt kevalasya prayogābhāvād guṇamātra vṛttitvaṃ kathamekādīnāmavadhāryata ityāha | dvayekayoriti nirdeśāt saṃkhyāmātre'pi sambhavaḥ | ekādīnāṃ prasiddhā tu saṃkhyeyārthatvamucyate || 32 ||
dvyekayoḥ...... iti dvivacananirdeśād dvitvaikatvayordvitvādyupapadyate | saṃkhyeyācca niṣkṛṣṭayordvitvai katvayorabhidhāne yuktamidam | anyathā nityasaṃkhyeyaprādhānye dvāvekaśca traya iti bahuvacanaṃ syāt | ādaśabhyaḥ saṃkhyā saṃkhyene vartante iti laukikīṃ prasiddhimāśritya bhāṣye "syādetad yatra niyogataḥ saṃkhyā saṃkhyete vartate" iti saṃkhyeyākhyāyitvamucyate | ayamatrārthaḥ | saṃkhyānamātre laukike prayoge naiṣāṃ vṛttiḥ | tatra hi padaṃ prayujyate | vibhaktyantaṃ ca padam | vibhaktiśca saṃkhyāṃ prātipadikārthasamavetāmāheti niyataṃ tatra saṃkhyeyāvadhāraṇam | śāstre tvapoddhārabuddhyā saṃkhyānamātravṛttitvaṃ vṛttāvasati vibhaktipratyaye kāmamupapadyate iti || 32 ||
iti bhūtirājatanayahelārājakṛte prakīrṇakaprakāśe saṃkhyāsamuddeśa ekādaśaḥ || 3,12ḥ upagrahasamuddeśaḥ ------------- idānīmākhyātārthamupagrahaṃ vicārayituṃ svarūpamasyālaukikatvāt pradarśayati | ya ātmanepadād bhedaḥ kvacidarthasya gamyate | anyataścāpi lādeśānmanyante tamupagraham || 1 ||
ātmanepadaparasmaipadavyaṅgyaḥ kartrabhiprāyataditarādirūpo viśeṣo yaḥ kriyāyāḥ sādhanasya vā sa upagraha iti pūrvācāryairabhyupagataḥ | pūrvācāryaprasiddhyopagrahaśabdavācyo'yamartho vyavahriyate'tra śāstre || 1 ||
kasyārthasyāsau bheda iti sāmānyenoktameva vibhajate | kvacit sādhanamevāsau kvacittasya viśeṣaṇam | sādhanaṃ tatra karmādi vyaktavāco viśeṣaṇam || 2 ||
sādhanaṃ karma upagrahaḥ ātmanepadābhivyaṅgyaḥ pacyate gamyate iti | ādiśabdāt kartā bhāvaśca | tatra kartā lādeśadvayavyaṅgyaḥ edhate yātīti | bhāva āsyate śayyata ityātmanepadavyaṅkhya eva | sa ca bāhyo bhāvo lakāravācyaḥ ābhyantarasya dhātvartharūpasya bhāvasya kriyāyāḥ svātmanyavasthitimekapadavācyasādhanānāveśādāvedayan bhavati sādhanam | vyaktā vāg yeṣāṃ vyaktā vāci vā yeṣāṃ (ye?) te vyaktavāco dhātvarthaṃ samuccāraṇārtha(tma?)kaṃ viśiṃṣanto'pi sādhanasya kartuḥ viśeṣaṇaṃ sāmarthyād bhavanto bhavantyupagraha śabdavācyāḥ | tad yathā saṃpravadante brāhmaṇā iti || 2 ||
kvacit kriyāviśeṣaṇa(ṣa u?)mupagraha ityāha | kriyā viṣayabhedena jīvikādiṣu bhidyate | lādeśaiḥ sa kriyābhedo vākyeṣvapi niyamyate || 3 ||
viṣayaviśeṣāśrayeṇa bhidyate kriyā | sa ca tasyā bhedo lādeśaiḥ parasmaipadātmanepadalakṣaṇairabhivyajyate pacanti yajantīti | pradhānaṃ hyatra kriyāphalaṃ na kartṛgāmi bhṛtimātraphalatvād bhṛtyānām | yajamānādinā pradhānaphaloddeśena pravartyamānā kriyā ātmanepadāt pratīyate yajate pacate iti | kvacit punaḥ sa eva kriyābhedo vākyeṣvapi satsvava(svaśabdenāva?)dhāryata iti vākyagamyaḥ | tad yathā svaṃ yajñaṃ yajate, svaṃ yajñaṃ yajatīti | "vibhāṣopapadena pratīyamāne" iti lādeśadvayānuśāsanāt svamiti padāntarasaṃsargaracitavākyāvaseyaṃ kriyāyāḥ pradhānaphalasya kartṛgāmitvam || 3 ||
viṣayabhedaṃ vināpi kvacit sākṣāt kriyāviśeṣa upagraha ityāha | dhātvarthastadviśeṣaścāpyuktaḥ kvacidupagrahaḥ | dhātvartho gandhanādiḥ syād vyatihāro viśeṣaṇam || 4 ||
gandhanāvakṣepaṇādayaḥ kriyāviśeṣo dhātuvācyāḥ santo'pi vinātmanepadamanabhivyaktā ityātmanepadābhivyaṅgyatvādupagrahaśabdavācyā bhavanti | tad yathā-utkurute avakurute ityādi | vyatihārastu kriyāviśeṣaṇamātmanepadābhivyaṅgyamupagrahaḥ | vyatipunata iti || 4 ||
kartrabhiprāye kriyāphala iti viśeṣya kathamucyate, yāvatā sarvameva phalaṃ kriyāyāḥ kartrāramabhipraitītyata āha-- kriyāpravṛttāvākhyātā kaiścit svārthaparārthatā | asatī vā satī vāpi vivakṣitanibandhanā || 5 ||
"sarva ime svabhūtyarthaṃ yatanta" iti | sarvasya svārthaṃ pravṛtteḥ svārthatā pāramārthikī, parārthatā tu asatī eva | satī vā iti tu laukikī vācoyuktiḥ | tathā hi-vivakṣā vivakṣitaṃ nibandhanaṃ heturasyāḥ parārthatāyāḥ | svārthatā hi mukhyaiveti na tasyā vivakṣānibandhanatvam | taditthaṃ pārārthyavivakṣāyāṃ mā bhūdātmanepadamiti kartrabhiprāye kriyāphala iti phalaṃ viśeṣyate | anye tu pradhānaphalābhiprāyeṇa vastuta eva svārthaparārthatāmāhuriti kaiścit iti vacanānmatāntaramupakṣiptaṃ bhavati | tathā hi-yaḥ svargaudanādimukhyaphalārthī sa tatrānyān vyāpārayati, nirveśena pratividhānaṃ cārabhate | tataśca tasya pratividhāturmukhyaphalārthinaḥ svārtha ārambha iti tatrātmanepadaṃ yajamānādau | yastu tatprayukto nirveśamātraphalaḥ sa svāmicittānuvartanādeva kṛtārthatāṃ manyata iti tasyāsau parārtha ārambha iti na bhavati tatrātmanepadam || 5 ||
itthaṃ ca saṃvidhāna ātmanepadaṃ tatraiva ṇijityanayoḥ samāno viṣaya ityāha | keṣāñcit kartrabhiprāye ṇicā saha vikalpate | ātmanepadamanyeṣāṃ tadarthā prakṛtiryaṃthā || 6 ||
ṇicaḥ saṃvidhānamātramarthaṃ manyanta kecit | `sarva ime svatbhūyarthaṃ yatante' iti svārthaṃ pravartamānasya prayojyasya prayojakastadānukūlyācaraṇāt saṃvidhātā maṇyate | na hnanuvidheyasya vacanāt svārthamasambhāvatayo vā pravṛttiriti na praiṣoṇijarthaḥ | api tu saṃvidhānamātram, tatraivātmanepadamapīti tulyaviṣayatvādanayoḥ paryāyeṇa prayogaḥ `yajate yājayati, pacate pācayati' iti | ātmanepadābhidheyo hi kartā saṃvidhānamapekṣate iti ṇicā tulyaviṣayam ātmanepadam iti vikalpate tena saha | yathā tadarthā ṇica utpādanārthā prakṛtiḥ dhāturṇicā saha vikalpate | ye dhātvarthaviśeṣaṇatāṃ hetumatītyasya manyante teṣāmanyeṣāṃ mate hetumati vyāpāre vartamānād dhātordyotako ṇijiti kutaścidarthasāmarthyāddhetumataḥ saṃvidhānaviśiṣṭasya vyāpārasya krīṇīṣvetyādivadavagamāṇṇijrehitā śuddhā prakṛtiḥ prayogamarhatyevetaci manyante | ye tu bhūyamaṇicamantareṇa praiṣasyāpratīterhetumatītyasya pratyayārthatvaṃ manyante teṣāṃ yathā ṇicaprakṛtirṇicā saha na vikalpate tathātmanepadamapīti | keṣāṃciditi vadan pakṣāntaraṃ sūcayati | tathāhi-ātmanepadaviṣayasya kartuḥ saṃvidhānaṃ kriyāgato dharmo dhātuvācyo bhavet | ātmanepadena hi kriyāphalaṃ kartṛgāmi dyotayatā sāmarthyāt pradānaphalayuktaḥ kartābhidhīyate, na tu praiṣaḥ spṛśyate | na hi prayojyaprayokavyāpāro ṇyantavadātmanepadāntadhātuviṣaye pratīyate | ata eva śābdī pratītirbhidyate | yajata iti phalārthī svatantro yāgaṃ bhāvayatītyarthaḥ | tatra cānanyaprayojyasya svatantrasya bhāvanāyāmaucityāta saṃvidhānaṃ vyāpāraḥ pratīyate, na tvasmācchābdavyāpārāt paraṃ prayuṅkta ityavagatiḥ | yājayatīti yāge paraṃ prayuṅkte iti śābda evāvagamaḥ | tātparyadṛśā tu vāstavavyāpārāśraye viṣayasāmyaṃ bhavet | tasmād bhinnaviṣayatvānnātra vikalpa ityeṣa siddhānto'bhimataḥ || anyathaikaviṣayatvād dhātusāmānyavihitasya ṇico dhātuviśeṣāt svaritaśrito vidhīyamānamātmanepadaṃ bādhakaṃ syāditi na vikalpo bhavet, lasya tiptas‌jhi..... ityanena vidhānāt `svaritañitaḥ....... ityādirna vidhiriti cenniyamastarhi bhaviṣyati | sa caikavākyatayā vidhiśeṣa eva | anyathā parasmaipadabādhakatvamapi kathamātmanepadasya syāditi | tadevaṃ bhinnaviṣaye ṇijātmanepade, saṃvidhāne ātmanepadaṃ tadviśeṣe tu praiṣe ṇijiti | yatra tu pārārthyaṃ dhātvarthasyānyato'vagamyate tatra na bhavatyātmanepadam | tad yathā-uktaḥ karoti, preṣitaḥ karotīti praiṣeṇa kartuḥ pārārthyāvagate svārthatāsampratyayādātmanepadābhāvo'tra | evamodanaṃ pacatīti karaṇādikārakāntarapraiṣe'pi prayojyakartuḥ pradhānaphalārthatābhāvādātmanepadābhāvaḥ | tathā ajāṃ nayati grāmamityatra dhātvarthapraiṣamātravivakṣāyāṃ tu svātmani kartari bhavatyātmanepadaṃ ajāṃ nayate grāmam iti || 6 ||
idānīṃ ye ṇicā sahātmanepadasya vikalpamicchanti teṣāṃ viṣayasāmyāvagamabhrāntibījamupadarśayati | krīṇīṣva vapate dhatte cinoti cinute'pi ca | āptaprayogā dṛśyante yeṣu ṇyartho'bhidhīyate || 7 ||
`svātmānaṃ krīṇīṣva' iti vinatābhihitā putrānāha `krīṇīta mām' iti śiṣṭaprayogo'sti | atra `krīṇīṣva' ityātmanepadāntasya prayogasya ṇyarthaḥ praiṣo'vadhāryate | dāsyaṃ prāptā hi vinatā nāgamātrātmānaṃ krīṇīṣva dāsyānmocayeti kadrūvā krayaṇasvātantrye niyujyata iti paraprayojyatāvagamād ṇyarthatāyāmātmanepadamidamiti samānaviṣayatvaṃ ṇijātmanepadayorotasmāt prayogād bhrāntibījaṃ manyante | tathāhi-sāmarthyādatra ṇyartho'vagamyate, nātmanepadāt | krayaṇe hi viniyujyate vinatā | krayaṇasya cātra dāsyavinavṛttilakṣaṇaṃ phalaṃ kretuḥ karturātmagāmīti kartrabhiprāyakriyāphalagatamātmanepadaṃ vihitam | iyatyeva śabdārthe paryavasite parato'rthasāmarthyāt krāpayeti ṇyaryo'trāvadhāryate | tathā hi-sā vinatātmānaṃ kathaṃ krīṇāti dāsyānmocayati? yadi pratyupakāraṃ kādraveyāṇāmācarati | na ca sā svayaṃ pratyupakartuṃ śakteti putrānāha krīṇīta mām iti | tathā ca `putrairātmānaṃ dāsyānmocaya',`kāpaya' ityamartho'sya krīṇīṣva iti padasya prakaraṇasāmarthyaparyālocanayā labhyata iti na padārthaviṣayeṇātmanepadenātra ṇic samānaviṣaya iti | evaṃ keśaśmaśru vapata iti prayogo bhrāntibījaṃ dṛśyate | tathā hi vapate paranaṃ muṇḍanamanyena kārayatītyarthaḥ iti ṇijātmanepade samānaviṣaye manyante | atra ca tiṅantāt kartṛdāmi kriyāphalaṃ pratīyata ityāmanepadaṃ sāmarthyāt tu svayamaśakto'nyaṃ prayuṅakta ityavagamyate | tathā' `tṛptā patnī reto dhatte' iti prayogo dṛśyate śiṣṭānām | reto dhāpayatītyatra cārthaḥ sāmarthyagamyaḥ | na hi patnyāḥ pauṃsnaṃ sambhavatiṃ, tacca retodhāraṇayogyam, pumindriyeṇa taddhāraṇāt, patnyāstu retodhāraṇayogyapumindriyābhāva iti sāmarthyalabhyo'tra ṇyartho na tiṅ‌ntavācyo yenātmanepadena samānaviṣayatā ṇicaḥ syāt | ātmanepadāddhi dhāraṇasvātantryamātramavagamyate | tacca patnīsambandhād vākyārthaparyālocanayā prayojakakartṛviṣayamātramavagamyate | padaṃ hi padāntaranirapekṣaṃ svārthamātramāvedayate | vākyasāmarthyāttu viśiṣṭārthāvagatiḥ | "saiṣātra yajñasya samṛddhiryo'gniṃ cinute yaścinoti yaścīyate" ityatrāpi cinuta iti śiṣṭaprayoge saṃvidhātā cayanagataḥ pratīyate | tiṅaḥ sāmarthyāttu preṣaṇamaśabdārtho'pi ṇijviṣayaṃ pratīyate | yo hi svayaṃ cayanamanutiṣṭhati paraprayuktaḥ sa cinotītyetasmādevāvagamyate iti prayojakastṛtīyo'rthāccinuta ityataḥ pratīyate | tadeteṣu prayogeṣvarthasāmarthyādināvasitamapi ṇyarthamātmanepadāntaśabdārtha iti matvā kaiścid bhramāṇṇijātmanepadayorvaṣayasāmyaṃ sarvatrāśritya vikalpaḥ pratipāditaḥ | gatamadaḥ || 7 ||
iha saṃvidhāne ātmanepadamityuktam | pacādīnāṃ ca pradhānabhūtaviklittyādivacanāt kathaṃ saṃvidhānopādānaṃ yena tadviśiṣṭavacanād dhātostatrātmanepadaṃ syādityāśaṅkhyāha | saṃvidhānaṃ pacādīnāṃ kvacidarthaḥ pratīyate | tannimittā yathānyāpi kriyādhiśrayaṇādikā || 8 ||
"kaḥ paceḥ pradhānārthaḥ | yāsau taṇḍulānāṃ viklittiḥ | athedānīṃ preṣaṇamadhyeṣaṇaṃ vā yuktaṃ yat sarvaṃ pacyarthaḥ syāt | bāḍhaṃ yuktam | " iti bhāṣye prayojakavyāpārasyāpi dhātvarthatopanyastā | tathā codāsīno'pi prayojakaḥ sāmagrīṃ paripoṣayan saṃvidhātā kāraka iti tad‌vyāpāro dhātuvācyaḥ pacata iti viklittyarthatvād yathādhiśrayaṇodakāsecanādiḥ prayojyakarturvyāpāraḥ | pacati devadatta iti adhiśrayati udakamāsecayati ityādyarthaḥ | pacate devadatta iti sambhāraṃ ḍhaukayatītyarthaḥ | tasyeva tu prayojyapreṣaṇe vivakṣite ṇij bhavati pācayatīti | na hi saṃvidhānameva praiṣaḥ, api tu tatpūrvakaṃ preraṇaṃ yatkurvan prayojaka ityucyate | saṃvidhānaṃ hi kurvannapi yāvat preṣaṇaṃ nācarati na tāvat prayojakaḥ kathyate || 8 ||
kartrabhiprāye vidhīyamānamātmanepadaṃ kathaṃ dhātoḥ saṃvidhānārthatāmākṣipatītyāha | kartrabhiprāyatā sūtre kriyābhedopalakṣaṇam | tayābhūtā kriyā yā hi tatkartā phalabhāg yataḥ || 9 ||
kartrabhiprāyakriyāphalagrahaṇena saṃvidhānaviśiṣṭā kriyā nirdiśyate yasmād yaivaṃbhūtā kriyā viśiṣṭarūpā tasyāḥ kartā phalena yujyate | na hyasaṃvidadhad yājakādiḥ kriyāphalaṃ svargādyaśnute | tataśca kāryabhūtena phalasambandhena kāraṇabhūtā | kriyopalakṣiteti tatrātmanepadamityuktaṃ bhavati || 9 ||
upalakṣaṇe dṛṣṭāntamāha | yathopalakṣyate kālastārakādarśanādibhiḥ | tathā phalaviśeṣeṇa kriyābhedo nidarśyate || 10 ||
`nakṣatraṃ dṛṣṭavā vācaṃ visṛjet' iti nakṣatradarśanasya saṃdhyāvigamalakṣaṇakālaviśeṣolakṣaṇārthatvāt ghanāghanagahane gagane tadabhāve'pi nālikādibhistathāvidhakālāvadhāraṇe vāgvisargo bhavatyeva yathā tathā pradhāna phalasaṃbandhasya saṃvidhānopalakṣaṇārthatvādanādṛtyāpi phalaviśeṣadyotanamātmanepadaṃ saṃvidhānamātre bhavati || 10 ||
bhāṣye svaritañidgrahaṇaṃ pratyākhyātamiti yātiprabhṛtibhyo'pi kasmādātmanepadaṃ na bhavatītyāha | kriyāviśeṣavacane sāmarthyamuparudhyate | keṣāñcadanye tu kṛtāḥ svariteto ñitastathā || 11 ||
kartrabhiprāyakriyāphalopalakṣite saṃvidhānalakṣaṇe kriyāviśeṣe pratyāyye yātiprabhṛtīnāṃ dhātūnāṃ śaktiḥ pratihanyate | niyatā hi śabdaśaktiḥ | ye tu saṃvidhānābhidhānasamarthāstesvaritetsaṃjñakā ñakāretsaṃjñakāśca paṭhitā dhātupāṭhe saṃvidhānaviśiṣṭakriyāvacanasāmarthyamavadyotayitumityarthaḥ | svābhāvikī hi dhātūnāṃ śaktirniyataviṣayā duravasāneti ñakārādyanubandhastadavagamāya kṛto gaṇakāraiḥ || 11 ||
yadyevaṃ kathaṃ svaritañidgrahaṇaṃ pratyākhyāyate | asati hi tasminnanubandhāḥ kathaṃ paṭhyante | taddhi teṣāṃ kāryam | asati tasmin tadabhāvaḥ | tathā ca saṃvidhānaviśiṣṭakriyābhidhānaśaktirdhātūnāṃ kathamavagamyetetyāha | anubandhaśca siddhe'rthe smṛtyarthamanuṣajyate | tulyārtheṣvapi cāvaśyaṃ na sarveṣvekadharmatā || 12 ||
iha kriyāmātravacanatvena samānābhidheye'ṣvapi dhātuṣu na sarveṣu kriyāmātravacanasvabhāvaḥ, api tu śabdaśaktivaicitryād yathāsvaṃ viśiṣṭakriyāvacanatvam | tathā hi-`yā prāpaṇe', `ṇīñ prāpaṇe' iti tulye'pyarthanirdheśe yāteḥ prāptiḥ prāpaṇamarthaḥ, nayatestu prāpaṇā prāpaṇamiti saṃvidhānamartho'vagamyate | evamanyeṣāmapi saṃvidhānārthatā svābhāvikī boddhavyā | tāmeva sūcayituṃ ñakārādyanubandhaḥ smaraṇārthaṃ niveśyate | yo hi prayogādeva svabhāvaviśeṣamavadhārayitumaśaktastaṃ prati smṛtyartho'nubandhāsaṅgaḥ, prayogajñaṃ tu prati nārthastena | tathā ca prayogadarśinaṃ ca prati svaritañidgrahaṇaṃ śakyamakartumiti pratyākhyātaṃ etadbhāṣye | vacanānusāriṇaṃ tu prati kriyata evaitat | tathā ca bhāṣyam "vṛttajño hyācāryaḥ tatsamarthān anubandhān āsajati" iti | vartante'smin kāryāṇīti vṛttaṃ prayogo vartanaṃ vṛttamiti śabdavyāpāro vā | tajjñaḥ sūtrakāro vacanānusāriṇamavṛttajñaṃ prati ñakāramāsatītyarthaḥ || 12 ||
tulyārtheṣvapi naikadharmatetyatra dṛṣṭāntamāha | dṛśīkṣyoḥ sadṛśe'pyarthe nābhedaḥ pratipūrvayoḥ | ṇyarthopādāyinastasmānna tulyārthāḥ pacādibhiḥ || 13 ||
gaṇapaṭhite'rte samāne'pīkṣate paśyatītyanayoḥ pratipūrvayoḥ nābhedo na samānārthatā, api tu pratakṣīṃta ityanya evārthaḥ pratipālanaṃ nāma | pratipaśyatīti tu pratīpadarśanamarthaḥ | dṛśīkṣī copalakṣaṇaṃ rakṣatipālayatyorapi, pratirakṣati pratipālayatītyanya evārthaḥ | evaṃ haratinayatyoḥ sampūrvayoḥ saṃharati saṃnayatītyādyapyudāhāryam | evaṃ ṇyarthamapi ye sambandhitayā svīkurvanti te saṃvidhānābhidāyibhiḥ pacādibhirna samānavācyāḥ | na hi sarve dhātavo ṇyarthena saṃgacchanta ityetāvatā saṃvidhānābhidhāyino'pi syuḥ, śaktibhedāt | praiṣo hi ṇyarthaḥ, saṃvidhānaṃ tato'nyat taddheturapītyuktameva | ata eva saṃvidhānameva ṇyartho'tra nābhimataḥ | evaṃ hi pacādibhistadabhidhāyināṃ bhinnārthatā na bhavet, pacādīnāmapi saṃvidhānābhidhānāt sāmānyena pacādibhirityuktatvānna parasmaipadāntairātmanepadāntānāṃ bhinnārthateti labhyate || 13 ||
saṃvidhānena svaritañid‌vyatiriktānāṃ na sarvayaivāyogo'pi tu yoge'pi te tadabhidhānaśaktivikalā ityāha | umbhyarthe vartamānasya karoterbhinnadharmaṇaḥ | ṇyarthopādāyitā tasmānniyatāḥ śabdaśaktayaḥ || 14 ||
udumbhāñcakāretyāmantasyānabhivyaktapadārthakasyābhivyakttyarthaṃ karotiranuprayujyate | sa ca kriyāsāmānyavācītyatrombhyarthe vartate | tataśca tasya viśiṣṭakriyopanipāte bhinnadharmaṇo nānāsvabhāvasya ṇyartha iva ṇyarthaḥ saṃvidhānaṃ tadabhidhāyitvaṃ dṛṣṭam | tathā ca ñidayaṃ paṭhitaḥ | yata evaṃ tasmācchabdānāṃ śaktayo niyatāḥ | ekasminnapi hyarthe'trombheḥ saṃvidhānābhidhāne śaktirnāsti karotestvasti | itthaṃ cāsti saṃvidhānenommeḥ sambandho yena tadarthapravṛtteḥ karotestadabhidhānaśaktiḥ | satyapi ca tasmiṃstadabhidhānasāmarthyamasya nāsti | vastuta eva tu saṃvidhānenombheḥ sambaṃdhābhāve karotyartho'pi saṃvidhānena na viśeṣyate || 14 ||
kathamavasīyate karotyartho'tra saṃvidhānaviśiṣṭa iti tadarthasaṃpratyāyakasyātmanepadasyādarśanādityāśaṅkya bhāṣyakārābhyupagamamatrārthe saṃvādakamāha | tathā hyanuprayogasya karoterātmanepade | pūrvavad‌grahaṇaṃ prāpte svaritaṃ samupasthitam || 15 ||
iha `ām‌pratyayavatkṛño'nuprayogasya'  ityātmanepadavidhānamakartrabhiprāye caritārtham | kartrabhiprāye tu kṛño'nuyogasyātmanepade `svaritañitaḥ kartrabhiprāye kriyāphale'  ityanena prasakte `pūrvavat sanaḥ' ityataḥ sūtrāt svaritaliṅgayuktaṃ pūrvavadgrahaṇamadhikṛtamiti bhāṣyakāreṇopagatam | tathā cānuprayogasya kṛño yadām‌pratyayāt pūrvasya dhātorātmanepadaṃ tadā kartrabhiprāye'pi tad bhavati nānyatheti niyamārthāt pūrvavadgrahaṇādatrātmanepadābhāvaḥ | etacca kathamupapadyate yadyanuprayogasya karoteḥ saṃvidhānābhidhānasāmarthyaṃ syāt | anyathātmanepadāprasaṅgāt kiṃ pūrvavad‌grahaṇena || 15 ||
ṇij‌yogyārthābhidhāne'pi na sarveṣāṃ dhātūnāṃ saṃvidhānapratyāyanasāmarthyamapyanumeyamityetannidarśanopanyāsena sthirayati | ekatve'pi kriyākhyāte sādhanāśrayasaṃkhyayā | bhidyate na tu liṅgākhyo bhedastatra tadāśritaḥ || 16 ||
sādhyasvabhāvatvāt kriyāyāḥ svato nāsti bhedaḥ | tiṅantapadaviṣaye tvekapadopāttakartṛkarmalakṣaṇasādhanādhāradravyagatadvitvabahutvābhyāṃ pacataḥ pacanti pacyete pacyante iti viśiṣyate | dvibahusādhanasādhyatvaṃ hyatropagamyate kriyāyāḥ | yathā ca sādhanādāradravyasaṃkhyāyogastathā tadgataliṅgaviśeṣayogo'pi kasmānna bhavatīti na śakyate vaktumākhyātālliṅgaviśeṣasyāpratīteḥ | ekapadopādāne sādhanāśrayasya dvitvāderevāvagamo na tu strītvapuṃstvaviśiṣṭe'rthe samaveteyaṃ kriyetyākhyātādavagamyate | svābhāvikaṃ hi śabdānāmartha pratyāyanaṃ na yuktigamyam | sādhanasaṅgakhyayetyeva vaktavye vyāpārāviṣṭaṃ dravyātmakameva saṅkhyāyuktamākhyātābhidheyaṃ na śaktimātramityāśrayagrahaṇena sūcayati | tathā ca devadattaḥ pacatīti dravyeṇa sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ dṛśyate | ata eva dravyavādināmākhyātārtho'pi dravyamityabhyupagamaḥ || 16 ||
tadayaṃ nidarśanārthaḥ sādhyena yojyate | tasmādavasthite'pyarthe kasyacit pratibadhyate | śabdasya śaktiḥ sa tveṣa śāstre'nvakhyāyate vidhiḥ || 17 ||
yata evaṃ śabdaśaktibhedāpekṣama bhidānamanyatrāpi tasmāt saṃvidhānasaṃbandhe satyapi dhātūnāṃ kasyacid yātyādestatpratyāyane sāmarthyaṃ pratihanyata ityuktamumbhyādisamānārthasya karoteḥ saṃvidhānābhidhānasāmarthyaṃ nombheriti | sa caiṣa śabdaśaktiniyamārthaḥ prakāraḥ svaritañid‌grahaṇena śāstre jñāpyate prakaṭīkriyate | gatametat || 17 ||
iha yajanti yājakāḥ pacanti bhaktakarā ityetat kartrabhiprāyakriyāphalagrahaṇasya vyāvartyamudāhṛtya yājakānapi dakṣiṇā phalamabhipraiti karmakarānapi bhṛtirityākṣipya "sarvatraiva kriyāphalaṃ kartāramabhipraiti | tatra prakarṣagatirvijñāyate sādhīyo yat kriyāphalamabhipraiti | kiñca sādhīyo yadarthā kriyārabhyate" iti bhāṣye samarthitam etad vyācaṣṭe | yasyārthasya prasiddhyarthamārabhyante pacādayaḥ | tat pradhānaṃ phalaṃ teṣāṃ na lābhādi prayojanam || 18 ||
iha kartrabhiprāyakriyāphalasya saṃvidhānopalakṣaṇatvāt saṃvidhānakriyāvacanād dhātorātmanepadamityuktaṃ bhavati | yatra ca saṃvidhāne yat phalaṃ tadevopalakṣaṇaṃ yuktam | tacca yadarthaṃ saṃvidhānārambhaḥ , yaduddeśena hi saṃvidhātā prathamameva saṃvidhānaṃ sādhanopārjanaṃ yogyatānusāreṇa ca pravartanamārabhate tat svārgādi pradhānaṃ phalaṃ veditavyam | saṃvidhātrā niyuktāni kārakāṇi tadicchayā pravartanta iti teṣāṃ dakṣiṇā bhṛtirvā phalamapradhānaṃ tādarthyena pūrvameva kriyāpravṛttyayogāt | saṃvidhātā punaḥ pradhānakriyārthamudāsīno'pi bahumukhamāceṣṭata iti mukhyaphalābhisandhānena sa eva kriyāḥ pacyādikāḥ pravartayati | tadayaṃ phalasya prakarṣastādarthyena pūrvameva pradhānakriyārambhād vyākhyātaḥ || 18 ||
saṃvidhāne ātmanepadamityasmin pakṣe siddhānte coditaṃ bhāṣye--- "iha kathaṃ bhavitavyaṃ svāmidāsau pacataḥ" iti | etad vyācaṣṭe | yatraubhau svāmidāsau tu prārabhete sahakriyām | yugapad dharmabhedena dhātustatra na vartate || 19 ||
prabhubhṛtyayoḥ sambhūya dvandvanirdeśenābhidhīyamānayoḥ kriyārambhe tatsādhyasya vyāpārasya bhedāt yugapadekakālaṃ dhāturvācakatvaṃ nāsādayati | tathāhi-prabhusādhyaṃ saṃvidhānaṃ sambhāraghaṭanaṃ bhṛtyasādhyaṃ tu pradhānakriyārūpamiti vilakṣaṇatvāt vyāpārasyaikadhātuvācyatā nopapadyate | tathā ca kimātmanepadaṃ saṃvidhātrapekṣaṃ kriyatāṃ kiṃ vā dāsāpekṣaṃ parasmaipadamiti saṃśayo na vyāvartate || 19 ||
athāpi kathañcit kriyādvayaṃ vilakṣaṇamapyanekārthatvād dhāturabhidadhīta tathāpi yatra pratividhānārthaḥ pacistatrātmanepadam | parasmaipadamanyatra saṃskarādyabhidhāyini || 20 ||
pratividhānaṃ saṃvidhānaṃ tadvacanāt paceḥ ātmanepadam āmnātaṃ vākyagataviklittiparyantasādhanaviniyogādilakṣaṇasaṃskārādivacanāt tu parasmaipadam iti dhātunārthadrayasvākāre'pyekasmin prayoge viruddhasvarūpalādeśadvayanupapattiḥ || 20 ||
atra samādhiḥ saṃvidhātuśca sānnidhyāt dāse dharmo'nuṣajyate | plakṣaśabdasya sānnidhyānnyagrodhe plakṣatā yathā || 21 ||
ayamarthaḥ | atulyakakṣyayoryadyekaśabdavācyatā'bhyupagamyate tadā yugapadadhikaraṇavacanatāyāṃ dvandvavidhānād dvandvanirdiṣṭau svāmigadāsāvekasmin pacyarthe saha vivakṣyate | tatra cetaretaradharmādhyāsāt sāhacaryamiti svāmisāhacaryād dāse saṃvidhānaṃ tadvayāpāro'dhyāropyate | tathā ca svāminā tulyo dāsa iti svāmidvayasya kartṛtve saṃvidhānavacanād dhātorātmanepadaṃ kriyate svāmidāsau pacete iti | tad yathā plakṣanyagrodhāviti sahavivakṣāyāṃ nyagrodhe plakṣarūpāropaḥ prakṣaraṇānnyagrodho'pi plakṣa iti | tathā cānusyūtabhedasya samudāyasyābhidhānāditaretarāpekṣāyāṃ dvandvād dvivacanaṃ bhavati | etadagre dvandvavicāre nirṇeṣyāmaḥ || 21 ||
kathamatadrūpeṇa sannidhānamātrādanyarūpāropa iti dṛṣṭāntena vyutpādayati | puroḍāśābhidhānaṃ ca dhānādiṣu yathā sthitam | chatriṇā cābhisaṃbandhācchatriśabdābhidheyatā || 22 ||
prātaḥsavane "puroḍāśaiḥ pracaranti" ityucyate | tatra caikasya puroḍāśasya bahutvasaṃkhyānupapattestatsahacariteṣvadhyāropitapuroḍāśayāgeṣu satsvayaṃ prayogaḥ | tatra puroḍāśaḥ dhānāḥ karambhaḥ parivāpaḥ payasyeti pañca puroḍāśāḥ kathyante | tathā chatriṇo yāntīti bahuvacanānyathānupapattyā parākṛtacchatrasaṃbandhā api chatrisāhacaryāt tacchabdenābhidhīyante | evaṃ dāse'pisvāmisāhacaryād dvandvanirdeśānyathānupapattyā svāmidharmāsaṅga ityātmanepadaṃ bhavati | svāmidāsasādhyasya hi vyāpārasya bhedo'tra na vivakṣyate ityabhinnadhātuvācyakriyārūpāśrayapradhānagatadharmopapattiḥ || 22 ||
yadvā matāntaramatretyāha | arthāt pratītamanyonyaṃ pārārthyamavivakṣitam | ityayaṃ śeṣaviṣayaḥ kaiścidatrānuvarṇyate || 23 ||
svāmidāsayoḥ kriyāpakāritvaṃ vilakṣaṇamekasya mukhyaphalābhisandhānāditarasya tadanabhisandhānādityetadavivakṣitvā sāmānyena mātāpitarau putraṃ janayata itivat kriyāyāṃ kartṛtvamātravivakṣāyāṃ `śeṣāt kartari parasmaipadam' bhavati | svāmipadasannidhānādeva hi saṃvidhānamavagataṃ dāsapadārthasāmarthyācca tasyānyagāmi kriyāphalamiti caritārthatvādākhyātasya nātra vyāpāra iti kriyāsāmānyavacanāddhātorātmanepadavidhāvanupayogāccheṣāt parasmaipadaṃ ' svāmidāsau pacata iti || 23 ||
pañcabhirhalaiḥ kṛṣatīti svāminaḥ pratividhātustathā sambhavāṇṇicaḥ prāptimāpādayituṃ bhāṣyakāreṇopanyastam | tatra codyate | atha pratividhātā yo halaiḥ kṛṣati pañcabhiḥ | bhāṣye nohāhṛtaṃ kasmāt prāptaṃ tatrātmanepadam || 24 ||
yugapat pañcabhirhalaiḥ karṣaṇaṃ svāmina upapadyate, na karṣakasyeti pratividhātaryātmanepadaṃ pratividhānavacanād dhātoḥ kutaḥ kāraṇāllakṣaṇena prāptaṃ na kṛtaṃ bhāṣyakāreṇa || 24 ||
atra parihāraṃ śaṅkitvā pratikṣipati | pratītatvāt tadarthasya śeṣatvaṃ yadi kalpyate | na syāt prāptavibhāṣāsau svaritetāṃ nivartikā || 25 ||
bhṛtyasya pañcabhirhalairyugapad vilekhanāsambhavāt svāmyeva tatheti gatārthatvāt saṃvidhānasyātmānepadavidhāvanupayogāt śeṣatvaṃ parasmaipadanimittaṃ yadyatrāvasthāpyate tadā pradeśāntaravirodhaḥ prāpnoti | tathā hi `na veti vibhāṣā'  ityatra `vibhāṣopapadena pratīyamāne'  itīyaṃ prāptavibhāṣā gaṇitā kartrabhiprāye kriyāphale svaritetsaṃjñākānāṃ nitye ātmanepade prāpte pakṣe tannivṛttyarthā | yadi cātropapadena dyotite na syādātmanepadaṃ tadā svaṃ yajñaṃ yajatītyādāvapi tadaprāpteḥ vibhāṣopapadena...... ityaprāptavibhāṣā bhaved vidhimukhena pravṛtterapi virodhaḥ | tasmād dvābhyāmupapadātmanepadābhyāṃ saṃvidhānaṃ dyotyata iti prāptavibhāṣāvacanāllabhyata iti kathamatrātmanepadaṃ na bhavet || 25 ||
atra kecidāhuḥ | śuddhe tu saṃvidhānārthe kaiścidatreṣyate kṛṣiḥ | taddharmā yajirityevaṃ na syāttatrātmanepadam || 26 ||
ye ṇicā samānaviṣayatāmātmanepadasya manyante, ta evamicchanti saṃvidhānamātre'rthe kṛṣirvartata iti na bhavatyātmanepadaṃ ṇij‌vaditi | tathā hi ṇic‌parihārāyoktam--- "kṛṣṇādiṣu cānutpattirnānākriyāṇāṃ kṛṣyarthatvāt  "nāvaśyaṃ kṛṣirvilekhana eva vartate | kiṃ tarhi | pratividhāne'pi vartate | evaṃ śuddhe vilekhanānavacchinne saṃvidhānārthe kṛṣiḥ vartata iti vilekhanasya prayojyavyāpārasyāsambhavād yathā ṇiñ notpadyate tathātmanepadamapi, saṃvidhānena viśeṣyamāṇasyānyasya dhātvarthasyābhāvāt | saṃvidhānaviśiṣṭārthavācino hi dhātorātmanepadaṃ na tu śuddhasaṃvidhānavacanāt | yadyapi ca vilekhanamatra dhātvarthaḥ tathāpi tadviṣayaṃ pratividhānaṃ viśiṣṭameva śabdaśaktisvābhāvyāt kṛṣirabhidhatte| tad yathā-- `phale lugvacanānārthakyaṃ prakṛtyantaratvāt' iti pratyākhyāte luki rūḍhiśabdatve'pi śabdaśaktisvābhāvyādāmalakādibhirvanaspativiśeṣaprabhava eva phalaviśeṣo'bhidhīyate | tadetannivārayati | tathā hyevamatrocyamāne yajiḥ api tasya kṛṣeriva dharmo'syeti taddharmā kṛṣidharmā syāditi tato'pi na bhavedātmanepadam | yathā hi kṛṣiḥ śuddhe pratividhāne vartate tathā yajirapi varteta | tathā ca bhāṣye pratividhāne yajervṛttiruktā | idaṃ hi tatra codyate-- "iha yājakā yājayantītīṣyate | haviḥprakṣepamātravacane tu yajau yājakāḥ haviḥ prakṣipanti, tān yajamānaḥ prayojayan yājayatīti viparītamabhidhānaṃ syāt" iti | atra parihāra uktaḥ "yajyādiṣvaviparyāso nānākriyāṇāṃ yajyarthatvāt" "nāvaśyaṃ yajirhaviḥprakṣepaṇa eva vartate | kiṃ tarhi | tyāge'pi | taṃ yajamānaḥ karoti, yājakāḥ kārayanti |" iti | evaṃ ca dravyatyāgamātrarūpo yajerartha iti kṛṣivat tato'pi na syādātmanepadam | atha tyāgaviśiṣṭaṃ pratividhānaṃ yajyartha iti bhavatyātmanepadaṃ kṛṣerapi vilekhanaviśiṣṭaṃ saṃvidhānamartha iti prasajyata evātmanepadam | ṇic tu praiṣasyāsampratyayānna bhavati | na hi saṃvidhānameva ṇyartha iti pūrvameva nirṇītam || 26 ||
kathaṃ tarhyātmanepadaṃ na bhavatīti siddhāntamāha | atra tūpapadenāyamarthabhedaḥ pratīyate | prāpte vibhāṣā kriyate tasmānnāstyātmanepadam || 27 ||
samīpe śrūyamāṇena pañcabhirhalairiti padenāyaṃ saṃvidhānalakṣaṇo'rthaviśeṣo gamyate yatastato'tra `vibhāṣopapadena pratīyamāne'  iti prāpta ātmanepade vibhāṣākaraṇāt pakṣe na bhavatīti kṛṣatīti sādhuḥ prayogo bhāṣye'vasthita iti siddhamiṣṭam || 27 ||
iti bhūtirājatanayahelārājakṛte prakīrṇakaprakāśe upagrahasamuddeśo dvādaśaḥ || <3.3> prakāśaḥ asamastapadagatānarthān vicārya samastapadaviṣayān vicārayituṃ pañcaprakāravṛtti- padavicāraḥ prastāvyate | tatra prathamaṃ samānādhikaraṇatadhditavṛttivicāraḥ | tathāhi--kutsitādīnāmarthe rcolliṅgavacanānupapattiḥ| kutsitādisamānādhikaraṇāditi cet, atiprasaṅgaḥ, yathā ṭābādiṣviti pratyayārthapakṣaṃ samānādhikaraṇapakṣaṃ ca doṣavantamubhdāvya 'sidhdaṃ tu yena kutsitādivacanaṃ tadyuktāt svārthe pratyayavidhānāt" iti prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇapakṣo 'vasthāpitaḥ | yena dharmeṇa kutsādayaḥ pratipādyante tadhdarmayuktārthābhidhāyinaḥ prātipadikāt tenaiva kutsāderupādā(nā)t tad‌dyotanāya svārthe kanādayaḥ pratyayā vidheyā iti vārtikārthaḥ | evañca prakṛtyartho viśiṣṭaḥ pratyayārtho na kutsādidharmamātramiti liṅgavacanopapattiḥ | upāttakutsādereva caśabdāt pratyaya iti tatsamānādhikaraṇādidamādeḥ svayamanupāttakutsādestadabhāvaḥ | evaṃ sthite kena dharmeṇa kutsādaya ityuktam | 'svārthamabhidhāya śabdo nirapekṣa--'ityādi | svārthādipañcakābhidhāyinaḥ prātipadikāt svārthādinimittaku-tsanādidyātanāya kanādayaḥ pratyayā iti prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇapakṣaḥ | 'priyakutsānādiṣu punaḥ pravartate'sau vibhak‌tyantaḥ' iti ca na subantāt pratyayavidhānaparametad vacanam, api tu pañcakārtha nimittatvāt kutsanādeḥ 'devadattakaḥ' ityādau kutsādimātre pratyayena dyotite prakaraṇādestadhdeturliṅgādīnāmanyatamo'vadhāryate | sa ca subantena dyotyata iti viśiṣṭakutsādyarthapratipādanāya vibhak‌tyantaḥ pravartata ityucyate | tadetad vyācaṣṭe-- kutsāpraśaṃsātiśayaiḥ samāptārthaṃ tu yujyate | padaṃ svārthadayaḥ sarve yasmāt‌ kutsādihetavaḥ || 1 ||
svārthadravyaliṅgasaṅkhayākarmādilakṣaṇenārthena paripūrṇābhidheyaṃ padaṃ svārthādi- nimittena viśiṣṭena kutsādyarthena yuktamavadhāryate | svārthādayaścānyatra vyākhyātā neha prapañcyante | tadatra prātipadikārthanimittatvāt kutsādesta- dviśiṣṭārthābhidhāyinaḥ prātipadikādevādhikārāt pratyayaḥ | pratyayāntād vibhaktiparācca kutsādihetorviśiṣṭasyābhivyaktiriti samāptārthaṃ tena sambadhyata ityucyate | tatra svārthanimittā kutsā yathā--paṭukaḥ, paṇḍitakaḥ, mṛduka iti | pāṭavāderaparipūrṇatvād duṣṭatvād vā kutsyate'rthaḥ | evaṃ paṭurūpaḥ paṭutara ityādipraśaṃsātiśayayoḥ svārthanimittayorudāhāryam | dravyasya viśeṣyatvena prādhānyād dharmāntaramukhenaiva tannimittaḥ kutsādirbodhdavyaḥ | liṅganimittā kutsā yathā--puruṣe klībatvapratipādanārthā strītvāropeṇa kutsā, nirlajjatvākhyānāya vā striyāṃ puṃstvāropeṇa puruṣo'yaṃ strī, strīyaṃ puruṣa iti ca | parārthe śabdaprayogādeva kutsāvagateḥ kapratyayasyāya- maviṣayaḥ | evamekatraiva durbharatvād bahutvasamāropādidameva me sahasramiti saṅkhyānimittā kutsā | pratyayo'tra pūrvavanna bhavati | evaṃ praśaṃsādāvapi yathāyogaṃpradarśanīyam || 1 ||
tadatra `kutsitakaḥ, anukampitakaḥ' iti ko na prāpnoti,svaśabdenābhihitatvāditi | tadbhāṣye coditaṃ parihartumāha-- devadattādikutsāyāṃ vartate kutsitaśrutiḥ | kutsitasthā tu yā kutsā tadarthaḥ ko vidhīyate || 2 ||
kutsāṃ pravṛttinimittāmāśritya devadatte kutsitaśabdo vartate | sa ca kutsā-sambandhopalakṣitaṃ liṅgasaṅkhyākarmādyupādhikaṃ dravyamabhidhatta iti svārthamātre viśrāntyabhāvādarthāntare liṅgādāvapi tātparyād bāhyakutsāpratipādane sāmarthyābhāvāt tatra pratyaya utpadyate | svārthabhūtā hi prātipadikavācyā devadattādeḥ kutsā,tad‌vyatiriktā tu bāhyā svārthādinimittā pratyayavācyā | tad yathā devadattaśabdāt priyakutsanādisādhāraṇārthābhidhāyinaḥ kapratyayaḥ kutsā- sambandhaṃ prakāśayati, tathā kutsitaśabdādarthāntaranimitta pravṛttinimittabhūtakutsā- bhidhāyinaḥ svārthagatāṃ bāhyāṃ kutsāṃ prakāśayituṃ kapratyaya ityarthaḥ || 2 ||
evamatiśāyane'pi svaśabdenābhihite tatpratyayāprasaṅgaḥ iti samānanyāyatvātcoditaṃbhavatīti tadapi prakṛtasamādhānāya pratividhatte-- prakṛṣṭa iti śuklādiprakarṣasyābhidhāyakaḥ | prakṛṣṭasya prakarṣe tu tarabādirvidhīyate || 3 ||
yo'tiśayena śuklaḥ śuklataraḥ,sa prakṛṣṭaḥ śukla ityucyate | niratiśayāpekṣayā hi sātiśayaḥ śuklastarabantena vā śuklaśabdenocyate, kevalena vā prakṛṣṭaśabdena | tathā ca śuklādigatasya prakarṣasya prakṛṣṭaśabdo'bhidhāyaka iti na tatraiva tatastarappratyayaḥ | yastvaparaḥ prakṛṣyebhyo'pi tasya prakarṣaḥ, sa nābhihita iti tadabhidhānāya tarap kriyate,prakṛṣyatara iti | yathā jyeṣṭatamāyetyatiśāyanapratyayāntaram | ādigrahaṇāt praśasta- rūpamiti praśaṃsopādheḥ pratyayāntaramudāhāryam | evaṃ kutsitaka iti kutsitasthe kutsāntare kaḥ || 3 ||
kiṃ punaḥ kutsitasya kutsāntaramityata āha-- kutsitatvena kutsyo vā na samyag vāpi kutsitaḥ | svaśabdābhihite kena viśiṣṭo'rthaḥ pratīyate || 4 ||
svaśabdena kutsita ityanena sāmānyaśabdenābhihite'rthe viśeṣo nāvadhāryate-- kimasyākāryakaraṇānnindārhatvenaiva kutsitatvam, uta yuktakāryapi śatruṇā duṣṭa- tvāropoṇa garhyata iti | utpanne tu pratyaye viśeṣāvadhāraṇam | tathā hi--kutsitamasyakutsitatvam,na samyagidaṃ kutsitatvam, śatruṇā tu dveṣeṇādhyāropitamiti pratyayā-ntādanagamyate kutsitaśabdāt | sā hi kutsitasya kutsāyāṃ nirdoṣasyaiva kriyate | yadvā kutsāyā api nindya-taratvena kutsāviśeṣaḥ | tathā cānirdhāritadharmaviśeṣanibandhanā kutsā kutsitaśabda- pravṛttinimittam,brahmahatyādiviśeṣanibandhanā tu kapratyayaheturiti viśeṣaḥ | tadevaṃkutsitārthasamavetāṃ dvitīyāṃ kutsāmāśritya samarthitam || 4 ||
yadvā nāstyevātra dvitīyā kutsā | yaiva tu prātiradikenopāttā, tatraiva pratyaya ityāha-- na ca sāmpratikī kutsā bhedābhāvāt pratīyate | pūjyate kutsitatvena praśastatvena kutsyate || 5 ||
kutsopalakṣitasya dravyasya kutsitaśabdena priyakutsanādisādhāraṇasyābhidhānād vartamānakutsābhisambandho nāvadhāryate'smāt | tathāhi--tat kutsayopalakṣitaṃ dravyaṃ kadācit pūjyate praśasyate'pi kutsitarūpa iti | yathā vṛṣalarūpo, dasyurūpa iti | tadyathā praśastatvenopalakṣitaṃ nindyate praśastaka iti aparipūrṇapraśaṃso'dhyāropita-praśaṃso vā | kasyaciddhi praśaṃsā na parisamāptā, aṃśena khaṇḍitatvāt | kasyācit praśaṃsā na vidyate, ariṇādhyāropitatvāt | kasyacittu ariṇā praśastasyāpyapraśastatvamāropyate | evaṃ kutsāvyabhicārasambhavāt kutsitaśabdād vartamānakutsāsāmbandhamanavagataṃ dyotayitumupapadyate kapratyayaḥ | evam anukampitaka ityanenaiva nyāyenānukampāyāṃ kapratyayaḥ samarthanīya iti samānādhikaraṇataddhitavṛttau kiñcid vicāritam || 5 ||
yathā kutsādibhiḥ samāptārthaṃ padaṃ sambadhyate, tathā avacchedyāvacchedakabhāvenā- pīti samānādhikaraṇasubvṛttiṃ vicārayitumāha-- viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyatvaṃ padayorupajāyate | va prātipadikārthaśca tatraivaṃ vyatiricyate || 6 ||
iha `vīraḥ puruṣaḥ' iti vīrādiśabdo'napekṣitetaretarapadalamanvayo'vyatirikta- svārthamātravacanaḥ | tathā ca padāntarasaṃnidhāne'pi tasya tāvatyevābhidhā niścīyate, tatra ca sambandhe guṇapradhānabhāvasyāvaśyaṃbhāvād viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvo vākyārthaḥ padayoḥ samanvitayoradhiko jāyate, na prātipādikārthayoḥ | yathā `rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ' ityatra vyadhikaraṇapadaviṣaye rājaprātipadikārthasyaiva viśeṣaṇatvamiti tataḥ ṣaṣṭhī na viśeṣyādupakāryatvena svaniṣṭhāt | tathā ca "ṣaṣṭhī śeṣe" ityatroktam--`artharūpamevaivaṃjātīyakam iti | viśeṣyalakṣaṇarūpamavyatiriktasvārthaṃ svaniṣṭhamityarthaḥ | yadā ca samānādhikaraṇaviṣaye viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāve padārthapṛṣṭhapātitvena vākyārthatā, tadā tatra prātipadikārtho na vyatiricyate rūpāntareṇa na vipariṇamata iti prathamā nopasaṅkhayeyā | tathā coktaṃ `na vā vākyārthavad yadatrādhikyaṃ vākyārthachaḥ saḥ' iti | vyadhikaraṇaviṣaye tu viśeṣaṇasya rūpāntarāpattimavasāya bhedamabud‌dhvā coditam--`prāti- padikārthamātre prathamāvidhāne padasamānādhikaraṇa upasaṅkhayānamadhikatvād' iti | avacchedyāvacchedakabhāvasya cāniyamaśacoditaḥ | `viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyayorubhaya- viśeṣamatvādubhaya viśeṣyatvāccopasarjanāprasidhdiḥ' iti | viśeṣyābhimatenāpi viśeṣaṇābhimatasya svātmani niyamanāt tasyāpi taṃ prati viśeṣaṇatvamiti dvayorapi viśeṣaṇatvamiti samāsaśāstre prathamānirdeśādupasarjana- saṃjñāyāṃ pūrvanipātaḥ paryāyeṇa syāt | atra samādhiruktaḥ `na vānyatarasya pradhānabhāvāt tadviśeṣaṇatvāccetarasyopasarjanasya prasidhdiḥ' iti || 6 ||
tatra niyamena guṇapradhānabhāvaḥ kiṅkṛta iti vyācaṣṭe-- viśeṣyaṃ syādanirjñātaṃ nirjñātārtho viśeṣaṇam | parārthatvena śeṣatvaṃ sarveṣāmupakāriṇām || 7 ||
iha viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyayorlakṣaṇamanvarthena nāmnaivāveditam, bhedyaṃ viśeṣyam, bhedakam viśeṣaṇamiti | idaṃ tu guṇapradhānatājñāpanārtham | tatrocyate--sambandhānyathānupapattyaca sidhdo guṇapradhānabhāvaḥ, dvayoḥ samayoḥ sambandhāyogāditi kutaḥ saṅkaraḥ ? prasiddhayaprasiddhibhyāṃ vyavasthāpanāt | tathāhi--sāmānyātmanā kriyāsambandhitāyāmupakrāntaṃ viśeṣyaṃ jñātamapi svagatenātmabhūtena viśeṣaṇāniścitamiti tanniścayāya jñāpakatvādeva niścito'rtho guṇādiḥ pravartamāno viśeṣaṇam | tataśca jñāpyaṃ pradhānaṃ viśeṣyam, jñāpakaṃ paropakārāyopādīyamānaṃ śeṣabhūtamapradhānaṃ viśeṣaṇam | dravyasya ca sākṣātkriyā- sambandhāt tadeva tatra pradhānam | guṇastu tad‌dvāreṇa kriyānambandhamanubhavan dravyāvacchedako'pradhānabhūtaḥ | sarvatraiva saguṇasya dravyasya kriyāsambandhitayā vidhīyamānatvam | ādhāradvārako vā guṇānāṃ kriyāsambandhaḥ | na tu dravyamanūdya guṇasya pṛthak kriyāyāṃ vidhānamiti vyavasthito guṇapradhānabhāvaḥ | tena `kṛṣṇājinamulūkhalasyādhastādavastṛṇāti', `kṛṣṇājinena dīkṣayati'| `kṛṣṇāviṣāṇayā kaṇḍūyati' ityādau sarvatra guṇaviśiṣṭasya dravyasya vidhānāt tasyaiva prādhānye sati viśeṣyatvamitasya tu kṛṣṇaguṇasya viśeṣaṇatvamityupasarjanaprasidhdayarthamavasthito guṇapradhānayorniyamaḥ | sa ca samānādhi- karaṇasamāse ṣaṣṭhīsamāse ca || 7 ||
tathāhi-- vibhaktibhado niyamād guṇaguṇyabhidhāyinoḥ | sāmānādhikaraṇasya prasidhdirdravyaśabdayoḥ || 8 ||
paṭasya śukla iti dravyaguṇābhidhāyipadaprayoge śābdo guṇapradhānabhāvaḥ | tathā hyatro-pasarjanaṃ pradhānopakārapariṇataṃ svārthamācaṣṭa iti guṇavibhaktiṃ ṣaṣṭhīmupādatte | pradhānaṃtu svātmanyavasthitamaparopakārīti prathamayā yujyata iti niyato vibhaktibhedo vyadhikaraṇe viṣaye | `vīraḥ puruṣaḥ' ityādau tu samānādhikaraṇe viṣaye dvāvapi dravyaśabdausvaniṣṭhaṃ svārthamācakṣāte | tathā ca tatra prathamaiva | sāmarthyanibandhanastu guṇapradhāna-bhāva uktaḥ `viśeṣyaṃ syādanirjñātam' ityādinā | evañca satyapi guṇapradhāna- bhāve śabdāśabdatvakṛto viśeṣaḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyavaiyadhikaraṇayayoriti ṣaṣṭhīsamānādhikaraṇayoḥ samāsayorbhedaḥ || 8 ||
yadi tarhi samānādhikaraṇe viṣaye dvāvapi dravyaśabdau parasparānupakārakapradhānārthavācakau viśeṣiśeṣyabhāvātmakaḥ, tadā kathamanayoḥ parasparasambandha ityata āha-- dravye'nirjñātajātīye kṛṣṇaśabdaḥ prayujyate | anirjñātaguṇe caiva tilaśabdaḥ pravartate || 9 ||
abhedopacārānmatubalopādvā kṛṣṇaśabdo dravye vartate | sa ca guṇanimittaka iti tatra niyatajātīyatayā niścayastato nāsti | avinābhāvāt tu jātimātramavadhāryata eva | evaṃ tilaśabdo'pi jātinimitto'niścitaniyataguṇasambandhe dravye vartate | tathā ca dvayorapi viśeṣākāṅ‌kṣitvam || 9 ||
evamapi kathaṃ paraspareṇa sambandha ityāha-- sāmānyānāmasambandhāt tau viśeṣevyavasthitau | rūpābhedād viśeṣaṃ tamabhivyaṅktuṃ na śaknutaḥ || 10 ||
aniścitaniyatajātiguṇāni kṛṣṇatilaśabdābhidheyāni dravyāṇi sāmānyānyatra vivakṣitāni | teṣāmatra svātmavyavasthitānāṃ parasparopakārābhāvāt sambandho na syādityekavākyatāvaśāt sambandhānyakhānupapattyā prathamamevātra viśeṣe kṛṣṇatila- śabdau vyavasthitau | kṛṣṇaśabdena hyatra tilajātīyamevābhidhitsitam, tilaśabdena ca kṛṣṇaguṇaṃ dravyam | sa ca viśeṣaḥ pratipattṛbhiḥ parasparasambandhāt prāgavadhārayituṃ na śakyate | anyajātīye'pi kṛṣṇaśabdasya pravṛtteranyaguṇe'pi tilaśabdasyaivaṃvidha- syeti pratipattrapekṣayā viśeṣṭārthābhivyaktihetutvaṃ kathyate | taktrabhi- prāyāt tu viśiṣṭa evopakrānto'rthaḥ sambandhaḥ || 10 ||
sa eva vākyaikatāvaśādabhivyajyata ityāha-- tāvevaṃ sannipatitau bhedena pratipādane | avacchedamivādhāya saṃśayaṃ vyapakarṣataḥ || 11 ||
evamiti rūpābhedād vivakṣitaviśeṣapratipādane pratipattāraṃ pratyaśaktatvena pravṛttau kṛṣṇatilaśabdau viśeṣopalakṣitasya dravyasya pratyāyane pratipattṛgataṃ tilātilaviṣayam,kṛṣṇākṛṣṇaviṣayaṃ ca sandehaṃ nivārayataḥ, kṛṣṇaśabde'nya- jātīyād vyāvṛttiṃ tilaśabde cānyaguṇādādhāya | kṛṣṇaśabdo hi tilajātīyameva tilaśabdesannidhāne'rthamāhetyajātīyāt tasya nivṛttiḥ | evaṃ tilaśabdaḥ kṛṣṇaguṇame- vetyanyaguṇādasyāvacchedaḥ | sa cātra pūrvameva svīkṛta itīvaśabdaḥ | pratipattā hi sati sambandhe'vacchedamevaiti | taduktaṃ bhāṣye--"kṛṣṇaśabdastilaśabdenābhisambadhyamāno viśeṣavacanaḥ sampadyate | tathā tilaśabdaḥ kṛṣmaśabdenābhisambadhyamāno viśeṣavacanaḥ sampadyate" iti | tadānīṃ viśeṣavacanatvasyābhivyaktirityarthaḥ || 11 ||
tadevaṃ smbandhaḥ samarthitaḥ | sa cātra sāmānādhikaraṇyasvabhāvaḥ | sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ ca śabdayorbhinnanimittaprayuktayorekasminnarthe vṛttiriti | yadi samānābhidheyatva- lakṣaṇam, tadā viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvo'rthadvārakastayornopapannaḥ, bhedāśrayatvāt | tasyārthaikye tadabhāvāt | athārthayoḥ samānāśrayatvaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyam, tadā guṇadravyayoradhikaraṇāntarābhāvāt kathamatra tadupapattiḥ ? viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvastu syād dravyaguṇayoḥ | atha guṇasya dravyajāteścaikādhikaraṇyamāśrīyate, tadā viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvo na syāt | tayordravyāvacchedapravṛttayonyonānabhisambandhādityetadāśaṅkaya samarthayitumāha-- dravyātmā guṇasaṃsargabhedādāśrīyate pṛthak | jātismbandhabhedācca dvitīya iva guhyate || 12 ||
iha dravyātmā niraṃśavastu tattadupādhibhadārūpaṃ vyavahārayogyamiti kṛṣṇaguṇasama- vāyopahitabhedamanyadiva kṛṣṇatilābhidheyamākṣīyate | ekaikavyāvṛttiniṣṭhatvā- cchabdānāṃ tadabhideyaṃ bhāgaśaḥ khaṇḍarūpameva niyataṃ pratīyate | tataśca jātisamavāyopalakṣitaṃ tilaśabdena dvitīyamiva dravyaṃ pratyāyyate | ekasyaiva jātiguṇāvācchinnasya pratipādanādekaikaśabdavyāpārāpekṣayā vicchidyeva sampratyayādivaśabdaḥ || 12 ||
etadeva samarthayitumāha-- nimittairabhisambandhād yā nimittasarūpatā | tayaikasyāpi nānātvaṃ rūpābhedāt prakalpate || 13 ||
nimittād guṇajātyādernimittavatyarthe dravye nimittasarūpapratayayo jāyamānaḥ svapratyayaṃ vibhaktameva darśayati || 13 ||
tathā ca jātiguṇoparāgād bhinnaṃ dravyadvayamādheyam | tasya tvādhārabhūtaṃ tṛtīyaṃ dravyamabhisambandhakāle buddhayā nirbhajyata ityāha-- dravyāvasthā tṛtīyā tu yasyāṃ saṃsṛjyate dvayam | tayorevasthayorbhedādāśrayatve niyujyate || 14 ||
jātiguṇopādhisaṃsargapravibhaktaśarīradvayamādheyaṃ yatra saṃsṛjyate sambhedamāpadyate, tat tṛtīyaṃ dravyarūpamādhārabhūtamavacchedyam | avacchedakāt tasmād dvayādanyadāśrayatve tayordvayorniyujyate kalpyate || 14 ||
kathamekasya vastuto dravyasya bhedakalpanetyāha-- buddhayaikaṃ bhidyate bhinnamekatvaṃ copagacchati | buddhayāvasthā vibhajyante sā hyarthasya vidhāyikā || 15 ||
iha pratyayarūḍhārthābhidhāyinaḥ śabdā yathāpratyayaṃ bhedābhedābhyāṃ vyavahāraṃ varta- yanti | pratyayaśca svanimittānuvidhānenārthakārān bahirnirmimīta iva | tathā ca prāk samāsādupādhibhedācchuritasya dravyadvayasyābhidhānam | samāse tu bhedastirohitaḥ | so'rtho'ntarbhūta iti padasamudāyātmakamekaṃ padamabhedena kṛṣṇātilā ityarthamabhidhatte | tathā ca `nīlamañjarī, mattamadhukarī ' iti puṃvadbhāvaḥ samānādhikaraṇalakṣaṇaḥ siddhaḥ || 15 ||
buddhiprakalpitaśca bhedābhedavyavahāraḥ kātyāyanācāryasyāpyabhimata ityāha-- vyapadeśivadekasmin buddhayā nānārthakalpanā | tayā kalpitabhedaḥ sannarthātmā vyapadiśyate || 16 ||
tatra `vyapadeśivayadvacanam, ekāco dve prathamārtham' iti vyapadeśivadbhāvavacanam `avacanāllokavijñā nāt siddham' iti pratyācakṣāṇo vārtikakāro buddhipratibhāsinaṃśabdārthamabhyupagacchati | tathā hi buddhisamāropitabhedāśrayeṇa mukhyavadekasminnapi dvirvacanādikārthaṃ siddham | śabdaprayagācca pratyayasya gauṇamukhyayoraviśeṣaḥ, viparyayo bhedenoktaḥ | vikalpo hi puruṣasya caitanyaṃ svarūpamityatrābhinnasyāpi bhadapradarśane `rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ' itivat pratītisāmyam || 16 ||
śilāputrakasya śarīramityabhede'pi bhedo laukika vyapadeśivadbhāve dṛṣaṭāntitaḥ, taṃ vyācaṣṭe-- kriyābhedena dṛṣṭānāmaśmādināṃ punaḥ punaḥ | kiñcid darśanamanyena darśanenāpadiśyate || 17 ||
anekaśaḥ preṣaṇādikriyābhedopadhāritabhedānāṃ śilāputrakādīnāṃ vivakṣitaika- kriyāsambandhitvena jñānamanekakriyāgatena jñānena sambandhitayāvacchidyate | nānākriyāsambandhinaḥ śilāputrakasyedamekakriyāsambandhi pratiniyataṃ śarīramiti || 17 ||
evamiṇādidhātuviṣaye'pyekāctvaṃ bhedakalpanayā-- prayogabhedād dhātūnāṃ prakalpya bahurūpatām | bhedābhedāvupādāya kvacidekāctvamucyate || 18 ||
eko'c yasya so'yamekājiti bahurvīhāvāśrite ekavarṇeṣvanyapadārthasya vartipadārthabhinnasyābhāvād dvirvacanāprasaktāvekavarṇeṣu ca vyapadeśivadvacanādityu-ktam | tataḥ `eti, ayanam, itaḥ, etā, etavyam , āyan' ityādi- bahubhedaprabhinnaprayogagatanānārūpāśrayeṇānyapadārthaṃ prati niyataprayogagatābhedāśrayeṇa vartipadārthaṃ ca parikalpya `iyāya' ityādau dvirvacanasiddhiruktā || 18 ||
yadvā, anvayavyatirekābhyāmarthavān parikalpitaḥ | eko dhātvarthavigamād varṇatvenopacaryate || 19 ||
iṇo dhātorityādau pade pratyayarūpabhinne'pyanugamād yo'nugato'rthaḥ sa vācyaḥ | anyatra tasminneva pratyaye dhātvantaraprayoge tadapratīterityartha- vato'sya nirarthakamidaṃ varṇarūpameko'jiti kalpanayā vyavahriyate | dhātiśabdo hi kriyāvacanasya saṃjñeti tonārthavānasāvacyate | ajiti tvanapekṣitārthasambandha- varṇaviśeṣātmakaṃ rūpamabhidhatte | tathā ca kalpate vyapadeśaḥ, eko'j yasya so'yamekājiti | prathamatvama- pyasatyaprathame'pekṣaṇīye'pūrvatvāt samāropitaṃ yathā prathamagarbheṇa hateti nirṇītam || 19 ||
tadevaṃ yathā buddhiprakalpitabhedāśrayeṇātra vyapadeśasamarthanam, tathā sāmānādhi- karaṇyamapi bauddhabhedāśrayamiti prakṛtaṃ nigamayati-- dravyātmānastrayastasmād baddhau nānā vyavasthitāḥ | āśrayāśrayidharmeṇatyayaṃ pūrvebhya āgamaḥ || 20 ||
jātiguṇācchuritamādheyaṃ dravyadvayam, tadādhārabhūtaṃ tu tṛtīyaṃ guṇajāti- viśiṣṭabuddhibhedād bhinnamiti vibhaktamātmagrahaṇaṃ sarvatra niraṃśavastuvācakamityu- pādhibhedenāpi pratītau niraṃśavastuviśrāntiḥ sūcitā, yathā sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ vākye'pisidhyati | tathā ca tatra puṃvadbhāvopapattiḥ | eṣa ca vṛddhānāmāmnāya ādaraṇīyaḥ, na svamanīṣikācarcitaḥ | tadevam `samānādhikaraṇeṣūpasaṅkhayānamasamarthatvād dravyaṃ padārtha iti cet' iti dravyapadārthapakṣe vārapuruṣaśabdābhyāṃ dvābhyāmapyekasya dravyasya prati- pādanād bhinnābhidheyābhāve bhedādhiṣṭhānasya saṃsargasyābhāvāt samāsābhāvo yaścoditaḥ, sa dravye'pi padārthe pratīyamānavīratvādiguṇabhedakṛtaṃ dravyasya bhedamāśritya samarthitaḥ | jātāvapihi padārthe pratīyamānaikadravyāśrayaṃ sāmānādhi- karaṇyaṃ vīratvapuruṣatvayorāśrayaṇīyam, anyathānupapatteḥ | evamarthayoḥ sāmānādikaraṇyamadhikaraṇāntaravibhajanāt samarthitam | ata eva viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvo'pi siddhaḥ | yo hi yamabhedenopaśliṣyati sa svarūpeṇa niyogataḥ taduparañjayatīti dṛṣṭam || 20 ||
taditthamarthayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyanupapādya śabdayorapyupapādayitumāha-- sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ ca śabdayoḥ kaiścidiṣyate | viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyatvaṃ saṃjñāsaṃjñitvameva vā || 21 ||
kṛṣṇatilaśabdayorbhinnanimittaprayuktayorekasmin jātiguṇāviśiṣṭe dravye pravartamānayoḥ samānābhidheyatvaṃ samānādhikaraṇyamucyate | evaṃ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣya- bhāvo'pi tayoreva | kṛṣṇaśabdo hi tilaśabdaṃ svārthaviśiṣṭe'rtha'vasthāpayati | tilaśabdo'pyanyaviśeṣapratipādanādapāvartamāno'vacchedyaḥ | saṃjñāsaṃjñibhāvo'pi pratyastayostayoreva | tathāhi--pradeśastho vṛddhiśabdaḥ saṃjñāsaṃjñivākyasthena vṛddhiśabdena pratyāyitaḥ svarūpopadhānena saṃjñinaṃ pratipādayati `adaic' ityādaicchabdo- pahitarūpam | ataśca svarūpopadhānena pratyāyanāt so'yamityabhisambandhāt sāmānādhikaraṇyamekavibhaktitvaṃ ca viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyayoḥ saṃjñāsaṃjñinośca vṛddhivākye varṇitam | tadiha nidarśanatvamantarbhāvya nirdiṣṭam || 21 ||
prakārāntareṇārthayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyamāha-- keṣāñcijjātiguṇayorekārthasamavetayoḥ | vṛttiḥ kṛṣṇatileṣviṣṭā śabde dravyābhidhāyini || 22 ||
kṛṣṇātileṣu pratipādyeṣu vṛttirekārthībhāva iṣṭaḥ | tathāhi--sati viśeṣaṇa- viśeṣyabhāve sā bhavati | asti cātra sā, jātiguṇayorekatrāśraye vṛtteḥ | yadeva dravyaṃ jātiniṣṭhaṃ tilaśabdena sākāṅkṣamavagamitam, tadeva kṛṣṇaśabdenāvacchidyate | atastadvācyo guṇo viśeṣaṇam | guṇanimitto hi kṛṣṇaśabdo dravya iti tasya tātparyārtho guṇaḥ, dravyasya tilaśabdonāpyākṣepāt | śabde dravyābhidhāyinīti sāmānādhikaraṇyārthamāha-- kṛṣṇaśabdena hi guṇamātrābhidhāne tilasya kṛṣṇaḥ iti vaiyādhikaraṇyaṃ syāt | tathā ca vṛttirna bhavet, ṣaṣṭhīsamāsasyāpi guṇena neti niṣedhāt | evaṃ tilaśabdena jātimātrābhidhāna iti jātiviśiṣṭadravyābhidhānamatrāpi pakṣe | guṇapradhānabhāvakṛtamastu pakṣabhedaḥ | tathā ca prādhānyena vācyasya dravyasya vastuto'dhikaraṇāntarābhāvād dravyapadārthapakṣe pūrvaṃ bauddhabhedāśrayeṇa samarthitam | idaṃ tu jātipadārthapakṣe kathyate | na ca jātiguṇau nirāśrayāvatra tilakṛṣṇaśabdābhyāṃ pratyāyyau, yena tayorekādhikaraṇatvaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ na syāt | nāpi tayoḥ svato viśeṣyatvam, dravyācchede pravṛttayoranyonyasamanvayā- bhāvāt | tasmād dravyadvāreṇaivātra viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvo vivakṣitaḥ | tilaśabdena jāti- niṣṭhasya dravyasyābhidhānāt kṛṣṇaśabdaḥ pravṛttinimittadvāreṇa tatra viśeṣaṇa- mityeva yuktam || 22 ||
yatra tu dravyābhidhānaṃ nāsti, kevalaguṇābhidhānam, tatra nāntarīyakadravyā- kṣepe'pi viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvābhāvāt samānādhikaraṇasamāsābhāva ityāha-- saṃstu rūparasādīnāmāśrayo nābhidhīyate | dravyābhidhānena vinā tataste dvandvabhāvinaḥ || 23 ||
rūparasādiśabdāḥ svabhāvāta eva dravyānniṣkṛṣṭarūpaṃ svārthamācakṣate | nirāśrayasya tu guṇasyābhāvāt sāmarthyākṣiptamatra dravyam | tathā cābhidhādvāreṇa dravyasyāviṣayīkaraṇād rūparasayoḥ parasparamasambandhād viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvabhāva iti samānādhikaraṇasamāso na bhavatyatra | api tu dvandvaṃ bhāvayante prāpnuvanti, dvandvo vā bhāvī eṣāmiti | dvandvapadavācyā rūparasādayaḥ | te vā rūparasādiśabdā dvandvabhājaḥ | tadevaṃ sāmādhikaraṇyaṃ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaścetyubhayaṃ vicāritam || 23 ||
idaṃ tu vaktavyam--kṛṣṇatilaśabdayordvandvayorapi dravyaśabdatvād guṇajāti- nimittāśrayeṇa dravye pravṛtteḥ samavāyatirohitabhedatvasya samānatvena dravyavyavadhinākriyāyogasya tulyatvād viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyatvāniyama ityupasarjanāprasiddhau coditāyāṃ dravyaṃ pradhānamiti parihṛtaṃ bhāṣye | tat kathaṃ jātinittasyaiva dravyaśabdatvāt prādhānyam, na guṇanimittasyāpītyāha-- dravyābhidhāyī kṛṣṇādirākāṅkṣāvān pravartate | nimittānuvidhāyitvāt tat tilādau na vidyate || 24 ||
iha guṇaguṇinorabhedopacārāt kṛṣṇaśabdo dravyaśabdo dravyamabhidyate | kriyayā guṇo na sākṣātsambandhamupaiti, api tu dravyadvāreṇa dravyasyaiva śaktyadhikaraṇatvāditi dravyākāṅkṣo guṇaḥ kriyāyāṃ pravartate | dravyeṇa ca nityamapi yogābhāvāt tato bhinnaḥ svayamanarha eva sambandhe | tathāhi--kadācid dravyānnikṛṣyāpi guṇo vyavahriyate | upajanāpāyau hi guṇasya dravye | ata eva matup ṣaṣṭhī ca bhavati | `avyatirekāt siddhimiti ced dṛṣṭo vyatirekaḥ' iti coktam | jātistūtpattiprabhṛtyāvināśād dravyeṇāvyabhicarita- sambandhā, arūpakatvāt | ataśca nimittaṃ jātimutpattikāla eva prāptasambandhā- malakṣitavivekāmanuvartate, yo'bhidheyamukhena tilādiśabdaḥ, tatra tatsākāṅkṣa- pravṛttitvaṃ nāsti | yathā hi guṇo dravyākāṅkṣo bhavan kriyayā dravyavyavadhinā samanvayameti, naivaṃ jātiḥ, tadrahitasya dravyasyābhāvāt | ātmakalpaiva hi sā tasyeti sākṣādeva jātimad dravyaṃ kriyāyogi | ataśca jātimad dravyaṃ viśeṣyaṃ pradhānamuktam, guṇo viśeṣaṇamiti tadabhidhāyinorapi śabdayoḥ parasparāvacchedakatve'pi niyato viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāva ityarthaḥ || 24 ||
tadetadāha-- evaṃ jātimati dravye pratyāsanne kriyāṃ prati | guṇadharma guṇāviṣṭa dravyaṃ bhedāya kalpate || 25 ||
evamiti | yatheditānnimittānuvidhānāt tilaśabdena jātyācchuritasya dravyasya pratipādanāt tasyaiva sākṣāt kriyāyogaḥ | kṛṣṇaśabdena tu guṇācchuritaṃ dravyaṃ na jātyāviṣṭamiva, api tu guṇasyeva svabhāvo yasya tad vyavahitakriyāsambandhaṃ guṇabhūta- mucyata iti tadviśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyāvacchedādatretyarthaḥ | `nīlotpalaṃ paśyati, svādu phalamāsvādayati, surabhi kusumamājighrati, samudāyārthasya dravayasyaiva viśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭasya kṣutyāveditakarmabhāvasya kriyāsamanvayāvagamāt | `utpalasya rūpaṃ paśyati' tyādāvapi vāstavena rūpeṇa gumasya dravyadvāreṇaiva kriyāyogaḥ saṃyuktasamavāyāt | śrautena tu rūpema rūpādibhiridaṃ taditi sarvanāma(prayogayogyasya dravyasyaiva pratipādanam | evaṃ `paṭasya rūpaṃ jāyate' ityādāvapi śābdena rūpeṇa dravyameva kriyāyogīti guṇasya dravyavyavadhānena kriyāsamanvaye nāsti vyabhicāraḥ | evaṃ dravyābhidhāyi- tve'pi kṛṣṇāderguṇaśabdasya viśeṣaṇatvamupapāditam || 25 ||
samprati tadabhāve'pi tat pratipādayitumāha-- guṇamātrābhidhāyitvaṃ kecidicchanti vṛttiṣu | atāśvādiṣu sambandhād rūḍhīnāmiva rūḍhibhiḥ || 26 ||
vākye kṛṣṇaśabdo guṇāvacchinnadravyavacanaḥ | vṛttau tu tiktaśabdenaiva dravya- syābhidhānād guṇamātraṃ tadviśeṣaṇabhūtamāheti yuktam | guṇaviśiṣyasya dravyasya pratīterguṇo viśeṣako vyavasthāpyate | yathā `rājapuruṣaḥ' ityatra ṣaṣṭhayabhāve'pi rājārthaḥ | dṛṣṭaṃ ca dravyaśabdasyāpi vṛttau guṇamātrābhidhāyitvam , yathā `ajāśvo devadattaḥ' ityatrājaśvaśabdayau rūḍhayā niyatajātīyadravyābhidhāyitve virodhāt sambandho na syādityavidyamānajanmāno'śvā yasyetyajanmalakṣaṇadharmamātravacanatve- 'jaśabdasya sambandhopapattiḥ | evamihāpi bhinnayoḥ kṛṣṇatiladravyayoḥ sambandhābhāvājjātiśabdenaiva dravyāsyākhyānāt tasyaiva punarabhidhāne prayojanābhāvād guṇamātravacanaḥ kṛṣṇaśabdaḥ sāmarthyād vṛttau vyavatiṣṭhate | ekārthībhāvakṛtaścāyaṃ vṛttau viśeṣa iti vṛttiṣvityāha | tathā ca vyātirekavibhak- tyabhāve'pyavyatiricyamānaśarīra eva guṇo dravyamatraviśinaṣṭi, yathā `rājapuruṣaḥ' ityatra puruṣārthaikībhāvamapanno rājārthaḥ puruṣam | mīmāṃsakāstu--rājaśabdo vattau lakṣaṇayā puruṣārthamabhidadhātītyāhuḥ, taccāyaktam; mukhyasyaiva rājārthasyaikārthībhāvād viśeṣakatvena puruṣārthopādānopapattau lakṣaṇāyā abhāvāt | mukhyasambhave hi sābhyupagamanīyā | lakṣaṇāyāṃ ca `rājānaṃ puruṣamupāste' ityatra vākye'pi rājaśabdaḥ puruṣaṃ lakṣayet | svasvāmisambandhaśca niyogato na pratīyeta | lakṣaṇāyāḥ sāmīpyādinimittāyā api bhāvāt, puruṣaśabdenaiva ca puruṣārthasya pratitatvānna lakṣaṇā | kāṣ‌rṇottarāsaṅgamākarṣatīti ca śrutyarthasambhave kathaṃ lakṣaṇā ? na cedaṃ nopasarjanamiti śakyate vaktum, pūrvapadaprakṛtisvarāvadhāraṇād bahurvīhi- tvāvasāyāt || 26 ||
prakārāntareṇāpi guṇavacanasya kṛṣṇāderviśeṣaṇatve niyamamāha-- tile pūrvamupātte vā tatraiva matuviṣyate | sa ca dharmaḥ samāseṣu guṇastasmād viśeṣaṇam || 27 ||
tilajātyavacchinne pthamamupātte viśeṣye sāmānyasvabhāvenāvasite viśiṣṭaguṇa- tayāvasāyārthaṃ kṛṣṇaśabdaḥ pravartamāno guṇavacano matublopāt tatraiva vartate | atra hi kṛṣṇo'syāstīti matup tiladravya eva hi sambandhini sāmārthyād guṇaśabdāt kṛtaḥ | tasya "guṇavacanebhyo luk"  iti luk sāmarthyalabhyo noktaḥ | sa ca sambandhākhyo dharmo matupaḥ prakramāt tadarthatvena pratyāsatteravatamyamānaḥ samāseṣvantarbhavati | abhihitaḥ so'rtho'ntarbhūtaḥ prātipadikārthaḥ sampanna iti tasmāt samāsaviṣayāt sambandhākhyād dharmāddhetorgiṇa evāvacchedakaḥ, sambandhe dravye svarūpasamarpaṇāt | jātistu na guṇaśabdena pūrvamupāttaṃ dravyamavacchinatti, guṇāpekṣayā jāteratyā- sannatvāt pūrvaṃ tadātmanaiva dravyasya nirūpaṇaucityāt | gatametat || 27 ||
evaṃ samānādhikaraṇavṛttiṃ vicārya dvandvaikaśeṣavṛttiṃ vicārayitumāha-- anusyūteva bhedābhyāmekā prakhyopajāyate | yadā sahavivakṣāṃ tāmāhurdvandvaikaśeṣayoḥ || 28 ||
ihakakriyāgumaniveśārthamarthā buddhayā nirūpyamāṇāḥ kriyāguṇadvāreṇetaretarasyā- pekṣayā samudāyabhāvamāpadyamānāḥ sāhabhāvyena vaktumabhipretā dvandvaikaśeṣalakṣaṇasamāsapada-vācyā bhavanti | samudāyaścātra nāvayavavyātiriktaḥ, api tu ta evāvayavāḥ saṃhanyante | tathā cātrāvayavabhedābhāsānuviddhā pratītirnaiyamikī | avayavābhāsācca dvivacanabahuvacane na virudhyete | na hi yathā samāsāntareṣveka evānyāvacchinno'rthaḥ pradhānam, tathātra sarveṣāṃ padārthānāṃ samakakṣyatvādavayavabhedānugataikaprakhyāvaśāccodbhūtāvayavabhedaḥ samudayo vṛttipadavācyaḥ | sa cāvayavāvyatirikta ityavayavaśabdaireva vyapadiśyate dhavakhādira- palāśā iti | yastvavayavyatiriktaḥ sa śabdāntareṇocyate, samudāyo vanaṃ yūthāmityādi | ekaprakhyānyathānipapatteścāyaṃ samudāyaḥ parasparāpekṣaiḥ pratyekameva padairucyate | tatrāvadhāryamāṇena samudāyena bhedarūpasya tirodhānādivaśabdaḥ | ekasamudāyābhidhā- yitve'pi ca dvandvasya paṭavīmṛd‌vyāviti samānādhikaraṇalakṣaṇaḥ puṃvadbhāvo na bhavati, vākye vyabhicārasambhavāt tadgatasya samānādhikaraṇatvasyāśrayaṇāt | vṛttau tvekā- rthībhāvāt tadavyabhicāraḥ | paṭvī ca mṛdvī ceti tu vākye bhedapratītiprādhānyam | ata eva bhedādhiṣṭhānena samuccayena yoga iti samānābhidheyatvābhāvaḥ || 28 ||
bhedānuvedhasya sahavivakṣāyāmaviśeṣāt samāhāretaretarayoḥ ko bheda ityata āha-- itaretarayogastu bhinnasaṅghābhidhāyinām | pratyekaṃ ca samṛho'sau samūhiṣu samāpyate || 29 ||
sahavivakṣāyāmanekānusyūdaikaprakhyārūpāyāṃ dvaitamavayavaprādhānyaṃ ca | tatrāvayava- prādhānyamitaretarayogasya viṣayaḥ | tathāhi--bhinnamudbhūtamedaṃ saṅghaṃ samūhaṃ ye'bhidadhati, teṣāmayaṃ vācyo dvandvapadānāṃ pratibhāgaṃ hyasau samūhaḥ paryavasyati | tata ekaikasyāpi vācyaḥ | pratyavayavapari- samāpto hi samudāya ekāvayavadṛṣṭāvapi gṛhyate | evamekāvayavavācakenāpyabhidhīyate | yathā ca bhūyo'vayavadṛṣṭau sphuṭamavadhāryate, tathā samudāyādapi spaṣṭārthābhidhāyinaḥ sphuṭā pratītiḥ | tathā ca pratyavayavaṃ pratipattāvapi na śabdāntaravaiyarthyam | saṅghaprādhānyetu samāhāra ityarthāduktam | itthamanusyūtabhedatve samāne'pi ayaṃ viśeṣastu śabdadyotyo'vayavaprādhānyalakṣaṇaḥ |ayameva caikaśeṣasyāpi dvandvāpavādasya viṣayaḥ || 29 ||
udbhūtāvayavabhedaḥ samudāyaḥ pratyavayavasamāpto'bhidhīyata ityatra sadṛśaṃ nidarśanamāha-- vyāpārasamudāyasya yathādhiśrayaṇādiṣu | pratyekaṃ jātivad vṛttistathā dvandvapadeṣvapi || 30 ||
kramikasya pūrvāparībhūtasya kriyākalāpasya pacyāderyathāsvamadhiśrayaṇādi- vyāpārarupe bhāve jāterivādhyāsād vṛtteḥ sa eko dṛśyamāno vartamānaḥ kriyāvayavaḥ pacatīti vartamānakālābhidhāyipratyayāntapadavācyo yathā samarthitaḥ prāk, evaṃ dvandvapadavācyo'pi samudāyaḥ pratyavayavavṛttiriti pratipadamābhidheyakamāpadyate | dvandvapadārtheṣvekaikasyānyāpekṣāpratītiravayavāntakaśravaṇe parisamāpyate | iyameva cātrāvayavānuviddhasamudāyapratītiḥ | jātirapi prativyakti parisamāpte- tyekaikavyak‌tyabhidhāyināpi gavādiśabdena pratyāyyate | prathamavyaktidarśane spaṣṭāvabhāsā vyak‌tyantaragrahaṇe sphuṭībhavati | evamanyonyāpekṣiṇāmadhiśraya- ṇādīnāṃ pacipratyayaḥ sphuṭaḥ || 30 ||
syādetat | tādarthyādadhiśrayaṇādirapi paciriti yaktaṃ tatrābhidhānaṃ jātāvapi jātiśabdena | iha punardhavakhadirādiśabdaḥ pṛthagarthatayā vākyeṣu jñātaḥ kathamekarthā- bhidhāyī vṛttau syādityāśaṅkaya dṛṣṭāntena vyutpādayati-- śauṇḍārdharcapuroḍaśacchatriṇo'tra nidarśanam | te viṣṇumitrā iti ca bhinneṣu sahacāriṣu || 31 ||
"saptamī śauṇḍaiḥ" , "ardharcāḥ puṃsi ca "  ityatra gaṇapaṭhitadūrtā-diśabdabhedāśrayaṃ bahuvacanam | taccaivamupapadyate, yadi dhūrtādayo'pi śauṇḍādiśabda- vācyāḥ, kathaṃ ca te tathā bhavanti, yadi sāhacaryādadhyārepitaśoṇḍādibhāvāḥ ? evaṃ puroḍāsā iti bahuvacanānyathānupapatteḥ sahacaritā api karambhaparivāpadhānāpayasyā abhidhīyante | tathā `chatriṇo yānti, dhvajino yānti, te viṣṇumitrāḥ' iti sāha- caryādadhyāropitānyathārūpāstacchabdavācyā dṛṣṭāḥ | evaṃ dvandvaikaśeṣayordvivacanabahuvacanānyathānupapattyā pratipadamanekārthatvamavasthā- pyate, ekakriyāguṇaviṣayatvena sāhacaryāt paraspararūpāpatteḥ || 31 ||
tadāha-- arthāntarābhidāyitvaṃ tathārthāntaravarttinām | yābhyāṃ caikamanekārthaṃ tābhyāmevāparaṃ padam || 32 ||
yathā śauṇḍādiṣu sāhacaryādarthāntarābhidhānam, tathātreti dārṣṭāntike yojitam | sahacaritayoreva paraspararūpādhyāsenābhidhāne'nyasyāsahacaritasyābhidhānābhāvādupāttā- bhyāmeva `dhavakhadirau' ityatra pratyetamanekārthatā | tathā ca bahuvacanābhāva ityāśayaḥ | kriyā cārthāntare'dhyāsaheturatroktā, yadi prakṣaratīti plakṣoḥ nyagrodhe- 'pyetat tulyamiti | tadevaṃ vārtikakāroktā, yugapadadhikaraṇatā vyākhyātā | sa hi `cārthe dvandvavacane asamāse'pi cārthasampratyayādaniṣṭaprasaṅgaḥ' iti codayitvā `siddhaṃ tu yugapadadhikaraṇe dvandvavacanād' iti nyāsāntaraṃ papāṭha | yugapadekena śabdena yadādhikaraṇamabhidheyaṃ dvandvapadavācyamabhidhīyate, samudāyarūpaṃ parasparāropitasvārtham, tadā dvandvo vaktavya ityarthaḥ | evaṃ sahavivakṣāyāṃ dvandva ityuktaṃ bhavati | tatraiva yugapadadhikaraṇavacanatāyāḥ samarthitatvāt | nanu cābhidhānakramādabhidheyakramo'vaśyambhāvīti kathaṃ hi yugapadadhikaraṇavacanatā ?
