naitat, plakṣanyagrodhau, dhavakhadirapalāśā ityatra yadi nyagrodhārthapratipattikāle plakṣārthasya nāvagatiḥ, palāśārthapratipattikāle ca yadi dhavādyarthasya nāvagatiḥ, tadā nyagrodhapalaśaśabdayorekārthatvādekavacanameva syād, na dvivacanabahuvacane, ato dvivacana bahuvacanānyadhānupapattyātraikaiko'pi śabdo'nekārthābhidhāyītyanumānād yugapad‌- vācitā niścīyate | taduktam--`śabdapaurvāparyādarthapaurvāparyābhidhānamiti ced, dvivacanabahuvacanānu- papattirityudbhūtāvayavabhedaśca samudāya iti samudāyāśrayamekavacanaṃ na codanīyam | sāhacaryaṃ cārthāntarābhidhāne heturlokaprasiddhayārthāntaratvāt kathyate | prakṣaraṇaṃ tu vistāreṇāvasthānaṃnyagrodhe'pyastīti tasyāsau svārtha eva | taduktam `karaṇād dravye śabdanivośa iti cet, tulyakāraṇatvāt siddham' iti | na caivamatiprasaṅgaḥ, vākye'pi nyagrodhaśabdena plakṣārthasya pratipādanaprasaṅ- gād | `yatastadviṣayaṃ ca' ityuktam | vṛttiviṣaye śabdānāṃ śaktivaicitryādarthāntarābhidhānam, na tu sarvatretyarthaḥ|ata eva tatra sāhacaryādetaditītarasyāprayoge tadabhāva uktaḥ | ekenoktatvādaparasya prayogo'nupapanna iti ced, anuktatvāt plakṣeṇa nyagrodhasya nyagrodhaprayoga iti| evaṃ cetaretarasaṃnidhāne bhārodyantṛvat parasparaśak‌tyāvirbhāvanād niyataviṣayameva parasparābhidhānaṃ śabdānāmityuktam | abhidhānaṃ punaḥ svābhāvikamiti | tadevaṃ samarthitā yugapadadhikaraṇavacanatā | bhāṣyakāreṇa tu `duḥkhā, durupapāda ceyam' ityak‌tvā pāṇinīya eva sūtrānyāsaḥ samarthitaḥ kila | neyaṃ pratītāvupārohatīti duḥkhā, pramāṇābhāvācca durupapādā || 32 ||
tad vyācaṣṭe-- samudāyāntaratvācca tādṛśo'rtha na laukikaḥ | anvayavyatirekābhyāṃ śāstrārtho'pi na dṛśyate || 33 ||
iha lokācchabdārthavasāyaḥ | na cātra sthitalakṣaṇo'lokikau vyavahāropayogī pratyekaṃ padavācyo'rtho naiko'vadhāryate | na hi śabdāntarasya śabdāntarārthābhidhānaṃloke dṛśyate | rūḍhatvācca laukikasyārthasya prakṣaṇamātrānnayagrodhaḥ plakṣo nocyate | na hi gamanād gauriti puruṣo'pi gacchan gaurityābhidhīyate | tasmād dvandvalakṣaṇena samudāyenāyamanya evāvayavavācyāt samudāyādabhidhīyamānaḥ samudāyo vijñeyo'laukikaḥ | atha prakṛtipratyayārthavadāpoddhāriko'yamanvayavyatirekalabhyaḥ śāstrīyo'tra pratyekaṃ dvandvapadavācyo'rthaḥ | tadapi na; yasmādanvayavyatirekābhyāmatra svārtha eva prasiddhaḥ pratyekaṃ padānāmavadhāryate, na tvārthāntarābhidhānaśaktiravadhārayituṃ pāryate | plakṣaśabdasannidhāne hi nyagrodhasya plakṣo'pyartha ityucyate, pratīteḥ | sā ca pratītistasya svaśabdādeva siddheti na sto'nvayavyatirekau | kāmamekaśeṣe śabdāntarasyāprayogād bhārodyantṛnyāyena parasparaṃ śak‌tyāvirbhāvanā- dekasyānekārthapratyāyanaśaktatvamanena nyāyena vyutpādyate svavācakasyaivānupahata- śaktestu dvandvesambhavāt kuto'pratītā śabdāntarasya tatra śaktiḥ kalpyate ? udbhūtāvayavabhedasya tu samudāyasya samāsavācyatvād dvivacanabahuvacanopapattiḥ | samāsāddhi dvivacanabahuvacane jāyate | nottarapadamātrād, yena tadarthasya dvitvādi- yogasamarthena prayasyeta | ekakriyāguṇaniveśāpekṣayā cāneko'rthaḥ prakhyayaikayā viṣayīkriyamāṇo'śakyo'bhidhātumekena śabdeneti padasamūhākhyena samāsenā- bhidhīyate | sa ca samāsaśabdo'nvākhyeyo niraṃśo'pi bhāgakalpanena vyutpādyate | te ca bhāgāḥ pṛthak padāntarasadṛśā iti tadarthā evānugamyante | tathā ca pravibhāgenānuśāsane sākāṅkṣamapi padaṃ svārtha eva paryavasyati | apekṣāmātraprabhāvitaścāyaṃ samudāyaḥ kramavatāmarthānāmātmabhūtaḥ | sa kathaṃ padārthamātra pratītau pratibhāseta, yenottarapadārthapratītāveva vacanaṃ śakyeta ? saṅkalanāpratyaya- viṣayatvāt samudāyasya bhūyo'vayavāvadhāraṇakāle'vadhāraṇāt | na ca viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvāyogād dvandvapadārthā na saṃhanyanta iti śaṅkanīyam, sarvasya nāmapadārthasya kriyayaiva saṃsargaḥ, kasyacit tu sākṣātkriyayā sambandhaḥ, anyasya tu tadviśeṣaṇatvenetyetāvān samāsāntareṣu bhedaḥ | dvandve tu samudāyavibhak‌tyā samudāyārthasya kriyāsambandhadyotanādavayavārthāḥ kriyārthinaḥ samudāyātmatāmāpadyante | etacca parasyāpi matam | kathamanyathaikaiko'pi dvayarthaḥ syāt ? dvayorevārthayorapekṣāvatoḥ samudāyatvāt | ata evānyonyāpekṣāyāḥ samudāyādevārthānāmavagateścaritārthatvāccaśabdo nivartate | vākye tvarthānāṃ vicchetaprati bhāsāt samuccayadyotane caśabdo'pekṣyate | tasmātsamudāyādevānyonyāpekṣāprabhāvitadvitvādiyogino dvivacanabahuvacanayorupapattau na kācid bipratipattiḥ || 33 ||
yata evaṃ-- duḥkhā durupapādā ca tasmād bhāṣye'pyudāhṛtā | yugapadvācitā sā tu vyavahārārthamāśritā || 34 ||
`duḥkhayati, na cetaḥ paritoṣayati' iti duḥkhā, pratītāvanupārohāt, prayojanasya cānyathāsiddheḥ, ata eva pramāṇābhāvāt parasya sukhena pratipādayituṃ na pāryata iti durupapādā | saṅkalanāviṣayāścārthā samāsāntare'pi samudāyabhāvamāpadyanta ityasti sahavivakṣā | ekajātīyaviṣayāścārthā bhavantyekaśabdavācyā ekaśeṣa iti sahavivakṣāyāmiyaṃ vyāhṛtā yugapadadhikaraṇavacanatā vadatā bhāṣyakāreṇa kṛcchopapādanāya garbhīkṛtā, tataśceyamaṅgīkṛtaiveti || 34 ||
tatsambhāvanābījamāha-- samudāyamupakramya padaṃ tasyāṃ prayujyate | vibhāgena samākhyāne tatastad dvayarthamucyate || 35 ||
iha `plakṣanyagrodhau, dhavakhadirapalāśāḥ' ityādiḥ samudāyo lokiko'nvākyeyaḥ śabdo'vayavavibhāgakalpanayā vyutpādyate | tatra ca yāvānarthastāvāneva vibhajyamānasyā- vayavasyāvasthāpyate | atra hi viṣaye yaḥ plakṣādiśabdo'vayavaḥ, sa svārthamātre na viśrāntaḥ, api tu parisamāptārthavacanaḥ | tathā ca samudāyopakrame parasparasaṃbandhādanvitābhidānanayena pratyekaṃ padamitara- padārthānugatārthābhidhānādanekārthameva |9 tasyāṃ yugapad‌vivakṣāyāṃ samudāyamabhidheyamuddiśya prayujyata iti, tathaiva prakriyāyāṃ plakṣau ca nyagrodhau ceti dvayarthasyaivāpoddhāravākyam | evaṃ dharakhadira- palāśā ityatra bahvarthasyāpīti boddhavyam | vivakṣopārūḍho hyarthaḥ śabdānām | atra caitāvitī vivakṣā | paramārthatastvabhinna eva samāso'rthasamudāyārthābhidhāyīti na vākye'nekārthatvaṃ laukike'sti | prakriyāvākye tvavayavadharmeṇa samudāyābhidhānāt plakṣāvayatvādudbhūtāvayavabhedo'yaṃ samudāyaḥ plakṣau nyagrodhāvayavatvācca nyagrodhāvityucyate | tad yathā samāvayā- vatvāt samaṃ cūrṇamiti | vṛttau tvekārthībhāvād bhedasya vigalanāt tadadhiṣṭhānasamu- ccayadyotanacaśabdāprayogāt samudāye samaprādhānyenāvayavaśabdo vartate | anyathā samaprādhānyād dvandvapadānāṃ tadarthasya sākṣātkriyāṃsaṃbandhasaṃbhavāditaretaropaślo- ṣābhāve vākya iva vibhaktārthābhidhāyitvād dvivacanādyanupapattireva syāt | samāsā- ntareṣu hi pradhānamukhenopasarjanaṃ kriyayā yujyata iti tena saṃsṛjyeta, na tu dvandve, sarveṣāṃ samapradhānatvāt | tasmāt tatraikaikena padena samudāyārthābhidhānamavaśyāmabhyupagantavyam, yena parasparārthasamanvayopapattāvudbhūtabhedasya samudāyasyābhidhānād dvivacanabahuvacanopapattiḥ | āśrayato hi liṅgavacanānyatra pratipādayiṣyante | vṛttivākyayośca śabdaśaktivaici-tryaṃ suprasiddhamiti vākye laukike dṛṣṭārthāntarābhidhānaśaktirapi śabdo vṛttau tadabhidhāyī yujyate | ata evoktam `tadviṣayam ca'  iti| iti siddhā yugapadadhikaraṇavacanatā dvandvaikaśeṣayoḥ || 35 ||
ekameva śabdaśaktivaicitryakṛtaṃ viśeṣaṃ vṛttivākyayoḥ pratipādayati-- vīkye'pi niyatā dharmāḥ kecid vṛttau dvayostathā | te tvabhedena sāmarthyamātra evopavarṇitāḥ || 36 ||
vākye vyapekṣāyāṃ kecidarthabhedā niyatāḥ, kecid vṛttāvekārthībhāve, kecid vṛttivākyayordvayoḥ sādhāraṇa iti yadyapi bhedaḥ, tathāpi nāsāvidantayā viṣayabhedena śāstre nirdiṣṭaḥ, api tu `samarthaḥ padavidhiḥ" iti sāmarthyasāmānya eva nirūpitā bhinnā dharmāḥ | anāśritaviśeṣe sāmarthyenirdiṣṭe sati yathāyathaṃ te vibhaktāḥ | sāmarthyamātrametanniyatarūpamuktamityarthaḥ || 36 ||
evaṃ sāmānyenābhidhāya viśeṣeṇa nirṇetumāha-- vṛttau viśeṣavṛttitvād bhede sāmānyavācitā | upamānasamāsādau śyāmādīnamudāhṛtā || 37 ||
"upamānāni sāmānyavacanaiḥ"  ityatra `śastrī śyāmā' ityudāhṛtam | tatra ca śyāmāsabdo viśiṣṭāyāṃ śastryāmupamānabhūtāyāṃ tadupamitāyāṃvā devadattāyāṃ vartata iti viśeṣavṛtti tvāt kathaṃ sāmānyavacana iti codye `prāgabhisaṃbandhād‌yaḥ sāmānyavacanaḥ'  iti bhāṣye samarthitam | ābhimukhyena svabhāvasaṃbhedena yatra padārthāḥ saṃbadhyante, asau samāso'bhisaṃbandhaśabdenā- troktaḥ | tasmāt prāgbhede vākye pṛthagarthatvāt sāmānyavacanāḥ śyāmādayaḥ | `śastrī iva śyāmā' ityatra hi śyāmatvasāmānyamupamānopameyagatamāśritya śyāmaśabdaḥ pravṛttaḥ | vṛttāvekārthībhāvādasya viśeṣāvarodhaḥ | evamanyatrāpi boddhavyamupamitasamāsādau || 37 ||
udāharaṇāntaramāha-- vṛttiranyapadārthe yā tasyā vākyeṣvasaṃbhavaḥ | cārthe dvandvapadānāṃ ca bhede vṛttirna vidyate || 38 ||
`snigdhāni kisalayānyasya'iti vākye padānāmanyapadārthe `snigdhakisalayo vanaspatiḥ' iti vṛttivad vṛttirnāsti, asyetyanyapadārthasya svaśabdenaiva vākye gamitatvāt | vṛttau tu matvarthasya saṃbandhasyāntarbhāvāt padānyekārthībhūya saṃbandhinaṃ pratipādayanti | tathā dvandvapadānāṃ bhede vākye cārthe samāhāretare- tarayogalakṣaṇe vṛttirnāstīti tatra caśabdo vācakaḥ prayujyate | vṛttau tvakakriyāvaśāt samuditārthābhidhāyīni padānīti tatra samuccitapradhāne co na prayujyate || 37 ||
anyadapyāha-- bhede sati nirādīnāṃ krāntādyartheṣvasaṃbhavaḥ | prāgvṛtterjātivācitvaṃ na ca gaurakharādiṣu || 39 ||
bhidyante'sminnarthā iti bhedo vākyaṃ tatra nirādīnāṃ niṣkrāntaḥ kośāmbyāityādau krāntādyarthavācitvaṃ nāstīti krāntādeḥ sākṣāt tatra prayogaḥ | vṛttau tu niṣkauśāmbirityādāvasti krāntādyarthābhidhānam | vākye hi nirādīnāmasattvavācināṃ kriyāyogini krāntādau dravye vṛttirna saṃbhavati | samāse tu pūrvapadārthasya prādhānyādanekakriyāyogī dravyabhūtastadartho'bhidhīyate | so'yamekārthībhāvakṛto viśeṣaḥ | tathā gaurakharaḥ, kṛṣṇasarpo, lohitaśālirityādivṛtti- padāt prāgvākye jātiviśeṣapratyāyanasāmarthyaṃ nāsti | na hi `gauraḥ kharaḥ, kṛṣṇaḥ sarpo, lohitaḥ śāliḥ' ityatra jātiviśeṣapratītiḥ padasamudāyānabhidheyatvājjātervarṇaviśeṣāvacchinnasyārthasya pratīteḥ | jātiviśeṣa- pratīteḥ | jātiviśeṣe tu varṇaviśeṣānādaraḥ | aikārthyāt tu samāsenaikapadatvād viśiṣṭā jātiracyate | tathā ca jātyabhisaṃbandhe vivakṣita karmadhārayānmatvarthīyo bhavati gaurakharavadaraṇyaṃ,kṛṣṇasarpavān valmīkaḥ, lohitaśālinām grāma iti | tenātra karmadhārayamatvarthīyābhyāṃ bahurvīhirlaghutvāta prakramasyetyetannāvatarati | lohitaśālirgrāma ityikte viśiṣṭajātīyaśālisaṃbandhe vivakṣito na gamyate | evamudāharaṇāntare'pi yojyam | tathā ca bhāṣyam--`astyatra viśeṣo jātyātra saṃbandhaḥ kriyate'  iti || 39 ||
tadekasmin vṛttivākyayoḥ svābhāvike viśeṣe saṃvādakamācāryamatamāha-- krīḍāyāṃ jīvikāyāṃ ca vākyenāvacanāt tathā | na nityagrahaṇaṃ yuktaṃ kauṭilye yaṅ‌vidhau yathā || 40 ||
vārtikakāraḥ papāṭha--`uttarayorvigraheṇa viśeṣāsampratyayānnityagrahaṇārthakyami'ti  `nityaṃ kauṭilye gatau'  `lupasada--' ityanayoryogayorvākyanivṛttyarthaṃ nityagrahaṇaṃ na kāryam, vākyena gatikoṭilyasya bhāvagarhāyāścābhihitatvāt | kuṭilaṃ krānatīti cetaḥ koṭilye- nāsadācārasyāpi pratīteḥ | caṅkramyata iti tu gatapratyāgatopādhiḥ kriyāviśeṣaḥ pratīyate | evaṃ garhitaṃ lumpatīti dhātvarthagarhā niyagato na pratīyate | sādhanagarhāyā api pratipatteḥ | lolupyata iti tu vṛttau bhāvagarhāpratipattiḥ | anenaiva nyāyena `nityaṃ krīḍājīvikayoḥ'  ityatra nityagrahaṇaṃ pratyākhyeyamiti nidarśanavyājena tadapyudāhṛtam | yadi vā yathā `nityaṃ kauṭilye--' ityatra sākṣānnityagrahaṇasya vārttike pratyākhyānam, tathā `nityaṃ krīḍājīvikayoḥ'ityasyeti | sādhyatayopanyāsaḥ | taditarasya nidarśanatvena, siddhasya ca nidarśanatvāt | tadevācāryamataṃ saṃvādakamupapadyate | uddālapuṣpasya bhañjikā, dantānāṃ lekhakaḥ' iti vākyāt krīḍājīvikayorapratipattiḥ| krīḍānaṅgībhūtasya jīvanānupāyarūpasyāpyarthasya pratīteḥ | evaṃ kriyāsamabhihārasyāpi caṅkramyate lolupyate ityato'pratīternaitebhyastatrayaṅ bhavati | tathācoktaṃ--`kriyāsamabhihāre naitebhyaḥ' iti | etadarthaṃ kecinnatyagrahaṇaṃ vyācakṣate--`kuṭilāyāṃ gatau nitayaṃ' bhāvagarhāyāṃ nityaṃ, nakriyāsamabhihāre' iti | yathā ca vākyād vivakṣitārthānavagamāt pratyākhyātaṃ nityagrahaṇam, tathā kriyāsamabhihārānavagamādeva tatra pratyayābhāvādetadarthamapi tad pratyayābhāvādetadarthamapi na nityagrahaṇam | vacanānusāriṇāṃ tu prāta vākyanivṛttyarthamapi tad bhavitumarhati | yathā caita vṛttiviṣayā viśeṣāḥ, tathā saṃkhyāviśeṣa upasarjanaviśeṣaṇaṃ ca yogo vyaktabhidhānamiti vākyaikaniyatā viśeṣāḥ proktāḥ | viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvādastu dvayorapyanu- sartavyāḥ || 40 ||
evaṃ vṛttivākyavaidharmye sati-- nirdhāraṇādiviṣaye vyapekṣaiva yataḥ sthitā | samāsapratiṣedhānāṃ tato nāsti prayojanam || 41 ||
vyapekṣālakṣamasāmarthyaṃ vākyaikaniyatanirdhāraṇaviṣaye vyavasthitaṃ svabhāvato niyatamitigavāṃ kṛṣṇā sampannakṣīratameti `na nirdhāraṇe'  iti samāsapratiṣedho nārambhaṇīyaḥ | na hyatraikārthībhāve samāse kṛte gokṛṣṇā sampannakṣīratameti nirdhāraṇaṃ pratīyate nirdhāraṇahetorbāhyasyāpekṣaṇīyasya bhāvādasāmarthyādatra samāsābhāva iti tātparyam | evaṃ `pūraṇa-' ityādirapi pratiṣedho'śiṣya ityanusaraṇīyam || 41 ||
jñāpakatvāt śāstrasya svabhāvasiddhameva śaktivaicitryaṃ śabdānāmanugantuṃ śāstrārambha ityāha-- vidhibhiḥ pratiṣedhaiśca bhedābhedanidarśanam | kṛtaṃ dvandvaikavadbhāve saṅghavṛttyupadeśavat || 42 ||
samāsavidhinā abhedaḥ saṃsarga ekārthībhāvaḥ svabhāvasiddho jñāpyate, pratiṣedhena tu bhedo'saṃsargo vyapekṣālakṣaṇo mandamatīn prati | tad yathā--dvandvasya prāṇitū- ryāṅgājau svābhāvikīsaṅghe samāhāre tirohitāvayavabhede vṛttiḥ,`prāṇitūryasenāṅgā-nām ityekabadbhāvaśāstrema samāhāra eveti niyamenānvākhyāyate | dadhipayaḥprabhṛtīnāṃ tu svābhāvikī prodbhūtāvayavabhede itaretarayoge pravṛttiḥ pratiṣe- dhena | vibhāṣāvacanena vṛkṣamṛgādīnāmubhayatreti śāstramanuvādakam | na hyasatī śabdānāṃ śaktirvacanaśatenāpi kartuṃ pāryate | `na vā samāhāraikatvāt'- ityekavaddhāvapratyākhyānasya sākṣāduktatvāt siddhatve sati nidarśanatvanātro- panyāsaḥ | nyāyastu samānaḥ || 42 ||
tadevaṃ vṛttivākyayoḥ `samarthaḥ padavidhiḥ' ityatra sāmānyena yat sāmarthyaṃ nirdiṣṭam, tadeva vyapekṣaikārthībhāvalakṣaṇabhedena śabdaśak‌tyanusāribhi- rvibhaktamityāha-- sāmarthyamaviśeṣoktamapi lokavyavasthayā | vṛttyavṛttyoḥ prayogajñairvibhaktaṃ pratipattṛbhiḥ || 43 ||
samarthapadena sāmānyavācinā saṅgatārthatvaṃ vṛttivākyagatamaviśiṣṭamuktam | lakṣyajñaistu lakṣyamṛlatvāt smṛteḥ sūtrakārāśayamanusṛtyā vṛttāvekārthībhāvo vākye vyapekṣeti vibhāgaḥ kṛtaḥ | tathāca paribhāṣāpakṣe ṣatvādividhāvapi vyapekṣāsāmarthyasambhāvādasyaiva vyāpāraḥ | niyataviṣayatvācca sāmarthyabhedasya `vā vatanānarthakyaṃ ca svabhāvasiddhatvātṣa' ityuktam | ekārthībhāvaprakṛtāśca vṛttau krāntādyarthapratītyādayo viśeṣā uktāḥ | vākye tvekārthībhāvābhāvakṛtāḥ saṅkhyāviśeṣādayaḥ || 43 ||
kathamaviśeṣoktāvayaṃ pravibhāgaḥ, viparyayo'pyatra kasmānna sambhāvyata ityāśaṅkayāha-- arthasya vinivṛttatvāllugādi na virudhyate | ekārthībhāva evātaḥ samāsākhyā vidhīyate || 44 ||
iha dvividhā vṛttiḥ, jahastvārthā ajahatsvārthā ca | jahanti svārthanupasarjanapadāni yasyāṃ sā jahatsvārthā, tadviparītā ajahat‌svārtheti matabhedāśrayo vikalpaḥ | tatra jahatsvārthāyāmasannevopasarjanārthaḥ | ajahatsvā- rthāyāmapi pradhānena sambhedāpatteḥ pṛthagasanniti bhedādhiṣṭhānasya sambandhasya nivṛttatvāt saṅkhayāviśeṣatirodhānācca vibhakteḥ svābhāvikamarthābhāvādadarśana- manvākhyāyamānamupapadyate | tathāca samāsa ekārthībhāve yuktaḥ | vyapekṣāyāṃ tu bhedasya saṃkhyāviśeṣāṇāṃ ca saṃbhavād vibhaktiśravaṇe vākyamava- tiṣṭhate | lugādītyādigrahaṇāt `stokānmukta' ityaluka ekavadbhāvavacanaṃ gṛhyate | bhedatirodhānāddhi samāse'bhedaikatvasaṃkhyāprādurbhāvāt svābhāvikamevai- kārthābhidhānamanugamyate | tathācoktam | `ekavadvacanagrahaṇamanarthakam' dvibahuṣvasamāsa' iti | tadevamekārthobhāve samāsavidhānasya lugādyanvākhyānaṃ liṅgamuktam | tathāca vākyasamāsayorniyataviṣayatvāt parasparaviṣayāvarodhāsāmarthyād vikalpaśāsana- manupapannam || 44 ||
kecit tu vācanikameva viṣayaniyamamāhuḥ, tad darśayati-- vyavasthitavibhāṣā ca sāmānye kaiścidiṣyate | tathā vākyaṃ vyapekṣāyāṃ samāso'nyatra śiṣyate || 45 ||
vyapekṣaikārthībhāvayoryat sāmānyaṃ saṃbanjamātraṃ sāmarthyamityaviśeṣeṇoktam, tatra vibhāṣayā vākyasamāsāvabhyanujñāyate | vyavasthitavibhaṣāvijñānācca vyapekṣāyāṃ sāmarthyabhede vākyameva, ekārthībhāve tu vṛttireveti śabdaśak‌tyanu- sārī viṣayaniyamaḥ sūtrakārābhiprāyamanusaradbhiruktaḥ | vākyakāro vāvacanaṃ pratyācakhyāviti pūrvoktanayena vyavasthāmāha | sūtrakārasya tu sāmānye vyavasthitavibhāṣā sthitā || 45 ||
tathāca sāmānyārthāśraye samānaśabdatve'pyekārthībhāvakṛto'yamaparo viśeṣa ityāha-- tulyaśrutitvāt tattve'pi rājādīnāmupāśrite | vṛttau viśeṣaṇākāṅkṣā'gamakatvānnivartate || 46 ||
ya eva rājādiśabdā vākye, ta eva vṛttāviti rūpasādṛśyādabhede vṛttivākyayoḥ samāśrite'pi `ṛddhasya rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ' iti vākyavad `ṛddhasya rājapuruṣaḥ' iti vṛttāvapi viśeṣaṇenopasarjanārtho na yujyate gamakatvābhāvāt, pradhānasaṃsṛṣṭena hyasvantreṇa rājñā ṛddhāderabhisaṃbandhā- yogāt | ekārthībhāvāddhi saṃbandhasyāntarbhāve sati kathamudbhūtavyatirekeṇa viśeṣaṇena yogaḥ syāditi `saviśeṣaṇānāṃ vṛttirna vṛttasya vā viśeṣaṇaṃ na' iti vaktavayam | kṛte hi samāse viśeṣaṇayogo na pratīyate upasarjanārtha- syetyagamakatvāt pratyāyakatvābhāvāt tatra viśeṣaṇākāṅkṣā nāsti | vākye tvasti gamakatvāt | ataśca śabdaśaktibhedādarthabhede vṛttivākyayoratyantameva bhedaḥ | sārūpyanimittaṃ tvabhedāvasānaṃ bhrāntam | yenāpi vṛttāvekārthībhāvādupasarjanārtha- sya vivekābhāvāt saviśeṣaṇayogo na bhavatītyādiratra yuktirupanyasyate tenāpyekā- rthībhāvakṛtādviśeṣaṇādbheda eva śabdaśaktinimitto vṛttivākyayorukto nāpūrvaḥ kaścit || 46 ||
tathāca yatrāsti gamakatvaṃ, tatraikārthībhāve'pi bhavati viśeṣaṇayoga ityāha-- saṃbandhiśabdaḥ sāpekṣo nityaṃ sarvaḥ prayujyate | svārthavat sā vyapekṣāsya vṛttāvapi na hīyate || 47 ||
iha kecicchabdāḥ svārthamitarāpekṣaṃ nāntarīyakamabhidadhānāḥ saṃbandhiśabdāḥ kathyante|tadyathā--guruśiṣyapitṛputramātṛbhrātrādayaḥ | ataśca te vṛttāvapi svārthamarthānta- rāpekṣāyoginameva pratipādayantīti gamakatvāt tatra saviśeṣaṇānāmapi vṛttirbhavatīti `saviśeṣaṇānāṃ vṛttirna' ityatra `aguruputrādīnām' ityāpi na vaktavyam | devadattasya gurukulaṃ, devadattasya guruputra ityādi | atra hi prātipadikamātreṇāpekṣitaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ nodbhūtavyatirekeṇetyekārthībhāvādvyatirekasyāntarbhāva'pyupasarjanena saṃbadhyate | gurvāderhi vācyaṃ śiṣyādyape- kṣamityekārthībhāve'pi tadākāṅkṣā na nivartate svārthasya nivṛttyabhāvāt ||47|| atraiva prakārāntaramāha-- samudāyena saṃbandho yeṣāṃ gurukulādinā | saṃspṛśyāvayavāṃste ca yujyante tadvatā saha || 48 ||
dāsīgṛhavat prasiddhameva gurukulaṃ devadattena pradhānaṃ viśeṣyate, na tvatropasarja- nārthasya gurordevadattāpekṣetyapi samarthane kiṃ devadattasya samīpaṃ gurukulamutānya- theti sandehe avaśyamidaṃ vaktavyaṃ devadattasya yo gurustasya kulamityevamavayavān gurvādīn saṃbandhena svīkṛtya te devadattādayastadvatāvayavinā samudāyena saṃbadhyanta ityavayavadvāreṇaiva samudāyasaṃbandho `dvimayamudaśvid yavānām' ityādivat | evañca ya eva devadattena sākṣād guroryoge'rthaḥ, sa eva saṃpanna iti, nāsti prakārāntaratvamityatra tātparyam || 48 ||
prakriyāyāṃ vākyopamardena vūtteranvākhyānāt kathamatyantabheda ityāśaṅkayāha-- abudhān pratyupāyāśca vicitrāḥ pratipattaye | śabdāntaratvādatyantabhedo vākyasamāsayoḥ || 49 ||
iha rājapuruṣādayo viśiṣṭārthavṛttayaḥ saṅghātāḥ paramārthato niraṃśā eva parikalpitapūrvottarāvayavapravibhāgena vyutpādyanta iti mandamatayaḥ śrutisārūpyā- dupāyopeyayoraikyamadhyavasyanti | bhāvatastu yathā rekhāgavayena satyagavayapratipattāvanya eva rekhāgavayo'nyaśca satyagavayaḥ, tathā dhūliprakṣepagataṃ prakriyāvākyamanyadeva samāsāt | prayogasamavāyi kila vākyamanenopāyena pradarśyate | tacca vyapekṣaikaniyatamekārthībhāvaviṣayāt samāsādanyadeva | arthabhedena śabdānāṃ bhedāt | saṃkhyāviśeṣādiścārthabhedaḥ pradarśitaḥ| kvacit samāsāntādeścasaṃbhavād rūpabhedo'pyasti | bhedasaṃsargalakṣaṇasya pradhāna- syārthasyābhedād dūraviprakarṣeṇa vākyaprakṛtirvṛttirvyutpādyate | tathā kvacid vākyārthe padavacanamityevaṃ vicitrā vyutpādanopāyāḥ prakriyāyām | tatra ca vākyāvibhaktīnāṃ darśanāt samāse luganvākhyānaṃ nalopādipratyayalakṣaṇakārya- siddhayartham || 49 ||
yadyevaṃ gorathādivṛttiviṣaye'pi yuktādīnāṃ vākye dṛṣṭānāṃ kathaṃ na lopākhyāna- mityata āha-- asamāse samāse ca gorathādiṣvadarśanāt | yuktādīnāṃ na śāstreṇa nivṛttyanugamaḥ kṛtaḥ || 50 ||
vibhaktayo'samāse vākye dṛṣyaprayogā iti prakriyāyāṃ tadabhedena vṛttyanuśāsane tāsāṃ prasaṅgādyuktaṃ yadācāryo'rthābhāvāt svābhāvikīṃ nivṛttiṃ pratyayalakṣaṇaṃprārthayamāno'nvācakṣīta | `gorathaḥ, dadhighaṭaḥ' ityādau tu yuktādayaḥ prakriyāvākya- gatā na dṛśyante, nāpi tallopalabhyaṃ kiñcanāpi kāryamiti na teṣāṃ luganvākhyānām | tathāca daghnā odano dadhyodanaḥ gavāṃ ratho goratha iti dravyāṇāṃ kriyāmantareṇāsāmarthyāt samāsābhāve codite, "siddhaṃ tu samānādhikaraṇādhikāre ktastṛtīyāpūrvapadottarapadalopaśca""ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaśca yuktāpūrṇāntaḥ" ityukte dadhnā upasikto dadhyupasiktaḥ, dadhyupāsikta odano dadhyodanaḥ, dadhnaḥ pūrṇo dadhipūrṇaḥ, dadhipūrṇo ghaṭaḥ dadhighaṭaḥ, gavāṃ yukto goyuktaḥ goyukto ratho goratha ityevaṃ samāse uttarapadalopasya vacane codite "na vā asamāse'darśanād""yuktārthasampratyayācca sāmarthyam" "sampratyayācca tadarthā- dhyavasānan" , iti pratyākhyātaṃ lopavacanam | dadhyodanaḥ, guḍadhānā ityannavyañjanabhāvāvagateltaddhetubhūtopasekamiśraṇakriyāsāmarthyāt pratīyata iti tena dadhnā odana ityādyeva vākyaṃ kriyate | nāstyevopasiktādiratra śabdaḥ | evaṃ gavaṃ rathaḥ, dadhno ghaṭa ityeva vākyam | sambandhisāmarthyāt tu yuktādya- rthapratītiḥ | tathāhi--gavāṃ rathasya vāhyavāhanasambandho yuktārthamantarbhāvayati | evaṃ dadhighaṭayorādhārādheyasambandhaḥ pūrṇārthamiti yathāyogamanusaraṇīyam || 50 ||
nanu ca goyakto ratho dadhyupasikta odanaḥ dadhipūrṇo ghaṭa iti vākye dṛśyanta eva yuktādayaḥ, tathā pragataparṇaḥ prapatitaparṇaḥ ityādau praparṇādivṛttiviṣaye vākye gatādiśabdaḥ śrūyata iti lopo'nvākhyeya evotyata āha-- śabdāntaratvād yuktādiḥ kvacid vākye prayujyate | praparṇaprapalāśādau gataśabdaśca vṛttiṣu || 51 ||
iha dvividhaṃ vākyam | prayogasamavāyi lokikaṃ nityaṃ, prakriyāvākyaṃ cānityama- lokikaṃ samāsaprakṛtirekhāgavayasthānīyam | tatra ca yuktādirna dṛśyate | laukike dṛśyate | taccānyadeva gorathādeḥ samāsasya paryāyarūpamiti na paryāyāṇāṃ gajo mataṅgajo vṛṣo vṛṣabha ityādīnāṃ gurulāghavādareṇa lopānvākhyānamupapadyate | praparṇādiviṣaye vṛttaṣvekārthībhāveṣu satsu kvacillaukike vākye pragartaparṇa ityādau gataśabdaḥ prayujyate śabdāntarabhūta iti samanvayaḥ || 51 ||
prayogasamavāyinā ca laukikena vākyena satyapyavāntarārthabhede pradhānārthāpekṣayā vṛttirabhinnārthetyāha-- viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyatvaṃ kaiścidekastathāśrayaḥ | upāye tattvadarśitvādiṣyate vṛttivākyayoḥ || 52 ||
niraṃśasya samāsasyānvākhyātimaśakyatvāllaukikavākyasadṛśaṃ prakriyāvākyamupāyaḥ kalpyate | yatra cānvayavyatirekābhyāṃ prakṛtipratyayavadarthāpod‌dhāraḥ | abudhāstu- pāyopeyayoraikyamadhyavasyanto'rthābhedamatrāvayanti | tathāhi--ya eva viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvo nilamutpalamityatra vākye, (a)bhedaniṣṭaṃ ca samānādhikaraṇyaṃ tadavilakṣameva nīlotpalamityatra vṛttau | evaṃ vyadhikaraṇaviṣaye'pi rājñaḥ puruṣa ityādau viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaḥ saṃsargātmako rājapuruṣa iti vṛttyā samāna iti vṛttivākye abhinne ca | tathā ca `parasparavyapekṣāṃ sāmarthyameke,ityekīyaṃ matam | samāse'pyatra vyapekṣaiva sāmarthyaṃ, vākyopamardena kāryaśabdadarśane samāsaprādurbhāvādarthabhedāyo gāt prātipadikenaiva ca pañcakadarśanāśrayeṇa vibhak‌tyarthābhidhānāt talluganvākhyānam, na tvarthasyābhāvāt | tathā ca tāvakīnādau viśeṣaṇapratipattinibandhane sati saṅkhyāviśeṣo'vadhāryata eva | sarvathā tvekārthībhāvābhāvena syādatra pratītiḥ | upasarjanaviśeṣaṇāyogastu `saviśeṣa- ṇānāṃ vṛttirne'ti vācanikaḥ | dvandve caśabdasyāprayogaśca tadartha eva | tasyānuśā- sanāt,na tu bhedavigamanāt, tanniṣṭhasamuccayābhāvāditi kāryaśabdavādino vṛttivākyayoḥ pradhānārthābhedena paryāyayoḥ sarvathaikyaṃ bhrāntyādhyavasyanti | naikārthībhāvo nāma viśeṣakaraḥ kaścid,vyapekṣaiva, ṣatvādiviṣaye'pi sambhavāt sarvatra sāmarthyamiti pratipannāḥ | itthaṃ ca bhinnanimittābhyāṃ śabdābhyāmekasyaivārthasya pratyāyanāt sāmānādhi- karaṇyamavacchedyāvacchedakabhāvaśca bhedāśrayo vṛttāvapi yujyata iti na tat prayatnasādhyam | eṣāṃ ca mate vā vacanena vikalpo bhinnaviṣaye kriyata iti nānarthakaṃ tat || 52 ||
etadapadarśanaṃ nirākartumāha-- padaṃ yathaiva vṛkṣādi viśiṣṭe'rthe vyavasthitam | nīlotpalādyapi tathā bhāgābhyāṃ vartate vinā || 53 ||
varṇānāmānarthakyasya vṛkṣādau pratipāditatvānniraṃśamavibhaktārthapratayāyakaṃ sphoṭa svabhāvaṃ padaṃ svaśak‌tyā niyatārthaṃ yathā, evaṃ nīlotpalaṃ sadṛśabhāgaprakalpanayā prakṛtipratyāyadivad vyutpādyate'dūraviprakarṣeṇa vākyena | yathā vṛkṣādāvasannapiprakṛtipratyayārthavibhāgo'nvākhyānārthaṃ kalpitaḥ, tathā vṛttāvapyavayavārthabhedaḥ | vākye hi bhedo'rthasyeti sambandhavibhaktiḥ | vṛttau tvavibhāgena pāṃsūdakavadarthasyā- bhedāpattyā sambandhavigalanāt svābhāvikī nivṛttirvibhakteḥ, saṅkhayāviśeṣo'pi nāsti | pañcake prātipadikārthe dyotakābhāvādapratīteḥ | payaḥ payo jarayatītyatra kriyāsambandhānyathānupapattyā śaktipratītiḥ | abhedaikatvasaṅkhayā ca sarvasaṅkhyāviśeṣasāmānyabhūtā vṛttāvastyuparjanārthasya dravyasya nissaṅkhayatvābhāvāditi yathāyogaṃ sati viśeṣadyotake tadavagamo na virudhyate | pradhānārthasambhedādeva ca svaviśeṣaṇena na yajyate upasarjanārthaḥ | vacanena tu śabdānāṃ śak‌tyādhānāyogād viṣayaviveko duravasānaḥ | dvandve'pi samuccitaprādhānyācca śabdanivṛttirna tu cārthe'nuśāsanāt | nāhyatrārthā vidheyatayā śabdeṣu nirdiśyante, ānantyenāśakyatvāt | taduktam--`arthānādeśānāt, tacca ladhvarthami'ti| siddhasya tu laukikasyārthasyānuvādaḥ sarvatra | parasparavyapekṣā sāmarthyamiti tvekīyamatam | ekārthībhāvaḥ sāmarthyaṃ paribhāṣā cetyetraṃ sūtramabhinnatarakaṃ bhavatīti siddhāntavyavasthāpanāt | tadevamekārthībhāvakṛtaviśeṣadarśanādatya- ntameva vṛttivākyayorbhedaḥ | kenacidaṃśena tu sādṛśyādhyavasāyo bhramaḥ || 53 ||
na cāpi sarvatra vṛttivākyayoḥ sādṛśyānugama ityāha-- śrotriyakṣetriyādīnāṃ na ca vāsiṣṭhagārgyavat | bhedena pratyayo loke tulyarūpāsamanvayāt || 54 ||
vāsiṣṭhagārgyādau taddhitavṛttiviṣaye yathānvākhyānāya prakṛtipratyayavibhāgena pratipattiḥ, naitraṃ śrotriyakṣetriyapāraśavādeḥ | na hyatra prakṛtirūpānugamo dṛśyate, chandaḥśabdaparakṣetraśabdastrīśabdānāmananugamāt | tathāca vākyādanyadeva vṛttipadam | tathā sarvatraiva boddhavyam | etadeva hi sāmānyato dṛṣṭamatra liṅgamupodbalakamarthabhodādeva siddheḥ || 54 ||
vṛttivākyayoḥ śabdabhede'rthānugamo'pi kacinnāstītyāha-- saptaparṇādivad bhedo na vṛttau vidyate kvacit | rūḍhayarūḍhivibhāgo'pi kriyate pratipattaye || 55 ||
parvaṇi parvaṇi sapta parṇānyasyetyetraṃ saptaparṇaśabdo vyutpādyate | na ca sarva evaṃvidho vṛkṣaḥ, api tu kaścideva śīrṇaparṇo'pi viśiṣṭajātīyo'bhidhīyate | yadyetraṃ kathaṃ saptaparṇādayo rūḍhiśabdā iti prasiddhāḥ na rājapuruṣādaya ityata āha--rūḍhayarūḍhīti | pratipattaye nyāyasiddhārthābhedasampratyayasthirīkaraṇārthamayaṃ vibhāgaḥ | pratipādano-pāyaḥ | pradhānārthānugamād rājapuruṣādau tu vākyagatārthānugamavyabhicārād rājapuruṣādau yaugikatvam, saptaparṇādau tu vākyagatārthānugamavyabhicārād rūḍhitvamiti vibhāgena vyavahāraḥ | krameṇa hi paro'vabod‌dhyate | na cārthānugamamātrāṃ vinā rūḍhitvam, saptaparṇādāvapi rūḍhiviṣaye kvacit tatsambhavāt | tathāhi rūḍhīnāmapi kvacit saptaparṇādāvarthānugamo'sti | na caitāvatā yaugikatvam, atiprasaṅgāt | tadevamanaṅgīkṛtāvayavārthā eva nīlotpalādayaḥ samāsāḥ prakalpitāvayavabhedena vyutpādyamānā bhinnā eva tattvato vākyebhya ityatyantabhedo vṛttivākyayoḥ siddhaḥ || 55 ||
yadyekārthībhāvakṛto bhedo vṛttivākyayoḥ, tadā bahirvīhāvanekavarttipadasambhavādanya- padārthe teṣāmekārthībhāvānyathānupapattyā parasparasamanvaye samāsāntaramantarā kasmānna bhavatītyāha-- yā sāmānyāśrayā saṃjñā viśeṣaviṣayā ca yā | bahulagrahaṇānnāsti pravṛttirubhayostayoḥ || 56 ||
susūkṣmajaṭakeśādau samāso'vayave yadi | syāt, syāt tantrāntaraṅgatvāt bādhako'vayavasvaraḥ || 57 ||
atiśayena sūkṣmā jaṭarūpāḥ keśā yasya so'yaṃ susūkṣmajaṭakeśaḥ | atra sūkṣma- jaṭaśabdayoḥ sati sambandhe viśeṣaṇasamāse samāsāntodāttatvaṃ syāt | bahurvīhisvareṇa hi tripadasamāsagataṃ samāsāntodāttatvaṃ bādhitamekaviṣayatvāt | avayavayostu bahuvrīhyabhāvādapratiṣiddhaṃ samāsāntodāttatvameva syāt | naca paratvād bahurvīhisvaraḥ antaraṅgatvādavayavasvaraśca pūrvaśālā priya itivat | tasmādatrāvayavasvaranivṛttyarthaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyeṇe'-- iti yā karmadhārayasamāsasaṃjñā, yā ca `sup supā'iti yogāvibhāgāt sāmānyena samāsasaṃjñā, sā bahulagrahaṇānna pravartata iti vācyam || 56,57 ||
nanu ca prakṛtayaiva mahāvibhāṣayātrāvayavayoḥ samāsasaṃjñā dvividhāpi na pravartata iti kasmānnocyate, kiṃ bahulagrahaṇāt tadabhāvaḥ kathyata ityāśaṅkyāha-- samudāyasya vṛttau ca naikadeśo vibhāṣyate | bheda eva vibhāṣāyāṃ niyato viṣayo yataḥ || 58 ||
vyavasthitavibhāṣāvijñānādekārthībhāvaprakrame vikalpo nāsti | tasya vyapekṣaika- niyatatvādityanyapadārthe vṛttimanubhavatāmavayavānāmanyonyasaṃsargasyāvinābhāvādekārthī- bhāva eva nyāyya iti prāptā samāsasaṃjñā bahulagrahaṇena nivāryate | yadā hi vṛttistadāvayavayorvṛttireva | tadyathā `pañcagavadhanaḥ, vāk‌tvacapriyaḥ'ityantarā tatpuruṣo dvandvaśca pravartata iti tadāśrayaṭacsamāsāntasiddhiḥ | tadetad bhāṣye--`dvandvatatpuruṣayoruttarapade nityasamāsavacanam' ityetadvārtikakāravacanasamādhānārthamuktam--`yadā vṛttiḥ, sarveṣāṃ tadā pravṛttiḥ'iti || 58 ||
nanu caikasmin prayoge bahurvīhisaṃjñāyā bhāvo'vayave tatpuruṣasaṃjñāyāścābhāvo vibhāṣayānayā pratipādyatām | ayameva hyasyā mukhyo viṣaya ityatrāpravṛttāva- caritārtheyaṃ syādityāśaṅkayāha-- yataścāviṣayaḥ so'syāstasmānnāstyakṛtārthatā | abhedaprakrame'tyantaṃ bhedānāmapasāraṇāt || 59 ||
ekārthībhāvaviṣaye pṛthagarthatābhāvād vividhabhāṣaṇarūpāyā vyapekṣāniyatāyā vibhāṣāyā nāsti pravṛttirityaviṣaye'pravṛttāvasyāḥ kathamacaritārthatvam | anyanta-miti | na kevalaṃ samudāyagato bhedo nāsti, yāvadavayavagato'pi | pradhānārthapara- vaśatvena pāṃsūdakavad vibhāgāpatteravayavārthānām | tadevamatra prāptaḥ samāso bahulagrahaṇena nivāryate avayavayoriṣṭasvarasid‌dhyarthaṃ | susūkṣmajaṭakeśaḥ. sunatājinavāsā ityevamādau hi bahurvīhisvara eveṣyate || 59 ||
kvacit tvavayavasvareṇa samudāyasvaro na bhidyata iti bhavatyeva tatrāvayavayoḥ samāsa ityāha-- mahākaṣṭaśritetyevaṃ na syād bhedaḥ padatraye | vṛttāvayavasyāttvaṃ yasmānna pratiṣidhyate || 60 ||
evamiti | samudāyasya vṛttāvayavayorapyekārthībhāvābhyupagame sati mahat kaṣṭaṃ śrita iti tripadasamāsaprakrame'vayavayoḥ `sanmahat--'iti samāse vihite bhavatyāttvamuttarapade vidhīyamānām | tripade cātra samāse na syādāttvamu- ttarapadatvasya sarvāntye lokavijñānānmadhyapade tadabhāvādityavayavasamāsa āśrayitavyaḥ | svare tvatra bhedo nāsti | dvipade samāse samāsāntodāttatvasya bādhakasthāthādisvaraḥ, tasyāpi bādhakaḥ `ahīne dvitīyā' iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaraḥ, sa evāvayavasamāsāntodāttaḥ || 60 ||
kvacit tu svare'tra bheda ityāha-- mahāraṇyamatīte tu tripadād bhidyate svaraḥ | yasmāt tatrāntaraṅgatvād bādhako'vayavasvaraḥ || 61 ||
mahadaraṇyamatīta iti tripade dvitīyātatpuruṣe samāsāntodāttatvasya bādhakaṃ thāthādisvaramavayavāśrayo'ntaraṅgaḥ samāsāntodātto bādhetetyatra tripadād dvipade tatpuruṣe bhidyate svaraḥ || 61 ||
tathāhi-- satiśiṣṭabalīyastvāt thāthādisvara eva tu | dvipade tena yugapat tritayaṃ na samasyate || 62 ||
mahadaraṇyaṃ mahāraṇyamiti pūrvaṃ `sanmahat--' iti samāse paścānma- hāraṇyaśabdasyātītaśabdena dvitīyāsamāse satiśiṣṭasvarabalīyastvāt `thāthādi--' svaro'ntodātto bhavati | satyavayavāntodāttatve śiṣṭatvāt kakṣyā- ntaraprāptyotkṛṣyabalatvena bādhakatvāt | tadevamatra tripade samāse madhyodāttat- vam, dvipade tvantodāttatvamiti bhedaḥ | tathāca sup supeti saṃkhyāvivakṣāyāṃ tripadasamāso na bhavati | mahākaṣṭaśrite tu svarabhedābhāvāt satyapi tripade samāse nāsti kaścid doṣaḥ || 62 ||
nanu ca śritārthe samanvayāt parasparasaṃsargābhāve mahatkaṣṭaśabdayoḥ kathaṃ samāsaḥ | tathācottarapade vidhīyamānamātvaṃ na syādityata āha-- yeṣāmapūjyamānatvaṃ parārthānugamārthake | viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyatvamapi teṣāṃ na kalpate || 63 ||
kaṣṭārthasya śritārthānugame mahatā sambandhābhāvāt pūjyamānatvaṃ nāstīti vadatāma- vayavānāṃ viśeśaṇaviśeṣyabhāvo'pi na syādasambandhāt | tathāca pañcagavadhana ityādāva- vayavayoḥ samāsābhāvāt samāsāntodāttatvaṃ na syāt | sa ca siddhāntitaḥ--`navāvayava- tatpuruṣatvāt, tasyāntodāttatvaṃ vipratiṣedhādi'ti | `khādiretaraśamyaḥ' ityatra cāvayavasamāsāśrayaḥ puṃvadbhāvaḥ | pradhānānugrahāya cāvayavāḥ paraspareṇa sambadhyanta eva | saguṇasya hi dravyasya kriyā samanvayaḥ | śraute'pi samanvaye dravyāśrayatvāt tadviśeṣaṇadvāreṇaiva kriyāyogād guṇasya | tasmādastyeva samudāyaprakrame'pyavayavayoḥ parasparasamanvaya iti mahākaṣṭaśrite rūpasvaraviśeṣābhāvādabhyupagamyāpi tripadaḥ samāsa uktaḥ | sup supeti saṃkhyāviśeṣavivakṣaiva tu siddhānta iti tripado dvitīyāsamāso nāsti|tathāca `mahāraṇyātītaḥ' ityatra dvipade samāse sidhyatīṣṭasvaraḥ | bahurvīhau dvandve cānekagrahaṇādaviśeṣeṇa samāsaḥ siddhāntitaḥ | tatra ca diksaṃkhyāpūrva evāvayavata- tpuruṣaḥ `taddhitārthottarapada--'ityuttarapade vihito bhavati | tathāca tatraiva tadāśrayo'ntaraṅgasvaraḥ | susūkṣmajaṭakeśādau tu bahulagrahaṇādavayavayorviśeṣaṇasamāsābhāvaḥ| samudāyapāratantrye cāvayavānāṃ pṛthak svakāryāprayojakatvāt samudāyasamāsenaivaika- padyasya siddhatvāt | tadyathā samudāyadvirvacane tvavayavadvirvacanaṃ na bhavati papāceti | `pūrvaśālāpriyaḥ' ityādau tu uttarapade svarasamāsāntasid‌dhyarthaṃ dvigurvācanikobhavati | `khādiretaraśamyaḥ' iti itarā śamyā itaraśamyeti pūrvaṃ viśeṣaṇasamāse kṛte khādirī itaraśamyā yasyeti dvipado bahurvīhirityuttarapade puṃvadbhāvaḥ sidhyatīti sarveṣṭasiddhiḥ || 63 ||
prastutameva vṛttivākyayorvaidharmyaṃ vicārāntarārthaṃ pratipādayati-- viśeṣaḥ śrūyamāṇo'pi pradhāneṣu guṇeṣu vā | śabdāntaratvād vākye tu vṛttau nityaṃ na vidyate || 64 ||
ṛddhasya rājñaḥ puruṣa iti vākye guṇasya rājño viśeṣaḥ śrūyate samṛddhatālakṣaṇaḥ | vṛttau tu `rājapuruṣaḥ'ityatra ṛddhasyeti viśeṣaṇaṃ rājño nāsti, pradhānārthasaṃbhi- nnasya svaviśeṣaṇāyogāt | etacca vṛttivākyayoḥ śabdāntaratve satyupapadyate | vākyaprakṛtau tu vṛttau vākyagatadharmānuṣaṅgaḥ | evaṃ citrā gāvo yasya devadattasyeti pradhānasyānyapadārthasya devadattādiviśeṣo vākye śruto'pi vivakṣito'pi vṛttau citragurityatra nāntarbhavatīti padārthābhi- dhānādanuprayogānupapattau coditāyāṃ, `na vā anabhihitatvāt'iti tyanuprayogaḥ samarthitaḥ | anyapadārthasāmānyaṃ hyantarbhavati, na tu tadviśeṣaḥ || 64 ||
nanu ca vṛttau guṇasya svaviśeṣaṇenāsambandhāt kṛtapūrvīṃ kaṭamityatra kṛtena kaṭasya sāmānādhikaraṇyābhāvādasati kriyāsambandhe karmatā na syādityāsaṅkayāha-- viśeṣakarmasambandhe nirbhukte'pi kṛtādibhiḥ | viśeṣanirapekṣo'nyaḥ kṛtaśabdaḥ pravartate || 65 ||
kṛtaḥ pūrvaṃ kaṭo'nena, bhuktaḥ pūrvamodano'neneti vākye kaṭādīnāṃ viśiṣṭena karmaṇā samanvaya iti niṣṭhayā tasya viśiṣṭasya karmaṇo nirbhuktatvādabhihitatvād dvitīyā na bhavati | vṛttau tu kṛtapūrvī kaṭamityatra kṛtārthasya prādhānārthānugāmi- tvādasati svātantrye svakarmaṇā kaṭādinā sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ na syāt || 65 ||
tasmādanya eva vākyasthāt sakarmakāt kṛtaśabdāt vṛttau kṛtaśabdo'yamakarmaka iti bāhyena karmaṇā kaṭādinā sambadhyata ityāha-- akarmakatve satyevaṃ ktāntaṃ bhāvābhidhāyi yat | tataḥ kriyāvatā kartrā yogo bhavati karmaṇām || 66 ||
vṛttivākyayoratyantabhedād vākye viśiṣṭakarmasamanvayayogyo'pi kṛtaśabdo vṛttau viśeṣasyābhidhānasambhavāt sāmānyakarmaiva pratīyate | tacca nāntarīyakatvāda- vivakṣitamityakarmako'yaṃ kṛtaśabdo bhāvābhidhāyī sampadyate | prasiddhaṃ hi nāntarīyakaṃ sāmānyakarmeti | yathā dīkṣito na dadātīti prasiddherakarmikā kriyā, tatheyamapīti bhāvo'tra niṣṭhā kathyate | tathāca kriyayāvacchinnaḥ taddhitavācyaḥ kartā `kṛtapūrvī- devadattaḥ' iti | tasya ca bāhyena kaṭādinā sambandho dṛśyate, kaṭamiti | kārakāṇāṃ ca kriyāvyapetaḥ sambandha ityanyasyā atra kriyāyā abhāvāt taddhitārthaviśeṣaṇabūtayaiva kriyayā sambandho yukta iti tadapekṣameva kaṭādeḥ karmatvam kṛtapūrvī kaṭam,bhuktapūrvī odanamityādi | bhāve'tra niṣṭheti kriyaiva tadantavācyā| tadetaduktaṃ bhāṣye--"yo'sau kṛtakaṭayorabhisambandhaḥ, ca utpanne pratyaye nivartate | asti ca karoteḥ kaṭena sāmarthyamiti dvitīyā bhaviṣyatī"ti | vākyo yo viśiṣṭena kaṭādinā kṛtasyābhisambandhaḥ, sa utpanne taddhite vṛttau nivartate | śabdaśakti- svābhāvyād viśeṣābhidhānaṃ nāsti vṛttau, sāmānyakarmaṇaiva sambandhapratīteḥ | tathāca prasiddheḥ karmaṇo'karmikeyaṃ kriyeti bhāvābhidhāyī kta iti tatratyayā kriyayā vyāpyamānaṃ kaṭādi karma bhavatīti samanvayopapattirityarthaḥ || 66 ||
nanu ca taddhitārthe kartari guṇībhūtā kriyā vṛttāvabhedena pratīyate, na tu karturbhedena svarūpaprādhānyeneti kathaṃ tayā kaṭādeḥ karmaṇo yoga ityāśaṅkya nidarśanenaitad vyutpādayati-- avigrahā gatādisthā yathā grāmādikarmabhiḥ | sambadhyate kriyā tadvat kṛtapūrvyādiṣu sthitā || 67 ||
grāmaṃ gato devadatto, grāmaṃ gacchati cetyādau gatādiśabdena gamikriyākarturabhidhā- nād gamikriyāyāstataḥ karturvividhaṃ pṛthak‌tvena grahaṇaṃ nāstītyāvigrahā sā | pratyayārthe hi sarvatra guṇabhūtaḥ prakṛtyarthaḥ, vyāpārāviṣṭasya sādhanasyākhyātāt pratīteḥ kārakamukhenaiva kriyā prādhānyaṃ bhajate, na tu svataḥ, sarvatra prakṛtyarthasya guṇatvāt | evañca kriyā sarvatra kārakād bhedena nāvagṛhyate | kārakāṇāṃ hi pravṛttiviśeṣarūpāsau tatsamavetaiva tadabhidhāyapratyayānugataprakṛtivācyā nyāyyā | na ca kevalasya kriyā vācino dhātoḥ prayogo'sti | ikśtibādinā ca siddhatayā pratyāyyate, na tu sādhyamānāvasthena svarūpeṇa | tasmāt kārakasaṃsṛṣṭaiva sarvā kriyā karmaṇā sambadhyata iti kṛtapūrvyādāvapi tādṛśyā eva samanvayopapattiḥ || 67 ||
yadi kṛtaśabdo vṛttau viśeṣakarmāntarbhāvayitumasamarthaḥ, muṇḍaṃ karoti muṇḍayati, sūtrayati, miśrayatītyādāvapi vṛttau māṇavakāderviśeṣasyānabhivyaktiḥ syāt | na ca kṛtaśabdavad muṇḍyādiśabdaḥ kriyāvācīti tasya kriyāviśeṣe'ntarbhāvāt kathamatra bāhyena māṇavakādikarmaṇā yoga ityata āha-- muṇḍisūtryādayo'sadbhirbhāgairanugatā iva | vibhaktāḥ kalpitātmano dhātavaḥ kuṭṭicarcivat || 68 ||
muṇḍaṃ karotītyādi vākyaṃ prakṛtipratyayaparikalpanenānvākhyānopāyamātramiti tadgatabhedavāsanayā bhāgānugama ivātra | satyataḥ punarnirastoddeśavibhāgā viśiṣṭa- kriyāvacanā ete dhātavaṃ itthaṃ vyutpādyante, samudāyapratītyāvayavapratīterbādhanāt |tataśca yathāyathaṃ svakarmaṇā sambandho na virudhyate | prakṛtivācyaṃ hi muṇḍādi guṇakarma, pratyayavācyastu karotyartha ityanvākhyānāya vibhāgaḥ kalpitaḥ | keśacchedanavacano hi muṇḍayatiḥ | tasya sākṣādeva māṇavakaḥ karma | evaṃ sūtrayatyādau vyākaraṇādiḥ | gumatvena nityasāpekṣā vā muṇḍādayo bāhyena guṇinā māṇavakādinā yujyante | keśacchedanaṃ vā kriyāviśeṣarūpaṃ karoteḥ karma | tadviśiṣṭasya tu māṇavakādi karma | kuṭṭicarcivaditi | sākṣād dhātuṣu pāṭhādanayorniraṃśatvasya prasiddhernidarśanatvaṃ nyāyyam || 68 ||
evamanyatrāpi prakṛtipratyayabhedo'nvākhyānopāya ityāha-- putrīyatau na putro'sti viśeṣecchā tu tādṛśī | vinaiva putrānugamād yā putre vyavatiṣṭhate || 69 ||
putraśabdo'trāsatyaḥ kalpito'vayavaḥ | tathāca putraviśiṣṭecchā putrīyatinābhi- dhīyate || 69 ||
yadi tarhi putre vyavatiṣṭhate, tadā bāhyaiḥ putraviśeṣaiḥ sambadhyeteyamicchetyā- śaṅkayāha-- prāṇairvinā yathā dhārirjīvatau prāṇakarmakaḥ | na cātra dhārirna prāṇā jīvatistu kriyāntaram || 70 ||
jīvatītyasyārthaḥ prāṇān dhārayatīti | na cātra jīvatau prāṇaśabdo'sti | nāpi dhārayatirdhātuḥ | atha ca viśiṣṭakarmikaivaṃrūpā kriyā pratīyata ityantarbhūtatvāt karmaṇo'karmavyapadeśamāsādayati yathā || 70 ||
tathā vineṣiputrābhyāṃ putrīyāyāṃ kriyāntaram | anvākhyānāya bhedāstu sadṛśāḥ pratipādakāḥ || 71 ||
iṣiputrānugama upāyamātram, paramārthatastu putrīyāyāṃ putrīyāśabde kriyāntara- manyā viśiṣṭā kriyā pratīyate | putrīyāyāṃ vā kriyāyāṃ kriyāntaramiti bhāva- pradhāno nirdeśaḥ | tena kriyāntaratvamityarthaḥ | evañca yathā jīvaterbāhyena karmaṇā'yogaḥ, tathā putrīyatāvityakarmikeyaṃ kriyā | tathā ca bhāṣyam--`atha kyajantasya kāni sādhanāni ? bhāvaḥ kartā ca | atha karma ? nāsti karma' iti | subantāt karmaṇa icchāyāṃ kyajiti tu pratipādanopāyo'- nvākhyānaṃ bhedeneti pṛthagbhūtaputrādiśabdasādṛśyād vibhāgabhrāntiratra || 71 ||
nanu `maṇḍayati māṇavakam' itivat `putrīyati māṇavakam' iti bāhyena karmaṇā kriyāntaratve'pi yogaḥ kasmānna bhavatītyāśaṅkayāha-- ākṣepācca prayogeṇa viṣayāntaravartinā | sadapīcchākyacaḥ karma vākya eva prayujyate || 72 ||
putraviśeṣalakṣaṇaṃ māṇavakādikarma putreṣaṇāyāṃ vidyamānamapi vṛttāvarthāntarapratī- terna prayujyate | `putrīyati māṇavakam' iti hyukte viṣayāntaramācāralakṣaṇam, tadvācinopamānakyacaḥ prayogeṇecchāviṣayā kyajapahriyate, ācārārthapratīteḥ | tasmāt `putramicchati māṇavakam' iti vākya eva viśeṣakarmaprayogaḥ || 72 ||
anena nyāyenaitatsadṛśaṃ prasaṅgenānyadapyupapādayati-- prasiddhena kṛtaḥ śabdo bhāvagarhābhidhāyinā | abhyāse tulyarūpatvānna yaṅantaḥ prayujyate || 73 ||
`lolupyate, caṅ‌kramyate, jaṅgamyate' iti yaṅi kṛte gatikoṭilyasya bhāva- garhāyāśca pratīteḥ kriyāsamabhihāre yaṅanto'yaṃ sadṛśo'pi na prayujyate, yaṅantād, astadapratīteḥ | bhāvagarhābhidhāyinetyasyopalakṣārthatvāt kauṭilyābhidhāyinetyapi draṣṭavyam | taduktam--"kriyāsamabhihāre ca naitebhyaḥ"iti | etadarthaṃ ca nityagrahaṇaṃ kecid vyācakṣate | abhyāsaḥ paunaḥpunyaṃ kriyāsamabhihāraḥ | itthaṃ ca vākyavācya eva kriyāsamabhihāro'tra | bhṛśaṃ krāmati, punaḥ punaḥ krāmatītyādi || 73 ||
tadevamanvākhyānopāyamātramavayavavibhāgaparikalpanā samudāyārthapratītyā tvavayavārtha- saṃvidāṃ bādhādasatyā avayavāḥ | tathāhi-- śabdā yathā vibhajyante bhāgairiva vikalpitaiḥ | anvākhyeyāstathā śāstramatidūre vyavasthitam || 74 ||
yatheti vīpsāpradhānam | yathā vibhajyante bhāgairiva kalpanākalpitairniraṃśatvāt satyata ityanvākhyeyāḥ, tathā anvākhyānopāyo bhāgakalpaneti yāvat | paramārthatastu śāstramavayavavibhāgaprakalpanārūpamatidūre nityādanvākhyeyānniraṃśācchabdatattvādava- sthitam | pratipādakaśabdaniṣṭhaṃ hyanvākhyānam | tena ca rekhāgavayasthānīyena satyagavayavadavasthitaśabdapratipattiḥ | ata eva copāyānāṃ prakriyābhedaḥ | kecit kila bhavatiśabdam `bhavāt tiḥ' iti vyutpādayanti, kecid bhūśabdādati- pratyayena, anye madhye vikaraṇena | evamekaśabdāññāgārikaṭ, ekāgāraśabdāññikaṭ | chandasaḥ śrotabhāvo ghaśca, tadadhīte vākyārthe padavacanamityādiprakriyābheda uktaḥ | evaṃ putrīyādiśabde'pi prakriyābhedo'bhyūhyaḥ | puto rīyaṇe vā postrīyeṇa vā putrāḍḍīyeṇa vā vyutpattiḥ | itthaṃ ca vyutpattāvapi putrīyaśabdo viśiṣṭakriyāvacana ityakarmakatvam | yadā ca vyutpattau niyamābhāvaḥ, tadauṇādikā api kecidaṣṭādhyāyyāṃ vyutpādyante || 74 ||
itthamavayavānāmasatyatvaṃ sārvatrikaṃ nigamayati-- arthasyānugamaṃ kañcid dṛṣṭyaiva parikalpitam | padaṃ vākye pade dhāturdhātau bhāgaśca muṇḍivat || 75 ||
vākyārthā eva sthitalakṣaṇaḥ, vākyasyaivākhaṇḍasya vācakatvāt | tathā cāpoddhāra- bud‌dhyārthasāmānyaṃ vākyārthe viśeṣe'nugatarūpamud‌dhṛtya tāvadarthaṃ padaṃ nāma pṛthaga-nvākhyātumapod‌dhriyate, niraṃśasya vākyasyānekarūpasyānvākyātumaśakyatvāt | padaṃ hi sarvavākyeṣu samānarūpamityarthasāmānyavāci śakyate vyutpādayitum | tacca vyutpāditaṃ yathāyathaṃ vākyeṣu sannipatitaṃ tattadvākyagatāviśeṣasvīkārād viśiṣṭā- rthavyahārasādhanaṃ jāyate | na ca purvaṃ sāmānyārthaṃ bhūtvā viśeṣaṃ svīkartuṃ samartham, "sāmānyārthastirobhūto na viśeṣe'vatiṣṭhate | upāttasya kutastyāgo nivṛttaḥ kāvatiṣṭhatām ||" ityādidoṣāpātāditi sāmānyabhūtamartharūpaṃ parikalpitamucyate | yathaiva hi padena vyavahārābhāvāt parikalpitarūpaṃ tad, evaṃ tadartho'pi | tadāpi ca padaṃ prakṛtipratyayaparikalpanayā vyutpādyata iti tatrāpyapoddhārāśrayeṇa parikalpitā-nvayavyatirekavaśenārthamātrā pravibhajyate prakṛtipratyayayoḥ | dhāturityupalakṣaṇaṃ prakṛtirūpasya | pratyayo'pi ca gṛhyate | tatrāpi ca prakṛti- rūpaṃ muṇḍisūtriputrīyādyavayavavibhāgena prakṛtipratyayakalpanayā vyutpādyate | evamastiṃ sakāramātiṣṭhante | akārastvāgamo'treti kecit | tathā atipratyayasti- pratyayo vikaraṇaśceti vā | evaṃ `syati, syataḥ, syanti' pratyayāḥ, syo vā vikaraṇa ityevamanyadapyūhyam | evañca bhāgaparikalpane varṇeṣvevāvasthānam teṣāṃ turīyādibhāgānāmavyavahāryatvāt | tatrāpi vā paramāṇuparyantabhāgaparikalpane na kaścit śabdaḥ syādityavaśyaṃ bhedavādinā varṇeṣvabhinnatvamabhyupagantavyam, abhinnatvapratīteḥ | itthaṃ ca prathamameva vākyagatayā abhinnasaṃvidā bhedasya bādhanād vitathatvaṃ kasmā- nnocyate ? vyavahāre'pi vākyameva prathamapratītam | tathā ca tadevābhinnabuddhipratyā- yitamastu satyam | etacca vākyakāṇgānniścetavyam || 75 ||
tadevaṃ prakriyābhede'pi-- aviprayogaḥ sādhutve vyutpattiranavasthitā | upāyān pratipattṝṇāṃ nābhimanyeta satyataḥ || 76 ||
sādhutve viṣaye vividhaprayogo nānāvidhaṃ pratipādanaṃ nāsti, sthitalakṣaṇasya śabda- syopeyasyopāyabhede'pyekarūpatvāt | upāyā hi pratipādanāṅgabhūtāḥ prāptāvupeya- sya caritārthatvāt tirobhavantīti na teṣu satyatābhimānaḥ kāryaḥ | vicitratvācca pratipādyapratipādakayoryathāruci pravṛttau vyutpattiḥ paraṃ bhidyate | sarvatraiva cāyameva kramaḥ | avidyaiva hi vidyopāyaḥ | pratipattikāle gatyantarābhāvād yathākathañcit prātipādanasambhavādupeyaprāptiśca tayā bhavantī dṛśyate | taduktam-- "śāstreṣu prakriyābhedairavidyaivopavarṇyate | anāgamavikalpā tu svayaṃ vidyopavartate ||"  iti || 76 ||
sarvatraiva copāyānāmasatyatve yadṛcchāśabdavannaimittiko'pi śabdo nirastāvayavavibhāgaiti nāsti tattvato bhedaḥ śabdānāmityāha-- yathaiva ḍitthe ḍayatiḥ pācake pacatistathā | ḍayatiśca paciśraiva dvāvapyetāvalaukikau || 77 ||
yathaiveti | asyaiva spaṣṭīkaraṇam--dvāvapyetāvalaukikau lokavyavahāre'prasiddhau | prakṛtyādivibhāgasya loke'saṃpratyayānniraṃśasya ḍitthapacatirūpasya samudāyasya loke prayogādubhayatrāpi samānaivārthagatirabhinnārthasamudāyāt | kalpanayā tu ḍayatidhāturasaṃbhava- dartho ḍitthasyānvākhyānāyāpod‌dhriyate | pacatistu sambhavadarthaḥ pacatiśabdasyetye- tāvān bhedaḥ | tathā ca catuṣṭayī śabdānāṃ pravattiruddhoṣyate sādhutvasya satyatve || 77 ||
tasmādabhinnādabhedapūrvakā bhedāḥ kalpitāḥ śiṣṭairabudhān prati vyutpattyarthami- tyāha-- prakṛtipratyayāvūhyau padāt tābhyāṃ padaṃ tathā | anubandhasvarādibhyaḥ śiṣṭaiḥ śāstraṃ na tān prati || 78 ||
śabdānāṃ śiṣṭāḥ pramāṇam | te hi bhāvatattvasadṛśo yadyad dharme'ṅgatāmeti tattat sādhutvenābhyupayantaḥ prakṛtipratyayāvanuguṇāvūhitvā laukikaṃ padaṃ tāvad vākyādapod‌dhṛtaṃ vyutpādayanti | tathā ca tābhyāṃ pratipādyaṃ padamūhitamavayanti | ḍitthādivāpadaṃ pratyakṣakalpenopadiṣṭamityanuguṇaprakṛtipratyayohe kāraṇam | paca- tyādi tu prakṛtipratyayopadeśenānumānakalpane, śabdānuśāsane saṅghātasyohāt | dvividhaṃ hi śiṣṭairanuśāsanaṃ prārabdham--sākṣādupeyanirdeśena, yathā nipātanam | upāyanirdeśānusāreṇa vā, yathā vidhiḥ | tatra ca prakṛtīnāmanubandho ñakārādi- rūpāgrahadarśanānniyataḥ kalpitaḥ, pratyayānāṃ tu svaravṛddhayādidarśanāt tathaivānubandha- praklṛptiḥ | śiṣṭānāṃ tu nirāvaraṇakhyātitvāt pratibhātmani vivṛttānāmeva yathā- vat sarvabhāvagatatvaprakhyānāt saṃpratyupadeśena na kṛtyam, anādiśāstrābhyāsādeva siddheḥ | tathā ca kacidupāyānapekṣāpītyasatyā eva te | ata evod‌dhuṣyate-- `śiṣṭaparijñānārthā'ṣṭādhyāyī' iti || 78 ||
yastu śiṣṭasmaraṇamanādṛtya śāstramātraśaraṇaḥ, saḥ -- śāstradṛṣṭistu śāstrasya prāptimātre'pyaniścite | yujyate pratyavāyena śāstraṃ cakṣurapaśyatām || 79 ||
`bahulamanyatarasyāmekeṣām' ityādisāmānyalakṣaṇāt prāptimātre kasyacid vidherviṣayavibhāgenāniścite śiṣṭaprayogamananusṛtya svecchayaiva śabdān prayuñjāno- 'sādhuśabdaprayogādadharmeṇa sambadhyate | prayogamūlau hi dharmādharmau | tasmācchiṣṭa- prayogānusāreṇa lakṣaṇaṃ viṣayavibhāgenāvasthāpayitavyam | yadyevam, astu śiṣṭaprayoga eva, kimanarthakena śāstreṇetyāha--apaśyatāṃ śiṣṭaprayogaṃ sākṣādakurvatā śāstrameva cakṣuriva cakṣuḥ, śabdatattvanidarśananibandha-natvāt | evañca śāstreṇa lakṣitān śabdān jñātvā lakṣaṇanirapekṣameva sādhūn prayañjā- nān śiṣṭānanumimate | tebhyaśca sāmānyalakṣaṇe bhrāntimapanayantīti śāstramapi saphalam | tathā ca `lakṣyalakṣaṇe vyākaraṇam' ityaktam | `saiṣā śiṣṭaparijñānārthā- ṣṭādhyāyī' iti ca || 79 ||
yadi tarhi śāstraṃ cakṣuḥ, kimiti tat kvacid `na vāniṣṭādarśanāt'  iti pratyākhyāyata ityāśaṅkayāha-- arthāntarābhidhānācca paurvāparyaṃ na bhidyate | rājadantāhitāgnyādirājāśvādiṣu sarvathā || 80 ||
rājadantādau laukikaṃ yanniyataṃ paurvāparyam, tanna bhidyate nānyathā kadācidapi bhavatīti viprayogādarśanācchāstramatra pratyākhyāyate | prayogo viprayogaśca dvayaṃ yatraikasminnarthe dṛśyate, tatra śāstrārambho viprayokanivāraṇena saphalaḥ | iha tu `dantārājaḥ, aśvarājaḥ' iti prayogaviparyāse vivakṣitaviparīto'rtho gamyate, na tu ya eva rājadanta ityādau | samāne cārthe śāstrānvito'śāstrānvitasya nivartakaḥ | āhitāgnyādau tu prayogāniyame'pyarthābhedo dṛśyata iti pratyākhyānameva yuktam | kvacit tu pāṭhaḥ `paurvāparyamupedaśyatvena nāstītyarthaḥ || 80 ||
yadi tarhi viprayogādarśanācchāstramatra pratyākhyāyate, tadā `gargāḥ'ityādāvapi lukcchāstreṇa kiṃ kāryamityata āha-- vinaiva pratyayairvṛttau ye bhinnārthābhidhāyinaḥ | gargādayo lukā teṣāṃ sādhutvamanugamyate || 81 ||
śabdānāṃ svābhāvikamarthābhidhānamiti vṛttāvekārthībhāve gargā vatsā ityādayo- 'patyapratyayamantareṇa prakṛtyarthabhinnaṃ pratyayārthamapatyalakṣaṇamācakṣate | gārgya ityādi ca pratyayasahitaṃ tadabhidhānaṃ dṛṣṭam | `na kevalā prakṛtiḥ prayoktavyāṃ iti "paraśca"iti niyamenāveditam | ataḥ śāstraprakriyānusāreṇa kevalasya prakṛtirūpāsyāsādhutve prāpte luganvākhyānamupapadyate || 81 ||
na caivamapi so'yamityabhisaṃbandhādapatye gargādīnāṃ prayogaḥ sidhyati | tad yathā bhṛguścarati, aṅgirāścaratītyapatyavato'patye prayoga iti kiṃ luganvākhyāne- netyata āha-- so'yamityabhisaṃbandhāt pratyayena vinā yadi | babhrūvādayaḥ prayujyerannapatye niyamo bhavet || 82 ||
apatyāpatyavatsambandhapūrvaḥ (pūrvakāt) so'yamityabhedenopacārādapatyavatā'patya- mityucyate gargā iti | so'yamityabhedasaṃbandhaḥ kathyate | bahuvacanānupapattyā hi gargāpatyānyucyante, mūlaprakṛterekatvād bahuvacanānupapatteḥ | tatra cābhedasaṃbandhe bhedasaṃbandhasyāvivakṣitatvād apatyapratyayo nāstīti śakyate lugavaktum, kintu abhedasambandhasyopacaritasya niyatabheda(saṃbandha)pūrvakatvābhāvādantevāsino'pi gargasya samāropitagargarūpā bahuvacanena pratyāyyanta ityapi śakyate vaktumiti niyamenāpatyā- dīnāmabhidhānaṃ na pratīyate | tasmādapatye niyamārthamapatyapratyayasya lugucyate | svabhāvādeva tu pratyayarahitā prakṛtistadarthaṃ brūte | anyatra pratyayalakṣaṇārthaṃ luk, iha tvarthaniyamārtham || 82 ||
`praṣṭhesyeyam'itīdamarthapratyayasya tarhi lugārambhaṇīyoḥ, anyathā niyamena bhāryā na pratīyatetyāśaṅkayāha-- so'yamityabhisaṃbandhe liṅgopavyañjanādṛte | praṣṭhādiṣu na jāyaiva niyamena pratīyate || 83 ||
satyamatrāpi yatnaṃ vinā bhāryāyāmabhedoracārānniyamo na syāt | asti hyatrāpi yatnaḥ, "puṃyogādākhyāyām"  iti strīpratyayo liṅgopavyañjano yataḥ | ākhyāgrahaṇāddhi yādṛśaḥ puṃsi dṛṣṭaprayogaḥ śabdaḥ, tādrūpādeva strīpratyayo'n-vākhyāyata iti taddhitāntasyākhyārūpatvābhāvāt tadanutpattāvanumitāyāṃ satyapyabheda- saṃbandhe strīpratyayasahāyāt praṣṭhādiśabdād bhāryāvagatiḥ | nanu rbhāganyādāvapi kathaṃ na saṃpratyayaḥ ? maivam, prasthānakartṛtvāsaṅgāddhi striyāmapi prasthāne saṃvidhānaṃ saṃpādayantyāṃ puṃśabdaḥ pravartate | saṃvidhātṛtvaṃ cabhāryāyā evopapadyate, nānyasyāḥ || 83 ||
`prastho rvīhiḥ' ityādau tarhi prasthena pramita iti niyamapratipattyarthaṃ pratyasya luganvākhyeya ityāśaṅkayāha-- mānameyābhisaṃbandhaviśeṣe'ṅgīkṛte tathā | prasthādīnāmasādhutvaṃ taddhitena vinā bhavet || 84 ||
taddhito yogabhedena vākyaṃ vā syād vibhāṣitam | parimāṇādhike tatra prathamā śiṣyate punaḥ || 85 ||
atrāpyadhyāropeṇābhedasaṃbandhe mānameyayogo niyamena na pratīyate, samīpyāderapi saṃbhavāditi "tadasya parimāṇam" iti yogavibhāgena taddhitaḥ syāt | vākyaṃ vā mahāvibhāṣayā, prasthaḥ parimāṇame vā rvīhīṇāmiti | yatnāntaraṃ parimāṇādhike prātipadikārthe prathamālakṣaṇamārabdham | nimittinaḥ prasthapramitasya rvīhyādergauṇasyābhidhāne prātipadikārthagrahaṇādeva so'yamiti saṃbandhe siddhā prathamā | prasthaḥ parimāṇameṣāṃ rvīhīṇāmiti (prastho rvīhīriti) | parimāṇātirikte prameye bhūyaḥ parimāṇagrahaṇenopadiśyate | tena prathamāntāt parimāṇaśabdānmukhyata eva prameyaṃ pratīyate | taddhito'pi vibhāṣito vacanasāmarthyānna bādhyate `prāsthikaḥ' iti | vākyamapi bhavati || 84,85 ||
nanu ca parimāṇavāci prātipadikaṃ kathaṃ parimiye vartata ityāha-- vyatiriktasya sādhutve tadeva ca nidarśanam | yujyate'ṅgīkṛtādhikyaṃ tat sarvābhirvibhaktibhiḥ || 86 ||
tadeva parimāṇāt punaḥ prathamāvidhānaṃ jñāpakaṃ mānameyasaṃbandhopahitavyati- rekārthābhidhāne| prasthādeḥ svābhāvikaṃ hyarthābhidhānaṃ jñāpyate | tathā ca taddhiteneva bhinnaṃ prameyaṃ prathamayābhidhīyate | tatra cāntaraṅge mānameyasaṃbandhe caritārthā prathamā bāhyākriyāvibhāvite karmādike bhede ādhikye'pekṣite saṃbandhe vibhak‌tyantarai- rdvidīyādibhirbādhyate | ato bāhyakriyāvibhāvitakarmādiśaktibhedalakṣaṇaṃ prātipadikārthādhikyamaṅgīkṛtaṃ svīkṛtaṃ yena tat parimeyavāci padaṃ yathāyathaṃ sakalābhirdvitīyādivibhaktibhiryujyate saṃbadhyate | `prasthaṃ pacati, prasthena krītam' ityādi | evamabhedopacārādabhidhāne'pi niyamārthaṃ lugādiyatnārambhaḥ || 86 ||
guṇaguṇinostu svabhāvādeva niyato yoga iti kimarthaṃ guṇavacanebhyo matupo luganvākhyānamityāha-- śuklādiṣu matublopo vyatirekasya darśanāt | asādhutvanivṛttyarthaṃ sādhavaste bidādivat || 87 ||
`paṭasya śuklaḥ' iti vyatireko dṛṣṭaḥ | tathā ca `śuklaḥ paṭaḥ' ityavyātireke matup syāditi kevalāyāḥ prakṛterasādhutvaśaṅkā syāditi vyatirekanibandhanasyotpanna-sya matuppratyayasya yuktaṃ luganvākhyānam | tathā `hyavyatirekāt siddhamityuk- tvā'`dṛṣṭo vyatirekaḥ'iti punarlugeva samarthitaḥ | luganvākhyānadvāreṇa ca `bidāḥ, gargāḥ'ityādiśabdavadguṇini saṃbandhād vṛttirākhyāyate | yathā hi svārthaviśiṣṭāpatyārthābhidhānād `bidāḥ'ityādayaḥ prayogārhāḥ, tathā śuklādayo'pi, na tu so'yamityabhisaṃbandhādevetyarthaḥ || 87|| tadevaṃ samānādhikaraṇavṛtteḥ prastāvena viśeṣaṇāviśeṣyabhāvasamarthanapūrvakaṃ prasaktānu- prasaktāyātaṃ vicāraṃ parisamāpya prakṛtameva viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaṃ vṛttāvabhedapratīteranupa padyamānamāśaṅkayaikīyamatena tāvadupapādayitumāha-- viśeṣaṇād viśeṣye'rthe tadbhāvābhyuccaye sati | punaśca pratisaṃhāre vṛttimeke pracakṣate || 88 ||
ihaikayā prakhyayā dvayorviśeṣaṇaviśeṣyayorgrahaṇe parasparopakārāgrahaṇāt kiṃ bhūto viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaḥ syāt | na hi vastuto niyatajātīyaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ nāma kiñcidasti | na cāpyatra śābdī pratītirekā yujyate | abhidhānakramāddhayabhidheye kramikaiva pratītirnyāyyā | tataśca `nāgṛhītaviśeṣaṇā viśeṣye buddhiḥ' iti pūrvaṃ viśeṣaṇagrahaṇam, tato viśeṣaṇāddhetorava- cchedakatvena gṛhātād viśeṣye tadbhāvasya viśeṣaṇarūpasyābhyuccaye atireke sati punaḥ pratisaṃhāre'sannidhestadbhāvābhyuccayasyaivopekṣaṇe vṛttirekārthībhāvaḥ | viśeṣye hyatiśayamādhāya kṛtārthaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ na svarūpeṇa viśeṣamayamatirecayati, mā bhūd vyarthāvasāya iti | tathā ca viśiṣṭasyaivārthasya vṛttāvavadhāraṇamupapadyate || 88 ||
tadetanmataṃ dūṣayati-- nimitte pratyayaḥ pūrvo nānuprāpto nimittinā | nimittavati buddheśca na nimittasarūpatā || 89 ||
saṃskārasahitād jñānānnopaśleṣaḥ smṛterapi | vyāpāre tannimittānāṃ na grāhyaṃ syād tathāvidham || 90 ||
bhinnājñānālambanavāde dūṣaṇamidam | nimitte'vacchedakābhimate viśeṣaṇe prathamaḥ pratyayo nimittinā viśeṣyābhimatena nāsāditaḥ | na hi viśeṣaṇagrahaṇakāle viśeṣyagrahaṇamatra pakṣe, tasya tadānīmastamayāt | nimittavati ca viśeṣyābhimate yā buddhirjñānam, tatra nimittasya viśeṣaṇasyāpratibhāsanānna tadācchuritatvam | evaṃ ca vastusvarūpamātragrahaṇaṃ jñānaṃ kathaṃ tatra viśeṣaṇatāṃ viśeṣyatāṃ ca gṛhṇīyāt | viśeṣyāpekṣaṃ hi viśeṣaṇatvaṃ viśeṣaṇāpekṣaṃ ca viśeṣyatvamiti paraspara-jñāne parasparasvarūpānābhāsanādāpekṣikaṃ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyatvaṃ na gṛhītaṃ syāt | atha pūrvajñānāhitavāsanāsavyapekṣamuttaraṃ jñānamiti tasmāt krameṇa dvayoranu- bhave'pi paścāt saṃskārakrameṇāyatā smṛtistatrāvacchedyāvacchedakabhāvamāvedayata ityucyate, tadapi na; yasmād yathānubhavaṃ smṛtirupajāyata ityanubhavagṛhītārtharūpā- dhikyamupaśleṣaṃ parasparayojanamavacchedyāvacchedakatvena saṅghaṭanaṃ kathaṃ sāvakalpayet | evaṃ hyanubhūtārthaviṣayatvaṃ tasyā vighaṭetetyapramāṇaṃ syāt | atha yathā smṛtirbāhyaviṣayānusandhānāt tadviṣayā kathyate, tathā bāhyasya tadānīmabhāvādāntarasyānusandhātuḥ pramāturyā vicitrāḥ śaktayaḥ, tā api tasyā nimittamiti teṣāṃ tannimittānāṃ vyāpāre'trāvacchedyāvacchedakabhāvaṃ pratyupayogekathyamāne'nubhavagrāhyaṃ bāhyaṃ vastu viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyarūpaṃ na syāt | pramātṛśak- tyaivāsatyapi saṃśleṣe'rthānāṃ ghaṭanāditi na bhāviko viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaḥ samarthitaḥ || 89,90 ||
mā bhūd bhāvika iti cedāha-- antaḥkaraṇavṛttau ca vyarthā bāhyārthakalpanā | tasmādanupakāro vā grāhyaṃ vā na tathā sthitam || 91 ||
antaḥ karaṇaṃ kriyā, yasyāsāvanusandhātā pramātaivaṃ kathyate | sārvārthagrāhakaṃ vā mano'ntaḥkaraṇam, tasya vṛttau vyāpāre'tra viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvādiviṣaye'bhyupagamya- māne sarvatrāntaḥ karaṇasyaivābhāso bahīrūpatayādhyasto bhavatyarthaḥ, tāvataiva laukayātrā- siddheriti kimanupapadyamānena bāhyena kalpitena prayojanamiti bāhyārthavādinaṃ pratīda- mucyate | tasya hi viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvādisambandho vastusamavāyyabhimataḥ | tathā ca kalpanānāmanubhavamūlatvamiti tadanubhavāyāto'yaṃ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyavikalpaḥ | tatra ca yathāsvaṃ viṣayopakṣayatvāt pratyayasya taṭa sthasyārthasya viśeṣyāvacchedakatva- lakṣaṇo nāstyupakāraḥ | anusandhātṛpamātṛvaśena tu mānase vikalpe'bhyupagate grāhyasyatadrūpaśūnyatvamityuktārthanigamanam || 91 ||
evaṃ paramate bhinnajñānāvalambanapakṣe'nupapattimudbhāvya svamatenaikajñānāvalambanavā- dena vāstavaṃ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvamavasthāpayitumāha-- anusyūteva saṃsṛṣṭerarthe buddhiḥ pravartate | vyākhyātāro vibhajyātha tāṃ bhedena pracakṣate || 92 ||
tadātmanyavibhakte ca bud‌dhyantaramupāśritāḥ | vibhāgamiva manyante viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyayoḥ || 93 ||
iha yathāvastu pratyayāḥ prabhavanti | vastu jātiguṇopādhiviśiṣṭamabhinnamityabhinna eva pratyayaḥ | samavāyatirohitabhedā hi jātyādayo vastūnāmanurūpakāḥ | tatra samavāyinaḥ śvaityāt śvaitye buddhe śvete buddhiḥ | te kāryakāraṇabhūte iti pāramā-rthikapadārthabhedāvalambane, anaucityāt kramasyocyete | pratibhāsavelāyāṃ tu kramo nāsti, viśiṣṭasyaiva vastuno jhaṭityekaprakhyopārohāt | ata eva kecid jātyādīn saṃsargiṇo'panhu vate | evañca bhedāvabhāsapūrvakasya saṃsargasyābhāvādanusyūteveyaṃ buddhirjātyādibhiḥ saṃsargibhiḥ kathyate | paramārthato bhedapūrvakasya saṃsargasyārthānāmabhāvāt vastusthityātvevamucyate | evamabhinnabuddhipratibhāsinornīlotpalādau guṇadravyayorbhedapūrvakasyāvacchedyā- cchedakabhāvasyābhāvaḥ, kintu niraṃśasya vastunaḥ parebhyaḥ pratipādayituśakyatvāt pratipādanakāle pratipādakāstān saṃsṛṣṭān jātyādīnarthānapoddhārabud‌dhyā pṛthak- kṛtyāyaṃ guṇo jātirvā viśeṣaṇam, idaṃ dravyaṃ viśeṣyamiti bud‌dhyantaravibhāgena pūrvapratipāditarītyā pratipādayanti | tathaiva ca pratipadyante pratipattāraḥ | evañca vastubījamanusṛtya pratipādanād bāhye'sti sadbhāvo viśeṣaṇaviśeṣya- tvasya| tadeva hi bāhyaṃ saṃsṛṣṭaṃ vyākhyānāya vibhajyate | tatra cāsti guṇādirviśeṣaṇaṃ dravyoparañjakam, jātyādirahitasya dravyasyāyogācca tadavacchedyam,sambandhaśca samavāya iti sarvaṃ vāstavam | tathā ca vibhāgakalpanopāyena tadātmā'vibhakta evārthaḥ pratipādito bhavati | tayaiva ca vibhāgabuddhayāhitaviśeṣaṇaviśeṣyarūpatayā pratipadyante vyavahartāraḥ | yadyapi vibhāgāvasthā vākyadaśā, tathāpi vākyāvasthāgatajñānavāsanayā vṛttāvapi viśeṣamaviśeṣyapratītirastyeva | paramārthastu vṛttau niraṃśa evārtha iti sāpi niraṃśā vācikā siddhā | tadevaṃ dharmabhedena vṛttivākyayoratyantabhedaḥ pratipāditaḥ || 92-93 ||
matāntaramapyupakṣiptaṃ bhāṣye--`atha ye vṛttiṃ vartayanti, kiṃ ta āhuḥ ? parārthābhādhānaṃ vṛttiriti' | tad vyācaṣṭe-- abudhān prati vṛttiṃ ca vartayantaḥ prakalpitām | āhuḥ parārthavacane tyāgābhyuccayadharmatām || 94 ||
nirvibhāgaṃ vṛttipadārtharūpamavagantumaśaktāḥ pratipattāro'budhāḥ | te hi yathāśru-tagrāhiṇo yathāvadvacanaṃ vācanikaṃ manyante | tataśca tān prati vākyopamardena prakriyāyāṃ vṛttirvyutpādyamānā vākyaprakṛtikaivāvatiṣṭhate | tataśca vākyamapi nityaṃ svaviṣaya iti tasyānnucchedyatvāt tatprakṛtitvena samāropitā kalpitā vṛttirnirvartyate | tatra kāraṇāt kāryamadhikārthakriyākāri dṛṣṭaṃ paṭādi | evamihāpi vṛttilakṣaṇasya kāryasya vākyagatapadārthādhikyaṃ nyāyyamiti parārthā- bhidhānaṃ vṛttilakṣaṇamārabhyate | parasyānyasya pradhānasya padasya yo'rthaḥ, tasyopa- sarjanapadena pratyāyanam, tatra, "ekamāhuranekārthaṃ śabdamanye parīkṣakāḥ |" iti naye vākyāvasthāyāmupasarjanapadasya parārthābhidhānaśaktipratighātāpekṣayā vṛttau parārthābhidhānamucyate | anekārthapratyāyanasāmarthyāddhi svārtha eva sa tasya tatra bhavati pararthaḥ | yadā `anyāyaścānekārthatvam' iti nayastadā vṛttāvanyadevopasarjanapadamitya- rthāntaramupādatte | evaṃ parārthavacane sati dvaitaṃ bhavati | vākyāvasthāgatamarthaṃ parityajyopasarjanaṃ vṛttau parārthamabhidadhāti | tadyathā kalaśe dadhi sthitamapanīya kṣīraṃ nidhīyate, nāvasthita eva dadhani nidhātuṃ śakyate tat | seyaṃ jahatsvārthā vṛttiḥ | apauruṣeye śabdārthasambandhe kathaṃ tyāga iti cet, na; anupādāna evātra tyāgopacā- rāt | yathā hyagnisaṃyogaḥ pākajān viśeṣaṇānutpādya paramāṇuṣu nivartate, tathopasarja- nārthaḥ pradhāne viśeṣamādhāya tāvanmātraprayojanatvānnivartate | atra nidarśanaṃ bhāṣyebhāhitam | tadā yathā--`takṣā rājakarmaṇi pravartamānaḥ svaṃ karma jahāti' iti | kośasamāharaṇasannidhānādau rājakarmaṇi vyāpriyamāṇastakṣā svaṃ dārucchedacatura- strīkaraṇādivyāpāraṃ jahāti, svavyāpārāparityāge rājakarmaṇo'nuṣṭhātumaśakyatvāt|evaṃ svārthānupādānena padāntarārthopādānamupasarjanānāṃ vṛttau nyāyyamanena nidarśanena | anye tu manyante--avasthita eva prācye'rthe'rthāntarābhyuccayo'sāvupasarjana-padānāmādhikyam (arthādhikyam) tathā hi--sikatākalaśe jalaṃ nihitamavatiṣṭhate | lakṣādihetujanitaśca rāgāti- śayastantūnāṃ kārye'pyanuvartate | evamupasarjanapadasya svārtho''rthāntaropādāne- 'pi | yuktaṃ caitat, dṛṣṭasyārthasya svarūpavacchabdaistyāgāyogāt | atrāpi nidarśanaṃ bhāṣye'bhihitam--`bhikṣuko dvitīyāṃ bhikṣāmāsādya pūrvāṃ na jahāti, sañcayāyaiva yatate'iti | tadiyamajahatsvārthā vṛttiḥ | evañca rājārthena puruṣārthasya viśeṣaṇād viśiṣṭārthasaṃpratyayaḥ | yadyevaṃ rājārthasyāpi sambhavād vṛttau `rājapuruṣaḥ' ityatra dvivacanaṃ prāpnotidhavakhadirādivat | naivadasti, dvandve samaprādhānyād dvayorudbhūtāvayavabhedatvāt samudāyasya yuktaṃ dvivacanam | iha tu viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvāvacchinnamarthāntaramevānabhidheyamavayavaiḥ samudāyeno- pādīyate | yathā bahurvīhau `lohitavasanaścitraguḥ' ityādi | tataścāvayavārthāhita- bhedasya parārthasya samudāyenābhidhīyamānatvāt tataḥ parā vibhaktiḥ samudāyārthaniveśinīṃ saṃkhyāmupādatte | tathā cārthavattve samudāyasyānekavacanasya parihāra uktaḥ--`saṅghātasyaikārthyā- nnāvayavasaṃkhyātaḥ subutpattiḥ' iti | tadevaṃ tyāgaścābhyuccayaśca yo dharmaḥ svabhāvo'syā vṛtteḥ tadbhāvastattā, tāmāhuḥ parārthābhidhānalakṣaṇāyāṃ tasyām || 94 ||
tatra jahatsvārthāyāṃ vṛttau coditam--`rājapuruṣamānāya' ityukte puruṣamātras- yānayanaṃ prāpnoti,`aupagavamānayetyukte'patyāmātram' iti | nanu copasarjanapadānāmarthatyāge prayogaḥ kimarthaṃ iti kathaṃ na codyate ? nāsteyetat, `yāvo yāvakaḥ' itivat paryāyarūpeṇa `rājapuruṣaḥ'iti prayogopapatteḥ | tathaikārthībhāva- lakṣaṇasāmarthyanibandhanā samāsasaṃjñāpi yathā syāditi | aviśeṣe tu samādhiruktāḥ--`jahadapyasau svārthaṃ nātyantāya jahāti | athavānvayād viśeṣaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati' iti | etad vivṛṇoti-- anvayād gamyate so'rtho virodhī vā nivartate | dvayarthamarthāntare vāpi tatrāhurupasarjanam || 95 ||
uktametadagnisaṃyogāhitā viśeṣāḥ paramāṇūnāṃ nivṛtte'pyagnisaṃyoge'nuvartanta iti | evamupasarjanapadārthaḥ pradhānārthaṃ viśeṣya nivartata iti tadāhitaviśeṣānugamād viśiṣṭaḥ puruṣaḥ pratīyate, na puruṣamātram | atra bhāṣye mallikāpuṭo dṛṣṭānto'bhihitaḥ | kusumasaṃsargopahitagandhaviśeṣānu- vṛtterapanītakusumo'pi puṭastad‌vyapadeśyaḥ | evamarthasya tyāge kathaṃ nātyantāya jahātītyucyute--tadapyaṃśenārtho nivartate'- śenāvatiṣṭhata ityāśaṅkaya pakṣāntaramāha--virodhī vā nivartata iti | pradhānārthavacchedapratidvandvī svabhāvo'paityupa sarjanārthasya | kaśca tasya pratidvandvī, yaḥ pradhānabhūtaḥ ? anayorhi prādhānye parasparasambandhābhāvād viśiṣ-ṭo'vacchinnaḥ pradhānārtho na pratīyetīti svaprādhānyamupasarjanārthasya nivartate | ata eva svaviśeṣaṇena samṛddhādinā na yujyate | pradhānopakārāya tu yadrūpaṃ viśeṣaṇatātmakam, tannāpaityavirodhāditi nātyantāya jahātītyuktiḥ | sarvathā hi svārthaparityāge svapadārthena pradhānopakārābhāvādupasarjanapadaṃ svarūpameva jahyāt | paropakāraprabhāvitaṃ hyu pasarjanatvam | asati ca paropakāre prayogavaiyarthyam | uttarapadādeva pradhānārthapratīteḥ | anarthakasya cāpareṇa sambandhābhāvāt sāmarthyanibandhanā samāsasaṃjñā na syāditi na sakalārthaparityāgaḥ | takṣāpi hikkitahasitādīni prāṇitvāvyabhicārīṇi rāja- karmamyanuguṇāni na jahāti | svaprādhānyameva svasya hīyata iti jahatsvārthā vṛttiḥ | ajahatsvārthāyāṃ tu vṛttau sarvathaiva sannupasarjanapadārthaḥ | svaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭaṃ pradhā-nārthaṃ hi tatropasarjanapadamabhidadhātīti dvayarthamucyate | pradhāne ca pāṃsūdakavadabhedāpatte-rvivekābhāvāt svaviśeṣeṇena na yujyate guṇapadārthaḥ | viṣayabhedena ca śabdānāmarthavaici- tryād vṛttau guṇapradhānabhūtārthadvayābhidhānamupasarjanapadānāṃ yuktam | dvivacanaṃ tu nabhavatīti pūrvamevoktam | kecittu jahatsvārthāyāṃ vṛttāvupasarjanapadasya sarvathaivārthatyāgaṃ pradhānārthavṛ-ttitvaṃ ca manyante | varṇavadanarthakaṃ hyapasarjanapadaṃ vṛttipadasyāvayavabhūtam | paryāyaścāyaṃ puruṣa śabdasya rājapuruṣaśabdaḥ | atra puruṣaviśeṣapratipattirna syāditi codyam || 95 ||
yadi tarhi vākya iva vṛttāvapi viśiṣṭārthapratīternātyantāya hānam, tadā jahatsvārthatvaṃ vāṅmātreṇa syādityāśaṅkayāha-- upāyamātraṃ nānātvaṃ samūhastveka eva saḥ | vikalpābhyuccayābhyāṃ vā bhedasaṃsargakalpanā || 96 ||
vākye vicchedopakramārthābhidhānam, vṛttau tu viśiṣṭo'rtho bhedena pratīyata iti niraṃśameva paramārthato vṛttipadam | upāyamātraṃ tu vākyagatapadārthabhedena vyutpādanamitiprādhānyasya tyāgājjahtsvārthatābhaṇitiḥ | ato'nantaraṃ bhāṣye paṭhitam--`athavā vṛttau samarthādhikāraḥ kriyate, sāmarthyaṃ nāma bhedaḥ saṃsargo vā, bhedasaṃsargovā' iti | tad vyācaṣṭe--vikalpetyādinā | vākyaprakṛtitvaṃ vṛttipadasya manyamānā vākyagatabhedasaṃsargakalpanāmatra kurvanti | tathāhi--bhedo vākyārthaḥ saṃsargo veti vikalpaḥ | dvāvapītyabhyuccayaḥ samuccayaḥ |tatra puruṣaśabdasya bhṛtyavācitve svāminaḥ sāmānyenāvagatau rājaśabdaḥ svāmiviśeṣe- bhyo vyāvṛttiṃ pratipādayatīti bhedo vākyārthaḥ | anumīyamānaścātra saṃsargaḥ | yadā tu jātivācī puruṣaśabdaḥ, tadā rājaśabdād viśiṣṭenārthenaitadarthasya samanva- yo'vagamyata iti saṃsargo vākyārthaḥ | viśiṣṭatvācca saṃsargasyārthāntarād bhedo'-numīyamānaḥ | evaṃ guṇapradhānabhedena vikalpaḥ | ubhayasya vā śabdāt pratīteraviśeṣeṇobhayaṃ sāmarthyam | tadevaṃ viśiṣṭārthavṛtti vṛttipadamiti na puruṣamātrasyānayanamavayavāsyāna-rthakye'pi || 96 ||
ata eva copāyatvādvibhāgasya matabhedo'viriddho'navasthitatvād rucivaicitryeṇo- pāyānāmityāha-- vṛtta vartayatāmevamabudhapratipattaye | bhinnāḥ sambodhanopāyāḥ puruṣeṣvanavasthitāḥ || 97 ||
vṛttivākyayorabhedadarśināṃ prakṛtivikārabhāvena vyutpādayatāṃ vyutpādakānāṃ puru- ṣeṣu pratipattṛṣu sambodhanopāyāḥ vyutpādane hetavo rucivaicitryād bhinnāḥ vilakṣaṇāḥ | ye hi vṛttivākyayoḥ samānamarthamadhyavasyanti, taddarśanenājahatsvārthatvamucyate | ye tu svābhāvikamarthabhedamanayoḥ paśyanti, tadarśanena jahatsvārthatvamityasatyabhūtabheda- saṃsargāśrayeṇa vyavasthā bhidyate || 97 ||
tadevaṃ paramārthato'tyantabhedo vṛttivākyayoriti saṅkhayāviśeṣatirodhānādayo vṛttau viśeṣāḥ proktāḥ | tatra ca vibhak‌tyabhāvādeva saṅkhayāviśeṣatirodhānamiti codite `na śabdanimittakena nāmārthena bhavitavyamarthanimittakena nāmaśabdena bhavitavyam | tadetadevaṃ dṛśyatāmartharūpamevaitadevaṃjātīyakam' ityuktam | etad vyācaṣṭe-- vācikā dyotikā vāpi saṅkhayānāṃ yā vibhaktayaḥ | tadrūpe'vayave vṛttau saṅkhayābhedo nivartate || 98 ||
trike prātipadikārthe saṅkhayāyā vācikā vibhaktayaḥ, pañcake tu dyotikāḥ | tāśca rājñaḥ puruṣo, rājño, rājñāṃ puruṣa iti vākye dṛśyante svārthaprayuktāḥ | vṛttāpi rājapuruṣa ityatra vākyasadṛśa eva pūrvapadabhāgaḥ | tathāca tatrāpi saṅkhayāviśeṣaprayuktā vibhaktayaḥ śrūyeran | saci hyarthe tadvacanaḥ śabdaḥ prāpnoti, na tu śabdābhāve vācanike vṛttāvarthābhāvāvidhānaṃ yujyate | saṅkhayāśabdābhāvād vṛttau saṅkhayāviśeṣo nāstītyanumīyate | tathāhi--pradhānārthasambhedādupasarjanārthasya bhedābhāvānnivartate saṅkhayāviśeṣa iti tadabhāvāt svābhāvikyevānutpattirvibhaktīnāṃ pratyayalakṣaṇārthaṃ luganvākhyāyate | itthaṃ sādṛśyamātraṃ bhrāntaṃ vṛttivākyayorna tattvata aikyam, vākye saṅkhayā-bhedasadbhāvād vṛttau tadabhāvādityatra tātparyārthaḥ || 98 ||
evaṃ tāvadupasarjanārtho nivṛttasaṅkhayābheda ityekīyaṃ matam | anye tu manyante-- abhedaikatvasaṅkhayā vā tatrānyaivopajāyate | saṃsarga(rgi)rūpaṃ saṅkhayānāmavibhaktaṃ taducyate || 99 ||
vṛttāvupasarjapadārthānāṃ sattvabhūtatvādāvaśyakaḥ saṅkhayāyogaḥ | na hyavyayavanni- ssaṅkhaya evopasarjanārtho yuktaḥ, sattvamātrasyāsampratyayāt | na ca viśeṣo'vadhāryate | ataḥ sāmānyasaṅkhayārūpaṃ sarvasaṅkhayāviśeṣāṇāṃ saṃsarga(rgi)rūpaṃ kroḍīkārakaṃ vidyata ityanumīyate | dvitvādipratipakṣaṃ hyekatvaṃ dvitvādyapāvartanānna samastasaṅkhayābhedasvīkārasa-martham | idaṃ tvabhedaikatvaṃ sarvānuyāyi | atra hi sarve saṅkhayābhedāḥ saṃsargamavibhāgamanuprāptā vidyante | tathāca sati nimitte te tata āvirbhavanto dṛśyante prasekādiva śāṇādiviśeṣāḥ (prasekādiva gandhādiviśeṣāḥ) | ataśca śaurpika(pārpika)tāvakīnamāsajātādau bhavati viśeṣa- niścaya iti vakṣyate | avibhaktamekasvabhāvatvāt kiñcid bhavati, na tu saṃsṛṣṭam | saṃsarge'pi ca bhedaḥ syādityubhayamupāttaṃ saṃsarga(rgi)rūpamavibhaktaṃ ceti || 99 ||
etadeva nidarśaṃnena vyutpādayati-- yathauṣadhirasāḥ sarve madhunyāhitaśaktayaḥ | avibhāgena vartante tāṃ saṅkhayāṃ tādṛśīṃ viduḥ || 100 ||
madhuni mākṣike bahupuṣparasāḥ pratyarpitasvarūpāstatkāryatvāditi nānājātīyau- ṣadhirasasambhedena madhurasasampādane vicitrāste rasā vivekena na lakṣyante | atha ca kāraṇabhūtauṣadhirasānuguṇyena madhuno rasavīryavipākā avadhāryamāṇā yathāsvaṃ kāryadarśanānumīyamānasāmarthyāḥ sannihitāsta ityavasīyante | tathaiva yathānimittaṃ saṅkhayābhedāvasāyādupasarjanapadārthe sarvasaṅkhayāviśeṣāṇāmavibhāgenāvasthānādabhedaikatva- saṅkhayāpi tathābhūtaiva boddhavyā | saṅkhayābhedānāṃ hi tato'poddhārāt saṅkhayeti kathyate, na tu tayā yat kiñcid gaṇyate dvitvādikayeva | saṅkhayāsaṃsargasya ca saṃsṛṣṭa- vivekena rūpānavadhāraṇāt saṅkhayā viśeṣasāmānyarūpeyam || 100 ||
prakārāntaramatraivāha-- bhedānāṃ vā parityāgāt saṅkhayātmā sa tathāvidhaḥ vyāpārājjatibhāgasya bhedāpohena vartate || 101 ||
parityaktabhedā tān bhedān vyāvartayantī saṃkhayāvyapadeśamiyamapyāsādayati | tathā ca tathāvidho'bhedaikatvasvabhāvo'sau saṃkhayātmā vyaktibhedatirodhānena jātirūpāśrayeṇa vartate | bhedāpohalakṣaṇaṃ hi sarvasaṃkhayānāṃ jātirūmamanugatam | pūrvatra samastabheda- saṃsargamātraṃ samastabhedātmakamabhedaikatvamuktam | idānīṃ tu samastabhedānugatarūpamanyāpoharūpamiti viśeṣaḥ | yathā hyekatvaṃ dvitvādyapāvartayati, dvitvaṃ ca tritvādi, evamidamabhedaikatvaṃ sarvamekatvādyapāva- rtayatītyasti saṃkhayātvam | sati ca nibandhane dvitvaikatvādi pratīyata iti sāmānyātmakatābhyupagatā'tra || 101 ||
nanu cābhinnapratyayāvedyaṃ sāmānyaṃ gotvādi | atra cābhedaikatvasya na kiñcit kāryam | bhedā eva hi śāstrakāryayogina iti kiṃ tatsadbhāve liṅgamityāśaṅkayāha-- agṛhītaviśeṣeṇa yathā rūpeṇa rūpavān | prakhyāyate na śuklādibhedarūpastu(rūpantu) gṛhyate || 102 ||
bhedarūpasamāveśe tathā satyavivakṣite | bhāgaḥ prakāśitaḥ kaścicchāstre'ṅgatvena gṛhyate || 103 ||
guṇairavinābhāvād dravyamapratītanīlādiguṇārūpamapi sāmānyena rūpavaditi pratīyate yathā dūrāt, tathā sam̐khayāviśeṣasamavāye pratipādyatvenāniṣṭe saṃkhayāvānitye- tāvatāvagate sattvabhūtatvādupasarjanārthe yoṃ'śastatsaṃsṛṣṭo nimittaviśeṣāt tavakā- dyādeśalakṣaṇādāvirbhūtaḥ sa tāvakīnādiśabdānvākhyānāya śāstre nimittatayopādīyate | tathāca saṃkhayāvattvasampratyaya evātropasarjanārthasyābhedaikatvasaṃkhayākāryam ||102,103|| yadi tarhi sarvasaṃkhayāsaṃsargarūpamabhedaikatvaṃ na tadravyātiriktaṃ tadopasarjanapadairviśe-ṣātmakameva kathaṃ na pratipadyata ityāha-- saṅkhayāsāmānyarūpeṇa tadā soṃ'śaḥ pratīyate | arthasyānekaśaktitve śabdairniyataśaktibhiḥ || 104 ||
soṃ'śaḥ pūrvapadārthabhāga upasarjanārthaḥ sattvarūpatvādanekasaṃkhyāsamāhārayoga- yogyo'pi saṃkhyāvānityevamabhedenaivopasarjanapadena pratipādyate | na tu viśeṣarūpaprati-pādane tasya śaktirasti | vākyavad vṛttau anekaśaktirapi hyartho na śabdaiḥ sākalyena spṛśyate, niyataviṣayatvācchabdaśaktīnāmityarthaḥ || 104 ||
nanu ca yadyupasarjanārthe saṃkhyāyā abhedaḥ, kathaṃ bhedānugamaḥ, atha bhedaḥ, katha- mabhedātmakatvamityāśaṅkayāha-- avyayānāṃ ca yo dharmo yaśca bhedavatāṃ kramaḥ | abhinnavyapadeśārhamantarālaṃ tadetayoḥ || 105 ||
aliṅgāsaṃkhyamavyayamityasaṃkhyatvamavyayānāṃ svabhāvaḥ | etādṛśī hi śabdaśakti- ryadavyayāni sattvasvabhāvādativṛttamataśca nissaṃkhyamarthamāhuḥ | bhedavanto vibhaktivi- śeṣāvacchinnāḥ śabdāḥ, teṣāmekatvādisaṃkhyāviśeṣāvacchinnārthapratyāyanaṃ svabhāva iti tadartho viśiṣṭasaṃkhyāyuktaḥ, tadetāmubhayīmavasthāmatītyopasarjanapadānāmarthā 3?painte | tadevaṃ vṛttāvabhedaikatvasaṃkhyāvagame viśeṣo vākyādityatyantabhedaḥ || 105 ||
atra vārttikakārīyaṃ saṃvādakamāha-- alukaścaikavadbhāvastasmin sati na śiṣyate | sa ca goṣucarādīnāṃ dharmo'sti vacanāntare || 106 ||
iha `stokābhyāṃ muktaḥ, stokebhyomuktaḥ' ityāpi vākye `stokānmuktaḥ' ityeveṣyate vṛttiḥ | tathā ca "ekavadbhāvo vaktavyaḥ"iti codite parihṛtaṃ vākya- kāreṇa--"ekavadvacanamanarthakam" , "dvibahuṣvasamāsaḥ"  iti | tadetat kathamupapadyate ? yadi vṛttāvabhedaikatvasaṃkhyāprādurbhāvād dvitvabahutvāvagatyabhāvaḥ | tathā ca tasminnabhedaikatve sati dvivacanahuvacanayorabhāvāt samāsābhāva iti dvitvādyapakrame'- pyekavacanāntānāmeva samāsa iti nārtha ekavadbhāvānuśāsanena | "ekavacanaṃ tatsargataḥ kariṣyate" iti bhavati | abhedaikatve'pi vā tadavirodhaḥ, sāmānyenaikatve vidhānāt | kathaṃ tarhi goṣucaro varṣāsujo'psuyoniriti bahuvacanāntānāṃ samāsa iti cet, aha sa ceti | so'bhedaikatvākhyo dharmo vacanāntare ekavacanādanyasmin bahuvacane'pyatrāsti | atra hi nedaṃ vyaktibahutve bahuvacanam, api tu `jātyākhyāyāmekasmin bahuvacanam |  iti | tathācaikasyāpi yo gavi carati prāṇī, so'pi goṣucara indragopo'bhidhīyate | eko'pi cāpparamāṇurapchabdena bahuvacanāntenābhidhīyate | varṣārātro'pi cābhinno varṣāśabdena bahuvacanāntena śabdaśaktisvābhāvyādityatrābhedaikatvasaṃkhyā vacanabhedaprati-bandhaṃ na karoti | tathāpyabhedaikatvasyaiva pratīterityarthaḥ || 106 ||
dvivacanaṃ tu nānvākhyātaṃ jātāviti tat sarvathā vṛttiṣu saṃkhyābhedatirodhānānna bhavatītyāha-- jātau dvivacanābhāvāt tad vṛttiṣu na vidyate | pratyākhyāne tu yogasya dravye goṣucarādayaḥ || 107 ||
tad dvivacanaṃ jātāvanupadeśād vyaktigatabhedatirodhānācca vṛttiṣu nāsti, bahuvacanaṃ tu "jātyākhyāyām" ityupadeśādasti | tathāca vṛttāvekavacanabahuvacanayorbhāve'pi dvivatanābhāvo'bhedaikatvaphalamavatiṣṭhate | yadā tu jāterāśrayopādhika eva bahutve bahuvacanopapatteḥ "jātyākhyāyām" iti sūtraṃ pratyākhyāyāte, tadā goṣucara ityatra godravyagatabhedāśrayameva bahuvacanaṃ vṛttā-vapi | anavayavena hi vyaktīḥ parāmṛśati goṣucaraśabdaḥ | `apsuyoniḥ, varṣāsujaḥ' ityatrāpyavayavapracayād dharmabahutvād vā vyakterekatve'pi bahuvacanam | śabdaśakti-svābhāvyāddhi kiñcid bahucanamavayavabahutvamāha kiñcid dravyagadharmabahutvam ||107|| tadetadanipapannamityāha-- āśrayād bhedavattāyāḥ sarvabhedasamanvayaḥ | dravyābhidhānapakṣo'pi jātyākhyāyāṃ na vidyate || 108 ||
sarvadravyagatiścaivamekaśeṣaśca nocyate | pratyākhyāte'nyathā sūtre bhinnadravyagatirbhavet || 109 ||
dravyabahutvāśrayeṇa goṣucarādau bahuvacane'ṅgīkriyamāṇe vṛttau saṃkhyāviśeṣayogaḥ sphuṭo'bhyupagataḥ syāt | tathā ca bhedavattāyā āśrayaṇāt sarvairekatvadvitvabahutvairapi sambandhaḥ prāpta iti kāsāvabhedaikatvasaṃkhyā ? ekasyāṃ dvayorvāpi carataśca bhavatyabhidhānaṃ goṣucara iti | tathā ca nedaṃ vyaktibhedāyattaṃ bahuvacanam, api tu jātyākhyāyāmeveti tatra dravyābhidhānapakṣasyābhāvāt kathaṃ dravyabhedāśrayamidaṃ bahuvacanaṃ varṇyate | evam `apsuyoniḥ' ityādāvapi vācyam | tasmājjātyākhyāyāmevedaṃ bahuvacanaṃ nyāyyam | na ca dravyavivakṣaśrayeṇa yogasya pratyākhyānamucitam | evaṃ hyekaśeṣa ārambhaṇīyaḥ syāt , pratyarthaṃ śabdaniveśānnaikenānekārthābhidhānamiti kṛtvā | jātyābhidhāne tutatraiva bahuvacane sarvadravyagatirbahuvacanāntādekasmādapi śabdād bhavatīti pratyākhyā- tamekaśeṣasūtram, "ākṛtyabhidhānād vaikaṃ vibhaktau vājapyāyanaḥ"  iti | "jātkhyāyāyām"iti sūtraṃ samarthitamevam,"jātyākhyāyāṃ sāmānyābhidhānādaikārthyam" iti | nanu ca ko'tiśayo jātyākhyāyāmityasya. yenaitadārambhaḥ samarthyata ityāha-- pratyākhyāta ityādi | "jātyākhyāyām" ityasmin yoge'nārabhyamāṇe jātiparāyāṃ codanāyāṃ bahuvacanābhāvād goṣucara ityādau dravyabahutve bahuvacanamiti vyaktibahutvapra-tītirbhavetama | na caivamiṣyate, ekasyāṃ gavi dvayorvāpi gavoścarati goṣucara ityabhi- dhānasya goṣucare kukkuṭākhye pakṣiviśeṣe rūḍhirityarthaḥ | tasmājjātyākhyāyāmevaitadupapadyata iti satyapyabhedaikatve tatraivedaṃ vācanikaṃ bahuvacanaṃ vijñeyam || 108,109 ||
idānīmabhedaikatvasaṃkhyāyāḥ sarvasaṃkhyāviśeṣātmakatvād bhedena vṛttau svarūpopa darśanamityetadabhidhātuṃ codyapūrvakamupakramate-- vṛttau yo yuktavadbhāvo varaṇādiṣu śiṣyate | abhedaikatvasaṅkhayāyāṃ godau tatra na sidhyati || 110 ||
"lupi yuktavad vyaktivacane" ityatra pakṣadvayaṃ sambhāvyate | tathāhi yadā vyaktivacane liṅgasaṃkhye kathyete, tadā lubantalakṣaṇāyāṃ taddhitavṛttau vibhaktini-vṛttāvapyarthanivṛtterabhāvād vṛttasya ye vyaktivacane tayoratideśa ityayaṃ pakṣaḥ | yadā punarvyaktidyotanaḥ śabdo vyaktiḥ, vacanamapyekadeśalopādekavacanādi vivakṣitam, tadā tasya vṛttāvadarśanād prāgvṛttervyapekṣāvasthāyāṃ ye vyakti-vacane tayorlubarthe'yamatideśa ityayaṃ pakṣaḥ | tatra pūrvasmin pakṣe godayoradūrabhāvo grāmo godaugrāma iti na sidhyati | yasmād vṛttāvupasarjanasyābhedaikatvasaṃkhyā prādurbhāvatītyuktam | tadgatasyaiva ca saṃkhyāla- kṣaṇasyārthasyātideśa iti dvitvasyātrātideśābhāvād dvivacanaṃ na syāt | bahuvacanaṃtu pañcālā ityādau jātyāśrayaṃ sidhyati || 110 ||
atha dvitīyaḥ pakṣaḥ, tatrātyāha-- prāgvṛtteryuktavadbhāve ṣaṣṭhī bhedāśrayā bhavet | vṛttau saṅkhayāviśeṣāṇāṃ tyāgād bhedo nivartate || 111 ||
godayoradūrabhāvo grāma ityatra vākye dṛṣṭā vyatiresanibandhanā ṣaṣṭhīti sā vṛttāvapi syāt, atideśāt | bhedasyābhedaikatve'pi godāvityatra `ṣaṣṭhayapi hi vacanam'  ityuktaṃ bhāṣye | atra parihāraḥ pakṣāntarāśrayeṇoktaḥ `vṛttasya ye liṅgasaṃkhye te atidiśyete'  iti | tad vyācaṣṭe--vṛttau saṃkhyetyādinā | yuktasya pratyayārthena sambaddhasya prakṛtyarthasyopasarjanasya saṃkhyābhedānāṃ hānād vṛttāvayaṃ vibhāgo nāstītyabhedaikatvasaṃkhyāmātrāśrayaṃ kāryamatidiśyate, na ṣaṣṭhī vyatireka- nibandhanetyarthaḥ | etadanantaraṃ kvacid bhāṣyamasti `prāgapi vṛtterye liṅgasaṃkhye, te atidiśyete|ṣaṣṭhī na bhavati sāmānyātideśe viśeṣānatideśāt' iti | iha prakṛtyarthasambandhi yadekavacanatvādi sāmānyānugataṃ vacanam, tadatidiśyate lubarthe saṃkhyāntarayoginyaprāptam‌ | tacca yadyapi viśeṣadvāreṇaiva pravartaṃte, tathāpyavyabhācārā ekavacanādayo viśeṣā atideśāt prāpnuvanti, na tu ṣaṣṭhī | sā vyatirekanibandhanetyasati tasminna bhavantī vyabhicāriṇī vacanasāmānyasya | yathā vasiṣṭhādayo brāhmaṇasya || 111 ||
evañcātra `vṛttasya ye liṅgasaṅkhaye, te atidiśyete' ityasmin pakṣe'bhedaika- tvasaṅkhayāyāṃ godau na sidhyatītīdameva codyamavaśiṣyate | tat samādhātuṃ pūrvoktamevābhedaikatvasaṅkhayālakṣaṇaṃ tāvadanuvadati -- vidyamānasu saṅkhayāsu kecit saṅkhayāntaraṃ viduḥ | abhedākhyamupagrāhi vṛttau taccopajāyate || 112 ||
keciditi | ye sarvasaṅkhayānāṃ saṃsargarūpamabhedaikatvaṃ manyante | atra hi darśane'- bhedaikatvaṃ sarvasaṅkhayābhedān svātmani svīkaroti | yeṣāṃ tu `tadrape'vayave saṅkhayābhedo vṛttau nivartate' iti bhedā- pohalakṣaṇamabhedekatvam, na tanmate saṅkhyābhedasvīkāro yujjata iti sūcayati || 112 ||
yataśca vidyamānāsu saṃkhyāsvabhedaikatvasaṅkhayā vṛttau prādurbhavati, tadā godāviti sidhyatītyāha-- vyāpāraṃ yāti bhedākhyaistat svairavayavaiḥ kvacit | ātmā bhedānapekṣo'sya kvacideti nimittatām || 113 ||
tadityanugatabhedamabhedaikatvaṃ kvacidantarbhūtadvitvādimukhenopayujyate, yatra bhedānā- māvirbhāvaheturasti | kvacit tu vyapagatabhedamabhinnena svarūpeṇopayujyate, yatra bhedaheturnāsti ||113|| atraivodāharaṇamāha-- dāsyāḥ patiriti vyakto godāviti ca dṛśyate | vyāpārabhedaḥ saṅkhayāyāstasyādevaṃ vyavasthitaḥ || 114 ||
