patyurākrośapratipādanāya dāsī sambandhitayopātteti tāvanmātrasya vivakṣitatvāddvitvabahutvānādara ityabhedaikatvasaṅkhayāyāḥ svarūpeṇātra vyāpāro vyakto niścitaḥ|godāviti tu godadvayasāmīpyaṃ vivakṣitam, grāmasyaikatvād godo grāma iti na pratī- yata ityantargatadvitvāśrayeṇābhedaikatvasaṅkhayāyā vyāpāro'tra niścitaḥ | tathā ca vṛttyavasthāgataliṅgasaṅkhayātideśe'pi sambhavantī dvitvādikā saṅkhayā lubarthe yujya-te'tideṣṭam | anyatrāpi cāyaṃ saṅkhyādharmo dṛṣṭaḥ | tadyathā--viṃśatisaṃkhyā daśad‌vargadvayārab-dhāpi na dvitvena savyāpārā, api tvabhedenaiva svadharmeṇa-viṃśatirgāva iti | viṃśatī iti tu viṃśatipracaye vivakṣite ekaśeṣaḥ | dvau traya iti tu dvayādikā saṃkhyā svarūpābhede'pi saṅkhayeyāśrayabhedopādānena | evamabhedaikatvasaṅkhayāyāmapi ko virodho viṣayabhedena bhedābhedopādāne ? na ca saṃkhyāsu saṅkhayāntarābhāvādabhedaikatvasaṅkhayāyāmapi saṅkhayāntarāsambhava iti vācyam, asatyapi saṅkhayāntarayoge saṃkhyānāṃ saṅkhayāntarbhāvasya darśanāt | tadyathā--kati bhavataḥ putrā iti | atrottarasaṃkhyāyāṃ pūrvasaṃkhyānupraveśādekatva- dvitvādāvaviśeṣeṇa praśno bhavati | tathā ca prativacanaṃ dṛśyate--eko dvau bahava iti | evamabhedaikatvasaṃkhyāyāmapi saṃkhyāntarāṇyantarbhavanti, tathā ca nimittavaśā- dudbhavanti ? anyathātyantamasattve kathamudbhavaḥ | sā ceyaṃ sarvasaṃkhyāsāmānyabhūtā `rājapuruṣaḥ' ityādāvapasarjanapadopādānaiva samavetasaṃkhyā | sāmānyaṃ hi svārthamupasarjanapadānyāhuḥ, svabhāvāt || 114 ||
yadyevaṃ dviputra ityatraṃ kathaṃ dvitvāvagamaḥ upasarjanārthasyetyata āha-- dvayādīnāṃ ca dviputrādau bāhyo bhedo nivartate | vibhaktivācyaḥ svārthatvānnimittaṃ tvavatiṣṭhate || 115 ||
dvayoḥ putra iti vibhaktivākyaṃ dvitvaṃ pūrvamanyadeva prātipadikārthāt samarthitam | tadeva ca vṛttāvabhedaikatvaprādurbhāvānnivartataṃ | prātipadikārthabhūtaṃ tu nāpagacchati | anyathā nirarthakatve prayoga eva na syād dviśabdasya | asti ca jahatsvārthāyāmapi vṛttāvupasarjanārthaṃ ityuktam | evaṃ triputra ityādau vācyam || 115 ||
yadi tarhi svārtho dvitvaṃ na nivartate, tadābhedaikatvasaṃkhyātra nāstītyāsaṃk- yāha-- dvitvopasarjane saṅghe dviśabdastatra vartate | so'yamityabhisambandhādubhaśabde na tattathā || 116 ||
vākye'vayavaprādhānyādudbhūtabhedau dvāvucyete | vṛttau tu samudāyasamudāyino- rabhedādhyāropād dvitvaguṇāvacchinnaḥ samudāya eka ityupasarjanārthasyātrāpi bhedo vyāvartate abhedaikatvāprādurbhāvāt | tadetat samudāyavṛttitvamubhaśabdaviṣaye tena prakāreṇa dvitvopasarjanatvena na sambhavatītyubhaputra iti na kadācidapi bhavati samāsaḥ | tathāhi-- "ubhayastasya tulyārtho vṛttau nityaṃ prayujyate |" ityanantarameva vakṣyati | ubhābāhurityādistu prayogo dvidaṇḍayāditvāt sādhuḥ | kathamubhaśabdo dviparyāyo'pi tadvad vṛttau saṅgha nābhidhatta iti | cet, śabdaśaktisvābhāvyāditi brūmaḥ | tathā ca vārttikam--"anyābhāvo dvivacanaṭābvi- ṣayatvāt, ubhayo'nyatra"  iti || 116 ||
tadetadāha-- ubhayastasya tulyārtho vṛttau nityaṃ prayujyate | sūtre'pi nityagrahaṇaṃ tadarthamabhidhīyate || 117 ||
ubhayaputraḥ, ubhayathā, ubhayata ityādau vṛttipade ubhaśabdasamānārtha ubhayaśabdaḥ prayujyate | sa hi dvitvopasarjanaṃ saṅghamabhidhātuṃ samartho nobhaśabdaḥ | tathā ca vastvabhedāśrayeṇa tulyārthatvam, nābhidhāvyāpārāśrayeṇa ubhāviti bhedarūpeṇa pratipā- danāt, ubhaya ityavayavirūpeṇa | "ubhādudātto nityam"  ityatra sūtre nityagrahaṇametadartham, dvitvopasarjanasamudāyābhidhānaśaktivirahamubhaśabdasya jñāpayitumityarthaḥ | ubhaśabdo hyasaṃkhyāvācī, pratyayāntarāṃ cāyajityatra pakṣe tayapo'prāptau tena sahavikalpanivṛttyarthaṃ nityagrahaṇaṃ nopayujyate | ubhaśabdaḥ saṃkhyāvācī tayabādeśaścāyaj ityatrāpi pakṣe'svaritatvādeva vikalpanivṛttau nityagrahaṇaṃ vṛttiviṣaye nityamaya- jevetyuktaprayojanameva | nacobhaśabdena dvayavayavaḥ saṅgho'bhidhīyate, yenobhayaśabdenāpi tatheti tulyārthatāyāṃ vikalpaḥ syāditi nityagrahaṇam | śabdaśaktisvābhāvyāt samudāyasyābhidhānaṃ hyabhaya- śabdeneti nyāyānuvādaḥ sūtre nityagrahaṇam || 117 ||
satyāṃ tvabhidhānaśaktau dvivacanaṭabviṣaye prayujyata evobhaśabda ityāha-- āpi ke cāparārthatvānnābheda upajāyate | ubhe iti tataḥ svārthe bhedavṛttiḥ prayujyate || 118 ||
strīvṛtteḥ prātipadikāt svārthe ṭāp, evaṃ kutsitādidyotane svārthe ka iti tatra pratyayārthe guṇabhāvānāpatterabhede'nupajāte svatantre svārthe bhede vartamānaḥ prayogārho'yamubhaśabdaḥ ubhe ubhaka iti | asvārthike tu pratyaye uttarapade ca pārārthyāt pradhānārthaikārthībhāvād ud- bhūtabhedatā (anudbhūtabhedatā) svārtho'sya hīyate iti tatrāsya prayogo'nyāyyaḥ || 118 ||
yadā tarhi "striyām" ityatra pratyayārthaviśeṣapakṣaḥ, tadā tatra prakṛtyarthavyatirikte'rthe viśeṣaṇāyopādīyamāno na svārtha prayuktaḥ syāditi kathaṃ tatrobhaśabdaprayoga ityāśaṅkayāha-- strītvābhidhānapakṣe'pi guṇabhāvaviparyayaḥ | svabhavādaparārthatvāt tatra bhedo na hīyate || 119 ||
gārgyādau prakṛtyartho guṇabhūtaḥ, pratyayārthaḥ pradhānaṃ pratīyate | strīprat-yayānteṣu tu pratyayārthapakṣe'pi strītvaviśiṣṭaṃ dravyamatrābhidhīyate, śabdaśa- ktisvābhāvyāt | nahi śabdānāmarthādeśanaṃ śakyate kartum, śāstraprakriyābhede'-pi laukikasya sthitalakṣaṇasyārthasyābhedāt | tasmādubhe ityatra bhedo na nivartate, parārthatvābhāvāt || 119 ||
yata evam-- tasmād dvivacanāṭṭāpaścobhayo'nyatra dṛśyate | pratyayaṃ tayapaṃ hitvā nāstyuttarapade punaḥ || 120 ||
dvivacanaṭābviṣaya ubhaśabdaḥ uktaḥ | ṭāpi ca nānyatra dvivacanāt | ato'nyatra tu pratyaye uttarapade cobhaśabdo nāsti | api tu tatsamānārtha ubhayaśabdaḥ | tayāpi tu prakṛtitvenobhādityupādānasāmarthyāt tatraikārthībhāvaviṣaye'pyubhaśabdaḥ prayujyata|ubhāhastyādayastu dvidaṇḍayādayaḥ | tatra ca śabdaśaktisvābhāvyādevobhaśabdaḥ samudāya- rūpeṇārthamācaṣṭe dviśabdavat || 120 ||
tadevamabhedaikatvasaṃkhyāyāḥ prasaṅgāyātaṃ kiñcinnirṇītam | idaṃ tvatra codyate-- "īdūded dvivacanaṃ pragṛhyam" ityatra vārtike'bhihitam--`īdādyantaṃ dvivacanāntamiti celluki pratiṣedhaḥ' iti | kumārayoragāraṃ kumāryagāramiti, śrutyedādyantaṃ pratyayakakṣaṇena ca dvivacanāntamiti pragṛhyasaṃjñāprasaṅgaśco- ditaḥ | sa nopapadyate, vṛttāvabhedaikatvasaṅkhyābhyupagame dvivacanāntasya samāsābhāvādityāha-- prāptiḥ pragṛhyasaṃjñāyā na syāt pratyayalakṣaṇāt | kumāryagāre na hyasti samāso vacanāntare || 121 ||
vyākhyātārthāḥ ślokaḥ || 121 ||
anyadapi codayitumāha-- ekadvayoryañādīnāṃ vibhāṣā luṅ na kalpate | yauṣmākastāvakaśceti bhedābhāvānna sidhyati || 122 ||
`yañādīnāmekasya dvayorvā tatpuruṣe ṣaṣṭhayā upasaṅkhayānam'  iti pakṣe lugukto vākyakāreṇa | gārgyasya kulaṃ gārgyakulaṃ gargakulamiti vā, gārgyayoḥ kulaṃ gārgyakulaṃ gargakulamiti veti prayogasiddhayartham | sa cābhedaikatvā- bhyupagame dvivatanāntānāṃ samāsābhāvādekavacanasyāpi dvayādipratipakṣasyābhāvād virudhyate | tathā sūtrakāramatenāpyabhedaikatvaṃ virudhyate | tathāhi--"tavakamamakāvevacane" iti yuṣmākāsmākabādhakāvekavacane vidadhātyādeśau | tataśca yauṣmāka iti vṛttau dvitvādi manyate | tāvaka ityekatvaṃ dvitvādipratipakṣamiti kathamabhedaikatvaṃ syāt || 122 ||
kiñca, dṛṣṭo gārgyatare bhedastathā gargatarā iti | yuṣmatpitā tvatpiteti tathādeśau vyavasthitau || 123 ||
bahuṣu "yañañośca" iti lugvidhānād gārgyatara iti pratyayaśrutau niyataṃ dvitvaikatve pratīyete, gargatarā iti ca bahutvamiti kathaṃ vṛttāvabhedaikatvā- prādurbhāvaḥ ? tathā pratyayottarapadayoḥ "tvamāvekavacane" iti vacanād tvatpitā matpitetyekatvaṃ pratīyate | yuṣmatpitā asmatpitā iti tu dvitvabahu- tvāvagatiriti | sarvametad vṛttāvabhedaikatvābhyupagame virudhyate || 123 ||
atra pratividhīyate-- upādhibhūtā yā saṅkhayā prakṛtau samavasthitā | ādeśaiḥ saṃjñayā vāpi vibhak‌tyāvyajyate vinā || 124 ||
vidyamānāsu saṅkhayāsu tatsaṃsargamayyabhedaikatvasaṅkhyā prādurbhavatītyuktam | tathāca yatra saṅkhyāviśeṣanibandhanamasti, tatrāsau pratīyata evetyupasarjanapadaviṣaye yā prakṛtiḥ prātipadikaṃ tadviśaye tadarthasyāvacchedakatvena yā bhedasaṅkhyā samavetā, sā pragṛhyasaṃjñāpravṛttyā kumāryagāram' ityatra pratīyata eva | yadi hyatra pragṛhyasaṃjñā syāt, tadā prakṛtibhāve sati dvitvamupasarjanārthas- yāvagamyeta, dvivacanāntasya pragṛhyasaṃjñāvidhānāt | evaṃ `tāvakaḥ,tvatpitā' ityādāvapyādeśādekavacane vihitād viśeṣād viśeṣāvagatiḥ | upasarjanasya hi prātipadikasyāpi caikatvasaṅkhyāsvīkārasāmarthye'pi viśeṣābhivyaktau nāsti sāmarthyamiti tatra vibhaktiṃ sahāyapekṣate | evamādeśādyapīti | ata eva kecit prakṛtiriva prakṛtirviśeṣasaṅkhyāyāḥ abhedaikatvasaṅkhyā, tato'syā udbhavāditi tatraikātmyenāvasthitā sopasarjanapadena śaktipratighātādaprakā- śitā vibhak‌tyevādeśaiḥ prakāśyata iti vyācakṣate | gargakulādau caikadvayorapi lugā- deśe, prakaraṇād viśeṣāvasāyo bhaviṣyati | anārambhe tu luko bahuṣveva lugvidhānād `gargakulam' ityekatvādvitvapratīti- rnaiva syāt | bahuṣu tu lugapatye niyamārthamavaśyārambhaṇīyaḥ | evaṃ `yuṣmatpitā' ityādau prakaraṇād dvitvabahutvaniyamāvadhāraṇam,`gārgyakulam' ityādau ca | itthaṃ ca kṛtvā `dvivacanabahuvacanāntānāmasamāsaḥ' iti nedaṃ vacanaṃ sambhavati, viśeṣāvagame samāsapravṛtteḥ | rājapuruṣādau tu viśeṣāvagamanibandhanābhāvād vṛttipadaman- vākhyātuṃ prakriyāyāṃ sadṛśasya vākyasya kalpanādekavacanāntānāmeva tadyuktamiti nyāyasiddhārthānuvādo'yamatra | yatra tu dvitvādyabhivyaktisambhavaḥ, tatra samāsaprakṛtau prakriyāvākye kumā- ryoragāramityādāvupādīyata eva dvivacanādīti na kaścid virodhaḥ || 124 ||
anenaiva ca nyāyenedamapi siddhamityāha-- śaurpike māsajāte ca parimāṇaṃ svabhāvataḥ | upādhibhūtāmāśritya saṅkhyāṃ bhedena vartate || 125 ||
śarpeṇa krīto, māso jātasya yasya saḥ--śaurpiko, māsajāta ityatra yadyabhedaikatva- saṅkhyā svātmāntargatasaṅkhyāviśeṣānupādanena varteta, tadā aniyatasaṅkhyatve viśeṣaṇa-sya krītajātayorniyatamūlyāvagamo vayoviśeṣāvagatiśca na syāt | paricchedārthaṃ ca śaurpikādayaḥ śabdāḥ prayujyante | tatra ca mūlabādhāyā anyāyyatvāt, prayogasvabhā- vādarthānāmātmabhūtaṃ prāthamakalpikaṃ caikatvaṃ saṅkhyābhedaṃ prātipadikārthāvacchedakamupā- dāya parimāṇaṃ vṛttimanubhavati || 125 ||
etadevāha-- vayasvini paricchedaḥ krīte cāpi na gamyate | iṣṭo bhedādṛte tatra parimāṇamanarthakam || 126 ||
iṣṭo'bhimataḥ paricchedo bhedamekatvasaṅkhyālakṣaṇamantareṇa krītajātayorna gamyata iti tatraikatvānupādāne śūrpamāsayoḥ prayogo niṣphalaḥ syāt | nanu cātra aśūrpavyāvṛttaye saptarātrādivyavacchedāya ca prayogasya sāphalyaṃ syāt | naitadasti | aniyatasaṅkhyatve parimāṇasya parimeyaviśeṣo nāvadhāryate | tadviśeṣāvadhāraṇāyaiva ca prayogaḥ parimāṇaśabdānām | te ca svabhāvādeva paricchinna- rūpārthābhidhāyinaḥ | tataśca prayogaprāmāṇyādupasarjanārthasyaikatvaviśiṣṭasyātrāva- gatiḥ, parimāṇaśabdairaktaparimāṇasyārthasyābhidhānāt || 126 ||
ata eva-- bhinnasyābhedavacanāt prasthādibhyaḥ śaso vidhiḥ | taddharmatvādabhedāt tu ghaṭādibhyo na dṛśyate || 127 ||
saṅekhyaikavacanād vīpsāyāṃ śaso vidhāne'nvarthatvādekavacanaśabdasya prātipadi- kādekatvasaṅkhyāvacchinnārthābhidhāyinaḥ śas , na tvekavacanāntāt | evañca vṛttau bhinnasya dravyasya, na tu jāteḥ;abhedo yadekatvaṃ tasyābhidhānāt parimāṇaśabdebhyaḥ prasthādibhyaḥ śaspratyayo bhavati | te hi śabdaśaktisvābhāvyādekatvasaṅkhyāparicchi- nnaṃ svārthamācakṣata iti taddharmatvāduktaparimāṇārthābhidhāyitvād vṛttāvabhedaikatva-prādurbhāve'pyekatvāvagamācchasutpattiḥ, prasthaśo dadāti, khāriśo dadātīti | ghaṭā- diśabdebhyastu na bhavati śas, te hi jātiśabdaḥ | tathā ca jātyabhedādabhedaikatvasaṃkhyāyoga iti na te bhinnasya dravyasyābhedamabhidadhati, api tu jāteḥ | sā ca vyaktibhede'pi sthitetyaniyatasaṅkhyāśrayajātivācitve ghaṭādiśabdānāṃ vṛttau niyamena vyaktyokatvāntarbhāvanāśaktatvānnaikārthābhidhānani- mittaḥ pratyayaḥ | dṛśigrahaṇaṃ cātra prayogānisaraṇārtham | ghaṭaśe dadāti iti prayogo nadṛśyate | yatra tu jātiśabdānāmapi vyaktiviśeṣapratyāyanaparatayā prayogaḥ, tatraikatvādyavagama- darśanād bhavatyeva śas | tad yathā--`yo vā imāṃ vācaṃ varṇaśaḥ padaśa akṣaraśo vāpi dadhāti, sa ārtvijīno bhavati'  iti | atra hi varṇasamadāyarūpatvāt padasya varṇebhyo bhedena nirdeśasāmarthyādekavyaktivivakṣā niścīyate | tadevamabhedaikatvasaṅkhyābhyupagame yo virodha udbhāvitaḥ, sa nivāritaḥ | sarvasaṃṅkhyābhedasaṃsargasvābhāvāyāṃ tasyāṃ yathāni- bandhanaṃ viśeṣāvirbhāvanasyopapatteriti yuktisiddhatvādetadanusāreṇa sūtravārtikavaca- nāni gamayitavyāni || 127 ||
idānīm`tadrape'vayave vṛttau saṃkhyābhedo nivartate'  iti ye bhedāpohalakṣaṇāmabhedaikatvasaṃkhyāṃ manyante, tanmate'pi virodhaparihārāyopakramate-- śrūyate vacanaṃ yatra bhāvastatra viśiṣyate | nivartate yad vacanaṃ tasya bhovo na vidyate || 128 ||
yatra vākye ekavacanādi śrūyate, tatra bhāvaḥ saṃkhyālakṣaṇo dharmo viśiṣyate, anyasmād vyāvṛttau viśiṣyo'vasīyate | yattu vṛttāvekavacanādi nivartate'paiti, tasya bhāvaḥ sa eva saṃkhyālakṣaṇo dharmaḥ pratyāyyo na vidyate nāsti | tadabhāvādeva hi tatra tadvacanasya nivṛttiḥ || 128 ||
saiva tu svābhāvikī lukānvākhyāyate pratyayalakṣaṇaprasiddhaya ityāha-- kāryaṃ sattāśrayaṃ śāstradapravṛttiradarśanam | vākye dṛṣṭaṃ yadatyantamabhāvastasya vṛttiṣu || 129 ||
iha vṛttau vibhaktīnāmarthābhāvādevāpravṛttiranutpattiḥ prāgabhāva evā- darśanam | tadāśritya pratyayasattāśrayaṃ kāryaṃ śāstrāt `pratyayalope pratyayala- kṣaṇam'ityasmāt pravartayituṃ lukchāstramārabhyate | tavakādirādeśaḥ pragṛhyasaṃjñā ca sati pratyaye'nuśiṣṭervṛttau saṃkhyāviśeṣābhāvādasati pratyaye na syāditi prakriyāyāṃ pratyaya utpādyate | tasya prasaktasyādarśanaṃ lugiti pratya-yalakṣaṇena tatsiddhiḥ | kathamapravṛttiḥ prāgabhāvo'darśanamiti ced, vākye dṛṣṭasya vṛttāvadarśanād vacana-sya | vṛttivākyayorhi śabdāntaratvenātyantaṃ bhedādarthābhāvādevāpravartanaṃ vṛttauvacanasya, na tu pradhvaṃsabhāva ityarthaḥ || 129 ||
yadyevaṃ supāmanutpādanād vacanaviśeṣākśrayā vidhayaḥ pratyayalakṣaṇenāpi kathaṃ labhyanta ityata āha-- saṃjñāviṣayabhedārthaṃ prasaktādarśanaṃ smṛtam | kṣūyamāṇaṃ tu vacanaṃ viśiṣṭamupalabhyate || 130 ||
sarvasya pratyayasya svaviṣayādanyatrātyantādarśanamityatiprasaṅganivāraṇāya lopa- saṃjñāyā viṣayaniyamārtham "siddhaṃ tu prasaktādarśanasya lopasaṃjñitvāt" ityuktam| yadyapi cātrārthābhāvācchāstrīyāpi nāsti prāptiḥ, tathāpi svābhāvika evāpra-yogo lukā jñāpyate | na hi saṃbhavadarthaḥ śabdaḥ śakyate vacanena nivartayitum | aprāptyanumānameva hi bādhā | evañca lukchāstraiṇaivātra prasaktorākhyānāt prakriyāyāṃ supa utpannā niva- rtyante | prayogasamavāyini hi vākye śrūyante niyatāḥ supaḥ | taccānyadeva vṛtteḥ | tatsadṛśaṃ tu prakriyāvākyaṃ vṛttiprakṛtibhūtaṃ kalpyate | tatra ca supaḥ prayogasamavāyivākyānusāreṇaiva kalpyante tathā ca tatra prakriyā- vākye viśiṣṭameva vacanaṃ śrūyate | tatra hi yadupalabhyate vacanaṃ tacchatatvādeva viśiṣṭaṃ vijñāyate | tataśca kāraṇānu- rūpatvāt kāryasya vṛttāvapi lukā jñāpyamānaṃ viśiṣṭameva vacanaṃ pratyayalakṣaṇena svakāryaṃ prayuṅkta iti rājapuruṣādau vacanaviśeṣakāryasyābhāvād vacanamātrāśrayaṃ nalopādikāryaṃ pravartate | tathā ca tatra bhūtapūrvo vacanabhedo nāvagamyata iti saṃkhyāviśeṣāvagamābhāvaḥ | tavakādayastvādeśāḥ pragṛhyasaṃjñā ca pratyayalakṣaṇakāryaṃ vacanaviśeṣapratibaddhamiti tatravacanabhedasya bhūtapūrvasyāvagamād bhavati tannibandhanaḥ saṃkhyāviśeṣāvasāyaḥ | "śrayate vacanaṃ yatra bhāvastatra viśiṣyate" iti vacanabhedanibandhano hi saṃkhyābhedāvagamaḥ | sa cātrādeśādinānumitasannidhāna iti kathaṃ svavācyaṃ na pratyāyayedityarthaḥ | tadevaṃ pūrvamādeśāderevābhedaikatvasaṃkhyāntarbhūtasya saṃkhyāviśeṣasyāvagama iti samarthitam | iha tvasatyapi saṃkhyāviśeṣāntarbhāve'bhedaikatvasaṃkhyāmādeśādinā viśiṣṭa- prakṛtyānumāne svavācakadvāreṇaiva saṃkhyābhedapratipattiriti bhedaḥ || 130 ||
atra tu darśane doṣamāha-- abhāvo vā luko yatra rūpavān vā vidhīyate | vyabhicārānnimittasya tatrāsādhuḥ prasajyate || 131 ||
prakriyāvākye yādṛśaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ vacanam, tādṛśa eva prasaktasya vṛttaulugityuc- yate | tathā ca yatra luko'bhāvaḥ "pañcamyāḥ stokādibhyaḥ"  ityādau, tatra dvitvabahutvayoḥ `stokābhyāṃ muktaḥ'`stokebhyo muktaḥ' iti prāpnoti | iṣyate ca stokānmukta ityevetyaluka ekavadbhāvo vaktavya eva syāt | sa cāśiṣya ityukta iti virodhaḥ | ekatvaṃ hi vṛttau pratīyate | `stokābhyāṃ muktaḥ' ityādau caikatvākhyasya vṛttinimittasya vacanāntaraśrutau parityāgād dvitvādāvapaśabdo'yaṃ stokānmukta iti prāpnoti | tathā rūpavān bhāvātmakastavakādyādeśo'pyekārthatve vidhīyate | anvartho hi tatraikavacanaśabdaḥ | tatra yadi vṛttau bhedāpohalakṣaṇābhedaikatvasaṃkhyābhyupagamyate, tato dvayādipratipakṣabhūtasyaikatvalakṣaṇasyādeśanibandhanasya vṛttau parityāgāt tavakādistatrāsādhuraprayogārha eva syāt || 131 ||
tasmādayamatra matadvaye'pi paramārtharūpaḥ siddhānta ityāha-- bhedaḥ saṃkhyā viśeṣovāvyākhyāto vṛttivākyayoḥ | sarvatraiva viśeṣastu nāvaśyaṃ tādṛśo bhavet || 132 ||
kimanena duḥsamarthenābhedaikatvenābhyupagatena ? śabdānāmabhidhānaśaktayo hi vicitrāḥ | tā viśeṣeṇānusartumaśakyāḥ kiñcit sāmānyamāśritya jñāpyante | tathā ca vṛttāvekārthībhāvakṛtaṃ vākyād viśeṣaṃ darśayatā bhāṣyakāreṇa yaḥ saṃkhyābhedāvagamalakṣaṇo viśeṣo vṛttau vyākhyāto vākye ca bhedaḥ saṃkhyāviśeṣa iti, so'bhedena vṛttipadāni prātisvikabhedānāśrayeṇopādāya boddhavyaḥ | tathāhi--na sarvatra vattipade saṃkhyāviśeṣāpratītiḥ, śaurpikamāsajātatāvakīnādau viśeṣapratīteḥ | asti tu rājapuruṣādāvaviśeṣa ityetāvatā vākyād bhinnā vṛttirla-kṣitā bhavatyeva | tadyathā kriyāvad guṇavat samavāyikāraṇaṃ dravyamityukte gaganādīnāṃ kriyāvattvābhāve'pi guṇādibhyo dravyasya bhedaḥ sidhyatyeva | teṣāṃ kadācidapi kriyāvattvābhāvāt | dravyasya tu kasyacit kadācit tathābhūtatvāt | evaṃ vākye sarvatraiva saṃkhyābhedapratīteḥ kvacit tadrūpāpi vṛttistato'nyā bhavatyeva jñāpitā | sarvaṃ hi lakṣaṇaṃ sāmānyenaiva pravartate, prativyaktayaśakyatvāttatpraṇayanasya | deśakālasvabhāvabhedena vicitratvānmātrāṇām, viśeṣataḥ śabdānāmabhidhāna-śaktiniyamasyāyogāditi sati nibandhane tāvakīnādau saṃkhyāviśeṣapratipattirbhavantī lakṣaṇavayabhicārāya na prabhavati, sāmānye lakṣaṇasya pravṛtteḥ sakṛtpravṛttāvapi caritā- rthatvādityarthaḥ || 132 ||
yathā ca vṛttau saṃkhyāviśeṣaḥ kvacinna pratīyate, tathā liṅgaviśeṣo'pi | tataśca kukkuṭayādīnāmaṇḍādiṣu puṃvadbhāvaḥ "na vā astrīpūrvapadasya vivakṣitatvāt"  iti pratyākhyātaḥ | tad vyācaṣṭe-- jāteśca bhedahetutvānna liṅgena viśeṣyate | pradhānaṃ mṛgadugdhādau gārgīputre na sa kramaḥ || 133 ||
`mṛgdugdham, kukkuṭāṇḍam, chāgamāṃsam'tyādau dugdhāderuttarapadārthasya pradhāna-syāvacchedāya mṛgādipūrvapadārtho viśeṣaṇamupādīyata iti jātiparāyāṃ codanāyāṃ liṅga- viśeṣasyāvivakṣeti `mṛgasya dugdham' ityādireva vigrahaḥ | jātyantaranivṛttiparāyāṃcodanāyāṃ mṛgādayaḥ śabdā niyatajātivācakā nirastaliṅgabhedā eva prabhavanti vivakṣitenārthena pradhānamavacchettum | tadetaducyate--"astrī pūrvapadasya vivakṣitatvāt " iti | astryarthatve hi pūrvapadasya kimanyajjātivivakṣāyāṃ syāt ? tatrāṇḍādīnāṃ strīpuṃsasādhāraṇyāt kukkuṭasyāṇḍam,chāgasya māṃsamiti kukkuṭādinā viśeṣaṇamanarthakam, avyabhicārāt | yadā tvanyajātinivṛttireva viśeṣaṇamabhisaṃhitam, tadā vākyameva bhavati, na samāsaḥ | tato viśeṣasyāniścayāt | nivṛtte hi strīpratyaye strītvasyānabhivyakteḥ saivasāmānyavivakṣā puṃvadvacanena sūcyate | kvacit tu sarvathaiva liṅgaviśeṣayogo bhavatyupasarjanārthasya | tad yathā gārgīputra- chāgalīmūtramahiṣīmūvādiṣu | putrasya hi nindāpraśaṃṣāparatayā mūtraviśeṣasya cārtha- kriyābhedakāritvāt striyaiva viśeṣaṇaṃ yujyate | tathā caivamādau na sānupūrvī yā kukkuṭayādiṣu (kukkuṭāṇḍādiṣu) | tatra hi liṅgasāmānyayuktaḥ pūrvapadārthaḥ | ata evādiśabdenaivaṃbhūtā jātiparā eva kukkuṭīprakārā abhimatāḥ | na tu yatra vyaktivivakṣā prayojanavatī gārgīputrādau, te'pi gārgīprabhṛtayo'tra gṛhyanta iti pratyudāharaṇamatraite bhavanti | itthaṃ ca kṛtvā saṃkhyāyā iva liṅgasyāpi viṣayaniyamena vivakṣā'vivakṣe vijñeye || 133 ||
yataśca jātiparatve liṅgasaṃkhyābhedastirodhīyate, ata eva-- abhede liṅgasaṃkhyābhyāṃ yogācchuklaṃ paṭāiti | prasakte śāstramārabdhaṃ siddhaye liṅgasaṃkhyayoḥ || 134 ||
iha padāvadhike'nvākhyāne padāntarānapekṣayā pade saṃskriyamāṇe niyatāvākyagata- viśeṣānavadhāraṇāt sāmānye svārthamātre liṅgasarvanāmanapuṃsakayogāt saṅkhayāsarvanāmā- bhedaikatvayogācca śuklamiti pade sthite, paṭā iti padāntarasamanvayopajane'pyabhi- nirvṛttasyāntaraṅgasya saṃskārasyānivṛtteḥ paṭā ityasamanvitārthātvādasamānādhika- raṇe'pi prayoge prāpte "viśeṣaṇānāṃ cājāteḥ"  iti viśiṣṭaliṅgasaṅ- khayāsiddhayarthamārabhyate śāstram | lubantaviśeṣaṇānāṃ hi lubarthasamānādhikaraṇatvāt "lupi yuktavad"  ityānenaiva lubarthagataliṅgasaṅkhayayoḥ siddhatvād "guṇavacanānāmāśrayato liṅgavacanāni" ityasminnarthe sūtramavasthāpitaṃ bhāṣye | viśeṣaṇānāṃ tairyuktasyeva vyaktivacane bhavata iti sūtrārthaḥ || 134 ||
tatra viśeṣaṇaśabdena sāmānyavācinā guṇa eva kathamabhidhīyata ityāha-- parārthaṃ śeṣabhāvaṃ yo vṛttiṣu pratipadyate | guṇo viśeṣaṇatvena sa sūtre vyapadiśyate || 135 ||
bhedakaṃ viśeṣaṇamiti yadyapi pratītam, tathāpīha paratantramātraṃ vivakṣitam | tathāhi--taddhitagrahaṇasaṃbaddhasya yuktavadityasyānuvṛttestaddhitārthayoga ekārthībhāve taddhitavṛttiṣu yo bhāvaḥ śrūyate, anyaṃ taddhitārthamātmopadhānenopakurvan sa guṇo'- tra viśeṣaṇamityuktaḥ | sa hi matublopāt, matvarthīyākārāntatayā vā dravyasāmānye prakrāntaḥ, tadāśritatvenātyapāratantryād viśeṣaṇam | yastu vyadhikaraṇaḥ paṭasya śukla iti, sa guṇamātrapratiṣṭho dravyeṇa viśeṣya- māṇatvād viśeṣaṇameva na bhavati | puṃliṅge ca guṇe ekatra tasya prathamata eva prāptasaṃskāratvānna liṅgasaṅkhayābhedā- kāṅkṣā | dravyasamānādhikaraṇasya tu dravyasāmānye napuṃsakaikatvayogini sthitasya dravyaviśeṣalakṣaṇāśrayadharmākāṅkṣiṇo yuktā viśiṣṭadravyaliṅgavacanapratipattiḥ | tasmād guṇamuktavān guṇavacanaḥ śuklādiratra sūtre viśeṣaṇamucyate | yadyapi cāsya luptapratyayasya viśeṣyavacanatā, tathāpi viśeṣyasāmānyavṛttitvād viśeṣākāṅkṣitvāt taṃ prati viśeṣaṇatvaṃ bhavatyeva || 135 ||
vākyāvadhike tarhyanvākhyāne padāntarāpekṣayā śuklo guṇo'sya paṭasyāstītyu-krama eva viśiṣṭaliṅgasaṃkhyāsiddhau kimarthaṃ sūtramityāśaṅkayāha-- śabdāntaratvād vākyeṣu viśeṣā yadyapi śrutāḥ | vṛtterabhinnarūpatvāt teṣu vṛttirna vidyate || 136 ||
śuklo guṇo'sya paṭasyāstīti yadidaṃ viśeṣavākyam, tanmatublopāt, matvarthīyā- kārāntatayā vā yā vṛttistasyā bhinnarūpameveti prāgeva pratipāditam | tataśca vākyagatā viśeṣā vṛttau nāntarbhavanti | abhinnarūpā hi vṛttiḥ paṭādiviśeṣeṣviti tasya (tasyāṃ) niyatavākyagataviśeṣābhivyaktirnāstīti sarvathā sāmānyāpekṣameva vṛttipadānuśāsanamiti viśeṣaliṅgasaṃkhyāsiddhayarthamidamārambhaṇīyameva sūtram || 136 ||
nanvemapi niyataviśeṣaniṣṭhasyaiva sāmānyasya pratipādyatvādanirdhārito'pi viśeṣo bhaviṣyatyanvākhyānanimittam, samanvayānyathānupapattyā vā bahiraṅgamapyāśrayaliṅgasaṃ- khyaṃ pratīkṣiṣyate | kathamanyathā satyapi vacane tat sidhyedityāśaṅkayāha-- rūpācca śabdasaṃskāraḥ sāmānyaviṣayo yataḥ | tasmāt tadāśrayaṃ liṅgaṃ vacanaṃ ca prasajyate || 137 ||
saliṅgaṃ ca sasaṅkhyaṃ ca tato dravyābhidhāyinā | sambadhyate padaṃ tatra tayorbhinnā śrutirbhavet || 138 ||
iha yo'rthaḥ śabdāt pratīyate, sa eva saṃskāranimittam | asmācca vṛttipadāda- bhinnarūpāt sarvaviśeṣasādhāraṇācchru tisāmānyasvabhāvādarthasāmānyaṃ pratīyate, na tu viśeṣaḥ | tathā ca vivakṣitasyāpi viśeṣasyāpratītasyāsatsamatvāt sāmānyanibandhanamevā- nvākhyānaṃ yuktamiti sāmānyāśrayayorliṅgasaṅkhayoḥ prāptiḥ || 137,138 ||
tayoścāntaraṅgayoḥ kṛtayorviśeṣasannidhāne'pi tyāgābhāvād vyadhikaraṇatvā- dasaṃbandhe vacanānusāriṇaṃ prati prāpte-- bhāvino bahiraṅgasya vacanādāśrayasya ye | liṅgasaṅkhye guṇānāṃ te sūtreṇa pratipādite || 139 ||
vākye padānāṃ prayogayaugapadyābhāvād bhāvigrahaṇamasamānakālatāpratipādanaparam, pūrvapratipādane'pyāśrayasya padāntarasaṃskāre'napekṣaṇāt | ata eva bahiraṅgatvamanape- kṣaṇādāśrayasyāśritasaṃskāre | evamapi vacanasāmarthyād bahiraṅgo'pyartho'pekṣyata iti viśiṣṭaliṅgavacanasiddhiḥ "viśeṣaṇānāṃ" iti sūtrārambhāt || 139 ||
yadā tarhi prathamata eva tadvitavācyatvaṃ viśeṣyasyābhidhitsitam, tadā kiṃ vacanenetyata āha-- viśeṣavṛtterapi ca rūpābhedādalakṣitaḥ | yasmād viśeṣastenātra bhedakāryaṃ na kalpate || 140 ||
vivakṣite'pi viśeṣe vṛttipadasya sādhāraṇyād yadanavadhāraṇaṃ tasya tata ityaśabdā- rtho'nvākhyānanimittaṃ na bhavati viśeṣa ityuktamevaitat || 140 ||
nanu ca sāmānyasya viśeṣeṣu pratiṣṭhānāt tannibandhanaṃ kāryaṃ sāmānyopakrame'p- bhidhāne'nivāryaṃ, nirviśeṣasya sāmānyasyābhāvādityāśaṅkayāha-- viśeṣa eva sāmānyaṃ viśeṣād bhidyate yataḥ | abhedo hi viśeṣāṇāmāśrito vinivartakaḥ || 141 ||
iha vyāvṛttirviśeṣalakṣaṇam | parasparaṃ vyāvartamānā hi viśeṣāḥ kathyante | tathā ca sāmānyamapyabhedenāśritaṃ viśeṣāṇāṃ nivartakatvādaviśeṣo bhavati | sāmānyavivakṣāyāṃ hiniyatā viśeṣā vyāvartitā bhavanti | tatra yathā niyato viśeṣaḥ samāśrito viśeṣāntaraṃ nivartayati, tathā sāmānyamapi viśeṣāniti so'pi viśeṣaḥ | taduktam "sāmānyamapi yathā viśeṣastadvata"  iti | evañca padāntarānapekṣe'nuśāsane'bhedaḥ sāmānyamāśritaṃ bhedānāṃ nivartakamiti kathaṃ viśeṣagataliṅgasaṅkhayālābhaḥ || 141 ||
nanu cābhedasya bhedanivāraṇe tairasāvuttarakālaṃ na saṃpadyeta, svānurūpapratyayajananaṃ ca teṣu, ato na syādityāśaṅkayāha-- yad yadāśrīyate tat tadanyasya vinivartakam | bhedābhedavibhāgastu sāmānye na nirūpyate || 142 ||
anyavyavacchedaphalatvācchabdaprayogasya viśeṣavat sāmānyamapi niyataviśeṣavyavacche- damāśritaṃ sat karotyeveti vīpsayā vyavacchedakatvaṃ viśeṣalakṣaṇaṃ sāmānyasyāpi yojitam | evamapi ca sāmānyaṃ bheda iti nocyate, sāmānyāntarāṇāmapākaraṇena svāśrayeṣvanuvṛtteḥ | nāpyabheda iti śakyate nirūpayitum, niyataviśeṣāṇāṃ sāmānyāntarāṇāṃ ca vyāvartakatvāt | itthaṃ ca yathā gauriti mukhye'rthe'nvākhyātaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyānyathānupapattyā vāhīkaṃ gotvasamāropeṇābhidhatte, tathā śuklādiśabdāḥ sāmānye mukhye'rthe saṃskṛtā viśeṣaiḥ padāntaropādānaiḥ saṃyujyeranniti tayorbhinnā śrutirbhavediti bahiraṅgāśra- yagataliṅgasaṃkhyāsiddhayarthaṃ sūtramityeva sthitam || 142 ||
nanu ca padavācyānāmarthānāṃ vastūnāmiva na kiñcidanvayi rūpaṃ dṛśyate, tat kimeṣāṃ sāmānyamityāśaṅkayāha-- apoddhāraśca sāmānyamiti tasyorakāriṇaḥ | nimittāvasthamevātastat svadharmeṇa gṛhyate || 143 ||
yadyapi sthitalakṣaṇārthaviśeṣaviśayaṃ vākyameva vācakam, tathāpi tasmāt saṃsargarūpāt padānāmapod‌dhriyamāṇānāṃ kiñcidarthaleśalakṣaṇaṃ sāmānyamapyapoddhā- rānuguṇaṃ vākyārthānuguṇyenāpoddhārāt tadupakāri vyavatiṣaṭhate | apod‌dhrite saṃsargāt pṛthak‌kriyate ityapoddhāraḥ sāmānyamiti | evamapoddhriyamāṇatvena tasya sāmānyasyopakāriṇo vākyārthabhūtaviśeṣā- vagamopāyabhūtasyetyarthaḥ | kevalāddhayāpod‌dhṛtāt padādarthasāmānyaviṣayā pratibhā jāyata iti tadviṣayaḥ sāmānyaṃ na viśeṣaḥ | tathāhi nimitte sākāṅkṣarūpe'vasthitiryasya, na viśeṣātmani, tat svenātmīyena svabhāvena niścīyate na bhedarūpeṇa, tasyāniyatsayopaplavāt | ataśca na viśeṣaliṅgasaṃkhyābhyāṃ saṃbadhyate padārthaḥ | nanu ca niyatavākyagatatvāt padānāmapoddhāre'pi padābhidheyā viśeṣā eveti kimanyat sāmānyaṃ syādityāśaṅkayāha-- anirdhāritadharmatvād bhedā eva vikalpitāḥ | nimittairvyapadiśyante sāmānyākhyāviśeṣitāḥ || 144 ||
padānāṃ viśeṣābhidhānāsāmārthyādanavagataniyataviśeṣarūpā bhedā eva tebhyaḥ pratīyamānāḥ sāmānyamityanayā saṃjñayā kalpanayā vyavasthāpitāḥ, na viśeṣasamākhyayā | yataśca jātiguṇakriyālakṣaṇairnimittairupādhibhiravacchinnā `gauḥ śuklo gacchati' ityādirūpeṇate vyapadiśyante, tato bhedā evaivaṃrūpā iti niścīyante | yadyapi hi padairvyavṛttarūpo'rtho nābhidhīyate, tathāpyupādhirūporadhānenārthābhidhā- nād bhedā evābhihitāḥ, nirupādheḥ sarvato'vyāvṛttasyāvyavahāryatvāt | dūrādapi rūpamātreṇa vyaktau naivāvasīyate | tasmāt sarvasyā vṛtteḥ pratītarbheda- niṣṭhatvāt padārthānāṃ viśeṣasya padāntaragamyasyānāsādanamātrāt pratītiḥ sāmānya syeti vyavasthāpyate | tattvadṛṣṭayā tu tadvākyopādānasya viśeṣasyānāsādanādākāṅkṣaṇācca vipluta- rūpatvādasatyaiva padārthānāṃ pratītiḥ | upāyamātraṃ tu sā vākyārthapratītāviti nirṇītacarametat || 144 ||
tadevaṃ `viśeṣaṇānām'  ityārambhaḥ samarthitaḥ | `svābhāvikametat' ityevaṃ tasya bhāṣye pratyākhyānamuktam | tadupapādayitumāha-- yadā tu vyapadiśyete liṅgasaṃkhye svabhāvataḥ | prayogeṣveva sādhutvaṃ vākye prakramyate tadā || 145 ||
prayogeṣveva prayujyamāneṣveva padāntareṣu vākyasthānāṃ vākyāvadhikamanvākhyānaṃ yadā prastūyate, tadopakrama evāśrayaviśeṣasāmānādhikaraṇyānyathānupapattyā so'yamityabhi-saṃbandhācchuklādīnāṃ viśeṣaliṅgasaṃkhyāyoga iti svābhāvikametādityucyate | atra hi darśane nāstayetadrūpābhedādalakṣito viśeṣaḥ | na cāpyantaraṅgabahiraṅgabhāvaḥ kaścit, upakrama evāśrayaviśeṣasyāpekṣitatvāt | tathācāntaraṅge'rthasāmānye saṃskāro paryavasyati | tadevaṃ pūrvaṃ vicchedopakrame'nvākhyāne guṇaguṇinorbhedamāśritya taddhitaprayogesatyāśrayasāmānye vṛtterantaraṅgo liṅgasaṃkhyāsarvanāmayoga uktaḥ | idānīṃ tu so'yamityabhisaṃbandhāśrayeṇābhedamāśritya prathamata eva niyata- vākyopāttaviśeṣavṛttitā kathitā | tathā cātra bhedasaṃbandhābhāvānmatupo lugakāro vā na vidhāyata iti nāstyabhinnarūpatvaṃ vṛtteḥ, bhedasaṃbandhavivakṣāyāmeva tadvidhānāt || 145 ||
nanvevamabhedavivakṣava nyāyyā, anyathā yathā bhedasaṃbandhe guṇavacanebhyo matupo lug vidhīyate, tathā jātyāpi yoge vivakṣite jātiśabdebhyo'pi kasmāt sa na vidhīyata ityāśaṅya jātiguṇayordravyasamavetatvāviśeṣe'pyavāntaraviśeṣapratipādanāyāha-- tatra prayogo'niyato guṇānāmāśrayaiḥ saha | sāmānyaṃ yat tadatyantaṃ tatraiva samavasthitam || 146 ||
śuklādayo guṇāḥ samupajāte dravye nimittavaśādaniyamena samavayanti, yāvadāśrayaṃ ca nāvatiṣṭhanta ityaniyataḥ prayogo bhedenābhedena ca paṭasya śukla, śuklaḥ paṭa iti | jātistūtpattiprabhṛtyāvinādavyabhicaritasaṃbandhā dravyeṇeti tadabhedena so'yamiti saṃbandhād vyavahriyate sadaiva, na tu kadācidapi bhedena paṭasya śukla ityādivaditi guṇaśabdā eva matublopaṃ bhedasaṃbandhavivakṣāyāṃ prayojayantītyarthaḥ | tathā ca vicchedopakrame sūtrārambhaḥ samarthitaḥ || 146 ||
etadeva prakaṭayati-- na gotvaṃ śābaleyasya gauriti vyapadiśyate | śuklatvaṃ bāhuleyasya śukla ityapadiśyate || 147 ||
bhāvapratyayamantareṇa vyakterniṣkṛṣṭaṃ sāmānyaṃ nābhidhīyate jātāvapi padārtha iti sarvathā vyaktirūpatāṃ prāptamabhedena tadabhidhīyate | so'yamiti saṃbandhāddhi vyaktirū- patāṃ prāptaṃ sāmānyaṃ tathaiva nirdeśārham | yadā tu vyakterniṣkṛṣṭarūpaṃ vivakṣitam, tadā bhānapratyayāntavācyaṃ śābaleyasya gotvamiti | jātāvapi hi padārthe dravyābhedaṃ gatāyā jāterabhidhānād gorgotvamiti pratītirbhinnā | guṇastu bhedenāpi kathyanta ityuktameva | tataśca tebhyo matupo lugucyate || 147 ||
anyathā, vyatireke ca satyevaṃ matupaḥ śravaṇaṃ bhavet | luganvākhyāyate tasmād rasādibhyaśca nāsti saḥ || 148 ||
`paṭasya śuklaḥ, iti bhede sati saṃbandhivṛttau matvarthīyapratyayenāsāvucyeta iti tatrāpi śukla ityeva yathā syāditi matupo lugucyate | `avyatirekāt siddhamiti ced dṛṣṭo vyatirekaḥ' iti hi bhedasaṃbandha eva luk samarthitaḥ | jātestu nāsti bhedasaṃbandha iti tadvacanād matub notpadyate | ayameva ca viṣayavibhāgo lug‌dvāreṇā- khyāyate abhidhānaśaktiniyamanimittaḥ | tataśca yathā śrūyamāṇe pratyaye prakṛtyarthāva- cchinnaḥ pratyayārtho'bhidhīyate, tathā lupte'pi śuklādāvityuktaṃ bhavati | rasādi- bhyaśca sa luṅ nāsti || 148 ||
na hi te matvarthīyarahitāḥ svāśrayamabhidhātuṃ śaknuvantītyāha-- yatso'yamiti saṃbandhādrūpābhedena vartate | śuklādivat tato lopastadrasādau na vidyate || 149 ||
vacanagrahaṇasāmarthyād ye guṇamuk‌tvā tadvati dravye so'yamiti saṃbandhena yādṛśā eva guṇamātre vṛttāstādṛśā eva vartante, tebhyo matupo lug vidhīyate, guṇamātravṛttitvasya darśanād guṇini vṛttimākhyātum | tatra nimittarūpāropeṇābhedavivakṣāyāṃ śuklādīnāṃ dravyābhidhānapakṣe bhedanimitta-sya matvarthīyasyāprāptau kiṃ lukā ? na ca `śuklaḥ paṭo vidyate yasya' ityatra bāhye vyatireke vivakṣite matupo lugiṣyata iti, śrautasyārthasyāyogāllākṣaṇi- ko'rtho'trāśrīyate | ye so'yamiti saṃbandhena guṇanimittadravyavacanā aviśiṣṭarūpā dṛṣṭāḥ, tebhyaḥ saṃprati guṇamātravṛttibhyo bhedasaṃbandhavivakṣāyāṃ matupaḥ śravaṇaṃ mā bhūditi luganvā- khyāyate | evañca rasādayo vyāvartitā bhavanti, yatastadrūpābhedena rasādiśabdānāṃ tadvati vartanaṃ nāsti | sadaiva hi te matvarthīyāntā eva svāśrayamācakṣate rasavān gandhavāniti| tathā ca "rasādibhyaśca" iti pratipadamārabhyate matvarthīyaḥ | iniṭhanāvebhyo na dṛśyate iti punarmatubeva vidhīyate | tathā ca vārtikam `rasādibhyaḥ punarvacanamanyanivṛttyartham' iti | anyasya prakṛta- sya pratyayasya nivṛttyarthamityarthaḥ | rūpiṇyapsarā iti tu śobhāsaṃbandho gamyate, nacakṣurgāhyarūpaguṇasamavāyaḥ | `rasiko rājā' ityadau tu śrṛṅgārādirasasaṃbandho na rasane- ndriyagrāhyaguṇayogo vivakṣita iti `guṇāt' iti gaṇe viśeṣaṇād guṇaśabdebhya eva rasādibhya iniṭhanornivartanādanyatasto bhavata eva | uktena nyāyena tu lugaprasaṅgādanya- śabdena vārttike lugucyata ityapavyākhyānam || 149 ||
tadevamupakrama eva viśiṣṭadravyavivakṣāyāṃ svābhāvikametaditi guṇānāmāśrayeṇa saha so'yamityabhedasaṃbandhe siddhe liṅgasaṃkhye iti prātipāditam | atrāpi ca pakṣe sūtrasyopayogaṃ pratipādayitumupakramate-- āveśo liṅgasaṃkhyābhyāṃ kvacinmañcādivat sthitaḥ | so'yamityabhisaṃbandhe sa praṣṭhādau na vidyate || 150 ||
iha so'yamityabhedasaṃbandhaviṣaye samāropyamāṇasyārthāntare dvaitaṃ dṛśyate, āviṣṭa- liṅgasaṃkhyatātadabhāvaśca | tatra `mañcān yuvatīḥ paśya,vasāṃsi vā' ityatra mañcaśabdaḥ tātsthayāt samāropyamāṇo'jahatsvaliṅgasaṃkhya eva vartate svādheye | tathā giriprabha- vāsu nadīṣu sāmīpyād girirūpasamāveśena giriśabdo'jahatsvaliṅgasaṃkhya eva pravarta- māno dṛṣṭaḥ, girīn saritaḥ syandamānāḥ paśyeti | praṣṭhapracarādiśabdāstu svābhā- ryāyāṃ prasthānādikriyāsaṅgāt pravartamānāḥ parityaktasvaliṅgasaṃkhyā eva samāveśa- viṣayāliṅgasaṃkhyopādāyino dṛśyante | tathā ca praṣṭhī pracarīti strīliṅgenaiva samākhyāyate strī | tadatra dve api liṅgasaṃkhye parityakte nimittini pravartamānena praṣṭhādiśabdena | mañcādiśabdastukaścit svagataṃ liṅgamevāpādāyopacāratanimitte nimittini pravartate, mañcān yoṣito harītakyaḥ phalānīti | kaścit tu vacanamevānuvartate svagatan, khalatikaṃ vanānīti | kaścit punarde api liṅgasaṃkhye svagate samāśritya tadvati nimittini vartate śabdaḥ | tad yathā viṃśatirbrāhmaṇā ityādi | eṣa ca śabdaśaktisvābhāvyānniyamo viṣayavibhāgena siddhaḥ || 150 ||
śāstre'pyasyaivārthasyāsti jñāpakamityāha-- liṅgaṃ liṅgaparityāge sūtre pratyayaśāsanam | so'yamityabhisaṃbandhāt puṃśabde stryabhidhāyinī || 151 ||
"puṃyogādākhyāyām"  iti praṣṭhādibhyaḥ strīpratyayānuśāsanaṃ so'-yamityabhisaṃbandhena striyāṃ teṣāṃ parityaktasvaliṅgasaṃkhyānāṃ pravṛttirityasyā- rthasya jñāpakam | tathā hyākhyāgrahaṇādabhedasaṃbandhāt puṃśabdāḥ striyāṃ yo vartante, te gṛhya- nte, na tu bhedasaṃbandhena praṣṭhasyeyamiti taddhitāntāḥ | tathā ca bhāṣyam "nahi taddhitāntamākhyā bhavati" iti | sati taddhite pumā- khyānāmabhinnarūpāṇāmeva nāsti striyāṃ vṛttirityarthaḥ || 151 ||
tadevaṃ praṣṭhādīnāmeva śabdaśaktisvābhāvyāliṅgācca svaliṅgasaṃkhyāparityāge- nārthāntare vṛttiḥ, nānyeṣāmiti mañcādiśabdavacchuklādiśabdānāmapi so'yamityabhi- sabandhena dravye svaliṅgasaṃkhyānāmeva pravṛttiprasaṅge "viśeṣaṇānāṃ' iti sūtramāśrayaviśeṣagataliṅgasaṃkhyāsiddhayarthamārabhyata ityāha-- āśraye liṅgasaṃkhyābhyāmāśritaṃ vyapadiśyate | viśeṣaṇānāṃ cājāteriti śāstravyavasthayā || 152 ||
śabdaśaktisvābhāvyāt praṣṭhādivadāśrayaliṅgasaṃkhyopādāne siddhe "puṃyogādākh- yāyām'itivad `viśeṣaṇānāṃ' ityapi śāstramanuvādakam | tataścāśrayaviṣayābhyāṃ liṅgasaṃkhyābhyāmāśritaṃ śuklādiguṇarūpamabhidhīyate sāmānādhi- karaṇyānyathānupapattyeti sthitam || 152 ||
tathāhi-- nimittānuvādhāyitvād ye dharmā bhedahetuṣu | ta āśraye'pi vidyanta iti buddhirnivartyate || 153 ||
nimittād nimittavatyarthe nimittasarūpaḥ pratyayo jāyata iti nimitte śuklādinā guṇena nimittī dravyāviśeṣastirohitarūpo'bhidhīyata iti teṣu bhedahetuṣu nimitteṣu ye dharmāste tatrāśraye nimittini sarve prāptā iti yathā śuklādiśabdastatra pravartate, tathā tadgataliṅgasaṃkhyāprāptāvapi sūtrārambha ityarthaḥ | tathā ca śuklādiguṇagataliṅgavacanapratipattiḥ śāstreṇa nivāryate dravyasya guṇaśabdenāpyākhyāyamānasya svaliṅgasaṃkhyāmeva vyapadeśa iti | dṛṣṭo hi nimittagataliṅkasaṃkhyāyogo nimittini | tadyathā pañcālā iti kṣatriyāvacchedena nivāsasyābhidhīyamānasya bahutvam | godau grāma iti godasāmīpye- nābhidhīyamānasya grāmasya dvitvam || 153 ||
nanu ca pañcālā ityādau "lupi yuktavad vyaktivacane"iti śāstrānnimittagataliṅgasaṃkhyāyoga ityāśaṅkayāha-- ākhyāyate ca śāstreṇa lokarūḍhā svabhāvataḥ | nimittatulyā godādau pravṛttirliṅgasaṃkhyayoḥ || 154 ||
"godau grāmaḥ, pañcālā janapadaḥ' ityādau śabdaśaktisvābhāvyānnimittānuvidhānena nimittini śabdapravṛttirloke siddhā vacanena prakāśyate, na tu vacanameva śabda- śak‌tyādhānakṣamam | tathā ca "tadaśiṣyaṃ saṃjñāpramāṇatvāt‌"  iti pratyākhyātametat | saṃjñā hi saṃjñānaṃ laukikasaṃpratyayo rūḍhaḥ | kaścit kila śabdo nimittadharmeṇa tadvantamācaṣṭe, yathā mañcādiriti | śuklādāvapyevaṃ sandehe praṣṭhādivannimittidharmeṇārthābhidhānam `viśeṣaṇānāṃ' iti vacanena prakāśyate || 154 ||
yataśca śabdaśaktireva vacanenānugamyate, tato viṣayavibhāgo'tra siddha ityāha-- harītakyādiṣu vyaktiḥ saṅkhayā khalatikādiṣu | manuṣyalubviśeṣāṇāmabhidheyāśrayaṃ dvayam || 155 ||
uktamidaṃ vārttike--"harītakyādiṣu vyaktiḥ khalatikādiṣu vacanaṃ manuṣyalupi pratiṣedhaḥ" iti| tatra vācanikatve liṅgasaṃkhyayonirnibandhano'yaṃ viṣayavibhāgaḥ | anena hi vacanena svabhāvasiddha evākhyāyate'rthaḥ, vacanasyārthaprabhāvane śak‌tya- bhāvāditi harītakyaḥ phalāni nakharajanyaḥ kāśāḥ drākṣā ityādiṣu liṅgameva nimitta- tulyam, saṃkhyā tvabhidheyanimittigataiveti phalānāṃ bahutvād bahuvacanameva bhavati | na hi pararūpasamārope tadviṣayasya sarvathaiva svarūpaṃ tirodhīyata iti phalasvarū- pasyātiraskārāt tadāśrayaṃ bahutvam | nimittasaṅkhayopādāne tu nāstyasya śabdasya śaktiḥ | tathā khalatikasya parvatasyādūrabhavāni vindhyasyādūrabhavānītyādau nimittagata- saṅkhayopādāne śabdasya śaktiḥ, liṅgaṃ tu nimittigatameva bhavatīti vanasya napuṃsakatvā- nnapuṃsakaṃ khalatikaṃ vanānītyādi | tathā cañceva manuṣyaścañcā manuṣya ityatra "lummanuṣye"  iti "ive pratikṛtau"  iti vihitasya kano lupi yāni viśeṣaṇānyupādīyante, abhirūpaḥ svākṛtirdarśanīya ityādīni, teṣāṃ viśeṣaṇānāmiti pañcālā bahvannā ityādivannimittakataliṅgasaṅkhayārūpaṃ bhavati | evañca nyāyasiddhe'smin prakaraṇe'jāterityetadapi pratyākhyātam | āviṣṭa- liṅgatvājjāteḥ pañcālā janapada iti janapadasya nimittaliṅgasaṅkhayānuvidhānaṃ na bhaviṣyati || 155 ||
yadapi vyākhyātamajāteriti jātiprayogaṃ vinā yāvadviśeṣaṇāni tāni lubantagata- liṅgasaṅkhayānuvidhāyīni, jātiviśeṣaṇāni tu na tatheti, tad vyācaṣṭe-- jātiprayoge jātyā cet sambandhamupagacchati | viśeṣaṇaṃ tato dharmāñ jātestat pratipadyate || 156 ||
kāmacārād viśeṣaṇenāvacchedasya yadā jātimabhisandhāya viśeṣaṇaṃ prayujyate, tadā tadgataliṅgasaṅkhayāsiddhiḥ, tadyathā--varaṇā nagaraṃ ramyopavanaṃ svacchodakaṃ sugandhikusumamiti || 156 ||
yadā tu lubantābhisandhānena viśeṣaṇaprayogaḥ, tadā-- lubante sannipatitaṃ jāteranyad viśeṣaṇam | lubantasya pradhānatvāt taddharmairvyapadiśyate || 157 ||
jātirāviṣṭaliṅgasaṅkhayeti tato'nyadviśeṣaṇaṃ lubantasamānādhikaraṇaṃ talliṅga- saṅkhayameva siddham | pañcālāḥ priyātithayaḥ spaṣṭābhidhānā vinītaveṣā bahvannāḥ janapadaḥ,godau sūkṣmakaṇṭakau vṛkṣa iti | evañca kṛtvā nārtha etadarthena sūtreṇeti `guṇavacanānāmāśrayato liṅgavacanāni bhavanti ityātrārthe sūtraṃ vyāpāritam | atrāpi yadāśritarūpamāśraye pratyasyate, tadāśritarūpasyodbhūtatvāt tacchabda- mivāśrayastaliṅgavacanamapi pratipadyeteti sūtrārambhaḥ | yadā tvāśrayarūpasyāśrite pratyāsaḥ, tadāśrayadharmapratipattireva yukteti svā- bhāvikametaditi pratyākhyātaṃ sūtram | āśrayadharmarūpasyāśrite'dhyāse hi paṭaśabdena śuklaguṇo'bhidhīyata iti tadgata eva liṅgasaṅkhayāyogo mukhyaḥ | na caivaṃ svaśabdena guṇasyābhidhānaṃ nivartata iti śuklaśabdena samānādhikaraṇena tulyaliṅgasaṅkhayenaiva bhavitavyam | aparaḥ kalpo vātrāramabhapratyākhyānayorvidvadbhiruktaḥ | tathāhi - nirāśrayasya guṇasyābhāvād yadāśrayamātre tasya niveśaḥ, tadā dravyasāmānyagata- liṅgavacanasarvanāmaprāptau sūtrārambhaḥ | yadā tu dravyaviśeṣavivakṣā pūrvameveti niyate dravye guṇasya niveśaḥ, tadā svā- bhāvikametaditi pratyākhyātam | upakrama eva hi prayogeṣveva vākye sādhutvaṃ prakramyata ityasti viśeṣapratyāyane śabdasya sāmarthyam | tṛtīyo'pyatra darśanabhedaḥ kāmacārād viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvasya | yadā guṇo viśeṣyate, tadā svagataliṅgasaṃkhyābhyāmeva prādhānyād yoge prāpte guṇigataliṅgasaṃkhyāsiddhaye sūtrārambhaḥ | yadyapi ca sūtre viśeṣaṇānāmityuktam, tathāpyatra guṇo viśeṣyo'pi prādhānye-nāśrayaṇāt svādhāraṃ pratyāśritatvādviśeṣaṇaṃ bhavatyeveti kathyate | asyāmapi pradhānadaśāyāṃ viśeṣaṇaśabdena āśritamātraṃ hyatra viśeṣaṇamabhipretam, na bhedakameva, asti ca viśeṣyatayā prādhānye'pi guṇasyāśritatvamiti na kaścid doṣaḥ | yadā tu guṇo viśeṣaṇam, tadā tasya pradhānānurodhitvādāśrayadharmapratipattirnyāya- siddheti svābhāvikametaditi pratyākhyānaśabdaḥ | tataśca nyāyasiddhārthapradarśanārtha- midaṃ sūtraṃ sakalaśāstravyāpakamiti || 157 ||
yeṣu bhāṣyavārttikaprayogeṣvasyopayogaḥ, tānudiśya krameṇa vicārayati-- nañsamāsabahurvīhidvandvastryatiśayeṣu ye | bhedā bhāṣyānusāreṇa vācyāste liṅgasaṃṅkhayayoḥ || 158 ||
eteṣu bhāṣyapradeśeṣvāśrayato liṅgalacanānyuktāni vicāryante | bhedā iti nimittānuvidhānena prāptānapodyāśrayato liṅgasaṃkhyāviśeṣā bhāṣye pratipāditā ihānugamyante || 158 ||
tatra prātilomyakrameṇa laghuktavyatvādatiśāyanasūtravārttikabhāṣyaṃ tāvad vyācaṣṭe-- yadi ṣaṣṭhīdvitīyāntānnikṛṣṭāt tarabādayaḥ | nyakkāriṇī syurutkṛṣṭe prakṛteḥ syāt viliṅgatā || 159 ||
"atiśāyane tamabiṣṭhanau" ityatra bahavaḥ pakṣāḥ, atiśāyanaśabdaḥ kartṛsādhanaḥ, karaṇasādhanaḥ, bhāvasodhano veti | atiśete ityatiśāyanaḥ | bahulavacanāt kartari lyuṭ | nipātanād dīrghaḥ | atiśete ityātiśāyano guṇakriyālakṣaṇo dravyā-śrayo dharmaḥ | dravyasya hi svataḥ prakarṣābhāvādāśritadharmadvārakaḥ so'yavasthāpitaḥ |tatra ca dharmāśrayo dharmī yadābhibhāvakatvena vivakṣyate, tadāsāvatiśete iti kartā pratyayārthaḥ | yadā tu dharmamātrasyātra vyāpāraḥ, tadā karaṇaṃ dharmamātraṃ pratyayārthaḥ | śuklenahi guṇena paṭo'nyānatiśeta iti sa evātiśāyano mukhyo guṇaḥ | ata eva tasya prayojakatvādatiśāyayatīti ṇyarthopapattau nirdeśo nyāyyaḥ | bhāvasādhane'pyatiśayanamatiśayaḥ prakarṣaḥ, sa cāśritaguṇanimitta iti sa eva guṇasta- mabādipratyayārtho'vatiṣṭhate, kriyālakṣaṇo vā dharmaḥ | eteṣu cārtheṣu pratyaye vidhīyamāne sāmarthyāt pratiyogino nikṛṣṭādasau bhavati | tatra ca viśiṣṭā prakṛtirnopātteti ṅyāpprātipadikasāmānyaṃ nikṛṣṭavāci prakṛtitvenāvatiṣṭhate | samarthavibhaktiśca sūtre nopāttetyuktam--`kimantāt punarutpattyā bhavitavyam' iti | tatra `dvitīyāntādatiśayyamānāt' ityuktam | śetirakarmako'pyupasargavaśāt sakarmake'bhibhave vartata ityabhibhavitā pratyayārthaḥ | tasya nyūnenābhibhāvyena prakṛtya-rthena yoga ityapakṛṣṭavācinaḥ pratyayāḥ | sūtreṣu ca yena kenacicchabdenārthanirdeśa iti | yadā tiṅantena vākyam tadā karmaṇi nyūne dvitīyā nyāyyeti dvitīyāntādityāha | yadā kṛndantenaiva vākyam, tadā kṛtprayoge karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhīti ṣaṣṭhayantādapi sambhavo'tra vyākhyātaḥ | "ṣaṣṭhayā rupya ca"  ityato vā ṣaṣṭhī samarthavibhaktiranuvartata eva | arthābhedaścātrobhayatrāpi samarthavibhaktāvityevaṃ parametat| bhāṣye tu kṛdyogaṣaṣṭhayāḥ kartaryapi bhāvājasandehena karma dvitīyāyā evāvagamyata iti dvitīyāntādityuktam | evamatra pratyayārthāviśeṣaṇapakṣe prakṛtipratyayārtha-yorbhedāt prakṛteryalliṅgaṃ tadviparītaṃ pratyayārthasya prasajyeta || 159 ||
tāmeva bhinnaliṅgatāmudāharaṇenāpyabhivyanakti-- kālyāṃ kālād dvitīyāntāt kāle kālyāstarab bhavet | nyakkartari tathā gārgye gargebhyaḥ pratyayo bhavet || 160 ||
kālamatiśete, tasya vātiśāyinī kālīti dvitīyāntāt ṣaṣṭhayantād vātiśayya- mānādatiśayitari pratyaye kālatarā kālīti prāpnoti | kālatireti ceṣyate | tathā kālīmatiśete, tasyā vātiśāyanaḥ kāla ityatra kālitara iti prāpnoti | kālatara iti ceṣyate | viliṅgateti cātropalakṣaṇam | vibhinnasaṅkhayatā ca prasajyate | tathāhi--gargānatiśete gārgya iti | tatra nyakkartari gargatara iti prāpnoti | gārgyatara iti sādhuriṣyate | gārgyamatiśerate gargā iti | teṣvatiśāyakeṣu gārgyād vidhau gārgyatarā iti prāpnoti | gargatarā iti ceṣyate | atra ca vṛttau saṅkhayāviśeṣa pratītirlugalugbhyāmeva pratīyata iti bhavatyekavacanabahuvacanāntāt tarabiti pūrvameva nirṇītam | evaṃ pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇapakṣo duṣṭo'bhihito bhāṣye | tadanantarameva `tarhi prathamā- ntāt svārthiko bhaviṣyati' iti prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇapakṣo'bhyupagataḥ | tathā hyatiśete'tiśāyana iti "kutyalyuṭo bahulam"iti kartaryevātiśāyanaśabdaḥ | tatra pratyayavācyasya vyatirekahetorabhāvādantaraṅgā prātipadikārthamātrāpekṣā prathamā tadantād vidhiḥ | arthāntarānirdeśācca svā- rthirāstarabādayaḥ | atiśāyane yad vartate, tasmāt pratyayaḥ svārthe | kālī atiśete kālitarā | kālo'tiśete kālatara iti viliṅgatā na bhavati, tathā gārgyo'tiśete gārgyatara iti | gargā atiśerate gargatarā iti visaṅkhayatāpi na bhavati || 160 ||
kintvidamatrāniṣṭamuktaṃ--yadi prathamāntāt svārthikaḥ, kumāritarā | avyati- riktaṃ vaya iti kṛtvā "vayasi prathame" iti ṅīp prāpnoti | tadetad vyācaṣṭe-- nyakkartṛṣu ca gargeṣu gārgyāt syāt tacca neṣyate | kumāryāḥ svārthike ṅīp syāt prakṛtyartho hi nādhikaḥ || 161 ||
kumārī atiśete, kiśorī atiśeta iti kumāritarā, kiśoritarā iti "vayasi prathame'iti ṅīp syāt, svārthikatve tarapaḥ prakṛtyarthasya prathamavayo'-vacchinnastrīlakṣaṇasyānatirekāt | na hi prathamena ṅīpābhivyaktātiśāyanasya strītve dyotitam | nanu ca tarapā kumāryarthasyaiva prakarṣaprakāśanāt prakṛṣṭasyārthasya strītvamavaga-tameva | tathā ca bhāṣyaṃ--"tarapoktatvāt tasyārthasya na bhaviṣyati" iti | strītvavata eva prakṛṣyamāṇatvāt tarabantenaiva dyotitameva strītvamiti ṅīb na bhaviṣyatītyarthaḥ| atra coditam--`ṭābapi tarhi na prāpnoti" iti | abhihitārthatvaṃ sarvastrī- pratyayānutpattinimittaṃ samānamityarthaḥ | atra parihāro'bhihitaḥ--`ukte'pi hi bhavantyete svārthikāṣṭābādayaḥ' iti | ayamarthaḥ--striyāṃ yad‌vartate prātipadikam, tasmāt svārthe ṭābādayo vihitāḥ|evañca yathā prātipadikārthasya sarvaliṅgasādhāraṇyādupāttamapi prātipadikena strītvaṃniyamena na pratīyeteti prathamena strīpratyayena tad dyotyate, tathā kumāritaretyasati ṭāpi viparītārthāvagamaprasaṅga iti bhavatyasau, na tu sarvathaivokte'navasthāprasaṅgāt svārthīkenāpi bhavitavyam | yadyevaṃ ṭābapavādo ṅībapi prāpnotītyuktaṃ bhāṣya iti codyameva | nanu ca prathamenaiva ṅīpā prathamavayo'vacchedasyoktatvāt strītvamātrābhivyak‌- tyarthaṃ ṭābeva nyāyyaḥ | naitadasti, arthānuguṇyāt ṅīp eva nyāyyatvam | tadyathā--eko dvau bahava ityatroktārthāpi prathamā samayād bhaviṣyatītyukte coditam--`yadi sāmayikī na niyogato'nyā api kasmānna bhavanti iti | tatra parihāro'bhihitaḥ--`arthato vyavasthā iti | na kevalā prakṛtiḥ prayoktavyeti prayoganiyamānupālanāyāṃ vibhaktau yadyapi na kaścidarthānurodhaḥ, tathāpyanugatārthatvāt prathamaiva nyāyyetyarthaḥ | atra darśane tatra yatre tyādāvapi saptamyeva nyāyyā | evamihāpi prakramābhedārthaṃ ṅībeva nyāyya iti yuktamuktaṃ ṅībapi tarhi prāpno-tīti | antareṇāpi ca tarabādīn prakaraṇādivaśāt kevalāpi prakṛtiratiśayamupagamaya- tīti | prakaraṇādyabhāve'tiśayaṃ dyotayanto bhavantyeva svārthikāstarabādayo na vācakāḥ | tathāhi-svatantramarthanyānapekṣaṃ gamayanto vācakāḥ kathyante śabdāḥ | tadapekṣāstu tadgatamarthaṃ dyotayantaḥ svārthikāḥ | tatreva ca (tasyaiva ca) dyotane'trānvayavyati-rekau savyāpārau | `paṭutaro devadattaḥ paṭukalpaḥ paṭurūpaḥ' iti ca samānādhikaraṇyāt prakṛtipratyayārthayoḥ prakṛtyarthānuvāditvena svārthikatvameṣāṃ tarabādīnāṃ niścīyate | vācakeṣu tu yañādiṣu gargasyāpatyaṃ gārgya iti vyadhikaraṇatvam, na `yāvat kālī tāvat kālitara' ityasmād bhāṣyānna vācakatvāvasāyaḥ | anabhivyaktaprakarṣā hi kālī, saiva prakṛṣyamāṇā kālitareti prakarṣopādanānu- pādānalakṣaṇabhedāśrayeṇa bhāṣyapravṛtteḥ | tasmāllaukika evārtho niyato'vasthitaḥ śāśtre vācakadyotakapravibhāgenānuvidhīyate, na tu prakriyāgatā evāmī vikalpā nirastārthapravibhāgāḥ || 161 ||
evaṃ svārthikatve'pi doṣamudbhāvyānantaramabhihitam--`evaṃ tarhi guṇo'bhidhīyate, athavā kriyābhidhīyata' iti | tadetad bhāṣyaṃ vyākhyātumāha-- ṣaṭhyantādadhike tasmād guṇe svāśrayavartini | utkṛṣṭasamavetāyāṃ kriyāyāṃ vā vidhīyate || 162 ||
karaṇasādhanenātiśāyanaśabdena guṇa ucyate'bhibhāvakaḥ | atiśayānamabhibhavantaṃ svāśrayaṃ prayojayatyatiśayayatītyatiśāyana iti vā ṇyantāt kartari lyuṭi guṇo'bhidhīyate | prakṛṣyamāṇena hi guṇena dravyasya samānaguṇāt prakarṣo bhavati, svataḥprakarṣābhāvāt | tena ca guṇena svāśrayasamavāyinā svāśrayavyatirekopajanāt prakṛti- rguṇāśrayavācinī ṣaṭhyantā bhavati guṇaḥ pratyayārthaḥ | śuklasyātiśāyano guṇaḥ śukla- taraḥ | svāśrayavartinīti ca vadannāśrayāntaravartini na bhavati pratyaya iti viliṅgatādi- pūrvoktadoṣo nāvataratītyāha | yadā tu bhāvasādhano lyuṭ atiśayo'tiśāyanamiti, tadā kriyā prakarṣākhyocyata ityetasyāṃ vācyāyāṃ pratyayaḥ | kriyopajanite ca vyatireke prakṛteḥ ṣaṣṭhī, śukla- syātiśāyanaṃ śuklatara iti | vyatiriktaścātra guṇakriyālakṣaṇaḥ pratyayārtha iti vayasvinyāḥ kumāryā viśeṣaṇatvenāprādhānyānna bhavati tadantād ṅīp‌- pratyayaḥ || 162 ||
atra pakṣe guṇakriyālakṣaṇo'rthaḥ pratyayavācyaḥ pradhānamiti dravyābhidhāyibhiḥ paṭādibhiḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyābhāvo bhāṣye kathaṃ na codita ityāha-- upāttaṃ ca prakṛtyartho dravyamevāśrayastayoḥ | so'yamityabhisaṃbandhādabhedena pratīyate || 163 ||
yadeva prakṛteḥ prātipadikasya vācyaṃ dravyamatra sannihitam, tadevānayorguṇā- kriyayoḥ pratyayavācyayoḥ so'yamitayabhedasambandhenāśrayaḥ pratīyata iti bhavati sāmānādhi- karaṇyam | prakarṣapratyayāntasya guṇakriyāmātre kadācidapi vṛttyadarśanāt kevalaṃ ṅīp‌pratisamādhānāya prakriyāyāṃ vyatirekārthatvaṃ karabāderupeyate | svārthikā eva tvime'tiśayadyotanāt | ata evātiśayaviśiṣṭasya dravyasyāti- śayapratyayāntenopādānāśrayato liṅgavacanāni bhavanti || 163 ||
nanu ca śuklaśabdenātra guṇopasarjanaṃ dravyamucyate | tarabantenāpyatiśayaviśiṣṭaṃ tadeva | tathā cāśritamātrasya konacidanabhidhānāt kasyāśritasyāśrayavālliṅgavacane syātāmityāśaṅkayāha-- rūpābhedācca tad dravyamākāṅkṣāvat pratīyate | viśeṣairbhinnarūpaistadāśrayairiva yujyate || 164 ||
iha śuklaśabdena guṇopasarjanaṃ dravyamātramucyate | tadevātiśayaviśiṣṭaṃ tarabante- neti viśeṣeṣu tasmāt paṭādiṣu na pratipattiḥ, sādhāraṇyāt sarvaviśeṣeṣu dravyamā- trasya | tathā ca tat paṭādīn viśeṣānapekṣamāṇaṃ pratīyata iti te tasyāpekṣyamāṇā viśeṣā vilakṣaṇā bahiraṅgā paścātsaṃbadhyamānatvādāśrayatvena vyavahriyante | tacca tadāśritatvena || 164 ||
tataśca-- bhinnarūpeṣu yalliṅgaṃ viśeṣeṣu vyavasthitam | saṃkhyā ca tābhyāṃ dravyātmā so'bhinno vyapadiśyate || 165 ||
sa nirviśeṣo'rthātmā gaṇavacanaśabdenocyata iti tasya saṃbadhyamānaviśeṣagata- liṅgasaṃkhyātideśaḥ sūtreṇa pratipādyata iti tābhyāmāśrayaliṅgasaṃkhyābhyāmupalakṣitaḥ pratipādyate | evaṃ guṇapakṣe tasya svāśrayavṛttitvāt tadgatameva vacanamupapadyate | kriyāpakṣe tu tasya yaścaivātiśete yaścātiśayyate ubhau tāvāśrayau bhavata ityevamapi dvivacanaṃ prāpnotī'ti coditaṃ bhāṣye | atrottaramabhihitam--`śetirakarmaka' iti || 165 ||
atra paryunuyogaḥ--`akarmakā api dhātavaḥ sopasargāḥ sakarmakā bhavanti iti | siddhāntavādinā tu yenābhiprāyeṇākarmaka ityuktam, tadāviṣkaroti--`karmāpadiṣṭā vidhayaḥ karmasthabhāvakānāṃ karmasthakriyāṇām,' `kartṛsthabhāvakaḥ śetiḥ, iti kila samavāyikāraṇamasya karma nāstītyevamakarmako'bhihitaḥ | tadetad vyācaṣṭe-- āśrayaḥ samavāyī ca nimittaṃ liṅgasaṃkhyayoḥ | kartṛsthabhāvakaḥ śetirato bhāṣya udāhṛtaḥ || 166 ||
kriyā yatra samavaiti, sa tasyā āśrayaḥ | sa caika evetyekavacanaṃ bhavati | abhibhavanaṃ hyatra śetyarthaḥ kartari samavaiti, na karmaṇyabhibhāvye | yatkiñcit karma nimittatayābhihitaṃ tat karmaṇyapadiṣṭamiti dvivacanamapi karmāpadiṣṭo bhāṣya uktaḥ || 266 ||
karmaikatvāpekṣeṇa hi karturekatvena dvitvasyātra jananaṃ syāt | yadi karmāpya-samavāyi gṛhyetetyāha-- nimittamāśrayatvena gṛhyeta yadi sādhanam | karmāpadiṣṭayoḥ prāptistatra syālliṅgasaṃkhyayoḥ || 167 ||
`guṇavacanānāmāśrayato liṅgavacanāni bhavanti' ityatrāśrayaśabdena yadi nimitta- mātrāmucyeta, tadā kriyāyā ātmalābhe dvayamapekṣyate kartṛkarmarūpamatra sādhanamiti syāt karmāpekṣayāpi tadgataṃ liṅgam | tadapekṣya dvitvorajananācca dvivacanam | abhibhavohyabhibhāvyamapekṣate | tatra kartṛkarmasthatvena ca kriyāyāḥ prasiddhatvānna karaṇādyapekṣayā bahuvacanaprasaṅgaścoditaḥ | tadevamatiśāyanabhāṣyaṃ liṅgavacanātideśa- vicāraprasaṅgena vyākhyātam || 167 ||
idānīṃ tenaiva prātilomyakrameṇa strīsūtravārttikabhāṣyaṃ liṅgavacanātideśāvi-cāraprasaṅgena vyākhyātumāha-- śāstre nirmittabhāvena samudāyādapod‌ghṛtaḥ | stryarthastasyecchayā yogaḥ prakṛtyā pratyayena vā || 168 ||
sthitalakṣaṇo laukiko'rthaḥ strītvaviśiṣṭadravyasvabhāvo niraṃśāt padāt pratī-yate | tasya tu padasya prakṛtipratyayaparikalpanayānvākhyāne tayoḥ prakṛtipratyayayorava- yavaranuśāsanāṅgatvena prakṛtyarthapratyayārthatayā niraṃśo'pyasāvartho vibhajyate | tatra samit, dṛṣadityādau prātipajikamātreṇāpi strītvapratipādanaṃ dṛṣṭam, gaurī, kiśorītyādau pratyayasahitena, ityanvayavyatirekāyorniyamābhāvādanvākhyātu- ricchayā prayogānurodhinyā prakṛtipratyayārthatayā tadvimarśaḥ || 168 ||
tathāhi-- strīśabdo guṇaśabdatvāt tulyadharmā sitādibhiḥ | guṇamātre prayujyate saṃstyānavati vāśraye || 169 ||
saṃstyānaṃ rūpādīnāṃ saṃhananaṃ guṇaḥ, tatra vā strīśabdo vartate, tadvati vā guṇinīti śuklādiśabdaistulyaḥ | te'pi hi paṭasya śuklaḥ paṭa ityādau guṇamātre guṇini ca dṛṣṭaprayogāḥ | evañca "striyām" iti nirdeśe yadā guṇamātravṛttiḥ strīśabdaḥ, tadā prāti-padikāt strītve guṇe vartamānāt pratyaya iti prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇapakṣe bhavati | abhidheye strītve ṭābādaya iti tu pratyayārthapakṣo jāyate | yadā tu tadvati vṛttiḥ, tadā saṃstyānavati dravye vartamānāt prātipadikāt svārthe ṭābādaya iti prakṛtyarthapakṣo bhavati | atra tu pakṣe yathā śukalādayo guṇaṃ nimittīkṛtya tadvati vartante, naivaṃ kiñcit prātipadikamasti, yasya dravye vṛttau strītvaṃ nimittam | strīśabda eva hi tathā | tata eva vidhau sarvaprakṛtisādhāraṇyena "striyām" ityapārthako nirdeśaḥ syāt | ataḥ striyāṃ strīśabdapratyāyite'rthe yat prātipadikaṃ vartata iti strīśabdena prātipadikārtha upalakṣyate || 169 ||
tataśca kumāraḥ strīti strīśabdasamānādhikaraṇe'rthe vartamānāt prātipadikādi- tyaye pakṣo(pratyayo) jāyate | sa cāniṣṭa ityuktam--`strīsamānādhikaraṇāditi ced, bhūtādiṣvatiprasaṅgaḥ | ṣaṭsaṃjñakebhyaśca pratiṣedhaḥ' iti | tadetad vyācaṣṭe-- stryarthaḥ saṃstyānavad dravyaṃ prakṛtyarthaśca yadyasau | dravyopalakṣaṇārthatvaṃ saṃstyānasya tathā sati || 170 ||
saṃstyānena nimittabhūtenāvacchinnaṃ saṃstyānavat | tathā satīti saṃstyānanimi- ttasyārthasya strīśabdena nirdeśa sati dravyasya śabdāntaropādānasya saṃstyānamu- palakṣaṇaṃ bhavet | tannimitte'rthe kasyacidapyapravṛtterityabhiprāyaḥ || 170 ||
evaṃ sati ko doṣa ityāha-- saṃstyānena kvacid dravyaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ yadupalakṣitam | anaṅgīkṛtasaṃstyānāt tad‌vṛtteḥ pratyayo bhavet || 171 ||
anaṅgīkṛtamanupāttaṃ vācyatvena saṃstyānaṃ strītvaṃ yena tad‌vṛtteḥ strīśa-bdasannidhāpite'rthe vartamānāt prātipadākāt pratyayaḥ prasajyeta | bahiraṅgasyaiva padāntaropalakṣitārthasyānvākhyāne nimittatvenāpekṣaṇāt || 171 ||
atrodaharaṇamāha-- bhūtādayaḥ ṣaḍākhyāśca saṃstyānenopalakṣite | brāhmaṇyādau yadā vṛttāstebhyaḥ syuḥ pratyayāstadā || 172 ||
yathākumāraḥ strīti strīśabdapratayāyite'rthe kumāraśabdo vṛttaḥ strīprat-yayamasmin pakṣe pratipadyate | tathā bhūtamiyam, kāraṇamiyam, āvapanamiyaṃ brāhmaṇītyatra bhūtādiśabdebhyo brāhmaṇīśabdopalakṣitastrītve'rthe vartamāne- bhyaṣṭāp syāt | tathā pañca ṣaṭ sapta nava daśa brāhmaṇya iti pañcādibhyaḥ strīpratyayaprasaṅge "na ṣaṭsvastrādibhyaḥ" iti pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ syāt | prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇapakṣe strītvavacanāṭṭābādirityanaṅgīkṛtasaṃstyānānna bhavatīti strīsamānādhikaraṇapakṣa evāyaṃ doṣaḥ || 172 ||
tathāhi-- tadvanto hi pradhānatvāt pratyayānāṃ prayojakāḥ | sāmānādhikaraṇye'pi tasmāṭṭābādisambhavaḥ || 173 ||
atra pakṣe saṃstyānābhidhānaṃ prātipadikena nāśrīyate pratyayotpattau | api tu saṃstyānavantaḥ strīśabdopalakṣitā arthāḥ pradhānāni pratyayānāṃ pravartakā ityu-pasarjanatvāt saṃstyānasya padāntareṇa bāhyena samānādhikaraṇatve'pi tathābhūtasya saṃstyānasya pratīteṣṭābādayo bhaveyureva | na hyetadatra śakyate vaktum--kathaṃ padāntaragamyo'rthaḥ śabdasaṃskāre nimittamiti |tathābhūtasyaiva vacanenāśrayaṇāt || 173 ||
evaṃ hi strīsamānādhikaraṇapakṣaṃ dūṣayitvā `siddhaṃ tu striyāḥ prātipadikaviśeṣaṇa-tvāt svārthe ṭābādayaḥ' iti prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇapakṣo'bhihitaḥ | etadutthānabījamāha-- guṇamātrābhidhāyitvaṃ strīśabde varṇyate yadā | prakṛtyarthaśca saṃstyānaṃ svārthikāḥ pratyayāstadā || 174 ||
saṃstyānamātraṃ yadā strīśabdavācyam, tacca prātipadikaviśeṣaṇamiti, tadā strītve vartamānāt prātipadikāṭṭābādaya ityarthasya teṣāmanyasyānirdeśāt svārthikatvaṃ bhavati | yadā tu strītve'bhidheye ityarthaḥ, tadā pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇa- pakṣo jāyate || 174 ||
nanu ca strītvamātre kasyacit prātipadikasya vṛttyasambhavāt kathaṃ prakṛtyartha-viśeṣamapakṣo bhavatītyāha-- saṃstyāne kevale vṛttiḥ prakṛtīnāṃ na vidyate | tadāviṣṭe tato dravye gṛhyante samavasthitāḥ || 175 ||
laukiko'rthaḥ sthitalakṣaṇo'nvākhyānāṅgamupādīyamāno yathāsambhavamasau gṛhyata iti `striyām' ityukte'pi strītvamātre prātipadikasya vṛttyadarśanāt sāmarthyāt tadviśiṣṭārthābhidhāyinaḥ prātipadikād vidhirvijñāyate || 175 ||
tathā ca tena strītvenāviṣṭe sambhinne dravye vartamānāḥ pratyayamutpādayan- tīti pūrvadoṣānavatāra ityāha-- upakāri ca saṃstyānaṃ yeṣu śabdeṣvapekṣitam | tebhyaṣṭābādayastacca bhūtādiṣvavivakṣitam || 176 ||
vācyatvenopayogi yeṣu śabdeṣu. tebhyaṣṭābādaya ityupalakṣaṇabhūtaṃ yeṣu saṃstyānaṃ tebhyo bhūtādibhyaḥ pratyayābhāva ityarthaḥ | taduktaṃ bhāṣye--`bhūtamiyaṃ brāhmaṇī' iti | `nātra strītvaṃ vivakṣitam, kiṃ tarhi pautanyam' iti | strītve vācye vivakṣite bhavatyeva pratyayaḥ `bhūtā brāhmaṇī' iti | satyavādinī atītā vetyarthaḥ, na pautanyam | tathā ` kāraṇamiyaṃ brāhmaṇī' iti prādhānyaṃ vivakṣitam | `āvapanami- yamuṣṭrikā' iti sambhavanam | ādheyapramāṇādādhārasya pramāṇānatireko vivakṣitaḥ | pañcādīnāmapi bhedagaṇanātmikā saṅkhayā vācyā, na strītvamiti tebhyaḥ strīpratyayāprasaṅgāt tataḥ pratiṣedhaḥ pratyākhyātaḥ | evaṃ nirdoṣaḥ prakṛtyartha-viśeṣaṇapakṣo'vasthāpitaḥ || 176 ||
tṛtīyo'pi pakṣo'bhihitaḥ `athavā punarastu striyāmabhidheyāyām' iti pratyayārtha-tvaṃ strītvasya | atra pakṣe sambhāvanābījamupanyasya doṣamabhihitaṃ vyācaṣṭe-- saṃstyānaṃ pratyayasyārthaḥ śuddhamāśrīyate yadā | tadā dvivacanānekapratyayatvaṃ na sidhyati || 177 ||
śuddhaṃ kevalaṃ dravyaviśeṣaṇabhāvamanāpannaṃ yadā saṃstyānaṃ striyāmiti nirdiṣṭaṃ pratyayārthatvenāśrīyate, tadā tasyaikatvāt kumāryau kumārya iti dvivacanabahuvacane nasyātām | ekasya ca saṃstyānasya pratyāyane strīpratyayo bhavanneka eva syāditi `gārgyā- yaṇī, kārīṣagandhyā, kālitara' ityādāvanekaḥ strīpratyayo na syāt | taduktaṃ vārttike--`striyāmiti stryarthābhidhāna iti ced dvivacanabahuvacanāne-kapratyayānupapattiḥ' iti || 177 ||
atha `tisro jātaya evaitāḥ sarvatra samavasthitāḥ' iti darśane strītvajātiratra nirdiṣṭā pratyayārthatvena | tasyāśca vyaktibhedena `gāvau gāvaḥ' ityādivad vacanabhedo yokṣyata ityāśaṅkayāha-- jātiścet strītvamevāsau bhedo'nyatrāvivakṣitaḥ | yasmād bhinnairapi dravyaistadekaṃ sad viśiṣyate || 178 ||
striyāmiti pratyayārthatvena jātinirdeśe `prakṛtipratyayau pratyayārthaṃ saha brūta' iti tasyā eva prādhānyena vivakṣitatvādanyatra vyaktau yo dvitvabahutvā- khyo bhedo viśeṣaḥ, sa nātra pratipādyatvena vivakṣitaḥ | yatastat strītvamekaṃ sad bhinnairbahubhiḥ prakṛtivācyairāśrayabhūtairdravyaiḥ saṅkhayābhedavadbhiravacchidyata iti pradhānabhūtapratyayāvācyastrītvaikatvāśrayamekavacanameva nyāyyam | `gāvau gāvaḥ' ityādau tu jātyāveśena vyaktīnāmabhidhānād yukto vacanabhedaḥ ||178|| atha guṇāvasthā liṅgamityasmin darśane avasthānāṃ bhedād vacanabhedo bhaviṣya- tītyata āha-- mātrāṇāṃ hi tirobhāve parimāṇaṃ na vidyate | kumārya iti tena syāt kumāryāṃ bhedasambhavāt || 179 ||
mātrāṇāṃ sattvādiguṇamayānāṃ rūparasādīnā tirobhāve pratilaye'pacaye'tra saṃst- yānalakṣaṇe strītve vivakṣite'vasthābhedāśrayeṇa vacanabhede kathyamāne'vasthābhedānāme-katrāpīyattānavadhāraṇāt sadaiva kumārya iti bahuvacanānta eva prayogaḥ syāt | tadarthasya saṃstyānasya bahutvasambhavāt | calaṃ hi guṇavṛttamiti pariṇāmasya kṣaṇikatvādavasthābhedaḥ sadātanaḥ | avasthābhedānādareṇa pratyayānuvṛttikārya mekaṃ cet strītvaṃ, tadā jātipakṣādasyā-bheda iti niyogata ekavacanaṃ syāt | ata eva cātrāpi jātereṣaṇīyatvāt phalata ekapakṣībhāvaṃ manyamānaḥ pūrvoktārtho- papādanahetudyotanaṃ hiśabdaṃ paṭhati, na samuccayārthaṃ cakāram | yathā cātra pakṣe dvivacana- bahuvacanānekapratyayānutpattidoṣaḥ, tathā dravyeṇa sāmānādhikaraṇyābhāvo'pi | tathā cāsyāḥ kumārīti syāt | saṃstyānasya ca dharmamātratvāt kriyāyogo na kalpate, alaṅkriyāyāṃ kumārīti || 179 ||
tadatra pratisamādhānamuktaṃ vārttikakṛtā--`guṇasya cāśrayato liṅgavacanabhāvād' iti | tadetad vyākhyātumupakramate-- jātisaṅkhayāsamāhārairyāthaiva sahacāriṇi | dravye kriyāḥ pravartante ekātmatve'pyapekṣite || 180 ||
mūrtibhyo mūrtidharmāṇāṃ tathā'bhedasya darśanāt | sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ ca kriyāyogaśca kalpate || 181 ||
`gaurduhyatām, brāhmaṇaśataṃ bhojyatām, pañcapūlī samānīyatām' ityādau jāti- saṅkhayāsamāhāraiḥ śabdopādānāt karaṇabhūtaiḥ svātmanyasambhavādavinābhāvini dravye kriyāḥ kriyante, jātitadvatoḥ samavāyād bhedasya pracchādane'bhede nirūpite, dharmadha-rmiṇorapi tathaiva vivekānavasāyāt tattvato bhede'pyekātmatve buddhayā nirūpite sati|evaṃ mūrtibhyo vastubhyastaddharmāṇāṃ saṃstyānādīnāmabhedasya dravyādavyatirekasya pratibhāsanāt sāmānādhikaraṇyam, dravyeṇa kriyāyogaśca kalpate | svabhāvāddhi pratyayena dravyād vyatirekeṇa strītvaṃ na pratyāyyate | prakriyāyāṃ tu pratyayārthapakṣāpoddhāraḥ | `sarvāśca punarmūrtaya evamātmikāḥ saṃstyānaprasavaguṇāḥ' iti bhāṣye mūrtiśabdena vastumātrasyābhidhānādihāpi mūrti- śabdena vastumātraṃ lakṣyate | digādīnāmamūrtānāmapi strītvākhyasya dharmasya sambhavāt || 180,181 ||
kecidāhuḥ--`luptamatvarthīyāḥ kumāryādayo dravyavacanaiḥ samānādhikaraṇā bhavanti' iti | tanmatamapākaroti-- sāmānādhikaraṇye tu matublopādapekṣite | luk taddhitalukīti syālluk tatrāpyupalakṣaṇam || 182 ||
saṃstyānalakṣaṇadharmamātravacanaḥ strīpratyayānta iti guṇavacanatvānmatupo lukā śukladivad dravyasāmānādhikaraṇye'ṅgīkriyamāṇe "luk taddhitaluki" iti strīpratyayasya lukprasaṅgaḥ | atha sarvadā dravyasyaiva strīpratyayāntaiḥ pratyāyanāt strīpratyayasyālug bhaviṣyati, na tu matupa eva | evaṃ hi strīpratyayasya lug naiva prāpnoti | tasmād vināpi matupaṃ svabhāvādevadravyasya strītvābhedena pratyāyanam | tathā ca yatrāpi matupo lugārabdaḥ śaklādau, tatrāpi svārthāvacchinnapratyāyanaśaktiṃ prakṛtereva jñāpayitumityupalakṣaṇaṃ tatra luk | asati tu tathārthābhidhāne lukāpi kiṃ kṛtyam | evaṃ pratyayārthapakṣe guṇavacanatvādabhedopacārādāśrayeṇa saha tatsāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ vacanabhedaścopapāditaḥ| anekaśca pratyayo bhavati svabhāvād dravyopasarjanasya strītvasya kvacidanekapratyayena pratipādanāt||182|| pratyayārthapakṣa eva sāmānādhikaraṇyādyapareṇa prakāreṇa samarthayitumāha- keṣāñcit tyaktabhedeṣu dravyeṣveva vidhīyate| saṃstyānavatsu ṭābādirabhedena samanvayāt||183|| saṃstyānavatsu dravyeṣu "striyām"  iti strīśabdasya tadvati vṛttimā- śritya pratyayārthapakṣe'pi ṭābādirvidhīyate| strīpratyayāntāddhi niyogatoṃ dravyaṃ pratīyata ititadeva pratyayavācyaṃ nyāyyaṃ kalpayitum| yadyevamekaṃ prakṛtya- rthabhūtaṃ dravyamaparaṃ pratyārthabhūtamiti dravyadvayapratītiprasaṅgaḥ| na ca bhedena dravyadvayaṃ pratīyate| prakṛtipratyayārtha dvayoḥ parasparamanabhisambandhaprasaṅga ityāśaṅkyoktam- yaktabhedeṣviti| yasmādavidyāmanaviśeṣeṇārthenāvirodhād bhavati prakṛtivācyasya viśeṣasyābhi- sambandho'bhedena, sarvatra strītyevamākārasaṃvinnibandhanena sāmānyenāvagamāt| tasmāt prakṛtipratyayavācyatayā sāmānyaviśeṣakalpanayā dravyebhedaḥ| prakṛtivācyaṃ hi viśiṣṭaṃ dravyam, pratyayavācyaṃ tu dravyasāmānanyam| tadeva ca prakṛtyarthāvacchinnaṃ viśeṣamāsādayati| tathāhi- prakṛtivācyānāṃ dravyaviśeṣāṇāṃ strītyevamabhedo'nugataḥ pratītayata iti prātīkiko'yaṃ bhedaḥ prakṛtipratyayārthayoḥ, na tu parasparāsaṃbaddhau dvau dravyātmā- nau||183|| tathāhi- sāmānyabhūto dravyātmā paricchinnaparigrahaḥ| kriyābhiryujyate bhedairbhāgaścāvatiṣṭhate||184|| prakṛtivācyena dravyaviśeṣeṇāvacchedād buddhyā parikalpitaḥ pratyayavācyo dravyātmā sāmānyamiva, na tu sāmānyameva| ekapadanibandhanena hi viśeṣeṇoparāgānna sāmānyatmani dravyamatrāvatiṣṭhate| api tu paricchinnaparigrahaḥ| eva?ñca kṛtvā kriyāyogo'sya na virūddhaḥ| taiśca prakṛtivācyairbhedairvi- śeṣaistasya samūharūpasya sarvatrānugatatvāt sāmānyasya bhāgairivāvacchedāt tad‌rūpatayāvasthānamiti sāmānādhikaraṇyamapi yujyate| ayamatrāśayaḥ- prakṛtipratyayasudāyād viśiṣṭaṃ dravyaṃ pratīyata iti tatrāpoddhāre prakriyāyāṃ kalpanayā sāmānyaviśeṣabhāvena bhedamāśritya prakṛtyarthapratyayārthatvamava-sthāpyate| tadeva dravyaṃ prakṛterarthādanyasmād bhedenāvadhāryamāṇaṃ viśeṣaṣṭābādera- rthasya- strītyanuyāyinā svabhāvenānugamyamānaṃ sāmānyamiti| laukike tu prayoge viśeṣaparyavasānaiva pratipattiriti sarvamupapadyate||184|| tadevaṃ pratyayārthapakṣe prakāradvayena svāśrayato vacanamupapāditam| etadākṣipati- śuklādiṣvāśrayadravyaṃ prādhānyenābhidhīyate| strītvaṃ tu pratyayārthtavādabhidhāviṣayo yataḥ||185|| guṇopasarjanadravyavacanāḥ śuklādayo yuktaṃ yadāśrayagataliṅgasaṅkhyānuvartinaḥ, prā- dhānyādāśrayasya| strītvaṃ tu pratyayasya ṭābādarvācyaṃ prādhānyena| prakṛtya- rthastu dravyamatra guṇabhūtamiti kathamatra guṇadharmān pradhānaṃ pratipadyeta| "viśeṣaṇā- nāma"  ityapi sūtreṇa viśeṣyavad viśeṣaṇānāṃ vyaktivacane atidiśyete, na tu viśeṣaṇavad viśeṣyāṇām| abhidhāviṣaya iti| satyapi vāstave dravyasya prādhānye na śabdāstadanurudhyante, api tu svasāmarthyānurupameṣāmabhidhāna-mityarthaḥ||185|| etat pariharati- so'yamityabhisambandhādāśrayaṃ pratipadyate| strītvaṃ svabhāvasiddho vā guṇabhāvaviparyayaḥ||186|| yadyapi prakriyāyāṃ strītvaṃ pratyayārtha iti vyavasthāpyate, tathāpi śabdaśaktasva-bhāvād guṇabhāvasyeha viparyayo vaiparītyaṃ dṛśyate| strītvasyāprādhānyam, dravyasya tu prādhānyamiti| na hi sarvatra pratyayārthaḥ pradhānam| tadyathā- sādhane vidhīyamānāstiṅo nākhyāte sādhanaṃ prādhānyenācakṣate, api tu kriyopasarjanam| saṃkhyāyāṃ vidhīyamānāścavibhaktayaḥ saṃkhyeyopasarjanaṃ tāmācakṣate| dīvyatyādiṣu ca vidhīyamānāṣṭhagādayaḥ kriyā- vantamabhidadhati prādhānyeneti sarvata śabdaśaktirevānusaraṇīyā| evañcāśrayasyaiva prādhānyāt tatsaṃkhyātropapadyate| yadvā yadyapi saṃstyānamātramabhidheyaṃ pratyasya, tathāpi tenopacaritā bhedāḥ prakṛtyartha vyaktīḥ pratyayānto'bhidhatta iti siddhaṃ vacanam| tadevaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇye trayaḥ prakārāḥ| dravyādanatiriktasya strītvasya pratyāyanam, tadyathā- `mūrtibhyo mūrtidharmāṇām' ityuktam|abhedopacāro dravyasya vā prādhānyamitīhoktam||186|| idānīṃ saṃstyānavad dravayasamānyābhidhānapakṣe'pyatra pratyayārthabhūtasyāpi sāmānyasya vāstavaguṇatvasaṃbhavād guṇavacanatvādāśrayato liṅgavacanātideśaṃ yojayitumāha- sākāṅkṣatvād guṇatvena sāmānyaṃ vopadiśyate| vyaktīnāmātmadharmo'sāvekaprakhyānibandhanaḥ||187|| yadabhedana saṃstyānavad dravyaṃ pratyayavācyaṃ sāmānyabhūtamuktam,tat sūtre viśeṣaṇaśa- bdena guṇaparyāyeṇoktam| yasmāt pratyayārthatvena pradhānamapi dravyasāmānyaṃ prakṛtyarthagatadravyaviśeṣāpekṣatvād guṇaśabdenārhatyabhidhānam, dravyākāṅkṣasyārtha- sya guṇatvena prasiddheḥ| na ca viśeṣebhyo vilakṣaṇaṃ tat| yasmād vyaktīnāṃ dravyaviśeṣāṇāmasau guṇasvabhāvatāṃ prāptaḥ| ekaprakhyānibandhano hi vyaktīnāṃ svabhāvaḥ sāmānyaṃ kathyate| vyatirekadarśa- ne'pi samavāyāt svarūpatirodhānāt svabhāvātāprāptireva||187|| nanu sākāṅkṣatvād bhavatu guṇatvaṃ dravayasāmānyasya buddhyā parikalpitasya, tattvatastu saṃstyānaviśiṣṭasya dravyasyaikatvādāśrayāśrayibhāvaḥ kathamityāha- evambhūtā ca sāvasthā bhāgabhedaparigrahe| kṛte buddhyaiva bhedānāmāśrayatve'vakalpite||188|| niṣkṛṣṭeṣvapi bhedeṣu vyaktirūpāśraye tataḥ| liṅgapratyavamarśena liṅgasaṃkhye prapadyate||189|| sā sāmānyaviśeṣarūpābhyāṃ śabalāvasthā liṅgasaṃkhye vyaktirūpāśraye kaviśiṣṭadravyā śraye ye pratipadyata iti samanvayaḥ| tathāhi- apoddhārabuddhyā prakṛtipratyabhāgaparikalpane kṛte tayaiva samudāyavācyamarthaṃ prakṛtipratyayorvibhajya kiñcidasya bhedarūpaṃ prātipadikopādānamaparaṃ pratyayavācyaṃ saṃstyānānuviddhamaṃśaprakhyaṃ prakalpitam| bhede ca parikalpite, prakṛtivācyānāṃ viśeṣaṇānāmāśrayatve samāropite teṣu prṛthakkṛteṣvapi svatantreṣvapi nirūpyamāṇeṣu viśeṣeṣu liṅgapratyavamarśena strītyevaṃ nirūpaṇena strītvavad āśritatvādāśrayagataliṅgasaṃkhyāpratilambhaḥ| anyatra liṅgasaṃkhyayoḥ sāhacaryeṇa dṛṣṭatvādiha liṅgagrahaṇam, na tvatra strītvavato liṅgāntarasya virodhino'tideśaḥ saṃbhavati| tadevaṃ dvivacanānupapattiḥ prativihitā| anekapratyayānupapattistvatra na prativihitā| liṅgavacanavicāraprastāvenahīdamiha kathyata ityatrāprastutānekapratyayānupapattiḥ| supratividhānā ceyam| kvacit kila svabhāvād dravyopasarjanasya strītvasyānekena pratyayenābhi- vyaṅgayatvāt | na hi vyañjakānāṃ niyamaḥ | etāmeva ca śabdaśaktimanusartuṃ ṣphasya ṣitvaṃ ṅīṣarthaṃ kṛtam | ṣyaṅaśca ṅit- karaṇaṃ "yaṅaścāp"  ityatra sāmānyagrahaṇārtham | bhāṣye tvanyathā parihāro'bhihitaḥ--`bhavasya ca bhāvayuktatvāt" iti hi vārtikam | guṇapariṇāmarūpatvāt strītvasyāpi strītvena yoga upapanna ityarthaḥ |vistaravyākhyātra vārttikonmeṣe | etacca śabdaśaktimananusṛtya pratyayārthapakṣe saṃstyānasya prādhānyaṃ prakriyāgatamāśrityoktam | yathā tu śabdaśak‌tyanusāreṇeha dravyaprādhānyaṃ vivakṣitam, tathā anekenāpi vyañjakena vyaṅgayapratītirddaṣṭeti yathāsamarthitameva jyāyaḥ | tathā hyabhidhānabhedāt strītvasya strītvayoga ucyate | prātipadikena dravyarūpasyābhidhānāt pratyayena dharmarūpasyeti pratyayadvayopapattiḥ | yathā tadeva karmādivibhaktibhiḥ śaktirūpaṃ pratyāyyate | prātipadikena tu vastubhūtam | ayaṃ hyekatvādarthasya śabdabhedāt pratītibheda upapannaḥ || 188,189 ||
kramaprāptyā dvandve liṅgavacanātideśasyopayogo vicāryate | tatra cārthedvandvavidhānādaliṅgasaṃkhyatve codite `svābhāvikatvāt' iti parihāro'bhihitaḥ | sa kathamupapadyate | yataścārthasya dvandvenopagrahād mā bhūccāsya tatra prayogaḥ | caśabdavat tu dvandvasyāpyartho'bhihita iti aliṅgasaṃkhyatvaṃ kena na syādi-tyāśaṅkaya krameṇaitadupapādayitumāha-- antareṇa caśabdasya prayogaṃ dvandvabhāvinām | aviśiṣṭārthavṛttitvaṃ rūpābhedāt pratīyate || 190 ||
dhavakhadirādiśabdā dvandvaṃ bhāvayante prāpnuvanti, dvandvo vā bhāvī yeṣām, teṣāṃ caśabdaprayogaṃ vinā aviśiṣṭārthavṛttitvamavagamyate | samuccayākhya- viśeṣānapekṣayā dhavādijātīyasyārthasya caśabdenāviśeṣitarūpā aviśiṣṭarūpā dhavādayaḥ śabdā vācakā iti samuccayadyotanāya vākye caśabdamapekṣante || 190 ||
yataḥ-- vikalpavati vā vṛttirnivartye'rthe samuccite | teṣāmajñātaśaktīnāṃ dyotakena niyamyate || 191 ||
asati cādipadaprayoge samuccayādiviśiṣṭe'rthe dvandvabhāvināṃ padānāṃ vākyāvasthānāṃ vācakaśaktirnāvardhāyate | sandeho hi syād vikalpādau | tataśca yathā vikalpyamāne'rthe vāśabdena padānāṃ vācakaśaktirjñāpyate, nañā ca nivartye pratiṣidhyamāne, tathā caśabdena samuccīyamāne | dyotakeneti na vadan parapadaniṣṭhasya śabdasya vācakatvābhāvāt dyotakalakṣaṇaṃ jñāpayati | akevalapadaprayogo dyotaka iti nirṇītaṃ vākyakāṇḍe || 191 ||
evaṃ vākye caśabdaprayogaḥ samarthitaḥ samāse tu dvandve nāsti tasya prayoga ityāha-- vṛttau viśiṣṭarūpatvāccaśabdo vinivartate | arthamede'pi sārūpyāt taccārthenāpadiśyate || 192 ||
ekārthībhāvakṛtād vṛttivākyayorviśeṣād vākyagatadharmavailakṣaṇyena vṛttipa- dānāmarthābhidhānādantareṇāpi caśabdaṃ samuccayopādhikaṃ viśiṣṭārthābhidhānaṃ dvandve svābhāvikam, na tu cārthe dvandvavacanāt | na hyarthā ādiśyante | sahavivakṣāyāṃ hi vṛttāvanusyūtabhedaḥ pratyekaṃ padaikanyonyāpakṣaiḥ samudāyo'bhidhīyata iti tatra bhedasya vigalanāt tadadhiṣṭhānaḥ samuccayo na dyotyaḥ | vākye tu bhedaprādhānyāc caśabdena bhedādhiṣṭhānaḥ samuccayo dyotyate | tadevamatyantārthabhede'pi cārthena dvandvārtho nirdiśyate, kriyāyāmitaretarāpe- kṣāsāmyamātrāt | anvākhyānāya hyartho lokasiddha eva sarvato vyāvṛttasvabhāvaḥ kathañcit sādṛśyaleśānugamanena śabdeṣu nirdiśyate | sarvato vyāvṛttasya pratiśabda-marthasyānantyānnirdeṣumaśakyatvāt prakriyāgauravaprasaṅgācceti lāghavenārthani- rdeśo nyāyyaḥ || 192 ||
tatra ca taddhitārthanirdeśavannairdeśikasyārthasyāprādhānyāt svabhāvasiddha evārthaviśeṣo'nugamyate | yadi tu yathānirdeśamarthāḥ syuḥ, tadā-- casya cāsattvabhūto'rthaḥ sa evāśrīyate yadi | taddharmatvaṃ tato dvandve cādiṣvarthakṛtaṃ hi tat || 193 ||
`aliṅgamasaṃkhyamavyayam' ityarthanibaddhāvyayasaṃjñeti cārthe dvandvavidhānāttasya cārthasyeva dharmo liṅgasaṃkhyārahitatvaṃ dvandve'pyanuṣajyeta | dvandvasya cādiṣvapāṭhādavyayasaṃjñā na prāpnotītyāśaṅkayoktam--`codiṣvarthakṛtaṃ hi tat' iti| aliṅgasaṃkhyatve cādīnāmavyayatvaṃ svabhāvasiddhaṃ pāṭhenānūdyate, na tu pāṭha eva vidhāyakaḥ, udāharaṇārthatvāt tasyeti ca samānārthatve dvandve'pyavyayatvaṃ syādeva | mā bhūd vāvyayasaṃjñā pāṭhanibaddhā, aliṅgāsaṃkhyatvaṃ tvarthāśrayaṃ kena nivāryetetyarthaḥ | anvarthatvād vāvyayasaṃjñāyāḥ sāpi bhavet || 193 ||
tasmānna vacanānurodhī svārthaḥ śabdānāmityabhidhānavaicitryādarthavaicitrya- mudāharati-- cārthaḥ śakteḥ kvacid bhedāt kathañcit samavasthitaḥ | dyotakāścādayastasya vaktā dvandvastu tadvatām || 194 ||
śabdaśaktibhedād yathā samuccayaśabdo liṅgasaṃkhyāyuktaṃ cārthamāha, tathā dvandva iti samuccayopādhikārthābhidhāyako'sau | padāntaropādānārthaniṣṭhāstu dyotakāḥ cādaya iti vācakatvadyotakatvakṛta evāyaṃ viśeṣo vyaktivacanābhyāmayogo yogaśca || 194 ||
tathāhi-- vikalpādyabhigheyasya cārthasyānyapadārthatā | dyotakatvānna kalpeta tasmāt sadupalakṣyate || 195 ||
vikalpaḥ samuccayaḥ pratiṣedha ityevamādibhiḥ śabdairabhidhīyamānasyārthasyānyena rūpeṇa liṅgasaṃkhyāyoginā padapratyāyyatā vāprabhṛtirvikalpādiśabdānāmarthābhede vāśabdādidyotakatvānna ghaṭeta | asti tu liṅgasaṃkhyāyogino'rthasya vikalpādiśabdairabhidhānāt sānyapadārtha- tetyekasyaiva vastunaḥ śabdaśaktibhedānnānākārasya prakāśanamiti śabdārtho'rtha iti naye svābhāvika evāyamarthabheda iti sat sattvabhūtaṃ vastu dvandvaviṣayatvena (viṣayakeṇa) caśabdenopalakṣyate kutaścit sāmānyāt | na tvasau tattvataścaśabdeneva dvandvena pratyāyyata ityarthaḥ | tadetaduktaṃ bhāṣye--"nedaṃ vācanikamaliṅgatā asaṅkhayatā vā | kiṃ tarhi, svābhāvikametat"iti || 195 ||
etadevāha-- tatra svābhāvikaṃ liṅgaṃ śabdadharme vyapekṣite | śabdaḥ kaścit tamevārthaṃ kathañcit pratipadyate || 196 ||
śabdadharme śabdasvabhāve'bhisaṃhite bhāṣya etaduktamityarthaḥ | tathāhi--vastuna aikye'pi śabdabhedādarthavaicitryam | tadyathā - kārśyam, kraśimā, kṛśateti prakṛtipratyayārthayoḥ prakṛtirūpas-yābhede'pi pratyayaśrutibhedanibandhanaḥ sthitiprasavasaṃstyānabhedaḥ | jalam, āpaḥ, dārā, bhāryeti ca śabdaśaktibhedālliṅgavacanabhedaḥ | tathā dvaidhamityaliṅgo'saṃkhyaḥ sa evamatidvaidhānīti saliṅgasaṃkhyo'rthaḥ pratipādyate | atra hi "dhamuñantāt svārthe ḍadarśanam" iti pratyayāntaratve śabdāntaratvam | evaṃ dvandvo'pi saliṅgasaṃkhyārthābhidhāyī || 196 ||
syādetat vakturabhiprāyādarthānāṃ vyavasthā, na śabdadharmata ityāśaṅkayāha-- śabdādarthāḥ pratāyante sa bhedānāṃ vidhāyakaḥ | anumānaṃ vivakṣāyāḥ śabdādanyanna vidyate || 197 ||
jātāvekavacanaṃ śabdāditi | yathābhipretamarthaṃ pratipādayituṃ vaktā yogyān śabdānudāharatīti tebhyaḥ śabdebhyo vak‌tṛninakṣānumānād vyavahāre śabdā evārtha- vyavasthāpane prabhavaḥ | akṣinikocādīnāmapi śabdainaivānumāpakatvaṃ, saṅketitatvāt | tathāhi--śabdebhyo vastvarthā ekasvabhāvā api vistāraṃ bhajante, tebhyo nānārūpāṇāṃ prakāśanāt | tathā ca dāraśabdaḥ striyaṃ puṃstvaviśeṣaṇāmācaṣṭe, bhāryāśabdaḥ strītvavi- śiṣṭām, apśabdo'vayavātmakaṃ tamevārthaṃ bahutvāvacchinnamāha | udakaśabdastu samūharūpamekamityādiśabdadharmo'nugantavyaḥ | ataśca saśabdaḥ svaśaktivaśād bhedānāṃ vācyaviśeṣaṇāṃ vidhāyako nirmātā | bhāgabhedasya vastuni samāropaṇamivārthasya svabhāvāt tatkṛtaṃ nānātvamityarthaḥ || 197 ||
tadevaṃ svābhāviko liṅgasaṃkhyāyogo dvandve samarthitaḥ | `athavāśrayato liṅga-vacanāni bhaviṣyanti' iti pakṣāntaraṃ vācanikaṃ bhāṣye uktaṃ vicārayitumāha-- samuccitaḥ syād dvandvārtho guṇabhūtasamuccayaḥ | samuccayo vāpi bhaved guṇabhūtasamuccitaḥ || 198 ||
samuccayopādhikāḥ samuccitā vā arthā dvandvenocyeran, samuccitopasarjano vā samuccaya iti dvaitam || 198 ||
tatra, samuccitasya prādhānye liṅgasaṃkhye svabhāvataḥ | samuccayasya prādhānye śāstraṃ syāt pratipādakam || 199 ||
samuccayepasarjanasya sattvabhūtasyārthasya dvandvavācyatve svābhāvike liṅ-gasaṃkhye ityuktam | yadā tu vacanenārthanirdeśe samuccayaḥ prādhānyena dvandvavācyaḥ, tadā vacane- naiva "viśeṣaṇānām"ityāśrayato liṅgavacane vidhīyate | dharmarūpatvāt samuccayasyāprāptayoriṣṭayorliṅgasaṃkhyayoḥ śāstraṃ vidhāyakam | tatra samuccayasya prādhānye'pyāśritamātrasya viśeṣaṇaśabdenābhidhānād yujyate'tideśaḥ || 199 ||
samuccitaprādhānye'pi śāstrasyopayogamekīyamatenāha-- samuccayavato'rthasya prādhānye'pyapare viduḥ | nimittānuvidhāyitvādasiddhiṃ liṅgasaṃkhyayoḥ || 200 ||
nimittarūpeṇa nimittino'vadhāryamāṇasya tadāveśād rūpatirodhānamitīhāpi samu- ccayākhyānimittāvacchāditasya samuccitasya svadharmapratipattyayogyatvāt tadīyayo- rliṅgasaṃkhyayoraprāptāvatideśa iti pakṣadvaye'pi śāstramupayogi || 200 ||
etadayuktamityāha-- samuccayo nimittaṃ cet syānnimittānuvartanam | anvayavyatirekābhyāṃ cārtho dvandvanibandhanaḥ || 201 ||
samuccayopādhirartho na dvandvavācyaḥ, yena nimittānuvidhānaṃ syāt | api tu yo'rtho'nvayavyatirekābhyāṃ dvandvasya vācya ityavadhāritaḥ, sa cārtha ityevaṃ dvandvasyānvākhyānāyānubhāṣyate | sa ca kriyāyāṃ samakakṣyāṇāmarthānāṃ samūha udbhūtakārakaśaktiḥ | tasya ca kathañcit samuccitaśabdenābhidhānadarśanād bhrāntyā samuccayo nimittatvenādhyā- ropyate || 201 ||
paramārthastvayamatretyāha-- samuccitanimittatve cārthasyāpagame'pi vā | svabhāvasiddhe dvandvasya liṅgasaṃkhye vyavasthite || 202 ||
yadā samuccito dvandvasya nibandhanam, tadā pradhānadharmānuvidhānād nyāya- prāpte tadīye liṅgasaṅkhaye | yadvātyantavailakṣaṇyāccārtha evārthasamuccayo nāsti, yasya dravyeṇa saha guṇapradhānabhāvāścintyeta | sādṛśyaleśānugamamātreṇa tu śabdānuśāsane yathākathañci- dartho nirdiśyate dvandvanimittatvena cārtha iti | sattvabhūta eva tu svabhāvato dvandvārtha iti samuccayasyāsattvādeva nimittabhāvo nāsti || 202 ||
anyonyāpekṣā dvandvāntarvartipadārthā dvandvavācyāḥ,sa eva ca samuccayaḥ | tat kimucyate cārthasyāpagama ityāśaṅkaya pūrvoktamarthabhedaṃ smārayati-- padāntarasthasyārthasya dyotakatvānna yujyate | nipāto liṅgasaṅkhayābhyāṃ dvandvastvarthasya vācakaḥ || 203 ||
vastvarthasyābhede'pyabhidhāvyāpārabhedācchabdārtho bhidyata iti dvandve sattvabhūtārthābhidhānāccārthasya vākye'sattvabhūtasya dṛṣṭasyāpagamo varṇita ityarthaḥ | vācakadyotakaśaktivilasitaṃ caitat prāgevoktam || 203 ||
punarapi nimittānuvidhānadarśanamupālabhate-- nimittānuvidhāne ca dravyadharmānapekṣaṇāt | guṇapradhānabhāvena kriyāyogo na kalpate || 204 ||
nimittānuvidhāne nimittarūpācchuritasya nimittino dravyasyābhidhānāt tasya dharmaḥ śaktirbuddhayā nāvadhāryata iti kriyābhiḥ prādhānyena guṇatvena vāsya yogo na syāt | dravyaṃ hi sādhanam | tasya cānavadhāritasvaśakteḥ kathaṃ kriyābhisambandhaḥ ? na ca nimittasya kriyāyogo'sattvabhūtatvāt | tatra guṇabhāvena karaṇādirūpatayā kriyāsambandhaḥ, pradhānabhāvena karmarūpatayā ca tasya kriyābhirutpattisaṃskārapratipa- ttiviṣayasya samanvayāt || 204 ||
mā bhūt kriyāyoga iti cedāha-- yasya nāsti kriyāyogaḥ svatantro'sau na vidyate | artho dvandvasya tatra syādupādānamanarthakam || 205 ||
"kriyānuṣaṅgeṇa vinā na padārthaḥ pratīyate" iti svatantraḥ svaniṣṭhaḥ kriyābhirasambadhyamānaḥ padārtho nāsti | tataśca tasminnarthe nimittānura- kte kriyāyogābhāvā d‌dvandvasya vācakatvena parigraho niṣprayojana iti nānvākh- yeyo'sau bhavedavyavahāryaḥ | tasmādanvākhyānādevāvasīyate nimittānanuvidhānamatra||205|| nacāpi sarvatra nimittānuvidhānamityāha-- samuccayavato'rthasya vācako nānuvartate | nimittamapi cāsyārthaḥ svadharmairyujyate tataḥ || 206 ||
ye'pyete samuccitādayaḥ śabdāḥ samuccayopādhikārthābhidhāyakatvena prasiddhāḥ, te'pi nimittaṃ nānurudhyante | prāgeva tu dvandvaḥ, yatra samuccayopādhitve bhrāntiḥ, yatra hi nimittarūpeṇa nimittini tirohitasvarūpe pratipattiḥ, tatra nimittānuvidhānam, yathā śuklādau | iha punarnimittena bhinnenāvacchinnasyākhyānamiti nāsti tat | ata eva samuccayavata iti matubupāttaḥ | bhinnena nimittenāvacchinnasyātrākhyānamiti matupā darśayati | yatra tu nimittarūpeṇābhidhānam, tatra śuklādau matub notpadyate | tasmānnimittānuvidhānābhāvādatra samuccitaśabdaḥ svārthaṃ svaliṅgasaṃkhyāyoginamabhi- dhatte, tadvad dvandvo'pīti na kaścid doṣaḥ | tadevam `samuccitaḥ syād dvandvārtha' ityatra pakṣe svabhāvata eva liṅgasaṃkhye ityetadeva yuktam | samuccayaprādhānye tu "viśeṣaṇānām" iti śāstreṇa liṅgasaṃkhyāvidhānaṃ tatraiva tad vaktavyam || 206 ||
samakakṣyānarthānabhidadhato dvandvasya kaḥ samānādhikaraṇapadavācya āśrayaḥ, yasya vyaktivacane pratipadyetetyāśaṅkayāha-- bāhyo nāstyāśrayo dvandve viśeṣau tatra hi śrutau | samuccayastadādhārastaddharmairvyapadiśyate || 207 ||
`śuklāḥ paṭāḥ' ityatra yathā paṭaśabdopādāno guṇavacanasyāśrayo'sti, naivaṃ padāntaropādāno dvandve vidyate | śrutyaiva dvandvapadābhyāṃ viśeṣayorbhedayorupādānāttadantaraṅgayoḥ | dhavakhadirāviti tāveva viśeṣau samuccīyamānau samuccayasyādhāra āśraya iti talliṅgasaṃkhye samuccayavācinau dvandvasya bhavataḥ | tatra ca pūrvottarapadagatābhyāṃ viruddhābhyāṃ liṅgābhyāṃ yugapad vyapadeśāsa- mbhavāt paryāye prāpte paravalliṅgaṃ niyamyate | saṃkhyāpyavayavagataikatvasamāhārātmikādvitvabahutvalakṣaṇāvayavalakṣaṇāśrayavad dvandvasya bhavati || 207 ||
