evaṃ parasparāpekṣā avayavārthā eva dvandvārtha ityatra darśane pratipāditami-dam | idānīṃ yugapadadhikaraṇavacanatāyāścārthasyāsambhavapakṣe pratipādayitumāha-- yo vāvayavabhedābhyāṃ bhedavadbhyāmivānvitaḥ | ekaḥ samūho dharmān sa bhāgayoḥ pratipadyate || 208 ||
avayavabhedānugataḥ samudāyaḥ sahavivakṣāyāṃ dvandvavācyaḥ, abhidhānaṃ punaḥ svābhāvikam `yābhyāṃ caikamanekārthaṃ tābhyāmevāparaṃ padam' iti pratyekaṃ padairabhidhīyamāno'rtha ityatra darśane vyaktivacane avayavāśraye samudāyaḥ pratilabhata iti spaṣṭametat | anusyūtabhedasya ca samudāyasya dvandvenapratipādyatvādbhedavadbhayāmivetyāha | na tvatyantabhinnābhyāmityarthaḥ | abhedānugamācca tayorbhāgayorāśrayabhūtayoḥ samudāyo liṅgasaṃkhye anuvartate | anyathā nirastabhedasya vanayūthādivadabhidhāne bhedayorāśrayabhūtayoranupādānād vartipadābhyāṃ kasya liṃṅgasaṃkhye bhajeta dvandva ityabhiprāyaḥ || 208 ||
nanvevamapyavayavavyatirekeṇa samudāyānupalakṣaṇāt kva āśrayāśrayibhāva ityāha-- ekaśca dvayātmako'rtho'sau bhedābhedasamanvitaḥ | yau bhedāvāśritastatsthe liṅgasaṅkhaye prapadyate || 209 ||
avayavātmatayā gṛhyamāṇaḥ samudāyo bhinnaḥ, svatastvekapraśyānibandha- natayā'bhinna iti dvirūpaḥ | tathāca pratyekaṃ padairbhedātmanā pratyāyyamāna āśrayaḥ, samūhātmanā tvarthā- śritaḥ (tvāśritaḥ) ityāśrayabhūtavartipadārthasamavete liṅgasaṃkhye samavalambata iti sthitam || 209 ||
idānīṃ bahurvīhau vyaktivacanātideśopayogaṃ krameṇa vyutapādayitumāha-- yathā svaśabdābhihite caitrārthe na prayujyate | caitraśabdo bahurvīhāvaprayogastathā bhavet || 210 ||
ihānyapadārthe bahurvīhiranvākhyāyate | tataśca tenaivānyapadārthasyoktatvād dvandva iva caśabdasya tadabhidhāyinaścaitrādeḥ prayogo na prāpnoti | tadyathā--caitraśabdenokte svārthe punaścaitraśabdo na prayujyate | uktā- rthānāṃ hyaprayogaḥ | taduktaṃ vārttike--"padārthābhidhāne'nuprayogānupapattirabhihi- tatvāt" iti | atra parihāro'bhihitaḥ "na vānabhihitatvāt, sāmānyābhidhāne hi viśeṣānabhidhānam" iti || 210 ||
etad vyācaṣṭe-- yathā gauriti śuklāderabhidhānaṃ na vidyate | evaṃ yasyābhisambandho gobhistāvat pratīyate || 211 ||
sambandhisāmānye bahurvīhiriti tadviśeṣapratipattirato na bhavati | tadyathā-- sāmānyavācī gośabdo viśeṣābhidānāyāsamartha iti prayujyate viśeṣapratipattaye śabdaḥ, tatra `gauḥ śuklaḥ kṛṣṇo vetyādiḥ | evaṃ `citraguścaitro maitro vā' iti prayogo viśeṣaprati pattaye nyāyyaḥ | citrā gāvo yasyeti svāmimātrasya pratīteḥ||211|| yatra tu śabdaśaktisvābhāvād bahurvīhiṇaiva viśeṣo'ṅgīkṛtaḥ, tatra tadabhidhāyīna prayujyata ityāha-- sambandhī niyato rūḍhaścitrāṇāṃ na ca vidyate | gavāṃ yathā vajrapāṇistryakṣo vāpi vyavasthitaḥ || 212 ||
vajraṃ pāṇau yasya, trīṇyakṣīṇi yasyeti niyataḥ prasiddho'vyabhicārī rūḍhaḥ śakraḥ śivaśca sambandhī vṛttāvantareṇa viśepadaprayogamavagamyata iti bhavati tatra sambandha viśeṣe'nyapadārthe bahuvrīhiḥ| citragurityatra viśeṣo nāvadhāryate, citrairgobhira- viśeṣeṇaṃ svāmimātrasya samanvayasambhavāditi viśeṣyasyānuprayogo'trāviruddhaḥ| prakaraṇādestu viśeṣāvagame'trāpi tatprayogo nāsti||212|| evaṃ vārttikakṛtā viseṣābidhānāyānuprayoge samarthite coditaṃ bhāṣye "bhavet siddham, yadā sāmānye vṛttiḥ| yadā tu viśeṣe vṛttiḥ, tadā na sidhyati | citrā gāvo'sya devadattasya" iti| atra saramādhiḥ `nedamubhayaṃ yugapad bhavati vākyaṃ samāsaśca| yadā vākyaṃ , na tadā samāsaḥ, yadā samāsaḥ, sāmānye tadā vṛttiḥ| tatrāvaśyaṃ viśeṣārthinā viśeṣo'nuprayoktavyaḥ| citraguḥ kaḥ, devadattaḥ iti| tadetad vyācaṣṭe-- śabdāntaratvād vākyeṣu viśeṣā yadyapi śrutāḥ| vṛttiśabdo'nya evāyaṃ sāmānyasyābhidhāyakaḥ||213|| nirṇītacarametad vṛttivākyayorartharūpabhedena śabdāntaratvamiti| viśeṣaprakrame'pi vākye vṛttiśabdo viśeṣābhidhānaprahataśaktiriti yukta evānuprayogaḥ| na hi vākyameva vṛttyāvanantararbhāvāt sāmānyamevāsāvācaṣṭe| adūraviprakarṣeṇa tu vṛttyartho vākyenopadarśyate| na tu sarvataḥ paricchinne vākyārthe vṛttipadasyābhidhānaśaktiḥ, saṃkhyāviśeṣāderato'pratīte||213|| yadyevaṃ kimanenānavagamitaviśeṣeṇa sākāṅkṣeṇa sāmānyābhidhānāyinā bahuvrīhi samāsena prayuktenetyāśaṅkyāha- agoracitragoścaiva rūpabhedānnivartakaḥ| evaṃ citraguviśeṣāṇāṃ rūpābhedāttu vācakaḥ||214|| citraguśabdenāvidyamānagosambandhād vyāvṛtto'rthābhidhīyate| citratvena viśeṣaṇāda-citragorvyāvṛttiḥ| evañca na sarvathā sāmānyaśabdo'yam, api tvanyavyāvṛttiviśeṣasyā- pyabhidhātetyarhati prayogam| etāvatīṃ vivakṣāṃ puraskṛtya citragavīsambandhe hi pratipādye bhinnarūpa evāyaṃ śabdaḥ| tanniṣṭhāparaviśeṣapratipādane tu rūpasāmānyādaśakta iti sāmānyasyābhidhāyakaḥ kathyate| caitro'pi hi syāccitragurmaitro'pītyatrāviśeṣaḥ||214||5 evaṃ viśeṣaśabdānāmanuprayoge sādhite punaścoditam- `sāmānyasyaiva tarhnuprayogago na prāpnoti| citragu tat, citragu kim, citragu sarvam' iti| atra samādhiḥ- `sāmānyamapi yathā viśeṣaḥ, tadvat citragu ityukte sandehaḥ syāt, sarvaṃ vā viśvaṃ veti, tatrāvaśyaṃ viśeṣo'nuprayoktavyaḥ'iti| atra sāmānyasya kathaṃ viśeṣasādṛśyamiti vyācaṣṭe-- yathā citragurityetatprayukte na prayujyate| evaṃ yadi syāt sāmānyaṃ tasya na syāt pratiśrutiḥ||215|| citragurityevaṃ citragavīsvāminyākhyāte na tadartha eva śabdo'nākāṅkṣitārthaḥ prayogamarhati| evaṃbhūtaṃ yadi sarvādipadopādānaṃ sāmānyamanākāṅkṣyamāṇaṃ syāt, tadā anyavyāvṛttābhidhānācca viśeṣapadamevaitadityāha- sarvādayo viśeṣāstu pradeśānāṃ nivartakāḥ| yathā pradeśāḥ sāmānyapradeśāntarabādhakāḥ||216|| iha bhedakatvaṃ viśeṣalakṣaṇamiti yathā caitra ityukte maitrādiviśeṣāntaravyava- cchedaḥ pratīyate, sāmānyasya ca nivṛttiḥ, tathā `sarvaṃ viśvam' ityādisāmānyapada- prayoge'pi viśeṣanivṛttipratīteranyavyavacchedakamidaṃ sāmānyamapi viśeṣo bhavatyapekṣāvaśādityarthaḥ||216|| evaṃ padārthābhidhānapakṣe'nuprayogānupapatticodyaṃ samāhitam| yadā tu citrā gāvo yasyeti vibhaktyarthe'nyapadārthe sambandhalakṣaṇe bahuvrīhiḥ, tadā sambandhavācikā vibhaktiḥ ṣaṣṭhī mānuprayoji, dravyaṃ tu sambandhana- bhihitamiti tadabhidhānāyānuprayoga upapadyata eva| taduktaṃ bhāṣye-" athavā vibhaktyartho'bhidhīyate| etaccātra yuktam| atra hi sarvapaścātpadaṃ vartate' iti| citrā gāvo devadattasyeti yathaitat ṣaṣṭhyantaṃ padaṃ tadabhidhāvyāpāreṇa prātipa- dikārthopasarjanaṃ vibhaktyarthaṃ prādhānayenācaṣṭe| tathā ca samabandhyupasarjanasya sambandha- syānyapadārthatā nyāyyeti sarvapaścācchabdena ṣaṣṭhyantasya padasya tatra vibhaktya- rthe vyatireke sambandhalakṣaṇe vṛttimāha abhidhāvyāpāreṇa| `nāgṛhītaviśeṣaṇā viśeṣye buddhiḥ' iti nyāyāt pūrvamavacchedake prātipadikārthe sambandhini vṛttiḥ, paścāt tadupahitaviśeṣe sambandha iti sa evānyapadārthaḥ pradhānabhūto nyāyyaḥ| tadetadāha-- vibhaktyarthābhidhānād vā ṣaṣṭhī nānuprayujyate| dravyasyānabhidhānāttu tacchabdo'nuprayujyate||217|| gatārtho'yaṃ ślokaḥ||217|| atra pakṣe coditam- " vibhaktyarthābhidhāne dravyasya liṅgasaṅkhyopacārānupapattiḥ" iti vibhaktyarthasyāsattvabhūtatvāt sattvasya dravyasya ye liṅgasaṅkhye tadupacāro vyavahāro'tra samāsavāttyasya na syādityarthaḥ| atra samādhirūktaḥ- "siddhaṃ tu yatā guṇavacaneṣu"ita| tatra guṇavacanānāmāśrayato liṅgavacanāni bhavanti| śuklādīnāmāśrayairmatublopena sāmānādhikaraṇyāt| iha tu sambandhamātravacanasya bahuvrīheḥ sambandhivacanairmatublopāt sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ na yujyata ityāha-- sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ cenmatublopāt prakalpate| matupo'pi tadarthatvādanavasthā prasajyate||218|| bahurvīhivanmatupāpi sambandhasyaiva pratipādanāt sambandhino'nabhidhāne punara- paro matub vidheyaḥ, tenāpi sambandhino'pratyāyane punarapara ityanavasthā aniṣṭā matupāmatra syāt | matupā tu sambandhyabhidhāne matvarthe bahurvīhervidhānāt tenāpi tathaivārthābhidhāne vibhak‌tyarthābhidhānapakṣo na bhavet || 218 ||
na kevalamanavasthā, yāvat-- sambandhasya ca sambandhī sambandho'nyaḥ prasajyate | vibhak‌tyarthapradhāne ca kriyāyogo na kalpate || 219 ||
bahurvīhivācyaḥ sambandhaḥ prakṛtyarthaḥ | tenāvacchinno'paro matubvācyaḥ sambandhaḥ | prakṛtyarthoparaktatvācca pratyayārthasya prakṛtyarthasambandhāvacchinnaḥ pratyayārthaḥ prakṛtyarthasya sambandhī syāt | tathā ca prakṛtyarthasya sambandharūpatā hīyate | upādhimattvāt sambandhirūpatā prāptetyabhiprāyaḥ | ṣaṣṭhayarthapradhāne ca bahurvīhau citragurānīyatāmityādiḥ kriyāyogo na syāt, sambandhasyāsattvabhūtatvena kārakaśak‌tyāvirbhāvāyogāt||219|| atha `tatra paśya, tataḥ paśya' iti vibhak‌tyarthapradhāne'pi dṛṣṭaḥ kriyāyogaḥ, netyāha-- vibhak‌tyarthapradhānatvāt tatastatreti na kriyā | dṛśyādiḥ karmakartrādinimittatvāya kalpate || 220 ||
apādānādhikaraṇaśaktipradhānayostatastatretyanayordṛśitiṣṭhatītyādikā kriyā kartṛkarmaśaktī nāvirbhāvayati, vibhak‌tyantarārthavirodhāt | kintvatrāvadhimatata ādheyasya ca kriyāyogaḥ pratīyate | tataḥ paśya, tatra tiṣṭhatīti || 220 ||
evaṃ vibhak‌tyarthābhidhānapakṣe doṣaḥ | kiñca vibhak‌tyarthābhidhāne citragurdevadattasyeti ṣaṣṭhī syāt ? na bhaviṣ- yati | "abhihitaḥ so'rtho'ntarbhūtaḥ prātipadikārthaḥ sampannaḥ" iti | ata eva kriyāyogo bhaviṣyatītyāśaṅkyāha-- antarbhavecca sambandhaḥ prādhānyābhihitaḥ katham | sa prātipadikārthaśca tathābhūtaḥ kathaṃ bhavet || 221 ||
caitrasyeti yathā ṣaṣṭhayā sambandhaḥ prādhānyenodbhūtarūpo'bhidhīyate, tathā ca bahurvīhiṇeti sa kathamatrāntarbhavet ? yo hi sambandhyupasarjanaḥ sambandho'bhidhīyate, so'ntarbhavati samāse | tadyathā--`rājapuruṣaḥ' ityatra rājaviśiṣṭasya puruṣārthasya prādhānyāt sambandho guṇabhūta iti bhavatvasau prātipadikārthaḥ, iha tu vyatirekeṇocyamānaḥ kathaṃ prātipadi- kārthaḥ syāt || 221 ||
idānīṃ kriyāyogaṃ tāvadupapādayati-- asambhavāttu sambandhe sambandhasahacāriṇi | jātisaṅkhyāsamāhārakāryāṇāmiva sambhavaḥ || 222 ||
`gāmālabheta' brāhmaṇānāṃ śatamānaya, pañcapūlī badhyatām' iti jātyādiṣu śabdacoditeṣu kriyāyogānupapattestatsahacāriṇyavinābhāvini dravye kriyā yathānuṣṭhīyante, tathā `citragurānīyatām' iti sambandhamātre kriyānupapatteḥ, tadavinābhūte sambandhini tanniveśaḥ || 222 ||
syādetat | jātiśabdaiḥ svārūpācchurito'bhidhīyate'bhedena sahacārīti yujyatetatra kriyāyogaḥ | iha tu sambandhasya prādhānyāt kathametadityāśaṅkyātrāpi sāmānā-dhikaraṇyamupapādayitumāha-- so'yamityabhisambandhād viśiṣṭāśrayavācinām | śuklādivalliṅgasaṅkhye śāstrārambhād bhaviṣyataḥ || 223 ||
mā bhūnmatublopadatra sāmānādhikaraṇyam, so'yamityabhisambandhāśrayeṇa tu śuklādivat sambandhenopacaritābhedaḥ sambandhī vṛttipādavācyaḥ sambandhamātre'pi vṛttividhāne, śabdaśaktisvābhāvyāditi mañcādivannimittānuvidhānaparihārārtham `viśeṣaṇānām"iti sūtreṇa sambandhigataliṅgasaṅkhyāsiddhiḥ | nimittānuvidhā- netu sambandhasya diṣṭhatvād dvivacanaṃ syāt | śāstrārambhāttu pradhānabhūtānyapa- dārthāśraye vyaktivacane sidhyataḥ || 223 ||
yadyevaṃ kathamidamuktaṃ bhāṣye--"yadi tarhi vibhak‌tyartho'bhidhīyate, kṛtsnaḥ padārthaḥ kathamabhihito bhavati sadravyaḥ, saliṅgaḥ,sasaṅkhyaśca" iti | yāvatā so'yamityabhisambandhālliṅgaḥ saṅkhyopapattirityāśaṅkhaya bhāṣyakārā- bhiprāyaṃ vyācaṣṭe-- bhedena tu vivakṣāyāṃ sāmānye vā vivakṣite | saliṅgasya sasaṅkhyasya padārthasyāgatirbhavet || sambandhino vyatirekeṇa yadā sambandhasya bahurvīhiṇā pratipādanamiṣṭam, tadā dravyeṇāsāmānādhikaraṇyāt talliṅgasaṃkhyorayogāt kṛtsnasya padārthasyāgatiruktā | so'yamiti sambandhivivakṣāyāmeva vā nirviśeṣasya sāmānyasya citragorida- mucitamityacitraguvyāvṛttimātrapare'bhidhāne bahiraṅsya caitrādipadāntaragamyasyā- śrayasyābhāvālliṅgasaṃkhyāsarvanāmanapuṃsakaikavacanaprasaṅgāt kṛtsnaḥ padārthaḥ kathamabhihitobhavatītyuktam | ataścātra so'yamityabhisambandhe'pi kṛtsnapadārthābhidhānābhāvād vibhak‌tyarthābhidhānapakṣastyājyaḥ, dravyābhidhānapakṣa evāśrayitavyaḥ || 224 ||
sa kathamupapadyata ityāha-- sādhutvaṃ na vibhak‌tyarthamātre vṛttsya dṛśyate | kṛtsnārthavṛtteḥ sādhutvamityarthagrahaṇaṃ kṛtam || 225 ||
prayuktānāṃ śabdānāmanvākhyānāt ṣaṣṭhyarthamātre dravyādirahite vṛtta- syaikārthībhāvāpannasya bahurvīhaiḥ samāsasya prayogo yato na dṛśyate, dravyapradhānasyaivānyapadārthasyasmāt pratīteḥ | ato'rthagrahaṇaṃ sakalārthavācinaḥ prayogajñāpanārthaṃ kṛtam | taduktaṃ bhāṣye-"anyapada ityetāvatā siddhe yadarthagrahaṇaṃ karoti, tasyaitat prayojanaṃ kṛtsnaḥ padārtho yathā vijñāyeta sadravyaḥ saliṅgaḥ sasaṃkhyaśca" iti | sadravya ityevamapi nirdeśe dravyameva pradhānamabhisaṃhitam, na guṇādayo'pi samakakṣyāḥ,dravyasyaiva tātparyadṛśā guṇādyuparaktasya pratīteḥ | tatra pada ityukte sāmarthyād vibhak‌tyarthaḥ sannihitaḥ pratīyate, śabde śabdasya vṛttyabhāvāt | arthaśabdopādāne tu padenārtho viśeṣyamāṇaḥ sarvapadāvadhiko vijñāyeta | yathā hyādhikyād vākyārtho'traiva vyāvartyate, tathā nyūnatvād vibhak- tyarthamātramiti liṅgasaṃkhyāvat padārthabhūtaṃ dravyamevānyapadārtha iti padārthābhidhāna- pakṣa eva jyāyān | tataścānuprayogaḥ samarthitaḥ || 225 ||
atra ca pakṣe vyaktivacanātideśasya nāstyupayoga iti tasya pakṣāntare saprayojanatvamāha-- so'yamityabhisambandhād dravyavṛttirayaṃ yadā | saliṅgasya sasaṅkhyasya tadā sādhutvamucyate || 226 ||
vibhak‌tyarthapradhānapakṣe dravyasāmānyena sambandhasyopacaritābhedasyābhidhāne'pi viśeṣagataliṅgasaṃkhyāsiddhyartham `yathā guṇavacaneṣu"iti vārttikakāreṇa vyaktivacanā-tideśasyopayoga uktaḥ, na tvarthapakṣe | arthagrahaṇāt kṛtsnadravyābhidhāne svābhāvi-katvālliṅgavacanayoratretyarthaḥ || 226 ||
atra tvayamupālambhaḥ--"yadi tarhi kṛtsnaḥ padārtho'bhidhīyate, laiṅgāḥ sāṃkhyāśca viṣayo na sidhyanti" iti bhāṣya uktaḥ | tameva vyācaṣṭe -- antarbhūtavibhak‌tyarthe ṣaṣṭhī na śrūyate yathā | tathā'śrutiḥ prasajyate liṅgasaṅkhyābhidhāyinām || 227 ||
arthagrahaṇāt saliṅgasaṃkhyasya dravyasya prādhānyenābhidhāne tadguṇābhūtasya vibhak‌tyarthasya sambandhasyāntarbhāvāt prātipadikārthatve yathā ṣaṣṭhīvibhaktirna bhavati, tathā liṅge strītve bhavā laiṅgaṣṭābādayaḥ, saṃkhyāyāmekatvādikāyāṃ bhavāḥ sāṅkhayāḥ svādayasteṣāmapyaśrutiraśravaṇamaprayogaḥ prasajyetāpadyeta || 227 ||
svādyabhāve kevalā prakṛtiḥ kathaṃ prayogārhetyāśaṅkyāha-- sādharmyamavyayena syād bahurvīhestathā sati | liṅgasaṅkhyānimittasya saṃskārasyāpavartanāt || 228 ||
liṅgasaṅkhāprāpitasya saṃskārasya ṭābādisvādyutpattilakṣaṇasyābhāvādaliṅ-gasaṅkhayaikhyayairbahurvīhipadānāmekayogakṣematā syāt | yathaivāvyayasya strīpratyayavi-bhaktirahitasya prayoganiyamāpavādāt kevalasya prayogaḥ sādhuḥ, evaṃ bahurvīherbhaveditya- rthaḥ || 228 ||
caitrādinā sattvavacanena padāntareṇa tarhi kathaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyamityata āha-- prayuktena ca sambandhāccaitrādiśravaṇaṃ bhavet | vinā vibhak‌tyā sambandho vibhak‌tyā vidyate vinā || 229 ||
bahurvīhipadena dravyasāmānyavācinā vibhaktirahitenoccaritena citragvityā- dinā viśeṣapratipādakānāṃ caitrādīnāṃ tatsamānābhidheyatvāt tadvadeva vibhaktirahitānāṃ prayogo bhavet | vibhaktirahitasya vibhaktisūnyenaiva saha sambandho nyāyyaḥ, na tu savibhaktikenātyantavaidharmyāṃt | tathā cāsambaddhe dravyasāmānyaniṣṭhadravyaviśeṣā- bhidhānaṃ na syāt || 229 ||
evamatra padārthābhidhānapakṣe codyabhāṣyaṃ vyākhyātam | atraiva parihārabhāṣyam--"laiṅgeṣu tāvaduktam--siddhaṃ tu striyāḥ prātipa- dikaviśeṣaṇatvāt svārthe ṭābādayaḥ" iti | yathānyatra ṭābādayo dyotakāḥ, tathā bahurvīherapi bhaviṣyantītyarthaḥ | sāṅkhyeṣvapyuktam--"karmādīnāmanuktā ekatvādayaḥ" iti dvitīyādayo bhaviṣyantītyādi | tadetad vivṛṇoti-- abhidhāne'pi saṅkhayāyāḥ saṃkhyātvaṃ na nivartate | ṣaṣṭhyarthasyābhidhāne tu syāt prātipadikārthatā || 230 ||
bahurvīhipadairabhihitāpi saṃkhyā svakāryaṃ svādilakṣaṇaṃ prāpayatyeva | tadya- thā-`ekaḥ,dvau, bahavaḥ ; ityatra | nahyabhihitāpi saṃkhyā svarūpaṃ jahāti | tataśca karmādiviśeṣaṇāyāḥ saṃkhyāyā abhidhānāya dvitīyādayastāvadutpadyante | prathamāpi `na kevalā prakṛtiḥ prayoktavyā' iti samayapālanāyotpatsyate | avyayāttu lugvacanenāyaṃ prayoganiyamo bādhitaḥ | na caivaṃ bahurvīhipadebhyo luganvākhyātaḥ | tulye samayapālane dvitīyādayaḥ kasmānna bhavantīti cenna, arthābhāvāt | karmādiṣu hi dvitīyādayaḥ, tadabhāve kathaṃ bhaveyuḥ ? tasmādekādiśabdebhya ivārthānugu- ṇyāt prathamaikavacanādīnyeva bhaviṣyanti prātipadikārthamātre | taduktam--`arthato vyavasthā' iti | vacanagrahaṇādvā prathamā bhaviṣyatyuktārthāpi | ṣaṣṭhyarthasya tu sambandhasya dravye guṇabhatasyābhidhāne prātipadikārthatvādabhihitaḥ so'rtho'ntarbhūta iti ṣaṣṭhī nabhavati | yatra hi prādhānyenodbhūtaḥ sambandhaḥ, sa viṣayaḥ ṣaṣṭhayāḥ | tadevaṃ padārthābhidhāne'nuprayogāpapatticodyapratisamādhānāya vibhak‌tyarthābhidhānapakṣa samāśritaḥ | tatra ca sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ kriyāyogaścopapāditaḥ | kiñcārthagrahaṇāt kṛtsnārthavṛtte sādhutvaṃ prayogaprāmāṇyādavasthā- pitam || 230 ||
kecit punarmatāntaramāhurityāha-- anuprayogasid‌dhyarthaṃ na vibhak‌tyarthakalpanā | vastvantaramupakṣiptamiti kecit pracakṣate || 231 ||
`padārthābhidhāne'nuprayogānupapattirabhihitatvāt' ityasya pratisamādhānāya vibhak‌tyarthābhidhānapakṣo nāśritaḥ `na vānabhihitatvāt | sāmānyabhidhāne hi viśeṣāna- bhidhānam' ityevamanuprayogasyopapāditvāt | kintu darśanāntaramevedaṃ yuktāyuktavicāraviṣayatayopanyastamityanyeṣāṃ matam| tathā hyatrāpi so'yamityabhisambandhād dravyasyābhidhānamiṣyate | tathā cānuprayogānupapattiriti tadavastho doṣaḥ | tatra punastathaiva pratividheyam `na vānabhihitatvāt' iti | tat kathaṃ parihārāntaramidaṃ bhavediti | kociditi vacanādatrāruciṃ sūcayati | tathā hi bhāṣye|?thaveti samādhānāntaratvenaivāsyopakṣepaḥ | `evaccātra yuktam, atra hi sarvapaścātpadaṃ vartata' iti cāsya pakṣasyotkarṣo'bhihitaḥ | yadyapi cātrāpi pakṣe so'yamiti sambandhād dravyābhidhānam, tathāpi prakriyāyāmanuprayogasiddhyarthaṃ vibhak‌tyarthaprādhānyameva | anuprayogaprāmāṇ- yāttu kṛtsnābhidhānamarthagrahaṇāt siddhānta iti prāguktameva jyāyaḥ | tatra ca svābhāvike (svābhāvikyau) liṅgasaṃkhye | pakṣāntare tu śāstrāditi nirṇī- tam || 231 ||
vastvantaropakṣepadarśane pakṣadvayasaṅkalanāyāha-- sambandhibhirviśiṣṭānāṃ sambandhānā nimittatā | sambandhairvā viśiṣṭānāṃ tadvatāṃ syānnimittatā || 232 ||
vartipadopādānaiḥ sambandhibhiravacchinnānāṃ sambandhānāṃ bahurvīhipravṛttau nimittatvaṃ vibhak‌tyarthābhidhānepakṣe | bahurvīhipravṛttau nimittatvam | bahuvacana-matrāpi pūrvavat || 232 ||
etadevaikayogakṣemamatvarthīyadarśanena vyutpādayati-- kecit saṃyogino daṇḍād viṣāṇāt samavāyinaḥ | tadvati pratyayānāhurbahurvīhiṃ tathaiva ca || 233 ||
saṃyogākhyena sambandhena viśiṣṭād daṇḍāt sambandhini pravṛttinimittāt samavāyākhyasambandhopakṛtācca viṣāṇāt tadvati saṃyogidaṇḍasambandhini samavāyi- viṣāṇasambandhini ca pratyayānmatvarthīyān iniṭhanmatublakṣaṇān varṇayanti daṇḍī viṣāṇītyādau | tathaiva tenaiva prakāreṇa dravyābhidhānapakṣāvalambino bahurvīhiṃ sambandhopakṛta- sambandhinimittamācakṣate | yathā daṇḍaviṣāṇasambandhopakṛtau sambandhīnau matvarthīya- nimittamevaṃ yathāsvaṃ sambandhopakṛto vartipadārthalakṣaṇaḥ sambandhī bahurvīhisamāsasya pravṛttimanimittam | anyapadārthalakṣaṇastu sambandhī vācya iti padārthābhidhānapakṣa ityarthaḥ | pālāśadaṇḍatha iti saṃyogopakṛtaḥ sambandhī nimittam | tigmaviṣāṇa iti samavāyo- pakṛtaḥ || 233 ||
pakṣāntaramāha-- bhinnaṃ sambandhibhedena sambandhamapare viduḥ | nimittaṃ savibhak‌tyarthaḥ samāsenābhidhīyate || 234 ||
vartipadārthalakṣamasambandhiviśeṣopakṛtaḥ sambandho vā yathāyathaṃ bhinno'tra matvarthīyanimittam | tathāhi-damḍī viṣāṇītyukte sambandhinaḥ sambandhasya ca sannidhā-nācchabdapravṛttāvaviśeṣeṇa dvayorapi nimittatvamavadhāryate, dvābhyāmapi pratītāvanu- rāgajananāt | prakriyābhedastu kalpanākalpitaḥ | evaṃ bahurvīhiṇāpi samāsena sa vibhak‌tyarthaḥ sambandhiviśeṣopakṛtaḥ sambandhaḥ pratipādyata ityuktameva | sambandhamātre cātra viśrāntyabhāvādubhayatra so'yamiti sambandhena tadvadabhidhānam || 234 ||
tadevaṃ bahurvīheranyapadārthaviṣayatve sambandhasya yadā nimittamātratvam, tadavacchinnastu sambandhī vācyo'rthagrahaṇasāmarthyāt, tadā pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ | yadā tu sambandha eva pradhānamanyapadārthatayā svairupādhibhirguṇa- bhūtairavacchinno'bhidheyo vācyaḥ, tadā dvitīyaḥ pakṣa iti nigamayitumāha-- pradhānamanyārthatayā bhinnaṃ svairupasarjanaiḥ | nimittamabhidheyaṃ vā sarvapaścādapekṣyate || 235 ||
pradhānamanyapadārthatayā sambandho vartipadārthaguṇabhūtairavacchinnaḥ sambandhini pravartamānasya bahurvīhernibandhanamiti pūrvasya pakṣasya nigamanam | sa eva vā sambandho vācyaḥ | tathāhi sarvapaścādapekṣyata iti sambandhābhidhānapakṣaṃ bhāṣyeṇa saṃvādayati | atra hi `sarvapaścātpadaṃ vartate' iti bhāṣye uktam | abhidhānavyāpāreṇa ṣaṣṭhyantasya padasya sambandhyayavacchinnasambandhapradhānatvādasya pakṣasyotkarṣaḥ pratipāditaḥ || 235 ||
nanu ca citrā gāvo yasyeti vyatiricyamānena tatra guṇabhūtena svāminā svapadārthabhūtā gāva eva viśeṣyamāṇāḥ pradhānamiti kathaṃ sambandhaviśiṣṭaḥ sambandhī, sambandhiviśiṣṭo vā sambandho bahurvīhivācyaḥ syādityāśaṅkyāha-- svāmini vyatirekaśca vākye yadyapi dṛśyate | prādhānya eva tasyeṣṭo bahurvīhirvivakṣite || 236 ||
vṛttivākyayoratyantabhedādarthabhedo'vinābhāvīti vākye'nyapadārthasyopasarja-natve'pi vṛttau prādhānyaṃ tasyābhimatam || 236 ||
evaṃ ca nedamanuguṇaṃ vākyamityāha-- gavāṃ viśeṣaṇatvena yadā tadvān pravartate | asyaitā iti tatrārthe bahurvīhirna vidyate || 237 ||
kasyaitāścitragavya iti jijñāsāyāṃ citrā gāvo'syoti yadā vākyaṃ prayu- jyate, tadopasarjanatve tadvato gosvāmino vākyādasmādavagate vṛttyartho na pradarśitaḥsyāt paripūrṇaḥ || 237 ||
idaṃ tvanuguṇaṃ vākyamityāha-- yadā pratyavamarśastu tāsāṃ svāmī gavāmiti | gobhistadābhisambandho nimittatvāya kalpate || 238 ||
āsāṃ citragavīnāṃ kaḥ svāmīti jijñāsāyāṃ yadā svamiviśeṣapratipattyarthaṃ citragavya upalakṣaṇatvenāśrīyante, tadānyapadārthasya vartipadārthargobhirabhisambandho bahuvrīhisamāsasya nimittaṃ jāyate | tataśca citrā gāvo yasya so'yaṃ citragurityeva- matrānyapadārthaprādhānye vākyamucitamityarthaḥ || 238 ||
yadā tarhi sambandhānnimittāt sambandhī samāsāvācyaḥ, tadā liṅgasaṃkhyāti- deśasyopayogo na vetyāha-- apekṣamāṇaḥ sambandhaṃ rūḍhitvasya nivṛttaye | nimittānuvidhāyitvāt taddharmārthaḥ prasajyate || 239 ||
sambandhāvacchinnaḥ sambandhī vācya iti nimittasya sambandhasyānuvidhānamanu- pravṛttiriti tasyaiva sambandhasya dharmo liṅgasaṃkhyārahitatvaṃ yasya tathābhūto bahurvī- hivācyaḥ prāpnoti | sambandho hi nimittam | asattvabhūtaḥ sa ca nānuvidhīyate'tra nimittamiti na vācyam, yasmānnimitte'nanuvidhīyamāne rūḍhiśabdo bahurvīhiḥ syāt | rūḍhiṣvavayavārthānusaraṇābhāvāt | `citraguḥ'tyādau cāvayavārtho'nustriyata eva || 239 ||
etadeva nidarśanena draḍhayati-- nānācitrā iti yathā nimittamanurudhyate (vartate) | nānābhūte'pi vṛttaḥ san bahurvīhistathā bhavet || 240 ||
nānāśabdo'sahabhāvamātravacano'vyayaḥ | sa sadā'sahabhāvaṃ nimittamupādāya tadvati sattvarūpe vartate, tadāpi nimittānuvidhānādasattvabhūta eva | evaṃ bahurvīhirapi syāt | nimittānnimittavatyarthe nimittasarūpaḥ pratyayo jāyata iti nimittinaḥ svarūpasya śuddhasyāpratibhāsanāt svakāryayogābhāve nimittakāryameva nyāyyamityatra yuktirgarbhīkṛtā, na tu dṛṣṭāntamātrādartha- siddhiḥ || 240 ||
tadevaṃ nimittānuvidhāne'tra prāpte vyaktivacanātideśaḥ sapharaḥ | yadā tu varttipadārthabhūtāḥ sambandhino nimittamanyapadārthasya dravyasya, tadānārtho'tideśenetyāha-- sambandhini nimitte tu dravyadharmo na hīyate | liṅgābhāvo hi liṅgasya virodhitvena vartate || 241 ||
pravṛttinimittaṃ sambandhī vācyo'pi sambandhī liṅgasaṃkhyāsamanvayayogya ityatra pakṣe svābhāvike liṅgasaṃkhye, nārtho'tideśena | na hyatra nimittānuvidhāne'pi dravyadharmasya liṅgasaṃkhyayogitvasya hāniḥ, nimittasyāpi liṅgasaṃkhyāyogitvāt | yadyapi cānyaliṅgasaṃkhyāścitrā gāvaśca sambandhinyo nimittabhūtāḥ,devada- ttaścānyapadārtho vācyaḥ anyaliṅgasaṃkhyaḥ, tathāpi sambandhināmavayavārthānāmatra pravṛttinimittānāṃ nimittirūpātirodhāyakatvam, bhedena vṛttihetutvāt | tathā cātiraskṛtātmānyapadārthaḥ sambandhī pratīyamānaḥ svaliṅgasaṃkhyāyogārha eveti nāsti virodhaḥ | sambandhasya tu pravṛttinimittatve svaśabdopādāno'sau svarūpāvirodhena samban‌dhinaṃ gamayet | tathā ca tena nimittenāliṅgasaṃkhyena tiro- hitarūpaḥ sambandhī svaliṅgasaṃkhyākāryaṃ nāsādayati | liṅgabhovo liṅgavirodhī, nānyaliṅgatā || 241 ||
tathāhi-- saṃkhyāvām̐lliṅgaścārtho'bhinnadharmā nimittataḥ | āsanna eva dravyatvāt taddharmairna virudhyate || 242 ||
yadā sambandhī nimittaṃ, sa eva ca liṅgasaṃkhyāvānanyapadārthaḥ, tadāsāvabhinna- dharmā tulyadharmā | kenābhinnadharmetyāha--nimittata iti | lyablopo pañcamī | nimi- ttamapekṣyetyarthaḥ | nimittena tulyadharmeti yāvat | dvayorapi sambandhinoḥ sattvarūpatvāt | evañcāsanna evānyapadārtho nimittasya tulyadharmatvānnikaṭaḥ, nātidūraḥ sambandhanimittapakṣavat | ataśca nimittadharmairliṅgasaṃkhyābhedairanyapadārtho na virudh-yate | atirohitātmā hyabhidhīyamānaḥ svaliṅgasaṃkhyābhyāṃ yokṣyata ityarthaḥ | kvacit tu virodhe sati nimittadharmānuvṛttirbhatyeva | tadyathā--harītakyaḥ phalāni, khalatikaṃ vanānīti | itthaṃ ca vyatirekeṇa pratīya-mānasya nimittasya dvayī gatiḥ taddharmānuvidhānaṃ harītakyādiṣu | tadabhāvoyathā bahuvrīhau | svarūpāveśena tvabhedena pratīyamānasya nimittasya nimittinā dharmo'nuvidhīyata eva | gatametat || 242 ||
idaṃ tu vaktavyam--vibhak‌tyarthapakṣe'pi so'yamiti sambandhāt sambandhīni-ṣṭhatve, kaḥ padārthābhidhānapakṣād bheda ityata āha-- vibhak‌tyarthena cāviṣṭaṃ śuddhaṃ ceti dvidhā sthitam | dravyaṃ śuddhasya yo dharmaḥ sa na syādanyadharmaṇaḥ || 243 ||
ṣaṣṭhīlakṣaṇavibhaktivācyena sambandhenāpāditābhedaṃ dravyaṃ vibhak‌tyarthābhidhā-napakṣe vācyam, ananyopahitaṃ śuddhaṃ ca padārthābhidhānapakṣe vācyamiti prakāradvayena dravyasya pravartanāt pakṣabhedaḥ | tatra śuddhasya svenācmanābhidhīyamānasya yo dharmo liṅgasaṅkhye, sa na bhavati sambandhenāviṣṭasyākhyāyamānasya, pararūpoparāgāditi liṅgasaṅkhyātideśo'tra saphalaḥ | padārthābhidhānapakṣe tu śuddhasya dravyasyānyapadārthasya vartipadārthaviśiṣṭasyābhidhā-nād vartipadārthalakṣaṇāḥ sambandhinaḥ pravṛttinimittamiti dravyadharmāhāni- ruktā || 243 ||
etadova vācyasya prakāradvayena vartanaṃ pakṣayorvibhajati-- dravyamātrasya nirdeśe bhedo'yamavivakṣitaḥ | granthe pūrvatra bhedastu dvitīye'nupradarśitaḥ || 244 ||
vibhak‌tyarthāveśalakṣaṇo yo viśeṣaḥ, dravyamātrasya śuddhasya sambandhānupahitasya nirdeśe pratipādane pūrvasmin granthe yatrānuprayogānupapattiścoditā `na vā'nabhihitatvāt' ityādinā ca pratisamāhitā bhāṣye, tatra padārthābhidhānapakṣe nāmidhātumiṣṭaḥ | `athavā vibhak‌tyartho'bhidhīyate' ityatra tu dvitīye bhāṣyagranthe'yaṃ viśeṣaḥ sākṣādevoktaḥ | atrāpi ca vibhak‌tyarthāviṣṭaṃ dravyamevocyate, anyathā dravyānabhidhāne sarvethavāsad‌vyaktivacanaṃ kathamatideśādapi prāpyeta | pradhānaṃ tu sambandho'tra vivakṣitaḥ || 244 ||
yadyevaṃ tena saṃvṛtasvarūpatvād dravyasyābhidhānābhāva iti kathamidamuktam-- `sadravyaḥ saliṅgaḥ sasaṃkhyaḥ' ityata āha-- dravyasya grahaṇaṃ cātra liṅgasaṃkhyāviśeṣaṇam | dravyāśritatvaṃ hi tayostato'nyasya na sidhyataḥ || 245 ||
yadyapi liṅgasaṅkhyayordravyaṃ viśeṣyam, tathāpi tayorviśeṣaṇamatra dravya- grahaṇaṃ boddhavyam | anyasya guṇādestābhyāmayogapratipādanārthaṃ dravyāśritatvamevānayoriti sambandhābhidhāne'pi liṅgasaṅkhyāsiddhyarthaṃ sadravya ityuktam | sambandho hi ṣaṣṭhīvācyamudbhūtamatra rūpaṃ hitvā dravyābhedenābhidhīyamānaḥ sadravyo'bhihito bhavati | na tu dravyasyātra guṇabhāvādanabhidhānam | ārthena hi rūpeṇa prādhānyaṃ dravyasyaiva | pakṣamedārthaṃ tu sambandhalya śābdaṃ prādhānyamāśri- tam || 245 ||
tathāhi-- sambandhibhinnasambandhaparicchinne pravartate | samāso dravyasāmānye viśiṣṭārthānupātini || 246 ||
vartipadārthabhūtaiḥ sambandhibhirviśeṣito yaḥ sambandhastena paricchinne svarū- pasambhedenāvacchinne sambandhini dravyasāmānye vibhak‌tyarthābhidhānapakṣe bahurvīhi-rvācakatvena pravartate | sāmānya iti padārthaviśeṣāṇāmanabhihitānāmanuprayogopapattima- trāpi darśane pakṣāntaravadāha || 246 ||
ataśca viśeṣaiḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyāt tadanupātitve phalamāha-- dravyadharmānatikrānto bhedadharmeṣvavasthitaḥ (ṣvaśaktitaḥ) | bhaviṣyadāśrayāpekṣe liṅgasaṅkhye prapadyate || 247 ||
dravyasāmānyavṛttitvād yogyatāmātrād dravyadharmaṃ liṅgasaṅkhyālakṣaṇa-manatikrāntaḥ samāso dravyaviśeṣagataṃ ca rūpābhedādasamartho liṅgavacanaṃ pratipattumiti "viśeṣaṇānāṃ"  iti śāstrasāmarthyāt padāntaraprayogāvadhṛtadravyaviśeṣā- śrayagate yathāyathaṃ liṅgasaṅkhye samavalambate | ityavasitavicāro bahurvīhiḥ || 247 ||
kramaprāpte nañsamāse liṅgavacanātideśaṃ vicārayituṃ bhāṣyopakṣiptaṃ paśra- trayaṃ samarthayate-- śāstrapravṛttibhede'pi laukikārtho na bhidyate | nañsamāse yatastatra trayaḥ pakṣā vicāritāḥ || 248 ||
ekatra guṇaprādhānabhāvasyānavasthānāt kathaṃ pakṣatrayopapattiḥ ? abrāhmaṇāde- rhyanyapadārthasyaiva kṣatriyāderavadhāraṇāt tatpradhānatvameva nyāyyami ta coditaṃ satīdaṃ samarthayate--`arthānādeśanāt tacca laghvartham' iti vadatā sthitalakṣaṇo'rthaḥ prakriyābhede'pyavyabhicārī laukikaḥ uktaḥ | tathāhi--yadānyapadārthaḥ pradhānam, tadā vyaktivacanamuttarapadam, avidyamānā brāhmaṇavyaktirāśrayabhūtāsmin kṣatriye kṣatriyajātāviti | yadā tu pūrvapadārtho nañartho nivṛttirūpaḥ pradhānam, tadā tasyāsataḥ kriyāyo-gābhāvānniṣedhasya prasaṅgapūrvakatvāduttarapadārthasadṛśameva pratīyate | evamuttarapadārthaprādhānye'pi brāhmaṇyenāvasitaḥ kṣatriyādirevāvagamyata iti nāsti bhedaḥ sthitalakṣaṇasyārthasya | apoddhārapadārthastvanvākhyānāṅgamiti prakriyāyāṃ sa bhidyate | tathā ca `kiṃpradhāno'yaṃ samāsaḥ, uttarapadārthapradhānaḥ, pūrvapadārthapradhānaḥ, anyapadārthapradhāno vā' iti pakṣatrayamupanyasya bhāṣye yasmin pakṣe śāstrapra- kriyā na vilupyate, tamavasthāpayituṃ vicāro na virudhyate || 248 ||
yadyapi nāroddhārapadārthaḥ pratipādakaśabdaniṣṭhaḥ, tathāpi-- śabdāntare'pi caikatvamāśrityaiva vicāraṇā | abrāhmaṇādiṣu nañaḥ prayogo na hi vidyate || 249 ||
na brāhmaṇo'brāhmaṇa ityādiparikalpitāvayavavibhāgapratipādakaśabdaniṣṭhaṃ pūrvapadottarapadagatārthavibhāgaparikalpanayānvākhyeyasthitakṣaṇārthaśabdānuśāsanaṃ kriyate lāghavārtham | yathāhi--prakriyāyāmapi vākyād vṛtteḥ śabdānyatve'pi vākyena sahābhedaṃ parikalpya parīkṣā vidhīyate | tathā cābrāhmaṇādiṣu samāseṣu yadyapi nañ nāma na kaścid dṛśyate, tathāpi vākye naño dṛṣṭestadabhedena vyutpādanam | sarva eva hi vṛtteḥ saṃsṛṣṭā- rthāyā viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyādibhedo'rthānāṃ vākyābhedasamāśrayaḥ, vākyārthasyā vṛttau sampratyayāt | tataśca nivṛttilakṣaṇasya nañarthasya saṃpratyayādabrāhmaṇādiṣvakārarūpamidaṃ nañsambandhīti niścīyate | adhikāpanayādiṣu tvakārarūpamevānuvartate, na nañarthaḥ | paramārthatastvabrāhmaṇādirnirastāvayavavibhāgo muṇḍisūtryādivaditi `brāhmaṇārtho yathā nāsti kaścid brāhmaṇakamba kambale,  ityādinā nirṇītameva || 249 ||
evaṃ pakṣatrayavicāropapattimuk‌tvā kīdṛgartho vākye naño dṛśyate, tasya tadabhedena vṛttau vyutpādyamānāyāmanugama ityāha-- prāk samāsāt padārthānāṃ nivṛttirdyotyate nañā | svabhāvato nivṛttānāṃ rūpābhedādalakṣitā || 250 ||
vākye nañ‌prayoge nivṛttiravasīyate | sā ca na svatantrā, nirviśeṣaṇasyā- bhāvasyāpratīteriti padārthaniṣṭhāsau | tatra san padārtho nañprayogamātrānnivartituṃ notsahate | śabdāntaraprayoge'pani ca padānāṃ vācyasya nyūnatātirekayoranupapattiḥ | tasmāt svabhāvenaiva nivṛttānāṃ nañ dyotako nivṛtteḥ | nivṛttāstarhi kathaṃ śabdenocyanta iti ced , na vastvarthaḥ śabdārthaḥ | upacārasattāśrayastu bhāvābhāvasādhāraṇaḥ pratītipratibhāsī śabdavācya iti `vyapadeśe padārthānāmanyā sattaupacārikī'  iti | kṛtanirṇayam | tathā ca bhāvābhāvasādhāraṇyāt prayogasyānabhivyaktā nivṛttirnañāpi (vi) dyotyata iti parapadārthaniṣṭhasyārthasyāvedanād dyotakatvamucyate || 250 ||
yadyevaṃ nañaḥ svatantraḥ padārtha eva nāsti, yaḥ prādhānaṃ syāt | sati vā tasminnabhāvātmanā tena viśeṣyamāṇa uttarapadārthaḥ svabhāvāt pracyutaḥkathamasattvāt prādhānyaṃ pratipadyate ? sati ca vartipadārthayorabhisambandhe tadavacchinnanyapadārthābhidhānamapi na kalpeteti kathaṃ pakṣatrayopapattiḥ | athottarapadārthagatā kriyā pratiṣidhyate, tadā samāsa eva nāstītyāha-- brāhmaṇādisthayā vākyeṣvākhyātapadavācyayā | kriyayā yasya sambandho vṛttistasya na vidyate || 251 ||
kriyā pratiṣidhyamānā padāntaropādānā vā syād, vṛttipadavācyā vā | prathame kalpe `brāhmaṇo na bhuṅ‌kte, brāhmaṇo nādhīte' iti tiṅntapadapratipādyayābrāhmaṇādisamavāyinyā yasya nañaḥ kriyayā yogaḥ, tasyottarapadenāsāmarthyāt samāso nāsti | kriyayā hi naño'tra sambandhaḥ, na brāhmaṇādibhiruttarapadaiḥ | tataśca samāsasyaivātrābhāvād guṇapradhānabhāvavikalpo vartipadārthānāṃ nirālambanaḥ | padārthātmabhūtayā tvastikriyayā naño yoge samāso bhavatyeva | tadānīṃ hyuttarapadārthanaiva sāmarthyam, brāhmaṇo nāstīti | avyabhicārā hi sattā padārthasyāprayujyamāne'pi kriyāpade pratīyata iti sāmarthyalabhyāyāstasyā niṣedhe nivṛttapadārthakairevottarapadairūpātte'rthadyotakasya nañaḥ prayogāt siddhāntayiṣyate samāsaḥ || 251 ||
nanvanena nyāyenottarapadasvīkṛtayānyayāpi kriyayā nañaḥ sāmarthye bhavatu samāsa ityata āha-- pācakādipadasthā cennañā sambandhyate kriyā | tatra sattānupādānāt tripakṣī nopapadyate || 252 ||
uttarapadena pācakādinā yā guṇabhāvena racyādikriyāpāttā, sā yadi nañā dyotakena vākya iva yujyate, tadā svārthāvacchinnāyā vācyatvena nañā sattāyā parigrahāt pakṣatrayaṃ na ghaṭate | dyotyārthanottarapadenaiva sambandhāduttarapadā-rthaprādhānyamevaikaṃ bhavet | nahi nañaḥ svatantraḥ kaścit padārthaḥ, yaḥ pradhānaṃ, guṇa iti vā nirūpyate dyotakatvād dyotyārthaniṣṭhatvāt | tathā ca yatra dyotyena kriyālakṣaṇenārthenāsti sambandhaḥ, tatra samāso na pācako'pācaka ityādi | atra hi guṇabhūttottarapadena kriyābhidhīyata iti nañā niṣedhyatayā tasyāḥ sambandhaḥ | brāhmaṇādestūttarapadasya guṇabhūtāpi kriyā na vācyeti tena nañaḥ sambandhābhāvāt pūrvoktapakṣatrayānupapattiḥ | tasmād dyotakatvaṃ naña'nupapannam pakṣabhedānupapattiprasaṅgāditi vṛttiviṣaye vācakatvamabhyupagamanīyam | tathā cāsattāvacanatvānnaño nivṛttapadārthakairuttarapadairbrāhmaṇādibhirasamban- dhāt pakṣatrayamupapadyate | asattāsāmānyavacano hi nañ tadviśeṣavacanairyogamanubhavan yathāvivakṣaṃ pūrvottarānyapadārthapradhānetaretarabhāvasamāśrayeṇa vṛttimāpadyate || 252 ||
yadyevam-- sattayaivābhisambandho yadi sarvatra kalpyate | asanniti samāse'smin sattānyā parikalpyatām || 253 ||
sarvapadārthānāṃ sattāyogasyāvyabhicārāt sattayaiva padārthātmabhūtayā na kriyā-ntareṇa vyabhicāriṇā yadi naño yogaḥ kalpyate, tadā asannityatrāpi nañsamāse sattāyā uttarapadanibandhanāyāḥ sambandhi sattāntaraṃ nañā pratyāyyamānaṃ na kalpanīyamāpatati | caivaṃ sattābhedaḥ pratīyate, ekasyā evātra niṣidhyamānāyāḥ sattāyā avagamāt || 253 ||
atraivāparaṃ doṣamāha-- k‌tvānte ca tumunante ca nañsamāse na dṛśyate | viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyatvaṃ nañā (nañaḥ) sattābhidhāyināṃ || 254 ||
akṛtvā akartumityatrākhyāteneva kṛtvasujādisambandhayogyatayā sādhyasayaivā- rthasya pradhānatvenākhyāyamānasyāsannityevamarthena nañā karoterabhisambandho'vacchedyā-vacchedakabhāvo nopapadyate | na hi sattāṃ niṣedhatā nañā karoteḥ sambandho yujyate, pratiṣedhyenaiva bhavediti kathamabhisambandhaḥ | tasmādasattāvācitve nañaḥ ubhayatrāpyatra nopapattiriti niṣedhamātravacano'tra nañ | tathā cāsinnityatrottarapadārthabhūtāṃ sattāṃ niṣedhatīti sambandhopapattiḥ | kiṃtvabrāhmaṇādāvanupapattiḥ, brāhmaṇārthasya sato niṣed‌dhumaśakyatvāt | atrāpi sannantaḥ karotyarthaśca bhāvātmakaḥ kathaṃ niṣed‌dhuṃ śakyate ? evaṃ tarhi svabhāvato nivṛttasyārthasya dyotako nañ vākya iva vṛttau prayujyate, tatrāpi dvayī gatiḥ | kriyāyogamantareṇa padārthasya kevalasyānupapatte- rviśiṣṭakriyāśrayo vārthātmā svabhāvato nivṛtto dyotyatām, kriyāsāmānyā- śrayo vā | pūrvatra kalpe sāmarthyābhāvād vṛttirnāsti | sati vā sāmarthye pakṣatrayānupapattirityuktam | dvitīye pakṣe sattālakṣaṇasya kriyāsāmānyasya nañ‌dyotyasya sāmānvayavā-cinaivottarapadena sambandhe'navasthoktā | viśeṣavācinā tvasambandha iti dyotakatvamatra nopapadyate | dyotakatve hi dyotyārthaniṣṭhatvāt satyapi sambandhe uttarapadārtha- prādhānyamevaikaṃ syāt | tasmād vācakatvamabhyupeyam | tathā ca nañaḥ svatantro'rtha iti yathāyogaṃ tasya guṇapradhānabhāvopapattau pakṣatrayavicāraḥ || 254 ||
tatrāsattāvacano nañiti, yathā dvitīyā sattā nāpatati, yathā cākṛtvetyādau saṃbandho yujyate, tathopapādayati-- kriyāyāḥ sādhanādhārasāmānye nañ vyavasthitaḥ | tato viśiṣṭairādhārairyujyate brāhmaṇādibhiḥ || 255 ||
sāmānyābhidhāne'pi naño'sattāvacanatvena prastāvat sattālakṣaṇātra kriyā | tathā hyabhāvātmako naño'rtho bhāvasya sattāyāniṣedharūpaḥ, tasyāḥ sādhanamakarmaka- tvāt kartṛśaktiḥ | nirāśrayāyāḥ sādhanabhāvānupapatteḥ sāmarthyalabhyastadādhāra āśrayo-'nāśritaviśeṣaḥ sāmānyamastītyevaṃrūpo'tra nirdiṣṭaḥ | tatra vācakatvena nañ vyavasthitaḥ pravṛttaḥ | kiṃ vidyamāno'rtho'stītyevaṃrūpo naño vācyaḥ | neti brūmaḥ | kathaṃ tarhi `kriyāyāḥ sādhanādhārasāmānye nañ vyavasthitaḥ' ityucyate ? svārthamabhāvātmakaṃ tatra niveśayatītyevametaducyate | tataścābhāvoparaktamasti- kriyāsādhanādhārasāmānyaṃ vṛttiviṣaye nañ vācyamiti nāstītyevaṃrūpo naño'rthaḥ | tatra kiṃ nāstīti viśeṣākāṅkṣā taduttarapadaiḥ pūryate | tathā ca tataḥ sāmānyāvasthānāddhetorvilakṣaṇaiḥ sattāviśeṣasādhanādhāraviśeṣa- vacanairbrāhmaṇādiśabdaiḥ sambadhyate nañiti tadarthayoḥ sāmānyaviśeṣabhāvena viśeṣaṇaviśeṣ- yabhāvopapattiḥ | sāmānyarūpaṃ hyavidyamānaṃ viśiṣṭairavidyamānairyujyate, gotvaṃ śāba-leyādibhiriva | tatra brāhmaṇasyāsattvamiti yadā kāmacārād viśeṣaṇāviśeṣyayorvi- vakṣā, tadā pūrvapadārthapradhānatā | asad brāhmaṇyamasyetyevamanyārthagāmitve vartipadārthayoranyapadārthaprādhānyopapattiḥ | evaṃ viśeṣe sāmānyasyāvyabhicārāt pācakādau pacyādikriyāviśeṣānugata- sattātmakakriyāsāmānyāśrayapakṣabhedopapattiḥ | evaṃ viśeṣe sāmānyasyāvyabhicārāt pācakādau pacyādikriyāviśeṣānugata- sattātmakakriyāsāmānyāśrayapakṣabhedopapattiḥ | evaṃ karotinā sattātmanaiva yujyate, na viśeṣarūpeṇeti viśeṣe sattāmeva samavā- yinīṃ nañartho'satsāmānyaṃ niṣedhayogyatayākṛtvā kartumityādāvāskandati | asannityatrāpi prakaraṇād viśeṣaniveśinīmeva sattāmasattāsāmānyaṃ niṣedhyata-yāvalambate | anacchinnaviṣayasyāsattvasya prayojanābhāvenāpratipādyatvāt | brāhma-ṇādireva hi kaścit san niṣeddhamātropādīyate, na san brāhmaṇa iti | prakaraṇāttu viśeṣāvasāye brāhmaṇādipadaprayogānādaraḥ | tathā ca brāhmaṇādirityevātrāpyartha iti sāmānyaviśeṣayorevāyaṃ viśeṣaṇaviśe-ṣyabhāvaḥ | na hi dvayoḥ sāmānyayoḥ prayogo'sti, naipākāṅkṣyānupapatteriti sattāntaraparikalpanādoṣānavatāraḥ | sarvatra cātrottarapadārthasadṛśapratipattiḥ | anya- trādhyāropitasya hi svato nivṛttasya niṣedhaḥ suvacaḥ | taditthaṃ vācakatvamabhyupagamya sarvamupapadyate || 255 ||
dyotakasya tarhi vākye naño vṛttau vācakatvaṃ kathamupapadyata iti cedāha-- vṛttau yathā gatādyarthamupādāya nirādayaḥ | yujyante sādhanādhārairnañsamāse'pi sa kramaḥ || 256 ||
niṣkauśāmbiḥ atikhaṭ‌vaḥ praparṇa ityādivṛttipadeṣu pūrvapadabhūtā niratipra-bhṛtayo'sattvavacanā api vākye dṛṣṭāḥ sattvabhūtārthābhidhāyinaḥ | tathāhi--gatakrāntādisasādhanakriyāvacanāḥ kauśāmbyādibhirapādānādisādhana- śak‌tyādhārairdravyaiḥ sambadhyante | yadi cāsattvavacanā eva syuḥ, tadā taiḥ sattvavacanaiḥ sambandho na syāditi tadanyathānupapattyā niṣkramaṇādikriyopasarjane sādha-naśak‌tyādhāre dravye vṛttireṣāmanumīyate | vākyaparadṛṣṭa eva ca tatra vṛttirabhidhānaśa- ktiniyamāditi nātiprasaṅgaḥ | yadāha vākyakāraḥ--`tadarthagatervā' iti | yenārthena nirāderbhavati kauśāmbyādinā sāmarthyam, tadanyathānupapattyā tasyaiva pratīterita- yarthaḥ | evaṃ yathātra vṛttau pūrvapadaṃ padāntarasambhinnārthatayā vākyaparidṛṣṭaṃ viśeṣama- ntarbhāvayati, tathaivābrāhmaṇādāviti sāmyam | atrāpi hyuttarapadārthasambandhānyathānupapattyā naño'satsāmānyavācakatvaṃ parikalpyata iti vācakatvopāyā saivānupūrvī || 256 ||
evamapyasatsāmānyābhidhāyitve kathaṃ pakṣatrayopapattiḥ, pūrvottarapadārthayo- rguṇapradhānabhāvāniyame sati hi trayaḥ pakṣā upapadyeran | sa tu kathamatrāniyama ityāha-- tatrāsati naño vṛtterbrāhmaṇakṣatriyādibhiḥ | viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyatvaṃ kalpyate kubjakhañjavat || 257 ||
dvayorapi khañjakubjaśabdayorguṇanimittatvād viśeṣamaviśeṣyabhāvaṃ pratyaniyama ukto bhāṣye--khañjakubjaḥ kubjakhañja iti | evamasatsāmānye naño vācakatvena vartanāt tadviśeṣavacanairbrāhmaṇādibhirya- thāruci viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyatvaṃ guṇapradhānabhāvaḥ paryāyeṇa ghaṭate || 257 ||
tathā cābrāhmaṇo'kṣatriya ityādau kiṃ siddhamityāha-- kāmacāre ca satyevamasataḥ syāt pradhānatā | guṇatvamitareṣāṃ ca teṣāṃ vā syāt pradhānat || 258 ||
`siddhaṃ tu viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyayoryatheṣṭatvāt' iti khañjakubjādivadaniyame yadāsa- tsāmānyaṃ nañarthaḥ prādhānyena viśeṣyatayā vivakṣyate, tadā pūrvapadārthapradhānatā ita-reṣāmuttarapadārthānāṃ brāhmaṇādīnāṃ guṇatvavivakṣāyāṃ satyām | yadā tu teṣāmutta-padārthānāṃ prādhānyaṃ vivakṣyate, tadottarapadārthapradhāno nañ samāsaḥ | ata eva ca pūrvottarapadayorabhisambandhe'rthāntaraviṣaye vivakṣite anyapadārtha- prādhānyamapyuktaṃ bhavati | vākye tu niṣedhyaniṣṭhatayā niṣedhasyānavagaterna svatantronañaḥ padārtha ityavācakatvād dyotakatvam | ataśca guṇapradhānabhāve vivakṣāniyamābhāvāt tatra pakṣatrayānutthānam | ata eva cādivadaliṅgāsaṅkhyatvamavyayadharmo nañarthasya vākye, na tu vṛttau, sattvabhūtārthavācitvāt || 258 ||
itthaṃ pakṣatrayopapattau samarthitāyāṃ prathamaṃ bhāṣya upakṣiptamuttarapadārtha- prādhānyaṃ parīkṣyam | tathāhi--virodhādasatā kathaṃ brāhmaṇādirviśeṣyetetyata āha-- prādhānyenāśritāḥ pūrvaṃ śruteḥ sāmānyavṛttayaḥ | viśeṣa eva prākāntā brāhmaṇakṣatriyādayaḥ || 259 ||
sato niṣeddhumaśakyatvānnivṛttiviśiṣṭa eva viśiṣṭe'rthe brāhmaṇādayaḥ śaktā vācakatvenātrorakrama eva pravṛttāḥ | yadā tu teṣāṃ bhāvarūpe'pyarthe śruteḥ śabdasya rūpamīdṛśameva, tadāsau svā- rtharūpā nivṛttirdyotyate nañā | nañpadaprayoge hi sa viśeṣaḥ prakāśata iti virodhābhā-vāt kalpate viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaḥ || 259 ||
`prādhānyenāśritā' ityuttarapadārthaprādhānyapakṣamavalambate | etadeva nidarśanena vyutpādayati-- yathā gaurādibhisteṣāmavacchedo vidhīyate | asatāpyanabhivyaktaṃ tādātmyaṃ vyajyate tathā || 260 ||
gauraḥ śuklaḥ kṛṣṇo brāhmaṇaḥ ityādau yathā gaurādibhirviśeṣaṇairavacchidyante sāmānyabhūtā brāhmaṇādayaḥ, tathā'sadviśeṣavacanāḥ śrutisārūpyādanavagataviśeṣā nañā viśeṣyante || 260 ||
nanu gaurādayo vidyamānārthagatameva viśeṣamādadhānā yuktaṃ yadviśeṣaṇaṃ syuḥ | nañā uttarapadārthonmūlakena kathaṃ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaḥ ? nañaprayogo hyuttarapadārtho'sa- nnityavadhāryate | tathā cāsattvāduttarapadārthasyāprayoga eva brāhmaṇādiśabdānāṃ prāpnotītyāśaṅ‌kyāha-- yathā sattābhidhānāya sannarthaḥ parikalpyate | tathā sattābhidhānāya nirupākhyo vikalpyate || 261 ||
iha padāduccaritād bhāvābhāvasādhāraṇo'rthaḥ pratāyate | na cāsau tathāvidho bāhyaḥ, tasya bhāvaikaniṣṭhatvāt | sa eva cecchabdairucyate, tadā tasya sattā'vyabhicārāt tāṃ pratyākāṅkṣānupapatteḥ san brāhmaṇa iti nāvakalpeta viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaḥ | avakalpateca | tasmādupacārasattārūḍho'rthaḥ padavācyatvena kalpyate sāmānyena bhāvābhāvasamban-dhasya ityasan brāhmaṇa ityatrāpi parikalpitārthaniṣṭhatvena nañaprayogo na virudhyate | buddhirhyasya bahiḥ sadasattvamanapekṣyākāraṃ nirūpayantī virodhyavi- rodhiviśeṣaṇasamanvayakṣamaṃ taṃ padārthīkarotīti prāgeva nirṇītam | tatra yathā nīlotpalamiti buddhyā bhāgabhodakalpanayā sāmānyātmanā vastu nirūpitaṃ nīlaviśeṣaṇena sambadhyate, tathā bhāvābhāvasādhāraṇyena buddhayā gṛhītasya nivṛttirviśeṣaṇaṃ yujyate | na hyutpalaṃ nāma kiñcit sāmānyaṃ jagatyasti vastu, yannīlasambandhād viśeṣamāśrayeta | ekameva hi tadapi nirbhāgaṃ nīlotpalamiti buddhayaiva bhāgabhedopapattiḥ | evamihāpyabrāhmaṇa iti nirviṣayasya pratiṣedhasyāpravṛtteḥ sattā niṣedhya- tvenopacaryate | buddhisthāyāśca sattāyā bāhyatvenāropād bāhyasattāviṣayaḥ prati- ṣedho'vatiṣṭhate | tenaitadacodyaṃ buddhipratibhāsasyāpi brāhmaṇaśabdasya prayoga upapādite tatsa- dṛśādhikaraṇapratipattiṃ nañsamāse pratipādayitumāha-- kṣatriyādau padaṃ kṛtvā buddhiḥ sattāntarāśrayā | jātyā bhinnāṃ tataḥ sattāṃ prasaktāmapakarṣati || 262 ||
brāhmaṇasattāviṣayā buddhiryadā kutaścid bhrāntikāraṇāt kṣatriye prava-rtate, tadā brāhmaṇaśabdastatra prayujyate | so'yaṃ mithyādhyavasāyo yadā tattvajñā-nānnivartate, tadā nañaḥ prayoga ityayaṃ viṣayo nañsamāsasya | abrāhmaṇo'yaṃ kṣatriya iti kṣatriyasāmānādhikaraṇyāt tadavagatiḥ | evañca nañprayogādupajātā samyag‌buddhirbrāhmaṇakatvaikārthasamāvāyinīṃ sattāṃ kṣatriye brāhmaṇaśabdaprayogāt prasaktāmapakarṣati tato nivārayati | nāyaṃ brāhmaṇo mithyā tvevamavasitastatsadṛśo'brāhmaṇo'yamiti, sadṛśaḥ kṣatriyādireva samāsārthaḥ sampadyate na loṣṭādi, samāropanibandhanasya sādṛśyādera- bhāvāt | tathā coktam `nañiva yuktamanyasadṛśādhikaraṇe tathāhyarthagatiḥ' iti || 262 ||
iha kathaṃ nañ samāsaḥ abhāva iti | na hyatrottarapadārthasadṛśārthasaṃpratyayaḥ, api tu niṣedhaḥ pratīyate bhāvasyottarapadārthasya, tasya cāsataḥ kathaṃ bhāvaśabdaviṣayatetyata āha-- abhāva iti bhāvasya pratiṣedhe vivakṣite | sopākhyatvamanāśritya pratiṣedho na kalpate || 263 ||
pratiṣedhaviṣayapraklṛptyarthamatrāpi buddhayā nirūpitamākāramavalambya bhāvaśabda-prayogāt tasya śrutisāmyādasadviṣayatānavagamāt tadavagamāya nañprayoga upapadyate | nirū- pākhye hi vyāmohād bhāvatacvasamārope tattvādhyavasāyānnañprayoga ityarthaḥ ||263|| evaṃ caitat | "athavā sarva ime śabdā guṇasamudāye vartante' iti darśanamupakṣi- ptamatra bhāṣye | tadavalambanenāpyāha-- anekadharmavacanaiḥ śabdaiḥ saṅghābhidhāyibhiḥ | ekadeśeṣu vartante tulyarūpāḥ svabhāvataḥ || 264 ||
jātiguṇakriyālakṣaṇo dharmo'tra guṇaśabdena vivakṣyata iti dharmapadenāha | samudāyasya śabdāt pratīteḥ sa eva śabdārtho nyāyyaḥ | tacca `tapaḥ śrutaṃ ca yoniścetyetad brāhmaṇakārakam' ityuktam | yasya paripūrṇā dharmā jātyādayaḥ śrutādayaśca sa mukhyo brāhmaṇaḥ | tadabhidhāyī brāhmaṇaśabdo rūḍhaḥ | tena tulyaśrutiravayave vartate | samudāyoṣu hi vṛttāḥ śabdā avayaveṣvapi vartate | tad yathā--`tailaṃ bhuktam ghṛtaṃ bhuktam' ityuktam | yadyapi ca saṅghābhidhāyyekadeśābhidhāyī cārthabhedāt svabhāva-to'tyantabhinna eva śabdaḥ, tathāpi śrutisāmyādarvāgdarśanā bhedaṃ nāvagacchantītyabhe-damāśritya samudāyāvayavavṛttitvaṃ kathyate | tathā ca brāhmaṇajātirahite kṣatriye vidyāvinayalakṣaṇaikadeśāśrayo brāhmaṇaśa- bdaprayoga iti tasyaikadeśavṛttitā śrutisārūpyādanavagatā nañ prayogādavadhāryate | `tapaḥśrutābhyāṃ yo hīno jātibrāhmaṇa eva saḥ' iti vā brāhmaṇaka ucyate, yo guṇahīno jātimātreṇa tu brāhmaṇaḥ | itthaṃ cātra guṇasamudāyaviṣayatvāt pūrvottarapadayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyamupapadyate | atra hi nañā yasyaiva guṇasya svābhāvikī nivṛttiḥ, saiva dyotyata ityavaśiṣṭānāṃ guṇānāmarthāt sadbhāvo'vagamyate | tatra pūrvamupacārasattāśrayeṇoktam | idānīṃ tu pāramārthīkasyaiva kasyacid dharmasya nañā nivartane'pi pariśiṣṭamātrākalāpe samudāyādhyāsena śabdapravṛttirna nirviṣayetyetadākhyāyate | ubhayorapi ca tayoravayavayoḥ samudāyātmanādhyāsāt tasyaiva niṣedhaḥ, tatraiva ca śabdapravṛttiriti || 264 ||
nedaṃ codyam, uttarapadārthānupādānāṃśaniṣedhāt kathamuttarapadena samanvaya iti | tathāhi-- yathaikadeśakaraṇāt kṛta ityabhidhīyate | akṛtaśceti saṅghātaḥ sa evābrāhmaṇe kramaḥ || 265 ||
yathā ekadeśasya niṣpattestadaparasya caikadeśasyāniṣpatteḥ kṛtākṛtaḥ saṅghāto'bhidhīyate | avayavātmakatvāt samudāyasyāvayavadharmopacāro na virudhyate | evaṃ guṇasamudāyasyaikadeśe pravṛttinivṛttibhyāṃ brāhmaṇābrāhmaṇaśabdavācyatā || 265 ||
atra doṣamāha-- brāhmaṇo'brāhmaṇastasmādupanyāsāt prasajyate | akṛte vā kṛtāsaṅgādaviśiṣṭaṃ kṛtākṛtāt || 266 ||
ekadeśaṃ saṅghātātmanāvasāya brāhmaṇo'yamiti kathyate | ekadeśāntarasyāsattvāt punaḥ sa evābrāhmaṇa iti prāpnotīti virodhāpattiḥ | yadi vā sarvathaivākṛte samudāye samarthasādhanasannidhernirvṛttisambhāvanayā kṛtaśabdo yathā prayujyate, tadvat kṣatriyādau brāhmaṇasamānadharmadarśanād brāhmaṇaśabdavācyamātrākalāpaṃ pratyasya brāhmaṇatvasambhāvanayā brāhmaṇaśabdaprayoge sati yadā nañā mukhyārthatā nivartanena gauṇārthatedṛśī prakāśyate, tadā kṛtākṛtaśabdena tulyo'yaṃ nañ samāsaiti dvitīyārdhena codyaṃ nivāritam || 266 ||
ekadeśe ca brāhmaṇaśabdo'mukhya iti sādṛśyānmukhyabhrāntiḥ syāt | tāmapākartuṃ nañ prayujyamāno bhavati viśeṣaṇamityāha-- amukhyasambhave tatra mukhyasya vinivṛttaye | śāstrānvākhyānasamaye nañ prayukto viśeṣakaḥ || 267 ||
upakrama evāmukhye'rthe brāhmaṇaśabdaḥ prayukto'nadhihatavivakṣitārtha ityabrāhmaṇa śabdasya laukikasyākhaṇṭasyānvākhyānārthamevaṃ vibhāge vivakṣitārthasiddhyarthamupapadyate nañ prayoga ityarthaḥ || 267 ||
atrottarapadārthaprādhānye bhāṣye coditam--`abrāhmaṇamānayetyukte brāhmaṇamātrasyānayanaṃ prāpnoti' iti | tat katham ? yāvatā rājapuruṣādivat pūrvapadārthopahitaviśeṣasyottarapadārthasya pratīterityāśaṅkya bhāṣyakārābhiprayāmācaṣṭe-- padārthānupaghātena dṛśyate ca viśeṣaṇam | atha jātimato'rthasya kaścid dharmo nivartitaḥ || 268 ||
rājapuruṣādau rājādyarthaḥ puruṣādyarthasyānucchedena viśeṣopasaṃhārād yuktaṃviśeṣaṇam | iha tu nañartha uttarapadārthocchedakaḥ kathaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ syāt ? anarthaka evātra nañ | tathā ca brāhmaṇamātrasyānayanaṃ syāditi bhāṣyakārābhiprāya ityarthaḥ || atha na sarvathottarapadārthanivṛttiratra, api tu-- nañoti śeṣaḥ | guṇasamudāye jāteḥ pravṛttihetutvāt | tadvataḥ samudāyasya pradeśamātrasya nivṛttirnañā dyotyate | tadaparasya tu pradeśasya sthitiriti bhavati viśeṣāvasāyaḥ || 268 ||
yadyevam-- avaśyaṃ brāhmaṇe kaścit kvacid dharmo na vidyate | viśeṣāvacanāt tatra nañaḥ śrutiranarthikā || 269 ||
nahi sarvo brāhmaṇaḥ paripūrṇaguṇo labhyata iti brāhmaṇaśabdaḥ pradeśavṛttirevasarvaḥ, pūrṇeguṇe'pi jātimātrasaṃsparśena pravṛtteḥ | tathā ca nañ prayoge'pītyanarthako nañ || 269 ||
kiñcāsmin pakṣe-- aviśiṣṭasya paryāyo nañ‌viśiṣṭaḥ prasajyate | anvākhyānāddhi sādhutvamevambhūte pratīyate || 270 ||
ya evārtho brāhmaṇaśabdasya nivṛttaikadeśaḥ sa evābrāhmaṇaśabdasyeti nañsamāsanacanena prajñāpitasādhubhāvo'brāhmaṇaśabdo brāhmaṇaśabdasya paryāyaḥ prāpnoti||270|| etat samādhatte-- padārthānupaghātena yadyapyatra viśeṣaṇam | upacārasato'rthasya sāvasthā dyotyate nañā || 271 ||
ekadośo'pyatra na mukhyo brāhmaṇajātīya iti buddhyā tamupacarya tacchabdaprayogaḥ | tathā cāsya sopacaritalakṣaṇāvasthā nañā prakāśyata iti padārthānupaghātenaivedamapi viśeṣaṇaṃ yujyata ityarthaḥ || 271 ||
tathāhi-- viśeṣyeṣu yathābhūtaḥ padārthaḥ samavasthitaḥ | tathābhūte tathābhāvo gamyate bhedahetubhiḥ || 272 ||
rājapuruṣanīlotpalādāvapi yathāvasthiviśeṣyapadārthaniṣṭho viśeṣaṇapadārtha iti bhedahetubhirviśeṣaṇairyathāyathamartho'vagamyate; evamihāpi brāhmaṇapadārtho buddhyopacaritarūpa ityevaṃ nañapadaprayogādavagamyata iti yuktaṃ viśeṣaṇam | taduktaṃ bhāṣye-- "atheha `rājapuruṣamānaya' ityukte puruṣamātrasyānayanaṃ kasmānna bhavati ? astyatra viśeṣaḥ | rājātra viśeṣakaḥ prayujyate | tena rājaviśiṣṭasyānayanaṃ bhavati | ihāpi tarhi nañ viśeṣakaḥ prayujyate | tena nañviśiṣṭasyānayanaṃ bhaviṣyati" iti ||272|| atra coditam--`kaḥ punarasau'? tatroktam--`nivṛttapadārthakaḥ' iti | etadākṣipati-- nivṛtte'vayavastasmin padārthe vartate katham | nānimittā hi śabdasya pravṛttirupapadyate || 273 ||
buddhiparigṛhītākāre'pi śabdaḥ pravartamāno bāhyagataṃ bījamavalambata eva | tathā ca dṛśyavikalpayorekatvādhyavasāyād bāhyameva śabdārthaṃ manyanta iti kṣatriyādau brāhmaṇāderekadeśavācitvādavayavaśabdasya kathamasati nimitte pravṛttiḥ | yena sāvasthā nañā dyotyata ityucyate || 273 ||
atha svābhāvikī nivṛttiriti kṣatriye'pi brāhmaṇaśabdaḥ, tadā-- ārācchabdavadekasya viruddhe'rthe svabhāvataḥ | śabdasya vṛttiryadyasti nañaḥ śrutiranarthikā || 274 ||
yathā dūrāntikārthavṛttirārācchabdaḥ, tathā brāhmaṇakṣatriyavṛttiḥ svabhāvato brāhmaṇaśabdo rūḍha ityupagame vināpi nañprayogaṃ prakaraṇādivaśāt kṣatriyāvagatirbrāhmaṇaśabdād bhaviṣyatīti kiṃ nañā kṛtyam, yena nañsamāso'nvākhyāyate | nahyavaśyamanekārthānāṃ padāntaraprayogābhivyaṅgyaviśeṣatvamupalabdham | taduktaṃ bhāṣye--"yadi svābhāvikī nivṛttiḥ, kiṃ nañ prayujyamānaḥ karoti " iti || 274 ||
ato'nantaramuktam--`atha vācanikī | tad vaktavyaṃ nañ prayujyamānaḥ padārthaṃ nivartayati' iti | etad vyācaṣṭe-- atha svabhāvo vacanādanvākhyeyatvamarhati | tadvācyamaprasiddhatvānnañārtho vinivartyate || 275 ||
svabhāvo'pi duravadhāraṇatvānnañityanena yadi śabdena jñāpyate; tadedamapi vacanenānvākhyeyaṃ nañprayoge padānāṃ prasiddho'rtho vinivartata iti | athāsyāyaṃ svabhāvaḥ prayogapāramparyāvaseyaḥ, tadā sarvasyaiva vyāpāre śabdāntarānapekṣaṇāduttarapadenāpi nivṛttyābhidhāne nañ nāpekṣitavya ityarthaḥ || 275 ||
ato'nantaraṃ `kīlapratikīlavad vācanikī nivṛttiḥ | yadyevaṃ naño māhātmyam,na jātucid rājāno hastyaśvaṃ bibhṛyuḥ' iti dūṣayitvā svābhāvikī nivṛttiḥ siddhāntitā | tatra ca nañ nimittā tūpalabdhiḥ | tadyathā--samandhakāre dravyāṇāṃ pradīpanimittaṃ darśanam ityuktam | etad vyācaṣṭe-- yadyapyubhayavṛttitvaṃ pradhānaṃ tu pratīyate | prasthānaṃ gamyate śuddhe tadarthe'pi na tiṣṭhatau || 276 ||
gatinivṛttivacanastiṣṭhatiḥ prasiddha ityantareṇa praśabdamupasargam (sthādhātuḥ) prasthānārtho'pi tamarthamavagamayitumaparyāpto yathā, evaṃ kṣatriyavacano'pi brāhmaṇaśabdo nañamantareṇa na tadarthaniścayādhāyītyarthaḥ | na hi praśabdasya prasthānamarthaḥ tiṣṭhaternirarthakatvaprasaṅgādityasau tiṣṭhatyarthaḥ | praśabdastu dyotakaḥ | evamatrāpi vijñeyam || 276 ||
nanu ca yadi kṣatriye mukhyo brāhmaṇārtho nāsti, tadā kimarthaṃ sandigdhārtho brāhmaṇaśabdastatra vācako'bhyupagamyate | tasya cāyamamukhyo'rtho nañ prayogādavadhāryata iti | `yadi punarayaṃ nivṛttapadārthakaḥ, kimarthaṃ brāhmaṇaśabdaḥ prayujyata' ityuktaṃ bhāṣye | tadāha-- kimarthamatathābhūte sati mukhyārthasambhave | bhede brāhmaṇaśabdasya vṛttirabhyupagamyate || 277 ||
vyākhyātārtho'yaṃ ślokaḥ || 277 ||
atra parihārabhāṣyam--"evaṃ yathā vijñāyeta asya padārtho nivṛtta iti | neti hyukte sandehaḥ syāt--kasya padārtho nivṛtta iti | tatrāsandehārthaṃ brāhmaṇaśabdaḥ prayujyate" iti | etad vyācaṣṭe-- ayaṃ padārtha etasmin kṣatriyādau na vidyate | iti tadvacanaḥ śabdaḥ pratyayāya prayujyate || 278 ||
ayamarthaḥ--ajñānād durupadeśād vā kenacid brāhmaṇārthaḥ kṣatriye'dhyavasitaḥ | sa evaṃ bodhyate--nāyaṃ brāhmaṇo'brāhmaṇo'yamiti | kṣatriya iti tūkte brāhmaṇārthasya tatra niṣedho na kṛtaḥ syāditi vivakṣitārtho na pratīyate | tasmād buddhayā tatra brāhmaṇārthamāśritya naño viṣayapraklṛptau tadarthanivṛttiḥ kathyata iti yuktam || 278 ||
boddhuśca śabdārthaḥ samāropitarūpaḥ sarvatra yujyata evetyāha-- buddherviṣayatāṃ prāpte śabdādarthe pratīyate | pravṛttirvā nivṛttirvā śrutyā hyartho'nuṣajyate || 279 ||
iha yaḥ śabdādarthaḥ pratīyate, sa vyavahārāṅgaṃ bahiḥ sadasattvamanapekṣyeti `śabdādarthāḥ pratāyanta' ityādinā pūrvaṃ nirṇītam | tathā ca bhāvābhāvasādhāraṇaśabdaiḥ svārthaḥ samullikhyata iti tatra-tatra padārthe'navasthite yathāyogaṃ bhāvarūpamabhāvarūpaṃ vā viśeṣaṇamupakalpata eva || 279 ||
tatrottarapadārthapradhāne nañ samāse `nañiva yuktamanyasadṛśādhikaraṇe tathāhyarthagatiḥ" ityuktatvād yatraiva brāhmaṇaśabdasya bhrāntyā prayogastatraiva tadarthaniṣedhe tadadhikaraṇasampratyayo na sarvatretyatiprasaṅgābhāvārthaṃ `sandehād durupadeśācca brāhmaṇaśabdo vartate' ityādi bhāṣyam | tad vyācaṣṭe-- asamyagupadeśād vā nimittāt saṃśayasya vā | śabdapravṛttirna tvasti loṣṭādiṣu viparyayam || 280 ||
durupadeśāt kṣatriye brāhmaṇaśabdapravṛttiḥ | paṅgalakeśāderupadiṣṭasya viṣayavivecanāvadhāraṇāt kasyacid bhavati | sandehanimittaṃ guṇaḥ sandehaśabdenātroktaḥ | tathāhi--sādṛśyalakṣaṇāt saṃśayanimittāt tatra śabdapravṛttirityatyantavisadṛśeṣu loṣṭādiṣu brāhmaṇaśabdapravṛttyabhāvādabrāhmaṇaśabdāduttarapadārthasadṛśa eva kṣatriyo'vagamyate, na loṣṭādi | bhrāntinivāraṇāya hi nañaḥ prayogaḥ | bhrāntiśca sati nimitte, nirbījabhrāntyayogāditi sadṛśa eva tasya (niyamaḥ) viṣayaḥ | ata eva ca nañā brāhmaṇārthe mukhye kṣatriye nivārite tadadhikaraṇabhūtaḥ kṣatriyo'vasthita eveti pratipadyate'sau kriyāsu sādhanabhāvamabrāhmaṇamānayetyādau | pratiṣedhamātropakṣayatve tu nañsamāsasyātrāsādhanaḥ samāsārthaḥ syāditi na samāropitarūpapratiṣedhamātro'sya vyāpāraḥ | samāropasya ca pratipattṝṇāṃ viparyāsitadarśanānniyamābhāva ityasatyapi sādṛśye kutaścid bhrāntikāraṇāt sarvatra prasiddhe nañsamāse samāropo'nugantavyaḥ | upacaritottarapadārthapratiṣedhena hyuttarapadārthapradhāno nañsamāsa ityaprāṇināmastrīviṣayādayopadhādacittavat kartṛkāditi prayogadarśanāt samāropanimittānusaraṇenottarapadārthasadṛśapratipattirvijñeyā || 280 ||
`idaṃ khalvapi bhūya uttarapadārthaprādhānye saṅ‌gṛhītaṃ bhavati | kim, anekam' iti bhāṣyam | tad vyācaṣṭe-- anekasmādasa iti prādhānye sati sidhyati | sāpekṣatvaṃ pradhānānāmevaṃ yuktaṃ tvatalvidhau || 281 ||
ekaśabdārthasyātra pradhānatve tadāśrayamekasaṅ‌khyatvādekavacanamanupasarjanatvāt sarvanāmasaṃjñākāryaṃ smāyādi ca bhavati | yadi tu pūrvapadārthasyānyapadārthasya vā prādhānyaṃ syāt, tadaikārthasyopasarjanatvāt `saṃjñopasarjanapratiṣedhaḥ' iti sarvanāmasaṃjñā na syāti | tathā asa ityatrāntargaṇakāryam, "tyādādīnāmaḥ"  ityevamādi tadarthasya prādhānye sidhyati| gaṇapāṭho hi sārvārthyena prādhānyena viśeṣyata ityuktam--`pāṭhāt paryudāsaḥ, paṭhitānāṃ saṃjñākaraṇaṃ sarvādyānantaryakāryārtham' iti | tathā `tvatalbhyāṃ nañsamāsaḥ pūrvapratiṣiddhaḥ tvataloḥ svarasiddhyartham' ityasya parihārārthaṃ yaduktaṃ bhāṣye-- `nātra tvatalau prāpnutaḥ | kiṃ kāraṇam ? asāmarthyāt' iti | taduttarapadārthaprādhānye yujyate | tathāhi--abrāhmaṇatvamityasya nirastāvayavavibhāgasya laukikasya śabdasyānvākhyānāya yadā vibhāgaḥ kriyate, tadā nañarthasya pratiṣedhasya bhāvasya cāpod‌dhṛtasya brāhmaṇādanyasya bhāva iti, yadā yugapadvivakṣā, tadā paratvāt tvatalau syātām | tayoḥ kṛtayoḥ punaḥ prasaṅgavijñānānnañsamāse samāsasvaraḥ syāt | sati śiṣṭatvādavyayapūrvapadaprakṛtisvaraḥ, pratyayasvaraśceṣyata iti pūrvavipratiṣedhenātra nañsamāse codite parihāro'yaṃbhāṣye'bhihitaḥ--nātretyādi | brāhmaṇādanyasya bhāva iti pratiṣedhamapekṣamāṇo brāhmaṇārthastaddhitenaikārthībhāvamanubhavituṃ pūrvasamartha iti prathamamatra nañsamāsaḥ kriyate | nanu ca bhāvārthamapekṣamāṇo'pi brāhmaṇārthaḥ sāpekṣa eveti nañsamāso'pi na syāt | naitadasti | pradhānamidānīṃ sāpekṣamiti bhavati vṛttiḥ | taddhite tu prakṛtyarthasyopasarjanasya sāpekṣatvam | tadetat kathamupapadyate, yadyuttarapadārthapradhāno nañsamāsaḥ | pūrvapadārthānyapadārthaprādhānye tu abhāvapratyayayorekayogakṣemo nañsamāsaḥ syāt | ubhayatrāpi guṇasya sāpekṣatvāditi parihārabhāṣyaṃ nopapadyetetyuttarapadārthapradhānatāyā utkarṣaḥ | nanu ca nityaśabdadarśane vibhajyānvākhyānanaye'pi "vāha ūṭha"  iti liṅgād yugapatsannidhāne'pyantaraṅgayorantāraṅgaṃ balavaditi nañsambandhamātrāśrayo nañsamāsa eva pūrvaṃ bhavati | satyametat | bhāvārthaṃ tvapekṣamāṇo brāhmaṇa udbhūtavyatireko nañā sambadhyata iti pradhānamatra sāpekṣamityetadeva yuktam | pūrvavipratiṣedhavacanaṃ tu jñāpakamuktam--`ato'nyo bhāvapratyayo nañsamāsāt prāg bhavati' iti | tathā ca tatrottarapadavṛddhirnañsvaraśca bhavati || 281 ||
ato'nantaraṃ bhāṣyam--`kimatra saṅgṛhītam, ekavacanam' iti | tad vyācaṣṭe-- ekasya ca pradhānatvāt tadviśeṣaṇasannidhau | pradhānadharmāpyāvṛttirato na vacanāntaram || 282 ||
ekārthasya pradhānatvāt tanniṣedhenāneka ityatra bahuṣvapi pratipādyeṣu pradhānārthānuyāyyekavacanameva bhavati, na tu bahuvacanamityarthaḥ || 282 ||
nanu ca dvyādayo'traikaśabdavācyāḥ samāropitaikatvā iti nañā tatraikārthapratiṣedhe tadādhākasya dvyādeḥ sampratyayāt | tadgatameva vacanaṃ nyāyyamityāśaṅkyāha-- pradhānamatra bhedyatvādekārtho vikṛto nañā | hitvā svadharmān vartante dvyādayo'pyekatāṃ gatāḥ || 283 ||
nañviśiṣṭo'neka ityatraikārthaḥ pradhānam viśeṣyatvāditi tadācchuritarūpāḥparityaktasvabhāvadharmāḥ dvyādayo nimittasarūpatāmāpannā nimittānuvidhānādekatvenaiva pratīyanta ityekavacameva nyāyyam || 283 ||
viruddheṣu dvitvādiṣu kathamekatvayoga iti cedāha-- brāhmaṇatvaṃ yathāpannā nañyuktāḥ kṣatriyādayaḥ | dvitvādiṣu tathaikatvaṃ nañyogādupacaryate || 284 ||
nañprayogād brāhṇaśabdo yathā'brāhmaṇa ityatra kṣatriyavṛttiravadhāryate, tathāneka ityatrāpi dvyādivṛttirekaśabdaḥ | pratīyate hyuttarapadārthasadṛśo'rthaḥ | tatra cādhyāropito durupadeśādinā nimittenottarapadārtha iti sarvatra samānam || 284 ||
tathāhi-- ekatvayogamāsajya sa dharmaḥ pratiṣidhyate | dvyādibhyasteṣu tacchabdo vartate brāhmaṇādivat || 285 ||
bhrāntyā dvyādāvekatvamāropitaṃ nañā nivāryate, na tvekaśabdaḥ | tathāhi bhrāntinivāraṇaṃ vivakṣitaṃ na pratīyoteti kṣatriyādau brāhmaṇādiśabdagavadekaśabdo'traprayogārhaḥ | asati hyekaśabde dvayādiṣvekatvāropābhāvāt kiṃ bādhituṃ nañ prayujyeta || 285 ||
tasmānnaño viṣayapraklṛptyarthamekaśabdaḥ prayujyamānaḥ pradhānārtha iti svadharmānanuvartate vṛttivākyayoraviśeṣeṇetyāha-- āviṣṭasaṅkhyo vākye'sau yathā dvayādau prayujyate | vṛttau tasya pradhānatvāt sā saṅkhyā na nivartate || 286 ||
ekaṃ cennaṅit‌kitau, naikaṃ dvayādaya iti yathā vākye saṅkhyāntare'pyekaśabdo'parityaktasvasaṅkhya eva prayujyate, tathā samāse'pi tadarthasya pradhānatvādaneka ityatra svasaṅkhyāparityāgo nāsti || 286 ||
tatparityāge tu vivakṣitārthāpratītirityāha-- pratiṣedhyo yathābhūtastathābhūto'nuṣajyate | vacanāntarayoge hi na so'rthaḥ pratiṣidhyate || 287 ||
pratiṣedhāviṣayapraklṛptyarthamasadarthamapyuttarapadaṃ prayujyata iti yādṛśo'dhyastaḥ pratiṣedhyaḥ, tādṛśārthābhidhānāyottarapadamupādīyate | dvayādau caikatvaṃ pratiṣedhyamityuttarapadasyaikavacane satyayaṃ vivakṣitaḥ pratiṣedho'vagamyate | dvivacanādyupādane tvekatvaṃ pratiṣidhyamānaṃ na pratīyate | tasmād vivakṣitārthaupayikatvādekavacanameva nyāyyam || 287 ||
`kathaṃ punarekasya pratiṣedhe dvibahūnāṃ sampratyayaḥ' iti bhāṣyamekatvanivṛttimātraṃ prasajyapratiṣedharūpamabhipretya pravṛttaṃ paryudāsāśrayaṇena samarthayate-- aśukla iti kṛṣṇādiryathārthaḥ sampratīyate | saṅkhyāntaraṃ tathāneka ityatrāpyabhidhīyate || 288 ||
paryudāse śuklanivṛttyā nīlādayo'viśeṣeṇāśuklaśabdād yathā pratīyante, tathā dvyādyo'pyekasaṅkhyānivṛttyā'viśeṣeṇānekapadādavagamyante || 288 ||
etadeva samarthayituṃ bhāṣyam--`prasajyāyaṃ kriyāṃ guṇaṃ vā tataḥ paścānnivṛttiṃ karoti | tadyathā--āsaya bhojaya śāyayānekam' iti | tad‌vyācaṣṭe-- kriyāprasaṅgāt sarveṣu karmasvaṅgīkṛteṣu ca | ekasmin pratiṣiddhe'pi prāptamanyat pratīyate || 289 ||
kriyāpadamarthasāmarthyāt sādhanānyākṣipatyaviśeṣeṇa | tathāsayetyukte karmasāmānyamavagamyate | tatra vidhipūrvakatvānnivṛtteḥ kriyāsāmarthyākṣiptanānāsaṅkhyāśrayakarmaprasaṅge satyekapratiṣedhādapratiṣiddhasya saṅkhyāntarayogina eva sādhanatvamavabudhyate || 289 ||
evacca kasmin pakṣe kathyata ityāha-- kriyā śrutiśca prakrānte prasajyapratiṣedhena | paryudāse tu niyataṃ saṅkhyeyāntaramucyate || 290 ||
prasajyapratiṣedhe pratiṣedhopakṣayatvācchabdasya kriyāsāmarthyāt pratiṣiddhavarjaṃ sādhanopādānam | paryudāse tu śabdādevānekamityasmāduttarapadārthasadṛśaniyatasādhanopādānamityuktameva || 290 ||
`āsaya śāyaya bhojaya' iti prayojyaprayojakapraiṣopādānena viruddhakriyānirdeśasyopādāne bhāṣyakārasyābhiprāyaṃ vyācaṣṭe-- dhātvarthaḥ karmaviṣayo vyapadiṣṭaḥ svasādhanaiḥ | arthāt sarvāṇi karmāṇi prāgākṣipyāvatiṣṭhate || 291 ||
sakarmako dhātvartha āsanādibhedabhinnaḥ pūrvaṃ yadā nirdiṣṭaḥ prayojyaprayojakādisvasādhanāvacchinno viruddhakriyāsvabhāvaḥ, tadā tasya viruddhānekasvabhāvasyaikena sādhanena sādhyatvāyogāt pūrvamevānekaṃ sādhanamupāttamityekaniṣedhena tasyaiva sampratyayaḥ || 291 ||
anantaraṃ bhāṣyam--"yadyapi tāvadatraitacchakyate vaktum, yatra kriyāguṇau prasajyete | yatra tu khalu na prasajyete tatra kathamanekaṃ tiṣṭhati" iti | tatra parihāraḥ--`bhavatyevaṃjātīyakeṣvapyekasya pratiṣedhe bahūnāṃ sampratyayaḥ' iti | atra codyabhāṣye prasajyapratiṣedhe niṣedhamātropakṣayād dvayādīnāmapratipattiḥ syādityarthaḥ | paryudāse samānajātīyasya saṅkhyāntarasyaikatvasamāropāspadatvāt siddhaḥ sampratyaya iti parihārābhiprāyaḥ | etad vyācaṣṭe-- nirjñātasādhanādhāre yatrākhyāte prayujyate | aneka iti paścācca tiṣṭhatītyanuṣajyate || 292 ||
sādhyatvāt tatra siddhena kriyā dravyeṇa lakṣyate | prāgevāṅgīkṛtaṃ dravyamataḥ pūrveṇa bhidyate || 293 ||
yatra kutaściddhetorekatayāvadhṛtaḥ sādhanaśak‌tyadhikaraṇabhūto dravyātmā ākhyāte, tadvācyāyāṃ kriyāyāṃ punarayathārthatāvasāyādaneka iti pratiṣidhya paścāt kriyāpadaṃ tiṣṭhatīti prayujyate | tatra prāgavadhṛtasya śaktimato dravyasya parārthamupādīyamānatvāttadātmānurūpāṃ sādhyāmākṣipati kriyāṃ, na kriyāsāmarthyenākṣipyate dravyamiti pūrvasmādasya bhedaḥ | atrāpi ca jñātasādhanaviṣayopanipātādekapratiṣedhasya pratiṣiddhaparihāreṇa pratīyate sādhanam | tadevamaśrute'pi pūrvaṃ kriyāpade naikaniṣedhamātra eva vākyaṃ paryavasyati, kriyākāṅkṣaṇāditi tatrāpyekaniṣedhe saṅkhyāntarasya sādhanatvamavagamyate || 292,293 ||
evaṃ yatrāpi hi kriyāpadeśe nāsti tātparyam, tatrāpi tāvatsaṅkhyāntaraṃ pratīyata eveti dṛṣṭāntitaṃ bhāṣye | `tadyathā na na ekaṃ priyaṃ, na na ekaṃ sukham' iti |tad vyācaṣṭe-- saṅkhyaiva pratiṣedhena saṅkhyāntaramapekṣate | vākye'pi tena naikatvamātrameva nivartyate || 294 ||
"na na ekaṃ priyaṃ, na na ekaṃ sukham" ityetad vākyam | "ābādhe ca"  ityatra dvirvacanam, śatroḥ sukhena priyeṇa ca prayokturābādhaḥ | atra ca kriyāpadasyāśravaṇāt sukhapriyapratiṣedhamātravyāpāre'pi vākye saṅkhyāntarādhyāsitāni sukhāni priyāṇi ca pratīyante | ekaṃ śatrorna sukham, api tu bahūni | evaṃ priyāṇīti | ayaṃ hyatra vākyārthaḥ--viśeṣapratiṣedhasya śeṣābhyanujñāviṣayatvāt | sarvasukhapriyaniṣedha ekapadopādānamanarthakaṃ syāt | evañca yatra vākye'pyetatsāmarthyam, tatra vṛttāvuttarapadārthasadṛśasyārthasya paryudāse pratīto kā vicikitsā ? tatra hyekapadameva dvibahūnāheti naikatvamātre nivṛttiḥ, api tu tannivṛttiviśiṣṭhasya dvyādeḥ pratipattiḥ siddhā || 294 ||
nanu kathaṃ dvyādireva niyamena pratīyate | ekapratiṣedhe'nyadeva śeṣarūpaṃ pratīyatāmityāśaṅ‌kyāha-- snehāntarādavacchedā yastathāsatteḥ pratīyate | tailena bhojane prāpte na tvanyadupasecanam || 295 ||
yathā bhojanamatailena vidheyamiti codite tailapratiṣedhasāmarthyāt sarpirādisnehāntarāddhetoravacchedo viśeṣaṇaṃ bhojanasya pratyāsatterekajātīyatvāt, pratīyate, na dadhnā payasā vā, tathehāpyekapratiṣedhe samānakāryaṃ saṅkhyāntarameva saṅkhyājātyā pratyāsannaṃ pratīyate, na tvaviśeṣeṇa yatkiñcidevānyaditi sthitamuttarapadārthapradhānatāyāṃ nañsamāsasyānekamityasyopapattiriti | kathaṃ tarhi "vṛttibhedaprayojakaṃ cittamekanekeṣām" iti bhagavataḥ patañjaleḥ prayogaḥ ? ekaśeṣāśrayeṇeti bramaḥ | ekaniṣedhe'pi hi kutaścinnimittānniyatāmeva vyaktiṃ sambhāvayoditi sampratyekaśeṣo nyāyyaḥ | bhāṣyakṛtā tvekavacanaṃ samarthitam, na tubahuvacanaṃ nivāritam || 295 ||
idānīmanyapadārthapradhānapakṣavicārāyāha-- ekārthe vartamānābhyāmasatā brāhmaṇena ca | yadā jātyantaraṃ bāhyaṃ kṣatriyādyapadiśyate || 296 ||
tadāvakalpate'nyapadārthapradhāno nañsamāsa iti prakaraṇādavaseyam | ihābrāhmaṇādibhirnañsamāsairuttarapadārthaviparītavastupratyāyanaṃ dṛśyate | tatra cānvākhyānaprakriyāyāṃ yadottarapadopādānāḥ samāropitabrāhmaṇādyarthāḥ kṣatriyādaya iti nayaḥ, tadottapadārthaprādhānyaṃ nirṇītam `prādhānyenāśritāḥ pūrvam' ityādinā | yadā tvasatsāmānyavṛttirapyayaṃ nañ sadviśeṣānibandhanayā brāhmaṇaśrutyā sāmānyaviśeṣabhāvenaikādhikaraṇyena saṃbandhamanubhūya tatsaṃbandhaprāpitārthātiśayaṃ bāhyaṃ padāntaropādānaṃ kṣatriyādyanupatati, na tāvatyeva viśrāmyati tadānyapadārthapradhāno nañsamāsaḥ | tathā hyavidyamāno brāhmaṇo brāhmaṇavyaktirāśrayabhūtā yasya kṣatriyasya kṣatriyajāterityasya anyapadārthabhūtāyā varttipadārthābhyāmabhāvabrāhmaṇābhyāmavaccheda iti jātyantaraṃ bāhyaṃ bhavati || 296 ||
uttarapadārthaprādhānye tu kṣatriyādau samāropitāyā brāhmaṇajāteḥ pratiṣedhāt, sadṛśaṃ kṣatriyādijātyantaramuttarapadavācyameva na bāhyaṃ bhavati, bahurvīhāvivānyapadārtha ityasyāśruterantaraṅge svapadārtha eva yuktā vṛttirityāśayaitatsadṛśatatpuruṣāntaranidārśanena vyutpādayati-- śyāmeva śastrī kanyeti yathānyad vyapadiśyate | asan brāhmaṇa ityābhyāṃ tathānyaṃ kṣatriyādayaḥ || 297 ||
śastrīva śyāmā śastrīśyāmā kanyeti śyāmāśabdasya śastryaṃ vṛttau samāsavācyamupameyamuktamiti tatra yathā varttipadābhyāmanabhidhāyamānāpi kanyā samāsenābhidhīyate| yataḥ kanyāśabdena samāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ pratipadyate samāsaḥ, tathāsanniti nañā'sadarthena brāhmaṇa iti ca tadviśeṣavacanenānabhidhīyamāno'pi kṣatriyaḥ samāsenābhidhīyate | tathā ca yathopamānasamāso viśeṣavihitaḥ sāmānyavihitena bahurvīhiṇā na bādhyate, tathā nañ samāso'pīti vacanādanyapadārthe'pyayaṃ tatpuruṣa ityarthaḥ || 297 ||
atraiva nidarśanāntaramāha-- asāsno gauriti yathā gavayo vyapadiśyate | jātyantaraṃ na goreva sāsnā'bhāvaḥ pratīyate || 298 ||
gauravaśyaṃ sāsnāsaṃbaddha ityasāsna ityukte yadi paraṃ sāsnāmātramasya nāsti, pariśiṣṭāvayavasaṃniveśasāmyamiti gosadṛśasya gavayasya pratipattiḥ, na goreva pratiṣiddhasāsnāyogasya, ato vākyāt pratītirgavayasāmānādhikaraṇyād | evabrāhmaṇa ityukte jātyantaraṃ kṣatriyo'vagamyate | brāhmaṇajātimātraniṣedhe pariśiṣṭataddharmasāmyapratipatteḥ || 298 ||
tathā-- tulyarūpaṃ yathākhyātaṃ kaṇṭakai(kaṅkaṭai)rbhedahetubhiḥ | khadiraṃ jātibhedena kharjūrāt(barburāt) pratipadyate || 299 ||
khadirakharjūrau (khadirabarburau) gaurakāṇḍau sūkṣmaparṇāvityabhedena pūrvamākhyāte sadṛśau khadirakharjūrau (khadirabarburau) pratipadya paścāt kaṇaṭakavān (kaṅkaṭavān) khadira ityabhidhāne kaṅkaṭānāṃ kharjūre'bhāvāt (kaṅkaṭānāṃ barbure'bhāvāt) tataḥ khadirasya bhedahetubhyastebhyo viśeṣaḥ pratipadyate | tathā ca khadiraḥ kharjūrādanyaḥ (barburādanyaḥ) eva, natu kaṇṭarādi (kaṅkaṭādi) saṃbandhamādhikaṃ tasyaiva pratipadyate, tathā brāhmaṇadharmaiḥ sādṛśyamavadhārya kṣatriye brāhmaṇatvāvasāyād brāhmaṇaśabde prāpte kathyate nāyaṃ brāhmaṇa iti jātibhedamātram, anyat sarvaṃ sadṛśamiti jātyantaramiti pratīyata iti ||299|| dārṣṭāntikamāha-- avidyamānabrāhmaṇyo yādṛśo brāhmaṇo bhavet | aṅgīkṛtopamānena tathānyārthobhi'dhīyate || 300 ||
śastrī śyāmā kanyeti yathā vartipadābhyāmanupāttā kanyābhidhīyamānopamānopameyabhāvamavagamayati, asāsno gauriti ca sāsnāvarjamavayavasādṛśyaṃ gogavayayorarthāntarābhidhānanibandhanam, kaṅkaṭavarjaṃ ca gaurakāṇḍādisādṛśyameva vivakṣitamiti sarvatropamānagarbhamanyārthābhidhānam, tathā'brāhmaṇa ityatrāpi | tathā ca brāhmaṇajātivarjamanyairdharmaiḥ sādṛśyāt kṣatriyādirevānyo'rtho'bhidhīyate | tathāhi--vaiśyaḥ kṣatriyo vā brāhmaṇa ivāyamabrāhmaṇaḥ | tatra sarvathā bhede'bhede vā nāsti sādṛśyamiti gogavayavat kathañcidbhedābhedāvanusartavyau | yathā hi brāhmaṇaḥ kutaścinnimittādapoddhṛtabrāhmaṇyasāmānyastathājātīyako'yamityarthaḥ | brāhmaṇyasyāpi hi saṃbandha ityabrāhmaṇa ityabhidhānaṃ kathamiva kṣatriyāderna syādityatiśayoktigarbhametaduktam | tadevamupamānopameyabhāvamaṅgīkṛtya nañsamāsaḥ kṣatriyādijātibhedopādānamarthamāsādayati | dṛṣṭaśca sādṛśyāntarbhāvo nañsamāse | tadyathā--`avarṣā hemanta' iti | atra hi nañsamāse varṣāsadṛśo hemanto'bhidhīyate ||300|| kathamatra sādṛśyamityāha-- avṛṣṭayo yathāvarṣā nīhārābhrasamāvṛtāḥ | tadrūpatvāt sa hemanta ityabhinnaḥ pratīyate || 301 ||
na varṣā avarṣā hemanto varṣāsadṛśa ityarthaḥ | avidyamānavarṣaṇakriyā yathā varṣāḥ prakrīyamāmanīhāranikarāḥ pralambamānanīlaghanācchāditadigantarāḥ | tathāyaṃ hemantastamaḥ-santatitiraskṛtāloka ityevaṃvidhavarṣāsādṛśyād varṣā ityabhidhīyate | tādrūpyeṇa svapadārthe'pi hyaṃ tatpuruṣo vyutpādito garbhīkṛtyopamāmanyapadārthe vartate| na tvavidyamānā varṣā varṣātvamasyetyupakrama evānyapadārthe vyutpādyate | upasarjanahrasvatvaprasaṅgāt | evaṃ garbhīkṛtopamā nañasamāsāḥ prakriyāyāmanyapadārthapradhānaviṣayā ityekeṣāṃ darśanam || 301 ||
apare brāhmaṇādīnāṃ sarveṣāṃ jātivācinām | dravyasyānyapadārthatve nañā yogaṃ pracakṣate || 302 ||
jātipadārthapakṣe brāhmaṇādayaḥ śabdā jātimevādhāraviviktāṃ prādhānyenācakṣata iti vartipadena dravyasyanupādānāt tadabhidhāyī samāso'nyapadārthapradhāno bhavati | asan brāhmaṇo'vidyamānaṃ brāhmaṇyaṃ kṣatriyadravyalakṣaṇe'rthe'sāvabrāhmaṇa iti jātivācinā brāhmaṇaśabdena saha tatpuruṣaḥ | tatra brāhmaṇajāteryatrāśrayāntare saṃbhāvyate samavāyastatraiva niṣedhaḥ samucitaḥ, nātyantavijātīya iti kṣatriyādidravyamevānyapadārtha uktaḥ || 302 ||
asmin darśane bahurvīhinañsamāsayorviṣayaviveko'pi kalpata ityāha-- na caivaṃviṣayaḥ kaścid bahurvīhiḥ prakalpate | aguraśva iti vyāptirnañsamāsena yasya na || 303 ||
evaṃviṣayo jātyavacchinnānyapadārthadravyābhidhāyī nañsamāsavanna kalpate bahurvīhiḥ, matvarthe bhūmādau bahurvīhividhānāt | avidyamānā gāvo yasyetyagurayamaśva ityayaṃbahurvīhiryasya nañsamāsenānena gocaro nākrāntaḥ, sa kalpata ityarthāduktaṃ bhavati | avidyamāno gaurgotvamasyāśvasya so'yamagauraśva iti hi nañsamāsapratipattiḥ | uttarapadārthavijātīyasya nañsamāsena svabhāvādabhidhānāt | avidyamānā gāvo yasyeti tu matvarthe bahurvīhirityanayorviṣyavivekaḥ siddhaḥ | yadā tu `naño'styarthānāṃ bahurvīhirvā cottarapadalopaśca' iti pratipadavihito nañāśrayo bahurvīhistadaivaṃ vyākhyāyate nañsamāsena yasya na vyāptiravakāśadanaṃ sa evaṃ bhūtaviṣayo na kaścid bahirvīhiḥ prakalpate | tato'nayoḥ samāne viṣaye prāpte svābhāviko yathāpavarṇito viṣayaviveka ityetat sāmarthyājjñeyam | itthamarthānuguṇye'pyanyapadārthapradhānatāpakṣe'tra prakriyāyāṃ doṣa uktaḥ || 303 ||
"yadyanyapadārthapradhānaḥ avarṣā hemanta iti hemantasya yalliṅgaṃ vacanaṃ ca tat samāsasya prāpnoti" iti bhāṣye'bhihitam | etad vyācaṣṭe-- dvandvaikadeśinoruktā paravalliṅgatā yataḥ | avarṣāsu tato'siddhiriṣṭayorliṅgasaṃkhyayo || 304 ||
avarṣā hemanta ityanyapadārthaprādhānye hemantagataliṅgasaṃkhyāprasaṅga itīṣṭaṃ bahutva strītvaṃ ca na syāt | na cāpi "paravalliṅgaṃ dvandvitatpuruṣayoḥ" iti paravalliṅgatā bhavati | ekadeśisamāsa eva tatpuruṣe paravalliṅgatā niyamitā, yataḥ tatpuruṣamātre hi paralliṅgatāyāṃ prāptajīvikādāvatiprasaṅgaḥ syāt | tathā ca vārttikam' "prāptādiṣu caikadeśigrahaṇāt siddham " iti | `upasarjanahrasvatvamapyatra prāpnoti' iti | avarṣā iti agauriti ca, anyapadārthapradhānatvāviśeṣād bahurvīhivat | na cāpi `paravalliṅgamiti śabdaśabdārthau' ityataḥ parihartuṃ śakyate | viśiṣṭetatpuruṣe'sya vacanādityanyapadārthapradhānapakṣo duṣṭaḥ || 304 ||
idānīṃ pūrvapadārthuprādhānyamadhikṛtya-- viśeṣaṇaṃ brāhmaṇādi kriyāsaṃbandhino'sataḥ | yadā viṣayabhinnaṃ tat tadā'sattva pratīyate || 305 ||
yadā nañpadopādāno'sadarthaḥ kriyāsaṃbandhitayā prakrāntaḥ, tadottarapadārthena brahmaṇena sa evāvacchidyamāno viśiṣṭaḥ pratīyate | brāhmamalakṣaṇena viśeṣaṇena bhinnamavacchinnamasattvaṃ nañarthaḥ pratīyamānaṃ pradhānaṃ bhavatīti pūrvapadārthapradhānatāpakṣo jāyate || 305 ||
nanu cāsataḥ kathaṃ kriyāsaṃbandhatvamityāśaṅkyāha-- brāhmaṇatvena cāsattvāducyate'sattadanyathā | asadityapi sattvena sataḥ sattā nivartyate || 306 ||
kṣatriyādirūpeṇa sannevārtho brāhmaṇyenāsannityevaṃ viśiṣṭaviṣayamasattvaṃ nañupādatte, na sarvathāsattvamiti nāsti kriyāsaṃbandhavirodhaḥ | ata eva sādṛśārthāsaṃpratyayo'pi siddhaḥ | asadityapi nañasamāse sattveneti | atrāpyanyatheti saṃbadhyate | bhāvaviśeṣānupahitasyābhāvasyāvyavahāryatvāt prakārāntareṇa vastutvenopalakṣitasya satauttarapadārthasya vidyamānatā niṣidhyate | tathā cāsya bhāvarūpānupātinā kriyāviśeṣeṇa yogo'styeva || 306 ||
tadetasmin pūrvapadārthapradhānapakṣe bhāṣye coditam--`avyayasaṃjñā prāpnoti | avyayaṃ hyasya pūrvapadam' iti | tad vyācaṣṭe-- sāmānyadravyavṛttitvānnimittānuvidhāyinaḥ | ayogo liṅgasaṃkhyābhyāṃ syād vā sāmānyadharmatā || 307 ||
uttarapadārthaviśiṣṭo nañarthaḥ prādhānyenābhidhīyata iti tasyātra dravyasāmānyarūpe kṣatriyādau śabdapravṛttinimittasyāliṅgasaṃkhyatvānnimittānuvidhānānnimittavataḥ svena tattvenāvyapadeśāt satyapi sattvarūpatve'vyayadharmopapattirityarthamātralakṣaṇāvyayasaṃjñāprasaṅgāt samāsārtho'liṅgasaṃkhyaḥ syāt | naño hi vākye'bhāvasāmānyamartho'sattvabhūto dṛṣṭaḥ | sa evātra vṛttāvṛttarapadārthaviśiṣṭaḥ prādhānyenābhidhīyata iti kṛto liṅgasaṃkhye syātām | atha samāsasyāvyayeṣu pāṭhābhāvādavyayasaṃjñābhāvād vibhakterluṅ nāstītyucyate, tathāpi vyapadeśanivṛttāvapi vastavartho na nivartata ityavyayadharmā bhaveyureva | tathā ca bhāṣyam `pāṭhenāvyayasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāmabhidheyavalliṅgavacanāni bhavanti' iti | `yaścehārtho'bhidhīyate, na tasya liṅgasaṃkhyābhyāṃ yogo'sti' iti | ananuvidhīyamāne'pi vā nimitte sattvasāmānyagataṃ liṅgasarvanāma syādekatvasaṃkhyā cetyabrāhmaṇamityeva prayogaḥ syāt, na tvabrāhmaṇāvabrāhmaṇā ityādi | vyaktiviśeṣanibandhano hi liṅgasaṃkhyābhedaḥ | atra ca vyaktiviśeṣo na vācyaḥ, kriyāyogye sattvamātre nañsamāsasyābhidhāvyāpārādaviśeṣasyāpratīteḥ || 307 ||
atra parihāro bhāṣye'bhihitaḥ--`nedaṃ vācanikamaliṅgatā asaṃkhyatā vā | kiṃ tarhi svābhāvikametat' ityādi | ` tatra kimasmābhiḥ śakyaṃ vaktum, yannañaḥ prāk samāsālliṅgasaṃkhyābhyāṃ yogo nāsti, samāse tu bhavati' iti | tad vyācaṣṭe-- prāgasattvābhidhāyitvaṃ samāse dravyavācitā | nimittānuvidhānaṃ ca na sarvatra svabhāvataḥ || 308 ||
ihāpauruṣeyī śabdānāmarthapratyāyanaśaktirniyataviṣayā yogyatābhidhānā prayogaprāmāṇyāvaseyasatattvā | tatra vṛttivākyayoḥ śabdabhedād bhinnaśaktitve vākye nañartho'sattvabhūto'pi vṛttyā sattvabhūto'bhidhīyate | tathā ca kriyāyogo dṛśyate | tathāhi--vākye nañpratiṣedhyād vyatirekeṇa pratiṣedhamācaṣṭa iti prādhānyenāvyayārthasyābhihitatvālliṅgasaṅyāyogo nāsti| vṛttau tu pratiṣedhopasarjanasya pratiṣedhyasya nañarthatvāt pratiṣedhyaprādhānyālliṅgasaṅkhyāyoga upapadyate | na cāvaśyakamanyatrāpi nimittānuvidhānam, harītakyādiṣu vyaktivacanayorvyavastānadarśanāt | tataśca nañsamāse liṅgasaṅkhyāyogasya darśanācchuklādivannimittānuvidhānaṃ nāstītyarthaḥ || 308 ||
tathāhi-- nimittānuvidhāne ca kriyāyogo na kalpate | tathācāvyapadeśyatvādupādānamanarthakam || 309 ||
nañarthasyāsattvarūpasya nimittasyānuvidhāne samāsārthasya liṅgasaṅkhyāyogavad`abrāhmaṇamānaya, paśya vā' ityādidarśanādikriyāsādhanabhāvo na syādityākriyāṅgasya nāmapadārthasya kīrtanamaphalamityananvākhyeyo nañsamāsaḥ syāt | dṛśyate cāsya kriyāṅgabhāva iti prayogaprāmāṇyādananuvihitanimittaḥ sattvabhūtārthābhidhāyī yujyate liṅgasaṅkhyābhyā nañsamāsaḥ || 309 ||
iyatā ca liṅgasaṅkhyāsambandhamātraṃ svābhāvikatābhidhānena syāt, prayogānupātī tu yathāyathaṃ liṅgasaṅkhyāviśeṣo vivakṣita iti tatsiddhyarthaṃ pakṣāntaramatra bhāṣye pratipāditam--`athavā guṇavacanānāṃ śabdānāmāśrayato liṅgavacanāni bhavanti' iti | tad vyācaṣṭe-- asatsāmānyavṛttirvā viśeṣaiḥ kṣatriyādibhiḥ | prayuktairāśrayairbhinno yāti talliṅgasaṅkhyatām || 310 ||
uttarapadārthaviśiṣṭamasatsāmānyaṃ samāsārtho'nirjñātaviśeṣa iti tajjijñāsāyāṃ viśeṣaprayoge, tairviśeṣairāśrayairasau samāsārtho viśiṣṭaḥ prayogayogya iti talliṅgasaṅkhya eva nyāyyaḥ | arthānāmitaretarābhāvāvyabhicārād brāhmaṇādinivṛtteḥ kṣatriyādaya evāśraya iti tadgate eva liṅgasaṅkhye yukte | sarvamūrtīnāṃ ca sarvaliṅtvācchabdaśakterliṅgapratiniyame kṣatriyaḥ kṣatramiti yathā sa evārtho bhinnaliṅgābhyāṃ śabdābhyāmabhidhīyate, evamabrāhmaṇaḥ kṣatramityabrāhmaṇaśabdena puṃstvaviśiṣṭaḥ so'rthaḥ pratipādyate | nivṛttivacanenābhedopacārāt tadvata evopādānāt | yathā cānye jātiśabdā āviṣṭaliṅgasaṅkhyāḥ, tathā nañsamāso'pīti kṣatrādinābhinnaliṅgenāpi sāmānādhikaraṇyamasyopapannam | evamanāpaḥ pṛthivī' ityādyupapattiḥ | ata eva cātrāpi svābhāvikatvameva liṅgasaṅkhyāvyavasthāhetuḥ | pūrvatra tu parihāre dravyavacanatve svābhāvikatvaṃ heturityetāvatā viśeṣaḥ || 310 ||
nanu nirviśeṣasya sāmānyasyābhāvāt sāmānyaśabdenaivopagṛhīto viśeṣa iti kathaṃtadvācinaḥ prayoga ityāha-- prāgāśrayo hi bhedāya pradhāne'bhyantarīkṛtaḥ | punaḥ pratyavamarśena vibhakta iva dṛśyate || 311 ||
asatsāmānye samāsavācye prathamata eva yadyapi viśeṣaḥ svāśrayo garbhīkṛtaḥ tathāpi sāmānyaśruterviśeṣasyāvadhāraṇābhāvād viśeṣaśabdena punarasau pratyavamṛśyata eva | tathāca sāmānyād viśeṣasya vibhāga iva śabdanibandhana ityāśrayāśrayibhāvapratītāvāśrayagatasaṅkhyāyoga ucyate || 311 ||
tathāhi-- samāse śrūyate svārtho yena tadvāstadāśrayaḥ | dravyaṃ tu liṅgasaṅkhyāvadasatābhyantarīkṛtam || 312 ||
vṛttau nañaḥ sattpradhānārthatvālliṅgasaṅkhyāyogi dravyasāmānyamabhāvānuraktam, tenāsatāsadvacanenābhyantarīkṛtaṃ pratipāditamiti pūrvasya parihārasya svābhāvikatvadarśanasyārtho nigamitaḥ | guṇavacanadarśane tu dvitīye parihāre samāse svavācyo'rthaḥ pratīyate, yonāsatsāmānyena kṣatriyādistadvān nivṛttiviśiṣṭo'vadhāryate tasyādhāra iti || 312 ||
nimittano nimittānuvidhāne guṇavacanavalliṅgasaṃkhyāyogaḥ kathitaḥ, svapadārthaḥ anyapadārtho vā kṣatriyādiḥ katham, yena pakṣadvayopapattirityāha-- ekārthaviṣayau śabdau tasminnanyārthavartinau | asataiva tu bhedānāṃ sarveṣāmupasaṃgrahaḥ || 313 ||
prāk samāsānnañ vākye nivṛttidyotakaḥ, brāhmaṇaśabdaśca nivṛttiviśiṣṭārthābhidhāyī | evamanyārthavartināvetau śabdau | tasmin samāse uttarapadārthenāvacchinno nañartha ekaḥ pratipādyaḥ, yayostāvekārthaviṣayau, upasarjanasambhinnasyaikasyaiva nañarthasya vācyatvāt | sarvaiṣāṃ tu bhedānāṃ kṣatriyādīnāmabhāvena nañarthenaiva svīkārāduttarapadasya tad‌dyotanamātre vyāpārāt pūrvapadārthaprādhānyam || 313 ||
yadā tvanyapadārthaprādhānyam, tadāha-- te kṣatriyādibhirvācyā vācyā vā sarvanāmabhiḥ | yāntīvānyapadārthatvaṃ naño rūpāvikalpanāt || 314 ||
kṣatriyo vaiśya ityevamādayaḥ śabdā abrāhmaṇa ityatratyān viśeṣān sphuṭamitaretaravivekena gamayanti prayuktāḥ santaḥ | tadaprayoge tu sarvanāmapadaṃ sāmānyarūpeṇa tadarthamāha | evañca kṛtvā vartipadābhyāmupagṛhīto'pyayamartho na śakyate'vadhārayituṃ padāntaprayogamantareṇeti śabdaśaktimanavadhārayanto'nyapadārthatvam, kṣatriyāderavagacchanto'nyapadārthapradhānatvaṃ nañsamāsasyāhuḥ | nañpadaṃ hi pratiṣedhamāha, brāhmaṇapadaṃ tu svajātīyamarthamiti kṣatriyo'nyapadārtha iti bhrāntāḥ | śabdaśak‌tyanusāriṇāṃ tu svapadārtha evātra sadṛśalakṣaṇo'rtha itīvaśabdaḥ | tathāhi--naño rūpamīdṛśamatra na vikalpyate na viśeṣeṇānugamyate yaiḥ, yadutottarapadārthabhāvaviśiṣṭamasatsāmānyaṃ kṣatriyādyāśrayabhedopakalpitaviśeṣaṃ nañartha iti teṣāṃ bhrāntiḥ | pūrvapadārthapradhānatāyāṃ liṅgavacanātideśasyopayogaḥ || 314 ||
atra pakṣe doṣamudbhāvayati-- viśeṣasyāprayoge tu liṅgasaṅkhye na sidhyataḥ | avarṣādiṣu doṣaśca hemanto'nyāśrayo yataḥ || 315 ||
asatsāmānyasyottarapadārthopakṛtasya samāsavācyatve'tra yadā kṣatriyādayo viśeṣāḥ prayujyante, tadā taiḥ prayuktaipāśrayairviśiṣṭaliṅgasaṃkhyāsiddhirastu | tadaprayoge tu vyaktiviśeṣanibandhane liṅgasaṅkhye na sidhyata iti sāmānyāśraye eva napuṃsakaikatvalakṣaṇa te syātām | avarṣā hemantaḥ, anāpaḥ pṛthivī, apañcālā janapadaḥ, agodau grāmaḥ, atejaḥ sikatā, anartho gṛhāḥ, anidāgho varṣā
