ityādiṣu ceṣṭaliṅgasaṅkhyā siddhirna syāt | yasmādvarṣābhyo'nyo hemanto'trāśrayaḥ samāsārthasyetyavarṣā itihemantagataliṅgasaṅkhyāprasaṅgaḥ | evamanyatra yojyam | hemantagrahaṇasyopalakṣaṇārthatvāt, pūrvapadārthaprādhānyācca varṣārthasyopasarjanatvāddhrasvaprasaṅga iti pūrvapadārthapradhānapakṣo'pi duṣṭaḥ | uttarapadārthaprādhānyameva tvatra siddhāntaḥ | tathā ca yathāyathamuttarapadārthagataliṅgasaṅkhyāsiddhiḥ | atideśasya tu nāyaṃ viṣayaḥ | ye hi bāhyapadārthasambandhe bhede viparivartante, te guṇavacanāḥ svāśrayato liṅgasaṅkhye pratipādyante | tadyathā śuklādayaḥ, yathā bahurvīhiḥ samāsaḥ | nañsamāsastūpāttaliṅgasaṅkhyābhedāparityāgenātyantamanuvartate varṣādiṣviti jātiśabdānāmivāviṣṭaliṅgatvānnāśrayato liṅgānugamo'tra kriyate | tathāhyabrāhmaṇaḥ kṣatram, abrāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriya ityuttarapadārthasamavāyyeva liṅgaṃ dṛśyate | ata eva svābhāvikametadityuktam | saṅkhyāpyavarṣādiṣūttarapadārthasamavetaiveti sāpi svābhāvikī | abrāhmaṇāvityādau tu kvacid bāhyapadārthāpekṣā saṅkhyā | yadyevaṃ śabdaśaktipratiniyamādaprayoge'pi viśeṣasya viśiṣṭe liṅgasaṅkhye sidhyata eveti pūrvapadārthapradhānapakṣo'pi na tyājyaḥ | ata eva bhāṣye codyapratisamādhānena samarthita evāyam | asaḥ asarvasmā iti ca sarvanāmakāryaṃ bhavatyeva, nañarthasyāvyatirekakaratvāt samānādhikaraṇatvāt | atisarvāyetyādāveva hi vyadhikaraṇaviśeṣaṇaviṣaye sarvādyarthasyāprādhānyam, na tu samānādhikaraṇe, nañsamāse | vākya iva svārthāparityāgenaiva hi nañsamāse sarvādayo nañarthaviśeṣaṇaṃ bhavatīti pravartata eva sarvanāmakāryam | ata eva pradhānasāmānādhikaraṇyānnānāvibhaktitvādaprathamānirdeśāccāsatyupasarjanatve hrasvatvamapi na prāpnoti | na copasarjanakāryeṣu pāribhāṣikasambhave laukikamupasarjanamupādeyam | tasmādupapannaṃ pūrvapadārthaprādhānyadarśanam | tadevaṃ nañsamāsādau liṅgasaṅkhyātideśo yathābhāṣyamanusṛtaḥ || 315 ||
yathā nañsamāsādau, evam `ākṛtyabhidhānadvaikaṃ vibhaktau vājapyāyanaḥ' iti jātipadārthaśrayeṇaikaśeṣapratyākhyāne `liṅagvacanasiddhirguṇasyānityatvāt' ityuktam | guṇo dvitvastrītvādikaḥ | sa caikārthasāvāyājjāteravacchedakaḥ | niyataliṅgasaṃkhyaiśca jātiśabdairjātiḥ pratyāyyata iti śabdaśaktisvabhāvāpekṣayā'nityatvaṃ tasya kathyate | kācit kila jātiḥ strītvayuktena śabdena pratyāyyate, kācit pustvayuktenetyādi | tathā kācidekatvayuktenetyādyapītyanityatvam | ata eva `guṇavivakṣānityatvād' iti bhāṣye pāṭhaḥ | atraiva pakṣāntaramabhihitam `guṇavacanavad vā' iti | liṅgavacanasiddhirityeva | tadetad vyākhyātumupakramate-- ākṛtiḥ sarvaśabdānāṃ yadā vācyā pratīyate | ekatvādekaśabdatvaṃ nyāyyaṃ tasyāṃ ca varṇyate || 316 ||
`prakhyā''viśeṣādākṛtisadbhāve codanāsu ca tasyārambhād jñāyate caikopadiṣṭam' iti tasyā eva śabdārthatvaṃ nirṇītam | tathācaikaśabdatve tadāśraye siddhe pratyākhyāta ekaśeṣaḥ | ākṛterekatvāt tatra sambandhagrahaṇopapatteḥ saiva śabdavācyā | na ca pritiniyato viśeṣaḥ śabdāt pratīyata iti sāmānyābhidhānameva | āśrayabhedāpāyopajaneṣvapi caikaprakhyānibandhanāyā jāterbhedāpāyopajanābhāvāt tatprayuktaḥ śabda eka eva nyāyyaḥ | arthabheda hi śabdānāṃ bhedaḥ | arthaśca pradhānabhūto jātireketyeka eva śabdaḥ || 316 ||
evamupakṣipya liṅgaṃ tāvad vicāryate | tathāhi--iyamākṛtiḥ śabdairabhidhīyamānā āviṣṭaliṅgoktā | āviṣṭaṃ liṅgaṃ yayā sā āviṣṭaliṅgā niyataliṅgetyarthaḥ | sarvatrasarveṣāṃ liṅgānāṃ sadbhāve'pi kenacicchabdena kiñcilliṅgaṃ pratyāyyata iti śabdaviśeṣāpekṣayā āviṣṭaliṅgatvamucyate | tadetadāha-- āviṣṭaliṅgatā tasyāṃ syād grāmyapaśusaṅghavat | dravyebhede'pi caikatvāt tatraikavacanaṃ bhavet || 317 ||
"grāmyapaśusaṅgheṣvataruṇeṣu strī"  iti jātipadārthe pratyākhyāte sūtre svabhāvāt pratiniyataliṅgabhedopagrahaḥ | tathāhi--tatra mūlodāharaṇaviṣayeṣu strītvameva gāva imā iti | pratyudāharaṇaviṣayeṣu tu puṃstvameva taruṇeṣviti | evaṃ jātiśabdānāṃ niyataliṅgatā svabhāvāt | jātipadārthadarśanāśrayeṇa hi sūtrapratyākhyāne śabdaśaktibhedāśrayo liṅganiyamaḥ | tathā ca brāhmaṇo brāhmaṇītyādāvapi jātyabhidhāne śabdaśaktinimittamevobhayaliṅgābhidhānam | vṛkṣa ityādau tu puṃstvameva niyatam, jātereva cābhidhīyamānatvāt | anumīyamānadravyabhede'pi tasya śabdenānupādānāgabhidhīyamānajātibandhanamekavacanameva bhavediti jātyākhyāyāmekasmin bahuvacanamārabhyate | pūrvaśloke yad yadeti, tatsambandhādiha tadeti yojyamiti samanvayopapattiḥ || 317 ||
yadi tarhi liṅgabhedena yogaḥ, kathamāviṣṭaliṅgatā jāterityata āha-- āśrayāṇāṃ hi liṅgaiḥ sā niyataireva yujyate | tathā ca yuktavadbhāve pratiṣedho nirarthakaḥ || 318 ||
ekārthasamavāyādāśrayagataliṅgopādanā jātiḥ śabdaśak‌tyanusāreṇa niyamamaṅgīkṛtavatī| tathāhi--vṛkṣaḥ pādapastaruriti vṛkṣatvajātirāśrayagataṃ puṃstvamevopādatte, na kadācidatra strītvanapusakatve dṛśyate | śiṃśapādayaḥ strītvamenāśrayante | panasamityādayastu napuṃsakatvameva | iṣvaśaniprabhṛtayo dviliṅgāḥ, padmaśaṅkhādayaśca | taṭādayastriliṅgāḥ | brāhmaṇo brāhmaṇīti ca dviliṅgaḥ | na hyatra liṅgavyatikaraḥ kadācidapi dṛśyata iti śabdaśaktibhedāpekṣo liṅganiyamo'yamāviṣṭaliṅgatā jātervivakṣitā | ata eva ca "viśeṣaṇānāṃ cājāteḥ"  iti jātipratiṣedho niṣphalaḥ | jātiśabdā hi svasāmarthyānurodhena liṅgopādāyino ca yuktasya liṅgamanurudhyante || 318 ||
nanvevaṃ guṇavacanavadāśrayagataliṅgaparigrahe na jāteḥ svato liṅgayogaḥ kaścid, dravyadharmatvālliṅgasya | satyametat | prabhūto'yaṃ prayoga iti tu śabdasaṃskāramātramatra liṅgam | āviṣṭaliṅgo vā pādapaśabdo'nubhavati bhinnaliṅgena sāmānādhikaraṇyam | tadyathā--brāhmaṇo'yaṃ napuṃsakamiti | pravṛttimanto hi sarve'rthāstisṛbhiḥ pravṛttibhiraviyuktā iti yathāyathaṃ śabdairanugamyante | ata eva caitadāviṣṭaliṅgatvaṃ jāteḥ stanakeśādivyañjanalaukikaliṅgaparigrahe nopapadyata ityāha-- sarvatrāviṣṭaliṅgatvaṃ lokaliṅgaparigrahe | virodhitvāt prasajyeta nāśritaṃ tacca laukikam || 319 ||
lokavyavahāranirūḍhe liṅge samāśrīyamāṇe stanādīnāṃ vyañjakānāṃ pratiniyamāt tadvyaṅgyasya strītvāderekārthasamavāyavirodhāt sarvasminnarthe niyataliṅgatvametacchabdānāṃ prāpnuyāt | stanakeśayogābhivyaktastrītvā yoṣit strīliṅgenaiva śabdena vyapadiśyeta, na dārakalatraśabdābhyāṃ puṃnapuṃsakaliṅgābhyām | asvādayaśca napuṃsakena vāhanaśabdena nocyeran | tasmādātmīyaḥ siddhāntaḥ śabdārtho'rtho yathā nānāliṅga upapadyate, sa pratijñeyaḥ | arthavyaktivastuśabdaiḥ sarvārthānāṃ vyavahārād yathā triliṅgatā sampadyate, tathā paribhāṣaṇīyam | tathā ca bhāṣyam--`tasmānna vaiyākaraṇaiḥ śakyaṃ laukikaṃ liṅgamāsthātum | avaśyaṃ kaścit svakṛtāntaḥ āstheyaḥ' iti || 319 ||
tathāhi-- sāmānyamākṛtirbhāvo jātirityatra laukikam | liṅgaṃ na sambhavatyeva tenānyat parigṛhyate || 320 ||
sāmānyādayaḥ śabdāḥ padārthamekamācakṣate bhinnaliṅgā | na ca tasya padārthasya laukikamasti liṅgamityaliṅgāstadāśrayaṇe prasajyanta ete śabdāḥ | tasmādanyat vyāpakaṃ śastrīyaṃ liṅgamāśrīyate || 320 ||
kiṃ tadityuktaṃ bhāṣye `saṃstyānaprasavau liṅgam' iti | tad vyākhyātumāha-- pravṛttiriti sāmānyaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ tasya kathyate | āvirbhāvastirobhāvaḥ sthitiścetyatha bhidyate || 321 ||
ajasraparimāṇināṃ guṇānāṃ pariṇāmaviśeṣānādareṇa pravṛttiḥ pariṇāma ityeva sāmānyaṃ liṅgalakṣaṇam | tathāhi `kasya punaḥ saṃstyānāṃ strī pravṛttirvā pumān' iti codayitvā `guṇānāṃ rūpādīnām' iti bhāṣyam | sattvarajastamassaṃniveśānāṃ rūpādīnāṃ saṃstyānaṃ saṃhananaṃ vivekenāvasthāya dharmāṇāṃ keṣāñcit prakṛtau pravilayasti rodhānaṃ strītvam | apareṣāṃ prasavo dharmiṇi udbhava avirbhāvaḥ puṃstvam | rajasaḥ pravṛttidharmaṇo'ṅgitāyāṃ prādurbhāvaḥ | guṇānāṃ cātyantamitaretarasāhacaryāt tamasa udbhūtasyāṅgabhūtarajodharmapravṛttyanurodhe tirobhāvaḥ | dharmirūpasyāpi tirobhūtadharmāvasthāyāmanuvṛttiḥ, tamasaḥ sattvadharmoparāgāt sthitirnapuṃsakaṃ strīpuṃsaniṣedharūpatayaiva gamyamāntāvanna bhedena lakṣitam | ata eva saṃstyānaprasavāvasthāvyāpitvāt sthiterliṅgasarvanāma napuṃsakam | sthitirobhāvāvasthayo rajodharmasya pravṛtterguṇāntare'pyanuvedhādanvayitve sati liṅgānāṃ sāmānyametat || 321 ||
anena liṅgena sarve padārthā vyāptā ityuktaṃ bhāṣye `pravṛttiḥ khalvapi nityā | nahi kaścit svasminnātmani muhūrtamapyavatiṣṭhate' ityādi | tad vyācaṣṭe-- pravṛttimantaḥ sarve'rthāstisubhiśca pravṛttibhiḥ | satataṃ na viyujyante vācaścaivātra sambhavaḥ || 322 ||
`vardhate yāvadanena vardhitavyamapāyena vā yujyate' ityanugrahopaghātanimittasannidhye bhāvānāṃ pariṇāmamanubhavatāmāvirbhāvādilakṣaṇābhirviśeṣapravṛtibhirajasramaviyogaḥ | tathāhi--pratikalamavasthāntarāvadhāraṇānyathānupapattyā samunnīyate pariṇāmaḥ | taduktaṃ bhāṣye--`sarvāśca punarmūrtaya evamātmikāḥ saṃstyānaprasavaguṇāḥ' iti | evaṃrūpāśca padārthāḥ śabdairanugamyante | na hi śuddhaṃ pariṇāmi vastutattvamabhidhānaviṣayaḥ, ākāropagraheṇa śabdavācyatvāditi sarvaśabdānāṃ svaśak‌tyanusārī liṅganiyamaḥ samañjasaḥ || 322 ||
tatra prakṛtestriguṇāyā rajasānavaratamastu pravṛttiśīlatā, tadvikārāṇāṃ ca bhogyātmakānām | yastu bhoktā puruṣaścetanaḥ, so'tyantavidharmā bhogyajātānnirgumaḥpravṛttimananubhavan kathamātmā caitanyaṃ citiriti liṅgaviśeṣaniyatābhidhānaviṣayatāmanubhavatītyāśaṅkyāha-- yaścāpravṛttidharmārthaścitirūpeṇa gṛhyate | anuyātīva so'nyeṣāṃ pravṛttīviṣvagāśrayāḥ || 323 ||
buddhidarpaṇe cicchāyāsaṅkrāntyā bhoganiṣpatterbhogyabhāvaśabalitameva caitanyaṃ vyavahāre'dhyakṣyate | tadeva ca śabdagocaro'tyantājñātasyābhidhānayogāt | tathā cānyeṣāṃ bhogyānāṃ pṛthagaparimitapadārtharūpānugatāḥ pravṛttīḥ pariṇāmaviśeṣānanugacchatītyābhāsagataliṅgabhedopacāro nirābhāse'pi caitanye || 323 ||
tathāhi-- tenāsya citirūpaṃ ca citikālaśca bhidyate | tasya svarūpabhedastu na kaścidapi vidyate || 324 ||
tena buddhidarpaṇasaṃkrāntena bhogyajātenāsya bhoktuścitikriyā bhidyate pratibhogyaṃ vivekena gṛhyate | viṣarūpānukāreṇa hi jñānamanyathā pravibhajyate | ata evāvacchinnāpīyaṃ citikriyā cetyagatakālabhedopacārāt pravibhaktakālevāvadhāryate | paramāthataḥ punaścaitanyamātrarūpasya bhokturna kaścana svarūpato deśataḥ kālato vā bhedaḥ | citikriyāpi na tato bhinnā, nirābhāsasaṃvinmātrarūpatvāt tasya | puruṣasya caitanyamiti tu vikalpakalpitākāro bhedo rāhoḥ śira ityādivat | anutpannavivekakhyātayo'rvāgdarśanā guṇapuruṣayoḥ svarūpamelanena vyavaharanti || 324 ||
itthañca kṛtvā pāramārthikena caitanyarūpeṇa vyavahārābhāva ityāha-- acetaneṣu saṃkrāntaṃ caitanyamiva dṛśyate | pratibimbakadharmeṇa yattacchabdanibandhanam || 325 ||
buddhyākārasaṃniviṣṭeṣu sattvādiguṇeṣu jaḍeṣu sattvadharmasvacchatvātiśayaśavaśena caitanyoparāga iti tatrādarśatalaprakhye pratisaṅkrāntaṃ bimbaṃ vyāvahārikaṃ caitanyamabhidhānaviṣaya iti tadanyeṣāṃ pravṛttīranuvidadhadanubhavati liṅgayogamityarthaḥ | yattu patraṃ svayaṃ jyotirapetavikāragranthi tad‌pariṇāmi nāvatarati vyavahāram |taduktam `citiśaktirapariṇāminī' ityādi || 325 ||
tadevaṃ vyavahāre caitanye'pi liṅgayogād-- avasthā tādṛśī nāsti yā liṅgena na yujyate | kvacittu śabdasaṃskāro liṅgasyānāśraye sati || 326 ||
bhokatṛbhogyayorliṅgabhedānugamasya sādhitvāt tadvyatirekema padārthāntarābhāvānna kācidasau padārthāvasthā, yasyā liṅgasambandho nāstīti vyāpakamidaṃ liṅgalakṣaṇaṃ jātāvapyanvayi | avasthātrayasyāviyogāt sarvabhāvānāṃ nityāyā api jātestadanapāyāt | sambhavadapi cedaṃ liṅgaṃ kvacidavivakṣayāpākīryate | tadāha bhāṣyakāraḥ--`taccobhayaṃ sarvatra | yadyubhayaṃ sarvatra, kṛto vyavasthā | vivakṣātaḥ | styānavivakṣāyāṃ strī, prasavavivakṣāyāṃ pumān, ubhayoravivakṣāyāṃ napuṃsakam' iti | tathā ca śabdasaṃskāramātram `na kevalā prakṛtiḥ prayoktavyā' iti liṅgapratyayastatra | yathocyate `taddhitārthānirdeśe liṅgavacanamapramāṇaṃ tasyāvivakṣitatvāt' iti || 326 ||
yaduktam--`avasthā tādṛśī nāsti yā liṅgena na yujyata' iti | tadeva vyaktayati-- kṛttaddhitābhidheyānāṃ bhāvānāṃ na virudhyate | śastre liṅgaṃ guṇāvasthā tathā cākṛtiriṣyate || 327 ||
pākaḥ paktiḥ pacanamiti kṛdabhihito bhāvo'vasthābhedena bhidyamānastadanugataṃ liṅgabhedamanubhavanniyataliṅgaiḥ śabdairviṣayīkriyate | evaṃ garimā gurutā gurutvamityādistaddhitābhidheyaḥ | ekāpi hi yāvadavasthāvasthāntaramanubhavatyeva | na hi kaścit svasminnātmani muhūrtamapyavatiṣṭhate yataḥ | tathā ca saṃstyānaṃ saṃstyāyaḥ saṃstyeti dhātūpādānaikāpyavasthā liṅgabhedanibandhanaiḥ śabdaiḥ pratyāyyate | tadevaṃ guṇāvasthālakṣaṇaṃ śāstre paribhāṣitaṃ liṅgaṃ na virudhyate kṛttāddhitābhidheyānāṃ bhāvānāṃ bhinnamapi | anyathaikatvād bhāvasya kiñcidekameva liṅgaṃ yujyeta | taditthaṃ siddhe'sya liṅgalakṣaṇasya vyāpitve, upasaṃharati--tathā cākṛtiriṣyataiti | tathā ca evaṃ sati guṇānāṃ rūpādīnāṃ sattvādiguṇapariṇāmarūpāṇāmāvirbhāvādyavasthā pravṛttisāmānyarūpā liṅgajātirabhyupagamyata ityupasaṃhāraḥ kṛtaḥ || 327 ||
itthañca jātiśabdānāṃ liṅgavyāptisiddherdravyapadārthakena yatra liṅgāsiddhiḥ prasañjitā, sā pratisamāhitā bhavatītyāha-- liṅgaṃ prati na bhedo'sti dravyapakṣe'pi kaścana | tasmāt sapta vikalpā ye saivātrāviṣṭaliṅgatā || 328 ||
dravyapadārthapakṣe'pi guṇāvasthā liṅgam | ākṛtipadārthanaye'pi tā eva tyaktabhedāvyaktayo jātiriti guṇāvasthāsambhavād yathāyathaṃ svaśaktyanusāreṇa śabdairniyataliṅgā jātirdravyaṃ vā niyataliṅgaṃ pratipādyata iti darśanadvaye'pi liṅgaṃ prati bhedabhāvaḥ | kathaṃ na bhedo yāvatā jātirāviṣṭaliṅgā, dravyaṃ punaraniyataliṅgamityāśaṅkya nigamayati--tasmāditi | dvitryekaliṅgatayā `upādānavikalpāśca liṅgānāṃ sapta darśitāḥ' iti jātiśabdaistadupagrahe niyatairevāsaṅkareṇa liṅgopādānādāviṣṭaliṅgatā jāteḥ kathitā | na tvekaliṅgaparigraha eveti pakṣadvayasāmyam | vaiyākaraṇairhi na vastudharmo liṅgamiṣyate | api tu śabdārthasya liṅgayogaḥ | pratīyate ca śabdebhyo jātirupagṛhītaliṅgasambandhā | tena jāteḥ svameva liṅgam | ata āśrayaliṅgena liṅgavattve nābhiniviśyate | ata eva guṇavivakṣānityatvādityetadabhyupapadyate, dravyavyabhicāreṇa jāterapi guṇasya strītvādervivakṣāpraklṛpteḥ || 328 ||
evaṃ svapakṣe dravyapakṣasāmyaṃ liṅgaṃ prati samarthitaṃ jātipadārthakena, samprati vacanaṃ samarthayitumāha-- vacane niyamaḥ śāstrād dravyasyābhyupagamyate | yatastadākṛtau śāstramanyathaiva samarthyate || 329 ||
dravyapadārthadarśane'pi "bahuṣu bahuvacanam" ityādiśāstrasāmarthyād vacananiyamaḥ, na tu dravyasya saṅkhyāstītyeva, sāṅkaryaparihārārthaṃ hyavaśyaṃ vacanamārambhaṇīyam | evañcecchāstraśaraṇā vyavasthā tadā jātāvapi padārthe tacchāstramanyathā varṇyate || 329 ||
kathamityāha-- vartate yo bahuṣvartho bhede tasya vivakṣite | svāśrayairvyupadiṣṭasya śāstre vacanamucyate || 330 ||
yo jātilakṣaṇo bahuṣu vartate, tasya bhede bhinnādhārasamavāye vivakṣite, bahuṣviti svāśrayaiḥ śāstre kathitasya bahuvacanaṃ vidhīyate | evaṃ dvayoriti vyapadiṣṭasya dvivacanamityādi vācyam | tadayamarthaḥ--dvitvasaṅkhyāvacchinnavyaktiviśeṣādhikaraṇā jātirdvivacanāntena śabdena pratyāyyate, bahutvasaṅkhyāvacchinnādhārasamavetā tu bahuvacanāntena, ekasaṅkhyādhārāvacchinnā tvekavacanāntena | tadetaduktaṃ bhāṣye-- "atha yasya dravyaṃ padārthaḥ, kathaṃ tasyaikavacanadvivacanabahuvacanāni | evaṃ sa vakṣyati`ekasminnekavacanam, dvayordivacanam, bahuṣu bahuvacanam' iti | yadi tarhi, tasyāpi vācanikāni, na svābhāvikāni | ahamapyevaṃ vakṣyāmi--ekasminnekavacanam, dvayordvivacamūna,bahuṣu bahuvacanamiti |" ekasmin yā vartate jātirityādyarthaḥ | kecidakārapraśleṣeṇābhede tasyeti paṭhantastasyaikaśabdatārthamekatve sahaje śabdena pratipādayitumiṣṭa iti vyācakṣate | evamanadhigatabhedāyāmeva jātāvāśrayato vacanamupapadyate || 330 ||
yadā tvāśrayabhedena bheda eva pratīyate | ākṛterdravyapakṣeṇa tadā bhedo na vidyate || 331 ||
āśrayabhedena jāterbhedānuvidhāne vacanabhedaḥ svagata eva | tathā cānekaśabdatvamapīti ekaśeṣa ārabhyata eveti dravyapadārthapakṣeṇa jātipadārthapakṣasya bhedo nāsti | ubhayatrāpi pratyarthaṃ śabdaniveśāt | etacca darśanaṃ bhāṣye heyatvenoktam | "yadi kadācidākṛtirekatvena vivakṣitā, kadācid dvitvena, kadācid bahutvena ekā ākṛtiriti pratijñā hīyate | yaccāsya pakṣasyopādāne prayojanamuktam--ekaśeṣo na vaktavya iti,sa idānīṃ vaktavyo bhavati" iti || 331 ||
tasmāt prāguktameva yuktamityapasaṃharati-- abhede tvekaśabdatvācchāstrācca vacane sati | ekaśeṣo na vaktavyo vacanānāṃ ta sambhavaḥ || 332 ||
vyaktinibandhanabhedānuvidhānābhāve'pisvāśrayabhedanibandhanam "bahuṣu bahuvacanam" ityādiśāstrād yathoktena nyāyena yadā jātirvacanabhedaṃ pratipadyate, tadā prayojakasyārthasyaikatvādekaśabdatve siddhe pratyākhyāyate sūtramekaśeṣalakṣaṇam || 332 ||
atra codayati-- nanu cānabhidheyatve dravyasya tadapāśrayaḥ | ākṛterupakāro'yaṃ dravyābhāvānna kalpate || 333 ||
ākṛteḥ śabdārthatve dravyasyānabhidhīyamānatvāt tadāśrayaliṅgasaṃkhyāsiddhiḥ katham ? śabdārthanimitto hi śabdasaṃskāraḥ | anabhidhīyamānasya ca vastutaḥ sattve'pi saṃskāraṃ pratyasattvameva || 333 ||
etat parihartumāha-- vyapadeśo'bhidheyena na śāstre kaścidāśritaḥ | dravyaṃ nāma padārtho yo na ca sa pratiṣidhyate || 334 ||
"bahuṣu bahuvacanam" ityādiśāstre'bhidhīyamānāśrayabhedanibandhanāni vacanānīti na vacanamasti | kintu sāmānyenaitaducyate | tathā ca bhinnādhārā jātirvacanabhedaṃpratipadyata eva | na ca jātipadārthadarśane dravyaṃ nāma padārtho nāsti | tathā ca bhāṣyam--`na hyākṛtipadārthasakasya dravyaṃ na padārtho, dravyapadārthakasya vākṛtirna padārthaḥ' iti | ākṛtipadārthavādino dravyaṃ nāma yaḥ padārtho na sa nāsti | api tu vidyamāna eveti bhinnadravyasambaddhāyā jāterāśrayagato vacanabhedo'viruddhaḥ || 334 ||
ato'nantaraṃ bhāṣyam--`kasyācittu kiñcit pradhānabhūtam, kiñcid guṇabhūtam' ityādi | tad vyācaṣṭe-- guṇabhāvo'bhidheyatvaṃ prati dravyasya nāśritaḥ | upakārī guṇaḥ śeṣaḥ padārtha iti kalpanā || 335 ||
jātipadārthakasya jātiḥ pradhānaṃ śabdavācyā, dravyaṃ tu guṇatvena śabdavācyamiti na vivakṣitamatra | api tvanabhidhīyamānasyāpi dravyasyopakāritvājjātiṃ prati guṇamucyate | tathāhi--loke yo yasyopakārī, sa tadarthaḥ śeṣabhūto guṇa iti kalpyate | tathāca dravyaṃ jātāviti tatsambandhena tadgatavacanabhedapratipattirityuktaṃ bhavati || 335 ||
kathadhamabhidheyatvaṃ prati guṇabhāvo dravyasyātra bhāṣye spaṣṭo na vyākhyāyata ityata āha-- dravye na guṇabhāvo'sti vinā dravyābhidhāyitām | ākṛtau vā pradhānatvamata evaṃ samarthyate || 336 ||
dravyābhidhāyitāṃ vineti| atrāsati dravyābhidhāne yasmād dravye guṇabhāvo nāsti, jātervā prādhānyam, tasmādevametad bhāṣyaṃ vyākhyāyate--guṇatvamupakāritvena dravyasya nābhidhīyamānatveneti | abhidhīyamānatāyāṃ hi dravyasyākṛtiravacchedikā syāditi tadeva pradhānamabhidhīyamānaṃ syāt | ākṛtistvacchedopayoginī guṇa eva syāt, na pradhānam | tathā ca yathā rājapuruṣa ityatra rājārtho na saṃkhyābhedaṃ pradhānagatamavalambate, tathā jātirapi nāvalambeta | satyapi tu guṇatve tadanuvṛttau vacanabhedāpatterekaśeṣapratyākhyānamayuktaṃ syāt | yadā tu nābhidhīyate dravyam, tadānabhidhīyamānamabhidhīyamānāyā jāterguḍaśabda iva (guḍa iva) mādhuryāderbhedakamityātmādhāraliṅgasaṃkhyopahāreṇopakāritvād guṇa iti yujyate vaktum || 336 ||
kecidabhidhīyamānayorapi jātidravyayorguṇapradhānabhāvaṃ samarthayanta ityāha-- kaiścid guṇapradhānatvaṃ nāmākhyātavadiṣyate | na vṛttivat parārthasya guṇabhāvastu varṇyate || 337 ||
pācakaḥ pacatīti yathābhidhīyamānayoreva kriyākārakayorguṇapradhānabhāvaḥ, tathātrāpi | tathāhi--nāmapadena kriyākārakasambandhopasarjanaḥ sādhanāśrayaḥ prādhānyenābhidhīyate, dhātvarthasyātra pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇatvāt | tena cātra bhūtena bhāvināpi ca sa viśeṣyata iti na kriyā pradhānam, bhāvyāvasthāyāmeva tathātvāt | ata evātra sambandhe bhāvapratyayaḥ, tasyaiva pravṛttinimittatvāt | kriyā tvatra guṇabhūtāpi bhedenāvasīyate | ākhyātapadena tu sādhanaviśeṣapratilabdhānugrahā kriyā prādhānyenocyate | bhāvyāmānāvasthā hyatra kriyā vyāpriyamāṇena sādhanena viśeṣyate pratyayārthenāpi satā | kartṛvyāpārarūpā hi bhāvanā bhāvyarūpadhātvarthaniṣṭheti pradhānabhūtavyāpārāveśena karturya evāvagamaḥ, sa eva parārthasyāpi prādhānyāvagamahetuḥ | tadevaṃ guṇabhūtamapyatra sādhanaṃ bhedenāvadhāryate | tathā ca viśeṣaṇairyujyate devadattaḥ pacatīti | ata eva svasaṃkhyayā kriyāmupakaroti pacataḥ pacantīti | evaṃ jātipadārthakānāṃ jātiḥ prādhānyena śabdavācyā | dravyapadārthakānāṃ jātiraprādhānyena śabdavācyā | dravyapadārthakānāṃ tu dravyam, vivakṣāniyamena hi yujyate guṇapradhānabhāvaḥ | yathā tu rājapuruṣādau vṛttipade parārthasyopasarjanapadārthasya guṇabhāvo'pradhānatvam, naivaṃ nāmākhyātayoḥ sādhyasādhanabhāvasya kathyate | tathāhi--vṛttāvupasarjanārthasya pradhānena sambhedāpattervivekāgrahaṇāt svaprayuktasaṃskāranimittatā nopapadyate | śābda eva hi guṇabhāvastasya | tathā ca ṛddhādi viśeṣaṇaṃ na yujyate | pācakaḥ pacatīti tūbhayatrāpi sādhyasādhanabhāvāvacchedenobhayamapi kriyākārakarūpaṃ pratīyata eva | kevalaṃ sāmarthyād guṇapradhānabhāvaḥ pratīyate yathāyogam | tathāhi bhūtaṃ bhavyāyeti pariniṣṭhitarūpaṃ sādhanaṃ parārtham, pariniṣṭhitatvādevānyasyopakārāyopādīyamānatvāt | yaduddhiśya ca tatpravṛttistat sādhyaṃ pradhānamākhyātapade | nāmapade tu kārakaśaktiḥ pravṛttinimittamiti tadādhāraḥ prādhānyenābhidhīyate | evamiha darśanabhede'pi dvayorapi śabdārthatvena yadākṛterādhāraprakalpitātiśayasampādanāya dravyopādānam, tadākṛtiḥ pradhānaṃ viśeṣyatvenopakramāt | yadā tu vyaktiviśeṣāvacchedaparamākṛtyupādānam, tadā viparyayaḥ || 337 ||
yadyevamākṛtipakṣe'pi dravyasyābhidhīyamānatvāt tadgatavacanabhedavacchabdabhedaprasaṅga ityārabdhavyo'trāpyekaśeṣa ityāśaṅkayāha-- guṇabhūtasya nānātvādākṛterekaśabdatā | siddho vacanabhedaśca dravyabhedasamanvayāt || 338 ||
ākṛtipadārthakānāṃ dravyaṃ guṇabhūtaṃ bhinnamiti na guṇabhūtaśabdārthabhedāpekṣamanekaśabdatvam | api tu pradhānabhūtaśabdārthābhedāpekṣamekaśabdatvameva nyāyyamiti nārtha ekaśeṣeṇa | vacanabhedastatra sutarāṃ siddho'bhidheyena dravyeṇa bhinnena yogāt | ayamabhiprāyaḥ--bhedābhedayorguṇapradhānabhūtayorvirodhāt pradhāne yuktamevaikaśabdatvam | nahi pradhānamanādṛtya guṇavidhānaṃ yuktam | svanimittaṃ tu saṃskāraṃ pradhānānugrahāya guṇo vacanabhedalakṣaṇaṃ pradhānānuparodhinaṃ prāpayatu, ko'tra virodhaḥ || 338 ||
tathāhi-- sādhanaṃ guṇabhāvena kriyāyā bhedakaṃ yathā | ākhyāteṣvekaśabdāyā jāterdravyaṃ tathocyate || 339 ||
kriyāprādhānye'pyākhyātasya yathā guṇabhūtasādhanāśrayo vacanabhedaḥ pacataḥ pacantīti, tathaikaśabdavācyāyāḥ pradhānabhūtāyā jātestenaiva śabdena dravyasyābhidhāne sannihito'bhidhīyamāno guṇo'sāvātmādhāraṃ saṃkhyābhedaṃ tatra kalpayati | yena hi guṇadharmeṇa pradhānasyoparodho na bhavati, taṃ pradhānopakārāyopasthāpayatyeva guṇaḥ | anyathā guṇatvamevāsya hīyate | yata upakāraprabhāvitatvāt tasya | itthaṃ ca nāmākhyātavaditi nidarśanaṃ susadṛśamuktam, na vṛttivaditi | nahi rājapuruṣe rājārthanimittaḥ kaścid vacanabhedādiḥ saṃskāro'tyantamabhedāpatteḥ pradhānārthenopasarjanārthasya | atra ca sādhanaṃ kriyāyāṃ na bhinnāṃ saṃkhyāmupaharati | api tvavidyamānabhedāpi svataḥ kriyāśrayagatavacanabhedāpekṣayā pacataḥ pacantīti tiṅantenābhidhīyata ityucyate | tathā ca guṇabhūtasādhanabhedādeva nirjñātabhedatvānna tiṅntānyekaśeṣārambhaṃ prayojayantīti bhāṣye'bhihitam || 339 ||
tadevaṃ jātiviśiṣṭasya dravyasyābhidhāne'pi pradhānyājjātipadārthābhyupagameliṅgavacanasiddhirūpapāditā liṅgavacanāsiddhirguṇasyānityatvāditi | guṇo'tra dravyaṃ vivakṣitam | yadā tu jātimātrābhidhānameva, tadā guṇavacanavadāśrayato liṅgavacanāni vyākhyātumāha-- ekatve tulyarūtvācchabdānāṃ pratipādane | nimittāt tadvato'rthasya viśiṣṭagrahaṇe sati || 340 ||
so'yamityabhisambandhādāśrayairākṛteḥ saha | pravṛttau bhinnaśabdāyāṃ liṅgasaṃkhye prasidhyataḥ || 341 ||
ādhāraiḥ saha jāterabhede sati śabdaiḥ pratyāyane kriyamāṇe ye jātiviśiṣṭadravyābhidhāyinaḥ, ye ca jātimātrābhidhāyinaḥ śabdāste tulyarūpatvādabhedenādhyāvasīyante | tathāhi, svārthapratipādane jātiśabdairjātilakṣaṇaṃ nimittaṃ tadvati dravye'dhyāropitamāśritya jātiviśiṣṭasya dravyasyabhedena pratyāyanamiti tairāśrayabhūtairdravyaiḥ saha jāteḥ so'yamityabhedaprāptau nimittānuvidhānena nimittino'pyabhidhānāt tadgataliṅgasaṃkhyopādānaṃ śukladivadaviruddhaṃ bhinnaśabdāyāmapi pravṛttau | yadā hi jātitadvantau dvāvapyekaśabdavācyau, tadaikaśabdā pravṛttirvyākhyātā | iha tu jātimātrasya śabdena pratipādane bhinnaśabdā pravṛttiḥ | atrāpi ca nimittasarūpapratyayopajanād yathāpratyayaṃ ca śabdenābhidhānānnimittasaṃkrāntaiva śabdapravṛttiḥ | tathā hyasya gauriti vyatireko na dṛṣṭa ityabhedopacārādāśrayaliṅgavacanasiddhiḥ |evañca phalataḥ pakṣayorabhedaḥ | pūrvatra tu guṇapradhānabhāvena dvayorabhidhānam, iha tvabhedopacārādityetāvān viśeṣaḥ || 340, 341 ||
yadvā pūrvatrānabhidhīyamānamapi dravyamupakārakaṃ vivakṣitam | tathā ca coditam --`nanu cānabhidheyatva' ityādi | jātilakṣamanimittānuvidhānamantareṇa ca na vyaktayo yathāsvaṃ viśeṣeṇa vyavahāramavatarantītyāha-- prāk ca jātyabhisaṃbandhāt sarvanāmābhidheyatā | vastūpalakṣaṇāḥ sattve prayujyante tyadādayaḥ || 342 ||
yāvajjātirūpamādhāre na pratyasyate, tāvadvyaktīnāṃ rūpānavasāyādanirūpaṇameva viśeṣaṇam | ārūpikā hi jātirādhāraṃ nirūpayantī vyavahārayati yathāsvaṃ viśeṣaśabdairviśiṣṭajātirūpaṇābhāve tu viśeṣaśabdānāmagocaraḥ padārtha iti sattve dravye siddhasvābhāve vastumātropalakṣaṇāḥ sarvanāmaśabdāstyadādayaḥ prayujyante | te hi vastu kiñciditi sāmānyamātratayā padārthamavagamayanti | tasmād viśepratyāyanāya jātirūpādhyāsena nimittarūpatāṃ prāptāḥ padārthā yathāyathaṃ jātiśabdairabhidhīyante gavādibhirityābhedopacārājjātiśabdānāṃ dravyābhidhānaṃ na gauṇam, api tu mukhyamevetyāśrayaliṅgavacanasiddhiruktā || 342 ||
atraiva matāntaramāha-- pākau pākā iti yathā medakaḥ kaiścidāśrayaḥ | iṣyate cānupādāno dharmo'sau guṇavācinām || 343 ||
pākaśabdaḥ kriyādharmavacano nopādatte tadāśrayam | anupādāno'pi cātra kriyāśrayo bhedakaḥ | tathāhi dvivacanabahuvacane bhavataḥ karmasthāvāt pacikriyāyāstadbhede pākabhedābhidhānamatra | evaṃ guṇavācināṃ śabdānāṃ so'yamiti sambandhāśrayānupādāne'pyanupādāno'sāvāśrayo bhedaka iti jātiśabdānāṃ guṇavacanatvādanupāttadravyāṇāmapi vacanabhedaḥ setsyatītikaiścidabhyupagamyate | etattu na yuktam | pākau pākā iti so'yamityabhisambandhenāśrayopādānasyādṛṣṭeḥ yuktaṃ yadāśrayabhedena pākabhedād bhinnaśabdabhidheyatve svata eva vacanabhedaḥ | na hyayamāśrayagataḥ | āśrayabhedenāśritasya bhedādaśritabhedo'nuyāyyeva | tathā ca guḍatilataṇḍulaudānānāṃ pāka ityāśrayabhedāvagamādevāśritabhedapratīterna bahuvacanam | śuklādiśabdānāṃ tu so'yamiti sambandhena dṛṣṭamāśrayopādānam | ta eva ca jātiśabdānāṃ bhāṣye nidarśanatvenopanyastā `guṇavacanavad' iti | tathāhi--jātiśabdā apyāśrayamabhedopacārādupādadata eva | āśritamātraśca guṇo vivakṣita iti jātirapi tathā prasiddhavastu | guṇavacanatvena śuklādirityupamānam | na cādhārabhede'pi jātibhedaḥ pākādivadityabhinnaśabdatve pratyākhyāte ekaśeṣe'bhedopacāreṇa tad‌vṛttivṛtte liṅgavacanasiddhiratra vivakṣitā, na tvāśrayānupādānena || 343 ||
tathāhi-- āśrayasyānupādāne kevalaṃ labhate yadi | ādhāradharmān sāmānyaṃ purastāt tadvicāritam || 344 ||
anupāttādhāraṃ śuddhameva jātiśabdena sāmānyamabhihitamityādhāragatālliṅgasaṃkhyālakṣaṇān dharmān pratipadyata iti nedaṃ guṇavacanavadityatra parihāre vyākhyātu yujyate | etaddhi pūrvatra parihāre `liṅgavacanasiddhirguṇasyānityatvāt' ityatra pakṣāntaraṃ vyākhyātam | tathāhi--tatra `nanu cānabhidheyatve' ityādinā codayitvā `vyapadeśo'bhidheyena na śāstre kaścidāśrita' iti parihṛtam | dvitīyaścāpi pakṣo'tra vyākhyātaḥ `kaiścid guṇapradhānatvami' tyādinā dvayorapyabhidhīyamānatvalakṣaṇo guṇapradhānabhāvena | asmiṃstu parihāre jāterevābhidhīyatā | abhedopacārāttu tadāśrayopādāne taddharmasiddhiḥ || 344 ||
tatra kathamabhedopacāra ityuktaṃ bhāṣye--`sāmānye vṛttasyā vṛttirūpajāyate' iti | tadupapādayitumāha-- jātau pūrvaṃ pravṛttānāṃ śabdānāṃ jātivācinām | aśabdavācyāt sambandhād vyaktirapyupajāyate || 345 ||
nimittapurassarā nimittino vṛttiriti pūrvaṃ nimittabhūtāyāṃ jātau śabdapravṛttiḥ | sā ca jātirnirāśrayā na sambhavatīti śabdenābhidhāyakenāviṣayīkṛtādapi tadvatsambandhalakṣaṇāt sāmarthyād vyaktistadvān pratyayapathamupārohati | tathā cāha--`adhikaragatiḥ sāhacaryāt' iti || 345 ||
pratyayānusāreṇa ca śabdāḥ pravartanta iti kramo'pyatropapanna ityāha-- so'yamityabhisambandhājjātidharmopacaryate | dravyaṃ tadāśrayo bhedo jāteścābhyupagamyate || 346 ||
abhedādhyāsājjāteriva dharmo'syeti dravyaṃ jātiśabdenocyate | jātyātmakatvāpatteḥ | nimittarūpācchuritasya padārthasyāvagamāt tathaivābhidhānapravṛttiriti jātilakṣaṇanimittaṃ vyaktāvadhyasya tadabhedena śabdastatra vartate | tathā ca dravyāsyāpi nimittācchuritasya nimittanibandhanena śabdenābhidhānamarthato jāyata iti tadāśrayaḥ saṃkhyābhedo nimitte'pi pratijñāyate, na hi jātiśabdena dravyaṃ svena rūpeṇābhidhīyate, api tu nimittasya tatra sannidhānānnimittamabhidadhatā śabdena sāmarthyānnimittyupādānam, nimittino nimittasya niṣkṛṣṭasyābhāvāt | upāttanimittigatastu dharmapratilambhaḥ | viramya vyāpārāyogācca śabdasya nāyamabhidhāyāṃ kramaḥ| pratipattārastu--tamekameva saṃsṛṣṭamarthaṃ svakalpanābhirvibhajanta iti tadabhiprāyeṇa sāmānye vṛttesyeti bhāṣye krama uktaḥ || 346 ||
etadeva nidarśanena sādhayati-- mañcaśabdo yathā''dheyaṃ mañceṣveva vyavasthitaḥ | tattvenāha tathā jātiśabdo dravyeṣu vartate || 347 ||
mañcāḥ krośantīti kriyāsambandhasyādheye mañcasthe prāṇinyupapatterādhārarūpābhedenādhāravacano'pi mañcaśabdastadādheyavacana iti niścīyate | evamānīyantāṃ gāva iti kriyāsambandhasya jātāvanupapattestadabhedāpannā vyaktayaḥ kriyāsamanvayasamarthā jātinibandhanena śabdenopādīyanta ityavagamaḥ || 347 ||
yadyevaṃ kathaṃ jātireva padārtha ityata āha-- tatra jātipadārthatvaṃ tathaivābhyupagamyate | jātirutsaṅkhyā tu dravyātmanyanuṣajyate || 348 ||
yathādheyābhidhāne'pi mañcaśabdastadādhāravacana ityucyate, tathaiva satyapyāśrayadravyopādāne jātiśabdo jātipadārtha eva vyavasthāpyate | dravyamapi hi nāsau svarūpeṇācaṣṭe, api tu jātirūpādhyāsenetyupacaritaṃ jātirūpasamāveśād dravyābhidhānaṃ vāhīkābhidhānavat | mukhyaṃ tu jātyabhidhānameva | nirūḍhatvācca nopacārapratītiḥ | yadyevaṃ nimittābhidhānaṃ mañcādivadeva syāt | tathā caikajātyācchuritā vyaktayaḥ sarvā aikyenābhidhīyeranniti vacanabhedo na syādityāśaṅkyoktaṃ--jātirutsṛṣṭasaṅkhyetyādi | jāteḥ svataḥ saṅkhyārahitatvānnirastasaṅkhyāsvarūpeṇa kevalamasau dravye'dhyasyata iti na tadāśrayā kācidatra saṅkhyā prāpnoti | nāpi liṅgamaliṅgatvāt tasyā ityādhāragataliṅgasaṅkhyopagraha eva nyāyyaḥ || 348 ||
tadevamupapanno jātiśabdānāṃ liṅgavacanayogaḥ, śuklādiśabdavat | tatra śuklādiśabdānāṃ matublopādabhedopacārād vā tadvati vṛttiḥ | jātiśabdānāṃ tu vyatirekasya kadācidapyadarśanānmatublopena nārtho'bhedopacārād vā tadvati vṛttiḥ | jātiśabdānāṃ tu vyatirekasya kadācidapyadarśanānmatublopena nārtho'bhedopacārādeva tadvati vṛttiḥ | tathāpi ca tadvadabhidhānamātraṃ samānamāśritya upāyabhedānādareṇa śuklādīnāṃ dṛṣṭāntatopapattiratretyāha-- asyedamiti vā yatra so'yamityapi vā śrutiḥ | vartate paradharmeṇa tadanyadabhidhīyate || 349 ||
matvarthīyavaśenābhedopacāreṇa vā śabdo'nyatra vartatām | nimittarūpādhyāsena tu nimittino'bhidhānaṃ tulyam | iyatā ceha prayojanamityarthaḥ | itthañca yathā guṇaśabdatvaṃ dravyavācyatve'pi śuklādīnāmucyate, tathāgavādīnāṃ jātiśabdatve'pi na kāpi hāniḥ || 349 ||
tathāhi-- yat pradhānaṃ na tasyāsti svarūpamanirūpaṇāt | guṇasya cātmanā dravyaṃ tadbhāvenopalakṣyate || 350 ||
nirupādherarthasya dravyātmanaḥ kriyāsambandhakṣamasya śuddhaṃ rūpaṃ vyavahāre nāsti śābde vaikalpike vā nirūpaṇapūrvako hi vyavahāraḥ | tacca nirūpaṇamarthasyopādhirūpācchuraṇenaiva | tataśca guṇasya yathāyathaṃ śuklajātyāderviśeṣamasyātmanā svarūpeṇa dravyaṃ vyavahāre tadbhāvaṃ guṇātmatāmivopagatamupalakṣyate | nimittasarūpatāṃ prāptaṃ nimittītyarthaḥ || 350 ||
evamapi ca jātiprādhānyaṃ na truṭyatītyāha-- guṇasya bhedakāle tu prādhānyamupajāyate | saṃsargaśrutirartheṣu sākṣādeva na vartate || 351 ||
yadā dravyaṃ prādhānyena vivakṣitaṃ bhavati, tadā jātyupadhīyamānaṃ tadabhidhīyate | yadā tu guṇasyānyasmād bhedenākhyānaṃ pradhānatayā, tadā svasāmānyāveśena tadabhedaprāptasya tasya pratyāyanam | yadā tu jātireva prādhānyenābhimatā, tadā tasyāḥ śabdasvarūpādhyāsenābhidhānam | tathāhi--dharmāntasaṃsargopahitaviśeṣaṃ vastu śabdāḥ śaknuvantyabhidhātuṃ, na śuddham | ata eva saṃsarganimittā śrutiḥ śabdaḥ saṃsargaśritirityucyate | sā ca dharmāntaramukhenārthoṣu niviśate, nopadhāntayāgena sākṣānnirūpādheranirūpaṇānnirūpaṇapūrvakāṇāṃ śabdānāmaviṣayatvāt || 351 ||
evaṃ tāvajjātipadārthatāprasaṅgād dravyapadārthatāpi kathaṃ bhavatītyāha | yadi vā so'yamiti sambandhād dravyābhidhāne'pi yadi jātipadārthatā, kathaṃ tarhi dravyapadārthatetyāha-- jātau vṛtto yadā dravye sa śabdo vartate punaḥ | jātereva padārthatvaṃ na tadābhyupagamyate || 352 ||
jātau vartitvā tadviśiṣṭaṃ yadā dravyamapyāha, na jātāvevābhidhāvirāmaḥ śabdasya, tadā jātereva kevalāyā na padārthatvam | abhedopacārācca so'yamiti sambandhena yathā samarthitaṃ na dravyopādānamabhyupagamyate | api tu tadvatyakṣo'yaṃ pūrvatra parihāre'bhihita ityarthaḥ || 352 ||
nanu ca virambha vyāpārānupapatteḥ śabdānāṃ kathaṃ jātau vartitvā sa eva śabdo dravye vartate | darśanabhedena hi bhinnā eva śabdā jātimātravacanāstadvacanāścetyata āha-- pravṛttānāṃ punarvṛttirekatvenopavarṇyate | pratipatterupāyeṣu na tattvamanugamyate || 353 ||
sādṛśyādabhedāvasāyenaivamekatvena vyavahāraḥ pratipādanopāyaḥ | saṃsṛṣṭārthābhidhānaṃ hyakramamapyevaṃ kalpanayā krameṇa pratipādyate | na ca parapratipattyupāyānāṃ paramārthānugamo nyāyyo heyatvāt teṣām | tathā ca tadvadabhidhānanaye'kramamevobhayābhidhānam || 353 ||
atrāpi cobhayābhidhāne prādhānyāprādhānyavivakṣāvaśena jātipadārthatā dravyapadārthatā ca darśanabhedena samutiṣṭhata ityāha-- apṛthak|chabdavācyasya jātirāśrīyate yadā | dravyasya sati saṃsparśe tadā jātipadārthatā || 354 ||
ekaśabdorādānatve'pi jātidravyayoryadā jātirādhārabhedaprakalpitabhedā kāryaṃpravṛttau prādhānyenāśrīyate, brāh‌maṇāḥ śuśrūṣitavyāḥ, yo'yaṃ pānīyaṃ pibati sa gauḥ padā na spraṣṭavyaḥ, gauranubandhya ityādau, tadā satyapi dravyasya śabdena saṃsparśe jātipadārthapakṣa eva, jātibhedapratipādanamātropakṣayatvād dravyasya || 354 ||
dravyasya sati saṃsparśe dravyamāśrīyate yadā | vācyaṃ tenaiva śabdena tadā dravyapadārthatā || 355 ||
jātyupādāyinaiva śabdena dravyopādāne satyapi tasyābhidheyatayaiva sambandhe saṃsparśe yadā dravyaṃ prādhānyena kāryasambandhitayāśrīyate, jātistadviśeṣaṇamātropakṣayā, brāhmaṇamimaṃ bhojayetyādau, dravyaparāyāṃ codanāyāṃ, tadā dravyapadārthapakṣaḥ | tadetaduktaṃ `kasyacit tu kiñcit pradhānam' iti || 355 ||
jātiparāyāmapi codanāyāṃ kriyāsambandhakṣamatvād dravyameva tātparyadṛśā padārtho'vatiṣṭhata ityāha-- apṛthakcchabdavācyāpi bhedamātre pravartate | yadā sambandhavajjātiḥ sāpi dravyapadārthatā || 356 ||
dvayorapi śabdopādānatve kāryapratipattyogyatvādanādṛtya jātiṃ dravyamevapadārthamātiṣṭhante vyāliprabhṛtayaḥ | yadāhuḥ--`codanāsu ca tasyārambhād' iti | jātistu bhedamātre svāśrayavyavacchedamātra eva tatra pravartate śabdābhidheyāpi | tadyathā--rājapuruṣa ityatra samāsavācyo'pi sambandhaḥ sambandhisvarūpāvacchedamātropayogītyuttarapadārthapradhāna eva samāsaḥ, na sambandhapradhānaḥ | evaṃ gavādiśabdā jātyabhidhāyino'pi tadvatpradhānāḥ | yathā ca rājapuruṣādayaḥ śabdāḥ sambandhopādhimarthaṃ sakṛdevābhidhānam | evaṃ darśanabhedena padārthadvayaṃ vibhaktam || 356 ||
keṣāñcittu śuddhaiva jāti śabdavācyeti jātipadārthapakṣe, śuddhaṃ ca dravyaṃ śabdavācyamiti dravyapadārthapakṣa itīdamaparaṃ pakṣadvayamityāha-- atyantabhinnayoreva jātidravyābhidhāyinoḥ | avācyasyolapakāritva āśrite tūbhayārthatā || 357 ||
kevalajātyabhidhāyī śabdo'nya eva | anyaśca kevaladvyābhidhāyī | ubhayatrāpi cānabhidhīyamānā jātirdravyaṃ vā yathāyogamādhārabhedaprakalpena svagataliṅgasaṅkhyādidharmaprakalpena copakarotīti bhagavataḥ pāṇinerācāryasyāyaṃ pakṣaḥ sarvapaścānnirdiṣṭaḥ | tathā ca viṣayabhedena kvacijjātipadārthatā madrahradādisiddhyarthamāśritā | kvacid dravyapadārthatā dadhyukādisiddhyarthamāśritā | ata eva "jātyākhyāyāṃ"  "sarūpāṇām" iti ca yogadvamārabdhavānācāryaḥ || 357 ||
tadevaṃ prasaṅgād darśanabhedopakṣepaḥ | prakṛtamupasaṃharati-- āśrite tvāśrayakṛtaṃ bhedamabhyupagacchatā | punaścāpyekaśabdatvaṃ jātiśabde'nuvarṇitam || 358 ||
vyaktiviśeṣāśritāyāṃ jātau śabdenābhidhoyamānāyāṃ saṃnihitāśrayanibandhanaṃ śabdasaṃskāranimittaṃ liṅgavacanabhedamaṅgīkurvatā prayojakasya śabdārthasyābhedādekaśabdatvaṃ jātipadārthavāde'tra pūrvasmin pakṣe bhāṣyakāreṇa `yadi tasyāpi vacanāni nācanikānya hamapyevaṃ vakṣye bahuṣu yo'rtho vartate tatra bahuvacanam' iti bruvatā varṇitamabhihitam| tathā caikaśeṣaḥ pratyākhyāyate | prādhānyena jātiḥ śabdenābhidhīyata iti siddha ekastadabhidhāyī śabdo vyaktibhede'pi | ye tu sambandhino jāteste bhedanibandhanaṃ saṃskāraṃ śabdasyaikasya nirvarttayanti | dvitīyasminnapi pakṣe'tra `guṇavacanavadāśrayato liṅgavacanāni' iti guṇabhūtasyābhidhīyamānasyāpi dravyasya śabdabhedaprayojakatvābhāvāt tadevaikaśabdatvamupapāditam | sambandhino hi jāteḥ sāmarthyād vā sannihitā nimittarūpācchuritā vopādīyanta iti parihāradvayatātparyaṃ vyākhtātam || 358 ||
tadevaṃ vṛttivicāraprasaṅgātaṃ guṇavacanānāṃ śabdānāmāśrayato liṅgavacanasiddhivicāraṃ bhāṣyapradeśānuvādena yathāyathaṃ parisamāpyopamānasamāsavicārāyopakramate | tatra prathamaṃ tāvadupamānalakṣaṇopayogi bhāṣyam--`mānaṃ hi nāmānirjñātajñānārthamupādīyate | anirjñātamarthaṃ jñāsyāmi' iti | etad vyācaṣṭe-- anirjñātasya nirjñānaṃ yena tanmānamucyate | prasthādi tena meyātmā sākalyenāvadhāryate || 359 ||
mīyate paricchidyate yena tanmānamiti sāmānyenāvadhāritasya padārthasya niścayena viśeṣarūpeṇāvadhāraṇanibandhanaṃ sākalyena paricchedakaṃ prasthaḥ khārī āḍhakamityādi mānaṃ kathyate | etacca mānasāmānyalakṣaṇamiti | prasthādītyādigrahaṇāt pramāṇonmānādayo'pi gṛhyante | mānasya hyutpraparibhirviśeṣaṇam | tatra prasthādi parimāṇam, diṣṭyādi pramāṇam, palādyunmānam || 359 ||
mānasamīpamupamānaṃ vyākhyātumāha-- anirjñātaṃ prasiddhena yena taddharma gamyate | sākalyenāparijñānādupamānaṃ taducyate || 360 ||
prasiddhasādharmyāt sādhyasādhanamupamānam | tathā hyaprasiddhamanirjñātaṃ gavayādi prasiddhena gavā sādṛśyastaddharma tasyeva dharmo yasya tadiveti paricchidyate | sādṛśyamātreṇa paricchedo nārohapariṇāhataḥ sākalyena viśeṣātmanāpi | ata eva sādṛśyaṃ pratyakṣeṇa sphuṭamatrāvadhāryata iti tadapekṣopamānasyeti nedaṃ mānam, apitu tasya samīpam, kiñcidrūpatayā paricchedāt | ata evopamānasya prāmāṇye'pi vivadante kila | pratyāyitārthakaṃ vākyameva pramāṇam | sādṛśyakathanaṃ tūpāya iti | upamīyate'neneti ca karaṇavyutpattyā sadṛśajñānamupamānam | sākṣāt tenopameyaparicchedāt | saṃjñāsaṃjñisambandhapratipattiḥ phalaṃ keṣāñcit | anyeṣāmanena sadṛśī madīyā gauriti phalam | gavādistūpamānaṃ paramparayopayogād vyavahriyate, cakṣurādīva pramāṇaśabdena || 360 ||
evamupamāne vyākhyāte sāmarthyādupameyamapi vyākhyātaṃ bhavati, upamitikriyāyā upameyaviṣayatvāt | tataśca sāmānyadharmavyākhyānopakramaṃ sūtrārthaṃ vyācaṣṭe-- dvayoḥ samāno yo dharma uramānopameyayoḥ | samāsa upamānānāṃ śabdaistadabhidhāyibhiḥ || 361 ||
yena nimittenopamānopameyabhāvo'rthayorasāvavaśyasannidhiratra dharmaḥ sādṛśyaṃ sāmānyamucyate | dvivṛttitvāt sāmānyaṃ bruvanti sāmānyavacanāḥ | taiḥ śabdairūpamānavacanānāṃ samāsa iti sūtrārthaḥ | śastrīśyāmā | śarakāṇḍagauriti || 361 ||
nanu cātra śyāmatvādiguṇaḥ pratyāśrayasamavetatvād bhinna eveti kathaṃ sāmānyamityāśaṅkyāha-- ādhārabhedād bhedo yaḥ śyāmatve so'vivakṣitaḥ | guṇo'sāvāśritaikatvo bhinnādhāraḥ pratīyate || 362 ||
āśrayabhedācchyāmatvāguṇasya yo bhedaḥ, so'tra sāmānyavacanairiti vadato nābhidhitsitaḥ | āśrayaviśeṣasamaveto'pyapekṣitamekatvaṃ yena sa tathābhūtaḥ sāmānyavacanasāmarthyādevāvagamyate guṇaḥ | bhinnāśrayatve'pi hi guṇasyānvayi rūpamastyeva | yadvaśācchyāma ityabhinnābhidhānapratyayasambhavaḥ | na cātrābheda eva vivakṣitaḥ || 362 ||
api tu-- guṇayorniyato bhedaḥ guṇajātestathaikatā | ekatve'tyantabhede vā noramānasya sambhavaḥ || 363 ||
atyantaikatve bhedādhiṣṭhānasya sādṛśyasyābhāvānnopamānopameyabhāvaḥ | na hi bhavati gauriva gauriti | nātyantabhede'nvayino rūpasyābhāve himavāniva loṣṭa ityupamāsti | tasmād bhedābhedavimarśenopamāyāmādhārabhedād bhedaṃ svālakṣaṇyenānvayirūpavaśena cābhedamāśritya guṇo'tra savyāpāraḥ | evaṃvidha eva cārthātmā śabdavācyaḥ | na hi śabdāḥ svālakṣaṇyena bhedamarthānāmāvedayante | sāmānya eva sambandhagrahaṇāt || 363 ||
mā bhūdatyantabhede upamā | abhede tu kathaṃ na bhavati | guṇo hyeko dvayorupamānopameyabhāvaṃ vartayatyevetyāśaṅkyāha-- jātimātravyapekṣāyāmupamārtho na kaścana | śyāmatvamekaṃ guṇayorubhayorapi vartate || 364 ||
anāśritādhārabhedasya śyāmatāmātrasya vivakṣāyāṃ śastrīdevadattayoḥ śyāmaguṇasamavetamekaṃ śyāmatvaṃ sāmānyamityeva vacanavyaktiḥ | tathā ca sādṛśyena paricchedābhāvaḥ || 364 ||
tathāhi-- yenaiva hetunā śyāmā śastrī tatra pravartate(pratīyate) | sa heturdevadattāyāḥ pratyaye na viśiṣyate || 365 ||
yenaiva abhinnasāmānyānugatena śyāmaguṇena samavetena śastrī śyāmeti samadhigamyate | tenaiva cābhinnasāmānyādhāreṇa guṇena devadattāpi śyāmeti pratyayamupārohatītyubhayoḥ śyāmatvamekamityeva pratītirnopamārthaḥ kaścidatra || 365 ||
tasmāt, āśrayād yo guṇe bhedo jāteryā cāviśiṣṭatā | tābhyāmubhābhyāṃ dravyātmā savyāpāraḥ pratīyate || 366 ||
ādhārabhedanimitto yo guṇe viveko'nvāyirūpahetukaścāvivekastābhyāṃ gaṇagatābhyāṃ bhedābhedābhyāṃ kāraṇabhūtābhyāṃ dravyasvabhāva upamānākhyaḥ paricchedakaraṇe upameyasya vyāpṛto'vadhāryate | tataścopamānopameyapraklṛptau tayorupamānopameyalakṣaṇaḥ sambandho'vatiṣṭhate || 366 ||
nanu bhedābhedau viruddhau kathamekatra vyāpṛtau syātāmityāśaṅkyāha-- so'yamekatvanānātve vyavahāraḥ samāśritaḥ | bhedābhedavimarśena vyatikīrṇena vartate || 367 ||
so'yamityanubhavasiddhatvenāpratyākhyeyatvamāha kila | bhedābhedāvayamāśritaḥ sādṛśyavyavahāraḥ saṅkīrṇenaikatvanānātvarūpeṇa hetunāvatiṣṭhamāno buddhāvupārohatīti ko viśeṣaḥ | tathāhyatyantābhede sa evāyamiti buddhiḥ | atyantabhede tvanyadevedamiti | sadṛśa iti tu buddhirbhedābhedobhayarūpasambhinnā jāyate | tathā ca jātisamuddeśe'bhihitam-- "sakṛtatpravṛttāvekatvāmāvṛttau sadṛśātmatām | bhinnātmikānāṃ vyaktīnāṃ bhedāpohāt prapadyate ||"iti || 367 ||
etadeva vyatirekamukhenopapādayati-- śyāmetyevābhidhīyate jātimātre vivakṣite | śastryādīnāmupādāne tatra nāsti prayojanam || 368 ||
śyāmatvasāmānyanugatasya guṇamātrasyādhāraviśeṣaṇatve'bhidhitsite śyāmeyaṃ devadattetyeva vaktavyaṃ syād, etāvatāviśiṣṭajātīyena sambandhasya pratipādanāt | tatrakimarthaṃ śastrīvetyucyate | aviśiṣṭaguṇayogasya gumapadādeva pratīterna kañcanātiśayamupamānaśabdāḥ pratyāyayantīti niṣprayojanameṣāmupādānam || 368 ||
nanvevaṃ bhedābhedavimarśenopamānopameyabhāve'tiprasaṅgaḥ | tathāhi--śyāmaguṇaḥ sakalāśrayavartyapyādhārabhedād bhinno jātyekatvāccaika iti kathaṃ śastryevopamānamityāśahkya svālakṣaṇyena guṇayorupamāviṣayayostāvad viśeṣamāha-- aśabdavācyo yo bhedaḥ śyāmamātre na vartate | śyāmeṣu keṣucid vṛttiryasyaso'tra vyapekṣyate || 369 ||
pratyādhāraṃ sūkṣmāṇāṃ bhedānāmasādharaṇaḥ - bhedānāmādhāraḥ svavācakāsambhavādasaṃvijñānapadaḥ śyāmaguṇaviśeṣo vācakābhāve'pi vācyānapāyādasti sa sarvasminnananvayī kvacideva vartamāno'sminnupamānopameyasambandhe vyapekṣyate-savyāpāratvenāśrīyate | tathāhi śastrīśyāmeti vṛttipadādevopamānopameyayoḥ śyāmaguṇo vilakṣaṇaḥ pratīyate | yo'nyatrāsambhavīti nātiprasaṅgaḥ | itthaṃ cādhārabhedādanyo'pi kayācit svarūpapratipattyānavasitavivekatvād guṇa ena sāmānyaṃ bhedābhedarūpābhyāmaupamyamavasthāpayatītyuktaṃ bhavatīti || 369 ||
guṇajāterapi na sarvasyā atra vyāpāra ityāha-- śyāmeṣu keṣucit kiñcit kiñcit sarvatra vartate | sāmānyaṃ kaścidekasmin śyāme bhedo vyavasthitaḥ || 370 ||
kiñcidaparasāmānyaṃ keṣucicchyāmaguṇeṣu vartate tadupamāyāṃ savyāpāram | kiñcit tu sarvatra vartate mahāsāmānyam | tadaviśeṣādupamānimittaṃ na bhavati | kaścit tu śyāme guṇe pratiniyate bhedo viśeṣo vartate | so'pyatiśayaprakhyāpanāyopamānanimittaṃ bhavatyeva | tadyathā--candramasaḥ kāntiviśeṣaḥ kanyāvadanasyopamānimittamatiśayādhyāropāt | utkṛṣṭaguṇena hi nyūnaguṇasyopamānādutkarṣasamāropāt praśaṃsājāyate | pūrvaṃ tu niratiśayo bhedo nopamānāṅgamityuktam || 370 ||
guṇasāmānyavyatirekeṇāparā jātiratra nāvadhāryata ityāśaṅkyā tāmupapādayitumāha-- tathāhi sati saurabhye bhedo jātyutpalādiṣu | gandhānāṃ sati bhede tu sādṛśyamupalabhyate || 371 ||
jātyutpalādigandhānāṃ gandhatvamahāsāmānyavyatirekeṇa saurabhye śobhanāmodatvalakṣaṇe'parasāmānye sati bhedo'vadhāryate | yeṣāṃ saurabhyaṃ nāsti, tato vyatireko lakṣyate | tathāhyutpalagandhamāghrāyā santamase'pi pratyabhijānātyutpalamidamiti | evaṃ jñātigandhādyapi | tataśca surabhitvamaparasāmānyamādhāraviśeṣaniyatamastīti niścayo yatsambandhāt surabhīṇi sugandhīnīmāni dravyāṇīti nirūpaṇā | satyapi caivaṃ saurabhyeṇa gandhānāṃ viśeṣe keṣāñcit sādṛśyamapyasti | tathāhi--gandhayuktadravyairnakhaśaileyādibhirgandhadravyayuktairna śaileyādibhiravāntarabhedabhinnasurabhigandhairapi kayācit svabhāvapratyāsattyā padmādisurabhisadṛśagandhaṃ dravyāntaraṃ nirvartyate, padmagandhi kiñjalkagandhi mālatīgandhi ityādi | evaṃ gandhavadrūpasyāpyavāntarajātibhedo nyāyya iti śyāmeṣu keṣucit vartamānaṃ siddhaṃ pratiniyataguṇavṛttyaparasāmānyamiti || 371 ||
guṇānāṃ pratiniyamaḥ kiṃkṛta ityāha-- guṇānāmāśrayād bhedaḥ svato vāryanugamyate | anirdeśyād viśeṣād vā saṅkarād‌vā guṇāntaraiḥ || 372 ||
svakāraṇādāsāditabhedād dravyalakṣaṇādādhārāt kaścid guṇānāṃ viśeṣaḥ | tadyathā--utpalamālādigatasya śyāmatvasya | tathā cātra svabhāvasāmyādupamāpravṛttiḥ-- "rolambagaralavyālatamālaśyāmalaṃ nabhaḥ | nabhonirmalanistriṃśavyagrapāṇaya āhave ||" iti | ekajātīyādhārasamavāye'pi kaścit svarūpādecintyaivabhavād guṇānāṃ viśiṣṭānāmevotpatterviśeṣo'dyakṣyata eva dhūsaratvādiḥ | kaścit punarasaṃvijñānapadaḥ kāraṇamātrādanutpannaḥ kālaparivāsahetuko viśeṣo guṇānām | tadyathā--surādīnāṃ pariṇāmaviśeṣāsādanena rasagandhavaicitryotpattiḥ | tathāhi tatra sāmagrayā khaṇḍaśaḥ kāryānutpādāt sāmagrayantargatāt kāraṇādayamatiśaya iti nirdeṣṭuṃ na śakyate | dravyāntaragataguṇasammiśraṇād vā viśeṣo guṇānām | tadyathā--sahakāragandhādhivāsasyāsavasya mālatīkusumādhivāsitasya ca tailasya | tadevamupāttabhedānāṃ guṇānāṃ kayācit pratyāsattyā keṣāñcidaparasāmānyasadbhāve sāmānyavacanenoramānavacanasya samāsasiddhiḥ || 372 ||
na ca niyogato guṇānāṃ sāmyamevepamāhetuḥ | apitūtkṛṣṭaguṇamupamānāmityāha-- upamānaṃ prasiddhatvāt sarvatra vyatiricyate | upameyatvamādhikye sāmye vā na nivartate || 373 ||
vyatireko'trādhikyaṃ vivakṣitam, tenādikaguṇamupamānamityarthaḥ | taccādhikyaṃ vāstavena rūpeṇa bhavatu mā vā bhūt | kintu prasiddhatvāt pratītatvād jñāpakatvenopameyaṃ pratyāśrīyamāṇaṃ prasiddhameva nyāyyamiti tad‌guṇasyotkarṣaḥ prasiddhataiva| tathā ca nyūnaguṇamapi śrṛṅgārarasaparipoṣaṇaparatayā nārīmukhaṃ śaśibimbasyopamānatvena nirdiśanti | kāmināṃ hi preyasīmukhamutkṛṣṭaguṇatvena prasiddham | yathā-- "īrṣyāvaśena kaluṣatvamupāgatasya dūrānmukhasya tava sundarī ! sāmyametya | cetaḥpraharṣabharapūritapūrṇadehaḥ svāṅgeṣvapi prasabhamadya na māti candraḥ || " itthañca kṛtvā paripūrṇaguṇena nyūnaguṇamupamīyata iti yathāprasiddhi paripūrṇaguṇatā vyākhyeyā | ata evāha--sarvatreti | na kevalaṃ vastuto yatrotkṛṣṭo guṇastadupamānaṃ yāvannyūnaguṇamapi svaprasiddhyāśrayeṇopamānaṃ vyatiricyate guṇādhikyena vyavatiṣṭhate | upameyabhāvastu guṇasya vastuta ādhikye'tireke sāmye tulyatve vā na nivartate nāpaiti | upamānaṃ niyogato'dhikaguṇameva vivakṣitam | upameye tvaniyama ityarthaḥ || 373|| idānīṃ prakārāntareṇopamānaṃ lakṣayitu mānalakṣaṇabhāṣyamanyathā vyācaṣṭe-- anyaistu mānaṃ jātyādi bhedyasyārthasya varṇyate | anirjñātasvarūpo hi jñeyo'rthastena mīyate || 374 ||
bhedyasyāvacchedyasya dravyasyopādhivivaktasya pratītyanupārohāt pratīyate jātiguṇakriyāḥ samāśrīyamāṇā mānavyapadeśamāsādayanti || 374 ||
mitastu svena mānena prasiddho yo guṇāśrayaḥ | aiśrayāntaramānāya svadharmeṇa pravartate || 375 ||
rūpāntareṇa saṃsparśo rūpāntaravatāṃ satām | bhinnena yasya bhedyānāmupamānaṃ taducyate || 376 ||
svenātmīyena jātyādimānena paricchinno yo guṇaviśeṣādhāraḥ prasiddhaḥ--pratītaḥ so'pratītaguṇāntaraprajñāpanāya svasamavetenaiva guṇena yadā vyāpriyate, tadā tena rūpāntareṇa bhinnena rūpāntaravatā bhinnānāmari bhedyānāṃ--paricchedyānāṃ paricchedakaṃ tadupamānamucyate | tatra saṃsparśaḥ sambandho'tyantabhinnānāṃ nopapadyata ityarthādanvayidharmākṣepaḥ | tataśca bhedābhedavimarśenaitadapyupamānam | sādṛśyamātreṇa ca paricchedānnātyantāya mānamupamānamiti lakṣaṇamavasthāpitam | tatra śastrīdevadattayorguṇaḥ śyāmatvamupamānopameyabhāvanibandhanaṃ śastrīśyāmeti || 375, 376 ||
yadā tu śyāmatvāmidamanena sadṛśamityucyate tadā-- dharmaḥ samānaḥ śyāmādirupamānopameyayoḥ | āśrīyamāṇaprādhānyo dharmeṇānyena bhidyate || 377 ||
upamānopameyabhāvavyavasthāpako yaḥ śyāmādirdharmaḥ sa yadopakāritvavyudāsenāśrayabhinnaḥ prādānyenopameyatayopādīyate, tadādravyāyamāṇatvāt tasyāpareṇa svagatena dharmeṇa viśeṣyamāmatvamityanyo dharmo'tropamānopameyabhāvanibandhanam || 377 ||
etadevodāharati-- śastrīkumāryoḥ sadṛśaḥ śyāma ityevamāśrite | vyapadeśyamaneneti nimittaṃ guṇayoḥ sthitam || 378 ||
anena karaṇabhūtena dharmeṇa dīptyādinā śyāmaguṇagatena tulyo'yaṃ śyāmaguṇa iti nirūpaṇīyam | tatrāpi ca śyāmaguṇayorayaṃ dīptyākhyo dharmaḥ samāna iti prādhānye dharmasya dharmāntaramupamāyāṃ savyāpāramanveṣyamityanavasthaivātra brahmakāṇḍe pratipāditā-- "sāmānyamāśritaṃ yadyadupamānopameyayoḥ | tasya tasyopamāneṣu dharmo'nyo vyatiricyate ||" iti || 378 ||
yāvaccātra vivakṣā tāvadaparyavasānā dharmāṇāṃ vivakṣā, virāme tu viratiḥ, etaccopamānamupameyād bhedena yadā vivakṣyate, tadopamānopameyabhāvaḥ śābda ityāha-- yadā nimittaistadvanto gacchantīva tadātmatām | bhedāśrayaṃ tadākhyānamupamānopameyayoḥ || 379 ||
upamānopameyabhāve yannimittaṃ guṇaḥ śyāmādistena yadā tau nimittināvupamānopameyāvaikātmyamiva pratipadyate guṇaguṇinorabhedopacārāt, tadā bhedādhīno vyapadeśo vivekenopamānasyopameyasya ca | tathā ca tatropamānopameyabhāvalakṣaṇasambandhadyotakamivādipadamupādīyata iti paripūrṇeyamupamā | devadattā śastrī yathā śyāmā | gauriva gavayaḥ | śailā iva valāhakā iti | atra hyupamānopameyabhāvasambandhahetorguṇasya tadvatā'bhedena nirdeśe sambandhaścābhihita iti prathamā | abhihitaḥ--so'rtho'ntarbhūtaḥ prātipadikārthaḥ sampanna iti nyāyāt tadvācikāyā vibhakterabhāvāt prathamāntayoḥ samanvayo na syāditi dyotakamivādyupādīyate samanvayārthamityupamānopameyatadbhāvadyotakapadasādhāraṇadharmavācakapadaprayogāt paripūrṇatvam || 379 ||
yadā tu sādṛśyahetuko'bhedādhyāropaḥ, tadopamānopameyabhāvasya garbhīkāra ityāha-- tattvāsaṅgavivakṣāyāṃ yeṣu bhedo nivartate | luptopamāni tānyāhustaddharmeṇa samāśrayāt || 380 ||
upamānopameyayostattvāsaṅgo'bhedādhyāropo yadā vivakṣyate, tadā bhedasya nivṛttatvāt tadadhīna upamānopameyabhāvo'pi tirodhīyate | gaurbāhīkaḥ, siṃho māṇavaka iti | parārthe śabdaprayogānyathānupapattyā cātra kāryāt kāraṇānumānena yāskaprabhṛtaya ācāryāḥ samānadharmāntarbhāvanena luptopamānīmānyupamānānyācakṣate | luptā sākṣādanavadhāryamāṇā upamā yeṣām | taddharmeṇa samāśrayāditi | tena samānena dharmeṇa garbhīkṛtena satā upamānaśabdenopameyasya parighahādityarthaḥ || 380 ||
evañca kāryasya niyatakāraṇapūrvakatvamuktam | `anyaistu mānaṃ jātyādītyanena prakāreṇa yannātyantāya mimīte tadupamānam' iti bhāṣyaṃ tātparyeṇa vyācaṣṭe-- śastryāṃ prasiddhaṃ śyāmatvaṃ mānaṃ sā tena mīyate | anyāśyāmātu tadrūpā (tvatadrūpā) tenātyantaṃ na mīyate || 381 ||
sākalyena paricchedakaṃ mānam | tacca śastrīgataṃ śyāmatvam | taddhi tatra prasiddhaṃ paricchedakam | anyā tu devadattā śyāmāpi na prasiddheti tena śyāmatvena karaṇabhūtena paricchidyate | evamapi paricchidyamānā nātyarthaṃ sarvataḥ parimīyate | nahi dharmasāmānyānugamamātrāt sarvātmanārtho'vadhārayituṃ pāryate || 381 ||
tadevaṃ śastrīgatena śyāmatvena devadattā yadā nātyantāya paricchidyate, tadā ntyantāya mānamupamānaṃ śastrī sampadyata ityāha-- śastrīṃ svena guṇenāto mimānāmāśrayamāntaram | asamāptaguṇaṃ siddherupamānaṃ pracakṣate || 382 ||
nijena samāptakālena śyāmaguṇenāsamāptaguṇamādhārāntaraṃ devadattālakṣaṇaṃ paricchindatīṃ śastrīmupamānamāhuḥ--siddheriti | paripūrṇaguṇatvādityarthaḥ || 382 ||
evaṃ prakāradvayenopamānopameyau vyākhyāya sāmānyavacanatvaṃ vicāryate | tathā hi nimittābhedāpannasya nimittino'bhidhānādupamānagataṃ vā tadabhedāpannaṃ nimittamucyate, tadupameyagataṃ vā, na tūbhayagataṃ sakṛdabhidhātuṃ śakyata ityananvayāt kathaṃ sāmānyavavacanatvamityāśaṅkyāha-- upameye sthito dharmaḥ śruto'nyatrānumīyate | śruto'thavopamānastha upameye'numīyate || 383 ||
iha sādhāraṇadharmaprayukta upamānopameyabhāvaḥ | tatra ca yugapadubhayagatatvena sādhāraṇadharmasyābhidhānaṃ na sambhavatīti śastrīśyāmā devadattetyukte śrutenaiva śyāmatvena samanvayādaśrutakalpanāyogādekatropakṣaye'pi śabdasyārthāntare'pyanumānād guṇasambandhāvasāya iti yo dṛṣṭaḥ samāno gumastasyaikataropakṣaye'pyabhidhāne sāmānyavacanatvopapattiḥ || 383 ||
tatropameye śruternidarśanamāha-- adhīyate brāhmaṇavat kṣatriyā dṛśyate | upameyasya bhinnatvād vacanaṃ kṣatriyāśrayam || 384 ||
upameyānāṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ bahutvād bahuvacanamatra śrūyamāṇamadhyayanasya sādhāraṇasya dharmasyopameyagatatvamāvedayate | sāmarthyāt punarupamānairbrāhmaṇairasya sambandhaḥ pratīyate | upamānasya punarupakāritvāt tadgataḥ śrato dharma upameye niyogato'vagantavya iti na tatrodāhṛtam || 384 ||
itthaṃ cobhayagatatvenānabhidhāne'pi sāmānyavacanatvamupapadyata ityāha-- sādhāraṇaṃ bruvan dharmaṃ kvacideva vyavasthitam | sāmānyavacanaḥ śabda iti sūtre'padiśyate || 385 ||
anyataragatatvenāpi śabdenābhidhīyamāno dharmo vāstavena rūpeṇa bhedāparamarśāt sāmānyamiti tamabhidadhad bhavati sāmānyavacanaḥ śabdaḥ | nahi yataḥ śabdo vak‌tyubhayagatatvenātaḥ sādhāraṇo dharmo bhavati | viśeṣasya brāhmaṇādeḥ śabdena sāmānyenābhidhāne'pi sādhāraṇatvābhāvāt | tasmād vāstavena rūpeṇa sādhāraṇaṃ śyāmatvasāmānyamekagatatvenāpyabhidhīyamānamanyatrānumānāt sādhāraṇamevābhihitaṃ bhavati || 385 ||
tadevaṃ guṇajātau vṛttaḥ sāmānyavacanaḥ | yadāpi guṇaḥ śyāmādistatrāpi vartamānaḥ śyāmādiḥ śabdaḥ sāmānyavacana evetyāha-- nābhedena na bhedena guṇo dviṣṭho'bhidhīyate | bhinnayordharmayorekaḥ śrūyate'nyaḥ pratīyate || 386 ||
dvayorupamānopameyayorvartamāno guṇaḥ śyāmalakṣaṇo nābhedenānvayirūpāveśenābhidhīyate śabdena | yasmādupamānenāvacchidyate upameyena vā | tathā caikagatatvena viśiṣṭa iti nābhedenābhidhānam, nāpi sahajena vyāvṛttenātmanābhidhīyate | na hi svālakṣaṇyena bhedaṃ śabdāḥ spṛśanti, sāmānyavacanatvāt | nāpi vyāvṛttenātmanā upamāyāmupayogaḥ | tasmācchyāmaśabdeva tāvad guṇo'viśeṣeṇa kathyate, anyatarasambandhād avacchidyamāno'pi sāmarthyāditaragatatvenāvadhāryata iti bhavati tacchabdaḥ sāmānyavacanaḥ || 386 ||
evaṃ tātparyato bhāṣyaṃ vyākhyāya pāṭhapūrvakaṃ sākṣād vyācaṣṭe-- nātyantāya mimīte yat sāmānye samavasthitam | sādṛśyādupameyārthaḥ samīpe parikalpyate || 387 ||
yadatyantāya meyaśarīraṃ paricchinatti tanmānaṃ prasthādi jātyādi vā vyākhyātām | tatsamīpe yat tadupamānam, atra ca tadityanena prajñāpanīyatvenādhikṛtatvāt pradhānamupameyaṃ pratyavamṛśyate | tasyopameyasya yat samīpe, tadupamānam | sāmīpyaṃ ca dharmapratyāsattikṛtam | tathā ca sādṛśyena paricchedakatvāt sāmānye sādhāraṇe dharme sambandhahetāvavasthitaṃ tadapekṣamupamānaṃ nātyarthaṃ paricchinatti | yo hi sādhāraṇo dharmastāvatopameyasyātra paricchedo vidhīyate upamānena, na tvanyena dharmeṇa | śastryā hi śyāmaguṇatayāvacchidyate devadattā, na tu saṃstyānādirūpeṇetyaparipūrṇamidaṃ mānamupameyasamīpavati || 387 ||
tatsamīpa ityasya bhāṣyasya vyākhyānāntaramāha-- mānaṃ prati samīpaṃ vā sādṛśyena pratīyate | paricchedāddhi sādṛśyamiha mānopamānayoḥ || 388 ||
iha yadā pradhānānugrahāya guṇo vyāpriyate, tadāsyopasarjanatvāt parāmarśo mā bhūt, iha tu meyaṃ prati paricchedopayogyapi mānaṃ svarūpe lakṣyamāṇe pradhānamiti tadeva tacchabdena parāmṛśyate | tathā ca mānasya yatsamīpaṃ tadupamānam | sāmīpyaṃ ca samānadharmayogāt | asti ceha sādṛśyaṃ paricchedahetutvaṃ nāma mānopamānayoḥ | ekamatyantāya paricchedakam | aparaṃ nātyantāyeti bhedaḥ || 388 ||
evamupamānalakṣaṇārthaṃ `mānaṃ hi nāmānirjñātajñānārthāmupādīyate--anirjñātamarthaṃ jñāsyāmīti | tatsamīpe yannātyantāya mimīte tadupamānam' iti bhāṣyaṃ vyākhyātam | ataḥ pūrvaṃ tūpamānalakṣaṇaprastāvahetuḥ praśnabhāṣyam,`kiṃ yadevopameyam, āhosvidanyadupamānamanyadupameyam' ityasti | tad vyācaṣṭe-- ekajātivyapekṣāyāṃ tadevetyavasīyate | bhedasyaiva vyapekṣāyāmanyadeveti gamyate || 389 ||
iha yathāpratyayamarthāvyavahāryatāmāpadyante | tatra yadopamānorameyayorabhinnamanvayirūpaṃ vyaktibhedatirodhānenaikaguṇajātyātmakamabhisaṃhitam, tadā tadekarūpādhyāsādanayorabhedo niścīyata iti tadevetyucyate | yadā tu nijo bhedo vyāvṛttirvyaktirūpanirūpaṇenābhisaṃhitā, tadārthāntaratvasyaiva prasiddhasyāvadhāraṇādanyadeveti bhaṇitiḥ | kimupamānatve'tyantābheda upayujyate, kiṃ vātyantabheda ityabhiprāyaḥ || 389 ||
nanu copamānamupameyamiti sādhanavibhāgānurodhī vyapadeśa evānayorbhedaṃ darśayati | karmakaraṇasādhanau hi pratyayau bhinnārthāviti kathamabhedāśaṅketi | etadabhyupagacchati-- karmatvaṃ karaṇatvaṃ ca bhedenaivāśritaṃ yataḥ | atyantaikatvaviṣayānna syāt tenātra saṃśayaḥ || 390 ||
pratyayābhyāṃ vibhāgena yasmāt karmatvaṃ karaṇatvaṃ copāttam, tasmādatra nirastāśeṣabhedanibandhanaṃ vāstavaṃ yadekatvaṃ tat saṃśayasya pakṣo viṣayo nopapadyata iti bhinnayoreva sāmānyadharmorādhikamekatvaṃ saṃśayaviṣayo na virudhyate || 390 ||
dṛśyate caivaṃvidhena bhinnānāmapi kālpanikenābhedena vyavahāra ityāha-- bhedena tulyarūpatvācchālīṃstāniti dṛśyate | jātyabhedāt sa evāyamiti bhinno'bhidhīyate || 391 ||
avadhṛtātmabhedā api śālayo rūpasāmānyāpahṛtabhedaiḥ pratyayairabhedenāvasāya ta eva bhujyanta iti vyapadiśyate | evam `tānyeva vāsāṃsi paridhīyanta' iti ca | etacca sādadṛśyaparyāyaṃ rūpasāmānyamabhedanibandhanamuktaṃ śāstre, `rūpasāmānyād vā' ityākaravārttike | tadevopapādayituṃ `tāneva śālīn bhuñjmahe ye madhurāyāṃ dṛṣṭāḥ' iti dṛṣṭāntitam | na kevalaṃ ca sādṛśyamātranimitto'bhedāvasāyo yāvajjātyabhedanibandhano'pi | tathā hyekasāmānyādhyāsitā vyaktayo'bhedena vyapadiśyante | `catvāro brāhmaṇā udakumbhānāhareyuḥ' ityādo | atra hi māṭharādibhede'pi brāhmaṇyenābheda upāttaḥ | evāmihāpyupamānopameyayoḥ sadṛśadharmanimittāyā pratyāsattyā tadgataikacātisamāveśanād vā'bhedasya yujyate saṃśayaviṣayatā || 391 ||
bhedasyāpi yujyata ityāha-- kathaṃ hyavayavo'nyasya syādanya it cocyate | atyantabhede nānātvaṃ yatra tattvaṃ na vidyate || 392 ||
halantācc ityatrāntaśabdāmavayavamāśritya hal ante yasyekaḥ tasmāditi vyākhyāyamāne coditamidam | `kathaṃ hi iko nāma hal antaḥ syādanyasyānyaḥ' iti | atra cāvayavāvayavinoranyatva evopapattirityatyantabhedo'yaṃ vivakṣitaḥ | tathā hyatyarthena yayorbhedo yatra na kathañcit tattvamabhedaḥ sambhavati | tasmin sati yannānātvamatyantaṃ tadabhisandhāyaitaduktamanyasyānya iti | ubhābhyāmanyaśabdābhyāmaikāntikamanyatvaṃ nirdiśati | avayavastvavayavinaḥ kathañcidananyaḥ, samavāyena tirohitabhedatvāt | varṇastu varṇāntarasyānārambhakatvāt sarvathaiva bhinno nāvayavo yujyate | tadevamatra yathākathañcidanantve'pyavayavasyātyantabhedabhiprāyamanupapattiruktā | evamihāpyupamānopameyayorjātyabhedād rūpasāmānyādvā kathañcidabhede'pi tadānādareṇātyantabhedamāśrityānyadeveti saṃśayaviṣayatā kathitā || 392 ||
tatrāvayavāvayavinorevābhedasambhavo bhinnayorapi, na tu varṇayoḥ parasparamanārambhakayorityāha-- abhedasya vivakṣāyāmekatvaṃ saṅghasaṅghinoḥ | saṅghinorna tvabhedo'sti tathānyatvamudāhṛtam || 393 ||
saṅgho'vayavī, saṅghino'vayavāḥ, teṣāṃ samāvāyādapoditabhedānāṃ yadā vivakṣā, tadā'bheda evābhimataḥ | saṅghaḥ samudāyo vā vanādiḥ | tadvantaḥ samudāyino vṛkṣādayaḥ, teṣāṃ samudāyena sahābhedena avyatireke'bhidhitsite vanaṃ vṛkṣā brāhmaṇāḥ saṅgha ityekatvamabhedo bhavati | tathāhi--vanādiśabdāḥ saṅghātmanā tān samudāyinaḥ pratipādayanti | vṛkṣādayastu jātibhedānurāgeṇa tānevetyasti bhinnanimittaprayuktayoḥ śabdayorekatra vṛttiḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyam | yadā tu bhedavivakṣātra, tadā vanādiśabdāḥ saṅghalakṣaṇadharmamātravacanā iti tadupajanitavyatirekāṇāṃ saṅghināmabhidhānam--vṛkṣāṇāṃ vanam, brāhmaṇānāṃ saṅgha iti | evaṃ saṅghasaṅghinorbhedābhedau | saṅghinoḥ--samudāyinostu na kadācidabhedo bhavati,asambandhāt | tathā hi śiṃśapāyāḥ palāśasya vā nābhedapratipattiḥ | māharasya kauṇḍinyasya ca | evaṃ varṇā api parasparamanārambhāt saṅghino'tyantabhinnāḥ paraspareṇābhedaṃ na yogyāḥ pratipattumityanyatvameva kathitam | tathā ca bhedābhedāvanyonyānuviddhau śuddhau ca sambhavata itīha śuddhau vihāyetarau vivakṣitāviti bhedāśrayaḥ pratyayabhedo'bhedāśrayaścaikatvena praśna upapadyata eva | athavopamānamupameyamiti yat prasiddhaṃ loke tat kimekamutānekamiti vicāraviṣayatvena prasiddhabhedānuvādaḥ || 393 ||
etadanantaram `kiñca bhoḥ' ityupakramyedaṃ bhāṣyam "yadi yadevopamānaṃ tadevopameyaṃ ka ihopamārtho gauriva gauḥ, athāpyanyadupamānamanyadupameyaṃ ka ihopamārtho gaurivāśvaḥ" iti || etat krameṇa vyācaṣṭe-- tatrābhinnavyapekṣāyāmupamārtho na vidyate | yo hi goriti vijñāne hetuḥ so'sti gavāntare || 394 ||
iha yena dharmeṇa yaḥ prasiddhaḥ, tenāprasiddhaṃ jñāpayannaupamyamanubhavati | abhinnasya tu sāmānyasyopamāhetutvenāpekṣāyāṃ na kiñcit phalamutpaśyāmaḥ | tathā hi--gauriva gauriti yadeva jātirūpamupamānāvasāye nibandhanam, tadevopameyābhimate'pītyajñātasyopameyasya jñāpanābhāvānnopamānopameyabhāvaḥ | evañca gogavayayorapyanvayidharmamātrāpekṣāyāṃ nopamārthaṃ ityuktaṃ bhavati || 394 ||
atyantabhede'pi nopamārthaṃ iti vivṛṇoti-- vyāvṛttānāṃ viśeṣāṇāṃ vyāpāre tu vivakṣite | na kaścidupakāro'sti buddherbuddhyantaraṃ prati || 395 ||
anvayinā dharmeṇānanugatānāmapyatyantavyāvṛttānāṃ bhedānāmapekṣaṇe nopakāraḥ kaścidupamānapratīterupameyapratītau dharmasāmānyamantareṇa samanvayābhāvād go'śvayoḥ || 395 ||
atra hi parihārabhāṣyam--`evaṃ tarhi yatra kiñcit sāmānyaṃ kaścicca viśeṣastatropamānopameyabhāvaḥ' iti | etad vyācaṣṭe-- kiñcid yatrāsti sāmānyaṃ yadi bhedāśca kecana | gotvaṃ goṣvasti sāmānyaṃ bhedāśca śabalādayaḥ || 396 ||
tatropamānopameyabhāva iti śeṣaḥ | tathā ca prāgeva vyākhyātam | evañca kṛtvā dvayorapi gavoḥ sāmānyaviśeṣāpekṣo bhavatyevopamānopameyabhāva ityāha-- tataśca śābaleya iva ca bāhuleya iti śābaleyatvādyavāntarajātibhinnayorapyekārthakāritvādinaikajātīyatvena pratyāsattau bhavatyevopamānopameyabhāva ityarthaḥ || 396 ||
yadvā yatra kiñcit sāmānyamatyādibhāṣyasyāyamākṣepaḥ--sarvatra padārtheṣu sāmānyaviśeṣayogādaupamyaṃ syādityātiprasaṅgo meruriva sarṣapa ityapi syāt, gauriva gauriti ceti ślokārdhasyārthaḥ | ata evaitaccodyapratisamādhānatvena vakṣyamāṇo'yaṃ grantha upapadyate | tathā hi--na mahāsāmānyamatra vivakṣitaṃ, kintarhi-- sāmānyaṃ śyāmatādyeva taddhi sādhāraṇaṃ dvayoḥ | tadeva siddhyasiddhibhyāṃ bheda ityapadiśte || 397 ||
`yatra kiñcit sāmānyam' ityatra bhāṣye sāmānyaśabdena na jātirabhidhitsitā, api tu tato'rthāntaraṃ śyāmatvādi | tacca dvayorupamānopameyayoranvayi sādhāraṇamiti sāmānyamucyate | tathā hyuttaratra bhāṣyamasti--`na cāvaśyaṃ sa eva sāmānyavacano yo bahūnāṃ sāmānyamāha so'pi sāmānyavacanaḥ' iti | evañca dvivṛttiḥ śyāmatvādiratra sāmānyamiti gamyate | tadeva ca sāmānyamapi vyāvṛtterapi bhāvād viśeṣa ityucyate `kaścicca viśeṣaḥ' ityatra bhāṣye | tathā hi--yathopamāne tatprasiddhaṃ na tathopameye, nyūnatvādityāsti bhedaḥ | evañca jāteranyat sādṛśyaṃ bhedābhedānusyūtamiha sāmānyaśabdena sādhāramaparyāyeṇa kathitamiti, yayoḥ sādhāraṇo dharmaḥ prasiddhāprasiddhadarśanaḥ, tayorupamānopameyabhāvastadupanibandhana ityuktaṃ bhavati | evañca kṛtvā sajātīyayorapi saṃsthānādidharmasādṛśyakṛtaḥ śābaleyabāhuleyayorupamānorameyabhāvo naikajātinibandhano dvayorgauriva gauriti || 397 ||
atraiva matāntaramāha-- śyāmatvameva sāmānyamanyeṣāmubhayoḥ sthitam | sampūrṇatvāt tadanyasmād viśeṣa iti gamyate || 398 ||
pūrvaṃ prasiddhyaprasiddhibhyāṃ bheda uktaḥ | idānīṃ sampūrṇāsampūrṇatayeti viśeṣaḥ | tathāhi--śyāmatvalakṣaṇo guṇa eva dvivṛttirāśrayabhedād bhinno'pi saukṣmyādalakṣitavivekaḥ sāmānyamityuktaḥ | sa evopamāne sarvātmanā parisamāptatvād upameye tu kenacidaṃśena nyūnatvādanāśrite'pyādhārabhedopādhau bhede viśeṣyamāṇo viśeṣa ityuktaḥ | tathāca bhedābhedābhyāmavadhāryamāṇo guṇa eva sādṛśyaṃ na tato'rthāntaram || 398 ||
yadvā jātirapyastu upamāyāṃ savyāpārā, na tvabhedenaivāvasīyamānā, kintu bhedenāpītyāha-- ākṛtau vāpi sāmānye kvacideva vyavasthitāḥ | śyāmādayo'vasīyante viśeṣāsta ihāśritāḥ || 399 ||
jātyekārthasamavāyino ye sūkṣmā viśeṣāḥ pratiniyate kvacideva jātyādhāre'vasthitāḥ, te jāterbhedahetavo yadā samāśrīyante, tadā tairviśiṣṭā jāti kvacideva samavetā savyāpārā bhavatyupamānopameyabhāvalakṣaṇe sambandhe | tathā hi--śastrīdevadattāgatayoḥ śyāmaguṇayoryā guṇajātiḥ, sāśrayaviśeṣagatakāntimattvādidharmaviśeṣairanujyamānā bhedānuvedhāt sādṛśyapratyayaṃ prasūyate | gauriva gorityatra vidyamāno hi viśeṣo jāterbhedakaḥ śabdānnāvadhāryata iti na bhavatyupamā | śastrīśyāmā devadattā, śābaleya iva bāhuleya ityādau tu guṇādhārabhedādevāvadhāryate viśeṣaḥ || 399 ||
itthaṃ bhāṣyagranthaṃ vyākhyāya piṇḍitārthamāha-- jāterabhede bhede vā sādṛśyaṃ tat pracakṣate | kaścit tadācidarthātmā tathābhūto'padiśyate || 400 ||
jāterabhede'nanyatve'pyekārthasamavetāviśeṣāhite ca bheda ityanantaroktārthānuvādaḥ | bhede veti `sāmānyaṃ śyāmatādyeve'ti pūrvoktārthānuvādaḥ | evaṃ yat sāmānyamuktaṃ tat sādṛśyamityāhuḥ | tena ca sādṛśyena kaścideva na sarvo'rthātmorameyastathābhūtaḥ sadṛśa iti kathyate nirūpyate cābhidhānasya nirūpaṇapūrvakatvāt | itthaṃ ca sattvajñeyatvādi na sādṛśyam, tataḥ sadṛśapratyayābhāvāditi sāmānyadharmayogādevaupamye nātiprasaṅgaḥ || 400 ||
idānīṃ sadṛśapratyayasya viṣayaṃ vyavasthāpayituṃ tatpratyanīkabhūtaṃ pratyayāntaramudāharati-- yatrārthe pratyayābhedo na kadācid vikalpate | avidyamānabhedatvāt sa eka iti gamyate || 401 ||
yasmin vastuni pratyasyākārābhedo na kadācidvikalpena bhedapratyayena saha paryāyaṃ nāpadyate, sadaivābhedākāreṇotpatteḥ, tadvastu dharmirūpamavalthānānātve'pi tatkṛtasya bhedasyāsaṃviditatvād vyavahāre pratibhātasya satkalpatvādavidyamānabhedameka iti pratyayaviṣayaḥ || 401 ||
pratiyabhijñāpratyayamudāharati-- yo'rtha āśritanānātvaḥ sa evetyapadiśyate | vyāpāraṃ jātibhāgasya tatrāpi pratijānate || 402 ||
prasiddhabhedo'pi yaḥ padārthaḥ sa eveti pratyabhijñāyate, tatra jātyaṃśasya vyāpāra ityāhuḥ | jātervyaktibhiraikātmyāpattau bhāgavācoyuktiḥ | evañca kevalāyā jāteḥ pratyabhijñāpratyaye vyāpāraḥ, na sadṛśapratyaye | yatra ca sādṛśyanibandhāt tattvasamāropāt pratyabhijñā, bhrāntirasau lūnapunarjātakeśeṣviva jātyāpāditā | bhedānāṃ tu tattvanibandhanaiva pratyabhijñā || 402 ||
vastuni hi saṃvidā bhedābhedasaṃsparśaḥ kathamityāha-- jātibhāgāśrayā prakhyā tatrābhinnā pravartate | vyaktibhāgāśrayā buddhistatra bhedena jāyate || 403 ||
jātyaṃśasya vyāpārādabhedenaikajātīyaḥ parāmṛśyate, gaurevāyamiti | vyaktirūpāśrayā tu tatra saṃvidbhe dopalakṣitā prabhavati || 403 ||
idānīṃ sadṛśapratyayaṃ lakṣayati-- anyatra vartamānaṃ sad bhedābhedasamanvitam | nimittaṃ punaranyatra nānātveneva gṛhyate || 404 ||
ādhāreṣu padanyāsaṃ kṛtvopaiti tadāśrayam | sa sādṛśyasya viṣaya ityanyairapadiśyate || 405 ||
nimittaṃ prakṛtatvāt sadṛśapratyayasya śyāmatvākhyamanyatrādhāre śastrīgate guṇe vartamānaṃ sad bhūya āśrayāntare devadattāguṇe vartamānaṃ nānātveneva bhedeneva paricchidyate, tenāśrayāntareṇāvacchedāt | abhedenāpi tu samanvayādivaśabdaḥ | ata eva bhedābhadasamanvitaṃ sāmānyaviśeṣarūpasambaddhimityarthaḥ | tadevaṃvidhanimittamādhāreṣu svāśrayeṣu guṇeṣu padanyāsaṃ vidhāya tadālambanaṃ sādṛśyapratyayamutpādya tasyaguṇasya ya ādhāro dravyaṃ tat prāpnoti, samavetasamavāyāt tatra sadṛśapratyayaṃ janayati | tathā ca sa guṇāśrayaḥ sādṛśyasya viṣayaḥ | tatra sādṛśyanimitta upamānopameyabhāva ityarthaḥ | itthaṃñcedaṃ sādṛśyaṃ bhedābhedasamanvayājjāteranyadabhedātmikāyāḥ | jātiścānyatra nānātvena na gṛhyate | api tvekatvenaiva | anena ca granthenaikīyamatena `yatra kiñcit sāmānyaṃ kaścit viśeṣaḥ' iti bhāṣyamanyathā vyākhyātam | tathā hi--pūrvaṃ yatrādhāre kiñcit sāmānyaṃ kaścit viśeṣastatropamānopameye bhavata iti bhavitṛbhyāṃ bhāvasyopalakṣaṇāt tatropamānopameyabhāva ityartho'bhīṣṭaḥ | iha tu yatra nimitte bhedābhedasamanvite sati sāmānyaviśeṣāvabhāsapratyayo dravye bhavati, tatra nimitte satyupamānopameye dve dravye bhavataḥ | tannimittarūpasya sādṛśyasya tatra pāramparyeṇa samavāyādityarthaḥ | atrāparaṃ bhāṣyam--`kiṃ vaktavyametat | nahi | kathamanucyamānaṃ gaṃsyate | mānaṃ hi nāma' ityādi | tat prāgeva sūtrārthaupayikatvenopamānalakṣaṇarūpaṃ vyākhyātam || 404, 405 ||
ato'nantaraṃ bhāṣyam--`kāmaṃ tarhyetenaiva hetunā yasya gavayo nirjñātaḥ gauranirjñātaḥ' tatkartavyaṃ syād gavaya iva gauriti | bāḍhaṃ kartavyami'tyanenopamānopameyayoravyavasthābhyupagatā | tāṃ nidarśanena vyutpādayitumāha-- parāpekṣe yathā bhāve kāraṇākhyā pravartate | tathānyādhigamāpekṣamupamānaṃ pracakṣate || 406 ||
kāryāpekṣaṃ kāraṇatvamityanyāpekṣatve'pi na kāryakāraṇabhāvasaṅkaraḥ | nahi yameva prati kāryaṃ tameva prati kāraṇam | evamaprasiddhamupameyaṃ prasiddhamupamānaṃ tadapekṣayā yadyapi vyavahriyate, tathāpi pirasiddhyaprasiddhyoḥ saṅkarābhāvānnopamānopameyabhāvaviparyāsa ityarthaḥ || 406 ||
atraiva nidarśanāntaram-- guruśiṣyapitāputrakriyākālādayo yathā | vyavahārāstathaupamyamapyapekṣānibandhanam || 407 ||
na gururgurvantarāpekṣayā | śiṣyo'pi na svaśiṣyāpekṣayā śiṣyaḥ | pitā na pitrantarāpekṣayā | putro'pi na svaputraṃ prati putraḥ | kriyā svāsādhānāpekṣayā sādhyā na hi kriyāntaraṃ prati | sādhanamapi na tu svasādhanāpekṣayaiva | yathoktaṃ-- "tatra yaṃ prati sādhyatvamasiddhā taṃ prati kriyā | siddhā tu yasmin sādhyatvaṃ na tameva punaḥ prati" || iti || prasiddhaparimāṇā kriyā paricchedyakriyāntaraṃ prati kālaḥ, paricchedakatvāt | na tu paricchedyāyā eva paricchedyā | ādigrahaṇāt viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvāderāpekṣikasya saṅagrahaḥ | evaṃ yasya gavayaḥ prasiddhastasyāsāvupamānaṃ vanecarasya, gauraprasiddha upameyaḥ | nāgarakasya tu viparyayaḥ | ata eva kāminaḥ śrṛṅgārarasaparipoṣaṇaparatayā nārīmukhamutkṛṣṭaguṇatvena prasiddhamiti śaśibimbasyopamānaṃ bhavatītyuktam || 407 ||
ataḥ paramidaṃ bhāṣyaṃ `kiṃ punarihodāharaṇam | śastrīśyāmā | kva punarayaṃ śyāmāśabdo vartate | śastryāmityāha | kenedānīṃ devadattābhidhīyate | samāsene'ti | etad vyācaṣṭe-- śyāmatvamupamāne ced vṛttaṃ vṛttau prayujyate | upameyaṃ samāsena bāhyaṃ tatrābhidhīyate || 408 ||
pakṣāntarasyāpi vakṣyamāṇatvāccedityasya pakṣasyābhyupagamaṃ dyotayati | upamāne śastryāṃ yadi śyāmatvaṃ vṛttau samāse sthitamabhyupagamyate, tadā vartipadayorupamānavṛttitvāt tato bāhyaṃ tābhyāmanupagṛhītamupameyaṃ samāsenābhidhīyata ityāyātam | tathācānyapadārthapradhāno'yaṃ samāsastatpuruṣo'pi | nahi tasyottarapadārthaprādhānyaniyamaḥ, nañsamāse pakṣatrayavicārānupapattiprasaṅgāt | na cārthādeśanaṃ vacanānusāri, lokaprasiddhārthasyānuvādāt | tathāceha samānādhikaraṇasamāsānurodhād vṛttau śastrīśabdasamānādhikaraṇatvenāpi śyāmāśabdasya prayoge bhavatyupameyasya sampratyaya ityanyapadārthapradhānatvena vyavasthā | yadyevamanenaiva nyāyena bahurvīhāvanyapadārthaprādhānyasiddheḥ kimanyapadārthagrahaṇena | satyam | kintu na sarvaṃ pratyākhyeyaṃ prayogānusāreṇetyantaraṅge svapadārthe sampratyayāśaṅkāpanodāya yuktamanyapadārthagrahaṇam | tatra śeṣādhikāravihitatvācca bahuvrīherna tenāsya bādhaḥ | anyathā bahuvrīhisaṃjñāyāṃ gumavacanasyā śyāmāśabdasya viśeṣaṇatvāt pūrvanipātaḥ syāt | klṛptavyavasthitavibhāṣāvijñānādapi parihriyate | svarastvabhinnaḥ, tatpuruṣe'pyatropamānāśraya eva pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaro bhavati | nanu ca bahuvrīhau śastrī śyāmā yasyetyevaṃ sambandhe na bhavedaupamyapratītiḥ | naitadasti | śastrī śyāmā yasyā devadattāyā iti sambandhasāmānye bahuvrīhiḥ | sāmānyaṃ ca viśeṣaniṣṭham | kaścātra sambandhaviśeṣa ityupamānopameyabhāva eva pratīyetānyasyāyogāt | tasmāccheṣavacanād bahuvrīherayaṃ na viṣayaḥ | atha `saṅkhyāsamānādhikaraṇanañsamāseṣu doṣaḥ' iti yadā śeṣavacanaṃ pratyākhyāyate, tadā katham | tadāpi `prākvaḍārāt paraṃ kāryam' ityatra darśane vacanasāmarthyādayaṃ tatpuruṣo bhavati | anavakāśo'yamiti parameveti niyamānupapattiḥ | yadāpi `prāk kaḍārādekā saṃjñe'ti darśanaṃ tadāpyanena viśeṣavidhinopamānāni sāmānyavacanaṃ ca viśeṣamāśritya pravṛtterupameyalakṣaṇānyathānupapattyā sādṛśyamantarbhāvyopameyamācaṣṭe, yathā śastrī śyāmā tathā devadatteti śastrīśyāmā kathyate | śastrīva śyāmā devadatteti vākye śyāmāśabdasyorameyābhyāṃ sambandhayogyatvādekataropakṣayatve taditaro vākyārthaḥ | samāse tu samānādhikaraṇaprastāvādupamāna eva sāmānyavacanaḥ sakṛduccarita ityupameyaḥ samāsārtho varṇyata iti viśiṣyavṛttāvityāha || 408 ||
ato'nantaramidaṃ bhāṣyaṃ `yadyevaṃ śastrīśyāmo devadatta iti kena ṭāpna śrūyate' iti | etad vivṛṇoti-- ṭābanta eva caitrādau śyāmāśabdastathā bhavet | sūtre ca prathamābhāvānna śyāmādyupasarjanam || 409 ||
śastryāṃ vartamānaḥ śyāmāśabdo guṇavacanānāmāśrayato liṅgavacanabhāvāt strīvṛttiṣṭābanta iti samāsavācyatve caitroderupameyasya śastrīśyāmā caitra iti syāt | sāmānyavacanairiti ca tṛtīyānirdeśāt prathamānirdiṣṭamityupasarjanasaṃjñā'bhāve hrasvatvamatra nāsti | upameyavṛttitve tu talliṅgaṃ sidhyati | ato'nantaraṃ bhāṣyam `upasarjanahrasvatvamatra bhaviṣyatī'ti tatra prathamānirdeśābhāve `ekavibhakti--'ityupasarjanatvaṃ syāt | anvarthatvena vā'pradhānatvāt | tathācānantaraṃ codyabhāṣyaṃ--`yadi tarhyupasarjanānyevañjātīyakāni bhavanti, tittirikalmāṣī, kumbhakapālalohinītyanupasarjanalakṣama īkāro na prāpnotīti | tadetad vyācaṣṭe athavaikavibhaktitvād guṇatvād vopasarjanam | naiva tittirikalmāṣyāmiṣṭaḥ strīpratyayo bhavet || 410 ||
pratiyoginaḥ padasya nānāvibhaktiyoge'pi yadabhinnavibhakti tadupasarjanamuktaṃ kauśāmbyādi | ihāpi samāse kartavyatvena viṣayabhūte yat prakriyāvākyaṃ, tatra pradhānamanyapadārthaṃ padaṃ nānākriyāveśādanekavibhaktīti tadapekṣayā guṇavacanaṃ bhavatyevaikavibhakti| pradhānasya nānākriyāveśe'pi hi na guṇaḥ svarūpādapaiti | tathāca `bahuvrīhāvanekavacanamupasarjanārthaṃ navaikavibhaktitvāditi pratyākhyātam | tatra ca pradhānasyānyapadārthasma padasya nānāvibhaktitvamāśrityaikavibhakti varttipadam | evamihāpi bhaviṣyatītyayastyekavibhaktitvādupasarjanatvam | anyatra tu samānādhikaraṇasamāse'niṣṭaprasaṅgo nāstyuttarapadārthaprādhānyāccottarapadārtho guṇaḥ | na caivaṃ laukike'rthe samāśrīyamāṇe saṃjñākaraṇamaphalam, pradhānasyāpi kasyacit pūrvanipātārthaṃ saṃjñāviṣayatvāt | tadyathā--puruṣavyāghraḥ, pācakavṛndārikā, pūrvakāyaḥ, ardhapippalīti | atra pūrvapadārthaḥ pradhānamiti samāsaśāstre prathamānirdeśādupasarjanasaṃjñā saphalā | viṣayabhedena ca kṛtrimākṛtrimayoḥ śāstre samāśrayaṇānnātra laukikamupasarjanamāśrīyate | tathāca pūrvanipātāvyavasthābhāvaḥ, rājño goḥ kṣīramiti samāsaśāstre dvayoḥ ṣaṣṭhīti prathamānirdeśādupasarjanatve'nvarthatvāśrayamekasyaiva tad‌vyavasthānam | evañca kauśāmbyādīnāṃ samāse parārthatvādevopasarjanatve siddhe'pyekavibhakteḥ kṛtrimatāsiddhyarthamupasarjanasaṃjñā apūrvanipātārthaṃ yujyata eva | kṛtrimākṛtrimatve'pyupasarjanasya pūrvanipāte kṛtrimasyaivāśrayaṇam | ubhayoḥ kṛtrimatve'nvarthatvena vyavasthā | hrasvavidhau tu vyāpternyāyādubhayorāśrayaṇam | `luk taddhitaluki'  iti strīpratyayāntarasyottarapadatvena prathamānirdeśābhāve'pi taddhitārthaviśeṣaṇatvādanvārthamupasarjanatvam | tadevamatra śyāmāderupasarjanatvamupapadyata iti hrasvaḥ sidhyati | upameyasyānyapadārthasya nānāvibhaktitve'pyekavibhaktitvaṃ tadapekṣam, upamānasya copameyārthatvād guṇabhāva ityupamānāpekṣamatra śyāmāderguṇatvamiti vikalpaḥ samarthanīyaḥ | anyathopameyāpekṣa eva guṇatve tenaivaikavibhaktiriti vikalpo nopapadyeta | evamanena prakāreṇa hrasvasiddhāvapi tittirikalmāṣītyatra `anyato ṅīp'  iti strīpratyayo'bhimato na syāt | tathāhyatra pūrava strīpratyaye tittiriṇopamānena pulliṅgena kalmāṣīśabdasya sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ na syāditi pūrvamakṛtvaiva strīpratyayaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyādupamānavṛttitve vartipadayoḥ samāsaḥ kriyate | samāsavācyā copameyā strīti striyāmanupasarjanādhikārānṅīṣ na syāt | kalmāṣasyopameye guṇatvāt | tataśca ṭābatra strīpratyayaḥprasajyeta | evaṃ kumbhakapālalohinīti `varṇādanudāttāt--' iti ṅīp na syādityarthaḥ | evaṃ satyupasarjanatve'niṣṭamidamabhyupagamyoktam | na tvatropasarjanatvaṃ nyāyyam | kṛtrime hi sambhavati hrasvavidhau tasyaiva sampratyayo yuktaḥ | `luk taddhitaluki'  ityatra prakṛtasya kṛtrimasyāsambhavādanuvṛttisāmarthyāllaukikamanvarthamāśrīyate | tato'nyatra tvakṛtrimāśrayameva yuktam | atra ca kṛtrimatvaṃ nāsti | `ekavibhakti' iti hyevaṃ vyākhyāyate--samāsa ityādhārasaptamī, na viṣayasaptamī | tena samāsādhāraṃ yadekavibhakti tatraiva pratiyogino nānāvibhaktitve tadupasarjanasaṃjñamiti | atra sa samāsasthasya pratiyoginaḥ padasya vibhinnavibhaktiyogābhāvaḥ samānādhikaramasamāso hyamiti kathaṃ bhinnavibhaktiyogaḥ syāt | ata eva bhāṣyakāreṇāruciratra sūcitā `yadi punarupasarjanānyevañjātīyakāni bhavantī'ti | naivaṃvidheṣūpasarjanasaṃjñāvakalpata ityarthaḥ | tasmādupasarjanatvābhāvād‌dhrasvatvamatra na syāditi sthitametat-- `ṭābanta eva caitrādau śyāmāśabdastathā bhavet'  iti | yattu coditaṃ kaiścit--satyapi copasarjanahrasvatve `paravalliṅgaṃ--'  iti śabdārthātideśāt punarākāraprasaṅga iti | tadanupapannam | dattā yavatītyatra śabdātideśe dvitīyasya tiśabdasya prasaṅgāt | pratyākhyātaṃ taditi, kutaḥ punarākāraprasaṅgaḥ || 410 ||
abhyupagamyopasarjanatvaṃ strīpratyaye doṣa uktaḥ | tatra samādhānaṃ śaṅkitvādoṣāntaraprasaṅgena nirākaroti-- sati śiṣṭabalīyastvād bāhye ṅīṣi ca satyapi | upamānasvaro na syāt tasmāt stryantaḥ samasyate || 411 ||
kṛte samāse tasyopameyārthavṛtteranupasarjanatvāt tasmāt samāsād bahurbhūtaḥ strīpratyayo'tra bhaviṣyati | tittirikalmāṣakumbhakapālalohitādayo hi samudāyā eva varṇaviśeṣavācino rūḍhāḥ | kalmāṣādīnāmeva tu varṇavācitve grahaṇavatā prātipadikena tadantavidheḥ pratiṣedhāt, samudāyādatra strīpratyayo'bhyupapagamyāpyucyate | ata evāha--satyapi ṅīṣi ceti | yadvā `anupasarjanāt  iti pradhānena tadantavidhyartho yogo vyākhyātaḥ | atra ca naivañjātīyakānyupasarjanānīti bhāṣyābhiprāyād varṇavācinā pradhānena tadantavidheḥ samāsāt strīpratyayo jāyate | evamapyupamānapūrvapadaprakṛtisvaro'treṣṭo na syāt | tathāhi--kṛte samāse pūrvapadaprakṛtisvarastāvatyeva pravartate | padagrahaṇaṃ hi parimāṇārthamityuktaṃ na subantatiṅantaparigrahārtham | tatra strīpratyaye pratyayasvaraḥ satiśiṣṭatvādupamānapūrvapadaprakṛtisvaraṃ bādheta | ṅīṣi cāyaṃ doṣaḥ | tatra svarasya pratyayodāttasyabhāvāt | ṅīṣi tvanudāttatvādupamānasvara evāvaśiṣyata iti viśeṣya ṅīṣītyuktam | yata evaṃ svaradoṣastasmāt pūrvamakṛte samāse strīpratyaye kṛte tadantasya sāmānyavacanasyopamānena samāsaḥ kāryaḥ | tathā ca satiśiṣṭatvādupamānasvara eveṣṭa sidhyati | etaccopamāne sāmānyavacanasya vṛttau na labhyate, tittiriṇā puṃsā kumbhakapālena napuṃsakena ca sāmānādhikaraṇyāt strīpratyayānutpatteriti sāmānyavacanasyopamāne vṛttāvayaṃ doṣaḥ || 411 ||
kiñca-- guṇe na copamānasthe sāpekṣatvaṃ prakalpate | prādhānyasya (pradhānasya) tathā na syād vyāghrādau liṅgadarśanam || 412 ||
puruṣo'yaṃ vyāghra iva śūraḥ puruṣavyāghra iti `upamitaṃ vyāghrādibhiḥ sāmānyāprayoge  iti samāse sāmānyavācinaḥ śūrādeḥ śabdasya prayoge tatsāpekṣatvādasāmarthyādeva samāso na bhaviṣyatīti kiṃ sāmānyāprayoga iti vacanena | tattu jñāpayati--bhavati pradhānasya sāpekṣasyāpi samāsa iti vyavasthāpitaṃ liṅgadarśanam | etacca guṇe sāmānyadharme śauryādau vyāghrādyupamānagate puruṣādeḥ pradhānasya tadapekṣatvaṃ na syād, uttarasyopasarjanasya sāpokṣatvāditi nopapadyate vivakṣitārthajñāpanam | urameyavṛttau hi guṇasyaitad jñāpakaṃ yujyate, nopamānavṛttiviti pradeśāntaraparyālocanayāpi nopamānasthatvaṃ guṇavacanasya yuktam || 412 ||
upasarjanatvena hrasvasamarthanamanupapannamitīmaṃ pakṣaṃ heyatayopasaṃhartumāha-- tasmāt sati guṇatve'pi prādhānyaṃ vigrahāntare | naivañjatīyakaṃ śāstre sambhavatyupasarjanam || 413 ||
upamānavṛtterupameyaviśeṣaṇatvāt satyapyaprādhānye śyāmādervigrahāntare prādhānyamasti, yadopameyavṛttirguṇastadā yad vākyaṃ tatra | tathāhi--śastrīva devadattā śyāmetyatra upameyavṛtteḥ śyāmasya prādhānyam | upamānavṛttitve'pi ca samāsenopameyasyābhidhānād vastutaḥ prādhānyameva dharmasya, prakriyāvākyāpekṣayā tu guṇatvam | tathācaivaṃprakāraṃ vastutaḥ pradhānaṃ śāstre'pi nopasarjanamupapadyate | prakiyābhede'pi hi laukiko'rthaḥ śāstreṇānuvidheyaḥ | loke ca pradhānamevedamityantavarthamapi śāstre lokasiddhārthānuvādake nāstyupasarjanatvam | ata eva `upasarjanānyapyevañjātīyakānī'ti bhāṣye'ruciḥ sūcitetyuktam || 413 ||
tadevamupamānavṛttitvaṃ guṇavacanasyānupapannamuk‌tvāto'nantaraṃ bhāṣye'bhihitam--`evaṃ tarhi śastryāmeva śastrīśabdo vartate | devadattāyāṃ śyāmaśabda ityupameyavṛttitvamākhyātam | atra tu coditam--"evamapi guṇo'nirdiṣṭo bhavati | bahavaśca śastryāṃ guṇāḥ sūkṣmā mṛdutarī" iti | upameye sāmānyavacanasya vṛtteryathāyathaṃ talliṅgaparigrahaḥ siddhaḥ | prakṛtaṃ cottarapadārthaprādhānyameva nirvāhitaṃ bhavati | kintu śastrīva śyāmā devadatteti śyāmaguṇopalakṣitasyopameyasya nirdeśādupamānagatasya guṇasya strīśabdena jātiviśiṣṭārthābhidhāyinā niyatasyāsaṃsparśādopamyahetordharmasya pratiniyatasya prajñāpanaṃ na syāditi bhāṣyārthaḥ || atra parihārabhāṣyam--`anirdiśyamānasyāpi guṇasya bhavati loke sampratyayaḥ' iti | etad vivṛṇoti-- upameyātmani śyāme vartameno'bhidhīyate | upamāneṣvanirdiṣṭaḥ sāmarthyāt sampratīyate || 414 ||
yadyapi sādhāraṇo dharmaḥ śyāmādirupameyasthaḥ svaśabdena pratyāyyate | sakṛdabhidhāvyāpārācca śabdasya tadupakṣayatvameva | tathāpyumāne samānadharmasyānyasyāśruteḥ saṃnidhānāt sākāṅkṣatvācca śrutenaiva yogaḥ parikalpyate, aśrutaparikalpanāyāḥ śrutasambandhasya nyāyyatvāt || 414 ||
atraiva dṛṣṭāntabhāṣyaṃ--`tadyathā--candramukhī devadatteti | bahavaśca candre guṇāḥ | yā cāsau priyadarśanatā, sā gamyate' iti | etad vyācaṣṭe-- dravyamātre'pi nirdiṣṭe candravaktre'nugamyate | viśiṣṭa eva candrastho guṇo nopaplavādayaḥ || 415 ||
