candramukhīti sāmānyadharmamantareṇopamānabhūtadravyamātropādāne'pi prasiddherupamānaheturāhṇādakatvādiḥ sādhāraṇo dharmo'nuvartyate, na tvanye candradharmā upaplavādayaḥ | upaplavaḥ śaśākhyo malaḥ | ādiśabdād vṛddhikṣayayogaḥ | anye tu vṛddhikṣayayogo nityapravṛttagatitvaṃ vopaplavaḥ | ādiśabdācchaśalāñchanatvādaya iti vyācakṣate | itthañca yatra nāmānirdiṣṭo guṇaḥ prasiddherupamānaheturviśiṣṭaḥ pratīyate,tatraikatra śruto'pi sāmarthyādanyatra kathaṃ na pratīyetetyatiśayo nidarśane garbhīkṛtaḥ|| 415 ||
tadevamupameyavṛtti sāmānyavacanamityayaṃ pakṣaḥ | etaccātra prakriyāyāṃ nānātvaṃ vitāryate | paramārthatastu laukikaḥ śastrīśyāmādirakhaṇḍaḥ śabdo viśiṣṭopameyārthavācītyāha-- bhedabhāvanayaitacca samāse'pyupavarṇyate | viśiṣṭaguṇabhinne'rthe padamanyat prayujyate || 416 ||
upamānavṛttitve sāmānyavacanasyaikaṃ vākyam, upameyavṛttitve tu dvitīyamitivākye bhedasya nānātvasyopamānārthatvamupameyārthatvamityevambhūtasyānubhavena yāhitā vāsanā saṃskārastayā hetubhūtayā vākyasamānārthatvaṃ vṛtteravasāya tatrāpyetadupamānopameyārthavacanatvaṃ sāmānyavacanasya kathyate | upamānopahitabhedaśyāmādiguṇaviśiṣṭe tūpameye niraṃśaṃ samāsapadaṃ vākyādanyadevoccāryate | tadanvākhyānopāyaparikalpanā tu prakriyānurodhād yathānyad doṣajātaṃ nāpatati tathā kartavyeti sampratyupameyavṛtti sāmānyavacanaṃ sthitam | evaṃ hi śastrīśyāmo devadatta iti sidhyati | tittirikalmāṣīti ceṣṭaḥ strīpratyayo bhavati || 416 ||
atrāpi pakṣe codyabhāṣyam--`evamapi sāmānādhikaraṇeneti vartate| vyadhikaraṇānāṃ samāso na prāpnotī'ti | upameyavṛttitve śyāmāśabdasya śastrīśabdena sāmānādhikaraṇyābhāvāt samānādhikaraṇaprakaraṇaṃ nānugṛhyetetyarthaḥ | atra parihāro'bhihitaḥ--`kiṃ hi vacanānna bhavatī'ti | anyatra kṛtārthatvād durbalataramatra prakaraṇamakṛtārthatayā śrutyā bādhyata ityāśayo bhāṣyakārasya | nanu copamānavṛttitve sāmānyavacanasyāsti vacanasyāvakāśaḥ | tathāca prakaraṇānugraho'pi kṛto bhavati | naitadasti | viśiṣṭārthavṛtteḥ padasyānvākhyāne śāstraprakriyābhaṅgāya yaḥ prabhavati, asāvapoddhārapadārtho nāśrayaṇīyaḥ | upamānaviṣaye ca sāmānyavacane dvayorapi padayorupameyaṃ prati guṇatvāt sāpekṣatve'sāmarthyād vṛttirna syāt | upameyavṛttitve tu saṃnnihitobhayādhikaraṇaḥ sambandho nirākāṅkṣo vartate | tathāca sāmarthyāmiti vyadhikaramayorapi gamakatvād vacanaṃ vidhatte vṛttim | ato'nantaraṃ bhāṣyaṃ--`yadyapi tāvadvacanāt samāsaḥ syāt | iha tu khalu mṛgīva capalā mṛgacapalā | samānādhikaraṇalakṣaṇaḥ puṃvadbhāvo na prāpnoti' iti || tadeva vivṛṇoti-- yadi bhinnādhikaraṇo vacanādanugamyate | mṛgīva capaletyatra puṃvadbhāvo na sidhyati || 417 ||
yadi vacanasāmarthyāt prākaraṇikaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyamanādṛtya vyadhikaramayorapyayaṃ samāso'nuvidhīyate, tadā mṛgacapaletyatra karmadhārayāśrayo'nyatra samānādikaraṇapade caritārthaḥ puṃvadbhāvo na syāt || 417 ||
atra parihāraṃ pradeśāntaroktatvād bhāṣye'nuktamapyāśaṅkate-- astrīpūrvapadatvāt tu puṃvadbhāvo bhaviṣyati | tathaiva mṛgadugdhādo na cet stryartho vivakṣyate || 418 ||
jātyantaranivṛttiparāyāṃ codanāyāṃ mṛgakṣīrādau puṃvadbhāvaḥ, tatphalaṃ pumarthaśabdaprayogaḥ siddha itiṃ pratyākhyātaḥ puṃvadbhāvaḥ `na vā astrīpūrvupadavivakṣitatvādi'ti | evamihāpi mṛgacapalādau mṛgajātīyasya cāpalasya vivakṣitatvānmṛga iva capaletyeva vigraha iti strītvāvivakṣāyāṃ siddhamiṣṭam | tathāhi--kṛte'pi puṃvadbhāve śabdāt strītvasyāgateravivakṣaiva samarthanīyā | sa hi vivakṣito'rthaḥ, yaḥ śabdāt gamyate | yadā tu viśiṣṭasya strīcāpalasya striyaivopamopapatteḥ strītvavivakṣā, tadārambhaṇīya evātra puṃvadbhāvaḥ | kṛte ca tasmin vṛttau strītvasyāntarbhāvo vaktavyaḥ | ata eva na cet stryartho vivakṣyata iti pākṣikatvenāyaṃ parihāraḥ śaṅkitaḥ | anenaiva cāśayena bhāṣye nopanyastamidam || 418 ||
ata evāto'nantaraṃ nirdoṣapakṣāśrayoṇa bhāṣyam--`evaṃ tarhi; tasyāmevobhayaṃ vartata iti | etad vyācaṣṭe-- śastrīva śastrī śyāmeti devadattaiva kathyate | tasyāmevobhayaṃ tasmāducyate śāstravigrahe || 419 ||
ihopamānavṛttitve sāmānyavacanasyopameyaḥ samāvavācyo'bhihiṃtaḥ | evañcātra vākye vartipadayorevopameyavṛttitvamastu | tathāhi--upacārācchastrīva śastrīti devadattā kathyate | atastasyāṃ devadattāyāmupameyabhūtāyāmevobhayamupamānavacanaṃ sāmānyavacanaṃ ca vartata iti sāmānādhikaraṇyopapattau puṃvadbhāvasiddhiḥ | prakaraṇaṃ ca na bādhitaṃ bhavati | upamānasambandhamantarbhāvya ca devadattāyāṃ śastrīśabdaḥ pravartata ityabhedādhyāsād gamyate | parārthe śabdaprayogo garbhīkṛtevārtho yujyate, nānyathā | tadyathā--siṃho māṇavaka ityādiḥ | siṃhamadhyāpayeti copacaritena śabdena vyavahāro dṛśyate | evamiha śastrīśabdena devadattaiva vyavahriyate | etacca tasyāmevobhayaṃ vartata iti śāstravigrahe śāstraprakriyāgate vākye kathyate | vākyāvasthāyāṃ hi samānādhikaraṇatāsamarthanārthamidamabhidhīyate | tatra ca śāstraprakriyāyāṃ vividhanānābhūtamapoddhārapadārthānāṃ grahaṇam | laukike tu pade viśiṣṭārthavācake niraṃśe vibhāgābhāvānnāsyopanyāsasyāvasaraḥ | tatra hi varṇavat padavibhāgasyāsatyatvānna kaścicchastrīśabdastadartho vā, yasyopacaritārthatvaṃ varṇyetetyabhiprāyaḥ || 419 ||
eṣa eva pakṣaḥ siddhāntatayā bhāṣye'vasthāpitaḥ | tathāhyanantaraṃ bhāṣyam--`etaccātra yuktaṃ, yattasyāmevobhayaṃ vartate | itarathā bahvapekṣyaṃ syādi'ti | etad vyācaṣṭe-- puṃvadbhāvasya siddhyarthaṃ pakṣe strīpratyayasya ca | bahvapekṣyamatastasyāmubhayapratipādanam || 420 ||
yadā śyāmāśabda upameye vartata iti pakṣastadātra pakṣe vaiyādhikaraṇyād vacanasāmarthyāt samāse'pi puṃvadbhāvasya siddhyarthamastrīpūrvapadavivakṣāniyamo'pekṣyaḥ | mṛgakṣīrādivadatra mṛgacapalādau sāmānyasyaiva vivakṣā, na viśeṣasyetyetadanusaraṇīyam | eṣa vivakṣāniyamo'śabdako'trānustriyamāṇo gauravaṃ pratipattāvāpādayatīti bahvapekṣatvamatra | yadā tu śastryāmupamāne śyāmāśabja iti pakṣastadātra pakṣe śastrīśyāmo devadatta ityupasarjanahrasvatvena siddhau tittirikalmāṣītyādāvanupasarjanādhikārādiṣṭasya strīpratyayasya siddhyarthaṃ samudāyā evaite varṇaviśeṣavācino naivañjātīyakaṃ vopasarjanamiti pradhānena tadantavidheḥ samāsād bāhyo ṅīṣiti vācyam | tathāca svare doṣa ityetadatra bahvapekṣyam | yata evamanayoḥ pakṣayorbahvapekṣyam, atastasyāmevobhayasyopamānopameyavacanasya bhāṣye'bhyupagama ityarthaḥ || 420 ||
prāk samāsādupameyavṛtteḥ kalmāṣādeḥ strīpratyayasyeṣṭasya siddheryathāyathamupameyagataliṅgasiddheśca prakārāntareṇātra bahvapekṣatvaṃ vyācaṣṭe-- śyāmā śastrī yathā śyāmā śastrīkalpeti cocyate | tatropamānetarayoḥ śyāmetyetadapekṣyate || 421 ||
śyāmā śastrī yathetyupameyavṛttau śyāmāśabdasya vigrahavākyaṃ pradarśitam | śyāmā śastrīkalpetyupamānavṛttau śyāmāśabdasya vigrahavākyam | tadatraikaniṣṭhasya guṇasyābhidhāne taditaragatatvena sāmarthyāt kalpanaṃ, dharmasāmānyaprayuktatvādupamānopameyasya sannidhānādekatra śruto'pi sādhāraṇo dharmo'paratrānumīyata iti bahvapekṣatvaṃ kecidāhuḥ | tadetaduktaṃ bhāṣye--`yadi tāvadevaṃ vigrahaḥ kriyate, śastrīva śyāmā devadatteti, śastryāṃ śyāmetyetadapekṣyaṃ syāt | athāpyevaṃ vigrahaḥ kriyate yathā śastrī śyāmā tadvadiyaṃ devadatteti | evamapi devadattāyāṃ śyāmetyetadapekṣyaṃ syādi'ti || 421 ||
nanu vigrahavākyaṃ laukikārthānuguṇaṃ pradarśanīyamityubhayatrāpi śyāmāśabdo vākye prayoktavyaḥ | vṛttau tu dvitīyasya śyāmāśabdasyāntarbhūtatvādaprayoga iti kathaṃ bahvapekṣyamityata āha-- atha śyāmeva śastrīvaṃ śyāmetyevaṃ prayujyate | śastrī yatheyaṃ śyāmeti tāvadeva pratīyate || 422 ||
śyāmā śastrī yathā tathā iyaṃ devadattā śyāmā ityevaṃ dvayoḥ śyāmāśabdayorūpamānopameyagatayoḥ prayoge śastrī yatheyaṃ śyāmeti sakṛcchyāmāśabdaprayoge yatparimāṇaṃ vastu tāvat tatparimāṇamevāvagamyate || 422 ||
tathāhi-- upalakṣaṇamātrārthā guṇasyāsya yadi śrutiḥ | pṛthag dvayoḥ śruto'pyeṣa neṣṭasyārthasya vācakaḥ || 423 ||
vastumātropalakṣaṇāya guṇaśabdasyopādāne'sakṛtprayoge'pi neṣṭasyaupamyasya pratipādanaṃ syāt | yā śyāmaguṇopalakṣitā śastrī, sā dharmāntareṇāpi tathābhūtāyā devadattāyāḥ paricchediketyapi pratīteraipamyanibandhanatvaṃ niyogataḥ śrutasyāsakṛtprayoge'pi na gamyeta || 423 ||
athopamāyāṃ savyāpāratvamatra śrutasya, tadā-- upameyaṃ tu yad vācyaṃ tasya cet pratipādane | savyāpārā guṇāstatra sarvasyoktiḥ sakṛcchrutau || 424 ||
upamānasambandhena paricchedyamupameyaṃ yat pradhānaṃ vācyamabhidheyaṃ, tasya rūpaviśeṣaprajñāpane yadi vyāpṛtā guṇā nopalakṣaṇamātrārthāḥ, tadaikaguṇaprayoge'pi sarvasyopamānasyāpi guṇapratipādanaṃ sāmarthyāditi dvirabhidhānaṃ nopayujyate | sādṛśyāvacchedena hi sambandhaṃ niyantuṃ guṇasyopādānamiti yathāvivakṣitārthapratipattirbhavati | tadevamupamāne upameye vā vṛttau sāmānyavacanasya itaragatatvenāpekṣaṇād bahvapekṣyamiti `tasyāmevobhayaṃ vartata' ityeṣa eva siddhānto bhāṣyakāreṇāvasthāpitaḥ || 424 ||
ataḥ paraṃ vākyakāraḥ papāṭha--`upamānasamāse gumavacanasya viśeṣabhāk‌tvāt sāmānyavacanāprasiddhiri'ti | tadetad vyācaṣṭe-- prakārādhārabhedena viśeṣe samavasthitaḥ | śabdāntarābhisambandhe sāmānyavacanaḥ katham || 425 ||
pūrvaṃ `sādhāraṇaṃ bravan dharmam'  ityādinā sāmānyavacanatve pratipādite'pyupameyagatatvenopamānagatatvena vā guṇasyehoktatvādekataropakṣaye kathaṃ sādhāraṇyamityākṣepo'yamupapadyate | tathāhyādhāraniṣkarṣeṇa guṇamātrābhidhāne'niyatenādhāreṇāvacchedād bhavet sāmānyavacanatvam | tadā cāyaṃ guṇaḥ svaprādhānyenābhidhīyamānopamāyāṃ savyāpāraḥ, apitu dharmāntareṇopamānimittena sambadhyate | yathoktaṃ--`dharmaḥ samānaḥ śyāmādiḥ'  ityādi | yadāpi sādhāraṇaguṇanimittastattvādhyāropastadā sāmānyavacanasya prayoga eva nāsti | yadā punarabhedopacārānmatublopād vā dravyasamānādhikaraṇo guṇavacanastadāyaṃ samānādhikaraṇaḥ samāsaḥ | sāmānyaṃ sādhāraṇo dharmo guṇaḥ, tamuk‌tvā tadvati yo vartate, sa sāmānyavacana ityuktam | tatra cādhāreṇa niyatena yogāt tadbhedena viśiṣṭa eva guṇaḥ saṃsargidharmāntarādibhedād vā | yathoktaṃ--`guṇānāmāśrayād bhedaḥ svato  ityādi | yadyapi caikatra śruto'nyatra sāmarthyāt pratīyata ityuktaṃ, tathāpi vacanagrahaṇādihābhidhāvyāpāreṇa sādhāraṇyaṃ vivakṣitaṃ, na śrutyarthābhyām | śyāmāśabdaśca guṇamātrasyāpi pratītau śabdāntareṇopamānavācinā vā yogāt tanniyatatvena viśeṣavṛttireva | nanu cāsau vākyārtho na padasaṃskāraṃ pratibadhnāti | naitadasti | nirastāvayavabhedasya vṛttipadasyānvākhyeyatvāt pūrvapadottarapadapravibhāge kriyamāṇe tadarthānusāreṇaivāpoddhārapadārthaḥ pravibhajanīyaḥ | tatra ca viśiṣṭārthavacana eva śyāmāśabdaḥ pravibhaktuṃ nyāyya iti kathaṃ sāmānyavacanatā || 425 ||
atra parihāraḥ-- sādṛśyamātraṃ sāmānyaṃ dviṣṭhaṃ kaiścit pratīyate | guṇo bhede'pyabhedena dvivṛttirvā vivakṣitaḥ || 426 ||
vyāpāro jātibhāgasya dravyayorvābhidhitsitaḥ | rūpāt sāmānyavācitvaṃ prāgvā vṛtterudāhṛtam || 427 ||
ubhayagataṃ sādṛśyamātraṃ sāmānyaśabdenātra vivakṣitam | sādṛśyaṃ ca bhedābhedābhyāmeva bhavati | tathā caikagatatvenāpyabhidhāne tasyānyāpekṣatvādabhidhāvyāpārādevobhyaniṣṭhatāvagamyata ityupapadyate sāmānyavacanatvam | guṇa evātra prakārādhāraviśiṣṭo'pyupamāyāṃ vyāvṛtto'viśeṣeṇopamānopameyagato vivakṣitaḥ | sāmānyavacanaśabdasya pratyāyayitumiṣṭa ityarthaḥ | tathā cānvayinā rūpeṇocyamāno guṇa eva sādṛśyam, na tato'rthāntaram | tadetaduktaṃ bhāṣye--`na cāvaśyaṃ sa eva sāmānyavacano yo bahūnāṃ sāmānyamāha | dvayorapi yaḥ sāmānyamāha, so'pi sāmānyavacanaḥ' iti | yattu vākyakāreṇoktam--`na vā śyāmatvasyobhayatra bhāvāt tadvācakatvācca śabdasya sāmānyavacanaprasiddhiḥ' iti | tad vyācaṣṭe--vyāpāro jātibhāgasyetyādinā | dravyayorupamānopameyalakṣaṇayorguṇajātervyāpāro guṇābhedapratyayakaraṇadvāreṇaupamyasambandhapratyāyanaṃ sāmānyavacanena vivakṣitam | yadyapi guṇajātiḥ sakavāśrayasamavetā''bhinnatvānnopamāyāmupayoginītyuktam, tathāpi svadhārahakasūkṣmaviśeṣoparāgādavāntarasāmānyarūpatāmāpannā sādṛśyaśabdavācyaupamyopayoginī bhavati | tathā ca jātyāpāditābhedasya śyāmatvaguṇasyobhayatropamānopameyayoḥ samavetasyābhidhāyakaḥ sāmānyavacanaśabdaḥ | tadāha--`rūpāt sāmānyavācitvam' iti | upamānopameyagatasya guṇasya rūpasāmānyāveśādabhinnasya pratyāyane sāmānyavacanatā śyāmādeḥ śabdasya sidhyatītyarthaḥ | abhedopacārād dravyavṛttitā cātra śabdasyeti dravyayorityāha | parihārāntaraṃ spaṣṭamidaṃ bhāṣye'bhihitam | `athavā sāmānyavacanairityucyate | sarvaḥ śabdo'nyena śabdenābhisambadhyamāno viśeṣavacanaḥ saṃpadyate'ta evaṃ vijñāsyāmaḥ prāgabhisambandhād yaḥ sāmānyavacanaḥ' iti | tadevāha--`prāg vā vṛtterudāhahṛtam' iti | ābhimukhyenānyonyarūpasammiśraṇena sambadhyante yasminnarthā iti samāso'bhisambandhaśabdena vivakṣitaḥ, tatrārthānāṃ nirvibhāgatvāt | yathā `viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyeṇa',  `dvitīyā śritādibhiḥ  samānādhikaraṇena'  "ardhaṃ napuṃsakam"  ityādivyavahāro vākyagatabhedabhāvanāvaśādāśrīyate, tathā sāmānyavyavahāro'pi | tathāhi--vṛttivākyayoḥ saṃsṛṣṭāsaṃsṛṣṭārthatayā satyapi bhede rūpasāmānyādabhedābhidhānopapattervākyagatairdharmairvṛttyānvākhyānamapoddhārapadārthakalpanayopapadyata eva | tataśca samāse sāmānyasyopameyāvaruddhatve'pi tataḥ pūrvaṃ vākye vicchinnārthapratyāyakapadaprayoge viśeṣāvarodhābhāvāt sāmānyavacanatopapattiḥ | yadvā sāmānyamuktavān sāmānyavacana iti vākyāvasthāparidṛṣṭaṃ sāmānyavacanatvaṃ bhūtapūrvagatyāśrīyate | yathā śastrīśabdasya vṛttāvupameyavṛttitve'pi bhūtapūrvagatyopamānavācitvamiti sarveṣṭasiddhiḥ || 426,427 ||
idānīm "upamitaṃ pyāghrādibhiḥ"  ityatra bhāṣyaṃ vicāryate | tathāhi-tatra sāmānyavacanasya prayoge śūraśabdasya puruṣo'yaṃ vyāghra iva śūra iti samāso mā bhūditi sāmānyāprayoga ityucyate | atra ca pūrvottarapadayorupamānopameyārthaūbhedādvaiyadhikaraṇyādeva samāsasyāpravṛttiḥ | yadyevaṃ mūlodāharaṇe'pi puruṣavyāghra iti kathaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyamityata āha-- vyāghraśabdo yadā śauryāt puruṣārtho'vatiṣṭhate | tadādhikaraṇābhedāt samāsasyāsti sambhavaḥ || 428 ||
śauryādisamānaguṇāntarbhāvanenopamānavacanā api vyāghrādayo yadā tattvādhyāropādupameyavṛttayo bhavanti, tadā samānābhidheyatvāt samānādhikaraṇādhikāravihitā vṛttirupapadyate, puruṣavyāghra puruṣasiṃha iti | atra ca sāmānyadharmasyāntarbhāvādaprayogaḥ || 428 ||
yadā tu sa prayujyate, tadā-- śūraśabdaprayoge tu vyāghraśabdo mṛge sthitaḥ | bhinne'dhikaraṇe vṛttestatra naivāsti sambhavaḥ || 429 ||
svaśabdenaiva sāmānyadharmasyopameyagatasyābhidhāne mṛgajātīye svārtha upamāna lakṣaṇa eva vyāghraśabdo vācakatvena vartate, nopameye puruṣe; bhedasambandhasyodbhūtasyevādinā dyotitatvādabhedenāyogāt | evañca bhinnādhikaraṇatvāt prākaraṇikaḥ samāso na prāpnotīti kiṃ pratiṣedhenetyarthaḥ || 429 ||
etat samarthayate-- sāmānādhikaraṇye'pi guṇabhedasya sambhavāt | prayogaḥ śūraśabdasya samāse'pyanuṣajyate || 430 ||
yadāpi samānaguṇāntarbhāvanena vyāghraśabdaḥ puruṣe vartate, tadāpi śūraśabdasya prayogaḥ syāt, samānasya dharmasya niyamakhyāpanāya | anyathā sāmānādhikaraṇyānyathānupapattyādhyāropahetuniyato guṇaḥ pratīyate | tathāhi--guṇabhedasyāsti sambhavo vyāghre, śauryahiṃsratvabalavattvādirapi guṇaḥ sambhavādantarbhūta ityavadhāryate | tathā ca niyamāya śūraśabdaprayoge'pi samāsaḥ syādityarthavān pratiṣedhaḥ || 430 ||
nanu siṃho vyāghra iti pūjāyām, śvā kāka iti kutsāyāmityuddhoṣyate | tathā ca puruṣavyāghraḥ, puruṣasiṃha iti śoryameva pūjārthamantarbhūto guṇa iti kathamaniyama ityāśaṅkyāha-- pūjopādhiśca yo dṛṣṭaḥ kutsanopādhayaśca ye | teṣāṃ bhinnanimittatvānniyamārthā punaḥ śrutiḥ || 431 ||
pūjāpratipādanaparatayā ye guṇā upameyopakāriṇo'ntarbhāvyante upamānena te bahavo vyāghrādeḥ prakaraṇabhedagatāḥ | tataśca sāmānyaśabdādasmānniyamena nāvagamyanta iti punaḥ śrutiḥ śūrādiśabdo'vadhāraṇārthaḥ prayoktavya eva | tadyathā--`abhimanāyate, sumanāyate, durmanāyate' ityatra sudurabhīnāṃ pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇapakṣe gatārthānāmapi pratyaya--prayogādrapasāmānyāt pratyayāntasya manāyata iti sarvasādhāraṇyād viśeṣānabhivyaktau prayogastādarthyenopapadyate, tathātra | evaṃ puruṣavāka iti nindāpratipādanaparatayāpi prayoge kākagatāśucibhakṣaṇānavasthāyitādayo nindāhetavo bahava iti niyamāya punaḥ śrutiḥ sādhāraṇavacanasyeti samāsaprāptau yuktaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ | candramukhādau tu prasiddhivaśād viśiṣṭadharmapratipattiruktā | ihāpi prakaraṇādivaśād viśeṣapratipattāvapi yadā prakaraṇādyabhāvastadā prayoge sādhāraṇavacanasya samāsa niṣedha upapadyata eva || 431 ||
kiṃ vātra sāmānādhikaraṇyasamarthanena | tathāhi--sāmānyaprayoge'pi sāpekṣatvenāsāmarthyāt samāsāprāptau pradhānasya sāpekṣasyāpi bhavati samāsa iti jñāpakārthametaduktam | evañca vaiyadhikaraṇyena samāsāprāptāvapi bhavatyevaitajjñāpakamityāha-- asambhave'pi vā vṛtteḥ syādetalliṅgadarśanam | acveriti yathā liṅgamabhāve'pi bhṛśādiṣu || 432 ||
vaiyādhikaraṇyādasambhave'prāptau vṛtteḥ samāsasya tatsambhāvanayā yadetat sāmānyāprayoga iti vacanam, tat sutarāmeva liṅgadarśanaṃ jñāpakaṃ bhavet | na kevalaṃ sāpekṣātvādasāmarthyam, yāvad vaiyadhikaraṇyādapi | pradhānasya ca svātantryādanekaviśeṣaṇayogopapattirnyāyasiddhā | guṇo hyekena vaśīkṛto nānyena sambadhyeta | guṇatvameva hi tadā jahyāt | pradhānasya yugapadanekenopakāriṇā sambandho bhūṣaṇameva, prādhānyasya paripoṣaṇāditi nyāyasiddhe'rthe liṅgadarśanamidam | dṛṣṭaṃ cāsambhave'pi sambhāvanāmātreṇopādīyamānaṃ liṅgam | tadyathā--"bhṛśādibhyo bhuvyacveḥ"  ityatra bhavatyarthe kyaṅo vidhāne, tatraiva bhavatiyoga cvipratyayasyāpīti cvāvutpanne tenaiva bhavatyarthasyoktatvāt tadantebhyo bhṛśādibhyaḥ kyaṅo'nutpattau siddhāyāmapi prāptiṃ sambhāvyacveriti pratiṣedhaḥ kriyamāṇo liṅgaṃ yatrārthe cvistatraiva kyaṅityasyārthasyetyabhūtatadbhāve kyaṅ siddho bhavati, abhṛśo bhṛśo bhavati bhṛśāyata iti | evamihāpi vaiyadhikaraṇyādeva samāsāprāptau prāptisambhāvanayā sāmānyāprayoga iti pratiṣedhaḥ pradhānasya sāpekṣasyāpi bhavati samāsa ityasyārthasya liṅgaṃ jāyate | tena rājapuruṣaḥ śobhana ityādi siddham | upameyagatve cātra sāmānyavacanasyā pradhānagāmitā bhavati, nānyatheti prāgeva nirṇītam || 432 ||
idānīmupamānaprasaṅgenedamaparaṃ vicāryata ityāha-- vatyantāvayave vākye yadaupamyaṃ pratīyate | tatpratyayavidhau sūtre nirdeśo'yaṃ vicāryate || 433 ||
brāhmaṇavadadhīte, kṣatriyavad yudhyate, vaiśyavadarjayatīti vatyantapadaikadeśakaṃ yad vākyam, tatropamānopameyabhāvalakṣaṇaḥ sambandho'vadhāryate | tathā hyadyayanādikriyālakṣaṇo'tra samāno dharma upameyagatatvena śrūyate | arthādupamānagatatvena pratipattiriti bhavatyaipamyasyāvagamaḥ | tasyaipamyasya pratipādako yo'tra pratyayo vatiḥ, tadvidhāyake sūtre "tena tulyaṃ kriyā ced vatiḥ"  ityatra yo'yaṃ nirdeśaḥ, sa parīkṣyate | tathā hi--prakṛtyarthatvena vātra kriyā nirdiśyeta, pratyayārthatvena vā | yadyapi prakṛtyarthatvena pratyeyā, dharmasādhāraṇyaprayuktatvādupamānopameyabhāvasyetiphalābhedaḥ, tathāpi kaḥ sambandhī kriyāyāṃ nyāyyaḥ, lakṣyavyavasthā ca kathaṃ na bhidyata ityasti vicārasya prayojanam || 433 ||
tatredaṃ bhāṣyam--`idamayuktaṃ vartate | kimatrāyuktam ? yat tṛtīyāsamarthaṃ kriyā syāt' iti | tatra ko'bhiprāyo bhāṣyakārasya ? yena tṛtīyāsamarthaṃ kriyeti prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇapakṣamabhyupagamyākṣipatītyata āha-- kriyetyupādhiḥ prāthamyāt prakṛtyarthasya yadyapi | na prātipadikaṃ tatra kriyāvācyupapadyate || 434 ||
teneti samarthavibhaktirarthaviśeṣanibandhanā | tathā hyupameyāpekṣayā tadupakārāyopasarjanībhūtaḥ parigṛhītavyatirekaḥ prakṛtyartha upamānalakṣaṇaḥ (pratyayārthena) pratyayārthatvena samanvayayogyo'nayā vyatirekavibhak‌tyā jñāpyata iti samarthavibhaktiriyamucyate | sāmarthyaṃ ca prakṛtyarthasya pratyayārtheneti prakṛteriyaṃ vibhaktiḥ | tulyamiti pratyayārthaḥ | pratyayasannidhau tasyānadhigatasyāvasāyāt | tatra kriyeti viśeṣaṇamupādīyamānaṃ sannihitatvāt prakṛtyarthena vā sambadhyeta pratyayārthena vā | śrutiliṅgavākyaprakaraṇasthānasamākhyābhiśca padārthānāṃ guṇaviniyogādiha sthānānniyamaḥ | tathāhi--prathamasthānapatitaṃ tenetyetaditi tasyaiva kramavyatikrame prayojanābhāvād yuktaṃ kriyeti viśeṣaṇam | tadyathā--"sāsya devatā"  iti setyasyopādhirdevatā | "tena raktaṃ rāgād"  iti ca tenetyasya rāgāditi viśeṣaṇam | pañcāmīnirdeśādeva prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇatātra, na sthānabalāt | tadevaṃ yadyapi tṛtīyāsamarthaṃ kriyeti na kenacidatra prathamamuktam, tathāpi nyāyabalāt kriyetyupādhiḥ prāthamyāt prakṛtyarthasyeti yuktam `yat tṛtīyāsamarthaṃ kriyā cet sā bhavatītyucyate' iti bhāṣyam | nyāyāyāto'martho'vaśyābhyupagamanīya ityukta kalpatvāducyata iti bhāṣye vyapadiṣṭaḥ | tatra tṛtīyā sattvavācinaḥ prātipadikād vidhīyate | na ca tat kriyāvāci, sādhyamānarupāyāḥ kriyāyāstiṅntaikagocaratvāditi kathaṃ tṛtīyāsamarthasya kriyetyanena viśeṣaṇam, asambhavādityākṣepaḥ || 434 ||
viśeṣaṇasāmarthyāt kriyāvāci, tarhi tṛtīyāsamarthaṃ bhaviṣyatītyāha-- sattvṛttasya śeṣe vā tṛtīyā sādhane'pi vā | tiṅāmasattvācitvādubhayaṃ tanna vidyate || 435 ||
sattvaṃ sīdantyasmin jātiguṇakriyā iti idaṃ taditi vyapadeśayogyaṃ dravyamucyate | tatra vṛttasya prātipadikasya tṛtīyayā yogaḥ | tathāhi--sa prātipadikārthaḥ paropakārādhānayogyatvāt tadupakāropajanitavyatirekastadvācikāṃ vibhaktimāśrayate | sa ca vyatirekaḥ kriyākārakasambandhanimittaḥ kaściccheṣasambandhaḥ | tadyathā--adhyayanena vasati | dadhnā jaḍaḥ | tapasā kṛśaḥ | dhanena kulamiti hetuhetumadbhāvo'yaṃ śeṣasambandhaḥ | kaścit punaḥ kriyākārakasambandha eva vyatirekaḥ, tatrāpi tṛtīyā tadyathā--dātreṇa lunāti | paraśunā chinattītyādi | tadetad dvayamapi tṛtīyānimittaṃ kriyāvācināṃ tiṅāmasambhavi | ākhyātasya kriyāvācitā | kriyā ca sādhanavyāpārāsvabhāvā prasṛtāvayavā sādhyā siddhasvabhāvadravyavilakṣaṇeti sādhyopayoginīnāṃ śaktīnāmanāśrayaḥ | siddhasvabhāvānāṃ cārthānāmanyonyopakāre sādhanaśaktiprabhāvitaḥ śeṣasambandhaḥ, na tu sādhyasvarūpāyāḥ kriyāyā iti nāsti kriyāvācina ākyātāt tṛtīyā | kriyāvācinastṛtīyāsamarthatāvirodhapratipādanatātparyāccāprātipadikatvaṃ tiṅantasyānupāttam, arthavirodhādeva tṛtīyānupapatteḥ siddhatvāt | yadyapi ca tulyārthe vatividhānāt tannimittā śeṣaviṣayaiveha tṛtīyā sambhāvyate, tathāpi sarvathā'sambhavamākhyātuṃ sādhane'pi tṛtīyopanyastā | nanu ca "karaṇe ca stokālpakṛcchrakatipayasyāsattvavatanasya"  ityasattvabhūtārthābhidhāyino'pi karaṇabhāva uktaḥ | sarvathā'sattvabhūtatve kriyāṃ prati sādhanatvāyogāt karaṇabhāvo'ghaṭamānaḥ syāditi dharmamātravacano'tra vivakṣitaḥ | dharmamātrasya hi dravyāyamāṇasya svenātmanā siddhatvāt karaṇabhāvopapattiḥ | kriyā tu sādhyatvenālabdhasvabhāvā sarvathā nānyatropakārāya prabhavati || 435 ||
pākārayastarhi kriyāvacanāstṛtīyāsamarthā bhaviṣyantītyata āha-- pākādastṛtīyāntāḥ sattvadharmasamanvayāt | na kriyetyapadiśyante kṛtvorthapratyaye yathā || 436 ||
dhātvarthasiddhatāyāṃ ghañādīnāṃ vidhānād dravyadharmeṇa siddhatvena yogānna tadantāḥ kriyābhidhāyina ityākhyāyante | ata evaiṣāmakriyāvacanatvāllapiṅgasaṅkhyāsamanvayopapattau kṛdabhihito bhāvo dravyavadityucyate | siddhatā ca kriyādharmo na dravyaṃ bhavatīti dravyavaditi vatinirdeśaḥ | upasaṃhṛtasādhanavyāpāratvāt siddhāvasthā sādhyatvābhāvānna kriyā, apitu bhūtapūrvayā kriyayā vyapadiśyate taddharma iti | na tu siddhatāyāmeva sādhyātāsti, virodhād yaugapadyāsambhavāt | evañca kṛtvā ghañādyantaprayoge kriyāvyāvṛttigaṇane vācye ye pratyayāste na bhavanti | pañcakṛtvaḥ pākaḥ, dviḥ pāka iti | ataścābhyāvṛttigrahaṇaṃ pañca pākā ityetad vyavacchedārtham | anyathā dharmadharmiṇorabhedapratipattyā syādatra kriyāgaṇanāt prāptiḥ | sādhyasya tvarthasyāvyāvṛttyā punaḥ punaḥ pravṛttirūpayā yogaḥ | yadi ca ghañādivācyaḥ sādhyaḥ syāt, so'pyavyāvṛttiviṣayaiḥ pratyayairyujyate | na ca yujyate | tasmādatra kṛtvorthapratyayaviṣaye tadanutpattyaiva yathā pākādayo na kriyāvacanā iti niścīyante, tathā sarvatraiṣā kriyābhidhāyitvābhāvo nyāyasiddha ityarthaḥ || 436 ||
evaṃ tarhi tumunaḥ svārthe vidhānāt kriyāvāci tadantaṃ prātipadikamasti | tathā ca pañcakṛtvo gantumiti kṛtvorthapratyayayogastumunantasya | ye ca tumunnarthe vidhīyante k‌tvāprabhṛtayaḥ, te'pi sādhyārthavācino yujyante ca kṛtvorthairdvirbhuk‌tvetyāśaṅkyāha-- ye cāvyayakṛtaḥ kecit kriyādharmasamarnvitāḥ | teṣāmasattvācitvaṃ tiṅntairna viśiṣyate || 437 ||
yānyetānyavyayāni kṛdantāni, teṣāṃ bhāvyamānarūpo'rtho vācya ityākhyātatulyāste tadvadeva tṛtīyayā na yujyanta ityarthaḥ | prātipadikārthamātre tu prathamātra na virudhyate || 437 ||
kṛtyādivācyā tarhi kriyā svena rūpeṇa satī kriyāntarasādhanaṃ syāditi yujyate tṛtīyayetyata āha-- kṛtvasujviṣayā yāpi śayitavyādiṣu kriyā | upamānopameyatva tatrāpyantamasambhavi || 438 ||
pañcakṛtvaḥ śayitavyamiti kṛtvorthapratyayadarśanād yadyapi śayitavyādayaḥ sādhyasvabhāvakriyāvacanāḥ tathāpyatra viṣaye upamānopameyabhāvāsambhavānnaite kriyāvācinastṛtīyāntāḥ prakṛtitvenātrābhīṣṭā ityarthaḥ | nanu ca dhātunaiva sādhyā kriyopātteti śayitavyādau kānyā vyatiriktā kriyāpratyayārthaḥ syāt | na caite pratyayāḥ svārthikāḥ | `tayoreva kṛtyaktakhalarthāḥ" iti bhāvakarmaṇorvidhānāt | atra pratipādyate--iha dhātuḥ kṛdviṣayāṃ sādhanamavacchindantīṃ kriyāmavasthāntaraparidṛṣṭena bhāvyatvenopalakṣitāmāha, na vartamānena bhāvyatvenopalakṣitām | tataśca pratyayopāttasavyāpārasādhanasambandhādabhivyajyate bhāvyatā vartamānakriyāyāḥ | tadyadhā--`pacati devadatta'ityatra lakāravācyakartṛsambandhād dhātvartho bhāvyatāṃ bhajate | evaṃ pācaka ityādau | itthaṃ cāsyate devadattenetyatrāpi lakāravācyabhāvanāsambandhād dhātvartho bhāvyatāmanubhavatīti vyatirikto bhāvo lakāravācyaḥ, sa eva kṛtyādiṣvanuvartate | `kṛtvā śayitavyam' ityādāvapi bhāve pratyayavidhiriti bāhyo'yaṃ pratyayavācyo bhāvaḥ || 438 ||
kathamatrātyantamupamānopameyabhāvāsambhava ityāha-- na kevalau dravyaguṇau tadvān vāpyupamīyate | śayitavyādibhisteṣu nopamārtho'sti kaścana || 439 ||
śayitavyādivācyayā kriyayā dravyaṃ vopamīyeta, guṇo vā śuddhaḥ, tadvān dravyavān guṇī veti pakṣabhedāḥ | tatra svenātmanā siddhatvānna dravyamupameyam, nahi śayitavyena tulyo devadatta iti kriyādravyayoḥ kaścidanvayī dharmaḥ sādṛśyanimittamasti| nāpi śayitavyena tulyaṃ devadattasya svamiti dravyavataḥ kaścidupamārthaḥ | nāpi śayitavyena tulyaḥ sthūlaḥ, śayitavyena tulyaṃ sthaulyamiti guṇaguṇinoraupamyaṃ vidyate, kriyayā sādṛśyahetudharmābhāvāt, prasiddhaguṇakriyāhetuko hyupamānopameyabhāvaścandramukhādau dṛṣṭaḥ, na ceha tathā prasiddhiḥ || 439 ||
tatraitat syāt--sannapi kriyādravyaguṇādeḥ samāno dharmo'tra na prayujyata iti sadṛśadharmāntarābhidhāyinaḥ śabdasyāprayogādupamānopameyabhāvānavagama iti | naitad yuktamityāha-- upamānopameyatve dravye cānuktadharmiṇi | nimittatvena gamyante rūḍhayogāḥ kriyāguṇāḥ || 440 ||
anabhihite'pi sadṛśe dharme prasiddhivaśādupamānopameyabhāvanimittatvena guṇakriyā nirūḍhasambandhāḥ padārthaikadeśabhāvāpannā ivāvinābhāvinaḥ pratīyanta eveti na te niyamena śrutimapekṣante | tathāhi--candravanmukhamasyā ityukte priyadarśanatvaṃ kāntimattvaṃ cāśrutamapi pratīyata ityuktameva | evamihāpi śayitavyena tulya ityukte pratīyeta kaściddharmo yadyupamā yujyeta || 440 ||
evaṃ tarhi kriyāyāṃ pratyāsannaḥ kriyāvānupamīyata ityata āha-- hotavyasadṛśo hotetyatrāpyartho na vidyate | virodhāt kriyayā tasmāt kriyāvān nopamīyate || 441 ||
śayitavyena tulyaḥ śāyakaḥ, hotavyena tulyo hoteti kṛtyāntena kriyāvacanena svāśrayaḥ kriyāvānupameyo na yujyate | kriyā hi sādhyasvabhāvā siddhasvabhāvena saha viruddhatvānna sambandhakṣamā | sādhyatvena cāprāptasvarūpā kriyā paraṃ kathaṃ prajñāpayet | samānaguṇayogāccaupamyam, atyantabhedaśca kriyādravyayorityatrāpyartha upamāyāṃ prayojanaṃ nāsti || 441 ||
evaṃ tarhi samānatvāt kriyayoreva sākṣādupamānopameyabhāvo bhavatvityāśaṅkyāha-- kriyā samānajātīya tadbhāvānnopamīyate | jātibhede'pi pākena (vā kena) bhinnāḥ pākādayaḥ kriyāḥ || 442 ||
tulyajātīyā kriyāntarasyopamānaṃ syād, bhinnajātīyā vā ? pūrvatra pakṣe tadbhāvādekātmyānnopameyāḥ kriyāḥ | tathāhi--śayitavyena tulyaṃ śayitavyam, adhyetavyena tulyamadhyetavyamityatyantābhede gauriva gauritivannopamārthaḥ kaścit | tathā ca bhāṣyakāraḥ--`yadi yadevopamānaṃ tadevopameyam, ka ihopamārtho gauriva gauḥ' iti | bhinnā api hyarthā ekajātyāveśenāvadhāryamāṇā nopamām, bhedāśrayatvāt tasyetyāśayaḥ | dvatīye tu pakṣe'tyanbhedānnopamārthaḥ,, nahi bhavati vaktavyena tulyaṃ paṭhitavyamiti | jātibhedādeva jñāte hi bhede bhinnā iti punarvacanamupamānahetoḥ samānadharmasyāsambhavasūcanārtham | bhinnajātīye hi samānadharmābhāvānnopamārthaḥ | tathā ca bhāṣyam--`athānyadupamānamanyadupameyam | ka ihopamārtho gaurivāśvaḥ' iti | evaṃ na kenacit prakāreṇopamānopameyatvamatretyatyantāsambhavītyuktam | guṇaleśenāpi yadapi sāmyam, tadapīha na sambhavatītyatyantagrahaṇenācaṣṭe | nāpi bhinnajātīyatve'pi kriyayā dravyaguṇādīnāṃ sattvajñeyatvādibhirdharmaiḥ sādṛśyamāśrityopamā kalpata iti vācyaṃ, sattvādidharmāṇāṃ sarvārthasādhāraṇyānna nimittatvamupamāyāmatra pratyaye sambhavatīti pūrvapakṣabhāṣyaṃ vyākhyātam || 442 ||
atredānīṃ śayitavyādigatānāṃ sajātīyānāṃ kriyāṇāmupamānopameyabhāvanimittabhūtaṃ bhedamupapādayitumāha-- ādhārabhedād bhinnāyāmupamānasya sambhavaḥ | adhyetavyena viprāṇāṃ tulyamadhyayanaṃ viśām || 443 ||
tulyacātīyāyāḥ kriyāyā āśrayabhūtadravyabhedād viśeṣajātyanugamācca sāmye bhedābhedaprayuktasyopamātvasyāsti sambhavaḥ | tathāhi--brāhmaṇānāmadhyetavyena sadṛśamidaṃ kṣatriyādīnāmadhyayanam, rājñaḥ śayitavyena tulyaṃ devadattasya śayitavyamiti prayogo dṛṣṭaḥ || 443 ||
nanu cātra kriyāvacanaḥ śabdo bhedapratipattaye adhikaraṇamapekṣamāṇaḥ sāpekṣatvādasamartho bhavannānubhavati taddhitavṛttimityāśaṅkyāha-- arthāt prakaraṇād vāpi yatropekṣyaṃ pratīyate | sāmarthyādanapekṣasya tasya vṛttiḥ prasajyate || 444 ||
yasmin viṣaye sāmarthyāt kutaścit prastāvād vā yadāpekṣaṇīya ādhāro nirjñāto bhavati, tadādhyetavyādereva śabdāśrayaviśeṣāvacchedasyāvagamāt tadvācakapadaprayogamantareṇānapekṣo'sāvanubhavet sāmarthyanibandhanāṃ vṛttim | brāhmaṇādhyetavyena tulyaṃ kṣatriyādhyetavyam, rājñaḥ śayitavyena tulyaṃ devadattaśayitavyamityatra ca samāse kṛte bhedābhāvādekārthībhāve sati sopakṣatvābhāvaḥ | tathā sthātavyena tulyaṃ gamanam, mandatvāt, nṛttena tulyaṃ gamanaṃ bahuvikāratvāditi bhinnajātīyā nāmapi kriyāṇāmastyevopamānopameyabhāvaḥ | kṛdabhihitasya ca bhāvasya na kevalaṃ dravyavadbhāvaḥ, kriyāvadbhāvo'pi dṛśyate | tathāhi--bhoktuṃ pākaḥ, bod‌dhuṃ pāṭhaḥ, kārakasya gatiriti kriyāyāmupapadabhūtāyāṃ vidhīyamānau tumun‌ṇvulau dṛśyete ghañādyanteṣvapyupapadeṣviti teṣāṃ kriyādharmavattvaniścayaḥ|| 444 ||
nanu cātra dhātubhāgavācyakriyāśrayeṇa tumun‌ṇvulau bhaviṣyataḥ | naitadasti, pratyayavācyāyāḥ kriyāgatāyā nirvṛttereva sutarāṃ bhojanādyarthatvāt | yadyevaṃ kriyāśabdenopapadasya nirdeśe kathaṃ siddharūpatā, taddharmo'pyupapadatvena gṛhyate | dharmadharmiṇorabhedāśreyaṇa kriyāśabdena dharmasyāpi pratyāyanamaviruddhamityadoṣaḥ | evaṃ tarhi kṛttvorthapratyayā api kathaṃ na bhavanti ghañādyantaprayogāt ? ucyate, abhyāvṛttigrahaṇāt tatra kriyā kartavyatātmakena svenaiva rūpeṇopayujyate, na siddhatayā, nirvṛttasyānirvartyatayā punaḥ pravṛttyayogāt | tataścākhyātaprayogamantareṇa tatra kriyāyāḥ kartavyatānavagamādabhyāvṛttyabhāvāt pratyayābhāvaḥ | ākhyātaprayoge tu vākyaparisamāptiḥ, statrākhyātasya sādhyasvabhāvakriyābhidhāyitvāditi tadāśrayaḥ kṛtvorthapratyayo bhavati, pañcakṛtvaḥ pāko vartata iti | nanu ca dharmadharmiṇorabhedāśrayeṇa bhoktuṃ pāka iti kriyopapadanimittaḥ pratyayo bhavatu, nirvṛtterbhojanārthatvāpapatteḥ | tathā ca samanvayaḥ padānām | odanasya pāka ityādau tu kathaṃ karmaṇā samanvayaḥ, pratyārthatvena pradhānabhūtasya siddhatākhyasya sādhanasaṃbandhānupapatteḥ | sādhyasyaiva hi kārakairyogaḥ | satyam, upasarjanabhūtadhātvarthadvārakastu karmayogaḥ | yadyevamabhyāvṛttyāpyupasarjanabhūtasādhyasvabhāvadhātvarthadvāreṇāstu yogaḥ | na bhavati, virodhāt | tathāhi pradhānasyārthāntaraiḥ saṃbandho guṇadharmeṇa svabhāvavirodhinā na bhavati | abhyāvṛttirhi siddhatāvirodhinī, nivṛttasya punaḥ pravṛttyayogāt tadvācyamapi kriyā tṛtīyāntā saṃbhavatyatropamānabhūtā pratyayārtha ityāha-- tailāpākena tulye ca dhṛtapāke vivakṣite | kriyāvadapi kāryāṇāṃ darśanāt pratyayo bhavet || 445 ||
na kevalaṃ kṛdabhihitasya bhāvasya dravyavat kāryāṇi liṅgasaṃkhyāyogalakṣaṇāni dṛśyante;yāvat tumunnādīnīti pradarśitam | evañca tailapākena tulyo ghṛtapāka iti tṛtīyāsamarthāt kriyāvācino vatirbhavet | sāpekṣatvaṃ cātra nāsti, ekapadopāttatvādadhārasya || 445 ||
ghañādyanta upapade kriyāvat kāryayostumun‌ṇavulorbhāva vārttikakāramataṃ saṃvādakamāha-- atiṅ‌grahaṇamevaṃ tu samāsasya nivartakam | gamanaṃ kārakasyeti ṇvulyanyasminna saṃbhavet || 446 ||
"upapadamatiṅ" ityatra supasupetyadhikārāt tiṅntasyopapadasya kārako vrajatītyādau samāsaprāptireva nāstīti kimatiṅiti pratiṣedheneti codite sati vākyakāraḥ papāṭha--`upapadamatiṅiti tadarthapatiṣedhaḥ' iti | tacchabdena tiṅaḥ parāmarśaḥ | tasyārtho yasya tasyāya subantasya saṃbhavatīti sāmarthyāduṣṭramukhavadupamānagarbhaḥ samāsaḥ | tasyevārtho yasyeti kriyārthasyetyuktaṃ bhavati| atiṅityarthapradhāno nirdeśaḥ ityarthaḥ | ata eva spaṣṭamidaṃ paṭhitavyamityāha--`kriyāpratiṣedho vā' iti | upapadamakriyetyeva vivakṣitārthapratipādakaḥ spaṣṭaḥ sūtranyāsaḥ kartavya ityarthaḥ | evañca yat kriyāpradhānaṃ subantamupapadam, tasya samāsaprāptau pratiṣedho'yaṃ saṃpadyate | tadyathā--kārakasya gatiḥ, kārakasya gamanam, kārakasya brajyetyudāhṛtam | etacca kathamupapadyate yadi gatyādyupapadeṣu tumun‌ṇvulau bhavataḥ | anyathā siddhatāvacanatvāt tadabhāve kathamidaṃ samāsapratiṣedhasya prayojanaṃ syāt ? na cānyasmin "ṇvultṛcau"iti sāmānyalakṣaṇena yo vihitastatra ṇvuli tadantena kriyāvacanasya samāsaniṣedho'yamupapadyate, tatropapadasyābhāvāt | kriyāvacanasya samāsaprāptavasatyāṃ pratiṣedhasyānarthakatvāt | tadevaṃ kārakagatirityādau gatyādeḥ subantatvādupapadasamāsasya prasaṅgādupapadyamānaḥ pratiṣedho ghañādyanteṣūpapadeṣu kriyākāryaṃ tumunṇvulādi jñāpayati, na tu gatyādyartharūpatvanibandhanamasya siddharūpasyārthasya kriyātvamavagamayati, vastusvabhāvaviparyayakhyāpanasyāśakyatvāt || 446 ||
taditthaṃ śayitavyādīnāṃ pākadīnāṃ ca kriyāvacanānāmatra tṛtīyāsamarthatopapattāvāpi kenāśayena `naiṣa doṣaḥ | sarva ete guṇaśabdā samudāyeṣu vartante' ityādyupakramya `samudāyeṣu vṛttā śabdā avayaveṣvapi vartante' iti brāhmaṇādīnāṃ śabdānāmadhyayanādilakṣaṇakriyāmātravṛttitvāśrayeṇa yat tṛtīyāsamarthaṃ kriyā cet sā bhavatīti prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇapakṣo bhāṣyakāreṇa samarthita ityāśaṅkyāha-- sarvasya parihārārthaṃ samudāyatvamāśritam | śuddhāyāḥ saṃbhavānnasyāt kriyāyā brāhmaṇādiṣu || 447 ||
saṃbhavatyapi hotavyādau kriyāvācini tṛtīyasamarthe yadarthasya samudāyatvam `sarva ete śabdā guṇasamudāye vartante' ityāśritaṃ bhāṣyakāreṇa siddhāntatayā tatrāyamāśayaścūrṇīkṛtaḥ sarvasādhāraṇaḥ parihāro yathā syāditi | anyathā śuddhāyāḥ kevalāyāḥ śayita vyādipadopādānāyāḥ kriyāyāḥ pratyayaprakṛtitvena tṛtīyāsamarthāyāḥ saṃbhavād brāhmaṇādiśabdaviṣaye vatipratyayo na syād brāhṇavadadhīte kṣatriya ityādau | brāhmaṇādiśabdohyupacārādekadeśavṛttyā kriyāvācī | hotavyapākādiśabdastu mukhyayā vṛttyā kriyābhidhāyīti sati mukhye viṣaye kuto gauṇaparigrahaḥ syāt | nanvevaṃ samudāyaikadeśabhāvakalpanayāpi kriyāvacanasamarthane saṃbhavati mukhye viṣaye kathaṃ gauṇaparigraha iti kathaṃ na codyate | vyāpternyāyāt sarvasya parigraha ityadoṣaḥ | yadvā, kriyāyāstṛtīyāsamarthatāmanupapannāmabhyupagamya prakārāntareṇa pratisamādadhataścūrṇīkārasyāsaṃbhavaḥ eva śuddhakriyāvacanasya tṛtīyāsamarthasyetyāśayaḥ || 447 ||
tathāhi-- upamānavivakṣāyāṃ svadharmaśca nivartate | kriyāyā na śrutād yasmādupamānaṃ samāpyate || 448 ||
pākādipadopādānāyāḥ kriyāyā upamānatvenāpekṣāyāṃ svo dharmaḥ svabhāvasattvabhūtatvalakṣaṇo nivartate, yato nopamānasya śravaṇamātrāt tattvaṃ paripūrṇaṃ bhavati || 448 ||
anvayidharmāpekṣāyāṃ tattvād apekṣyatāṃ tarhyanvayidharmaḥ | kimetāvatā upamānabhūtāyāḥ svadharmo'paitītyata āha-- tṛtīyā'pyāśrito bhedo dharmaḥ sādhāraṇo dvayoḥ | vyāpāravān na kṛtsnasya sāmyaṃ kṛtsnena vidyate || 449 ||
tṛtīyaḥ svābhāvavyavasthārthamupamānopameyābhyāmapekṣito yo viśeṣo'parasmād vyāvṛttastayordvayoḥ samānaḥ so'pi nodāsīna evāpekṣyate, yenākiñcitkaratvāt tasya svadharmānna kriyāpeyāt | kiṃtu vyāpāravān, dvayoḥ samavāyāt | tathā ca kriyāyāmāśritatvādupamānatvasya saṃpādane vyagro vyāpṛta iti samānadharmādhāratvena kriyā viprakīryamāṇatvāt sādhyasvabhāvādapaiti | svātantryeṇa dravyāyamāṇā hi svāśritadharmavaśādupameyaparicchedasaṃpādanāṅgabhāvagamanāt siddhatayātmānamuddarśayet | nahi svabhāva eva rūpe'vasthitāyāḥ kriyāyāḥ prajñāpanahetutvamupameyaṃ prati yujyate, aniṣpannasya paraṃ pratyaṅgabhāvāyogāt | itthañca tailapākādiridaṃ taditi pratyavamṛṣṭaḥ samānadharmādhāratāṃ pratipadyata itidravyamasau, hotavyādiśca sauṣṭhavāditulyadharmāśrayo'pi tathaiveti na kriyāvāci etattṛtīyāntamasyāmavasthāyam | nahīha vāstavena rūpeṇa kriyādravyādiḥ padārtho varṇyate, api tu siddhasādhyatādirūpeṇa śabdavācyena | tathāhyeko'pi dhvaniḥ kriyāguṇadravyarūpatayābhidhīyate | dhvanati ghaṇṭeti kramopajātāvayavaḥ śabdasantānaḥ pūrvāparībhūtaḥ sādhanapratibaddhotpādo yadā vivakṣyate, tadeyaṃ kriyāviprasṛtāvayavā dhvanatītyākhyātenābhidhīyate | yadā tu kāraṇāntaranirāsārthaṃ saṃbandhinyā ghaṇṭayā viśeṣyate `ghaṇṭāyā dhvaniḥ'-iti, tadā niṣpannarūpo'sau guṇaḥ subantena śabdenocyate | dhvanitvamityatra tu bhāva pratyayāntena śabdena dravyabhāvāpanno jāterguṇībhūtaḥ prātipadikārthaḥ kathyate | dhvanati śabda iti ca kārakaśaktiyuktaḥ sa evārtho'bhidhīyate | vyaktavarṇasya cātra kartṛtvamavyaktasya sādhyatvamityanavasthitā vyākaraṇe padārthāḥ | tasmāt kriyāpadādapi na sākṣātkriyā sādhyasvabhāvātra pratīyate, api tu siddha svābhāveti dravyamevaitaditi subantaṃ na kriyāvācyasti | ākhyātameva tathā | tataścāprātipadikatvāt tṛtīyā nāsti | ata eva ca nāmākhyātabhedena siddhasādhyārthabhedād dvidhā padaṃ saṃkṣepeṇoktam |tatraitat syāt | kasmāt samāno'rtha dharmo vyāpāravānityata uktam na kṛtsnasyetyādi | sakalasyārthasya sakalena sarvadharmāṇaṃ sāmye bhedābhāvānna sāmyaṃ sādṛśyamupamānopameyabhāvādhāyi saṃbhavati, bhedābhedābhyāṃ tadupapatteruktatvāditi || 449 ||
sādhāraṇo dharmo bhedābhedābhyāmatra savyāpāra eva bhavatu | dravyeṇa siddharūpeṇāsāvapekṣyate, na sādhyasvabhāvayā kriyayā upamānabhūtayetyāśaṅkyāha-- dravye vāpi kriyāyāṃ vā nimittāt tat prakalpate | kriyāṇāṃ vidyamānatvād vṛttirna syād gavādiṣu || 450 ||
taditi pūrvaprakāntaṃ sāmyaṃ nirdiśyate | dravyaṃ vā bhavatu, kriyā vārthāntaraprajñāpanenopamām, sarvathā sādṛśyanibandhanatvādarthanāṃ sāmyasya taddheturnimittaṃ sādhāraṇo dharmo'nveṣyaḥ | tathāhi--śuddhaṃ svātmāvasthaṃ dravyamarthāntarasyopameyasya paricchedakaṃ na saṃbhavatīti tadarthaṃ samānaṃ guṇamākāṅkṣati | tato hi nimittāt sāmyena paricchedaḥ saṃbhavati | evaṃ kriyāpyanapekṣitasamānadharmā nopakārāyārthāntarasya prajñāpanīyasya prabhavatītyavaśyamapekṣaṇīyaṃ nimittamanayāpi | tathā ca dravyāyamāṇeyaṃ kriyātvaṃ jahāti | sādhanavyāpārāvasthāpratipattaye hi nirvartyamānā prādhānyenopadīyamānā kriyā bhavati | yadā tu sādhanavyāpārāvasthā kathayituṃ na prakṛtā, nāpi kriyā pratilabdhaprādhānyenopādīyate, kintu dharmāntaraṃ pratyāśrayabhūtā sādhanavyāpāranirapekṣopādīyate, tadā vyāpārānapekṣayā dharmāntarāṇāmāśrayabhūtatvena cedaṃ taditi vyapadeśyaṃ dravyamevocyate, na kriyāsau | yadi punaranapekṣitanimittānāṃ svarūpādeva kriyāṇāmupamānatvaṃ yujyate, tadāsāṃ śuddhānāmupamānabhūtānāṃ saṃbhavāt kimarthaṃ gauṇakriyāvacanagavādiśabdaviṣaye vatipratyayo bhavet | saṃbhavati mukhye viṣaye gauṇaparigrahasyāyyatvāditi `govat, brāhmaṇavat' iti prayogo na syāt || 450 ||
yadā tu sādhāraṇadharmāśrayaiṇaupamyaṃ bhavati, tadā kriyābhirapi dharmāntarāṇāmapekṣaṇāduktanayena svarūpahānāmukhye viṣaye'sambhavati gauṇāśrayaṇaṃ yuktamityāha-- abhāvāt kevalāyāstu tadvānarthaḥ pratīyate | pradhānāsambhave yuktā lakṣaṇārthā kriyāśrutiḥ || 451 ||
kramavyatikrame prayojanābhāvāt prathamaśrutaṃ tenetyetat kriyopādhinā yadā sambadhyate, tadā prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇapakṣe'pi yathoditanayena śuddhāyāḥ kriyāyāḥ sambhavo nāstīti śrautārthaparityāge lākṣaṇiko'rthaḥ samāśrīyate | svādhāreṇa nityamaviyogācca kriyāyāḥ sa evāvinābhāvitayā lakṣyata iti tṛtīyāsamarthaṃ kriyāviṣṭadravyavacanamāśrīyate | tataścaikadeśavṛttyā brāhmaṇādayaḥ kriyāvacanāḥ prakṛtiḥ | tadvadeva śayitavyādayo'pi || 451 ||
teṣamapi hyatropamānatve brāhmaṇādibhiḥ sarvathā sāmānyamityāha-- kriyādharmāntareṣu sāpekṣāḥ kriyāśabdāḥ kriyāntare | upakārāya gṛhyante yathaiva brāhmaṇādayaḥ || 452 ||
kriyāntare'nyasyāṃ kriyāyāṃ kṣatriyādhyetavyādilakṣaṇāyāmupakārāya sādṛśyena paricchedāya kriyāśabdā upamānavacanā brāhmaṇādyetavyādayaḥ kriyāntareṣūpamānahetusoṣṭhavādiṣu sākāṅkṣāḥ prayujyante | ataśca yathādyayanādisādṛṣyahetukriyāpekṣā brāhmaṇādayaḥ śabdāḥ kṣatriyādipariccedāyopādīyante, tathaita iti sarvaprakāraṃ kriyāśabdānāṃ dravyavacanairupamānatvaṃ sāmyamityubhaye'pi vṛttimanubhavantītyarthaḥ || 452 ||
tatraitat syāt--kriyāpyupamānatvenopādīyamānā yadi dharmāntarāpekṣiṇī, tadānavasthātretyāśaṅkya nidarśanapūrvakaṃ tāmabhyupagantumāha-- yathā prakarṣaḥ sarvatra nimittāntarahetukaḥ | dravyavad guṇaśabde'pi sa nimittamapekṣate || 453 ||
`na vai dravyasya svataḥ prakarṣāpakarṣau staḥ' iti nirupādheratiśayābhāvāt saṃsargidharmāntaranimittaḥ prakarṣo'sya vyavasthāpitaḥ | śuklataraḥ paṭa iti svasamavāyiśuklaguṇahetuko'tiśayaḥ | evaṃ yadāsau śuklo guṇo'tiśayavattvena vivakṣyate, tadā dravyāyamāṇaḥ svaśabdenābhihito bhāsvaratādisvagatanimittāpekṣastathocyate śuklataramasyarūpamiti || 453 ||
atraivārthe nidarśanāntaramāha-- yo ya uccāryate śabdaḥ sa svarūpanibandhanaḥ | yathā tathopamāneṣu vyapekṣā na nivartate || 454 ||
iha karaṇasanniveśī parigṛhītakramaḥ śabdo vācakaḥ `agnimantodāttamadhīṣva' iti | tasya ca nirupādhervācakatāyoga iti svarūpakramamupādhitvenāsāvāśrayati | tathā ca tadadhiṣṭhānāḥ śrutayaḥ pratyāyyamarthamabhiniviśanta iti brahmakāṇḍe'bhihitam | tadeva ca saṃhṛtakramaṃ svarūpamasyābhidheyamatrārthamapi svarūpācchuritaṃ śabdo vaktīti nirṇītacaram | tatra karaṇasaṃniveśinaḥ svarūpācchuritasya vācakatve prayogasthaṃ vācyaṃ svarūpam | tadapi yadā karaṇopārohi, tadāpyaparaṃ vācyaṃ saṃhṛtakramaṃ svarūpamasyābhidheyamatrārthamapi svarūpacchuritaṃ śabdo vaktīti nirṇītacaram | tatra karaṇasaṃniveśinaḥ svarūpācchuritasya vācakatve prayogasthaṃ vācyaṃ svarūpam | tadapi yadā karaṇopārohi, tadāpyaparaṃ vācyaṃ saṃhṛtakramaṃ kalpayitavyamiti sarvatra tritayamanvayi, nimittaṃ tadvānabhidheyaṃ ceti | tadeva vīpsayā sārvatrikatvena darśayati--yo ya iti | yadapi hi pravṛttinimittaṃ svarūpaṃ, tadapi yadā karaṇasanniveśi bhavati tadāparaṃ pravṛttinimittamavaśyāpekṣyam, nirupādhervācakatvābhāvāditi kṛtanirṇayametat kāṇḍāntare, pūrvamihāpīti punariha na vitanyate | evaṃ yathā prakarṣe dharmāntarasya yāvat sambhavo vacasastāvat parikalpanaṃ svarūpe ca svarūpāntarasya, tathaupamye'pi tannimittasya prakalpanādupamānamupameyaṃ tayośca sādhāraṇo dharma iti sarvatra tritayamaparihāryam | ataśca brāhmaṇavat kṣatriyo'dhīta ityadhyayanaṃ sādhāraṇo dharmaḥ | tasyāpyupamānatve brāhmaṇādhyayanena kṣatriyādhyayanaṃ tulyamiti soṣṭhavādidharmāntaraṃ sādhāraṇaṃ kalpyam | tasyāpyupamānatve'nyaditi śabdavyāpāroparamānnivṛtternānavastheyaṃ mūlakṣatikarī, paryavasānasambhavāt || 454 ||
tadevaṃ śuddhāyāḥ kriyāyāstṛtīyāsamarthāyā asambhava iti pūrvapakṣabhāṣyaṃ samarthitam | idānīm `atraivedamayuktaṃ vartate' iti yad bhāṣyam, tat pūrvapakṣasamarthānuvādena gamayati-- kiyāvṛttestṛtīyāntasyaitaccāsaṃgate sati | prasiddhanyāyakaraṇo bhāṣye yujirudāhṛtaḥ || 455 ||
idamayuktaṃ vartata iti yujikriyāyāḥ karaṇaṃ kimiti nopāttamiti codye kathyate prasiddhatvāt karaṇasya bhāṣyakāreṇānupādānaṃ vacanenetyarthaḥ | tathāhi--tṛtīyāntasya kriyāvacanasyoktena nyāyenāsambhavaḥ pratipādita iti nyāyalakṣaṇamatra karaṇaṃ prasiddheḥ sākṣānna nirdiṣṭam, tena nyāyenāyuktamityarthaḥ | yat kila kriyāsvarūpamāsarthyaparyālocanayā sādhanamavagamyate, tasya svaśabdenopādānamanādṛtam | tadyathā--arhanniti viśiṣṭameva karma satkārādi pratīyata iti na svaśabdenopādīyate | varṣatīti ca prasiddheḥ karmaṇo'karmikeyaṃ kriyoktā, kartāpi cātra prasiddha iti na svaśabdenāvaśyaṃ kathyate deva iti || 455 ||
yastu manyate--antarbhūtamatra kriyāsvarūpa eva nyāyalakṣaṇaṃ karaṇamiti na prayogamarhatīti, tanmataṃ nirasyati-- antarbhūte tu karaṇe prayogo na punarbhavet | nyāyenāyuktamityatra jīvatau prāṇakarmavat || 456 ||
yathā jīvati prāṇān dhārayati, jāyate'styātmānaṃ bibhartīti prāṇādilakṣaṇasya karmaṇaḥ kriyāsvarūpe'ntarbhāvajjīvati prāṇān, astyātmānamiti prayogo na bhavati, evaṃ nyāyalakṣaṇasya karaṇasya yujāvantarbhāve nyāyenāyuktamupapattyā'yuktamiti na kadācit prayogo bhavet | bahirbhūtaṃ hi sādhanaṃ kriyāyāḥ pṛthak prayogamarhati, nāntarbhūtam | tasmāt prasiddhirevātra karaṇasyāprayoge'nusaraṇīyā | etaccānvākhyānasamayapālanāya kathyate, yuktamityasya śabdasyānvākhyāne yujikriyā prakṛtyarthaḥ, karaṇaṃ nyāya iti || 456 ||
paramārthataḥ punarnirastāvayavavibhāgo'yaṃ śabdo nātra kācid yujikriyā, yasyāḥ karaṇamucyeta, vyutpattikarmaṇi kevalaṃ kriyeyaṃ parikalpyata ityāha-- śāstrābhyāsāya bhedo'yamayuktamiti varṇyate | aśobhanamasambaddhamiti rūḍhirvyavasthitā || 457 ||
anvākhyāne vyutpattinimittamanuguṇāyā yujikriyāyā asyā upādānādakaraṇikāyā asyā asambhavāt prasiddho nyāyaḥ karaṇaṃ sākṣānnopāttamiti bhāṣyakārābhiprāyo'yamasmābhirvyākhyāyate | prayoge tu laukike nirastāvayavavibhāgo'śobhanamasambaddhamanyāyyamaśliṣṭamayuktaśabdaḥ pratipādayatīti nātra yujikriyā kācidityanenaivāśayena bhāṣyakāraḥ karaṇaṃ nātra niradikṣat || 457 ||
tadevaṃ kriyāvācinastṛtīyāntasyābhāvāt prakṛtyarthaviśeṣamapakṣākṣepaḥ | asambhava eva tvasya pakṣasyeti pratipādayitumāha-- vivibhaktiḥ prakṛtyarthaṃ pratyupādhiḥ kathaṃ bhavet | vibhaktipariṇāme ca prakalpyaṃ viṣayāntaram || 458 ||
teneti tṛtīyāsamarthā prakṛtiratra pradhānaṃ viśeṣyatvāt | tadarthamuddiśya kriyetyayamupādhiḥ prathamāntatvena bhinnavibhaktiḥ kathamupapadyate, sāmānādhikaraṇyābhāvāt | `arthaviśeṣa upādhistadantavācyaḥ samānaśabdo yaḥ' iti hi samānādhikaraṇo'rtha upādhitvena lakṣitaḥ | tadyathā--dṛtihariḥ paśuḥ | daṇḍaḥ praharaṇamasyāṃ dāṇḍā | `sāsya devatā'  iti prājāpatya ityādi | viśeṣaṇaṃ tvavacchedakamātralakṣaṇaṃ vivibhaktamapi bhavati | yathā gārgikayā ślāghata iti ślāghā | tatraitat syāt, sanbandhānyathānupapattyā vibhaktivipariṇāmaḥ kalpyata iti | tacca na, śrutasya prathamāntatvasyedamevotpattivākyamityanyatra kṛtārthatvābhāvāt kathaṃ vipariṇāmaḥ ? vipariṇāme hi viṣayāntaraṃ prakalpyam, yatra kṛtārthatvaṃ syāt, anyathā prathamāntaśruterniṣphalatā syāt | ūhanyāyo hi pariṇāmaḥ | catra ca prakṛtau śratasya vikṛtāvanyathātvaṃ nyāyyam || 458 ||
etadevopapādayati-- vibhak‌tyantarayogo hi yasya tadviṣayāntare | vibhak‌tyantarasambandhaḥ sāmarthyādanumīyate || 459 ||
sārūpyāt tu tadevedamiti tatropacaryate | śabdāntare vibhak‌tyā tu yuktaṃ śāstre tadaśrutam || 460 ||
yasya śabdasya śrutā vibhaktiḥ kvacid viṣaye kenacidupakāreṇa samanvayameti, tasyānyasmin yoge sākṣādanirdiṣṭasambandhini prakṛtatvāt svaritaliṅgadapekṣaṇīyatve śrutayaiva vibhak‌tyā samanvayāyoge tadanyathānupapattyā tadanvayayogyavibhak‌tyantarasambandho'nugamyate | tatra ca nityatvācchabdārthasambandhasya nopāttasya śabdasya tadarthasya vānyathābhāvo yujyata iti śabdāntarameva yogayavibhaktiyuktaṃ sākṣādanuccāritamapyutprekṣyate | prakṛtibhāgena tu pūrveṇa sādṛśyādabhedādhyavasāye sa eva śabdo vibhak‌tyantareṇa pariṇamata iti pariṇāmavyavahāraḥ | tadyathā--tadeva kṣīraṃ dadhi jātamiti pariṇāmaḥ | atrāpi hi kṣīradharmāṇāṃ keṣāñcidanvayād bhede'pi kṣīrād dadhnaḥ paridṛśyamāne, pariṇāmavyavahārastadevedamiti ca pratyabhijñānam | evamihāpi pratyayabhāgabhede'pi prakṛtibhāgānvayādabhedādhyavasāyaḥ | itthaṃ ca vibhaktivipariṇāmo bhāvato'nyasyaiva kalpanamūha iti kathamutpattivākya eva śrutasya yujyate ? prakṛtau hyupayuktasya vikṛtāvūho nyāyyaḥ | tathā hi-"bhūvādayo dhātavaḥ"  iti saṃjñāsambandhe dhātava iti prathamāyāḥ śrutāyāścaritārthatve `anudāttaṅita--'  ityādau samanvayānyathānupapattyā pañcamyantaṃ dhātoriti śabdāntaramanumīyate | tasmāduccāryamāṇā vibhaktirupayogavatī kasmiṃścid vākyārthe pradarśanīyā | tato vibhaktivipariṇāmaḥ kalpyate | anyathā yadvibhaktiravayava uccaritastadvibhak‌tyarthāpekṣo vākyārtho yadi nābhipretaḥ, tadā tadvibhak‌tyuccāraṇamanarthakameva syāt | na hyanyathoccārayitavye'nyatoccārayato vaktuḥ kaścid guṇolakṣyate | asambaddhābhidhāyitvameva hi paraṃ syāt | kvacit punarekavibhak‌tyantāntarbhāvatātparyeṇa nirdeśād yathāyathaṃ tadupayogo yujyata eva | tadyathānal‌vidhāviti sarvavibhak‌tyantasamāsaḥ | nānāvibhak‌tyarthayogī hi prātipadikārthaḥ sakṛnnirdeśe'pyatrābhipretaḥ | tathā cārthatantre tatra nirdeśe śrutāyā vibhakternāntarīyakatvamavasthāpya vidhiśabdamantareṇāpi vivakṣitārthalābho varṇitaḥ | iha tu kriyeti niyatatvād vibhak‌tyarthasya naitad yujyate varṇayitum, tṛtīyārthenaiva samanvayasyeṣṭeḥ || 459,460 ||
tataśca tenetyasmāt prathamaṃ prakṛtistṛtīyāntāvagateti tadanurodhāt kriyayetyapi tṛtīyā nirdiśyeta | anyathā prathamānirdeśe pradhānasya tṛtīyāntasya tadanurodhena vipariṇāmābhāvāt kathaṃ samanvaya ityāha-- prakṛtiścet tṛtīyāntā tenetyasmāt pratīyate | kriyeti prathamāntā sā kathaṃ bhavitumarhati || 461 ||
pariṇāmāyogasyopapāditatvād vivibhaktitve kathaṃ sambandha ityuktametat || 461 ||
satyapi vā vibhaktivipariṇāme tenetyanena kriyayetyasyāsamanvaya evetyāha-- kriyayeti tṛtīyā ca prayoge kasya kalpyatām | tenetyasya hi sambandhaḥ sūtrasthena na vidyate || 462 ||
sūtre śrutena tenetyanena kriyetyasya liṅgabhedāt sambandho na vidyata iti kasya prayoge kriyayeti tṛtīyopādhiḥ kalpyatām, na kasyacidityarthaḥ | samānaliṅgasya sambandhinaḥ prayujyamānasyāsambhavāt | kriyayā tulyamityevaṃ pratyayārthena samanvaye tu prakṛterayamupādhirna syāt || 462 ||
tadevaṃ sambandhamākṣipya samarthayitumāha-- sopaskāreṣu sūtreṣu vākye śeṣaḥ samarthyate | tena yat tat tṛtīyāntaṃ kriyā cet seti gamyate || 463 ||
iha sūtravākyānāṃ kriyāpadāśravaṇāt sādhyāhāratvamavasīyate | lakṣyānuguṇyena ca lakṣaṇapraṇayanād yathāyathaṃ lakṣyabhedānusāreṇa kriyāpadamadhyāhartavyam | tataścātra cecchabdena sambandhabhedasyāvedanād yat tat tṛtīyāsamarthaṃ kriyā cet sā bhavatītyevaṃ vākyaśeṣasamarthanādupapannaḥ sambandhaḥ | ayamatrāśayaḥ--mā bhūt sūtra eva vipariṇāmaḥ | tasya tu yat samanvayavākyaṃ vyākhyānarūpam, tatra pariṇāmopapattiḥ | tatra ca teneti tṛtīyānirdeśaḥ prakṛtestṛtīyāntatāprajñāpane caritārtha iti cecchabdena punaḥ pratyavamṛśyopādhisambandhamanubhavituṃ svātantryamāpāditasya tasya yujyate yathopādhipariṇāmaḥ | tadyathā--"iko guṇavṛddhī"  ityasyāḥ paribhāṣāyāḥ samagrapradhānaviṣayopakārakatvam | yatra tu guṇavṛddhī iti brūyāt , tatreka ityupasthitaṃ draṣṭavyamiti vākyādhyāhāreṇa samarthyate || 463 ||
tadevamatra kriyetyupādhestenetyupādhimatā samanvayo vākyādhyāhāreṇa | na cāvaśyaṃ samānaśabda evopādhiranyathāpi sambhavādityupādhivailakṣaṇaṃ pratipādayitumāha-- upādheḥ kasyacid vākye prayoga upalabhyate | pratīyamānadharmān yo na kadācit prayujyate || 464 ||
"tadasyāṃ praharaṇam"  iti nedameva sākṣātpratyayavidhānavākyam, pañcamyā aśravaṇāt | api tu prayoge daṇḍaḥ praharaṇamasyāṃ krīḍāyām, muṣṭiḥ praharaṇamasyāṃ krīḍāyāmiti bhinnānāṃ vākyānāṃ sāmānyenānukaraṇam | prayogavākye ca daṇḍādervyabhicāriṇī prahararūpatā sāmānādhikaraṇyenopādīyata iti tathaiva sūtre'pyanukāraḥ | tadayamupādhiḥ samānaśabdo yasya loke'bhedaviṣaye vyabhicārāt prayogaḥ | aparaḥ punarupādhiḥ sāmarthyagamyasvabhāvatvāt prayoge naiva śrūyate | tataśca tasya prayoge'śravaṇāt sūtre'pi tathaivānukaraṇaṃ nāsti| kevalaṃ yathākathāñcit sūtre'sāvupakṣeptavyaḥ | tathā cāyamiha kriyālakṣaṇa upādhiḥ | nahi brāhmaṇena tulyamadhīte kṣatriya ityatra brāhmaṇagatatvena kriyā sākṣāt prayujyate, api tu sāmarthyāt pratīyata iti tasyāsyopādheḥ prathamāntasyāpi sūtre nirdeśe na kaścit paryanuyogaḥ, vākyādhyāhāreṇa samanvayopapatteḥ || 464 ||
tatra pratīyamānopādherudāharaṇamāha-- nīlamutpalamityatra na viśeṣye na bhedake | kaścit taddharmavacano vākye śabdaḥ prayujyate || 465 ||
nīmutpalamityatra vākye sāmānādhikaraṇyādeva gamyamānatvāt taddharmasya viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyatvasya tadabhidhāyī nīlaṃ viśeṣaṇamutpalaṃ viśeṣyamiti na prayujyate śabdaḥ | kevalaṃ sūtra eva "viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyeṇa" iti(pā...) padayoravacchedārthaṃ prayogaḥ || 465 ||
ataśca atyantānugamāt tatra na sūtre na ca vigrahe | vibhaktipariṇāmena kiñcidasti prayojanam || 466 ||
avacchedyāvacchedakatvasyātyarthenāntarbhāvānnīlaṃ ca tadutpalaṃ cetyatra vākye viśeṣyaśabdasya sūtre tṛtīyāntasya viśeṣyamutpalamiti nāsti pariṇāmaphalam , sāmānādhikaraṇyādeva viśeṣyatvasyāvagatatvāt | itthañca vākye prayogābhāvād viśeṣyādeḥ śabdasya sūtre'pi kasyānukaraṇamidaṃ syāt, yadanurodhād viśeṣyeṇeti tṛtīyāntaṃ prathamāntatayā vipariṇamyeta | evañjātīyake viṣaye vibhaktipariṇāmasyāprasaktiḥ prakṛtopapādanaparatayocyate | na tu viśeṣyeṇetyatra vibhaktipariṇāmaḥ samanvayārthaḥ sambhāvyate, śrutenaiva samanvayopapatteḥ || 466 ||
ata evaitannidarśanīkṛtya prakṛte yojayitumāha-- tṛtīyāntaṃ kriyetyetad vigrahe na prayujyate | yathā daṇḍaḥ praharaṇaṃ krīḍāyāmiti dṛśyate || 467 ||
brāhmaṇena tulyamadhīte kṣatriya vigrahavākye kriyayeti tṛtīyāntasya prayogo nāsti| yasmādupameye śrutā kriyeti sāmarthyādupamāne'pi pratīyeta | anyathopamānopameyabhāva eva na syāditi yathākathañcidapyupakṣepe'syopādherna doṣaḥ | daṇḍaḥ praharaṇamasyāṃ krīḍāyāmityatra tu vākye praharaṇasyopādheḥ prayogo dṛśyate | praharaṇakriyāsādhakatamatvaṃ hi daṇḍasya na daṇḍapadaprayogādeva gamyate, svārthamātrasya tataḥ pratipatteriti svaśabdena praharaṇamityanena tasya tattvamāvedyate | tathā ca tathaiva sūtre'nukāraḥ || 467 ||
tatraitat syāt | nīlaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyamutpalamityapi prayogo dṛśyata iti kathamidamantarbhūtadharmaṇa upādhernidarśanaṃ syādityāśaṅkyāparaṃ nirvivādamatrodāharaṇamāha-- ghavidhau ghaśca saṃjñāyāmiti sūtra udāhṛtam | upādānaṃ prayogeṣu tasyātyantaṃ na vidyate || 468 ||
`puṃsi saṃjñāyāṃ ghaḥ prāyeṇa"  ityatra ghapratyayavidhau saṃjñāyāmiti prayukto ya upādhiḥ, tasya prayogeṣvatyantamanuccāraṇam, prakṛtipratyayasamudāyasya saṃjñātvāt samānaśabdo'yamupādhirgatārthatvānnopādīyate | evaṃ kriyayetyapi || 468 ||
tatraitat syāt--pradhānānuvidhāyitvād guṇānāṃ tenetyabhisambandhe kriyayetyavaśyaṃ vipariṇamanīyamityāśaṅkyāha-- yairaprayuktaiḥ saṃskāraḥ pradhāneṣu pratīyate | te bhede'pi vibhaktīnāṃ nirdiśyanta upādhayaḥ || 469 ||
prayoge prayogamantareṇāpi kriyetyayamupādhiḥ pradhānātiśayāya prabhavatīti kiṃ pradhānānuvṛttyā ? tathā hi--bhinnavibhaktitve'pi yadi pradhānopakāro vighaṭate, tadā pradhānavibhaktirāśrīyeta | yāvatānyāvibhaktitve'pi vyavacchedamātraphalatvādupādherlabhyate pradhānopakāra iti na tadvibhaktāvatrādaraḥ | tathā hi--kriyayetyapi vibhak‌tyupādāne bhinnaviṅgatvādasāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ tadavasthamiti yathākathañcidapyupakṣepe guṇānāṃ labhyate pradhānopakārasampādanāyopādānatātparyādabhisambandha iti sthitam || 469 ||
evaṃ prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇapakṣe kriyāvacanasya tṛtīyāntasyāsambhavāt `sarva ete śabdā guṇasamudāyeṣu vartante' iti kriyāvācinastṛtīyāntatāsamarthanārthaṃ yad bhāṣyam, tadidānīṃ vyācaṣṭe-- samudāyeṣu vartante bhāvānāṃ sahacāriṇām | śabdāstattvāvivakṣāyāṃ samuccayavikalpayoḥ || 470 ||
gauratvaśucyācāratvapiṅgalakeśatvādīnāṃ niyatajātyācchuritānāṃ sahabhāvināṃ dharmāṇāṃ yaḥ samudāyaḥ, tatra vācakatvena brāhmaṇādiśabdā vartante | yadyapi caite dharmāḥ kadācid vyabhicārānna niyogataḥ sahabhāvinaḥ, tathāpi ye yajjātisahacarā dharmāste tajjātinimittena śabdenocyanta iti brāhmaṇatvādijātyā sahabhāvo'vyabhicāro vivakṣitaḥ | ata eva ca śabdārthasaṅkaro na bhavati | sarveṣāṃ mātrākalāpavatanatve'pi niyatajātisāhacaryopalakṣitāḥ pratiniyatā eva śabdānāmarthā yataḥ | tadetat punaḥ samuccayasya vikalpasya cāvivakṣāyāṃ samudāyavacanatvamacyate śabdānām | avidyamānavikalpo'yaṃ vāyaṃ vetyevaṃrūpo'vidyamānaśca samuccayo'yaṃ cāyaṃ cetyevaṃrūpo yasya tasya samudāyasya vivakṣāyām || 470 ||
nanu mā bhūd vikalpaḥ samudāyārthavirodhitvādatra, samuccayastu yagapadanekārtharūpaḥ kathaṃ samūhārthatāṃ viruṇaddhītyāśaṅkyāha-- samuccayastu kriyate yeṣu pratyarthavṛttiṣu | bhedādhiṣṭhānayā yogasteṣāṃ bhavati saṅkhyayā || 471 ||
pratyarthavṛttitve vācakasya samudāyaḥ samuccarūpeṇa vācyaḥ syāt | tathā hi--samakakṣyatāyā samudāyāntargatānāmavayavānāmabhidhāne sarve prādhānyena samuccitā abhihitā bhavanti | evañca bhedasyodbhūtatvāt pradhānārthaprayuktaṃ bahuvacanaṃ syāt | tadyathā --vṛkṣā iti bhedaprādhānyenābhidhīyamānā bahutvayoginaḥ | yadā tu vanamitivadvigalitabhedaḥ samudāyo'bhidhīyate, tadaikavacanamevārthaikatvānnyāyyam | tadā ca bhedādhiṣṭhānasya samuccayasyābhāvaḥ | evamiha samudāyārthatve pratyarthavṛttitvāyogāt samuccayābhāvaḥ || 471 ||
yadi tarhi na tulyakakṣyatayā mātrākalāpo'bhidhīyate, tadā jātiviśiṣṭadravyābhidhānapakṣadasya pakṣasya ko bheda ityāha-- sarvairviśiṣṭāstairarthairjanyante sahacāribhiḥ | buddhayaḥ pratipattṝṇāṃ śabdārthāṃstānato viduḥ || 472 ||
jātiguṇākriyābhiḥ sahabhāvirarthaiḥ pratipattṝṇāṃ yato viśiṣṭāḥ, tadācchuritā jātyavacchinnārthagrāhiṇyo buddhayo jāyante, ato buddhyanusāreṇa nirūpite'rthe śabdaprayogāt tato'pi tathaiva pratipatterguṇasamudāya eva pratīyamānaḥ śabdārtha iti vyavasthāpyate | dravyasya cārthakriyāyogāt tadeva pradhānaṃ jātiguṇakriyādidharmasaṃsṛṣṭamabhidhānagocara ityarthaikyādatrāpyekavacanameva | jātyāviṣṭaṃ tu dravyamevocyate dravyābhidhānapakṣe | kriyāguṇāstu dravyasya niṣkriyasya nirguṇasya cānupapatteḥ sāmarthyādavagamyanta iti pakṣāntarādasya viśeṣaḥ pakṣasya, sarvasyāpyabhidhāgocaratvādatra || 472 ||
tadetadāha-- saṃsṛṣṭāḥ pratyayeṣvarthāḥ sarva evopakāriṇaḥ | teṣāṃ pratyayarūpeṇa sarveṣāṃ śabdavācyatā || 473 ||
bāhyaṃ vastu svabhāvata eva niraṃśatvād viśiṣṭam | na tatra bhedapūrvakaḥ saṃsargavyavahāraḥ kaścit | tat punarbaddhau viparivartamānamanādivāsanāvibhramajuṣāṃ pratyayānāmavikalamaviṣaya iti parikalpitabhāgavibhāgenāvasīyate | avasāya ca pṛthak pratyayairanusandhīyate | tathā ca pratyayeṣvevārthā jātiguṇakriyādravyalakṣaṇā bhedapūrvakaṃ saṃsargaṃ bhajanta iti tadabhiprāyeṇa samudāyavācoyuktiḥ | tathā hi--pratyayopārūḍhākārābhidhāyinaḥ śabdā brāhmamabhiniviśante'bhedādhyavasāyāditi mātrākalāpātmano'rthasya sarvasyaiva buddhiviparivartyākārānuvidhānena vācakāḥ śabdā vyavasthāpyante | buddhāvapi ca yathābāhyaṃ guṇapradhānabhāvenārthānāmuparohād jātiguṇakriyāsaṃsṛṣṭasya dravyasyaiva prādhānyenābhidhānādekārthyaṃ bhavati || 473 ||
yadyevaṃ dravyasyaivābhidhānamastu, ko'nurodho guṇasamudāyanaya ityāśaṅkyāha-- kevalānāṃ tu bhāvānāṃ na rūpamavadhāryate | anirūpitarūpeṣu teṣu śabdo na vartate || 474 ||
nirūpaṇapūrvakatvādabhidhānasyopādhiviviktisya ca dravyamātrasya rūpamagocaro nirūpaṇāyā iti saṃsṛṣṭopādhi dravyaṃ guṇasamudāyadarśane śabdavācyam | tatra samudāye vṛttāḥ śabdā avayaveṣvapi vartante | tadyathā--pūrve pañcālā ityuktam | janapadavacanasya ca pañcālaśabdasya prasiddhasyaikatvājjanapadasya pūrvaśabdena viśeṣaṇānupapattāvavayavavṛttiḥ samudāyaśabdasya || 474 ||
tataśca samudāyāt pracyutyāvayave vartamānaḥ śabdo'nityamarthasambandhamākṣipedityāśaṅkya samarthayitumāha-- pūrvaśabdaprayogācca samūhānna nivartate | vartate'vayave vāpi nopāttaṃ tyajati kvacit || 475 ||
śabdārthasambandhasya nityatvānneha samudāyād vācyād vicalati pañcālaśabdaḥ | pūrvaśabdaprayogāddhetornāpyapūrvamavayave vācakatvamāsādayati | nirūḍhasya tyāgo'pūrvasya copādānaṃ na kvacid viṣaye śabdānāmiṣṭam || 475 ||
yadi tarhyupāttasya samudāyasya na tyāgaḥ, tadā kathaṃ samanvayaḥ ? tasmāt samudāyena samanvayānyathānupapattyā samudāyaśabdo'pyayamavayavamupādāsyata ityāśaṅkyāha-- samudāyābhidhāyī ca yadi bhedaṃ viśeṣayet | tatrātulyavibhaktitvaṃ pūrvakāyādivad bhavet || 476 ||
ekatvājjanapadasya pūrvaśabdena vyavacchedābhāvāt samudāyābhidhāyī pañcālaśabdo'tra pūrvaśabdena sambandhānurodhād bhedamekadeśaṃ yadi vyavachindyāt , tadāvayavopajanite vyatireke samudāyasya ṣaṣṭhyā bhāvyamiti samānavibhaktikatvaṃ na syāt | yathā kāyasya pūrvaḥ paro vā bhāga iti | evaṃ pañcālānāṃ pūrva iti syāt | tathā ca sāmānādhikaraṇyabādhaḥ | na cābādhite'pi sāmānādhikaraṇaye mukhyārthatyāgenāvayavārthopādānaṃ yuktam, nityatvāt sambandhasya | tasmādatyajyata eva mukhyamarthamavayavopādānaṃ vaiyadhikaraṇyena syādatra, na sāmānādikaraṇyenetyarthaḥ || 476 ||
idānīmavayave vṛttiṃ samarthayate-- samūhe ca pradeśe ca pañcāvā iti dṛśyate | tathā viśeṣaṇaṃ sarva ityetadupapadyate || 477 ||
iheme pañcālādayaḥ śabdā nivāsādhikaraṇabhāvānugamanena vā vyutpādyeran vyutpattipratyākhyāne vā svābhāvikārthaviśeṣasambandhāḥ samanujñāyeran | pūrvatra pakṣe yathā saṃstyāyaviśeṣaḥ samasto janapadabhidheyaḥ svāmiviśeṣāṇāmādhārabhāvamanubhavati, tathā tadekadeśo'pi, na hyayamavayavī kāyādivad, api tu vanasthānīyaḥ | tathā ca sakalāvayavasya samūhasyādarśanāt pratyavayavaparisamāpteśca bhāgaśa evādhāratāṃ pratipadyate | tataśca nimittarūpānuvidhānena nimittinamabhidadhadayaṃ śabdaḥ samudāyaikadeśayostulyapravṛttiḥ, ubhayatrāpi nimittarūpasya nivāsādhikaraṇabhāvasya samānatvāt samudāyo'pi hyekadeśadvāreṇaiva kāryeṣūpādīyate | tadyathā--pañcālān praviṣṭaḥ, pañcālādṛśyantām, pañcāleṣu kṛtamiti | svābhāvikadarśane'pi śabdānāmanekārthatvād samūhaikadeśayorvartamānatvamupapadyata eveti na tyāgopādānārthaḥ kaścidatra | ataścobhayathā pañcālaśabdasya dṛṣṭervyabhicārasambhave sarve pañcāla labdhā, hṛtā, ācchinnā iti samudāyapratipipādayiṣāyāṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ sarvaśabdaḥ kathyate | anyathā samūhasyaikatvāt kṛtsnatvena viśeṣaṇaṃ na sambadhyeta | tadevaṃ samudāyaśabdasyāpi prasiddhasyāvayave vṛttirmukhyatayaivetyuktam || 477 ||
atraiva bhāṣyakāramataṃ saṃvādakamāha-- tathārdhapiplītyatra jātyantaranivṛttaye | ardhaṃ ca pippalī ceti khaṇḍe śabdaḥ prayujyate || 478 ||
samānādhikaraṇasamāsābhyupagameṃnaikadeśisamāsaḥ pratyākhyāto bhāṣye | tathā cārdhaṃ ca pippalī cetyardhapippalīti sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ kathamupapadyeta, yadi khaṇḍe'vayave'trāvayavavācī pippalīśabdo nābhyupagamyate | yuktaṃ caitat | yadayaṃ jātiśabdo vyaktau pracayāpacayānapekṣo'tra vartate | tathāhyekadeśisamāse'pyardhaṃ pippalyā iti jātyantarāpohārthamardhaṃ pippalyāvacchidyate | tathā ca samānādhikaraṇasamāse'pi jātyantaranivṛttyarthamevārdhaśabdasya pippalī viśeṣyeti phalataḥ pratītyorabhedaḥ | prakriyābhedāttu pūrvapadārthapradhānataikadeśisamāse | tatra paravalliṅgatārambhaḥ | ekadeśisamāsasyaiva tatpuruṣasya tadiṣṭeḥ | samānādhikaraṇasamāsetūttarapadāthaprādhānyādeva tatsiddhiriti tat pratyākhyātam || 478 ||
evaṃ yathātra jātyabhivyaktisamarthāvayavivacano'pi pippalīśabdastadekadeśe jātyantaranivṛttiparāyāṃ codanāyāṃ vartate, tathehāpi pañcālaśabda ityāha-- pañcālānāṃ pradeśo'pi bhinno janapadāntarāt | tatrānyasya vivṛttyarthe śabde bhedo na gamyate || 479 ||
yathā samasto janapadaḥ pañcālā magadhādijanapadāntarād vilakṣaṇaḥ, tathā tadavayavo'pi grāmādiriti janapadāntaranivṛttiparāyāṃ codanāyāṃ pañcālaśabde prayukte samudāyāvayavavibhāgasyāvivakṣitatvādasau bhedaḥ samudāyāvayavalakṣaṇo viśeṣo nāvasīyata ityanādṛtya taṃ sannihite'rthe mukhyatayaiva śabdasyātra vṛttirityarthaḥ | itthañcāvayavena sāmānādhikaraṇyādatulyavibhaktitvamatra nāsti, jātyantaranivṛttivivakṣāyāṃ prayogasyāviśeṣāt samudāyāvayavayoḥ || 479 ||
yadyevaṃ tayostulye'bhidheyatve kathamucyate `samudāyeṣu hi vṛttāḥ śabdāḥ' ityata āha-- prasiddhāstu viśeṣeṇa samudāye vyavasthitāḥ | pradeśe darśanaṃ teṣāmarthaprakaraṇādibhiḥ || 480 ||
pañcālādayaḥ śabdāḥ samūhe yathā prasiddhāḥ, na tathāvayave, sāmarthyaprakaraṇādivaśenāvayavavṛttitvasya niścayāditi samudāyeṣu mukhyatvameṣāṃ kathyate prasiddhataratvādityarthaḥ || 480 ||
evaṃ brāhmaṇādiśabdānāmapi samudāye iva mukhyā vṛttiravayave'pītyāha-- yadupavyañjanaṃ jāteḥ sahacāri ca karmasu | tatra vā rūḍhasambandhaṃ yat prāyeṇāpalakṣitam || 481 ||
samudāyaḥ pradeśo vetyevaṃ tasminnanāśrite | arthātmanyaviśeṣeṇa vartante brāhmaṇādayaḥ || 482 ||
jāterabhivyañjakamupanayanādisaṃskāraviśeṣopabṛṃhitamupadeśasahāyaṃ dravyam, karmasu yajanayājanādikāsu kriyāsu sahacāryavyabhicāri śaucaśraddhāvidvattādi, tatra tasyāṃ jātau rūḍhasambandhaṃ prasiddhayogaṃ mṛducittatā satyavāditvamavairānuśaya ityevamādi bāhulyenānumitam, tadāśritya śabdaḥ pravartamānaḥ samudāyābhidhāyīti vyavasthāpyate, prasiddheḥ | tatra ca jātyantaranivṛttiparāyāṃ codanāyāṃ jātinimittasyāsya śabdasya samudāyāvayavavibhāgānaśrayeṇa pravṛtteravayave'pi vṛttiraviruddhā | arthaprakaraṇādivaśāt punastathāvasāya ityamukhyatvameva || 481,482 ||
evaṃ tarhi samudāyārtho'nya eva, anya eva cāvayavārthaḥ, śabdārthabhedād bhedopapatteriti kathamabhedena `samudāyeṣu vṛttāḥ śabdā avayaveṣu vartanta' iti vyapadeśa ityata āha-- yaśca tulyaśrutirddaṣṭaḥ samudāye vyavasthitaḥ | tenopacaritaikatvaṃ pradeśe'pyupalabhyate || 483 ||
tulyaśrutitvād rūpasāmyādekatvamavasāya samudāye vācakatvena vyavasthito'vayave'pi vartata ityuktam | nahi samudāyāt prayutyāvayave tasyaiva śabdasya vṛttirasti, sambandhānityatvaprasaṅgādityuktameva || 483 ||
evaṃ sārūpyād tadevedamityupacārādavayave samudāyaśabdasya vṛttau, `pūrve pañcālāḥ' ityekaṃ nidarśanaṃ vyākhyātam | aparamapi `tailaṃ bhuktaṃ ghṛtam, bhuk‌tam | tad vyācaṣṭe-- saṃskārādupaghātād vā vṛtto'ktaparimāṇake | tailādau jātiśabdo'tra sāmarthyādavasīyate || 484 ||
nekṣitā jātiśabdānāṃ samudāyānupātitā | jātimācakṣate te hi vyaktirjātisamāśrayā ||  tailādiśabdānāṃ jātinimittatve kathaṃ samudāyavacanatāyāmatra dṛṣṭāntatopapattirityākṣepe pratisamādhānamidam | tathāhi--rogaviśeṣapraśamanāya yadauṣadhāhitaviśeṣaṃ dhṛtaṃ tailaṃ vā mātrāparicchinnam, tadiha tailādiśabdavācyaṃ vivakṣitam | tacca ṣojaśa dvātriṃśadityādipalaparimāṇatvāt paricchinnaparimāṇamiti samudāyo bhavati | śvakākādyuṣṭatvena vopahataṃ parityājyaṃ ghṛtatailādyatra niyataparimāṇameva vivakṣitam, prakaraṇasāmarthyāt | anyathā jātinibandhane'tra tailādiśabde jātisamavāyāviśeṣāt samudāye, avayave vā vṛttirityetannopapadyate | aktaparimāṇe tu vṛttau yadetat ghṛtaṃ tailaṃ vā, tasya pratidinamekadeśābhyavahāre'pi tadevedaṃ bhuktamiti samudāyābhedādhyāropeṇāvayave vṛttirupapadyate | evaṃ śvādisamparkadūṣite'pi tadidaṃ śvaghṛtaṃ tailaṃ vetyavayave samudāyāropād vṛttiḥ || 484 ||
kathamayamāśayo bhāṣyakārasyāvasīyata iti cedāha-- na jātiguṇaśabdeṣu mūrtibhedo vivakṣitaḥ | te jātiguṇasambandhabhedamātranibandhanāḥ || 485 ||
jātiguṇanimittāḥ śabdā mūrtibhedamasarvagatadravyaparimāṇaviśeṣamanāśritya tadvanmātre vartante | upacayāpacayānapekṣā hi teṣāṃ viśiṣṭajātiguṇayogāvadhāraṇāya pravṛttiḥ | tathāhi--jātiguṇasambandha evānyasmād bhidyata iti bhedo viśeṣastanmātraṃ mūrtibhedānapekṣaṃ nibandhanaṃ nimittameṣāmiti | ye tu parimāṇaśabdā droṇādayaste'ktaparimāṇamarthamabhidadhati | tathā caikadeśāpāye na vartante | tataśca jātinimittāyāṃ vṛttau tailādiśabdānāṃ samudāyāvayavayoraviśeṣaḥ syāditi saṃskāropaghātaviśiṣṭe'rthe'tra bhāṣyakārasyatailādiśabdo'bhimata ityunnīyate | pradeśāntare hi cūrṇīkāraḥ parimāṇaśabdebhyo jātiguṇaśabdānāṃ droṇaḥ prasthaḥ śatamiti bhedamupāgamat || 485 ||
idānīṃ śuklo nīlaḥ kṛṣṇa ityudāharaṇāntaramatraiva vyākhyātumāha-- kṛṣṇādivyapadeśaśca sarvāvayavavṛttibhiḥ | guṇaiste'pyekadeśasthāḥ paṭādīnāṃ viśeṣakāḥ || 486 ||
guṇanimittānāṃ śabdānāṃ mūrtibhedānapekṣā idānīmevoktā | tathāpi loke samastāvayavavyāptyā yo guṇo vartate, tatra tad‌vyapadeśaḥ siddhaḥ | kṛṣṇaḥ paṭaḥ, śuklaḥ paṭa iti | tathā ca samudāyaśabdā ete mukhyayā vṛttyā kathyante | yatra tvavayavaḥ kaścicchuklo'paraḥ kṛṣṇaḥ, tatrāpi samudāyāropācchuklādiśabdapravṛttiḥ | yasya hi paṭasyāvayavo'pi nāśuklastannivṛttiparāyāṃ codanāyāṃ samudāyāropācchuklādiśabdapravṛttiḥ | yasya hi paṭasyāvayavo'pi nāśuklastannivṛttiparāyāṃ codanāyāṃ samudāyāvayavayorabhedavivakṣāyāmayaṃ prayogaḥ | tathā hi sadyaḥ--prakṣālitapaṭāvayavamalinīkaraṇe sābhyasūyā vaktāro bhavanti kṛṣṇaḥ paṭaḥ kṛta iti || 486 ||
tatraiva prakārāntaramāha-- paṭāvayavavṛttāstu yadā tatra paṭādayaḥ | tadā tailādivat teṣāṃ jātiśabdatvamucyate || 487 ||
ekadeśakṛṣṇe paṭe paṭaḥ kṛṣṇa ityabhidhāne dvayī gatiḥ | samastāvayavakṛṣṇasyādhyāropādavayave kṛṣṇaśabdo yathā prāg vyākhyātam | yadā tu paṭaśabdo'traikadeśe pravṛttaḥ, tadā sannihitaḥ kṛṣṇo'vayavaḥ kṛṣṇaśabdena kṛtsnāvayavavyāpikṛṣṇaguṇanimittena mukhyatayābhidhīyate | paṭastu samudāyavacano'vayave pravṛtto'trodāharaṇam | tasya ca tadānīṃ tailādiśabdavajjātivācitvaṃ boddhavyam | yathā hi jātiśabdā api tailādayaḥ saṃskāropaghātaprāpitātiśaye dravye samudāyaśabdatāṃ pratilabhya tadanyavyāvṛttipare'bhidhāne'vayave tadrūpāropādasādayanti pratyāyakatvam, tatheme'pi paṭādayo'vayave'pi pravartanta ityarthaḥ | anayaiva ca diśā ghṛtādiśabdo mukhyārthaḥ | bhuktaśabdastu samudāye'vayavarūpādhyāsāt prayukto mantavyaḥ, yadi kriyāśabdasyāpi bhuktaśabdasyāktaparimāṇe karmaṇi prasiddharanugantuṃ pāryate | tathāhi--yadā bhuktatvamupahatasya saṃskṛtasya vā tailādeḥ sandigdham, tadā'bhuktatvavyāvṛttaye tailaṃ bhuktamityucyamāne samudāyāvayavayorbhedavivakṣā nāstīti yujyate samudāyaśabdenāvayavasyābhidhānam | tadayamatra paramārthaḥ--yadā paṭaḥ prādhānyena vivakṣitaḥ, tadā śuklaśabdo'vayave vartate; yadā tu śuklo'vayavaḥ prādhānyena vivakṣitaḥ, tadā paṭaśabdo'vayave vartate | evaṃ tailaṃ bhuktamityatrāpi vācyam | yathā ca janapadāntaranivṛttiparāyāṃ codanāyāṃ pañcālaśabdo'vayave'pi mukhyaḥ | pippalīśabdaśca taditaravyavacchedavivakṣāyāmekadeśe'pi mukhyaḥ, tathā tailādiśabdo'pyanyavyāvṛttipare'bhidhāna iti || 487 ||
nigamayitumāha-- nivṛttyarthā śrutiryeṣāṃ bhedasteṣvanapekṣitaḥ | pradese samudāye vā guṇo'nyeṣāṃ nivartakaḥ || 488 ||
anyanivṛttipare'bhidhāne samudāyāvayavabhedamanādṛtya pradeśe vā samudāye vā vartamānaḥ śabdo guṇādyabhidhāyī kṛṣṇādiranyavyavacchedaṃ karotyeveti mukhyaiveyaṃ śabdapravṛttiḥ || 488 ||
tadevaṃ nidarśanānyupapādya dārṣṭāntikabhāṣyam `evamayaṃ samudāye brāhmaṇaśabdaḥ pravṛtto'vayave'pi vartate' ityetad vyākhyātumāha-- brāhmaṇādhyayena tatra vartate brāhmaṇaśrutiḥ | sādṛśyaṃ tatra dṛṣṭaṃ hi kṣatriyādhyayanādibhiḥ || 489 ||
kecit tāvadāhuḥ--brāhmaṇavadadhīte kṣatriya ityupameye'dhyayanasya śrutestaddhetukamevātra sāmyamupalakṣitam | tathā ca brāhmaṇaśabdo'dhyayanamātre'vayave vartate | tapaḥ śrutamadhyayanamityādau hi samudāye mukhyo brāhmaṇaśabdaḥ prasiddha iti tadekadeśe'dhyayanamātre samupacaritaḥ | tataścādhyayanakriyāvācinastṛtīyāsamarthād vatirityekīyaṃ matam || 489 ||
etadanupapannamityāha-- brāhmaṇādhyayane vṛttiryadi syād brāhmaṇaśruteḥ | vaktavyaṃ kena dharmeṇa tulyatvaṃ kriyayoriti || 490 ||
adhyayanamātravācitve brāhmaṇaśabdāsyādhyayanayorevopamānopameyabhāvo'vagamyeta, nādhyāyakayoḥ tannimittaḥ | adhyayanayoścopamyanimittadharmaḥ sauṣṭhavādirvācyaḥ syāt | tathā ca tadadhikaraṇabhāvāpannamadhyayanamidaṃ taditi vyapadeśyatvāt kriyātvaṃ jahyāditi na kriyāvācinastṛtīyāsamarthatā samarthitā syādityabhiprāyaḥ || 490 ||
tasmādidamatra yuktamiti svamatena siddhāntamupanyasyati-- adhyetari yadā vṛttirucyate brāhmaṇaśruteḥ | nimittatvaṃ tadopaiti kriyaivādhyetari sthitā || 491 ||
śuddhakriyāvācinastṛtīyāntasyāsambhavāt kriyāviśiṣṭadravyavacano gṛhyate | tatra brāhmaṇaśabdasya samudāyavācakatve'pyadhyayanapradhāne dravye gumasamudāyāvayave vṛttiḥ kalpyate | tathā cādhyayanakriyāvyāpārapradhānād brāhmaṇaśabdāt tṛtīyāntād brāhmaṇena tulyamadhīte kṣatriya iti brāhmaṇavaditi vatipratyaye kṛte śabdopāttādhyayanahetuko brāhmaṇakṣatriyayorupamānopameyabhāvo'vagamyata itīṣṭasiddhiḥ || 491 ||
ekīyamate tu doṣāntaramāha-- siṃhaśabdena saṃbandhe śauryamātrābhidhāyinā | caitrāt ṣaṣṭhī prasajyeta yoge śauryādibhiryathā || 492 ||
yaḥ kila brāhmaṇavadityatra brāhmaṇaśabdasyādhyayanamātrābhidhāyitāmāha, tasya śauryamātrābhidhāyinā siṃhaśabdena caitrasyābhisambandhe caitrasya siṃha iti vyatirekanibandhanā vibhaktiḥ prasajyeta, yathā caitrasya śauryamiti | asmatpakṣe tu tadvati siṃhaśabdasya pravṛtterupamānopameyayostattvāsaṅge sāmānādhikaraṇayamupapadyate || 492 ||
upalambhāntaramaramapyekīyamatasyāha-- brāhmaṇāyeva dātavyaṃ vaiśyāyetyevamādiṣu | sampradānādiyogaśca kriyāmātre na kalpate || 493 ||
adhyayanakriyāmātre brāhmaṇaśabde vativiṣaye'bhidhīyamāne brāhmaṇavad vaiśyāya dātavyam, brāhmaṇavad vaiśyādadhyetavyam, brāhmaṇavad vaiśye vartitavyamiti samprādānāpādānādhikaraṇādisambandho na syāt, kriyāmātrasya tadanupapatteḥ | nahi brāhmaṇādhyayanādadhyetuṃ śakyate | asmatpakṣe tu tadvato'bhidhāne sarvametad yujyate || 493 ||
kiñca bhāṣyavirodho'pyekīyamata ityāha-- kriyāmātrābhidhāyitvādavyayeṣu vaterna ca | pāṭhaḥ kadācit kartavyastulyau pakṣāvubhau yataḥ || 494 ||
pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇapakṣe'traiva bhāṣyakāraḥ prāha--`api cāvyayeṣu vateḥ pāṭho na kartavyo bhavati | kriyāyāmayaṃ bhavallim̐ṅgasaṅkhyābhyāṃ na yokṣyata' iti | yadi ca prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇapakṣe'pyupamānaśabdānāṃ kriyāmātravacanatvam , tadā kriyāyāstulyā kriyaiva pratyayārtho nyāyya ityasattvabhūtatvāt tasyāḥ siddhe'liṅgasaṅkhyatve svarādiṣu sattvavacaneṣu madhye'vyayasaṃjñārthaṃ vateḥ pāṭho'trāpi prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇapakṣe na kāryaḥ syāditi pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇapakṣamutkarṣayituṃ kathamevaṃ tatraiva pāṭhaḥ kartavyaḥ syāditi bhāṣyakāraḥ prāha | kriyāmātravacanatve hi brāhmaṇādiśabdānāṃ dvāvapi prakṛtyarthapratyayārthaviśeṣaṇapakṣau samānāvubhayatrāpi kriyāyāḥ pratyayārthatvāt | yadā tvasmatpakṣe kriyāvān brāhmaṇaśabdavācyaḥ, tadopameyo'pi tena tulyaḥ kriyāvāneva nyāyya iti tasya sattvabhūtatvālliṅgasaṅkhyāprāptāvavyayeṣu vateḥ pāṭho'sminneva pakṣe kartavyaḥ syāditi yuktaṃ pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇapakṣasya tadāpāṭhenotkarṣa ākhyātum || 494 ||
tadevamekīyamataṃ sāvadyamudbhāvya svamataṃ niravadyatayā nigamayitumāha-- jahāti jātiṃ dravyaṃ vā tasmānnāvayave sthitaḥ | kriyāyāstu śrutiryasmāt tadvatyarthe'vatiṣṭhate || 495 ||
yata evaṃ kriyāmātrābhidhāne doṣaḥ, tasmādekadeśe'pi vartamāno brāhmaṇaśabdo jātiṃ dravyaṃ vā na parityajati | jātiratropamānatvenopāttā draṣṭavyā | yathā sāṅkaryaparihārārthaṃ guṇasamudāye'pi vartamānaḥ śabdo jātinimittatvaṃ na tyajati, tathāvayave'pi vartamāno dravyaṃ vācyaṃ na jahāti | yasmācca sūtre kriyāyāḥ prakṛtyarthepādhitvena śravaṇam, tasmāt tadvati kriyāvati dravye brāhmaṇādiśabdo'tra vartamāno gṛhyate, anye tu sahacāriṇo dharmāstyajyanta ityavayavayavṛttitāpyupapadyate || 495 ||
yadi tarhi kriyāvānābhidheyaḥ, tadā kriyāyāstṛtīyāsamarthatvaṃ kathamityata āha-- ākriyāṇāṃ nivṛttyarthā yataścātra kriyāśrutiḥ | kriyopalakṣite tasmāt kriyāśabdaḥ pratīyate || 496 ||
mukhyasya kriyāmātrābhidhāyinastṛtīyāntasyāsambhavādakriyāyāṃ dravyaguṇatadvatāṃ nivṛttitātparyeṇa kriyāśabdo'tra kathyamānaḥ kriyāvantamupalakṣayati mukhyārthasambhave lakṣaṇāyā gaṅgādiṣu dṛṣṭatvāt || 496 ||
kathametat ? yāvatā hotavyādayaḥ kriyāmātravacanāḥ santīti | tadāha-- hotavyādiṣu yasmācca kriyānyā brāhmaṇādivat | apekṣaṇīyā śuddhe'rthe tasmād vṛttirna kasyacit || 497 ||
brāhmaṇavadityukte yathādhyayanamupamānanimittatve'pekṣaṇīyaṃ sādhāraṇo dharmaḥ, tathā brāhmaṇahotavyena tulyaṃ kṣatriyasya hotavyamityatrāpyanyā kriyā sādhāraṇadharmabhūtāpekṣaṇīyā syāt | anyathā samanvayānupapattiḥ | tathā ca sattvavacanairbrāhmaṇādiśabdaistulyā hotavyādayaḥ | tatrāpi dharmāntarādhāra bhāvamanubhavantī kriyā svarūpādapaiti, sattvabhāvāpatteriti kevalakriyāvacanābhāvānmukhyārthāsambhave kriyāśabdena tadvadupalakṣaṇaṃ nyāyyameva || 497 ||
tatraitat syāt--yadyupameye kriyāśruteḥ saivopamāne'pyāśrīyate sādhāraṇo dharmaḥ, tadā kimavayavavṛttiparikalpanāprayāsena ? astu samudāya eva vācyaḥ, tathāpi hi tatsthāṃ kriyāmevopakāriṇīmapekṣiṣyāmāha ityāśaṅkyāha-- sarvaṃ vāpyekadeśo vā yasminnāśrīyate kvacit | viśeṣavṛttiṃ taṃ sarvamāhurbhede vyavasthitam || 498 ||
samudāyavacano'vayavavacanaśca yaḥ śabdastaṃ sarvaṃ śabdaṃ viśeṣavṛttiṃ viśiṣṭārthavācakamācakṣate, yato bhede viśeṣe sarvasya śabdasyāvasthānam | tathāhi--yadāvayave prayogaḥ, tadā sarvaṃ samudāyarūpaṃ nāpekṣyata iti tannivṛttyā viśeṣa eva śabdārthaḥ | yadāpi samudāye prayogaḥ, tadaikadeśo nāpekṣyata iti tannivṛttyā viśeṣa eva śabdārthaḥ | yadāpi samudāye prayogaḥ, tadaikadeśo nāpekṣyata iti tannivṛttyā viśeṣavacana eva śabdaḥ | yathā hi pradeśaḥ pradeśāntaramavacchindan viśeṣa ityucyate, tathā samudāyo'pyavayavaṃ nivartayan viśeṣa ityubhayavṛttirapi śabdo viśeṣaviṣayaḥ | tataśca samastadharmācchuritasyārthasyā nirūpaṇāt tathaiva śabdenābhidhāne guṇasamudāyaviṣayatve śabdānāṃ samarthite brāhmaṇaśabdena yadā samudāyābhidhānam, tadāvayavasyāvacchedānnivāraṇāt kathaṃ sa pratīyate, yena samudāyavacanatve'pi tannimitta upamānopameyabhāvo'vagamyate | samudāyābhidhāne hi tasyaiva prādhānyaṃ vikalpasamuccayavyudāsenoktam | saṃmūrchitarūpo hi samudāyo'bhidhīyate | na tvatrāvayavā bhedavantaḥ kathyante | vikalpena samuccayena vā bhedavivakṣāyāṃ hi vikalpo vā syāt samuccayo vā | abhedaprāptāstu samuditā yadā abhidhīyante, tadā na vikalpo na samuccayaḥ | ata eva vṛkṣaśabdena mūlādīnāṃ bhedenānabhidhānād bahuvacanaṃ na bhavati | tasmāt samudāyābhidhānenābhidhīyamāno'vayava iti tena niṣkṛṣṭarūpeṇānabhidhīyamānena na kaścidupakāra iti samudāyādapod‌dhṛto'vayavaḥ samāviṣṭavyāpāradravyalakṣaṇo'tra brāhmaṇaśabdasyārtho vācyaḥ | kevalāyāḥ kriyāyā vācyatve doṣābhidhānāt kriyonmukhaṃ dravyamabhideyamiti kriyāmukhena tulyatopapattistasya || 498 ||
yadyavayave samudāye ca śabdasya vṛttau viśeṣavacanatvam, kimidānīṃ sāmānyavacanaṃ syādityata āha-- samuccayo vikalpo vā prakārāḥ sarva eva vā | viśeṣā iti varṇyante sāmānyaṃ vā'vikalpitam || 499 ||
yadi samuccitāḥ sarve bhedāḥ śabdenābhidhīyante, atha vikalpitāḥ | sarvathā viśeṣavacanatvameva śabdānām | tathā hyanekārtho bhinnarūpaḥ samakakṣyatayābhidhīyamānaḥ samuccito'bhihito bhavati jātiguṇakriyādirūpaḥ | tatra caikadeśamātrasya vikalpasya ca nivṛttiriti viśeṣa evāyam | evaṃ paryāyaṇābhidhīyamānāsta evārthā vikalpitā bhavanti | tatrāpi ca samuccayasya vyudāsād viśeṣarūpataiva | yadyapi ca samudāyo'vikalpasamuccayo vācya ityuktam, tathāpyanekārthatāprakāraparasaṃkhyāprasaṅgenātra vikalpasamuccayāvupāttau | samuccayād bhedenopādānācca prakāraiti | prakārā iti dravyaṃ prati guṇabhūtā dharmā nirdiṣṭāḥ | tathā ca sāmānyāveśaprāptā guṇapradhānabhāvenātra dharmā vivakṣitā iti tṛtīyo'yaṃ pakṣaḥ | samaprādhānyaṃ paryāyo guṇapradhānabhāvaśceti etāvānatra prakāraḥ saṃbhavī krameṇopanyastaḥ | ta ete sarva evābhidhīyamānāḥ prakārāḥ pratiniyatabhedāpohahetutvād viśeṣā evāvagantavyāḥ | sāmānyamapyavikalpitaṃ prādhānyenābhidhīyamānaṃ viśeṣa eva pratiniyataviśeṣāpāvartanāt | tathāhi sāmānyarūpoparāgeṇa yugapadeva bahavo viśeṣāḥ kathyamānāḥ pratiniyatamapāvartayantyeva viśeṣam, sarveṣāmabhinnasāmānyānuvedhena kriyāyogāt | ata eva bhāṣyam-`sāmānyamapi yathā viśeṣastadvat' iti || 499 ||
evaṃ viśeṣavacanatve śabdānāṃ vyāptirupadarśitā | tathā ca samudāyavacanatve'pi tatsiddhiḥ | idaṃ tu vaktavyam--upamāne kriyāguṇayorevopakārāt tadviṣayaṃ śabdānāṃ samudāyavacanatvaṃ kīdṛśamityāha-- na hi brāhmaṇa ityatra bhedaḥ kaścidupāśritaḥ | apākṛto vā tenāyaṃ samudāye vyavasthitaḥ || 500 ||
niyatasya bhedasya pratipādane tadaparasya nivāraṇāt samudāyavacanatvaṃ na syāt | na cātra kaścidaṅgīkṛto'paraśca nivārito viśeṣa iti yuktaṃ samudāyavacanatvam | prakaraṇādinirapekṣo hi brāhmaṇaśabdaḥ samūhamevācaṣṭe | itthaṃ ca samudāyavacanatve kriyāgumayoḥ śabdārthatvādupamāhetutvamityupamānaviṣaye samudāyavacanatvasyāpayogaḥ || 500 ||
tathā hyavayavavṛttitvaṃ tatra yatnādityāha-- kriyā tvāśrīyate yasmin sa bhedo'dhyavasīyate | tathānyathā sarvathā cetyaprayoge na vidyate || 501 ||
yasminnupamāne kriyāśrīyate sādhāraṇadharmatvenāpekṣyate, tatra sa kriyākhyo dharmaḥ samudāyavṛttasya śabdasya niścīyate | brāhmaṇena tulyamadhīta ityatra hyadhyayanasya sādhāraṇasya dharmasyāśrayaṇamiti śabdāntarasaṃnidhānāt tatraivāvayave brāhmaṇaśrutiḥ samarthyate | yataḥ śabdāntarasyāprayoge sa niyato'bhimataḥ prakāro'nyaḥ sarvo vā na saṃbhavati | anapekṣitaśabdāntaraprayogādiḥ śabdo jhaṭiti svārthaṃ prasiddhaṃ samudāyarūpamevāha yataḥ, tasmādupamāviṣaye yatnāt samudāyaśabdāsyāvayave vṛttirityarthaḥ || 501 ||
tameva yatnamāha-- upamāne kriyāvṛttimupameye kriyāśrutiḥ | pratyāyayantī bhedasya karotīva padārthatām || 502 ||
`brāhmaṇavadadhīte kṣatriyaḥ' ityupameye kṣatriye kriyā śrūyamāṇā upamāne'pi brāhmaṇaśabde kriyārthatvaṃ sūcayati | samānadharmaprayukto hyupamānopameyabhāva ityubhayatra kriyāsādhāraṇatvam | tataśca bhedasya pradeśasyātropamānapadenābhidhānaṃ niścīyate | upameyagatā kriyāśrutirupamānagatāṃ kriyāṃ nābhidadhāti, kintu tato'vasīyate kriyāvacanatvamupamānaśabdasyetīvaśabdaḥ || 502 ||
na ca śuddhāyāḥ kriyāyā vacanaṃ saṃbhavatīti kriyayorapyupamānopameyabhāve'bhisaṃhite vyāpārāviṣṭadravyavacanādeva tṛtīyāsamarthād vatirityāha-- vyāpāreṇaiva sādṛśye vyāpārasya vivakṣite | kriyāvad vacanācchabdāt pratyayaḥ pratipādyate || 503 ||
brāhmaṇādhyayanena tulyaṃ kṣatriyādhyayanamityapi kriyayoḥ sāmye'dhyayanavaditi sauṣṭhavādidharmāntarādhārabhāvaṃ pratipādyamānā kriyā prātipadikārtho dravyāyamāṇaivetyatrāpi pūrvavat kriyāśruterupalakṣaṇatvāt kriyāviṣṭadravyavacanādeva tṛtīyāsamarthād vatiriti samānaṃ pūrveṇa || 503 ||
yadi dravyavacanādapi samāśritakriyāpradhānāt pratyayo'bhyupagamyate, tadā kriyāyā asattvabhūtatvādaliṅgasaṃkhyatve siddhe svarādiṣu vateḥ kimarthaḥ pāṭhaścodyata ityāśaṅkyāha-- kriyāvato'pi sādṛśye vaktumiṣṭe kriyāvatā | adhyetā brāhmaṇa iva pratyayo na nivartate || 504 ||
kriyāvatordravyayorapyupamānopameyayorupāttakriyādvārakaṃ sādṛśyamāśritya brāhmaṇa ivāyaṃ kṣatriyo'dhyetā, brāhmaṇena tulyo'dhyetā brāhmaṇavaditi syādaniṣṭaḥ pratyayo vatiḥ | tathā ca sattvavatanatvādavyayeṣu vateḥ pāṭhaḥ kartavya ityuktam | dravyaprādhānye hi sattvaṃ vatyantasyeti liṅgasaṃkhyāyogaḥ syāt | ataḥ svarādipāṭhenāvyayatvamārabhyate || 504 ||
nanu ca kriyāvatorapi kriyādvāraka evopamānopameyabhāvaḥ, tatra ceṣyata eva vatiriti kathamaniṣṭatvena pratyayo na nivartate ityuktamityāha-- adhīte tulya ityevaṃ puṃlliṅgena viśeṣaṇam | kriyāvati kriyāyāṃ tu tulyaśabde napuṃsakam || 505 ||
