kriyāvatoḥ sādṛśye vatirvidhīyamānaḥ, sattvarūpatvāt tayostulyaśabdastalliṅga eva prayujyate, brāhmaṇena tulyo'dhīte kṣatriya iti | tathā ca kriyānimittaṃ tulyatvaṃ niyamena na pratīyate | anyena kenacid dharmeṇa tulyo'dhīta ityapyavagamāt kriyātulyatvasyāsaṃpratyayādatra pratyayo neṣyate | kriyānimitte tu sādṛśye pratyaya iti tatra tulya śabdaḥ nipatannasattvabhūtatvāt tasyāḥ śabdasaṃskārārthaṃ liṅgasarvanāmanapuṃsakamevāśrayate | tathā ca kriyānimittaṃ tulyatvaṃ brāhmaṇena tulyamadhīta iti niyogataḥ pratīyata iti tatraiveṣyate vatiḥ | atra ca pakṣe sattvabhūtasyāpi kriyāviśeṣaṇasya viśeṣyadharmānuvṛtterliṅgaviśeṣāyogādavyayeṣu pāṭho na kāryo vateḥ || 505 ||
idānīmatraiva prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇapakṣe "yadi tarhi tṛtīyāsamarthaṃ viśeṣyate, pratyayārtho'viśeṣito bhavati | tatra ko doṣaḥ ? tṛtīyāsamarthāt kriyāvācino guṇatulyatve'pi pratyayaḥ prāpnoti | putreṇa saha tulyaḥ sthūlaḥ, putreṇa saha tulyaḥ piṅgalaḥ" iti yo bhāṣye guṇatulye'pi pratyayaḥ prasañjitaḥ, sa kathamupapadyate ? yāvatā na putraśabdaḥ kriyāvācītyāśaṅkya bhāṣyaṃ samarthayitumāpātayāta-- prakṛtyarthe viśiṣṭe'pi pratyayārthāviśeṣaṇāt | putreṇa tulyaḥ kapila iti vṛttiḥ prasajyate || 506 ||
ekatvāt kriyāśabdasya prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇopakṣaye pratyayārthasya tulyatvasyāviśeṣitatvād guṇenāpi kapilatvena tulye putraśabdāt tṛtīyāsamarthād vatiḥ syāditi codyabhāṣyaṃ vivṛtam || 506 ||
putraśabdasya kriyāvācitvaṃ samarthayitumāha-- yāḥ putre rūḍhasambandhāḥ kriyāloke vivakṣitāḥ | tābhiḥ kriyāvataḥ putrād guṇatulye vatirbhavet || 507 ||
piturnideśe yo vartate'dhīte, santānamanuvartate ca, sa putraḥ sadācārānupālanāt kathyate | yastu na niyogakārī, nādhyetā, na sadācāraḥ, tamaputro'yamiti vyavaharantīti nideśasthānādikriyāḥ putraśabdārthe nirūḍhayogaḥ putraśabdo'ntarbhāvayati, yathā brāhmaṇādayo'dhyayanādikān dharmāniti | tadvadayamapi samudāyavacana ityatropāttakriyābhiḥ kriyāvataḥ putrādavayavavacanāt tṛtīyāsamarthād guṇenāpi tulye vivakṣite vatirbhavet || 507 ||
tatraitat syāt| `punnāmno narakād yasmāt trāyate putra ityataḥ' iti putraśabdapravṛttinimittaṃ pavanādikriyāmavadhīrya ko nideśasthānādiṣu bāhyāsu putrārthasahacāriṇīṣu kriyāsvādara ityata āha-- antarbhūtaṃ nimittaṃ ca rūḍhiśabdeṣu yadyapi | kriyāstu sahacāriṇyo rūḍhāḥ santi padārthavat || 508 ||
iha rūḍhiṣu nāvayavārthānugama iti pravṛttinimittabhūtāmantaraṅgāmapi kriyāmanādṛtya padavācyadravyatulyāḥ sāhacaryeṇāvyabhicārāt pratīyamānāḥ prasiddhā nideśasthānādayaḥ kriyāḥ samāśrīyante | pravṛttinimittabhūtā hi kriyā vyutpattinibandhanatvena paramāśrīyate | nārthakriyāsu tasyā vyāpāraḥ | tadevamekena viśeṣaṇenobhayaviśeṣaṇāyogāt kriyāgrahaṇena prakṛtyarthe viśeṣite kriyāvadupalakṣaṇārthatvāt kriyāśruterbrāhmaṇādiśabdebhyaḥ kriyāvadvacanebhyaḥ pratyaye samarthite'pi pratyayārthasyāviśeṣitatvād guṇatulye'pi pratyayaprasaṅga iti || 508 ||
astu tarhi pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇam, yattat tulyaṃ kriyā cet sā bhavatī'ti pakṣāntaramupanyastaṃ bhāṣye vyākhyātumāha-- kramaṃ tu yadi bādhitvā pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇam | pradhānānugrahāt sāmyād vibhakteścāvatiṣṭhate || 509 ||
sthānanimittaḥ krama uktaḥ | prāthamyāt tenetyetat kriyāśabdena viśeṣyata iti tasya ttatra bādhaḥ | samānavibhaktikatvāt pradhānatvācca pratyayārthasya tulyamityasya kriyeti viśeṣaṇaṃ nyāyyamityevaṃ kalpyate | tathāhi pradhānasya pratyayārthasya viśeṣaṇayoge kalpyamāne guṇasya prakṛtyarthasya tadanupapattiḥ | sāmānādhikaraṇyena ca sambandhasambhave'dhāyāhāreṇa tenetyasya kriyeti sambandho na nyāyyaḥ | vibhaktisāmyaṃ hi śabdavat | aśabdastu kramaḥ || 509 ||
evaṃ prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇapakṣaṃ bādhitvā yadi pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇapakṣaḥ kalpyate, tadātrāpi pūrvadoṣasāmyamityāha-- prakṛteraviśiṣṭatvāt kriyātulye prasajyate | putrādau guṇaśabdebhyaḥ pūrvoktasya viparyaye || 510 ||
ekena viśeṣaṇena dvayorayogāt kriyāgrahaṇena prakṛtiraviśeṣitātra syāt | tataśca guṇavacanebhyaḥ sthūlādibhyaḥ pūrvoktanideśastānādikayā kriyayā tulye putre vācye vatirbhavet | tathāhi--prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇe yadudāhṛtam, tadevātra viparyayeṇodāhartavyam, sthūlena tulyaḥ putra iti | taduktaṃ bhāṣye--`evamapi tṛtīyāsamarthamaviśeṣitaṃ bhavati | tatra ko doṣaḥ | tṛtīyāsamarthādakriyāvācinaḥ kriyātulye'pi pratyayaḥ prāpnoti' iti || 510 ||
kecit punaratra sākṣād bhāṣye'nudāhṛtatvāt sthūlena tulyo yātītyevamudāharanti | tathāhyākhyātādupameyasya kriyāviśiṣṭasya pratītiritīdameva yuktamiti manyante | tacca na | yataḥ-- sthūlena tulyo yātīti bahiraṅgā kriyāśrutiḥ | animittaṃ vatestulyaṃ yātītyatreṣyate vati || 511 ||
tulyo yātīti puṃliṅgena sāmānādhikaraṇyānniyogataḥ kriyātulyatvaṃ nāvagamyate | yaḥ kenacidanyena dharmeṇa sthūlena tulyo devadattaḥ, sa yātītyevamapi pratīteḥ | tathā ca devadatte nirūḍhena dharmāntareṇa tulyatayā nirjñāte tasya paścāt sannipatantī kriyāśrutirvateḥ pratyayasyotpattau nimittaṃ heturna bhavati | śābdī hi kriyā bhavedupamānopameyasambandhe nibandhanam | na ceha sthūlena tulya iti padadvayasambandhakāle tatpratyotpattinimitte kācit sannihitā kriyā, sthūlaśabdasya guṇavacanatvāt, tulyaśabdasya ca puṃliṅgatvena kriyāviṣayatvābhāvāt | vṛtte tu sambandhe pratyayotpattinimitte padāntarāt paścāt pratīyamānā kriyā bahiraṅgā nopamāsambandhe nimittam | evañca sthūlena tulyaḥ putra ityasmādasyāviśeṣaḥ | yadā tu sthūlena tulyaṃ yātīti napuṃsakaliṅgena tulyaśabdena sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ yātītyasya, tadā kriyāprādhānyaṃ niyogataḥ pratīyate, asattvabhūtatvāt kriyāyāstadviśeṣaṇasya, napuṃsakatvopapateḥ | tathā cātreṣyate vatiḥ | sthūlavad yāti mandāyamānapadavinyāsaścālitodarakalaśa iti | atra hi prakṛtipratyayārthābhidhāyīpadadvayasamanvayakāla eva śabdavācyā kriyā saṃbhavatyupamānopameyabhāvanimittam, brāhmaṇavadadhīta itivaditi na bahiraṅgāt pratītiḥ || 511 ||
tadevaṃ pakṣadvaye'pi samīkṛtasya doṣasya bhāṣye samādhiramihitā--`naiṣa doṣaḥ | yat tat tulyaṃ kriyā cet sā bhavatītyucyate | tulayā ca saṃmitaṃ tulyam | yadi ca tṛtīyāsamarthamapi kriyā pratyayārtho'pi kriyā, tatastulyaṃ bhavati' iti | tadetat tātparyato vivṛṇoti-- dvayaṃ viśeṣyate tena yadekatra viśeṣaṇam | tulyaśabdo hi taṃ dharmamubhayasthamapekṣate || 512 ||
yat kriyāgrahaṇamekatra śrutaṃ sadviśeṣaṇaṃ tena kriyāgrahaṇena dvayaṃ prakṛtipratyayārthalakṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyate'vacchidyate | kathamekenobhayaviśeṣaṇam | evaṃ hi pravṛttibhedastasyabhavedityata āha--tulyaśabdo hītyādi | sādṛśyasyobhayādhiṣṭhānatvād yasmāt tulyaśabdastaṃ kriyākhyaṃ dharmamubhayagatamaṅgīkaroti, tasmādubhayaviśeṣaṇaṃ sāmarthyādavatiṣṭhate śrutyaikaniṣṭhatve'pīti || 512 ||
evaṃ hi tulyaśabdārtha upapadyata ityāha-- ekaḥ samāno dharmaścedupamānopameyayoḥ | tulayā saṃmitaṃ tulyamiti tatropapadyate || 513 ||
bhāṣye'bhihitaṃ `tulayā ca saṃmitaṃ tulyami'ti | yadyapi sadṛśe'rthe tulyaśabdo rūḍhaḥ, tathāpi vyutpattinibandhanaṃ kriyānuvidhīyata ityāśayaḥ | tathā ca yathā tulayā kiñcit paricchidyate, tathā samānena dharmeṇa pariccheda iti saṃmitatvaṃ samānamasti | evañcaikatrāpi śruto'paratra sāmarthyādanvayī samāno dharmo'vagamyata iti tātparyeṇa tulayā saṃmitatvamuktam | tasmāt prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇe'pi pratyayārthaḥ kriyā | na hyanyastulyaḥ kriyayāsti, anyadataḥ kriyāyāḥ || 513 ||
evaṃ pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇe'pi tulyaśabdasāmarthyāt prakṛtyarthakriyākṣepa ityubhayapakṣabhāvī doṣo nāsti | sa cātra samāno dharmo na yaḥ kaścit | api tu yaścodanāyāṃ saṃnihita ityāha-- sūtre śrutaśca dviṣṭho'sāvabhedena pratīyate | na ca sāmānyaśabdatvādaśrutā gamyate kriyā || 514 ||
asau kriyākhye dharmaḥ sūtre kriyā cediti śrutaḥ śabdenaikagāmitve'pi codite tulyātāsāmarthyādubhayagato'vadhāryate | evañca putreṇa tulyaḥ sthūlaḥ, sthūlena tulyaḥ putra ityatra pratyayo na bhavati | yatra hi śrūyate kriyā, tatrobhayagatatvenāpekṣyatāṃ na tvatrāśrūyamāṇe kriyāśabde | na ca putraśabda eva kriyāvacano'sya sāmānyaśabdatvāt | sakiye niṣkriye cāviśeṣeṇa hi putraśabdaḥ pratyāyakatvena vartate | tataścā niyogataḥ kriyayaiva sādṛśyamiti nāstyavagamaḥ | dharmāntareṇāpi sāmyasaṃbhave samudāyaśabdasya kriyāvatyavayave pravṛtterapramāṇakatvāt | yatnasamadhigamyā hi pradeśe vṛttiḥ śabdasyetyuktam || 514 ||
nanu ca nideśasthāyitādayo nirūḍhasaṃbandhāḥsa putrārthe kriyāḥ pratipāditā iti tāsāmasaṃpratyayaḥ kasmāt putraśabdādityata āha-- aśrutāśca pratīyante nideśasthāyitādayaḥ | ye dharmā niyatāsteṣāṃ putrādiśu na vidyate || 515 ||
śruteḥ pratītihetutvādaśrutāḥ kathaṃ pratīyanta ityuktaṃ niyatā iti | tadayamarthaḥ--śrutyabhāvādayameva dharma iti pratītirnāsti | sāmānyena tu pratītāvasti nimittaṃ naiyatyaṃ nāma | tathā hi nirūḍhayogatvāt prasiddheḥ padārthaikadeśabhūtānāṃ bhavati kriyāṇāmantareṇāpi svavācakaprayogaṃ putraśabdāt sāmānyena pratītiḥ | evamapi teṣāṃ bahūnāṃ dharmāṇāṃ nirūḍhatvānniyatasya vācakasyābhāvānniyogataḥ kriyāyā evopamāhetutvasyāsaṃpratyayāt teṣāṃ sāmānyadharmāṇāṃ saṃbandhatvena putrādiṣu vācyeṣu taddhitavṛttirnāsti | putravadayaṃ māṇavaka ityatra vatyarthasāmarthyāt kriyā yogyādhyāhartavyā | putravadayaṃ māṇavako draṣṭavya ityādi | evaṃ sthānivadādeśa  ityatrāpi sthānivad vartata ityarthaḥ | itthañca sthūlena tulyaṃ yāti sthūlavad yāti iti vṛttiruktā | anapekṣite tu kriyāpade nāstyavagatiḥ || 515 ||
etamevārthaṃ nigamayati-- anāśritakriyastasmānna tulyo'sti kriyāvatā | kriyāyāḥ śravaṇe sāpi kriyāvattā pratīyate || 516 ||
asati kriyāpadaprayoge yasmānniyamena kriyā sādhāraṇī na pratīyate, tasmāt putrādiṣu niyogataḥ kriyānimittasyopamānopameyabhāvasyāpratītervṛttirnāsti | ato'napekṣitāsādhāraṇakriyo nāpareṇa kriyāvatā sadṛśo vidyate | brāhmaṇavadadhīte kṣatriya ityādau tu malodāharaṇe sākṣādupameyagatatvena kriyāyāḥ śravaṇe kriyāsaṃbandhanimittatvenopamāne'pi gamyata iti dvayorapi pakṣayordoṣapratividhānasāmyam || 516 ||
evamapi pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇapakṣa eva siddhāntitaḥ | tathā hi bhāṣyam--"kiṃ punaratra jyāyaḥ | pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇapakṣa eva jyāyaḥ | kuta etat | evaṃ hi kṛtvācāryeṇa sūtraṃ paṭhitam | vatinā sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ kṛtam | api cāvyayeṣu vateḥ pāṭho na kartavyo bhavati kriyāyāmayaṃ bhavam̐lliṅgasaṃkhyābhyāṃ na yokṣyate" iti | etad vyācaṣṭe-- dvayoḥ pratividhānācca jyāyastvamabhidhīyate | nityāsattvābhidhāyitvāt pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇe || 517 ||
ubayorapi pakṣayordoṣapratividhānāt praśasyatve pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇapakṣe jyāyastvamadhīyate | yatnāntarāpekṣayā hyatra pakṣe lāghavamiti praśasyataratvamākhyāyate | tathā hi--kriyāyā asattvabhūtāyā nityaṃ niyogato vateḥ pratyāyakatvādaliṅgasaṃkhyatayāvyayatvasiddheḥ svarādiṣu pāṭho na kartavyo bhavati || 517 ||
nanu cātrāpi pakṣe kriyāvataḥ sattvabhūtasya vativācyateti kartavya eva svarādiṣu vateḥ pāṭha ityāśaṅkyāha-- asattvabhūto vyāpāraḥ kevalaṃ pratyaye yataḥ | vidyate lakṣaṇārthatvaṃ nāsti tena kriyāśruteḥ || 518 ||
pratyaye viṣayabhūte vācyatvena yasmādasattvabhūto vyāpāraḥ kriyālakṣaṇaḥ kevalo dravyarahito'sti, tena kriyāśruteḥ kriyāśabdasya kriyāvadupalakṣaṇatvaṃ nāstyatra pakṣe yathā prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇapakṣe śuddhāyāḥ kriyāyāstṛtīyāsamarthāyā asaṃbhavāt pūrvamuktam | saṃbhavati hi śraute mukhye'rthe lakṣaṇāyā anupapattiḥ | tathā ca kriyāmātrābhidhāyitvāt pratyayasyāvyayatvopapattau tatra pāṭho na kartavyaḥ || 518 ||
tatraitat syāt | yathā prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇapakṣe śuddhāyāḥ kriyāyā asaṃbhavāt tadvadupādānam, tathātrāpi pakṣe pratyayavācyāyāḥ kriyāyāḥ kriyayaiva tulyatvāt tasyāḥ śuddhāyā abhāve kriyāvacanādeva pratyaya iti kaḥ pakṣayorviśeṣa ityata āha-- kriyāvatastu grahaṇāt prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇe | kriyāmātreṇa tulyatve siddhā'sattvābhidhāyitā || 519 ||
prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇapakṣe kriyāvataḥ prakṛtyarthatvenopādānāt tulyatāsāmarthyād yadā kriyaivopameyeti pakṣaḥ, tadāsattvabhūtārthatvād vatyantasyāvyayatvaṃ siddham || 519 ||
yadā tu kriyāvān pratyayārtha iti pakṣastadāha-- yadā kriyānimittaṃ tu sādṛśyaṃ syāt kriyāvatoḥ | kriyāvato'bhidheyatvāt tadā'dravyābhidhāyitā || 520 ||
tulyamiti napuṃsakena viśeṣaṇāt sākṣāt kriyaiva sadṛśī samadhigamyate | sā ca kriyā kriyāntaraṃ yadā sauṣṭhavādinā samānena dharmeṇopamimīte, tadā pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇapakṣaḥ | yadā tu kriyāvānupamīyate, tadā dvaitam | vyāpārānuviddhasya vā prādhānyaṃ tasya vyāpāropalakṣitasya vā | pūrvatra pakṣe'sattvabhūtatvād avyayatvaṃ siddham | ākhyātavācyo hyupameya ityākhyātasyāsattvabhūtārthaprādhānyādavyayatvam || 520 ||
kriyopalakṣitasya dravyasya tu prādhānye prakṛtivācyo'pi kriyāvān, pratyayārtho'pi kriyāvāṃstulyatāvaśād iti vateḥ sattvabhūtārthavācitvāt pāṭhenāvyayatvamuktamityāha-- avyayeṣu vateḥ pāṭhaḥ kāryastatra svarādivat | brāhmaṇena samo'dhyetetyatra ca pratyayo bhavet || 521 ||
svarādīnāṃ sattvavacanatvam, svī rohāvaḥ, svaryāta iti sattvasaṃbandhāvyabhicāriṇaḥ karmādibhāvasya dṛṣṭatvāt | ata eva cādiṣvasattvavacaneṣveṣāṃ pāṭho na kṛtaḥ | pṛthak pāṭhenāvyayasaṃjñārabdhā | evaṃ vatyantasya dravyavacanatve tadvat pāṭhenāvyayasaṃjñā kāryā | pāṭhasāmarthyāddhi sattvavacanatve'pyavyayasaṃjñā pravartate | pūrvatra tu pakṣe'nvarthatvādavyayatvaṃ sidhyati | bhāṣyakāramate hi na vyetītyavyayamityeva lakṣaṇam | prapañcārthastu pāṭhaḥ | sūtrakāramate'pyapaṭhitānāṃ keṣāñcit saṅgrahārthamanvarthasaṃjñaiva lakṣaṇam, prapañcārthaḥ pāṭha ityeva nyāyyam | vārttikakāramate tvaliṅgāsaṃkhyamavyayamityetadevāvyayalakṣaṇamiti | munitrayadarśane'pi pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇapakṣe pāṭhamantareṇa siddhāvyayasaṃjñā vatyantasyetyasya pakṣasyotkarṣaḥ | uttarasūtreṇāpi vatervihitasyāsattvabhūtārthābhidhāyitvamivaśabdasyeva | `tadarham  ityanenāpi kriyāyāṃ vatirvidhīyata iti na tadartho'pi pāṭhaḥ | prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇapakṣe cāvyayeṣu pāṭhacodanāpraṇālikayā bhāṣyakāreṇa brāhmaṇena kriyāmātravācitve hyasattvarūpateti sāmarthyāt tadvadvācitve sattvarūpatāyāṃ tatraiva tadvati pratyayo'niṣṭaḥ sphuṭamukto bhavati || 521 ||
idānīmatra pakṣe vatinā sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ vivarītumāha-- sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ ca vatyarthenāpadiśyate | tulyamityanyathā kalpyo vākyaśeṣo'śruto bhavet || 522 ||
vatiśabdena bhāṣye vatyarthastulyaśabda uktaḥ | tathā hi--vidhīyamānatvād vaterasiddhāvasthasya viśeṣaṇīyatvaṃ nāsti | prasiddhasya hi bhedāya viśeṣaṇopādānamarthavad bhavati | sādhutvapratipattaye viśeṣaṇāpekṣāyāṃ ca na yugapad vateḥ sāmarthyaṃ vidyate | na cāpyasya kriyārūpatā akriyārūpatā cāsti, yenākriyānivṛtyarthaṃ kriyetyetad viśeṣaṇamupādīyeta | tasmād vatyupalakṣitena vatyarthavācinā tulyaśabdenātra kriyāśabdasya sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ bhāṣye vivakṣitam | tulyārtho hi kriyā cāstyakriyā ceti yuktaṃ viśeṣaṇam | yattat tulyaṃ kriyā cet sā bhavatīti ca śrautameva sāmānādhikaraṇyam | prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇapakṣe tu tenetyasya kriyetyasamānādhikaraṇyād yat tat tṛtīyāsamarthaṃ kriyā cet sā bhavatīti vākyaśeṣādhyāhāreṇa samanvayaḥ kalpayitavyaḥ syāt | saṃbhavati tu śraute samanvaye'dhyāhāreṇa tadupapattirgarīyasī || 522 ||
adhyetari ca pratyayo'niṣṭo'tra pakṣe na prāpnotītyāha-- kriyāvatośca sādṛśye pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇe | adhyetrā sadṛśo'dhyetetyatra nāsti vatervidhiḥ || 523 ||
sāmānādhikaraṇyena kriyāyā eva tulyatayā viśeṣaṇāt tadāviṣṭa eva kartaryapi pratyayo'tra pakṣe, na pradhānabhūte dravye | evañca kṛtvākhyātenātra kriyāpradhānena nirdeśo brāhmaṇena tulyamadhīta iti | pūrvatra pakṣe kriyāvatā pratyayārthena tathāvidhasyaina pratyayārthasya (prakṛtyarthasya) sāmyamupamāhetutvena kriyāyā guṇatvāditi dravyaprādhānye'niṣṭaḥ pratyayaḥ prasajet | nāpyuttarasūtreṇa `tatra tasyeva'  ityanena putreṇa tulyaḥ sthūla ityādau pratyaya iṣyate | bāhyena ti sambandhinopajanitaḥ prātipadikārthavyatirekāt ṣaṣṭhyantāt saptamyantād vā tatra pratyaya iṣyate | tena putravat sthūla ityatra naivotpattavyaṃ pratyayena | yadā tu putravat sthūlo vartata ityucyate, tadā kriyākṛto bhavatyupamānopameyabhāvo na guṇakṛta iti bhavati pratyayaḥ | sarvathā kriyānāśrayaṇe tadabhāvaḥ | tadevaṃ śrautasya sāmānādhikaraṇyasyopapatteravyayeṣu pāṭhāprasaṅgādadhyetari tulye'niṣṭapratyayāprasaṅgācca pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇapakṣaḥ praśasyataratvena siddhāntitaḥ || 523 ||
idānīṃ `tatra tasyaiva'  ityayaṃ vatirivārthaviṣayo vicāryate | tatredaṃ bhāṣyaṃ--`kimarthamidamucyate | na tena tulyaṃ kriyā ced vatirityeva siddhami'ti | tatrevatulyaśabdayoḥ samānārthatve'pi pūrveṇa tṛtīyāntād vidhiḥ, anena tu saptamyantāt ṣaṣṭhyantācceti samarthavibhaktibhedāt kathaṃ pūrveṇa siddhiriti pūrvapakṣabhāṣyābhiprāyaṃ vyācaṣṭe-- tulyārthairiti yā tasyāstṛtīyāyā na bhidyate | artho bhede'pi sarvābhiritarābhirvibhaktibhiḥ || 524 ||
`tulyārthairatulopamābhyāṃ tṛtīyānyatarasyām,  iti yā tulyārthairyoge tṛtīyā vidhīyate, tasyā yo'rthaḥ, sa sakalābhirvibhaktibhirivayoge vidhīyamānābhiḥ karaṇabhūtābhiryo'rtho'bhidhīyate, tato na bhidyate | bhede'pīti | sāmarthyādanyatve'pi vibhaktīnām | yadvābhidhāvyāpārabhede'pi vastvabhedaḥ | vṛttau hyatra vibhakterapagamāt tadarthabhedakṛtasyāvacchedasyāsambhavaḥ, sadṛśārthasampratyayasya samānatvāt | kevalaṃ vigrahavākyamātramatra bhidyate | tasmād vastvabhedāt pūrveṇaiva siddhiruktā || 524 ||
tamevārthābhedamudāharati-- bhujyate brāhmaṇeneva tulyaṃ bhuktaṃ dvijātinā | paśyati brāhmaṇamiva tulyaṃ vipreṇa paśyati || 525 ||
brāhmaṇeneva vijñātaṃ tulyaṃ jñātaṃ dvijātinā | dīyatāṃ brāhmaṇāyeva tulyaṃ vipreṇa dīyatām || 526 ||
brāhmaṇādiva vaiśyāt tvamadhīṣvādhyayanaṃ bahu | ityevamādibhirbhedastṛtīyāyā na kaścana || 527 ||
tulyārthayoge tṛtīyā śeṣavibhaktiḥ, ivārthayoge kriyāsādhane vibhaktayaḥ | śeṣasambandhaśca kriyākārakasambandhapūrvaka iti tṛtīyayātra samastasya kriyākāraka sambandhasya hetubhūtasyākṣepād vastvarthasya bhedo nāsti | ādigrahaṇāt-- vipreṇa tulyaṃ vaiśyāt tvamadhīṣvādhyayanaṃ bahu | brāhmaṇasyeva vaiśyasya dhanametadupasthitam || vipreṇa tulyaṃ vaiśyasya dhanametadupasthitam | guṇā vipra ivātraite kṣatriye bahavaḥ sthitāḥ || vipreṇa tulyaṃ tiṣṭhanti kṣatriye bahavo guṇāḥ | ityudāhāryam || 525--527 ||
atra codayati-- tulyaṃ madhurayādhīye mātrā tulyaṃ smarāmi tām | madhurāyāśca mātuśca kathaṃ sādṛśyakalpanā || 528 ||
madhurāyāmiva pāṭaliputre'dhīye'ham, māturiva devadattāyāḥ smarāmi ityatra "tatra tasyeva"  itīṣyate vatiḥ, madhurāvadadhīye, mātṛvat smarāmīti | pūrveṇaiva tu siddhāvatredaṃ vākyaṃ syād, madhurayā tulyamadhīye, mātrā tulyaṃ smarāmīti | tathā cādhyayanasya madhurayā sādṛśyam, smaraṇasya ca mātrā | tatra mātuḥ smaryamāṇāyā adhikaraṇasya ca madhurāyā na kācit tādṛśī kriyā lakṣyate, yādhyayanasmaraṇayostulyā syāditi tasyāṃ mātṛmadhurāśabdayorvṛttiḥ kalpyate | yadi paramadhyayanasyādhyayanāntaraṃ smaraṇasya ca smaraṇāntaramāśrayabhedena bhinnaṃ sadṛśaṃ syāt, tacca kartṛsamavetamiti karmādhikaraṇayormātṛmadhurayorasyāsambhava eva || 528 ||
tasmāt kathamatra pūrveṇa pratyaya ityata āha-- madhurāviṣayaḥ pāṭhaḥ smaraṇaṃ mātṛkarmakam | madhurāmātṛśabdābhyāmabhedenābhidhīyate || 529 ||
madurayā tulyamadhīya ityupameye'dhyayanakriyā śrūyamāṇoramāne'pi tāmavagamayati samānadharmaprayuktatvādaupamyasya | tathā ca madhurādhikaraṇakamadhyayanaṃ madhuretyādhārādheyayorabhedavivakṣāyāmayaṃ prayogaḥ | evaṃ mātṛviṣayaṃ smaraṇaṃ viṣayaviṣayiṇorabhedābhisandhānena mātṛśabdena kathyata iti mātrā tulyaṃ smarāmīti prayogaḥ | madhurādhikaraṇenādhyayanena tulyaṃ smarāmīti prayogaḥ | madhurādhikaraṇenādhyayanena tulyaṃ pāṭaliputre'dhyayanam, mātṛviṣayeṇa smaraṇena tulyaṃ devadattāyāḥ smaraṇamityarthaḥ | yadyapi ca mātātra śeṣaḥ, tathāpi vāstavaṃ karmatvamabhipretya smaraṇaṃ mātṛkarmakamityuktam | karmaprabhāvito hyatra śeṣaḥ | tathāca " adhīgarthadayeśāṃ karmaṇi"  iti karmaṇaḥ śeṣatvavivakṣāyāmiyaṃ ṣaṣṭhī pratipadoktā samāsanivṛttyarthamiti nirṇītacaram || 529 ||
yathā ca pūrvaṃ samudāyaśabdānāmavayave vṛttirupapāditā, tathātrāpyastīti nidarśanapūrvakamāha-- uṣṭrāvayavatulyeṣu mukheṣūṣṭraśrutiryathā | vartate gṛhatulye ca prāsāde madhurāśrutiḥ || 430 ||
uṣṭro mukhamasyetyevamuṣṭramukhaśabdo vyutpādyate | tatra copamānapūrvapadasyottarapadalopaḥ pratyākhyāto bhāṣye | sāmānādhikaraṇyānyathānupapattyā hyuṣṭraśabdo'troṣṭrāvayaye mukhe vartate | na ca prāṇyantaramukhaṃ prāṇyantarasya sambhavatīti sāmarthyādivārthagarbhīkāreṇātra sambandhaḥ | itthaṃ cātra yathā samudāyaśabdo'vayave vartate, tathā madhurāśabdaḥ samudāyavacano'pyatraikadeśe gṛhe vartata iti madhurātulyāḥ pāṭaliputre gṛhā ityapyayamartho madhurāgṛhaistulyāḥ pāṭaliputragṛhā iti | caśabdo'tra tathāśabdārthe | yadvā nidarśanāntarbhāvanena dṛṣṭantadārṣṭāntikayoḥ samuccayena nirdeśopapattiḥ | evamanena madhurāyā iva pāṭaliputrasya gṛhā itīvārthaviṣayo vatiḥ saṅgṛhyate || 430 ||
yadvātropacārāt kriyāyāṃ dravyavacanasya vṛttirmā bhūt | kriyādvārakaṃ tu dravyayoreva sāmyamiti nidarśanadvāreṇa vyutpādayitumāha-- yathādhyayanayoḥ sāmyamadhyetrorapadiśyate | tathā kriyāgatairdharmairucyante sādhanāśrayāḥ || 431 ||
brāhmaṇavadadhīte kṣatriya ityadhyayanakriyayoḥ sāmyaṃ tulyatvamadhyetrostatsādhanayoḥ kartrorākhyāyate | tathā hyadhyayanadvāreṇādhīyānayorupamānopameyabhāvo vyavasthāpyate | evaṃ madhurāvadadhīte, mātṛvat smaratītyadhyayanasmaraṇākhyakriyāśrayairdharmaiḥ sādṛśyalakṣaṇaiḥ kārakaśaktyādhārā madhurādayaḥ kathyante | adyayanasmaraṇadvāreṇa hi tatkarmādhikaraṇayorupamānopameyabhāvalakṣaṇaḥ sambandho'vatiṣṭhate | na hi kartāra eva kriyādvāreṇa sambandhamanubhavanti, sādhanamātreṇa kriyāyā avinābhāvāt | tadevaṃ madhurayā tulyamadhīte, mātrā tulyaṃ smaratītyādāvapi pūrveṇaiva vatiḥ siddhaḥ || 431 ||
tatraitat syāt--kriyopādhau sādṛśye pūrveṇa vidhiḥ | tathā ca vatinaivāntarbhāvāt kriyāyāstadvacanasya prayogo na bhavati | iha tu sāmānye sādṛśyamātre vidhānamityasti viśeṣa ityāśaṅkyāha-- ivārthe yacca vacanaṃ pūrvasūtre ca yo vidhiḥ | kriyāśabdaśrutau bhedo na kaścit vidyate tayoḥ || 432 ||
sati kriyāpadaprayoge "tena tulyaṃ kriyā ced vatiḥ"  ityanena pūrvasūtreṇa "tatra tasyaiva"  ityasya yogasya viṣayo vyāpta iti nedamārabdhavyam || 432 ||
na ca pūrveṇa vidhau kriyāpadaprayogo nāsti, yataḥ-- yadyapyupādhiranyatra niyato na prayujyate | rūpābhedāt tvanirjñātā kriyātra śrūyate punaḥ || 533 ||
"haraterdṛtināthayoḥ paśau" , "sāsya devatā'  ityādāvayaṃ paśvādirupādhiravacchedako viśiṣṭa iti dṛtiharirityādau prayoge svaśabdena nopādīyate, pratyayenaiva gamitatvāt | niyate hyarthe vidhīyamānaḥ pratyayo nārthāntare sandihyate | iha punaḥ sāmānyena kriyopādhiriti vatyantānniyogataḥ kriyāviśeṣasyāvagamād viśiṣyakriyāvacanasya prayogo'vaśyambhāvī vṛttipadaṃ hyaviśiṣyarūpaṃ kriyāmātrāpratyāyane samarthaṃ syāt, na tu niyatakriyāvedane tasya śaktiḥ || 533 ||
etadeva nidarśanena sādhayati-- yathā vyutparayaṛ pucchau kyaṅnte sudarādayaḥ | satyapi pratyayārthatve bhedābhāvādudāhṛtāḥ || 534 ||
pucchādudasanavyasanaparyasaneṣu ṇaṅo vidhiruktaḥ | tathā ca pucchau ṇyante pucchayatāvaviśeṣādudasanādīnāṃ sāmānyenāvagame viśeṣābhivyaktaye pratyayenaivāntarbhāvite vyudasanādāvudāderupasargasya prayogo'ṅgīkṛtaḥ | utpucchayate, vipucchayate, paripucchayata iti | tathā bhṛśādiṣvabhimanas ityādāvupasargāṇāṃ prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇapakṣe'ḍādiṣu doṣāt siddhāntite, bhavatyarthalakṣaṇapratyayārthaviśeṣaṇapakṣe pratyayenaivopagṛhītārthatve'pi rūpābhedāt pratyayāntasya viśeṣābhivyaktāvasāmarthyāt prayogo'ṅgīkṛtaḥ | abhimanāyate, sumanāyate, durmanāyata iti | evaṃ kriyāmātre vatervidhānāt tadantena kriyāviśeṣānabhivyaktau tadabhivyak‌tyarthaṃ kriyāpadaprayogo nyāyyaḥ | tathā ca kriyāśabdaśrutau bhedābhāvāt pūrveṇaiva siddhamiti sthitam || 534 ||
etadeva nigamayati-- evañca sati pūrveṇa siddho'trāpi vatervidhiḥ | niyame vābhidhāne vā bhidyate na kriyāśrutiḥ || 535 ||
iha yadā pūrvasūtreṇa vatiḥ, tadāpi tena kriyāsāmānyasyābhidhānād viśeṣavyaktaye kriyāpadaprayoga iti niyamo bhavati, viśeṣāntaravyacchedāt | anena tu yogena yo vatiḥ, sa sādṛśyamātramupādatta ityanākhyātatvād vatyantena kriyāyāḥ kriyāśabdena pratyāyanamapūrvamavatiṣṭhate | itthaṃ caitāvānatra bhedaḥ | kriyāśabdaprayogastu sarvathā na bhidyate na viśiṣyata ityanarthakaḥ punarvateranena vidhirlakṣye viśeṣābhāvādityabhiprāyaḥ pūrvapakṣabhāṣye vyākhyātaḥ || 535 ||
anantaramakriyārtho'yamārambha iti yogaprayojanamuktaṃ vyācaṣṭe-- ive dravyādiviṣayaḥ pratyayaḥ punarucyate | kriyāṇāmeva sādṛśye pūrvasūtre vidhīyate || 536 ||
"tena tulyam"  ityanena kriyayā tulyatvasya viśeṣaṇāt kriyānimitte sāmye vatiruktaḥ | tathā ca gavā tulyo gavaya ityatra kriyāsādṛśye vatirna bhavati | anena tvivārthe vatirdravyaguṇanimitte'pi sādṛśye bhūyo vidhīyata ityasti viśeṣaḥ || 536 ||
tathā hyatrodāharaṇam-- madhurāyāmiva gṛhā brāhmaṇasyeva pāṇḍurāḥ | ityatra dravyaguṇayoḥ pūrveṇa na vatirbhavet || 537 ||
madhurāyāmiva pāṭaliputre gṛhā nicitanavaratnā ityatra gṛhadravyayostulyatvam, brāhmaṇasyeva kṣatriyasya śuklā dantā iti śauklyaguṇanimittaṃ sādṛśyam | atra pūrvasūtreṇa vatirna bhavati, tasya kriyānimittasādṛśye niyamitatvāditi punarihocyate || 537 ||
etadākṣipati-- ārambhasyākriyārthatve nārtho yogena vidyate | ṛte kriyāyā grahaṇāt pūrvayogena sidhyati || 538 ||
"tatra tasyeva"  ityasya yogasya dravyaguṇatulyatvārthe karaṇe'ṅgīkriyamāṇe pūrvatra kriyāgrahaṇamakṛtvā nārabdhavyamidam | tathāhi--kriyāgrahaṇasya dravyaguṇanimitte sādṛśye mā bhūditi prayojanam | tatrāpi cānena vidhāvanarthakaṃ tad‌vyāvartyābhāvāditi tena tulyamityevāstu sarvaviṣaye sādṛśye vatividhānamityatrārthaḥ || 538 ||
nanu ca na madhurayā tulyā gṛhāḥ, nāpi devadattena tulyā dantāḥ, api tu madhurādhikaraṇairgṛhairitare tulyāḥ, devadattasambandhibhiśca dantairitare dantā iti pūrveṇāsiddhau ṣaṣṭhīsaptamīsamarthād vatividhānaṃ yuktamevetyāśaṅkyāha-- madhurāvayave vṛttirvyākhyātā madhurāśruteḥ | brāhmaṇāvayavān dantān vakṣyati brāhmaṇaśrutiḥ || 539 ||
nedamapūrvaṃ codyate, prāgevāsyārthasya nirṇītatvāt | tathā hyaṣṭraśabdo yathāvayave mukhe vartate, tathā madhurādiśabdastadavayave gṛhe vartiṣyata iti madhurayā tulyā ityādivigrahopapattiḥ | niyatāvayavaparigrahaścātra dantādīnāmupameyatvena prayogādavadhāryate || 539 ||
idānīṃ pūrvatra kriyāgrahaṇasya vyavacchedyamupadarśayannivārthaviṣayasya vaterārambhasamarthanārthamāha-- na kācidivayoge tu bāhyāt sambandhino vinā | ṣaṣṭhī vidhīyate tatra pūrveṇa pratyayo bhavet || 540 ||
yadi pūrvatra kriyāgrahaṇaṃ na kriyate, tadā gauriva gavaya ityatrāpi vatiḥ syāt | ivaśabdayoge hi vyatirekavibhaktiḥ ṣaṣṭhī na kācidupadiśyate'napekṣya bāhyaṃ sambandhinamivārthamātre | ivārtho hi sāmānādhikaraṇyenaiva samanveti, na tu vyatirekaṃ janayati | tathā ca tadyoge prathamaiva bhavati || 540 ||
nanu pūrvatra tṛtīyāsamarthād vatirityatra prathamāsamarthāt kathaṃ prasaṅga āpadyate ityata āha-- ādhikyaṃ tulyaśabdena sambandha upajāyate | ṣaṣṭhītṛtīye tatra stastulyaśabdo hi vācakaḥ || 541 ||
tulyaśabdaḥ svatantrasyārthasya vācaka iti tena sattvabhūtārthābhidhāyinā samanvaye pratiyogino vyatirekaḥ samudbhavati | tathā ca "tulyārthaiḥ--"  iti vikalpena vyatirekavibhaktī ṣaṣṭhītṛtīye bhavataḥ || 541 ||
tulyaśabdasamānārthastu yadevaśabdaḥ prayujyate, tadā-- ivaśabdaprayoge tu bāhyāt sambandhino vinā | nādhikyamupamāne'sti dyotakaḥ samprayujyate || 542 ||
parapadārthaniṣṭhatvena prayogāt tadgataṃ viśeṣaṃ prakāśayan svatantreṇārthenāyogād vyatirekamivaśabdo dyotako nāpādayati | tataśca yadā tulyaśabdasamānārthenevaśabdena sādṛsyamupadarśyate, tadā vyatirekavibhak‌tyabhāvādasati kriyāgrahaṇe pūrveṇa vatirbhavedityavaśyakartavyametannivṛttyarthaṃ kriyāgrahaṇam | tathā cākriyārtho'yamārambho yujyata ityarthaḥ | na cānenevārthe prathamāsamarthād gauriva gavaya ityatra prasajyate, `tatra tasyeva' iti samarthavibhaktiniyamāditi na kiñcidaniṣṭam || 542 ||
nanu pūrvatra tulyaśabdenaiva sādṛśyamupadarśayitavyaṃ tṛtīyānimittavyatirekahetunā, anapekṣya bāhyaṃ sambandhinaṃ prakṛtyarthasyevārthena samanvayābhāvādivaśabdena sādṛśyopadarśanāyogāditi kuto gauriva gavaya ityatra pratyayaprasaṅga ityāśaṅkya, ivatulyanimittayorvyatirekayo rbhedapradarśanenāsati kriyāgrahaṇe pūrvayogena tulyanimitte vyatireke vidhīyamāno vatistulyaśabdenāpi sādṛśyopadarśane'tiprasajjedevetyāha-- ive yo vyatireko'tra sa prālādādihetukaḥ | tulye tadviṣayāpekṣamādhikyamupajāyate || 543 ||
madhurāyāmiva pāṭaliputre prāsādāḥ, devadattasyeva yajñadattasya dantā iti yo'yamivaśabdaprayoge vyatirekaḥ ṣaṣṭhīsapta mīvibhaktinimitta upalabhyate, nāsāvivārthanibandhanaḥ | api tvanapekṣita evevārthayoge dantāprāsādādinimitto'yam | tataśca pratyayārthahetukasya vyatirekasyātrāsambhavāt sāmarthyād bāhyasambandhinimittaṣaṣṭhīsaptamyantād vatiravatiṣṭhate | pūrveṇa tulyārthe tu yo vatistatra bāhyaṃ sambandhinamanapekṣyaiva tulyārthanimitta eva vyatireke tṛtīyāntād vatiriti bhinnaviṣayatānayoḥ || 543 ||
tathā cāsati pūrvatra kriyāgrahaṇe tulyārthanimitte vyatireke'tiprasaṅgamudāharati-- gavayena samo'naḍvāniti vṛttistadā bhavet | na tvasti gaurivetyatra vyatireka ivāśrayaḥ || 544 ||
kriyānimitte tulyatve kriyāgrahaṇapratyākhyāne'nādṛte gavayena tulyo'naḍvānityatrāpi vatiḥ syāt sākṣād dravyayoreva sādṛśye | tasmādavaśyakartavyaṃpūrvatra kriyāgrahaṇamiti tenāsiddhau dravyaguṇasādṛśye dvitīyayogasyārambho yuktaḥ | na ca dvitīyena yogena gavayena tulyo'naḍvānityatra prāpnoti, ivārthanibandhano hi vyatireko na sambhavatīti bāhyasambandhyapekṣe tasmin vatirdvitīyena yogena na bhavati | na cātra bāhyasambandhyanusaraṇam | ata eva sādṛśyabhāvaḥ | na cāpi gauriva ityatrāpi dvitīyena yogena pratyayaḥ prāpnoti, ivārthanibandhanasya vyatirekasyābhāvād bāhyasambandhyananusaraṇāt | tathā cātra ṣaṣṭhyabhāvāt prathamaiva | na ca prathamāsamarthād dvitīyena yogena pratyayo vihitaḥ | yadā tu bāhyo'pekṣyate sambandhī, tadā gauriva gavayasya saṃsthānamiti bhavatyeva vatirgovaditi || 544 ||
tadevaṃ kriyāgrahaṇasamarthanena yogadvayārambhe samarthite pūrvottarayoryogayorviṣayavibhāgenāvasthānamāha-- upameyena sambandhāt prāk tu prāsādādihetuke | vyatireke vaterbhāvo na tu tulyāpthahetuke || 545 ||
prāgupameyasambandhāt prāsādidinimittavaśesañcātevyatireke tadvibhaktau ṣaṣṭhyāṃ saptamyāṃ copajātāyāṃ paścādivārthayoge satyupameyasambandhe vatirdvitīyena yogena | bāhyasambandhi samutthāpite vyatireke samupajāte'ntaraṅge tannimittavyatirekavibhaktīstṛtīyā samarthā | tatra hi tulyārthanimittasyaiva vyatirekasyodbhavād bāhyasambandhyapekṣā niṣpramāṇikā | kintu asati kriyāgrahaṇe brāhmaṇena tulyaḥ kṣatriya iti dharmāntaranimitte'pi sādṛśye syād vatiriti vibhaktaviṣayatve'pi yogayoḥ kriyāgrahaṇaṃ kartavyameva | tadevamakriyārthaḥ samarthitaḥ "tatra tasyeva"  ityārambhaḥ || 545 ||
tatraitat syāt--prakṛtāṃvibhaktiṃ parityajya kimarthaṃ samarthavibhak‌tyantamupādīyate, tatra bhāṣyam--`na kācidivaśabdena yoge tṛtīyā vidhīyate' iti | tad vyācaṣṭe-- ivaśabdena sambandhe na tṛtīyā vidhīyate | prakṛtāṃ tāmatastyak‌tvā vibhak‌tyantaramāśritam || 546 ||
ivaśabdena pratyayārthe nirdiṣṭe prakṛtāyā eva vibhaktestena sambandhaḥ kalpyeta, yadīvaśabdayoge śeṣaviṣaye tṛtīyā vidhīyeta "tulyārthaiḥ"  iti tṛtīyā ivaśabdayoge'vidhānādivaśabdasya dyotakatvāt tulyārthatvābhāvāt | evaṃ tāvadantaraṅge sambandhe nāstīvayoge tṛtīyā, nāpi tadyoge śeṣaviṣaye tṛtīyā jñāpayitumiṣṭā saptamīvat | bāhyasambandhyapekṣāyāṃ tu śeṣaviṅaktirnāstīvārthayoge | api tu kārakavibhaktiryathāyathaṃ kriyāsambandhe bhavati | na ca tayā kārakavibhak‌tyā tṛtīyayā sarvo vibhak‌tyartho vyāptastulyārthayoge tṛtīyāvad yathā prāk pradarśitamiti prakṛtāsambhavantīṃ tṛtīyāṃ parityajya ṣaṣṭhīsaptamyau bāhyārthasambandhopajanitavyatirekanimitte nirdiśyete | tābhyāṃ ca tulyaśabdasya samanlayānupapatteḥ pratyayārtho'pyanya ivaśabdeneha darśitaḥ | tathā cāntaraṅge sambandhe pūrvo vidhiḥ, ayaṃ tu bāhyasambandhyapekṣāyāmiti sphuṭo vivekaḥ | ato'nantaraṃ bhāṣyam--`nanu ca saptamyapi na vidhīyate | evaṃ tarhi siddhe sati yadivaśabdayoge saptamī śāsti, tajjñāpayatyācāryo bhavatīvaśabdena yoge saptamīti | kimetasya jñāpane prayojanam | deveṣviva nāma brāhmaṇeṣviva nāmetyeṣa prayoga upapanno bhavati' iti | śeṣaviṣaye yathā tṛtīyā nāsti, tathā saptamyapītyata eva jñāpakād yathā saptamī bhavatyevaṃ tṛtīyāpi bhaviṣyati | ivaśabdayoge tasmādeva jñāpakādityanuvṛttyaiva tṛtīyāntād vatau siddhe tatreti saptamīnirdeśo jñāpayati śeṣaviṣaye bhavatīvaśabdayoge saptamīti | tṛtīyā tu neṣyata iti nāsau jñāpyata iti bhāṣyārthaḥ || 546 ||
etad vivṛṇoti-- saptamyapi na tatrāsti jñāpanārthā tu sā kṛtā | iṣṭā sā śeṣaviṣaye niyatāsu vibhaktiṣu || 547 ||
bāhyasambandhinimittasya vyatirekasya ṣaṣṭhyaiva saṃgrahāt saptamīvibhaktiratra tṛtīyāvadeva nāsti | tathā ceyamapi nopādeyā | nanu ca ṣaṣṭhīsamarthād vidhau saptamyarthasya na sagrahaḥ, yena saptamyantamupameyaṃ prayujyeta madhurāvat pāṭaliputre prākārā iti | ṣaṣṭhyartho hi śeṣaḥ, saptamyarthastvādhāraḥ sādhanam | na ca yugapaccheṣasādhanayorvivakṣā nyāyyā, virodhāt | sādhanānāṃ hyavivakṣā śeṣa ityuktam | atra pratipādyate-ṣaṣṭhīsamarthādapi vatau vṛttau vibhaktiviśeṣasyāśravaṇādupamānopameyabhāvamātrasyāvagateḥ sambandhasāmānye sarvaviśeṣāntarbhāvād yujyate saptamyantamupameyam | tathāhi--vatyantena padenaupamyamātraṃ pratipādyate, loke viśeṣāvirbhāvane tasyāśaktatvāditi śāstre tathaivānugamāt sambandhasāmānye ṣaṣṭhīsamarthādeva vatirupadiśyate | sarvaviśeṣāṇāṃ ca sambandhasāmānye'ntarbhāvād yadopameyaṃ saptamyantaṃ prayujyate, tadā tatrādhikaraṇatvavivakṣāyāmupamāne'pyadhikaraṇaviṣayatvamavasīyate | guṇībhūtaṃ hyupamānaṃ prakṛtyarthaḥ pratyayārthe vatyarthe'tretyupameyād viśeṣāvadhāraṇaṃ tasya | tathā codghoṣyate--upamāne yaḥ saṃśayaḥ sa upameyād vyāvartata iti | nanvanena nyāyane matup‌pratyayo'pi ṣaṣṭhīsamarthādeva vidheyaḥ, tathāpi saptamiyrthasyāvagamāditi kiṃ tatrāsminniti saptamīnirdeśena | naitat samānam | matupo hi ṣaṣṭhīsaptamyartha eva vācyaḥ pradhānamiti vṛkṣavān parvata ityādāvādhārabhāvaḥ śrutyaivāvagamyamāno'sminniti bhedena ṣaṣṭhyā nirdeṣṭuṃ nyāyyaḥ | anvākhyāne hi pratīyamāno loke'rtho'ṅgabhāvenopādīyate | asti cātra viśeṣeṇa pratītiḥ | vatau punarupasarjanabhūtaḥ prakṛtyartha iti tadantādaupamyamātrasya pratītiḥ pradhānasya pratyayārthasyeti tadeva ṣaṣṭhyā samarthavibhak‌tyā guṇabhūtena prakṛtyarthena yojanīyamiti tayaiva saptamyarthasya vyāpteḥ saptamī nopādeyā satī jñāpanāyopādīyamānā prakalpate | tathāhi--yathāyogaṃ niyataviṣayāvasthānāsu vibhaktiṣu parasparaviṣayāvagāhanamanupapannamityatra ṣaṣṭhīviṣaye śeṣe saptamī bhavatīti jñāpyate, yathevaśabdayoge ṣaṣṭhī bhavati bāhyasambandhinimittā tathā saptamyapītyarthaḥ || 547 ||
tadanyāstu vibhaktayaḥ svaviṣayapratiniyatā ivayoge'pi na saṅkīryanta ityāha-- yadi tu vyatirekeṇa viṣaye'smin vibhaktayaḥ | pravarteraṃstṛtīyaiva vyabhicāraṃ pradarśayet || 548 ||
asaminnivārthaviṣaye sarvā vibhaktayo yadyaviśeṣeṇa svāviṣayātikrameṇa saṅkareṇa syurityevaṃ jñāpanamatreṣṭaṃ syāt, tadā prakṛtā tṛtīyaivemamarthaṃ śaknoti jñāpayitumiti tāṃ tyak‌tvā vibhak‌tyantarāśrayaṇe na syāt | vibhak‌tyantaropādāne tu saptamyeva śeṣaviṣaye'tra bhavati, nānyā vibhaktaya iti viśeṣeṇa jñāpanamiṣṭamityavasīyate | tataśca devairiva nāmetyādiprayogo'sādhuḥ || 548 ||
etadeva nigamayitum `evaṃ tarhi siddhaṃ' iti bhāṣyaṃ nigamayati-- vyabhicāre tathāsiddhe saptamīgrahaṇād vinā | saptamyevocyate sarvā na santyanyā vibhaktayaḥ || 549 ||
tatheti tṛtīyānuvṛttyā saṅkare niścite'ntareṇāpi saptamīgrahaṇaṃ yat tasyā upādānam, tajjñāpakasya niyataviṣayatāṃ darśayati || 549 ||
evaṃ tarhi saptamyevātropadīyatām | tathā hi--jñāpanamapi sidhyati | ṣaṣṭhyāntācca vatau yo'rthaḥ, sa eva saptamyantādapi | viṣayabhāvalakṣaṇo hi saptamyarthaḥ ṣaṣṭhyarthamapi saṅgrahītuṃ prabhavati | tathā ca bhāṣyam--`nityaṃ parigrahītavyaṃ parigrahītradhīnaṃ bhavati' ityāśaṅkyāha-- atyantasya viṣaye saptamyā jñāpanārthayā | bādhitā vinivarteta ṣaṣṭhī sā gṛhyate punaḥ || 550 ||
ivārthaviṣaye'sambhavantī saptamī nirdiśyamānā svātmano'bhāvaṃ tatra nityameva jñāpayatīti pakṣe ṣaṣṭhī naiva syāditi tasyā api grahaṇamatra pakṣe bhāvārtham | nanu cāsati ṣaṣṭhyupādāne kevalasaptamīnirdeśe bāhyasambandhinimitte'dhikaraṇa eva saptamyā upapadyamānatve kathaṃ śeṣaviṣaye bhāvo jñāpyate | satyāṃ hi ṣaṣṭhyāṃ śeṣo'yamiti niścīyate, tatraiva ṣaṣṭhyupapatteriti tatsāhacaryeṇa saptamī nirdiśyamānā svātmānaṃ tadviṣayaṃ jñāpayet | tasmāt ṣaṣṭhyā anirdeśe saptamyā jñāpakatvameva nopapadyeta | kuta eva tayā ṣaṣṭhī bādhyeta | satyametat anyatāsyaiva tu vibhak‌tyātretaraviṣayavyāptisiddherubhayopādānādekā jñāpanārthā sampadyate | tatra ca saptamīviṣaye ṣaṣṭhyā aniṣṭatvāt saptamyeva jñāpanārthā bhāṣye'bhihitā | ṣaṣṭhyantādapi ca vateriṣṭatvāt svaviṣaye ṣaṣṭhī nāpāvartate'tretīyamevāsyā abādhākhyāyate | nanu ca yadi śeṣaviṣaye saptamīyam, ata eva jñāpakādityucyate, tadādhikaraṇasaptamyantād vatirna syāt | madhurāyāmiva pāṭaliputre prākārā iti | etasmin hi viṣaye śeṣaviṣayeyaṃ saptamītyanuprayoge pāṭaliputra iti saptamī na syād antareṇādhārādheyavivakṣām | ivaśabdayoge hi śeṣaviṣayā saptamī jñāpyate | na cānuprayoge'stīvaśabdaḥ | tasmānmadhurāyāmiva pāṭaliputrasya prākārā ityeva sidhyet | satyametat | tatretyetat punarāvartate, tantreṇa vā nirdeśa ityadhikaraṇasaptamyantād vatirekena kriyate | apareṇa śeṣaviṣaye saptamī jñāpyata iti bhāṣyakārābhiprāyamupādhyāyā varṇayanti | anye tvāhuḥ--saptamyartho'pyādhārādheyabhāvaḥ sambandhasāmānyavihitayā ṣaṣṭhyāntarbhāvayituṃ śakyata evetyanuprayoge saptamyante'pi ṣaṣṭhyantādeva pratyayaḥ | na hyatrādhārādheyabhāvavivakṣāyāṃ vatipratyayo nivāryate saptamyarthe, api tu śeṣavivakṣāyāmivaśabdaprayoge'sti saptamītyeva jñāpyate param | gatametat || 550 ||
idānīṃ kramaprāptaḥ "tadarham"  iti vihito'rhārthe vatirvicāryate | tathāhi--tatrākṣepabhāṣyam--`kimarthamidamucyate ? na "tena tulyaṃ kiyā ced vatiḥ' ityevaṃ siddham' iti | etad vyācaṣṭe-- pūrvābhyāmeva yogābhyāṃ vigrahāntarakalpanāt | arhārthe'pi vatiḥ siddhaḥ sa tvekena nidarśyate || 551 ||
iha rājānamarhati vṛttaṃ rājavad vṛttamityudāharaṇam | atra ca kriyāgrahaṇasyānuvṛttestaditi dvitīyāsamarthādarhateḥ kartari kriyālakṣaṇe pratyayo vatiḥ | arhateḥ kartrī yā kriyā vṛttādilakṣaṇā tasyāṃ pratyayaḥ | eṣa cārtho yadā vibhāgapradarśakaṃ rājñā tulyaṃ vartate vṛttimiti vākyaṃ kriyate, tadāpi pratīyate | tataśca tṛtīyāntāt `tena tulyam'  ityevātra vatiḥ siddhaḥ | yadāpi rājānamarhati dhairyaṃ rājavad dhairyaṃ veṣo vā, brāhmaṇamarhatyupaśamo brāhmaṇavadupaśama ityudāharaṇam, tadāpi "tatra tasyeva"  ityanena pratyayaḥ siddhaḥ | kriyātulyatvābhāvāt `tena tulyam' ityanenātrāsiddhiḥ | yat kila rājānadhairyam, tadrājña iva dhairyamiti śakyate vaktuṃ, kevalaṃ marhatyanyasya vigrahavākyabhejamātram, vastuno'bhedaḥ | yayā tu bhāṣye, `tena tulyamityeva siddham' ityekena yogena siddhiruktā,soralakṣaṇārthā vedatavyā | udāharaṇamātraṃ hi tat | tathā ca sa vatirekena nidarśyate upalakṣyata ityarthaḥ | pūrveṇaivātra siddhirityetāvati tātparyam || 551 ||
tatra "tena tulyaṃ"  ityanena tāvad kathaṃ siddhirityāha-- tena tulyamiti prāpteḥ kriyopādhiḥ prasidhyati | rājavad vartate rājetyatra bhede vivakṣite || 552 ||
kriyā tulyārthalakṣaṇapratyayārthāvaccedadvāreṇopādhirviśeṣaṇaṃ yasya vateḥ sa sidhyati | "tena tulyam"  ityanenaivātra prāptestasyānayā vā prāpteścetyarthaḥ | vartate rājetyarthaḥ, tadā katham ? tathā hi--rājanamarhati vṛttamityeṣa evārtho rājñā tulyaṃ vṛttamasyeti | nanu ca bhavet siddhaṃ yadā rājavad vartate brāhmaṇa iti vivakṣā, yadā tu rājavad | na hi tenaiva tasyopamānaṃ sambhavatītyata āha-atra bhede vivakṣita iti | bhedo'tra vivakṣita ityaupamyamasti || 552 ||
kathamekasya bheda ityāha-- rājatvena prasiddhā ye pṛthuprabhṛtayo nṛpāḥ | yudhiṣṭhirāntāste'nyeṣāmupamānaṃ mahīkṣitām || 553 ||
iha pṛthubharatayayātidilīpaprabhṛtayo'navadyacaritāḥ paripūrṇarājavṛttā yudhiṣchirāvadhayo rājānaḥ | te ca prāthamakalpikāḥ sāmpratikasyāparipūrṇarājaucitasamācārasya praśaṃsārthamupamānamupādīyante, prasiddhena rājñā tulyamasya vṛttaṃ rājño rājavadayaṃ vartata iti | aparipūrṇarājasamācārasya hi rājaviparītamapi vṛttaṃ sambhāvyata iti praśaṃsāyāṃ rājavad vṛttamasyetyucyate | tathā ca bhede satyupamānopameyabhāvaḥ | prayogasāmarthyādeva caivaṃvidhabhedāvasāyo'tra, abhede vateranupapatteḥ || 553 ||
nanu ca prajāpālananimittaṃ rājatvamupameyasyāpyastīti rājaivāyamiti kena viśeṣeṇānyenopamīyate ? athāsya rakṣādirājakāryaṃ nāsti, tadāsya sādṛśyābhāvāt kathamasya prasiddho rājopamānaṃ syādityata āha-- siddhyasiddhikṛto bheda upamānopameyayoḥ | sarvatraiva yato'siddhaṃ prasiddhenopamīyate || 554 ||
paripūrṇāparipūraṇaguṇanimittaḥ prasiddhyaprasiddhivṛtaḥ sarvatropamānopameyabhāvo nehaiveti nātra vicikitsā, sarvathā bhede'bhede vā tasyānupapatterāveditatvāt | tathāhi--brāhmaṇavadadhīte kṣatriya iti karaṇasauṣṭhavātiśayād brāhmaṇādhyayanaṃ prasiddhamaprasiddhasya kṣatriyādhyayanasyopamānam | evamiha yasya paripūrṇaṃ rājatvaṃ caturudadhimekhalāparyantapṛthivīpālanāt, sa prasiddho bharatādī rājaiva vyapadiśyate | na tvasya rājānaṃ vṛttmarhatīti vyapadeśaḥ | yastvekadeśasvāmī kośadaṇḍādisādhanadaridro'kṛtātmarakṣo'viśrṛṅkhalaceṣṭaḥ sambhāvitaḥ, sa praśasyate, rājavad vṛttamasyeti | evaṃ prasiddhena vasiṣṭhādinā brāhmaṇenānyo brāhmaṇavadayaṃ vartate brāhmaṇa ityupamīyate | tadevamatra "tena tulyam"  iti siddhiḥ || 554 ||
"tatra tasyeva"  ityanena kva siddhirityāha-- rājavad rūpamasyeti rājanyeva vivakṣite | akriyārthena yogena dvitīyena bhaviṣyati || 555 ||
akriyārtho'yamārambha iti vyavasthāpitam | tathā ca rūpādiguṇatulye'nena sidhyati vatiḥ | bharatasya rājña ivāsya rūpaṃ dhairyamupaśamo rājavaditi | etaccārabdhe'pi "tadarham"  ityasminnarhateḥ kartryāṃ kriyāyāmeva pratyayasyeṣṭerna sidhyatītyavaśyaṃ pūrveṇa sādhyam | tadevaṃ pūrveṇa siddhirūpapāditā || 555 ||
to'nantaramārambhasamarthanārthaṃ bhāṣyam--`na sidhyati | tṛtīyāsamarthāt tatra yadānyena kartavyāṃ kriyāmanyaḥ karoti, tadā pratyaya utpadyate | iha punardvitīyāsamarthādātmārhāyāṃ kriyāyāmarhatikartari niścitabalādhāne pratyaya utpadyata' iti | etad vyācaṣṭe-- upamānāvivakṣāyāṃ niyamārtho'yamucyate | dharmo'rhatikriyākartā tadarthaṃ vacanaṃ punaḥ || 556 ||
iha yadā sāmānyavacano rājaśabda upādīyate, tadā jātimātropādāne bhedasyāvivakṣitatvāt tannibandhana upamānopameyabhāvo nāsti | tatra hi rājānamevāyamācāro'rhati nānyamityavadhāraṇavivakṣā | rājasambandhitvenāvadhāritasyāpi vṛttasyānyasambandhāpākaraṇena balādhānaṃ sthairyotpādanamatra vivakṣitaṃ rājavadidaṃ vṛttaṃ vartata iti || 556 ||
kiñca, yadā teṣāmeva prasiddhānāṃ rājñāṃ kaściducyate rājavad vartata iti, tadopamānopameyabhāvo nāsti | tadāha-- kṛtahastavadityetat prasiddheṣveva dṛśyate | rājatvena prasiddhe ca rājñi rājavadityapi || 557 ||
kṛto'bhyāsānniveśito hasto yenāsau kṛtahasto'rjunaprabhṛtiḥ prasiddhaḥ | sa eva caivamucyate `ciccheda kṛtahastavad' iti | nātrāpareṇa kṛtahastena tulyatvaṃ vivakṣitam | kiṃ tarhi, dṛḍhamuṣṭerasyaiva ya ucitaśchedaḥ śarīrapāṭanaṃ tadanena kṛtamityeṣo'rtho vivakṣitaḥ | tathā copamānopameyabhāvābhāvāt kṛtahastamarhati nānyamityevaṃ vijñātasyāpi kṛtahastatvena niyamārthaṃ punaḥ śrutiḥ kṛtahastavaditi | evaṃ prasiddhasya rājño rājatvena nirjñātasyāpi-- pāṇṭorvidura sarvāṇi pretakāryāṇi kāraya | rājavad rājasiṃhasya ||  ityetat prayujyate | na cātra pāṇḍoranyena rājñā sambhavatyupamānam, paripūrṇaguṇatvāt | tataścāyamatrārthaḥ--yāni rājānamevārhanti pretasya paralokaprāptasya kāryāṇi sampādyāni, tāni vidhatsveti || 557 ||
tathā cāsya yogasyāyaṃ tātparyato viṣaya ityāha-- arājñi yeṣāṃ dharmāṇāṃ dṛṣṭo'tyantamasambhavaḥ | te rājani niyamyante tyajyante vyabhicāriṇā || 558 ||
ye rājanyeva dṛṣṭā dharmāsteṣāṃ tatraiva niścitānāṃ balādhānaṃ sthairyotpādanaṃ yadā vivakṣitaṃ bhavati, tadā niyamāya bhavati prayogaḥ | niyame cānyanivṛttiriti rājānamevedameva ca vṛttamarhatītyubhayato niyamaḥ sampadyate | yadāha--tyajyante vyabhicāriṇa iti | rājānamevedaṃ vṛttamarhati, nedamanyaiḥ sādhāraṇamarājasu nāstyasya sambhava iti | `ātmārhāyāṃ kriyāyāmarhatikartari niścitabalādhāne' ityasya bhāṣyasyārthaḥ | arhatikartā vṛttam, vyāpāraḥ kriyā, tasya ca kartuvyāpārasya kartrantarebhyo yadāvacchedo vivakṣitaḥ, tadānena sūtreṇa vatirityarthaḥ | sā ca kriyā ātmārhā, dvitīyāntavācyasyārthasyātmano'rhā nānyārheti | rājavad‌rūpaṃ rājavad dheryamityādau tu "tatra tasyeva"  ityanenaiva vatiḥ | "tadarham"  ityanena tvarhateḥ kartryāṃ kriyāyāṃ vidhānādatrāprāpteḥ | tadidamatratātparyam--bhede vivakṣite pūrveṇa vatiḥ siddhaḥ | abhedavivakṣāyāṃ tūpamānopameyabhāvābhāvānniyamaphalenānena vatiriti || 558 ||
nanu ca rājānamarhatyetad vāsaḥ, brāhmaṇamarhatyeṣa kamaṇḍalurityatra kasmādayaṃ vatirna bhavati ? anabhidhānāt | tathā ceha kriyāgrahaṇānuvṛtterarhateḥ kartryāṃ kriyāyāmevāyaṃ pratyaya ityāha-- arhateśca kriyā kartrī yā tasyāṃ vatiriṣyate | rājānamarhaticchatramiti na tvevamādiṣu || 559 ||
arhatikartarīti sāmānyena vidhāne'pi vṛttādikāyāṃ kriyāyāmeva pratyaya iṣyate, na chatrādāvarhatikartari dravye || 559 ||
kuta etadityāha-- prayuktānāṃ hi śabdānāṃ śāśtreṇānugamaḥ satām | chatrādyarthe tu vacane pratyākhyānaṃ na sambhavet || 560 ||
`siddhe śabdārthasambandhe' śāstrārambhānna śāstreṇa śabdā janyante, api tu śiṣṭapravāhaprayuktānāṃ vidyamānānāmeva teṣāṃ sādhutvānusaraṇamātramiti nirṇītacarametat | tataśca `rājavacchatram, brāhmaṇavat kamaṇḍaluḥ' ityasya śabdasyopamānopameyabhāvānaṅgīkaraṇenārhatyarthasya vivakṣitasyāpratyāyakatvādasādhutve'nvākhyānaṃ nopapadyate | kiñca `tena tulyaṃ--'  ityanenaiva siddhe pratyākhyānaṃ yadasya yogasya kriyate, tadevaṃ sati na syāt | tathā hi--rājavacchatramityādau tena tulyamityanenāsiddhiḥ,kriyopādhau tulyatve tena vidhānāvacchatrādiṣu kartṛṣvasiddherityetadarthamidaṃ sūtraṃ syāditi kathaṃ pratyākhyāyate ? abhyupagamya ca tatpratyāśyānamanyathā samarthyamāne rājavad vṛttamityādau prayoge chatrādau kartari pratyayasyābhāvaḥ sphuṭamukto bhavati bhāṣyakṛtetyāśayaḥ | tataścārambhe'pi kriyaivāsya vācyetyevamārambhapratyākhyāne samānaphale bhavataḥ || 560 ||
tadevaṃ bhāṣye samarthito'syārambhaḥ | pratyākhyānaṃ tu tatra nāstīti kuto niścitaṃ tadityāha-- tadarhamiti nārabdhaṃ sūtraṃ vyākaraṇāntare | sambhavatyupamātrāpi bhedasya parikalpanā || 561 ||
āpiśalāḥ kāśakṛtsnāśca sūtrametannadhīyate | ato'vasīyate pratyākhyānamasya | tathāhi--bhāṣyakārastantrāntarādevāvasitamarthaṃ svavacanenādideśa | `paramatamapratiṣiddhamanumatamiti' hi tatra yuktiḥ | tatra ko'bhiprāyasteṣāmācāryāṇāṃ, ye sūtramidaṃ nādhīyate | ucyate--ihābhinne'pyarthe bhedaparikalpanayopamānopameyabhāvopapatteḥ pūrveṇaiva siddho vatirityasyānārambhaḥ || 561 ||
kathaṃ bhedaparikalpanetyāha-- ekasya kāryanirjñānāt siddhasya viṣayāntare | taddharmatvavivakṣāyāṃ buddhyā bhedaḥ prakalpyate || 562 ||
ekasyāpyarthasya viṣayāntare nirjñātakāryasya yatra viṣayāntare'nyasmin viṣaye taddharmatvaṃ tatkāryakaraṇaśaktatvaṃ yadā vivakṣitaṃ bhavati, tadā tatkāryakaraṇanimittayā kalpanayā buddhyā nānātvaṃ samāropyate | tathā ca nānātvasyāvasthāpanānnijāccābhedād bhedābhedāśrayamupamānopameyatvamupapadyate | tathā hi--yatā bhavānanyasmin raṇe pūrvatrābhyāsavaśāddhastalāghavenācchaitsīt, tathā tena tulyamanyadāpi cchinattīti | evaṃ pūrvāparakālatayā kāryabhedāt prasiddhyaprasiddhibhyāṃ ca bhedakalpanayā `ciccheda kṛtahastavat' ityekatrāpyupamānopameyabhāvopapattau siddhaḥ pūrveṇaiva vatiḥ | tathā sāmānyavacane'pi rājaśabde nirjñātaviśeṣavṛttau vā viṣayāntare dṛṣṭena dharmeṇa prasiddhenaprasiddhasyopamānam | yāni vā bhūtapūrvāṇāṃ rājñāṃ pretakāryāṇi tattulyatayā pāṇḍorapi vidhatsvetyarthaḥ || 562 ||
avaśyaṃ caitadevaṃ vijñeyam | anyathā sūtrārambhe vatirbhavatu | ivaśabdastu bhedābhāvādatra na syādityāha-- sūtrārambhānna caitasmādivaśabdasya vidyate | prayogaḥ so'pi caitasya viṣaye vidyate vateḥ || 563 ||
kriyamāṇe sūtre vacanāt pratyayo labhyate | ivaśabdaprayogastu prasiddhād bhedaparikalpanāmantareṇa na ghaṭanāmetītyāvaśyako'tra bhedaḥ || 563 ||
dṛśyate ca parikalpitabhede'nyatrāpīvaśabda ityāha-- dasyuhendra ivetyetadendre mantre prayujyate | anyatra dṛṣṭakarmendro yathetyasmin vivakṣite || 564 ||
indra iva hyupastūyase | indra iva dasyuhā bhava, kṣetrāṇi sṛjetyatrendradevatāke mantre dṛṣṭo'yamivaśabdo nānātvādhyāropeṇopamānopameyabhāvaṃ dyotayati | tathāhi--indra evendra ivetyatropamīyate | nānātvaṃ ca viṣayāntare nirjñātakāryasya viṣayāntare taddharmatvavivakṣāyāmatra | tataścāyamarthaḥ--yathā tvamanyatrendrastaskaranipātanavyāpāro bhūtaḥ, tathehāpi bhaveti indraḥ ivendraḥ prasiddhyaprasiddhikṛtād dṛṣṭādṛṣṭakāryabhedād bhedaparikalpanayā kathyate || 564 ||
atraiva laukikamapyudāharaṇamāha-- pūrvāmavasthāmāśrityā yāvasthā vyapadiśyate | sadṛśastvaṃ tavaiveti tatraivamabhidhīyate || 565 ||
avasthābhedena padārthabhedamāśritya sādṛśyasampratyayo dṛṣṭaḥ | tadyathā yauvanāvasthāṃ cārutvātiśayavatīṃ prasiddhāmāśrityānyā sthāvirāvasthopamīyate, tavaiva sadṛśastvamiti | avasthābhede hyavasthāvato bhedamāśritya tvayā tulyastvamityeka evopamīyate || 565 ||
tadayamatra saṅkṣepaḥ-- prasiddhabhedaṃ yatrānyadupamānaṃ na vidyate | upameyasya tatrātmā svabuddhyā pravibhajyate || 566 ||
vāstave bhede'sati stutyatiśayavivakṣayānanvayālaṅkāramukhenaikasyaivopamānopameyabhāvaḥ pratītacaraḥ | tadyathā-- `rāmarāvaṇayoryuddhaṃ rāmarāvaṇayoriva' iti | evaṃ nānyo bhavataḥ sadṛśaḥ sambhavati, yadi parastvamevātmanaḥ sadṛśa ityupamānāntarāsambhavena stūyate'rthaḥ | tatra ca buddhiparikalpanayā bhedaḥ samavalambanīyaḥ | tadevaṃ kālpanikasya bhedasya rājeva tvaṃ rājetīvaśabdaprayogānyathānupapattyāvadhāritvāt pūrveṇaiva siddheḥ pratyākhyānaṃ siddham || 566 ||
tatraitat syāt--gauṇo'yaṃ viṣayaḥ | pūrvasūtrasya sati ca mukhye vāstavabhedaviṣaye kathamatra pravṛttirityāśaṅkyāha-- yo'pi svābhāviko bhedaḥ so'pi buddhinibandhanaḥ | tenāsmin viṣaye bhinnamabhinnaṃ vā na vidyate || 567 ||
yo'pi vastusanniveśī bhedaḥ, so'pi bud‌dhyupārūḍha eva bhedavyavahāraṃ vartayatīti buddherevātra svātantryādasmin śabdavyavahāre vastuto nānā ekaṃ vā na sambhavati, abhinne'pi buddhyā bhedād bhinne'pi cābhedasamāropeṇa vyavahārāt tāneva śālīn bhuñjmaha iti | upamāyāṃ ca buddhiparikalpitabhedasya hetutvaṃ prāgeva pratipāditam || 567 ||
atraiva bhāṣyakārīyaṃ saṃvādamāha-- aṅgadī kuṇḍalī ceti darśayan bhedahetubhiḥ | caitramīdṛśa ityāha buddhyavasthāparigrahāt || 568 ||
"upadeśe'janunāsikaḥ"  ityatra guṇaiḥ pariprāpaṇamud‌deśa ityud‌deśalakṣaṇasyedamudāharaṇaṃ bhāṣye--`aṅgadī kuṇḍalī vyūḍhoraskastāmrāyatākṣo vṛttabāhurīdṛśo devadatta' iti | tatra guṇairaṅgaditvādibhiravacchedakairdevadattameva lakṣayannīdṛśo'nena tulya ityācaṣṭe | tatra nānyena tulyo vivakṣitaḥ | kiṃ tarhi, aṅgaditvādibhidharmairupalakṣito yo buddhau tadānīṃ parisphurati, tena sadṛśa ityabhimatam | ataśca buddhipratibimbena bāhyasya sārūpyābhidhānād buddhisamāropitabhedaḥ sphuṭamevopamānopameyabhāva uktaḥ || 568 ||
kimevamabhidhāne phalamityāha-- etaiḥ śabdairyathābhūtaḥ pratyayātmopajāyate | tatpratyayānukāreṇa viṣayo'pyupapadyate || 569 ||
aṅgadītyādibhiḥ śabdairyadarthāvabhāso jñānaviśeṣa udbhavati, tadākārasādṛśyena bāhyo'rtho'vabuddhyate | jñānākārasyaiva bāhyatvena vyavahartṛbhiradhyavasāyāt | tadidamatra tātparyam--aṅgaditvādibhirdharmairācchurito buddhāvākāro yamarthaṃ bāhyaṃ paśyataste samudgacchati, sa tvayā devadatta iti vyavahartavya iti dṛśyāvikalpayorabhedādhyavasāyena vyavahārasiddhiḥ || 569 ||
tasmāt kālpanika eva bhedaḥ sarvatropayogīti vyāptimāha-- buddhyavasthāvibhāgena bhedakāryaṃ pratīyate | janyanta iva śabdānāmarthāḥ sarve vivakṣayā || 570 ||
yadyacchāstre bhedakāryam, tat tad buddhikṛtabhedāvalambanam | tathā hi--kārakavyavahāro bud‌dhyavasthānibandhano'bhihito vyaradeśivadbhāvāccaikāco dvirvacanamityādyanusandheyam | yuktaṃ caitat, yato bahiḥ sadasattvamanapekṣyaiva vivakṣāprāpitasaṃnidhāne'rthekṛtapadabandhāḥ śabdāḥ | tathā ca prayoktrabhisandhānena śabdānāmarthaprādurbhāvo'vatiṣṭhate | cirātītānāmapi kaṃsādīnāṃ pratyayopahṛtasadākārāṇāṃ prayojyaprayojakabhāvavyavasthāyāṃ kaṃsaṃ ghātayati, baliṃ bandhayatītyādiprayogapravṛtteḥ || 570 ||
tasmācchabdārtho na vastvartha ityāha-- tathāvidhe'pi bāhye'rthe bhidyante yatra buddhayaḥ | na tatra kaścit sādṛśyaṃ sadapi pratipādyate || 571 ||
vyak‌tyantarasādṛśyeṣvapyartheṣu sādhāraṇadharmāvalambanā yāvad buddhayo na jātāḥ, tāvat sadapyanaṅgīkṛtya sādṛśyamatyantavyāvṛttākārabuddhiparicchedyatayā na kaścit pratipattā sāmyamapagacchati | gavayasaṃsthānānupalambhe hi gavi na tatsadṛśapratyayaḥ || 571 ||
atyantavyāvṛtte ca buddhisamāropitābhedāśrayo bhavati sampratyaya ityāha-- atyantaṃ viṣaye bhinne yāvat prakhyā na bhidyate | na tāvat pratyabhijñānaṃ kasyacid vinivartate || 572 ||
atyantavyāvṛttāyāmapi vyaktau buddherbhinnāyā anutpattāvanvayidharmācchuraṇayā'bhedāvasāye sa evāyamityekākāraparāmarśo'vicalaḥ samudeti | tathāhi--mandāloke deśe dūrādvā rūpamātreṇārthāvadhāraṇād vivekānavasāye pūrvadṛṣṭākārānusandhānenābhedenāvasāyaḥ | nikaṭe sphītāloke'pi ca prathamākṣasannipāte jhaṭiti pūrvavāsanodbodhāt sa evāyamiti pratyabhijñetpattiḥ | evaṃ devadattayajñadattayorbhedamanavasāyaikyapratipattiḥ || 572 ||
tadevaṃ bhedā bhedavyavahārasya bahiḥ sadasattvaparamarśo'nupakāraka iti pratyayapratibhāsinā bhedākāreṇa sambhavatyekasyaivopamānopameyabhāva iti rājavad vṛttamityādeḥ pūrveṇaiva siddhāvabudhabodhanārthaṃ `tadarham' ityasyārambha ityāha-- ayameva tu sūtreṇa bhedo bhedena darśitaḥ | prasiddhamapi durjñānamabudhaḥ pratipadyate || 573 ||
ayameva bud‌dhyavasthāśrayo bhedavyavahāre yogārambheṇa vyutpādyate, vāstavād bhedādayamanyo bheda iti bhedena pṛthak‌tvena khyāpitaḥ sūtrārambheṇa | nahi sarvaḥ svayamevaṃvidhamarthaṃ vivektumutsahate | sarvapuruṣādhikāreṇa ca śāstrapravṛttiriti pratīte'pyarthe mandabuddhivyutpādanāya śāstrarambho yuktaḥ | rājānamarhatīti ca vigrahāntaraṃ dṛśyate, mandamatīnāṃ pūrveṇāsiddhyadhyavasāyanimittam || 573 ||
tadatra durjñānatvamekasyopamānopameyabhāvābhāvāt syāt | tacca na yuktam | dṛśyate hyekasyāpyupamānopameyabhāva ityabudhabodhanārthamapi nedamārabdhavyamityāha-- vaiyākaraṇavad brūte na vaiyākaraṇaḥ sadā | vaiyākaraṇavad brūṣvetyataḥ so'pyabhidhīyate || 574 ||
vyākaraṇajño hi kaścit grāmyadurbhagābhidhānaprayogādapagatasaṃskāraśabdābhidhānācca vaiyākaraṇatvamatikrāntaḥ sādhuśabdaprayogakuśalairvaiyākaraṇairupamīyate vaiyākaraṇavat kathayeti | anyaistulyamabhidhatsva, mlecchabhāṣaṇadurgrahaṃ tyajeti || 574 ||
tathā-- kecit pumāṃso bhāṣante strīvat, puṃvacca yoṣitaḥ | vyabhicāre svadharmo'pi punastenopadiśyate || 575 ||
vyabhicāra iti svadharmasya | tathā ca sambhāvitasvadharmāḥ sajātīyairevopamīyante'rthāḥ | puṃvadabhidhīyatām | anyairanativṛttapuruṣocitabhāṣaṇaistulyaṃ bhavadbhiḥ kathyatām, kimapragalbhoktibhiḥ sadasi yoṣitsambhāvanayopahāsyātāmatmā nīyata iti | tathātipragalbhabhāśiṇī kācidabhidhīyate--strīvadabhidhīyatām | anyābhivrīḍātatībhiḥ strībhistulyaṃ kathyatām | mātipragalbhoktibhiryoṣitsīmānaṃ hāsīriti | tathā klaibyamācaran kaściducyate--puvad yudhyasva | yathānativṛttapauṃsnā yudhyante tathā yudhyasvetyarthaḥ | tadevaṃ svocitānuṣṭhānatyāgadarśanād ātmīyācāro'pyaprasiddhatvādupamāyā vidhīyate iti dṛṣṭam | tathā caikasyopamānopameyabhāvo na durjñānaḥ || 575 ||
yattu prāguktaṃ pūrvāmavasthāmāśritya tavaiva sadṛśastvamityavasthāntaraṃ sāmprātikamupamīyata iti, tatroktitātparyaṃ vyācaṣṭe-- sadṛśastvaṃ tavaiveti loke yadabhidhīyate | upamānāntaraṃ tatra prasaktaṃ vinivartate || 576 ||
sarvopamānadharmātikrāntastvamityanyopamānavyāvṛttyā stutiparametadabhidhānamananvayālaṅkāracchāyayeti vyākhyātametat | tadevaṃ sarvatra bhedakalpanayopamānopameyabhāvapraklṛptervyākaraṇāntare nārabdhamidaṃ sūtram | ihāpyupamānavivakṣāyāmanārambho'syābhyupagata eva || 576 ||
vivakṣāntare tvāvaśyakamidamityāha-- yuktamaupayikaṃ rājña ityarthasya nidarśane | upamānāvivakṣāyāṃ tadarhamiti paṭhyate || 577 ||
yuktamidamucitamidaṃ rājño vṛttaṃ rājyānupālane'pyupāyabhūtamidamiti rājānamevārhati nānyamiti niścitabalānakhyāpane nāstyupamānopameyabhāvavivakṣeti tatsambandhe vihitasya vatenāryaṃ viṣaya iti pṛthaksūtramatra pratyayavidhyarthaṃ paṭhyata ityārambho'sya samarthitaḥ | ayamāśayaḥ--bhavedupamānavivakṣāyāṃ siddhiḥ | tathā ca vyākaraṇāntare'syānārambhaḥ | evamihāpyanārambha, paramatasyāviruddhasyāpratiṣiddhatvāt | arhattāpratipipādayiṣāyāṃ tvasyārambhaḥ saphala iti vyākaraṇāntare'vyāptirudbhāvitā | ata eva bhāṣyakāraḥ prayojanasthāpanādeva virato naupamyāśrayeṇa pratyācakhyau | itthaṃ ca vaiyākaraṇavad brūhītyādāvapi yadaupamyamavivakṣitvā yogyatāmātraṃ pratipipādayiṣitaṃ bhavati, tadānenaiva vatiriti siddham || 577 ||
idānīṃ vakṣyamāṇaprastāvārthamāha-- prasaktānuprasaktastu vatiśeṣo'bhidhīyate | upamānābhisambandhādasmin vatirudāhṛtaḥ || 578 ||
iha vṛttipadavicāraḥ prādhānyena prastutaḥ | tatra copamānasamāsavicārānuṣaṅgeṇopamānasambandhe vidhīyamānasya vaterihopanyāso vicārāyetyupamānavatiranuṣaṅgāyātaḥ prasaktaḥ | tasyānu paścāt kramāyāto'nupamānavatirapi "upasargācchandasi dhātvarthe"  ityayamapi śiṣṭaḥ prasaṅgena vicārārthaṃ nirūpyata iti prakaraṇānusandhiḥ || 578 ||
tatra arthagrahaṇaṃ kimartham? na, upasargācchandasi dhātāvityevocyeteti bhāṣye'rthagrahaṇamākṣiptam | tatrābhiprāyaṃ vyācaṣṭe-- pradhānakalpanā'bhāve guṇaśabdasya darśanāt | upasargād vatau siddhā dhātau dhātvarthakalpanā || 579 ||
dhātuśabdena bhūvādermukhyataḥ pratyāyanād dhātāvityukte tasya śabdasya pratyayavācyatvābhāvādantareṇāpyarthagrahaṇaṃ dhāturūpādhyāsād guṇakalpanayā sāmarthyāt tatsahacarito'rtho labhyata iti kimarthagrahaṇenetyarthaḥ | ata eva bhāṣyaṃ--`śabde kāryasyāsambhavādarthe kāryaṃ vijñāsyate' iti || 579 ||
tatraitatsāhacaryānniyogato'rthe pratipattiḥ katham ? anyasyāpi dhātusambandhinaḥ śabdadharmasya dhātunā sāhacaryādityata āha-- svaṃ rūpamiti caitasminnarthasyāpi parigrahaḥ | rūpavajjñāpitastasmādasanno'rtho grahīṣyate || 580 ||
antaraṅgatvādaheyatvādasādhāraṇatvācca svaṃśabdasyetyeva svatvena viśeṣitasya rūpasya parigrahe siddhe `svaṃ rūpam' iti  rūpagrahaṇaṃ rūpavadartho'pyaṅgīkriyata iti jñāpanārtham | tathā ca rūpasamānakakṣyaḥ pratyāsannataraḥ sambandhī prasiddho vācyo'rtha eva grahīṣyate | tāvataiva vākyārthasyopapattau śabdadharmaḥ sambandhī kathamanurodhād gṛhyeteti bhāvaḥ || 580 ||
atrottaraṃ bhāṣyam--`idaṃ tarhi prayojanam | uttarapadalopo yathā vijñāyeta | dhātukṛto'rtho dhātvarthaḥ | kaḥ punardhātukṛto'rthaḥ | sādhanam' iti | etad vyācaṣṭe-- dhātvarthenopajanitaṃ sādhanatvena sādhanam | dhātunā kṛtamityevamasmin sūtre pratīyate || 581 ||
dhātuśabdena svārthasyātropalakṣaṇād dhātukṛtaḥ kriyākṛtaḥ kriyayā prādurbhāvito'rtho'tra nirdiṣṭaḥ | sa ca sādhanaṃ kārakam | tathāhi--yadyapi siddhasvarūpaṃ kāraka kriyāṃ pratyupādīyate sādhanatvena, tathāpi na svārūpeṇa kriyayā sādhanaṃ kṛtaṃ janitam, api tu sādhanatvena, sādhyāpekṣatvāt sādhanabhāvasya sāmānyasya karmādiviśeṣarūpasya ca kriyā hi sādhanāni pravartayatīti | pravṛttireva prathamaṃ kvacidapyanapāśritā | śaktīrekādhikaraṇe srotovadapakarṣati || ityādinā pūrvameva nirṇītametat || 581 ||
yaduktamuttarapadalopa iti | tatra ko'yamananvākhyātaḥ sūtrakāreṇottarapadalopo nāmetyata āha-- yaḥ śabdaścaritārthatvādatyantaṃ na prayujyate | viṣaye'darśanāt tatra lopastasyābhidhīyate || 582 ||
ihārthaprayuktasya śabdasya satyarthe vacanaśatenāpi prayogo nivārayituṃ na pāryate, kevalamanyato nirjñātārthasya caritārthatvāt, kṛtakṛtyatvāt, prasaktādarśanasya lopasaṃjñā pratyayādarśanavat sarvatra vyavahriyate | tataśca dhātuśabdena kriyābhidhānāt tatkṛto'rthastadupacārāt sa eveti dhāturevārtho dhātvartha iti gauṇe sāmānādhikaraṇye mayūravyaṃsakāditvāt sati samāse dhātukṛto'rtha iti yad vastu sampadyate, tad bhāṣyakāreṇa darśitam | yadvā, dhātustadarthaḥ kriyā arthaḥ prayojanaṃ yasya sādhanasyetyevamayaṃ bahurvīhiḥ kriyate | kriyā ca sādhanasya sādhyatvādeva prayojanaṃ bhavati | tasmin sādhane vartamānādupasargāt svārthe vatiḥ || 582 ||
evamarthagrahaṇasāmarthyāt sādhanalābhe prayojanamuktam--`sādhane'yaṃ bhavalliṅgasaṃkhyābhyāṃ yokṣyate' iti | tatra śaktirūpatvena kriyāvadasattvabhūtatvāt sādhanasya kathaṃ liṅgasaṅkhyāyoga ityata āha-- kriyāyāṃ sādhane dravye prādayo ye vyavasthitāḥ | tebhyaḥ sattvābhidhāyibhyo vatiḥ svārthe vidhīyate || 483 ||
sādhanaśak‌tyāśrayo dravyamatra sādhanaśabdena vivakṣitam, śaktiśaktimatorabhedāt | tasmin dravye kriyāsādhanākṣipte ye vācakatvena pravṛttāḥ prādaya upasargāstebhyaḥ sādhanakriyā (kriyāsādhana) vācibhyaḥ svārthe vatipratyo'yaṃ vidhīyate | tathā ca sattvabhūtārthābhidhānalliṅgasaṃkhyāyoga upapadyate || 583 ||
tatraitat syāt--kriyāviśeṣadyotakāḥ prādayo'vadhṛtāḥ | naiṣāṃ dravyābhidhānasāmarthyamavadhṛtamityāśaṅkyāha-- pratyayena vinā prādistatrārthena prayujyate | bhedena tu samākhyāne vibhāgaḥ parikalpitaḥ || 584 ||
vākye ke'pi niyatā dharmāḥ | kecid vṛttiriti śabdaśaktipratiniyamād yadyapi vākye prayuktānāṃ prādīnāṃ dravyābhidhānaśaktirnāsti, tathāpi vṛttiviṣaye śaktiriyamavagamyate | udgatāni udvataḥ, nigatāni nivata ityakhaṇḍo'yaṃ śabdaḥ prakṛtipratyayavibhāgenānvākhyāyamānaḥ prakṛtibhāgasya kriyāsādhanopasarjanadravyavacanatvaṃ pratyayabhāgasya ca svārthikatvaṃ pratipadyate | itthaṃ copasargāṇāmatra vṛttiviṣaye'sya svabhāvo'rthagrahaṇenānuvidhīyate, laukikasyaivārthasyānvākhyānāṅgabhāvenopādānāt | asati punararthagrahaṇe śabde kāryāsambhavāt kriyā pratītā, avinābhāvāt sādhanaśaktimevopalakṣayet | arthagrahaṇāt tu tadabhedāpannaṃ dravyaṃ pratīyate | anyathārthagrahaṇamaphalaṃ syāt || 584 ||
yadi ca sādhanaśabdena śaktimatra vivakṣitaṃ syāt, tadā-- anaṅgīkṛtasattvaṃ tu yadi gṛhyeta sādhanam | vibhaktibhirna yogaḥ syād yathaiva tasilādiṣu || 585 ||
anupāttādhāre sādhanamātra gṛhyamāṇe tatastannetyādāvivātyantaprādhānyāyāḥ śakteḥ śak‌tyāntarāyogād yathāyathaṃ vibhaktayo na syuḥ sarvāḥ | samayādekavacanameva syāt | tataścāsarvavibhaktitve avyayasaṃjñā prasajyeteti liṅgasaṃkhyāyogo virudhyeta | arthagrahaṇasāmarthyāt tu guṇīkṛtakriyāsādhanaṃ dravyaṃ prādhānyenopasargāṇāṃ vācyamatrānugamyata iti vatyantasya sattvavacanatāyāṃ yathāyathaṃ kriyāsamanvaye sarvavibhaktiyogādavyayasaṃjñābhāve udvato nivata ityādibahuvacanāntaprayogapapattiḥ | `ekārthe śabdānyatvād dṛṣṭaṃ liṅgānyatvam' iti ca liṅgāntarayogo na virudhyate || 585 ||
nanvevamapi svarādiṣu vateḥ pāṭhāt prāptamavyayatvamityata āha-- pāṭhād yairavibhaktitvaṃ vatyanteṣvanugamyate | teṣāmudvat ityatra vaktavyā savibhaktitā || 586 ||
avibhakritvaṃ vibhak‌tyadarśanaṃ tannibandhanamavyayasaṃjñā kathyate | tathā ca svarādipāṭhādavyayatve'vibhaktitvaṃ vibhak‌tyadarśanamiti sāmarthyāt tannibandhanāvyayasaṃjñāpāṭhād yairaṅgīkriyate teṣāṃ mate, udvata ityatrāvyayatvāllope prāpte savibhaktitā vaktavyā pratipādyā | tathā hyarthagrahaṇasāmarthyādavyayatvaṃ na bhavati | anvarthasaṃjñā hi sā'liṅgasaṃkhyatve'vatiṣṭhate | atra ca sādhanasya dravyasya grahaṇāt sattvavacanatvāt tadabhāva ityarthaḥ || 586 ||
tadevaṃ vatiḥ parīkṣitaḥ | tatprasaṅgana tatratyamanyadapi vicāryate--vākyakāraḥ papāṭha--`strīpuṃsābhyāṃ vatyupasaṃkhyānam' iti | "strīpuṃsābhyāṃ nañsnañau bhavanāt"  ityavadhiviśaṣopādānena prāg bhavanāt prakṛtiviśeṣādasmānnañsnañāvupa diśyamānāvapatyādiṣvartheṣu siddhyarthaṃ vatiratropasaṃkhyeyaḥ | tatra vatīti vatisahacaritasyārthasyādhikaraṇatvena nirdeśaḥ | yadvā vatau vidhīyamāne strīpuṃsābhyāmapyasau vidheya ityarthaḥ | bhāvalakṣaṇe saptamīyam | etasya vārttikasya bhāṣye pratyākhyānamuktam--`ācāryapravṛttirjñāpayati na vatyarthe nañsnañau bhavata iti | yadayaṃ striyāḥ puṃvaditi nirdeśaṃ karoti' iti | etad vyācaṣṭe-- vatyarthaṃ nāvagāhete puṃvadityasya darśanāt | nañsnañāvapavādasya bādhakaṃ tannipātanam || 587 ||
"striyāḥ puṃvad"  ityuccāraṇād vatyarthādutkarṣo nañsnañorjñāyate | yadi hyetau vatyarthamavagāheyātām, apavādena nivartito vatirna śrūyate | śrutastu nūnametāvetamarthamutkrāmataḥ, yenānayorviṣaye utsargaḥ śrūyata iti jñāpayati | nanu ca puṃvaditi nirdeśād vatirapyustu, yathāprāptau ca nañsnañāvapi vatyarthe'dhikāreṇa pratipāditasaṃnidhānau bhavetāmityāśahkyoktaṃ`bādhakaṃ tannipātanami'ti || 587 ||
kathamasya bādhakatvamityetadeva vyaktayati-- evamutkrāmato nūnaṃ vatyarthaṃ nañsnañāviti | tayoḥ pravṛttāvutsargo bādhanānnopapadyate || 588 ||
apavādaviṣaye pravṛttirutsargasyopalabhyāmānānyathānupapattyāpavādamapāvartayati tataḥ | anyathā satyevāpavādaśatrāvayamutsargo varākastatra kathaṃ pravarteteti bādhakatvaniścayo'sya | aprāptyanumānaṃ hi bādhā | tatra yathāpavādaḥ svarūpanirvṛttau sasaṃrambho'pi sāmānyavidheḥ svaviṣaye'prāptiṃ sūcayati, tathā nipātanamātmasvarūpapratilambhavyāpṛtamapi yathāprāptabādhane paryavasyati, tathā sarvādivārttike nipātanamapyevaṃjātīyakamiti bādhakāni nipātanāni vyavasthāpitāniī | ataśca vatyarthe pauṃsnamityādiprayogo'sādhuḥ || 588 ||
`evamapi strīvaditi na sidhyati' iti codayitvā `yogāpekṣaṃ jñāpakam' iti bhāṣyam | tad vivṛṇoti-- nañsnañau vihitau yena sa yogo nāvagāhate | vatikaraṇaṃ taddhi liṅgameva samarthyate || 589 ||
sāmānyato dṛṣṭamidaṃ liṅgamanumānaṃ jñāpakam | tathāhi--"strīpuṃsābhyāṃ nañsnañau bhavanāt"  iti yo yogaḥ sa vatyarthaṃ nākrāmatītyavaṃvyāpāramidaṃ liṅgamupapādyate | vatiprakaraṇamiti | "tena tulyaṃ"-,"tatra tasyeva"  "tadarham"  iti sūtratrayavihite'pi vatāvarthaṃ nañsnañāvutkrāmata ityarthaḥ | tathā caitān yogānapekṣata iti yogāpekṣaṃ tajjñāpakaṃ sūtram | tataśca vatyarthe nañsnañorabhāvāt strīvadityapi sidhyati, viśeṣanirapekṣasya liṅgasya jñāpakatvata iti siddham || 589 ||
tadevamupamānaprasaṅgāyāto vatirvicāritaḥ | idamidānīmupamānavicāre parīkṣaṇīyam | bahūnāmupameyānāmupamānaṃ yadaikamupādīyate, tadā kimupameyabhedamanuvartate tat | athābhinnamevopakārāya prabhavatīti saṃśītāvāha-- abhedenopamānasya bhinnārthopanipātitā | ūhastathopamānanāmaṅgavannopalabhyate || 590 ||
iha prādhānānugrahāya guṇāḥ prayujyamānā yathānugraho bhavati pradhānasya, tathaivātmarūpamanuvartanta iti nyāyaḥ | ekatvenaiva tu svadharmeṇa yuktaṃ śaknotyupamānamupameyamanekamupakartumiti kimanurodhād bhedamavalambeta | ata eva vikṛtāvupameyabhede'pi prakṛtigatameva vacanamabhinnārthāvedakamupamānamityūho yathopameyaṃ vacanabhedo na dṛśyate | tadyathā-aṅganāmnāmūhābhāvo'ṅgibhedādeva, nirjñātabhedatvāt, saṃkhyāntarapariṇāmasya kṛtakṛtyatvāditi sambandhābādhanamevātra | tathā cohavidāmāmnāyaḥ-- aṅgāni jātināmāni upamā indriyāṇi ca | etāni nohaṃ gacchanti ad‌dhrigau (advigau) viṣamaṃ hi tat || iti | tatrohopāttameva dṛṣṭāntadārṣṭāntikamudāhriyate | aṅganāmanūho yathā--`yatpaśurmāyumakṛtoro vā padbhirāhatāgnirmā tasmādenasaḥ pramocayatu'  ityatraikapaśuke prakṛtiyāge ura ityekavacanamaṅganāma | dvipaśuke'pi vikṛtiyāge asyohābhāvāt paśū ityāhaṃsātāmiti cāsyaiva vipariṇāmaḥ, na punarurasī iti vipariṇamyate | aṅgibhedādevāṅgānāṃ saṃkhyābhedasyāvadhāraṇāditi cātra nyāyaḥ | evaṃ bahupaśuke'pi vikṛtiyāge paśava āhaṃsatetyūhyate, norāṃsīti | tadvadupamānānāmanūho yathā--`kaśyape vāsāṃ acchidre śroṇī kavaṣorūsrekaparṇe'tyādi | abhedenaivopamātuṃ śakterupamānavacanānāṃ kaśyapakavaṣastrekāṇāṃ kacchapamatsyajātīyakaravīravācināṃ yathopameyalihgasaṃkhyāntaravipariṇāmo na bhavati || 590 ||
evamūhābhāvo nyāyavidāṃ prasiddho'trābhedenopamānasya saṃvādaka uktaḥ | saṃvādakāntaramapyāha-- gāvedhuke carau dṛṣṭā govikartākṣavāpayoḥ | paśū rudra iva hyetāvityekavacanaśrutiḥ || 591 ||
`rudra ivaitau govikartākṣavāpau paśū abhimanyete' iti vede śrūyate | tathāhi--gavedhunā tṛṇajātiviśeṣeṇa saṃskṛte carau prakṛte govikartākṣavārayorviśasitroriyamupamā `rudra ivaitau viśasitārau govikartākṣavāpau'| gā vikṛntatīti govikartaḥ, akṣān vapatītyakṣavāpaḥ, tannāmānau paśūnāṃ viśasitārau | tau copameyāvekavacanāntena rudraśabdenopamānenātra dṛṣṭau | tathā caikavacanaśrutiriyaṃ rudra iti dṛṣṭāsminnāmnāya ityasmādapyāmāmnāyādupamānam `upāttaikasaṃkhyamevānekamapyupameyamupasaṃskaroti' iti niścīyate || 591 ||
yadi punarupameyabhedenopamānaṃ bhidyeta, tadā-- upamānasya bhedācca bahuṣu syādaño vidhiḥ | kaśyapā iti lopaḥ syāt tathā pratikṛtiṣvapi || 592 ||
"yañañośca"  iti bahuṣu lugucyate | tatra codyate-baidasya baidayorvā patyāni bahūni māṇavakā bidā ityatrāñ yo bahuṣvityarthe vyākhyāyamāne bahuṣu luṅna prāpnoti | año baidasya baidayorityekadvayorutpatteḥ | ata uktam-`mābhūdevam | añantaṃ yad bahuṣvityevaṃ bhaviṣyati' | tata uktam-`naivaṃ śakyam | ihāpi syāt | kāśyapapratikṛtayaḥ kāśyapā' iti | kaśyarasyāpatyaṃ kāśyapaḥ bidādyañ | kāśyapa iva pratikṛtayaḥ kāśyapā iti "ive pratikṛtau"  ityutpannasya kano devapathāditvāt "jīvakārthe cāpaṇye"  iti lupi kṛte pratikṛtibahutve'ñantasya vartamānatvādañantaṃ bahuṣviti luk syāt | tathā ca kaśyapā iti pratikṛtiṣu sādhuḥ syāt | na ceṣyate | kāśyapā ityeveṣyata iti añ yo bahuṣviti sthāpitam | baidasyāpatyāni bidā ityatra tu `ekavacanadvivacanāntasya pravṛttau bahuṣu lopo yūnī' tyuktatvād adoṣaḥ | yadi cātropameyabhedādupamānabhedaḥ, tadā pratikṛtīnāmupameyānāṃ bahutvādupamānaṃ kāśyapo'pi bhinna iti bahuṣvevāyamañ syāt | tathā ca añyo bahuṣu ityevamapyatra luk prasajyeteti bhāṣyavirodhaḥ | kāśyapā iti pratikṛtiṣu cāniṣṭaprayogaprasaṅgaḥ | tasmādupameyabhede'pi nopamānaṃ bhidyate || 592 ||
nanvevaṃ kāśyapa iva pratikṛtaya iti vihitasya pratyayasya lupi yuktavadbhāvādekavacanameva syādityāha-- evaṃ tu yuktavadbhāvādatraikavacanaṃ bhavet | lummanuṣye tathoktaṃ syālliṅgasyaikasya siddhaye || 593 ||
evamityupameyabheje'pyajahadekasaṃkhyākasyopamānasya pravṛttau pratikṛtibahutve'pyekavacanamatideśādaniṣṭamāpadyeta | atra parihāramutprekṣitamāha-- `liṅgasiddhyarthaṃ lummanuṣye' iti vārttike liṅgagrahaṇāt kevalād vacanamatra prakaraṇe'tideśānna bhavatītyavasīyate | anyathā liṅgavacanasiddhyarthamityeva vacanaṃ bhavati| cañceva manuṣyaḥ, manuṣyau cañce, manuṣyāścañcā iti manuṣyasaṃkhyaiva | liṅgaṃ tu cañcāśrayam | evaṃ kāśyapā ityatrāpi pulliṅgamatideśād, vacanaṃ tu pratikṛtigatameva || 593 ||
nanu cāviśeṣeṇa "lupi yuktavad vyaktivacane"  ityukte kathaṃ vārttike liṅgamātrapāṭhādatra vacanamapākriyate ? atideśaprāptamapi cāmanuṣyalupyeva vārttikaprāmāṇyādastu | tatrāpi harītakyādiṣu vyaktiḥ"  iti vacanāt siddhiriti kāśyapā ityatra kathaṃ vacanaṃ yuktavadbhāvānna syādityāśaṅkya parihārāntaraṃ vaktumāha-- upameyeṣu bhinneṣu kiñcidekaṃ pravartate | pratyayasya vidhau tatra nityaṃ yuktavadiṣyate || 594 ||
nānābhūteṣu paricchedyeṣu pratikṛtirūpeṣvabhinnaṃ vā kana utpattinimittamupamānamatra vyāpriyate, pratyupameyaṃ vā bhinnamiti dvau pakṣau staḥ | tatrābhinnasya vyāpāre pratikṛtibahutve"lupi yuktavad"  iti yaktavadbhāvo niyata eva pravartate | tathā ceṣyata eveti na kācidaniṣṭāpattiḥ || 594 ||
yadā punarupamānaṃ bhedenopameyaṃ prati vartate, tadā kāśyapā iti siddhirityāha-- yadā pratyupameyaṃ tu tadekaikamavasthitam | tadā bāhyārthabhedena taddhitāntaṃ pracīyate || 595 ||
upameyabhede pratyekamupamānaṃ yadā paricchedāya pravartate, tadā prāthamakalpike'rthe bhedo nāsti | tathā ca kāśyapasya pratikṛtiḥ kāśyapaḥ | evaṃ dvitīyo'pi kāśyapaḥ, tṛtīyo'pi kāśyapa iti pratyekamabhisaṃbandhānnānātvamatra nāsti| kevalametat taddhitāntaṃ liptapratikṛtipratyayaṃ śabdarūpaṃ pracīyate pracayamanekatvamāpadyate | tathāhi--sārūpāṇāmekaśeṣavaśena kāśyapaśca kāśyapaśca kāśyapaśca kāśyapā iti bahutvena saṃbadhyate | na cedānīmatideśaśāstrasya "lupi yuktavad"  ityasya vyāpāro'sti, vṛttatvāt tadvyāpārasya | yadā tu kāśyapa ivāyaṃ pratikṛtisamūha iti prathamameva pratyayastadāsya vyāpāraḥ | tadā hi yuktasya saṃkhyābhedo'sti tannibandhanam | idānīṃ tu pratikṛtīnāṃ pracaya ityanyo'yaṃ bāhyārthabhedanibandhanaḥ saṃkhyābhedo na vartate || 595 ||
nanu caivamapi lubartha evāyaṃ pracīyamāna iti yuktavadbhāvaḥ kasmānna bhavatītyāśaṅkya nidarśanadvāreṇa vyutpādayati-- yathā samūhapracaye dvigūnāṃ bhinnasaṃkhyatā | pañcapūlyādiṣu tathā subantapracaye bhavet || 596 ||
pañcapūlāḥ samāhṛtāḥ pañcapūlīti "dvigurekavacanam"  iti kṛte ekavadbhāve, pañcapūlī ca pañcapūlī ca pañcapūlī cetyekaśeṣe pañcapūlya iti bahutve punarekavadbhāvaḥ kasmānna bhavatīti codye `na kintvanyasyaikaśeṣaśabdasyedaṃ bahutvam, vānyasyānekatvāt' ityuttaramuktam | ayaṃ hi nadviguranekārthābhidhāyī, kintvanyasyaikaśeṣaśabdasyedaṃ bahutvam | dvigvarthasya hyekavadbhāva ārabdhaḥ | akṛte caikaśeṣe'rthāntarānapekṣasya dvigoreva yo'rthastatraikavadbhāvaḥ | sa eva hi dvigvartho nyāyaḥ | kṛte tvekaśeṣe dvigvarthasamudāyasya pracitasya dvigvarthādanyatvādantaraṅge prāthamakalpike dvigvarthe caritārthatvādekavadbhāvasya punaraprāptiḥ | evamiha lupaḥ so'rthaḥ, yo lubantādeva pratīyate'nyānapekṣādityekaśeṣe kṛte śabdāntaratvādantaraṅge caritārtho yuktavadbhāvo bahuraṅge'tra pracayabahutve na pravartate || 596 ||
tadatra dṛṣṭānto'yamasadṛśa ityāha-- pracaye bhidyamāne tu saṃkhyā pūleṣu bhidyate | arthabhedo lubanteṣu naiva kaścana dṛśyate || 597 ||
pañca pūlāḥ samāhṛtāḥ pañcapūlīti yo'rtho dvigoravadhāryate, nāsāveva pañcapūlya iti pracayavivakṣāyāmekaśeṣe kṛte | pūrvatra hi pañcasaṃkhyāvacchinno'rthaḥ | ekaśeṣe tu pañcadaśasaṃkhyāvacchinnaḥ | dvayorekaśeṣe tu pañcapūlyāviti daśasaṃkhyāvacchinnaḥ | tasmād dvitvabahutvādīnāṃ pracaye bhidyamāne dvigvarthasaṃkhyāyā anyaiva saṃkhyā jāyate | tathā ca nāyaṃ dvigvartha iti śakyate vaktum | pañcasaṃkhyāvacchinnasamāhriyamāṇārthavācakatvādeva dvigoriti yukto'tra `na vānyasyānekatvāt' itiparihāraḥ | iha tu lubantaviṣaye na kaścanārthasya bhedaḥ | ya eva hyarthaḥ pratyekamupamānasaṃbandhe pracayavivakṣāyāmekaśeṣe kṛte, sa evaikasyāpyupamānasya bahuṣūpameyeṣu saṃbandhe prathamata eva bahuvacanasya pravṛttau | tathā cārthabhedābhāvādatra pracayārtho'pi lubarthaḥ śakyate vaktumiti tatra vacanātideśaḥ syādeva | nanu cāstyevātrārthabhedaḥ | tathāhi--pratyekaṃ pratikṛtīnāmupamānasaṃbandhe satyekaśeṣeṇa bahuvacanāntaprayoge pratikṛterekaikasyāḥ kāśyapa upamānatvena pratīyate | abhinnasya tūpamānasya bahuṣūpameyeṣu viśeṣe'pyasti bhedaḥ | satyametāvānasti | viśeṣaḥ | kintu lubantasyārthānapagamāllupā saṃbandhitvena pracayo'pyartho'vacchedamarhatyeva | tathā hi ya eva lubantavācyaḥ pratikṛtirūpo'rthaḥ sa eva pracaye bahutvamāpadyate, nānyaḥ | kiñca kāśyapa iva kāśyapa ityatra prayojanābhāvādatideśo na pravartate, dvayorapi prakṛtipratyayārthayorekārthatvāt | tathā ca pracayavivakṣāyāmeva yuktavadbhānena kṛtyam | kāśyapa iva pratikṛtya ityatrāpi hi pratikṛtīnāmupameyānāmekaśeṣādeva bahutvamavadhāryata iti bahiraṅga evārthe saṃbhavati yuktavadbhāvaḥ pravartetaiva | tasmāt prakārāntareṇātra kāśyapā ityasya siddhirvaktavyā | na tvekaśeṣeṇāpyatra siddhiḥ || 597 ||
tat prakārāntaramāha-- yeṣūpameyavacanaḥ śabdo'nyo na prayujyate | upamānasya tatrānyaiḥ saṃkhyāyā bheda iṣyate || 598 ||
yeṣu lubanteṣu upameyavacanaḥ paricchedyabhūtapratikṛtyarthaḥ śabdo lubantādanyo noccāryate, tatropamānasya kāśyapasya saṃkhyābheda iṣyate, bhinnamatropamānaṃ pravartata ityarthaḥ | tathā hyupameyavacanasya śabdasyopādāne tata eva bahutvāvagaterupamānamabhinnamevepameyopakārāya prabhavati | tadyathā kāśyapa iva devadattayajñadattaviṣṇumitrā imāḥ pratikṛtaya ityādau | yadā tūpameyavācī śabdo na prayujyate, tadā kāśyapa ityukte sandehaḥ, kimekasyāḥ pratikṛteridamupamānamutānekasyā iti | anekasyā hyupamāne yuktavadbhāvena kāśyapaśabdasyaikavacanāntasyopapatteḥ | tasmādatropameyabhedaparicchedāyopakrama eva kāśyapa ātmabhedamupamānabhūtaḥ pratipadyata iti kāśyapāḥ pratikṛtaya iti siddham | anyairiti cātra vacanaṃ matāntarasya vakṣyamāṇatvāt || 598 ||
atraivārthe nidarśanamāha-- yathā guḍatilādīnāṃ prayogādekasaṃkhyatā | pākāderaprayoge tu bhinnasaṃkhyābhidhīyate || 599 guḍatilataṇaḍulānāṃ pākaḥ tāmraḥ palāśeṣu babhūva rāga ityādau pākyādibahutvādevāvadhṛtanānātvaḥ pākādirekatvenaiva nirdiśyate | yadā tu pākyabhedāvadhāraṇanimittaḥ svāśrayabhedāvadhāraṇanimittaśca śabdāntaraprayogo nāsti, tadā pāko rāga ityukte sandehaḥ, kimekapākyadravyagato'yaṃ pāko'thānekādhāra iti niściyapratipattyarthaṃ pākau pākāḥ, rāgau rāgā ityanekasaṃkhyāyukta evārthaḥ pratinirdiśyate || 599 ||
evamihāpīti dārṣṭāntike yojayitumāha-- yaḥ saṃbandhigato bhedaḥ sa prayoge pratīyate | saṃbandhināmato bheda upameye na gamyate || 600 ||
yaḥ svato na bhidyate, api tu saṃbandhibhedād bhedamavalambate, sa saṃbandhivacanasya prayoge bhedapratītimāsādayati padārthaḥ | tadyathā--guḍādīnāṃ prayoge pākādiḥ | aprayoge tu saṃbandhivacanasya yathā pākāderviśeṣo nāvadhāryate, tathā pratikṛtivacanasyāprayoge tad‌vato bhedo viśeṣa upameye paricchedye nāvadhāryata iti tadarthamupāttabhedamevopamānaṃ pravartate | tathā ca bhinnenopamānenopameyasya bheda āvedyata ityarthaḥ || 600 ||
etadeva nigamayati-- tasmāt sāmānyaśabdatvaprasaṅgavinivṛttaye | upameyagato bheda upamāneṣu dṛśyate || 601 ||
kāśyapa ityukte'patyaṃ gotraṃ pratīyate, na niyamena pratikṛtiḥ | satyāmapi vopamānasaṃbandhapratipattāvekānekasādhāraṇasyopameyasyāvagamāt sāmānyaśabdatvamucyate | tataśca tannivāraṇāyopameyāśrayabhedapratipattyarthaṃ pradhānānuyāyitvād guṇānāmupamānamavalambate bhedam || 601 ||
upakrama eva yadā tarhyupameyavacanasya prayogastadā gatārthatvād bahutvasyāprayoga ityāśaṅkyānyairiti vacanānmatāntaraṃ yadatra sūcitam, tadupakramate vaktum-- upamānaṃ samastānāmabhinnaṃ śrūyate kvacit | bhinnānāmupameyānāmekaikaṃ vopamīyate || 602 ||
iha kadācit samuditānāmekamupamānamupameyānām, kadācit tu nānābhūtānāṃ pratyekamupamānapravṛttiriti dvaitam || 602 ||
pūrvatra pakṣe nidarśanamāha-- yathā garuḍa ityetad vyūhāpekṣaṃ prayujyate | ekena yatra sādṛśyaṃ vainateyena hastinām || 603 ||
gajānāṃ sanniveśaviśeṣo garuḍenopamīyate, garuḍa iveme hastina iti | evamaśvānāṃ racanāviśeṣo makareṇa, makara iveme vājina iti | tathā śyena ivemā iṣṭakā iti| evañcāyaṃ garuḍavyūhādisaṃniveśaviśeṣo racanābhedaḥ sainikādeḥ parikalpitaḥ śakyate vainateyādinopamātum, yadyekatvatanānta eva garuḍaśabdaḥ prayujyate | tathā hi--garuḍākṛtayo gajā gamyanta iti saṃsthānaviśeṣo garuḍena paricchinnā bhavatīti sambandhibhedādatra bhedo na bhavati | na hi garuḍasyorameyā gajāḥ sambandhinaḥ, api tu tadvyūhaḥ | yadā tu garuḍā iveme hastinaḥ, makarā iveme vājina iti bahuvacanaprayogaḥ, tadā pratyekaṃ hastināmaśvānāṃ copameyatvaṃ pratīyate | tathā ca śīghrajavatvādinā sādṛśyenopamānatvamavagamyeta, na tu vyūhaḥ parimeyo'vadhāryeta || 603 ||
evamihāpi-- ekasyāpi pratīyate bhinnā pratikṛtiḥ saha | kāśyapasyeti tenāyaṃ pratyekamavatiṣṭhate || 604 ||
yadi kāśyapa ivemāḥ pratikṛtayaḥ kāśyapa ityekavacanāntamupamānaṃ prayujyate, tadā garuḍasyeva hastino vyūhena tulyāḥ, kāśyapasya nānābhūtā pratikṛtiḥ kenacit sanniveśādinā dharmeṇa saha tulyā vijñāyate | na tu pratyekamupamānaṃ gamyeta | sahaśabdastulyārthaḥ | tadyoge kāśyapasyeti ṣaṣṭhī | tasmāt pratyekamupamānabhāvapratiprattyarthamatra kāśyapaśabdaḥ pratyupameyaṃ bhedenaivāvatiṣṭhate | pūrvatra darśane upameyaśabdasyāprayoge upameyabhedāvagamāyopamānaṃ pārārthyādātmabhedaṃ pratipadyata ityuktam | iha punaḥ satyupameyaśabdaprayoge bhedenopamānasya dṛṣṭatvāt pratyupameyamekaikamupamānamiti pratiparttthamupakrama eva bhedamupamānamupādatta iti darśanabhedaḥ || 604 ||
idānīmekena samuditānāmupamāne nidarśanāntaraṃ prasiddhataramāha-- meghāḥ śaila ivetyukte samastānāṃ pratīyate | sādṛśyaṃ giriṇaikena pratyekaṃ tena bhidyate || 605 ||
śaila ivāmī balāhakā mahāparimāṇā, nānāvidharāgavicchuritānekasaṃsthānaśikharatvāditi parvatenaikena balāhakānāmupamīyamānatve samuditānāṃ giritulyatvamavadhāryate, na tu pratyekam | na hyekaiko meghaḥ parvatasadṛśo'neravarṇavicchuritānekasaṃsthānaśikharatvādiparvatasādhāraṇadharmābhāvādekaikasya | samuditānāmeva hi tathābhāvaḥ | yata evamekavacanāntamupamānasyāto'navadhāraṇāt pratyekamupamānasambandhapratītyarthamidaṃ kāśyapalakṣaṇamupamānamupakrama evātmabhedaṃ pratipadyata ityarthaḥ | tadevaṃ vivakṣitārthapratītyarthaṃ kāśyapā iti bahuvacanaprayogo'vasthāpitaḥ | nanvevamupakrama eva bhedapratipatteraño bahuṣūtpattiḥ syādityaño bahuṣvityevaṃ lugatra prāpnoti | naiṣa doṣaḥ | añekatva eva hyartha utpadyate | tathā ca yuktavadbhāvādekavacanaṃ prāptamityekaśeṣeṇa bahuvacanaṃ samarthitam | tatrāpi ca yuktavadbhāvasyāprāptimāśaṅkyopameyabhedapratipattyarthaṃ bahuvacanamidaṃ samarthitam | tathā ca vivakṣitārthapratipādanānurodhād yuktavadbhāvāyātaṃ vacanamatra bādhyate | etamava ca nyāyaṃ garbhīkṛtya `harītakyādiṣu vyaktiḥ' ityuktamitīdamapi tatraiva draṣṭavyam | añantaṃ yad bahuṣvityapi cāśrīyamāṇe'tra lugaprasaṅgo bhāṣye'bhihitaḥ | tathā hi-"yañañośca"  ityatra "yaskādibhyo gotre"  ityato gotragrahaṇānuvṛtterlaukikasya cāpatyalakṣaṇasya tatra gotrasya grahaṇādañantaṃ yad bahuṣu gotramityāśrayaṇāt pratikṛtibahutvasya gotrabahutvābhāvālluhaviṣayo'yam | itthaṃ ca kṛtvā baidasya baidayorvā apatyāni bahūni bidā ityatrāpyañantasya gotrabahutve vartamānatvādanenaiva luk siddha iti ekavacanadvivacanāntasya ca (ekavacanāntāñantasya dvivacanāntāñantasya ca) pravṛttau yūnītyetadanārabdhavyamiti bhāṣye siddhānto'vasthāpitaḥ | laukikasya hi gotrasya "yañośca"  ityatra grahaṇād yuvāpi gotramiti | gatametat || 605 ||
idānīmupamānaprasaṅgena "samāsācca tadviṣayāt"  ityayamivārthaviṣayaśchavidhivicāryate | tatra `tadityanena kiṃ pratinirdīśyate' iti bhāṣyam | sarvanāmnā pradhānaparāmarśaḥ samucitaḥ | samāsaścātrāpradhānam, pratyayaprakṛtitvena guṇabhāvād ivārtho'pi chavidhau guṇabhāvādapradhānam ityanyasyāsambhavāt kasya parāmarśa iti praśnaḥ | atrotraṃ chapratyaya iti | sa eva hi vidheyatvāt pradhānaṃ sarvanāmasambandhayogya ityāśayaḥ | anantaramuktam-`kathaṃ samāso nāma chaviṣayaḥ syāt' iti | bhavet prādhānyācchapratyayasya parāmarśaḥ, kintvarthasyāsaṅgatiḥ | tathā hi--chapratyayo viṣaye yasya tasmāt samāsācchapratyayo bhavatītyarthaḥ sampadyate | samāsasya kathaṃ chapratyayo viṣayaḥ syāt | na hi śabdaḥ śabdasya viṣayo bhavati| artha eva hi śabdasyābhidheyo viṣayo nyāyyaḥ | śabdastvanukaraṇasya pratyāyyo bhaved viṣayaḥ | na ca samāsasyānukaraṇam, cha eva hi tathā syāt | athātrāyamāśayaḥ--ananyatrabhāvo viṣayārtha iti chapratyayādanyatra yasya samāsasyābhāvaḥ, sa chaviṣayaḥ samāsa iti | etadapyayuktamityāha-- chāpekṣā tadviṣayatā vidheyatvānna gamyate | kākatālīyamityatra prasiddhaṃ hyupalakṣaṇam || 606 ||
