yaḥ samāsaśchapratyayādanyatra na bhavati, tataścho bhavatītyevaṃ chapratyayāpekṣaṃ samāsasya tadviṣayatvaṃ na ghaṭate | kākatālīyamityatra vyutpādyate | yasmād yannirjñātam, tadanyasya jñaptiheturupapadyate | chapratyayoṣa?nenaivedamprathamatayā vidheya ityaprasiddhamamumupāśritya viśeṣaṇaṃ kathametadviṣayatayā prakṛtibhūtaḥ samāso'vacchettuṃ pāryata | yadi hi chupratyayo sakṣaṇāntareṇa labdhātmarūpo bhavet, tadā tatra niyatatvaṃ prakṛteḥ samāsasyāvadhārya pratyayavidhyarthamupādānaṃ yujyate | na tu lakṣaṇāntareṇa cho vihitaḥ | idameva hyutpattivākyamasya | tathā ca prāk chavidheḥ samāsasya chaviṣayatvamasiddhaṃ kathamūdyate | atha bhāvyavasthāśrayeṇa chaviṣayatvaṃ samarthyate, tadā kimanenoktena | yasmāt samāsāccho vidhāsyate, sa cecchaviṣayo bhavati, tasmācchapratyayo bhavatītyevamarthe vijñāyamāne na kaścit prakṛterupakāro'bhihito bhavati | chaprakṛteḥ samāsasya chaviṣayatvāvyabhicārādanyasya nivartanīyasya siddhasyābhāvāt || 606 ||
nanu ca bhāvyavasthāśrayeṇa viśeṣaṇasyāsti prayojanam | tathāhi--chaviṣayatvena samāsasya viśeṣaṇe viṣayārthasyānanyatrabhāvarūpatvācchapratyayādanyatrāprayogaḥ samāsasyāsya khyāpito bhavatītyāśaṅkyāha-- rājāśvādiśca viṣayaḥ syādanyo vetyaniścitam | tena chasya vidhānāt prāg vyapadeśo na vidyate || 607 ||
tadviṣayādityanena chaviṣayaḥ samāso'viśeṣaṇopādīyamānaḥ sarvo rājāśvādiprasiddho vidhāsyamānachaprakṛtitvādeva chaviṣayo'nyo vā prakārāntareṇa sambhāvyamānaśchaviṣayo gṛhyetetyetāvannāvadhāritam | yena prasiddhasya niścitacchaviṣayatvapraṇālikayā sādhutvaṃ jñāpyate samāsasya | prakārāntareṇa hi chaviṣayatvānupapatteśchapratyayaprakṛtitavādeva samāsasya tadviṣayatvam | itthañca sarvasyai samāsasya prakṛtitvopapattau kimanena viśeṣaṇena vyavacchidyeta | na ca sarvasya samāsasya chapratyayādanyatrāsādhutvameva jñāpyate, aniṣṭeḥ | na cāniṣṭārthā śāstraprakṛlṛptirnyāyyā | tadityasya tu parāmarśanīyamanyat kalpyatām | tasmācchavidheḥ pūrvaṃ niyatasya samāsasya prasiddhatadviṣayasyābhāvācchaviṣayāditi viśeṣaṇaṃ na yuktam | siddhe hi pratyaye kāryāntare tena viśeṣaṇaṃ prakṛtirūpasya dṛṣṭam | tadyathā--"ṣaṣṭhyatasarthapratyayena"  iti | na tu svayamalabdhātmalābhaḥ svanimittasyaiva viśeṣaṇaṃ yuktam | svajñānenānyadhīhetuḥ siddhe hyarthe jñāpako bhavati | tadevaṃ pradhānapratyavamarśāsambhave sarvanāmnā chavidhau nimittabhūtaḥ pratyayārtho guṇabhūto'pipratyavamṛśyate ivārthaḥ | so'pi hyatra prakṛtatvāt saṃnihita ityuktam "evaṃ tarhi ivārthaḥ pratinirdiśyate" iti | ivārthaścātra pratyayavācya iti kathaṃ prakṛtibhūtaḥ samāsastadviṣayaḥ syāditi sarvanāmapratyavamarśasāmarthyādivārthasyātra dvau vyāpārau sampadyete | tenaikena vyāpāreṇevārthaḥ samāsasyāvacchedako'pareṇa pratyayavācyo jāyate | ivārthaviṣayāt samāsādivārtheṃ cha ityarthaḥ | atraitamabhiprāya'yamabud‌dhvā coditam--`samāsenoktārthatvāt taddhito na prāpnoti' iti | ekasyaivārthasya vyāpārabhedābhāvāt samāsaviśeṣaṇatve samāsavācyatvācchapratyayo na syāt | na hyabhidhānamantareṇa samāsasya viṣayabhāvamupagantumarhatīvārtha ityarthaḥ | atha vacanādabhihite'pīvārthe pratyayaḥ, yathā taddhitārthe dviguriti vacanād dvigutaddhitayoḥ sādhāraṇo'rthaḥ, tadā śastrīśyāmāderapi samāsādivārthābhidhāyakācchapratyayaḥ syāt | atra parihāro'bhihito `dvāvivārthāvi'ti | sarvanāmapratyavamarśānyathānupapattyā vyāpārabheda ivārthasyetyabhiprāyaḥ pūrvameva nirṇītaḥ || 607 ||
kau dvāvatrevārthāvityāha-- dvayorivārthayoratra nimittatvaṃ pratīyate | ekenāvayavo yuktaḥ pratyayo'nyena yujyate || 608 ||
`kākatālīyam, ajākṛpāṇīyam' ityatra dvāvivārthau gamyete | tayorekena samāsaikadeśaḥ pūrvapadamuttarapadaṃ ca sambaddhamiti tamivārthaṃ pratyāyayan samāso bhavatīvārthaviṣayaḥ | taddhitāntaśabdāpekṣayā vā prakṛtibhūtaḥ samāsa evātrāvayavaḥ | so'pi ca svāvayadvāreṇevārthena yujyate, na tu sākṣād | apareṇevārthena vācyena chapratyayaḥ sambadhyate | śastrīśyāmetyatra punaḥ prasiddhaśyāmaguṇayā yathā śastryā devadattā upamīyate, tathānyāpīti devadattākhyenopameyenopamānasyāpyojanatvād eka ivārthaḥ || 608 ||
tatra yenevārthenāvayavo yujyate, tamāha-- caitrasya tatrāgamanaṃ kākasyāgamanaṃ yathā | dasyorabhinipātastu tālasya patanaṃ yathā || 609 ||
kākatālīyamityatra kākasyāgamanamupamānam, caitrāgamanamupameyam | tathā tālapatanamupamānam, dasyusamāgamaḥ punarupameyaḥ | atarkitopanatvamubhayatrāpi samāno dharmaḥ | tadayaṃ samāsavācya ityarthaḥ | pratyayavācyamapyāha-- saṃnipāte tayoryānyā kriyā tatropajāyate | vadhādirupameye'rthe tayā chavidhiriṣyate || 610 ||
kākatālayoḥ samāgame sati yā aparā tatsamāgamanimittā vadho'ṅgabhaṅgaḥ sphoṭa ityādika kriyā jāyate, tayā ya upameyaḥ paricchedyaścaitravadhādilakṣaṇo'rthastatropamānopameyasambaddhe dvitīye ivārthe vācye sūtreṇa chupratyayo vidhīyate || 610 ||
nanu ca kākagamanena caitrāgamanaṃ bāhyamupamīyata iti tat prati tasya guṇabhāvaḥ | tālapatanena ca dasyusamāgama upamīyata iti tatra guṇabhāvavaḥ | tataśca kākatālayoranyonyasambandhābhāvādasati sāmarthye samāsaḥ katham ? anenaiva chavidhinā jñāpakenātra samāso bhāṣye'vasthāpita iti ceta, tathāpi `sup supā' ityasyaiva vyāpāro bhāṣye gamita iti kathamasāmarthye tatpravṛttiḥ | bhavatu vā samāsaḥ | kintvasamanvitābhyāmavayavārthābhyāṃ samudāyārthasyānupajanāt kena prakṛtyarthena pratyayārtho viśeṣyetetyāśaṅkyāha-- kriyāyāṃ samavetāyāṃ dravyaśabdo'vatiṣṭhate | pātāgamanayoḥ kākatālaśabdau tathā sthitau || 611 ||
dadhyodano guḍadhānā ityādau yathā dravyāṇāṃ siddhasvabhāvānāṃ parasparasambandhābhāvāt tadanyathānupapattyopasekādikriyāyāmātmāśritāyāṃ dravyaśabdo dadhyādirvartate, tathātra kākatālaśabdau samavete vyāpāre vartete | tataśca kākāgamanaṃ kākaśabdavācyam, tālapatanaṃ tālaśabdavācyamityasti parasparamasambandhaḥ | pratipāditā ca brāhmaṇavadadhīta ityādau brāhmaṇāderanyatra dravyaśabdasyāpi kriyāyāṃ vṛttiviṣaye vṛttiḥ | tataścāyamatrārthaḥ-kākāgamanamivātarkitopasamprāptamidaṃ tālapatanamiva cātarkitopasamprāptamidaṃ kākāgamanamiti parasparopamānena pūrvottarapadārthayoḥ samanvayopapattau pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇatopapattiḥ | kākāgamanatālapatanayorhi samanvayopapattau tābhyāṃ devadattāgamanadasyūpanipātayorupameyatvāt tatrevārthe vācye samāsasyopapattau tadvadhād devadattavadhe upameye chapratyayapravṛttiḥ || 611 ||
nanu copakrama evāśaṅkitopanatena tālakṛtena kākavadhādinā devadattavadhādirdasyukṛtaḥ kimiti nopamīyate | tathāhi--kākagamanatālapatanayorgauṇyā vṛttyā kākatālaśabdayoratra vṛttiḥ parikalpayituṃ nopayujyata iti kiṃ kākagamanatālapatanayoratrānyonyopamānenetyata āha-- yadanvākhyāyakaṃ vākyaṃ tadevaṃ parikalpyate | prayogavākyaṃ yalloke tadevaṃ na prayujyate || 612 ||
iha prakṛtipratyayavibhāgavaśenānvākhyānamiti prakriyāvākyamanena prakāreṇa samanvitārthapadaṃ sampādyate | kākagamanamiva tālapatanam, tālapatanamiva kākāgamanamityanyonyopamānena hi prakriyāyām anvākhyānopāyabhūtamidaṃ vākyam, na tvetalloke prayujyate | anyathā vadhenaiva tālakartṛkeṇa kākaḥ sambadhyeta, na tālena, yadi nedamuparacyeta prakriyāvākyam | sthitalakṣaṇārthapratyāyakaṃ tu prayogavākyaṃ laukikaṃ naivambhūtam | na hi chapratyayamantareṇa kākatālaśabdo vākyasvabhāvo loke prayujyate | kevalaṃ kākatālīyamityasya laukikasya śabdasyānvākhyānopāyaparikalpanepāyaparikalpaneyam | yathāsamanvayaṃ hi parikalpanamityanuguṇataro'yamupāyaḥ || 612 ||
tadāha-- yayoratarkitā prāptirdṛśyate kākatālavat | tayoḥ samāsaprakṛtervṛttirabhyupagamyate || 613 ||
yathā kākatālayoranāśaṅkitopasthitayorvadhādinimittaḥ sambandhaḥ, tathā yayordasyudevadattayordṛśyate, tayoḥ sambandhopādhikayostatsamāgama ivavācye samāsalakṣaṇā yā prakṛtistasyāḥ sakāśācchasya pratyayasya vṛttiḥ pratijñāyate | tadevaṃ kākatāladvayasambandhopādhiḥ prakṛtyartho vibhajyate | upameye tu vadhādau chapratyayaḥ, tadviṣayaiva ca niyameneyaṃ prakṛtirityanyatrāsyāḥ sādhutvābhāvaḥ | idameva ca vastubhāṣye vistareṇa pradarśitam || 613 ||
kasminnarthe vṛttirabhyupagamyata ityāha-- kākasya tālena yathā vadho yasya tu dasyunā | tatra citrīkṛte'nyasminnupameye cha iṣyate || 614 ||
kākatālasamāgamasamo dasyudevadattasamāgama ekaḥ samāsārtha ivārthaḥ pūrvaṃ darśitaḥ | ayaṃ tvaparaḥ pratyayāvācyo'tra pradarśyate yadihānyasminniti | yathā yadṛcchayopari napatatā tālena yadṛcchāgatasya kākasya vadho vṛttaḥ, tathā'śaṅkitopanipatatā dasyunā asampradhāritopasthitasya devadattasya vadha ityevamadbhutarūpatāṃ prāpte paricchedye'rthe chapratyayaḥ | kākatālasamprāptinimittopajanitakriyāviśeṣopamite'nyasmin kriyāviśeṣe chavidhirityarthaḥ | tena yathā tālena kāko yadṛcchayā hataḥ, tathā yadaparasamīhitamāścaryabhūtaṃ jāyate, tat kākatālīyamucyata ityarthaḥ | gatametat || 614 ||
upamānaprasaṅgevārthaprastāvācchavidhivadanyadapyatra vicāryate | tathāhi--"sthūlādibhyaḥ prakāravacane kan"  ityatra sādṛśyaṃ prakārārthaḥ | tatra `cañcadbṛhatorupasaṃkhyānam' ityuktam | cañcatsadṛśaścañcatko bṛhatkaḥ | kasyaitadabhidhānamityāha-- cañcatprakāraścañcatko bṛhatka iti cāpare | maṇimaṇḍūkakhadyotān sādṛśyena pracakṣate || 615 ||
prakāro'tra sādṛśyamiti cañcatprakāro bṛhatprakāraścañcatko bṛhatka iti maṇiprabhṛtīnāmanyatamasyābhidhānamācāryā manyante | apara ityācāryāṇāmabhinnamatānāṃ nirdeśaḥ || 615 ||
kīdṛśamatra maṇyādisādṛśyamityāha-- tatronmeṣanimeṣābhyāṃ khadyota upamīyate | śvāsaprabandhairmaṇḍūkaḥ spandamānaprabhomaṇiḥ || 616 ||
acalannapi khadyotaḥ svaprabhācchuritaścalannivāvadhāryamāṇaścañcatkaśabdavācyaḥ | tathā hi--svaprabhonmīlananimīlanakriyābhedāt spandamāna iva lakṣyate | tathānavaratapravartamānocchvāsavaśocchūnaśarīratayā calitaśarīra ivāvadhāryamāṇo bhekaścañcatkābhidhānaviṣayabhāvamupaiti | evamavicchinnodgamadīpyamānaraśmicakravālacalitamūrtiriva maṇiścañcatkaḥ || 616 ||
bṛhatke kaḥ prakārārtha ityāha-- pravikāsiprabho'lpo'pi mahān ya upalabhyate | bṛhatka iti tatraiva maṇau śabdaḥ prayujyate || 617 ||
parikṛśo'pi maṇiḥ sarvataḥ prasarpiprabhājālavaśena sthūlataramūrtiravadhāryamāṇo bṛhatsadṛśo bṛhatka ityabhidhīyate || 617 ||
prasaṅgena prakārasvarūpaṃ darśanabhedena vicārayati-- sādṛśyameva sarvatra prakāraḥ kaiścidiṣyate | bhede'pi tu prakārākhyā kaiścidabhyupagamyate || 618 ||
"prakāravacane thāl"  "prakāre guṇavacanasya"  "sthūlādibhyaḥ prakāravacane kan"  ityādau sarvatra śāstre sādṛśyameva prakāraśabdārthaḥ | tathāhi--yathā tatheti tulyatvameva dyotyate | paṭujātīya iti tu jātīyarā sadṛśaḥ prādhānyenābhidhīyate | paṭupaṭuriti dvirvacanena sādṛśyameva tadvati guṇabhūtaṃ dyotyate | evaṃ sthūlaprakāraḥ sthūlaka iti | kaiścit tu bhede'pi prakārākhyeṣyate | atrāpi sarvatreti yathā tatheti bheda eva vācyaḥ | sa eva samānaḥ sādṛśyaheturiti tadapyarthād gamyate | evaṃ paṭupaṭuḥ sthūlaka ityatrāpi | itthañca bhedasādṛśyayoḥ sarvatra pratītāveko'bhidhayo'paraḥ sāmarthyagamya iti matabhedena prakāro vibhajyate | paśuprakāro devadatta ityatra sāmānyaviśeṣabhāvāyogāt sāmānyameva prakāraḥ | tadgarbhādapi paśurdevadatta ityabhedābhidhānāt kāryāt taddhetusādṛśyameva gamyate, na tu prayogadvaye'pyatra bhedo'vasīyate | brāhmaṇaprakārā māṭharādaya iti tu sāmānyasya viśeṣe'nvayād bhedenāpratītau sādṛśyāsambhave bhedaḥ prakāra ityāhuḥ || 618 ||
astu sādṛśyaṃ bhedaḥ prakāro vā | idaṃ tu vicāryate--"kiṃ sarvanāmabahubhyaḥ prakāravacane vidhīyamānasthāl prātipadikasāmānyād vihitasya jātīyaro bādhakaḥ | tathā ca kiñjātīya iti na sidhyet | prakārasya ca thālaivābhivyaktau tathājātīya iti kathaṃ prayoga ityata āha-- prakāravacanaḥ kaścit prakāravati saṃsthitaḥ | prakāramātre vartitvā kaścid tad vyativartate || 619 ||
kaściditi jātīyar kaṃśca pratyayo dvirvacanaṃ ca | atra hi pratyaye svabhāvād guṇabhūtasya prakārasyābhidhānamiti prakāravāneva prādhānyenocyate | ata evaṃprakāra ucyate yasmin sa prakāravacanastasmin prātipadikādayaṃ pratyaya iti prakāravati bhavati | thāl punaḥ prakāramātra eva, na tadvati | kintu prakāre vṛttimanubhūya tadvati jātīyar‌sahito vartata iti sāmarthyādavaseyam, na tu śukladivat tadvati vṛttisthālantasyeha dṛśyate | evañca bhinnaviṣayatvād bādhyabādhakabhāvaśca na bhavati | tathājātīya iti ca prayogo bhavati | yathā devadattastathā yajñadatta ityatrāpi na thālanta eva prakāravantamabhidhatte, api tu kriyāyāṃ vākyasyāsya parisamāptervartate dṛśyate vetyādikā yāsāvapekṣitā kriyā, tatra karaṇabhāvamāpannaḥ prakāra eva pratīyate | yena prakāreṇa devadatto vartate, tena prakāreṇa yajñadatto'pītyarthaḥ | ataśca kriyāsaṃbadhyamānaḥ karaṇatayātra prakāraḥ prakāravati ṣaṣṭhīnimittaṃ vyatirekaṃ nāpādayati | na tu tadvadabhidhānaṃ ṣaṣṭhyabhāvādanumameyam, anyathāsiddheḥ ṣaṣṭhyabhāvasya || 619 ||
yadi tarhi thālaḥ sādṛśyaṃ prakārārthastadā yathārthe'vyayībhāvamuk‌tvā kimarthaṃ punaḥ sādṛśye'nvākhyāyata ityāha-- sādṛśyagrahaṇaṃ sūtre sadṛśasyopalakṣaṇam | tulyayoravyayībhāve sahaśabdo'bhidhāyakaḥ || 620 ||
vīpsāsādṛśyayorvṛttiryā yathārthābhidhāyinaḥ | sa cāyamavyayībhāve bhedo bhedena darśitaḥ || 621 ||
"avyayaṃ vibhakti"  ityādau sūtre sādṛśyagrahaṇena dharmī sadṛśo lakṣyate | dharmo hyavyabhicārāt svāśrayamupalakṣayituṃ paryāpta eva | tathā ca sadṛśaḥ sakhyā sasakhīti sadṛśayoravyayībhāve sahaśabdo vācako na sādṛśyamātrasyeti sāmarthyādatra sūtre dharmiṇo dharmaḥ sadṛśasyopalakṣaṇam | vṛttikārairhi pūrvairudāharaṇamidamatroktamiti tadāśrayeṇa sahaśabdo'bhidhāyako vācakaḥ sadṛśākhyasya dharmiṇa ucyate | evañca yadavyayamabhidhāyakaṃ sadṛśārthasya, tasya sādṛśyagrahaṇena samāsaḥ kathyate | sattvabhūtārthābhidhāyitve'pi cāsya vacanād "avyayībhāvaśca"  ityasmādavyayatavam, yathā svarādīnām | yat punaravyayaṃ yathārthābhidhāyi samāsabhāk‌tvena nirdiṣṭam, tasya vīpsāyāṃ sādṛśye ca vṛttirdharmamātre na dharmiṇi | pratyartham, anurūpamiti | "yathā'sādṛśye"  iti pratiṣedhād yathāśabdaḥ sādṛśyavacano na samasyate | thālantapratirūpako vā yathāśabdo vīpsāvacano nipātaḥ samasyata eva | vīpsā ca yathārtho bhedaḥ | tathā hi pratyarthamityatrārthasāmānyasya kriyāyā vyāpyamānatāviśeṣaḥ pratinā prakāśyata iti sākalyena padārthānāṃ kriyayā samanvayo vīpsāmānyasya bhedako viśeṣaḥ prakāro bhavati yathārthaḥ | tadevaṃ yathārthe sādṛśyamātre'vyayībhāvaḥ syāditi tadvati sādṛśyagrahaṇena punarvidhīyata ityayaṃ viśeṣaḥ pṛthak praṇayanādeva dharmadharmiṇoratrābhimataḥ || 620 ||
621 ||
prakārāntaramatraivāha-- sādṛśyaṃ yogyatā kaiścidanāvabhyupagamyate | yat tu mūrtigataṃ sāmyaṃ tat sahenābhidhīyate || 622 ||
anāvanuśabdaviṣaye yā yogyatā tenānuśabdena dyotyā, tadeva sādṛśyaṃ yathārthaṃ iti samāsastatra | anurūpaṃ surūpo vahatīti | rūpeṇa tulyo hārakaṭakādinā veṣo'nyo vā kaścicchobhātiśayahetutvāt taṃ surūpo dhārayatītyarthaḥ | itthañca kṛtvātra guṇasya rūpasya sādṛśye yathārthe'vyayībhāvaḥ | yogyatālakṣaṇo hi yathārthaḥ sādṛśyamātraguṇaviṣayaḥ | yattu mūrtigataṃ vastuniṣṭhamavayavasaṃniveśādinā sādṛśyaṃ dravyaviṣayam, tat sasakhītyatra sahaśabdenākhyāyate | tathāhi sādṛśyaṃ sakhyā sasakhi, na tu sadṛśa iti | evaṃ dravyagatatvena bhinnaṃ sādṛśyaṃ sūtre sādṛśyaśabdenopādīyate, yathāśabdena tu yogyatākhyaṃ guṇagatatvenetati bhinnaṃviṣayataiva samāsayoḥ | yadā tu yogyatā vīpsā sādṛśyaṃ ca yathārtha iti bhedena nirdeśādanurūpaṃ surūpo vahatītyatra sādṛśyādanyaiva yogyatāśabdārtho yadyogyaṃ rūpasya śobhākāritvena yaducitaṃ tadanurūpamiti, tadā pūrva eva dharmadharmibhedaḥ pṛthagupādāne heturvācyaḥ || 622 ||
sādṛśyameva sarvatra prakāra iti yaduktam, tadavyāpakam | tathā hītthaṃbhāve kamaṇḍalunā cchātamityatra manuṣyatāsāmānyasya chātrādirviśeṣa iti bhedo'tra prakāro na sādṛśyam, aparasya bhedavato'napekṣaṇādityetat samarthayitumāha-- itthaṃbhāve'pi sādṛśyaṃ bud‌dhyavasthānibandhanam | grahaṇe bhedamātrasya tatrānyaivābhidhīyate || 623 ||
aṅgadī kuṇḍalītyādinā pūrvamīdṛśo devadatta iti buddhiprakalpitasārūpyopādānādatrāpītthaṃbhāve grahaṇe pratyaye bhedamātrā kathyate | bāhyavastuna uparāgād bhedaleśo na tattvato bhedaḥ | tataśca jñānānukāro bahirarthasya vyavasthāpakatvāt prakāra iti sādṛśyamapyatra prakāra upapadyate | evaṃ pañcadhā bhuṅkte, tredhādhīte ityādāvapi "saṃkhyāyā vidhārthe dhā"  iti grahaṇanirbhāsasya bāhyānukāritvena sādṛśyaṃ prakārārtha upapādyaḥ | saṅkalpitabhedasadṛśasya kriyāviśeṣasya hi nirvartanamatra || 623 ||
tadetadāgamopabṛṃhitaṃ śobhata ityāgamarucirupāsitavṛddhatāmupadarśayan sarvatra prakārārthaḥ sādṛśyamityatra bhāṣyakāramataṃ saṃvādakamāha-- gaurvāhīka iti dvitve sādṛśyaṃ pratyudāhṛtam | śuklādau sati niṣpanne bāhīkona dvirucyate || 624 ||
iti | "prakāre guṇavacanasya"  ityatra dvirvacanavidhau guṇavacanagrahaṇasya pratyudāharaṇam--`agnirmāṇavakaḥ, gaurvāhīkaḥ' iti bhāṣye'bhihitam | yadi ca prakāraḥ sādṛśyam, tata etadupapadyate | gosādṛśyāddhi vāhīko gauḥ | agnisādṛśyācca māṇavako'gniḥ | na tu sāmānyasya gotvasyāgnitvasya cāyaṃ viśeṣo bhedaḥ | tadanena dvirvacanavidheranyatrāpi prakāraḥ sādṛśyamiti sūcitaṃ bhavati, dvirvacanābhāve'pi tasyaiva pradarśanāt | nanu ca gavādiśabdo guṇanimittābhedādhyavasāyādeva vāhīkādau prayukta iti kathaṃ ca guṇavacana ityāśaṅkyāha--śuklādau sati niṣpanne bāhīko na dvirucyata iti | parisamāptarūpaguṇavacane śuklādau prasiddhe sambhavati vāhīke vāhīkābhidhāyī gośabdo na dviṣprayujyata ityarthaḥ | itirgranthasamāptau, śuklādiśabdo hi guṇe tadvati samāropitaguṇasambandhe vartamāno guṇavacana eva | gośabdastu vāhīka eva tathā, na jātau | ata eva guṇamuktavān guṇavacana ityabhidhīyate | gośabdastu vāhīke vartamāno na guṇamuktavān, pūrvaṃ jātau pravṛtteḥ | itthañca kṛtvā `prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇatvāt siddham' ityuktam | dvirvacanakāraṇatvāt prakṛtirdvivacanasyātra sthānī kathyate | tadartho guṇavacanasyetyanena viśeṣyate, na tu prakārārthaḥ | tathā cāha--`prakāre sarveṣāṃ guṇavacanatvāt sarvaprasaṅgaḥ' iti | dravyavācināmapi gavādīnāṃ vāhīkādau guṇanimittasādṛśyavaśena pravṛtteḥ prakāre guṇavacanatvasyeveti kiṃ viśeṣaṇena vyāvartyeta | tasmād guṇavacanagrahaṇasāmarthyād guṇavacano yaḥ śabdo nirjñātastasya prakāre sādṛśye dyotye dvirvacanamiti nāstyatiprasaṅga iti guṇopasarjanadravyavācinaḥ śuklādereva dvirvacanaṃ guṇamātravācinaśceti `śuklaśuklaḥ paṭaḥ, śuklaśuklaṃ rūpam, paṭupaṭuḥ' itīṣṭaṃ siddham | tadevaṃ saṃsargāvasthaḥ padārtho vākyārthādapod‌dhṛtya padavibhāgapūrvakaṃ samīkṣita iti parisamāpto'rthadvārakaḥ padavicāra iti śubham || 624 |iti bhūtirājatanayahelārājakṛte prakīrṇakaprakāśe vṛttisamuddeśaścaturdaśaḥ|samāptaṃ cedaṃ padakāṇḍam |
